members.model_name: Cosmic-ray boosted sub-GeV gravitationally interacting dark matter with a spin-2 mediator
members.description: The momentum-dependent spin-2 (KK graviton) CR-DM scattering cross section and boosted-flux calculation exist only as a private modification of DarkSUSY; no public code computes dPhi_chi/dT_chi and its Earth attenuation for the G^{mu nu}T_{mu nu} coupling with its strong q^2 dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public DarkSUSY CRDM module with the spin-2 mediator differential cross section d(sigma)/dT for CR protons/helium on chi (parameterized by m_chi, m_G, c_SM/Lambda, c_DM/Lambda) and thread the same momentum dependence through the layered-Earth attenuation solver, validating against the paper's O(1e-35) cm^2 benchmark reach.

members.model_name: Inelastic dark matter with a dark photon mediator
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the two-state Majorana inelastic dark matter with kinetically mixed dark photon is not confirmed public, blocking off-the-shelf reproduction of the micrOMEGAs coannihilation thermal targets over (m_chi1, Delta, m_A', epsilon, alpha_D).
members.proposed_resolution: Release or re-derive the FeynRules v2.3.32 iDM implementation, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs v5.0.6, and validate against the paper's benchmark thermal targets at m_A'/m_chi1 = 2.5 and 3 with Delta = 0.1 m_chi1.

members.model_name: PQ Dirac-neutrino model with scalar WIMP and axion dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP (or equivalent) implementation of the mixed singlet-doublet scalar sector of this one-loop PQ Dirac-neutrino model exists, so the scalar WIMP freeze-out and sigma_SI cannot be computed beyond the paper's limiting-case benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the eta_u-singlet scalar sector (mass eigenstates, quartic couplings, Higgs and gauge interactions) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP, and run micrOMEGAs for Omega_S h^2 and sigma_SI across the singlet-doublet mixing plane.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet freeze-in dark matter in fast-expansion cosmology
members.description: No freeze-in relic-abundance solver implements this model's non-standard fast-expansion pre-BBN cosmology; the required Boltzmann integration with a modified H(T) (parameters n, T_r) and decays of thermalized doublet-like states is not available in any public code identified by the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone Boltzmann script) to accept a user-defined H(T) = H_std (T/T_r)^(n/2) fast-expansion history, and validate against the relic-density contours in the primary paper benchmarks.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in quark-portal dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline maps the quark-portal CFT operator (lambda_CFT, Lambda_CFT, d) onto the listed null channels — CMB energy injection, stellar cooling, meson decays, and collider unparticle searches — for couplings above the freeze-in benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a screening recast combining existing unparticle collider limits, stellar-cooling rate formulas, and ExoCLASS-style CMB energy-injection constraints, parameterized by (lambda_CFT, Lambda_CFT, d), validated against the paper's benchmark consistency statement.

members.model_name: Two-Higgs-doublet plus pseudoscalar mediator Majorana dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the one- and two-loop matching of the 2HDM+a pseudoscalar interactions onto nucleon scalar and gluon operators, which produces the leading (loop-induced) spin-independent signal since the tree-level rate is momentum suppressed; the model's critical direct-detection observable therefore cannot be computed with existing packages like micrOMEGAs, which stop at tree level for this structure.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published one- and two-loop Wilson-coefficient formulas (from the primary paper and the pseudoscalar-mediator matching literature, e.g. 1810.01039) as a module feeding DirectDM/DDCalc, validated against the paper's maximum sigma_SI near 5e-47 cm^2 at m_A = 600 GeV.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric B-L neutralino LSP dark matter with metastable cosmic strings
members.description: No public code couples the B-L hybrid-inflation dynamics, tachyonic preheating, heavy-neutrino leptogenesis, B-L-Higgs-to-gravitino decays, and thermal plus nonthermal neutralino production into one scan, so the viable window (v_B-L = 3.0-5.8e15 GeV, m_3/2 = 10 TeV-10 PeV, x about 0.4) cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a scan pipeline that combines micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY for the thermal higgsino/wino relic component with a set of coupled Boltzmann equations for reheating, gravitino production, and B-L Higgs decays (following the paper's equations), validated by recovering the quoted viable window.

members.model_name: Inelastic freeze-in pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the pseudo-Dirac dark-photon freeze-in setup exists; the paper's micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files for computing the chi1/chi2 freeze-in yields (including Z-decay contributions) are not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the pseudo-Dirac model (chi1, chi2, kinetically mixed A' with off-diagonal current) in CalcHEP/FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines, validating against the paper's relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_{B-L} light Dirac-neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled Boltzmann system for phi_1 freeze-out, chi freeze-in from phi_1 decay, and thermal plus nonthermal right-handed-neutrino energy density in the gauged B-L setup, so Delta N_eff and the relic abundance cannot be evaluated at new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's coupled abundance and energy-density equations in a public freeze-in framework (e.g. extend micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines or a standalone ULYSSES/odeint solver) tracking Y_phi1, Y_chi, and rho_nuR through the Z' and scalar portals, validated against the paper's Delta N_eff contours.

members.model_name: Messenger-inflation minimal GMSB gravitino superWIMP
members.description: The paper's spectrum and relic pipeline is unreleased: the mapping from (Lambda, M, N_5, tan beta) to the sparticle spectrum satisfying the 125.1 GeV Higgs constraint and the bino freeze-out abundance cannot be reproduced from the card alone, which blocks any independent rescan of the messenger-inflation-consistent parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the minimal GMSB pipeline with public tools (a standard MSSM spectrum generator with GMSB boundary conditions plus a relic-density code for slepton-coannihilating bino freeze-out), validating against the paper's benchmark (tau_B < 1 s at N_5=1, Lambda=10, m_3/2 < 5.8 GeV).

members.model_name: Non-thermal WIMP baryogenesis model
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled reheating + nonthermal WIMP re-annihilation + baryon source/washout Boltzmann system; the paper's numerical integration is unreleased and standard relic codes assume a radiation-dominated thermal history, so Y_B and Omega_DM h^2 cannot be recomputed across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a coupled ODE solver (or extend micrOMEGAs' low-reheating/nonstandard-cosmology module) tracking rho_phi, rho_rad, n_X, n_Xbar, and Y_B with CP asymmetry and washout rates as inputs, validated against the paper's benchmark Y_B ~ 0.86e-10 curves without the sudden-decay approximation.

members.model_name: Purely gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code solves the scalar mode equations for gravitational particle production in a coupled inflaton/reheating background for general m_chi, xi, H_inf, and T_R; the paper relies on private semi-analytic and numerical estimates, so the relic abundance and coherent fraction cannot be recomputed or scanned by outside users.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop and release a Bogoliubov mode-function solver coupled to an inflaton background integrator: integrate the FRW plus inflaton-oscillation background for a parameterized potential, solve the chi mode equations with nonminimal coupling xi, output occupation numbers n_k, Omega_chi h^2, and the coherent-oscillation fraction, validated against the conformal-coupling suppression limit at xi = 1/6.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L inverse-seesaw Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the gauged B-L plus L_mu-L_tau inverse-seesaw model that the paper used for relic density and sigma_SI is not publicly released, so the Boltzmann-abundance step cannot be run or the scan plots reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs, and validate by reproducing the paper's sigma_SI-vs-M_DM and M_ZBL-g_BL scan plots near the h_2 and Z_BL resonance regions.

members.model_name: Conformal hidden-QCD dark meson model
members.description: No Boltzmann network implementation exists for the multi-component pi/K hidden-meson relic abundance with inverse conversion (pi pi <-> K K), annihilation into eta-like states, and the small Higgs-singlet portal; the route's forward chain contains no relic step at all and the paper's y3 ~ 0.0024 statement is benchmark-level only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled multi-species Boltzmann equations for the near-degenerate pi/K multiplet (conversion-driven freeze-out) in micrOMEGAs' multi-component mode or a dedicated code, with hadronic cross sections from the NJL chiral Lagrangian, and validate against the paper's BP1 y3 scan.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter from late pseudo-WIMP decays
members.description: No numerical implementation of the U(1)_X dark sector with Higgs-portal messenger S exists for computing the S freeze-out abundance and its tree/three-body/loop branching ratios within one consistent pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the post-breaking Lagrangian in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs for the S freeze-out abundance, adding the paper's analytic three-body and loop decay widths as model-specific routines.

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal scalar-singlet dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model file for the neutrinophilic THDM with the Z2-odd scalar singlet is not publicly released, so the WIMP relic-density, direct-detection, and annihilation pipeline cannot be run without re-implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the THDM plus sterile-neutrino-portal Lagrangian in FeynRules from the published scalar potential and Yukawa terms, export micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's Planck relic-density scan band and Higgs-portal direct-detection results.

members.model_name: Light thermal pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: No public code implements the order-alpha_D NLO corrections to pseudo-Dirac dark-photon annihilation and scattering; the O(10 percent) to tens-of-percent shifts to the thermal target exist only as the paper's private matrix-element calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the NLO annihilation and scattering matrix elements as a public package (e.g. an add-on cross-section module for micrOMEGAs or MadDM for the pseudo-Dirac dark photon model), validated against the paper's stated NLO/LO ratios.

members.model_name: Radiative seesaw warm N_1 dark matter with N_2 entropy dilution
members.description: No reusable scan pipeline couples the thermal yield, N_2 entropy injection, BBN reheating bound (0.7-4 MeV), relic density, and LFV constraints; the paper provides only analytic estimates for benchmark points (agent_notes: no reusable global scan).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled yield/dilution ODE system with a BBN reheating-temperature check as a small standalone solver (or a micrOMEGAs non-standard-cosmology module) and combine it with the analytic LFV formulas into a parameter-scan driver.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free leptophobic axial Z-prime Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the anomaly-free leptophobic U(1)_B model with axial Dirac DM; the paper's implementation is of unknown availability, so relic-density and collider rates cannot be reproduced without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the benchmark Lagrangian (Z' with vector quark and axial DM couplings, scalar s, heavy anomalons integrated out) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/UFO, validate against the paper's g_B(m_Zprime) relic curves, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Simplified light FIMP with decay and scattering production
members.description: No documented public tool computes the freeze-in phase-space distribution including the 2-to-2 s- and t-channel scattering contribution with variable yield fraction Y_scat/Y_total; the paper's bespoke collision-term solver and its neural-network parameter maps exist only as undocumented arXiv ancillary files with no repository or tests (reproducibility_level: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Package the collision-term integrator for decay-plus-scattering freeze-in (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routines to output full momentum distributions rather than yields) together with the neural-network weights as a documented repository reproducing the A_3.5keV = 0.46 and N_sat = 63 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Self-interacting singlet scalar freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the coupled freeze-in/dark-freeze-out history of this model: Higgs-decay freeze-in of the scalar, lambda_s-dependent internal thermalization, and relativistic 4-to-2 number-changing freeze-out, tracking both the relic abundance and the evolved momentum distribution f(p) needed downstream; existing freeze-in tools (e.g. micrOMEGAs) do not treat cannibal 4-to-2 dynamics or output phase-space distributions.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop (or extend a phase-space Boltzmann framework such as the unintegrated freeze-in codes used for FIMP spectra) a momentum-level solver for the s-sector with Higgs-decay source terms, elastic self-thermalization, and 4-to-2/2-to-4 collision terms including relativistic corrections, outputting Omega h^2, xi, and tabulated f(q) over the (lambda_hs, lambda_s, m_s) plane, validated against the paper's relic contours.

members.model_name: Z4-odd inert-doublet WIMP in an A4 three-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files exist for the A4-Z4 three-Higgs-doublet inert sector (associated_code lists no repositories), so the relic scan with H_3-A_3 co-annihilation and the mixing-angle-dependent effective Higgs portal cannot be reproduced with standard IDM implementations alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the A4-Z4 3HDM scalar sector in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's benchmark points (42.2 GeV, 53.65 GeV, and the >536 GeV high-mass window) before public release.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant inverse-seesaw Majoron freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP model implementation of the scale-invariant inverse-seesaw Majoron model exists; the paper used private model files, so the micrOMEGAs freeze-in pipeline cannot be run without re-implementing the full scalar potential and inverse-seesaw Yukawa sector, including the CP-even scalar mixing.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the reparametrized scale-invariant potential and inverse-seesaw Yukawa sector in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, validate against the paper's freeze-in benchmark table with micrOMEGAs 5.3, and publish the model files in a public repository.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino self-interacting dark matter in double focus point BLSSM
members.description: Stock relic-density codes (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY with standard model files) do not include the Sommerfeld enhancement of sneutrino annihilation into light bilepton pairs that the paper relies on to reach the Planck abundance in the MeV-mediator regime, so Omega h^2 cannot be computed with released tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a micrOMEGAs BLSSM implementation with Sommerfeld factors for the attractive Yukawa potential of eta_1 exchange (Hulthen-potential approximation) applied to the annihilation into bilepton pairs, and rerun the freeze-out integration to reproduce Omega h^2 = 0.1199 +/- 0.0027 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter in early matter domination
members.description: No public code couples the micrOMEGAs inert-doublet freeze-out to the early-matter-domination Boltzmann system (phi field, Gamma_phi, T_end, entropy injection); the modified relic computation exists only as the paper's private numerical solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or wrap its rate output in a standalone integrator) with the coupled phi-radiation-DM Boltzmann equations parameterized by (T_end, k, Gamma_phi), validating against the standard radiation-dominated limit; micrOMEGAs 5.x hooks for user-defined H(T) make this a natural extension point.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_e scotogenic pattern-A fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/SARAH model files feeding micrOMEGAs, CalcHEP, and SPheno/FlavorKit) exists for the U(1) B-3L_e scotogenic field content, so the relic density, sigma_SI, and LFV branching ratios computed privately by the authors cannot be reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release a SARAH or FeynRules implementation of the model (three N_R, inert doublet eta, singlet S, heavy scalar H, flavored Z') and export micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files for relic and direct detection plus SPheno/FlavorKit output for mu -> e gamma and related LFV rates.

members.model_name: Real scalar split SIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/abundance solver treats hidden-sector 4-to-2 number-changing freeze-out plus freeze-in through on-shell dark photons for two nearly degenerate real scalars with an independently evolving dark-sector temperature; existing relic codes (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY) do not include 4-to-2 collision terms or the two-state chemical network that sets the late abundance ratio R_0.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a hidden-sector relic module (e.g. the micrOMEGAs dark-sector-temperature framework or a standalone SIMP code) with 4-to-2 collision terms, the freeze-in portal term, and coupled Boltzmann equations for phi_1, phi_2, and the dark temperature, outputting the yield and R_0 as functions of (m, Delta m, m_V, g_V, epsilon).

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=2 and singlet scalar
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation exists for the B-L=2 SU(2)_R quintuplet, including the radiative mass splittings that determine where the neutral component stops being the lightest state (around 3 TeV in the paper's setup), W_R coannihilation, and singlet-scalar (H_1) annihilation channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the left-right gauge sector, B-L=2 quintuplet, and singlet scalar in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs via CalcHEP model files with charge-specific couplings and one-loop mass splittings, and validate by reproducing the paper's relic bands and the neutral-lightest boundary near 3 TeV.

members.model_name: Two-component hidden U(1)_D scalar dark matter
members.description: The two-component hidden U(1)_D scalar model (Z2 x Z2' stable states, dark photon and dark-scalar mediators) has no public model implementation, so the coupled Boltzmann relic calculation that fixes the 40-60 percent component split cannot be reproduced with existing multi-component solvers.
members.proposed_resolution: Write the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs' two-component dark-sector mode, validating against the primary paper's benchmark relic splits and annihilation cross sections.

members.model_name: Heavy-quark and gluon-philic Majorana dark matter EFT
members.description: No public model-specific implementation of the Majorana heavy-quark/gluon operator basis exists: the paper used MadDM, FeynRules, and micrOMEGAs but released no FeynRules/UFO model files, so the relic-density normalization of the Wilson coefficients cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the seven Majorana heavy-quark and gluon operators (scalar, pseudoscalar, axial-vector, twist-2, and gluonic structures) as a FeynRules model, export UFO files for MadDM/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1198 single-operator contours over 10 GeV to 2 TeV.

members.model_name: Z' portal thermal squeezeout dark-baryon model
members.description: No public code implements the squeezeout relic calculation (pre-confinement freeze-out, pocket-stage baryon survival, glueball abundance, and entropy dilution) for this Z'-portal dark-SU(3) model, so the relic-abundance line cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled abundance network as a released solver: standard Boltzmann freeze-out of dark quarks (micrOMEGAs-style), the source's squeezeout survival prescription as a swappable module, and the glueball early-matter-domination dilution, validated against the paper's O(10^6) TeV relic line.

members.model_name: Type I seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in relic abundance from h -> SS is only an analytic order-of-magnitude estimate (f_h ~ 1e-12); the dark U(1)_D seesaw model is not implemented in any public freeze-in solver, so Omega_S h^2 as a function of (f_h, m_S, T_R) cannot be computed numerically or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Build model files (FeynRules/CalcHEP) for the effective hSS coupling and run micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module to compute Omega_S h^2 including the reheat-window dependence; validate against the paper's f_h ~ 1e-12 target.

members.model_name: Lepton-quarticity self-interacting Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No solver implements the right-handed-neutrino thermal history of this Z4 x Z4' Dirac-seesaw sector (nu_R production through the phi/N Yukawas, decoupling temperature, vector-like N decays) needed to compute Delta N_eff against the Planck interval and the CMB-S4 target of ~0.06.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Delta N_eff Boltzmann framework for Dirac-neutrino nu_R thermalization (as in the arXiv:2103.05648 approach) with this model's f_ij and g_ij couplings and N masses, outputting Delta N_eff(T_dec) over the scan parameters.

members.model_name: Lepton-quarticity self-interacting Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files plus micrOMEGAs or DDCalc hookup) exists for the lepton-quarticity model, so the relic-density scan and especially the one-loop spin-independent nucleon cross section cannot be reproduced or recast against direct-detection exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs for the relic density, code the paper's one-loop Wilson coefficient for the Higgs-exchange sigma_SI, and compare through DDCalc to LZ/XENONnT likelihoods.

members.model_name: Feebly coupled U(1)_X hidden-sector dark fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code chains the two-temperature cosmology end to end for this model: hidden-sector effective potential with xi(T)-dependent nucleation, plus the coupled Boltzmann yield equations for D, A', and the hidden scalar with feeble kinetic-mixing energy exchange; the paper's pipeline is internal.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CosmoTransitions/FindBounce to evaluate the bounce action at hidden temperature T_h = xi(T) T and couple it to a released two-temperature Boltzmann integrator (building on micrOMEGAs 5's hidden-sector temperature-ratio machinery) for the U(1)_X reaction network, validated against the paper's Omega_hidden h^2 and T_n benchmarks.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_tau scotogenic pattern-C fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the U(1) B-3L_tau scotogenic spectrum (N_Ri, inert doublet eta, singlet S, heavy scalar H, Z'): the paper's micrOMEGAs and MadGraph5_aMC@NLO setups were not released, so Omega_N1 h^2 near the M_H about 2 M_N1 scalar resonance and the scalar-portal sigma_SI cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full model in FeynRules/SARAH with the pattern-C charge assignment, export CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files for relic density and direct detection, validate the resonance region M_H about 2 M_N1 per the route's validation test, and couple sigma_SI output to public xenon likelihoods (XENON1T/LZ) to replace the card's qualitative benchmark statements.

members.model_name: Scotogenic type-II seesaw inert-doublet dark matter cogenesis model
members.description: The SARAH model files, SPheno input cards, and micrOMEGAs implementation of the scotogenic-plus-type-II model used for the three benchmark points are not publicly released, so the spectrum, relic density, and LFV checks cannot be reproduced from the paper alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model in SARAH 4 (Yukawas Y^N, Y^Delta, trilinear mu eta eta Delta, triplet sector), regenerate SPheno and micrOMEGAs code, and validate against the three published benchmark relic-density curves.

members.model_name: Scotogenic type-II seesaw inert-doublet dark matter cogenesis model
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled Boltzmann system that evolves the inert-doublet abundance together with the lepton asymmetry sourced by tree-level interference with the absorptive triplet propagator, which is the paper's central cogenesis calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a coupled freeze-out/asymmetry Boltzmann module (e.g. on top of micrOMEGAs rates or in a ULYSSES-style leptogenesis framework) implementing the L=2 scattering CP source, washout terms, and sphaleron conversion, validated against the Y_B peak near m_Delta ~ 2 m_eta.

members.model_name: BLSMIS two-component S_1^1 plus nu_H^1 FIMP dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the coupled two-component BLSMIS freeze-in calculation: the paper used SARAH/SPheno/micrOMEGAs internally but released no model files, and micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module does not directly handle two simultaneously produced FIMP species (keV S_1^1 and GeV nu_H^1) fed by Z' decay, h_2 decay, and annihilations across Regions I and II.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release a SARAH/FeynRules model file for the B-L inverse seesaw with Z2-odd S_1^1, and extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines (or write a small standalone integrator using its rates) to track the two yields Y_S1 and Y_nuH1 simultaneously, validating against the paper's Region I/II benchmarks and the g_prime -> 0 vanishing-yield limit.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal complex-scalar freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in code covers the full IR freeze-in calculation for keV-to-GeV complex-scalar dark matter through a heavy kinetically mixed dark photon including in-medium plasmon decay, which dominates the yield at low masses; existing tools (micrOMEGAs freeze-in) treat only vacuum annihilation rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone integrator) with thermal-field-theory plasmon decay and in-medium mixing suppression for the scalar dark-photon portal, validated against the primary paper's observed-relic epsilon(m_phi) target lines.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal self-interacting freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files or released freeze-in scripts) exists for the two-field X/Y Higgs-portal dark sector, so the Sommerfeld-corrected freeze-in relic calculation (Omega_X and the Y overproduction check) cannot be reproduced from the paper alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the renormalizable X/Y Lagrangian with the feeble portal couplings in micrOMEGAs 5.x using its freeze-in module (or a standalone yield integrator for H->XX decay and HH->XX annihilation with Sommerfeld factors), validated against the paper's Planck-saturating benchmark.

members.model_name: Singlet + Triplet Scotogenic scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: The paper's Python scan chaining SARAH, SPheno, micrOMEGAs, and MadGraph, including its neutrino-oscillation fit and constraint filters, is not publicly released, so reproducing the viable eta_R parameter regions requires rebuilding the singlet-plus-triplet scotogenic model files and scan logic from scratch.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the singlet-plus-triplet scotogenic SARAH model file and the scan driver (with the Casas-Ibarra-style neutrino fit and Planck/XENON1T/collider filters), validating against the paper's benchmark exclusions.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric radiative-neutrino two-component dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum-plus-relic-density implementation of the supersymmetric radiative-neutrino model exists: the N1/eta_u sector with N1-N2 coannihilation on top of the MSSM neutralino is not available as micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files, so the two-component relic abundance cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the radiative-neutrino superpotential sector (N_i, eta_u, eta_d superfields) in LanHEP/FeynRules, generate CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs in its multi-component mode to reproduce the paper's Omega_N1 + Omega_chi = 0.11 benchmarks including N1-N2 coannihilation.

members.model_name: Two-real-singlet self-interacting scalar dark matter model
members.description: No public CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files exist for the two-real-singlet Z2 x Z2-prime model, so the paper's relic-density, direct-detection, and invisible-Higgs computations cannot be reproduced without reimplementing the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the scalar potential (two real singlets plus Higgs, with Z2-prime-breaking trilinears and Majorana-neutrino couplings) in FeynRules or LanHEP, export CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic density and PandaX-II comparison at m_chi = 100 GeV in micrOMEGAs 5.x.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter with L=2 masses
members.description: No implementation exists of the coupled freeze-in calculation for the L=2 right-sneutrino LSP: the full decay inventory of higgsinos and heavier superparticles into the sneutrino, plus the accompanying sterile-neutrino yield, is not encoded in any public Boltzmann setup for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MSSM plus right-chiral neutrino superfields with L=2 Majorana and soft masses in SARAH/FeynRules, generate CalcHEP files, and use the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module extended to include NLSP freeze-out-and-decay and the sterile-neutrino warm component, validated against the paper's hierarchy/cancellation viable regions.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter in a fast-expanding universe
members.description: No public code couples the micrOMEGAs inert-doublet freeze-out to the fast-expanding-universe Boltzmann evolution (extra energy density redshifting as a^-(4+n), parameters n and T_star/T_R); the modified relic computation exists only as the paper's private numerical solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or wrap its rate output in a standalone integrator) with the modified H(T) = H_rad sqrt(1 + (T/T_star)^n rescaling) parameterized by (n, T_star), validating against the eta->0 radiation-dominated limit; micrOMEGAs 5.x hooks for user-defined H(T) make this a natural extension point.

members.model_name: Heavy-quark and gluon-philic real scalar dark matter EFT
members.description: No public model-specific implementation of the real-scalar heavy-quark/gluon operator basis exists: the paper used MadDM, FeynRules, and micrOMEGAs but released no FeynRules/UFO model files, so the relic-density normalization of the Wilson coefficients cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the four real-scalar heavy-quark and gluon operators (scalar and twist-2 type-2 structures for quarks and gluons) as a FeynRules model, export UFO files for MadDM/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1198 single-operator contours over 10 GeV to 2 TeV.

members.model_name: Extended L_mu-L_tau singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled leptogenesis-plus-dark-matter Boltzmann system (Y_N, Y_dm, Y_{B-L}) with the dominant N N -> phi_dm phi_dm production term exists, so the relic-density window 0.004 < y_st < 0.05 cannot be reproduced or extended beyond the paper's scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis solver such as ULYSSES with the phi_dm collision term for N N -> phi_dm phi_dm (including the late-thermalization check on y_st), validated against the paper's benchmark window and the OCR-ambiguous lower dark-matter mass bound checked against the PDF.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in relic abundance from h -> SS is only an analytic order-of-magnitude estimate (f_h ~ 1e-12); the Type III dark U(1)_D seesaw model with its scalar triplet is not implemented in any public freeze-in solver, so Omega_S h^2 as a function of (f_h, m_S, v2, T_R) cannot be computed numerically or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Build model files (FeynRules/CalcHEP) for the effective hSS coupling including the scalar-triplet mixing and run micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module to compute Omega_S h^2 with the reheat-window dependence; validate against the paper's f_h ~ 1e-12 target and the m_S = 1 keV benchmark.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: No public mode-function/Bogoliubov code computes gravitational production of a spectator scalar with a non-minimal xi chi^2 R coupling through inflation and reheating, including the large-xi tachyonic/parametric-resonance regime that controls f(q) and the relic abundance in this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or extend a gravitational-particle-production mode solver (Bogoliubov evolution over a numerically evolved T-model inflaton background plus reheating equation of state) with the xi R term, outputting f(q), n_chi, and Omega_chi h^2 on a (m_chi, xi, H_end, T_reh) grid, validated against the paper's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV inelastic dark photon thermal relic
members.description: No public code solves the two-state thermal history of the pseudo-Dirac pair: the coupled number-density Boltzmann equations tracking chi_2 depletion after coannihilation freeze-out down to recombination (giving f_2, on which the CMB constraint and the primordial excited abundance hinge) exist only as the authors' private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a standalone module) with coupled chi_1/chi_2 number-density equations including coannihilation, up/downscattering on the SM bath, and chi_2 decay, outputting Omega h^2 and f_2(z) down to recombination as functions of (m_1, Delta, m_Aprime, alpha_D, epsilon).

members.model_name: Mirror Twin Higgs reheaton baryogenesis atomic dark matter
members.description: The reheaton baryogenesis step (coupled asymmetry generation in visible and twin sectors with washout) is a paper-level analytic Boltzmann calculation with no released solver, so the mapping from (m_N1, m_phi_A, Y_phi, f/v) to visible and twin baryon asymmetries cannot be scanned or reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's coupled Boltzmann equations for reheaton decay, CP asymmetries, and two-sector washout as a small public package (e.g. an extension of a leptogenesis solver such as ULYSSES), outputting f_aDM and the twin reheating temperature over the m_h < m_N1 < m_WB window.

members.model_name: Scalar nontopological soliton dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the NTS charge, radius, and mass spectrum from the renormalizable scalar potential via solitosynthesis (fusion/accretion networks) or phase-transition trapping, so the mass function feeding every observable is unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a solitosynthesis Boltzmann-network solver (charge accretion and fusion rates onto growing Q-balls) plus a phase-transition trapping module using CosmoTransitions-derived bubble parameters, outputting the NTS mass function as a function of potential parameters and charge asymmetry.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_mu scotogenic pattern-B fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/SARAH files feeding micrOMEGAs, CalcHEP, and SPheno/FlavorKit) exists for the U(1) B-3L_mu scotogenic field content, so the combined relic-density (Omega h^2 in [0.117,0.123]), sigma_SI, and LFV scan cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release a SARAH or FeynRules implementation of the model (three N_R, inert doublet eta, singlet S, heavy scalar H, flavored Z') exporting micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files for relic and direct detection and SPheno/FlavorKit routines for mu -> e gamma and related LFV observables.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with two-Higgs-doublet scalar portal
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the hidden-sector 2HDM-scalar-portal model; the paper's relic-density and HDecay-based branching calculations are not released, so coupling normalization via relic matching cannot be reproduced out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release FeynRules model files for the hidden-sector annihilation operators plus 2HDM-mixed scalar mediator, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the relic-density benchmarks quoted in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar Co-SIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/relic solver implements Co-SIMP number-changing collision terms (phi phi e -> phi e with a Standard Model electron in the initial state), so the 3-to-2 thermal target coupling that anchors every observable of this model cannot be computed with existing tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Co-SIMP 3-to-2 collision integral with electron participation in a dedicated freeze-out solver (or as an extension module to micrOMEGAs), including the late-thermalization initial condition, and validate against the primary paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 thermal-target benchmarks.

members.model_name: Sequestered LARGE-volume Wino-like LSP from modulus decay
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled modulus-decay plus Wino reannihilation Boltzmann system for the sequestered LVS scenario; the card's route relies on the paper's analytic benchmark formulas and lists a 'spectrum and decay calculator or dedicated recast code' as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the modulus-radiation-LSP Boltzmann system (e.g. in micrOMEGAs' non-standard cosmology interface or a standalone ODE code) taking m_modulus and z_GM as inputs, using micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY Wino cross sections, and jointly outputting Omega h^2 and Delta N_eff against modern Planck constraints.

members.model_name: SU(2)_X hidden-sector vector and monopole dark matter with Higgs portal
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/FeynRules implementation of the SU(2)_X vector-plus-triplet model exists, so the resonant scalar-portal relic density (Omega_V h^2) reported in the paper cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the SU(2)_X gauge sector, triplet dark Higgs, and Higgs-portal mixing in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs, validating against the source resonance relic bands; include V V annihilation to dark photons and H_i H_j channels.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal vector freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-in integrator implements the spin-2 portal production rates (vector X final state) through a non-instantaneous reheating history, including the T_max-sensitive UV contribution and the narrow-width resonant regime near m_G ~ T; the yield calculation currently requires custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator) with the paper's spin-dependent spin-2 production rates and a radiation-plus-inflaton reheating history parameterized by (T_RH, T_max), including a narrow-width resonant term validated against direct thermal integration near m_G ~ T.

members.model_name: MeV singlet-scalar SIMP dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: No public solver exists for the assisted-SIMP coupled Boltzmann system (3-to-2 annihilation of the Z2-odd scalar with the assisting scalar plus the 2-to-2 conversion process); the paper's custom code is unreleased, so the relic-density band in (M_DM, M_s, lambda_11, lambda_12) cannot be independently reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or release a small dedicated integrator) to include thermally averaged 3-to-2 collision terms and dark-sector temperature evolution for the two-scalar system, validated by reproducing the paper's Planck-band scan (Omega h^2 = 0.1206 +/- 0.0021).

members.model_name: MeV singlet-scalar SIMP dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: The scalar-assisted low-scale leptogenesis calculation (resonant asymmetry from ~10 TeV right-handed neutrinos with the assisting-scalar Yukawas) has no implementation; viability of the baryon-asymmetry sector is asserted from the paper's scan without a reusable calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's right-handed-neutrino and assisting-scalar interactions in a public leptogenesis Boltzmann package (e.g. ULYSSES), adding the scalar-assisted decay/washout channels, and verify the paper's benchmark asymmetry.

members.model_name: Stable scalar mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled chi-S Boltzmann system exists: the chi chi -> SS freeze-out with subdominant stable-S depletion via SS -> h2 h2, semi-annihilation, and a dark-sector temperature evolving separately after decoupling is not covered by stock micrOMEGAs runs and no model files are released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in the micrOMEGAs 5 hidden-sector/two-component framework (or a custom coupled solver tracking T_dark), including semi-annihilation channels, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic abundances with S subdominant.

members.model_name: Heavy-quark and gluon-philic real vector dark matter EFT
members.description: No public model-specific implementation of the real-vector heavy-quark/gluon operator basis exists: the paper used MadDM, FeynRules, and micrOMEGAs but released no FeynRules/UFO model files, so the relic-density normalization of the Wilson coefficients cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the seven real-vector heavy-quark and gluon operators (scalar, pseudoscalar, axial-vector, twist-2 type-2, and gluonic structures) as a FeynRules model, export UFO files for MadDM/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1198 single-operator contours over 10 GeV to 2 TeV.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken fermionic FIMP with domain walls
members.description: No solver exists for this model's freeze-in production combining UV scattering through dimension-five operators (reheating-sensitive) with IR production from s and h decays, including the resulting chi momentum distribution f(q); the paper works only at yield level, so the relic contours cannot be reproduced and no phase-space output exists for structure-formation use.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the unintegrated freeze-in Boltzmann equation for this model at the distribution-function level (extending existing FIMP phase-space frameworks in the style of the Konig-Merle-Totzauer sterile-neutrino codes, or micrOMEGAs freeze-in plus a dedicated f(q) integrator), covering both the T_RH-dominated UV contribution and the s/h decay IR contribution, validated against the paper's T_RH-Lambda_FI and v_s-m_DM relic contours.

members.model_name: Winding string freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the winding-string freeze-in pipeline: the Kaehler-derived 2-to-2 production cross sections through the massive winding vector mediator and the freeze-in Boltzmann integral over the (m_DM, m_M, g1 g2, H_i) space exist only as the paper's private calculation, with no scan table released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's winding-mediator cross sections as a micrOMEGAs freeze-in model file or a small standalone integrator (including the irreducible graviton-exchange channel for the guardrail), and validate by reproducing the paper's H_i-versus-coupling scan at m_DM near 1e16 GeV.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline exists for translating the Higgs-portal CFT operator (coefficient lambda_CFT, dimension d) into LHC unparticle/Higgs-invisible and CMB energy-injection limits; the paper asserts consistency for the tiny freeze-in coupling but provides no channel-by-channel machinery for enlarged couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a screening recast that maps (lambda_CFT, Lambda_CFT, d) to unparticle production and Higgs-decay rates using existing unparticle-search limits and to energy-injection constraints via ExoCLASS-style deposition, validated on the paper's benchmark consistency claim.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal scalar freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-in integrator implements the spin-2 portal production rates (scalar X final state) through a non-instantaneous reheating history, including the T_max-sensitive UV contribution and the narrow-width resonant regime near m_G ~ T; the yield calculation currently requires custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator) with the paper's spin-dependent spin-2 production rates and a radiation-plus-inflaton reheating history parameterized by (T_RH, T_max), including a narrow-width resonant term validated against direct thermal integration near m_G ~ T.

members.model_name: Asymmetric singlet scalar and Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the Higgs-portal phenomenology block: resonant symmetric-component depletion through the light mixed scalar h2, the resulting sigma_SI for both GeV-scale components, and confrontation with XENON/LUX/CRESST-II and Higgs signal-strength constraints (the card lists no likelihood or code).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the two-component dark sector with the mixed scalars, run it through micrOMEGAs for the resonant annihilation rate and sigma_SI, and couple to DDCalc-style direct-detection likelihoods plus a Higgs signal-strength/invisible-width fitter (Lilith/HiggsTools) over (M_h2, theta, lambda_DM, lambda_H_phi').

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet scalar dark matter with GUT-baryogenesis washout
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled Boltzmann network tracking lepton-number washout and asymmetry transfer between the lepton, Higgs, and Z2-odd inert-doublet sectors before the electroweak phase transition; the paper's equations are a private calculation, so the Y_B-L survival prediction cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann framework (e.g. ULYSSES) with the scotogenic y_eta-mediated washout terms and chemical-potential bookkeeping for the inert doublet, reproducing the paper's washout contours in (M_N, y_hat, lambda_5) as validation.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino double-seesaw freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public solver reproduces the scalar-decay freeze-in production of the 7.1 keV sterile neutrino with entropy dilution, i.e. the nonthermal f(p) with p/T = 2.477/d^(1/3) and the Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199 benchmark; the calculation exists only in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a scalar-decay freeze-in module (momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for in-equilibrium parent decay plus dilution factor, following the Merle-Totzauer formalism) that outputs f(p) and the relic abundance, validated against the paper's benchmark values.

members.model_name: Light higgsino dark matter in a non-standard thermal history
members.description: No public relic-density code solves the coupled Boltzmann equations for a decaying scalar phi (with branching b to higgsinos), radiation, and the higgsino number density through early matter domination, reheating, and re-annihilation; micrOMEGAs is only used as a check in the radiation-dominated limit.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (which already supplies the temperature-dependent effective annihilation cross section for the MSSM higgsino sector) with a nonstandard-history module solving the phi-radiation-chi system parameterized by (m_phi, Gamma_phi, b, T_rh), validated by recovering the paper's T_rh = 1-230 GeV window for mu = 100 GeV-1 TeV.

members.model_name: Light higgsino dark matter in a non-standard thermal history
members.description: No recast pipeline is in place for the direct-detection and disappearing-track probes: the Xenon-1T and LHC charged-track curves quoted from the literature were not digitized, and mapping (M1, M2, mu, Delta m) to track lifetime and signal reach requires a long-lived-chargino collider recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI with micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY over the gaugino-mass grid and digitize the published Xenon-1T exclusion; implement the disappearing-track recast with an existing LLP framework (e.g. SModelS long-lived results or CheckMATE) using the chargino lifetime from the charged-neutral higgsino splitting.

members.model_name: Freeze-twin electron and positron dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the twin-QED freeze-in calculation exists: the FeynRules model files for the massive Stueckelberg twin photon with kinetic mixing and the resonant freeze-in Boltzmann integration used in the paper are not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the twin-photon/twin-electron model in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or a dedicated integrator including the on-shell twin-photon resonance) to reproduce the paper's epsilon(m_gamma_prime) relic-target curves for f/v = 4 and 10, then release the model files.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)' Dirac fermion dark matter with extended-seesaw neutrino masses
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of this hidden U(1)' model (Dirac DM, dark Z', dark scalar, heavy neutrinos N_4/N_5, kinetic and scalar portals) used for the paper's relic-density and cross-section numbers is not publicly released, so the freeze-out calculation near thresholds and resonances and the coupled direct-detection recast cannot be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files to micrOMEGAs for the relic density and sigma_SI, and validate against the paper's benchmarks (sigma_p^SI about 1e-46 cm^2 and Omega h^2 = 0.12 regions), then publish the model files.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac Higgs-portal dark matter with excited-state decay
members.description: The core prediction, an O(1e-4) shift in N_eff from post-freeze-out chi_1 -> chi_2 decays injecting energy into photons or neutrinos, has no public solver: existing precision-N_eff codes (e.g. NUDEC_BSM-style or FortEPiaNO-type neutrino-decoupling solvers) do not include collision terms for late electromagnetic/neutrino energy injection from a decaying excited DM state.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public neutrino-decoupling code (NUDEC_BSM or FortEPiaNO) with a decaying-species source term parameterized by (tau_chi1, Delta m, branching to gamma gamma vs neutrinos), validated against the paper's benchmark Delta N_eff ~ 1e-4 curves, and release it as the executable version of this route step.

members.model_name: CP-symmetric complex-singlet WIMP with strong first-order electroweak phase transition
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the CP-symmetric complex-singlet potential are released, so the MicrOMEGAs pipeline (relic density, sigma_SI, annihilation spectra) cannot be run without re-implementing the model from the Lagrangian in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the CP-symmetric complex-singlet scalar potential in FeynRules 2.3, export CalcHEP files for MicrOMEGAs 5.x, validate against the three benchmark rows (Omega_DM h^2 and sigma_SI) quoted in the paper, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Scotogenic singlet fermion dark matter with one-step first-order phase transition
members.description: No public model-specific implementation of this scotogenic one-step setup exists: the finite-temperature effective potential is not released as a CosmoTransitions model and no CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model file for the N_1/inert-doublet spectrum accompanies the card, so the benchmark (T_n, alpha, beta/H) values and cross-section inputs cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the one-loop daisy-resummed scotogenic finite-temperature potential as a CosmoTransitions model to reproduce the BM1/BM2 one-step nucleation temperatures, and build the scotogenic model files for CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (starting from existing public inert-doublet implementations) for the annihilation cross sections.

members.model_name: Inflaton-coupled spectator scalar dark matter
members.description: No public solver computes spectator-scalar mode functions through inflation and reheating for the phi^2 chi^2 inflaton coupling in Starobinsky/T-model potentials, outputting the occupation numbers f_chi(q), the isocurvature spectrum P_S(k) down to the CMB pivot, and the relic abundance; all three observables depend on this upstream calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain and release) a mode-by-mode integrator for the chi field on the inflaton background: evolve the Starobinsky/T-model background plus perturbative reheating, solve the mode equations with effective mass m_chi^2 + lambda_phi_chi phi^2 from horizon exit through the end of reheating, and tabulate f_chi(q), P_S(k), and Omega_chi h^2 over the (m_chi, lambda_phi_chi, T_reh) grid, validated against the paper's m_chi ~ 0.5 H_* and 0.34 meV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Extended double-seesaw WIMP-FIMP dark matter model
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the coupled WIMP-FIMP Boltzmann system: S_m freeze-in from dimension-5 operators (with T_R dependence and N_m/H_1 decay contributions) coupled to W_D freeze-out in the dark U(1)_D double-seesaw model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_D extended double-seesaw model in CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs using its two-component and freeze-in modes, adding the dimension-5 operators with explicit reheating-temperature cutoff, and validate against the source benchmarks reproducing Omega_Tot h^2 = 0.12.

members.model_name: Excited-bound-state t-channel superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No public code computes high-n bound-state formation, bound-to-bound electric/chromoelectric dipole transitions (n up to 1000), and the coupled mediator-yield Boltzmann network for the colored scalar t-channel mediator, so the excited-state relic depletion and its mediator-lifetime dependence cannot be reproduced or scanned outside the private implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the excited-bound-state rate calculation and network solver as a public package (e.g. extending DRAKE-style yield equations with the paper's Coulombic BSF/transition rate tables), validated against the paper's order-of-magnitude relic reduction and n_max convergence tests.

members.model_name: Light-right-handed-neutrino lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter (freeze-in)
members.description: No public Boltzmann/rate-equation solver computes the freeze-in B-L yield from a rotating PQ field transferred through light (sub-weak-scale) right-handed neutrinos with tiny Yukawa couplings; the branch-specific transport equations coupling the PQ charge chemical potential, RHN production, and sphaleron processing exist only as the authors' in-house calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the lepto-axiogenesis transport network (PQ-rotation source term, RHN/sneutrino production rates for m_N below the weak scale, spectator chemical-potential relations, and sphaleron freeze-out) as an extension of an existing leptogenesis rate-equation framework such as ULYSSES, validated against the primary's Y_B contours and the Y_B^obs = 8.7e-11 target.

members.model_name: Confining dark-baryon inverse-seesaw dark matter model
members.description: No numerical Boltzmann implementation exists for the coupled dark-baryon freeze-out with dark-meson inverse-decay thermalization through heavy sterile neutrinos; the relic density and thermal-contact exclusion regions rely on analytic conditions valid only near the showcased benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled B/M/N Boltzmann system (annihilation, M <-> N N inverse decays, N decays to SM) in a standalone solver or as a micrOMEGAs/DRAKE-style hidden-sector module scanning Lambda_D, M_D, and the Yukawa couplings.

members.model_name: Feebly gauged B-L freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled number-density Boltzmann system for N, Z', and phi with freeze-in via phi -> N N, inverse decay Z' Z' -> phi, photon-bath single-Z' production, and the forbidden-regime Z' Z' -> N N channel, so the relic-density contour in (g_B-L, m_N, m_phi, m_Z') cannot be independently rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or a standalone stiff ODE solver) with the paper's tree-level rates, including the f gamma -> f Z' bath-production channel, and validate against the source g_B-L ~ 1e-13 to 1e-10 (scalar regime) and 1e-7 to 1e-6 (forbidden regime) ranges.

members.model_name: QCD-like dark-pion forbidden dark matter model
members.description: No Sommerfeld-corrected calculation exists for the coupled SU(2)_W triplet and quintuplet dark-pion system at 1-100 TeV; the tree-level micrOMEGAs relic bands and the wino-analogy annihilation rates can shift by order one, and the paper explicitly postpones this treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing electroweak-multiplet Sommerfeld/bound-state frameworks (wino/minimal-DM potential codes) to the coupled triplet-quintuplet pion channels including forbidden mass splittings, and interface the resulting effective cross sections with the micrOMEGAs freeze-out and present-day annihilation calculations.

members.model_name: QCD-like dark-pion forbidden dark matter model
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the dark-pion chiral Lagrangian (including WZW-mediated quintuplet decays and forbidden channels) used by the paper is not publicly released, so the relic scan cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's chiral Lagrangian and WZW terms as a public FeynRules model file, validate against the published f_d-m relic bands, and release with the micrOMEGAs interface.

members.model_name: Bino-wino co-annihilation dark matter in high-scale SUSY
members.description: The thermal bino-wino coannihilation relic calculation requires a Sommerfeld-corrected coannihilation treatment for the nearly degenerate electroweakino spectrum that standard public relic codes do not provide out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with Sommerfeld-enhanced wino (co)annihilation cross sections for the bino-wino spectrum with Delta m up to 30 GeV, and validate the relic contour against the paper's mass-splitting result.

members.model_name: Light fermionic dark sector with dark photon and dark Higgs
members.description: No public relic-density implementation covers this model's full annihilation structure: the pseudo-Dirac coannihilation, pure-Majorana, and secluded chi_1 chi_1 -> S S regimes with a light dark Higgs in the spectrum have not been encoded in a hidden-sector freeze-out solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a micrOMEGAs model file (via FeynRules/CalcHEP) for the U(1)_D sector with chi_1, chi_2, V, and S, including chi_1-chi_2 coannihilation and the secluded S S channel, and reproduce the paper's scan points that meet the relic target at 2 sigma.

members.model_name: T1-2A scotogenic WIMP dark matter model
members.description: The T1-2A SARAH model files (and the SPheno/CalcHEP modules generated from them) are not confirmed publicly released; only ancillary SLHA spectra and tool versions are recorded, so the one-loop spectrum step cannot be run without re-implementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the T1-2A Lagrangian in SARAH 4.x (or obtain and archive the authors' model files), regenerate SPheno 4.0.4 and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs modules, and validate against the published ancillary SLHA benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Multipole vector dark matter below the GeV scale
members.description: No public model implementation of the complex-vector electromagnetic multipole EFT (dimension-five dipoles, dimension-six quadrupole/anapole/toroidal/charge-radius operators) exists in any relic-abundance code, so neither the freeze-out lines nor the UV-dominated, T_RH-sensitive freeze-in lines can be reproduced outside the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the multipole-vector Lagrangian in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs or MadDM for freeze-out, and add a light-weight freeze-in Boltzmann module with UV-dominated production integrated from T_RH (benchmarks 0.1-1 GeV), validating against the paper's operator-by-operator relic lines.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector thermal relic dark matter parameterization
members.description: No public Boltzmann freeze-out solver spans the relativistic, semirelativistic, and nonrelativistic hidden-sector freeze-out regimes with a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio xi as a free parameter; the paper's custom solver is not released, so the (m_chi, <sigma v>, xi) -> relic-density map cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public relic code (e.g. micrOMEGAs or DRAKE-style momentum-dependent solvers) or write a lightweight standalone integrator of the hidden-sector yield equation with separate hidden and visible temperatures, validated against the paper's m_chi ~ 1.5 keV floor and xi-dependence.

members.model_name: Warm dark matter from long-lived Majorana fermion decays
members.description: No implementation of the two-Majorana simplified model (suppressed epsilon_i^2 diagonal and epsilon_1 epsilon_2 transition Z couplings) exists in a relic-abundance code, so the chi_2 freeze-out abundance that seeds the entire decay chain cannot be computed numerically across (M2, epsilon_2).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the chi_1/chi_2 Lagrangian with suppressed Z couplings in FeynRules/CalcHEP for micrOMEGAs and validate the frozen-out chi_2 abundance against the primary paper's relic-abundance line before propagating it to the daughter.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet dark matter with U(1)' cosmic-string production
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists that combines IDM thermal freeze-out with the cosmic-string energy-injection source term (parameters q0, p), which is the model-defining calculation for the mixed thermal-plus-string relic abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (which already has the IDM) or write a lightweight ODE solver that adds the q0*t^-p defect source term to the H0 number-density Boltzmann equation, validated by reproducing the q0 exclusion curves in the primary paper.

members.model_name: CMSSM stop-coannihilation neutralino dark matter
members.description: The relic-density calculation including Goldstone-mode stop annihilation, Sommerfeld enhancement, and stop-antistop bound-state formation exists only in the private SSARD code; no public relic code reproduces the stop-coannihilation strip with these effects included.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or DarkSUSY) with the Sommerfeld factors and stop-antistop bound-state formation/dissociation rates for colored coannihilation partners, validate against the published SSARD strips versus m_1/2, and drive it with a public spectrum generator (SoftSUSY or SPheno) at the CMSSM boundary.

members.model_name: Littlest Seesaw right-handed-neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public implementation solves the coupled Boltzmann equations for chi and phi freeze-in through the right-handed-neutrino portal (N_R decays plus dark-sector scatterings) with the Littlest Seesaw Yukawas fixed, ultra-heavy M_R near 10^10-10^11 GeV, and UV/reheating sensitivity tracked; the card lists the coupled freeze-in solver as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (N_R, chi, phi with L_portal = y_DS N_R chi phi) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and extend the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module — or write a dedicated coupled-yield solver — including RHN decay and 2-to-2 production channels, both mass orderings, and an explicit reheating-temperature dependence, validated against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1188 and y_DS < 1e-4 viable band.

members.model_name: U(1) B-L inert-doublet two-component dark matter
members.description: No public LanHEP/CalcHEP or FeynRules model files exist for the U(1)_B-L plus inert-doublet two-component model, so the micrOMEGAs conversion-relic and direct-detection pipeline cannot be run without reimplementing the Lagrangian and discrete-charge assignments from scratch.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model in LanHEP or FeynRules (fields N1-N3, S, eta2, Z_BL with the Z2 x Z2' charges), export to micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's lambda_7 ~ 1, v_BL ~ 10 TeV conversion benchmarks, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: U(1) B-L inert-doublet two-component dark matter
members.description: No model-specific one-loop RGE code exists for the extended scalar/gauge/Yukawa sector, so the vacuum-stability and perturbativity cutoff (10^9 GeV thermal-conversion versus Planck-scale freeze-in comparison) cannot be recomputed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the one-loop (optionally two-loop) RGEs for this field content with PyR@TE or SARAH, wrap them in a scan script that reports the first stability or perturbativity failure scale, and validate against the paper's quoted 10^9 GeV and Planck-scale benchmarks.

members.model_name: Decay-induced freeze-in baryogenesis scalar dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs 5 model implementation used to cross-check the freeze-in yield is not publicly released, so the relic-density route cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild and publish the FeynRules model (singlet scalar S, Z2-odd vectorlike leptons F_i, feeble lambda_{alpha i} couplings) with CalcHEP output and a micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in run card reproducing the paper's benchmark yield.

members.model_name: Two-dark-vector DSMEFT/DLEFT dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the two-dark-vector dimension-six triple-field-strength operators: the freeze-in collision integrals over photon/Z/hypercharge channels were computed privately, and there is no FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP model file that would let standard relic codes evaluate Y_X1, Y_X2, and Omega h^2 across (m1, m2, Lambda, T_RH).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the C_BX2 and C_tilde_BX2 operators in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or MadDM) to reproduce the paper's benchmark relic curves, releasing the model files publicly.

members.model_name: CP in the Dark scalar dark matter with SFOEWPT
members.description: No public MicrOMEGAs/ScannerS model implementation (CalcHEP model files and scan configuration) for the CP-in-the-Dark N2HDM-like scalar sector is released, so the relic-density and rescaled direct-detection scan cannot be reproduced even though the generic tools are public.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CP-in-the-Dark scalar potential in ScannerS and generate CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files (or obtain the authors' implementation), then validate against the paper's relic-density and XENON1T-rescaled benchmark points.

members.model_name: A4 discrete dark matter scalar WIMP model
members.description: No numerical model implementation of the A4 dark scalar sector exists for standard WIMP calculators: relic density with co-annihilation among the compressed xi^D states, t-channel gauge-boson annihilation, and Higgs-portal sigma_SI are all currently only qualitative statements in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y x A4 Lagrangian in FeynRules/SARAH, export CalcHEP model files to micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 (with co-annihilation) and sigma_SI, and confront sigma_SI with current LZ/XENONnT limits via DDCalc to reproduce the paper's benchmark compatibility claim.

members.model_name: Composite neutrino-portal dark matter from a light hidden sector
members.description: No public model implementation of the composite neutrino-portal effective Lagrangian (chi, composite singlet neutrinos N, mixing U_N, effective coupling y_eff) exists for micrOMEGAs, so the paper's relic-density bands and the derived direct/indirect rates cannot be reproduced from released files.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the low-energy effective Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs 5.x, validating against the paper's relic-density bands and benchmark exclusion contours over (m_chi, m_N, U_N, y_eff).

members.model_name: Cosmic-ray-boosted puffy dark matter with a light mediator
members.description: The Earth-attenuation and flux computation for puffy CRDM exists only as a private modification of DarkSUSY 6.2.2 adding the dipole finite-size form factor F_DM(q^2)=1/(1+r_DM^2 q^2)^2 and light scalar/vector mediator propagators to the energy-loss integration; no public code covers this momentum dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Upstream the momentum-dependent cross section (light-mediator propagator times dipole/tophat/Gaussian DM form factors) into DarkSUSY's public CRDM attenuation module so the underground flux can be computed for arbitrary (m_chi, m_phi, r_DM), validating against the source's band-shaped exclusions.

members.model_name: SO(10) mixed singlet-inert-doublet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the SO(10) mixed singlet-inert-doublet scalar sector exists for micrOMEGAs; the paper used micrOMEGAs 4.3.2 but its model files were not released, so relic-density and cross-section scans cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the low-energy scalar potential (singlet S plus inert doublet eta with the stated mixing and quartic couplings) in SARAH or FeynRules, export to CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic values in micrOMEGAs.

members.model_name: CP-violating AKS Higgs-resonance scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the AKS Lagrangian (CP-violating 2HDM plus charged scalars S+- and Majorana N_R with exact-Z2 real scalar DM) exists for micrOMEGAs or MadDM, so the Higgs-resonance freeze-out at m_eta near 63 GeV cannot be recomputed or scanned with proper near-pole thermal averaging.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CP-violating AKS model in SARAH or FeynRules including the CP-mixed neutral Higgs spectrum, export CalcHEP files to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the stated benchmark (m_eta = 63 GeV, lambda_2 = 1.1e-3 giving Omega h^2 = 0.12).

members.model_name: Majorana dark matter from gauged lepton-number anomaly cancellation
members.description: No numerical model implementation of the gauged U(1)_L theory exists for relic-density and direct-detection evaluation: the full freeze-out across resonance/nonresonance regions with the many annihilation channels (Z_L, H_1/H_2, right-handed neutrinos, Majoron final states) and the scalar-mixing-suppressed sigma_SI are only available as paper-level analytic envelopes, with no model file for a public relic calculator (associated_code unknown, route status planned).
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules implementation of the U(1)_L model exporting CalcHEP/UFO files, run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) for Omega_chi h^2 and sigma_SI over (M_chi, M_ZL, g_L, scalar masses, mixing), and compare against the Planck abundance and current LZ limits to reproduce and refine the quoted 30/50 TeV envelopes.

members.model_name: Well-tempered singlet-quintuplet fermion WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) exists for the Majorana singlet plus SU(2)_L quintuplet with dimension-5 mixing and dimension-7/8 operators, so neither relic-density codes nor event generators can be run on this model out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet-quintuplet EFT in FeynRules including the higher-dimensional mixing and Z-coupling operators, export UFO files for MadGraph/MadDM and CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs, and validate the coannihilation relic strip against the primary paper.

members.model_name: Well-tempered singlet-triplet fermion WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) exists for the Majorana singlet plus SU(2)_L triplet with dimension-5 mixing and dimension-6 Z-coupling operators, blocking automated relic-density and collider event generation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet-triplet EFT in FeynRules with the higher-dimensional operators, export UFO files for MadGraph/MadDM and CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs, and validate the coannihilation relic strip against the primary paper.

members.model_name: Down-scattering excited Dark Matter
members.description: No implemented solver exists for the model's nonstandard relic calculation: thermal X1 freeze-out followed by late (tau ~ 100 s) decay repopulating chi with possible residual chi annihilation, which standard freeze-out codes such as micrOMEGAs do not evolve.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the source paper's coupled X1/chi Boltzmann system in a small dedicated solver (or as a micrOMEGAs extension with an injected decay source term), validated by reproducing the paper benchmark m_X1 ~ 3.8 TeV giving Omega h^2 = 0.11.

members.model_name: Long-lived mixed scalar-pseudoscalar mediator model with Dirac dark matter
members.description: No solar-capture calculation exists for this model's mixed scalar-pseudoscalar mediator with Yukawa-proportional quark couplings; the compute_capture step has null tool_or_code and existing capture codes assume contact-like SI scattering rather than a 10-100 MeV mediator.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend Capt'n General or the DarkSUSY capture routines with the model's g_q y_q cos-alpha scalar cross section including the light-mediator propagator momentum dependence, validated against the paper's benchmark capture rates.

members.model_name: Leptonic fermion dark matter with scalar dilepton mediator
members.description: No computational representation or model implementation exists for this model (computational_representation null, no associated code): there is no FeynRules/micrOMEGAs-style model file to compute the relic abundance, Sommerfeld-enhanced late-time annihilation to the light mediator, and mediator decay width beyond the paper's single benchmark point.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Lagrangian (f_L, f_R Yukawas, scalar dilepton, right-handed neutrinos) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs/MadDM to scan relic density and annihilation over (m_chi, m_zeta, f_L, f_R), adding the standard Sommerfeld enhancement factor for the light-mediator regime.

members.model_name: Leptonic scalar dark matter with scalar dilepton mediator
members.description: No computational representation or model implementation exists (computational_representation null, no associated code): there is no FeynRules/micrOMEGAs-style model file to scan relic density from the lambda_12/mu_12 scalar interactions, the Higgs-portal direct-detection rate from lambda_01, and the mediator lifetime beyond the paper's benchmark points.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the scalar potential (chi, zeta with lepton numbers 1 and 2, Higgs-portal quartics, zeta-nu_R Yukawas) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs/MadDM to compute relic abundance, sigma_SI through lambda_01, and the mediator width over (m_chi, m_zeta, lambda_12, mu_12, lambda_01, f_ij), validating against the m_chi = 150 GeV, sigma_el/m = 1 cm^2/g paper example.

members.model_name: Singlet scalar Higgs-portal dark matter with non-standard expansion
members.description: No public relic-abundance code is wired to solve the singlet-scalar number density (covering both freeze-out and freeze-in and the thermalization threshold between them) on top of the paper's non-standard pre-BBN expansion parameterized by (w, F, T_end); existing solvers assume radiation domination or need per-model modification.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or DRAKE) for the Z2 scalar singlet with a user-supplied H(T) and entropy-injection history: integrate the rho_phi/rho_R background for given (w, F, T_end), pass it into the abundance solver, implement the freeze-in branch and thermalization check, and validate against the paper's radiation-dominated lambda_HS(M_S) curve.

members.model_name: Scalar Clockwork FIMP Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules model files and micrOMEGAs5.0 freeze-in implementation for the scalar Clockwork chain (gear-decay-dominated a0 production) are author code of unknown public availability, so the relic yield cannot be independently recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or rebuild the FeynRules model for the N+1-site scalar Clockwork with Nth-site Higgs portal, export to CalcHEP, and run the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module to reproduce the published relic bands; publish the model files.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter with dynamical lepton-number breaking
members.description: No public implementation exists of the freeze-in Boltzmann calculation for nu_4 production from thermalized pseudo-Dirac neutrino decays into the phi_1/phi_2/A/J scalar sector; the relic abundance currently rests on the paper's private semi-analytic solve.
