members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the inverse-seesaw plus two-singlet-scalar Lagrangian and run it through micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery (or a dedicated decay-production Boltzmann script), validating against the paper's Omega h^2 ~ 0.12 benchmark scaling.

members.model_name: Vector Scotogenic HNL dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files or UFO) of the Vector Scotogenic Model with its massive SU(2)_L vector doublet and nonminimal gauge couplings (lambda_1, kappa) is identified, so independent micrOMEGAs relic scans and MadGraph collider event generation cannot be run; the paper's own micrOMEGAs setup is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z2-odd HNL plus vector-doublet Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs (validating relic-density trends against the paper's scans at M_V+ = 200 and 800 GeV) and a UFO for MadGraph, taking care with the nonminimal vector-gauge interactions and perturbative-unitarity limits.

members.model_name: CP-violating AKS heavy scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the AKS Lagrangian (CP-violating 2HDM plus charged scalars S+- and Majorana N_R with exact-Z2 real scalar DM) exists for micrOMEGAs or MadDM, so the heavy-scenario freeze-out through additional-Higgs final states cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CP-violating AKS model in SARAH or FeynRules including the CP-mixed neutral Higgs spectrum, export CalcHEP files to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the stated benchmark (m_eta = 250 GeV, lambda_1 = 0.0841 giving Omega h^2 = 0.12).

members.model_name: ENMSSM singlino-singlet light neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum generator implements the ENMSSM (NMSSM extended by the paper's additional dimensionful superpotential/soft terms): the original scan used a private modification of NMHDECAY linked to micrOMEGAs, so the singlino-singlet points cannot be reproduced or rescanned with public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ENMSSM superpotential and soft terms in SARAH to auto-generate a SPheno spectrum module and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, validating against the paper's quoted benchmark points (Omega h^2 ~ 0.113, sigma_SI targets for 4-10 GeV neutralinos).

members.model_name: Nonminimally coupled scalar dark matter from R^2 inflation
members.description: No reusable code integrates scalaron-decay production of the nonminimally coupled scalar through R^2 reheating to a relic abundance; the yield step exists only as the paper's semi-analytic estimate, so Omega_phi h^2 (m_phi, xi, mu, T_rh) cannot be scanned reproducibly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small semi-analytic reheating module (Friedmann plus scalaron and scalar number-density Boltzmann equations with the coupling-dependent decay width) and validate it by reproducing the paper's 1.1 MeV viability threshold and the conformal suppression near xi = 1/6.

members.model_name: Goldilocks cosmology gravitino dark matter in minimal GMSB
members.description: The route is a single unimplemented 'compute' step: no assembled pipeline links mGMSB inputs (Lambda, tan beta, m_chi, m_G, T_R) through spectrum generation, neutralino freeze-out, and the analytic superWIMP post-processing (Omega_G h^2, tau_chi, lambda_FS, d_e, m_h), so none of the paper's allowed-region contours can currently be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire together SOFTSUSY (or SPheno) for the mGMSB spectrum and Higgs mass, micrOMEGAs for the neutralino freeze-out abundance, and a short post-processing module implementing the superWIMP rescaling, the neutralino-to-gravitino lifetime, the free-streaming integral, and one-loop EDM formulas; validate against the paper's quoted allowed/excluded regions.

members.model_name: CMSSM LD 5+5 vector-like extension with neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the LD 5+5 vector-like CMSSM extension: the SARAH model files and the SPheno/CalcHEP-to-micrOMEGAs export used in the source scan are not released, so the spectrum step at the head of the only route cannot currently be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the SARAH model files from the published MSSM+LD superpotential (lambda_D, lambda_L, M_D, M_L and mixing terms), generate SPheno and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs outputs, and validate against the paper's benchmark spectra and coannihilation/A-funnel relic regions before publishing the model package.

members.model_name: CMSSM QUE 10+10 vector-like extension with neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (SARAH model files, SPheno spectrum generator, CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model code) exists for the CMSSM QUE 10+10 vector-like extension, so the spectrum, relic density, SI cross section, flavor/Higgs observables, and muon g-2 cannot be recomputed from the card alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the QUE model in SARAH from the paper's superpotential (lambda_Qu, lambda_Qd, lambda_U, lambda_E, Y_10 terms and vector-like masses), regenerate SPheno and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model code, and validate against the paper's benchmark coannihilation and A-funnel points.

members.model_name: Strongly self-interacting vector dark matter via freeze-in
members.description: The LanHEP/CalcHEP implementation of the U(1)_X vector freeze-in model (including symmetric- and broken-phase production channels and h_1 -> XX decay) described in the paper is not publicly available, so the relic yield Y_X and the dark Higgs abundance/lifetime cannot be recomputed without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the model in LanHEP or FeynRules and run the freeze-in calculation in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in mode (or a bespoke Boltzmann integrator with both electroweak phases), validating against the paper's Omega_X h^2 = 0.11 contours, then publish the model files.

members.model_name: Light-vector freeze-in dark matter with plasmon decay
members.description: No public finite-temperature freeze-in integrator includes in-medium plasmon decay for light-vector/millicharged dark matter; existing freeze-in tools (micrOMEGAs) omit the plasma-mass channel that dominates sub-MeV production and do not output the momentum-resolved nonthermal f(p).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator) with Braaten-Segel in-medium photon self-energies, resonant plasmon decay to chi pairs, and unintegrated collision terms so both the yield and the tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) are produced; validate against the paper's result that plasmon decay dominates sub-MeV production.

members.model_name: p-wave Breit-Wigner enhanced dark matter annihilation
members.description: No public relic-density code implements p-wave Breit-Wigner resonant annihilation with explicit kinetic-decoupling treatment: near-threshold resonant enhancement keeps annihilation active after chemical freeze-out, so the yield depends on x_kd and on the DM temperature evolution, which standard micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY defaults (kinetic equilibrium assumed) do not capture for this narrow-resonance regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the p-wave Breit-Wigner cross section sigma_v(delta, gamma, v) in DRAKE (which solves the coupled number-density and temperature Boltzmann equations beyond kinetic equilibrium) or in micrOMEGAs with a user-supplied T_chi evolution, and validate against the paper's b-normalization and Omega h^2 benchmarks for x_kd = 50, 5e2, 5e3.

members.model_name: Two-pseudoscalar-mediated simplified dark matter model
members.description: No public UFO/FeynRules (and matching micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP) implementation of the two-mixed-pseudoscalar model, including the NLOCT/MoGRe loop-induced P_i F Fdual and P_i G Gdual couplings and Higgs-pseudoscalar trilinears, is identified, so the relic and collider chains cannot be independently rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the mass-basis Lagrangian in FeynRules, generate loop-induced couplings with NLOCT/MoGRe, export UFO and CalcHEP model files, validate against the paper's benchmark relic-density and cross-section values, and publish the model files in a public repository.

members.model_name: Spin-2 dark matter from inflation
members.description: No public code evolves massive spin-2 spectator modes (scalar, vector, and tensor helicities with independent time-dependent sound speeds c_I) through inflation and a general non-instantaneous reheating history; the analytic mode solutions cover only limiting benchmark cases, so relic abundance and the relativistic BBN tail cannot be scanned over general EFT coefficients, T_reh, and N_e.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a mode-by-mode numerical solver for the unitary-gauge spin-2 EFT action (per-helicity equations of motion with time-dependent coefficients), integrating from sub-horizon vacuum through inflation end and a parameterized reheating equation of state, outputting rho_sigma(k) and C_e(c_I, N_e) for arbitrary parameter points.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac SU(2)_L lepton-doublet dark matter with late scalar decay
members.description: No public relic-density tool solves this model's hybrid abundance: doublet freeze-out (under-abundant), independent Higgs-portal freeze-out of the singlet scalar S, and late S decay through the tiny Yukawa y_s repopulating the neutral pseudo-Dirac state after chi freeze-out; the paper's coupled Boltzmann solve is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a lightweight two-species solver on top of its rate calculations) with a coupled yield system Y_chi, Y_S including S decay width Gamma_S(y_s), validating against the paper's y_s=1e-10 benchmark and the 450-1200 GeV viable window.

members.model_name: Singlet majoron with primordial freeze-out abundance in a low-scale seesaw
members.description: No public implementation evolves the singlet majoron's combined primordial relativistic freeze-out abundance and nu-nu -> J freeze-in coalescence through decay to neutrinos after neutrino decoupling; the paper treats the two contributions separately as a conservative visualization, and NUDEC_BSM does not ship a module coupling both production channels with the J -> nu nu decay for a precision Delta N_eff in the m_J-f plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend NUDEC_BSM with a majoron species carrying an initial freeze-out yield Y_J(T_fo), the m_nu/f-scaled nu-nu -> J coalescence collision term, and inverse-decay/decay terms into the neutrino sector, then validate against the paper's quoted T_fo bounds (>64 MeV BBN, >104 MeV Planck) and the CMB-S4 closure forecast of the f window.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter in MSSM inverse/linear seesaw extensions
members.description: The SARAH model file for the inverse/linear seesaw MSSM with RH sneutrino LSP built by the paper is not publicly released, so the entire SARAH -> SPheno -> micrOMEGAs chain cannot be run until the implementation is recreated and validated.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the inverse/linear seesaw superpotential (Y_nu L H_u N^, M_R N^ S, mu_S S S or Y_SL S L H_u) and soft terms as a SARAH model file, validate against the paper's Higgs-pole and quartic-Higgs relic features, and contribute it to the public SARAH model database.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal vector millicharged dark matter
members.description: The relic-fraction step has no implementation: the vector millicharged DM plus near-resonant invisible dark photon model is not available as a micrOMEGAs/MadDM model file, and the resonant p-wave thermal average (xi = m_Aprime/2m_V slightly above 1) is exactly the regime where default freeze-out treatments lose accuracy.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the V, A' model (kinetic mixing epsilon, dark charge e_D) in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via FeynRules/CalcHEP model files and validate the resonance-region thermal averaging against direct numerical integration of the Boltzmann equation, reproducing the paper's f_DM windows.

members.model_name: Littlest Seesaw right-handed-neutrino-portal FIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled freeze-in Boltzmann equations for this RHN-portal dark sector (neutrino-Yukawa scatterings, dark-sector scatterings, and dark-scalar decays with fixed Littlest Seesaw inputs); the paper's custom ODE integrator was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's published reaction densities and coupled yield equations in an open ODE workflow, or encode the model in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module with the Littlest Seesaw Yukawa benchmark, validating against the m_chi~1e10 GeV, T_RH=6.5e15 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: No-Scale F-SU(5) golden-strip Bino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum generator implements the No-Scale F-SU(5) construction: M0=A=B_mu=0 boundary conditions imposed at the secondary unification scale M_F with flipped SU(5)xU(1)_X running modified by TeV-scale vector-like flippon multiplets; the paper relied on a customized private codebase.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the F-SU(5) model with vector-like multiplets in SARAH/SPheno (or patch SuSpect/SoftSUSY) with two-loop RGEs and the No-Scale boundary conditions at M_F, validating against the published golden-strip spectra, then chain the output SLHA files into micrOMEGAs.

members.model_name: Pseudo-familon dark matter
members.description: The relic density exists only as a single analytic benchmark that neglects scalar mixing (computational_representation is null and no model code is released), so the viable (m_phi, m_S, m_2, lambda) region cannot be mapped and the quoted Omega_D h^2 about 0.1 carries uncontrolled precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pseudo-familon plus singlet-scalar potential (including S-h mixing) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and scan the relic density with micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's x_f = 28 benchmark and updating the target to the Planck abundance.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet multi-Higgs-inflation dark matter
members.description: No public pipeline connects the multi-field Higgs-inflation sector (nonminimal couplings xi_1, xi_2, stability/perturbativity at the unitarity scale, pseudo-scalar direction effects on n_s, r, and non-Gaussianity) to the low-energy inert-doublet quartics; micrOMEGAs handles only the low-energy freeze-out side of the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-doublet nonminimal-coupling potential in a multi-field inflation solver (e.g. PyTransport or MultiModeCode) to predict n_s, r, and f_NL, and couple it to two-loop RG running of the quartics (e.g. via SARAH-generated RGEs) down to the electroweak scale so inflationary stability regions map onto the micrOMEGAs input parameters.

members.model_name: Symmetric vector-mediator SIDM with Z-boson mass mixing
members.description: No model implementation (e.g. FeynRules/micrOMEGAs or equivalent) exists that computes the relic abundance from freeze-out into light mediators, the mediator lifetime for the BBN floor, and the momentum-dependent direct-detection recoil spectrum with Z-mass-mixing (neutron/weak-current) couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (g_X vector coupling plus eta_Z Z-phi mass mixing) in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs for the relic density and mediator width, and extend a recoil-rate code such as DDCalc with the light-mediator q-dependent propagator and Z-mixing nucleon couplings to recast current xenon/argon limits.

members.model_name: Nonthermal two-component singlet-scalar dark matter
members.description: No implementation exists for the coupled two-component Boltzmann system with zero initial densities, Higgs-decay production, and SM-annihilation freeze-in that sets the phi_2 and phi_3 abundances; the paper's private numerical solution is not available.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-singlet scalar potential in FeynRules/CalcHEP and use micrOMEGAs' freeze-in and multi-component machinery (or a bespoke coupled-ODE solver) to evolve Y_phi2 and Y_phi3, validating against the paper's benchmark couplings.

members.model_name: Sub-GUT stop-coannihilation neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public code reproduces the sub-GUT stop-coannihilation relic density with Goldstone, Sommerfeld, and stop bound-state effects at multi-TeV LSP masses; the calculation exists only in the private SSARD code with sub-GUT (M_in) boundary conditions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement sub-GUT universality boundary conditions (input scale M_in below M_GUT) in a public spectrum generator such as SoftSUSY or SPheno, extend micrOMEGAs with stop-antistop Sommerfeld and bound-state rates, and validate against the published M_in = 1e9 GeV, A_0 = 2.75 m_0 benchmark reaching m_chi about 8 TeV.

members.model_name: Five-dimensional Dirac dark photon fermion dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for Dirac dark matter annihilating through a full dark-photon KK tower with near-resonance destructive interference; generic single-mediator dark-photon model files miss the mechanism that separates the freeze-out and late-time cross sections.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) model file via FeynRules containing the first N dark-photon KK modes with analytically computed masses and wavefunction-overlap couplings as functions of (R^-1, g_D, epsilon, boundary conditions), with careful resonance treatment in the thermal averaging, and validate against the source benchmark relic densities.

members.model_name: CP-even sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: No public SARAH model files or standalone repository exist for the Type-I seesaw NMSSM with a CP-even sneutrino LSP, so the spectrum-to-observable pipeline must be rebuilt from the superpotential before any step can be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the NMSSM plus Type-I seesaw model in SARAH from the superpotential and soft terms given in the paper, generate SPheno and micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's benchmark near-degenerate Higgsino-sneutrino relic points; publish the model files.

members.model_name: B-L two-Higgs-doublet thermal right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs (or equivalent) model implementation exists for the B-L 2HDM with Z2-odd right-handed neutrino N_1, so the freeze-out relic density with Z-prime resonance and scalar/gauge channels cannot be reproduced; the paper's private implementation was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP format and load it into micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's D=550 and D=2750 benchmark relic densities before and after dilution.

members.model_name: Higgs-induced reheating vector freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann integrator evolves the Higgs-induced reheating background (inflaton, SM radiation, inflaton-dependent Higgs mass) together with vector freeze-in production from gravitational, dimension-5 inflaton-decay, and dimension-6 Higgs-portal channels; the paper's calculation exists only as private custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled rho_phi, rho_R, and n_X evolution equations of the paper in a public reheating/freeze-in framework (e.g. extend a FeynCalc/ulysses-style ODE pipeline or add a reheating-era module to micrOMEGAs freeze-in), parameterized by (n, sigma, m_X, operator coefficients), and validate against the paper's massive-vs-massless reheating benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Extended KSVZ axion model with scalar S1 dark matter and an up-type vector-like quark
members.description: The model-specific implementation (FeynRules model, CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs files, collider UFO) for the extended KSVZ scalar S1 plus up-type VLQ setup is not publicly released, so the relic-density scan, direct-detection cross sections, and collider signal generation cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian (VLQ Yukawa f_i S psi_L u_iR, Higgs portal lambda_SH, residual Z2) in FeynRules and export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs v5 and a UFO for MadGraph, validating against the paper's benchmark relic and K-factor values.

members.model_name: Branon dark matter with thermal and misalignment production
members.description: No public branon EFT model implementation exists that computes pair-production, annihilation, and elastic nuclear-scattering rates from (M, f, N) via the stress-tensor coupling; every route step currently relies on scattered analytic formulas rather than a reusable code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the branon operator (partial pi partial pi - M^2 pi^2 g) T_SM / f^4 in FeynRules, exporting a UFO model for MadGraph collider studies and a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model for relic density, direct-detection cross sections, and annihilation spectra.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter in supersymmetric U(1)_R U(1)_{B-L} seesaw model
members.description: No public, validated SARAH/SPheno model implementation of the supersymmetric U(1)_R x U(1)_{B-L} inverse-seesaw model (with the Y_s N-S mixing term and BLR Higgs sector) is recorded on the card, so the spectrum, couplings, and downstream CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs inputs cannot be generated without rebuilding it.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the BLR superpotential and gauge sector in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum routines and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's v_R=5.5 and 10 TeV benchmarks including the analytic tadpole solutions.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal scalar millicharged dark matter
members.description: The relic-fraction step has no implementation: computing f_DM from near-resonant p-wave freeze-out requires careful thermal averaging across the A' resonance (relic abundance is sensitive to the resonance offset xi per the card's validity domain), and no model files or solver configuration exist for the scalar millicharged phi plus invisible A' setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi/A' simplified model in a standard relic code (micrOMEGAs or MadDM) with resonance-aware thermal averaging, validate f_DM against the paper's quoted mass/fraction windows as the route's validation test specifies, then scan xi and e_D.

members.model_name: Electric-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in yield code implements UV freeze-in through the photon electric dipole operator including thermal in-medium effects (plasmon decay) and the reheating-temperature dependence for keV-to-GeV dark matter; the paper's analytic formulae have no reusable numerical implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone yield integrator) with the dipole-operator collision terms, in-medium plasmon decay rates, and an explicit T_R cutoff on the UV-dominated collision integral, validated against the primary paper's freeze-in target curves.

members.model_name: Magnetic-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in yield code implements UV freeze-in through the photon magnetic dipole operator including thermal in-medium effects (plasmon decay) and the reheating-temperature dependence for keV-to-GeV dark matter; the paper's analytic formulae have no reusable numerical implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone yield integrator) with the magnetic-dipole collision terms, in-medium plasmon decay rates, and an explicit T_R cutoff on the UV-dominated collision integral, validated against the primary paper's freeze-in target curves.

members.model_name: U(1) L_mu-L_tau Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs or MadDM) exists for this L_mu-L_tau gauge extension with inert doublet and scalar leptoquark, so relic-density and spin-dependent scattering scans over (M_-, g_mu_tau, M_Zprime, M_S1, Y_l, y_qR) cannot be reproduced; only paper formulae and figure contours are available.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the full Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs to reproduce the paper's relic-density band and sigma_SD scans, releasing the model files with benchmark validation points.

members.model_name: Vector Higgs-portal UV freeze-in dark matter in nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No public code solves the coupled decaying-fluid plus radiation reheating system for general pre-BBN equation of state w (including kination) together with freeze-in production through the dimension-six vector Higgs portal |H|^2 V_mu_nu V^mu_nu; existing freeze-in tools (micrOMEGAs freeze-in module) assume instantaneous reheating in a radiation-dominated background, so scans over (Lambda, m_V, T_RH, T_max/T_RH, w) rely on the paper's analytic formulae done by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small reusable reheating-era Boltzmann module (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routine) that integrates the two-fluid energy-density equations for user-specified w and inflaton width, feeds the resulting T(a) into the T^n collision term for the dimension-six Higgs-portal operator, and outputs Omega h^2 and the boost factor, validated against the paper's kination benchmarks.

members.model_name: AMSB axion-wino dark matter from heavy axino decay
members.description: No public implementation of the nonthermal relic pipeline for heavy axino decay to wino CDM: thermal axino yield as a function of T_R and f_a/N, axino decay temperature, and the post-decay Boltzmann re-annihilation of injected wino-like neutralinos on AMSB spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the cited thermal axino production yield formulae plus a decay-injection Boltzmann module (freeze-out then reannihilation at the axino decay temperature) as a scan wrapper around Isajet/IsaReD spectra, taking f_a/N, m_axino, T_R and the wino annihilation cross section as inputs.

members.model_name: E6-inspired custodial SUSY model with two dark-matter candidates
members.description: No spectrum-generator or relic-density model implementation exists for this E6-inspired model with custodial Z_H2, matter parity, and the inert Higgs/singlino sector; consequently neither the stable-state spectrum (s1) nor the two-component (ordinary neutralino plus lightest inert state) relic abundance (s2) can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (superpotential W_IH with lambda_alpha, f_alpha, f_tilde_alpha couplings, U(1)_N gauge sector, and discrete-symmetry assignments) in SARAH to generate FlexibleSUSY/SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP model files, then use micrOMEGAs' two-component dark-matter mode to solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the exotic-parity and R-parity relics.

members.model_name: No-scale supergravity neutralino LSP dark matter framework
members.description: No public spectrum generator implements the no-scale SU(5) super-GUT boundary conditions used here (m0 = B0 = A0 = 0 imposed at an input scale M_in above M_GUT, with SU(5) RGE running between M_in and M_GUT), so the (m_1/2, M_in) strips cannot be regenerated from the model inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public spectrum generator (SoftSUSY or SPheno/SARAH) with SU(5) RGEs above the GUT scale and the pure no-scale boundary condition at M_in, then chain the output SLHA spectrum into FeynHiggs and micrOMEGAs to reproduce the paper's dark-blue relic strips as a validation test.

members.model_name: Asymmetric vector-mediator SIDM with photon kinetic mixing
members.description: No model implementation exists for the asymmetric relic-abundance computation: depleting the symmetric X anti-X component via annihilation into dark vectors with a primordial asymmetry is currently handled only by the paper's benchmark scaling, not by an executable Boltzmann setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a CalcHEP/FeynRules model file for the Dirac X plus dark vector and use micrOMEGAs' asymmetric-dark-matter mode to solve the coupled Boltzmann equations with the asymmetry as an input parameter, verifying the m_phi < m_X < 300 GeV symmetric-depletion window quoted for alpha_X = 1e-2.

members.model_name: Five-dimensional Majorana dark photon fermion dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for Majorana dark matter annihilating through a full dark-photon KK tower with boundary-condition-generated diagonal axial-vector couplings and off-diagonal transitions to the heavier Majorana partner; generic single-mediator dark-photon model files cannot reproduce the direct s-channel mechanism.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model with the two Majorana states and the first N dark-photon KK modes, with analytic masses and axial/off-diagonal couplings as functions of (R^-1, g_D, epsilon, boundary conditions), run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM with resonance-aware thermal averaging, and validate against the source benchmark relic densities.

members.model_name: Type-III-seesaw U(1) B-L model with two-component Dirac dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP implementation of the anomaly-free B-L model with two fractionally charged Dirac components used for the paper's coupled micrOMEGAs Boltzmann analysis is not publicly released, so the relic-density and cross-section pipeline cannot be run without re-implementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the full Lagrangian (Z_BL, three singlet scalars, triplets, chi_1/chi_2 with fractional B-L charges) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP, and run micrOMEGAs in two-component mode, validating against the paper's benchmark relic densities summing to 0.120; release the model files publicly.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) L_mu-L_tau charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the inelastic L_mu-L_tau scalar model exists: the S/P coannihilation relic density with the off-diagonal Z-prime coupling to mu/tau flavors, Higgs-portal cross sections, and present-day annihilation are computed privately in the paper, with no FeynRules/CalcHEP files or micrOMEGAs port released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-singlet U(1) L_mu-L_tau scalar sector (S, P, light Z', h/H mixing) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs, which treats coannihilation automatically; validate against the paper's relic curves at the benchmark splitting m_P - m_S = 0.01 m_S, including the light-mediator sub-GeV region.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) light neutralino/slepton coannihilation scenario
members.description: No public spectrum-generator implementation of the flipped-SU(5) GUT-scale boundary conditions exists: the independent external U(1) gaugino mass M_X1 and right-handed slepton soft mass m_1 (with M5, m_10, m_5 matching) are not available in stock SoftSUSY/SPheno/FlexibleSUSY model files, so the light bino plus right-handed slepton spectra cannot be generated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flipped-SU(5) soft-term matching conditions (M5, M_X1, m_10, m_5, m_1, mu, M_A, A0, tan beta) as GUT-scale boundary conditions in FlexibleSUSY or SPheno, interface to FeynHiggs (or its successor) for the Higgs mass, and pipe the SLHA output into MicrOMEGAs for the coannihilation relic density; validate by recovering the charged-LSP boundary and the 15-20 GeV coannihilation strip.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation U-antiquark dark atoms
members.description: No reusable code implements the abundance pipeline from sphaleron balance through post-BBN helium binding: the (UUU)-He recombination efficiency, helium screening, and the residual free positively-charged or neutral U-hadron abundances that feed the anomalous-isotope consistency check are currently hand estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small Boltzmann/Saha network code that evolves anti-U cluster formation and Coulomb capture on primordial helium through the post-BBN plasma, tracking residual charged and neutral relic fractions versus m_U and the asymmetry parameter k, validated against the paper's m_U ~ 3.5 TeV full-abundance benchmark.

members.model_name: Dark-photon freeze-in Dirac fermion dark matter during early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-in solver implements dark-photon-portal freeze-in production through a generalized early matter-dominated era with temperature- and scale-factor-dependent dissipation (exponents n, k, b); the paper's yield integration exists only as a private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module (or release a standalone ODE code) to accept a user-defined dissipation law Gamma(T,a) and modified Hubble/entropy evolution, validated against the paper's radiation-dominated limit and published Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours.

members.model_name: Bimetric nonstandard-cosmology WIMP/FIMP dark matter
members.description: No public code couples the bimetric two-scale-factor background (deformed Poisson-bracket source-sink evolution) to a freeze-in/freeze-out relic solver, so the modified H(T) cannot be fed into standard Boltzmann machinery and none of the card's relic-abundance observables can be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Integrate the bimetric background ODEs to tabulate H(T) and the entropy source-sink history for given (lambda, initial density ratio, transition temperature), and pass the table to micrOMEGAs' nonstandard-cosmology interface (or a bespoke yield integrator) for WIMP freeze-out and FIMP freeze-in; validate by recovering standard radiation-dominated results as the deformation is removed.

members.model_name: Electron-philic scalar mediator with Majorana dark matter
members.description: The thermal relic-density calculation for the Majorana DM through the electron-philic scalar mediator is not implemented anywhere in the card's resources, so the fixed-target reach cannot be compared to the thermal-target parameter space the paper invokes for complementarity.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi-chi simplified model in micrOMEGAs (or an analytic light-DM freeze-out solver including the resonance region m_phi ~ 2 m_chi) to compute Omega h^2 over the sub-GeV benchmark plane and overlay the thermal-target contour on the fixed-target reach.

members.model_name: SU(2) x U(1) five-plet accident dark matter
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model file or equivalent) exists for the SU(2) x U(1) five-plet accident scalar, so the thermal relic abundance in either branch and the Higgs-portal direct-detection cross section cannot be computed quantitatively; only scaling estimates are available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model of the five-plet with the loop-lifted accident mass, remnant U(1)' coupling, and lambda_H portal; run micrOMEGAs for freeze-out and sigma_SI, and pass sigma_SI through DDCalc against current LZ/XENONnT limits.

members.model_name: SU(2) x U(1) five-plet accident dark matter
members.description: No dark-sector thermal-history module computes the dark-photon kinetic decoupling temperature and dark-to-visible temperature ratio as functions of lambda_H, which controls both the Delta N_eff prediction and the relic calculation in the secluded (cold dark sector) branch; the card gives only an order-of-magnitude mass implication.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a two-sector temperature evolution solver that tracks Higgs-portal energy exchange rates versus Hubble, outputs T_dec and T'/T, and maps (m_DM, alpha_D, lambda_H) to Delta N_eff for comparison with Planck and CMB-S4 forecasts.

members.model_name: Gravitational-portal right-handed-neutrino dark matter during reheating
members.description: No numerical solver exists (per the card) for the coupled reheating Boltzmann system - inflaton condensate, radiation bath, and RHN number density with graviton-mediated and xi_h-enhanced production terms - so the N1 relic abundance and T_RH are only estimated analytically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled rho_phi, rho_R, n_N1 Boltzmann equations with the paper's tree-level gravitational production rates for general inflaton exponent k and xi_h, validating against the abundance curves of the related gravitational-portal papers (arXiv:2112.15214, 2210.05716); couple the leptogenesis piece to an existing public code such as ULYSSES.

members.model_name: Dirac-scotogenic singlet-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code computes Delta N_eff for this model's Dirac-neutrino sector across both regimes: thermal right-handed-neutrino decoupling for lambda > 1e-3 and nonthermal freeze-in-like production from Z2-odd scalar decays for smaller lambda.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a Boltzmann/energy-transfer solver for the nu_R energy density (thermal decoupling temperature tracking plus phi -> nu_R decay injection), parameterized by lambda and the phi mass, and validate against the paper's thermal and nonthermal Delta N_eff cases; this can be built on standard g_star tables or as a light extension of existing Delta N_eff decoupling codes.

members.model_name: Alternative [SU(3)]^4 leptonic-color dark matter model
members.description: No numerical dark-matter pipeline exists for the scalar singlet phi^0 with z-mediated annihilation into hemions: the relic density and the Higgs-portal direct-detection bound are known only as analytic benchmarks at one parameter point, and freeze-out with hemions kept in equilibrium through photons before SU(2)_l confinement is not implemented in any public relic code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi^0, z, and hemion sector as a FeynRules/UFO model and run micrOMEGAs to scan Omega h^2 and sigma_SI over (m_phi, m_x, m_z, f_x, f_H), treating the hemion bath's thermal contact via photons explicitly, and validate against the paper's 1 pb benchmark and the f_H < 4.4e-4 bound.

members.model_name: High-scale-SUSY gravitino UV freeze-in in nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No public code solves the coupled inflaton/decaying-fluid plus radiation Boltzmann system for general pre-BBN equation of state w together with the goldstino-dominated gravitino pair-production rate; existing freeze-in tools (micrOMEGAs freeze-in module) assume instantaneous reheating in a radiation-dominated background, so scans over (T_RH, T_max/T_RH, w, m_3/2, F) rely on the paper's regime-by-regime analytic formulae done by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small reusable reheating-era Boltzmann module (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routine) that integrates the two-fluid energy-density equations for user-specified w and inflaton width, feeds the resulting T(a) into the T^n freeze-in collision term with n=6 for the gravitino, and outputs Omega h^2 and the boost factor across the parameter space, validated against the paper's kination benchmarks.

members.model_name: Higgs-philic U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the Higgs-philic U(1)' right-handed sneutrino model: the LanHEP/CalcHEP files producing matrix elements, decay widths, and MicrOMEGAs inputs are author-only with no identified repository, blocking automated evaluation of the full spectrum-to-observable chain.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the superpotential W = h_lambda S H_u H_d + (1/M_R) S L H_u Y_N N and the U(1)' sector in SARAH or FeynRules, export CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's benchmark decay widths and Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1036.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter from spontaneous B-L breaking reheating
members.description: No public code implements the coupled post-B-L-breaking reheating network — false-vacuum decay and tachyonic preheating initial conditions, B-L Higgs/gauge and heavy-neutrino decays, entropy production, lepton asymmetry, and thermal gravitino production — needed to reproduce the temperature plateau and the correlated (m_G, m_g, T_RH, M_1, m_tilde_1) relic and baryogenesis regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled Boltzmann network as an open-source ODE solver (or extend a public leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES with time-dependent entropy injection and a gravitino production equation using standard thermal rates), validating against the paper's m_G > ~10 GeV benchmark for a 1 TeV gluino.

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed bottom quarks
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the Majorana singlet plus near-degenerate colored scalar exists for micrOMEGAs, so the relic-density calculation with mediator coannihilation and the VIB contribution cannot be run out of the box despite the tool itself being public.
members.proposed_resolution: Write the simplified-model Lagrangian (y chi b_R eta + h.c. with the (3,1)_{-1/3} scalar) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and validate the micrOMEGAs relic output including eta coannihilation against the paper's analytic relic estimates.

members.model_name: Symmetric scalar-mediator SIDM with Higgs mixing
members.description: No executable relic-abundance implementation exists for the p-wave freeze-out of X anti-X into light scalar mediators: the route's boltzmann_solver step has null tool_or_code and the abundance target is currently only the paper's benchmark scaling relation.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a CalcHEP/FeynRules model file for the Dirac X plus real scalar phi with Higgs mixing and run micrOMEGAs to solve the freeze-out including the p-wave X anti-X to phi phi channel, reproducing the WIMP-miracle alpha_X(m_X) relic target quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: Equilibrium-scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the momentum-dependent freeze-in Boltzmann equations of this model (equilibrium scalar phi with dimension-five UV annihilation and IR decay channels); reproducing f_N1(p) and the abundance curves currently requires re-deriving the paper's private computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi phi -> N1 N1 and phi -> N1 N1 collision terms in a public momentum-level freeze-in code (e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or a standalone f(p) solver in the style of DRAKE) with T_RH-dependent UV truncation, validated against the paper's abundance and lambda_FS benchmarks.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter with sterile-neutrino Dark MSW interactions
members.description: The full Solar Dark MSW pipeline — asymmetric-DM solar capture profile n_X(r), 3+1 neutrino propagation through the combined standard and dark matter potentials, and the SNO/Borexino chi-square — exists only as the primary paper's private numerical implementation, so the model's critical solar-neutrino observable cannot be re-evaluated or scanned without rebuilding it.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public solar neutrino propagation framework (e.g. nuSQuIDS) with a 3+1 Hamiltonian including the radial dark potential V_s(r) computed from a Gould-formalism capture-and-thermalization module (adapting DarkSUSY capture routines to the asymmetric, non-annihilating case), and package the SNO polynomial/covariance and Borexino survival-probability likelihood as interpolable tables validated against the paper's m_X = 5 GeV, m_4 about 1 eV benchmark contours.

members.model_name: Z-prime portal right-handed neutrino dark matter in minimal gauged U(1) B-L
members.description: The minimal gauged U(1) B-L model with RHN DM lacks a public implementation tying together the relic-density scan, LHC narrow-resonance dilepton recast, and Planck-scale perturbativity (Landau-pole) check that jointly define the allowed (m_DM, m_Z', alpha_BL) region.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the B-L model in micrOMEGAs/MadDM for the resonant relic calculation, add a ZPEED-style recast of current LHC dilepton narrow-resonance limits for the B-L charge assignments, and include the one-loop g_BL running to the Planck scale as a perturbativity cut in a single scan script.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter nuggets with scalar and vector forces
members.description: No public code implements the dark-nugget synthesis network (Boltzmann/aggregation equations for fusion freeze-out plus RMFT nugget properties) that maps dark-sector masses and couplings to N_fo, M_fo, nugget radius, and density; the step is currently done with analytic estimates whose bottlenecks are model dependent.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a standalone dark-nucleosynthesis solver: coupled aggregation Boltzmann equations with two-to-two fusion cross sections through bottleneck states, closed by a relativistic-mean-field equation of state for large-N nugget binding, parameterized by constituent mass, scalar/vector couplings, and mediator masses.

members.model_name: CP-odd sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: No public SARAH model files or standalone repository exist for the Type-I seesaw NMSSM with a CP-odd sneutrino LSP, so the spectrum-to-observable pipeline must be rebuilt from the superpotential before any step can be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the NMSSM plus Type-I seesaw model in SARAH from the superpotential and soft terms given in the paper, including the RR mass-splitting sign choice that makes the CP-odd state lightest, generate SPheno and micrOMEGAs model files, validate against the paper's coannihilation benchmarks, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Scalar freeze-in inelastic dark matter with dark photon portal
members.description: No public freeze-in Boltzmann integrator computes the relic abundance and initial excited-state fraction for this split-scalar dark-photon portal, including e+e- annihilation through an off-shell V and plasmon decay with in-medium (thermal photon mass) effects in the m_e < m_V < 2 m_D regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator following the DarkSide/plasmon freeze-in literature) to include the in-medium photon self-energy for plasmon decay and to evolve the chi_1 and chi_2 number densities separately, validated against the paper's e_D epsilon ~ 1e-13 to 1e-12 relic benchmarks.

members.model_name: Spinor freeze-in inelastic dark matter with dark photon portal
members.description: No public freeze-in Boltzmann integrator computes the relic abundance and initial excited-state fraction for this pseudo-Dirac dark-photon portal, including e+e- annihilation through an off-shell V and plasmon decay with in-medium (thermal photon mass) effects in the m_e < m_V < 2 m_D regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone integrator following the plasmon freeze-in literature) to include the in-medium photon self-energy for plasmon decay and to evolve the chi_1 and chi_2 Majorana number densities separately, validated against the paper's e_D epsilon ~ 1e-13 to 1e-12 relic benchmarks.

members.model_name: Dark-charge Z4 two-scalar dark matter model
members.description: No implementation of the Z4 dark-charge two-scalar model (phi2, phi3, Z prime, scalar self-couplings) exists in any public relic-density code, so the coupled two-component freeze-out with component-changing annihilations that sets both the local density fractions and the boosted flux cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the U(1)_N gauge sector with the Z4 charge assignments and run it through micrOMEGAs' two-component dark matter mode to solve the coupled Boltzmann equations, including the phi2 phi2 <-> phi3 phi3 conversion channels, over the small- and large-coupling regimes.

members.model_name: Pure-scalar inelastic coannihilation dark matter model
members.description: No public UFO/FeynRules implementation of the pure-scalar inelastic coannihilation model (s1, s2, lambda_22 and lambda_12 Higgs-portal operators) is identified, so collider event generation and cross-checked relic calculations cannot be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-scalar Higgs-portal Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP files, validate the s2 lifetime against the paper's O(10 cm) benchmark and the relic lambda_22 bands with micrOMEGAs/MadDM, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Asymptotic-safety sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No solver produces the sterile-neutrino momentum distribution f_N(p) from decays of the thermal scalar S in this model; existing freeze-in tools (e.g. micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines) return only the integrated abundance, while structure and X-ray recasts need the full nonthermal spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for scalar-decay freeze-in (following the Merle-Totzauer scalar-decay formalism) as a small integrator parameterized by (Y_S, M_N, m_S, scalar thermal abundance), outputting f_N(p) and Omega_N h^2 consistently.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_X remnant scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the U(1)_X remnant-Z2 scalar sector in a relic-density solver; only the paper's parametric annihilation estimate exists, so the Omega h^2 = 0.12 region cannot be scanned precisely including coannihilation with the nearby Z2-odd scalars.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the full Z2-odd scalar spectrum plus Z' and run micrOMEGAs freeze-out including A_2 A_2 -> Z'Z' and suppressed electroweak channels, validating against the m_A2 = 271 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Electron-specific spin-2 mediator with light Dirac dark matter
members.description: The thermal relic-density calculation for Dirac DM through the effective spin-2 mediator is not implemented in any of the card's resources, so the fixed-target reach cannot be compared to the thermal-target parameter space the paper invokes for complementarity, and the EFT-validity boundary in Lambda is not mapped onto that plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the energy-momentum-tensor couplings of the spin-2 simplified model in micrOMEGAs via a CalcHEP/UFO model file (or an analytic freeze-out solver including the resonance region m_G ~ 2 m_chi), compute Omega h^2 over the sub-GeV benchmark plane, and flag points where the required couplings violate the Lambda EFT cutoff.

members.model_name: Minimal clockwork neutrinogenesis scalar dark-sector subcomponent
members.description: No packaged solver exists for the scalar 3-to-2 SIMP freeze-out in the clockwork regime where kinetic contact with the SM is inefficient, which decides whether the O(10-100 MeV) saturation regime or the small hot subcomponent applies.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled 3-to-2 number-changing and dark-temperature evolution equations (extending standard SIMP freeze-out codes to a decoupled-temperature dark sector) and scan m_phi and the phi self-coupling against the relic target.

members.model_name: Low-tension brane-world branon WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public branon EFT implementation computes relic abundance (hot-warm and cold branches), collider pair-production, nuclear-recoil cross sections, and annihilation spectra from (M, f, N) via the stress-tensor coupling; all four chain steps depend on this single missing implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the branon bilinear-to-T_SM/f^4 coupling in FeynRules, exporting UFO for MadGraph mono-X studies and a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model so that relic density (including the relativistic freeze-out branch checked against the paper's analytic bands), direct-detection cross sections, and indirect spectra come from one validated code.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Dirac asymmetric dark matter
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled leptogenesis-plus-dark-asymmetry Boltzmann system: the Y_N1/Y_B-L/Y_DM network with CP-asymmetric N_1 decays branching into lepton-Higgs and dark-sector final states, Z_L gauge-boson washout of the N_1 abundance, and sphaleron redistribution is given only as equations in the paper, so the M_ZL/g_L ~ 1e10 GeV bound and the Y_DM-M_DM relic relation cannot be independently rescanned (the card also defers some washout processes to future work).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann framework (e.g. a ULYSSES-style solver) with the dark-sector decay branch (y_DM, y_L, y_R couplings), Z_L-mediated 2-to-2 scattering keeping N_1 in equilibrium, the deferred dark-asymmetry washout terms, and the modified sphaleron conversion relations of the U(1)_B x U(1)_L theory.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in composite dark-pion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation exists for conformal freeze-in: the collision term for SM hypercharge coupling to a dark-CFT antisymmetric tensor operator of dimension d, transferring energy into the conformal sector without thermalization, is not available in any released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the COFI collision integral (parameterized by Lambda, d, and the reheating asymmetry) as a standalone freeze-in module or micrOMEGAs/DRAKE-style extension that outputs the dark-sector energy density versus temperature, validated against the paper's relic contours and nonthermalization screen.

members.model_name: B-L right-handed sneutrino inflaton dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable implementation of the U(1)_B-L MSSM with right-handed sneutrino LSP exists: no spectrum generator input or micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files covering the Z' and Z'-gaugino mediated annihilation channels, so neither the freeze-out relic density nor sigma_SI can be computed automatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_B-L extended MSSM in SARAH (or FeynRules), generate SPheno spectrum code and micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files including Z', Z'-gaugino, and Higgs-sector superpartner exchange, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic-density regions including the Z'-pole.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated NMSSM light and heavy dark-sector model
members.description: No numerical implementation of the GMSB NMSSM plus U(1)_X dark sector exists: LDM freeze-out into dark gauge bosons and the CP-even dark Higgs, the ONLSP relic abundance, and the coupled visible/dark-sector thermal history are only estimated analytically (has_associated_code=no).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian (superpotentials W_1 and W_dark with kinetic mixing) in FeynRules/SARAH and export to micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute LDM freeze-out with a possibly decoupled dark-sector temperature, plus the ONLSP (neutralino or right-handed sneutrino) abundance feeding the late-decay transfer.

members.model_name: H-parity stable Higgs dark matter in SO(5) x U(1) gauge-Higgs unification
members.description: No computational implementation of the SO(5) x U(1)_X gauge-Higgs unification model exists (computational_representation is null and has_associated_code is no): the H-parity spectrum, gauge-Higgs couplings at theta_H = pi/2, and stable-Higgs annihilation channels are not encoded in any model file usable by relic-density or collider tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file of the 4D effective theory (SM fields with theta_H-modified couplings plus the lightest H-parity-odd KK states), feed it to micrOMEGAs for Omega_H h^2 including coannihilation, and export a UFO for MadGraph-based collider event generation; validate against the paper's m_H ~ 70 GeV WMAP anchor point.

members.model_name: Secluded U(1)' neutralino dark matter benchmarks
members.description: The LanHEP/CalcHEP implementation of the secluded U(1)' model (singlet-extended neutralino sector, Z', exotics) used in the paper is not publicly released, so the benchmark spectra, relic densities, and collider events cannot be regenerated by third parties.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the secluded U(1)' superpotential and gauge sector in FeynRules/LanHEP, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs and UFO files for MadGraph, and validate against the published LM1'/LM2'/LM6' benchmark masses and relic densities.

members.model_name: Interacting two-component dark matter conversion model
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled two-component Boltzmann system with chi_2 chi_2 -> chi_1 chi_1 conversion staying in conversion equilibrium after thermal decoupling for nearly degenerate states with large g2/g1, which is the mechanism that generates the boost factor.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled abundance equations in micrOMEGAs' two-component dark-matter mode (or a standalone stiff ODE solver) with the conversion cross section as input, validating against the benchmark m1 = 1 TeV, Delta = 1e-4, g2/g1 = 60, u ~ 0.5 boost factor.

members.model_name: EZSSM bino dark matter with inert-Higgsino up-scattering
members.description: No public EZSSM model implementation exists: neither a spectrum generator producing the bino/inert-Higgsino masses, splittings, and R_Zij mixings nor micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files, so the freeze-out route that sets the relic density cannot be run outside the thesis's private setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EZSSM (E(6)SSM with exact Z_2^S, vanishing f_u/f_d couplings, and massless inert singlinos) in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum output and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the thesis benchmark relic densities near M_1 of about 94 GeV.

members.model_name: Pure gravity mediation neutral wino dark matter
members.description: No public maintained code computes the Sommerfeld-enhanced SU(2)L wino annihilation cross section and photon/W spectra across the sub-TeV to multi-TeV range, forcing reliance on digitized literature results for the route's first step.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the coupled-channel chargino-neutralino Sommerfeld calculation (Hisano/Hryczuk-style potentials with one-loop corrections) as a public module, e.g. by extending DarkSUSY or releasing a standalone calculator that outputs <sigma v>_WW and annihilation spectra versus m_wino and Delta m_wino.

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed muons
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the Majorana singlet plus near-degenerate charged scalar exists for micrOMEGAs, so the relic-density calculation with mediator coannihilation and the VIB contribution cannot be run out of the box despite the tool itself being public.
members.proposed_resolution: Write the simplified-model Lagrangian (y chi mu_R eta + h.c. with the SU(2)_L-singlet Y=1 scalar) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and validate the micrOMEGAs relic output including eta coannihilation against the paper's analytic relic estimates.

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed tau leptons
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the Majorana singlet plus near-degenerate charged scalar exists for micrOMEGAs, so the relic-density calculation with mediator coannihilation and the VIB contribution cannot be run out of the box despite the tool itself being public.
members.proposed_resolution: Write the simplified-model Lagrangian (y chi tau_R eta + h.c. with the SU(2)_L-singlet Y=1 scalar) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and validate the micrOMEGAs relic output including eta coannihilation against the paper's analytic relic estimates.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu global U(1) B-L complex scalar dark matter
members.description: No FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the extended Zee-Babu global U(1)_{B-L} model (complex X split into X_R/X_I, dark scalar phi, Goldstone final states, charged h+/k++ channels) exists, so the freeze-out step including hidden-sector Goldstone annihilation and X_I coannihilation cannot be run automatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar potential of the extended Zee-Babu U(1)_{B-L} model in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files to micrOMEGAs, and validate the relic contours against the paper's resonance (m_phi=2m_R) and large-v_phi benchmarks including Goldstone final states at theta_H=0.

members.model_name: Majoronic dark radiation with residual-dark-parity scalar dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the model exists: relic abundance, spin-independent cross section, and Higgs invisible width for the L=1 scalar with sub-GeV Higgs-mixed mediator are available only as the paper's private scan outputs, not as a reproducible pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the H-S-scalar potential and seesaw sector in FeynRules/LanHEP and compute <sigma v>, sigma_SI, and Gamma_h_inv with micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's <sigma v> = 2.5e-9 GeV^-2 target and M_S < 0.8 GeV accepted region.

members.model_name: X-portal vector MeV dark matter
members.description: No implementation of the X-portal vector DM model (V V* X and V V* X X vertices with 8Be-motivated SM couplings) in a public relic-density solver; the p-wave freeze-out is currently only reproduced from the paper's analytic formulae and figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the vector DM plus X mediator Lagrangian and compute the relic abundance with micrOMEGAs or MadDM, validating against the paper's 13.6-16.7 MeV window.

members.model_name: Z2-odd fermion dark matter annihilating to Majorana sterile neutrinos
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled chi/sterile-neutrino number-density Boltzmann system in which the annihilation products (N) chemically decouple from the SM bath before chi freeze-out; standard micrOMEGAs assumes equilibrated final states, and neither the paper's FeynRules/CalcHEP model files nor its custom stiff solver are released.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the FeynRules model for (chi, phi, N) and extend micrOMEGAs (or a generic solver such as a DRAKE-style code) with a second number-density equation for Y_N including its L H Yukawa-mediated coupling to the bath, validating that the standard single-equation result is recovered at large y_N.

members.model_name: Z2-odd fermion dark matter annihilating to pseudo-Dirac sterile neutrinos
members.description: No public model implementation exists: the paper's FeynRules model and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs setup for the chi-phi-N_D simplified model (including the pseudo-Dirac sterile-neutrino treatment) were used privately and never released, so annihilation cross sections and widths cannot be regenerated without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Lagrangian (y_chi phi chi N, phi^2 H^dagger H portal, N L H Yukawa, pseudo-Dirac N_D limit) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate widths and cross sections against the paper's benchmark points before public release.

members.model_name: Z2-odd fermion dark matter annihilating to pseudo-Dirac sterile neutrinos
members.description: No public solver handles the model's key effect: coupled Boltzmann evolution of Y_chi and Y_N when the sterile-neutrino annihilation products fall out of thermal contact with the SM bath before chi freeze-out; standard single-equation freeze-out machinery (micrOMEGAs default mode) gives the wrong relic abundance precisely in the small-y_N regime the paper targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled stiff number-density system (chi and N with annihilation, N decay through y_N, and g_* tables) as a standalone solver or a micrOMEGAs/DRAKE-style extension, validating against the standard equilibrium result in the large-y_N limit and against the paper's BBN lifetime check at the smallest y_N benchmarks, as the card's validation tests specify.

members.model_name: Kination non-equilibrium Majorana dark matter production
members.description: No public freeze-in/out-of-equilibrium production solver handles a kination-dominated expansion with a finite maximum radiation-bath temperature T_max; the yield step has tool_or_code null and existing freeze-in codes assume radiation domination.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a lightweight standalone ODE solver) with the kination H(T) parameterized by T_R and T_max, validating against the paper's analytic non-equilibrium branch scaling and the <sigma v> < 2.7e-38 cm^3/s abundance boundary.

members.model_name: Cosmic-selection-rule SU(N)d glueball dark matter
members.description: No public semi-analytic early-universe solver implements the full chain of vectorlike-quark freeze-out, temporary Q/Qbar matter domination, Q-onium decay reheating of two sectors, and dark confinement into glueballs; the route lists such a solver as a required resource and its status is planned.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's coupled evolution (Q abundance, matter-domination epoch, two-sector reheat temperatures, glueball yield) as a standalone numerical solver, validated by reproducing the published N_d versus Lambda_d selection curve and the T_r > MeV viability boundary.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_H bosonic H2 dark matter for radiative neutrino mass
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files exist for the hidden-U(1)_H radiative-neutrino model (H2 dark matter, Z' with loop-induced leptonic decays, inert singlet/triplet scalars, vectorlike L'), so the relic-density step cannot be run as published.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules or SARAH and export CalcHEP/UFO files for micrOMEGAs, including the H2 H2* Z' Z' contact and gauge interactions, validating against the paper's m_H2 = 3 TeV thermal-relic benchmark.

members.model_name: Singlet majoron extension with majoron or sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann pipeline exists for this model's majoron freeze-out/freeze-in from the (m_J, f, m_N) couplings, which is needed even just to verify the paper's underproduction statement quantitatively (the s2 step lists a boltzmann_solver with null tool_or_code).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet-majoron Lagrangian (majoron-neutrino and scalar-sector couplings) in micrOMEGAs' freeze-out and freeze-in modes and scan (m_J, f, m_N) to reproduce and delimit the underproduction region as a validation test.

members.model_name: Composite pNGB dark matter with a massless dark photon
members.description: No public model implementation computes freeze-out for the composite pNGB with derivative Higgs portal plus massless U(1)_DM dark photon, including the phi phi -> A_D A_D channel, Sommerfeld enhancement of late-time annihilation, and the dark-visible kinetic decoupling temperature T_dec needed for the Delta N_eff prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pNGB plus massless dark photon Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP and micrOMEGAs for the freeze-out calculation, add a Coulomb-regime Sommerfeld correction factor for alpha_D, and couple a dark-visible energy-transfer-rate calculation to output T_dec, validating against the paper's relic and Delta N_eff contours.

members.model_name: Gauged inverse-seesaw inert-scalar dark matter
members.description: No public MicrOMEGAs/CalcHEP implementation exists for the gauged inverse-seesaw inert-scalar sector (eta_R/eta_I splitting, new singlet scalars, N_R Yukawa channels); the paper's private MicrOMEGAs model file is not released, so the relic curve beyond the pure singlet-Higgs-portal decoupling limit cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full scalar potential and Yukawa sector in SARAH/FeynRules, generate a CalcHEP model for MicrOMEGAs including eta_R-eta_I coannihilation and annihilation to new scalars and sterile neutrinos, and validate by recovering the Higgs-funnel and 1-30 TeV viable regions.

members.model_name: Scalar inelastic cosmic-ray-accelerated dark matter
members.description: No public forward model computes the cosmic-ray-accelerated inelastic flux for the two-state scalar dark sector: upscattering p/He + phi_1 -> phi_2 with sub-GeV splitting Delta, the boosted phi_1 spectrum from phi_2 -> phi_1 + V decay, and attenuation to underground xenon detectors for the g_phi derivative-coupling and Lambda_s dipole-like benchmark operators.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the DarkSUSY cosmic-ray-boosted DM module to inelastic two-state scalar kinematics: implement the phi_2 production cross sections for the derivative vector-current and dimension-six dipole-like operators with light-mediator form factors, the phi_2 decay boost spectrum, and inelastic Earth attenuation, keyed to the D_eff flux parameterization.

members.model_name: Axionlike dark matter electroweak cogenesis model
members.description: No public code integrates the ALP equation of motion with the Higgs-dependent potential, the EWPT-induced minimum shift, and hidden-gauge thermal friction through the electroweak epoch, so the secondary-oscillation relic abundance and baryon asymmetry cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated ODE integrator for phi(T) coupled to the SM electroweak crossover background (using standard SM equation-of-state tables for g_*(T) and the lattice Higgs-VEV profile v(T)), with the hidden friction entering as a Gamma(T) phi-dot damping term, and validate it against the paper's quoted 0.01-30 eV viable mass window.

members.model_name: Alternative U(1)_X Dirac right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the alternative U(1)_X charge assignment: reproducing the relic, sigma_SI, dilepton, and Delta N_eff scans (including the x_H=-2 coupling-cancellation case and the m_X near 2 m_chi resonance band) currently requires re-deriving everything from the paper because no FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model files are released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_X model with alternative right-handed-neutrino charges in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs/MadDM for relic and sigma_SI, add the massless nu_R decoupling calculation for Delta N_eff, and validate against the paper's x_H = 0, 1, -1.2, -2 plots and the resonance band.

members.model_name: Z2 x Z2 two-inert-doublet 3HDM two-component dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the Z2 x Z2-prime two-inert-doublet 3HDM exists for relic-density or event-generation pipelines: the paper's micrOMEGAs and MadGraph runs used private model files, so the two-component freeze-out with inter-family conversion and the collider cascades cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a FeynRules implementation of the Z2 x Z2-prime symmetric 3HDM potential with Type-I Yukawas, exporting CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs' two-component mode (with conversion x_a x_a -> x_b x_b enabled) and a UFO for MadGraph, validated against the paper's benchmark relic-density and cross-section plots.

members.model_name: Model I final-bound-state real scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public relic-abundance code (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY, DRAKE) implements final-state Sommerfeld enhancement or final-bound-state formation channels (D D -> B, D D -> B V), so the Model I pipeline must be re-implemented from the paper formulas for every scan and cannot be validated against standard tooling.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the Model I FSS/FBS cross sections and their thermally averaged rates as a reusable module (e.g. a DRAKE or micrOMEGAs extension) validated against the paper benchmark of about 93 percent additional relic reduction at alpha_V = 0.5, z = 1.1, m_D = 1 TeV.

members.model_name: Model II final-bound-state complex scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public relic-abundance code implements the angular-momentum-resolved final-state Sommerfeld and final-bound-state channels of Model II (p-wave FSS, p-wave B formation, s-wave B plus V emission), so the relic calculation and the late-time SS*BV channel hierarchy must be re-implemented from the paper for every use.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Model II FSS/FBS cross sections and thermally averaged rates as a reusable module (e.g. extending DRAKE or micrOMEGAs), validated against the paper benchmarks of about 13 percent additional relic reduction at alpha_V = 0.5 and SS*BV dominance at x > 150.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated bound-state-forming WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the generalized bound-state-formation cross section with bath-particle scattering (thermal-field-theory kernel with mediator correlator) nor the coupled Boltzmann/Saha network of annihilation, BSF, dissociation, and bound-state decay, so the relic abundance for this vector-mediated heavy WIMP cannot be recomputed with existing public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the bath-scattering BSF kernel of the source formalism (arXiv:1910.11288 building on 1604.01776) as a module — e.g. extending DarkSUSY's or micrOMEGAs' freeze-out machinery with bound-state Saha/ionization-equilibrium equations — and validate against the paper's benchmarks showing bath-BSF dominance over on-shell emission and the resulting relic depletion.

members.model_name: Light vector dark matter with neutrino contact scattering
members.description: No UHE-neutrino propagation code exists for transport through galactic-spike and intergalactic dark-matter columns with the strongly energy-dependent contact cross section sigma ~ s^2/(192 M^6), including multiple scattering, energy regeneration, angular deflection, and a consistent DM column-density (halo plus source spike) model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing neutrino cascade/transport framework (e.g. a nuSQuIDS-style Boltzmann transport code) with the differential nu-X cross section from the dimension-seven operator and a parameterized line-of-sight DM column (NFW halo plus optional source spike), outputting attenuated spectra and arrival-direction/time-delay distributions.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter with Type-I seesaw neutrino masses
members.description: No public model implementation of the singlet-doublet Majorana plus Type-I-seesaw Lagrangian exists for micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP, so the relic-density scan with electroweak coannihilation and the sigma_SI computation cannot be reproduced or extended beyond the paper's private setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules (vector-like doublet, three RH neutrinos, Z2-odd sector) and export a CalcHEP model for micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's Omega h^2 scatter plots and the absence of Z-mediated elastic scattering in the Majorana limit.

members.model_name: Y=0 inert-triplet radiative neutrino model with bosonic dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (CalcHEP/LanHEP model files for micrOMEGAs) exists for this Y=0 inert-triplet radiative-neutrino model with the eta_R bosonic DM candidate, so the gauge-coannihilation relic calculation and the source scan counts (325 NH, 20 IH points) cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian (inert triplet, N_R, vector-like leptons, charged scalar S+) in LanHEP/FeynRules and export micrOMEGAs 5.x model files, packaging the neutrino-oscillation/LFV filter as a reproducible scan script that recovers the 166 MeV charged-neutral splitting and the published scan counts.

members.model_name: Symmetric ultraheavy atomic dark matter freeze-out through rearrangement
members.description: No public Boltzmann/relic-density code implements the defining mechanism of this model: sequential dark-sector freeze-out (dark-proton annihilation, scalar injection of dark electrons, atomic formation) followed by atom-antiatom rearrangement depletion with a geometric cross section C r_b^2 at a decoupled dark temperature.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small coupled-Boltzmann integrator (or extend micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector freeze-out module) that tracks dark-proton, dark-electron, and atom abundances with the paper's rearrangement rate, parameterized by (m_p, m_e, alpha_D, C, xi = T_dark/T_SM), and validate against the paper's 1e6-1e10 GeV viable band.

members.model_name: pNGB scalar singlet dark matter with linear U(1)_X breaking
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP files for the linear-breaking pNGB complex singlet) is released, so the micrOMEGAs relic workflow and resonance structure cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the complex-singlet potential with the soft linear breaking term in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs, and validate that the SI amplitude vanishes only for degenerate H1 and H2 as the paper states.

members.model_name: Q4-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: No CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (or FeynRules) implementation of the Q4-invariant scalar potential exists, and writing one is blocked by OCR-degraded field symbols, so neither the relic band nor sigma_SI can currently be recomputed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recover the exact Q4 representation assignments and potential terms from the typeset PDF, encode the model in FeynRules, and export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, validating by reproducing the paper's m_X-lambda_5 relic-density band.

members.model_name: No-Scale Flipped SU(5) neutralino dark matter with TeV flippons
members.description: The F-SU(5) spectrum calculation requires flippon-enhanced RGEs implemented only in a proprietary modification of SuSpect 2.34; no public spectrum generator reproduces the No-Scale Flipped SU(5) strip, which every downstream observable (relic density, Higgs mass, collider signatures, gamma line, proton decay) depends on.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the flipped SU(5) x U(1)_X boundary conditions and TeV vector-like flippon RGE contributions in a public framework (SARAH/SPheno or FlexibleSUSY), and validate against the paper's benchmark (m_chi10 = 145 GeV, WMAP7 strip with M_1/2 = 400-900 GeV).

members.model_name: Thermally produced gravitino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public, reusable BBN late-decay constraint tool covers hadronic plus electromagnetic cascades from NLSP decays in gravitino-LSP scenarios; existing public codes (e.g. ACROPOLIS) treat photodisintegration but not full hadronic showers, so the (NLSP abundance, tau, branching fractions) plane can only be checked against fixed literature grids rather than recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend ACROPOLIS (or wrap the published Kawasaki-Moroi-style hadronic-injection exclusion grids into an interpolated likelihood) to accept per-NLSP decay spectra from a spectrum calculator plus micrOMEGAs, outputting light-element constraints as a function of (NLSP identity, abundance, tau, branching fractions).

members.model_name: Nearly supersymmetric atomic dark matter
