members.description: No Boltzmann/recombination code exists for the supersymmetric dark-atom sector: the dark recombination history, residual ionized fraction, and molecule/macroscopic bound-state formation (with photino as well as photon emission channels) are uncomputed, leaving the cosmological abundance of atoms versus ions undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a RECFAST/HyRec-style recombination network to a dark sector parameterized by (alpha_D, m_eD, m_pD, dark-sector temperature ratio), adding the supersymmetric bound-state multiplets and gaugino emission channels derived from the paper's spectrum, and couple its output ionized fraction to the perturbation step.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric U(1)_B x U(1)_L multicomponent cold dark matter model
members.description: No public model implementation (LanHEP/FeynRules to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs) of the supersymmetric U(1)_B x U(1)_L sector exists, so the coupled relic densities of the leptophobic X_B, leptophilic X_L, and neutralino components — including Z_B-resonant annihilation and low-velocity Sommerfeld enhancement for X_L — cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in LanHEP or FeynRules from the paper's superpotential, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and use micrOMEGAs' multicomponent mode (extended to three sectors if needed) with dedicated treatment of the Z_B resonance and Sommerfeld factors for the TeV X_L component.

members.model_name: Degenerate leptophilic radiative-neutrino-mass dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model file exists for this radiative-neutrino-mass model with nearly degenerate N1/N2 and inert-doublet coannihilations; the paper's micrOMEGAs setup was private, so the relic-density colored regions cannot be reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Ma-model Lagrangian (three N_i, inert doublet eta, Z2, complex Yukawa texture) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and rebuild the micrOMEGAs model file, validating against the paper's WMAP-era relic contours before updating to the Planck value.

members.model_name: Leptophobic U(1)_B scalar X cold dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density model implementation exists for the leptophobic U(1)_B sector with a scalar X candidate; the card gives only a partial Lagrangian and the boltzmann_solver step names a generic micrOMEGAs-style solver without model files, so the p-wave-suppressed and resonant (m_X ~ M_ZB/2) freeze-out cannot be computed precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the full scalar-X Lagrangian (Z_B couplings, spectrum, widths) from the primary and referenced papers, encode it as a CalcHEP/FeynRules model, and run micrOMEGAs including the velocity-suppressed annihilation and the Z_B resonance across (m_X, M_ZB, g_B).

members.model_name: Spread Supersymmetry with wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the total wino abundance in Spread SUSY: Sommerfeld-corrected thermal freeze-out combined with gravitino freeze-in from heavy-scalar decays and UV gravitino production at reheating, as a function of (M_2, m_3/2, m_scalar, M_*, T_R).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs with Sommerfeld-enhanced wino annihilation and add a gravitino production/decay Boltzmann module (freeze-in plus T_R-dependent UV term), validated against the paper's parameter-space boundaries and the ~3 TeV thermal wino benchmark.

members.model_name: Non-thermal electroweak-phase-transition vector WIMP dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists that combines the bubble-collision nonthermal source term at T_EW with subsequent thermal annihilation washout for the Higgs-portal vector, which is the model's defining relic-density calculation; standard relic codes assume pure freeze-out initial conditions.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a lightweight custom solver using its Higgs-portal-vector annihilation cross sections) to accept an injected comoving yield at a user-specified T_EW and evolve the number density through post-transition annihilation to today, validated against the paper's analytic washout estimate.

members.model_name: Gauge B-L radiative neutrino mass multipartite dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists for the multi-component relic calculation: the cold S1/S2 abundances via B-L gauge and scalar-Yukawa annihilation have never been computed numerically, and no SARAH/FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for this exotic-charge B-L model are identified.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (exotic B-L charges, eta/chi scalars, S-sector mass matrix from phi2/phi4 VEVs) in SARAH or FeynRules and run the micrOMEGAs multi-component mode to compute Omega_S1 h^2 and Omega_S2 h^2 across the gauge-coupling and mass parameter space.

members.model_name: X-portal scalar MeV dark matter
members.description: No model-file implementation of the X-portal scalar Lagrangian (e_D X_mu J_DM^mu plus e epsilon_f X_mu J_SM^mu) exists in a relic-density code, so the p-wave freeze-out with the near-resonant 16.7 MeV mediator and hadronic threshold effects is only computed via the paper's approximate analytic x_f expressions.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the scalar-DM-plus-X simplified model and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) freeze-out including the X width and e+e- threshold, validating against the paper's e_D^2 epsilon_f^2 relic contour.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) inflaton-scalar dark matter unification
members.description: No implementation of the low-energy Z2 scalar-singlet limit exists in a relic/direct-detection pipeline for this card, so the quoted mass windows (m_S near 62.5 GeV for k <= 0.06, m_S above about 450 GeV for k about 0.2) are inherited from the literature rather than re-derivable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the standard scalar-singlet Higgs-portal model in MicrOMEGAs (public singlet model files exist) over (m_S, k), imposing Planck relic density and current LZ/XENONnT limits via DDCalc to re-derive the viable windows.

members.model_name: CP-violating spin-0 mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No implemented relic-density calculation covers this model's CP-phase-dependent annihilation including Sommerfeld enhancement from the light mediator and the 2-to-3 chi chi to 3 phi channel; the freezeout step relies on analytic approximations with tool_or_code null.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CP-mixed Lagrangian (couplings y_chi, alpha) as a micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model file and add the Sommerfeld factor for the alpha-dependent Yukawa potential and the 3 phi final state, fixing y_chi by Omega h^2 = 0.12 across the (m_chi, m_phi, alpha) plane.

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model I
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO, micrOMEGAs or MadDM model files) exists for the Dirac DM plus inert-scalar-doublet Lagrangian, so relic-density scans and LHC charged-scalar recasts (MadGraph plus CheckMATE/MadAnalysis) cannot be automated; computational_representation is null and associated code is unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Model I Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP model files, validate the relic density against the paper's analytic freeze-out contour, and run charged-scalar pair production through MadGraph with slepton-search recasts in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis.

members.model_name: Baryon-number-violating Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/yield code implements the late-modulus-decay cosmology in which one decay sources both the nonthermal chi abundance and baryogenesis within the 3 MeV < T_R < 1 GeV window, so the relic-abundance and BBN-window constraints cannot be scanned beyond the paper's benchmark relations.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled modulus-radiation-chi-baryon Boltzmann module (a small ODE code, or an extension of micrOMEGAs' nonstandard-cosmology mode) taking (m_modulus, T_R, Br_chi, Br_X, m_chi) to Omega_chi h^2 and the baryon yield, with the BBN T_R > 3 MeV boundary imposed.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian vector dark matter freeze-in through a heavy invisible Z prime
members.description: No public freeze-in code implements this model: the generalized Chern-Simons Z'-SM gauge-boson operators for non-Abelian vector dark matter are not available as model files in any public tool, and public freeze-in solvers assume instantaneous reheating, whereas the R(T) ~ T^16 rate makes the relic yield dominated by the T_max/T_RH noninstantaneous-reheating boost.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the GCS effective operators in FeynRules/CalcHEP and extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone Boltzmann integrator) to evolve production through a noninstantaneous reheating phase parameterized by (T_RH, T_max), including exact matrix elements near the Z' threshold; validate against the paper's R(T) ~ T^16 scaling and Omega h^2 = 0.12 benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Multipartite SU(2)_N freeze-in vector-boson dark matter
members.description: No public numerical implementation of the coupled freeze-in plus late-decay Boltzmann system for the SU(2)_N model: the X yield from eta_1 decays after eta freeze-out, the nonthermal scalar-triplet component from the Higgs quartic interaction, and the SU(2)_N spectrum/decay-width inputs are all uncomputed by any identified code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(2)_N model in micrOMEGAs or MadDM freeze-in mode (via a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file providing the spectrum and eta decay widths) and extend the yield calculation to track eta freeze-out followed by late decays into X, validating against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1198 contours.

members.model_name: S3 Majorana right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (SARAH/FeynRules to micrOMEGAs or SPheno) exists for the S3 x Z2 Majorana-neutrino model, so the t-channel inert-scalar/lepton-mediated relic density and the one-loop sigma_SD and LFV observables cannot be computed with existing public pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the S3 x Z2 model in SARAH, generate SPheno and micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's viable region (M_DM > ~300 GeV, y_5 of order one, small lambda_7) and its one-loop sigma_SD and BR(mu->e gamma) formulae.

members.model_name: Bosonic forbidden light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: The relic density is computed only in the forbidden-channel analytic approximation; no model implementation exists in a numerical relic solver to control the near-threshold Boltzmann-suppression precision across the Delta m up to 0.6 m_1 splitting range.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the S1-phi Lagrangian (lambda S1^2 phi^2 with Higgs-mixed phi decays) as a micrOMEGAs or MadDM model file and solve the full Boltzmann equation to validate the approximate 1 pbn freeze-out target.

members.model_name: Fermionic secluded light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: The relic abundance rests on the analytic p-wave estimate (y_phi about 0.01 benchmark); no numerical implementation of the psi1-phi secluded sector in a public relic solver exists to control freeze-out precision and the sub-dominant s-wave contamination relevant for CMB limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the y_phi phi psi1 psi1 plus Higgs-portal mediator Lagrangian as a micrOMEGAs or MadDM model file, solve the full Boltzmann equation, and extract the exact thermally averaged s- and p-wave components of <sigma v>.

members.model_name: Z2 Fraternal Twin Higgs right-handed twin tau WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation of the Z2 Fraternal Twin Higgs twin-tau sector (twin photon, twin Z, Y=2 scalars, Higgs-portal mixing) exists in a relic/scattering code, so Omega h^2, sigma_SI, and <sigma v> over the viable parameter space can only be reproduced from the paper's analytic appendix rather than computed systematically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z2 FTH Lagrangian (twin gauge sector, tau'_1/tau'_2 mixing, Y=2 scalars, Higgs portal) in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs or MadDM for freeze-out and spin-independent scattering, validating against the appendix analytic cross sections and the paper's viable-region contours.

members.model_name: Gauged inverse-seesaw right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public MicrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for this U(1)_{B-L} plus Z4 gauged inverse-seesaw model with residual-Z2 N_R dark matter; the paper's private MicrOMEGAs setup is not released, so the relic-density scan (including sterile-neutrino and Z prime pair final states) cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian (B-L gauge sector, inert scalar, sterile-neutrino Yukawas, residual Z2 assignments) in FeynRules/SARAH, export a CalcHEP model file for MicrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's quoted viable region m_N > 1 TeV, g_B-L > 0.7, M_Zprime > 6 TeV.

members.model_name: Light 2HDM-portal forbidden scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the leptophilic 2HDM plus Z2-odd real scalar singlet exists for relic-density codes; forbidden freeze-out just below charged-lepton thresholds requires exact thermally averaged cross sections across the kinematic threshold, which the card's route leaves with null tool_or_code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 2HDM+S model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs with exact relativistic thermal averaging over the forbidden threshold, validating against the paper's relic-density-preferred Yukawa contours for the muon, tau, and mixed-lepton channels.

members.model_name: SU(2) center-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled two-component Boltzmann system for the SU(2)_D center-stabilized model exists: the relic ratio Omega_plus/Omega_minus, which controls the direct-detection rescaling, requires solving freeze-out with dark-photon, dark-scalar, and Higgs-portal channels (and hidden-sector thermalization for tiny portal couplings).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in CalcHEP/FeynRules and use micrOMEGAs' multi-component dark-matter mode to solve the coupled chi_plus/chi_minus freeze-out, extending it with a hidden-sector temperature evolution for the secluded and freeze-in regimes the paper mentions.

members.model_name: SU(3) center-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: No micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the SU(3)_D center-stabilized scalar sector, so the Z3 semi-annihilation relic-density network (chi chi -> chi* + X plus ordinary annihilation into dark and SM final states) with a partially thermalized dark sector cannot be solved numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(3)_D model (ten-plet Phi, triplet chi, dark gauge bosons, Higgs portal) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs' Z3 semi-annihilation module, extending the code with a two-temperature (dark vs visible bath) Boltzmann treatment for the partially coupled regimes.

members.model_name: Freeze-in dark matter from a light thermal fermion mediator
members.description: No public freeze-in code implements finite-temperature forbidden mediator decays with thermal masses; the relic yield from the combined forbidden-decay plus scattering collision terms can currently only be obtained by re-implementing the paper's formulas by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or release a standalone numerical solver) that adds temperature-dependent thermal masses to the mediator and evaluates the forbidden-decay and scattering collision terms, validated against the paper's y_chi versus thermal-parameter relic curves; optionally include LPM/gauge-thermalization corrections the paper defers.

members.model_name: Multi-component asymmetric cogenesis dark-sector model
members.description: No public code solves the coupled cogenesis Boltzmann system linking right-handed-neutrino decays to both the visible and dark asymmetries and then evolving asymmetric freeze-out, freeze-in, and late-decay populations of chi and S; existing leptogenesis and relic codes each cover only one piece.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis solver such as ULYSSES with the dark-sector branching ratios and washout terms of this Lagrangian, and couple its Delta_D output to a custom yield module (or micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines) covering the asymmetric freeze-out, freeze-in, and late-decay regimes with the branching parameter R.

members.model_name: Modular A4 muon-specific scalar dark matter model
members.description: No numerical model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs) exists for the eta_I plus vectorlike-lepton Lagrangian; the relic density relies on a velocity expansion truncated at d-wave with fixed x_F ~ 24, which is untested against a full Boltzmann solution for this p-wave-sensitive leptophilic annihilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the eta_I, eta_R, E_1/E_2 interaction Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs, and recompute Omega_DM h^2 over the scan ranges (m_1, m_2 in 90-1000 GeV, y_E, s_E in 0.01-1) to quantify the error of the analytic freeze-out approximation.

members.model_name: SESM general-scalar-potential inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the SESM Z_2-odd scalar singlet/doublet sector with CP-violating potential exists for relic and direct-detection calculators; the Z-mediated co-annihilation between nearly degenerate CP-even and CP-odd states and the inelastic scattering channels are beyond stock micrOMEGAs model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Build FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the SESM scalar potential (including a_H, a_H_prime, lambda_SH_prime, lambda_DH_prime and singlet-doublet mixing) and run them through micrOMEGAs, validating the Higgs-resonance and Z-resonance co-annihilation benchmark branches quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: FIMP dark matter from flavon portals
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled flavon-DM freeze-in Boltzmann system (thermal flavon equilibrium via dimension-six Yukawa plus Higgs portal, S/h_S/A_S decay production), so the relic-density band cannot be reproduced without reimplementing the paper's equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and use micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or a small standalone ODE solver for the yield equations) validated against the paper's n=7.5 and n=8.5 benchmark windows.

members.model_name: SO(10) pseudo-Goldstone dark matter with 126_H and 16_H singlets
members.description: The SO(10) pGDM scalar sector has no numerical implementation for the relic-density scan or the momentum-suppressed (loop-level) direct-detection amplitude; the card records only an outline of the potential, no associated code, and no rerun of the decay-lifetime constraint, so the suppressed direct-detection prediction and the m_h/2-10 TeV thermal bands cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the minimal pGDM limit (S plus soft U(1)-breaking term with Higgs mixing to h_2) in FeynRules and micrOMEGAs to scan the relic density over (m_DM, v_16) including the m_h/2 and m_h2/2 resonances, and add the known one-loop pseudo-Goldstone direct-detection cross section to test the null-signal prediction against current xenon limits.

members.model_name: Type-III radiative inert-doublet scalar dark matter
members.description: The LanHEP implementation of the two-inert-doublet plus vector-like-triplet model that feeds micrOMEGAs is private: no public model files exist, so the relic-density and sigma_SI pipeline cannot be reproduced or rerun over new parameter ranges.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian in LanHEP or FeynRules, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs including all inert-scalar coannihilation channels, and validate against the paper's 100-2000 GeV scan filters.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for micrOMEGAs or MadDM) exists for the Z3 two-inert-doublet scotogenic model in the scalar-S1 hierarchy, so relic abundance with coannihilation and the neutrino-mass-fitted Yukawa structure cannot be scanned numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z3 scotogenic Lagrangian in FeynRules/SARAH, export to micrOMEGAs to compute Omega h^2 including S1-S2 and charged-scalar coannihilation, validating against the paper's p-wave analytic estimate at x_f=18.

members.model_name: Dirac dark matter with a vector mediator and modified freeze-out
members.description: No public code produces the nonperturbative effective annihilation rate for vector-mediated Dirac dark matter combining Sommerfeld enhancement with bound-state formation, decay, and thermal dissociation at finite temperature, which is required to reproduce the 2.85 to 5.90 TeV benchmark shift.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published Coulombic pNREFT vector-mediator rates (Sommerfeld factors, BSF cross sections, finite-temperature ionization-equilibrium effective rate) as an open rate-table generator whose output feeds micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY as a user-defined sigma_v_eff(T), validated by recovering the 2.85 and 5.90 TeV standard-cosmology benchmarks.

members.model_name: Superweak sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No computational implementation of the superweak U(1)_z model exists on the card (no FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO model file), so the sterile-neutrino relic abundance in either the resonant freeze-out branch or the small-coupling freeze-in branch cannot be computed with public solvers, and the published relic-density lines cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model of the SWSM (Z-prime with anomaly-free U(1)_z charges, three sterile neutrinos, mixed scalar) and export to micrOMEGAs/MadDM for the resonant freeze-out branch and to micrOMEGAs' freeze-in mode for the small-g_z branch, validating against the paper's relic-density lines at fixed M_N1.

members.model_name: Low-reheat stable massive neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann integrator computes the abundance and phase-space of a stable keV-MeV massive neutrino produced by weak interactions during MeV-scale reheating with entropy injection; the route's required low-reheat neutrino integrator does not exist as a reusable code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement momentum-resolved weak production of a massive Dirac or Majorana neutrino in a public low-reheat kinetic solver (extending a pyBBN-style code with a decaying-field entropy source), validated against the primary 33 keV to 5-6 MeV excluded band and against the standard equilibrium abundance at high T_RH.

members.model_name: Z-portal CP-violating 3HDM dark matter
members.description: No public numerical implementation of the CP-violating Z2-symmetric 3HDM (spectrum, Z S_i S_j couplings versus theta_CPV, and coannihilation channels) exists for relic-density and detection-rate calculations; computational_representation is null and the paper's benchmark scans are private.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z2-symmetric 3HDM with CP-mixed inert scalars in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs with coannihilations to reproduce the benchmark Omega h^2, sigma_DM-N, and <sigma v> scans versus theta_CPV and mass splittings.

members.model_name: Heavy-moduli nonthermal LSP dark matter scenario
members.description: No public Boltzmann-yield code tracks LSP production from late modulus decay together with post-decay annihilation, gravitino branching, and entropy injection; the card's route relies on the paper's instantaneous-decay analytic expression, and standard relic-density codes (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY) assume thermal freeze-out in a radiation-dominated history rather than a modulus-dominated one.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with a nonstandard-cosmology module that solves the coupled modulus/radiation/LSP Boltzmann system (modulus decay width, branching to superpartners, LSP annihilation at T_chi), parameterized by (m_chi, T_chi, m_LSP, <sigma v>, Br(chi -> superpartners)), validating against the paper's analytic scaling.

members.model_name: Z2-breaking complex singlet pseudo-Goldstone scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the Z2-breaking cxSM exists: the FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs files with the a_1 and b_1 soft-breaking terms and h_1/h_2 mixing were not released, blocking reproduction of the relic-density and rescaled sigma_SI scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the cxSM potential with nonzero a_1, b_1 and singlet vev in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files, and run micrOMEGAs over the paper's scan domain, checking the exact tree-level SI cancellation as a_1 -> 0 as a validation test.

members.model_name: Gauged charged complex scalar dark matter with dark Higgs and dark photon
members.description: No implementation of this gauged complex-scalar dark sector (X, dark Higgs H1, dark photon Zprime with Higgs mixing) exists in a public relic-density code; the paper uses analytic freeze-out estimates with x_f ~ 12-19 rather than a full Boltzmann solution over the X Xbar -> Zprime Zprime, H1 Zprime, H1 H1 channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules model file for the X/H1/Zprime Lagrangian and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) to compute Omega_X h^2 across the m_X = 10 MeV-10 GeV window, including resonance and threshold effects near m_Zprime ~ 2 m_X.

members.model_name: Vector-like lepton dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files exist for the vector-like lepton sector; the original relic-density implementation is private, so the freeze-out, resonance, and E_1 coannihilation calculation cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the vector-like lepton Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and rerun micrOMEGAs for relic density and SI/SD cross sections, validating against the paper's Z/Higgs resonance dips at 45 and 62 GeV.

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the coupled decay-chain yields (modulus abundance, gravitino branching, NLSP yield with possible annihilation, late entropy dilution) that set the axino relic abundance; the card's route lists a 'nonthermal momentum-distribution calculator' as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled Boltzmann yield code for the modulus/gravitino/NLSP/axino chain parameterized by (modulus_yield, gravitino_branching, NLSP identity, tau_nlsp, f_PQ), including NLSP annihilation and entropy dilution, validated against the paper's O(100) MeV axino benchmark.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter with general neutralino NLSP
members.description: The supergravity neutralino-NLSP decay calculator (lifetime plus hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions for arbitrary Bino/Wino/Higgsino mixing, including three-body channels) is a private paper implementation with no public release.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the two- and three-body neutralino-to-gravitino widths and B_had/B_em as an open module interfaced to SoftSUSY/micrOMEGAs spectra (or as a DarkSUSY extension), validated against the paper's lifetime scans.

members.model_name: Oscillating asymmetric dark matter (scalar variant)
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled oscillation-plus-annihilation evolution of complex-scalar asymmetric dark matter: a density-matrix/Boltzmann system tracking phi and phi* abundances with the X=2 mass-squared mixing term m_M^2, large annihilation, and elastic-scattering decoherence from freeze-out to today; the paper's own integration was released with no code artifact.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled density-matrix Boltzmann equations as a public module parameterized by (m_1, Delta m, <sigma v>, initial asymmetry, decoherence rate), with the scalar mass-squared mixing mapped to the oscillation frequency, validated against the paper's 10 GeV and 1000 GeV benchmark exclusions.

members.model_name: Secluded dark matter coupled to a hidden CFT
members.description: No solver exists for two-sector freeze-out with a large hidden CFT: the relic abundance depends on separate SM/hidden temperatures, hidden g_* evolution, and entropy transfer through the confinement phase transition, all currently handled by order-of-magnitude analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement coupled Boltzmann equations with independent visible/hidden sector temperatures and an entropy-conserving treatment of the confinement transition, parameterized by (M_chi, g_5, Lambda, N, g_*), e.g. by extending micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector/two-temperature machinery or a standalone solver validated against the paper's benchmark abundance curves.

members.model_name: U(1)_X isospin-violating asymmetric Dirac dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the U(1)_X double-portal model used by the authors is not publicly released, so the asymmetric relic calculation with quasi-resonant Z_X depletion and the coupled scattering amplitudes cannot be reproduced directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian (kinetic mixing, scalar mixing, Dirac chi, singlet S) in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs in its asymmetric dark matter mode, validating against the paper's Planck target Omega h^2 = 0.1187 and the residual symmetric fraction near the Z_X resonance.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal vector dark matter with broken U(1)
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files) exists for this specific hidden-U(1) vector plus complex-singlet model; the card lists micrOMEGAs only as 'or equivalent' and records no associated code, so the relic-density scan is not reproducible off the shelf.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the renormalizable hidden-U(1) Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the primary paper's relic-density and annihilation-channel benchmarks.

members.model_name: U(1) flavor symmetric vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of this specific flavor-symmetric singlet-doublet construction is released for Micromegas; the paper's scan cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files linking the flavor-breaking operator to the Higgs portal Yukawa.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the singlet-doublet Lagrangian with the flavor-induced Yukawa Y and mixing theta_d in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's benchmark that LUX constrains Y below about 0.05 for sub-TeV M1.

members.model_name: Sequestered LVS thermal Higgsino dark matter with Affleck-Dine baryogenesis
members.description: No implemented pipeline maps the sequestered LVS soft-term pattern and modulus reheating parameters to a full MSSM Higgsino spectrum and precision relic density; the route's own required_code_resources note that a spectrum calculator and relic-density solver are needed for a full recast, and the card's route relies on the m_chi/20 freeze-out estimate rather than a numerical Boltzmann calculation including Sommerfeld/coannihilation effects at the ~1.2 TeV Higgsino scale.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the sequestered LVS boundary conditions (split-SUSY-like soft terms plus modulus-set reheating temperature) in a public spectrum generator such as SoftSUSY or SPheno, and pass the spectrum to micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with the low-reheating-temperature option to compute the thermal Higgsino relic abundance numerically, including coannihilation with the nearly degenerate chargino/neutralino states.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs complex scalar sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the minimal U(1)_D dark-Higgs sector: the paper's freeze-out with off-shell dark-photon annihilation to e+e- plus t-channel phi phi -> S S channels was run through private BayesFITS interfaces, a modified relic-density module, and non-SUSY SPheno spectrum generation.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model of the complex scalar plus dark photon plus dark Higgs sector and compute the relic density in micrOMEGAs with all coannihilation and S-containing final states enabled, validating against the paper's Planck-compatible (Omega h^2 = 0.1188) scan points.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant U(1)_X singlet fermion dark matter
members.description: The CalcHEP model files and micrOMEGAs setup used for the relic-density and sigma_SI scan are author code with no public repository identified, so the resonance bands and direct-detection predictions cannot be regenerated or extended off the paper's benchmark mixing angles.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the renormalizable scale-invariant Lagrangian (given in full in the paper) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs, validating against the published relic-density resonance bands and SI scatter plot, then archive the model files publicly.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet fermionic UV/IR freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-in code implements UV, IR, and mixed UV-IR freeze-in production through the dimension-five Higgs operator with explicit reheating-temperature dependence; existing freeze-in machinery (e.g. micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines) targets IR-dominated renormalizable freeze-in and does not track the T_RH-sensitive UV contribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a lightweight yield integrator following the paper's UV/IR/mixed rate formulae (production rates before and after electroweak symmetry breaking, integrated from T_RH down), validated by recovering the UV-to-IR dominance transition near T_RH ~ 10^4 GeV; alternatively extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module to accept temperature-dependent effective-operator rates with a finite reheating temperature.

members.model_name: Gauged lepton-number dark-sector CP-violating fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files feeding micrOMEGAs or MadDM) exists for the chi relic density with its combined Z-prime, lepton-pair, and dark-scalar annihilation channels, so the freeze-out abundance in the baryogenesis-favored region cannot be recomputed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules implementation of the gauged-U(1)_L dark sector (chi, S components, Z-prime) and export to micrOMEGAs to compute the relic density including chi chi -> Z' Z', s-channel Z' -> leptons, and dark-scalar final states, validated against the paper's allowed-point plots.

members.model_name: Freeze-in hidden-sector self-interacting dark fermion model with a light dark photon
members.description: No public released implementation of the coupled two-temperature Boltzmann system for this Stueckelberg U(1)_X hidden sector (equations y1-y3/y7: D and gamma-prime yields plus the hidden-to-visible temperature ratio with freeze-in sourcing and dark freeze-out); the paper used a custom stiff-equation solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs' two-sector (hidden-sector temperature) freeze-in/freeze-out framework, or release a standalone stiff ODE solver for the (Y_D, Y_gamma_prime, T_h/T) system, validated against the paper's six benchmark relic densities and the allowed epsilon/m_gamma_prime band.

members.model_name: Scalar portal dark matter from inverse phase transition
members.description: No numerical scalar-field thermal-history solver exists to compute the phi abundance through the inverse phase transition; the relic density is currently a rough analytic kick-approximation estimate, and the card provides no target_fraction or validated Omega_phi h^2 mapping over (M, g, lambda, N).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a solver that integrates the homogeneous phi equation of motion with the varphi-induced thermal mass through T_sym (a CosmoTransitions-style effective-potential evolution coupled to the background Friedmann equations), validating the kick approximation and producing Omega_phi h^2 contours in the (M, g, lambda) space.

members.model_name: S3 symmetric two-Higgs-doublet vector-like lepton dark matter
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO model files for the S3 symmetric 2HDM plus vector-like lepton sector, so the micrOMEGAs relic/scattering scan and the MG5aMC@NLO collider event generation cannot be reproduced from the paper alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the S3 symmetric 2HDM+VLL Lagrangian (scalar potential, VLL Yukawa couplings, soft S3-breaking Dirac/Majorana masses, mass-matrix diagonalization) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP and UFO model files, validate against the BP1-BP4 relic-density and cross-section tables, and publish the files in a model repository.

members.model_name: Two-component WIMP-FIMP scalar dark matter with U(1) L_mu-L_tau
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled two-component Boltzmann system for this model, in particular the FIMP semi-production channel phi_1 phi_2 -> phi_2 phi_2 and the three-body decay phi_1 -> phi_2 phi_2 phi_2 that couple the WIMP and FIMP abundances; the paper's numerical solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model file in micrOMEGAs 5's two-component mode and extend it with the semi-production and superWIMP-decay collision terms (or implement the coupled number-density equations in a standalone solver), validating against the paper's one- and two-component regime benchmarks.

members.model_name: STFM singlet FIMP with triplet next-to-lightest odd particle
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the STFM coupled Boltzmann system in which the singlet N is produced by thermal freeze-in from H2/triplet decays and scatterings and additionally by late out-of-equilibrium decay of the frozen-out triplet NLOP; micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines do not handle the coupled NLOP freeze-out-then-decay contribution out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Write CalcHEP/FeynRules model files for the STFM and extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone ODE solver) to solve the coupled N and triplet-NLOP yield equations through the NLOP decay epoch, validating against the primary scan trends in M_N, M_Sigma, and Y_Sigma.

members.model_name: Reheaton-decay nonthermal Dirac fermion dark matter with kination and early matter domination
members.description: No experiment-specific recast exists for the long-lived Higgs-mixed reheaton at DUNE, FASER(-II), MATHUSLA, and SHiP with the branching fraction to dark matter fixed by the relic-density condition.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the reheaton production modes and visible/invisible branching pattern in a public LLP forward-detector sensitivity framework (FORESEE/SensCalc-type machinery for Higgs-portal scalars), imposing the relic-fixed Br(S->chi chi).

members.model_name: Portalino-inspired neutrino-portal Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation used for the relic scan is not released as a public model package, so the end-to-end pipeline from Portalino-model parameters to relic density and search observables is not reusable.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the U(1)_d Portalino model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and publish the micrOMEGAs model files, validating against the paper's resonance relic-density plots.

members.model_name: WIMPy leptogenesis inert-doublet dark matter with early matter domination
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled WIMP-abundance plus lepton-asymmetry Boltzmann equations for the inert-doublet/scalar-triplet WIMPy-leptogenesis model in an early-matter-domination cosmology with entropy dilution near T_end; the paper's custom integrator is private, so the relic/BAU cogenesis window cannot be independently recomputed or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP to generate the annihilation and washout cross sections (cross-checked against the paper's appendices), and couple them to a modified-expansion Boltzmann integrator — e.g. extend a ulysses-style leptogenesis code or the micrOMEGAs nonstandard-cosmology branch with the EMD H(z) and entropy injection near T_end — validating against the paper's published evolution plots.

members.model_name: WIMPy leptogenesis inert-doublet dark matter with fast expanding universe
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled WIMP-abundance plus lepton-asymmetry Boltzmann equations for the inert-doublet/scalar-triplet WIMPy-leptogenesis model in a fast-expanding-universe cosmology (energy density redshifting faster than radiation, parameters n and T_r); the paper's custom integrator is private, so the relic/BAU cogenesis window cannot be independently recomputed or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP to generate the annihilation and washout cross sections (cross-checked against the paper's appendices), and couple them to a modified-expansion Boltzmann integrator — e.g. extend a ulysses-style leptogenesis code or the micrOMEGAs nonstandard-cosmology branch with H(T) scaling as (T/T_r)^(n/2) relative to radiation — validating against the paper's published evolution plots.

members.model_name: WIMPy leptogenesis inert-doublet dark matter with scalar-tensor gravity
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled WIMP-abundance plus lepton-asymmetry Boltzmann equations for the inert-doublet/scalar-triplet WIMPy-leptogenesis model in a scalar-tensor-gravity cosmology with an enhanced Hubble rate relaxing to standard expansion before BBN; the paper's custom integrator is private, so the relic/BAU cogenesis window cannot be independently recomputed or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP to generate the annihilation and washout cross sections (cross-checked against the paper's appendices), and couple them to a modified-expansion Boltzmann integrator — e.g. extend a ulysses-style leptogenesis code or the micrOMEGAs nonstandard-cosmology branch with the scalar-tensor speed-up factor for H(T) — validating against the paper's published evolution plots.

members.model_name: Chiral U(1) B-L scalar dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH/SPheno/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the chiral U(1) B-L model with right-handed-neutrino charges (5,-4,-4), the extra doublet eta, singlet chi, and DM scalar phi_d, so the spectrum, vertices, relic density, and sigma_SI of the source scan cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the chiral B-L Lagrangian in SARAH, export SPheno spectrum-generator code and CalcHEP model files, feed them to micrOMEGAs 5.x, and validate by reproducing the paper's Planck-band scan points and resonance regions.

members.model_name: Adagio dark-photon thermal relic dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-density solver implements freeze-out with a time-dependent effective Planck mass (reduced Hubble rate before a pre-BBN transition at T_*), which is the defining ingredient of the Adagio mechanism; the paper's computation is analytic and not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a lightweight Boltzmann integrator) with H(T) rescaled by mp_early_over_mp_today and a transition at T_*, for the kinetically mixed dark-photon model; validate by recovering the standard thermal relic result at mp_early_over_mp_today = 1 as the card's validation test specifies.

members.model_name: Dirac dark matter with a scalar mediator and modified freeze-out
members.description: No public implementation of the scalar-mediator Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation and bound-state formation/dissociation effective rates for Dirac dark matter with mixed scalar/pseudoscalar Yukawa couplings, including the finite-temperature BSF treatment the source relies on.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published closed-form Coulombic pNREFT rates (Sommerfeld factors, BSF cross sections, ionization-equilibrium effective sigma_v_eff(T)) for the scalar/pseudoscalar coupling structure as an open-source rate module that outputs tabulated effective annihilation rates consumable by micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY as user-defined cross sections.

members.model_name: Z6 singlet Dirac dark matter
members.description: The LanHEP/micrOMEGAs model files for this specific Z6 singlet Dirac model are not public, so reproducing the relic-density and cross-section pipeline requires reimplementing the model from the Lagrangian rather than running released inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Z6 Lagrangian in LanHEP or FeynRules, generate and publicly release the CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate by recovering the paper's viable 60 GeV to 6 TeV mass range and its LZ-compatible scan points.

members.model_name: Local baryon-number anomaly-cancellation Majorana dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (UFO or CalcHEP model files) exists for the U(1)_B anomaly-cancellation spectrum with the leptophobic Z_B, Cucuyo Higgs, and Majorana chi, so relic-density and collider event generation cannot be run out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_B Lagrangian (Z_B, baryon-breaking scalar with Higgs mixing, Majorana chi with n_chi = -3/2) in FeynRules and export UFO/CalcHEP files for use in micrOMEGAs and MadGraph, validating against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours.

members.model_name: Linear-seesaw mixed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: The SARAH model files and SPheno/CalcHEP inputs for the MSSM-plus-linear-seesaw sneutrino sector (nu^c and S superfields with the Y_SL S l H_u term and its sneutrino mass matrices) used in the paper are not established as publicly released, blocking automated spectrum generation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the linear-seesaw superpotential and soft terms in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's WMAP-band scan features and the neutrino-constraint limit on the inelastic-splitting option.

members.model_name: Non-SUSY SO(10) triplet fermion dark matter
members.description: No public relic/annihilation module computes the Sommerfeld-enhanced freeze-out and late-time <sigma v>_WW for the multi-TeV hyperchargeless SU(2)_L triplet; standard perturbative codes miss the resonance structure that moves the thermal mass target (2.4 vs 2.7 TeV) and enhances indirect signals.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or wrap the published wino-like nonrelativistic potential calculation) with electroweak Sommerfeld factors for the (Sigma^0, Sigma^+-) system including the 166 MeV splitting, covering both freeze-out and v ~ 1e-3 halo velocities.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine Q-ball gravitino dark matter in gauge-mediated MSSM
members.description: No gravitino abundance calculator exists that chains Q-ball decay injection, NSP freeze-out/annihilation after injection, NSP decay, and thermal gravitino scattering into a single yield; the card lists the gravitino abundance calculator as unavailable and the thermal-versus-nonthermal channel split is only assumed separable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Boltzmann module that takes (Q, T_d, n_B/s, NSP species, m_3/2, T_re) and solves NSP number density with Q-ball injection and annihilation, adds standard thermal gravitino production, and outputs Omega_3/2 h^2; validate against the source T_re ~ 1e7 GeV thermal benchmark and Y_N ~ 1e-11 examples.

members.model_name: TeV-scale Majorana fermion dark matter with a massive vector portal
members.description: No released model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or micrOMEGAs/MadDM model files) exists for the chiral-coupled massive vector mediator with Majorana dark matter, so the resonant relic scan, collider event generation, and direct-detection operator matching all start from scratch.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP model files, run micrOMEGAs or MadDM for the resonant freeze-out grid (validating the Omega h^2 = 0.120 boundary and the 0.8 < 2 m_DM/M_med < 1.0 window), and match couplings through DirectDM/DDCalc for nuclear-recoil limits.

members.model_name: TeV-scale scalar dark matter with a massive vector portal
members.description: No released model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or micrOMEGAs/MadDM model files) exists for the chiral-coupled massive vector mediator with scalar dark matter, so the resonant relic scan, collider event generation, and direct-detection operator matching all start from scratch.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP model files, run micrOMEGAs or MadDM for the resonant freeze-out grid (validating the Omega h^2 = 0.120 boundary and the 0.8 < 2 m_DM/M_med < 1.0 window), and match couplings through DirectDM/DDCalc for nuclear-recoil limits.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation scalar doublet WIMP Case B
members.description: The catalyzed-BBN constraint on the long-lived charged scalar is only an approximate lifetime label (tau above about 1e3 s); no BBN network calculation with charged-relic catalysis and the actual coannihilation-set primordial X- abundance has been run for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the electroweak-doublet coannihilation freeze-out abundance of X- to a BBN network code extended with catalyzed reactions on charged relics (extending AlterBBN or PRIMAT with the CBBN reaction set), producing a quantitative excluded region in the (tau, Delta m) plane.

members.model_name: Secluded WIMP with right-handed neutrino mediator
members.description: No numerical relic-density implementation of the N_prime/S plus N_R secluded sector exists; the annihilation cross section and freeze-out are only treated analytically, so the abundance-coupling relation across the hierarchy-dependent parameter space (N_prime vs S dark matter) is not computed to modern precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the N_prime, S, N_R Lagrangian as a CalcHEP/FeynRules model file and compute the relic abundance with micrOMEGAs, scanning m_chi, m_NR, and Y_Nprime over both mass hierarchies.

members.model_name: PQ-extended MSSM axino dark matter with thermal inflation
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann/decay-network solver evolves the flaton condensate, radiation, thermally generated NLSP, and axino densities through the thermal-inflation reheating epoch at T_d ~ 100 GeV, so the NLSP-decay contribution to the axino abundance (route step s3) is only estimated analytically; standard relic codes (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY) assume radiation domination without a decaying flaton.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a stiff-ODE network (or extend micrOMEGAs' non-standard-cosmology freeze-out machinery) with equations for rho_flaton, rho_radiation, n_NLSP, and n_axino including flaton branching fractions and NLSP annihilation/decay, validated by recovering the paper's m_axino ~ 0.9-1 GeV benchmark in the flaton-decay-dominated limit.

members.model_name: E6SSM inert neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum-generator or micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation of the E6SSM inert neutralino sector exists, so the Z-pole relic-density benchmarks (m_chi near M_Z/2 with suppressed Z coupling) cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the E6SSM inert Higgsino/singlino sector in SARAH/FeynRules, export a SPheno spectrum generator and CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic densities at the Z resonance.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic scalar doublet dark matter from triplet scalar leptogenesis
members.description: No public code implements the coupled triplet-leptogenesis plus inert-doublet evolution for this model: CP-asymmetric triplet decays, lambda5-driven washout, and eta0-eta0* particle-antiparticle oscillations against freeze-out, which together set whether the scalar dark asymmetry survives (the M_eta0 > ~2 TeV condition).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled Boltzmann system as a public module — triplet decay/washout terms (extending a leptogenesis framework such as ULYSSES) plus a density-matrix or oscillation-rate treatment of eta0-eta0* mixing with gauge/Higgs annihilation from micrOMEGAs cross sections — validated against the freeze-out-before-oscillation mass threshold of about 2 TeV.

members.model_name: Split-neutrino right-handed sneutrino inflaton dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the U(1)_B-L MSSM with a right-handed sneutrino LSP exists per the card, so the freeze-out through B-L gauge interactions for m_N in 100-2000 GeV cannot be computed; the freezeout step names only 'micrOMEGAs or B-L sneutrino relic code' with no model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the B-L MSSM with right-handed sneutrinos in SARAH, generate the spectrum with SPheno, and link the exported model to micrOMEGAs to compute Omega_N h^2 across (m_N, g_B-L, M_B-L).

members.model_name: Z4 two-sector scalar semi-annihilation dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the Z4 two-sector model (coupled Boltzmann equations for the singlet and inert-doublet-like sectors with semi-annihilation and inter-sector reactions) is not publicly released, so the coupled relic benchmark (total h^2 about 0.1 with comparable components) cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Z4 potential as CalcHEP/FeynRules model files in micrOMEGAs 5+, which handles two dark matter components with semi-annihilation and inter-sector conversion, validating against the paper's total h^2 about 0.1 benchmark with comparable sector abundances.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric scalar N1 cogenesis dark matter model
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled Boltzmann system for late modulus decay below the QCD phase transition producing N1 dark matter, entropy dilution, and simultaneous baryogenesis from TeV colored mediator decays; standard relic codes (micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY) assume thermal freeze-out histories that the model explicitly bypasses.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled modulus-radiation-N1-mediator Boltzmann equations with branching-fraction and CP-asymmetry parameters as a standalone module (or extension of micrOMEGAs' non-standard-cosmology mode), parameterized by T_R, Br(S to R-odd), M_X, and the lambda couplings, and validate against the paper's benchmark yield and Omega_B/Omega_DM about 1/5.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn leptoquark-diquark mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO plus micrOMEGAs/MadDM model files) exists for the residual-PQ-Z2 leptoquark-diquark Model II, so the scalar-WIMP relic density, spin-independent cross section, and collider signals cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in FeynRules from the card's operator list (Higgs-portal quartic, KSVZ Yukawa, leptoquark/diquark couplings), export UFO and CalcHEP files, and validate micrOMEGAs relic and sigma_SI output against the primary 100 GeV to few-TeV window.

members.model_name: S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with softly split H2^0 inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No public CalcHEP/FeynRules model implementation of the S3 three-Higgs-doublet inert sector with soft Z2-breaking terms exists; the paper used a private implementation, so relic density, sigma_SI, and Br(h -> H2 H2) cannot be regenerated for arbitrary parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the S3 3HDM scalar potential with soft non-diagonal quadratic terms in FeynRules/CalcHEP, export to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Scenario 2a/2b/2c benchmark relic densities and branching fractions.

members.model_name: Annihilation-product direct-detection dark matter
members.description: The solar capture-and-annihilation calculation needed for the boosted dark-sector flux was never performed, and public capture codes are tailored to standard WIMP-nucleus scattering rather than the model's loop-suppressed or secluded X couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing solar capture module (e.g. the DarkSUSY/Asteria-style capture machinery) to the X capture cross section and X X -> Y Y branching, then propagate the boosted Y flux to large-volume neutrino detectors and direct-detection targets.

members.model_name: SU(2) triplet fermion dark matter with type III seesaw Higgs inflation
members.description: No implemented relic-abundance calculator for the zero-hypercharge SU(2) triplet including Sommerfeld-enhanced coannihilation of the charged partners at M_DM ~ 2.4 TeV; the boltzmann_solver step has no tool and relies on quoted minimal-dark-matter results.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the triplet (wino-like) multiplet in a micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY model file with Sommerfeld-corrected effective cross sections from the minimal-dark-matter/wino literature, validating against the published 2.4 TeV relic benchmark.

members.model_name: Accidental real singlet scalar dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the scale-invariant local U(1)_B-L model with the real singlet scalar S, its SM Higgs and dark-Higgs portals, and the Z_B-L sector, so precision relic-density contours (step s2) cannot be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the scale-invariant B-L Lagrangian (S, Phi, Z_B-L, right-handed neutrinos) and run micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 over (m_S, lambda_sh, lambda_sphi, m_ZBL, m_phi), validating against the paper's m_h/2 resonance and few-TeV dark-Higgs portal regions.

members.model_name: SO(10) scalar-singlet Higgs-portal dark matter model
members.description: No public code implements the model's multi-stage two-loop RGE running from the weak scale through the intermediate SU(3)xSU(2)xSU(2)xU(1) stage to SO(10), including the 16/126 scalar thresholds, so the perturbativity and radiative-EWSB mass window (1.35-2 TeV) cannot be reproduced or rescanned with varied thresholds.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the two-loop RGEs for both stages with SARAH or PyR@TE, encode the source threshold matching at M_int ~ 1e9 GeV, and release the running-and-EWSB scan as a script coupled to the micrOMEGAs relic calculation.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant SU(2)_X vector dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the classically scale-invariant SU(2)_X vector model exists, so the semiannihilation-capable relic solvers that would otherwise cover the Boltzmann step cannot be applied without first coding the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the renormalizable Lagrangian (dark SU(2)_X gauge sector, scalar doublet plus singlet, right-handed neutrinos) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs with semiannihilation enabled, validating against the paper's x_f of 25-26 and the 710-740 GeV relic band.

members.model_name: Majorana fermion dark matter with 750 GeV quark-coupled pseudoscalar portal
members.description: The model has no numerical implementation (computational_representation is null and no associated code exists), so the thermal relic density and the width-to-cross-section mapping are only available through the paper's narrow-resonance analytic approximation, which loses accuracy near the resonance and threshold regions of the (m_chi, M) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Majorana-DM-plus-pseudoscalar simplified model in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via a FeynRules/UFO export to compute the relic density and annihilation cross sections beyond the narrow-width approximation.

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model II
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO, micrOMEGAs or MadDM model files) exists for the Dirac DM plus singly-charged-scalar-singlet Lagrangian, so relic scans and LHC charged-scalar recasts cannot be automated; computational_representation is null and associated code is unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Model II Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO/CalcHEP files, validate against the paper's analytic relic contour (lambda_2 about 1.7 at m_chi about 1.5 TeV), and recast S+ pair production through MadGraph with right-handed slepton-like searches in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis.

members.model_name: Z3-stabilized scalar dark matter in neutrinophilic THDM
members.description: The paper's micrOMEGAs 4.3.5 implementation of the Z3 nuTHDM+X model (scalar potential with semi-annihilation term S*XXX and Goldstone channels) is not publicly released, so the four relic-density scenarios cannot be reproduced or scanned without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and release micrOMEGAs model files including the Z3 semi-annihilation vertices, validated against the paper's Scenario I-IV benchmark relic densities over m_X = 50-500 GeV.

members.model_name: Dark U(1)_X Majorana WIMP for b -> s anomalies
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP or micrOMEGAs model files) exists for the dark U(1)_X Majorana model with N_-/N_+, the q and lepton-like scalars, Z', and dark Higgs H_2, so the relic density across the Yukawa, dark-gauge, and Higgs-portal annihilation scenarios and the spin-independent cross section cannot be computed reproducibly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and reproduce the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours in the three annihilation scenarios plus the sigma_SI(theta_H, M_-) predictions as validation.

members.model_name: Two-scalar Z2 Higgs-portal dark matter without singlet-only s-s' cross-couplings
members.description: The LanHEP/CalcHEP model files for the two-real-scalar Z2 Higgs-portal model (no-cross variant) used for the micrOMEGAs relic scan are not publicly released, so the freeze-out and sigma_SI pipeline cannot be rerun without re-implementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the two-scalar potential in LanHEP or FeynRules from the published Lagrangian, export to micrOMEGAs, and validate by reproducing the m_s = 127-277 GeV viable window and the maximum 25 percent relic fraction at m_s = 210 GeV.

members.model_name: Two-scalar Z2 Higgs-portal dark matter including singlet-only s-s' cross-couplings
members.description: No public LanHEP/CalcHEP model files or micrOMEGAs implementation of the two-real-scalar Z2 Higgs-portal model with the singlet-only s-s' cross-couplings is released, so the relic-density and sigma_SI scan (including coannihilation with s') cannot be rerun or extended beyond the paper-level windows.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the two-scalar potential with all six portal/cross couplings in LanHEP (or FeynRules/CalcHEP), export to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's c2 full-DM window (m_s = 240 GeV to 2.7 TeV) and the a2 benchmark near 126 GeV.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1) Higgs-portal singlet-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of this model's low-energy singlet-doublet sector (m_D, m_S, Y_H with the SO(10)-fixed charge assignments) exists in a relic/direct-detection code, so the 57.10-61.23 GeV allowed window and the y_33 <= 1.5e-2 XENON1T bound are stored only as paper-quoted numbers and cannot be re-derived or updated to newer data (route_status: planned, no associated code).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet-doublet Majorana model in micrOMEGAs (an existing singlet-doublet model file can be adapted with the SO(10) parameter relations), couple it to a DDCalc XENON1T/LZ likelihood plus the Planck Omega_DM h^2 = 0.120 target, and validate by recovering the paper's mass window and coupling bound.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet Z2-odd scalar dark matter in a lepton-specific U(1)_X two-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: The micrOMEGAs 4.3.5 implementation of the U(1)_X lepton-specific THDM with the Z2-odd complex singlet phi-prime and exotic charged leptons is not publicly released, so relic-density and annihilation-rate calculations (including the coannihilation regime the paper neglects) cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP from the paper's charge assignments, scalar potential, and exotic-lepton Yukawa terms, export to micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's three benchmark scenarios and the 0.11 < Omega h^2 < 0.13 scan window, and release the model files.

members.model_name: chameleon scalaron dark matter in F(R) gravity with R^2 correction
members.description: No public integrator exists for the chameleon scalaron background in F(R)+R^2 gravity: solving phi(t), phi_min(T), and m_phi(T) through the radiation era requires coupling the Einstein-frame equation of motion to the thermal matter trace T_mu^mu(T) from the QCD equation of state, and no such code is identified.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated ODE integrator (standard scipy/Boltzmann-adjacent stack) for the Einstein-frame scalaron with V_eff(phi, T) built from the tabulated lattice-QCD trace anomaly (e.g. the Borsanyi et al. equation of state), reproducing the paper's damped-oscillation behavior as a validation test, and release it with the registry.

members.model_name: LSP dark matter in Affleck-Dine hilltop supernatural inflation
members.description: No public code implements the coupled reheating/gravitino/LSP Boltzmann system of this scenario: thermal LSP production in a low-T_R plasma plus nonthermal production from gravitino and inflaton decay with BBN consistency, which the card itself lists as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with a reheating-era Boltzmann module that tracks inflaton, gravitino, and LSP number densities as functions of T_R, m_3/2, m_LSP, and sigma_v, including the T_R < 2e10 GeV (100 GeV/m_LSP) production bound and gravitino/BBN decay constraints.

members.model_name: Vector-like lepton mediated heavy dark photon freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No public FeynRules/UFO (or equivalent) model implementation of the heavy stable A_H plus charge -1 vector-like lepton simplified model exists, so the MadDM/micrOMEGAs relic-density and sigma_SI calculations used in the paper cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the h A_H A_H portal operator and the A_H-E-lepton interaction in FeynRules with couplings c_AHh and q_H, export a UFO model for MadDM/micrOMEGAs including coannihilation channels, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours in the compressed and uncompressed regimes.

members.model_name: Z2-odd Y=0 inert SU(2) triplet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density tool includes the Sommerfeld enhancement and bound-state effects of SU(2)L gauge interactions for the Y=0 scalar triplet near the TeV scale, so the full-relic mass quoted as ~1176 GeV (and hence the quantitative severity of the relic/phase-transition tension) carries an uncontrolled O(10%) uncertainty from tree-level-only freeze-out codes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or interface a dedicated electroweak-multiplet code following the wino/minimal-dark-matter Sommerfeld literature) with the SU(2)L Sommerfeld factors and coannihilation network for the scalar triplet, and recompute the full-relic mass and the underabundance factor across the FOPT-compatible m_T < ~320 GeV region.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal real scalar dark matter with vector-like leptons
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) of the muon-philic scalar plus vector-like lepton doublet-singlet Lagrangian exists, so the micrOMEGAs coannihilation relic calculation and any collider event generation cannot be run out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the L, E, X Lagrangian with mixing in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO model files, and validate the micrOMEGAs relic output against the paper's nearly-degenerate m_E1 < 200 GeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Z3 complex scalar inflaton-dark-matter model
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the Z3 complex scalar with Higgs mixing and semi-annihilation: the thermal relic density (including chi chi -> chi* X semi-annihilation channels) and the theta-suppressed nucleon scattering cross section cannot be recomputed without building the model files (associated_code unknown, step s2 tool generic).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z3 complex scalar Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP and load it into micrOMEGAs, whose discrete-symmetry machinery handles Z3 semi-annihilation; couple the output to a public direct-detection likelihood (e.g. DDCalc with XENON1T/LZ) and validate against the source window |theta| < 0.25, m_chi > 80 GeV, m_h2 > 300 GeV.

members.model_name: Minimal light lepton portal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) exists for the singlet Dirac chi plus extra scalar doublet with flavor-specific lepton-portal Yukawas, blocking reusable relic-density computation and collider event generation.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP files for MadGraph and micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic contours and the roughly 350 GeV m_Hplus perturbativity ceiling.

members.model_name: Singlet-extended light lepton portal dark matter
members.description: No numerical model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP model file) exists for the singlet-extended lepton-portal Lagrangian with the doublet-singlet mixed scalar sector, so the thermal relic abundance mediated by the light singlet-like scalar cannot be computed with standard tools; the paper-level result relies on rescaling the minimal model with m_H -> m_s.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the extended Lagrangian (inert doublet plus Z2-odd singlet with A_S eta^dagger H S mixing and lepton-portal Yukawas) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO files, and run micrOMEGAs to compute Omega h^2 over (m_chi, m_s, theta_s, y_i), validating against the paper's minimal-model rescaling.

members.model_name: Simplified new Littlest Higgs with T-parity heavy photon dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model implementation of the simplified NLHT (heavy photon LTP, T-odd lepton co-annihilators, kappa_l/kappa_q Yukawa structure) used by the paper is not publicly released, so neither the micrOMEGAs relic scan nor any collider study can be rerun for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or reimplement the NLHT Lagrangian in FeynRules and export CalcHEP/UFO model files, validating against the paper's benchmarks (m_lH approximately 1.16 M_AH relic band and kappa_l approximately 0.185 at f = 900 GeV) before public release.

members.model_name: Light two-Higgs-doublet scalar forbidden dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists for the light-2HDM scalar forbidden dark matter Lagrangian in a public relic solver, so the Boltzmann-suppressed forbidden freeze-out (which requires careful thermal averaging across the lepton threshold with splitting Delta) cannot be scanned quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 2HDM plus scalar-S model with lambda_ab portal couplings and leptophilic Y_l in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs relic scans over (m_DM, m_H, Delta, lambda_12, Y_l) in the forbidden branch, validating threshold thermal averaging against the analytic forbidden-DM treatment.

members.model_name: Lowest-energy higgson WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model file) of the lowest-energy higgson with its second-order W/Z gauge interactions exists, so the MicrOMEGAs relic-density and annihilation results pinning m_h near 70 GeV cannot be reproduced, scanned, or fed into MadDM/MadGraph pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model of the higgson sector from the parent-theory Lagrangian, export CalcHEP and UFO files, and validate the MicrOMEGAs pipeline against the paper's Omega_DM h^2 = 0.134-0.162 for m_h = 70.5-69.5 GeV and sigma_v = 1.19e-26 cm^3/s.

members.model_name: Dark-sector seeded Nelson-Barr scalar WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP files) of the Z8 Nelson-Barr dark sector for a relic-density solver, so the eta_1 freeze-out including the Higgs-resonance dip and the H_1/H_2-mediated channels beyond the minimal singlet case cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the inert scalars eta_i, even scalars H_1/H_2, and portal couplings in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs, and validate by recovering the m_eta1 ~ 62.6 GeV Higgs-resonance dip and the H_1/H_2 annihilation regions reported in the paper.

members.model_name: Type-II radiative scalar triplet dark matter with vector-like lepton doublets
members.description: The LanHEP/micrOMEGAs model implementation for the two-inert-triplet plus vector-like-lepton-doublet field content is not publicly released, so the relic-density and sigma_SI scan cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild and publish the model files: encode the scalar potential, triplet mass matrices, and Yukawa sector in LanHEP (or FeynRules/CalcHEP), validate against the paper's benchmark points near Omega h^2 = 0.12, and release with micrOMEGAs run scripts.

members.model_name: B_3-L_2 Dirac right-handed-neutrino thermal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the U(1)_{B3-L2} Lagrangian (Z' couplings to third-generation quarks, second-generation leptons, and the x_N-charged Dirac state) exists for standard relic and precision-observable pipelines, so the Omega h^2 contours and g-2 overlap cannot be regenerated or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a FeynRules/LanHEP model file for the B3-L2 gauge sector and run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM, validating against the paper's Omega_chi h^2 ~ 0.1 contours and the x_N=5, m_chi=5 MeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Light Self-Interacting Dark Matter (LSIDM) model
members.description: No Boltzmann/relic solver is set up for freeze-out in the model's fast-expansion cosmology: existing public codes (micrOMEGAs, MadDM) assume standard radiation domination and there is no public LSIDM model implementation, so the enhanced relic abundance with H(T) boosted by a component redshifting as T^(4+n) down to T_r cannot be computed off the shelf.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the LSIDM Lagrangian in FeynRules/micrOMEGAs and modify the solver's Hubble rate to include the fast-redshifting component parameterized by (n, T_r), following micrOMEGAs' non-standard-cosmology hooks; validate by recovering the paper's relic contours and the T_r > (15.4)^(1/n) MeV BBN condition.

members.model_name: Majorana Majoron ALP dark matter
members.description: No numerical transport/Boltzmann implementation exists for spontaneous leptogenesis sourced by the rotating Majoron with Weinberg-operator lepton-number violation, so the baryon-asymmetry and relic-density benchmark can only be reproduced as an order-of-magnitude analytic estimate rather than scanned or used in a numerical likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement coupled equations of motion for the rotating Majoron field plus lepton-number transport equations (chemical potentials with Weinberg-operator and sphaleron rates), e.g. as an extension of an axiogenesis/leptogenesis solver such as ULYSSES, outputting Y_B and Omega_a h^2 over (m_a, f_a, dot theta_i, T_W).

members.model_name: U(1)_R x U(1)_{B-L} extended-gauge sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH/SPheno/CalcHEP implementation of the U(1)_R x U(1)_{B-L} sneutrino model is established: the paper's model files, soft-term inputs, and micrOMEGAs interface were not released, so the spectrum and relic/direct-detection pipeline cannot be rerun as-is.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the U(1)_R x U(1)_{B-L} superpotential, extra U(1) charges, and gauge kinetic mixing in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP model files, and link them to a current micrOMEGAs release (5.x) to reproduce the relic-density and sigma_SI scan.

members.model_name: S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with degenerate CP-even inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No public CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with two degenerate inert doublets exists, including the two-component freeze-out setup that tracks Omega_H2 and Omega_H3 separately; the paper's implementation is private, so the summed relic density and component fractions cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the S3 3HDM inert sector in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through the micrOMEGAs multi-component (two-DM) mode to obtain Omega_H2 h^2, Omega_H3 h^2, and local component fractions, validating against the Scenario 1a/1b benchmarks and annihilation fractions.

members.model_name: Flavor-specific scalar mediator secluded Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density solver combines secluded freeze-out to scalar mediators with Sommerfeld enhancement, bound-state formation, and early kinetic decoupling (coupled Boltzmann) for this MeV-mediator Dirac dark matter; the paper's DRAKE-based setup covers kinetic decoupling but not bound-state formation, and micrOMEGAs lacks both.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DRAKE (or micrOMEGAs) with Sommerfeld-corrected annihilation and scalar-mediator bound-state formation/dissociation rates following the arXiv:1606.02305 formalism, parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, alpha_chi), and validate against the paper's Case-1/2/3 relic curves.

members.model_name: Deeply bound uuddss sexaquark dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/rate solver exists for sexaquark abundance evolution across the QCD transition: the network of XS -> BB' breakup, formation, and baryon statistical-equilibrium reactions around T ~ 150 MeV is outside the scope of standard relic codes such as micrOMEGAs or MadDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a dedicated hadronic-era Boltzmann network (S, baryons, mesons) with the lattice QCD equation of state and parameterized matrix elements from gap_1, verifying the lambda < ~2e-6 non-thermalization boundary and mapping the surviving-abundance contour in (m_S, lambda).

members.model_name: Fermionic U(1)_X dark matter with Higgs charge and kinetic mixing
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP or micrOMEGAs model file) exists for the U(1)_X model with both kinetic mixing and a SM-Higgs U(1)_X charge q_H, so the relic-density and direct-detection scans cannot be reproduced or extended with the public tools the paper invokes.
