members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full Lagrangian (kinetic mixing, Z-Z' mass mixing from q_H, dark Yukawa sector) in FeynRules, export UFO/CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's m_Zprime=500 GeV scan and the two-order sigma_SI suppression benchmark in micrOMEGAs and MadDM.

members.model_name: Stable brane-vector dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the brane-vector EFT exists: the F_X^-4-suppressed couplings to the SM energy-momentum tensor and hypercharge field strengths (K1, K2) are in no released FeynRules/CalcHEP model, and the authors' custom freeze-out code is unreleased, so Omega_X h^2 across the M_X-F_X-N plane cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the world-volume effective action operators (X_i X_i T_SM / F_X^4 and the K1/K2 hypercharge terms) in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs for the multi-flavor SO(N) freeze-out, and validate against the paper's WMAP-boundary contours (its Fig. 3 red/green regions).

members.model_name: S3 schizophrenic-neutrino right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No model implementation of the TeV-scale B-L MSSM with a right-handed sneutrino LSP exists in a public relic-density code, so the thermal freeze-out abundance through Z-prime-mediated annihilation cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the B-L extended MSSM (Z-prime, RH sneutrinos, B-L Higgs sector) in SARAH/FeynRules and generate a micrOMEGAs or MadDM model file to scan relic density over (m_sneutrino, M_Zprime, g_B-L).

members.model_name: Inert doublet model new viable region
members.description: No collider recast exists projecting LHC dilepton-plus-MET searches (Run 1 in the card, and later runs) onto the specific A0/H+- mass splittings of the new relic-density-compatible region, so the complementary collider exclusion cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast electroweak-ino/slepton dilepton-plus-MET searches onto inert-scalar pair production using MadGraph event generation with the public IDM UFO model plus CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 recast cards, scanning the mass splittings allowed by the relic-density band.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant hidden-sector pion cold dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation (model file or code) exists for hidden-pion relic abundance, spin-independent nuclear scattering, and invisible scalar branching fractions through the singlet/Higgs mixing portal; the card lists computational_representation as null and has_associated_code: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the effective pion-singlet-Higgs Lagrangian (from gap_1) as a FeynRules/CalcHEP model and run micrOMEGAs to compute Omega h^2, sigma_SI, and the mixed-scalar invisible widths across the (m_pi_h, lambda_SH, lambda_k, theta) space.

members.model_name: Radiative seesaw minimal dark matter Majorana quintuplet model
members.description: No public code computes Sommerfeld-enhanced (and bound-state-corrected) coannihilation freeze-out for the SU(2)_L Majorana quintuplet, so the 9-10 TeV thermal mass window that anchors both the relic constraint and the direct-detection mass prediction cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled-channel Sommerfeld/bound-state freeze-out for electroweak n-plets (following the Cirelli-Mitridate-Panci-Redigolo minimal-dark-matter treatments) as a micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY extension parameterized by multiplet dimension and mass, and validate against the published quintuplet mass window.

members.model_name: Z3 symmetric scalar semi-annihilation dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the Z3 mixed singlet-doublet scalar model (with the x1 x1 -> x1* h semi-annihilation channel) used in the paper is not publicly released, so the freeze-out benchmark (Omega h^2 = 0.105, 54 percent semi-annihilation) cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Z3 scalar potential via FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, which supports semi-annihilation natively, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.105 benchmark with 54 percent semi-annihilation fraction.

members.model_name: pMSSM gravitino LSP model set
members.description: The NLSP-to-gravitino decay module (lifetimes and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions for varying NLSP identity and gravitino mass from eV to TeV) exists only as a private modification of SUSY-HIT, so tau_NLSP and injection spectra cannot be recomputed publicly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the goldstino-coupling NLSP decay widths (suppressed by the SUSY-breaking scale F) as a public extension of SUSY-HIT or a micrOMEGAs add-on module, covering neutralino, slepton, stop, and gluino NLSP cases.

members.model_name: Scalar singlet-triplet Z2 dark matter model
members.description: No public FeynRules/SARAH model file plus micrOMEGAs implementation of the Z2-odd singlet-triplet scalar potential is released, so the paper's relic-density scan over (m_1, theta, delta, lambda_11, lambda_22) with coannihilation cannot be reproduced directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full scalar potential in SARAH or FeynRules with the paper's conventions, export to micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP, and validate against the pure-singlet and pure-triplet limiting cases and the paper's scenario bands.

members.model_name: Big-Bang Dark Nucleosynthesis nuclear dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the BBDN fusion/fission reaction network: the dark-nucleus size distribution over dark nucleon number A (up to ~1e8) is known only in the paper's analytic efficient-fusion and bottleneck limits, so general (m1, E_b, sigma1, T_b/T) parameter points cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Smoluchowski-type coagulation network solver with the paper's geometric fusion cross-section scaling laws, dissociation freeze-out, and optional small-A bottlenecks, validated by recovering the logarithmically peaked distribution in the efficient-fusion regime and the bottleneck-controlled large-A tail.

members.model_name: SU(2) fiveplet fermion dark matter with type I seesaw Higgs inflation
members.description: No implemented relic-abundance calculator for the SU(2) fiveplet with zero hypercharge including Sommerfeld-enhanced coannihilation of the multiplet components at M_DM ~ 4.4 TeV; the card's boltzmann_solver step has no tool and relies on quoted minimal-dark-matter results.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the fiveplet in a micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY model file and add Sommerfeld-corrected effective annihilation cross sections following the minimal-dark-matter literature, validating against the published 4.4 TeV relic benchmark.

members.model_name: Dark left-right scotino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the dark left-right model's leptophilic sector (scotino, charged/doubly charged triplet Higgs, generalized R-parity) exists for a relic solver, so the coannihilation relic density and internal-bremsstrahlung annihilation spectra cannot be recomputed; the paper's tools (PPPC4DMID, GALPROP) are generic analysis codes, not a DLRM implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the scotino-triplet sector including the c_d Yukawa and near-degenerate Delta_R+ spectrum, export to micrOMEGAs for coannihilation relic density and mu+mu-(gamma) internal-bremsstrahlung spectra, and validate against the published m_chi=800 GeV, z=1.02 benchmark.

members.model_name: Two-portal fermionic dark matter model
members.description: The authors' LanHEP/CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files for the two-portal U(1)-prime Lagrangian are not public, so annihilation cross sections and the relic density cannot be recomputed without reimplementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the published renormalizable Lagrangian (Dirac chi, complex scalar phi, leptophobic Z-prime, Higgs-mixed scalar) in FeynRules or LanHEP, export CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's viable-mass-range and 34 GeV b-bbar benchmark.

members.model_name: SUSY SU(2)_H confinement model with Z2- and R-parity dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation exists for the model's relic density, direct-detection rate, radiative neutrino masses, and LFV rates; the paper's combined checks are benchmark assertions with no reusable code or likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the low-energy effective model in SARAH/FeynRules, generate SPheno and micrOMEGAs model files to compute the relic abundance, sigma_DD, neutrino mass matrix, and LFV rates, and validate against the paper's benchmark table.

members.model_name: vector-like sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum-generator or micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the MSSM plus vector-like lepton doublets plus right-handed neutrino sector; the authors' FeynRules-generated CalcHEP files were never released, so relic density with slepton coannihilation and sigma_SI cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's superpotential and soft terms in FeynRules (or SARAH), export CalcHEP/UFO model files including the split CP-even/CP-odd sneutrino states and coannihilating sleptons, validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1199 benchmarks and the 370 GeV all-slepton coannihilation point, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant SU(2)_DM vector dark matter with leptogenesis
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs (or equivalent) model implementation exists for the SU(2)_DM vector triplet with semi-annihilation, so the relic-density scan and the phi < 17 TeV overclosure boundary cannot be independently recomputed at new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the scale-invariant SU(2)_DM Lagrangian (three degenerate Z' states, scalar mixing, semi-annihilation vertices) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and load it into micrOMEGAs, which supports semi-annihilation natively; validate against the published scan boundaries.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1) vector-like quark model with inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP) exists for the gauged U(1) model with Z2-odd vector-like quarks and complex inert scalar DM, so the pole-aware resonant relic density and the loop-induced spin-independent scattering cross section cannot be recomputed with standard solvers.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (Z-prime, three vector-like quark doublets, inert complex scalar) in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs, and use its resonance-aware thermal averaging for Omega h^2 plus its loop-level effective-coupling machinery for sigma_SI; validate against the paper's m_Zprime ~ 2 m_eta strip.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant two-singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the two-singlet scale-invariant model used for the relic-density scan is not published, so the combined relic-density plus direct-detection plus phase-transition scan cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the h-s-s' scalar potential in FeynRules/CalcHEP, export micrOMEGAs model files, validate against the paper's m_sprime > 4.5 TeV and m_s > 200 GeV benchmarks, and release the files with the scan scripts.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter in partially composite supersymmetry
members.description: No implemented pipeline computes the combined thermal (T_R-dependent scattering) and nonthermal (NLSP superWIMP) gravitino yield for this spectrum; the card records only analytic estimates and flags that precision requires a yield code coupling NLSP freeze-out to gravitino production.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY NLSP freeze-out output with the standard thermal gravitino production rate (Bolz-Brandenburg-Buchmuller/Pradler-Steffen formulas) in a scan script over (T_R, m_3/2, m_g, m_NLSP), validated against the paper's reheating-temperature contours.

members.model_name: Secluded vector dark matter with hidden scalar mediator
members.description: No public solver reproduces the paper's coupled Boltzmann moment equations for the secluded sector: X and S number densities and separate hidden-sector temperatures, including cannibal 3-to-2 reactions, hidden-sector kinetic decoupling, and out-of-equilibrium S decay in the small-mixing nonconventional regimes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a moment-based freeze-out code such as DRAKE, or the hidden-sector temperature machinery in micrOMEGAs 6, to two coupled hidden species with independent temperature evolution and late S decay, validated against the paper's m_X = 80 GeV benchmark relic curves.

members.model_name: Extra U(1)_X right-handed Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No implementation of this U(1)_X model (chi_1 with axial-vector X couplings and chi_2 co-annihilation controlled by the S_1R-S_2R mixing angle and mass gap) exists in a public relic-density code, so the Planck band Omega h^2 = 0.1188-0.1212 cannot be independently mapped onto (m_chi1, M_X, g_X, theta, delta); the route lists a Boltzmann freeze-out solver as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model file in FeynRules with the paper's charge assignment n1 = n4 = 1/sqrt(2), export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and use micrOMEGAs' co-annihilation machinery to recompute Omega h^2 across the scanned ranges, validating against the paper's allowed contours.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the inelastic B-L scalar model exists: the S/P coannihilation relic density with the off-diagonal Z-prime coupling, Higgs-portal cross sections, and present-day annihilation are all computed privately in the paper, with no FeynRules/CalcHEP files or micrOMEGAs port released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-singlet U(1) B-L scalar sector (S, P, Z', h/H mixing) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs, which already treats coannihilation automatically; validate against the paper's m_S-m_Z_prime relic curves at the benchmark splitting m_P - m_S = 0.01 m_S.

members.model_name: FASER fermionic dark-sector cascade model
members.description: The relic abundance is set only by an approximate analytic pb-scale freeze-out target; no Boltzmann relic-density implementation of the Y anti-Y to neutral-intermediate annihilation with the V mediator exists, so the coupling-relic relation g_Y(m_V, m_Y) carries uncontrolled precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the simplified model (Y, X, V, neutral scalar intermediates and their couplings) in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via a FeynRules/UFO model file and solve the freeze-out Boltzmann equations, verifying the benchmark g_Y about 0.07 (m_V/10 GeV)^1/2 relation.

members.model_name: FASER scalar dark-sector cascade model
members.description: The scalar relic abundance and the late X-pair depletion condition (lambda_2 above about 1e-4 m_X/GeV) rest on analytic cross-section estimates only; no coupled Boltzmann implementation of the lambda_2/lambda_3 quartic annihilations exists, so the freeze-out and X-depletion coupling targets carry uncontrolled precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar X/Y model with its quartic couplings (lambda_1, lambda_2, lambda_3) in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via a FeynRules/UFO model file and solve the coupled Y freeze-out and late X-depletion Boltzmann equations, verifying the paper's lambda benchmarks.

members.model_name: Three-scalar inelastic scalar dark matter model for muon g-2 and XENON1T
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the three-scalar model with nearly degenerate components, trilinear mediator couplings, and Z3 semi-annihilation, so the claimed simultaneous relic/CMB-safe solution cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full scalar potential and effective lepton Yukawas in micrOMEGAs (which supports Z3 semi-annihilation) and solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for both dark scalar components and the Z3 scalar, verifying the subdominant Z3 fraction below about 1e-3.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar dark matter in a gauged U(1)_ model
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP model file) exists for this gauged U(1) extension with vector-like quarks and leptons, inert scalars eta_l/eta_q, and the Z-prime, so the relic density near the Z-prime resonance cannot be computed with micrOMEGAs and the four-muon and dimuon+MET LHC signatures cannot be simulated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in FeynRules from the paper's Lagrangian, export UFO and CalcHEP files, compute the relic density and annihilation cross sections with micrOMEGAs (validating against the source 0.11 < Omega h^2 < 0.13 band and narrow g_prime-q_x region), and simulate the multimuon and dimuon+MET channels with MadGraph5+Pythia+Delphes.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant O(N) scalar dark matter with singlet mediator
members.description: The CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the O(N) conformal scalar model used by the authors is not public, so the relic-density and sigma_SI pipeline cannot be rerun or extended (e.g. to updated direct-detection limits or N other than 2) without re-implementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the H-S-phi scalar potential in FeynRules/CalcHEP for micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's Omega_CDM h^2 band and the M_phi ~ 1070 GeV lower bound, then refresh s4 with current LZ/XENONnT limits.

members.model_name: Stueckelberg U(1)_X scotogenic fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the U(1)_X Stueckelberg scotogenic sector: the authors' micrOMEGAs 5.2.4 vertices are unreleased, so relic density, sigma_N, and LFV rates cannot be recomputed or scanned beyond the paper's benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (N, two inert doublets, Stueckelberg Z-prime) in SARAH/FeynRules to auto-generate micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP files for relic density and scattering plus SPheno/FlavorKit output for mu -> e gamma, mu -> 3e, and mu-e conversion, validating against the paper's viable (m_N, g_X) region.

members.model_name: Complex singlet scalar model with stable pseudoscalar A dark matter
members.description: No public calculator gives the one-loop spin-independent DM-nucleon cross section for the CxSM pseudoscalar: the tree-level rate is velocity suppressed to irrelevance, so the direct-detection observable cannot be evaluated with standard tools, which stop at tree level.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published one-loop CxSM pseudoscalar-nucleon matching as a public module (extending micrOMEGAs or a DirectDM/DirectDet-style effective-operator pipeline) and compare against current XENONnT/LZ limits and the neutrino floor.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D isospin-charged gauge-boson dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP model file) of the SU(2)_D gauge sector with dark Higgs doublet, Higgs bi-doublet, and vector-like leptons exists, so the forbidden V+V- -> V0V0 freeze-out and the Higgs-mediated nucleon cross section cannot be computed with micrOMEGAs/MadDM despite those solvers supporting forbidden channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the full SU(2)_D Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/UFO, and run micrOMEGAs for the forbidden-channel relic density and spin-independent nucleon cross section (fed to DDCalc for the XENON1T likelihood), validating against the paper's relic-density corridor and shaded XENON1T exclusion.

members.model_name: Scalar-condensate electroweak non-restoration dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/kinetic solver exists for oscillation-assisted depletion of an asymmetric scalar condensate: the coupled evolution of phi and phi-dagger number densities under a small U(1)-breaking oscillation term, charge washout, and Higgs-mediated annihilation is treated only by the paper's simplified estimate, which the paper itself flags as needing dedicated study.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and implement momentum-integrated kinetic equations for the phi/phi-dagger system with an oscillation source term (analogous to oscillating asymmetric-dark-matter treatments), Higgs-mediated annihilation, and elastic-scattering-induced decoherence, as a standalone solver or an extension of a micrOMEGAs-style asymmetric-freeze-out module; validate against the paper's H_ann/H_WIMP scaling limit.

members.model_name: Muon-specific real scalar dark matter in a modular A4 hidden U(1)_H quark-lepton model
members.description: The relic density is computed with an analytic x_F ~ 25 freeze-out approximation for a strongly d-wave-suppressed cross section, without coannihilation with the nearby CP-odd partner phi_u_I or the charged lepton E, which the collider-favored small mass splittings make relevant.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs (via the FeynRules/CalcHEP interface) to solve the full Boltzmann equation with thermal averaging of the v^4-suppressed cross section and phi_u_I/E coannihilations, and re-derive the f_mu(m_phi, m_E) relation used in the relic/g-2 overlap.

members.model_name: Z_2 complex scalar singlet asymmetric dark matter from CP-violating scatterings
members.description: No public relic-density code solves asymmetric freeze-out driven by CP-violating 2-to-2 self-scatterings (phi phi to anti-phi anti-phi and conversion channels) coupled to CP-conserving pair annihilation; standard tools like micrOMEGAs assume CP-conserving networks and cannot track the particle-antiparticle yield split of this model, and the thesis integrator is unreleased.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the thesis's coupled Y_phi/Y_antiphi Boltzmann network with the unitarity-constrained CP-violating rates as a standalone integrator (or a micrOMEGAs extension supplying the asymmetric collision terms), validated against the symmetric-WIMP and fully-asymmetric limiting cases the thesis checks.

members.model_name: R-parity-conserving minimal SUSY U(1)_X gaugino-singlet neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (SARAH/FeynRules to micrOMEGAs pipeline) exists for the minimal SUSY U(1)_X gaugino-singlet neutralino, so the resonance-sensitive relic density (which depends on the Z-prime width including the invisible channel and the chi_l-chi_h mixing) cannot be recomputed or scanned outside the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_X superfield content and neutralino mass matrix in SARAH, generate SPheno spectra and a micrOMEGAs model, and validate against the paper's benchmark (m_Zprime=4.5 TeV, x_H=-0.5, alpha_gX about 0.00793 reaching Omega h^2=0.12).

members.model_name: R-parity neutralino dark matter in a split-SUSY SO(10) GUT
members.description: No pipeline connects the SO(10) split-SUSY benchmark parameters (M_SUSY, M_W, GUT-scale boundary conditions) to a low-scale neutralino spectrum and a quantitative relic-density calculation; the paper relies on generic wino/higgsino mass guidance, and the composition-dependent relic abundance and direct-detection predictions for BP1-BP3 are never computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a split-SUSY spectrum interface (RGE running from the GUT benchmarks to the electroweakino sector) feeding micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY, including Sommerfeld-corrected annihilation for TeV winos/higgsinos and coannihilation/heavy-Higgs resonance effects, to turn the quoted mass windows into computed Omega h^2 and sigma_SI values per benchmark.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet scalar dark matter assisted by a Y=1 vector-like triplet lepton
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP model files implement the inert doublet plus Y=1 vector-like triplet lepton with the tiny lambda_N dark Yukawa, so the coupled scalar-triplet Boltzmann evolution (coannihilation plus late decays) cannot be rerun in micrOMEGAs.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and use darkOmegaNTR to reproduce the source relic heat maps including the compressed-spectrum coannihilation and lambda_N-controlled decay terms.

members.model_name: GMSB messenger-sector scalar dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the extended GMSB messenger sector (phi0/phi+ with lambda_S, lambda_N, eta_S, eta_N, k couplings) exists in a relic-density code, so the 13-30 TeV thermal window, coannihilation with the charged state, and the charged-neutral splitting cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the messenger-sector Lagrangian in FeynRules and run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute Omega h^2 with phi+/phi0 coannihilation, checking for Sommerfeld/bound-state effects relevant at 20-30 TeV, and validate against the source M=50/150 TeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: SO(2N) baryonic glueball dark matter
members.description: No implemented module computes the baryonic glueball relic abundance from the Kibble-Zurek-like confinement production mechanism (bubble statistics, Z2-charge trapping, ordinary-glueball decay dilution); the abundance exists only as a hand estimate with O(1) uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a semi-analytic production code that evolves the confinement phase transition bubble/correlation-length statistics, tracks the Z2-charged remnant number density, and applies entropy dilution from ordinary glueball decays, parameterized by (N, Lambda, a, b) and validated against the paper's N-Lambda abundance band.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with lepton-number violating transfer operators
members.description: No public code tracks the coupled X-lepton-baryon chemical-potential evolution through sphaleron decoupling, including the lepton-number bleed-off regime where continued X-L transfer below sphaleron freeze-out depletes X number; the route's required chemical-potential solver and asymmetric-abundance calculator exist only as the paper's analytic approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Build (or extend micrOMEGAs' asymmetric-abundance module into) a coupled Boltzmann/chemical-potential solver spanning sphaleron decoupling and operator decoupling, so the bleed-off Omega_DM/Omega_B prediction is numerical rather than an instantaneous-decoupling estimate.

members.model_name: Nonthermal hypercharged multiplet dark matter from reheating
members.description: The chain from a detected mass to a reheating-temperature window relies on the paper's analytic freeze-in-during-reheating estimate; no reusable numerical Boltzmann/reheating calculator that tracks the bath-scattering source between T_max and T_R for general multiplet dimension k and hypercharge Y is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the number-density Boltzmann equation with the reheating-era temperature evolution and the electroweak pair-production source term for general (k, Y), validating against the paper's forecast that a detection at M_DM about 1e10-1e11 GeV pins T_R to roughly 1e7-1e9 GeV.

members.model_name: Model B radiative-seesaw dark matter with dark radiation
members.description: No numerical implementation of the Model B Z2 x Z2' Lagrangian exists, so the eta_R relic density, Higgs-portal sigma_SI, and LFV rates cannot be computed or scanned jointly; only the analytic Delta N_eff relation is currently evaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in SARAH/FeynRules to generate a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model for the eta_R freeze-out and direct detection, and SPheno+FlavorKit output for the LFV branching ratios, then scan (m_eta_R, lambda_2, lambda_3, Yukawa matrix) against LZ/XENONnT limits via DDCalc and MEG/mu-to-e limits, validating against the paper's 250-500 GeV viable region.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: The FeynRules/calcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files for the leptophilic scalar-DM scalar-mediator simplified model are not publicly released, so the annihilation, loop-induced nucleon scattering, and relic-density pipeline cannot be rerun without re-implementing the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the scalar-DM plus spin-0 mediator Lagrangian (scalar and pseudoscalar lepton couplings) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO model files for micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's relic-density and <sigma v>_0 benchmarks, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with vector mediator
members.description: The FeynRules/calcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files for the complex-scalar-DM leptophilic Z-prime simplified model are not publicly released, so the relic-density and scattering pipeline cannot be rerun without re-implementing the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the complex-scalar DM current coupled to a leptophilic Z-prime (vector and axial-vector lepton couplings) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO files for micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's relic-density benchmarks and its velocity-suppression conclusion, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: BLSMIS keV S_1^1 freeze-in warm dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the BLSMIS freeze-in calculation: the paper used SARAH plus SPheno/micrOMEGAs and a custom freeze-in integrator for nonthermal Z' production, but no model files or repository are released, so the relic-density benchmarks cannot be reproduced or scanned by third parties.
members.proposed_resolution: Release (or rebuild) the SARAH BLSMIS model files and implement the nonthermal-Z' freeze-in yield calculation in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module, validating against the paper's single-component benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Tsallis-statistics WIMP freeze-out
members.description: No public freeze-out solver supports Tsallis q-deformed equilibrium distributions with a time-dependent q(x) relaxation in the Boltzmann collision term; the paper's custom integrator is unreleased and standard relic codes assume Boltzmann-Gibbs statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a lightweight single-species freeze-out integrator with the q-generalized distributions and collision term, parameterized by (q0, q(x) relaxation, m_chi, <sigma v>), validating against the paper's q0=1 canonical target (2.2-2.6e-26 cm^3/s) and the q0=1.05, 100 GeV benchmark near 3e-34 cm^3/s.

members.model_name: Resonance-scanning Higgs-portal light fermion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/relic-abundance solver supports a temperature-dependent dark matter mass crossing the Higgs resonance with the paper's kinetic-equilibrium and adiabaticity validity checks; the published yield rests on private custom integration, so the resonance-scanning relic prediction cannot be independently evaluated or scanned over parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public relic framework (e.g. add m_DM(T) support to micrOMEGAs' thermally averaged cross-section machinery or to a DRAKE-style momentum-averaged solver), including automated Gamma_scatt/H and mass-change adiabaticity monitors, validated against the paper's benchmark yield.

members.model_name: Asymmetrically reheated Twin Higgs Portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation of the Twin Higgs Portal scalar exists: the freeze-out yield Y_f including twin-sector Higgs-mediated annihilation channels (and the pNGB/radial-mode mediator structure) is not available in stock micrOMEGAs/MadDM model libraries.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the THPDM Lagrangian (S with lambda_HS coupling to both H_A and H_B, twin Higgs spectrum) and run it through micrOMEGAs to compute Y_f and sigma_SI across (m_S, lambda_HS, f/v).

members.model_name: Asymmetrically reheated Twin Higgs Portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No asymmetric-reheating module exists that solves the coupled reheater-decay and two-sector (visible/twin) temperature evolution to predict the dilution factor D, T_RH, and residual Delta N_eff self-consistently; the card's route relies on instantaneous-decay analytic estimates whose quantitative mapping is reheater-implementation dependent.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Boltzmann/Friedmann solver for the long-lived reheater Q (or X/right-handed neutrino) energy density decaying preferentially into the visible sector, tracking both sector entropies through BBN, parameterized by (Gamma_Q, branching asymmetry, initial twin temperature), and validate against the paper's O(100-1000) dilution benchmarks.

members.model_name: Z3 scalar dark matter with semi-production freeze-in
members.description: No validated public solver exists for semi-production freeze-in: the mechanism requires coupled Boltzmann evolution of both the DM yield and a temperature-like second moment with an initial seed abundance Y_in, which standard relic codes (micrOMEGAs, MadDM) do not support, and the cited BoltzmannEquation repository is undocumented in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Audit and document the cited dkaramit/BoltzmannEquation code against the paper's benchmark scans, or implement the coupled (n, T_DM) moment equations with Y_in as input in a DRAKE-style coupled-Boltzmann framework, validating that scan points reproduce Omega h^2 = 0.12.

members.model_name: Type-II 2HDMS with pseudoscalar singlet dark matter
members.description: The SARAH model definition and derived SPheno/micrOMEGAs implementation of the Type-II 2HDMS with pseudoscalar singlet A_S were not publicly released, so the full spectrum-to-observables pipeline cannot be rerun without re-creating the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-create the CP-conserving Type-II 2HDMS in SARAH, regenerate the SPheno spectrum code and micrOMEGAs model files, validate against the paper's benchmark point (m_h1 ~ 95 GeV, BR_inv ~ 0.25) and Planck/LZ filters, and publish the model package.

members.model_name: Type-II 2HDM with real singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: The paper's FeynRules/SARAH model files and micrOMEGAs inputs for the Type-II 2HDM plus real singlet are not public, so the relic-density, direct-detection, and two-loop RGE pipeline cannot be run without re-implementing the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Type-II 2HDM+S scalar potential and Yukawa assignments in FeynRules/SARAH, export to micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 and sigma_SI and to 2HDME for two-loop running with stability/unitarity checks, and validate against the paper's 62.5, 200, and 400 GeV benchmark statements.

members.model_name: Type-X 2HDM with real singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: The paper's FeynRules/SARAH model files and micrOMEGAs inputs for the Type-X 2HDM plus real singlet are not public, so the relic-density, direct-detection, and two-loop RGE pipeline cannot be run without re-implementing the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Type-X 2HDM+S scalar potential and lepton-specific Yukawa assignments in FeynRules/SARAH, export to micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 and sigma_SI and to 2HDME for two-loop running with stability/unitarity checks, and validate against the paper's 62.5, 200, and 400 GeV benchmark statements.

members.model_name: Z3 inert doublet-singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation combines the Z3 inert doublet-singlet matrix elements (annihilation, co-annihilation, semi-annihilation) with a DRAKE-style coupled Boltzmann treatment of early kinetic decoupling; the paper's FeynCalc+DRAKE+micrOMEGAs pipeline is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z3 model files in micrOMEGAs (CalcHEP model) and couple its semi-annihilation rates into DRAKE's cBE mode with the gamma/H(x=100) switching criterion used in the paper, then release the model files.

members.model_name: Thermal leptophilic Majorana dark matter with CP-even scalar mediator
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP model files) exists for the Majorana DM plus CP-even leptophilic scalar mediator with mass-proportional lepton couplings, so relic contours and collider signal rates cannot be regenerated with standard pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Write the four-parameter (m_chi, m_phi, g_chi, g_e) Lagrangian in FeynRules, export UFO for MadGraph/MadDM and CalcHEP for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's thermal-target contour.

members.model_name: Asymmetric right-handed sneutrino dark matter in a supersymmetric neutrinophilic Higgs model
members.description: No public numerical implementation of the model exists (associated_code unknown): the asymmetric freeze-out with a free asymmetry parameter C and the neutrinophilic-sector spectrum are handled only with paper-level analytic formulae, limiting precision scans over (M_N2, M_Hnu, M_Hnuino, y_nu, C).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the supersymmetric neutrinophilic Higgs sector and run micrOMEGAs in its asymmetric-dark-matter mode to compute the coupled particle/antiparticle relic densities, cross sections, and Delta N_eff-relevant rates.

members.model_name: Large-volume light modulus dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann history solver exists for the coherent-modulus cosmology of this model — scalar domination, heavy-modulus reheating, a late thermal-inflation/trapping epoch, and entropy injection — so the residual fraction Omega_phi/Omega_DM (the dominant nuisance for all observables) can only be estimated by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled background solver (modulus field, heavy-modulus decay products, radiation, thermal-inflation flaton) parameterized by (m_phi, m_heavy, initial displacement, N_TI, T_R) that outputs residual Omega_phi and the BBN-era reheating temperature, validating against the paper's overclosure and dilution estimates.

members.model_name: Nonthermal neutralino dark matter in mirage mediation
members.description: No public solver exists for the nonthermal relic calculation in a modulus-dominated era: the coupled modulus/radiation/neutralino Boltzmann equations with direct LSP injection (branching B_chi) and S-wave residual annihilation near the Higgs resonance were implemented only in an unreleased modified DarkSUSY routine.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' non-standard cosmology interface or DarkSUSY with a modulus-decay module taking (m_T, Gamma_T, B_chi) and evolving through T_T into residual annihilation, validated against the paper's benchmark (T_T = 170 MeV at m_T = 1000 TeV) and its WMAP-band viable region.

members.model_name: CMSSM with GUT-scale right-handed neutrino, gravitino LSP, and sneutrino NLSP
members.description: No public nuCMSSM pipeline exists for this scenario: a spectrum generator including the GUT-scale right-handed-neutrino RGE effects that make the left sneutrino the NLSP, coupled to a relic calculator for the sneutrino would-be abundance Omega_snu h^2 that feeds the gravitino abundance formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the MSSM-plus-type-I-seesaw model in SARAH to produce a two-loop SPheno spectrum generator (or add y_N/M_N running to SOFTSUSY), pass the low-energy spectrum to micrOMEGAs for the sneutrino freeze-out abundance, and add the standard thermal gravitino production rate as a function of reheating temperature.

members.model_name: Minimal non-SUSY SO(10) scalar 16 dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the SO(10) scalar-16 singlet-doublet dark sector: the FeynRules interactions and the one-loop RGE setup running GUT-scale quartics to the weak scale are described but unreleased, so the mass window, relic density, and lambda_eff cannot be recomputed automatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the H_1-S-H_2 scalar potential in SARAH (which yields the one-loop RGEs plus CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files), validate against the paper's 70 GeV to 2 TeV thermal window and TeV-scale sigma_SI lower-bound scaling, and rerun the relic scan with the Planck abundance and measured 125 GeV Higgs mass.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine radiative neutrino mass model with two dark matter components
members.description: No numerical implementation of the exact supersymmetric radiative-neutrino model (MSSM plus N_i, eta_u, eta_d, chi with R parity and Z_2) exists: there is no spectrum generator model file and no two-component relic/LFV code, so all quantitative predictions currently rely on close-model-variant recasts.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the superpotential in SARAH to generate SPheno spectrum/LFV routines and a micrOMEGAs model, then use micrOMEGAs' two-component dark matter mode to compute Omega_neutralino and Omega_N1 together with mu -> e gamma and related LFV rates for the paper's TeV-scale benchmarks.

members.model_name: Two-real-singlet light scalar dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the two-real-singlet model (S0 dark matter plus mixed h1/h2 spectrum) exists in a relic-density/cross-section code, so the thermal freeze-out abundance, sigma_SI, and scalar branching fractions cannot be scanned over the 1-20 GeV S0 range reproducibly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-singlet Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs to compute the freeze-out relic density, sigma_SI, and h1/h2 branching fractions, validating against the paper's 1-20 GeV S0 scan and the 20-70 GeV / 280-400 GeV scalar-mass windows.

members.model_name: E(6)SSM inert-neutralino cold dark matter
members.description: No public E(6)SSM inert-sector model implementation exists: neither a spectrum generator producing the inert singlino/Higgsino masses and mixing matrix nor the corresponding CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, so the spectrum and relic-density steps that feed every observable cannot be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the E(6)SSM inert neutralino/chargino sector (superpotential trilinears and mass matrices from the thesis) in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP model files, and validate the resulting micrOMEGAs pipeline against the thesis claim that all-DM inert neutralinos are confined near m_Z/2.

members.model_name: Kinetic-mixing Z' portal FIMP dark matter
members.description: No implemented freeze-in Boltzmann solve exists for this kinetic-mixing Z' model that includes both the Z'-mediated/Z'-decay production channels and the dark-sector thermalisation corrections the paper finds to shift the abundance by up to a factor of two.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the kinetically mixed U(1)' model (epsilon, m_Z', m_chi, q_D g_D) in the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module for the production terms, and extend it with a coupled dark-sector temperature evolution (two-temperature Boltzmann system) to capture dark thermalisation, validating against the paper's epsilon ~ 10^-12 to 10^-11 relic band.

members.model_name: Z2-symmetric real scalar dark matter with thermal dissipation
members.description: No public solver integrates the coherent Z2-scalar condensate energy density together with the radiation bath using the paper's closed-time-path dissipation rate, so the (phi_i, m_phi, T_R, lambda) abundance contours and the critical coupling lambda_c cannot be reproduced or extended beyond digitizing the primary figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small ODE code evolving the coarse-grained condensate energy with Gamma_diss(T) and Hubble friction in a radiation-dominated background, coupled to a standard freeze-out module for the thermalized remnant, and validate it against the primary contour cases (m_phi, T_R) = (1 TeV, 1e5 GeV), (1 TeV, 1e9 GeV), (1 GeV, 1e9 GeV).

members.model_name: Scotogenic inverse seesaw scalar dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the full scotogenic inverse-seesaw model exists: the card's route is valid only in the simplified limit where all non-portal interactions of the three singlet scalars, the Majorana singlet N_L, and the vector-like lepton doublet are suppressed, and no model files are available to compute the relic density and sigma_SI when those interactions (coannihilation, scalar mixing, Yukawa channels) matter.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full scotogenic inverse-seesaw Lagrangian (three real singlets, N_L, vector-like doublet, Higgs-portal terms) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs for relic density and direct detection, validating against the paper's simplified Higgs-portal window near m_h/2 and above 150 GeV.

members.model_name: Higgsino-like dark matter from right-handed sneutrino late decays
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the MSSM plus right-handed-neutrino setup that chains freeze-in sneutrino production, late out-of-equilibrium decay, and Higgsino reannihilation into one relic-density pipeline; the card identifies no associated code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MSSM+RHN superpotential in SARAH/SPheno, compute the sneutrino freeze-in yield with micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routines, and couple it to a decay-plus-reannihilation Boltzmann solve, validating against the paper's benchmark decay temperature and relic density.

members.model_name: U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (spectrum-generator model file plus matrix-element/relic model files) exists for this U(1)' supersymmetric seesaw extension; stock MSSM tools do not include the Z' gaugino, singlets, and RH sneutrino sector needed for both the relic and collider calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)'-extended seesaw superpotential and charge assignments in SARAH, generating SPheno spectrum code plus CalcHEP/UFO and micrOMEGAs model files, validated against the paper's m_N1=110 GeV, m_N=100 GeV benchmark spectrum.

members.model_name: Global U(1)_DM-remnant Z3 scalar WIMP
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the U(1)_DM-remnant Z3 scalar model reported by the authors is not publicly located, so the semi-annihilation freeze-out (step s1) cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model definition.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the renormalizable H-phi_X-X scalar potential in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (which supports Z3 semi-annihilation), and validate against the paper's x_f ~ 25 self-annihilation benchmark.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant pseudoscalar WIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No public integrator for nonthermal WIMPzilla production during slow reheating: the abundance from scattering of thermalized inflaton decay products, with its power-law (not Boltzmann) suppression in M_eta/T_reh and sensitivity to the maximum temperature, is only estimated analytically for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a reheating-era Boltzmann integrator (coupled inflaton-radiation-WIMPzilla fluid equations following hep-ph/9809453) taking the model's portal and right-handed-neutrino scattering cross sections as input, and release it so Omega_eta h^2(M_eta, T_reh, couplings) can be scanned.

members.model_name: Singlet-like Majorana WIMP EFT with simplified mediators
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model files implementing the complete set of SM-gauge-invariant Majorana WIMP operators up to dimension six (and their matched simplified-mediator completions) have no identified public release, so the freeze-out and cross-section computations cannot be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the nine-parameter EFT Lagrangian plus the Z2-even/Z2-odd heavy-mediator simplified models in FeynRules, export CalcHEP and UFO files, validate micrOMEGAs relic output against the paper's allowed Lambda range (few hundred GeV to ~3 TeV) including the Z and Higgs pole regions, and publish the files.

members.model_name: Neutralino dark matter in quasi-Yukawa-unified U(1)' extended MSSM
members.description: No public implementation of the QYU UMSSM pipeline exists: the quasi-Yukawa-unified GUT-scale boundary conditions, universal soft terms, and the SARAH/SPheno-to-micrOMEGAs scan interface used by the source are not released, so the spectrum step cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the UMSSM with QYU Yukawa ratios at M_GUT in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and micrOMEGAs model files, and release the boundary-condition setup plus scan scripts so the 400 GeV bino A-resonance and 700 GeV higgsino coannihilation regions can be reproduced.

members.model_name: Real scalar dark matter with 750 GeV gluon portal mediator
members.description: With computational_representation null and no associated code, the relic density and annihilation rate are available only through the narrow-resonance analytic setup, which is inaccurate near the s-channel resonance region relevant for the 60 GeV DM / 750 GeV mediator hierarchy.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the simplified gluon-portal model in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via a UFO export to compute the thermal relic abundance and <sigma v> without the narrow-width approximation.

members.model_name: U(1) B-L freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled unintegrated Boltzmann system of this model, where the parent Z_BL is itself out of chemical equilibrium and the N1 momentum distribution f_N1(p) must be tracked, not just the yield; existing freeze-in modules (e.g. micrOMEGAs) assume thermalized parents and return integrated abundances only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a momentum-level freeze-in solver (in the style of sterile-neutrino distribution codes) to evolve the coupled Z_BL and N1 phase-space densities from W, Z_BL, Z, H, h decays and annihilations, outputting Y_N1 and f_N1(p) over the scanned (M_N1, M_ZBL, g_BL, theta) space.

members.model_name: Generalized deflected AMSB neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum-generator implementation of the generalized deflected-AMSB boundary conditions with messenger-matter interactions and complete/incomplete messenger multiplets exists; the spectrum step feeds every downstream observable and the card identifies no associated code.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the paper's deflected-AMSB soft-term formulae (deflection parameter d, F_phi, M_mess, messenger-matter couplings) as high-scale boundary conditions in SARAH/SPheno or a patched SoftSUSY, validating the resulting bino/wino-like spectra and Higgs mass against the paper's surviving scan points before passing spectra to micrOMEGAs.

members.model_name: Majorana fermion dark matter in SU(3) x U(1) gauge-Higgs unification
members.description: No model implementation file exists that maps the GHU parameters (bulk mass M, brane Majorana mass m, compactification scale M_KK) to the low-energy Majorana Higgs-portal effective theory, so standard relic and direct-detection tools cannot be run directly from the UV parameters; the card lists no computational representation and no associated code.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the effective SM-plus-Majorana-singlet Higgs portal with the (M, m) to (m_DM, y_DM) mapping from the paper's mass matrix, and run it through micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 and through DDCalc-style xenon likelihoods for sigma_SI.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac-gluino SSM multi-component neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum-generator implementation of the PDGSSM exists (pseudo-Dirac gluino, adjoint chiral superfield, vector-like fields, hybrid F/D-term breaking), so the UV parameters cannot be mapped to the neutralino/stau/Higgs spectrum in a reproducible pipeline; the card lists no computational representation and no associated scan code, and only spectrum-level masses can currently be scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PDGSSM in SARAH to generate SPheno spectrum-generator and micrOMEGAs model files covering the Dirac-gluino and adjoint sectors, then reproduce the paper's six case benchmarks (relic density, rescaled sigma_SI, Delta a_mu, Delta_EW) as validation.

members.model_name: Majorana singlet neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the dimension-five neutrino-portal EFT (phi chi H L / M with near-degenerate Z2-odd singlets) exists for automated relic-density computation; the paper's FeynRules/FormCalc files are unreleased and the relic band relies on an approximate analytic freeze-out formula rather than a full coannihilation Boltzmann solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EFT in FeynRules and export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (or UFO for MadDM) so the coannihilation-included relic abundance can be scanned over (M_chi, m_phi, M) and validated against the paper's orange relic bands.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the dimension-five neutrino-portal EFT (phi chi H L / M with near-degenerate Z2-odd singlets, real scalar phi as the lighter state) exists for automated relic-density computation; the paper's FeynRules/FormCalc files are unreleased and the relic band relies on an approximate analytic freeze-out formula rather than a full coannihilation Boltzmann solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EFT in FeynRules and export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (or UFO for MadDM) so the coannihilation-included relic abundance can be scanned over (m_phi, M_chi, M) and validated against the paper's orange relic bands.

members.model_name: ISS(2,3) sterile-neutrino dark matter from small lepton-number violation
members.description: The BAU-compatible parameter mask required by the recast step comes from the primary paper's private ARS leptogenesis scan; no public code reproducing the successful-leptogenesis region of the ISS(2,3) sterile sector is identified in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ARS leptogenesis kinetic equations for the ISS(2,3) pseudo-Dirac pairs in a public scan code (or extend an existing ARS/freeze-in leptogenesis package) so the BAU-compatible mask over (m_PD, M_PD, mixing) can be regenerated independently.

members.model_name: U(1)_D dark-sector Majorana WIMP model
members.description: No numerical relic-density implementation exists for the U(1)_D dark sector with chi_1 annihilation into massless Goldstone bosons; the paper's abundance window (M_chi1 40-90 GeV, benchmark 58.5 GeV) is a source scan output that was never rerun and cannot be reproduced or extended with a public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_D Lagrangian (chi_i, phi_1, phi_2, eta, Z', Goldstone) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and compute the relic density in micrOMEGAs including the Goldstone final state and chi_2,3 coannihilation, validating against the M_chi1 = 58.5 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Flavor-broken scalegenesis hidden-sector scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled Boltzmann equations for the DM scalar plus the nearby unstable would-be-DM scalar, including the finite-temperature conversion/annihilation channel and Gamma_L ~ 1e-10 GeV decay, so the relic density and the assisted-annihilation mechanism cannot be re-evaluated across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the mean-field effective masses and couplings as a two-component model in micrOMEGAs (which supports multi-species freeze-out with conversion processes) or write a standalone coupled-yield integrator, validating against the primary paper's Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1188 benchmark points.

members.model_name: SU(2) hidden vector dark matter from dark freeze-out
members.description: No implemented coupled two-sector Boltzmann setup exists for this model: Higgs-portal freeze-in populating a hidden bath with self-consistent temperature ratio xi, followed by internal SU(2)-triplet freeze-out including the non-Abelian semi-annihilation channel AA -> As and a check of internal chemical equilibrium.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(2)_D vector triplet plus hidden scalar model in micrOMEGAs 5 (CalcHEP model files) using its second-dark-sector temperature and semi-annihilation support, adding the freeze-in source term for the hidden bath and an explicit internal-equilibrium rate check against Hubble.

members.model_name: U(1) hidden vector dark matter from dark freeze-out
members.description: No implemented coupled two-sector Boltzmann setup exists for this model: Higgs-portal freeze-in populating a hidden bath with self-consistent temperature ratio xi, followed by internal U(1)-vector freeze-out through AA -> ss, including the scalar-self-coupling-dependent check that internal chemical equilibrium is actually reached (the U(1) model has no tree-level vector number-changing interactions).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hidden U(1) vector plus scalar model in micrOMEGAs 5 (CalcHEP model files) using its second-dark-sector temperature and freeze-in support, with an explicit comparison of ss and AA reaction rates to Hubble to flag where the dark-freezeout calculation is valid.

members.model_name: Top-philic vector-like portal scalar dark matter
members.description: The authors' modified micrOMEGAs implementing radiative corrections, loop-induced channels, Sommerfeld enhancement, and mediator co-annihilation for the top-philic vector-like portal has unknown availability and no public repository, so the precision relic-density calculation the analysis depends on cannot be reproduced with stock tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Recover or reimplement the corrections as a public micrOMEGAs extension: add the QCD-corrected annihilation/co-annihilation cross sections and Sommerfeld factors for the colored T mediator, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours; for y_t below about 1e-4 also add the coupled Boltzmann treatment the paper flags.

members.model_name: Low-scale hypercolor axion-domain-wall dark sector
members.description: No Boltzmann/relic-abundance code handles the cool hidden hypercolor sector: glueball self-heating and 3->2 cannibalism, glueballino/HC-hadron freeze-out within the dark bath at T_HC/T ~ 1e-3 to 1e-2, and the coupled evolution of dark-sector temperature are not implemented in micrOMEGAs, MadDM, or DarkSUSY.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a decoupled-sector Boltzmann network (separate T_HC evolution, glueball 3->2 cannibalism, glueballino freeze-out on the dark bath) as a standalone module or a micrOMEGAs extension parameterized by Lambda_HC, M_F, and the initial temperature ratio.

members.model_name: Secluded U(1)' singlino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: No documented dark-matter observable calculator is attached to the secluded U(1)' spectrum: the paper's Omega_chi h^2, sigma_SI, and <sigma v> values come from an unnamed code, and without a recorded SARAH-to-micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) interface for this four-singlet model the relic, direct-detection, and annihilation predictions cannot be reproduced from the SPheno spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Export CalcHEP model files from the existing SARAH 4.14.3 implementation of the secluded U(1)' model and run micrOMEGAs on the SPheno spectra to compute Omega_chi h^2, sigma_SI, and <sigma v>, validating against the paper's reported 4e-46 to 1e-50 cm^2 sigma_SI range, the sub-600 GeV singlino solutions, and the A-funnel points.

members.model_name: Z3 leptophilic complex scalar dark matter with vector-like lepton mediator
members.description: The LanHEP/micrOMEGAs 5.2.7 implementation of the Z3 complex-scalar plus vector-like-lepton model used for relic density and spectra is described but not publicly released, so the forward-model chain cannot be rerun or scanned by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model Lagrangian (Yukawa-like S e_R VLL coupling, cubic S^3 term, Higgs portal) in LanHEP or FeynRules and publish the CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files with validation points reproducing the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours.

members.model_name: Dark SU(3) scalar glueball dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the lattice-fitted thermal glueball/Polyakov-loop EFT and evolves the post-confinement glueball energy density to freeze-out; the paper's numerical solution of the field_evolution step exists only privately, so the Omega h^2 proportional to xi_T^3 Lambda relation cannot be independently rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's effective potential V(phi,l,T) with the published lattice-fit coefficients in a small standalone Python/C solver (or as a module coupled to a standard Friedmann integrator), evolve rho_gb(T) across the confinement transition, and release a (Lambda, xi_T) scan reproducing the paper's abundance normalization.

members.model_name: Super-weak sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the super-weak U(1)_z sector (N_1, Z', singlet scalar with the model's charge assignments) exists for a relic-density solver, so the resonant MeV-scale freezeout curve g_z(M_1, M_Zprime) cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the U(1)_z extension and run it through micrOMEGAs with the resonance-resolved thermal average, validating against the paper's M_Zprime ~ 2 M_1 viable curve and checking g_star treatment around MeV temperatures.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet scalar dark matter in the Dirac scotogenic model
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) of the Dirac scotogenic scalar sector exists, so micrOMEGAs or MadDM cannot compute the relic density through the gauge-annihilation window, coannihilation with eta2/eta3/eta_plus, or tree-level sigma_SI for benchmark scans.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model of the eta-doublet plus singlet plus Dirac N_Dk sector with the card's potential and Yukawas, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the source benchmarks (thermal target 3e-26 cm^3/s and the lambda3+lambda4+lambda5 ~ 1e-5 suppression).

members.model_name: Anapole photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No ready-to-run relic-density implementation exists for the dimension-six anapole inelastic dark matter operator: the coupled chi_0/chi_1 Boltzmann system with coannihilation into leptonic and hadronic electromagnetic final states must currently be assembled by hand or reproduced from the private author workflow.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the anapole iDM Lagrangian as a FeynRules/UFO model and run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM with coannihilation enabled, adding the R-ratio-based treatment of hadronic final states near threshold, and validate against the paper's relic-density curves for the Delta = 1e-3, 0.05, 0.2, 1 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Charge-radius photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the dimension-six charge-radius iDM operator: the coupled chi_0/chi_1 Boltzmann system with coannihilation into electromagnetic SM final states (including hadronic thresholds via the R-ratio) is not implemented in any released code, and the paper's own solver was not published.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the charge-radius operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) with coannihilation enabled and hadronic final states handled via the measured R-ratio, validating against the Delta-benchmark relic curves in arXiv:2305.16781.

members.model_name: Electric-dipole photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the dimension-five electric-dipole iDM operator: the coupled chi_0/chi_1 Boltzmann system with coannihilation into electromagnetic SM final states (including hadronic thresholds via the R-ratio) is not implemented in any released code, and the paper's own solver was not published.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the electric-dipole operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) with coannihilation enabled and hadronic final states handled via the measured R-ratio, validating against the Delta-benchmark relic curves in arXiv:2305.16781.

members.model_name: Magnetic-dipole photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the dimension-five magnetic-dipole iDM operator: the coupled chi_0/chi_1 Boltzmann system with coannihilation into electromagnetic SM final states (including hadronic thresholds via the R-ratio) is not implemented in any released code, and the paper's own solver was not published.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the magnetic-dipole operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) with coannihilation enabled and hadronic final states handled via the measured R-ratio, validating against the Delta-benchmark relic curves in arXiv:2305.16781.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen flavon-portal right-handed-neutrino freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No public model files (FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO) exist for the FN flavon-portal Lagrangian, blocking independent MadDM/micrOMEGAs relic-density scans and the automated computation of sigma_SD/sigma_SI for direct detection.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flavon-portal Lagrangian with the source FN charge assignment in FeynRules, export UFO/CalcHEP files, and validate against the paper's m_N1 = 1 TeV, m_a = 100-800 GeV, v_phi = 1.2 TeV relic benchmark and the quoted sigma_SD ~ 1e-46 to 1e-47 cm^2 estimates.

members.model_name: Light exothermic inelastic dark matter with vector mediator
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the two-component inelastic dark-photon model; the freeze-out of nearly degenerate X and X prime with channel thresholds (on-shell versus off-shell A prime) and the surviving X prime fraction is currently handled by an analytic estimate rather than a coupled Boltzmann calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the minimal U(1)_X model (X, X prime, A prime, dark Higgs) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs with coannihilation enabled to compute Omega_X h^2 and the late-time X prime abundance, replacing the equal-abundance assumption used for limit rescaling.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) L_mu-L_tau axi-Higgs portal fermionic dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the anomalous U(1) L_mu-L_tau axi-Higgs portal: the paper used micrOMEGAs 5.3.41 but released no model files encoding the Wess-Zumino axi-Higgs couplings to electroweak gauge-boson duals, so the relic-density scan cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model file for the U(1)' charge assignment with Stueckelberg/Wess-Zumino terms and the physical axi-Higgs, export to CalcHEP format, and validate the micrOMEGAs pipeline against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.120 benchmark points at m_Z' = 2.5 and 3.5 TeV.

members.model_name: Kaluza-Klein photon dark matter with level-one coannihilation
members.description: No public relic-density implementation accepts a general (non-minimal) level-one KK spectrum with arbitrary mass splittings Delta_i and all coannihilation channels (KK leptons, quarks, gauge bosons, Higgs states); existing micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP UED model files are tied to the minimal-UED spectrum, so the paper's 540 GeV to 2 TeV spectrum-dependent mass range cannot be reproduced across the full parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the existing micrOMEGAs MUED/CalcHEP model implementation to take the level-one masses as free inputs (spectrum file interface) and enable all level-one coannihilation channels, validating against the paper's 540 GeV right-handed-lepton and 2 TeV compressed-colored benchmark cases.

members.model_name: Strongly interacting hidden-sector pion cold dark matter
members.description: The relic density was computed with a privately modified micrOMEGAs; no public model implementation of the hidden-sector Gell-Mann-Levy pion sector with the two-Higgs-doublet portal (lambda_3, mixed h/H scalars) exists, so the freeze-out abundance and Higgs-portal direct-detection cross section cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the linear sigma-model hidden-pion Lagrangian with Higgs-portal mixing in FeynRules/CalcHEP and export to micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's illustrative scan (tan beta = 1, quartics up to 4) for the relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Z2-stabilized Higgs-portal unparticle dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density code implements the Z2-odd scalar unparticle with the lambda/Lambda^(2 d_U - 2) U^2 H-dagger-H portal; the paper's Boltzmann freeze-out through Higgs-mediated annihilation (including the s-channel Higgs pole and d_U-dependent phase space) exists only as an unreleased calculation, so the WMAP-window relic scan cannot be reproduced or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U^2 H-dagger-H model in micrOMEGAs or MadDM via a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file treating the massive unparticle as a scalar WIMP at d_U near 1 with the paper's mass relation fixing lambda, reproduce the published Omega_U h^2 in the m_U = 50-80 GeV window, then update to the measured 125 GeV Higgs mass and current Planck abundance and add Higgs invisible-width and direct-detection outputs.

members.model_name: Thermal right-handed sneutrino dark matter in the F_D-term hybrid inflation model
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the F_D-term hybrid-inflation right-handed sneutrino: the mSUGRA-plus-RHN spectrum with the inflaton-induced quartic N*N*HuHd coupling is not available as a spectrum-generator or micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model, so neither the Higgs-pole relic density nor sigma_SI can be recomputed from the card's input parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the F_D-term superpotential and soft terms in SARAH to generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, then validate against the paper's H_1-funnel relic region and CDMS-II exclusion figure.

members.model_name: Dark Left-Right Model 2 scotino dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable DLRM2 model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or micrOMEGAs model files) exists for the SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R x U(1)_X gauge sector with the Dirac scotino, so the full relic density and sigma_SI can only be estimated with the paper's 1 pb proxy and Ge-73 analytic formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the DLRM2 Lagrangian (Z-prime, W_R, scotino, exotic h quark, mixing s_R^2) in FeynRules, export UFO and CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs for the full freeze-out Omega h^2 and spin-independent cross section across m_n, M_Zprime, s_R^2.

members.model_name: Three degenerate light mixed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the three exactly degenerate light mixed sneutrinos with the full multi-flavor coannihilation treatment that sets the factor 1.5-3 relic-density enhancement over the one-flavor case.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MSSM+nu_R sneutrino sector with three degenerate flavors in FeynRules/SARAH, export to micrOMEGAs with all flavor coannihilation channels enabled, and validate against the paper's narrow accepted region (m_snu 4.5-8 GeV, theta 0.27-0.29) and the quoted Omega_three/Omega_one factor of 1.5-3.

members.model_name: E6-inspired exotic-state hot dark matter asymmetry scenario
members.description: No Boltzmann-equation implementation exists for the coupled generation of the B-L and U(1)_E asymmetries from lightest right-handed neutrino/sneutrino decays at T_R ~ 1e6-1e7 GeV, so the exotic-sector asymmetry and hence the hot-component density cannot be computed quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann framework (e.g. ULYSSES) with an additional charge-transport equation for U(1)_E, including the exotic Yukawa decay channels of N_1 and the washout terms from f_i, ftilde_i couplings, in the SUSY (sneutrino-inclusive) setup.

members.model_name: Miracle-less WIMP with gauged B-L entropy dilution
members.description: The entropy-dilution step assumes instantaneous N1 decay; no numerical tool tracks the coupled evolution of the overproduced chi relic, the N1 matter-dominated era, and the entropy release, so the dilution factor S and the decay temperature T_N1 that set the GW turning frequency carry uncontrolled analytic uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled Boltzmann system (chi yield, N1 energy density, radiation with entropy injection) in a public early-matter-domination code — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' or a ULYSSES-style solver's cosmological background module to non-standard histories — and output S, T_N1, and the modified expansion history for the string-spectrum step.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation WIMP Case A
members.description: The catalyzed-BBN constraint on long-lived charged excitations is only an approximate lifetime label (tau above about 1e3 s); no BBN network calculation with the bound-state catalysis reactions and the actual primordial charged-state abundance has been run for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the coannihilation-driven freeze-out abundance of X- to a BBN network code extended with catalyzed reactions on charged relics (extending AlterBBN or PRIMAT with the CBBN reaction set), producing a quantitative excluded region in the (tau, Delta m) plane.

members.model_name: Pseudo-scalar fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP implementation of the dimension-five parity-violating operator Q5 = i(H^dagger H)(chi gamma5 chi)/Lambda_5 exists per the card, so the thermal relic density across the 60 GeV - 2 TeV EFT range (with hh and tt threshold openings) cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Q5 EFT operator (plus the scalar Lambda_1 operator for the mixed case) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's 60 GeV - 2 TeV viable relic contour; include an EFT-validity flag comparing Lambda_5 to the annihilation center-of-mass energy.

members.model_name: Nambu-Goto Cusp Emission WIMP dark matter with p-wave annihilation
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-abundance code includes a cosmic-string/topological-defect injection source term of the paper's power-law form Q proportional to t^(-p), so the freeze-out-plus-source yield must currently be solved with private numerics or the paper's asymptotic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing relic solver (micrOMEGAs or the standalone MadDM/DRAKE Boltzmann module) with a parametrized injection term q_X t^(-p) with X-multiplicity, validated against the primary paper's yield curves for p-wave (n=1) annihilation.

members.model_name: Nambu-Goto Cusp Emission WIMP dark matter with s-wave annihilation
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-abundance code includes a cosmic-string/topological-defect injection source term of the paper's power-law form Q proportional to t^(-p), so the freeze-out-plus-source yield must currently be solved with private numerics or the paper's asymptotic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing relic solver (micrOMEGAs or the standalone MadDM/DRAKE Boltzmann module) with a parametrized injection term q_X t^(-p) with X-multiplicity, validated against the primary paper's yield curves for s-wave (n=0) annihilation.

members.model_name: Field-Theory String Decay WIMP dark matter with p-wave annihilation
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-abundance code includes a cosmic-string/topological-defect injection source term of the paper's power-law form Q proportional to t^(-p), so the freeze-out-plus-source yield must currently be solved with private numerics or the paper's asymptotic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing relic solver (micrOMEGAs or the standalone MadDM/DRAKE Boltzmann module) with a parametrized injection term q_X t^(-p) with X-multiplicity, validated against the primary paper's yield curves for p-wave (n=1) annihilation.

members.model_name: Field-Theory String Decay WIMP dark matter with s-wave annihilation
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-abundance code includes a cosmic-string/topological-defect injection source term of the paper's power-law form Q proportional to t^(-p), so the freeze-out-plus-source yield must currently be solved with private numerics or the paper's asymptotic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing relic solver (micrOMEGAs or the standalone MadDM/DRAKE Boltzmann module) with a parametrized injection term q_X t^(-p) with X-multiplicity, validated against the primary paper's yield curves for s-wave (n=0) annihilation.

members.model_name: Spin-flipped gauged U(1) model with singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No numerical model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP model file) exists for the spin-flipped variant with singlet Dirac DM, colored scalar Q-prime, and Z-prime mediator, so the relic density and scattering cross sections cannot be computed with standard solvers.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the spin-flipped Lagrangian (f-prime Yukawa term, colored scalar, Z-prime) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/UFO, and run micrOMEGAs for the s-wave freeze-out relic density and loop-induced direct-detection cross section.

members.model_name: Light scalar mediator freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation covers the full coupling range of this benchmark, from freeze-in through hidden-sector thermalization to dark freeze-out via chi chi -> phi phi, with the dark-sector temperature evolved self-consistently; the non-monotonic abundance turnover cannot be reproduced without it.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or implement in a standalone solver) coupled equations for n_chi, n_phi, and the hidden-sector temperature T_dark for the Higgs-mixed scalar benchmark, validated by reproducing the paper's abundance contours in (g_chi, theta, m_chi, m_phi).

members.model_name: Scalar-contact inelastic scalar dark matter EFT
members.description: No numerical implementation of the scalar-contact inelastic EFT exists for the two-component relic computation: the freeze-out plus late X'-X conversion system that fixes n_X/n_X' ~ 1 is not encoded in any named public code on the card (associated_code empty, computational_representation null).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dimension-6 scalar DM-lepton operators in FeynRules/CalcHEP and solve the coupled two-component Boltzmann system with micrOMEGAs' multi-component machinery (or a dedicated conversion-aware solver), validating against the paper's best-fit region m_X ~ 1.22 GeV, Lambda_S ~ 1.11 TeV.

members.model_name: Majoron-assisted semi-annihilating Z3 scalar dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP (or equivalent) implementation of the Majoron-assisted Z3 model exists, so the semi-annihilation relic-density calculation with chi chi -> chi* J cannot be reproduced with existing solvers.
