members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the U(1)_B-L Majoron plus Z3 scalar sector and run it through micrOMEGAs, which already handles semi-annihilating Z3 dark matter, validating against the paper's viable-region contours.

members.model_name: High-mass effective inert-doublet derivative-operator dark matter variant
members.description: No relic-density code implements the IDM augmented by the dimension-six derivative operators C_1-C_4, whose destructive interference in HH annihilation to longitudinal W/Z is the mechanism that repairs the high-mass underabundance; without it neither the relic abundance nor the relic/EWPT tension resolution can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the IDM plus C_1-C_4 derivative operators in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (or MadDM), verify the longitudinal-gauge-boson annihilation amplitudes against the Goldstone-equivalence expressions in the primary, and scan (m_H, Delta m, C_i) for Omega_H h^2 = 0.12.

members.model_name: High-mass effective inert-doublet derivative-operator dark matter variant
members.description: No finite-temperature effective-potential implementation includes the D6 derivative and H_1 field-strength operators, so the strong first-order electroweak phase transition claimed to coexist with the repaired relic abundance in the high-mass regime cannot be verified (v/T, nucleation temperature).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CosmoTransitions-style one-loop daisy-resummed finite-temperature potential with the dimension-six corrections, scan the high-mass (m_H, Delta m, C_i) space for v_n/T_n > 1, and cross-check gauge dependence with a gauge-invariant high-temperature expansion.

members.model_name: Pati-Salam Goldstino split-SUSY Wino dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density/annihilation calculator (micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY release) includes the Sommerfeld enhancement needed for the 2-2.5 TeV Wino, so the modern thermal relic mass target and present-day <sigma v> for this Pati-Salam Wino cannot be computed with named public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with the known electroweak Sommerfeld ladder resummation for Wino-chargino coannihilation (two-state Schroedinger solution with M2 and the chargino-neutralino splitting as inputs) and validate against published Sommerfeld-corrected Wino relic curves.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Majorana dark matter
members.description: The leptogenesis Boltzmann system with Z_L gauge-boson washout has not been solved for this model; the M_ZL/g_L > ~1e10 GeV bound is imported from prior literature rather than recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis solver such as ULYSSES with the U(1)_L gauge-scattering and Z_L-mediated washout rates for right-handed neutrinos, then scan (M_N1, M_ZL/g_L, CP asymmetry) to map the viable Y_B region for this model.

members.model_name: Leptoquark-portal SU(2)L-triplet vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the S3 leptoquark plus SU(2)L-triplet Psi_L and colored Psi_Q Lagrangian is not publicly released (availability unknown, no repository), so the relic-density calculation combining triplet electroweak annihilation with leptoquark-mediated coannihilation cannot currently be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the S3 + triplet Psi_L + Psi_Q Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic contours, in particular the lambda=0 pure-electroweak-triplet limit and its 1600-1750 GeV mass floor.

members.model_name: Majorana t-channel mediator freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in integrator handles thermal-mass-corrected eta -> X f decay kinematics (including the temperature windows where the decay closes or opens) together with a nonstandard pre-BBN expansion history H(T;n,T_ref).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone yield integrator) to use m_eta(T) and m_f(T) in the decay width and phase-space thresholds and to accept a power-law extra energy density in H(T), validating against the source suppression/enhancement examples and the Planck relic target.

members.model_name: Light mixed sneutrino thermal dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP implementation of the MSSM plus right-handed-neutrino mixed sneutrino model (weak-scale A_nu trilinear mixing, light mostly-RH sneutrino LSP) used by the primary paper is not publicly released, so relic density, annihilation channels, and sigma_SI for the 1-8 GeV scan region cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the MSSM+nu_R sneutrino sector (soft A_nu L N H_u term and one-generation mass matrix) in FeynRules or SARAH, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's accepted scan (1-8 GeV masses, Delta Gamma_Z < 2 MeV, sigma_SI > 1e-5 pb trend), including QCD-era degrees of freedom for the lowest masses.

members.model_name: Heavy-Z' effective complex-scalar NETDM
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solve exists for UV freeze-in of complex scalar dark matter through the (f gamma_mu f)(chi partial^mu chi* - chi* partial^mu chi)/Lambda^2 contact operator with explicit reheating-temperature dependence; the route currently relies on the source paper's analytic scaling only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar derivative-current operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run it through the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module with reheating temperature T_RH as an input, or code the single-species yield ODE dY/dx with the analytic collision term directly, validating against the paper's Lambda/T_RH ~ 10^3-10^5 band.

members.model_name: Twin Higgs Portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation of the Twin Higgs Portal scalar exists: computing Omega_S h^2 including twin-sector Higgs-mediated and heavy radial-mode annihilation channels requires a model file that stock micrOMEGAs/MadDM libraries do not provide.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the SU(4)-symmetric Twin Higgs plus singlet potential (S coupled to H_A and H_B, pNGB Higgs and radial mode m_hhat, specified FTH/MTH twin spectrum) and run micrOMEGAs to reproduce the paper's relic curves over (m_S, lambda_HS, f/v, m_hhat).

members.model_name: 750 GeV complex-scalar portal Majorana WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) exists for the 750 GeV scalar plus light pseudoscalar portal with dimension-five gauge-boson operators and the Phi-chi-chi Yukawa, so the micrOMEGAs relic-density contours in the m_chi-Gamma_s plane cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the s/a-portal Lagrangian (including the s B B, s G G, a B Bdual, a G Gdual operators and the chi Yukawa) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP, and run micrOMEGAs to recover the paper's relic contours including the aa (p-wave), sa (s-wave), and pole regimes.

members.model_name: Mirrored Dirac neutrino dark matter with B-prime-minus-L-prime annihilation
members.description: No relic-density solver implements mirror Dirac neutrino freeze-out in a decoupled mirror thermal bath with its own temperature ratio, including mirror weak and gauged B'-L' annihilation channels and Sommerfeld corrections from a light or slightly broken B'-L' gauge boson; only rough analytic estimates exist in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mirror-sector model in micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector mode (separate dark-sector temperature T'/T), adding the B'-L' annihilation channel with Sommerfeld enhancement factors, and validate against the paper's m_nu' ~ 8 GeV (v'/v)^2 and ~400 GeV (alpha_B'-L' = 1e-2) benchmarks.

members.model_name: Kination freeze-out Majorana dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-density code is configured for freeze-out during a kination era with H proportional to T^3 and continued annihilation between freeze-out and radiation domination; the card's freezeout step has tool_or_code null and only the paper's analytic formula as a check.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs non-standard-cosmology interface (user-defined H(T) and entropy history) with a kination equation of state parameterized by T_R, and validate against the primary paper's analytic <sigma v> > 3e-26 cm^3/s thermal-branch result.

members.model_name: Extended DM EFT with scalar singlet DM
members.description: No numerical model implementation exists for the scalar-singlet variant of the extended DM EFT with explicit (pseudo)scalar mediator and D=5 operators: computational_representation is null and no code was identified, so relic density and nuclear-recoil rates (including momentum-suppressed pseudoscalar subcases) cannot be scanned beyond the paper's analytic benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi_s Lagrangian (lambda_{S phi_s} S phi_s^2, lambda_{H phi_s} |H|^2 phi_s^2, and the S-SM D=5 operators) in FeynRules, export a UFO/CalcHEP model, and compute Omega h^2 and direct-detection cross sections with micrOMEGAs or MadDM, validating against the paper's benchmark correlations.

members.model_name: Vector-contact inelastic scalar dark matter EFT
members.description: No numerical implementation of the vector-contact inelastic EFT or its dark U(1)_X completion exists for the two-component relic computation: the freeze-out plus late X'-X conversion system fixing n_X/n_X' ~ 1, and the extra quark channels of the U(1)_X completion that can invalidate the generic EFT relic result, are not encoded in any named public code on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the O_VL/O_VR operators (and the U(1)_X gauge completion with its right-handed charge assignments) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and solve the coupled two-component Boltzmann system with micrOMEGAs' multi-component machinery, validating against the paper's best-fit region m_X ~ 2.95 GeV, Lambda_V ~ 74.8 GeV, and checking EFT validity given the low cutoff.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen flavon-portal right-handed-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO model files) of the Froggatt-Nielsen flavon-portal Lagrangian exists, so the micrOMEGAs/MadDM freeze-in calculation the authors cross-checked cannot be rerun or scanned independently, including the 2-to-3 UV freeze-in channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flavon-portal effective Lagrangian (scalar and pseudoscalar flavon couplings fixed by the FN charge texture) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO files, and validate the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module output against the paper's v_phi ~ 1e7-1e9 GeV viable band for below-TeV m_N1 and m_a = 10 GeV.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw mixed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: The SARAH model files and SPheno/CalcHEP inputs for the MSSM-plus-inverse-seesaw sneutrino sector (nu^c and S superfields with the mu_S S S term and CP-even/odd sneutrino mass matrices) used in the paper are not established as publicly released, blocking automated spectrum generation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the inverse-seesaw superpotential and soft terms in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's WMAP-band scan features and left-sneutrino scattering suppression.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with baryon-number violating transfer operators
members.description: No public asymmetric-dark-matter transfer code couples the chemical-equilibrium network, the decoupling of the B-violating operator at T_D, and symmetric-component freeze-out; the route's required chemical-potential solver and asymmetric-abundance Boltzmann calculator exist only as the paper's instantaneous-decoupling analytic approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' asymmetric-abundance machinery (or write a standalone solver) to integrate coupled Boltzmann equations for X, anti-X, and baryon chemical potentials through operator decoupling, replacing the instantaneous m_X/T_D approximation with a full numerical Omega_DM/Omega_B prediction.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu Z2 real scalar dark matter
members.description: No CalcHEP/FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the Zee-Babu model extended by the Z2-odd real scalar X exists on the card, so the freeze-out calculation with Higgs-portal annihilation plus near-threshold h+h- and k++k-- channels must be redone by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Zee-Babu-plus-real-scalar potential in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic contours (Planck-era Omega h^2 = 0.1199) including the charged-scalar threshold channels.

members.model_name: U(1)_X-charged Z2-odd scalar dark matter in a lepton-specific two-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs (or CalcHEP/FeynRules) model implementation of the U(1)_X lepton-specific 2HDM with the Z2-odd charged scalar is released; the paper's micrOMEGAs 4.3.5 implementation is private, so relic density, direct-detection, and annihilation rates cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the model in FeynRules from the published charge assignments, scalar potential, and Yukawa terms, export CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's three benchmark relic-density scenarios in micrOMEGAs.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with SU(2)_L sphaleron transfer
members.description: No machine-readable model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model file) exists for the SU(2)_L doublet Xogenesis Lagrangian with its anomaly-cancelling partner and singlets X_S^0/X_S^-, so the symmetric-component annihilation, direct-detection cross sections, and collider expectations cannot be computed with standard pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the doublet-plus-singlet Xogenesis Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs (which supports asymmetric dark matter relic evolution) and MadDM, and use micrOMEGAs' built-in direct-detection module to recast the su2l_direct_detection constraint against modern xenon limits.

members.model_name: Massive-dark-photon two-component composite pNGB dark matter
members.description: No public coupled-Boltzmann implementation exists for this pNGB scalar plus stable massive dark photon system, including phi-A_D conversion and injection effects that matter in the near-degenerate window m_phi < m_A_D < 2 m_phi where the two-component cold regime lives.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the phi/A_D model in micrOMEGAs' two-component dark matter mode (FeynRules to CalcHEP model files with the derivative Higgs portal, U(1)_DM gauge coupling alpha_D, and Stueckelberg mass), enable the conversion processes, and validate the near-degenerate regime against a dedicated coupled Boltzmann integration reproducing the paper's relic contours.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with a new gauge-group sphaleron
members.description: No public asymmetric-abundance code couples the chemical-potential network to the freeze-out of the new-gauge sphaleron transfer and to symmetric-component annihilation; the route's required chemical-potential solver and Boltzmann calculator exist only as instantaneous-decoupling analytic approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' asymmetric-dark-matter machinery or write a standalone solver integrating coupled Boltzmann equations for X and Standard Model chemical potentials through sphaleron decoupling, producing numerical Omega_DM/Omega_B predictions.

members.model_name: lambda_phi zero linear-breaking scalar singlet dark matter variant
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the lambda_phi=0 linear-breaking scalar singlet) is released, so the micrOMEGAs relic-density workflow used in the paper cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the scalar potential with the linear U(1)_X breaking term in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and validate against the paper's few-TeV to ~70 TeV allowed window in micrOMEGAs.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal complex scalar thermal freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No relic-density solver implementation exists for the Z_3-stabilized complex scalar with a neutrinophilic scalar mediator: the card has null computational_representation and no associated code, and the constraint con_freezeout_relic_target records likelihood_available: no with recasting needed, so the freeze-out step (s2) cannot be run beyond the paper's analytic heavy-mediator formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-field Lagrangian (complex scalar DM plus neutrinophilic scalar coupled to active neutrinos) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM, validating against the paper's target curve at the benchmark m_phi = 3 m_DM, y = lambda, and then relaxing the heavy-mediator and single-flavor assumptions.

members.model_name: Model A multicomponent radiative-seesaw dark matter
members.description: No solver implementation exists for the coupled three-component (N_1, phi, eta_R/eta_I) Boltzmann system with standard annihilation, DM conversion (eta_R eta_R <-> phi phi), and semi-annihilation, which is required to obtain the component relic fractions that every downstream recast weights by.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement Model A in FeynRules/CalcHEP and extend the micrOMEGAs multicomponent framework (two-DM-sector machinery) to three coupled dark sectors including the lambda_7 semi-annihilation and conversion terms, validating against the paper's benchmark total relic density at M_1 = 300 GeV, m_phi = 62 GeV.

members.model_name: Low-reheat WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann integrator implements WIMP production and annihilation through the reheating era with both T_MAX and T_RH tracked, including scattering production from the bath before radiation domination and entropy dilution; generic relic codes assume radiation domination or need bespoke modification for this regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' nonstandard-cosmology machinery (or write a standalone module) to solve the coupled reheating-field, radiation, and WIMP number-density equations with T_MAX and T_RH as inputs, validated against the paper's recovery of standard freeze-out as T_RH approaches the freeze-out temperature.

members.model_name: Zprime-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the Zprime-plus-Chern-Simons effective Lagrangian (couplings a1, a2, b1, optional a3/M) exists for use in a relic-density solver, so the W-boson-channel freeze-out and open-channel branchings cannot be recomputed against a modern Planck relic target.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Chern-Simons Zprime effective operators in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (or MadDM), and validate against the paper's quoted relic-viable regions before rerunning freeze-out with the Planck Omega h^2 target.

members.model_name: Z2-symmetric complex singlet scalar two-component dark matter
members.description: The cxSM Z2-symmetric FeynRules/CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files and scan machinery used for the relic-density and XENON1T comparison are not publicly released (associated_code has no repositories; the card notes the precise excluded region requires the original scan machinery), so the exclusion cannot be reproduced precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Z2-symmetric cxSM scalar potential in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's relic and rescaled-SI benchmark behavior over the stated scan ranges, and release the model files.

members.model_name: Singlet-dominated scalar dark matter in the Dirac scotogenic model
members.description: The exclusion of the singlet-dominated eta1 rests on analytic estimates at quoted benchmarks; no public model implementation of the Dirac scotogenic scalar sector exists for micrOMEGAs/MadDM, so the relic density, funnel region, and exclusion boundary cannot be re-derived quantitatively or re-tested under relaxed assumptions (subcomponent DM, coannihilation with eta2/eta3).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP implementation of the eta-doublet plus singlet plus Dirac N_Dk sector (shared with the doublet-DM variant of this model), run micrOMEGAs relic and direct-detection scans, and verify the source's lambda_7 < 4.8e-5 bound near 100 GeV and the singlet nonviability conclusion.

members.model_name: Decaying warm majoron dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver setup treats a keV-scale warm majoron with its thermal free-streaming distribution that also decays to relativistic neutrinos with tau_J of order 50 Gyr; the CLASS decaying-CDM module assumes cold parents, so the combined warm-plus-decaying linear evolution (T(k) and CMB spectra) cannot currently be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS by combining its non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) sector with the decaying-dark-matter module: give the ncdm species a decay term sourcing massless neutrino dark radiation, parameterized by (m_J, tau_J, initial phase-space distribution), and validate against the paper's N-body initial conditions and the tau_J > 50 Gyr CMB benchmark.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter with a long-range dark fifth force
members.description: The modified CLASS implementing the dark fifth-force background (H(z), rho_dm(z), s(z)) and linear perturbations (relative DM-baryon density and velocity modes) is not publicly released, so the whole CMB+BAO pipeline cannot be rerun or extended by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or reimplement the fifth-force patch in public CLASS: add the scalar-field background with m_chi(s) coupling and beta, m_s/H_0 parameters plus the coupled DM-baryon perturbation equations, and validate against the published beta < 0.011 (Planck) and beta < 0.0054 (Planck+BAO) bounds.

members.model_name: Non-canonical asymptotically-flat coth-potential unified dark sector
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the non-canonical UDM scalar with L=X(X/M^4)^(alpha-1)-V(phi) and the asymptotically-flat coth potential: neither CLASS nor CAMB evolves the perturbations of a single field whose kinetic energy clusters as dark matter with c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1 while its potential drives acceleration, so the transfer function and Jeans-scale viability test cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a k-essence/UDM module that takes the background solution for this potential and evolves the exact scalar perturbation equations (or, as a first pass, map the model onto CLASS's generalized-dark-matter fluid with w(a) from the background solve and constant c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1), validating the pressureless large-alpha limit against the paper.

members.model_name: Non-canonical cascading step-potential unified dark sector
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the non-canonical UDM scalar with L=X(X/M^4)^(alpha-1)-V(phi) and the cascading step potential: neither CLASS nor CAMB evolves the perturbations of a single field whose kinetic energy clusters as dark matter with c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1 while the staircase potential drives (possibly transient) acceleration, so the transfer function and Jeans-scale viability test cannot be computed, and the potential's step transitions need careful numerical treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a k-essence/UDM module that takes the background solution for this potential (with a smoothed parameterization of the vacuum-energy steps) and evolves the exact scalar perturbation equations, or as a first pass map the model onto CLASS's generalized-dark-matter fluid with w(a) from the background solve and constant c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1, validating the pressureless large-alpha limit against the paper.

members.model_name: Non-canonical Starobinsky-type unified dark sector
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements linear perturbations for the non-canonical unified dark sector L=X(X/M^4)^(alpha-1)-V(phi), whose effective sound speed c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1 and Jeans scale set the clustering viability; CLASS/CAMB only offer constant-c_s fluids or canonical scalar fields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS scalar-field (scf) or fluid module to a general k-essence Lagrangian L(X,phi), passing the background-dependent c_s^2 and adiabatic/non-adiabatic pressure terms into the perturbation equations, and validate against the large-alpha analytic limit c_s^2=(2 alpha-1)^-1.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-level Boltzmann solver covers neutrino-portal freeze-in with both resonant (on-shell N decay) and non-resonant (off-shell N) production, so the nonthermal f(p) that both the relic density and the free-streaming constraint depend on cannot be recomputed outside the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain release of) an unintegrated Boltzmann solver for the L h -> N -> chi phi chain with resonant and 2-to-2 off-shell contributions, outputting tabulated f(q) in the CLASS ncdm psd-file format; extending micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module to momentum level is a natural host.

members.model_name: Early mass-varying sterile-neutrino nugget dark matter with kination-diluted scalar EDE
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code implementation of the neutrino-scalar EDE fluid with a nugget-formation transition into a kination-like (w=1) scalar phase; the paper's modified CLASS patch (w(z), c_s^2(z) GDM transition plus kination dilution) is private with no repository.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the transition in public CLASS as a generalized-dark-matter component with parametrized w(z) and c_s^2(z) switching from w=1/3-like EDE to w=1 kination at z_F (analogous to existing public EDE branches such as CLASS_EDE/AxiCLASS), release it with MontePython parameter files, and validate against the paper's quoted Omega_nuphi, z_F, and H0 best-fit values.

members.model_name: UV freeze-in baryogenesis with scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code solves the coupled freeze-in plus CP-violating scattering asymmetry Boltzmann equations for the dimension-5 complex-scalar model with vector-like leptons; the paper's numerical scans are custom and unreleased, so Y_B and the viable Lambda-T_RH band cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled yield and B-L asymmetry equations (dimension-5 collision terms, tree-loop interference CP source, sphaleron conversion) in a released standalone solver, e.g. a Python/ULYSSES-style momentum-averaged Boltzmann code validated against the paper's Lambda-T_RH scaling for Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12 and Y_B = 8.71e-11.

members.model_name: Unified superfluid dark sector
members.description: No public background-plus-linear-perturbation code evolves the two-state superfluid mixture with its Josephson/Rabi cosine coupling V = M^4 cos^2((theta_2-theta_1+Delta E t)/2), so H(z), the growth function, and the growth rate cannot be computed without re-deriving and re-integrating the coupled effective-fluid equations by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled two-superfluid background and linear perturbation equations as two interacting effective fluids with time-dependent equations of state and sound speeds in CLASS (new species module with the cosine interaction source terms), validating against the paper's fiducial H(z), growth-function, and growth-rate plots.

members.model_name: Early mass-varying sterile-neutrino nugget dark matter, simple CDM-transition variant
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the EDE-to-CDM fluid transition (w(z), negative c_s^2 during instability, transition duration) for the neutrino-nugget component; the paper's modified CLASS patch is private with no repository.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the fluid transition as a generalized-dark-matter species in public CLASS with parametrized w(z), c_s^2(z), z_F, and transition duration, release it with MontePython support, and validate against the paper's Planck residual-versus-z_F behavior.

members.model_name: Mixed cold plus minimal cannibal dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code implementation of the cannibal fluid exists: the logarithmic temperature history, w_can(a), sound speed, and fluid perturbation equations for a percent-level cannibal subcomponent coexisting with cold dark matter are written in the paper but not available in CLASS or CAMB, so R(k) cannot be computed with public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a cannibal-fluid species implementing the paper's background scaling (parameterized by m, S_can, lambda, f_can,0) and its fluid perturbation equations with the self-scattering-supported sound speed, and validate against the paper's published R(k) suppression curves.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No public N-body initial-conditions generator implements the kurtosis-dependent peculiar-velocity enhancement V(k,z) and coarse-grained phase-space correction Q_cg for the DW distribution; the corrections exist only as the paper's Born/Fredholm perturbative formalism at z~30-50.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the WDM velocity and phase-space corrections as an initial-conditions module (e.g. extending MUSIC/monofonIC) parameterized by f(y), m, and g_d, validated against the paper's 10-15 percent corrections near k~1-2 k_fs and a CLASS run with the DW ncdm distribution.

members.model_name: 331 WIMPy dark radiation model
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for this model's mixed cold-thermal WIMP plus decay-produced relativistic WIMP subcomponent; the Delta N_eff contribution and the warm-fraction suppression of small-scale power are currently handled only by the analytic f-Delta N_eff benchmark relation rather than a full perturbation calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-produced relativistic daughter population as an ncdm species with a non-thermal two-body-decay phase-space distribution f(p; M_N1R/M_WIMP, tau_N1R) in CLASS, alongside the dominant cold component, to compute Delta N_eff at equality and the scale-dependent power suppression.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes f_N1(p,T) for UV freeze-in of phi through L H -> N_{2,3} processes followed by late phi -> N1 N1 decay; the paper's momentum-dependent collision-term solution is private, so the registry cannot regenerate the distribution that feeds every downstream observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the unintegrated freeze-in collision terms and parent-decay injection in a public momentum-level Boltzmann code (e.g. extend a DRAKE-style or CLASS ncdm-preprocessing solver) parameterized by (m_N1, m_phi, x_1, T_RH, phi lifetime), validated against the paper's abundance curves.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric equilibrium-scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver implements this model's freeze-in production channels (UV/IR freeze-in involving an equilibrium scalar phi plus sterile-sneutrino decays with variable parent lifetimes), so the momentum distribution f_N1(p,T) that feeds every downstream observable can only be reproduced by rewriting the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's unintegrated collision terms (phi-mediated freeze-in plus two-body parent decays) in a public momentum-level freeze-in code, e.g. as a module that outputs tabulated f(p) on a (m_N1, m_phi, x_1, T_RH, tau_Ntilde1) grid in the CLASS ncdm psd-file format.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric out-of-equilibrium scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes the two-component f_N1(p,T) sourced by both phi -> N1 N1 decays and sterile-sneutrino Ntilde1 decays with distinct lifetimes (momentum bumps near x ~ 100 and x ~ 1e4); the paper's momentum-level solution is private, blocking regeneration of the distribution that feeds all downstream observables.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement freeze-in collision terms plus multi-parent decay injection in a public momentum-level Boltzmann code (extend a DRAKE-style solver or a CLASS ncdm-preprocessing module) parameterized by (m_N1, m_phi, x_1, T_RH, tau_Ntilde1), validated against the paper's two-bump spectra and abundance curves.

members.model_name: Late Sommerfeld-enhanced dark-matter conversion to dark radiation
members.description: The Boltzmann-solver modification implementing late DM-to-dark-radiation conversion (background density transfer parameterized by zeta and a_t plus the compensating dark-radiation perturbations) is a private modified CAMB; no public solver reproduces the CMB/LSS predictions for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the (zeta, a_t, transition-rapidity) conversion background and perturbation equations in public CLASS (or obtain and release the original modified CAMB), validated by recovering LambdaCDM at zeta=0 and the published Planck-era limits.

members.model_name: Inflaton-decay singlet-fermion dark matter with inflaton-mediated scatterings
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver exists for inflaton-decay dark matter with inflaton-mediated 2->2 collision terms, Pauli blocking, and back-reaction during reheating; the paper's custom solver is private, so the benchmark distributions (and any parameter scan beyond the TeV-scale examples) cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement and release the binned f(k,t) kinetic solver with the paper's collision terms, validated by reproducing the benchmark lambda_FSH values of 0.0734 Mpc (collisionless) and 0.0020 Mpc (with collisions) for the 10 keV, m_phi = 5 TeV, T_R = 1 TeV point, and optimize the collision integrals to enable a global parameter scan.

members.model_name: Flavor-blind Z-prime mediated complex scalar MeV dark matter
members.description: The three-sector coupled Boltzmann solver that self-consistently tracks Y_chi, T_gamma, T_nu, and chemical potentials through neutrino decoupling is not publicly released, so the joint relic-density and N_eff solution (including the quoted ~7 MeV Planck exclusion) cannot be reproduced or recast for other branching ratios and s-wave variants.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public MeV-era neutrino-decoupling code (e.g. a NUDEC_BSM-style temperature/chemical-potential solver) with the complex-scalar yield equation and the paper's Z-prime collision terms, validating against the Standard Model N_eff limit and the quoted flavor-blind p-wave 7 MeV exclusion.

members.model_name: Thermal dark matter freeze-out during kination
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-out solver supports a kinaton-dominated expansion history: the required <sigma v> during kination must currently be computed with a bespoke modified-Hubble solver not released as a general tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public relic-abundance solver (micrOMEGAs or a DRAKE-style Boltzmann code) with a user-specified H(T) including a kinaton rho ~ a^-6 component and entropy bookkeeping through kinaton-radiation equality, parameterized by T_KR.

members.model_name: Neutrino-interacting asymmetric dark matter with a charged mediator
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function implementation exists for this model's DM-neutrino elastic scattering with late (keV-scale) kinetic decoupling; the card relies on the analytic M_cutoff ~ 1e8 Msun (keV/T_d)^3 estimate rather than a numerically evolved linear power spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's momentum-transfer rate (from m_chi, m_phi, g and the relativistic-neutrino scattering cross section) onto the ETHOS a_n dark-matter/dark-radiation parameterization in a modified CLASS, treating the neutrino bath as the interacting radiation species, and output transfer functions across the T_d ~ keV regime.

members.model_name: Singlet-SUSY singlino self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The relic abundance is computed only via an instant-freeze-out analytic approximation at an assumed dark-sector temperature ratio; no Boltzmann solver is set up for two-temperature hidden-sector freeze-out of the singlino into singlet scalars, limiting the precision of the Omega h^2 selection cut.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the hidden-sector Boltzmann equation with a dark-to-visible temperature ratio, e.g. via micrOMEGAs' two-sector mode or a small custom code tracking the dark-sector temperature evolution, using the paper's annihilation amplitudes to HH, AA, and HA.

members.model_name: Electrically charged massive particle dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements CHAMP-baryon Coulomb drag with late kinetic re-coupling (no tight-coupling assumption); the paper's modified CAMB following CHAMP, baryon, photon, neutrino, and metric perturbations was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the CHAMP-baryon momentum-exchange terms (Debye-screened Coulomb Gamma with kinetic re-coupling) in the coupled Euler equations of public CLASS or CAMB, parameterized by (m_Ch, q_Ch, tau_Ch), and validate against the paper's Gamma/H curves for 1e10-1e12 GeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Minimal LRSM N1 dark matter with right-handed triplet scalar dilution
members.description: No public solver exists for the right-handed triplet-scalar dilutor cosmology: coupled evolution of scalar matter domination, entropy release before BBN, and the secondary N1 momentum distribution from the suppressed Delta_R -> N1 N1 branch, including scalar widths set by Higgs mixing and off-shell W_R channels not fully encoded on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a semi-analytic dilutor module taking (M_DeltaR, lifetime, Br_Delta_to_N1, theta_h, M_WR) that outputs the dilution factor and two-component N1 f(p) for CLASS, including a scalar-width calculator for the two-body, off-shell-W_R, diphoton, and Higgs-mixing channels; validate against the paper's percent-level branching bound.

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric dark matter with a dark photon portal
members.description: No thermal-history integrator exists for the dark-photon recoupling scenario: computing N_eff(m_Aprime, epsilon, T_dark) through dark-sector entropy transfer above versus below neutrino decoupling is done only with the paper's analytic recoupling condition, not a solved temperature evolution.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled background/energy-transfer solver (extending the neutrino-decoupling machinery of nudec_BSM or a modified CLASS background module) that evolves the dark photon plus dark-pion bath through decay and recoupling and outputs N_eff over the (m_Aprime, epsilon) plane, validated against the paper's viable band.

members.model_name: Inelastic Dirac Dark Matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles the coupled chi_1/chi_2 number and momentum-distribution evolution f_i(x, q_i) required for coscattering and conversion-driven freeze-out at feeble couplings; the paper's custom solver is private and micrOMEGAs applies only where chemical and kinetic equilibrium hold.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public kinetic-decoupling framework such as DRAKE (or add a micrOMEGAs module) to a two-state inelastic system with off-diagonal conversion, decay, and inverse-decay terms, taking amplitudes from the stated i2DM FeynRules model and validating against the paper's Omega h^2 contours in the partner-annihilation and conversion regimes.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from singlet-scalar freeze-in and dark-sector freeze-out
members.description: No implementation of the coupled Boltzmann system for Higgs-portal freeze-in of the scalar singlet together with dark-sector thermalisation and the resulting dark-to-visible temperature ratio z; public freeze-in tools compute yields but not the self-thermalising dark-bath temperature evolution that sets z and the N distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone Boltzmann code) to evolve the dark-sector energy density and temperature from the Higgs-portal collision term, outputting z(lambda_p, scalar masses) and flagging the thermalisation boundary in parameter space.

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP dark matter with right-handed sneutrino NLSP
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the mixed cold-plus-warm gravitino population: the late-decay component has a nonthermal decay-kinematics phase-space distribution and fraction f_warm, so the single thermal-WDM mapping is explicitly invalid and no model-specific transfer function can currently be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-component gravitino population in CLASS's non-cold-dark-matter module, supplying the late-decay f(q) (delta-function momentum at production redshifted from tau_snuR) alongside the cold thermal-scattering component, parameterized by (f_warm, tau_snuR, m_3/2).

members.model_name: Dissipative dark matter from multiple Standard Model sectors
members.description: No modified Boltzmann-code implementation exists for N_sec hidden Standard Model copies with colder sector temperatures, dark acoustic oscillations, and dark-photon diffusion damping, so the CMB/LSS consistency and the smooth transfer-function cutoff cannot be computed quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a multi-fluid hidden sector (dark baryons, dark electrons, dark photons, dark neutrino-like radiation per copy) adapting existing atomic-dark-matter/ETHOS-style implementations, parameterized by N_sec, the sector temperature ratio, and epsilon, to produce transfer functions and Delta-N_eff for the CMB/LSS consistency check.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L thermal sterile neutrino with entropy dilution
members.description: The modified CAMB used to compute transfer functions for the entropy-diluted, redshifted nonthermal sterile-neutrino momentum distribution is not publicly released, so the colder-than-Higgs-decay transfer cutoff cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the diluted sterile-neutrino distribution as a non-cold relic in public CLASS (ncdm sector with tabulated f(q) rescaled by the dilution redshift factor r_p ~ 5) and validate against the paper's quoted thermal-WDM equivalent masses (1.1, 2.6, 4.9, 8.4 keV for m_s = 1, 3, 7, 14 keV).

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal scalar-singlet dark matter
members.description: No dedicated nonthermal Boltzmann solver is set up for scalar-singlet freeze-in through the competing Higgs-decay, sterile-neutrino-decay, and NLSP late-decay channels, whose relative importance depends on the dark-sector mass ordering.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or write a coupled-Boltzmann code tracking Y_DM and Y_NLSP with Higgs, sterile-neutrino, and NLSP source terms, validated against the paper's lambda_ds ~ 1e-12 to 1e-8 example yields.

members.model_name: Dark Dimension KK-graviton dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver module implements a dark-matter species with a time-dependent, decay-sourced momentum distribution f0(p,t) (Gaussian spread around p0(t) from intra-tower KK-graviton decays); the paper's modified CLASS/CAMB-style implementation, including the single-parameter v0 limit and any generalization to a full decay-lifetime distribution, is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the kick-velocity distribution in CLASS as a non-cold-DM species with a time-dependent phase-space source term (extending the existing ncdm and decaying-DM machinery), validate the CDM limit as v0 -> 0, and reproduce the paper's Planck v0 < ~1.2e-3 and KiDS 1e4 v0 < ~2.2 bounds.

members.model_name: Minimal LRSM N1 dark matter with N2 entropy dilution
members.description: No public released solver for the N2 dilutor cosmology: coupled Boltzmann evolution of N2 matter domination, entropy injection with BBN timing, and the momentum distribution of the hot secondary N1 component from partial N2 decays; the paper's calculation is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a semi-analytic dilutor module (e.g. building on public early-matter-domination codes or a light Boltzmann-hierarchy wrapper feeding CLASS) that takes (m_N2, tau_N2, Br_N1, M_WR) and outputs the dilution factor and the two-component N1 f(p), validated against the paper's 6.5-30 keV window.

members.model_name: Early matter domination with nearly degenerate daughter WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/perturbation solver evolves small-scale modes through an early matter-dominated era with mother decay, daughter branching fraction f_b, and the daughter free-streaming cutoff from near-degenerate two-body decay kinematics; the enhanced power spectrum and cutoff scale k_cut are currently only estimated analytically.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a three-fluid (mother matter, radiation, daughter DM) background plus perturbation module including the decay source terms and a daughter momentum distribution derived from the m/M degeneracy, outputting T(k) and k_cut as functions of (Gamma, f_b, m/M, <sigma v>).

members.model_name: Neutrino portal secluded dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation computes the secluded-sector thermal history, DM-neutrino kinetic decoupling (T_KD ~ 0.1 keV), the resulting smooth-cutoff transfer function, and the delayed neutrino free-streaming CMB effect for this U(1)_X neutrino-portal model with sterile-active mixing.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-parameterized modified CLASS (or an existing nu-DM interacting branch of CLASS) with the model's g_X, g_nu, theta_s scattering rates to compute T_KD, the linear power-spectrum cutoff, and CMB anisotropy shifts from delayed neutrino free streaming.

members.model_name: Pseudo-scalar mediator dark matter with hidden neutrinos
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the coupled dark-matter/pseudoscalar-mediator/hidden-neutrino perturbations with sudden kinetic decoupling; the paper's modified CAMB is private and the standard ETHOS parameterization does not capture the rapid mediator-density drop that produces enhanced (not just damped) DAO peaks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's momentum-transfer rate gamma(T) and dark sound-speed/imperfect-fluid equations as an extension of the ETHOS-style interacting-DM module in CLASS (or patch CAMB), parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, g_chi, g_nu, T_hidden/T_visible), and validate against the primary paper's oscillatory power-spectrum figures.

members.model_name: Symmetry-restored 2HDM plus 7.1 keV sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No numerical freeze-in pipeline exists for this 2HDM+3NR model that computes both the N1 relic yield and the decay-produced N1 momentum distribution f(q) from thermal scalar decays; the paper provides only the leading analytic abundance formula without the spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or a small dedicated Boltzmann integrator) for S -> N1 + lepton with thermal parents, additionally solving the unintegrated momentum-space equation to output f(q) — following the known decay-production spectra for scalar-decay sterile neutrinos — and pass f(q) to CLASS as an ncdm species.

members.model_name: FIMP Dirac singlet dark matter in extended neutrino 2HDM
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation exists for freeze-in production of the Dirac singlet FIMP from out-of-equilibrium right-handed-neutrino decays with the leptogenesis-linked parameters (Y_N1, K1, Br_chi) of this A4 x Z4 neutrino-2HDM; the calculation currently lives only in the paper's private equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in a public freeze-in framework: encode the N1 -> chi + scalar decay channel and N1 abundance evolution in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or extend a leptogenesis Boltzmann code such as ULYSSES to co-evolve the dark branching ratio and FIMP yield, validated against the paper's benchmark plots.

members.model_name: Z3 Dirac fermion dark matter from self-interacting scalar freeze-out
members.description: No public relic-abundance code implements 3-to-2 cannibal freeze-out for a Z3 complex scalar with a separately evolving dark-sector temperature, so the parent yield underpinning both observables cannot be computed with named tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 3-to-2 collision terms from the Z3 cubic coupling in a coupled (n_phi, T_dark) Boltzmann solver — either extending the micrOMEGAs hidden-sector machinery or writing a dedicated cannibal-freeze-out module — scanning M_phi = 0.1-100 GeV and self couplings 0.001-1 to reproduce the paper's scan.

members.model_name: Z3 Dirac fermion dark matter from self-interacting scalar freeze-out
members.description: No public code evolves the late scalar decay into dark matter plus active neutrinos between neutrino decoupling and recombination beyond the sudden-decay approximation, limiting the precision of the Delta N_eff prediction targeted at Planck and CMB-S4 sensitivity.
