members.model_name: Nonthermal warm wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code computes the neutral-wino momentum distribution and warm fraction from late gravitino decay including charged-wino electromagnetic energy loss and electroweak scattering on the thermal plasma; the paper's calculation is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's injection-plus-energy-loss Boltzmann equation as a public module that outputs a tabulated phase-space distribution f(q) and warm fraction, formatted for direct use as a CLASS ncdm species alongside a cold wino component.

members.model_name: Decaying warm majoron dark matter
members.description: The paper's modified CAMB/CosmoMC solver for a flat cosmology in which all dark matter is a majoron decaying nonradiatively to neutrinos is private/unreleased, so the CMB constraint cannot be reproduced or updated to Planck data without rebuilding the solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the public CLASS decaying-CDM-to-dark-radiation (dcdm->dr) module to the majoron case (decay products as free-streaming neutrino-like radiation, no stable CDM component), couple it to the Planck 2018 likelihood in Cobaya/MontePython, and validate by recovering the WMAP-era limits Gamma_J < 1.3e-19 s^-1 and tau_J > 250 Gyr.

members.model_name: Gravitino NLSP decay to N-superpartner plus stable N
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for a late invisible two-body decay producing one massive (N-superpartner) plus one lighter stable (N) daughter with the full injected phase-space distribution; the card relies on analytic median-velocity estimates, blocking precision Delta N_eff, CMB, and linear transfer-function predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS decaying-CDM/dark-radiation module to two-body decays with massive daughters, evolving the daughter distribution function f(q, tau) from the delta-function injection at decay, parameterized by (parent mass, daughter masses, lifetime, initial abundance), and output Delta N_eff(z) and matter transfer functions.

members.model_name: N-superpartner NLSP decay to gravitino-dominated dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for a late invisible two-body decay producing a GeV-scale gravitino plus the lighter stable N with the full injected phase-space distribution; the card relies on analytic median-velocity estimates, blocking precision Delta N_eff, CMB, and linear transfer-function predictions for the mixed gravitino-plus-N dark matter.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS decaying-CDM/dark-radiation module to two-body decays with two massive daughters of different masses, evolving each daughter's distribution function f(q, tau) from the delta-function injection at decay, parameterized by (parent mass, daughter masses, lifetime, initial abundance), and output Delta N_eff(z) and matter transfer functions for the two-component relic.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition vector dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the FOPT bubble-collision particle-production pipeline (field-excitation spectra to nonthermal vector yield to Omega_DM h^2) even at the level of the paper's prescription; the card lists a particle-production implementation as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a module on top of a CosmoTransitions-class finite-temperature code that takes a user potential, computes (alpha, beta_over_H, wall gamma), evaluates the paper's yield formulas for the lambda_V |phi|^2 V_mu V^mu coupling including the longitudinal mode, and outputs Omega_DM h^2 with entropy-dilution bookkeeping.

members.model_name: Fourth-family Dirac-neutrino Z' WIMP
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs or an equivalent Boltzmann code) exists for the non-universal U(1)' model with a fourth vector-like family, including the mixing-induced b and muon couplings, so the joint relic-density scan cannot be run out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian (Z', vector-like fourth family, mixing matrices) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and validate a micrOMEGAs relic-density scan against the primary paper's viable band in M_Zprime and m_chi.

members.model_name: Scalar field fluctuation dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists that propagates the scalar-fluctuation DM isocurvature spectrum P_S(k) (blue-tilted, set by m, H_*, and the stochastic field variance) through to the CMB and the matter power spectrum, so the predicted small-scale power enhancement cannot be computed and no survey limit can be quoted.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's uncorrelated DM-radiation isocurvature initial condition in CLASS with the primordial P_S(k) computed from the stochastic spectator-scalar variance as a function of (m, H_*, chi_*), and output the enhanced matter transfer function and CMB isocurvature spectra, validating against the benchmark numbers quoted in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Z3 Dirac fermion dark matter from Higgs-portal scalar freeze-out
members.description: No public code evolves the late scalar decay into dark matter plus active neutrinos between neutrino decoupling and recombination beyond the sudden-decay approximation, so Delta N_eff and the injected neutrino spectrum carry uncontrolled approximation error in the regime Planck and future CMB precision probes.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small Boltzmann module coupling the phi decay term (lifetime set by y1) to the neutrino and photon baths, tracking energy injection and Delta N_eff through BBN-to-CMB times, and validate it against the sudden-decay limit; interface its output to CLASS for CMB-era use.

members.model_name: Pseudoscalar-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of this model's t-averaged pseudoscalar DM-hidden-neutrino collision term exists; ETHOS-class CLASS modifications assume power-law momentum-transfer rates and do not encode the zero-momentum vs t-averaged prescription difference the paper shows is a leading systematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS-modified CLASS hierarchy with the paper's t-averaged pseudoscalar reaction rate (as a tabulated Gamma(T) rather than a power law) and validate against the primary paper's dark-acoustic-oscillation transfer functions and the perfect/imperfect fluid comparison.

members.model_name: Pseudovector-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the DM-hidden-neutrino collision term for the pseudovector mediator with the paper's t-averaged reaction rate and imperfect-fluid corrections; existing ETHOS-type modified CLASS versions parameterize the drag rate differently and do not cover the regime where the perfect-fluid approximation fails.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS parameterization in a modified CLASS to accept the pseudovector-mediator t-averaged momentum-transfer rate as an opacity input and add the higher Boltzmann-hierarchy moments needed beyond the perfect-fluid approximation, validating against the primary paper's transfer functions.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the DM-hidden-neutrino collision term for the scalar mediator with the paper's t-averaged reaction rate and imperfect-fluid corrections; existing ETHOS-type modified CLASS versions parameterize the drag rate differently and do not cover the strongly momentum-dependent scattering regime where the perfect-fluid approximation fails.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS parameterization in a modified CLASS to accept the scalar-mediator t-averaged momentum-transfer rate as an opacity input and add the higher Boltzmann-hierarchy moments needed beyond the perfect-fluid approximation, validating against the primary paper's transfer functions.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the DM-hidden-neutrino collision term for the vector mediator with the paper's t-averaged reaction rate and imperfect-fluid corrections; existing ETHOS-type modified CLASS versions use a power-law drag-rate parameterization and do not cover the regime where the perfect-fluid approximation fails.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS parameterization in a modified CLASS to accept the vector-mediator t-averaged momentum-transfer rate as an opacity input and add the higher Boltzmann-hierarchy moments needed beyond the perfect-fluid approximation, validating against the primary paper's transfer functions.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac split SIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles hidden-sector 4-to-2 SIMP freeze-out with an independent dark-sector temperature and the two-state chi_1/chi_2 network, so the relic abundance, dark temperature history, and the late excited-state ratio R_0 that controls all downstream signals cannot be computed with existing packages (micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY cover standard 2-to-2 freeze-out and freeze-in only).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a coupled temperature-and-abundance solver (micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector mode or a DRAKE-style code) with 4-to-2 collision terms and the chi_1/chi_2/V reaction network, importing the paper's CalcHEP/FeynArts matrix elements, and output Omega h^2, T_dark(t), and R_0 over the (m, Delta m, m_V, g_V, epsilon) space.

members.model_name: Dark fermion self-scattering with scalar-decay injection
members.description: No public momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver includes the elastic self-scattering collision term (dark-photon-mediated psi psi -> psi psi) together with late decay injection S -> psi psi; the paper's DRAKE extension implementing these is not released, and the public DRAKE version cannot reproduce the up-to-orders-of-magnitude nBE/fBE relic differences.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public DRAKE fBE framework with the 2->2 self-scattering collision integral (using the paper's parameterization of the dark-U(1) amplitude) and a decay source term, validated against the paper's resonance, threshold, and late-injection benchmarks.

members.model_name: Light Dirac neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled Boltzmann equations for chi dark matter and right-handed-neutrino dark radiation across the three phi regimes (phi in equilibrium, superWIMP-like freeze-out-then-decay, and Higgs-portal freeze-in of phi), including the phase-space distribution f(p,T) needed downstream.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in MicrOMEGAs 5's freeze-in module for the yield calculation and release a companion unintegrated-Boltzmann solver for f(p,T) covering all three phi thermal histories, validated against the paper's benchmark Delta N_eff of order 1e-3 and its relic-density contours.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition rescued self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No public implementation exists of the two-stage relic calculation in which a first freeze-out with a near-threshold mediator is followed by a post-FOPT second annihilation era after the mediator mass drops; standard relic codes cannot handle the time-dependent mediator mass across the transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated Boltzmann solver (or extend micrOMEGAs with a temperature-dependent mediator mass m_phi(T) switching at T_n) that evolves the chi abundance through freeze-out, the transition, and the second annihilation stage, validated against the paper benchmark m_chi = 0.438 GeV, alpha_chi = 0.145.

members.model_name: Partially interacting dark-atom dark matter with dark acoustic oscillations
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the full dark-atom perturbation system for this model: dark recombination of the dark plasma, dark Thomson and Rayleigh scattering opacities, and the DM-dark-radiation tight-coupling regime for an interacting fraction f_int; the original analysis code is not released and generic ETHOS parameterizations do not capture the atomic recombination history.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with an atomic-dark-matter module: add a RECFAST-style dark-recombination solver for dark hydrogen (parameters alpha_D, m_D, B_D, xi), the corresponding dark-photon drag terms including Rayleigh scattering, and a partially-interacting fraction f_int, validating the tight-coupling limit against the ETHOS implementation.

members.model_name: Decoupled self-interacting real scalar dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the relic abundance of a decoupled self-thermalizing real scalar with relativistic Bose-Einstein statistics, 2-to-4 number-changing self-reactions, dark-sector temperature evolution, and an effective chemical potential; the paper relied on private numerical integrations of the collision terms.
members.proposed_resolution: Release a standalone integrator (or extend the hidden-sector freeze-out machinery in micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY) that evolves the coupled dark-temperature and chemical-potential equations with Bose-Einstein collision integrals for SS <-> SSSS processes, parameterized by (m, lambda, T_dark_initial, mu).

members.model_name: Inflation-produced vector dark matter with neutrino decays
members.description: No implemented background integrator maps (m, H_I, g) through the vector decay history to Delta N_eff(z) at recombination; the paper's instantaneous-decay estimate is only approximate and the card lists the decay integrator as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the inflation-produced vector as a decaying matter component in the CLASS dcdm-to-dark-radiation module (or an equivalent stiff-ODE background solver), with the decay products routed into the neutrino radiation density and the injection window restricted to between neutrino decoupling and photon decoupling; validate against the paper's approximate Delta N_eff proportional to (H_I/1e14 GeV)^2 (1e-8/g) scaling and the zero-BBN-Delta-N_eff test.

members.model_name: Q-ball dark matter from Model A solitosynthesis
members.description: No public solitosynthesis Boltzmann solver exists for evolving the charge-binned Q-ball species network (free S/anti-S capture, fusion, charge exchange, and freeze-out of the total Q-ball number density) in Model A; the paper's coupled-Boltzmann validation code is not released, so the relic abundance and charge distribution cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a charge-binned coupled Boltzmann network (species Q = 1..Q_max with geometric capture/fusion rates and the Model A mass spectrum m_Q ~ Q^(3/4)), validated against the paper's analytic charge-domination and freeze-out estimates and its published benchmark regions.

members.model_name: Q-ball dark matter from Model B solitosynthesis
members.description: No public solitosynthesis Boltzmann solver exists for evolving the charge-binned Q-ball species network in Model B, including the altered large-Q mass scaling from the nonzero repulsive S self-quartic; the paper's coupled-Boltzmann code is not released, so relic abundance and charge distribution cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a charge-binned coupled Boltzmann network with the Model B mass spectrum (small-Q and large-Q regimes with lambda_S-dependent scaling), geometric capture/fusion rates, and charge-asymmetry initial conditions, validated against the paper's benchmark solitosynthesis regions.

members.model_name: Forbidden leptophilic Dirac-fermion dark matter with scalar mediator
members.description: The full momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver with the complete elastic collision term (beyond the Fokker-Planck approximation) for forbidden leptophilic freeze-out is a private authors' C/CVODE code; no public tool reproduces the relic-density shifts that redefine the viable parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the authors' solver, or extend DRAKE's fBE mode with the fully angular-integrated elastic collision term for scalar-mediated lepton scattering near forbidden thresholds, validating against the paper's nBE-vs-fBE relic shifts and the Fokker-Planck comparison benchmarks.

members.model_name: Mirror Twin Higgs reheaton baryogenesis atomic dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of Mirror-Twin-Higgs atomic dark matter exists for this model: twin recombination (twin hydrogen and twin helium), twin BAO features, and the f_aDM/Delta N_eff parameterization needed to reproduce the imported Planck/BAO bounds are only available in private modified codes from related studies.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the twin-sector fluid (twin baryons coupled to twin photons with a twin recombination history including twin helium) as a public CLASS extension parameterized by (f_aDM, Delta N_eff, f/v, twin binding energies), validated against the published twin-BAO bounds, and expose it to Cobaya/MontePython likelihoods.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the FOPT bubble-collision particle-production pipeline (field-excitation spectra to nonthermal scalar yield to Omega_DM h^2) even at the level of the paper's prescription; the card lists a particle-production implementation as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a module on top of a CosmoTransitions-class finite-temperature code that takes a user potential, computes (alpha, beta_over_H, wall gamma), evaluates the paper's yield formulas for the lambda_s phi^2 phi_s^2 coupling, and outputs Omega_DM h^2 with entropy-dilution bookkeeping.

members.model_name: Hyperlight coupled scalar late dark matter
members.description: The modified CLASS+HyRec Boltzmann code implementing scalar-dependent m_e and alpha at recombination together with the hyperlight scalar's background and perturbation evolution (m_phi about 1e-32 to 1e-28 eV) is cited by the paper but no public repository was resolved, so CMB/LSS predictions for this model cannot currently be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain the authors' CLASS/HyRec patch (the reference cited in arXiv:2405.10358) or reimplement it by combining an existing varying-constant CLASS branch with the standard ultralight-scalar fluid/field perturbation module, validating against the paper's LambdaCDM limit and quoted percent/permille shift and scalar-fraction posteriors.

members.model_name: Scalar-decay-produced cold dark matter after low-temperature reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation exists for the three-fluid reheating perturbation equations (pressureless scalar parent, coupled radiation, decay-produced CDM with production velocity v_RH); only the paper's fitting functions are available, limiting evaluation to the fitted parameter regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with the early-matter-domination fluid system (scalar source terms in the dcdm-like sector plus a decay-produced CDM species with tabulated production velocity), validating against the paper's fitting functions and the standard CDM limit for modes entering after reheating.

members.model_name: Pseudo-sakharon long-lived dark matter
members.description: No relic-density implementation exists for the pseudo-sakharon scalar sector: the S S -> h_xi h_xi freeze-out with the m_S > m_hxi hierarchy and suppressed Higgs portal has not been encoded in any public Boltzmann solver, so Omega_S h^2 rests on the paper's approximate 1 pb target only.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) model file for the two-scalar sector (S, h_xi) with lambda_xi and the small Higgs portal, and solve the freeze-out Boltzmann equation across the (m_S, m_hxi, lambda_xi) plane, validating against the paper's canonical 1 pb benchmark.

members.model_name: Late-universe two-body decaying dark matter
members.description: No mainline Boltzmann-solver implementation of two-body decaying dark matter with a warm massive daughter is packaged for this card; the linear CMB/matter-power prediction relies on a modified-CLASS fluid approximation from related papers that is not integrated or validated for the full tau-epsilon range used here.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt the public modified CLASS with the two-body DDM warm-daughter fluid approximation (Abellan et al. line of work cited as 2102.12498), validate it against the paper's background solution in the LCDM limits (tau to infinity, epsilon to 0), and register it as the route's Boltzmann step.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal freeze-in scalar with hierarchical lepton couplings
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code extension plus likelihood pipeline reproduces the paper's Planck/BAO/LSS/Pantheon fit for a keV freeze-in scalar with late two-photon decay; the required decaying-DM background and perturbation terms in CLASS/CAMB and the associated MCMC setup are not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public CLASS decaying-CDM branch (dcdm/exoCLASS-style) with phi -> gamma gamma late-decay source terms matching the paper's perturbation treatment, couple it to cobaya or MontePython with the Planck 2018+BAO+Pantheon likelihoods, and validate against the quoted H0 = 68.31 and 69.34 km/s/Mpc best fits.

members.model_name: Self-interacting forbidden vector dark matter with a cannibally co-decaying phase
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the cannibally co-decaying forbidden freeze-out: coupled X and S yields with a separately evolving hidden-sector temperature, 3-to-2 number-changing rates, finite-temperature forbidden XX->SS annihilation, and out-of-equilibrium S decay through Higgs mixing.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the paper's coupled yield/temperature equations as a public module — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector temperature machinery with 3-to-2 cannibal collision terms and thermally averaged forbidden rates — validated against the paper's relic-density curves in the (m_X, m_S/m_X, g_dm, theta) plane.

members.model_name: Kinetic recoupling dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver accepts a nonmonotonic DM-dark-radiation drag opacity: ETHOS-style CLASS/CAMB modifications implement monotonic power-law momentum-exchange rates, so the decouple-recouple-decouple history (T_kd, T_rec, T_kd_prime) cannot be propagated to transfer functions with existing released codes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS interacting-dark-matter module in CLASS to take a general tabulated Gamma(a) (or a parameterized recoupling template in T_kd, T_rec, T_kd_prime) as input for the DM-DR momentum-exchange term, validated against the CDM limit as Gamma goes to 0 and the published feature shifts under T_rec variation.

members.model_name: NMSSM light neutralino LSP dark matter with a 95 GeV Higgs
members.description: LHC exclusion status of the near-degenerate co-annihilation spectra (Delta M ~ 10 GeV charginos, sleptons, next-to-lightest neutralinos with diluted cascade branchings) is only approximately covered: SModelS simplified-model maps do not capture these unconventional NMSSM decay chains, so the collider viability of the co-annihilation benchmark class is under-constrained.
members.proposed_resolution: Run full event-level recasts of the ATLAS/CMS compressed-electroweakino and slepton searches (soft-lepton plus missing-energy analyses) with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 on the accepted benchmark spectra, and feed the resulting efficiency maps back as new SModelS topologies.

members.model_name: Hypercharge electroweak ALP-portal Dirac dark matter
members.description: The custom Boltzmann solver needed beyond micrOMEGAs for this model is not public: near-resonance (M_a approximately 2 M_chi) thermal averaging with narrow-width subtleties and the reheating-temperature-dependent freeze-in production of ALP plus DM are only implemented in the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the resonance-aware thermal-average and freeze-in Boltzmann equations as an extension of micrOMEGAs (using the public CalcHEP model files for the rates), parameterized by M_chi, M_a, f, the anomaly benchmark, and T_RH, and validate against the paper's thermal-target and freeze-in scan curves to the quoted 20 percent level.

members.model_name: Vector-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the boosted two-body-decay dark-matter subcomponent: the decay-produced monochromatic-then-redshifting momentum distribution of B_mu from W_mu -> B_mu + photon (gamma set by M_X/M_DM and tau_X) is not available as a species in CLASS/CAMB, so the mixed cold-plus-boosted transfer function and the CMB response (Delta N_eff-like behavior) cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic growth-suppression estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-produced component as a non-cold dark matter species in CLASS (ncdm sector with a delta-function injection distribution at time tau_X, Lorentz factor M_X/2M_DM, and fraction f), validate against the paper's analytic Delta N_eff and growth-suppression formulas, and output mixed-DM transfer functions.

members.model_name: Co-decaying dark matter with enhanced small-scale structure
members.description: No public Boltzmann/transfer-function code evolves the co-decaying A/B background and its small-scale perturbations through the early matter-dominated era, including the dark-temperature perturbation equation, kinetic decoupling, and free-streaming damping that set k_cut.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a two-species co-decay dark sector (coupled rho_A, rho_B, decay term, A A <-> B B interaction) and add the missing dark-temperature perturbation equation, outputting the EMDE-enhanced transfer function and k_cut as functions of m, Gamma_B, entropy ratio, and kinetic-decoupling temperature.

members.model_name: Asymmetric singlet scalar and Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements the coupled visible-plus-dark leptogenesis network of this model: CP-violating out-of-equilibrium N_1 decays feeding both the lepton and dark (psi, phi_prime) asymmetries, with the dimension-eight transfer operator freezing out near the sphaleron temperature; the relic prediction currently rests on unsolved source equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES with additional Boltzmann equations for the dark-sector asymmetries (branching-dependent CP asymmetries in N decays) and a washout/transfer term for the phi^2(LH)^2/M_asy^4 operator, outputting Y_B and Y_DM versus (M_N, Yukawas, M_asy).

members.model_name: Weakly coupled B-L gauge-boson freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver computes the phase-space distributions of an out-of-equilibrium B-L gauge boson and the N1 population produced by its decay; existing freeze-in tools return integrated abundances only, while both the relic density and the warm-DM free-streaming scale here require f(p).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an unintegrated freeze-in solver to a two-stage cascade (bath -> V -> N1) tracking f_V(p,t) and f_N1(p,t) over the (m_V, g_B-L) plane, validated against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 curves, and export f_N1(p) in CLASS ncdm format.

members.model_name: Vector-portal hidden-sector dark matter with an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No public code implements the EMDE microhalo pipeline for this hidden-sector model: perturbation growth through Z-prime domination and reheating, the resulting microhalo mass function with its small-scale cutoff, and the gravitational-heating suppression of the population; the paper's N-body-calibrated procedure is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the paper's analytic EMDE transfer function plus Press-Schechter/spherical-collapse microhalo mass function and its N-body boost-factor calibration into a public module parameterized by (T_dom, T_RH, lambda_fs), including the default and conservative gravitational-heating prescriptions.

members.model_name: 331_R keV sterile-neutrino mixed warm-hot dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the mixed warm-hot N1 phase-space distribution (diluted thermal component plus nonthermal component from N2 decay), so the mixed transfer function and small-scale power suppression cannot be computed; the paper only gives approximate free-streaming estimates and the thermal_wdm_mapping is flagged as invalid.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-component N1 distribution function f(p) (diluted thermal plus N2-decay nonthermal, parameterized by m_N1, f_NT, and alpha) as a non-cold dark matter species in CLASS/CAMB (ncdm module with tabulated psd) and compute the mixed transfer function across the benchmark grid.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac Higgs-portal dark matter with excited-state decay
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the pseudo-Dirac Higgs-portal Lagrangian with CP-even/CP-odd singlet mediators: the coannihilation relic density (including resonances and thresholds in the m_DM-m_s plane) was computed with private Boltzmann code, so relic and direct-detection scans cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules and export CalcHEP/UFO files so micrOMEGAs (with coannihilation channels enabled) reproduces the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours for m_DM = 300 and 500 GeV and its sigma_SI predictions, then release the model files.

members.model_name: Scotogenic singlet fermion dark matter with one-step first-order phase transition
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles relic production modified by a delayed one-step first-order phase transition: the coupled N/inert-scalar equations with finite-temperature mass shifts and production changing across the transition at low T_n cannot be run in stock micrOMEGAs, which assumes zero-temperature masses and a standard thermal history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a dedicated coupled Boltzmann integrator that takes micrOMEGAs cross sections plus the phase-dependent mass spectrum and T_n from the nucleation calculation, switching the spectrum at the transition, and validate by recovering the paper's low-T_n relic benchmarks and the standard freeze-out limit for high T_n.

members.model_name: WIMP freeze-out in dEGB cosmology
members.description: No public code integrates the dilatonic Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet background (scalar field with f(phi)=alpha exp(gamma phi) coupled to R_GB^2) from pre-freeze-out temperatures to BBN and feeds the resulting H(T) into a WIMP freeze-out Boltzmann solver; every observable on the card depends on this modified expansion history.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone ODE integrator for the dEGB Friedmann and scalar equations with (phi_BBN, phidot_BBN) boundary conditions enforcing BBN recovery, and couple its H(T) output to micrOMEGAs' modified-cosmology (alternative expansion) interface or to a custom freeze-out solver, validated by recovering the standard 3e-26 cm^3/s cross section when alpha goes to zero.

members.model_name: Spontaneously broken U(1)' asymmetric self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the decoupled two-temperature dark sector: evolving the asymmetric chi/anti-chi Boltzmann equations in the hidden bath with initial temperature ratio xi_ini to obtain the residual anti-DM ratio r_infinity and the S_1 dark-radiation contribution to Delta N_eff, which the CMB residual-annihilation and N_eff constraints require.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled Boltzmann solver tracking the dark-sector temperature xi(T) and the chi, anti-chi, A', S_1 number densities with secluded annihilation to dark mediators (inputs Y_chi, alpha', xi_ini, m_chi, m_A'), for example by extending an existing hidden-sector relic framework, and validate against the paper's r_infinity examples and the Delta N_eff < 0.29 room.

members.model_name: Vector SIMP dark matter in SU_X(2) x U(1)_Z' gauge model
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the vector SIMP relic abundance in the SU_X(2) x U(1)_Z' model: the 3-to-2 processes, 2-to-2 forbidden annihilations, and the kinetic-equilibrium condition with the SM bath are outside standard micrOMEGAs number-density freeze-out, and the paper imports relic contours from earlier work.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled Boltzmann equations for 3-to-2 and forbidden 2-to-2 channels of the non-Abelian vector SIMP sector (with the X_3-mediated kinetic-equilibrium term) as a standalone solver or a micrOMEGAs extension, parameterized by (m_X, m_X3/m_X, alpha_D, epsilon), and validate against the published Planck-compatible contours.

members.model_name: Dark-brane Dirac fermion radion-mediated dark matter
members.description: BBN safety of the about 40 MeV radion decaying near T_rd of about 5 MeV rests on an approximate decay-temperature threshold; no full BBN network calculation of the electromagnetic/hadronic injection and Delta N_eff from radion decays has been performed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run an ACROPOLIS-class MeV-scale decaying-particle BBN code with the radion mass, abundance, lifetime, and branching fractions to obtain proper light-element and N_eff constraints on (m_r, T_rd, Lambda_1), replacing the few-MeV rule of thumb.

members.model_name: CKM-aligned heavy-quark freeze-in ALP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the full ALP phase-space distribution f(p) from freeze-in via flavor-violating heavy-quark decays q_i -> q_j a and quark-gluon/quark-antiquark scatterings including g_*(T) evolution and thermal QCD corrections near the heavy-quark thresholds; existing freeze-in tools return only integrated yields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-in framework (e.g. the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or an unintegrated-Boltzmann code) with the derivative ALP-quark operators and CKM-aligned charge matrices to evolve the momentum-dependent collision terms for decays and 2-to-2 scatterings, outputting Y_a and tabulated f(p) for downstream cosmology; validate against the paper's Omega h^2 band.

members.model_name: Single-flavor-transition heavy-quark freeze-in ALP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the full ALP phase-space distribution f(p) from freeze-in via a single flavor-violating heavy-quark transition (bs, bd, cu, sd, tu, or tc) through decays q_i -> q_j a and quark-gluon/quark-antiquark scatterings including g_*(T) evolution and thermal QCD corrections near the relevant quark threshold; existing freeze-in tools return only integrated yields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-in framework (e.g. the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or an unintegrated-Boltzmann code) with the derivative ALP-quark operator for one right-handed two-flavor transition at a time, evolving the momentum-dependent collision terms for decays and 2-to-2 scatterings and outputting Y_a and tabulated f(p) per transition benchmark; validate against the paper's Omega h^2 band.

members.model_name: Decay-produced neutrino cold-plus-hot dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves the nonthermal light-neutrino distribution sourced by nu_H -> nu_L + phi decay after neutrino decoupling (plus the scalar dark-radiation daughter); the authors' modified CMBFAST is unreleased, blocking both P(k) and C_l predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the momentum-dependent decay Boltzmann hierarchy in CLASS (an ncdm species with time-dependent phase-space source from the parent decay plus a massless phi fluid), building on existing public decaying-neutrino CLASS branches, and validate against the paper's relativistic CHDM-like limit and nonrelativistic departures.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver module evolves the atomic-dark-matter plasma: dark recombination (case-B dark-hydrogen coefficients), the resulting time-dependent ionization fraction, the dark-photon drag opacity, and the coupled DM/dark-radiation perturbation hierarchy needed for the DAO transfer function and CMB spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (building on the ETHOS interacting DM-DR framework) with a RECFAST-style dark-hydrogen recombination module parameterized by (m_D, alpha_D, B_D, xi), feed the resulting x_D(z) into the DM-DR drag opacity, and output CMB spectra and matter transfer functions over the model grid.

members.model_name: Bino-wino co-annihilation dark matter in high-scale SUSY
members.description: No public solver evolves the momentum distribution of nonthermal binos injected by late gravitino decay through the inelastic bino-wino scattering energy-loss cycle to obtain f_warm, r_warm, and k_fs.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a momentum-space Boltzmann integrator for gravitino-decay injection with inelastic bino-wino scattering and decays, validate against the paper's r_warm and k_fs results for r_T = 0.5 and 0.9, and output f(p) in the CLASS/CAMB non-cold-dark-matter distribution format.

members.model_name: Nucleophilic scalar Co-SIMP dark matter
members.description: No public relic-abundance solver handles Co-SIMP freeze-out driven by the 3-to-2 process phi phi N -> phi N with a Standard Model nucleon in the bath; the thermal target coupling for this model cannot be computed with existing packages, which only support 2-to-2 annihilation or purely dark 3-to-2 cannibalism.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a standalone Boltzmann code) with a 3-to-2 collision term that includes the baryon number density as an external thermal target, parameterized by (m_phi, m_eta, y_phi, y_N), and validate against the primary paper's thermal-target curves.

members.model_name: Leptophilic Sommerfeld-enhanced WIMP toy model
members.description: No public coupled chemical/kinetic-decoupling solver validated for this model's resonant Sommerfeld regime evolves the full phase-space distribution: the Maxwellian second-moment approximation used by the paper (and by moment-based modes of DRAKE-class solvers) can fail in resonant and Ramsauer-Townsend-like regions where the reannihilation-driven relic shift reaches orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public coupled Boltzmann solver (DRAKE) with its full f(p) phase-space evolution mode configured for scalar/pseudoscalar leptophilic mediators, including velocity-dependent Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation and self-scattering kernels, and validate against the paper's Y-y benchmark trajectories and the standard freeze-out limit.

members.model_name: Fermion-parent non-thermal fermion WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the boosted two-body-decay dark-matter subcomponent: the decay-produced monochromatic-then-redshifting momentum distribution (gamma set by M_X/M_DM and tau_X) is not available as a species in CLASS/CAMB, so the mixed cold-plus-boosted transfer function and the CMB response (Delta N_eff-like behavior) cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic growth-suppression estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-produced component as a non-cold dark matter species in CLASS (ncdm sector with a delta-function injection distribution at time tau_X, Lorentz factor M_X/2M_DM, and fraction f), validate against the paper's analytic Delta N_eff and growth-suppression formulas, and output mixed-DM transfer functions.

members.model_name: MDM U(1)_X cold dark matter with sterile-neutrino hot component
members.description: No linear Boltzmann implementation covers this model's late kinetic decoupling of TeV chi against eV sterile neutrinos in a mixed CDM+HDM cosmology; only an analytic M_cut estimate exists, so the actual transfer-function suppression is uncomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the chi-sterile scattering rate onto the ETHOS parameterization and run a modified CLASS with DM-dark-radiation coupling plus the eV HDM component, producing transfer functions over (m_chi, m_X, g_X, T_x^dec).

members.model_name: Non-thermal higgsino dark matter from late decays
members.description: No coupled modulus-decay/reheating Boltzmann solver is implemented for the re-annihilation regime; the relic abundance rests on the analytic min-yield estimate, which loses precision near the Gamma_ann ~ H(T_R) regime boundary and for BBN-consistency checks of the reheating history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled modulus-radiation-neutralino Boltzmann system (m_phi, T_R, Br_phi, <sigma v>) as a small ODE code or as a modified micrOMEGAs nonthermal driver, validating against the source's moduli-mass scale of 1e6-1e7 GeV.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter with a stable vector mediator
members.description: No public implementation of the coupled two-component Boltzmann system for psi and stable Z_D including psi-Z_D conversion processes, Z_D Z_D -> h_D h_D depletion, and Higgs-portal-controlled h_D decays; the relic abundances of both species feed every downstream observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs' multi-component dark-matter mode (or a dedicated coupled-Boltzmann code such as a DRAKE extension) with the conversion collision terms from the primary paper, and validate against the paper's benchmark relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Two-body decaying cold dark matter to warm dark matter and dark radiation
members.description: The modified CLASS implementation of the two-body DCDM -> WDM + DR perturbation equations (warm-daughter fluid hierarchy with the massive-neutrino-style viscous closure) is author code without an identified public release, so independent computation of the linear P(k) and S8 suppression is blocked.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain and publish the authors' CLASS DDM patch or reimplement the background plus warm-daughter fluid equations in current public CLASS, validating the fluid approximation against a full phase-space hierarchy run on benchmark (Gamma^-1, epsilon) points including the best fit near 56 Gyr, epsilon = 0.007.

members.model_name: Decay-induced freeze-in baryogenesis scalar dark matter
members.description: No coupled Boltzmann solver exists that evolves the freeze-in S yield together with the CP asymmetry, flavor-dependent washout, and sphaleron conversion for the vectorlike-lepton Dirac-leptogenesis-like system; the paper's solver is private and abundance and baryon asymmetry must be solved together.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann framework (e.g. ULYSSES) or the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module with the F_i -> e_alpha S decay and 2-to-2 scattering collision terms, resonant CP asymmetry for nearly degenerate F_1/F_2, and flavored washout, validated against the paper's benchmark relic density and BAU figures.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV U(1)_T3R Majorana dark matter
members.description: No numerical relic-density implementation of the U(1)_T3R model exists: the resonant dark-Higgs annihilation, chi_1-chi_2 co-annihilation with mass splitting, and invisible final states require a Boltzmann solver model file that the card says is absent (computational_representation null, tool_or_code null on the freezeout step).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_T3R Lagrangian (chi_1, chi_2, A', phi' with the paper's charge assignments) as a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run micrOMEGAs or MadDM for the co-annihilating, near-resonant freeze-out scan.

members.model_name: Scotogenic sterile-neutrino FIMP dark matter with scalar-doublet mass splitting
members.description: No public implementation of this model's Z2-symmetric two-doublet finite-temperature effective potential exists; the paper's CosmoTransitions setup (potential, daisy resummation, bounce and transition parameters alpha, beta/H, T_n) is not released, so the phase-transition strength feeding the GW prediction cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scotogenic H1-H2 one-loop plus daisy finite-temperature potential as a CosmoTransitions (or PhaseTracer) model class, validate against the paper's benchmark (m_H+ = 300 GeV, U-DECIGO-reach spectrum), and release it with the registry card.

members.model_name: Super-Resonant Dark Matter
members.description: No numerical implementation exists for the freeze-in production of SQCD dark mesons through the kinetically mixed dark photon, including the dark-sector internal thermalization that fixes the charged-to-neutral meson relic ratio; the card records only the paper's mechanism-level benchmarks (computational_representation null, phase-space distribution unavailable).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dark-photon-portal model file for the meson EFT and extend micrOMEGAs freeze-in (or a dedicated Boltzmann code) with coupled dark-sector equations tracking the charged and neutral meson populations over (epsilon, alpha_D, m, m_Aprime), validating that freeze-out is excluded in the resonant benchmark region as the paper reports.

members.model_name: Spin-1 relativistic-decay dark matter EFT
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the model's injection history: a heavy scalar companion decaying via the dimension-five operator to a massive spin-1 daughter that is relativistic at injection (redshifting from radiation-like to matter-like) together with the accompanying photon energy injection, so Delta N_eff, the H0 shift, and the free-streaming transfer function cannot be computed precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS's dcdm/dr module to a two-body decay with a massive daughter evolved as an NCDM species with the delta-function decay phase-space distribution (following existing DM-to-DM+DR modified-CLASS implementations, which are spin-agnostic at the fluid level), and couple the photon branch to ExoCLASS/DarkAges-style energy-injection treatment for BBN and CMB consistency.

members.model_name: Ultralight scalar dark matter with refractive neutrino masses
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for a refractive neutrino mass that scales with the dark-matter density as m_nu(z) ~ (1+z)^(3/2) with resonance suppression at low energies, so the quoted Planck+BAO sum m_nu < 0.12 eV bound (derived for constant masses) cannot be legitimately applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS or CAMB with a time-varying effective neutrino mass module parameterized by (m_phi, m_chi, g, background state), including the resonance-energy cutoff in the neutrino distribution integrals, and rerun the Planck 2018 + BAO likelihood chains for this scaling.

members.model_name: Light-right-handed-neutrino lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter (freeze-out)
members.description: No public rate-equation/Boltzmann solver implements the freeze-out-branch B-L transfer from a rotating PQ field through light right-handed neutrinos (chemical-potential-sourced yield with equilibrium maintained down to T ~ m_N followed by freeze-out); the calculation currently exists only as the primary paper's in-house computation.

members.model_name: Light collisional cold dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation computes the exact linear transfer function for light DM elastically coupled to neutrinos/electrons: the route needs a linear P(k) with the model's oscillatory collisional/mixed-damping cutoff, but the paper only provides analytic damping-length scalings and the card identifies no perturbation code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement DM-neutrino and DM-electron elastic scattering terms in CLASS (following the ETHOS-style interacting dark-matter opacity approach, with temperature-dependent momentum-transfer rates and a kinetic-decoupling calculation), producing exact transfer functions across the ~5 MeV to 10 GeV mass window.

members.model_name: Coupled phantom cold dark matter
members.description: No public release exists of the modified CAMB/CosmoMC implementation of the coupled-phantom pCDM equations (Q = H xi rho_x with the xi > 0, w < -1, xi < -3w stability region), so both CMB and H0-tension observables cannot be re-evaluated without re-patching a Boltzmann solver.

members.model_name: Coupled quintessence cold dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the Q = H xi rho_x coupled-quintessence (xi < 0, w > -1) background and perturbation equations exists; the paper's CAMB/CosmoMC patch is private, so the CMB spectra and distance measures feeding the inference cannot be recomputed from the card alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's modified dark-matter and dark-energy continuity and Euler equations (including the stability-branch conditions) as a patch to CAMB or CLASS with xi and w as sampled parameters, and validate against the posterior contours reported in the primary paper before coupling to CosmoMC or Cobaya.

members.model_name: Coupled vacuum cold dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the Q = H xi rho_x interacting-vacuum equations (w fixed at -0.999, xi < 0 stable branch) exists; the paper's CAMB/CosmoMC modification is private, so CMB spectra and distances for this model cannot be recomputed from the card alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the modified dark-sector continuity and Euler equations with the w = -0.999 vacuum surrogate and xi < 0 stability condition as a CAMB or CLASS patch, validate against the paper's reported posteriors, then couple to CosmoMC or Cobaya for sampling.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M1
members.description: No linear Boltzmann-code implementation exists for this model's DM-neutrino elastic scattering with a keV-scale singlet mediator (DS_M1 regime), so the acoustic-damping transfer function and the ~1e10 solar-mass cutoff are only semi-analytic estimates rather than computed matter power spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the model's temperature-dependent DM-neutrino momentum-transfer rate from the sterile-bridge effective coupling and implement it in a modified CLASS (ETHOS-style parameterization with neutrinos as the dark-radiation partner) to compute linear transfer functions and half-mode masses across the (m_F, m_S, g_nu) space.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M2
members.description: No linear Boltzmann-solver implementation of this model's post-BBN DM-neutrino elastic coupling (singlet-scalar-mediated, effective g_nu with m_S above T_D) exists to compute the actual transfer function and protohalo cutoff mass; the route relies on an analytic rate-equals-Hubble estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's temperature-dependent DM-neutrino scattering rate in an ETHOS-parameterized modified CLASS (or the existing DM-neutrino-interacting CLASS branches), mapping (m_F, m_S, g_nu) onto the interaction-rate coefficients, and output linear power spectra and half-mode masses.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M2

members.model_name: Heavy-scalar decay gravitino warm dark matter
members.description: No implemented pipeline computes the linear transfer function for the mixed gravitino population (warm X-decay component with initial momentum ~M_X/2 redshifted from the scalar-decay epoch, plus a colder thermal-scattering component); the paper replaces this with a single free-streaming velocity bound v_0 ~ 1.2e-4 B_3/2.

members.model_name: Phenomenological early decaying dark matter
members.description: The DDM daughter perturbation equations (massive-neutrino-like hierarchy sourced by parent decay, covering both relativistic and nonrelativistic daughters) exist only in the authors' unreleased CAMB modification; no public Boltzmann code implements this two-daughter decay scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the parent-decay-sourced daughter phase-space hierarchy in CLASS (extending the existing dcdm/ncdm machinery to a decay-produced f(q) with arbitrary daughter mass ratio) and validate against the paper's published CMB and transfer-function responses.

members.model_name: Moduli-produced wino or higgsino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public linear perturbation solver handles the pre-BBN moduli-dominated era with neutralino annihilation and modulus-decay source terms, so the predicted small-scale enhancement/cutoff in the matter power spectrum cannot be computed end to end.

members.model_name: U(1)_D pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark-Higgs bound states
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the pseudo-Dirac freeze-out with p-wave chi_i chi_i -> h_D h_D annihilation, Sommerfeld enhancement from the light dark Higgs, chi_2 contribution before decay, and radiative bound-state formation, so the Omega h^2 = 0.1228 overclosure boundary cannot be recomputed across parameter space.

members.model_name: Very supersymmetric co-decaying dark sector
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the coupled co-decay/cannibalization thermal history of a nearly degenerate hidden supermultiplet: tracking 2-to-2 and 3-to-2 hidden-sector processes, the decaying scalar population, the evolving dark-to-SM temperature ratio, and entropy injection is beyond the standard freeze-out modules of micrOMEGAs or MadDM, so the relic abundance and entropy-dilution factor cannot be independently recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public relic-abundance framework (e.g. micrOMEGAs' two-sector/temperature-ratio machinery or a dedicated solver in the style of existing cannibal-dark-matter codes) with coupled number- and energy-density equations for psi, phi_R, phi_I including 3-to-2 rates from kappa Phi^3, the scalar decay term Gamma_phi, and self-consistent T_dark/T_SM evolution, validated against the paper's benchmark relic curves.

members.model_name: Superheavy right-handed-neutrino dark matter with zombie co-annihilation in extended B-L
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver implements zombie coannihilation (nu_R + psi -> psi + psi with an exponentially enhanced effective annihilation rate) together with the subsequent late sterile-neutrino decay and entropy dilution for superheavy 1e9-1e13 GeV relics; micrOMEGAs/MadDM coannihilation machinery does not cover this number-changing topology, so relic-abundance benchmarks cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone coupled Boltzmann solver (or extend micrOMEGAs' coannihilation module) tracking Y_nuR and Y_psi with the S-mediated zombie collision term, thermally averaged cross sections from the model Lagrangian, and an appended entropy-dilution stage from the sterile-neutrino decay width; validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 benchmark points.

members.model_name: Fermion-mediated dark matter from bubble expansion
members.description: No Boltzmann/relic code includes a bubble-wall production source term: combining the L -> N wall yield, N decays into the Z2-odd heavy state, the coannihilation/freeze-out contribution, and supercooling dilution by T_nuc/T_reh into a final Omega_DM h^2 is currently only a benchmark-level estimate in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated post-transition Boltzmann solver (or extend micrOMEGAs freeze-out output) that adds the analytic wall-production yield as an initial condition, evolves N decays and possible re-equilibration of the heavy states, and applies the reheating dilution factor; validate against the paper's relic-density isocontours.

members.model_name: Conformal scotogenic right-handed-neutrino dark matter from supercooled FOPT
members.description: No public model implementation of the conformal scotogenic Lagrangian (Z2-odd RHNs, inert doublet, conformal singlet) exists for the standard toolchain: neither a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model file for the freeze-out and direct-detection scan nor a PhaseTracer model class for the finite-temperature potential is released, so both routes cannot be run without rebuilding the paper's private setup.

members.model_name: Hybrid scotogenic/type-I right-handed-neutrino dark matter from relativistic bubble walls
members.description: No public model implementation of the hybrid scotogenic/type-I Lagrangian exists for the standard toolchain: neither a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model file for N_1 freeze-out and direct detection nor a PhaseTracer model class for the singlet-driven finite-temperature potential is released, so the combined GW/DM route cannot be rerun outside the paper's private setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hybrid model in FeynRules and export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs to reproduce the benchmark relic and direct-detection overlays, and code the one-loop finite-temperature effective potential as a PhaseTracer model to reproduce the benchmark (T_*, alpha, beta/H) and Fig. 5 GW spectra.

members.model_name: Hybrid scotogenic/type-I right-handed-neutrino dark matter from relativistic bubble walls

members.model_name: Defect-free dark photon dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements the linear cosmological perturbations of this model's runaway singlet scalar plus late-produced dark-photon sector (field-dependent W(phi) kinetic function, scalar energy fraction altering H(a) and CMB damping), so the production-history imprint on the CMB and small-scale power cannot be computed.

members.model_name: Mirror matter dark matter with cooler mirror sector
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the exact mirror sector — a second photon-baryon plasma at temperature ratio x with mirror recombination, mirror Silk damping, and the associated Delta N_eff — so the processed power spectrum with its lambda_max peak, oscillations, and damping tail exists only as analytic scale estimates.

members.model_name: Low-reheat warm gravitino dark matter

members.model_name: Two-component asymmetric dark matter via bound states and freeze-in decay

members.model_name: Nonthermal gravitino dark matter from pseudo-moduli decay

members.model_name: Effective neutrinophilic dark matter with late kinetic decoupling

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter with cosmological dark magnetic fields

members.model_name: Light-vector freeze-in dark matter with plasmon decay

members.model_name: Light-vector-meson dark pion SIMP model

members.model_name: Self-scattering vector-resonance freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No pipeline exists to propagate the computed nonthermal relic distribution f(p,T) into a linear structure-formation prediction (transfer function or matter power spectrum); the card's structure_formation block is entirely unknown and the paper explicitly defers this to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the frozen-out f(p) from the DRAKE-based fBE calculation into CLASS or CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-relic phase-space distribution (ncdm psd file) to compute the transfer function and half-mode mass, and map to an equivalent thermal-WDM benchmark.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal dark matter from relativistic bubble expansion
members.description: No relic code combines bubble-wall production with freeze-out for the heavy Higgs-portal scalar: the interplay of freeze-out dominance at small lambda_hchi and wall-production dominance at large lambda_hchi, plus T_nuc/T_reh supercooling dilution, exists only as benchmark-level isocontours in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard freeze-out calculation (micrOMEGAs or a bespoke Boltzmann solver) with the analytic wall-production yield as a nonthermal source term and the reheating dilution factor, and validate against the paper's relic-density isocontours in the (M_chi, lambda_hchi) plane.

members.model_name: Singlet-portal dark matter from bubble-wall production
members.description: No public end-to-end pipeline exists for bubble-wall dark-matter production in this singlet-portal setup: bounce solvers stop at T_nuc and transition strength, and the friction calculation that decides whether gamma_w reaches the required ultra-relativistic values (the fast-wall branch the relic prediction depends on) is done by bespoke analysis rather than any released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CosmoTransitions-class finite-temperature bounce solver with a bubble-wall friction/terminal-velocity module (LO plus NLO transition-radiation pressure) and couple its gamma_w and T_nuc output to the paper's analytic wall-production yield and standard sound-wave/collision GW spectral fits, so parameter scans over (v_s, lambda_hs, M_chi, lambda_schi) run in one pipeline.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine asymmetric dark matter with finite-temperature forbidden decay
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the finite-temperature forbidden-decay cogenesis network: coupled equations for the AD-generated dark asymmetry, psi -> L H2 decay active only above T_cr, Y_chi scattering kept out of equilibrium, H2 washout, and sphaleron conversion into Y_B, so the BAU-plus-relic benchmark cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann framework (e.g. ULYSSES) with temperature-dependent thermal masses gating the decay channel, the H2 washout and Y_S annihilation terms, and sphaleron conversion, then validate against the paper's benchmark (Y_l ~ 2.5e-6) reproducing both Y_B and Omega_DM.

members.model_name: Phantom hidden-sector sterile-neutrino dark matter creation
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for late-time vacuum decay into a negative-energy ghost fluid plus a source-produced sterile-neutrino component with evolving equation of state; the source's modified CosmoMC-era pipeline is unreleased, so CMB/BAO/DES/Pantheon constraints on (Lambda, m_nu_s, M_s, M_v, decay rate) cannot be reproduced or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vacuum-decay source terms in CLASS: add a two-fluid sector (massless ghost fluid with negative energy density plus a sterile-neutrino species evolved from the paper's f_nu_s^0 fitting forms via momentum bins), then interface with Cobaya against public Planck 2018, BAO, DES, and Pantheon likelihoods and validate by recovering the source mediator-scale lower bounds.

members.model_name: Two-component cold dark matter with self-heated light component
members.description: No public code implements the chi_1 self-heating temperature evolution and the coupled two-component linear perturbation equations (heated species with time-dependent sound speed plus cold chi_2), so the suppressed and oscillatory P(k) that seeds every downstream prediction cannot be regenerated at new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model as a CLASS extension: an interacting two-fluid module with the paper's T_1(a) heating equation sourced by the chi_2 chi_2 -> chi_1 chi_1 rate and chi_1 self-scattering, outputting P(k) validated against the paper's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Spontaneous chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists that evolves the late-transition-sourced perturbations through CMB, lensing, and LSS observables, so the existing Planck/ACT/SPT/BAO likelihood stack cannot be run on this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS or CAMB with a post-recombination stochastic source term for the transition-generated fluctuations and couple it to the public Planck/ACT/SPT/BAO likelihoods via Cobaya or MontePython, validating that the zero-transition limit recovers LCDM.

members.model_name: MeV complex-scalar thermal dark matter with pseudoscalar lepton portal
members.description: No public three-sector Boltzmann solver evolves the coupled number and energy densities of the EM plasma, neutrino bath, and the complex-scalar DM with mixed electron/neutrino annihilation branchings; the paper's numerical implementation is not released and instantaneous-decoupling approximations are stated to be insufficient.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public MeV thermal-history code such as NUDEC_BSM (or reimplement the paper's coupled number/energy equations) to include the chi chi* -> e+e- and chi chi* -> nu nu channels with free BR_EM/BR_nu and the pseudoscalar-mediated elastic scattering rates, validated against the paper's thermal cross-section curves.

members.model_name: Scalar-field unified dark matter model with fast transition
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the fast-transition k-essence UDM component: CAMB/CLASS lack a module evolving a single unified fluid with the model's w(a), transition parameters (beta, z_t), and scalar-field effective sound speed c_s^2(a), so CMB spectra, matter power, and the late-ISW signal cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS's generalized dark-energy/fluid sector with a UDM species whose background follows the fast-transition parameterization in (beta, z_t) and whose perturbations use the k-essence c_s^2 derived from L(phi,X)=f(phi)g(h(phi)X)-V(phi), validating against the CDM limit for c_s^2 -> 0.

members.model_name: Chilly asymmetrically reheated thermal dark sector
members.description: No linear perturbation implementation exists for the chilly hidden sector's matter-power and CMB signatures: the free-streaming versus interacting nature of the dark radiation and any dark-acoustic effects require a Boltzmann-hierarchy treatment that depends on hidden-sector particle content the framework leaves generic.
members.proposed_resolution: For concrete hidden-sector realizations, map the internally thermalized cold sector onto the ETHOS interacting dark-radiation parameterization in a modified CLASS (temperature ratio xi, DM-DR and DR-DR interaction rates), then run the CMB+matter-power comparison with standard Planck/LSS likelihoods.

members.model_name: Swampland-motivated fading dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code implementation exists for fading dark matter: a quintessence field with exponential potential coupled to dark-matter masses via m_DM(phi) at both background and perturbation level; the paper's modified CLASS branch was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-coupled dark-matter mass term in CLASS (extending existing public coupled-quintessence/coupled-dark-energy CLASS modules with the exponential m(phi) fading after phi crosses phi0 and the coupled fraction f), validate against the paper's H0 shift from 68.3 to 69.1 km/s/Mpc and best-fit lambda near 0.3, and release the branch with MontePython parameter files.

members.model_name: Pseudoscalar s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver handles s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in with the pseudoscalar coupling structure, including dark-sector temperature evolution, the quasi-static/reannihilation phase, and dark freeze-out; the paper's numerical framework is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's coupled number- and energy-density Boltzmann equations as a public solver, e.g. by extending the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or releasing a standalone notebook that tracks (n_chi, n_phi, rho_dark/T_D) and reproduces the paper's freeze-in and reannihilation regimes.

members.model_name: KOTO two-scalar P dark matter
members.description: No relic-abundance code covers this model's production regime: UV freeze-in through dimension-five quark operators with reheating at T_R ~ 10-100 MeV, where production proceeds through hadronic states below QCD confinement; public freeze-in modules (e.g. in micrOMEGAs or MadDM) assume partonic rates and radiation domination from high temperatures, so the P yield is currently only an analytic estimate with uncontrolled hadronic uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a freeze-in Boltzmann solver with chiral-perturbation-theory matrix elements for kaon/pion-bath production of S and P, low-T_R initial conditions with zero initial dark abundance, and the optional Lambda_nu neutrino-portal freeze-out branch, scanning (T_R, Lambda, m_P).

members.model_name: Hidden-sector early cannibal-dominated dark matter cosmology
members.description: No public Boltzmann code evolves perturbations through an early cannibal-dominated era: the cannibal fluid's 3-to-2-sustained pressure, sound speed after becoming nonrelativistic, and the model-dependent DM kinetic coupling/free streaming are all outside CLASS/CAMB, and the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the cannibal background and perturbation equations (cannibal fluid with time-dependent equation of state and sound speed, decay to SM radiation, optional DM-cannibal kinetic coupling) as a CLASS extension, validated against the paper's k_pk scaling at T_rh = 10 MeV and the CDM limit.

members.model_name: Self-scattering sub-threshold scalar dark matter
members.description: The public DRAKE full-phase-space Boltzmann solver lacks the elastic DM self-scattering collision term (C_self) needed for this sub-threshold phi1 phi1 -> phi2 phi2 benchmark; the paper's implementation is only available on request, so the fBE relic calculation with self-scattering cannot be reproduced with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public DRAKE code with the self-scattering collision-term module described in the paper (implementing the phi1^4-induced elastic self-scattering kernel on the discretized momentum grid), validating against the paper's nBE/cBE/fBE comparison for the sub-threshold benchmarks.

members.model_name: Self-scattering sub-threshold scalar dark matter
members.description: No pipeline exists to propagate the computed nonthermal relic distribution f(p,T) into a linear structure-formation prediction (transfer function or matter power spectrum); the card's structure_formation block is entirely unknown and the paper explicitly defers this to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the frozen-out f(p) from the DRAKE-based fBE calculation into CLASS or CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-relic phase-space distribution (ncdm psd file) to compute the transfer function and half-mode mass, and map to an equivalent thermal-WDM benchmark.

members.model_name: Reverse-engineered ultra-slow-roll primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No numerical pipeline exists that reconstructs an inflaton potential from the target P_R(k) and verifies it by solving the background plus Mukhanov-Sasaki perturbations through the USR phase; step r2207_s2 has no attached code and no reverse-engineering run was performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public single-field Mukhanov-Sasaki solver (PyTransport/MultiModeCode-class) with an outer optimization loop that iterates the potential's plateau-feature parameters until the computed P_R(k) matches the reverse-engineered target while holding the CMB-scale normalization fixed.

members.model_name: Abelian-Higgs string-decay dark matter scenario
members.description: No relic-density solver exists for dark matter injected nonthermally by decaying Abelian-Higgs string networks: the required calculation couples the string-network energy-loss history (weighted by eta_DM^2) to a Boltzmann equation with annihilation cross section sigma_0, including possible reannihilation, and is currently only estimated analytically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Boltzmann solver with a time-dependent source term dn_chi/dt proportional to the scaling string-network energy-loss rate for given (G mu, eta_DM^2), plus s-wave/p-wave annihilation, e.g. as an extension of micrOMEGAs' nonstandard-cosmology module or a lightweight standalone ODE code validated against the paper's m_chi = 500 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Type-III fermion triplet dark matter in a fast-expanding pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solver computes the triplet freeze-out with the nonstandard pre-BBN expansion: the relic abundance requires solving the coannihilating Sigma_1^0/Sigma_1^+- freeze-out equations under H(T) modified by (n, T_r), which standard relic codes do not support out of the box.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or an equivalent freeze-out solver) with a user-defined Hubble rate for rho_extra proportional to a^-(4+n) restored to radiation domination at T_r, using the standard SU(2)_L-triplet annihilation and coannihilation cross sections, and validate against the paper's sub-1 TeV viable relic examples.

members.model_name: FOPT-enabled forbidden-decay scotogenic right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann/asymmetry solver for the FOPT-window cogenesis network evolving N1, the inert scalars, and B-L with finite-temperature masses, the temporarily open forbidden decay channel, and finite-temperature CP asymmetry.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a leptogenesis-style Boltzmann code (e.g. a ULYSSES-type framework or a custom ODE network on top of micrOMEGAs rates) with temperature-dependent masses, the T_n < T < T_s decay window, and sphaleron freeze-out, reproducing the paper's benchmark eta_B and Omega_N1 h^2.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_B-L Miracle-less WIMP with late entropy dilution
members.description: No coupled Boltzmann implementation exists for the chi/N_1 system: standard relic codes assume radiation domination, whereas this model needs relativistic chi freeze-out through a heavy Z_BL followed by an RHN-driven early matter era and entropy release, currently handled only by the source's analytic yield-times-dilution estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled chi/N_1/radiation Boltzmann solver (either a lightweight custom code or an extension of micrOMEGAs-style freeze-out with a user-defined expansion history) tracking the Z_BL-mediated interaction rate, the RHN matter era, and the entropy injection, validated against the source's Omega_chi h^2 = 0.12 dilution benchmark.

members.model_name: Simplified spin-1 dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: No public implementation of the simplified spin-1 dark photon model exists: the FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the b5/b6/b7 operators, the custom relic Boltzmann solver, and the spin-1-modified BdNMC beam-dump Monte Carlo used in the paper are all unreleased, so relic contours and LSND/MiniBooNE/NA64/LDMX event rates cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the b_i interaction Lagrangians as public FeynRules model files exportable to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs for the relic calculation, and extend the public BdNMC code to complex-vector DM production and scattering through a dark photon, validating against the paper's y-vs-m_X thermal targets and 90% C.L. contours.

members.model_name: Dirac fermion WIMP from modulus-dominated nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solver couples modulus decay, entropy injection, and nonthermal Dirac WIMP production (with dilution of the pre-existing thermal abundance and possible reannihilation) to compute the final relic abundance; the source imposes only analytic B_DM and T_RH requirements.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs non-standard cosmology module (or adapt a public early-matter-domination Boltzmann code) to a decaying modulus with branching fraction B_DM into the Dirac WIMP, validating against the source's B_DM < 1e-4 requirement.

members.model_name: Mirror electron sequential freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements sequential (double) freeze-in in which SM gluons first populate an out-of-equilibrium mirror-photon distribution that then produces e-prime, with the mediator phase-space distribution tracked rather than assumed thermal; the primary paper's appendix calculation is not released as reusable code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone unintegrated-Boltzmann code in the style of DRAKE) to evolve the mirror-photon distribution f(p,T) from gluon-loop production at T_R < m_e_prime and feed it into the e-prime production collision term, validated against the primary paper's yield curves.

members.model_name: MST-EFT primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the MST-EFT scalar power spectrum with multiple sharp SR/USR transitions including loop renormalization and DRG resummation; P_zeta(k) must currently be reconstructed by hand from paper equations, and it feeds every downstream prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's regularized-renormalized-resummed spectrum as a standalone module (or a primordial-spectrum plugin usable by SIGWfast/CLASS-style pipelines) parameterized by the six transition-scale pairs, transition sharpness, w, and c_s, with a built-in perturbativity check.

members.model_name: Higgs portal scalar dark matter with gravitational reheating production
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the combined relic-abundance calculation for this model: Higgs-portal freeze-in plus SM graviton-exchange production plus inflaton-induced gravitational production integrated over the reheating history, as needed to reproduce the paper's Omega_chi h^2 contours in (m_chi, lambda, T_R, H_inf).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's three analytic source terms in a small dedicated Boltzmann integrator over the reheating era (or extend micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines with the two gravitational source terms), and validate against the published lambda = 10^-11 to 10^-8 abundance panels.

members.model_name: Dilaton forbidden dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements finite-temperature forbidden freeze-out of the dEFT pNGB multiplet into heavier dilatons (thermally averaged rate that vanishes at T=0 for M_pi < M_d, with N_pi species and detailed balance); the paper's numerical solver is custom and unreleased.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the single-species forbidden Boltzmann equation with the paper's dEFT cross section and micrOMEGAs g(T)/h(T) tables (or encode the dEFT Lagrangian in micrOMEGAs/MadDM, which handle forbidden channels via thermal averaging), and validate by reproducing the paper's Omega_CDM h^2 = 0.120 band and checking detailed balance.

members.model_name: Finite modular majoron
members.description: Decay-produced majorons can be relativistic or semi-relativistic today, so they act as neither pure CDM nor pure dark radiation; there is no CLASS/CAMB implementation of their phase-space distribution to confront Planck and BAO data beyond a crude Delta N_eff estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the modulus-decay majoron momentum distribution from the gap_1 integrator into CLASS as a non-cold (ncdm) species with tabulated f(q), then evaluate Planck+BAO likelihoods in MontePython or Cobaya over (T_D, modulus abundance, m_J).

members.model_name: Non-thermally produced WIMP dark matter
