members.description: No public released implementation propagates the Gaussian nonthermal WIMP distribution f(p) through a linear Boltzmann code; the original CMBFAST adaptation is not distributed, so the transfer-function cutoff cannot currently be reproduced without re-implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Gaussian f(p) as a tabulated psd file for the CLASS ncdm module (or CAMB's nu_mass machinery), validate against the paper's r_c = (1.3, 1.4, 1.5)e-7 examples and the R_f ~ 0.1 Mpc scaling, and release the configuration.

members.model_name: Chameleon-controlled density-dependent dark matter interactions
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles freeze-out with a chameleon-controlled time-dependent dark matter mass m_chi(phi) and gauge coupling f(phi); the paper's numerical solution of the modified Boltzmann equation is not released, so relic-density and late-time annihilation predictions cannot be re-derived across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a standalone ODE code) to co-evolve the cosmological chameleon field equation with the freeze-out Boltzmann equation, taking the chameleon potential and m_chi(phi), f(phi) functions as inputs and validating against the paper's Omega_chi h^2 = 0.1097 benchmark.

members.model_name: Filtered Dirac fermion dark matter at a first-order phase transition
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver exists for dark-matter phase-space filtering at a bubble wall: the transmission/reflection kinetics with the wall profile, annihilation of reflected particles, and the resulting filtered high-momentum tail were computed with a private numerical method in the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a 1D kinetic solver for the distribution function across a moving wall, parameterized by (m_chi_in/T_n, v_w, L_w, y_chi), reproducing the paper's benchmark m_chi/T_n values of about 25, 32, 40 for T_n = 1 GeV, 1 TeV, 1 PeV; a natural host is an extension of existing bubble-wall friction codes such as WallGo.

members.model_name: Re-annihilating Higgsino-like neutralino from DFSZ axino decay
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver evolves the DFSZ axino freeze-out abundance, its late decay into neutralinos, and the subsequent neutralino re-annihilation to the final relic density; the relic outcome is currently set only by the paper's analytic re-annihilation estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the freeze-out module of micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with an axino source term (yield and lifetime set by f_a and mu) and solve the coupled number-density equations through decay and re-annihilation, validating against the paper's Omega h^2 ~ 0.11 target for <sigma v> ~ 1e-8 GeV^-2.

members.model_name: Semi-constrained NMSSM singlino-like neutralino LSP benchmark lines
members.description: Standard Boltzmann solvers compute the singlino relic density only in standard Big-Bang cosmology, where generic sNMSSM points overclose; there is no card-consistent tool for evaluating the relic abundance under the modified expansion or entropy histories the model invokes as viability escapes, so the relic flag cannot distinguish which nonstandard history rescues a given point.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a micrOMEGAs-based NMSSM relic calculation with a parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN history (modified Hubble rate and late entropy injection, as in low-reheating-temperature freeze-out treatments) so the overclosure flag can be evaluated as a function of the cosmological-history parameters alongside the resonance-annihilation option.

members.model_name: U(1)H-stabilized superheavy WIMPZILLA with dark radiation
members.description: No implemented numerical pipeline evolves the subdominant hidden scalar's abundance and late decay into hidden photons to produce Delta N_eff at BBN and recombination for this model; the card's dark-radiation evolution step has no tool and the paper's exclusion contours are not reproducible from local text.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model onto the existing decaying-cold-species-to-dark-radiation sector of CLASS (dcdm->dr) or write a small ODE code evolving rho_phi and rho_gamma_H through phi decay, parameterized by (m_phi, tau_phi, initial phi yield), and validate against the paper's Fig. 2 exclusion region.

members.model_name: Global U(1)_DM-remnant Z3 scalar SIMP
members.description: The authors' FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the remnant-Z3 scalar SIMP model, including the Boltzmann solver for self-, semi-, and 3-to-2 annihilations, is not publicly released, so the 7-115 MeV relic-density scan and benchmark selection cannot be reproduced or extended from the card's resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the three-scalar potential (H, phi_X, X with U(1)_DM charges 0, 3, 1) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and add a custom number-changing Boltzmann module for the 3-to-2 and semi-annihilation rates, validating against the paper's 7-115 MeV SIMP window (or obtain and publish the original author files).

members.model_name: Closed-sector vector-mediator reannihilating SIDM
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves a fully closed dark sector (chi + light vector mediator + massless dark radiation) through freeze-out from dark radiation, kinetic decoupling, and a Sommerfeld-enhanced late reannihilation epoch with its time-dependent abundance and dark-radiation injection history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hidden-sector coupled Boltzmann equations of the primary paper (abundance plus dark-sector temperature, with velocity-dependent Sommerfeld-enhanced cross section) as a public module, e.g. extending DarkSUSY's or micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector freeze-out machinery to output n_chi(z), T_dark(z), and the dark-radiation injection rate.

members.model_name: Closed-sector vector-mediator reannihilating SIDM
members.description: No public CLASS/CAMB module computes the linear transfer function and CMB spectra for this model's combination of dark-acoustic damping from late kinetic coupling plus a time-dependent Hubble-rate modification from reannihilation energy injection; the ETHOS parameterization covers steady DM-DR coupling but not the reannihilation-driven time dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-style modified CLASS with (i) the DM-dark-radiation scattering rate for this vector-mediator coupling and (ii) a time-dependent background sector taking n_chi(z) and dark-radiation injection from the hidden-sector Boltzmann solver, then validate against the paper's theta_star consistency benchmarks.

members.model_name: Non-canonical Higgs-inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation solver handles the peaked noncanonical kinetic term G(phi)X of this Higgs-inflation realization; the paper's numerical P_zeta(k) code is not identified as released, and standard public solvers assume canonical kinetic terms, blocking reproduction of the enhanced small-scale spectrum that feeds every downstream observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public mode-by-mode inflation perturbation solver (e.g. a MultiModeCode-class MS solver) to the G(phi)X action with the H11/H12/H21/H22 peak functions, validating against the primary paper's benchmark P_zeta peaks and CMB-scale amplitudes.

members.model_name: Non-canonical T-model primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation solver handles the peaked noncanonical kinetic term G(phi)X added to the T-model potential V0 tanh^(2m)(phi/sqrt(6)); the paper's numerical P_zeta(k) code is not identified as released, and standard public solvers assume canonical kinetic terms, blocking reproduction of the enhanced small-scale spectrum that feeds every downstream observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public mode-by-mode inflation perturbation solver (e.g. a MultiModeCode-class MS solver) to the G(phi)X action with the T-model potential and its peak functions, validating against the primary paper's benchmark P_zeta peaks and CMB-scale amplitudes.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant Higgs-portal vector FIMP in a fast pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public implementation of the scale-invariant U(1)_X vector-FIMP model exists for a freeze-in Boltzmann solver with a faster-than-radiation pre-BBN Hubble rate H(T) parameterized by (n, T_R); the relic yield Y_X(T) currently cannot be recomputed outside the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP, and run the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module with its user-defined nonstandard expansion history set to the (n, T_R) power-law era, validating against the paper's m_X > 240 GeV bound and enhanced-coupling bands.

members.model_name: Bino-like neutralino dark matter from modulus decay in the MSSM
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solver couples modulus decay, entropy injection, and nonthermal bino production with possible residual annihilation to give the final relic abundance; the source only imposes analytic requirements.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs non-standard cosmology module (or adapt a public early-matter-domination Boltzmann code) to include a decaying modulus with branching fraction B_DM into LSP-producing cascades and validate against the source's B_DM < 1e-4 requirement.

members.model_name: Complex scalar WIMP from modulus-dominated nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solver couples modulus decay, entropy injection, and nonthermal complex-scalar WIMP production (with possible reannihilation) to compute the final relic abundance; the source imposes only analytic B_DM and T_RH requirements.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs non-standard cosmology module (or adapt a public early-matter-domination Boltzmann code) to a decaying modulus with branching fraction B_DM into the complex scalar WIMP, validating against the source's B_DM < 1e-4 requirement.

members.model_name: Minimal clockwork neutrinogenesis scalar dark-sector subcomponent
members.description: The Dirac-leptogenesis Boltzmann calculation with clockwork-suppressed couplings and resonant CP enhancement has no public implementation, so the heavy-gear decay-timing constraint on the parent framework cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann code such as ULYSSES with Dirac-leptogenesis asymmetry-transfer equations and clockwork-derived couplings and decay rates over the (N, q, m_i) benchmark space.

members.model_name: Synchronous mirror atomic dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code implements the synchronous mirror atomic sector: dark-proton/dark-electron recombination tied to the visible epoch, dark-photon Thomson coupling and free-streaming transition, and the FFAT ratio-preserving density scalings, so CMB spectra and transfer functions for (f_ADM, xi_d, lambda) cannot be generated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a dark-hydrogen recombination module (a rescaled RecFast/HyRec with alpha_d, m_e,d, m_p,d, xi_d inputs), a tightly-coupled ADM-dark-photon fluid with its own Thomson rate, and the FFAT proportional scaling of CDM, neutrino, and dark-radiation densities, validating on the synchronous-recombination ratio conditions and the paper's benchmark fits.

members.model_name: BSTV scalar-field oscillation cold dark matter
members.description: No relativistic Boltzmann/perturbation solver implements this preferred-frame tensor-vector-scalar framework with oscillating scalar-amplitude CDM; standard codes (CLASS/CAMB) assume GR, so modern CMB acoustic-peak and lensing predictions beyond the background density cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a modified-gravity Boltzmann code (e.g. hi_class or EFTCAMB) with the BSTV vector and scalar sectors and the averaged oscillating-q fluid, then compute C_ell against Planck-era data.

members.model_name: Heavy invisible Z-prime portal FIMP freeze-in during reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements UV freeze-in through the heavy invisible Z-prime portal (generalized Chern-Simons operators) during non-instantaneous reheating; the paper's coupled inflaton-radiation-FIMP Boltzmann system with T_R and T_max is custom and unreleased, and micrOMEGAs-style freeze-in routines assume a radiation-dominated history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the GCS-operator reaction-rate density R(T) in a public freeze-in solver extended with an inflaton-dominated reheating phase parameterized by (T_R, T_max) — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or release a standalone coupled Boltzmann-fluid code — and validate against the published relic-density contours for the benchmark T_R and T_max.

members.model_name: Two-flavor chiral composite asymmetric dark matter
members.description: No dark-sector thermal-history solver exists for this model's chiral composite setup: tracking the dark temperature through SU(3)_D confinement, dark pion annihilation to dark photons, and dark photon decay/recoupling to the SM at epsilon of 10^-11 to 10^-8 to output the entropy transfer and Delta N_eff.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement coupled visible/dark temperature evolution with dark-photon decay and inverse-decay collision terms in a hidden-sector Boltzmann code (e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' two-temperature machinery or a standalone solver feeding Delta N_eff into CLASS/CAMB), parameterized by (Lambda_D, m_A_prime, epsilon).

members.model_name: Real scalar condensate freeze-in model
members.description: No interface propagates the final condensate fraction and nonthermal freeze-in spectrum f(k) into a linear structure code, so the mixed cold-plus-warm matter power modification and any small-scale-structure comparison cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a converter that maps the solver output to a CLASS configuration with the condensate as CDM and the particle component as an ncdm species with the tabulated f(k), verifying the cold and pure-freeze-in limits of the resulting transfer functions.

members.model_name: Cool atomic dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the cool atomic-dark-matter subcomponent (dark recombination with B_d/T_d^0, dark-photon Thomson coupling, f_adm split against a CDM remainder); the paper's modified CAMB is not released, so the CMB/matter-power pipeline cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ADM subcomponent in public CLASS or CAMB, reusing the existing interacting-DM/dark-radiation (ETHOS-style) module structure and adding a dark-recombination history solver parameterized by (f_adm, T_d^0, B_d/T_d^0, dark baryon-to-photon ratio), then release it with CosmoMC/Cobaya wrappers.

members.model_name: Cosh-potential scalar-field dark matter
members.description: No modern public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the cosh-potential scalar-field dark matter (early exponential tracking plus late quadratic oscillations); the only perturbation computation is an unreleased amended-CMBFAST run from the source paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the cosh potential in a CLASS or AxiCLASS scalar-field module using an oscillation-averaged effective-fluid treatment after the field enters its quadratic regime, and validate against the source's claims of CDM-like growth and the m_phi > 3e-26 eV / BBN parameter mapping with modern Planck cosmological parameters.

members.model_name: Kinetic-mixing cosmic millicharged-particle background with dark photon
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver covers reheating-era mCP freeze-in with T_max = T_rh together with the subsequent annihilation and entropy transfer into the massless dark photon; both the yield Y_chi(T_rh) and Delta N_eff currently rely on the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery (or a standalone code in the style of ULYSSES/DRAKE) with a two-temperature reheating module that evolves the inflaton, SM bath, mCP, and dark-photon energy densities, parameterized by (m_chi, epsilon, g_d, T_rh), and validate by reproducing the primary paper's abundance and Delta N_eff contours.

members.model_name: Decaying scalar CDM to dark radiation
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for CDM decaying to dark radiation with the time-dependent rate Gamma = alpha H; the paper's modified CAMB patch was never released, and the stock CLASS/CAMB decaying-CDM modules assume a constant decay rate, so neither the late-growing Delta N_eff(a) background nor the coupled perturbation hierarchy for the massless daughter can currently be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the existing dcdm/dark-radiation sector in CLASS to accept Gamma = alpha H (background energy transfer plus the paper's perturbation equations for the massive parent and massless daughter), validate against the published alpha < 0.027-0.028 WMAP7+ACT/SPT limits, then rerun with Planck/ACT-DR6/SPT-3G likelihoods.

members.model_name: Mini-Split supersymmetry with neutralino LSP dark matter
members.description: Stock micrOMEGAs-class relic solvers lack the Sommerfeld-enhanced electroweak annihilation needed to compute the multi-TeV wino (and heavy higgsino) thermal abundance in the Mini-Split spectrum, so the ~2.5 TeV wino target cannot be turned into a precise likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or interface DarkSUSY) with Sommerfeld-corrected wino/higgsino annihilation and coannihilation rates and validate against published thermal wino benchmark masses.

members.model_name: Sub-MeV scalar-mediator dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the coupled dark-sector thermal history of sub-MeV chi with a light scalar mediator phi (plus optional phi_prime): thermalization status with the SM bath, hidden-sector freeze-out relic density, and the resulting Delta N_eff (the ~0.09 prediction in the high nuclear-cross-section regime) are currently only analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dedicated dark-sector Boltzmann module (temperature-ratio evolution plus chi and phi number densities with g_e/g_N-mediated SM exchange rates), validate against the paper's Delta N_eff ~ 0.09 benchmark, and feed the resulting Delta N_eff into CLASS/CAMB for CMB comparison.

members.model_name: Kination non-equilibrium Majorana dark matter production
members.description: No implemented calculation exists for the enhanced growth of perturbations entering the horizon during the w=1 kination era and the resulting small-scale matter power and microhalo abundance for this model; the small-scale-structure observable relies on later related work with no code on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Modify CLASS to include a kinaton (w=1) background component through T_R so kination-era mode growth is captured, combine with the gap_2 cutoff, and attach a semi-analytic microhalo mass-function module to translate the enhanced power into microhalo abundances and optional annihilation boosts.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector glueball dark matter in a late-modulus low-reheat cosmology
members.description: The modulus reheating step uses an instantaneous-decay approximation with order-one corrections acknowledged by the paper; no numerical two-sector (visible plus hidden) reheating solver exists for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small coupled Boltzmann solver evolving the modulus, visible radiation, and hidden radiation with a finite decay width and branching fraction B, replacing the instantaneous-decay temperatures used in the semi-analytic route.

members.model_name: Thermal dark matter through the Dirac neutrino portal
members.description: No Boltzmann-hierarchy treatment of the DM-neutrino interaction is available for this model, so the small-scale cutoff M_cut and the N_eff/BBN floor are only heuristic estimates rather than computed transfer functions and Delta N_eff values.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-style interacting-DM branch of CLASS with the model's DM-neutrino scattering rate (derived from y_L, U_alpha4, m_chi, m_phi) to compute the linear transfer function and M_cut, and couple the same thermal history to a BBN/N_eff calculation (e.g. a CLASS + PArthENoPE/PRIMAT pipeline) for the MeV-scale floor.

members.model_name: Phase-transition depopulated fermionic dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements thermal freeze-out with a temporarily unstable dark matter particle: temperature-dependent decay and inverse-decay terms active only between the phase-transition endpoints x_a and x_b, followed by incomplete regeneration from eta decays and possible entropy injection after symmetry restoration.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled Boltzmann integrator (e.g. extending the micrOMEGAs freeze-out routines or a standalone python/DRAKE-style solver) with number-density equations for N and eta that include annihilation, decay, and inverse-decay collision terms gated by the finite-temperature potential solution, plus entropy-dilution bookkeeping; validate against the paper's benchmark (M_N=237.7 GeV, x_a=1.21, x_b=25.1, Omega h^2=0.112).

members.model_name: Z2 fermion dark matter from broken local U(1) with bound states
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the coupled system with Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation, bound-state formation via R and A' emission, bound-state dissociation and decay, chi1-chi2 coannihilation, and late reannihilation before BBN for this broken dark U(1) model; the paper used private micrOMEGAs-based code with an admittedly rough scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a standalone code in the style of existing bound-state freeze-out packages) with the paper's bound-state formation/dissociation rate formulae, including longitudinal dark-photon contributions and the chi1-chi2 splitting, and validate against the paper's perturbative vs Sommerfeld-only vs bound-state-included relic curves.

members.model_name: Model A': Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light vector mediator
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for this model's hidden-sector thermal history: the coupled evolution of chi and A-prime abundances with a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio T-prime/T, mediator freeze-out or decay via kinetic mixing, and the resulting mediator yield and lifetime — inputs required by the CMB, BBN, and N_eff constraints — was not run and has no packaged tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' two-temperature hidden-sector mode (or a dedicated coupled-Boltzmann code) to track chi freeze-out, A-prime yield Y_med, and epsilon-dependent lifetime as functions of (m_DM, m_med, g-prime, epsilon_KM, T-prime/T), outputting the quantities the downstream CMB/BBN recasts consume.

members.model_name: Model A: Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light scalar mediator
members.description: No Boltzmann solver is configured for hidden-sector freeze-out of chi chi-bar to phi phi at a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio T'/T while co-evolving the scalar mediator number density, decay history, and lifetime, which are the inputs the CMB/BBN mediator-abundance constraints require.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a dedicated coupled two-temperature Boltzmann code) with a hidden-sector bath at T', the chi and phi number-density equations, and phi decay through the Higgs portal, outputting Omega_chi, Y_phi, and tau_phi over the (m_DM, m_med, y_phi, lambda_HP, T'/T) space.

members.model_name: Model B': vector-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No Boltzmann solver is configured for the model's two-mediator hidden-sector freeze-out: chi chi-bar to S S dominating the relic density alongside the subdominant A' A' channel at a temperature ratio T'/T, with co-evolution of the A' and S abundances, decays, and lifetimes that feed the CMB/BBN mediator-abundance constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a dedicated coupled two-temperature Boltzmann code) with the chi, A', and S number-density equations, the y_S and g' annihilation channels, and kinetic-mixing/Higgs-portal decays, outputting Omega_chi, Y_A', Y_S, and lifetimes over (m_DM, m_med, g', y_S, epsilon, lambda_HS, T'/T).

members.model_name: Model B: scalar-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No Boltzmann solver is configured for the model's two-mediator hidden-sector freeze-out: chi chi-bar to S S dominating the relic density alongside the subdominant phi channel at a temperature ratio T'/T, with co-evolution of the phi and S abundances, decays, and lifetimes that feed the CMB/BBN mediator-abundance constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a dedicated coupled two-temperature Boltzmann code) with the chi, phi, and S number-density equations, the y_S and y_phi annihilation channels, and Higgs-portal decays, outputting Omega_chi, Y_phi, Y_S, and lifetimes over (m_DM, m_med, y_phi, y_S, lambda_HS, T'/T).

members.model_name: Model C: p-wave scalar-mediator SIDM with scalar mediator-decay channel
members.description: No Boltzmann solver is configured for the model's decay-chain cosmology: p-wave chi chi-bar to phi phi freeze-out at a temperature ratio T'/T with phi depletion through phi to S S decays or annihilations and S decay to the SM through the Higgs portal, which sets the mediator yields and lifetimes the CMB/BBN constraints require.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a dedicated coupled two-temperature Boltzmann code) with the chi, phi, and S number-density equations including the lambda_S phi S^2 depletion channel and Higgs-portal S decay, outputting Omega_chi, Y_phi, Y_S, and lifetimes over (m_DM, m_med, y_phi, lambda_S, lambda_HS, T'/T).

members.model_name: Model D: stable vector-mediator SIDM with scalar annihilation outlet
members.description: No Boltzmann solver is configured for the model's defining cosmology: chi freeze-out into a stable A' whose relic population must be depleted by A' A' to S S annihilation followed by Higgs-portal S decay, all at a hidden temperature ratio T'/T; the A' residual abundance and S lifetime are exactly the quantities the overclosure and BBN/N_eff constraints act on.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a dedicated coupled two-temperature Boltzmann code) with the chi, A', and S number-density equations including the g' J_S A' depletion channel and lambda_HS-controlled S decay, outputting Omega_chi, the residual Y_A', Y_S, and tau_S over (m_DM, m_A', m_S, g', lambda_HS, T'/T).

members.model_name: Non-thermal sterile hot dark matter from inflaton or moduli decay
members.description: The modified CLASS plus MontePython implementation of the decay-produced nonthermal sterile distribution (f(q) mapped to ncdm inputs with m_eff and Delta N_eff as sampled parameters) is not publicly released, so the paper's pipeline cannot be rerun as-is.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the decay f(q) as a CLASS ncdm psd file (or analytic psd function) parameterized by (m_phi, Gamma_phi, B_sp, m_sp), wire it into a MontePython/Cobaya parameter block with the Planck, BAO/f_sigma8, Pantheon, and S8-prior likelihoods, and validate against the published posterior values (m_sp ~ 0.48-0.67 eV).

members.model_name: Heavy-Majoron three-to-two Z3 scalar dark matter variant
members.description: No public Boltzmann code solves the 3-to-2 (SIMP-like) freeze-out for this Z3 scalar model in the heavy-Majoron branch: the calculation needs the 3-to-2 matrix element plus coupled dark-sector number-density and temperature equations under the card's dark-sector thermalization assumptions, and standard relic codes only implement 2-to-2 and semi-annihilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or write a standalone solver in the style of published SIMP/cannibal-dark-matter codes) with the chi chi chi -> chi chi* thermally averaged rate from the lambda_3 phi* chi^3 vertex, coupled to a dark-temperature evolution equation with kinetic coupling to the SM tracked, and validate against the paper's light- versus heavy-Majoron abundance comparison.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium U(1)_X hidden-sector dark-fermion model
members.description: No public two-temperature coupled Boltzmann solver exists for this U(1)_X hidden sector: the relic density and N_eff history require evolving visible and hidden temperatures plus yields of D, A_prime, S, and the pseudoscalar under feeble kinetic-mixing population, which the paper did with a private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled visible/hidden-temperature Boltzmann system (collision terms for kinetic-mixing energy transfer plus dark-sector 2->2 reactions) as a public module, e.g. extending micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector/freeze-in machinery or releasing a standalone solver validated against the paper's benchmark points.

members.model_name: ALP-mediated fermion dark matter with freeze-in and decoupled freeze-out
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves the coupled ALP/DM number and energy densities with an independent hidden-sector temperature T_prime across the direct freeze-in, sequential freeze-in, and decoupled freeze-out regimes of this model; the relic-density route therefore cannot be run without re-deriving the paper's private solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a DRAKE-style dedicated code) with a two-temperature system tracking Y_chi, Y_a, and the hidden-sector energy density, including off-shell ALP-mediated SM-to-DM production, a-a to chi-chi conversion, and hidden-sector freeze-out at T_prime, validated against the paper's relic-density bands.

members.model_name: ALP-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled unintegrated (phase-space-resolved) Boltzmann equations needed for sequential freeze-in through a nonthermal ALP mediator population; existing relic codes assume integrated number-density equations with thermal or quasi-thermal distributions, so the sequential-freeze-in and decoupled-freeze-out phase boundaries cannot be recomputed reliably.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a momentum-discretized Boltzmann solver for the ALP distribution function f_a(p,t) coupled to the DM number density (extending a freeze-in framework such as micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or a standalone code), tracking the hidden-sector temperature, and validate against the primary paper's phase ordering in the (g_aff, g_a_chi) plane at the m_chi/m_a = 10 benchmark.

members.model_name: Fermionic UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the dimension-6 UV freeze-in dark-matter yield together with the sector-wise lepton asymmetry in a background including an early matter-dominated era and its entropy injection; micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines cover neither the asymmetry source nor nonstandard EMD histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a reusable coupled Y_DM/Y_B-L Boltzmann module (or extend a leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES) with a decaying-matter component, taking T_RH, Lambda, lambda_i, and Delta_EMD as inputs, and validate against the paper's standard-history viability window.

members.model_name: Scalar UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the dimension-5 UV freeze-in scalar dark-matter yield together with the sector-wise lepton asymmetry in a background including an early matter-dominated era and its entropy injection; micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines cover neither the asymmetry source nor nonstandard EMD histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a reusable coupled Y_DM/Y_B-L Boltzmann module (or extend a leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES) with a decaying-matter component, taking T_RH, Lambda, lambda_i, and Delta_EMD as inputs, and validate against the paper's standard-history viability window.

members.model_name: Resonant pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles the resonant pseudo-Dirac thermal history: coupled chemical and kinetic (temperature) evolution of chi_1/chi_2 with early kinetic decoupling near a narrow s-channel dark-photon resonance and tracking of the surviving excited-state fraction f_*.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a beyond-kinetic-equilibrium relic solver such as DRAKE (or add a coupled-temperature module to micrOMEGAs) to two pseudo-Dirac states with off-diagonal dark-photon coupling, delta_R-parameterized resonance, and chi_2 depletion equations, validated against the paper's delta_R = 0.001-0.1 scan and high-f_* benchmarks.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from slow supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: The secondary scalar-induced GW component requires integrating induced-GW kernels over the non-Gaussian curvature spectrum generated by the slow transition; existing public induced-GW integrators assume Gaussian primordial spectra and there is no tool covering this model's source statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public scalar-induced GW code (e.g. a SIGWfast-class kernel integrator) to accept the FOPT-generated curvature spectrum and its non-Gaussian corrections as input, validated against the primary's secondary-peak amplitude fits.

members.model_name: Asynchronous mirror atomic dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code implements the asynchronous mirror atomic sector: a dark recombination history with freely varying binding-energy-to-temperature ratio B_e,d/T_d, dark-photon Thomson coupling with a correctly timed fluid-to-free-streaming transition, and the associated perturbation equations, so no spectra can be produced for (f_ADM, xi_d, B_e,d/T_d).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a rescaled dark-hydrogen recombination solver (RecFast/HyRec generalized to alpha_d, m_e,d, m_p,d, xi_d with B_e,d/T_d as a free input) and a dark-photon Boltzmann hierarchy that switches from tightly-coupled fluid to free-streaming at the computed mirror recombination epoch, validating against the paper's preference for recombination between helium and hydrogen recombination.

members.model_name: Low-reheating warm neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public low-reheating Boltzmann code couples the scalar-decay era (T_RH ~ 10 MeV, b/m_phi production, suppressed annihilation and scattering) to the neutralino abundance and momentum evolution; the paper relied on a private relic-density evolution program.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a standalone solver) with the coupled scalar-radiation-neutralino Boltzmann system for low-T_RH cosmologies, including elastic/inelastic neutralino-lepton scattering terms so both Omega_chi h^2 and the out-of-equilibrium spectrum condition (m_slepton, mu bounds) are computed consistently.

members.model_name: Right-handed-neutrino-coupled dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements the late-time coupled fluid of a dark matter subcomponent scattering with light right-handed neutrinos through a light scalar mediator; existing public DM-neutrino-interaction CLASS patches target active neutrinos with constant or T^2 cross sections, not this model's strongly momentum- and velocity-dependent late momentum exchange.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing interacting DM-neutrino CLASS branch with a separate RH-neutrino species and the model's scalar-mediated momentum-exchange rate, evolving the coupled f_chi fluid perturbations and sound speed to output P(k) across the full f_chi range.

members.model_name: Power-law tachyon quartessence condensate
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the power-law tachyon unified fluid's linear perturbations with its variable adiabatic sound speed c_s(a) and shrinking acoustic horizon, so CMB and matter-power predictions can only be guessed from generalized-Chaplygin analogues that require an unvalidated recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the tachyon fluid (L = -V(phi)sqrt(1-X) with V = V_n phi^(2n)) as a dark-fluid species in CLASS with its exact background w(a) and adiabatic c_s(a, delta), validate the alpha->0 CDM limit against the related generalized-Chaplygin analyses, then run against Planck/BAO/SN likelihoods.

members.model_name: Exact-parity mirror-baryon dark matter thermodynamic model
members.description: No Boltzmann/CMB-LSS code implements mirror-baryon perturbations: a mirror photon-baryon fluid with mirror recombination at temperature x*T, dark acoustic oscillations, and the resulting linear transfer function for mirror-baryon dark matter, which the card lists as a required code resource with no tool named.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (building on existing atomic-dark-matter implementations) with a mirror sector: mirror photons and baryons as a coupled tightly-coupled fluid, a rescaled RECFAST/HyRec-style mirror recombination module at temperature ratio x, sourced by the g_star(T), g_star_prime(T_prime) tables from the thermodynamic steps.

members.model_name: Mirror-baryon asymmetric dark matter from Dirac leptogenesis
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver exists for Dirac leptogenesis with coupled visible and mirror sectors: heavy Dirac singlet-neutrino decays into both sectors, flavour effects, washout in each sector, and simultaneous tracking of Y_B and Y_Bprime; only the paper's unflavoured hierarchical analytic benchmark is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis solver (e.g. the ULYSSES framework) with Dirac-type asymmetry conservation, mirror-sector decay channels y and yprime, per-sector washout parameters, and dual sphaleron conversion, validating against the paper's M_1 lower-bound scaling in the unflavoured hierarchical limit.

members.model_name: Super-weak U(1) sterile neutrino dark matter (freeze-in variant)
members.description: No public model implementation of the super-weak U(1)_z coupled Z-prime/N1 freeze-in system exists; the relic-yield route relies on an unreleased custom Boltzmann solver, so the g_z-M_Zprime viability curves cannot be reproduced or scanned by third parties.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_z model (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files with the gauge covariant-derivative couplings) and run it through micrOMEGAs 5's freeze-in machinery, validating against the paper's M_1=10 keV example and the g_z ~ 1e-11-1e-10 band.

members.model_name: ALP-assisted SU(2)_D vector dark matter with catalyzed freeze-out
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements ALP-assisted catalyzed freeze-out: coupled Y_X/Y_C equations with X X -> Zprime Zprime, the 3 Zprime -> X X catalyst process, catalyst decay, and the temperature-dependent ALP-dark-sector scattering rate that maintains kinetic equilibrium and shifts the freeze-out temperature by an order of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standalone coupled-Boltzmann implementation of the base SU(2)_D catalyzed system with the ALP elastic-scattering collision term (parameterized by m_X/f_a and the thermal ALP bath), fixing the ALP coupling normalization noted in the route caveats; validate by reproducing the paper's benchmark freeze-out shift and the Omega_X h^2 = 0.12 contours versus r_XZprime.

members.model_name: EFT single-field sharp-transition PBH dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the one-loop corrected and resummed curvature power spectrum for the EFT of single-field inflation with a sharp SR-to-USR transition and c_s != 1; the primary's perturbativity window (1 < c_s < 1.17) can only be reproduced by re-deriving the loop integrals by hand under a specific renormalization/resummation prescription.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EFT mode functions and the one-loop/resummed P_zeta(k) in an inflationary transport-style numerical code (extending a PyTransport/CppTransport-class solver to the EFT Goldstone action with tunable c_s and sharp-transition matching), parameterized by (c_s, M_2^4/(H M_p^2), transition times, renormalization prescription), validated against the paper's 1 < c_s < 1.17 window.

members.model_name: Mirror-sector dark neutron WIMP-baryogenesis model
members.description: No public solver implements the coupled two-sector cosmology of parallel WIMP baryogenesis: visible and dark parent freezeout at different sector temperatures, CP-violating decays, symmetric-relic annihilation in the dark QCD sector, and reheaton entropy injection must be tracked together to predict Omega_DM/Omega_b, and the paper only provides benchmark logic.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dedicated coupled Boltzmann code (or extend micrOMEGAs-style machinery with a two-temperature hidden-sector module) evolving parent yields, asymmetries, dark-sector temperature, and reheaton decay through confinement, validated against the paper's benchmark Omega_DM/Omega_b relation.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino freeze-in at stronger coupling
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the Boltzmann-suppressed freeze-in regime with reheating temperature below the sterile-neutrino mass, including the transition toward freeze-out at larger couplings; the relic calculation currently exists only as the paper's own equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or implement a standalone solver of the paper's Boltzmann equations) to accept T_R < M with the scalar-bath abundance tracked, and validate against the paper's published relic curves in (M, lambda, T_R).

members.model_name: Q4-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: No solver is in place for the multi-component regime where heavier Q4 scalars do not decay: the coupled Boltzmann network with annihilation, semi-annihilation, and dark conversion among several near-degenerate hidden scalars exceeds the standard one- and two-component configurations of public relic codes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' multi-component/semi-annihilation machinery, or write a dedicated coupled-Boltzmann solver taking the enumerated Q4 reaction list, and validate it by recovering the one-component limit when the heavy-scalar decays are open.

members.model_name: Pure fermionic cosmic millicharged-particle background
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes pure-mCP production during reheating across the IR freeze-in, UV freeze-in (m_chi near T_rh), and thermalized freeze-out regimes with T_max = T_rh; the abundance contours underlying every route are private to the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or write a standalone yield solver) with a reheating phase evolving the inflaton and SM bath, covering the transition from freeze-in to thermalized freeze-out in (q_chi, m_chi, T_rh), validated against the paper's quoted q_chi about 1e-11 freeze-in contour.

members.model_name: Ghost dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements the ghost-dark-matter fluid perturbations, i.e. a component with time-dependent sound speed c_s^2 = rho_gdm/M^4 plus the higher-derivative (k^4/M^2) gradient term, so the predicted power-law Jeans suppression cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the GDM perturbation equations in CLASS by extending its generalized-fluid machinery with c_s^2(a) = rho_gdm(a)/M^4 and the k-dependent higher-derivative correction, restricted to the near-condensate validity domain, and validate against the paper's k_J,eq scaling and M ~ 10 eV bound.

members.model_name: Degenerate free-fermion dark matter with inflaton-decay production
members.description: No transfer-function calculation exists for the inflaton-decay quasi-monochromatic momentum distribution; the free-streaming constraint currently relies on the crude lambda_FS < 0.5 Mpc criterion instead of an actual linear power spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate the redshifted decay-produced f(p) and feed it to CLASS as a non-cold ncdm species with a custom phase-space distribution, producing T(k) over the (m_f, Br, m_phi/T_RH) plane.

members.model_name: Non-canonical scalar unified dark matter-dark energy model
members.description: No Boltzmann-code module implements the unified non-canonical scalar (L = X^alpha - V(phi)) with its kinetic dark-matter component evolving at sound speed c_s^2 = 1/(2 alpha - 1), so the linear matter power spectrum and growth observables cannot be computed for the critical perturbation observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in CLASS either as a generalized dark-matter fluid with the alpha-dependent constant sound speed and appropriate adiabatic/stress closure, or by extending the scalar-field sector to the X^alpha kinetic term, validating that c_s^2 -> 0 recovers CDM at large alpha.

members.model_name: General interacting dark sector with dark matter and dark radiation
members.description: The CLASS implementation of the IDS perturbation equations (two-component CDM with interacting fraction f, fluid dark radiation Delta_N_fluid, momentum-transfer rate Gamma_0) is author code of unknown availability, with no repository identified; without it neither the matter power nor the CMB observable can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain and publicly release the authors' CLASS IDS patch, or reimplement the paper's IDM-DR drag and fluid-DR equations in mainline CLASS building on the public ETHOS-type dark-radiation modules, validated against the paper's LCDM limit (Gamma_0 -> 0, f -> 0) and reported spectra.

members.model_name: Top-philic Majorana dark matter with colored t-channel mediator
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements conversion-driven freeze-out for this top-philic model: the coupled chi/tilde-t number-density equations with out-of-equilibrium chemical conversion terms are solved only in private code behind the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or implement a standalone coupled-Boltzmann module) with separate chi and mediator number densities and conversion rates chi <-> tilde t, validated against the published conversion-driven relic strip.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled scalar dark matter from inflationary fluctuations
members.description: No public solver evolves the non-minimally coupled scalar's mode functions (m, xi, H_I) through inflation and the inflation-to-radiation transition to produce the field and energy-density power spectra; the paper's calculation is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a mode-function integrator (an ODE code over k-grids with Bunch-Davies initial conditions and matching at the end of inflation, including a finite-duration reheating option), validated against the primary paper's viability plots; this could be packaged as an external module feeding CLASS/CAMB initial spectra.

members.model_name: Thermally corrected U(1)_Lmu-Ltau freeze-in scalar dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in Boltzmann solver accepts temperature-dependent parent masses M_Zprime(T), M_h1(T), M_h2(T), so the thermally opened forbidden-freeze-in yield Y_phi central to this model cannot be computed with existing tools; the authors' HPC implementation is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines (or write a standalone integrator) to take thermal-mass functions M_i(T) in the decay kinematics and channel-opening thresholds x_cr, validated against the paper's standard and forbidden freeze-in benchmark yield curves at g_mu_tau = 5e-4, v_mu_tau = 80 GeV.

members.model_name: Bouncing three-scalar dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the three-scalar dark sector with chemical potentials that produces the bounce (falling-then-rising equilibrium abundance before freezeout); the mass hierarchy m_chi > m_phi2 > m_phi1 with 2m_phi2 > m_chi + m_phi1 and the 2-to-2 interconversion network must currently be coded by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' multi-component freezeout module (or write a dedicated coupled number-density solver) to track chi, phi_1, phi_2 with species-dependent chemical potentials and the phi_2^2 chi phi_1 interconversion, validating against the primary-paper benchmark relic curves.

members.model_name: Dirac dark matter with a vector mediator and modified freeze-out
members.description: No Boltzmann solver integrates the BSF-corrected freeze-out equations under a nonstandard pre-BBN expansion history with an extra component scaling as (a_ref/a)^n relative to radiation, as this model's relic contours require.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs alternative-cosmology module (or a standalone integrator) to accept H(T;n,T_ref) with n=2,4 power-law extra energy density together with the effective BSF rate table, and validate against the source modified-history relic contours.

members.model_name: Gravity-portal stable right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver couples the reheating equations (inflaton potential power n, rho_end, T_rh) to Boltzmann evolution of both the gravitationally produced stable lightest RHN abundance and the heavy-RHN leptogenesis network, so the joint relic-density plus baryon-asymmetry target (M_N ~ 8e12 GeV benchmark) cannot be reproduced numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann code such as ULYSSES with source terms for graviton-mediated production from the SM bath and inflaton scattering during reheating, parameterized by (n, rho_end, T_rh, xi), and validate against the paper's M_N ~ 8e12 GeV and Omega_DM h^2 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Dark SU(2)_D neutron-decay freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the SU(2)_D model exists for the freeze-in relic calculation: the portal production rates (trace-operator coupling with coefficient c_1, neutron-sector couplings) for dark W^a and chi are not encoded in any Boltzmann solver, so the stated most-severe constraint (correct relic density) cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the SU(2)_D Lagrangian (dark W^a, chi, phi, effective trace operators) and compute the freeze-in yield with the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module, validated against the paper's stated relic-density hierarchy over BBN/direct/indirect bounds.

members.model_name: Scalar FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements moduli-portal freeze-in of a scalar FIMP through non-instantaneous reheating; the coupled inflaton-radiation-FIMP system with (T_R, T_max) and s-channel real/axial modulus pole effects exists only as the authors' custom code, and omitting the pre-radiation era can misestimate the yield by orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the real- and axial-modulus scalar rate densities in a public freeze-in solver extended with an inflaton-dominated reheating phase parameterized by (T_R, T_max) — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or release a standalone Boltzmann-fluid code — and validate by recovering the radiation-era-only yield and the published relic-density contours.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D vector dark matter with catalyzed freeze-out
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements catalyzed freeze-out for this SU(2)_D model: coupled equations for Y_X and Y_C including X X -> Zprime Zprime, the 3 Zprime -> X X catalyst process, and catalyst decay, plus a momentum-level treatment to test the late kinetic-equilibrium assumption that the paper itself flags as problematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a standalone coupled number-density solver with the thermally averaged 2->2 and 3->2 collision terms and catalyst decay width from the SU(2)_D Lagrangian, validated against the paper's analytic/numerical benchmark agreement; extend it (in the spirit of DRAKE's full phase-space fBE approach) to relax the kinetic-equilibrium assumption and quantify when the base-model relic contours are self-consistent.

members.model_name: Mirror-sector atomic dark matter with Affleck-Dine reheating
members.description: The modified CLASS v3.1.1 interacting-DM module implementing dark atoms, dark photons, and mirror neutrinos with dark recombination near z~1100 is private, so the model's CMB/BAO/H0 predictions cannot be independently reproduced, varied over (f_adm, T'/T, v'/v), or used in fits.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the described CLASS patch, or reimplement the mirror sector in a public atomic-dark-matter Boltzmann framework with a rescaled hidden recombination history (sigma_T' = (v/v')^2 sigma_T, hidden Saha/Peebles equations) parameterized by (f_adm, T'/T, v'/v).

members.model_name: Mediator-decay freeze-in dark matter during early matter domination
members.description: No public Boltzmann code couples the two-phase early-matter-domination background (T_O, T_R, entropy injection) to on-shell mediator population and mediator-decay freeze-in production; the paper's calculation exists only as a bespoke solver and the card's required 'custom Boltzmann solver for EMD' is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in and modified-cosmology modules (or release a standalone ODE solver) to evolve the coupled phi/radiation/mediator/DM system with inputs (m_chi, m_X, h, T_O, T_R, mediator gauge charge), validated against the paper's T_O vs m_X contours.

members.model_name: Dipolar dark matter from gravitational polarization
members.description: No cosmological perturbation/Boltzmann solver implements the dipolar-medium stress terms, so even once derived, the second-order or beyond-CDM signatures cannot be propagated to CMB spectra or non-Gaussianity estimators for data comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Boltzmann code (CLASS or CAMB) with the dipolar polarization field Pi and its stress-energy contributions, validated by reproducing the Lambda-CDM limit at first order, and couple the second-order terms to a bispectrum pipeline for comparison with Planck non-Gaussianity constraints.

members.model_name: Millicharged atomic dark matter with elastic nuclear scattering
members.description: No code computes the dark-sector recombination history (residual ionization fraction) and the resulting photon-baryon drag from millicharged constituents and atomic Compton scattering for this unbroken-U(1)_d atomic model, so the CMB observable rests on order-of-magnitude extrapolations of generic millicharged-DM limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Boltzmann code (CLASS with an interacting-DM/ETHOS-style drag term) with a dark-recombination module solving the dark Saha/Peebles equations in (alpha_prime, m_e, m_p, xi_dark) to get the ionization fraction, then add the millicharge and atomic-Compton momentum-exchange rates to the DM-photon-baryon coupling and confront Planck data.

members.model_name: Closed-sector scalar-mediator SIDM
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves a fully closed dark sector with Dirac DM, a light scalar mediator, and massless dark radiation through freeze-out, kinetic decoupling, and possible late Sommerfeld-enhanced reannihilation at phase-space-density level; the paper's numerical solution is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DRAKE (or micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector mode) to a closed sector parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, g_chi, g_l, r_BBN): add the dark-radiation bath temperature evolution, velocity-dependent Sommerfeld annihilation, and kinetic-decoupling tracking, validating moment-method output against full phase-space solutions as done in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Closed-sector scalar-mediator SIDM
members.description: No released CLASS/CAMB module implements this model's scalar-mediated chi-dark-radiation coupling with a time-dependent energy/entropy injection from reannihilation, so the matter transfer function, dark-acoustic damping, and CMB expansion-history response cannot be computed with public code; simple constant-N_eff limits are explicitly insufficient.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the ETHOS parameterization in a modified CLASS with the scalar-mediator drag coefficients and a time-dependent dark-sector energy budget sourced by the gap_1 Boltzmann solver, outputting matter power spectra and CMB spectra suitable for MontePython/Cobaya runs against Planck and BAO likelihoods.

members.model_name: Majorana dark matter co-annihilating with a strongly interacting scalar
members.description: No public code computes the plasma-modified Sommerfeld and bound-state spectral functions for a colored scalar coannihilation partner (thermal QCD potential, bound-state formation and dissociation, soft 2-to-2 scatterings) and folds them into the effective thermally averaged cross section; the calculation currently exists only as the paper's private numerical implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the NR EFT thermal-potential Schrodinger/spectral-function solver as a standalone module (parameterized by M, Delta M, color representation, alpha_s, and T > 1 GeV) and couple its effective sigma_eff(T) output to an existing coannihilation Boltzmann solver such as micrOMEGAs or DRAKE, validating against the paper's 5-6 TeV mass reach and mass-splitting window.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_X vector Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: No public model package ties the pipeline together: the U(1)_X model files for CosmoTransitions (thermal potential) and micrOMEGAs (CalcHEP model) used in the primary scan were not released, so the route cannot be re-run or extended without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Model-B Lagrangian as a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for micrOMEGAs and a CosmoTransitions generic-potential class, validating against the paper's benchmark classification table and XENON1T-excluded regions.

members.model_name: Dark glueballs with associated ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: No public dark-glueball relic calculator exists: the 3-to-2 number-changing freeze-out with cannibalistic self-heating, lattice-informed glueball spectra, and a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio T'/T is currently done by approximate semi-analytic estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Boltzmann code for 3-to-2 glueball freeze-out in a decoupled hidden sector, parameterized by (Lambda_dark, T'/T, gauge group), using lattice SU(N) glueball masses and dimensional 3-to-2 rates, and validate against the semi-analytic results in the glueball literature the card cites.

members.model_name: Ballistic Dark Matter
members.description: The CAMB/CLASS implementation of the BDM species (time-dependent w_B(z) from 1/3 to 0 with inherited acoustic velocity perturbations) is unreleased: no repository, patch, or module is public, so transfer functions and spectra cannot be reproduced without rewriting the fluid equations in a Boltzmann code.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the BDM fluid in public CLASS as a new species with parameterized w(z), sound speed, and vanishing anisotropic stress (following the paper's synchronous-gauge equations with a trace CDM component), and release it as a documented fork validated against the paper's example spectra.

members.model_name: STFM triplet WIMP with singlet-assisted nonthermal freeze-in
members.description: No public STFM model implementation exists for the relic-density pipeline: TeV-scale triplet freeze-out (including Sommerfeld-enhanced electroweak annihilation near the 2.45 TeV pure-freeze-out threshold) coupled to feeble singlet-NLOP production and its late decay into triplet DM must currently be solved with custom, unreleased Boltzmann code.
members.proposed_resolution: Build CalcHEP/FeynRules STFM model files for micrOMEGAs freeze-out, add Sommerfeld correction factors for the electroweak triplet, and couple a late-decay Boltzmann stage for the feeble singlet, validating against the primary 2.45 TeV pure-freeze-out threshold and scan trends.

members.model_name: Reheaton-decay nonthermal Dirac fermion dark matter with kination and early matter domination
members.description: The freeze-in/thermalization exclusion boundary rests on a modified approximate freeze-in estimate; no full Boltzmann computation of thermal DM production during the kination and reheaton-dominated epochs exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a freeze-in Boltzmann code (micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines or a dedicated solver) to the nonstandard kination/EMD thermal history to compute the thermal contamination of the reheaton-decay abundance.

members.model_name: Gluophilic Z-prime portal FIMP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements freeze-in during reheating for this model: the relic abundance depends on T_MAX and T_RH through gluon annihilation via the dimension-6 Z-prime-gluon operator, and the paper's coupled fluid-equation code is not released, so the freeze-in target curves cannot be reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or release/reimplement the paper's fluid solver) to include the inflaton-dominated reheating phase with T_MAX > T_RH and the gg -> chi chi collision term from the dim-6 operator, validated against the paper's approximate analytic relic expression and benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Dark-dimension dark graviton dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves the time-dependent mass distribution of a dense KK graviton tower under intra-tower cascade decays; the paper's tower equations are not released, so the present-day 1-100 keV dark-graviton distribution cannot be recomputed for other parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled tower Boltzmann equations as a standalone numerical code taking (T_i, m_KK, dark decay parameter, visible branching fraction) and returning the evolving graviton mass/abundance distribution, validated against the paper's benchmark of m_DM ~ 1-100 keV for T_i ~ 4 GeV.

members.model_name: Hidden self-interacting Dirac dark matter with scalar-mediated first-order phase transition
members.description: No public Boltzmann/relic solver computes hidden-sector freeze-out with equilibrium densities and thermally averaged cross sections evaluated at the dark temperature and with hidden radiation degrees of freedom in the Hubble rate, as this model requires for Omega_chi h^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or implement a standalone modified Boltzmann solver) with a two-temperature freeze-out mode parameterized by xi(T) and hidden-sector g_star, validated against the paper's quoted 0.01-10 GeV viable mass range.

members.model_name: Dirac dark matter with a scalar mediator and modified freeze-out
members.description: No Boltzmann solver couples the bound-state formation/dissociation network to a nonstandard pre-BBN expansion history H(T;n,T_ref) with an extra energy component redshifting faster than radiation, as required to reproduce the source relic contours.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs alternative-cosmology interface (or write a lightweight standalone solver) to integrate the coupled free-particle/bound-state Boltzmann equations with a user-specified power-law extra energy density rho_extra(T;n,T_ref), validating against the source scalar relic contours and the Planck target Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1200 +/- 0.0012.

members.model_name: Cold dark matter condensate transition model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the CDM-to-Q condensation transition: the energy-conserving conversion at z_t, the Q perturbation matching on the constant-energy hypersurface, and the post-transition large-Compton-wavelength scalar behavior were only ever coded in the authors' unreleased modification.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement in CLASS a fluid component whose energy density transfers instantaneously from CDM to a w_f fluid at z_t, with an explicit sound-speed/perturbation-matching prescription reproducing the paper's treatment, and validate against the CDM limit at large z_t and the reported z_t < 1.5 CMB disfavoring.

members.model_name: Three-level neutrino-laser majoron dark matter
members.description: No transfer-function interface exists for feeding the mixed output (a cold condensate-like boson population plus nonthermal hot boson and distorted neutrino distributions) into CLASS/CAMB to obtain P(k) and C_l for this MDM scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a CLASS extension that treats the low-momentum boson component as a CDM-like fluid and the hot boson and distorted neutrino populations as ncdm species with tabulated phase-space distributions imported from the kinetic solver of gap_1.

members.model_name: Logotropic dark fluid
members.description: No modified Boltzmann solver implements the logotropic unified dark fluid: the CLASS/CAMB modification named in the route is a planned recast target, so the matter transfer function, CMB spectra, and the k-range of the sound-speed suppression cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the logotropic background (rest-mass plus internal-energy split) and the derived perturbation closure as a fluid module in CLASS, validating that the Jeans length reproduces the quoted lambda_J=40.4 pc at the start of the matter era and that the A->0 limit recovers LambdaCDM.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector coscattering dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver handles conversion-driven (coscattering) freeze-out of a two-state dark sector, where inelastic n1 phi to n2 phi scattering decouples momentum mode by momentum mode before active-state annihilation; standard integrated coannihilation codes (micrOMEGAs-style) are explicitly insufficient in this regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public phase-space-level relic code such as DRAKE with two-species conversion collision terms (upscattering, downscattering, decays) parameterized by (m_chi, Delta, mixing epsilon, bath couplings), validated against the paper's pure-coscattering and coannihilation limits.

members.model_name: Superheavy vector-like doublet WIMP from incomplete thermalization
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the relic abundance from incomplete thermalization of a superheavy electroweak doublet, i.e. pair creation from the Boltzmann-suppressed tail of the SM bath at T_R < m_DM (including coannihilation in the restored electroweak phase) with an optional inflaton branching-ratio source term.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone momentum-integrated Boltzmann code) to include exp(-2 m_DM/T_R)-suppressed pair creation from the reheated SM plasma, electroweak coannihilation channels, and a Br(phi -> DM DM) injection term, validating against the paper's T_R ~ m_DM/29 abundance line.

members.model_name: Super-weak U(1) sterile neutrino dark matter (freeze-out variant)
members.description: No public implementation of the super-weak U(1)_z model exists for relic-abundance calculation; the resonant freeze-out band in the g_z-M_Zprime plane, which is sensitive to the near-pole thermal averaging, currently rests on an unreleased custom Boltzmann solver and cannot be independently reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_z gauge couplings and N1 sector as FeynRules/CalcHEP model files and run micrOMEGAs (which treats resonances via full thermal averaging without velocity expansion), validating against the paper's result that nonresonant g_z ~ 1e-2 at M_1 = 10 MeV is excluded while resonant g_z ~ 1e-6-1e-4 is viable.

members.model_name: Nonthermal decay-produced dark matter for the Hubble tension
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for this scenario's transient hot subcomponent: a massive daughter born relativistic at tau ~ 10^2-10^4 s that cools to cold DM by matter-radiation equality, with its nonthermal decay-produced momentum distribution; the public CLASS dcdm module treats massless daughters and cannot produce the H0 response or P(k) suppression for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS's decaying-CDM sector (or an existing two-body-decay branch with massive warm daughters) to evolve the exact decay-produced phase-space distribution f(q,t) as an ncdm-like species, parameterized by (tau, f, m_chi_prime/m_chi), including the phantom-like background option used by the paper.

members.model_name: Spin-zero no-freeze-in/no-freeze-out warm dark matter
members.description: No configured Boltzmann calculation exists for the exact linear transfer function of an early-decoupled spin-zero boson with T_S/T_gamma = (43/(11 g_dec))^(1/3); the route currently relies on an approximate thermal-relic half-mode rescaling the paper itself flags as imprecise.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure the CLASS (or CAMB) non-cold dark matter sector with the model's Bose-Einstein f(p) at temperature T_S = 0.345 T_gamma and M_S ~ 150 eV, compute the transfer function and half-mode scale directly, and validate against the paper's quoted (T_S/T_gamma)^1.11 rescaling factor.

members.model_name: Approximate-PQ electroweak supersymmetry with singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/thermal-history solver exists for the approximate-PQ singlet sector: e+e- <-> ss decoupling, G production and decay, entropy injection, and the resulting n_s/n_gamma and N_BBN/N_CMB are currently only order-of-magnitude estimates from the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet-sector rates in a hidden-sector thermal-history code (extend a nuMSM/keV-relic style momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver, or the temperature-evolution machinery of micrOMEGAs) with inputs (m_s, m_G, F_G, entropy source) and outputs (Omega_s, f(p), N_eff), validated against the paper's required dilution factor.

members.model_name: Late scalar-decay Wino/Higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solver for the coupled system of late Phi decay, baryon-asymmetry generation, LSP injection, and post-decay Wino/Higgsino reannihilation; the paper's abundance and Omega_chi/Omega_b ~ 5 target rest on analytic estimates with no reusable code (con_nonthermal_relic_ratio has likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' or DarkSUSY's nonthermal/late-decay relic machinery (or write a standalone solver) to evolve the coupled Phi, radiation, baryon, and neutralino Boltzmann equations with inputs (m_phi, T_d, branching to superpartners, m_chi, <sigma v>), validated against the paper's T_d ~ 120 MeV, m_phi ~ 1500 TeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Inert-Sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No code computes the nonthermal N1 phase-space distribution from eta_L freeze-out followed by late two-body decay (eta_L -> N1 + lepton), which sets whether the candidate is cold or warm and is the required input for the transfer-function step.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a micrOMEGAs inert-doublet freeze-out calculation with a momentum-level Boltzmann solver for decay-produced daughters (parameterized by M1, m_eta_L, T_decay), outputting a tabulated f(q) in CLASS ncdm format.

members.model_name: Dark-atom self-interacting dark matter with dark acoustic oscillations
members.description: No public Boltzmann implementation of the full atomic-dark-matter drag rate: the DM-DR coupling here is set by dark recombination (Rayleigh scattering off neutral dark atoms plus Compton scattering off residual ions), which the generic ETHOS power-law parameterization in modified CLASS does not capture, so the oscillatory transfer function cannot be computed precisely for arbitrary (m_P, m_E, alpha_D, xi).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public ETHOS-type CLASS branch with the atomic-DM recombination history and the resulting time-dependent drag rate (Rayleigh plus Compton terms) as model-level inputs, validated against the primary paper's benchmark spectra at k ~ 1-10 h/Mpc.

members.model_name: Many-body decaying dark matter with relativistic daughters
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the many-body decay kinematics (many massless daughters plus a stationary massive daughter with radiation fraction epsilon up to 1); existing public decaying-DM CLASS/CAMB branches implement either pure DM-to-dark-radiation decay or two-body kinematics, so the many-body perturbation equations are only approximately mapped.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public two-body decaying-DM CLASS branch (Franco Abellan et al. lineage) with the many-body source terms: a zero-velocity massive-daughter fluid plus dark-radiation injection, with the epsilon range widened to (0,1) and the corresponding perturbation equations derived and implemented.

members.model_name: Thermally produced dark pair plasma of vectorlike fermions
members.description: No calculator exists for the growth rates and saturation of dark-plasma kinetic instabilities (Weibel/filamentation-type) under cluster-merger conditions, which is needed to establish when collective effects dominate over two-body scattering (con_collective_instability_recast).
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing particle-in-cell plasma codes (e.g. Smilei or OSIRIS-class solvers rescaled to dark QED parameters) to compute instability growth and saturation times as a function of m_D, alpha_D, and merger velocity, and package the result as an analytic fitting function usable in the registry route.

members.model_name: Non-thermal fermionic dark matter in an anomaly-free B-L extension
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled non-equilibrium momentum-space Boltzmann equations of this model, in which an out-of-equilibrium Z_BL parent distribution f_ZBL(p,r) must be solved first and then feeds the daughter distribution f_psi1(p,r); the paper's numerical implementation was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain and release) a momentum-discretized coupled Boltzmann solver for parent-daughter freeze-in decays, parameterized by (M_psi1, M_ZBL, g_BL, scalar masses and mixings, g_star(T)), validated against the paper's benchmark lambda_fs < 0.01 Mpc results and against the number-density-only approximation.

members.model_name: High-scale SUSY D-term inflation with wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the combined thermal-plus-nonthermal wino relic abundance for this scenario: Sommerfeld-corrected wino annihilation exists only in private literature codes, and the nonthermal source term from decays of a 1e12-1e13 GeV gravitino (with the T_f versus T_3/2 branching logic) has no reusable implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate Sommerfeld-corrected wino <sigma v>(x) from the published Hisano-et-al.-style calculations (or extract DarkSUSY's electroweak Sommerfeld routines) and add a gravitino-decay source term Y_3/2 Gamma_3/2 to a Boltzmann integrator such as DRAKE or a micrOMEGAs extension, validating against the 2.7 TeV thermal benchmark.

members.model_name: Type-I seesaw Majoron warm dark matter completion
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation treats a warm keV Majoron with nonthermal f(p) that decays to neutrinos; existing CLASS decaying-DM branches assume cold DM decaying to dark radiation and do not combine warmness with the J -> nu nu channel needed for the CMB and matter-power predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS decaying-dark-matter branch to an ncdm species with tabulated f(p) and a decay term feeding the neutrino sector, validated by reproducing the cited decaying-Majoron CMB results (arXiv:0705.2406) in the cold limit.

members.model_name: Asymptotically safe quintuplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density code computes Sommerfeld-enhanced (and bound-state-corrected) freeze-out for SU(2)_L quintuplets with N_F non-coannihilating degenerate flavors; the route relies on a micrOMEGAs/Sommerfeld-style calculation that exists only as private literature implementations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a DRAKE-style Boltzmann solver) with the known electroweak Sommerfeld/bound-state annihilation matrices for the n=5 multiplet and an N_F-flavor scaling wrapper, validated against the paper's 1.2-2.1 TeV benchmark masses.

members.model_name: Asymptotically safe triplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density tool computes freeze-out for N_F degenerate SU(2)_L triplet flavors including electroweak Sommerfeld enhancement (and bound-state formation), which sets the 620 GeV to 1.7 TeV thermal mass window; the card marks the calculation as a micrOMEGAs/Sommerfeld-style computation not backed by released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or implement a standalone NREFT Boltzmann solver in the style of published wino Sommerfeld calculations) with the SU(2)_L triplet potential matrix, thermally averaged Sommerfeld factors, and the N_F * M_DM^2 flavor scaling, validating against the paper's quoted 3<=N_F<=20 mass window.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino Higgs-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-in code implements this model's production network (h -> ss, hh -> ss, hh -> s, s -> NN) with thermal masses, Bose-Einstein statistics, and electroweak/singlet phase-transition effects, which the paper finds shift yields by order unity to orders of magnitude near transitions; existing freeze-in tools (micrOMEGAs) omit these finite-temperature effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or implement a standalone Boltzmann solver) with temperature-dependent thermal masses for the Higgs and singlet, quantum-statistical collision integrals, and the two-step phase-transition background of the primary paper, validated against the paper's benchmark abundance curves.

members.model_name: Nonlinear charged dark matter with K-mouflage screening
members.description: No relativistic cosmological perturbation solver implements a dark U(1) force with K-mouflage screening from nonlinear electrodynamics; CLASS/CAMB and their modified-gravity extensions (e.g. hi_class-style codes) do not cover a screened long-range vector force acting only on dark matter, so CMB/BAO/Hubble-diagram consistency cannot be tested beyond the spherical-shell approximation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS-based modified-gravity branch with the L(Y,Z) dark-electrodynamics sector (background dark-electric field plus scale-dependent effective G_eff for dark matter), then attach standard Planck CMB, BAO, and SH0ES/Hubble-diagram likelihoods via MontePython or Cobaya.

members.model_name: Neutrino-philic twin two-Higgs-doublet cogenesis
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves coupled visible and twin lepton asymmetries from shared CP-violating heavy Majorana neutrino decays with independent washout in each sector, as required by the twin cogenesis abundance prediction.
