members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis code such as ULYSSES with a second (twin) lepton-asymmetry sector sharing the heavy-neutrino source terms, parameterized by Majorana masses, Yukawa couplings, CP phases, and per-sector washout rates.

members.model_name: Dark-photon-mediated inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: No public solver computes the coupled thermal history of the two scalar states (p-wave A'-mediated annihilation plus late phi1 phi1 -> phi2 phi2 conversion freeze-out) to predict the present excited fraction Omega_phi2/Omega_DM, including the regions needing entropy dilution or an extra annihilation mode.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' two-component/coexcitation machinery (or write a dedicated coupled Boltzmann code) to track both mass eigenstates through freeze-out and conversion freeze-out with the U(1)_D model file, outputting relic density and excited fraction over (m1, delta, m_A', g_D, epsilon).

members.model_name: Higgs-R^2 singlet scalar freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes UV freeze-in of a near-conformally coupled singlet scalar through the Higgs-R^2 reheating phase, including graviton-exchange scattering, nonminimal-coupling production, and inflaton-condensate scattering alongside the thermal-bath history (T_max, T_reh); the calculation currently exists only as the paper's private semi-analytics.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a reusable reheating+freeze-in module (e.g. extending micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery or a standalone code like DRAKE-style ODE integration) that solves the coupled inflaton-radiation equations of unitary Higgs-R^2 inflation and integrates the gravitational, nonminimal-coupling, and condensate-scattering production rates over the temperature history, parameterized by (m_s, xi_s, lambda_hs, xi, alpha).

members.model_name: Thermalized boosted milli-charged dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public electron-recoil rate code accepts the model's nonstandard thermalized boosted velocity distribution for a light millicharged species with a massless-dark-photon (1/q^4-enhanced) form factor, so the flagship boosted-MCP direct-detection spectrum cannot be computed end to end.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkELF or QEDark to take a user-supplied f(v) table, feed it the analytic equipartition distribution from step s1, and use the light-mediator F_DM = (alpha m_e / q)^2 form factor to produce XENON- and SENSEI-class electron-recoil spectra.

members.model_name: SU(6)/SO(6) composite pNGB singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP or micrOMEGAs model files) exists for the SU(6)/SO(6) composite pNGB singlet with Z2-odd dark top partners, so the relic-density scan cannot be reproduced or extended with a standard Boltzmann solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pNGB effective Lagrangian (S, H_2, dark top partners T, C_hS and y_L/y_R couplings, quartic SSVV terms) as a FeynRules model, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's C_hS = 0 benchmark mass window of about 190-230 GeV.

members.model_name: Hidden supersymmetric N=1 Yang-Mills dark sector
members.description: No Boltzmann implementation exists for the full production history: freeze-in through the singlet connector followed by hidden-sector self-thermalization (cannibalistic number-changing processes) and confinement, so the relic abundance and the DM momentum distribution relevant for the structure-formation lower bound rest on an analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the UV freeze-in collision term for the N N Tr(WW)/M_N^2 operator in a coupled visible/hidden temperature Boltzmann code (extending a micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or a dedicated two-temperature solver with 3-to-2 cannibalism and the confinement entropy transfer), outputting Omega h^2 and the free-streaming length over the (T_rh, M_N, N_c, m_DM) band.

members.model_name: Bino-like neutralino CDM with damping cutoff
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation computes the full neutralino transfer-function cutoff (acoustic damping during kinetic decoupling plus free streaming) for chosen MSSM benchmarks; the card's M_min is an order-of-magnitude semi-analytic estimate with values ranging 1e-7 to 1e-6 Msun across sources.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the bino-lepton relaxation rate into an ETHOS-style dark-matter/radiation coupling in a modified CLASS, using DarkSUSY or micrOMEGAs to supply the MSSM scattering amplitudes, and compute the linear transfer function and M_min per benchmark.

members.model_name: Baryon-including generalized Chaplygin gas quartessence
members.description: No full Boltzmann implementation of the baryon-plus-generalized-Chaplygin quartessence exists: the paper's ODE integration starts at z=100 with assumed initial conditions and computes only the linear matter side, so the CMB observable (obs_chaplygin_cmb_background) is judged only from related dark-energy-framing literature, not computed for this baryon-including model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the generalized Chaplygin gas as a fluid with c_s^2 = -alpha*w in CLASS alongside standard baryons, with proper radiation-era initial conditions, to produce self-consistent C_l and P(k) for the quartessence case.

members.model_name: Interacting quintessence cold dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the exact two-scalar iQCDM Lagrangian (quintessence exponentially coupled to a scalar iCDM component plus uncoupled nCDM): the perturbation equations, effective sound speed, and momentum-transfer terms for the scalar iCDM field have not been derived and coded, so CMB spectra, matter power spectra, and growth rates cannot be computed beyond the background level.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear perturbation equations for the coupled quintessence/scalar-iCDM/nCDM system from the explicit Lagrangian and implement them in an interacting-dark-energy branch of CLASS or CAMB, validating the background against the paper's tracking solution.

members.model_name: Scalar-tensor dynamical relaxation of the dark-matter-to-baryon ratio
members.description: No public code evolves the scalar-tensor background and linear perturbations with separate baryon and dark-matter conformal factors A_b(phi), A_d(phi); the fixed-point relaxation of rho_b/rho_d and its imprint on H(z) and the matter power spectrum currently exist only as the paper's private numerical examples.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a coupled-dark-energy branch of CLASS (or hi_class) with species-dependent conformal couplings parameterized by (beta_b, beta_d, V(phi)), solve background plus linear perturbations, and validate by reproducing the paper's three working examples and the rho_b/rho_d ~ 0.20 fixed point.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced superheavy X-particle dark matter
members.description: No public solver computes the gravitational and preheating production spectrum n_X(k) of superheavy X particles as a function of inflation model, m_X, curvature coupling xi, inflaton coupling q, and T_R; only paper-level numerical examples exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Release a Bogoliubov mode-function solver on parameterized inflationary backgrounds (inputs: inflaton potential, m_X, xi, q, T_R; outputs: k^3 n_X(k), Omega_X h^2 including entropy dilution), validated against the published few-10^13 GeV abundance window; couple lattice preheating runs (e.g. CosmoLattice-class) for the resonant q regime.

members.model_name: Multispecies hidden gauged SU(3) dark matter benchmark model
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver handles the 4-7 stable hidden SU(3) scalar/vector species with the full network of 2-to-2 annihilation, species-conversion, and 1-to-2 processes; the paper's adapted solver is private and was only run on three benchmark points, so component relic fractions Omega_i/Omega_DM cannot be computed across the parameter space, and every downstream observable depends on these fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs multi-component framework (currently limited to two dark sectors) to an N-species coupled system with 1-to-2 conversion terms, or obtain and release the paper's adapted solver; implement the hidden SU(3) model file (FeynRules/CalcHEP) so all 2-to-2 and 1-to-2 rates are generated automatically rather than per-benchmark.

members.model_name: Bolon coupled dark matter from dilatation anomaly
members.description: No Boltzmann code implements the coupled two-scalar cosmon-bolon cosmology: the route names only a 'CLASS/CAMB-style interacting scalar perturbation implementation' that does not exist, so CMB spectra, the matter power spectrum, and the bolon small-scale cutoff cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (building on its quintessence and AxiCLASS oscillating-scalar infrastructure) with the exponential cosmon-bolon potential, the averaged bolon fluid from gap_1, and early-dark-energy background evolution; validate against the paper's equality estimate and the uncoupled ultralight-scalar limit.

members.model_name: Neutralino dark matter from heavy gravitino decay
members.description: No public code solves the full nonstandard thermal history of this scenario: modulus domination and entropy release, gravitino pair production in modulus decay, gravitino decay to neutralinos, and neutralino re-annihilation at the low post-decay temperature; standard relic solvers assume radiation-dominated thermal freeze-out.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' non-standard-cosmology module (or a DRAKE-style Boltzmann code) with a modulus-gravitino-neutralino decay chain parameterized by (m_phi, m_3/2, C, T_phi), including entropy injection and neutralino re-annihilation, validated against the paper's analytic yield scalings.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter from GMSB scalar decay at low reheating temperature
members.description: The free-streaming viability of decay-produced gravitinos rests on an appendix analytic estimate; no code computes the actual decay-produced gravitino phase-space distribution f(q) from S decay and its linear transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the two-body decay-produced f(q) for gravitinos from the oscillating S condensate and feed it to CLASS as a tabulated non-cold-relic distribution to replace the analytic free-streaming estimate with a computed transfer function.

members.model_name: AMSB nonthermal wino dark matter from scalar-field decay
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implementation for wino reannihilation after late scalar/modulus decay: injecting a neutralino yield at reheat temperature T_R below freeze-out and evolving annihilation to the final abundance across AMSB scan points.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a relic-density code such as micrOMEGAs or IsaReD with a nonthermal injection mode that starts the Boltzmann evolution at T_R with yield b/m_phi times the scalar density and the wino <sigma v> from the AMSB spectrum, including Sommerfeld-free tree-level annihilation as in the paper.

members.model_name: A4 split-seesaw keV sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Leptogenesis viability is asserted only from the scale comparison M_R2,M_R3 ~ 1e11-1e12 GeV versus T_R; no Boltzmann leptogenesis calculation with the model's A4-constrained Yukawa textures exists to confirm the baryon asymmetry, including the flagged degenerate-enhancement option.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the A4 split-seesaw Yukawa and heavy-mass matrices in a public leptogenesis Boltzmann solver such as ULYSSES and scan T_R and the heavy-neutrino degeneracy for the observed eta_B.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric U(1)' hylogenesis antibaryon dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the three-stage hylogenesis cosmology: low-temperature modulus reheating, CP-asymmetric X decays generating equal and opposite baryon numbers, and hidden U(1)' annihilation/transfer reactions among psi and phi states.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the primary-paper reheating and hidden-sector Boltzmann equations as a dedicated numerical solver (coupled ODEs for modulus, X, visible and hidden asymmetries, and symmetric fractions), validated against the paper's benchmark scans and baryon-number-conservation test.

members.model_name: Big-Bang Dark Nucleosynthesis nuclear dark matter
members.description: No calculator exists for composite dark-nucleus form factors and detector response: mapping the A distribution and radius R_A to coherent recoil spectra in tonne-scale detectors and to optically levitated/optomechanical sensor signals is currently unimplemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive R_A-scaling (saturated-density) form factors for large dark nuclei and implement a recast module producing recoil and momentum-impulse spectra for xenon-class detectors and levitated-sensor proposals, integrated over the BBDN A distribution from gap_1.

members.model_name: ETHOS-3 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: No public, maintained Boltzmann-code implementation of the ETHOS dark-matter/dark-radiation opacity parameterization (a4 coefficient, xi, DAO/Silk damping) is identified; the paper used a private modified CAMB.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the ETHOS opacity terms (a_n momentum-scaling series, dark-radiation temperature ratio xi) as a public patch to CLASS or CAMB, validated against the published ETHOS-3 transfer function.

members.model_name: L_mu - L_tau scotogenic freeze-in two-component dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code solves freeze-in production from the decays of a nonthermal, never-equilibrated parent: the Z_mu_tau distribution f_Z(p) must be evolved and fed into the N_2/N_3 yield equations, which micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (thermal-bath parent assumption) does not cover.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone solver on its CalcHEP amplitudes) to evolve the unintegrated parent phase-space distribution f_Z(p,T) via a momentum-binned Boltzmann hierarchy and feed the resulting decay spectrum into the N_2/N_3 yield equations, validated against the paper's benchmark with g_mu_tau ~ 1e-11.

members.model_name: Z2-stabilized scalar dark matter from preheating and reheating
members.description: No public numerical Boltzmann solver covers 4-to-2 cannibal number-changing reactions in a fully decoupled dark sector with its own temperature evolution (micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY assume 2-to-2 freeze-out with the SM bath), so the depletion in step s3 rests on analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled number-density and dark-temperature Boltzmann system with the generalized <sigma v^3>_4to2 collision term (following the 1510.08063 formalism) as a standalone module or a micrOMEGAs extension, validated against the source benchmark f(T0)=5.3.

members.model_name: Thermal wino dark matter with inelastic kinetic decoupling
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the full perturbation hierarchy for wino dark matter with inelastic neutral-charged kinetic coupling: the ETHOS-style parameterizations in modified CLASS/CAMB cover elastic DM-radiation scattering, not the two-state inelastic conversion that produces the wino's dark acoustic oscillations with overshooting, so the transfer function relies on approximate analytic estimates with calibration factors carried over from bino studies.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (building on the ETHOS interacting-dark-matter framework) with a two-component wino sector including the temperature-dependent inelastic chi0-chi+ conversion rate and the coupled Fokker-Planck momentum evolution, and validate against the paper's T_kd = 9.2 MeV, k_fs = 3.5 pc^-1 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Multi-moduli nonthermal dark matter with prompt annihilation to dark radiation
members.description: No coupled Boltzmann solver exists for the two-modulus nonthermal history (phi2 and phi1 energy densities, hidden-sector chi number density with prompt chi chi -> dark radiation annihilation, and rho_dr) beyond the instantaneous-decay analytic estimates, so the final relic density and Delta N_eff cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled ODE system for (rho_phi2, rho_phi1, n_chi, rho_dr, rho_vis) with continuous (non-instantaneous) decay terms and the <sigma v>_ann sink, e.g. by extending an existing early-matter-domination/nonthermal relic code, and validate it against the source's dilution scalings and the m_mod > 50-100 TeV BBN floor.

members.model_name: Asymmetric atomic dark matter with massive dark photon bound-state formation
members.description: No maintained Boltzmann-code implementation maps this model's dark protons, dark electrons, and massive dark photon to DAO features in the CMB and matter power spectrum, so the cosmological consistency of the residual ionization used for the indirect signal cannot be checked.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-style modified CLASS with the atomic-DM tight-coupling and dark-recombination physics (using the x_D history from gap_2), and run Planck plus matter-power likelihoods to bound B_D, T_D/T_CMB, and the DAO scale for this parameter space.

members.model_name: Late-time dark matter to dark radiation conversion (DMDR)
members.description: The only implementation of the DMDR background and perturbation equations, DMDR-CAMB, is on-request author code with unknown maintenance status, unspecified license, and no public validation suite, so independent registry evaluation of the CMB and matter-power route depends on emailing the authors.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain and archive the DMDR-CAMB patch or, more robustly, reimplement the two-parameter conversion source term Q and the sourced free-streaming dark-radiation hierarchy in current public CLASS or CAMB, validating against the paper's <0.037 combined converted-fraction bound and the S8 shift.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_R superheavy LSP dark matter
members.description: No numerical Boltzmann solver run couples the inflaton decay, the T_max > T_reh reheating plasma evolution, and superheavy LSP production/annihilation (eta_X), so Omega_LSP is known only from analytic estimates that the card flags as insufficient for a precision relic abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled inflaton-radiation-LSP Boltzmann system during reheating (extending a freeze-in/reheating code such as a FRISBHEE- or micrOMEGAs-style framework with the T_max-era production integrals of hep-ph/9809453) using the model's computed inflaton widths and eta_X.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV hadrophilic UV freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver covers UV freeze-in during and after low-temperature reheating (T_R down to ~10 MeV, finite T_max) with hadronic initial states: photon and pion annihilation rates through the effective phi-FF and phi-GG operators below the QCD scale are not implemented in micrOMEGAs or MadDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a dedicated solver) with a modified expansion history parameterized by (T_R, T_max), adding chiPT-derived pi-pi -> chi chi and gamma gamma -> chi chi collision terms for the hadrophilic scalar mediator, validated against the paper's m_chi Y_DM = 4.37e-10 GeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Hybrid two-scalar dark sector
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the hybrid two-scalar dark sector exists: the authors' CLASS adaptation with the coupled scalar-fluid mapping (field-dependent DM mass, coupling function Q, modified G_eff) is not released, so CMB spectra, lensing potential, and P(k) cannot be recomputed for arbitrary hybrid-potential parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hybrid-potential background and perturbation equations (pressureless fluid coupled to the light scalar, with coupling Q and field-dependent mass) as a public CLASS module, building on existing coupled-dark-energy CLASS forks, and validate against the paper's published CMB lensing and P(k) deviation figures.

members.model_name: SU(6)/Sp(6) composite pNGB complex singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP or micrOMEGAs model files) exists for the SU(6)/Sp(6) complex pNGB singlet S = eta_3 + i eta_4 with dark U(1) stabilization and Z2-odd dark top partners, so the relic-density scan including the gauge-boson-dominated heavy regime cannot be reproduced with a standard Boltzmann solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pNGB effective Lagrangian (complex S, H_2, dark top partners, C_hS, y_L/y_R, and the quartic S* S VV terms with coefficient a_V) as a FeynRules model, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's C_hS = 0 benchmark near m_S ~ 870 GeV.

members.model_name: Post-recombination reheating decaying cold dark matter
members.description: The modified CLASS patch implementing DCDM background and perturbation equations with decay into photons and a time-dependent T_CMB is described in the paper but not publicly released, so neither the CMB spectra nor the H0/S8 posteriors can be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the DCDM-to-photon source term (Omega_DCDM_ini, Gamma, evolving photon temperature) in public CLASS following the paper's equations, validate against the quoted Planck+FIRAS+SH0ES best fits, and wire it into a Cobaya likelihood pipeline.

members.model_name: Two-component baryon-scattering dark matter for cool-core cluster heating
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation covers a fractional baryon-scattering dark subcomponent (fraction f_chi) that is simultaneously kinetically coupled to a dominant cold dark reservoir; existing interacting-DM branches of CLASS/CAMB treat a single species scattering with baryons and do not include the dark-sector kinetic-equilibrium term or the proposed CMB-evasion variants (post-recombination parent decay, dark phase transition, dark conductivity).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public interacting-dark-matter CLASS branch with a two-species dark sector: an f_chi subcomponent with sigma_n^B v^n baryon drag (n = 0, -2, -4) coupled by a dark-sector momentum-exchange term to the dominant CDM species, plus an optional post-recombination decay source term, and validate against the single-species limit.

members.model_name: Z_3 complex scalar asymmetric dark matter from semi-annihilation
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver tracks separate phi and anti-phi yields with the CP-violation parameter epsilon from interference of tree and one-loop semi-annihilation diagrams; existing relic-density codes (micrOMEGAs, MadDM) implement Z3 semi-annihilation only for symmetric populations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a standalone DRAKE-style solver) with a two-species asymmetric freeze-out module parameterized by (m_phi, m_eta, <sigma v>_S, <sigma v>_A, epsilon), reproducing the primary paper's coupled yield equations and their zero-CP and maximal-CP limits.

members.model_name: Conversion-driven t-channel mediator dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver reproduces the conversion-driven freeze-out relic strip for this quark-philic t-channel model including the coupled X-Y conversion terms (decays, inverse decays, scatterings) with Sommerfeld enhancement and bound-state effects that the card lists as key relic dependencies.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs coscattering/freeze-out machinery (or DRAKE) with the coupled X-Y number-density and conversion-rate equations for a colored scalar mediator, adding Sommerfeld and bound-state correction factors for Y Y-bar annihilation, and validate against the published CDFO strip (lambda_X ~ 1e-6, Delta m of few to few tens of GeV).

members.model_name: Low-reheating dark-photon freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The low-reheating freeze-in Boltzmann solver — the public benchmark code modified to start from a free visible-sector T_rh below m_chi with Boltzmann-suppressed production — is not publicly released, so the relic band between the BBN floor and the standard T_rh >> m_chi benchmark cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public freeze-in direct-detection benchmark code of the earlier work (arXiv:1807.05022 lineage) with T_rh as a free input and Boltzmann-suppressed production from all tree-level SM channels, and release it validated against the paper's recovery of the standard benchmark at T_rh >> m_chi.

members.model_name: Inhomogeneous Chaplygin-gas gravitational-condensate dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code implements the two-component inhomogeneous Chaplygin system: a smooth residual gas with p=-A/rho (nonzero, evolving sound speed) plus a CDM-like condensate fraction; the only implementation was an unreleased, preliminary CMBfast patch from 2003, so no modern CMB or matter power spectra can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the residual Chaplygin gas in CLASS as a generalized-dark-matter fluid with w(a) and c_s^2(a) from p=-A/rho and rho=sqrt(A+B/gamma), plus a separate CDM component for the condensate parameterized by (Omega_gas, v^2, Omega_CDM), then couple the output spectra to the public Planck and matter-power likelihoods in Cobaya for a modern constraint pass.

members.model_name: Long-lived radion dark matter in Randall-Sundrum cosmology
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation of RS radion linear perturbations exists: the entropy/isocurvature transfer during stabilization that produces the effective baryon isocurvature S_eff is not available in CLASS/CAMB or their scalar-tensor extensions, blocking the model's critical CMB observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a scalar-tensor Boltzmann code (hi_class or a CLASS fork) with the radion field, the brane-dependent couplings alpha_R^(1), alpha_R^(2), and the stabilization-era entropy-perturbation transfer, outputting curvature and S_eff transfer functions to last scattering.

members.model_name: Hybrid Chaplygin gas
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the two-component hybrid Chaplygin system (Chaplygin fluid with A promoted to an exponential-potential scalar), including the delta-A entropy perturbation and nonadiabatic pressure cancellation, so neither the matter power spectrum nor a modern SN/CMB/LSS confrontation of the model can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hybrid Chaplygin sector in CLASS or CAMB as a coupled fluid-plus-scalar module (Chaplygin background with dynamical A(phi), evolving delta phi and the induced delta p nonadiabatic term), validate against the paper's analytic result that entropy perturbations damp after horizon entry, then run standard Planck/Pantheon/BAO likelihoods through Cobaya or MontePython to quantify the large-scale-structure failure.

members.model_name: Flaxino dark matter with stau NLSP
members.description: No collider recast exists mapping the stau NLSP track length and delayed decay to flaxino onto LHC heavy-stable-charged-particle and stopped-particle searches; the card only gives analytic lifetime scaling and qualitative detector/stopper discussion.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a long-lived-stau simplified model in an existing LLP recast framework (SModelS/CheckMATE-class HSCP and stopped-particle analyses), parameterized by (m_stau, tau_stau) with tau_stau computed from F_a, m_flaxino, and the mixing.

members.model_name: Dark atoms with massive dark photon and millicharged subcomponent
members.description: No public Boltzmann code computes dark recombination and ionization freeze-out for atomic dark matter with a massive dark photon (B_D/m_A of order unity), so the residual millicharged fraction f_e cannot be scanned outside the paper's example points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the primary paper's ionization Boltzmann equation, with massive-mediator recombination cross sections parameterized by (alpha_D, B_D, m_A), as a standalone ODE module or an extension of an existing dark-recombination solver, validated against the paper's percent-level ionization regions.

members.model_name: MSSM bino-stau co-annihilation dark matter with universal slepton masses
members.description: The vacuum-stability constraint on the stau strip (con_stau_vacuum_stability, charge-breaking minima from large stau mixing, including the finite-temperature bound) has no evaluation tool attached: the card cites the bound but names no code to test charge-breaking minima across the scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Integrate an automated scalar-potential stability check (Vevacious/CosmoTransitions-class tunneling calculation of the stau-Higgs potential, including thermal corrections) into the scan pipeline, reproducing the bound of arXiv:1809.10061 used by the source.

members.model_name: Reshuffled SIMP Model A
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver exists for the two-component SIMP network with 3-to-2 number-changing reactions plus loop-induced number-conserving 2-to-2 X-N reshuffling; the paper's yield histories come from a private implementation and standard relic codes (micrOMEGAs, DarkSUSY) do not cover this reaction network.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the appendix's coupled equations for the X and N yields in a public stiff-ODE integrator (standalone Python/C++ or as a micrOMEGAs extension), taking the effective-operator cross sections and vector-portal kinetic-equilibrium terms as inputs, and validate by recovering the paper's benchmark yield histories and the rate hierarchy Gamma_2to2 > Gamma_el > Gamma_3to2 > H_DM.

members.model_name: Reshuffled SIMP Model B
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver exists for the three-component reshuffled SIMP system with 3->2 number-changing reactions plus loop-induced number-conserving 2->2 reshuffling; the Model B evolution equations are available only as appendix equations labeled by the card as 'custom coupled Boltzmann equations from the paper'.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the appendix coupled Boltzmann system (component yields Y_X, Y_N1, Y_N2 with 3->2 and two-loop 2->2 collision terms) as a public standalone integrator or a micrOMEGAs multi-component extension, validated against the paper's benchmark yield histories and the rate hierarchy Gamma_2to2 > Gamma_el > Gamma_3to2 > H_DM.

members.model_name: Kinetically coupled early dark energy and scalar field dark matter
members.description: The KCS-modified CLASS (SFDM with EDE-dependent kinetic term beta(psi) multiplying the kinetic term, plus shooting for the SFDM initial value) is author-private with no release URL, so neither observable can be recomputed or the beta/H0/S8 posteriors reproduced outside the original group.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain the authors' CLASS patch or re-implement the KCS equations in public CLASS by extending an existing EDE+ultralight-scalar branch (e.g. AxiCLASS) with the exponential kinetic-coupling function and its perturbation terms, validating against the published beta = 0.030 +/- 0.026, H0 = 72.38, and S8 = 0.8134 fit values.

members.model_name: Affine-EOS quintessence unified dark fluid
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the canonical affine-quintessence unified dark fluid: linear perturbations of the scalar with the hyperbolic potential (including its effective sound speed and Compton scale) have never been evolved through a CMB/matter-power pipeline, so the alpha ~ 1e-6 bound rests on a scaling argument rather than a computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the affine unified dark fluid in CLASS as either the derived scalar field (quintessence module with the hyperbolic potential and full perturbations) or a generalized-dark-matter fluid with c_s^2 set by the affine slope alpha, then compute P(k) and CMB spectra to turn the kpc-clustering and ISW arguments into quantitative constraints against Planck and galaxy-clustering data.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated O'Raifeartaigh R-ball dark matter
members.description: For the parameter regions where R-balls decay before today, there is no pipeline mapping the decay products (gravitinos, gauginos, visible gauge bosons) at the computed decay epoch onto BBN and CMB energy-injection constraints, leaving the cosmological-imprint half of the detection observable unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Once gap_2 supplies branching ratios and decay temperatures, feed the injected electromagnetic/hadronic spectra into existing BBN and CMB injection codes (AlterBBN/ACROPOLIS-class for light elements, ExoCLASS-class for CMB) to produce exclusion contours in the (R, M_F, m_3/2) plane.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled relativistic BEC dark matter
members.description: The CDM-like large-scale limit before condensation is asserted qualitatively only: there is no Boltzmann-solver implementation of the almost-cold scalar with late-time condensation, so the background evolution, linear power spectrum, and the epoch at which the NMC switches on cannot be computed or checked against CMB/LSS data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar BEC as a CLASS species (fluid or field-level, following existing scalar-field-dark-matter CLASS patches) with a parameterized condensation transition, and verify the background and linear perturbations reduce to CDM on large scales for the relevant parameter space.

members.model_name: U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements the coupled RH-neutrino decay/inverse-decay plus RH-sneutrino annihilation system that sets the thermal relic density in this model; standard freeze-out machinery assumes full thermal contact and does not track whether Z'-mediated interactions and N decays keep the sector coupled.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (once the model file from gap_1 exists) with coupled number-density equations for N_1 and N including decay/inverse-decay terms, reproducing the related-paper result that light U(1)' gaugino t-channel exchange yields the observed abundance.

members.model_name: Accidental complex scalar Z3 dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No model implementation of the scale-invariant local B-L complex-scalar Z3 sector (S_X, B-L Higgs, pseudo-Goldstone, Z_B-L) exists for a semi-annihilation-capable Boltzmann solver, so the relic density including S S -> S* phi channels cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the Z3 scalar sector with the cubic S_X^3 term and pseudo-Goldstone spectrum, and run micrOMEGAs (which natively supports Z3 semi-annihilation) to reproduce the m_S = 51 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Double-inflation parametric-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No second-order induced-GW integrator is bundled to map the narrow parametric-resonance (top-hat-like) curvature band to Omega_SGW(f); the card records only the primary paper's analytic computation with no numerical recomputation.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a public second-order induced-GW integrator (SIGWfast-class) and wire it to the model's parameterized narrow resonant-band P_R(k) (peak scale k_peak, width, amplitude), validating against the primary paper's spectra.

members.model_name: XC charged dark matter with a light C particle
members.description: No public Boltzmann code couples the XC dark-plasma ionization history (X, anti-X, C, massless dark photon with dark Thomson scattering off C) to linear perturbations; existing ETHOS/interacting-DR extensions of CLASS parameterize the drag rate generically but do not include the atomic-like dark recombination that sets z_dec and the DAO pattern for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a dark-sector RECFAST-like module computing the C ionized fraction and DM-DR momentum-transfer rate from (m_X, m_C, alpha_D, xi), then either solve the full perturbation equations or map onto the ETHOS a_n/DAO parameterization for constraint reuse.

members.model_name: Bino-right-handed-sbottom co-annihilation model
members.description: No public relic-density code implements the coupled Boltzmann system for bino-sbottom coannihilation including QCD Sommerfeld enhancement and sbottomium bound-state formation, decay, and dissociation, which the card says contribute up to about 30 percent of the effective annihilation rate and shift the preferred mass splitting.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-out solver (micrOMEGAs or a DRAKE-style coupled-Boltzmann code) with the radiative bound-state capture cross sections and thermally averaged dissociation rates for a color-triplet scalar partner, validating against the published 1703.02977 and 1604.01776 relic bands.

members.model_name: Bino-right-handed-stop co-annihilation model
members.description: No public relic-density code implements the coupled Boltzmann system for bino-stop coannihilation including QCD Sommerfeld enhancement and stopponium bound-state formation, decay, and dissociation; the card says omitting these terms misestimates the preferred mass splitting even though the bound-state contribution stays below about 10 percent for the right-handed stop.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public freeze-out solver (micrOMEGAs or a DRAKE-style coupled-Boltzmann code) with radiative bound-state capture and thermal dissociation rates for a color-triplet scalar partner including the electroweak annihilation channels, validating against the published 1703.02977 and 1604.01776 relic bands.

members.model_name: Subpercent minicharged dark matter
members.description: No public thermal-history solver is attached that evolves the coupled baryon/minicharged-DM temperatures, ionization fraction, and relative-velocity drag for a subpercent charged fraction f_dm (route lists 'thermal-history solver' and 'Boltzmann solver for DM-baryon scattering' as required with null tool_or_code).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing DM-baryon scattering implementation in CLASS (the sigma(v) ~ v^-4 interacting-DM module) or a standalone Munoz-Loeb-style code to include a fractional charged component f_dm with Coulomb drag and Debye-log cross section, tracking T_chi, T_b, x_e, and v_chi_b jointly, validated against the paper's T_b ~ 4 K at z ~ 17 benchmark.

members.model_name: Resonant self-interacting dark matter with dark deuteron bound states
members.description: No public dark-sector Boltzmann solver includes three-body recombination (d+d+d -> deuteron+nucleon), deuteron breakup, and a possible larger dark-nucleus network, so f_2(z) beyond the paper's simplified single-channel evolution cannot be recomputed or extended off-benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone dark-nucleosynthesis network code that evolves nucleon/deuteron (and heavier cluster) abundances with the universal K_3(a, m) recombination coefficient and breakup rates against the dark temperature history and Hubble rate, validated against the paper's f_2 < 1e-6 benchmark at m = 19 GeV, a = 17 fm.

members.model_name: Charged leptophilic dark electron model
members.description: No Boltzmann kinetic-decoupling integrator handles this model's near-resonant elastic scattering on SM electrons (mass splitting Delta M ~ m_e) together with strong scattering on the keV neutral scalar, so the kinetic-decoupling temperature and linear power-spectrum cutoff cannot be computed beyond the paper's estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-style modified CLASS (or the Bringmann-Hofmann kinetic-decoupling formalism implemented as a numerical integrator) with the resonant dark-electron/SM-electron momentum-transfer rate and phi0-mediated scattering, outputting T_kd and the linear transfer function over the (M, Delta M, M_0, alpha_0) space.

members.model_name: Feebly coupled leptophilic Majorana dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles the conversion-driven freeze-out regime of this leptophilic model, where chemical equilibrium between the Majorana DM and the charged scalar mediator breaks down and coupled per-species number-density equations with conversion terms must be solved; standard micrOMEGAs/MadDM coannihilation routines assume chemical equilibrium and misplace the viable feeble-coupling window.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or implement a standalone solver in the style of the conversion-driven freeze-out literature) to solve the coupled chi and phi number-density equations with explicit conversion rates chi l <-> phi and decay terms, scanning lambda from 1e-8 to 0.1 across the freeze-in/conversion/freeze-out transition, and validate against the paper's m_chi=150 GeV, Delta m=2 GeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Two-state unified superfluid dark sector
members.description: No linear perturbation solver exists for the unified two-state superfluid: the growth-rate difference from LCDM is the model's key cosmological signature, but no Boltzmann/fluid code implements the coupled two-state condensate perturbations with the Josephson/Rabi mixing potential and time-dependent sound speeds.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-state superfluid as an effective dark-sector fluid in CLASS: evolve the background phase/occupation equations with the cosine interspecies potential, derive delta and theta equations with the EFT sound speeds c_s(a), and output H(z), CMB spectra, and f*sigma8(z).

members.model_name: N2HDM Dark Singlet Phase
members.description: The electroweak (NLO) corrections to the singlet-scalar spin-independent direct-detection cross section in the N2HDM dark singlet phase exist only in a related private calculation, so precision comparisons with XENON1T-class limits rely on tree-level MicrOMEGAs output that can misplace points near the exclusion boundary.
members.proposed_resolution: Port the arXiv:2204.13145 one-loop electroweak corrections to the H_D-nucleon effective coupling into a public module (e.g. a micrOMEGAs add-on or standalone code) and rerun the abundance-rescaled XENON1T comparison for the ScannerS-allowed DSP points.

members.model_name: Hadrophilic scalar-mediator sequential freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-level (unintegrated) Boltzmann solver computes the nonthermal hadrophilic mediator distribution f_phi(p,T) with thermal masses and quantum statistics and then the sequential phi phi -> chi chi yield; micrOMEGAs and MadDM freeze-in routines use integrated densities and miss the distribution tail that controls this channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a public momentum-grid Boltzmann solver for f_phi(p,T) with finite-temperature collision terms for SM -> phi production (following the paper's treatment), coupled to a second stage integrating phi phi -> chi chi into Y_chi and Omega_chi h^2; validate by recovering ordinary freeze-in when the sequential channel is switched off, and consider contributing it as a micrOMEGAs or DRAKE-style extension.

members.model_name: Fraternal twin Higgs cogenesis
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver handles coupled two-sector (visible plus fraternal-twin) leptogenesis with shared heavy Majorana neutrino decays, branch-specific washout, and separate twin sphaleron conversion; the card's cogenesis route relies on hand-assembled coupled equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing leptogenesis Boltzmann code such as ULYSSES to evolve visible and twin lepton asymmetries simultaneously, parameterized by the Majorana masses, Yukawa couplings, CP phases, and fraternal-spectrum washout rates, with twin-sphaleron conversion factors applied at twin electroweak freeze-out.

members.model_name: Techni-Pati-Salam semi-integer-baryon-number composite dark matter
members.description: No solver exists for the TPS asymmetric relic abundance: computing Omega_DM/Omega_b requires a chemical-potential network with the model's equilibrium conditions plus Boltzmann suppression of the multi-component exotic sector through a strong electroweak phase transition, which standard freeze-out codes (micrOMEGAs, MadDM) do not cover.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated chemical-potential/Boltzmann code implementing the TPS charge assignments, sphaleron and PC4F equilibrium conditions, and Boltzmann-suppressed freeze-out of the exotic components at T_star, turning the paper's qualitative Omega_DM/Omega_b formula into a numeric M_DM prediction with uncertainties.

members.model_name: Reproductive freeze-in self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver integrates number-changing 2->k dark-sector reactions for a chemically underoccupied but kinetically equilibrated species, tracking the occupancy Z(t) and dark temperature T_dm(t) through the RFI phase and the subsequent cannibal-era check.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled (Z, T_dm) integrated Boltzmann equations with a parameterized 2->k collision term (rate coefficient plus exponent) as a standalone module or an extension of micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector freeze-in machinery, validated against the paper's semi-analytic yield-growth and no-cannibal criteria.

members.model_name: Atomic dissipative dark matter with dark black holes
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation covers this model's dark-atomic linear cosmology (dark recombination and ionization history, dark acoustic oscillations for the x/c/dark-photon sector), so the large-scale-structure viability constraint on alpha_D, m_c, m_x is judged only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with an atomic-dark-matter module (dark recombination via a rescaled RECFAST/HyRec treatment and ETHOS-like dark-photon tight coupling) to compute the linear power spectrum and delimit the CDM-like region of (alpha_D, m_c, m_x) parameter space.

members.model_name: Instantaneously decaying WIMP warm dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for decay-produced nonthermal WDM with a delta-function daughter distribution f_0(q) plus an associated massless dark-radiation component; the paper's CLASS modifications were not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the delta-function decay-produced distribution in the public CLASS ncdm module (which already accepts tabulated f_0(q)) together with the correlated dark-radiation species, parameterized by (m_L/m_H, a_d) or equivalently gamma and f_dr, and validate against the paper's CDM-limit and thermal-WDM comparison tests.

members.model_name: Coupled scalar-field dark matter and early-dark-energy model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation exists of this model's specific coupling, an SFDM mass depending exponentially on the EDE field (m_phi = m_0 exp(beta phi_EDE/M_pl)) with consistent background and linear-perturbation energy exchange; the paper's CLASS modification is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-scalar coupled sector in a public CLASS fork (extending an existing EDE branch such as CLASS_EDE/AxiCLASS with the field-dependent SFDM mass and its perturbed source terms), validate against the paper's H0=71.13 and S8=0.8256 best fits, and release the patch.

members.model_name: Dark group warm dark baryon model
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists that jointly evolves the warm dark baryon (ncdm species with T_D/T_gamma < 1) and the dark-meson inverse-power-law quintessence sector, which the model couples through the same gauge-sector parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure/extend CLASS with an ncdm species using the derived dark-baryon distribution and temperature ratio plus a scalar-field quintessence module with the IPL potential index n, wired to the shared inputs (N_c, N_f, Lambda_c, T_D/T_gamma).

members.model_name: Inhomogeneous dilaton oscillaton dark matter
members.description: No background/linear-cosmology implementation of the two-phase dilaton exists: the split into cooled (dark-matter-like) and uncooled (dark-energy-like) regions is only an averaging argument, so the expansion history, BBN consistency, and CMB/BAO/SNe predictions cannot be computed or fit, and possible backreaction from inhomogeneous averaging is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the averaged two-component dilaton (oscillating dust-like fraction plus rolling quintessence fraction, with the cooled volume fraction as a parameter) as a scalar-field/fluid species in CLASS or CAMB, then fit alpha, M, xi, and the cooling fraction to CMB, BAO, and supernova data with a standard sampler.

members.model_name: Complex scalar dark fluid
members.description: No cosmological Boltzmann implementation exists for this complex scalar dark fluid: existing CLASS/CAMB quintessence modules handle real fields with standard potentials, not a complex field with internal rotation interpolating between matter-like and cosmological-constant behavior, so w_D(z), CMB, and matter-power predictions cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the field in CLASS either directly (two real components with the U(1) charge conserved) or as an effective generalized-dark-matter fluid using the derived w(z) and c_s^2 from gap_1, validate matter-like behavior at last scattering and w_D near -1 today, then run SN/CMB/LSS/BBN likelihoods.

members.model_name: Z3 scalar dark matter with exponential-growth production
members.description: The momentum-level linearized Boltzmann solver for exponential-growth (semi-production) dark matter — evolving f_chi(q,x) from a freeze-in or heavy-decay seed through the lambda_tr-driven growth phase — exists only as the paper's private calculation; no public code produces the relic abundance and final phase-space distribution for this Z3 scalar model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the linearized momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for the chi + phi -> 2 anti-chi semi-production process as a public solver (standalone, or as an extension of micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery to full f(q) evolution), parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, lambda_tr, lambda_fi or decay-seed parameters), validated against the paper's 1 GeV / 2 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Cold natural hidden-sector confinement dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the relic abundance of a cold hidden confining sector populated at temperature ratio xi_i ~ 0.006: the dark-baryon case needs hidden-sector freeze-out with composite cross sections sigma ~ 1/Lambda_i^2 at T_i << T, and the pure Yang-Mills glueball case needs a 3->2 cannibalizing Boltzmann network, neither covered by standard relic tools that assume SM thermal contact.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the hidden-sector temperature-ratio machinery in micrOMEGAs (or a dedicated Boltzmann code) to solve the decoupled-sector network for (xi_i, Lambda_i), including glueball 3->2 cannibalism with lattice-calibrated Yang-Mills equation of state, and validate against the paper's Lambda ~ 50 MeV glueball and 10-100 TeV/xi_i dark-baryon estimates.

members.model_name: Boson-decay sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No public N-body initial-conditions generator implements the WDM peculiar-velocity enhancement V(k,z) and coarse-grained phase-space corrections Q_cg derived in the paper for the boson-decay distribution; these corrections exist only as the paper's Born/Fredholm perturbative formalism.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the kurtosis-dependent velocity and phase-space corrections as an initial-conditions module (e.g. an extension of MUSIC/monofonIC) taking f(y), m, and g_d as inputs, validated against the paper's z=30-50, k~1-2 k_fs results and against a CLASS run with the tabulated f_BD(y) as a custom ncdm distribution.

members.model_name: Z2-odd singlet fermion N dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements this model's low-scale leptogenesis: the new S/N loop contributions to the CP asymmetry and the associated washout channels are not included in any public leptogenesis network, so Y_B cannot be computed jointly with the N relic abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public leptogenesis Boltzmann code such as ULYSSES with the model-specific epsilon_i (including the new Z2-odd singlet loop) and the S N_i N washout terms, then couple its output to the relic solver from gap_1 for a joint (Y_B, Omega_N h^2) scan.

members.model_name: Hidden photon misalignment cold dark matter
members.description: No numerical code covers resonant hidden-photon-to-photon conversion through the recombination era for sub-neV masses, where the card notes the analytic small-mixing Landau-Zener treatment breaks down and a detailed numerical treatment of the plasma-mass evolution is required.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CMB thermalization/spectral-distortion code (CosmoTherm-class) with the photon-hidden-photon mixing term and the inhomogeneous ionization-history plasma mass, and solve the level-crossing conversion numerically for m_gamma_prime below a neV to replace the analytic resonance approximation.

members.model_name: Confined colored relic dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the two-stage abundance calculation (perturbative freeze-out followed by post-confinement H_X anti-H_X rearrangement and quarkonium de-excitation with tracked stable hadron fractions); the route lists a Boltzmann solver and bound-state cross-section model as required but has null tool_or_code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or a standalone relic-density solver with a second annihilation epoch module taking Lambda_D, sigma_BSF(T), and hadron-species fractions as inputs, validated against the paper's m_X-Lambda_D scaling.

members.model_name: Vector FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements moduli-portal freeze-in of a vector FIMP through non-instantaneous reheating; the coupled inflaton-radiation-FIMP system with (T_R, T_max), UV-sensitive high-temperature production, and axial-modulus pole enhancement exists only as the authors' custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the field-strength (t X X) and dual-field-strength (a X X-dual) rate densities in a public freeze-in solver extended with an inflaton-dominated reheating phase parameterized by (T_R, T_max) — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or release a standalone Boltzmann-fluid code — and validate by recovering the radiation-era-only yield and the published relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Semi-annihilation boosted dark matter interpretation
members.description: No public Earth-transport code handles a directional, mildly relativistic (v ~ 0.1c) boosted dark-matter flux scattering on electrons through a light vector mediator; the card's earth_stopping_constraint rests on an average-density continuous-energy-loss proxy, which also prevents a quantitative daily-modulation prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Monte Carlo underground-propagation code of the DaMaSCUS/DarkProp class to vector-mediated BDM-electron (and nuclear) scattering with a realistic PREM Earth density profile and source directionality, outputting the attenuated, time-dependent flux at 1600 m depth.

members.model_name: Surface-type DBI dark matter
members.description: The card's only route is a placeholder data transform: there is no forward-model implementation that evolves the s-DBI component (equation of state w(a) with transition scale a_d and sound speed c_s^2 = -w) through a Boltzmann code to CMB and matter-power predictions, and no identified associated code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the s-DBI fluid as a generalized-dark-matter component in CLASS or CAMB (which already support a fluid with tabulated w(a) and c_s^2), using the paper's derived w(a), density evolution, and c_s^2 = -w, then constrain a_d and rho_today with standard Planck/BAO/weak-lensing likelihoods.

members.model_name: Subcomponent millicharged Dirac dark matter with neutrino annihilation
members.description: No public three-sector Boltzmann solver computes freeze-out and N_eff for a millicharged Dirac subcomponent whose depletion is dominated by an added neutrino annihilation channel while it retains electromagnetic coupling; existing millicharge-only freeze-out treatments give the wrong thermal history by construction.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public MeV thermal-history code (e.g. NUDEC_BSM) with the millicharged EM annihilation/scattering rates plus a parameterized sigma_v_nu neutrino channel, evolving EM, neutrino, and DM sector temperatures to output (f_chi, N_eff) over (m_chi, epsilon, sigma_v_nu).

members.model_name: gravitino LSP superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No concrete recast of LHC/ILC long-lived charged slepton searches and stopped-particle trapping studies exists for this model's (m_NLSP, tau_NLSP, production cross section) space; the card cites the search class but no implemented analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS heavy-stable-charged-particle analyses for the slepton NLSP in an existing LLP recasting framework (e.g. the HSCP modules of SModelS or CheckMATE) and add a trap-geometry acceptance simulation for the stopped-slepton decay-distribution measurement.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-produced dark SU(N) glueball dark matter
members.description: No numerical pipeline computes the glueball relic abundance and dark temperature through the full history — scalaron decay to dark gluons in Starobinsky reheating, SU(N) confinement, 3-to-2 cannibal freeze-out, and optional entropy dilution from a second Yang-Mills sector — beyond the paper's analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a coupled Boltzmann solver for the scalaron energy density, visible bath, and dark-gluon/glueball sector (cannibal 3-to-2 network with lattice-informed glueball spectrum), parameterized by (Lambda, N, xi_h, Delta), reusing existing cannibal-dark-matter freeze-out codes as the core.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation maps this model's chi-neutrino scattering and annihilation (via the charge-two scalar with masses m_chi, m_phi and couplings mu, c_phi) onto CMB and matter-power spectra; existing nu-DM modified CLASS codes use a generic constant or T^2 cross section, not this mediator's structure, and the CMB constraint is flagged recast_required with no likelihood run.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermally averaged chi-nu momentum-transfer cross section for the charge-two mediator and add it to an existing DM-neutrino-interacting CLASS branch (ETHOS-like parameterization), then run Planck plus matter-power likelihoods in Cobaya/MontePython over (m_chi, m_phi, mu, c_phi).

members.model_name: Two-hidden-sector long-lived dark photon dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes dark-photon production and relic density in a two-hidden-sector U(1)_X1 x U(1)_X2 setup with independently evolving temperatures T1 and T2 coupled through epsilon_1, epsilon_2, and Stueckelberg mixing; the calculation exists only in the source paper's formalism.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled multi-sector temperature-evolution Boltzmann code (or extend micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector freeze-in machinery) that takes (m_gamma_prime, epsilon_1, epsilon_2, M3/M4, T1/T, T2/T) and returns Omega_gamma_prime h^2, T_i(z), and the lifetime check, validated against the paper's benchmarks.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal FIMP freeze-in during reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements spin-2-portal UV freeze-in during non-instantaneous reheating; the required coupled inflaton-radiation-FIMP system with (T_R, T_max), including resonant on-shell massive spin-2 production and decay near the pole, exists only as the authors' custom code, and standard freeze-in tools assume radiation domination.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the graviton and massive spin-2 stress-energy-coupling rate densities (light, resonant, and heavy regimes) in a public freeze-in solver extended with an inflaton-dominated reheating phase parameterized by (T_R, T_max) — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or release a standalone Boltzmann-fluid code — validating against the published relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal supersymmetric hylogenesis variant
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the low-temperature-reheating hylogenesis system (modulus/X decays, CP-asymmetric baryon-number generation, and Higgs-portal symmetric depletion into light pseudoscalars) needed to compute the asymmetric relic yield for this variant.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the main-text hylogenesis Boltzmann equations (reheating, X decay asymmetry, hidden-sector annihilation) as a standalone numerical solver, e.g. a Python/ODE code or an extension of micrOMEGAs' asymmetric freeze-out machinery, with the appendix aa annihilation channel swapped in for the U(1)' depletion term.

members.model_name: Mirrored neutron dark matter in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: No relic-density calculator handles freeze-out of composite mirror baryons at the 100 TeV scale, where annihilation proceeds through nonperturbative mirror-QCD channels near the unitarity limit in a mirror thermal bath; the card relies on an order-of-magnitude unitarity estimate (computational_representation is null).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a hidden-sector Boltzmann solver (e.g. micrOMEGAs hidden-sector mode) with a parameterized mirror-hadronic annihilation cross section (geometric/unitarity form rescaled by the mirror confinement scale) and a mirror-sector temperature ratio, validating against the paper's m_N' ~ 100 TeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Secluded composite hidden-baryon dark matter
members.description: No public thermal relic solver handles composite hidden-baryon freeze-out with annihilation into lighter hidden mesons, hidden-sector degrees of freedom, and a hidden-to-visible temperature ratio; micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY-class codes do not cover this secluded confining-sector topology.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Boltzmann relic code (e.g. micrOMEGAs with user-defined cross sections) with hidden-sector entropy/temperature evolution and B prime annihilation to M prime pairs parameterized by (m_Bprime, Lambda_prime), validated against the paper's greater-than-10-TeV abundance floor.

members.model_name: Affine-EOS purely kinetic k-essence unified dark fluid
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the affine pure kinetic k-essence unified dark fluid: its perturbations with c_s^2 tied to the small affine parameter alpha have not been evolved to compute matter power suppression or the ISW response, so the alpha/c_s^2 <~ 1e-6 viability bound remains an order-of-magnitude estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pure kinetic k-essence field in CLASS or CAMB as a unified dark fluid (generalized-dark-matter module with c_s^2 from the k-essence L(X), or a dedicated k-essence perturbation module), verify recovery of the CDM transfer function in the alpha -> 0 limit, and compute P(k) and CMB spectra across the small-alpha regime.

members.model_name: Spin-0 relativistic-decay dark matter EFT
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the model's injection history: a heavy companion decaying via the dimension-five operator to a massive spin-0 daughter that is relativistic at injection (redshifting from radiation-like to matter-like) together with the accompanying photon energy injection, so Delta N_eff, the H0 shift, and the free-streaming transfer function cannot be computed precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS's dcdm/dr module to a two-body decay with a massive daughter evolved as an NCDM species with the delta-function decay phase-space distribution (following existing DM-to-DM+DR modified-CLASS implementations), and couple the photon branch to ExoCLASS/DarkAges-style energy-injection treatment for BBN and CMB consistency.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal freeze-in scalar with universal lepton couplings
members.description: The Hubble-tension target region for the universal coupling is imported from the paper rather than computed: no public CLASS/CAMB late-radiative-decay extension with an attached Planck/BAO/Pantheon likelihood exists to independently delineate the cosmology-favored (m_phi, f_phi, tau_phi) region being excluded.
members.proposed_resolution: Reuse the same public decaying-dark-matter CLASS branch and MCMC pipeline proposed for the hierarchical variant (phi -> gamma gamma source terms plus Planck 2018+BAO+Pantheon likelihoods) to regenerate the target region before applying the stellar-cooling cut.

members.model_name: Baryon-triality DFSZ axion and light-axino dark matter model
members.description: No public likelihood exists for X-ray/gamma-ray line limits on a decaying keV axino that is only a fraction of the dark matter; the card notes limits must be rescaled by the axino fraction and records likelihood_available: no for con_axino_xray_gamma.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published X-ray line (e.g. NuSTAR/XMM blank-sky) and soft gamma-ray decaying-DM lifetime curves, wrap them as a lifetime-versus-mass likelihood with an explicit Omega_axino/Omega_DM rescaling parameter, and connect it to the analytic (m_axino, lambda, lambda_prime, f_a) to lifetime map.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino hot dark matter subcomponent in an SU(2)_V W-prime model
members.description: No numerical flavor/EWP/collider recast exists for the W-prime SU(2)_V sector that fixes the right-handed-neutrino parameters; the R_D(*), FCNC, EWP, and direct-search constraints are only described qualitatively (likelihood_available 'no', recasting_needed 'yes').
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the C_RR^V operator and right-handed mixing structure in a global flavor-fit package (e.g. extend flavio/smelli with the light-nu_R final state) and recast LHC W-prime and vector-like fermion searches for the model's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Thermal dark matter freeze-out during kination

members.model_name: Scalar singlet FIMP dark matter with vectorlike fermion parent during reheating

members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vectorlike lepton parent in an existing LLP recast framework (e.g. the LLP Recasting Repository or SModelS displaced/HSCP results) for the muonphilic benchmark, producing exclusion contours in the (m_P, c tau_P) plane that can be overlaid on the relic-density-required decay lengths per reheating history.

members.model_name: Modulus-decay axion hot-and-cold dark matter
members.description: No X-ray/gamma-ray flux likelihood exists for the decaying MeV-scale axion: the card gives only qualitative guidance for the photon probe, with no mapping from (g_aSM, tau_a, m_a) to instrument-level line or continuum limits (likelihood_available: unknown, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published X-ray and MeV gamma-ray line and diffuse-background searches (e.g. XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, INTEGRAL/SPI, COMPTEL) into decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits tau_a(m_a) and package them as a likelihood over the axion coupling-lifetime plane.

members.model_name: Early matter domination with nearly degenerate daughter WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the Fermi-LAT isotropic gamma-ray background and dwarf-galaxy constraints on the microhalo-boosted annihilation signal of this model, nor for the BBN reheating/branching consistency requirement; existing EMD gamma-ray bounds assume different free-streaming and final-state choices and must be recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Fermi-LAT IGRB and Draco analyses of arXiv:1910.08553 into a reusable likelihood parameterized by (<sigma v>, annihilation final state, microhalo boost factor), and add an analytic BBN consistency check on T_RH > T_BBN with the f_b relation as a prior.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal secluded dark matter
members.description: Only an approximate IceCube constraint exists on the card; there is no spectral/anisotropy likelihood for recasting the predicted absorption features against IceCube diffuse-flux data with source-distribution uncertainties marginalized.

members.model_name: Z4-odd inert-doublet WIMP in an A4 three-Higgs-doublet model

members.proposed_resolution: Compose an explicit likelihood pipeline from existing public components: Planck relic-density gaussian, HiggsTools/Lilith for invisible-width and Higgs signal strengths, DDCalc for XENON1T SI scattering, and Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihoods (gamLike) for the annihilation cross section, wired to the micrOMEGAs outputs of gap_1.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw freeze-in long-lived singlet N dark matter
members.description: No encoded likelihood exists for cosmological and astrophysical bounds on the late decay N -> e+ e- at m_N around 0.1 GeV and tau_N around 5e28 s; the card's lifetime constraint (long_lifetime_cosmology_condition) has likelihood_available unknown, so viability is asserted rather than quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits for the e+ e- channel at sub-GeV masses (Voyager 1 positron flux, CMB energy-injection limits computed with ExoCLASS/DarkHistory) into a tau_N(m_N) exclusion curve that the route can evaluate directly.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant inverse-seesaw Majoron freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The Majoron decay lifetime is only enforced as a hard tau_J > 1e25 s cut; no decay-spectrum recast maps the J -> nu nu and loop-induced charged-fermion channels onto current indirect-detection limits (neutrino telescope and gamma-ray/X-ray decay searches) in the 10 MeV to 1 GeV mass window.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the decay spectra (monochromatic neutrino line plus loop-induced e+e-/gamma final states, e.g. with HDMSpectra-style or low-mass spectrum tools) and recast published decaying-dark-matter limits from neutrino and gamma-ray experiments into a reusable tau_J(m_J) likelihood replacing the flat lifetime cut.

members.model_name: Z3 sterile-neutrino portal scalar WIMP dark matter

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter in early matter domination

members.model_name: Fourth-family Dirac-neutrino Z' WIMP

members.model_name: Non-Self-Conjugate ultra-light scalar dark matter with neutrino mediator
members.description: No likelihood exists for the UHE flux comparison: IceCube/Auger non-detections are published as source-flux limits, and there is no recast that folds detector effective areas with attenuated spectra so that propagation suppression can be distinguished from low source normalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood from public IceCube EHE effective areas and Auger exposures, computing expected event counts for MPR/Waxman-Bahcall benchmark fluxes attenuated by the model, for both the all-DM and ten-percent-DM scalar fractions.

members.model_name: Self-Conjugate ultra-light scalar dark matter with neutrino mediator
members.description: No propagation-aware UHE neutrino likelihood exists for this model: there is no framework that folds the model's DM-attenuated flux (with redshift-evolving DM density and source populations) through IceCube-EHE/Auger exposures while separating source-normalization uncertainty from the propagation suppression the paper warns can be confused with it.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that convolves MPR and Waxman-Bahcall benchmark source spectra with the model's optical depth tau(E_nu, z; m_phi, g_phi, M_I, f_phi) integrated over redshift, applies published IceCube-EHE and Auger effective areas/exposures, and marginalizes over source normalization to produce limits on (g_phi, M_I, m_phi).

members.model_name: Two-component hidden U(1)_D scalar dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Build a detector-response module for large water-Cherenkov detectors (effective volume, ring-finding efficiency vs opening angle, decay-length acceptance, atmospheric background rates) calibrated on the published Super-K boosted-DM search, and expose it as an event-count likelihood for Hyper-K forecasts.

members.model_name: Two-component Majorana FIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No unified machine-readable gamma-ray line-search likelihood spans INTEGRAL, COMPTEL, EGRET, and Fermi-LAT for a decaying dark-matter subcomponent; the card records only partial likelihood availability with recasting needed, and the flux must be scaled by the chi_2 abundance fraction, which existing single-component line limits do not support natively.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published line-search flux limits into a common lifetime-versus-mass likelihood grid (extending frameworks like MADHAT or the Fermi line-search data products) with an explicit decaying-fraction rescaling parameter, and validate against the primary paper's inverse-width exclusion contours.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with B-L vector portal
members.description: No public end-to-end likelihood exists for the joint Galactic Center gamma-ray excess plus AMS-02 antiproton fit that this model targets; the card lists likelihood_available as approximate with no likelihood_reference, and cosmic-ray propagation uncertainties are unquantified in the route.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative-seesaw fermion dark matter

members.model_name: Vector-portal hidden-sector dark matter with an early matter-dominated era
members.description: Only a partial Fermi-LAT constraint exists: no packaged IGRB likelihood is available that accepts the decaying-DM-like morphology of microhalo-boosted hidden-sector annihilation, so the exclusion curves cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable Fermi-LAT high-latitude/IGRB likelihood module (e.g. within a framework like swordfish or a MadDM/DarkFlux-style indirect-detection interface) that takes m_X, <sigma v>, boost factor B_0, and annihilation spectrum and returns the exclusion, validated against the primary paper's curves.

members.model_name: WIMP freeze-out in dEGB cosmology
