members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline that combines published Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods and the Planck CMB annihilation bound per channel with digitized dEGB compact-object exclusion contours from the GW literature, plus a simple BBN consistency criterion on H(T_BBN), so allowed/excluded regions become reproducible likelihood evaluations.

members.model_name: Extended double-seesaw WIMP-FIMP dark matter model
members.description: No likelihood exists for the fraction-rescaled W_D constraints: the XENON1T/DarkSide-50 direct-detection, Fermi-LAT+MAGIC dwarf, Higgs-invisible, and Higgs signal-strength bounds are applied only as digitized exclusion curves rescaled by Omega_WD/Omega_Tot.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published limit curves and assemble a joint recast likelihood (e.g. within a GAMBIT-style or standalone framework) that applies relic-fraction rescaling consistently across the direct, indirect, and Higgs channels.

members.model_name: Fermionic scalar-portal absorption dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood exists for keV fermionic-absorption electron-ionization signals in xenon TPCs; evaluating the XENONnT/LZ/PandaX-4T reach and the XLZD projection for the model's spectral line at E about m_chi requires atomic bound-electron response and detector efficiency curves not packaged with the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable absorption likelihood by combining atomic ionization form factors for xenon (DarkARC/QEdark-style bound-state wavefunction calculations) with published XENONnT/PandaX-4T efficiency and background models, exposing sigma_e versus m_chi limits and XLZD projections.

members.model_name: QCD-like dark-pion forbidden dark matter model
members.description: No detection likelihood has been run for this model: LZ/XENONnT spin-independent limits and HESS/MAGIC multi-TeV gamma-ray limits are invoked only through the wino analogy, with no recast onto the composite dark-pion annihilation spectra and sigma_SI ~ 2e-47 cm^2 prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the dark-pion annihilation spectra (electroweak gauge-boson final states with Sommerfeld enhancement from gap_1), recast the published HESS/MAGIC Galactic-center likelihoods over 1-100 TeV, and compare the loop-level sigma_SI against public LZ/XENONnT limit curves with neutrino-floor bracketing.

members.model_name: Compressed-stau No-Scale F-SU(5) bino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No target-specific Fermi-LAT likelihood for the internal-bremsstrahlung endpoint feature and the gamma-gamma/gamma-Z lines near 133/145 GeV has been applied to this benchmark; the card records both indirect-detection constraints as likelihood_available partial with recasting required and no updated Fermi-LAT likelihood used.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark IB and line spectra through the public Fermi-LAT bin-by-bin dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods (e.g. via MadDM or the released Fermi likelihood files) and the public Galactic-center line-search likelihood, with explicit J-factor systematics for the assumed density profiles.

members.model_name: Bino-wino co-annihilation dark matter in high-scale SUSY
members.description: No ATLAS jets+MET analysis likelihood or cutflow is implemented for recasting the gluino cascade bound onto the bino-wino coannihilation spectrum; the card records likelihood_available = no and recasting_needed = yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast a current ATLAS jets+MET search using a public framework (CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 with the published HistFactory likelihood) for gluino pair production with a bino LSP endpoint, reproducing the quoted 1.2 TeV bound as validation.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with baryon-number vector portal
members.description: No public end-to-end likelihood exists for the joint Galactic Center gamma-ray excess plus AMS-02 antiproton fit that this model targets; the card lists likelihood_available as approximate with no likelihood_reference, and cosmic-ray propagation uncertainties are unquantified in the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint likelihood by combining a published GCE spectrum-with-covariance likelihood with an antiproton likelihood marginalized over GALPROP/DRAGON propagation parameters, and validate against the m_chi 50-100 GeV, m_Zprime 10-100 GeV allowed regions quoted in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with hypercharge-vector portal
members.description: No public end-to-end likelihood exists for the joint Galactic Center gamma-ray excess plus AMS-02 antiproton fit that this model targets; the card lists likelihood_available as approximate with no likelihood_reference, and cosmic-ray propagation uncertainties are unquantified in the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint likelihood by combining a published GCE spectrum-with-covariance likelihood with an antiproton likelihood marginalized over GALPROP/DRAGON propagation parameters, and validate against the hypercharge-portal allowed regions quoted in the primary paper.

members.model_name: T1-2A scotogenic WIMP dark matter model
members.description: The composite MCMC likelihood combining the Planck relic density, the XENON1T spin-independent limit, neutrino-oscillation inputs via Casas-Ibarra, and the charged-lepton-flavour-violation suite (mu -> e gamma, mu-e conversion, Z LFV) is not public, and the flavour-observable covariance was not reconstructed.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the joint likelihood in a public scanning framework (e.g. GAMBIT with DDCalc for XENON1T and FlavBit-style LFV likelihoods, fed by the SPheno low-energy observables), and verify it recovers the published 1.0-1.2 TeV doublet-fermion preferred region and 0.1-10 GeV compressed gaps.

members.model_name: T1-2A scotogenic WIMP dark matter model
members.description: No point-by-point indirect-detection evaluation exists for the accepted scan points: annihilation spectra were not extracted, so the dwarf-spheroidal gamma-ray constraint can only be applied via generic WIMP-annihilation templates with assumed branching fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute per-point annihilation branching fractions and photon spectra with micrOMEGAs or MadDM from the regenerated model files, and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood (gamLike or the Fermi-LAT released likelihood profiles).

members.model_name: Multipole vector dark matter below the GeV scale
members.description: No experiment-level likelihoods are available for the final overlay step: sub-GeV direct-detection, indirect-detection, and cosmic-ray limits on the strongly momentum-dependent multipole scattering and annihilation are taken from published exclusion plots rather than recast statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the relevant sub-GeV direct-detection results with the model's q-dependent form-factor cross sections in a public likelihood framework, and combine with digitized CMB energy-injection and cosmic-ray annihilation limits per operator, reproducing the paper's conclusion that freeze-out survives only for toroidal/anapole operators.

members.model_name: Minimal U(1)' strictly anomaly-mediated wino LSP dark matter
members.description: The cosmic-string constraints are frozen at WMAP7-era quoted bounds: there is no modern recast of the model's flat-direction-reduced Gmu, loop-size assumptions, and particle-decay fraction against current CMB, pulsar-timing-array stochastic gravitational-wave, and diffuse gamma-ray data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the string network with a public string CMB code (e.g. CMBACT-class spectra against Planck) and PTA stochastic-background likelihoods (NANOGrav/EPTA free-spectrum posteriors) over (Gmu, loop size, f_particles), adding the diffuse gamma-ray bound on the particle-emission fraction.

members.model_name: MDM U(1)_X cold dark matter with sterile-neutrino hot component
members.description: No flux model or likelihood exists for the high-energy neutrino signal from chi annihilation to dark photons decaying to sterile neutrinos that oscillate to active neutrinos; the card cites only a qualitative IceCube cross-section comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the active-neutrino spectrum from chi chi -> X X with X -> nu_s nu_s and sterile-active oscillation probabilities, then recast published IceCube dark-matter annihilation neutrino-channel limits onto (m_chi, g_X, mixing angle).

members.model_name: Non-thermal higgsino dark matter from late decays
members.description: No implemented gamma-ray likelihood pipeline exists for the nonthermal all-DM higgsino: the Fermi-LAT dwarf bound is only quoted from the source, not rerun against the model's electroweak annihilation spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods to higgsino WW/ZZ annihilation spectra from micrOMEGAs or PPPC4DMID, with the relic fraction from the nonthermal yield formula rescaling the flux.

members.model_name: SU(3)_D triple-Higgs dark matter with vector bound states
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood exists for the model's annihilation and bound-state-decay signal, which proceeds through dark-sector cascades (V8 V8 and B decays) whose photon spectra and dwarf/halo constraints have never been evaluated for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the photon/positron spectra from V8 cascade decays to SM final states via the kinetic mixing (PPPC-style spectra with an extra boost from the cascade kinematics) and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood with the model's velocity-dependent cross section.

members.model_name: Curvaton sound-speed-resonance primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No assembled likelihood pipeline confronts the model's narrow but finite-width PBH mass function with the full constraint envelope (microlensing, CMB, extragalactic gamma-ray, ultra-faint dwarf, and LVK merger-rate bounds); the card records only partial likelihood availability and figure-level comparisons.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the public PBHbounds monochromatic constraint tables with the standard extended-mass-function recasting method, add the LVK O3 merger-rate abundance likelihood and a PTA/LISA SIGW likelihood, and expose f_PBH(k_star, xi) exclusion as a single registry-callable likelihood module.

members.model_name: Two-component scalar FIMP Higgs-portal model
members.description: No machine-readable gamma-ray likelihood spans the INTEGRAL/COMPTEL/EGRET/Fermi-LAT bands for the off-shell-Higgs decay spectra of a decaying scalar subcomponent with hierarchical or degenerate splittings; the card records only partial likelihood availability with recasting needed for masses down to about 1 MeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published keV-GeV diffuse and line-search gamma-ray limits into a common likelihood grid over lifetime, decaying-component mass, and mass splitting, with an explicit abundance-fraction parameter, validated against the primary paper's exclusion statements.

members.model_name: Resonance-enhanced light singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public MeV gamma-ray forecast likelihood (instrument response, exposure, and astrophysical background model) exists for COSI or GECCO, so the paper's claim that the surviving 0.3-2 GeV window is efficiently testable cannot be turned into quantitative projected exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a forecast pipeline coupling Hazma-computed annihilation spectra to the released COSI response matrices and published GECCO effective-area curves with a galactic-center MeV background model, producing projected sigma_v_today limits over the 0.3-2 GeV window.

members.model_name: Multi-component non-thermal flavon portal dark sector
members.description: No interfaced likelihoods exist for the late-decay probes: BBN light-element injection from long-lived flavons, CMB energy injection from intermediate-lifetime chi_i decays, and gamma-ray/neutrino limits on semi-visible decays are all applied only as literature exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the decay-chain lifetimes and visible branching fractions to existing injection frameworks: an ACROPOLIS-class BBN code for tau_phi and visible flavon decays, ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for CMB energy injection from chi_i -> chi_j q q, and published decaying-DM gamma-ray/neutrino likelihoods for the semi-visible channel.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino dark matter with forbidden annihilation
members.description: No Fermi-LAT Galactic Center / Sgr A* likelihood is packaged for this forbidden-annihilation signal (likelihood_available is no, recasting_needed is yes), so the primary constraint cannot be re-evaluated at new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Fermi-LAT Sgr A* point-source spectral data used in 2003.10416 into a tabulated flux likelihood keyed to the predicted phi-decay photon spectrum, marginalizing over spike-slope nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Scalar-driven sterile-neutrino dark matter with an ultralight scalar
members.description: X-ray/gamma-ray line searches have no spatial templates or likelihood for a decay flux scaling as the line-of-sight integral of rho_DM^3 (density-dependent mixing from the local scalar field); published blank-sky, dwarf, and cluster line limits assume rho_DM scaling and cannot be reinterpreted directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct rho_DM^3 line-of-sight flux templates for standard targets (Milky Way halo, dwarfs, M31, clusters) from published density profiles, quantify the profile-uncertainty systematics amplified by the cubed scaling, and recast existing XMM/NuSTAR/Chandra line-search likelihoods with these templates.

members.model_name: Composite neutrino-portal dark matter from a light hidden sector
members.description: No combined indirect-detection likelihood exists for the model's mixed annihilation final states: monochromatic-neutrino limits (Super-K/IceCube/ANTARES/KamLAND) and gamma-ray/positron/CMB energy-injection limits are only available as separate published exclusion curves, each assuming pure channels rather than the model's branching-dependent chi chi -> N N / nu nu spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast layer that computes the branching-weighted neutrino and secondary photon/positron spectra from N decays (using PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra-style spectral tables), rescales the published neutrino-line and Fermi/AMS/Planck CMB-injection limits accordingly, and combines them into an approximate joint likelihood over (m_chi, m_N, U_N).

members.model_name: Ultralight scalar dark matter with refractive neutrino masses
members.description: The astrophysical attenuation constraint is only a tau < 2.3 optical-depth criterion; no propagation calculation with line-of-sight halo profiles, source-spectrum models, flavor evolution, and their uncertainties exists for SN1987A and IceCube baselines.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend nuSQuIDS with the nu-phi scattering cross sections sigma_+/sigma_- on the scalar background, propagate SN1987A and TXS 0506+056 fluxes through Galactic and extragalactic density profiles, and wrap the result in a likelihood with profile and source nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: SO(10) mixed singlet-inert-doublet scalar dark matter
members.description: The Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood products (bin-by-bin likelihoods with J-factor priors) are not integrated into the indirect-detection route, leaving only a rough comparison to published limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Ingest the public Fermi-LAT dwarf bin-by-bin likelihood files and combine with the model's channel-weighted dN/dE spectra to produce a <sigma v> likelihood as a function of M_DM.

members.model_name: Majorana dark matter from gauged lepton-number anomaly cancellation
members.description: No implemented constraint evaluation exists for the Majoron sector: the BBN viability and photon-coupling bounds on (m_J, g_Jnunu, g_Jgammagamma) are stated qualitatively, with no recast of the long-lived Majoron's energy injection into BBN codes or of astrophysical/gamma-ray photon-coupling limits (con_majoron_lifetime_bbn likelihood_available 'no', recasting_needed 'yes').
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the Majoron abundance, lifetime, and neutrino/photon branching ratios into a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN) to map the excluded (m_J, tau_J) region, and overlay published ALP-like photon-coupling limits (cosmological, stellar, gamma-ray) translated to g_Jgammagamma.

members.model_name: Light collisional cold dark matter
members.description: The gamma-ray/radio bound on late S-wave annihilation of MeV-GeV light DM is stated as a requirement (S-wave suppression) without any extracted likelihood or recast pipeline connecting (m_dm, annihilation channel, velocity dependence) to indirect-detection data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the annihilation constraint with existing indirect-detection tooling: compute photon spectra for the light-DM channels (e.g. with Hazma/PPPC-style spectra for MeV-GeV masses) and evaluate against published diffuse gamma-ray (INTEGRAL/COMPTEL/Fermi) and radio likelihoods, packaged as a function of m_dm and the S-wave coefficient.

members.model_name: Down-scattering excited Dark Matter
members.description: No coded likelihood exists for the model's central target, the joint INTEGRAL 511 keV flux plus Fermi-LAT 130/135 GeV line with the required O(10^6-10^7) cross-section hierarchy; the card records only an approximate paper-era flux fit with low robustness.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint likelihood combining the INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV bulge-morphology flux measurement and the Fermi-LAT gamma-ray line-search results, parameterized in (m_chi, sigma_v_511, sigma_v_135) with an explicit halo-profile J-factor nuisance, so the down-scattering rate and loop-level line rate can be fit simultaneously.

members.model_name: Goldstini decaying dark matter
members.description: No modern indirect-detection likelihood exists for this decaying leptophilic scenario: the tau ~ 1e26-1e27 s target was fit to historical PAMELA/Fermi excesses, and no AMS-02 positron, current Fermi-LAT gamma, or antiproton likelihood pipeline is assembled for the three-body spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Propagate the tabulated injection spectra with DRAGON or GALPROP and confront them with AMS-02 positron/antiproton data and Fermi-LAT diffuse and dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods, delivering lifetime limits versus m_Gprime and leptonic branching fractions.

members.model_name: Moduli-produced wino or higgsino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection recast exists for the enhanced annihilation cross sections (up to ~1e-23 cm^3/s at T_rh ~ 5 MeV) required in the annihilation scenario; the constraint is recorded as recast_required with no exclusion curve for wino/higgsino final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the required <sigma v>(T_rh) relation against public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and Galactic-center likelihoods (and H.E.S.S./CTA for heavy winos) using standard annihilation spectra for WW/ZZ final states, mapping the excluded (T_rh, m_chi) region.

members.model_name: Long-lived mixed scalar-pseudoscalar mediator model with Dirac dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or sensitivity implementation exists to compare the predicted solar gamma-ray flux from long-lived mediator decays against HERD/LHAASO/Fermi solar observations; the route lists these as not ingested and the compare_searches step has no tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the HERD and LHAASO sensitivity curves and Fermi-LAT solar gamma-ray flux limits, and build a flux-comparison likelihood module that convolves the boosted Y -> gamma gamma box spectrum with each instrument's effective area and solar angular acceptance.

members.model_name: Higgs portal scalar hybrid dark matter
members.description: No public H.E.S.S. Galactic-center likelihood exists for the heavy-mass gamma-ray constraint on the surviving Higgs-portal coupling; only the Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood side of the indirect-detection comparison can be evaluated exactly, so the high-mass end of the coupling ceiling relies on digitized published limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an approximate H.E.S.S. Galactic-center likelihood by digitizing the published <sigma v> limit curves for the relevant final states (WW, hh, bb) and folding in the model's branching fractions and relic-fraction-squared rescaling, following existing GAMBIT-style H.E.S.S. recast practice.

members.model_name: Very supersymmetric co-decaying dark sector
members.description: No final-state-specific decay-spectrum and likelihood pipeline exists for the metastable hidden fermion's gravitino-mediated decays: the Fermi-LAT IGRB and CMB energy-injection constraints are applied through an approximate mapping onto generic dark-matter decay spectra rather than spectra computed for the actual phi*-mediated multi-body final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the photon and e+e- spectra of psi -> gravitino + (on/off-shell phi -> SM) decays with PYTHIA showering (or HDMSpectra for heavy masses), then recast the Fermi-LAT IGRB decay limits and CMB injection bounds (e.g. via ExoCLASS/DarkAges) into a lifetime likelihood as a function of m, Delta m, and m_3/2.

members.model_name: Millicharged excited-state scalar field dark matter halo
members.description: No public likelihood (spectrum with covariance, or spectro-morphological template fit) exists for testing the millicharged-SFDM inverse-Compton prediction against the Fermi Bubbles; the current comparison is a qualitative benchmark against the plotted spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from the published Fermi-LAT Fermi-Bubble spectral data (digitized with quoted systematic bands) and add a morphology term comparing the predicted lobed excited-state emission map to the observed bubble templates, packaged as a simple chi-square/Gaussian likelihood module.

members.model_name: CDF-II-favored inert two-Higgs-doublet scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood pipeline exists for the branch-specific experimental tests: PandaX-4T spin-independent recoil on the Higgs-resonance branch, HL-LHC soft-lepton/compressed searches for the SA-coannihilation branch, and Fermi-LAT gamma-ray plus AMS-02 antiproton constraints on the SS->WW* branch; the source comparisons are limit-curve overlays without statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a composite likelihood around the existing micrOMEGAs/2HDMC pipeline: DDCalc for PandaX-4T (and XENONnT/LZ) SI limits, published Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods and AMS-02 antiproton likelihoods applied to micrOMEGAs WW* annihilation spectra, and CheckMATE/MadAnalysis recasts of compressed-spectrum electroweakino-like searches mapped to the inert scalars for the HL-LHC projection.

members.model_name: Dark cluster microhalo clumps
members.description: The complementary macroscopic direct-detection channel has no usable recast: IceCube/DeepCore macroscopic-DM limits assume inelastic detector-visible deposition, and no mapping or likelihood exists for elastic multi-scatter signatures of dark clusters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the detector response (light yield per elastic multi-scatter transit) for dark clusters in large-volume detectors and recast the existing IceCube/DeepCore macroscopic-DM analysis into an (M, R, sigma_T/m_chi, f_chi) likelihood.

members.model_name: Vector Scotogenic HNL dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray likelihood has been recast for this model's leptonic HNL annihilation final states; the Fermi-LAT low-mass exclusion and CTA reach statements are inherited from the source paper without a rerun, so indirect-detection constraints cannot be independently evaluated or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate annihilation spectra for the N_L N_L to charged-lepton and vector-mediated channels (micrOMEGAs or PPPC4DMID tables) and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal binned likelihoods and CTA Galactic-center sensitivity curves over the (M_N, sigma_v) plane.

members.model_name: QED-like dark sector with heavy scalar messengers
members.description: No likelihood or validated recast exists for translating the laboratory neutron dark-decay operator into neutron-star constraints for this model; the card marks the constraint recast_required with likelihood_available: no and dense-matter blocking effects unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the in-medium neutron-to-dark-fermion conversion rate including Pauli blocking and dark-sector self-interactions, fold it into a neutron-star equation-of-state solver, and publish a mapping from (operator coefficient, dark final-state masses) to allowed/excluded regions against observed two-solar-mass pulsars.

members.model_name: Leptophilic flavor-violating Zprime portal Majorana dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection/CMB likelihood is implemented for the leptonic annihilation products: con_cmb_gamma_annihilation_limits has likelihood_available 'no', and the required 'indirect-detection likelihood mapper' listed in the route resources does not exist, so the noted low-mass CMB tension cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the micrOMEGAs channel-by-channel sigma_v_0 output into existing public likelihoods: compute p_ann for the CMB using ExoCLASS/DarkHistory energy-deposition efficiencies for charged-lepton final states, and apply Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood tables per annihilation channel, weighted by the model branching fractions.

members.model_name: PBH-seeded WIMP ultracompact minihalo boost scenario
members.description: No public likelihood exists for a PBH-seeded UCMH source population against Fermi-LAT point-source and isotropic diffuse gamma-ray data or against charged-lepton spectra; existing constraints assume smooth halos or standard subhalo populations.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a population-synthesis likelihood that draws UCMH positions from the Galactic DM distribution, computes fluxes from the calibrated profile model, and compares to the Fermi-LAT point-source catalog and isotropic diffuse measurement, with GALPROP/DRAGON propagation for the leptonic channel.

members.model_name: Vector-like portal scalar dark matter with finite-fermion-mass radiative corrections
members.description: No ready-to-use likelihood exists for the model's sharp gamma-ray spectral features (VIB plus line) as a function of (M_S, M_eta, y_f, portal flavor); the card records only partial gamma-ray likelihood availability and no machine-readable relic or direct-detection likelihood, so exclusion regions cannot be reproduced quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the public Fermi-LAT line/dwarf-spheroidal and HESS Galactic Center likelihoods onto the model's VIB+line spectra per portal flavor, and wire quark-philic direct-detection points through a DDCalc-style XENON likelihood including the loop-induced Higgs-portal contribution, exposing the result as a reusable per-flavor likelihood grid.

members.model_name: Hidden Higgs portal vector dark matter with two-step cascade annihilation
members.description: The Fermi-LAT Galactic-center and dwarf-spheroidal constraints have not been recast onto the cascade spectrum: the card marks con_1806_gce_dwarfs as recasting_needed with only a partial likelihood, and no combined GCE+dwarf+g-2 fit pipeline exists for this parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline feeding the gap_2 tabulated spectra into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood tables (and a GCE spectrum likelihood with profiled diffuse-background systematics), combined with the type-X 2HDM Delta a_mu and lepton-universality constraints, to produce joint posteriors over (m_X, m_S, m_A, tan_beta).

members.model_name: SU(2)L electroweak ALP-portal Dirac dark matter
members.description: No combined likelihood package maps this benchmark's parameter space (M_chi, M_a, f with C_aW = alpha_W T(R)/f) onto photon-line searches, CMB energy-injection bounds, and the LEP/LHC/fixed-target/flavor ALP searches; each constraint currently requires a manual paper-level recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast module combining digitized gamma-ray line limits (Fermi-LAT, MAGIC, H.E.S.S., COMPTEL, EGRET), CMB ionization bounds, and existing ALP-search compilations (e.g. ALPINIST-style tables) with the SU(2)L-benchmark branching-ratio calculator including W/Z/gamma-Z final states, exposing a per-point joint likelihood over (M_chi, M_a, f).

members.model_name: SU(5) inflection-point inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the PBH abundance constraint (likelihood_available: no): evaporation, microlensing, and gamma-ray bounds in the 10^17-10^18 g window are applied as monochromatic exclusion curves, not recast onto the model's extended mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the compiled public PBH constraint curves (PBHbounds-style compilation) onto the model's extended mass function using the standard extended-mass-function weighting, and expose the result as an f_PBH(M) likelihood over the inflaton parameters.

members.model_name: Dark Sink freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No CMB likelihood implementation exists for the Dark Sink sector: the dark-radiation constraint is applied only as quoted T'/T thresholds, and the CMB+BAO bounds on DM-SM interactions (baryon cooling, DM pressure, power suppression) are overlaid qualitatively rather than recomputed for this model's massless-dark-photon coupling to the electromagnetic current.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the sink sector in a Boltzmann code: add the light sink fermion as free-streaming dark radiation with temperature T' and the Coulomb-like DM-photon/baryon scattering (sigma proportional to v^-4 class of interacting-DM models already in CLASS) to CLASS, then run the Planck+BAO likelihood to replace the quoted thresholds with a proper posterior.

members.model_name: Pseudo-familon dark matter
members.description: The decaying-DM cosmic-ray comparison rests on 2012-era PAMELA/Fermi-LAT/H.E.S.S. excess fits with only an approximate borrowed likelihood; no pipeline propagates the model's e-tau/mu-tau decay spectra and confronts them with modern AMS-02 positron-fraction and CALET/DAMPE e+e- data over (m_phi, tau_phi, branching fractions).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate e+/e- spectra for the e-tau and mu-tau final states with PYTHIA 8 (replacing PYTHIA 6.4), propagate with GALPROP or DRAGON2 with a marginalized diffusion setup, and build a likelihood against AMS-02 positron fraction and DAMPE/CALET total e+e- flux, including a pulsar background component.

members.model_name: Nonthermal two-component singlet-scalar dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood is available for the Fermi-LAT Galactic-center excess fit used to select M_phi2 (likelihood_available: no), so the gamma-ray target can only be compared by eye to the historical spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a published Galactic-center excess spectral likelihood with background-model covariance and evaluate the model's b bbar spectrum for M_phi2 in 50-80 GeV against it, marginalizing over the NFW normalization.

members.model_name: Twin SIMPs
members.description: The gamma-ray requirement that meson mass splittings kinematically close present-day annihilation to SM final states is only an order-of-magnitude velocity comparison; no indirect-detection likelihood evaluates the splitting-dependent residual annihilation rate over the halo velocity distribution against Fermi-LAT-type limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the thermally averaged threshold-suppressed annihilation cross section as a function of mass splitting integrated over realistic halo velocity distributions, and compare with published gamma-ray annihilation limits (galactic center and dwarf spheroidal likelihoods) for the sub-GeV final states.

members.model_name: CP-even sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: The combined likelihood (Planck relic Gaussian, XENON1T upper limit, Fermi-LAT dwarf term, HiggsBounds/HiggsSignal and B-physics terms) exists only inside the authors' private EasyScan HEP setup; no reusable likelihood package or public posterior samples are released.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompose the scan likelihood in a public global-fit framework (e.g. GAMBIT or a released EasyScan HEP configuration) with documented priors and experimental terms, and publish the configuration plus posterior chains so the Bayesian evidence comparison can be reproduced and updated with newer data.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic axion-like dark matter
members.description: No propagation-and-attenuation likelihood exists for supernova and ultrahigh-energy neutrinos traversing the neutrinophilic ALP dark-matter background: the card's astrophysical observable requires flavor- and distance-dependent modeling of scattering/decay on Galactic-to-extragalactic baselines against SN 1987A and IceCube-class data, which has not been assembled.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a transport calculation for neutrino spectra propagating through the ALP background (attenuation and flavor-ratio distortion as functions of g_alpha_beta, m_a, L_nu), and confront it with SN 1987A event counts and IceCube diffuse-flux/flavor-ratio measurements as binned likelihoods.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with survival-based size distribution
members.description: No statistical likelihood exists for any AQN channel: macro flux limits, solar EUV/nanoflare energetics, and galactic diffuse/511 keV emission are all compared to data only at the order-of-magnitude level (likelihood_available: no for both constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Construct Poisson non-observation likelihoods for IceCube/ANITA/mica macro searches and template likelihoods for INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV and solar EUV data with explicit background models, parameterized in (B_min, alpha, B_cut, antinugget fraction).

members.model_name: Scalar s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No neutrino-telescope likelihood is implemented for late-time halo annihilation chi chi -> phi phi followed by phi -> nu nu; the indirect-detection constraint is only qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Super-Kamiokande and IceCube limits on dark-matter annihilation to neutrino final states onto the two-step phi-mediated spectrum (boosted box spectrum from phi -> nu nu), packaged as a likelihood over (m_chi, m_phi, <sigma v>_halo).

members.model_name: Phantom hidden-sector sterile-neutrino dark matter creation
members.description: The diffuse gamma-ray bound Lambda <= 18.8 MeV is a by-eye comparison of the predicted redshifted flux with the COMPTEL-region spectrum; no MeV diffuse-background likelihood is available (likelihood_available: no), so the cutoff bound cannot be assigned a rigorous confidence level or updated with newer data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a chi-square/Poisson likelihood over published COMPTEL and SPI diffuse MeV spectra (with astrophysical background modeling) that consumes the analytic dJ/dE prediction, and rerun the real- and complex-scalar-ghost cutoff limits.

members.model_name: Branon dark matter with thermal and misalignment production
members.description: Direct and indirect search comparisons are anchored to circa-2004 detector sensitivities (DAMA, ZEPLIN 1, EDELWEISS; qualitative gamma/positron/neutrino prospects); no modern direct-detection or indirect-detection likelihood evaluation exists for the branon parameter plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed branon nucleon cross sections and annihilation spectra from the gap_1 implementation into DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT-class likelihoods and into public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and IceCube solar-capture likelihood tools, producing an updated combined f-M constraint.

members.model_name: Hidden sector axion portal dark matter with p-wave freezeout and s-wave three-mediator annihilation
members.description: Only a binwise 95 percent flux-ceiling criterion is available for the Galactic Center point sources; no proper binned likelihood for the Fermi and H.E.S.S. spectra exists for this decay-in-spike signal, limiting statistical combination and parameter inference.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a binned Poisson/Gaussian likelihood from the published Fermi 3FGL and HESS J1745-290 spectral points with systematic nuisance parameters for the astrophysical point-source emission, replacing the binwise ceiling criterion.

members.model_name: Non-thermal wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No modern cosmic-ray likelihood exists for the 180-200 GeV nonthermal wino interpretation: the card's constraints are PAMELA/Fermi-era spectral comparisons with likelihood_available 'no' or 'unknown', and no AMS-02 positron/antiproton or current Fermi dwarf/Galactic-center gamma-ray recast is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the wino W+W- annihilation signal against AMS-02 positron and antiproton data and current Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods (public likelihood releases exist for the latter), scanning m_wino and <sigma v> with the reconstructed propagation setup from gap_1.

members.model_name: Familon-like WISPy pseudo-Goldstone dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or detector model maps the oscillating scalar/pseudoscalar family-current couplings and flavor-changing decay rates onto laboratory data (clock/spin-precession comparisons, rare charged-lepton decay searches); the route explicitly lists 'none supplied in primary paper' and both observables lack a signal-to-data pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: For chosen family-current textures, derive the time-dependent fermion mass/spin coupling signal and recast existing ultralight-scalar laboratory likelihoods (atomic clock ratio, comagnetometer, and torsion-balance datasets) plus mu-to-e-gamma/mu-to-3e style rare-decay limits into bounds on (m_phi, f_X, T_+, T_-), packaged as a reusable likelihood module.

members.model_name: Type-III-seesaw U(1) B-L model with two-component Dirac dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood is implemented for the two-component annihilation gamma-ray observable: the paper cites dwarf-spheroidal searches qualitatively, and no pipeline weights each component's spectrum by its relic fraction and confronts published Fermi-LAT likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate per-component annihilation spectra with micrOMEGAs/PPPC4DMID, weight each by (Omega_i/Omega_DM)^2, and evaluate against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal binned likelihoods to produce sigma-v limits for the benchmark scans.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) L_mu-L_tau charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the model's cascade annihilation: applying Fermi-LAT dwarf limits to S S -> Z' Z' with mu/tau/neutrino-dominated L_mu-L_tau branching fractions requires computing the boosted photon spectrum (largely from muon/tau radiative decays), which the card encodes only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Use MadDM or PPPC4DMID mu/tau spectra boosted through the Z' two-body cascade to build the gamma-ray spectrum for L_mu-L_tau branching fractions, then evaluate the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods to produce <sigma v>_0 limits as a function of (m_S, m_Z_prime).

members.model_name: Pseudoscalar s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No neutrino-telescope likelihood is implemented for late-time halo annihilation chi chi -> phi phi followed by phi -> nu nu; the indirect-detection constraint is only qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Super-Kamiokande and IceCube limits on dark-matter annihilation to neutrino final states onto the two-step phi-mediated spectrum (boosted box spectrum from phi -> nu nu), packaged as a likelihood over (m_chi, m_phi, <sigma v>_halo).

members.model_name: Hidden-sector early cannibal-dominated dark matter cosmology
members.description: No likelihood connects the boosted annihilation signal of ECDE microhalos to Fermi-LAT IGRB data for this model; the existing IGRB recast was built for early matter domination, not cannibal-modified spectra, and the primary paper explicitly leaves the constraint analysis to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the early-matter-domination IGRB recast of rel_2403_18893 to cannibal-era boost factors: compute the annihilation boost from the calibrated microhalo model and evaluate it against the Fermi-LAT isotropic gamma-ray background likelihood over (annihilation cross section, k_pk, cutoff scale).

members.model_name: Type-III fermion triplet dark matter in a fast-expanding pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: The indirect-detection step relies on the source-quoted 1.5-2.7 TeV exclusion instead of a recomputed limit: the Sommerfeld-enhanced Sigma_1^0 annihilation cross section into W+W- is not calculated for the scanned masses and no Fermi-LAT (or H.E.S.S.) likelihood is run for the sub-1.5 TeV fast-expansion parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the Sommerfeld factors for the electroweak triplet (standard nonrelativistic potential treatment), generate W+W- gamma-ray spectra with a public spectrum tool, and evaluate them against the released Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood to produce a mass-dependent limit across the M_Sigma1 < 1.5 TeV scan region.

members.model_name: Electron-philic scalar mediator with Majorana dark matter
members.description: No digitized likelihood or public recast pipeline exists for the NA64/LDMX missing-energy reach on the electron-specific scalar mediator with invisible decay to a Majorana DM pair; the paper's reach curves are undigitized and the detector acceptance model is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's production cross sections with a GEANT4-derived (or tabulated) positron track-length distribution and the published NA64 missing-energy signal efficiency, validate against the existing NA64 EOT 3.22e11 exclusion, and release a yield-to-limit recast covering (m_phi, m_chi, c_ee^phi, y_chi^phi) at the NA64e 5e12 and LDMX 1e15 EOT benchmarks.

members.model_name: Y-interacting fourth-generation heavy neutrino dark matter
members.description: The gamma-ray constraint is anchored to historical EGRET diffuse-flux normalization with no reusable likelihood; no recast of the recombination-enhanced N anti-N annihilation flux against modern Fermi-LAT diffuse and dwarf-spheroidal data exists, so con_egret_alpha_y_floor is only a dated benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute annihilation photon spectra for the Z-mediated and yy channels with modern PYTHIA 8 or PPPC4DMID tables (replacing the paper's PYTHIA 6.2 spectra), scale by the Sakharov-enhanced rate and subdominant fraction f_N, and evaluate against public Fermi-LAT diffuse-emission and dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods to replace the EGRET-based alpha_y floor.

members.model_name: Type-I NMSSM sneutrino WIMP dark matter
members.description: The paper's composite likelihood scan is not reproducible as released: the exact priors, the joint Planck relic + XENON-1T SI/SD + Fermi-LAT dwarf + LHC Higgs/sparticle likelihood glue, and the Type-I NMSSM SARAH model files were not published, and the direct-detection term uses XENON-1T-era rather than current LZ/XENONnT limits, which matter for the narrow 125-135 GeV co-annihilation islands.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the pipeline openly: regenerate the Type-I NMSSM in SARAH/SPheno, couple micrOMEGAs to DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT), the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood, and HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals plus SModelS for the collider terms, then rerun the MultiNest scan and validate against the paper's profile-likelihood islands.

members.model_name: Z4 sequential loop-suppression inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No LHC recast or likelihood exists for the vector-like exotic-fermion pair production with dijet/dilepton plus missing-energy final states; the paper supplies no cross-section tables or analysis mapping.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing ATLAS/CMS vector-like-lepton and slepton-like searches onto the exotic-fermion pair-production topology using MadGraph events passed through CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 recast cards.

members.model_name: Higgs-philic U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No modern cosmic-ray likelihood exists for the long-lived NLSP sneutrino decay signal: the positron/electron interpretation rests on historical PAMELA/ATIC/Fermi-LAT comparisons with no AMS-02-era propagation-plus-likelihood recast of the model's leptonic decay spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute NLSP decay spectra from the model files, propagate with GALPROP or DRAGON2 under current B/C-calibrated setups, and build an AMS-02 positron-fraction and antiproton likelihood (plus Fermi-LAT gamma-ray limits) for the (tau_NLSP, branching-fraction) plane.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric leptophilic Higgs singlino dark matter
members.description: The gamma-ray target is the 2011 Hooper-Goodenough Galactic Center excess interpretation with no implemented likelihood (likelihood_available: no); no modern Fermi-LAT Galactic Center likelihood or recast exists for this model's tau-dominated 7-10 GeV annihilation spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's tau+tau- (plus hadronic fraction) annihilation spectrum against current public Fermi-LAT Galactic Center and dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods (e.g. the Fermi dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods), replacing the paper-era excess target.

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed bottom quarks
members.description: No reusable Fermi-LAT spectral-feature likelihood exists for the b bbar gamma VIB endpoint template: the original optimized target-region analysis predates Pass 8 line searches, and the card states the likelihood must be rebuilt from data products for each recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the optimized target-region binned likelihood on current Fermi-LAT Pass 8 data with fermipy (or recast the published Fermi line-search likelihood curves onto VIB endpoint templates), and release it as a packaged likelihood scanning (m_chi, mu) with configurable halo J-factor.

members.model_name: Quasi-Yukawa-unified 4-2-2 neutralino dark matter with non-universal gaugino masses
members.description: No statistical likelihood is implemented for any of the card's constraints (likelihood_available is 'no' for the WMAP relic window, direct-detection reach, and collider/flavor cuts); viability is judged by hard cuts and by comparing points to plotted historical XENON1T/CDMS/Super-K/IceCube curves rather than by evaluating current LZ/XENONnT direct-detection likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the QYU 4-2-2 scan output (sigma_SI, sigma_SD, m_chi) into DDCalc or the GAMBIT DarkBit likelihoods for LZ/XENONnT, and replace the hard relic-density window with a Planck-based Gaussian likelihood on Omega_CDM h^2.

members.model_name: Z-prime portal right-handed neutrino dark matter in minimal gauged U(1) B-L
members.description: No decaying-DM gamma-ray likelihood is wired up for the eW/nu_e Z/nu_e h cascade channels of a 3 TeV RHN: the Fermi-LAT lifetime bound quoted in the card (a few times 1e28 s, making the DAMPE-fit lifetime marginal) cannot be re-evaluated with current dwarf, Galactic-halo, and extragalactic data.

members.model_name: Z-prime portal right-handed neutrino dark matter in minimal gauged U(1) B-L

members.proposed_resolution: Build a DAMPE e+e- spectral likelihood using DRAGON or GALPROP propagation with an injection term from chi -> eW decay spectra (HDMSpectra), a parameterized local-subhalo density profile, and the published DAMPE data points with correlated background nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass PBH dark matter from running-index inflation in early matter domination
members.description: PBH abundance constraints are applied as approximate monochromatic exclusion curves; no machine-readable likelihood set with a proper extended-mass-function treatment exists for the evaporation gamma-ray, microlensing, and dynamical bounds relevant to the asteroid-mass window.

members.model_name: Z4 singlet Majorana fermion dark matter tied to type-I seesaw

members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z4 model (Majorana fermion plus two mixed scalars) as micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files, compute sigma_SI with standard nucleon form factors, and couple it to the public DDCalc likelihoods for LUX, XENON1T, and successor experiments to produce a proper pass-fail/likelihood surface over (M_chi, alpha, m_H_light, u).

members.model_name: CP-odd sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: The combined likelihood (Planck relic Gaussian, XENON1T upper limit, Fermi-LAT dwarf term, HiggsBounds/HiggsSignal and B-physics terms) exists only inside the authors' private EasyScan HEP setup; no reusable likelihood package or public posterior samples are released for the CP-odd scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompose the scan likelihood in a public global-fit framework (e.g. GAMBIT or a released EasyScan HEP configuration) with documented priors and experimental terms, and publish the configuration plus posterior chains so the CP-even versus CP-odd evidence comparison can be reproduced and updated with newer data.

members.model_name: Dynamical dark matter MATHUSLA toy ensemble

members.model_name: Landscape SUSY DFSZ mixed axion-neutralino dark matter
members.description: No implemented indirect-detection likelihood pipeline exists for the neutralino subcomponent: the Fermi-LAT+MAGIC dwarf-galaxy limit must be rescaled by the model-dependent WIMP fraction xi_chi and recomputed for higgsino-like annihilation channels, and this recast has not been coded.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods (e.g. via gamLike or MadDM's Fermi module) to the route output, rescaling the annihilation flux by xi_chi^2 and using higgsino-like WW/ZZ/hh spectra from PPPC4DMID, reproducing the excluded WIMP-fraction band of the primary paper as validation.

members.model_name: Pre-early-matter-domination freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No recast connects the Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods to this scenario's low, channel-unspecified annihilation rate <sigma_ann v>_f: the published limits apply to standard radiation-dominated thermal WIMP benchmarks, so the quantitative (non-)exclusion of the pre-EMD freeze-in and early-equilibrium regimes is not evaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Choose representative annihilation channels (e.g. b bbar, tau tau), and reapply the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods directly to the (m_chi, <sigma_ann v>_f) plane of this scenario, overlaying the relic-consistent contours from the pre-EMD yield calculation.

members.model_name: U(1)_{e-mu} Dirac leptophilic dark matter with two-loop neutrino masses

members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the spectral fit from public CALET and AMS-02 data releases with a DRAGON/GALPROP propagation setup and a parameterized pulsar background, and package it as a reusable likelihood module with documented background nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Spinor freeze-in inelastic dark matter with dark photon portal
members.description: The SN1987A cooling constraint enters only as a quoted analytic bound on epsilon; no supernova transport calculation or likelihood covers this model's dark photon plus light dark-sector fermions (which open trapping/re-absorption channels), and the bound is unreliable outside the MeV mediator window.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun a supernova energy-loss calculation (following the Chang-Essig-McDermott style dark-photon luminosity treatment) including production and trapping of the dark photon with its decay to the chi_1 chi_2 pair, and publish the resulting exclusion as an (epsilon, m_V, e_D) mask usable as a route overlay.

members.model_name: RPV axiogenesis axion dark matter
members.description: No proton-decay recast exists for the SU(5)-motivated dimensionless RPV textures: the sfermion-mass lower bound (O(10-100) TeV for f_a of 1e8-1e11 GeV) is a text-level estimate with no likelihood tied to Super-Kamiokande/Hyper-Kamiokande kaon-mode data.

members.model_name: RPV axiogenesis axion dark matter

members.model_name: Electron-specific spin-2 mediator with light Dirac dark matter

members.model_name: Present-decaying lepton-number SUSY Q-ball dark-matter subcomponent

members.model_name: Low-tension brane-world branon WIMP dark matter
members.description: All search constraints are frozen at the 2004/2005 landscape with no machine-readable likelihoods: collider limits are undigitized Table 1 entries, direct detection is a historical DAMA/ZEPLIN/EDELWEISS insensitivity statement, and no modern mono-X, direct, indirect, or precision-loop likelihood exists for the M-f plane.

members.model_name: Fermionic FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with Higgs scalar portal

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated NMSSM light and heavy dark-sector model

members.proposed_resolution: Attach a public solar-WIMP likelihood built on IceCube data releases (nulike-style event-level likelihood, updated to current 86-string/DeepCore analyses) fed by DarkSUSY capture rates and WimpSim/charon neutrino yields per annihilation channel.

members.model_name: Interacting two-component dark matter conversion model

members.proposed_resolution: Compute the leptonic injection spectra (e.g. with PPPC4DMID or HDMSpectra tables for the triplet-scalar leptonic final states), propagate with DRAGON or GALPROP marginalizing over propagation nuisances, and fit AMS-02 positron and electron spectra, cross-checking against Fermi dwarf-spheroidal and Planck CMB annihilation likelihoods.

members.model_name: Asymmetric higgsino dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood has been connected to the regenerated symmetric higgsino component: the sigma_ann v ~ 1e-26 (1 TeV/mu)^2 cm^3/s WW/ZZ rate weighted by the symmetric fraction has not been evaluated against Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal or CTA-class likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the symmetric-fraction output of the gap_1 solver into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood (WW/ZZ spectra from PPPC4DMID) to bound the (mu, m0) plane, rescaling the annihilation signal by the square of the symmetric fraction.

members.model_name: Pure gravity mediation neutral wino dark matter
members.description: No public antiproton likelihood with marginalized propagation and halo uncertainties exists for the wino W-pair channel; the card's PAMELA/AMS constraint is a low-robustness upper-limit interpretation requiring full recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an AMS-02 antiproton likelihood for the WW channel using a DRAGON2- or GALPROP-based propagation grid with propagation parameters marginalized against B/C data, released as tabulated likelihood grids in (m_wino, <sigma v>).

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed muons
members.description: No reusable Fermi-LAT spectral-feature likelihood exists for the mu+ mu- gamma VIB endpoint template: the original optimized target-region analysis predates Pass 8 line searches, and the card states the likelihood must be rebuilt from data products for each recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the optimized target-region binned likelihood on current Fermi-LAT Pass 8 data with fermipy (or recast the published Fermi line-search likelihood curves onto VIB endpoint templates), and release it as a packaged likelihood scanning (m_chi, mu) with configurable halo J-factor.

members.model_name: Virtual-internal-bremsstrahlung Majorana dark matter coupled to right-handed tau leptons

members.model_name: Zee-Babu global U(1) B-L complex scalar dark matter
members.description: The gamma-line observable is anchored to the tentative Fermi-LAT 130 GeV line target (likelihood_available no); no current gamma-ray line-search likelihood or updated limit recast for X_R X_R -> gamma gamma exists on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Replace the historical line target with current Fermi-LAT (and H.E.S.S.) line-search upper limits on <sigma v>_gamma_gamma at m_R ~ 130 GeV, implemented as a likelihood over the model's predicted line rate.

members.model_name: Extra-light-modulus dilution of nonthermal LSP dark matter in mirage mediation
members.description: No implemented pipeline connects the diluted nonthermal LSP scenario to modern direct-, indirect-, and collider-search likelihoods; existing neutralino tools assume a thermal history and need the entropy-dilution rescaling and a concrete wino/Higgsino benchmark spectrum wired in.
members.proposed_resolution: Build benchmark mirage-mediation spectra with a public spectrum generator, feed them to micrOMEGAs for rates, and apply DDCalc-style direct-detection and Fermi-LAT dwarf indirect-detection likelihoods with the relic fraction fixed by the moduli-dilution calculation instead of thermal freeze-out.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with scalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: No reusable Fermi Galactic Center gamma-ray likelihood or per-channel <sigma v> limit tables exist for the mediator-mixing-weighted SM final states, so the indirect-detection route cannot produce quantitative pass/fail results.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Fermi LAT Galactic Center and dwarf-spheroidal limits into per-channel <sigma v>(m_d) tables (using the public Fermi dSph likelihood release) and weight them by the MicrOMEGAs branching fractions of each scan point.

members.model_name: Cosmic-selection-rule SU(N)d glueball dark matter
members.description: The gamma/X-ray constraint is applied as a single approximate lifetime floor (tau_phi > ~1e28 s) rather than an energy-dependent likelihood over the glueball mass range, so the m_Q lower bound inherits an unquantified uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published X-ray and gamma-ray decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits as a function of photon energy into a lookup table spanning the relevant m_phi range, and apply the loop-induced two-photon branching fraction to convert them into (m_phi, m_Q, N_d) exclusions.

members.model_name: Dark U(1)_D Breit-Wigner leptophilic dark matter model
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood exists to quantitatively re-evaluate the DAMPE/AMS-02 CRE fit and the Fermi-LAT dwarf-galaxy compatibility for this model's specific leptonic branching pattern (0.484/0.508/0.008); the paper's DRAGON-embedded MCMC setup is not released, so the constraints step can only reproduce qualitative compatibility arguments.
members.proposed_resolution: Package a DAMPE+AMS-02 CRE likelihood module (e.g. within GAMBIT/DarkBit or a standalone python likelihood) with a DRAGON or GALPROP propagation wrapper, and recast the public Fermi-LAT dwarf bin-by-bin likelihood tables against PPPC spectra for the fitted branching fractions.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_H bosonic H2 dark matter for radiative neutrino mass
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the DAMPE e+e- feature from Z'-pair-mediated four-lepton annihilation: the flux normalization depends on an unmodeled nearby-subhalo assumption and no cosmic-ray propagation recast is packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that convolves the four-lepton annihilation spectrum (e.g. from micrOMEGAs/PPPC spectra) with a GALPROP/DRAGON propagation model and an explicit local-subhalo flux model, and package the DAMPE spectral fit as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Primordial extremal black holes with dark electromagnetism
members.description: No IceCube/HAWC transient likelihood is implemented for short high-energy neutrino and gamma-ray bursts from evaporating merger remnants; the route lists all three detector likelihoods as unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a burst-search likelihood from published IceCube transient point-source and HAWC PBH-burst analyses, taking the predicted burst spectrum and R_merge as inputs and returning expected event counts against the measured burst-rate limits.

members.model_name: Decaying super-heavy dark matter explanation of IceCube PeV neutrinos and baryon asymmetry
members.description: No IceCube likelihood or exposure model is implemented: the constraint is an ad hoc chi-square over selected published flux points (sometimes including pink-band points), and the card documents that changing the selection moves the best-fit M_X between 1e7 and 1e11 GeV, so the mass/lifetime posterior is not robustly evaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Poisson event-level likelihood from the public IceCube HESE 7.5-year data release (effective areas, energy-zenith response) for the summed Galactic plus extragalactic decay flux, marginalizing over an astrophysical power-law component, replacing the point-selection chi-square.

members.model_name: Z5 two-component scalar dark matter model
members.description: No implemented Fermi dwarf-spheroidal likelihood recast exists for the Z5 model's abundance-weighted mixed-component and semi-annihilation channels (xi_i xi_j <sigma v>_ij into phi_k h final states); the published single-channel bb-bar/WW limit curves used in the paper do not directly apply to the boosted-Higgs spectrum from semi-annihilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate photon spectra for each phi_i phi_j -> phi_k h and annihilation channel with micrOMEGAs/PPPC4DMID, weight them by the micrOMEGAs relic fractions, and evaluate the summed spectrum against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihood tables (e.g. via the gamLike/DDCalc-style interface used in GAMBIT).

members.model_name: Z2 x Z2 two-inert-doublet 3HDM two-component dark matter
members.description: No statistical likelihoods are wired to any of the model's constraints: Planck relic density, XENON1T SI scattering (which needs per-component local-fraction rescaling), and Fermi-LAT/PAMELA annihilation limits are all applied as digitized exclusion curves with likelihood_available 'no', preventing a proper global fit of the two-component parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model to an existing global-fit framework (e.g. a GAMBIT model entry) whose DarkBit likelihoods already implement Planck, XENON1T, and Fermi dwarf-spheroidal statistics, extending the direct- and indirect-detection likelihoods to rescale each component by Omega_i/Omega_T.

members.model_name: SO(10)-embedded fermion triplet dark matter
members.description: None of the three constraints carries a likelihood (all likelihood_available: no): PandaX-II/XENON1T/LUX direct limits, the Fermi-LAT gamma-ray limit, and the Super-K proton-decay bound are applied only as quoted exclusion statements, so no quantitative confrontation of the model is possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble DDCalc likelihoods for the xenon experiments, the public Fermi-LAT dwarf/Galactic-center likelihood for the W+W- channel with Sommerfeld-corrected <sigma v>, and a Poisson likelihood from the Super-Kamiokande p -> pi0 e+ exposure for tau_p.

members.model_name: Supergravity axion-monodromy sharp-turn primordial black-hole dark matter model
members.description: No likelihood or recast machinery exists in the route for confronting the model's multi-peaked extended PBH mass functions with evaporation-era bounds (BBN, CMB, gamma-ray, Voyager) or its oscillatory P_R(k) with Planck feature constraints; both constraints carry likelihood_available no and recasting_needed yes, and the paper itself states exact extended-mass-function bounds were not evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a constraint pipeline that applies the standard extended-mass-function recasting method to public monochromatic bound compilations (PBHbounds-class data) for the model's multi-peak spectra, and couples the PyTransport-computed P_R(k) to the Planck 2018 likelihood via a primordial-spectrum input to CLASS/CAMB to test CMB-scale oscillation viability.

members.model_name: ALP-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The visible-sector exclusions (SLAC beam dump, NA62/NA48/2 and B-decay searches, SN1987A and globular-cluster energy loss) exist only as a recalculated overlay figure in the primary paper; no digitized constraint curves or packaged likelihood is available for this specific fermion-coupled DFSZ-like ALP mediator.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the model-specific exclusion curves and re-derive them within a public ALP-limits framework (recasting beam-dump, rare K/B decay, and stellar/SN energy-loss bounds with the DFSZ-like fermionic coupling pattern and loop-induced gauge couplings), packaged as reusable (m_a, g_aff) exclusion tables.

members.model_name: Post-recombination superheavy scalar dark matter decaying to gravitons
members.description: No likelihood is available for the diffuse gamma-ray comparison: the LHAASO diffuse-flux constraint used as reference was built for ALP conversion, and no released likelihood, exposure, or background model applies to the converted-graviton spectral shape of this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a binned likelihood from the published LHAASO diffuse gamma-ray flux measurements with a Galactic diffuse-emission background model, parameterized by (M_phi, Gamma, Omega_gw h0^2) times the conversion probability, and validate by reproducing the primary paper's order-unity-abundance sensitivity estimate.

members.model_name: Near-continuum Z-portal dark matter
members.description: No collider analysis implementation or likelihood exists for near-continuum Z-portal cascades: standard recast chains have no signal region tuned to soft high-multiplicity fermions plus missing energy with possible displaced vertices, no MadGraph-style model file handles the dense KK tower, and LHC limits were deferred by the authors.
members.proposed_resolution: Pipe VegasMC_WIC LHE output through Pythia/Delphes into MadAnalysis or CheckMATE, recasting existing electroweakino compressed-spectrum, soft-lepton, and displaced-vertex searches, and publish the resulting exclusion in (mu0, theta2, R_inverse); extend the event generation to hadron-collider initial states.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from slow supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood converts the model's extended PBH mass function into an exclusion in the (beta/H_0, T_reh) plane; the constraint step relies on overlaying public monochromatic PBH limit curves, which the card notes require recasting for extended mass functions and tails.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated bound-state-forming WIMP dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection or unitarity recast exists translating the Sommerfeld- and bound-state-enhanced late-time annihilation of this model into gamma-ray, CMB energy-injection, or cosmic-ray limits; the card records this only as a recast-required constraint with no likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the velocity-averaged enhanced annihilation plus bound-state-decay spectra for halo velocity distributions and recast against existing Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal limits and Planck energy-injection constraints (via ExoCLASS), scanning m_chi, m_V, alpha over the relic-viable surface.

members.model_name: Light moduli dark matter with anthropically selected abundance
members.description: No public, reusable X-ray line-search likelihood exists for a generic two-photon-decaying scalar: the Suzaku Draco/Ursa Minor analysis lives only in the primary paper, and external Chandra/Suzaku/Fermi-GBM line searches are published as sterile-neutrino mixing-angle limits that must be converted to a generic decay width before they constrain (m_phi, tau_phi, f_phi).

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudo-scalar Yukawa interaction

members.model_name: Light vector dark matter with neutrino contact scattering

members.model_name: Fermi-ball dark matter from a quartic dark-sector phase transition

members.model_name: ALP-assisted SU(2)_D vector dark matter with catalyzed freeze-out

members.model_name: Symmetric ultraheavy atomic dark matter freeze-out through rearrangement

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric techni-baryon dark matter from technicolor assisted leptogenesis
members.description: The BBN/entropy-injection lifetime window (tau_TB < 1 s or > 1e26 s) is only an order-of-magnitude estimate; no BBN energy-injection or late-decay indirect-detection likelihood has been run for decaying technibaryons with unspecified SM final states.

members.model_name: Type-I seesaw plus fermionic quintuplet minimal dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Recast current LZ/XENONnT direct-detection limits and CTA/H.E.S.S. galactic-center indirect limits for the Y=0 fermionic quintuplet using DarkSUSY or MadDM with published Sommerfeld/bound-state annihilation spectra, and package the result as a likelihood keyed to M_MDM.

members.model_name: Type-III seesaw plus fermionic quintuplet minimal dark matter
members.description: The card's direct/indirect search consistency is quoted from 2012-era experiments with no likelihood (likelihood_available unknown, recasting_needed yes); no modern recast exists on the card for a 9.6 TeV quintuplet against current direct-detection and indirect-detection data including Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current LZ/XENONnT direct-detection limits and CTA/H.E.S.S. galactic-center indirect limits for the Y=0 fermionic quintuplet using DarkSUSY or MadDM with published Sommerfeld/bound-state annihilation spectra, and package the result as a likelihood keyed to M_MDM.

members.model_name: Spread Supersymmetry with wino LSP dark matter
members.description: Indirect-detection evaluation is incomplete: H.E.S.S. gamma-line likelihoods are not public and no assembled recast propagates the wino fraction (Omega_W/Omega_DM)^2 scaling with halo-profile and antiproton-propagation uncertainties through Fermi, H.E.S.S., and AMS-02 data.

members.model_name: Degenerate free-fermion dark matter with inflaton-decay production
members.description: No stellar-kinematic likelihood exists for fitting degenerate Fermi-gas (Lane-Emden) halo profiles to the classical Milky Way dwarf-spheroidal velocity-dispersion data; the primary fit cannot be reproduced or updated.

members.model_name: Radiative neutrino-mass model with neutrino-interacting MeV dark matter
members.description: The few-MeV lower-mass floor from BBN/CMB radiation density (N_eff heating by annihilation into neutrinos) is applied only as a literature statement; no likelihood or model-specific N_eff computation exists for this candidate (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: partial).

members.model_name: CP-violating spin-0 mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline exists that maps the model's late-time annihilation rate, mediator branching ratios, and CP-mixed nucleon coupling onto the Planck CMB energy-injection bound, indirect-detection limits, direct-detection curves, and the BBN mediator-lifetime floor; the card records that no constraint curves were digitized and lists constraint-curve digitization as a required resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the cited Planck f_eff, direct-detection, and BBN limit curves; compute mediator decay branching fractions versus m_phi and alpha_SM with standard spectra tables; and assemble a mask-generating recast module over (m_chi, m_phi, alpha, y_SM, alpha_SM) that reproduces the paper's excluded regions.

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model I

members.model_name: Angular-momentum-stabilized self-destructing dark positronium
members.description: No likelihood or recast framework exists for visible-energy SDDM decay topologies (one to three lepton pairs with fixed invariant masses and directionality) in large neutrino detectors; existing boosted-DM searches provide context but no packaged efficiencies, backgrounds, or event-rate-per-volume limits for this signature.

members.model_name: Top-philic Majorana dark matter with colored t-channel mediator
members.description: No packaged likelihood pipeline exists for the model's threshold-dependent indirect-detection final states (gg/Higgs-mediated below top threshold, Wbt near threshold, tt above), so Fermi-LAT dwarf, Galactic-center line, and AMS-02 antiproton limits must be recast by hand with external J-factor and propagation assumptions.

members.model_name: Agnostic vector-portal self-interacting dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkHistory (or ExoCLASS) with an injection module for mediators of lab-frame lifetime gamma*tau_V produced by annihilation, tracking redshift-dependent decay and electromagnetic deposition efficiency, and couple it to the Planck annihilation likelihood plus Fermi-LAT/H.E.S.S. flux limits to produce epsilon(m_chi, m_V) exclusions.

members.model_name: Light 2HDM-portal forbidden singlet fermion dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection or indirect-detection likelihood has been evaluated for this model's exponentially threshold- and velocity-suppressed late-time annihilation; the card records likelihood_available: no, so the claim that the fermionic variant evades CMB and gamma-ray limits is not backed by a computable constraint.

members.model_name: Light 2HDM-portal forbidden scalar dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection or existing gamma-ray likelihood has been evaluated for this model's Boltzmann-suppressed late-time annihilation and its loop-induced gamma-gamma line; the card records likelihood_available: no for the cosmological constraint, so the forbidden-regime evasion of Planck limits is asserted rather than computed.

members.model_name: Light 2HDM-portal forbidden scalar dark matter
members.description: No forecast machinery exists to translate the predicted sub-GeV gamma-ray lines just below charged-lepton masses into detection reach for future MeV missions (AMEGO/e-ASTROGAM), which the card identifies as the key discovery channel of the scalar variant.

members.model_name: Small-lambda-kappa NMSSM neutralino dark matter

members.model_name: 2HD+a singlet-fermion dark matter
members.description: No assembled joint likelihood exists for the 2HD+a scan combining the Planck relic target, XENON1T loop-level direct detection, Fermi-LAT gamma-ray limits, and LHC/flavor/electroweak-precision plus W-mass and muon g-2 requirements; all four constraint entries have likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a GAMBIT-style composite likelihood for the 2HD+a parameter space, combining micrOMEGAs outputs with HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals, flavor and electroweak-precision fits (including the M_W oblique-parameter shift), and published XENON1T and Fermi-LAT likelihood curves.

members.model_name: Bouncing three-scalar dark matter
members.description: No numerical gamma-ray likelihood recast exists for the model's cascade annihilation: the primary benchmark only adapts published H'H' -> WW cascade limits, so Fermi dwarf exclusions and CTA projections cannot be evaluated for general dark-state decay modes and branching ratios.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate channel-specific cascade photon spectra (boosted secondary decays via Pythia or the analytic cascade formalism of arXiv:1503.02641) and interface them with the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood in MadDM, adding CTA Galactic Center projection curves for forecasts.

members.model_name: Gravitational right-handed-neutrino FIMP dark matter
members.description: The optional PeV-neutrino decay observable has no implemented recast: the N1 to high-energy-neutrino decay spectrum for the tiny-Yukawa scenario and a comparison against IceCube diffuse-flux data are not set up in the card's routing.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the PeV-scale decay spectra with HDMSpectra for the N1 final states, propagate to Earth fluxes with standard halo plus extragalactic decay templates, and recast against the public IceCube HESE/diffuse astrophysical-neutrino likelihood.

members.model_name: SU(3) center-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: No detector likelihood exists for the monochromatic boosted-dark-matter line at E_phi = (5 m_phi^2 - m_h^2)/(4 m_phi) predicted in the semi-annihilation-dominated regime, so the flux prediction cannot be confronted with neutrino-telescope or direct-detection data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a boosted-DM signal-and-response module: compute the halo-integrated semi-annihilation flux, fold it through published Super-Kamiokande/IceCube and large-xenon boosted-DM effective areas, and package the result as a recast likelihood for the line energy and flux normalization.

members.model_name: Multi-component asymmetric cogenesis dark-sector model
members.description: No BBN likelihood is implemented for the late-decaying parent fermion: the card's BBN bound is an analytic 0.1-1 s timing estimate with likelihood_available = no, and no cascade calculation covering hadronic and electromagnetic final states of the mediator has been run for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the parent lifetime and decay channels through ACROPOLIS for electromagnetic injection, extending it (or interfacing a hadronic-cascade BBN code) for hadronic final states, to replace the timing estimate with light-element abundance likelihoods over (tau, m_parent, branching fractions).

members.model_name: MeV-scale Z3 complex scalar semi-annihilation dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the archival MeV diffuse gamma-ray data (COMPTEL, EGRET, INTEGRAL, Fermi-LAT low-energy) against which the semi-annihilation continuum is compared; the primary paper reports only cross-section bound curves, so limits on <sigma v>_semi cannot be recomputed with proper background/covariance treatment or extended to new benchmarks and halo models.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a gamLike-style likelihood module for the archival MeV diffuse spectra (energy binning, effective area, and background model per instrument) plus the projected e-ASTROGAM response, taking arbitrary dN_gamma/dE inputs so semi-annihilation spectra with one boosted mediator in the final state can be constrained directly.

members.model_name: Modular A4 muon-specific scalar dark matter model
members.description: The Fermi-LAT Galactic-center GeV-excess constraint is applied only as an approximate 1-2 sigma window on (m_chi, <sigma v>) for the mu+ mu- channel; no proper GeV-excess likelihood with the muon-channel gamma-ray spectrum and halo-profile uncertainty is available in the route.
