members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from a published Fermi-LAT GCE spectral measurement, folding in the mu+ mu- annihilation spectrum (PPPC4DMID-style tables including final-state radiation) and marginalizing over the generalized-NFW profile parameters, replacing the fixed <sigma v>_FL window.

members.model_name: SESM general-scalar-potential inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: The flavor and muon g-2 viability selection is scan-level only: no public implementation of the SESM vectorlike quark/lepton loop contributions to R_K, B_s mixing, and Delta a_mu exists, so the anomaly-motivated parameter-space cut cannot be re-evaluated as a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vectorlike-fermion and Z_2-odd scalar loop contributions in a public flavor package (e.g. flavio or SPheno/FlavourKit via a SARAH model file) and combine with current B-physics and muon g-2 measurements into a joint chi-square usable in the scan.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: The BBN/CMB excess-radiation bound on MeV neutrino-coupled thermal relics is only quoted from minimal-model literature (~6 MeV fermion lower bound); the extended model's second right-handed neutrino and cancellation structure require a dedicated N_eff recast that does not exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a neutrino-decoupling code of the NUDEC_BSM type with the model's full dark-sector spectrum (N, S1, S2) to compute Delta N_eff and modified light-element yields across the low-mass region, and wrap Planck/BBN data as a likelihood over (m_DM, m_S1).

members.model_name: SU(2)_D vector dark matter with catalyzed freeze-out
members.description: No implemented indirect-detection recast exists for the secluded cascade signal: the boosted-catalyst-decay gamma-ray spectrum (X X -> Zprime Zprime followed by Zprime -> SM fermions) has not been generated and folded through the Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood or CTA sensitivity for this model's masses and branching fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate catalyst rest-frame decay spectra with Pythia (or PPPC4DMID tables) for the Zprime -> SM fermion channels, boost them to the X X -> Zprime Zprime cascade frame, and evaluate against the published Fermi-LAT six-year dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods and CTA projected sensitivity with standard J-factors, scanning m_X, r_XZprime, and tau_C.

members.model_name: Mediator-decay freeze-in dark matter during early matter domination
members.description: The collider constraint is only an approximate order-TeV guide line with no representation-specific LHC recast or likelihood for the SM-charged mediator X, and the Fermi-LAT annihilation bound is applied qualitatively with no public likelihood, so the constraint overlay cannot produce statistically meaningful exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the candidate mediator gauge representations (color-triplet scalar, U(1) B-L cases) in SModelS/CheckMATE to derive representation-specific m_X limits, and evaluate <sigma_ann v>(m_chi) against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods for the relevant final states.

members.model_name: Oscillating asymmetric dark matter (scalar variant)
members.description: No modern likelihood recast exists for the regenerated-annihilation signal: the card relies on source-era WMAP CMB, BBN, and stacked Fermi dwarf bounds reweighted by hand, whereas the oscillation-modulated anti-DM fraction requires a time-dependent annihilation-rate history in current Planck energy-injection and Fermi dwarf likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an exotic-energy-injection pipeline (DarkHistory or ExoCLASS/CLASS with Planck 2018 likelihoods) to accept the oscillation-modulated annihilation-rate history, and reweight the current Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal combined likelihood by the present-day anti-DM fraction for the b bbar and leptonic final states.

members.model_name: Lepton-number asymmetric dark matter with gamma-ray triangles
members.description: No public implementation exists of the windowed power-law-plus-feature profile likelihood used to set Fermi-LAT and H.E.S.S. limits on triangle spectra, so new (m_DM, m_N/m_DM, alpha) points can only be constrained by interpolating the paper's digitized limit curves; the H.E.S.S. inner-halo event data underlying the TeV limits are not publicly released.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's sliding-energy-window power-law background plus triangle-signal profile likelihood on public Fermi-LAT Galactic-center data, and approximate the H.E.S.S. reach with published effective-area/exposure tables or an existing spectral-feature recast framework, validating against the paper's 95 percent CL benchmark limits.

members.model_name: Majorana dark matter co-annihilating with a strongly interacting scalar
members.description: No direct-detection, indirect-detection, or LHC collider likelihoods or recasts exist for the colored scalar partner and the Majorana singlet in this model (the card records likelihood_available no/unknown and recasting_needed yes for the search-compatibility constraint).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/MadGraph, use MadDM or micrOMEGAs for direct- and indirect-detection cross sections, and recast LHC colored-partner searches (e.g. squark-like jets plus missing-energy limits) with SModelS or CheckMATE for the compressed-spectrum coannihilation region.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet fermion dark matter with scalar triplet
members.description: The collider constraint is only a benchmark cut-flow projection: no recast of existing LHC compressed-spectrum, displaced charged-vector-like-lepton, or hadronically quiet multilepton searches, and no ILC likelihood, is implemented for the vector-like fermion and triplet-scalar spectrum, so con_sdf_collider_reach cannot be evaluated as an actual exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the public model files from gap_1, generate signal events in MadGraph+PYTHIA and recast current ATLAS/CMS soft-dilepton, disappearing/displaced-track, and multilepton (doubly charged Higgs) searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, producing exclusion likelihoods in the (M_chi1, Delta M, theta, triplet-mass) plane.

members.model_name: Metastable conformal dark matter
members.description: X-ray/gamma-ray line constraints (XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, INTEGRAL) are applied only as lifetime curves read from the paper figure; no digitized limit tables or instrument-specific likelihoods are packaged for the monochromatic-line observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits tau(m_DM) from XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, and INTEGRAL over the keV-MeV range, package them as interpolable tables with target/profile assumptions recorded, and add an exclusion/likelihood test against the model's tau_phi(m_phi, alpha) line.

members.model_name: Two-component WIMP-FIMP scalar dark matter with U(1) L_mu-L_tau
members.description: No likelihood or reusable recast exists for the fraction-rescaled direct and indirect detection constraints on the WIMP component; the paper compares to XENON-1T and AMS-02 contours without a public statistical implementation for the two-component local-density rescaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model into DDCalc (for XENON-1T-class spin-independent likelihoods) and an AMS-02 antiproton/positron likelihood, applying the Omega_1/Omega_DM rescaling of local density and annihilation rate computed from the relic solver.

members.model_name: Portalino-inspired neutrino-portal Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: Gamma-ray limits on X X -> n n annihilation followed by Portalino cascade decays cannot be evaluated: Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal limits are tabulated only for standard two-body SM channels, and no cascade-spectrum recast against the public dwarf likelihood exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate Portalino decay cascade photon spectra with a parton-shower tool (Pythia-based spectra as in PPPC4DMID-style tabulations) for the model's branching fractions, then evaluate them against the released Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods.

members.model_name: Type-II seesaw electroweak-mass axion-like dark matter
members.description: No experimental likelihood exists for the ALP-neutrino matter-effect signature: the card marks likelihood_available 'no' with recasting_needed 'yes', so predicted spectral distortions cannot be statistically compared to oscillation-experiment data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast public atmospheric/long-baseline oscillation datasets (e.g. Super-K, IceCube, DUNE sensitivity releases) into a likelihood for anomalous flavor-dependent matter potentials, then map that onto the model's lambda_a_nu and local ALP density.

members.model_name: Two-component WIMP model with solar internal conversion
members.description: No neutrino-telescope likelihood or recast exists for multicomponent solar annihilation: published IceCube/Super-K/ANTARES solar-WIMP limits assume a single species in capture-annihilation equilibrium, and cannot be applied to the chi_1/chi_2 fluxes with relic fractions f and conversion-modified equilibration without a dedicated recast including neutrino yields and detector response.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine WimpSim/chi-aro-nu per-channel neutrino yield tables for each component mass with the model's N_1(t), N_2(t) annihilation rates, propagate through nuSQuIDS, and recast the public IceCube and Super-K solar effective areas into a joint likelihood over (m_1, m_2, f, sigma_kp, sigma-v_1122), including the non-equilibrium regime where the steady-state mapping fails.

members.model_name: Jovian captured GeV dark matter toy model
members.description: The Fermi-LAT Jupiter gamma-ray analysis (arXiv:2104.02068) is not packaged as a reusable likelihood, and its long-lived-mediator limits must be recast to this model's Borexino-tuned mediator branching ratios before they constrain the 1-4 GeV scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the Jupiter gamma-ray analysis with public Fermi-LAT data and Fermitools, publish the flux upper limits as a tabulated likelihood, and map them onto this model's mediator decay-length and gamma-branching parameter space.

members.model_name: Three-level neutrino-laser majoron dark matter
members.description: No BBN yield capability accepts the enhanced, nonthermal electron-neutrino spectrum from pre-BBN decays: public BBN codes assume thermal Fermi-Dirac neutrinos, so the helium response to the near-factor-three nu_e density enhancement cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN network (PRIMAT or AlterBBN) to take an arbitrary tabulated nu_e distribution, recompute the neutron-proton weak conversion rates with the distorted spectrum, and compare predicted helium and deuterium yields with observed light-element abundances.

members.model_name: SO(10)/SU(5) non-universal gaugino neutralino dark matter
members.description: All experimental comparisons in the card are frozen at 2011: WMAP relic band, CDMS-II/XENON100 sigma_SI limits, Super-K/IceCube solar-neutrino bounds, and pre-Higgs-discovery collider constraints; no assembled modern likelihood pipeline (Planck relic density, LZ/XENONnT direct detection, current IceCube SD limits, LHC Run-2 plus m_h=125 GeV) has been applied to the NUGM -1/2:-3/2:1 gaugino-ratio parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the scan with a public chain: SoftSUSY or ISAJET spectra for the fixed gaugino ratio, micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2/sigma_SI/sigma_SD against Planck and DDCalc (LZ, XENONnT) likelihoods, IceCube solar-capture limits via the DDCalc/nulike machinery, and SModelS plus HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals for collider and Higgs-mass viability, as done in GAMBIT-style MSSM global fits.

members.model_name: Oscillating asymmetric dark matter (fermion variant)
members.description: No modern likelihood recast exists for the regenerated-annihilation signal: the card relies on source-era WMAP CMB, BBN, and stacked Fermi dwarf bounds reweighted by hand, whereas the time-dependent anti-DM fraction requires feeding an annihilation-rate history (not a constant <sigma v>) into current Planck energy-injection and Fermi dwarf likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an exotic-energy-injection pipeline (DarkHistory or ExoCLASS/CLASS with Planck 2018 likelihoods) to accept the oscillation-modulated annihilation-rate history, and reweight the current Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal combined likelihood by the present-day anti-DM fraction for the b bbar and leptonic final states.

members.model_name: Non-SUSY SO(10) triplet fermion dark matter
members.description: The indirect-detection constraint near the triplet resonance is only quoted from related work: no implemented likelihood evaluates Sommerfeld-enhanced W+W- annihilation at ~2.7 TeV against Fermi-LAT dwarf, MAGIC, antiproton, and CMB energy-injection data for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire Fermi-LAT public dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods and the combined Fermi+MAGIC limits to multi-TeV W+W- spectra (with electroweak corrections from PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra), plus a Planck p_ann CMB check, parameterized by the Sommerfeld-corrected <sigma v>_WW from gap_1.

members.model_name: Double-inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No extended-mass-function constraint likelihood exists for the two-peak PBH spectrum: microlensing (including the wave-optics/finite-source weakening of Subaru/HSC limits the model relies on), femtolensing, Hawking-evaporation gamma rays, CMB accretion, and LIGO merger-rate constraints are only available as monochromatic exclusion curves, which the card says cannot validly be applied point-by-point to a broad mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an extended-mass-function recast package on top of a digitized PBH bound compilation (PBHbounds-style): implement the Carr-type integrated constraint conversion for f_PBH(M), recompute the HSC microlensing event rate with wave-optics and finite-source corrections, and add an accretion-modeling-marginalized CMB likelihood and a PBH-binary merger-rate likelihood for the stellar-mass peak.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw NMSSM sneutrino WIMP dark matter
members.description: The paper's composite likelihood scan is not reproducible as released: the exact priors, the joint Planck relic + XENON-1T SI/SD + Fermi-LAT dwarf + LHC Higgs/sparticle likelihood glue, and the ISS-NMSSM SARAH model files were not published, and the direct-detection term is XENON-1T-era rather than current LZ/XENONnT limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the pipeline openly: regenerate the ISS-NMSSM in SARAH/SPheno, couple micrOMEGAs to DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT), the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood, and HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals plus SModelS for the collider terms, then rerun the MultiNest scan and validate against the paper's profile-likelihood islands.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle dark matter from N>1 string-wall annihilation
members.description: No ready-to-use likelihood accepts this model's peaked Omega_GW(f) template in the 10^-16 to 10^-14 Hz CMB/astrometry band or the PTA band; existing bounds assume power-law spectra, which the card's caveats flag as inappropriate for the peaked wall-annihilation spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the peaked wall-annihilation Omega_GW(f) template as a custom spectrum in a PTA analysis framework (e.g. PTArcade/enterprise on NANOGrav data) and recast the Planck and BICEP/Keck ultra-low-frequency GW and astrometry bounds for monochromatic/peaked spectra, publishing constraint tables in the (V, epsilon_b, N, m_a) plane.

members.model_name: Bouncing multicomponent singlet fermion-pNGB dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray likelihood is attached to the enhanced present-day annihilation prediction: the route lists the gamma-ray likelihood as unavailable, so the above-thermal <sigma v>_0 values from bouncing freeze-out cannot be tested against dwarf-galaxy or Galactic Center data, including the nonstandard kinematics of semi-annihilation final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate photon spectra for the h_i-mediated annihilation and semi-annihilation channels (micrOMEGAs or PPPC4DMID tables, with the boosted single-scalar kinematics for semi-annihilation) and evaluate them against the published Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods with component-density-squared weighting.

members.model_name: High-scale-inflation Q-ball dark matter and baryogenesis scenario
members.description: No Q-ball-specific direct-search likelihood exists: the IceCube/Baksan reach is obtained by reusing subrelativistic magnetic-monopole flux limits with an assumed detection efficiency (eta = 1 or 0.1), while the actual nucleon-dissociation energy-deposition signature of an electrically neutral new-type Q ball in these detectors has never been modeled or turned into a limit.
members.proposed_resolution: Model the KKST nucleon-dissociation light yield of a subrelativistic Q-ball track in IceCube-like and Baksan-like detectors as a function of Q_N and velocity, derive the detection efficiency, and publish a flux likelihood on the (Q_N, F_Q) plane that replaces the monopole-limit proxy in con_qball_icecube_baksan.

members.model_name: QCD-confinement induced scalar dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable exclusion data or likelihood exists for comparing the QCD-scalar (m_phi, M, f) parameter space against fifth-force and astrophysical photon-decay limits; the constraints exist only as undigitized figure-level curves in the source paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the Fig. 1 dark-matter-preferred and exclusion curves from arXiv:1911.01050, assemble the underlying fifth-force (Eot-Wash-type) and photon-search (X-ray/gamma-ray line) datasets, and implement them as reusable limit curves or likelihoods over (m_phi, M, f) in a light-scalar recast module.

members.model_name: R-parity-violating gravitino decay dark matter
members.description: No reusable gamma-ray likelihood for decaying gravitino dark matter: Fermi-LAT line-search limits exist only as published exclusion curves, and there is no packaged likelihood for the W/Z-fragmentation diffuse continuum in the tau_3/2 - m_3/2 plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Fermi-LAT line-search and isotropic diffuse gamma-ray results into a lifetime-versus-mass likelihood table using a Milky Way decay J-factor plus the cosmological redshifted contribution, combining line and continuum channels with fragmentation spectra from PYTHIA or PPPC-style tables.

members.model_name: Secluded WIMP with right-handed neutrino mediator
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood exists for the cascade annihilation signal chi chi -> N_R N_R followed by N_R decays through the small neutrino Yukawa; the model-specific final-state spectra (neutrino/Higgs branching dependent) have not been computed or confronted with gamma-ray or neutrino-telescope data.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the boosted two-step cascade spectra (chi chi -> N_R N_R -> SM via L H N_R) with PYTHIA showering, then recast Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and IceCube likelihoods onto the resulting photon and neutrino spectra as a function of m_chi, m_NR, and branching fractions.

members.model_name: Secluded singlet-fermion WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No combined lifetime/flavor likelihood exists for the Higgs-mixed metastable scalar phi: the narrow allowed MeV windows (mixing ~1e-7 to 1e-8) are quoted from historical rare-K missing-energy, gamma-ray, and BBN arguments rather than computed against modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast modern light-scalar constraints (NA62 K -> pi + invisible, LHCb/Belle II, and BBN injection via ACROPOLIS) onto the (m_phi, lambda_1) plane using existing dark-scalar recast frameworks such as DarkCast-style mappings for Higgs-mixed scalars, producing a reusable lifetime-mixing likelihood.

members.model_name: Secluded singlet-fermion WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No direct-detection or indirect-detection likelihood is implemented for this model: the spin-independent cross section through Higgs mixing and the cascade annihilation spectra chi chi -> phi phi -> SM SM have not been confronted with current detector or gamma-ray data.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from the Higgs-portal mixing and evaluate it against public LZ/XENONnT likelihoods (e.g. via DDCalc), and generate the two-step cascade photon spectra with PYTHIA for a Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood recast as a function of m_chi and m_phi.

members.model_name: Secluded Dirac WIMP with U(1) prime vector mediator
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood exists for the secluded cascade signal chi chi -> V V with V decaying through kinetic mixing, in either the GeV-scale gamma-ray regime or the MeV/511 keV benchmark; the source's constraints are qualitative quotes rather than a computed likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the boosted V -> SM cascade photon and positron spectra (PYTHIA above the GeV scale, analytic leptonic spectra in the MeV regime) and recast Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal, INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV, and CMB energy-injection likelihoods as functions of m_chi, m_V, and epsilon.

members.model_name: Late scalar-decay Wino/Higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: No direct- or indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the nonthermally populated Wino/Higgsino benchmark; con_nonthermal_detection_recast is only figure-level context from related nonthermal CMSSM studies, not a spectrum-specific exclusion for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI and <sigma v> for the Wino/Higgsino spectrum with DarkSUSY or micrOMEGAs and confront them with current LZ limits via DDCalc and Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and H.E.S.S. Galactic-center likelihoods, rescaling rates by the nonthermal relic fraction.

members.model_name: PAMELA-favored NMSSM neutralino with light pseudoscalar resonance
members.description: No cosmic-ray or gamma-ray likelihood exists for the PAMELA-favored benchmarks: the positron/antiproton comparison and the Fermi-LAT gamma tension are source-era plot-level statements (likelihood_available: no for both constraints), with no modern AMS-02/Fermi recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the a2-resonance annihilation to a1 h1 with mu-rich final states against AMS-02 positron-fraction and Fermi-LAT diffuse/dwarf likelihoods using a public propagation code and published likelihood tables, scanning halo-profile and boost-factor systematics.

members.model_name: Axion-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No coded gamma-ray line likelihood is attached to the model's critical observable: the Fermi 130/135 GeV line target is only a historical cross-section window with likelihood_available marked no and explicit halo-profile dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a likelihood from current Fermi-LAT Galactic-center line-search results over <sigma v>_gamma gamma (and the Z gamma companion) as a function of m_chi, with an Einasto/NFW J-factor nuisance parameter, replacing the fixed 1.27-2.27e-27 cm^3/s historical target.

members.model_name: Broken U(1) Majorana dark matter with short-lived PGB scenario
members.description: No gamma-ray likelihood exists for the box-shaped spectrum from chi chi -> eta rho with in-flight eta -> gamma gamma decay: the card only records the paper's replacement rule for adapting Fermi-LAT equal-scalar box limits (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes), which does not cover general mass ratios or current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's box spectrum dN/dE through the public Fermi-LAT Galactic-center data and instrument response (e.g., via gammapy or the Fermi ScienceTools) for the model's M_chi, m_rho, m_phi grid, releasing a tabulated likelihood in (M_chi, m_phi/M_chi, Br(phi->gamma gamma)).

members.model_name: Hidden-sector self-interacting dark matter with light vector mediator
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the joint Galactic-center gamma-ray excess plus AMS-02/PAMELA positron fit that the model targets (route likelihoods list is empty; ams02_positron_constraint is only approximate), so compatibility claims cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a published GC-excess spectral likelihood with background covariance and an AMS-02 positron-fraction likelihood, evaluated on GALPROP outputs while marginalizing over propagation and pulsar-background parameters.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated Q-ball dark matter
members.description: No digitized BAKSAN/IceCube (or Baikal/KM3NeT) flux-limit curves or slow-particle-trigger detection likelihood exist for KKST-like Q-balls, so the flux-versus-cross-section exclusion in the (Q, M_F, m_3/2) plane cannot be evaluated numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published BAKSAN and IceCube slow-monopole/Q-ball flux limits (the primary paper's Fig. 3 overlay), encode them as a flux-limit lookup versus sigma_Q, and combine with published slow-particle trigger efficiencies to build a simple Poisson likelihood for large-volume telescopes.

members.model_name: Boosted two-component pseudoscalar-mediated dark matter
members.description: No IceCube likelihood or detector-response recast is implemented for boosted-chi scattering: predicting PeV shower plus lower-energy secondary event spectra and shower/track topology from the chi-nucleon cross section requires an effective-area and deposited-energy model that the card does not provide.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an event-rate calculator from the public IceCube HESE effective areas and data release, folding the boosted-chi flux with the pseudoscalar-mediated chi-nucleon deep-inelastic cross section into deposited-energy and topology distributions, and wrap it as a Poisson likelihood validated against the source m_a = 12 and 80 GeV benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Boosted two-component pseudoscalar-mediated dark matter
members.description: No packaged Fermi-LAT Galactic Center excess likelihood exists for the light-chi annihilation channel (chi chi -> b bbar via the pseudoscalar), so the 30-40 GeV benchmark fit cannot be reproduced quantitatively with background-model uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast a published GC-excess spectrum with full covariance (e.g. the Calore-Cholis-Weniger style spectral covariance) into a likelihood over (m_chi, <sigma v>, f_chi, branching fractions), with the b-bbar spectra generated by PPPC4DMID or Pythia tables.

members.model_name: Majorana fermion dark matter with 750 GeV quark-coupled pseudoscalar portal
members.description: No implemented Fermi-LAT likelihood recast exists for this pseudoscalar-portal Majorana model: the public dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods must be combined with b-bbar/tau continuum spectra and the loop-level gamma-line channel while accounting for the strong velocity dependence of pseudoscalar-mediated annihilation, which the standard velocity-independent dwarf limits do not cover.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that feeds PPPC4DMID (or Pythia-generated) b-bbar/tau and gamma-gamma spectra into the released Fermi-LAT six-year dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods, with the annihilation cross section evaluated at dwarf versus Galactic-center velocity dispersions for the s-channel pseudoscalar amplitude, and include the Fermi line-search likelihood for <sigma v>_gamma_gamma.

members.model_name: Vector dark matter with fermionic top-partner co-annihilation model
members.description: No collider recast or likelihood exists for the compressed fermionic top partner with vector dark matter: existing SUSY stop compressed-spectrum limits do not apply because production cross sections and decay kinematics differ for a color-triplet fermion, and the Higgs-portal direct-detection constraint on lambda_VVHH is likewise not implemented as a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO model for the vector-DM plus fermionic top partner Lagrangian, generate compressed-spectrum signal events with MadGraph+Pythia, recast LHC Run 2 soft-object and monojet searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis, and add a DDCalc-based Higgs-portal spin-independent likelihood for lambda_VVHH, combined into one joint likelihood over (m_V, m_T, Delta m).

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudoscalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: No reusable Fermi Galactic Center gamma-ray likelihood or per-channel <sigma v> limit tables exist for the mediator-mixing-weighted SM final states, so the indirect-detection route cannot produce quantitative pass/fail results.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Fermi LAT Galactic Center and dwarf-spheroidal limits into per-channel <sigma v>(m_d) tables (using the public Fermi dSph likelihood release) and weight them by the MicrOMEGAs branching fractions of each scan point.

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model II
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the DAMPE TeV e+e- spectral feature, and the combined indirect recast (DAMPE, AMS-02, CMB energy injection, IceCube) needed to bound <sigma v>_ee for this model is not packaged and predates current cosmic-ray data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned DAMPE electron-plus-positron likelihood with the published energy resolution, propagate the e+e- injection with GALPROP or DRAGON, and combine with CMB energy-injection limits via ExoCLASS and Planck to update the allowed <sigma v>_ee versus m_chi region.

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline confronts the model's internal-bremsstrahlung gamma-ray signal (N1 N1 -> l l gamma via inert-scalar exchange, with the two-body channel p-wave suppressed) with indirect-detection data; the card lists the constraint with likelihood_available: no and the step was not run.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the internal-bremsstrahlung spectrum from the micrOMEGAs/MadDM model implementation over the (m_N1, m_eta, y) scan and feed it to the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood (and H.E.S.S. Galactic-center limits for multi-TeV masses).

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray indirect-detection likelihood is available to recast continuum limits (Fermi-LAT dwarf spheroidal style) onto the inert scalar's WW/ZZ/hh annihilation channels; the card marks the gamma-ray recast unavailable and con_inert_scalar_indirect has likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple micrOMEGAs-computed <sigma v> and branching fractions to the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal binned likelihoods (e.g. via MadDM's indirect-detection likelihood module or the released Fermi likelihood tables), producing per-channel limits for WW, ZZ, and hh final states over the 50 GeV-20 TeV mass windows.

members.model_name: Z3-stabilized scalar dark matter in neutrinophilic THDM
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for this model's annihilation final states: Fermi-LAT dwarf limits were not rerun for the H3-mediated b-bbar cascade spectra (Scenarios II/IV), and no IceCube neutrino-line likelihood is attached for the neutrinophilic Scenario III final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute cascade gamma-ray spectra for X X* -> H3 H3 -> 4b with PPPC4DMID/Pythia boosting and run them through the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihood (e.g. via MadDM), and recast IceCube/ANTARES neutrino-line searches for the Scenario III nu-nubar-dominated states.

members.model_name: Gauged two-Higgs-doublet scalar D dark matter
members.description: Inert-doublet direct-detection, indirect-detection, and LHC search limits used as proxies (LUX/XENON, Fermi/AMS, monojet, disappearing tracks) have no G2HDM recast: the gauge-origin stabilization and extra SU(2)_H states change production and decay topologies, and the card marks both constraints as recast_required with only partial likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline: generate G2HDM signal events with MadGraph using the gap_1 model files and pass them through public recast frameworks (MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE for monojet and inert-scalar searches; DDCalc for XENON/LZ; likelihood from Planck Omega h2), producing combined exclusion contours in the (m_D, lambda_L, splitting) space.

members.model_name: Complex singlet scalar dark matter with restored CP and Z2
members.description: No assembled statistical pipeline applies the XENON1T spin-independent limit and the Fermi-LAT/AMS-02/Planck annihilation constraints to this model with the required f_X (subcomponent) rescaling of local density and annihilation rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire micrOMEGAs outputs (Omega_X h^2, sigma_SI, sigma v with branching fractions) into DDCalc for the XENON1T likelihood and the public Fermi-LAT dwarf and Planck f_eff likelihoods, applying f_X scaling for direct detection and f_X^2 scaling for annihilation signals.

members.model_name: Asymptotically safe quintuplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No implemented gamma-ray likelihood recast exists for quintuplet annihilation: the Sommerfeld-enhanced continuum plus line spectra with per-flavor 1/N_F density suppression have not been run through dwarf or Galactic Center likelihoods, so the exclusion is only qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine electroweak-corrected annihilation spectra (PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra) with the Sommerfeld-enhanced cross section and feed them through the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood stack (and published Galactic Center line limits), scanning halo-profile and J-factor systematics over (N_F, M_DM).

members.model_name: Asymptotically safe triplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood pipeline combines the public Fermi-LAT/MAGIC dwarf-galaxy likelihoods with Sommerfeld-enhanced WW/ZZ annihilation spectra and the 1/N_F per-flavor density suppression, so the dwarf gamma-ray constraint (including resonance regions and J-factor uncertainties) is only applied qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood wrapper that feeds electroweak-corrected annihilation spectra (from PPPC4DMID-style tables) with velocity-dependent Sommerfeld factors and 1/N_F^2-scaled rates summed over flavors into the published Fermi-LAT dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods, marginalizing over J-factor uncertainties.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet Z2-odd scalar dark matter in a lepton-specific U(1)_X two-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: No Fermi-LAT dwarf-galaxy likelihood recast exists for this model's p-wave-dominated annihilation to charged leptons through exotic-lepton exchange; the paper only estimates cross sections, so the indirect-detection constraint cannot be evaluated quantitatively across the scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the present-day velocity-averaged cross section including the p-wave suppression with a dwarf-appropriate velocity distribution, generate the lepton-channel gamma-ray spectra with PPPC4DMID or micrOMEGAs, and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector Dirac fermion self-interacting dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or recast exists for the sub-GeV hidden fermion with a light dark-photon mediator; XENON1T electron-recoil and PandaX-II light-mediator limits have not been mapped onto (epsilon, m_C, m_D) for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast XENON1T/XENONnT electron-recoil data with DarkELF/QEdark-style form factors and PandaX-II light-mediator nuclear-recoil limits into a likelihood over (m_D, m_C, epsilon), including the freeze-in relic fraction as the local-density normalization.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal real scalar dark matter with vector-like leptons
members.description: Indirect-detection limits cannot be evaluated for the mixed lambda_L/lambda_R case: no photon spectra including virtual internal bremsstrahlung and loop-induced gamma lines have been computed for both chiral couplings, and no Fermi-LAT/H.E.S.S. line or AMS positron likelihood recast exists beyond no-mixing guidance values.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the 2->2 and 2->3 (mu mu gamma internal bremsstrahlung) and loop gamma-gamma spectra with both couplings (extending MadDM or the Bringmann et al. lepton-portal spectra), then recast the Fermi-LAT line search, H.E.S.S. inner-halo, and AMS-02 positron likelihoods onto the (m_X, m_E1/m_X, lambda_L, lambda_R) space.

members.model_name: U(1)_{A Y + B q} vector-portal dark fermion model
members.description: No likelihood is available for the direct-detection or indirect-detection comparisons (likelihood_available is 'no' for both constraints); the paper's exclusions are digitized curve overlays, preventing a statistically meaningful combined scan of the (m_chi, M_Z', g_x) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the micrOMEGAs output to DDCalc (for XENON/LUX/PandaX spin-independent likelihoods) and to published Fermi dwarf-spheroidal and Planck energy-injection likelihood tables weighted by the model's SM-fermion branching fractions, e.g. within a GAMBIT-style global fit.

members.model_name: Lowest-energy higgson WIMP
members.description: No indirect- or direct-detection likelihood is packaged for the model: the dwarf-spheroidal comparison is a by-eye consistency statement and the Xe limits are quoted reaches, so the g4 likelihood step has nothing to evaluate against.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood (gamLike-style) with model annihilation spectra to WW/ZZ and a DDCalc-style LZ/XENONnT likelihood into the route, consuming sigma_v and sigma_SI from the upstream steps.

members.model_name: SU(2)_L quintet fermion minimal dark matter with Higgs inflation
members.description: The AMS-02 antiproton constraint on the 13.6 TeV quintet is only quoted qualitatively from the literature; no recast pipeline combining Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation spectra, Galactic propagation, and an AMS-02 antiproton likelihood exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the recast by feeding Sommerfeld-corrected WW/ZZ annihilation spectra (PPPC4DMID-style tables with electroweak corrections) through DRAGON or GALPROP propagation with marginalized propagation parameters into a published AMS-02 antiproton likelihood.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter with Higgs portal
members.description: The indirect-detection test lacks an assembled pipeline: the pion-rich cascade gamma-ray spectrum from mediator decays (2 m_pi0 < m_phi < M) and its confrontation with Fermi-LAT dwarf/GC likelihoods and CTA projections must be reconstructed by hand, and the low-mediator-mass e+e- channel (AMS-02) is not covered at all.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate boosted cascade spectra for phi decays via Higgs-portal mixing (Pythia/Hazma for the pion channels), convolve with halo J factors, and wire into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods and ctools/gammapy CTA sensitivity, including the Sommerfeld-enhanced late-time <sigma v>.

members.model_name: Bino-like neutralino CDM with damping cutoff
members.description: No public likelihood connects the sub-Earth-mass microhalo cutoff mass M_min to observational data (both card constraints have likelihood_available: no, and the route lists no public likelihood), so the predicted cutoff cannot be confronted with data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood tying M_min to observables sensitive to Earth-mass microhalos, e.g. pulsar-timing-array microhalo transit limits or gamma-ray annihilation boost-factor constraints, calibrated with microhalo survival simulations.

members.model_name: Multispecies hidden gauged SU(3) dark matter benchmark model
members.description: No current-generation likelihood recast exists for the relic-fraction-weighted multi-species signals: the direct-detection comparison uses the 2018 XENON1T one-ton-year rate limit rather than LZ/XENONnT likelihoods with per-species rate summing, and the Fermi-LAT dwarf W+W- limit was applied as a scaled cross-section comparison without rerunning any dwarf likelihood with the squared-fractional-abundance weighting.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the summed-species recoil rate (sigma_iN weighted by Omega_i/Omega_DM) into a public direct-detection likelihood tool (e.g. DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT data) and the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods with (Omega_i/Omega_DM)^2-scaled annihilation rates per component.

members.model_name: Hypercharge Impure Split Dirac Supersymmetry Higgsino dark matter
members.description: No assembled indirect-detection likelihood for the near-TeV Higgsino in this framework: the annihilation cross section including Sommerfeld enhancement near mu ~ 1.1 TeV is not computed by the stock micrOMEGAs pipeline, and AMS-02 antiproton and gamma-ray/CTA likelihoods are not attached to the route, so current indirect limits on the co-annihilating pseudo-Dirac spectrum cannot be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine published Sommerfeld-corrected Higgsino annihilation spectra (electroweak-corrected PPPC-style tables) with public AMS-02 antiproton and Fermi/H.E.S.S./CTA gamma-ray likelihoods, marginalizing over halo profile and cosmic-ray propagation, to produce a reusable constraint on (mu, <sigma v>).

members.model_name: Fermionic U(1)_X dark matter with Higgs charge and kinetic mixing
members.description: No collider/electroweak-precision likelihood exists for this model's visible sector: the LEP Z-pole and LHC dilepton bounds on epsilon and q_H are mapped by hand from generic kinetic-mixing literature, while the Higgs U(1)_X charge alters Z-Z' mixing and branching ratios relative to those references.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC dilepton searches with a ZPEED-style Z' likelihood extended to the q_H-modified fermion couplings, and add electroweak-precision (S,T,U / Z-pole) constraints on the Z-Z' mixing angle as an analytic likelihood, validated against the small-q_H bound quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: Neutralino dark matter from heavy gravitino decay
members.description: Direct- and indirect-detection viability of the Wino/Higgsino-rich nonthermal neutralino is asserted only from historical (CDMS-era, pre-Fermi) benchmarks; no modern combined recast of current direct-detection and indirect-search likelihoods has been applied to the composition-dependent parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Compose an existing pipeline (micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY for sigma_chi-p and <sigma v>, DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, Fermi dwarf-spheroidal and AMS antiproton likelihoods) over the (m_chi, Wino/Higgsino fraction) plane with the nonthermal abundance from gap_1 as input.

members.model_name: Dynamical R-parity breaking SUSYLR unstable gravitino dark matter
members.description: The diffuse gamma-ray constraint on gravitino -> photon + neutrino is EGRET-era only; no modern Fermi-LAT likelihood or recast exists for the GeV-scale endpoint spectrum implied by m_3/2 ~ 2 GeV and |U| ~ 1e-6 to 1e-7.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the photon spectrum of the two-body photon+neutrino channel (plus W/Z/h modes where open) and recast published Fermi-LAT isotropic diffuse and Galactic-halo decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits onto the (m_3/2, |U|) plane, packaging the result as a reusable lifetime likelihood.

members.model_name: AMSB nonthermal wino dark matter from gravitino decay
members.description: No machine-readable direct- or indirect-detection likelihood is attached to the wino detection route: the paper supplies only reach curves, so the computed sigma_SI and annihilation rates cannot be turned into quantitative exclusions for full-fraction or rescaled wino CDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the DarkSUSY/IsaReD cross-section outputs into DDCalc for current xenon-experiment direct-detection likelihoods, and recast the wino annihilation flux against published Fermi dwarf-spheroidal and H.E.S.S. Galactic-center gamma-ray likelihoods, rescaling both by the local wino fraction.

members.model_name: AMSB nonthermal wino dark matter from scalar-field decay
members.description: Wino direct and indirect detection constraints exist only as non-machine-readable reach curves; no experiment likelihood is available to evaluate sigma_SI and indirect rates for the nonthermal wino scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the predicted sigma_SI through a public direct-detection likelihood package such as DDCalc with current xenon-experiment likelihoods, and use published wino indirect-detection gamma-ray likelihoods for the full-fraction case.

members.model_name: Inert doublet model new viable region
members.description: No assembled modern astroparticle likelihood for the new M_W-160 GeV IDM window: the 2010 viability region was judged against Xenon100-era direct-detection bounds and pre-2011 gamma-ray data, and the card explicitly flags that updated xenon limits and Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihoods require a fresh recast that has not been wired to the micrOMEGAs-level predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the public micrOMEGAs IDM implementation over the gauge-boson-cancellation region with the measured 125 GeV Higgs mass, and pipe sigma_SI into DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT likelihoods) and the W+W-/ZZ annihilation spectra into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood tables.

members.model_name: Spin-3/2 effective dark matter
members.description: The antiproton constraint uses PAMELA-era antiproton/proton data with no likelihood; no operator-specific pipeline exists that generates annihilation spectra and propagates them to an AMS-02 antiproton likelihood with controlled propagation systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate per-operator annihilation spectra with PYTHIA (or PPPC4DMID tables for fermionic final states), propagate with GALPROP/DRAGON, and evaluate against the public AMS-02 antiproton likelihood including correlated systematics.

members.model_name: Degenerate-particle Majorana dark matter with enhanced internal bremsstrahlung
members.description: No public likelihood or recast pipeline exists for confronting the enhanced sharp internal-bremsstrahlung gamma-ray spectrum with CTA/GAMMA-400 sensitivities, nor for the AMS positron and direct-search compatibility checks; both constraints on the card have likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer that folds the analytic l l gamma spectrum through published CTA and GAMMA-400 instrument-response and sensitivity curves for spectral-feature searches (e.g. within a gamma-ray likelihood framework such as gammapy-based CTA line-search likelihoods), and add digitized AMS-02 positron and direct-detection limits as auxiliary constraint terms.

members.model_name: Long-lived scalar A neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No public, reusable IceCube/ANTARES/KM3NeT likelihood (effective areas, energy/angular response, backgrounds) exists to constrain this model's monochromatic neutrino line and halo-correlated anisotropy; the card's IceCube limits are digitized lifetime curves from a thermal line search, not a recastable likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module from published IceCube effective areas and the 2023 neutrino-line search data release, including an angular-power template for the Galactic-halo decay morphology, so that (M_A, tau_A) maps directly to a likelihood over line energy and sky distribution.

members.model_name: Dark left-right scotino dark matter
members.description: No current indirect-detection likelihood is wired for this model: the AMS-02 positron fit and Fermi-LAT/HESS gamma-ray consistency are quoted from the 2015 paper benchmark with an assumed local boost factor of 6400, and no reusable likelihood over (m_chi, c_d, boost) exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast with current AMS-02 positron data and Fermi-LAT/HESS limits using published likelihood tabulations (e.g. MadDM's indirect-detection likelihoods or LikeDM) applied to the muon-channel internal-bremsstrahlung spectra, treating the local-overdensity boost as a nuisance parameter.

members.model_name: Two-portal fermionic dark matter model
members.description: No ready-to-run combined likelihood exists for this model over LUX/XENON recoil limits, the LHC invisible-Higgs width, and the Fermi-LAT Galactic-center excess; the paper's allowed regions are overlay-style exclusions with no rerun likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire DDCalc (or equivalent) xenon likelihoods, the ATLAS/CMS invisible-Higgs-width bound, and a published Fermi GCE spectral likelihood into a joint scan over (m_chi, m_Zprime, m_hprime, g_prime, alpha), updating from LUX/XENON100 to current xenon exposures.

members.model_name: Thermal wino dark matter with inelastic kinetic decoupling
members.description: No implemented likelihood connects the wino prediction to data: neither an indirect-detection gamma-ray likelihood that propagates the cutoff-dependent subhalo boost factor into Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation limits, nor a direct-detection likelihood for the loop-induced sigma_SI near the neutrino background, has been reconstructed for this route.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Fermi-LAT dwarf/Galactic-halo and H.E.S.S./CTA Galactic-center likelihoods for the ~3 TeV Sommerfeld-enhanced wino annihilation spectrum with the boost factor (and its uncertainty) from the calibrated subhalo model, and implement the loop-level sigma_SI in a direct-detection likelihood tool such as DDCalc against current xenon exposures.

members.model_name: Secluded vector dark matter with hidden scalar mediator
members.description: The combined constraint comparison is only qualitative: XENON1T/LZ direct-detection contours and the BBN reheating screen exist as figures in the paper, and no pipeline wires the public Fermi-LAT dSph likelihood and Planck energy-injection bound to the model's cascade spectra for a quantitative scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI analytically from (alpha, g_dm, m_X, m_S) and compare against the published XENON1T/LZ limit curves, interface the cascade photon spectra to the public Fermi-LAT dSph bin-by-bin likelihoods and Planck f_eff injection bound, and encode the tau_S < 0.03 s BBN screen, producing pass-fail-with-likelihood flags across the parameter space.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the model's cascade annihilation: applying Fermi-LAT dwarf limits to S S -> Z' Z' with B-L (neutrino-rich) Z-prime branching fractions requires computing the boosted photon spectrum per final state, which the card only encodes qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Use MadDM or PPPC4DMID spectra boosted through the Z' two-body cascade to build the gamma-ray spectrum for B-L branching fractions, then evaluate the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods to produce <sigma v>_0 limits as a function of (m_S, m_Z_prime).

members.model_name: Low-mass weakly coupled B-L gauge boson Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: CMB energy-injection and AMS-02 antiproton constraints are imported from analyses assuming 100% dark-photon-like branching; no recast exists that uses the actual Z_BL branching fractions to SM fermions (including right-handed neutrinos) and the Sommerfeld-enhanced chi chi -> Z_BL Z_BL annihilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute Z_BL partial widths from the B-L charges, derive the cascade annihilation spectra (e.g. with PPPC4DMID-style tables reweighted by BR(Z_BL -> f fbar)), compute f_eff for the Planck annihilation bound and rerun an AMS-02 antiproton limit with the corrected spectra, including the Sommerfeld factor for the light mediator.

members.model_name: Complex vector condensate dark matter with magnetic dipole coupling
members.description: No model-specific likelihood connects the condensate-sourced magnetic field to data: the paper compares only to a quoted 1e-19 G to 1e-9 G window, without applying Planck PMF likelihoods or blazar/gamma-ray intergalactic-field constraints to the model's (B_0, coherence length, formation redshift) parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the field spectrum is available, map (B_0, coherence length) onto the published Planck PMF constraint machinery and gamma-ray cascade lower bounds, packaging the comparison as a reusable likelihood over (M, lambda, rho_Q, formation time).

members.model_name: Pico-charged particles from dark matter decay
members.description: No likelihood confronts the trapped C anti-C annihilation prediction with INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV line intensity and morphology data or with Voyager/in-flight-annihilation positron bounds; the paper's m_C < 12 MeV guidance is only a summary statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine the annihilation morphology from the gap_1 transport model with the INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV sky-map likelihood and published positron injection-energy constraints into a recast module over (m_C, q_C, f), recovering the m_C < 12 MeV positron-safety condition.

members.model_name: Spiked extended primordial black-hole mass-function dark matter
members.description: No end-to-end evaporation constraint pipeline exists for the low-mass tail of the spiked distribution: the paper computes no evaporation spectrum, and gamma-ray/BBN/relic bounds are only available as monochromatic compilation curves rather than a likelihood over the extended f_PBH(M).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate Hawking spectra for the low-mass component with BlackHawk, integrate over the spiked mass function, and compare against extragalactic/Galactic gamma-ray background data (and relic-abundance bookkeeping for Planck-mass relics), wrapping the result as a reusable evaporation recast over arbitrary mass functions.

members.model_name: Superheavy lepton dark matter decaying through virtual black holes
members.description: No UHECR spectrum/composition likelihood or IceCube/Baikal neutrino likelihood is available for this decaying superheavy-lepton model; the card gives only qualitative lifetime windows (tau_L/t_U ~ 1e3-1e4) with no numeric exclusion contour.
members.proposed_resolution: Propagate the HDMSpectra injection through CRPropa (galactic plus extragalactic components with an NFW halo profile) and recast published Auger/TA UHECR flux limits and IceCube EHE diffuse-neutrino limits on decaying dark matter into a (M_L, tau_L) exclusion, following existing superheavy decaying-DM constraint analyses.

members.model_name: Z_2 complex scalar singlet asymmetric dark matter from CP-violating scatterings
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the residual annihilation phi anti-phi to eta eta with visible eta decays: the eta branching fractions from Higgs mixing, the box/continuum photon spectra, and the asymmetry-weighted flux normalization (proportional to surviving particle times antiparticle densities via r_infty) have not been folded into Fermi-LAT or CTA analyses.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive eta branching fractions from the Higgs-mixing angle, generate the boxed and cascade photon spectra for eta pair final states, weight the flux by the asymmetric densities, and evaluate against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods and CTA galactic-center sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet scalar dark matter assisted by a Y=1 vector-like triplet lepton
members.description: No model-specific direct/indirect-detection likelihood pipeline exists; the source only compares benchmarks to published PandaX-4T/LZ and Fermi-LAT/H.E.S.S. limit curves rather than rerunning current likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the micrOMEGAs sigma_SI and annihilation-cross-section outputs to DDCalc (LZ/PandaX-4T) and published Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihoods to obtain a proper joint constraint on the benchmark scan.

members.model_name: GMSB messenger-sector scalar dark matter
members.description: The HESS Galactic-center interpretation has never been tested against a modern likelihood: no pipeline combines electroweak-corrected 20-30 TeV annihilation spectra with current HESS/Fermi (and projected CTA) Galactic-center data and astrophysical background models.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate NN and H_u H_d channel spectra with HDMSpectra or PPPC4DMID-class tables including electroweak corrections, convolve with NFW/Einasto J-factors, and recast against published HESS inner-halo likelihoods with a diffuse astrophysical background component to test whether the 20-30 TeV window survives.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation Majorana neutrino dark matter with residual U(1)_F parity
members.description: The direct-detection exclusion (55 GeV < m_1 < 175 GeV from XENON100 after r_Omega rescaling) rests on a 2011-era dataset with no likelihood; no recast against modern xenon exposures (which probe orders of magnitude deeper for a Z/Higgs-coupled Majorana fermion) exists, so the currently viable mass window above the top mass is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model through current xenon direct-detection likelihoods (e.g. LZ/XENONnT results via public recasting frameworks), applying the r_Omega relic-fraction rescaling from the freeze-out calculation, to produce an updated exclusion in the (m_1, theta) plane including both spin-independent and spin-dependent channels.

members.model_name: Leptophilic fermion WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: The constraint stage relies on paper-level approximate recasts: no packaged likelihoods exist for the LEP four-fermion bounds on leptophilic mediators, the loop-induced direct-detection limits, or the DAMPE electron/positron peak fit with its assumed 17-35x nearby-subhalo boost, so exclusions cannot be reproduced or updated within the registry.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast package: digitize LEP four-fermion contact-interaction bounds for scalar/pseudoscalar lepton couplings, implement loop-induced nucleon and electron scattering limits via DDCalc-style wrappers of PandaX/XENON/LZ results, and build a DAMPE spectral likelihood (electron injection plus local propagation with GALPROP/DRAGON and an explicit subhalo-boost nuisance parameter), validated against the paper's allowed/excluded operator table.

members.model_name: Leptophilic fermion WIMP with vector mediator
members.description: The constraint stage relies on paper-level approximate recasts: no packaged likelihoods exist for the LEP four-fermion bounds on the leptophilic Z prime, the tree-level and loop-induced direct-detection limits on vector couplings, or the DAMPE electron/positron peak fit with its assumed 17-35x nearby-subhalo boost, so exclusions cannot be reproduced or updated within the registry.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast package: digitize LEP four-fermion contact-interaction bounds for vector/axial-vector lepton couplings, implement spin-independent and helicity-suppressed scattering limits via DDCalc-style wrappers of PandaX/XENON/LZ results, and build a DAMPE spectral likelihood (electron injection plus local propagation with GALPROP/DRAGON and an explicit subhalo-boost nuisance parameter), validated against the paper's allowed/excluded operator table.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No reusable likelihood or recast code exists for the combined constraint set on leptophilic spin-0 mediators: LEP four-fermion contact-interaction limits, loop-induced direct-detection bounds (PandaX/XENON-family), and lepton g-2; the paper applies these only as one-off analytic recasts.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the LEP e+e- -> l+l- contact-interaction likelihood and the loop-level DM-nucleon cross-section mapping in a public recast package (e.g. a GAMBIT/DDCalc module or a standalone likelihood layer over micrOMEGAs output), updated to current LZ/XENONnT limits.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: The DAMPE electron/positron peak interpretation has no quantitative likelihood: the required 17-35 local density boost from a nearby subhalo is an assumed number with no probabilistic model from subhalo statistics, and the spectral fit itself is not distributed as a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a DAMPE e+e- spectral likelihood (peak plus background) coupled to a nearby-subhalo boost prior derived from CDM subhalo catalogs (e.g. from published N-body subhalo mass/spatial distributions), so the boost assumption becomes a marginalizable nuisance parameter.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with vector mediator
members.description: No reusable likelihood or recast code exists for the combined leptophilic Z-prime constraint set: LEP four-fermion contact-interaction limits, loop-induced nucleon and electron scattering bounds, and g-2; the paper applies these as one-off recasts only.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the LEP contact-interaction likelihood and the loop-level DM-nucleon/electron scattering mapping for leptophilic vector mediators in a public recast layer over micrOMEGAs output (e.g. a GAMBIT/DDCalc-style module), updated to current LZ/XENONnT limits.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar WIMP with vector mediator
members.description: The DAMPE electron/positron peak interpretation has no quantitative likelihood: the assumed 17-35 nearby-subhalo density boost has no probabilistic model from subhalo statistics, and the spectral fit is not distributed as a likelihood, which matters doubly here because the p-wave-suppressed <sigma v>_0 must be compared quantitatively to the required rate.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a DAMPE e+e- spectral likelihood coupled to a nearby-subhalo boost prior derived from published CDM subhalo catalogs, so velocity-suppressed models can be quantitatively excluded rather than dismissed by rough rate arguments.

members.model_name: Resonance-scanning Higgs-portal light fermion dark matter
members.description: Existing Higgs-portal likelihood compilations (GAMBIT-style direct-detection, XENON1T, and invisible-Higgs likelihoods) are built for standard fixed-mass Higgs-portal models and have not been recast for a sub-GeV scanned fermion with a decoupled late-time coupling, so obs_subgev_higgs_portal_scattering has only qualitative target status.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the GAMBIT Higgs-portal and invisible-Higgs-width likelihoods at the model's late-time (lambda_h, m_DM) point and add projected sub-GeV low-threshold detector sensitivities (phonon/ionization concepts cited by the card) as forecast likelihood curves for the scanned benchmark region.

members.model_name: Z3 scalar dark matter with semi-production freeze-in
members.description: Indirect-detection constraints are only an illustrative recast of shifted b-bbar limits: no pipeline generates the point-dependent photon spectra of the (semi-)annihilation final states through the Higgs-mixed light mediator and evaluates them against the Planck CMB energy-injection, Fermi-LAT/MAGIC dwarf, and CTA likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate per-point photon spectra for mediator-cascade final states with Pythia/PPPC4DMID (via MadDM or a custom interface), compute f_eff for the Planck energy-injection bound, and evaluate the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood and CTA projection instead of the shifted b-bbar curve.

members.model_name: Split-Supersymmetry neutralino dark matter
members.description: No modern likelihood pipeline is connected to this card: the relic, direct-detection, and indirect-detection constraints are WMAP/CDMS-era targets flagged recasting_needed, so current Planck, XENON/LZ-class, and Fermi-LAT data cannot be applied to the (M_1, M_2, mu) parameter space as encoded.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the split-SUSY electroweakino sector in an existing global-fit framework (e.g., GAMBIT with micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY backends) and evaluate it against Planck Omega h^2, DDCalc direct-detection likelihoods, and Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods, replacing the historical constraint rows.

members.model_name: Asymmetric right-handed sneutrino dark matter in a supersymmetric neutrinophilic Higgs model
members.description: No calculation-to-likelihood pipeline exists for the suppressed indirect signatures: secondary gamma rays and neutrinos produced by cosmic rays scattering on the asymmetric (annihilation-free) sneutrino halo have neither a flux calculator nor a comparison against Fermi/IceCube data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the cosmic-ray-on-DM upscattering flux for the Yukawa-portal couplings (following the related Dirac-sneutrino treatment), fold it with Galactic cosmic-ray and DM density models, and recast against public Fermi-LAT diffuse gamma-ray and IceCube neutrino likelihoods.

members.model_name: Large-volume light modulus dark matter
members.description: No modern MeV gamma-ray likelihood (COMPTEL, INTEGRAL/SPI, including the 511 keV positron channel) is packaged for decaying-dark-matter recasting of this model; the card's constraint is only the paper's analytic comparison to a COMPTEL diffuse-background fit, with likelihood_available: partial.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable decaying-DM likelihood over COMPTEL diffuse and INTEGRAL/SPI line data (photon line at m_phi/2 plus 511 keV injection), parameterized by (m_phi, tau, Omega_phi/Omega_DM) with standard Milky Way halo decay D-factors, and validate against the paper's COMPTEL density-fraction bound.

members.model_name: Nonthermal neutralino dark matter in mirage mediation
members.description: All constraints on the card are 2007-era (WMAP-3 abundance band, XENON10, pre-Fermi indirect prospects, old Higgs/flavor limits) with likelihood_available marked no; no modernized likelihood recast of the mirage-mediation nonthermal region against Planck, LZ/XENONnT/PandaX, LHC, and Fermi/AMS data exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the (M_0, alpha, tan_beta) scan with SoftSUSY plus micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY, applying a Planck relic-density Gaussian, DDCalc likelihoods for current xenon experiments, Fermi dwarf-spheroidal and AMS-02 positron limits for the enhanced <sigma v>, and current Higgs-mass/flavor constraints.

members.model_name: Mixed bino-Higgsino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No assembled multi-channel likelihood exists for the bino-Higgsino parameter space: the card's direct-detection, IceCube/DeepCore solar-capture, and LHC dilepton-edge constraints are all logged with unknown likelihood availability and paper-era (CDMSII/XENON100) data, so WMAP/Planck-compatible mixing regions cannot be scored against modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the existing public components into a joint likelihood for (M_1, M_2, mu, tan beta, m_A): DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT SI and SD likelihoods, DarkSUSY solar capture fed into the nulike IceCube likelihood, and an LHC electroweakino dilepton recast via CheckMATE or SModelS, bracketing the hadronic matrix element f_s as the paper prescribes (a GAMBIT-style scan provides all pieces).

members.model_name: Hylogenesis antibaryonic dark matter with induced nucleon decay
members.description: No ready-to-use likelihood or efficiency table exists for induced nucleon decay in water Cherenkov detectors: standard Super-K nucleon-decay selections assume back-to-back two-body kinematics, while IND mesons carry harder momenta of order the GeV-scale mass splitting, so existing lifetime limits cannot be applied without a dedicated topology recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate IND meson final states (e.g. p psi -> phi* K+ type topologies) in a public water-Cherenkov detector simulation, derive selection efficiencies versus meson momentum, and publish a recast efficiency table or likelihood that maps tau_N_IND in the 1e29-1e32 yr range onto Super-K (and Hyper-K) exposure.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric flavour-vacuum dark matter
members.description: No background-cosmology likelihood pipeline exists for the model: the (m1, m2, theta, K, a0) parameter space has never been confronted with CMB distance priors, BAO, or SNe data, and the card records likelihood_available: no on both constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the fermionic dust and bosonic dark-energy sectors as effective fluids (rho(a), w_eff(a)) in CLASS, and sample (m1, m2, theta, K, a0) against Planck compressed likelihoods, BAO, and Pantheon+ with Cobaya or MontePython.

members.model_name: Ekpyrotic-reheating inflaton-remnant dark matter
members.description: No likelihood of any kind is attached to the model (route lists 'No public likelihood identified'; both constraints have likelihood_available: no): the survival condition is an analytic threshold only, and the card explicitly notes the absence of BBN and CMB energy-injection likelihoods for a TeV remnant whose decay rate can sit just below the 10^-26 s^-1 survival threshold.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model onto existing decaying-dark-matter constraint machinery: feed Gamma_phi and the Yukawa-determined fermionic decay/annihilation spectra into ExoCLASS/DarkAges-style CMB energy-injection likelihoods and published Planck decaying-DM lifetime bounds, and compare Omega_DM h^2 against the Planck measurement instead of the WMAP-era 0.1126 +/- 0.0036 target.

members.model_name: Natural SUSY higgsino-axion dark matter
members.description: No modern experimental likelihoods are bundled for this model: XENON-era direct-detection curves, Fermi dwarf gamma-ray limits, and an LHC compressed-electroweakino recast all need to be assembled and applied with the neutralino-fraction rescaling (linear for direct rates, quadratic for indirect).
members.proposed_resolution: Wire DDCalc (XENONnT/LZ) with Omega_chi rescaling, the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood with (Omega_chi/Omega_DM)^2 flux scaling, and SModelS/CheckMATE soft-lepton compressed-higgsino analyses into the route as reusable likelihood modules.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_x asymmetric Y dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection or gamma-ray likelihood is implemented for the residual symmetric-component annihilation; the card only quotes a WMAP7-style bound and marks likelihood_available no with recasting_needed yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute f_eff from the cascade spectra and evaluate the Planck exotic-energy-injection constraint with ExoCLASS/CLASS plus the Planck likelihood, and recast Fermi continuum limits scaled by the residual symmetric fraction r_infty.

members.model_name: Vector fermion-portal dark matter
members.description: No modern collider recast exists for the heavy vector-like fermion partners with dark-sector decay topologies; only source-era (2014) bounds are recorded, leaving the mediator mass constraint outdated.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the UFO model from gap_1, recast Run-2 LHC searches for third-generation partners plus missing energy with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, and update Higgs-invisible and oblique-parameter constraints with current fits.

members.model_name: Multicomponent OHe and UU dark atoms
members.description: No cosmic-ray likelihood pipeline exists for the subdominant UU++ decay fit: the AMS-02 positron and Fermi diffuse-gamma comparison (f_UU ~ 1e-6, m_UU ~ 1 TeV, tau_UU ~ 1e20 s) was never rerun and likelihood_available is no.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the same-sign dilepton injection spectra from HDMSpectra/PPPC tables, propagate with DRAGON or GALPROP, and wrap AMS-02 positron-flux and Fermi diffuse-gamma data in a likelihood over (f_UU, m_UU, tau_UU, branching fractions).

members.model_name: Light dark photon force dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood is available for confronting the cascade spectra with the Fermi Galactic Center excess, AMS-02 positrons, and dwarf-galaxy limits; the card's indirect constraint has likelihood_available: partial with recasting_needed: yes and states no current likelihoods were rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a multimessenger likelihood suite: a Galactic Center excess spectrum likelihood with halo-profile (J-factor) nuisance parameters, the public Fermi dwarf-galaxy bin-by-bin likelihoods, an AMS-02 positron likelihood with propagation nuisances, and a Planck energy-injection term computed from the gap_1 spectra via an ExoCLASS/DarkHistory-type deposition calculation.

members.model_name: Light dark scalar force dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood pipeline exists to confront the scalar-cascade spectra with the Fermi Galactic Center excess, AMS-02 positrons, dwarf-galaxy limits, CMB energy injection, and the BBN mediator-lifetime bound; all three card constraints require recasting and none were rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood suite combining a Galactic Center excess spectral likelihood with J-factor nuisances, public Fermi dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods, an AMS-02 positron likelihood, a Planck energy-injection term computed from the gap_1 spectra with an ExoCLASS/DarkHistory-type deposition code, and a tau_phi < 1 s BBN cut evaluated from the gap_1 width module.

members.model_name: Accidental complex scalar Z3 dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No Galactic-center gamma-ray likelihood is wired for the semi-annihilation signal into a 44.3 GeV pseudo-Goldstone decaying to b quarks, so the gamma-ray-excess fit at the 51 GeV benchmark cannot be evaluated numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the photon spectrum from the boosted pseudo-Goldstone-to-bb cascade with PPPC4DMID/micrOMEGAs and fit it against a published Galactic-center excess spectrum with covariance matrix (Calore-et-al.-style likelihood) with the J-factor as a nuisance parameter.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant pseudoscalar WIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for ultraheavy (order-PeV and above) dark-matter searches applicable to a stable CP-odd relic with Higgs-portal couplings; the card records likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes for the search recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recasting likelihood from published ultraheavy-DM direct-search and indirect (gamma-ray/neutrino decay) limits as tabulated exclusion surfaces in (M_eta, sigma_nucleon, tau_eta), so both the stable benchmark and CP-violating deformations can be scored.

members.model_name: Charged Q-ball dark matter from B and L direction
members.description: No recast or likelihood exists for charged Q-ball absorption signatures (KKST pion-emission plus electromagnetic signatures) in Super-Kamiokande or IceCube; the card explicitly notes this recast was not performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a flux-based likelihood from published Super-Kamiokande and IceCube monopole/Q-ball slow-particle search results, mapping the Q-ball radius-dependent absorption cross section and pion/photon emission signature onto the reported effective areas and background rates.

members.model_name: Real scalar dark matter with 750 GeV gluon portal mediator
members.description: No implemented indirect-detection likelihood exists for this model: the gg-final-state gamma-ray spectrum must be mapped onto the Fermi-LAT six-year dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods (and the GCE spectral fit), since published dwarf limits are quoted for b-bbar/tau benchmarks and only a conservative rescaling to gluons is sketched in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate gg annihilation spectra with PPPC4DMID or Pythia showering, insert them into the released Fermi-LAT dwarf combined bin-by-bin likelihood with a standard J-factor treatment, and fit the GCE spectrum at the ~60 GeV scalar mass to replace the conservative rescaling.

members.model_name: Real scalar dark matter with 750 GeV quark-coupled portal mediator
members.description: No implemented dwarf-spheroidal likelihood recast exists for this model's b bbar (and tau) annihilation channel, including the velocity-dependence caveat for pseudoscalar-type mediation, so the GCE-favored region cannot be quantitatively confronted with the Fermi-LAT six-year dwarf limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model's annihilation spectrum (from PPPC4DMID tables or Pythia showering of b bbar/tau final states) into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods (e.g. via MadDM's indirect-detection module), with an explicit velocity-averaged cross section for the scalar-vs-pseudoscalar mediator cases.

members.model_name: U(1) B-L freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the radiative decay line of an MeV-mass sterile neutrino: standard keV X-ray line analyses do not cover the ~0.6-5 MeV photon energies implied by M_N1 = 1.2-10 MeV, and the card records photon-line likelihood unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decaying-DM line likelihood from COMPTEL/INTEGRAL-SPI and EGRET/Fermi diffuse-photon data covering 0.1-10 MeV, parameterized in (M_N1, theta) via the standard N1 -> nu gamma rate, and package it as a reusable module.

members.model_name: Minimal SUSY SO(10) benchmark with bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: No assembled modern direct/indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for this benchmark: the card compares only to superseded LUX numbers and quotes IceCube spin-dependent limits without running the released likelihood, so current xenon (LZ/XENONnT-era) and solar-capture constraints are not evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the reconstructed benchmark through micrOMEGAs with DDCalc for current xenon likelihoods and through the public IceCube 79-string solar-WIMP likelihood (nulike), using the benchmark annihilation branching fractions for the capture-annihilation mapping.

members.model_name: Flaxion axion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the flavor-dependent flaxion constraints: the mu -> e a rare-decay bound, stellar-cooling limits, and SN1987A energy-loss bound must each be mapped through the model's U(1)_F charge-dependent lepton and nucleon couplings (C_l/f_a, C_N/f_a), and the card bundles neither the charge-to-coupling mapper listed in required_code_resources nor any likelihood implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flavor-charge coupling mapper (charges plus v_phi/M in, C_l, C_N, and off-diagonal flaxion-fermion couplings out) and attach approximate likelihoods from the published TWIST/rare-decay Br(mu -> e a) < 1.1e-9 limit, red-giant/white-dwarf cooling bounds, and SN1987A cooling bounds, so f_a lower limits can be scanned over charge textures alongside the misalignment abundance.

members.model_name: High-scale SUSY light neutral higgsino dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood is implemented for higgsino annihilation into electroweak final states: the route cannot turn the post-gravitino-decay annihilation cross section plus a halo model into a quantitative gamma-ray reach or exclusion.
