members.proposed_resolution: Recast the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods (and CTA Galactic-center projections) using WW/ZZ/gamma-line spectra from PPPC4DMID-style tables for the higgsino mass range, wired to the model's annihilation cross section and a standard NFW halo parameterization.

members.model_name: U(1)_D dark-sector Majorana WIMP model
members.description: No gamma-ray line likelihood or background model is available for the monoenergetic 40-90 GeV gamma plus Goldstone annihilation signal; the paper gives a target line energy but no recast against Fermi-LAT line-search limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the chi_1 chi_1 -> gamma G^0 annihilation cross section from the model couplings and recast it against the published Fermi-LAT Galactic-halo line-search likelihood (or via MadDM's indirect-detection line module) for E_gamma = M_chi1 in the 40-90 GeV window.

members.model_name: SU(2) hidden vector dark matter from dark freeze-out
members.description: No reusable galactic-center-excess likelihood exists for the model's Sommerfeld-enhanced 4-fermion cascade final state (AA -> ss/As with s -> SM, e.g. 4-tau for 2 m_tau < m_s < 2 m_b); the paper's GCE comparison is a benchmark fit, not a recastable likelihood, and the self-interaction check uses only a broad sigma/m bound rather than a cluster/galaxy likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute boosted cascade gamma-ray spectra from mediator rest-frame decay spectra, interface them with a public Fermi-LAT galactic-center likelihood, and include the Sommerfeld enhancement at v ~ 1e-3; optionally add a modern SIDM halo likelihood in place of the flat sigma/m < 1 cm^2/g cut.

members.model_name: U(1) hidden vector dark matter from dark freeze-out
members.description: No reusable galactic-center-excess likelihood exists for the model's Sommerfeld-enhanced 4-fermion cascade final state (AA -> ss with s -> SM, e.g. 4-tau for 2 m_tau < m_s < 2 m_b); the paper's GCE comparison is a benchmark fit, not a recastable likelihood, and the self-interaction check uses only a broad sigma/m bound rather than a halo likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute boosted cascade gamma-ray spectra from mediator rest-frame decay spectra, interface them with a public Fermi-LAT galactic-center likelihood including the Sommerfeld enhancement at v ~ 1e-3; optionally replace the flat sigma/m < 1 cm^2/g cut with a modern SIDM halo likelihood.

members.model_name: Top-philic vector-like portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection, gamma-ray spectral-feature, or LHC recast likelihood is assembled for this model (all three constraints have likelihood_available 'partial' and were not rerun), so the multichannel complementarity conclusions (m_S reach near 700 GeV, mediator reach near 6 TeV) cannot be re-evaluated or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a combined likelihood: DDCalc for XENON1T/LZ spin-independent limits on the loop-induced sigma_SI, the public Fermi-LAT dwarf and spectral-feature likelihoods applied to the t tbar plus internal-bremsstrahlung spectra, and a MadGraph+Delphes recast of Run-2 stop/top-partner searches (via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis PADs) including compressed-spectrum signal regions.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay Dirac fermion model
members.description: The UCNA electron-positron limit is applied only as a quoted branching bound in the 100-644 keV kinetic-energy window; no digitized limit versus T_e+e- or spectrum-folding recast exists to test general (m_chi, h_V, h_A) points, and the card flags that the constraint needs current experimental updates.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the UCNA (and PERKEO) e- e+ exclusion versus pair kinetic energy, fold the model's predicted pair spectrum for each m_chi through the window and detection efficiency, and package the result as a branching-ratio likelihood.

members.model_name: Charged leptophilic dark electron model
members.description: No cosmic-ray propagation pipeline or DAMPE electron/positron likelihood is available for the leptophilic annihilation channels, so the 1.4 TeV CRE spectral feature cannot be quantitatively confronted with data; the route lists 'No CRE propagation likelihood bundled' and s1 notes propagation is not modeled.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's charged-lepton annihilation spectra (per flavor choice of g_i) in a public propagation code such as GALPROP or DRAGON, and build a binned DAMPE CRE likelihood including local dark-matter density and diffusion-parameter systematics.

members.model_name: Secluded U(1)' singlino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: The constraint step applies scan-level cuts rather than versioned experimental likelihoods: none of the Planck relic, XENONnT/DARWIN direct-detection, Fermi-LAT dwarf, or Higgs-invisible constraints is attached as a reusable likelihood (all record likelihood_available: unknown), and the Fermi-LAT limit in particular needs model-specific annihilation spectra and J-factor machinery before it becomes an exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood pipeline for the scan: DDCalc (or equivalent) for current and projected xenon-target limits on sigma_SI, the public Fermi-LAT six-year dwarf-spheroidal likelihood evaluated with final-state-specific gamma-ray spectra for the model's Higgs and A-funnel channels, a Gaussian Planck 2018 relic-density likelihood, and HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals or Lilith for the invisible branching ratio, all versioned per scan point.

members.model_name: Z3 leptophilic complex scalar dark matter with vector-like lepton mediator
members.description: No dedicated indirect-detection likelihood exists for the model's distinctive box-shaped positron spectrum from SS -> e+ e- S* semi-annihilation or for the radiative SS* -> e+ e- gamma spectral features; the paper recasts AMS-02 e+e- annihilation bounds as a proxy and uses CTA projections, not a public likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate box and internal-bremsstrahlung spectra for the semi-annihilation topology (micrOMEGAs or MadDM), propagate positrons with GALPROP/DRAGON, and build an AMS-02 positron likelihood plus a Fermi-LAT/CTA spectral-feature likelihood parameterized in (m_S, m_VLL, lambda_3, g).

members.model_name: Leptoquark-portal SU(2)L-singlet vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: No public gamma-ray likelihood pipeline is connected to this model: evaluating HESS constraints and CTA reach requires recasting multi-TeV annihilation spectra through Galactic-center and dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods, which the card marks as not rerun (likelihood_available partial, tool_or_code null at step s3).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate annihilation spectra for the model's final states (e.g. with PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra at multi-TeV masses via micrOMEGAs), then evaluate them against public HESS Galactic-center likelihoods and CTA sensitivity projections using an indirect-detection likelihood package such as gamLike or the MadDM indirect module.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) L_e+L_mu+L_tau axi-Higgs portal fermionic dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray likelihood is wired to the model: the Fermi LAT, CTA, and H.E.S.S. safety claim is taken from the source paper and cannot be re-evaluated for the model's specific mix of W W, Z Z, gamma gamma, Z gamma, and leptonic channels, including its line features.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate per-channel photon spectra with PPPC4DMID (continuum) plus the gamma gamma / Z gamma line components from the micrOMEGAs branching fractions, and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods (via gamLike or MadDM's indirect-detection module) and published H.E.S.S./CTA Galactic-center sensitivity curves over m_DM = 70-460 GeV.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) L_mu-L_tau axi-Higgs portal fermionic dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray likelihood recast exists for this model: the claimed safety from Fermi LAT, CTA, and H.E.S.S. is quoted from the primary paper without rerunning any likelihood, and no pipeline maps the model's WW/ZZ/Zgamma annihilation branching fractions (including the Zgamma line) to instrument-level limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate photon spectra per channel with micrOMEGAs/PPPC4DMID tables, then evaluate the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal binned likelihoods and H.E.S.S./CTA Galactic-center line and continuum limits over the benchmark grid, treating the Zgamma line channel separately.

members.model_name: SU(5) Goldstino split-SUSY Bino-Wino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No assembled modern detection likelihood recast exists for the Bino-Wino/Bino-Higgsino transition regime of this split-SUSY model: the card's detection constraint is marked recast_required with likelihood_available partial and step s4 has no tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a GAMBIT-style pipeline coupling micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY outputs to DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT spin-independent limits, Fermi dwarf and antiproton likelihoods, and LHC electroweakino search recasts, scanned over M1, M2, mu, tan_beta.

members.model_name: No-Scale F-SU(5) Golden Point neutralino dark matter
members.description: Constraints on the Golden Point rest on paper-era WMAP7, CDMSII, XENON100, Fermi-LAT, and pre-Run-2 LHC limits; no modern combined likelihood (Planck relic band, LZ/XENONnT sigma_SI, current LHC gluino/stau-coannihilation searches, Super-K/Hyper-K proton-decay limits) has been recast onto the benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline using DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT, SModelS or CheckMATE for current LHC SUSY searches on the light-gluino spectrum, Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihoods for the gamma-gamma rate, and compare the predicted tau_p = 4.6e34 yr against current Super-Kamiokande limits.

members.model_name: Hidden-condensate matter-parity-violating gravitino dark matter
members.description: No reusable combined likelihood exists for the three constraints that define the allowed Lambda window: the catalytic-BBN NLSP lifetime bound, the Fermi-LAT gamma-line bound on the gravitino lifetime, and the hidden pseudo-NG overclosure check; the card only records paper-era approximate bounds needing recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that combines an updated late-decay BBN injection code (AlterBBN or ACROPOLIS with catalytic Li-6 for charged NLSPs) with current Fermi-LAT gamma-ray line likelihoods, taking (tau_NLSP, tau_3/2, Omega_PNG h^2) as inputs and returning a joint likelihood over (Lambda, M_S, m_3/2).

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic vector-like fermion doublet dark matter from triplet scalar leptogenesis
members.description: No public likelihood covers inelastic Z-mediated nuclear recoils with O(keV) splitting for this model: the DAMA/Xenon100 Bayesian comparison is private and source-era, and modern experiments (XENONnT, LZ, PandaX) have not been recast for the ~100 GeV inelastic fermion-doublet target.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an open direct-detection rate/likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc or wimprates within a GAMBIT/pyhf-style likelihood) with the inelastic kinematics (delta ~ keV, minimum-velocity shift) and implement DAMA modulation plus current xenon-experiment likelihoods with explicit halo-parameter priors.

members.model_name: Quantum fermionic warm dark matter Thomas-Fermi galaxy model
members.description: No likelihood connects the Thomas-Fermi halo predictions to galaxy data: the card's only constraint is a placeholder (likelihood_available unknown), and there is no statistical pipeline fitting predicted core radii, central densities, or velocity dispersions of dwarf spheroidals to observed kinematics as a function of (m, g, mu(0)).
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the gap_1 solver in a Jeans/velocity-dispersion likelihood against published dwarf-spheroidal kinematic datasets (e.g. Milky Way dSph stellar-kinematics compilations) to turn the compact-dwarf phase-space argument into a proper posterior on the WDM particle mass.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Peccei-Quinn Dirac-neutrino axion-axino dark matter
members.description: No detector-level likelihood or modern recast exists for the diffuse cosmological neutrino flux from late RH-sneutrino NLSP decays; the paper gives only an analytic flux estimate with no comparison to neutrino-telescope limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published diffuse-neutrino-flux limits (Super-Kamiokande, Borexino, IceCube depending on decay energy) into an upper-limit likelihood on the NLSP abundance, lifetime, and lambda_eff, including redshift integration of the decay spectrum.

members.model_name: Pseudo-scalar fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: The card's constraints rest on XENON100-era direct-detection limits (approximate likelihood) and a qualitative indirect-detection discussion with no likelihood at all, so no current experimental likelihood is attached to either the velocity-suppressed recoil prediction or the velocity-independent present-day annihilation rate.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Lambda_1/Lambda_5 recoil rate against LZ/XENONnT likelihoods with DDCalc, and confront the velocity-independent annihilation cross section into hh/tt/bb with the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods using PPPC4DMID or HDMSpectra-style photon spectra.

members.model_name: Nambu-Goto Cusp Emission WIMP dark matter with p-wave annihilation
members.description: No dwarf-spheroidal gamma-ray likelihood applicable to velocity-suppressed p-wave annihilation is available on the card; the only imported limit is an illustrative s-wave WW Fermi-LAT bound, and p-wave limits require velocity-weighted (effective) J-factors per dwarf.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood profiles using published velocity-dependent (p-wave) effective J-factors for the classical dwarfs, scanned over m_chi and annihilation final state.

members.model_name: Field-Theory String Decay WIMP dark matter with p-wave annihilation
members.description: No dwarf-spheroidal gamma-ray likelihood applicable to velocity-suppressed p-wave annihilation is available on the card; the only imported limit is an illustrative s-wave WW Fermi-LAT bound, and p-wave limits require velocity-weighted (effective) J-factors per dwarf.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood profiles using published velocity-dependent (p-wave) effective J-factors for the classical dwarfs, scanned over m_chi and annihilation final state.

members.model_name: Minimal supersymmetric U(1)_x hidden-sector LSP
members.description: No implemented CMB energy-injection or gamma-ray likelihood evaluation exists for a subdominant fraction f_chi_x of annihilating hidden neutralinos; likelihood_available is no and no Fermi/HESS or Planck likelihood was evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate Planck exotic-injection bounds via ExoCLASS with f_eff from the cascade spectra and recast Fermi dwarf/Galactic-center continuum likelihoods with rates rescaled by f_chi_x squared.

members.model_name: Confined colored relic dark matter
members.description: No direct/indirect-detection or exotic-stable-particle likelihood is available for the composite relics; recasting is flagged as needed for QCD-charged variants but no portal-specific likelihood or recast pipeline exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Once a benchmark portal is fixed, build a recast of existing heavy stable charged/colored particle searches and direct-detection limits (e.g. via a micrOMEGAs/MadDM interface with composite form factors) into a reusable likelihood for the m_X-Lambda_D plane.

members.model_name: Inelastic third-generation B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the model's cascade annihilation: applying Fermi-LAT dwarf limits to S S -> Z' Z' with third-generation (tau, b, nu_tau) dominated Z-prime branching fractions requires computing the boosted photon spectrum per final state, which the card encodes only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Use MadDM or PPPC4DMID tau/b spectra boosted through the Z' two-body cascade to build the gamma-ray spectrum for (B-L)_3 branching fractions, then evaluate the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods to produce <sigma v>_0 limits as a function of (m_S, m_Z_prime).

members.model_name: Type-X 2HDM secluded Dirac-fermion dark sector
members.description: No packaged indirect-detection pipeline for the secluded cascade: boosted photon spectra from DM DM -> mediator mediator -> leptons are not tabulated for this model, and no Fermi-LAT target and likelihood have been selected for the recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Convolve public leptonic photon-yield tables (PPPC4DMID-style) with the mediator two-body decay boost to obtain dN_gamma/dE, then evaluate against the published Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods for the NFW J-factors assumed in the card.

members.model_name: Pati-Salam Goldstino split-SUSY Wino dark matter
members.description: No implemented indirect-detection likelihood recast exists for the Wino gamma-line, continuum, antiproton, and positron channels with current data and halo-profile systematics; the card marks the indirect constraint as recast_required with only partial likelihood availability.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module (e.g. within MadDM or a standalone likelihood package) combining published Fermi-LAT/H.E.S.S. line and dSph continuum likelihoods and AMS-02 antiproton likelihoods, taking Sommerfeld-enhanced Wino spectra and a parameterized Milky Way halo profile as inputs.

members.model_name: Leptoquark-portal SU(2)L-triplet vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: No public gamma-ray likelihood pipeline is connected to this model: HESS constraints and CTA reach for the ~1.6 TeV and heavier triplet, annihilating dominantly to W+W- and S3 pairs, are cited from the source rather than evaluated (likelihood_available partial, tool_or_code null at step s3).
members.proposed_resolution: Compute annihilation spectra for the W+W-, S3 S3 and coannihilation final states (PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra via micrOMEGAs) and evaluate them against public HESS Galactic-center likelihoods and CTA sensitivity projections with an indirect-detection likelihood package such as gamLike or the MadDM indirect module.

members.model_name: 750 GeV complex-scalar portal Majorana WIMP
members.description: The claim that direct and indirect detection limits are respected rests on paper benchmarks with unknown likelihood availability; no quantitative recast pipeline exists mapping the loop-level gluon/photon effective couplings to current direct-detection and gamma-ray limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the effective chi-nucleon coupling induced by c_GG (via the gluon scalar current) and evaluate it with DDCalc against current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, and confront the velocity-dependent annihilation into aa/sa and gamma-line channels with Fermi-LAT/CTA-style indirect likelihoods.

members.model_name: Kination freeze-out Majorana dark matter
members.description: No assembled likelihood pipeline maps (m_chi, <sigma v>, annihilation channel) to combined Fermi-LAT dwarf and H.E.S.S. Galactic Center exclusions for this scenario; the card marks the constraint likelihood as partial and recasting_needed yes, and the T_R lower bound is channel dependent.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module combining the public Fermi-LAT PASS 8 dwarf bin-by-bin likelihoods with digitized H.E.S.S. Galactic Center limit curves, using PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra-style final-state gamma-ray spectra per annihilation channel, so the channel-dependent T_R floor (0.05-1 GeV) can be reproduced continuously in parameter space.

members.model_name: Hidden-SU(N) confinement induced scalar dark matter
members.description: No modern decaying-dark-matter likelihood covers the model's phi -> gamma gamma lifetime constraint across the eV-to-MeV mass range; the exclusion (tau > ~1e27 s) exists only as a gray region in the source figure, with the QCD-coupling dependence of the decay rate not separately reusable.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a lifetime-versus-mass likelihood from published X-ray and gamma-ray decaying-DM line searches (XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, INTEGRAL/SPI, Fermi) spanning eV-MeV, parameterized by the model's loop-induced Gamma(phi -> gamma gamma)(m_phi, M, QCD-coupling ratio), replacing the digitized source figure.

members.model_name: Mirrored neutron dark matter in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: No indirect-detection pipeline exists for this model's 100 TeV mirror neutron decaying or annihilating into heavy axions that shower to QCD jets: neither the photon/antiproton spectra for these cascades nor EGRB lifetime, Fermi-LAT dwarf, or AMS-02 antiproton likelihood recasts have been produced (both constraints report recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the axion-to-jet cascade spectra with Pythia (or HDMSpectra for the ~100 TeV regime), then run them through the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods, published AMS-02 antiproton limits, and a Fermi EGRB decaying-DM lifetime bound to map the allowed (m_N', M_a, tau_n') region.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu Z2 real scalar dark matter
members.description: The gamma-line observable is judged only against the historical tentative Fermi-LAT 130 GeV line target (likelihood_available no); no current gamma-ray line-search likelihood for the loop-induced X X -> gamma gamma rate is in place.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current Fermi-LAT line-search upper limits on <sigma v>_gamma_gamma at 130 GeV as a likelihood over the predicted loop rate, replacing the historical line target.

members.model_name: U(1)_X-charged Z2-odd scalar dark matter in a lepton-specific two-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: No computation of gamma-ray spectra for the scalar-portal annihilation final states (cascades through H0/A0/H+ scalars) and no application of a Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood exists for this model; the indirect-detection constraint has likelihood_available 'no'.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate annihilation final-state spectra with micrOMEGAs/PPPC4DMID including the scalar cascade decays, and evaluate them against the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal bin-by-bin likelihoods to produce exclusion contours in the scenario-(2) portal-coupling plane.

members.model_name: Massive-dark-photon two-component composite pNGB dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast exists for indirect-detection and self-interaction constraints on the two-component mixture: dwarf-galaxy annihilation limits must be reweighted by the component fractions and channel mix, and dark-photon-mediated self-interaction bounds for the phi/A_D system have not been derived.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer that scales the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood by abundance-weighted annihilation rates (f_i^2 per component and per channel) using spectra from the gap_1 implementation, and derive the massive-mediator self-scattering cross sections for both components for comparison against standard halo SIDM limits.

members.model_name: Superheavy proton-like dark matter decaying through virtual black holes
members.description: No UHECR spectrum/composition likelihood or multi-messenger (secondary photon/neutrino) likelihood exists for this decaying composite superheavy DM model; the source discusses data only qualitatively and provides no numeric exclusion contour in (M_X, tau_X, Lambda_*).
members.proposed_resolution: Propagate the injection spectra with CRPropa (halo plus extragalactic decay components) and recast published Auger/TA photon-fraction and spectrum limits plus IceCube diffuse-neutrino limits on decaying dark matter into a (M_X, tau_X) likelihood, then map onto Lambda_* via the source lifetime formula.

members.model_name: lambda_phi zero linear-breaking scalar singlet dark matter variant
members.description: The indirect-detection route lacks an assembled pipeline from W+W-/ZZ/H1H1 annihilation at multi-TeV masses to Fermi-LAT dwarf and CMB energy-injection constraints; spectra and experimental likelihoods are external and unwired.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine tabulated PPPC4DMID (or HDMSpectra for the heaviest masses) final-state spectra with the public Fermi-LAT dSph likelihood and a Planck f_eff energy-injection bound to produce a channel-weighted sigma-v constraint.

members.model_name: Zprime-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No gamma-ray line likelihood is available for the Z gamma / h gamma channels (con_zprime_line_target has likelihood_available: no); only the historical 130/135 GeV Fermi line target is logged, with no modern Fermi-LAT line-search constraint applied at the 144-160 GeV benchmark masses.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the current Fermi-LAT Galactic-center line-search upper limits on <sigma v> into a likelihood over (m_chi, g_Zprime a1) for the Z gamma and h gamma final states, replacing the historical line target.

members.model_name: Nonthermal sub-keV light dark matter fraction from radiative decays
members.description: The structure-formation bound f < 0.01 is inferred from generic mixed cold/hot arguments rather than from a dedicated likelihood: no Lyman-alpha, CMB, or sigma8 likelihood has been run against this model's boosted-subcomponent transfer function, so the actual upper limit on f versus m_DM and tau is uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or emulator (e.g. the hydrodynamical-simulation-calibrated WDM/mixed-DM chains) plus Planck CMB data onto the mixed transfer functions from gap_2, producing f(m_DM, tau) exclusion contours.

members.model_name: Dark-fermion-production relaxion warm dark matter
members.description: No public Lyman-alpha likelihood applies to this model's mixed case: the constraint is imposed only as the thermal-relic 5-5.3 keV m_WDM bound, which does not cover a partial warm fraction f_WDM < 1 or a diluted non-standard spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood built for mixed cold-plus-warm dark matter, parameterized by (m_WDM_equivalent, f_WDM), using the transfer functions from the derived f(p) rather than the pure-thermal mapping.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No ready Lyman-alpha likelihood accepts the nonthermal freeze-in momentum distribution directly; the card notes the thermal-WDM template can misestimate the bound, and the exact transfer-function-to-likelihood mapping was not reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the tabulated f(p) through CLASS ncdm to obtain T(k), then apply a shape-based Lyman-alpha recast (area criterion or the Murgia et al. alpha-beta-gamma parameterization with the MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 likelihood) instead of the half-mode thermal-WDM mapping.

members.model_name: Baryon-triality DFSZ axion and light-axino dark matter model
members.description: Structure-formation constraints (Lyman-alpha, MW satellites) are calibrated for fully thermal WDM, not for a mixed cold-axion plus subdominant nonthermal warm-axino cosmology, so no direct likelihood exists for the warm-fraction versus axino-mass plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the mixed-DM transfer functions from CLASS onto existing mixed cold+warm Lyman-alpha analyses (fraction-versus-mass exclusion surfaces) or re-run an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator on the suppressed power spectra, releasing the result as a (f_warm, m_axino) likelihood.

members.model_name: keV gravitino dark matter with a nonthermal bino-decay component
members.description: The mixed cold(diluted-thermal)+warm(bino-decay) gravitino scenario is confronted with structure data only through the crude exp(-4.9 f) matter-power proxy; no pipeline computes the nonthermal gravitino phase-space distribution from late bino decay, feeds it through a Boltzmann code, and evaluates a Lyman-alpha/CMB/LSS likelihood (which would also give the actual Delta_N_eff and Hubble-tension impact).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the bino-decay gravitino distribution function analytically, implement it as a custom ncdm species (with the diluted thermal component) in CLASS, and recast the resulting linear power spectra against mixed cold+warm DM Lyman-alpha bounds (e.g. the published WDM-fraction likelihoods or a Lyman-alpha flux emulator) plus Planck for Delta_N_eff.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile-neutrino mixed dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or flux-power emulator handles mixed cold+warm transfer functions directly; current analyses are built for CDM or pure thermal WDM, and the card explicitly warns that transferring thermal-WDM Lyman-alpha bounds to mixed dark matter is misleading.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator with a two-parameter suppression template (cutoff scale and plateau depth set by M_s and r_warm), validated against a small set of hydrodynamical simulations with mixed initial conditions, and expose it as a public likelihood with thermal-history nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: UV freeze-in baryogenesis with scalar dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha constraint on the light freeze-in scalar DM is applied only as a translated thermal-mass floor (4.0-15.5 keV) rather than through a transfer-function-level likelihood for the model's nonthermal dimension-5 2-to-2 production spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the freeze-in momentum distribution f(q) for dimension-5 2-to-2 production, feed it into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution to obtain the linear transfer function, and evaluate against a public Lyman-alpha flux likelihood or emulator instead of the mapped thermal-WDM bound.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists that is valid for the sharply peaked, colder-than-thermal resonant sterile-neutrino spectra of this model; current practice maps to a thermal-equivalent WDM mass, an approximation the card flags as requiring validation for each non-thermal spectrum and DM fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints directly on the CLASS-computed transfer functions of the resonant spectra, either via the area-criterion generalization of thermal-WDM bounds or by evaluating a flux-power emulator (e.g. trained on MP-Gadget/Sherwood-style grids) on the non-thermal T(k), including mixed cold+sterile fractions.

members.model_name: Early mass-varying sterile-neutrino nugget dark matter, simple CDM-transition variant
members.description: No likelihood recast connects the nugget-cutoff matter power spectrum to small-scale structure data (Lyman-alpha forest, weak lensing, satellite counts); the route's lss_recast step has no tool and was never carried out.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the computed cutoff transfer function onto existing small-scale likelihoods via half-mode-scale matching to warm-dark-matter constraints, using public Lyman-alpha flux-power emulators and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods, and publish the resulting z_F/m_phi exclusion contours.

members.model_name: UV freeze-in baryogenesis with Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha constraint on the light freeze-in DM is applied only as a translated thermal-mass floor (4.6-18.1 keV) rather than through a transfer-function-level likelihood for the model's nonthermal dimension-6 2-to-2 production spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the freeze-in momentum distribution f(q) for dimension-6 2-to-2 production, feed it into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution to obtain the linear transfer function, and evaluate against a public Lyman-alpha flux likelihood or emulator instead of the mapped thermal-WDM bound.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: Lyman-alpha and structure limits are applied only through an approximate thermal-WDM equivalent-mass mapping that is not calibrated for the suppressed, cosmology-dependent momentum spectra produced in non-standard pre-BBN histories, and no numeric exclusion contour or likelihood is encoded.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_s(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold ncdm species to obtain transfer functions, then recast published Lyman-alpha flux-power WDM constraints (area-criterion or emulator-based) into distribution-specific limits on the mass-mixing plane at each dark-matter fraction f_s.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The quoted DW Lyman-alpha and satellite bounds are 2005-2013 vintage fixed limits, not a reusable likelihood; no current pipeline maps the DW distribution with its peculiar-velocity corrections onto modern Lyman-alpha flux-power or satellite-count data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute the DW transfer function in CLASS with the mixing-angle-normalized distribution and run it through a current Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood and a Milky Way satellite-count likelihood, including the velocity-correction effect on initial conditions.

members.model_name: 331 WIMPy dark radiation model
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists combining CMB N_eff, BBN light-element, and warm-fraction structure bounds as a function of the model parameters (f, Delta N_eff, tau_N1R, mass ratio); the card explicitly flags con_cmb_bbn_structure_neff as a recast target with likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that maps (f, tau_N1R, M_N1R/M_WIMP) to Delta N_eff and warm fraction and evaluates them against the Planck N_eff likelihood, standard BBN codes (e.g. PArthENoPE/PRIMAT outputs), and published Lyman-alpha/mixed-dark-matter warm-fraction bounds.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Lyman-alpha and small-scale-structure constraints are calibrated on thermal WDM, but the card marks the thermal-WDM mapping as misleading for this decay-produced nonthermal f_N1; only an approximate likelihood exists (likelihood_available: approximate), so exclusion statements from lambda_FS regimes remain qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_N1(q) into CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold species to obtain T(k), then apply a transfer-function-level Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator (area-criterion or flux-power emulator approach) validated against published thermal-WDM limits, instead of a single lambda_FS proxy.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric equilibrium-scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No validated Lyman-alpha/matter-power likelihood exists for this model's nonthermal mixed cold+warm N1 distributions; the available constraint is an approximate thermal-WDM/FIMP mapping that the card flags as potentially misleading for multi-component distributions.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated f_N1(p) into CLASS as a non-cold relic with an arbitrary psd file to compute the linear transfer function, then apply an area-criterion or emulator-based Lyman-alpha likelihood (e.g. the standard flux-power emulators recast for general suppressed transfer functions) validated against the related FIMP analytic mapping.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric out-of-equilibrium scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Lyman-alpha/small-scale-structure constraints are calibrated on thermal WDM, while the card marks a single thermal-WDM mapping as misleading for this mixed cold-warm two-bump distribution; only an approximate likelihood exists, so structure exclusions stay at the qualitative lambda_FS-regime level.
members.proposed_resolution: Pass the two-component f_N1(q) into CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold species (or two species) to compute T(k), then apply a transfer-function-level Lyman-alpha likelihood or flux-power emulator validated against thermal-WDM limits, rather than a lambda_FS proxy.

members.model_name: nuMSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with fermion-number-violating leptogenesis effects
members.description: No reusable Lyman-alpha/phase-space-density or X-ray decay likelihoods are implemented for spectrum-dependent resonant N1 dark matter; the mass-window constraint is marked likelihood_available partial with recasting needed and the viability step is qualitative only.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha and dwarf phase-space constraints using transfer functions computed from the non-thermal f(p) (e.g. CLASS with a tabulated ncdm distribution) and assemble X-ray decay limit tables in the (M1, mixing angle) plane as a reusable likelihood module.

members.model_name: Inflaton-decay singlet-fermion dark matter with inflaton-mediated scatterings
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or matter-power likelihood recast exists for this model's collision-cooled nonthermal distribution: the paper only compares a free-streaming-length proxy, and the card warns that a thermal-WDM mass mapping would be unreliable, so the allowed mass-coupling region has never been derived from an actual transfer-function-level constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the solver's tabulated f(p) into CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species to compute linear transfer functions, then constrain with a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. an area-criterion or WDM-emulator comparison recalibrated on the actual transfer-function shape).

members.model_name: Line-motivated resonantly produced sterile neutrino N1 dark matter
members.description: Structure-formation constraints on this model are applied only through the approximate half-mode-mass summary statistic; no released Milky Way satellite or Lyman-alpha likelihood consumes the full resonant (non-thermal) N1 transfer function directly, so limits inherit the thermal-WDM mapping error the paper warns about.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing satellite-count likelihood (e.g. the Milky Way subhalo framework used for WDM limits) and a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator to accept arbitrary suppressed transfer functions, then evaluate them on the gap_1 calibrated resonant T(k) grid rather than on thermal-relic equivalents.

members.model_name: Neutrino-interacting asymmetric dark matter with a charged mediator
members.description: No reusable Lyman-alpha forest or Milky Way satellite-count likelihood exists for this model's smooth interacting-DM cutoff; published small-scale-structure limits are calibrated on thermal-WDM transfer functions, and the card records likelihood_available: no for the cutoff-consistency constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (e.g. MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100-style area-criterion or emulator analysis) and a DES/PanSTARRS satellite-count likelihood using the model-specific transfer functions produced in gap_1, mapping the interacting-DM cutoff onto half-mode mass rather than thermal WDM mass.

members.model_name: Inelastic freeze-in pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No bespoke likelihood exists for late chi2 -> chi1 e+ e- energy injection; BBN/CMB/Lyman-alpha bounds are rescaled from generic decaying-DM energy-deposition studies rather than computed with the model's three-body injection spectrum and partial-fraction (half-of-DM) decay.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model's three-body e+e- injection spectrum into DarkHistory/ExoCLASS with a decaying-fraction treatment, couple to Planck CMB anisotropy and spectral-distortion (FIRAS/PIXIE forecast) likelihoods, and add a BBN energy-injection calculation for lifetimes near 1e12 s.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine L-ball resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter scenario
members.description: No spectrum-aware Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for this model's nonthermal resonantly produced f_s(q); the card explicitly warns that a thermal-WDM mapping is insufficient, so current flux-power constraints cannot be applied at face value.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the numerical f_s(q) into CLASS as a non-cold (ncdm) species to obtain the linear transfer function, then recast through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (e.g. the area-criterion or emulator-based nonthermal-relic pipelines used for resonant sterile neutrinos) over the (m_s, sin^2 2theta, L_nue_init) grid.

members.model_name: Minimal LRSM N1 dark matter with right-handed triplet scalar dilution
members.description: The LSS constraint on the secondary hot N1 fraction rests on an SDSS DR7/Lyman-alpha era comparison with only a partial likelihood; no modern packaged LSS/Lyman-alpha or X-ray line likelihood exists for this mixed cold+hot sterile-neutrino spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihoods (emulator-based eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES pipelines) and updated X-ray line searches onto CLASS transfer functions for the two-component N1 population, replacing the paper's SDSS-scale bound.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_{B-L} light Dirac-neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: The structure-formation constraint is only a free-streaming-length threshold; no pipeline maps the model's nonthermal FIMP momentum distribution to a linear transfer function and a Lyman-alpha (or Milky Way satellite) likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f(q) into CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species to obtain T(k), then constrain it with an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (or the area-criterion mapping to thermal WDM bounds) instead of the 0.1 Mpc FSL cut.

members.model_name: Sterile right-handed-neutrino dark matter from RHN oscillations
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for this model's nonthermal spectrum: the M1 > about 10 keV floor is a rough recast of thermal-WDM bounds under a pre-QCD production assumption, and the card records likelihood_available no with the constraint flagged recast_required.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute model transfer functions from the tabulated f(p) and evaluate them against XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE flux-power data via an existing Lyman-alpha emulator or the Murgia area-criterion recast, replacing the thermal-WDM mass-floor proxy.

members.model_name: Late-PQ-phase-transition axion parametric-resonance dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for any of the model's constraints: the abundance-reheating target, the warmness bound, and the defect-viability check are all pass/fail analytic comparisons with likelihood_available set to no throughout the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the abundance and transfer-function pipeline in a likelihood: an Omega_a h^2 Gaussian against the Planck CDM density plus a Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (e.g. an existing WDM emulator-based likelihood) evaluated on the model's T(k), exposed over (f_a, m_s, T_RH, n).

members.model_name: Decaying warm dark matter with a massive dark-photon daughter
members.description: Small-scale-structure bounds are imported only through an approximate thermal-equivalent WDM mass mapping; no Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator accepts the model's nonthermal transfer function directly, making the m_wdm > 5.3 keV recast unreliable for this phase-space distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply an area-criterion or half-mode mapping validated for nonthermal spectra, or better, run the model transfer functions through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator framework (e.g. the ones built on Sherwood/XQ-100-calibrated grids) to derive direct exclusion contours in (m_wdm, tau, epsilon_decay).

members.model_name: Messenger-inflation minimal GMSB gravitino superWIMP
members.description: No structure-formation likelihood is wired for the warmish gravitino: the card explicitly notes the absence of Lyman-alpha or satellite likelihoods, so the claim that lambda_FS may mitigate small-scale tensions without violating existing bounds cannot be tested against data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the transfer function from gap_1 exists, recast onto published WDM-style constraints via the half-mode mass: Lyman-alpha forest limits (e.g. emulator-based flux-power likelihoods), Milky Way satellite counts, and strong-lensing subhalo constraints, reporting the allowed (m_B, m_3/2) region.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from singlet-scalar freeze-in and dark-sector freeze-out
members.description: No public likelihood maps this model's colder-than-thermal Fermi-Dirac sterile-neutrino distribution (temperature ratio z ~ 0.1) onto Lyman-alpha forest and phase-space (Tremaine-Gunn) bounds; only a free-streaming-length estimate exists, and the card marks the Lyman-alpha likelihood availability as unknown with recasting needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the linear transfer function with CLASS ncdm using a Fermi-Dirac distribution at T_ncdm/T = z, then recast onto existing WDM Lyman-alpha constraints via half-mode-mass matching or by evaluating an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood/emulator on the resulting power spectra over the (m_N, z) plane.

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP dark matter with right-handed sneutrino NLSP
members.description: No structure-formation likelihood applies to the mixed cold/warm gravitino case: Lyman-alpha and satellite-count bounds exist only for pure thermal WDM, and the card states a model-specific mixed-component likelihood is unresolved (structure_free_streaming_bound: likelihood_available unknown, recasting_needed yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Once mixed transfer functions exist (gap_2), recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints using existing WDM/mixed-DM emulator machinery (area-criterion or dedicated emulator retraining on the two-component suppression shape) over (f_warm, lambda_FS), and add Milky Way satellite-count bounds for the same grid.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L thermal sterile neutrino with entropy dilution
members.description: Structure-formation constraints are applied only through approximate thermal-WDM equivalent masses; no Lyman-alpha or satellite-count likelihood that consumes the model's actual production-specific transfer function is available ('full production-specific likelihoods require transfer functions, not only equivalent masses').
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the computed transfer function to an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (e.g. a Sherwood- or PRIYA-style emulator with area-criterion or direct P_F(k) comparison) and to satellite-count likelihoods, replacing the equivalent-mass mapping.

members.model_name: Scalar singlet FIMP dark matter with vectorlike fermion parent during reheating
members.description: The Lyman-alpha bound for reheating-era decay production is only an order-of-magnitude relaxation estimate: no computed FIMP phase-space distribution f(q) for production during reheating exists, and no Lyman-alpha likelihood or transfer-function pipeline evaluates it, so the quoted 9.2-16 keV floors cannot be replaced by a real bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for two-body vectorlike-parent decays occurring partly during the monomial reheating phase, feed it to CLASS as a non-cold relic to get T(k) over the (m_DM, m_P, T_rh, k) grid, and evaluate against a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator as done for radiation-dominated FIMP production.

members.model_name: Radiative seesaw warm N_1 dark matter with N_2 entropy dilution
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood exists for this model's diluted-thermal distribution (card: likelihood_available = no for lyman_alpha_wdm_mass_bound); the quoted 5.6 keV sterile-neutrino bound is only an approximate proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model through an existing WDM Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood by mapping the model-specific transfer function onto thermal-WDM equivalents (e.g. via the half-mode or area criterion) once gap_1 supplies f(p).

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet-Higgs decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Small-scale-structure constraints are applied only through an approximate free-streaming-length cut (lambda_FS < 0.11 Mpc); no Lyman-alpha likelihood exists that consumes this model's decay-produced, colder-than-thermal momentum distribution via the full linear power spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold relic (ncdm with tabulated phase-space distribution) to obtain T(k), then recast through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or WDM-equivalent area-criterion emulator calibrated for non-thermal distributions.

members.model_name: Simplified light FIMP with entropy-modified decay production
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood exists for nonthermal FIMP transfer functions; the model is judged only through the thermal-WDM area proxy A < A_3.5keV = 0.46, which the paper itself warns is not a direct likelihood for arbitrary FIMP spectra, and the route caveat states a fresh hydrodynamical recast would be needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the alpha-beta-gamma transfer-function family in an existing hydrodynamical flux-power emulator framework trained on non-cold DM shapes (extending the nCDM Lyman-alpha emulator approach to MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 and newer eBOSS/DESI data) to produce a reusable likelihood on (alpha, beta, gamma).

members.model_name: Simplified light FIMP with decay and scattering production

members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the alpha-beta-gamma transfer-function family in an existing hydrodynamical flux-power emulator framework trained on non-cold DM shapes (extending the nCDM Lyman-alpha emulator approach to MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 and newer eBOSS/DESI data) to produce a reusable likelihood on (alpha, beta, gamma).

members.model_name: Minimal LRSM N1 dark matter with N2 entropy dilution

members.proposed_resolution: Recast modern Lyman-alpha (e.g. eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES emulator-based) and X-ray line-search (NuSTAR/XMM blank-sky) likelihoods onto the two-component N1 transfer functions computed with CLASS, replacing the SDSS-scale comparison used in the paper.

members.model_name: R-invariant gauge-mediated gravitino warm dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood is attached to the route; the card marks the Ly-alpha constraint as recast_required with likelihood_available partial, so the free-streaming suppression cannot be confronted with data quantitatively.

members.model_name: Abelian Z' sterile-neutrino progenitor dark matter variants

members.proposed_resolution: Apply a transfer-function-level recast (area-criterion or a Ly-alpha flux-power emulator trained on general suppressed spectra) to the CLASS output for the vector-decay f(q), and validate against the thermal-WDM limit in the appropriate limit.

members.model_name: Self-interacting singlet scalar freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Map the model transfer functions onto existing Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints via the area-criterion / half-mode matching used for generic non-cold DM, or interface them with a Lyman-alpha emulator trained on generalized suppressed power spectra, to replace the thermal-WDM mass floor with a spectrum-specific bound.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter in a singlet scalar portal sector

members.model_name: E-model attractor scalar-field dark matter

members.model_name: Nonthermal warm wino LSP dark matter

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP with right-handed sneutrino NLSP

members.proposed_resolution: Compute mixed C+WDM transfer functions with CLASS (gap_1 distribution) over the (lambda_FS, f_dec) plane and recast existing Lyman-alpha forest mixed-DM bounds and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods onto that grid, replacing the 0.4 warm-fraction cap.

members.proposed_resolution: Recast a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator using the model-specific transfer functions from gap_1 via an area-criterion or half-mode-mass mapping validated for decay-produced spectra, following the methodology of the modern decaying-DM Lyman-alpha analyses cited in the card, and combine with galaxy power-spectrum limits on the relativistic fraction f.

members.model_name: N-superpartner NLSP decay to gravitino-dominated dark matter

members.model_name: Thermal hadronic axion dark matter with kination

members.model_name: Planck-scale axion fuzzy-lump dark matter
