members.proposed_resolution: Package digitized power-law-integrated sensitivity curves for LISA/ET/BBO/DECIGO into a signal-to-noise forecast module for the Omega_GW(f) output, so GW reach maps onto the same (M_in, beta, k, q) grid as the relic and Lyman-alpha calculations.

members.model_name: Light collisional cold dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the structure-formation survival bound: the damping-scale constraint (likelihood_available: unknown) is a qualitative exclusion of parameters that erase observed galaxy/early-halo scales, with no Lyman-alpha or halo-abundance statistical pipeline applicable to the oscillatory light-DM cutoff.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing small-scale-structure likelihood (Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator or MW satellite-count likelihood) in terms of the model's damping mass M_damp and kinetic-decoupling parameters, validating the non-WDM cutoff shape against a small set of dedicated hydrodynamical runs.

members.model_name: Hidden-fermion-assisted gravitino dark matter
members.description: The mixed cold/warm small-scale constraint is inherited from a WMAP5-era Lyman-alpha analysis; no current mixed CDM+WDM Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator is connected to bound f_WDM versus lambda_FS for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply a modern Lyman-alpha framework to the computed transfer functions, e.g. the Murgia-Irsic-Viel area-criterion recast or a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator, to update the allowed (f_WDM, lambda_FS) region.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M1
members.description: The Lyman-alpha constraint is applied only as a broad overview bound (decoupling before the ~100 eV epoch); no Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator calibrated for acoustic-damping (dark-oscillation) transfer-function shapes, as opposed to thermal-WDM cutoffs, is available for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's CLASS transfer functions through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator (e.g. an ETHOS/interacting-DM extension of WDM-calibrated emulators) or apply the area-criterion mapping validated for non-WDM cutoff shapes, replacing the fixed 100 eV timing cut.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M2
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood is available for the late-kinetic-decoupling cutoff; the paper uses only a broad overview bound and the card flags that modern, more restrictive Lyman-alpha analyses were not recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's computed transfer functions onto existing WDM/interacting-DM Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihoods or emulators (e.g. half-mode-mass mapping onto published MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 style analyses), validating the mapping for acoustic-oscillation-type cutoffs.

members.model_name: Heavy-scalar decay gravitino warm dark matter
members.description: No modern small-scale-structure likelihood (Lyman-alpha forest or Milky Way satellite counts) is connected to this model's nonthermal suppression; the free-streaming constraint is a 2006-era analytic estimate, and the card records likelihood_available as no/unknown for all constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Once transfer functions exist (gap_1), recast them through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator or area-criterion WDM bound and through satellite-count likelihoods, mapping each (B_3/2, M_X, T_R) point to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass with validity checks on the shape mismatch.

members.model_name: DFSZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha/reionization likelihood applies to this model's mixed cold-warm axino scenario: the source used SDSS-era velocity bounds and a warm-fraction limit of about 0.35, while existing Lyman-alpha emulators and likelihoods are calibrated for pure thermal-relic WDM, not a subdominant warm component with a decay-injected spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast mixed cold+warm dark matter Lyman-alpha constraints onto the model by mapping the CLASS-computed transfer functions to the (warm fraction, thermal-equivalent mass) plane of published mixed-DM Lyman-alpha analyses, or extend a flux-power emulator with the mixed-spectrum suppression shape.

members.model_name: KSVZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha (small-scale structure) likelihood exists for the mixed cold-thermal plus warm-nonthermal axino population: the nonthermal phase-space distribution from NLSP decays is only approximate in the card, and existing Lyman-alpha bounds are calibrated to pure thermal WDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced axino f(p) analytically, evolve the mixed population with the CLASS ncdm sector to get the transfer function, and map onto Lyman-alpha constraints via the half-mode/area criterion or a WDM-calibrated flux-power emulator extended to cold-plus-warm mixtures.

members.model_name: Hidden-charged dark matter with chiral dark radiation
members.description: The Lyman-alpha bound on the model's power suppression exists only as a recast of a related but not identical DM-DR analysis (con_hidden_dr_lya_recast, likelihood_available: no); no validated mapping from the hidden-U(1) opacity to the flux-power likelihood used in that analysis is available for this model's e_D range.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the model's linear matter power spectra from the modified CLASS and evaluate them against a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or compressed emulator (e.g. an area-criterion or WDM-style emulator recast calibrated on SDSS/MIKE-HIRES data), validating the opacity-equivalence assumption stated on the card.

members.model_name: Mirror matter dark matter with cooler mirror sector
members.description: No Lyman-alpha (or satellite/reionization) likelihood is valid for the mirror-baryon transfer function: existing small-scale constraints assume thermal-WDM-like smooth cutoffs, while this model predicts acoustic oscillations plus collisional damping, and the card marks the thermal WDM mapping as misleading.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic Lyman-alpha forest simulations (or extend an existing flux-power emulator) over a grid of mirror transfer functions parameterized by (x, Omega_b_prime), so oscillatory damped spectra can be constrained directly rather than through a thermal-WDM mass proxy.

members.model_name: Low-reheat warm gravitino dark matter
members.description: Current small-scale-structure constraints on this model rest on a phase-space-density criterion and WMAP/Lyman-alpha-era literature; no modern Lyman-alpha or Milky Way satellite likelihood has been applied to the actual nonthermal gravitino spectra (likelihood_available: partial, thermal-WDM limits cannot be copied directly).
members.proposed_resolution: Propagate the model transfer functions through existing public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihoods and Milky Way satellite-count WDM likelihoods (DES/PS1-class), replacing the thermal-equivalent-mass shortcut with the exact f(p,t)-based suppression.

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood applicable to resonant nonthermal sterile-neutrino spectra is available; the card only carries a 2005-era thermal-WDM lower-bound recast whose thermal-equivalent mapping the paper itself flags as unreliable for these spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the model transfer functions from step s2 through a modern public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES-class analyses) instead of copying thermal-WDM mass limits, packaging the result as a likelihood over (M_1, sin^2 2theta, n_L/s).

members.model_name: Nonminimally coupled scalar dark matter from R^2 inflation
members.description: The warm/cold classification rests on an average-velocity-at-equality criterion; the decay-produced momentum distribution has not been propagated to a linear transfer function or confronted with a small-scale-structure (Lyman-alpha/subhalo) likelihood, and the card notes no dedicated Lyman-alpha likelihood was read.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(q) from the scalaron-decay kinematics, feed it to CLASS as a custom ncdm species to get the transfer-function cutoff, and map it to existing thermal-WDM Lyman-alpha and satellite-count bounds via a half-mode-mass matching.

members.model_name: Goldilocks cosmology gravitino dark matter in minimal GMSB
members.description: The small-scale-structure and BBN tests are only threshold criteria (lambda_FS < 0.5 Mpc, tau_chi < 0.1-1 s) with 'approximate' likelihoods; no transfer-function-based matter-power/Lyman-alpha likelihood for the decay-produced gravitino spectrum and no element-abundance BBN injection calculation exist for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the non-thermal gravitino momentum distribution from late neutralino decay, obtain T(k) via CLASS ncdm and evaluate a public Lyman-alpha or satellite-count likelihood in place of the 0.5 Mpc cut, and run the decay injection through a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS to replace the lifetime cut.

members.model_name: Light-vector freeze-in dark matter with plasmon decay
members.description: No reusable joint likelihood exists for the small-scale probes (Lyman-alpha forest, quasar lensing, stellar streams, Milky Way satellites) applied to arbitrary nonthermal freeze-in transfer functions; the quoted mass floor up to 20 keV was derived in the related paper and cannot be re-evaluated for other thermalization scenarios or parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a joint likelihood pipeline combining Planck CMB likelihoods, a compressed Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (or WDM-calibrated emulator), and published satellite/stream suppression likelihoods, parameterized by the model transfer function rather than a thermal-WDM mass, and calibrate it by reproducing the related paper's mass reach.

members.model_name: Benchmark FIMP freeze-in warm dark matter model
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator is available that consumes the FIMP's nonthermal transfer function directly; constraints are translated through an approximate thermal-WDM warmness or half-mode mapping, which the card flags as benchmark-dependent and a leading systematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the CLASS-computed nonthermal transfer functions into an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator framework (e.g. the MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 or eBOSS WDM emulator setups) with IGM nuisance marginalization, replacing the m_WDM-equivalent proxy with a direct P(k)-level likelihood.

members.model_name: Hadronic up-type minimal scalar FIMP freeze-in model
members.description: No distribution-specific Lyman-alpha constraint exists for the decay-produced scalar FIMP momentum spectrum: the m_s > 12 keV floor is a quoted proxy bound without a transfer-function table or likelihood, and modern flux-power limits may move it.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the decay-produced f(p) analytically, feed it to CLASS as a non-cold ncdm species to get the transfer function over (m_s, m_F, T_R), and recast current Lyman-alpha WDM limits (half-mode/area criterion or an emulator-based flux-power likelihood) into an updated m_s floor.

members.model_name: Leptonic minimal scalar FIMP freeze-in model
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood is attached for the suppressed power spectra of this decay-produced FIMP; the constraint is a single quoted 12 keV threshold from the primary paper, which modern flux-power data would shift.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model transfer functions onto the Murgia-Viel {alpha,beta,gamma} parameterization and evaluate against an existing MIKE/HIRES/XQ-100 flux-power likelihood or a trained Lyman-alpha emulator, revalidating the 12 keV edge before scanning.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal dark matter with neutrino-mediated self-interactions
members.description: The collisional-damping cutoff and Lyman-alpha constraint are evaluated only by comparing to a generic DM-neutrino elastic-scattering bound; no Boltzmann-level computation or likelihood exists for this EFT's temperature-dependent DM-neutrino interaction and M_cut prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutrino-portal scattering rate in a DM-neutrino-interacting modified CLASS (ETHOS-style nu-DM coupling), compute the linear power suppression, and score it against Lyman-alpha flux-power and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods instead of the translated generic bound.

members.model_name: Thermal-effects freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No production-specific structure-formation likelihood exists: Lyman-alpha, satellite-count, and phase-space bounds are quoted from thermal-relic or DW-based mappings, but constraining this model requires propagating its colder freeze-in distribution function to the matter power spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f(q) benchmarks into CLASS as non-cold dark matter to get transfer functions, then apply Lyman-alpha forest likelihoods/emulators and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods, reporting mass bounds as a function of the freeze-in channel mix and f_DM.

members.model_name: Regurgitated fermion dark matter
members.description: The warmness of Hawking-emitted RDM is only checked against a crude BBN temperature floor; no transfer-function calculation or Lyman-alpha/structure-formation likelihood exists for the Hawking-emission phase-space distribution, leaving the warm-DM region unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the redshifted Hawking-emission momentum distribution into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm f(q), compute the linear power-spectrum suppression, and map it to existing Lyman-alpha WDM-equivalent bounds (or an emulator) to obtain a quantitative (m_DM, M_PBH) warmness constraint.

members.model_name: Regurgitated scalar dark matter
members.description: The warmness of Hawking-emitted scalar RDM is only checked against a crude BBN temperature floor; no transfer-function calculation or Lyman-alpha/structure-formation likelihood exists for the Hawking-emission phase-space distribution, leaving the warm-DM region unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the redshifted Hawking-emission momentum distribution into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm f(q), compute the linear power-spectrum suppression, and map it to existing Lyman-alpha WDM-equivalent bounds (or an emulator) to obtain a quantitative (m_DM, M_PBH) warmness constraint.

members.model_name: Thermal hadronic axion in nonstandard cosmologies
members.description: No Boltzmann-to-likelihood pipeline exists for the mixed cold-misalignment plus warm-thermal axion population: CLASS-style ncdm setups handle a single thermal species with a nonstandard temperature, but no configured run or LSS/CMB likelihood covers the two-component (cold fraction plus warm fraction) case this model predicts.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure CLASS with a cold axion fluid plus an ncdm species at the computed axion temperature T_a0, and couple it to Planck and galaxy-clustering/Lyman-alpha likelihoods in MontePython or Cobaya, scanning (m_a, f_cold, f_warm) to produce reusable mixed-population constraints.

members.model_name: Relativistically decoupled warm dark matter with arbitrary distribution function
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood exists that accepts a general transfer function T(k) with distribution-dependent free-streaming and acoustic-oscillation features; existing flux-power constraints and emulators are calibrated on thermal-relic or Dodelson-Widrow-like cutoffs, so the quoted 550 eV / 2.0 keV limits cannot be transferred to arbitrary f_0(p) without recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Ly-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood framework to take generic T(k) shapes as input (parameterized by cutoff scale, slope, and oscillation amplitude/phase) instead of a thermal-equivalent WDM mass, trained on hydrodynamic simulations spanning that shape space.

members.model_name: A4 Froggatt-Nielsen seesaw sterile-neutrino warm dark matter model
members.description: No joint likelihood pipeline exists for this model combining X-ray decay-line limits, Lyman-alpha free-streaming constraints on a non-thermal sterile spectrum, and short-baseline/reactor oscillation fits over the (M_s, theta_s, FN-charge) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline: compute the transfer function from f(p) with a modified CLASS/CAMB non-cold-relic module, apply published Ly-alpha WDM likelihoods or emulators, add stacked X-ray line limits (e.g. from blank-sky and M31 analyses), and couple the eV-sterile sector to a public oscillation global-fit code.

members.model_name: Global-U(1) pseudo-Dirac dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: Lyman-alpha and small-scale-structure constraints are only partially available and calibrated for WDM-like exponential cutoffs; no likelihood handles this model's oscillatory dark-acoustic-oscillation power spectrum, so exclusions cannot be stated without recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints for DAO-shaped spectra using an emulator or area-criterion mapping trained on hydrodynamical simulations with ETHOS-like initial conditions, fed by the gap_1 transfer functions.

members.model_name: 7.1 keV sterile-neutrino dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: No matter-power/Lyman-alpha likelihood (nor a validated thermal-WDM mapping, which the card marks unavailable) exists for this model's decay-produced nonthermal transfer function, so the free-streaming constraint status is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the linear transfer function with CLASS ncdm using the derived f(p), then recast it through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (or a validated area-criterion thermal-WDM mapping) to bound the (m_s, T_prod) benchmark.

members.model_name: Quasi-cold dark matter with velocity-dispersion perturbations
members.description: No dedicated Lyman-alpha likelihood or calibrated recast maps sigma^2 to a flux-power constraint; the card's Lyman-alpha bound rests on comparing cutoff scales to thermal-WDM masses even though the quasi-cold transfer function is not identical to thermal WDM, and the validity of that mapping in the k ~ 20-70 h/Mpc range is untested.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the gap_1 linear P(k) into an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood framework calibrated on hydrodynamic simulations (e.g. the WDM-style emulators used for MIKE/HIRES/eBOSS analyses, or an area-criterion recast validated against them) to derive a direct exclusion on sigma^2 rather than an equivalent-WDM-mass proxy.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with Dodelson-Widrow modification of a non-trivial initial abundance
members.description: No structure-formation likelihood (Milky Way satellite counts or Lyman-alpha forest) valid for mixed cold+warm non-thermal sterile-neutrino spectra; existing constraints are parameterized in thermal-WDM mass and the paper substitutes an approximate subhalo-abundance estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast a public satellite-count likelihood (DES/PS1-type subhalo abundance) and a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator in terms of the full linear P(k) (e.g. via half-mode scale or area-criterion mapping) so that arbitrary DW-modified transfer functions can be scored directly.

members.model_name: Constrained self-interacting dark matter with dark photon and dark fermions
members.description: No validated Lyman-alpha likelihood or WDM-equivalent mapping exists for this model's oscillatory dark-acoustic-damping transfer function; the paper's satellite-suppression conclusion rests on a qualitative recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES-style) with an area-criterion or emulator-based treatment of dark-acoustic-oscillation transfer functions, validated against a small set of hydrodynamic simulations with DAO initial conditions.

members.model_name: Cannibal scalar dark matter with 3-to-2 self-interactions
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest constraint pipeline exists for CanDM: the paper defers the recast, and existing forest likelihoods/emulators are calibrated on WDM-like thermal cutoffs, not the pressure-driven suppression shape from cannibal dynamics (the card flags the WDM mapping as misleading).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed CanDM linear P(k) suppression shapes into an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power framework (e.g. an area-criterion or emulator-based WDM-style analysis extended to general suppression shapes), running a small set of hydrodynamic simulations to validate the mapping for full and ten-percent CanDM fractions.

members.model_name: Self-interacting warm dark matter
members.description: No full Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood exists for SI-WDM: existing Lyman-alpha emulators and likelihoods are calibrated on CDM and thermal-WDM transfer-function shapes, while self-interactions change the cutoff shape (late kinetic coupling, dark acoustic-like features), so the paper's deviation criterion against thermal-WDM bounds cannot yield robust mass/cross-section limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small grid of hydrodynamical simulations (or validated a-la Sherwood rescalings) over representative siwdm-class transfer-function shapes and extend an existing Lyman-alpha emulator/likelihood framework (e.g., a LaCE-style flux-power emulator) to the SI-WDM shape parameters, then derive proper posterior bounds on (m_DM, C_V, C_m).

members.model_name: Two temperature dark matter (2TDM)
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood exists for the two-temperature nonthermal transfer-function shape; the card's Ly-alpha bound is a recast against thermal-WDM reference masses (3.5/5.3 keV), which the card itself flags as approximate for two-temperature spectra whose cutoff shape differs from thermal WDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Ly-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood framework (e.g. the MIKE/HIRES + XQ-100 grids or a Sherwood-type emulator) to accept general suppressed transfer functions parameterized by (A_2, eta, m_DM) or by shape parameters like the area criterion, and validate against the paper's quoted A_ref thresholds.

members.model_name: Two-component cold dark matter with self-heated light component
members.description: Lyman-alpha constraints exist only as a qualitative argument that thermal-WDM mass bounds are weakened; no dedicated recast maps the model's nonthermal, fraction-and-splitting-controlled suppression onto Lyman-alpha flux-power data.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the model's transfer functions through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator or apply the area-criterion mapping calibrated on hydrodynamic simulations, scanning (r_1, m_1, m_2, sigma_self_1) to replace the qualitative weakened-bound statement with contours.

members.model_name: Light hidden fermion assisted gravitino dark matter
members.description: No mixed warm/cold structure-formation likelihood exists for decay-produced gravitino or hidden-fermion components: the route uses an approximate lambda_FS < 0.5 Mpc proxy instead of a transfer-function-level Lyman-alpha constraint on the warm fraction f_WDM with the nonthermal decay momentum spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nonthermal phase-space distribution f(q) for daughters of two-body LOSP or parent decays at lifetime tau_parent, feed it to CLASS as an ncdm component alongside the cold fraction, and compare against published Lyman-alpha mixed cold+warm fraction bounds or an emulator-based flux-power likelihood.

members.model_name: Two-body decaying dark matter with one massless and one massive daughter
members.description: No dedicated Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood exists for two-body decaying dark matter; current constraints rely on effective mappings of the decay-induced suppression onto emulators trained on LCDM/WDM grids, which is only approximate at the S8-favored (tau, epsilon) values.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Ly-alpha flux-power emulator with hydrodynamical runs using two-body DDM linear spectra from the modified CLASS branch, or validate the existing effective-model compression (arXiv:2210.06117 approach) across the full (tau, epsilon) plane.

members.model_name: Non-thermally produced WIMP dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha bound on r_c rests on a visual comparison to a 750 eV thermal-WDM transfer function rather than a modern flux-power likelihood evaluated for the model's actual nonthermal transfer functions, and the dwarf phase-space bound is only an order-of-magnitude estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the model's CLASS-generated transfer functions through an existing public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. the MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 or BOSS-based WDM analysis chains) using the standard area-criterion or direct P(k) interface to re-derive the r_c limit.

members.model_name: Interacting hot neutrino dark matter
members.description: The route lists no likelihoods: there is no pipeline comparing the diffusion-damped matter power spectrum to modern large-scale-structure or CMB data, so the phenomenologically allowed lambda_mfp range cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS implementation from gap_1 exists, connect it through Cobaya/MontePython to Planck CMB, galaxy power spectrum, and Lyman-alpha 1D flux likelihoods to derive posterior bounds on (m_nu, sigma_nunu or lambda_mfp).

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter from Peccei-Quinn-field parametric resonance
members.description: No LSS/Lyman-alpha likelihood has been applied to resonance-produced warm axions; the card only has the qualitative v_a < 1e-3 warmness bound, and the constraint con_axion_lss_warmness_recast explicitly lacks a likelihood, so no exclusion curve in (m_S,i, f_a) exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated nonthermal spectra into CLASS as an ncdm species, compute transfer functions, and evaluate them against an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. the area-criterion or emulator-based WDM pipelines generalized to arbitrary f(p)), producing a warmness exclusion in the model parameters.

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from out-of-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood applies to this model: the card's bound is a 2008 SDSS free-streaming comparison (k_fs ~ 2/Mpc), and modern Lyman-alpha constraints and emulators are calibrated on thermal-WDM transfer functions, not the nonthermal out-of-equilibrium singlet-decay cutoff shape.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's transfer functions onto existing Lyman-alpha analyses via half-mode or area-criterion matching to thermal-WDM emulators (MIKE/HIRES/eBOSS-based), validated with a small set of hydrodynamic simulations for representative warm out-of-equilibrium spectra.

members.model_name: Preheating dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline exists for the model: the paper only compares spectral shapes qualitatively to WMAP/SDSS/Lyman-alpha data with matter-radiation equality held fixed, so no modern CMB+LSS constraint on (m_phi, lambda) can be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS implementation of gap_1 exists, couple it to Cobaya or MontePython with the Planck 2018 CMB likelihoods plus a BOSS/eBOSS P(k) or Lyman-alpha likelihood and run an MCMC over (m_phi, lambda, z_T) alongside the standard cosmological parameters.

members.model_name: Equilibrium-scalar freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha/small-scale-structure constraint on the nonthermal N1 spectrum is applied only via an approximate thermal-WDM free-streaming mapping, which the card flags as a proxy; no likelihood ingests the actual nonthermal transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed f_N1(p) into CLASS as an ncdm species to compute exact linear transfer functions, then evaluate them against a Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator calibrated for generic suppressed spectra (area-criterion or emulator-based) instead of the half-mode WDM mapping.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter with sterile-neutrino Dark MSW interactions
members.description: No quantitative small-scale-structure likelihood exists for the late DM-sterile-neutrino momentum transfer: the card records likelihood_available no, robustness low, and no forward-model step covers the obs_dm_neutrino_momentum_transfer_small_scales observable, so the (q_s^2 q_X^2, m_A) bound is only a qualitative exclusion statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the A-prime-mediated DM-neutrino momentum-transfer rate as an ETHOS-style dark-matter/dark-radiation coupling in a modified CLASS, compute the suppressed linear power spectra over the (q_s^2 q_X^2, m_A, m_X) space including the model-dependent sterile-sector temperature, and recast Lyman-alpha bounds via an area-criterion or emulator likelihood.

members.model_name: String-axiverse misalignment dark matter parameterization
members.description: No fraction-aware Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or flux-power emulator exists for mixed ultralight-axion dark matter; existing bounds assume the axion is all of the dark matter, while this model's posterior favors Omega_a/Omega_cdm < 1 with log10(m_a/eV) near -21.5.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator with an axion-fraction parameter: run a grid of hydrodynamical simulations initialized with axionCAMB mixed-DM transfer functions over (m_a, Omega_a/Omega_cdm), train the emulator, and package it as a MontePython/Cobaya likelihood.

members.model_name: S3 x Z2 sterile-neutrino dark matter model
members.description: No packaged X-ray-line or structure-formation (Lyman-alpha, satellite-count) likelihood is linked to the card for mapping a nonthermal sterile-neutrino momentum distribution onto exclusions; existing published limits assume standard Dodelson-Widrow-like spectra and would need reinterpretation for this model's colder or warmer f(p).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recasting pipeline that maps arbitrary f(p) to a half-mode-mass or equivalent-thermal-WDM mass via CLASS transfer functions and applies published Lyman-alpha/satellite likelihoods, combined with X-ray line flux limits rescaled by the computed abundance fraction and mixing-driven decay rate.

members.model_name: Non-adiabatically produced gravitational ultra-light scalar dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood applicable to this model exists: the quoted XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE fuzzy-DM bound assumes standard misalignment-FDM transfer functions, and no flux-power likelihood or emulator accepts the non-adiabatic production distribution's transfer-function shape.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE flux-power likelihood using an existing Lyman-alpha emulator conditioned on the linear transfer function (marginalizing IGM thermal history), mapping this model's suppression scale onto the emulator's cutoff parameterization and checking the mapping's validity against a small set of hydrodynamical simulations.

members.model_name: Conformal GUT hidden-sector inert dark fermion dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha constraint is applied only as a lambda_fs < 1 Mpc coldness threshold; there is no transfer-function-level calculation or likelihood for the model's nonthermal dark-fermion momentum distribution, whose transfer_function_shape the card marks unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the nonthermal f(p) from the inflaton-decay Boltzmann solution into CLASS as a non-cold-DM species, compute the linear transfer function, and constrain it with an existing Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator (e.g. the WDM half-mode area criterion or a MIKE/HIRES-calibrated flux-power emulator).

members.model_name: Dark matter vortex filament model
members.description: No dedicated recast likelihood links the ultralight mass m implied by any chosen interpretation of the N_V/m fit to Lyman-alpha and halo/subhalo structure bounds, particularly in the subcomponent or self-interacting-condensate regimes where published all-DM fuzzy bounds do not directly apply.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints (using public WDM/FDM emulators or the axionCAMB transfer functions mapped through a calibrated flux-power emulator) and Milky Way satellite/subhalo likelihoods into a joint likelihood over (m, dark matter fraction, g), covering the mixed cold-plus-ultralight case.

members.model_name: Asymptotic-safety sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha (or combined structure/X-ray) likelihood exists for a sub-MeV sterile neutrino with a scalar-decay nonthermal spectrum; published bounds assume Dodelson-Widrow or thermal-WDM spectra and the card marks the constraint as recast_required with no likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_N(p) into CLASS/CAMB as an ncdm species to obtain transfer functions, then recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints via an existing WDM emulator or half-mode/area-criterion mapping, and rescale published X-ray line limits by the model's actual abundance-mixing relation.

members.model_name: Spinning-PBH evaporation Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No warm-DM structure-formation likelihood exists for the Hawking-emitted phase-space distribution: the card notes lighter evaporation-produced particles need a distribution check before Lyman-alpha-like limits apply, but no released chain converts the FRISBHEE/BlackHawk emission spectrum into a transfer function and small-scale bound in the (M_PBH, a_star, m_chi) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract the redshifted Hawking phase-space distribution f(q) for Kerr PBHs from BlackHawk/FRISBHEE, feed it into CLASS as a non-cold ncdm species to obtain the transfer function, and recast published Lyman-alpha WDM mass bounds onto the (M_PBH, a_star, m_chi) parameter space.

members.model_name: Multi-ultralight-axion mixed dark matter
members.description: No public Lyman-alpha likelihood or recast exists for multi-ULA transfer-function shapes; the cited 2e-20 eV bound assumes all-DM single-ULA spectra and the card marks likelihood availability unknown with recasting needed, while the WDM mapping is explicitly warned to be inaccurate.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. hydrodynamic-simulation-based emulators used for WDM/ULA bounds) onto the multi-ULA transfer-function parameter space (m_i, f_i, m_r), rather than relying on approximate WDM-equivalent masses.

members.model_name: Coherent-incoherent self-interacting bosonic dark matter framework
members.description: No likelihood exists for confronting the hybrid transfer function with data: standard one-component FDM Lyman-alpha boson-mass bounds cannot be applied without mapping the full hybrid transfer function, and no dwarf-galaxy/core likelihood is packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints by feeding the hybrid model's transfer functions through an existing Lyman-alpha emulator/likelihood pipeline over the (m, g, condensate fraction) space, and build an analogous recast of soliton-core and dwarf-galaxy density-profile constraints.

members.model_name: Hidden axion dark matter from saxion decay
members.description: No Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood is attached to the route (likelihood_available 'no' for con_lya_free_streaming_axion), so even with a transfer function the constraint can only be imposed through the crude L_fs < 0.1 Mpc criterion or a borrowed thermal-equivalent 5.3 keV bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the computed nonthermal transfer functions with an existing XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE flux-power likelihood or a Lyman-alpha emulator, or at minimum implement the published area-criterion recast that maps generic suppressed transfer functions onto the thermal-WDM exclusion.

members.model_name: Minimal clockwork neutrinogenesis scalar dark-sector subcomponent
members.description: Existing Lyman-alpha and CMB/LSS mixed hot-DM likelihoods are calibrated for thermal (WDM-like or massive-neutrino-like) spectra and no recast exists that bounds f_hot for this model's nonthermal secluded distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's transfer functions onto existing mixed cold-plus-hot constraints by matching suppression templates, or rerun a Lyman-alpha emulator-based likelihood on a grid of (m_phi, dark temperature, f_hot) to produce a reusable f_hot bound.

members.model_name: Intermediate-mass pseudo-Goldstone boson partial dark matter
members.description: The m_I-f_I exclusion rests on a 2001-era WMAP + SDSS + Lyman-alpha + sigma8 combination; no modern CMB and galaxy-clustering likelihood analysis of the fractional intermediate-mass PGB exists, so current limits on f_I cannot be quoted.
members.proposed_resolution: Run axionCAMB or AxiCLASS for the (m_I, f_I) grid inside Cobaya/MontePython with Planck 2018, BAO, and DESI/eBOSS full-shape likelihoods, validating against the paper's historical below-ten-percent bound in the intermediate window.

members.model_name: Frozen-in scalar decay production of keV sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for decay-produced nonthermal sterile-neutrino spectra: published warm-dark-matter Lyman-alpha bounds are calibrated on thermal-relic transfer functions, so the model's smooth-cutoff transfer function cannot be robustly confronted with forest data (the card itself notes transfer functions are more reliable than free-streaming estimates).
members.proposed_resolution: Map the CLASS transfer functions for f_N1(p) onto a generalized cutoff parameterization (e.g. the {alpha, beta, gamma} thermal-relic-equivalent scheme) and evaluate them with an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (Sherwood- or eBOSS-calibrated), instead of the half-mode area estimate.

members.model_name: Plateau-potential string axion ultralight dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or emulator is calibrated for transfer functions with resonance-enhanced power just below the fuzzy-DM Jeans scale; existing products are built for monotonic suppression shapes, so the claimed relaxation of the Lyman-alpha tension cannot be quantitatively tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator (e.g. one built on suppressed-power hydrodynamical grids) with hydrodynamical simulations of bump-plus-cutoff initial power spectra parameterized by (cutoff scale, bump amplitude, bump width), and expose it as a likelihood over (m, alpha, x_osc, omega_ULA).

members.model_name: Cosh-potential scalar-field dark matter
members.description: Neither card constraint has a likelihood (likelihood_available: no for both): there is no pipeline recasting modern Lyman-alpha, satellite-count, or rotation-curve data onto the cosh-potential parameter space, so current viability rests on historical order-of-magnitude arguments.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the cosh model onto the standard ULDM/FDM (m_phi, transfer-function) parameterization using the gap_1 solver output, then reuse published Lyman-alpha flux-power and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods for FDM, adding a rotation-curve core comparison for the r_c prediction.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated self-interacting sterile neutrino dark matter

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter with radiative decay

members.proposed_resolution: Recast the production-specific transfer functions (gap_1) through existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulators/likelihoods, combine with published X-ray line-search limits (XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR blank-sky) on (m_s, theta), and release the joint likelihood over (m_s, theta, f_s, production mechanism).

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from in-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood applies to this model: the card's bound is a 2008 SDSS free-streaming comparison (k_fs ~ 2/Mpc), and modern Lyman-alpha constraints and emulators are calibrated on thermal-WDM transfer functions rather than the colder nonthermal singlet-decay cutoff shape.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's transfer functions onto existing Lyman-alpha analyses via the area-criterion or half-mode matching to thermal-WDM emulators (MIKE/HIRES/eBOSS-based), and validate the mapping with a small set of hydrodynamic simulations for representative chilled spectra.

members.model_name: Effective A4 model with one keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter state

members.proposed_resolution: Compute the N2 distribution f(q) with temperature T_DS from the transfer solver, run it through CLASS as an ncdm species to get the linear transfer function over the (m_N2, T_DS/T_SM) plane, and recast against existing Lyman-alpha flux-power and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods.

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood is packaged for this nonthermal cutoff: the card marks likelihood_available as partial and recasting_needed yes, and thermal-WDM mass limits cannot be copied directly onto the decay-produced spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model transfer function through an existing generalized small-scale-suppression Lyman-alpha framework (e.g. the alpha-beta-gamma transfer-function parameterization fits used for non-thermal WDM), producing exclusion contours in (m_axino, decay time).

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7 keV sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Lyman-alpha and Local Group structure constraints are only partially available and are applied through approximate thermal-WDM mass mappings, which the card flags as invalid for the resonant transfer-function shape (benchmarks should be tested with the exact nonthermal transfer function).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints using an emulator trained on shape-varying (non-thermal) cutoffs fed the exact CLASS transfer functions for each L_4, instead of quoting a single thermal-WDM equivalent mass.

members.model_name: U(1)_R lepton-number model with keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: Structure-formation constraints beyond the analytic phase-space floor are not applicable yet: Lyman-alpha limits were not applied, and existing Lyman-alpha emulators are calibrated for thermal-relic WDM, not for this model's (currently unknown) nonthermal sterile-neutrino distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Once f(p) is derived (gap_1), map the resulting transfer function to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass via half-mode matching and apply published Lyman-alpha thermal-WDM likelihoods/emulators, validating the mapping for the nonthermal shape.

members.model_name: Higgs-singlet higher-dimensional-operator ultralight axion
members.description: No observational likelihoods are implemented for this model's (m_a, F, axion fraction) space: the card lists an empty likelihoods array and its caveats flag Lyman-alpha, black-hole superradiance, and CMB isocurvature constraints as needing external likelihood work.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a constraint module over (m_a, F, Omega_a fraction): recast published fuzzy-DM Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints via axionCAMB/axiCLASS transfer functions, add black-hole superradiance exclusion bands in m_a, and evaluate CMB isocurvature bounds for the F ~ 1e16-1e18 GeV misalignment scenario.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric instanton-generated ultralight axion
members.description: No likelihood connects the instanton-axion transfer function to small-scale-structure data: the route's likelihoods list is empty and the card states Lyman-alpha, superradiance, and CMB isocurvature likelihoods were not evaluated for the targeted m_a-F window.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple axionCAMB/AxiCLASS transfer functions, parameterized by (m_a, axion fraction), to existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulators and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods, and impose published superradiance and isocurvature exclusion curves as priors on (m_a, F).

members.model_name: Light asymmetric Bose gas dark matter with present-day condensate
members.description: The Lyman-alpha lower-mass bound near 10^-20 eV is quoted from debated external literature (likelihood_available: unknown, recasting_needed: yes); no dedicated Lyman-alpha likelihood recast exists for the condensed conserved-charge scenario, so ultralight allowed regions cannot be marked robust.
members.proposed_resolution: Once model transfer functions exist (gap_1), recast them through a public Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/compressed likelihood calibrated for suppressed-power cosmologies to derive a model-specific ultralight mass bound replacing the debated literature value.

members.model_name: Dark glueballs with associated ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood exists for a mixed cosmology in which an ultralight axion (m_a ~ 1e-23 to 1e-21 eV) is only a fraction of the dark matter with the rest in cold glueballs; existing FDM bounds assume a 100 percent fuzzy component and the card notes the literature disagrees even on those.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB to two-component (ULA fraction plus CDM-like glueball) linear power spectra and run or emulate hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha forest simulations over (m_a, Omega_a/Omega_DM), building a flux-power likelihood analogous to existing WDM/FDM forest analyses.

members.model_name: Leptophilic light flavon hot-relic model
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or small-scale-structure likelihood exists for a subdominant hot flavon fraction: the paper's order-one-percent hot-relic criterion is an estimate, and published mixed cold+hot bounds are calibrated for thermal non-cold species, not this model's freeze-out/freeze-in mixture.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast mixed cold+hot dark matter Lyman-alpha constraints (e.g. the 1702.01764-style f_ncdm bounds or a Lyman-alpha flux emulator) onto the (f_eta, m_eta) plane using the model's transfer functions, replacing the one-percent rule of thumb with a proper likelihood.

members.model_name: Self-interacting sterile-neutrino dark matter with heavy scalar mediator
members.description: No packaged X-ray line or structure (phase-space, subhalo, Lyman-alpha, reionization) likelihood exists for this model's nonthermal momentum distribution, which differs from both Dodelson-Widrow and thermal spectra; current constraints are overlaid exclusion curves derived for other spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that takes the solver output f_s(p), computes the transfer function with CLASS using a tabulated non-cold distribution, and applies Lyman-alpha emulator and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods, plus a digitized X-ray line likelihood in the (m_s, theta) plane.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with scalar-mediated neutrino NSI
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for the model's nonthermal, cosmology-dependent momentum distributions; the paper explicitly omits plotted Lyman-alpha exclusions because standard thermal-WDM mass bounds do not map directly onto NSI-modified spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_s(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter species to obtain T(k), then apply an area-criterion or emulator-based Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (e.g. built on existing WDM/sterile-neutrino forest analyses) valid for general suppressed spectra.

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or flux-power emulator is calibrated for multifield/fractional ULDM suppression shapes; the published m_a > 2e-20 eV bound applies only to canonical single-field all-of-DM axions and cannot be applied to N-field mixtures directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Recalibrate a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator on hydrodynamic simulations initialized with multifield ULA transfer functions (spanning N, mass ratios, and fractions), or recast the existing single-field likelihood via a matched-suppression mapping validated against a few dedicated hydro runs.

members.model_name: Mixed collisionless dark matter free-streaming model
members.description: No small-scale-structure likelihood (Lyman-alpha forest, satellite counts, or strong-lensing subhalos) is valid for general mixed cold+warm transfer-function shapes; published bounds assume a single thermal-WDM cutoff and the card warns against substituting a thermal relic mapping for these nonthermal mixtures.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing satellite-count likelihood and a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator onto a general transfer-function parameterization (e.g. the alpha-beta-gamma fitting form) so mixed-model transfer functions from gap_1 can be scored directly, instead of through an invalid thermal-WDM mass mapping.

members.model_name: Scalar-decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest likelihood is packaged that accepts the scalar-decay transfer functions: the claimed relief of the X-ray versus Lyman-alpha tension from the low-momentum-enhanced spectrum cannot be tested because only thermal-relic comparisons and old literature bounds are available (likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Run the model T(k) through a modern public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES-class) using the exact nonthermal spectrum rather than a thermal-equivalent mass, delivering a likelihood over (m_s, M, Y, T_dec).

members.model_name: Vector dark matter freeze-in through magnetic dipole interactions
members.description: Lyman-alpha, strong-lensing, and Milky Way satellite constraints are calibrated for thermal WDM transfer functions, and no validated recast exists for the nonthermal magnetic-dipole freeze-in momentum distribution (UV-dominated production near T_RH), so the warm-structure bound on (m_Aprime, d_f, T_RH) is only approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the freeze-in f(p) from the dipole collision term, implement it in the CLASS ncdm sector to obtain the transfer function, and map to existing thermal-WDM-calibrated likelihoods via a half-mode-mass or area-criterion matching validated against a Lyman-alpha flux emulator; report where the shape mismatch invalidates the mapping.

members.model_name: Nonthermal decay-produced dark matter for the Hubble tension
members.description: No structure-formation likelihood exists for the hot fraction f: the limit f ~ 0.01 is an order-of-magnitude argument, with no transfer-function-based galaxy-clustering or Lyman-alpha likelihood computed for the decay-produced daughter velocity distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the extended Boltzmann solver from gap_1, compute P(k) suppression versus (f, k_fs) and confront it with galaxy power spectra at k = 0.02-0.2 h/Mpc and existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator constraints, recasting mixed cold+hot DM bounds onto (tau, f, mass ratio).

members.model_name: Spin-zero no-freeze-in/no-freeze-out warm dark matter
members.description: Published Lyman-alpha forest limits apply only to thermal-relic WDM; no Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator accepts the colder no-freeze-in/no-freeze-out transfer function, so the translated limit rests on an approximate temperature-ratio rescaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (e.g. the Vid-Irsic-style or PRIYA/Sherwood-based WDM emulators) in terms of generic transfer-function suppression parameters (alpha, beta, gamma or half-mode scale) and evaluate it on the model's exact transfer function from gap_1.

members.model_name: Approximate-PQ electroweak supersymmetry with singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: The warm-DM bound on the singlino rests on a WMAP-era reionization argument (m_s > ~10 keV); no modern Lyman-alpha or Milky Way satellite likelihood has been applied to the model's nonthermal, entropy-diluted transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the diluted singlino f(p) from gap_2 into CLASS to obtain T(k), then constrain it with public Lyman-alpha flux-power emulators and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods, mapping the result back to (m_s, D) instead of the obsolete 10 keV estimate.

members.model_name: Inert-Sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The Lyman-alpha bound exists only as a thermal/conventional sterile-neutrino equivalent mass limit (m_s > 2.0 keV), and the card flags that no valid thermal-WDM mapping exists for this nonthermal decay-produced spectrum, so no likelihood can be applied to warm benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's computed transfer functions through a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator or the area-criterion method calibrated on WDM hydrodynamic simulations, producing a bound directly in (M1, m_eta_L, T_decay) space instead of a thermal-equivalent mass substitution.

members.model_name: R-parity violating axino warm dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood has been run for the 7 keV axino's nonthermal transfer function (likelihood listed as unavailable, recast required), so the reported tension of thermal-bath 7 keV axinos with Ly-alpha data cannot be quantified for this model's actual production history.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated f_axino(q) into CLASS, compute T(k), and evaluate it against a Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood/emulator that accepts general cutoff shapes rather than a single thermal-WDM mass.

members.model_name: Dark-atom self-interacting dark matter with dark acoustic oscillations
members.description: No Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood valid for oscillatory DAO spectra: existing Ly-alpha analyses and emulators are built on smooth thermal-WDM-like cutoffs, and the card flags that mapping them onto the dark-atom transfer functions without dedicated hydrodynamical modeling can misclassify the benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Train an extended Ly-alpha flux-power emulator on hydrodynamical simulations that include oscillatory DAO initial power spectra (parameterized by r_DAO, damping scale, and interacting fraction), marginalizing over IGM thermal history and feedback, and release it as a likelihood usable on the benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Many-body decaying dark matter with relativistic daughters
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or weak-lensing likelihood covers the many-body decay's late-time scale-dependent suppression; existing Ly-alpha emulators are calibrated on LCDM/WDM-like power spectra and the related-work constraints (arXiv:2210.06117-style) apply to two-body kinematics only.
members.proposed_resolution: Validate an effective-parameter compression (amplitude and redshift of power suppression) of the many-body model against an existing Ly-alpha flux-power emulator, or retrain the emulator on hydro/N-body runs with the many-body linear input spectra.

members.model_name: Non-thermal fermionic dark matter in an anomaly-free B-L extension
members.description: There is no pipeline from the nonthermal distribution f_psi1(p) to a proper structure-formation likelihood: the coldness verdict rests on a lambda_fs threshold proxy rather than a transfer function confronted with Lyman-alpha (or CMB) data, so borderline-warm parameter regions cannot be judged.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated f_psi1(p) into CLASS as a non-cold relic (ncdm with a tabulated phase-space distribution) to compute the linear transfer function, then recast against a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or WDM-style emulator to obtain fraction- and spectrum-dependent bounds.

members.model_name: Stable fermion dark matter from decays of gravitationally produced superheavy particles
members.description: No small-scale structure likelihood recast exists for this model: the coldness requirement is a heuristic threshold, and no Lyman-alpha forest or satellite-count constraint has been mapped onto the (m_chi, m_S, y) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the transfer function from gap_1 is available, recast existing Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints (via half-mode-mass matching to warm-dark-matter limits or a public flux-power emulator) and Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods into a lower bound on y as a function of m_chi and m_S, replacing the 1 keV coldness heuristic.

members.model_name: Gravitational-genesis two-component dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or small-scale-structure likelihood exists for this mixed cold (PBH relic) plus warm (evaporation-produced particle) dark matter scenario; the route explicitly lists the Lyman-alpha recast as unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the computed mixed C+W transfer functions onto published Lyman-alpha WDM bounds using an area-criterion or half-mode matching for the warm fraction (following existing mixed cold+warm DM Lyman-alpha analyses), or run the transfer functions through a public Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator with a warm-fraction parameterization.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with B-L vector NSI
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for the model's nonthermal, cosmology-dependent momentum distributions; the paper explicitly omits plotted Lyman-alpha exclusions because standard thermal-WDM mass bounds do not map directly onto NSI-modified spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_s(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter species to obtain T(k), then apply an area-criterion or emulator-based Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (e.g. built on existing WDM/sterile-neutrino forest analyses) valid for general suppressed spectra.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with neutrinophilic vector NSI
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for the model's nonthermal, cosmology-dependent momentum distributions; the paper explicitly omits plotted Lyman-alpha exclusions because standard thermal-WDM mass bounds do not map directly onto NSI-modified spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_s(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter species to obtain T(k), then apply an area-criterion or emulator-based Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (e.g. built on existing WDM/sterile-neutrino forest analyses) valid for general suppressed spectra.

members.model_name: Kerr primordial-black-hole evaporated non-cold dark matter
members.description: No end-to-end likelihood evaluation exists for the PBH-emitted non-cold spectra: the Lyman-alpha constraint is imposed by matching the CLASS transfer-function cutoff to thermal-WDM reference bounds rather than evaluating the actual T(k) in a Lyman-alpha likelihood, and the BBN/CMB Delta N_eff limits are taken from review tables instead of being recomputed for each (M_in, a_star, beta_prime) point.
members.proposed_resolution: Fit the FRISBHEE+CLASS transfer functions to the standard {alpha, beta, gamma} non-cold parameterization and reuse published Lyman-alpha MCMC posteriors on that space, and wire Delta N_eff and evaporation-epoch outputs into a Planck lite plus BBN (PArthENoPE/PRIMAT-style) likelihood, packaged as a scan over (M_in, a_star, beta_prime, m_DM, s_DM).

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition
members.description: No pipeline turns the domain-produced nonthermal spectrum f_N(p) into a linear transfer function and Lyman-alpha likelihood; the card explicitly warns that using a thermal or Dodelson-Widrow proxy spectrum would misstate the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Pass the computed f_N(p) into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution to obtain transfer functions, then recast against Lyman-alpha flux-power data via an emulator-based likelihood covering mixed cold-plus-warm and cool resonant spectra.

members.model_name: Self-interacting warm dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists that constrains the SI-WDM shifted cutoff against modern small-scale data: the card provides no thermal-WDM mapping, so standard Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite bounds calibrated on collisionless-WDM transfer-function shapes cannot be applied directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the computed SI-WDM transfer functions through a shape-agnostic Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator (or the half-mode/area criterion validated against hydrodynamic simulations) and through subhalo/satellite-count likelihoods parameterized by the full T(k) rather than a thermal WDM mass.

members.model_name: Nonthermal sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No ready-to-run Lyman-alpha forest likelihood or emulator is interfaced to the nonthermal sterile-neutrino transfer function; the card's mass bound relies on an approximate thermal-WDM mapping that the paper itself warns against for this spectrally distorted distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute T(k) from the tabulated f_s(p) with CLASS ncdm and feed it to a public compressed Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES style), replacing the thermal-relic-equivalent mapping with a direct nonthermal recast.

members.model_name: Bolon coupled dark matter from dilatation anomaly
members.description: No bolon-specific likelihood exists and the generic interacting-DE and scalar-DM Jeans constraints cited by the card apply only after an unperformed recast of (alpha, beta, lambda, chi_0) onto phenomenological coupling Q and transfer-function-cutoff parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the modified solver exists, run it inside MontePython/Cobaya against public Planck, BAO, SNIa, and growth likelihoods, and map the predicted small-scale cutoff to WDM-style half-mode-mass bounds from Milky Way satellite counts and Lyman-alpha data.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino WDM halo model
members.description: No Lyman-alpha flux-power or weak-lensing/substructure likelihood is connected to the DW sterile-neutrino transfer function; existing limits were quoted from thermal-relic analyses without rerunning likelihoods or IGM thermal histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast a public Ly-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. the compressed area-criterion or an MP-Gadget/Sherwood-based emulator) to accept DW sterile-neutrino T(k), marginalizing over IGM thermal-history nuisances, and add a lensing/substructure likelihood on the suppressed halo statistics.

members.model_name: Thermal-equilibrium fermionic WDM primordial-spectrum model
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood connects this model's thermal-WDM transfer function or k_1/2 to Lyman-alpha forest and high-redshift structure data; both constraints are marked recasting_needed with no resolved likelihood, so the data_compare step cannot produce a numerical exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the paper's T(k)/k_1/2 outputs with a public Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (e.g. eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES compressed WDM likelihoods) that accepts a generic transfer-function cutoff, and wire the mapping m_FD -> T(k) into it.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian WIMP multiplet dark matter with dark gluon radiation
members.description: No CMB+BAO+Lyman-alpha likelihood pipeline has been assembled for this model's smooth power damping and interacting-radiation Delta N_eff; existing constraints are quoted only as conservative order-of-magnitude bounds requiring parameter translation.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the ETHOS-CLASS implementation from the collision-term derivation to Planck+BAO likelihoods in Cobaya/MontePython, and add a compressed Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator recast validated for smooth (non-cutoff) suppression shapes.

members.model_name: Z2-stabilized scalar dark matter from preheating and reheating
members.description: The large-scale-structure/Lyman-alpha mass floor (con_lss_lya_kev_mass_floor) is applied only as a qualitative order-10-keV statement; no transfer-function computation or Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for this model's nonthermal spectrum (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the derived f(p) into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm phase-space distribution, compute the linear transfer function, and recast existing Lyman-alpha WDM bounds via the standard area-criterion or half-mode matching (or a Lyman-alpha flux emulator) to obtain a quantitative mass/coupling bound.

members.model_name: Starobinsky inflaton-decay hidden scalar dark matter
members.description: No transfer-function computation or structure-formation likelihood exists for this decay-produced 10-100 keV scalar: the strong disfavoring of the L_FS ~ 10 Mpc minimal case and the viability of the ~0.1 Mpc nonminimal case are source-level statements never confronted with Lyman-alpha forest or Milky Way satellite-count data.
members.proposed_resolution: Run CLASS with the derived f(p) as a non-cold relic to get the suppression scale, map to a thermal-WDM-equivalent mass, and evaluate against existing Lyman-alpha emulator likelihoods and MW satellite-count constraints, exposing the result in (m_X, xi_X, xi_h).

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino dark matter from Higgs-singlet decays
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood applies to the colder decay-produced spectrum: existing Lyman-alpha bounds and emulators are calibrated for thermal-WDM or Dodelson-Widrow spectra, so the paper's central claim (bound relaxed from 10 keV to about 2.7 keV) has never been tested against a modern flux-power likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f(p) into CLASS's non-cold-relic sector to obtain T(k), then evaluate against a modern Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator using a generalized suppression-shape (area-criterion) mapping instead of the thermal-mass rescaling.

members.model_name: Relativistic Bose-Einstein condensate scalar dark matter cosmology
members.description: No likelihood pipeline connects the BEC particle parameters (m, a_s, lambda) to rotation-curve, minimum-halo, or Lyman-alpha data for this model; existing constraints in the card are analytic recasts from related papers with likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the gap_2 transfer function into an existing Lyman-alpha/WDM-style likelihood and build a SPARC-based rotation-curve likelihood over the Thomas-Fermi (m, a_s) halo model, validating against the quoted m ~ 2.92e-22 eV noninteracting and a_s-bounded repulsive regions.

members.model_name: Light gravitino dark matter scenarios
members.description: No current Lyman-alpha likelihood exists for a mixed hot-thermal-gravitino plus CDM density fraction; the only quoted bound is the historical WMAP+Ly-alpha m_3/2 < 16 eV result at fixed effective temperature, which does not cover nonstandard-dilution or heavier all-DM scenarios.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast modern Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints (e.g. a WDM/hot-fraction emulator calibrated on hydrodynamic simulations) against CLASS ncdm transfer functions parameterized by (m_3/2, T_gravitino/T_photon, Omega_3/2 fraction), covering both the hot-subcomponent and diluted all-DM branches.

members.model_name: Resonant MSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with technically natural N2-N3 degeneracy
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood or emulator handles the nonthermal resonantly-produced N1 spectrum; existing Ly-alpha constraints are calibrated on thermal-WDM transfer functions, and the card flags that a thermal-equivalent mass proxy can misstate the viable region.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Ly-alpha flux-power emulator over CLASS transfer functions generated from resonant-DM phase-space distributions (parameterized by M_1, theta, L), validated with a small suite of hydrodynamic simulations, or rigorously validate an area-criterion mapping onto existing thermal-WDM likelihoods.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario A
members.description: No Lyman-alpha forest (or dwarf-count) likelihood is available that accepts a general nonthermal sterile-neutrino transfer function; existing thermal-WDM mass bounds cannot be applied directly to the FN spectrum (constraint marked recast_required, likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model's transfer function to an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood framework (e.g. area-criterion or emulator-based recasts of thermal-WDM analyses generalized to arbitrary suppressed transfer functions) and add a Milky Way satellite-count likelihood keyed to the half-mode mass.

members.model_name: sterile-neutrino dark matter from light vector boson decay
members.description: No Lyman-alpha/small-scale-structure likelihood or validated thermal-equivalent mapping exists for the decay-produced, colder-than-thermal spectrum (k/T about 2.4-2.5); the card flags that the 7.1 keV benchmark cannot be declared allowed from the lambda_FS estimate alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f(q) into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution, compute transfer functions across the parameter grid, and recast against existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihoods/emulators (e.g. the standard WDM area-criterion or MIKE/HIRES+XQ-100 based likelihoods) to derive bounds directly on (m_s, M_Zprime, g_prime).

members.model_name: U(1) B-L freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No pipeline exists to translate the nonthermal freeze-in distribution into a small-scale-structure constraint: thermal-WDM Lyman-alpha bounds cannot be applied directly, and no transfer function has been computed for this model's f_N1(p).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed f_N1(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold relic distribution to obtain the linear transfer function, then map to constraints via the half-mode matching to thermal WDM or directly through a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator.

members.model_name: Geometric-baryogenesis ultralight axion-like cold dark matter
members.description: No reusable Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator is available to recast the ultralight-ALP bound onto this model's (m, F_scalar) plane; the card can only quote the fixed published contour (m >= ~1e-21 eV for scalar fraction above ~30%), leaving the paper's m ~ 1e-22 eV full-DM benchmark and partial-fraction variants unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate linear matter power spectra with axionCAMB/AxiCLASS over a (m, F_scalar) grid and evaluate them against a public Ly-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator calibrated on hydrodynamic simulation grids (Sherwood/Nyx-style), reproducing the 1708.00015 contour as validation before extending to arbitrary fractions.

members.model_name: XC charged dark matter with a light C particle
members.description: Small-scale structure is constrained only through the proxy criterion z_dec > 10^6 (CDM-like power for k < 10 h/Mpc); no Lyman-alpha or subhalo-count likelihood exists for the model's oscillatory, DAO-suppressed transfer functions, and the Planck N_eff constraint is applied as a summary bound rather than a bundled likelihood (likelihood_available: no/partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihoods (or ETHOS/WDM emulator-based bounds) onto the model's DAO transfer functions via an area-criterion or half-mode mapping, and wrap Planck N_eff plus H0 inference as a joint likelihood over (xi, Delta N_eff).

members.model_name: Subpercent minicharged dark matter
members.description: None of the listed likelihoods is actually available for this model: the CMB scattering (Neff/mu-distortion and drag) limits, Lyman-alpha matter-power limits, and stellar/SN1987A/SLAC millicharge bounds are cited qualitatively without recast likelihoods, and no global 21-cm signal likelihood (EDGES-like, with astrophysical marginalization) is attached (likelihood_available: no/partial, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a joint likelihood in the (m_chi, epsilon, f_dm) space: recast the Planck DM-baryon-scattering CMB likelihood for a fractional charged component, add the published Lyman-alpha power-spectrum limit, digitize the stellar/SN1987A/SLAC exclusion curves, and wrap a global-21-cm-signal likelihood with marginalized radio background and heating.

members.model_name: Despicable dark relic non-minimally coupled scalar dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha constraint exists for this model's light (sub-keV) relics: existing Lyman-alpha bounds and emulators are calibrated to thermal warm dark matter, while these relics have a nonthermal (or dark-thermalized, T_dark < T_gamma) distribution whose free-streaming differs from an equal-mass thermal relic, so sub-keV parameter points cannot be accepted or excluded.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the full relic distribution f(q) from gap_2 into a Boltzmann code that accepts arbitrary non-cold distribution functions (CLASS with ncdm psd files), compute the linear transfer function, and recast against Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints using the area-criterion or an existing WDM-emulator mapping generalized to non-thermal spectra.

members.model_name: Reproductive freeze-in self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists to confront RFI predictions with data: the relic constraint is only a target-density comparison (likelihood_available: no) and the Lyman-alpha/matter-power and SIDM halo constraints are flagged recast_required with no evaluated likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Once gap_2 provides P(k), recast existing Lyman-alpha WDM/ETHOS emulator bounds onto the RFI suppression scale, and map the model's predicted sigma/m onto published SIDM dwarf-and-cluster constraint compilations for the example Majorana and scalar realizations.

members.model_name: Self-interacting ultra-light axion-like Bose-Einstein-condensate dark matter
members.description: No Lyman-alpha (or other small-scale structure) likelihood accepts the self-interaction-modified BEC transfer function; the cited m > 2e-21 eV bound comes from free-ULA analyses whose cutoff shape and thermal-history marginalization do not transfer directly to this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the self-interacting BEC transfer functions with an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood (e.g. the Rogers-Peiris ULA pipeline or lym-alpha compressed likelihoods), marginalizing over IGM thermal history, to produce joint (m, lambda_s) bounds.

members.model_name: Starobinsky inflaton-decay massive Abelian vector dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists mapping the decay-produced vector's small-scale power suppression onto current structure-formation data; the coldness constraint is currently only a qualitative free-streaming argument.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published Lyman-alpha forest and Milky Way satellite-count WDM limits onto the nonthermal vector spectrum via half-mode-mass matching of the CLASS ncdm transfer function, or run the spectrum through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator to produce an m_X - (g v) exclusion curve.

members.model_name: Two-component wave dark matter with distinct boson masses
members.description: All small-scale constraints on the model are single-component FDM bounds needing recast: no likelihood exists that maps ultrafaint-dwarf granule heating, satellite counts, or Lyman-alpha flux power onto the two-component (m_major, m_minor, f_major) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Generalize the published FDM granule-heating relaxation model to a two-mass superposition for the dwarf stellar-kinematics likelihood, and feed the two-component transfer function (gap_2) through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator calibrated for suppressed-power cosmologies.

members.model_name: Instantaneously decaying WIMP warm dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the SDSS DLA/HI collapsed-fraction lower limits used to constrain the warm tail of this model; the paper's comparison relies on private halo-threshold-mass modeling and the card flags recasting_needed for the Lyman-alpha/HI constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a MontePython/cobaya likelihood module that maps a suppressed matter power spectrum to halo collapsed fractions (Sheth-Tormen or simulation-calibrated mass function with WDM correction) and compares to SDSS DLA/HI lower limits at threshold masses 1e10 and 5e10 Msun, exposing the host-mass mapping as a nuisance parameter.

members.model_name: Dark group warm dark baryon model
members.description: No modern likelihood recast exists for the model: the BBN/Neff energy-density bound and the free-streaming criterion are applied only as early-2000s analytic bounds (likelihood_available: no for both constraints), with no Lyman-alpha, satellite-count, or CMB/Neff pipeline connected.
members.proposed_resolution: Once transfer functions exist, recast standard WDM Lyman-alpha likelihoods/emulators and Milky Way satellite counts onto (Lambda_c, T_D/T_gamma), and apply Planck Neff and background-expansion (SN/BAO) likelihoods to the pre-condensation radiation and w_DE predictions.

members.model_name: Boson-decay sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: Lyman-alpha and satellite-count limits are quoted only for thermal-relic or Dodelson-Widrow distributions; no likelihood or validated mass-mapping exists that recasts these bounds onto the colder boson-decay distribution with g_d ~ 100.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the boson-decay transfer function in CLASS with the tabulated f_BD(y), match it to the equivalent thermal-relic half-mode scale, and run it through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator/likelihood to derive a distribution-specific mass bound.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario B
members.description: No Lyman-alpha or dwarf-count likelihood exists for the resulting nonthermal FN sterile-neutrino transfer functions; only thermal-relic and Dodelson-Widrow mass bounds from the literature are available and they do not map directly onto this model's spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model transfer functions onto modern Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints via half-mode/area-criterion matching to a thermal-WDM emulator, and add Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods for the same suppression scale.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-produced dark SU(N) glueball dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or transfer-function recast tests the glueball scenario against structure-formation data: the combined abundance/coldness/self-interaction verdict is a source-level statement, with no mapping of the cannibalized glueball momentum distribution and sigma/m onto Lyman-alpha, Milky Way satellite, or cluster/dwarf SIDM constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the glueball transfer function with a CLASS non-cold-relic run seeded by the post-cannibalism phase-space distribution, map suppression to thermal-WDM-equivalent Lyman-alpha and satellite-count limits, and combine with existing SIDM cluster/dwarf constraint compilations for sigma/m.
