members.model_name: DFSZ axino dark matter in the Kim-Nilles mechanism
members.description: No Lyman-alpha likelihood is available for nonthermal axino transfer functions: the quoted ~5.3 keV thermal-WDM bound and the 7 keV comparison are borrowed thermal-relic mappings, and the card marks the recast (con_freezein_axino_lya_recast) as required but not performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the computed nonthermal transfer functions against Ly-alpha forest data using an area-criterion or half-mode mapping onto published thermal-WDM limits as a first pass, and for a proper likelihood connect them to a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator trained on hydrodynamical simulations that accepts general suppressed transfer functions.

members.model_name: Spin-0 relativistic-decay dark matter EFT
members.description: No end-to-end likelihood pipeline maps the EFT parameters (Lambda, m_X, m_DM, tau_X, fraction f) onto joint CMB N_eff/H0, BBN light-element, and matter-power/free-streaming data, so the quoted H0 about 70 km/s/Mpc claim and the allowed parameter region cannot be statistically validated.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the modified solver of gap_1 in a Cobaya/MontePython run using Planck plus BAO plus SH0ES likelihoods, add PRIMAT/AlterBBN for photon-injection BBN bounds, and include a Lyman-alpha or CMB-lensing matter-power likelihood for the free-streaming constraint.

members.model_name: Spin-1/2 relativistic-decay dark matter EFT
members.description: No end-to-end likelihood pipeline maps the EFT parameters (Lambda, m_X, m_DM, tau_X, fraction f) onto joint CMB N_eff/H0, BBN light-element, and matter-power/free-streaming data, so the quoted H0 about 70 km/s/Mpc claim and the allowed parameter region cannot be statistically validated.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the modified solver of gap_1 in a Cobaya/MontePython run using Planck plus BAO plus SH0ES likelihoods, add PRIMAT/AlterBBN for photon-injection BBN bounds, and include a Lyman-alpha or CMB-lensing matter-power likelihood for the free-streaming constraint.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L Dirac-neutrino two-component fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for this anomaly-free B-L variant: the fractional-charge chiral fermion sector, extended scalar potential, and two-component (psi_1, psi_2) coupled freeze-out with conversion annihilation must be re-encoded before micrOMEGAs can reproduce the paper's relic and direct-detection numbers.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the charge assignments, scalar sector, and Yukawa structure in FeynRules, export CalcHEP files, and run micrOMEGAs 5 in two-DM-component mode including psi_2 psi_2 -> psi_1 psi_1 conversion, validating against the paper's Omega_psi1 + Omega_psi2 = 0.120 benchmark regions.

members.model_name: UV freeze-in baryogenesis with Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code solves the coupled freeze-in plus CP-violating scattering asymmetry Boltzmann equations for the dimension-6 Dirac-fermion model with vector-like leptons; the paper's numerical scans are custom and unreleased, so Y_B and the viable Lambda-T_RH band cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled yield and B-L asymmetry equations (dimension-6 collision terms, tree-loop interference CP source, sphaleron conversion) in a released standalone solver, e.g. a Python/ULYSSES-style momentum-averaged Boltzmann code validated against the paper's benchmark Lambda-T_RH scaling.

members.model_name: 331 WIMPy dark radiation model
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model file for the 3-3-1LHN scalar WIMP sector is identified in the card, so the thermal relic input to the route cannot be reproduced without re-implementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 3-3-1LHN Lagrangian (scalar WIMP, N_R fermions, 3-3-1 gauge and scalar sectors) in FeynRules/SARAH and export a CalcHEP model file for micrOMEGAs freeze-out computation.

members.model_name: nuMSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with fermion-number-violating leptogenesis effects
members.description: No public numerical solver exists for the three-HNL finite-temperature density-matrix kinetic equations including the fermion-number-violating rates; the primary paper derives the equations but defers the full numerical produced-asymmetry scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's FNV-extended density-matrix equations in a numerical HNL kinetics code (extending an existing low-scale leptogenesis solver such as AMIQS-style density-matrix codes), validating against the zero-FNV limit and asymmetry-conservation checks named in the route's validation tests.

members.model_name: Decaying warm dark matter with a massive dark-photon daughter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver branch evolves a nonthermal (scalar-decay-produced) fermionic WDM parent that subsequently decays into a massive keV dark photon plus massless dark radiation, so the matter-power cutoff and CMB energy-transfer consistency cannot be computed from the actual phase-space distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS decaying-CDM branch with massive daughters (e.g. the DCDM-to-warm-daughter implementations) to take the scalar-decay-produced parent f(q) as a tabulated ncdm input and add the two-body decay to a massive vector plus dark-radiation species, outputting T(k) and the free-streaming scale for the 0.3-0.5 Mpc target.

members.model_name: U(1)' dark-photon self-interacting dark matter from a MeV first-order phase transition
members.description: The CMB annihilation check for symmetric or partially asymmetric populations is not implemented: the Sommerfeld-enhanced, dark-photon-mediated annihilation with subsequent A'/phi decay to e+e- through the dimension-six operator is not wired into any energy-injection code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's cascade annihilation spectrum and Sommerfeld factor S(v) in DarkHistory or ExoCLASS and evaluate the Planck p_ann constraint as a function of the residual symmetric fraction set by Y_chi.

members.model_name: Twin bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation of the twin-sector spectrum exists: freeze-out proceeds through twin-fermion (especially twin tau) final states via a right-handed twin stau, with twin-sector degrees of freedom and only partial thermal contact with the SM, none of which is covered by stock micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the twin bino/higgsino/stau sector in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs with the twin-sector relativistic degrees of freedom and (if needed) a visible-twin temperature ratio to reproduce the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours.

members.model_name: 2HDM singlet-doublet fermion Higgs-portal dark matter with generalized blind spots
members.description: The extended FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the 2HDM plus singlet-doublet fermion dark sector, which every numerical step (spectrum, relic density via micrOMEGAs, sigma_SI) depends on, are described in the paper but not publicly released.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model in FeynRules starting from the public 2HDM model file, add the S, D_1, D_2 fermions with the four Yukawa operators, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Type-I/Type-II blind-spot strips and y_eff_DD ~ 0 samples.

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model file for the neutrinophilic THDM with the Z2-odd Dirac-fermion and scalar singlets is not publicly released, so the WIMP relic-density and cross-section pipeline cannot be run without re-implementing it.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the THDM plus sterile-neutrino-portal Lagrangian in FeynRules from the published field content and couplings, export CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's quoted Planck relic-density scan band.

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: No dedicated nonthermal Boltzmann solver is set up for the FIMP regime with freeze-in from a thermal sterile-neutrino bath followed by late scalar-NLSP decay into the fermion DM, including the mass-ordering-dependent channel switching.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a custom coupled-Boltzmann code) to track Y_DM and Y_NLSP with sterile-neutrino decay and NLSP late-decay source terms across the WIMP/FIMP coupling range.

members.model_name: Scalar singlet FIMP dark matter with vectorlike fermion parent during reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes scalar-singlet freeze-in from decays of a thermalized vectorlike fermion parent during non-instantaneous monomial reheating (m_P > T_rh), including entropy injection and bosonic versus fermionic reheating histories; the yield exists only in the paper's private integration.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routines (or release the paper's solver) to evolve the DM yield through a user-specified reheating history parameterized by (T_rh, k, bosonic/fermionic inflaton decay), validated against the radiation-dominated limit for m_P < T_rh and the stated factor-of-two rate difference from the charged-scalar-parent variant.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter in a singlet scalar portal sector
members.description: No solver exists for the two-stage hidden-sector phase-space history of this model: momentum-level freeze-in production of the scalar parent from Higgs decays, its decay to sterile fermions, and lambda_s/g-dependent hidden-sector thermalization or dark freeze-out, yielding the sterile-neutrino distribution function f(p) needed for structure-formation predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a momentum-dependent Boltzmann code for the coupled s and psi phase-space densities with Higgs-decay source terms, s -> psi psi decay terms, and hidden-sector scattering, covering both the free-streaming freeze-in and dark-freeze-out regimes; output Omega h^2 and tabulated f(q) for direct use in CLASS ncdm, validated on the paper's 7.1 keV benchmark.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=0 and singlet scalar
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation exists for the B-L=0 SU(2)_R quintuplet with its radiatively split charged partners, W_R-mediated coannihilation, and singlet-scalar (H_1) annihilation channels, so the resonance-dominated relic-density bands cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the left-right gauge sector, quintuplet multiplet, and singlet scalar in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs with the full coannihilation spectrum, and validate by reproducing the paper's H_1-resonance, H_1 H_1, and W_R-coannihilation relic dips at the M_W_R = 6 TeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=4 and singlet scalar
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation exists for the B-L=4 SU(2)_R quintuplet with its H_1, W_R, Z_R, and mixed Z_R H_1 annihilation/coannihilation channels and radiative mass splittings, so the five resonance-dominated relic-density dips cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the left-right gauge sector, B-L=4 quintuplet, and singlet scalar in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs with the full coannihilation spectrum, and validate against the paper's five relic dips at the M_W_R = 6 TeV and M_Z_R = 7.14 TeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Z3 sterile-neutrino portal scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public CalcHEP/FeynRules model file for the Z3 sterile-neutrino portal (scalar singlet DM, dark fermion, electroweak-scale N, cubic phi^3 term) is released, so the micrOMEGAs pipeline the paper used cannot be reproduced or rerun by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian in FeynRules, export a CalcHEP model file for micrOMEGAs including the Z3 cubic term driving semi-annihilation, and validate by reproducing the paper's scan figures (Rf/Rs, fsmbr, sigmav, fsms).

members.model_name: Majorana FIMP dark matter with charged scalar parent during reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes freeze-in from decays of a thermalized charged scalar parent during non-instantaneous monomial reheating (m_P > T_rh), including entropy injection and the k-dependent bosonic versus fermionic reheating histories; the yield exists only in the paper's private integration.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routines (or release the paper's solver) to evolve the DM yield through a user-specified reheating history parameterized by (T_rh, k, bosonic/fermionic inflaton decay), validated against the radiation-dominated limit for m_P < T_rh and the paper's factor-of-two scalar-versus-fermion parent rates.

members.model_name: Hidden dark matter cosmology (HiDM)
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver module implements the HiDM species (equation of state w(a), sound speed c_s^2(a), fermionic/bosonic statistics with chemical potential, and equilibrium versus free-streaming perturbation treatments), so CMB spectra and linear matter power for HiDM cannot be computed with released tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement HiDM in CLASS either as a generalized dark matter fluid with the paper's fitted w(a), c_s^2(a) transition or as a full non-cold-dark-matter species with the HiDM phase-space distribution (statistics plus mu_ini), validated against the primary paper's suppression curves.

members.model_name: Z3 sterile-neutrino portal fermion WIMP dark matter
members.description: No public CalcHEP/FeynRules model file for the Z3 sterile-neutrino portal (fermion singlet, dark scalar, electroweak-scale N) is released, so the micrOMEGAs pipeline the paper used cannot be reproduced or rerun by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian in FeynRules, export a CalcHEP model file for micrOMEGAs including the loop-induced effective Higgs coupling of the fermion, and validate by reproducing the paper's scan figures (Rf/Rs, fsmbr, sigmav, fsms).

members.model_name: PQ Dirac-neutrino model with fermionic WIMP and axion dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for the PQ Dirac scotogenic sector, so the fermionic WIMP relic density including the NN -> nu_R nu_R channel, scalar mixing, and possible coannihilations is only known at the benchmark analytic-estimate level.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the model Lagrangian (N, eta_u, singlet scalar, nu_R, and scalar mixing) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP, and run micrOMEGAs to compute Omega_N h^2 with coannihilations across the (m_N, m_S, y') plane, validating against the paper's ~1 pb benchmark.

members.model_name: PQ Dirac-neutrino model with fermionic WIMP and axion dark matter
members.description: No public solver computes Delta N_eff from right-handed neutrinos populated by dark-matter annihilation in this model; the source-flagged N_eff risk that could disfavor the fermionic case cannot currently be evaluated because the coupled nu_R thermal history (production, decoupling before BBN/CMB) has no released implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a nudec_BSM-style temperature-evolution code with collision terms for nu_R production from NN annihilation and singlet-scalar-mediated interactions, evolve the nu_R energy density through decoupling, and map the output Delta N_eff onto Planck/BBN bounds.

members.model_name: Scalar field dark matter in the Thomas-Fermi self-interaction regime
members.description: No public linear Boltzmann/fluid solver implements the Thomas-Fermi-regime self-interacting scalar-field perturbation equations, so the SFDM-TF transfer function as a function of (m, g, R_TF) cannot be reproduced outside the authors' private treatment; existing codes cover only quintessence-like scalars or non-self-interacting FDM (axionCAMB).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with an SFDM-TF fluid module: implement the equation-of-state evolution through the stiff-to-matter-like transition and the effective sound speed from the repulsive quartic self-interaction, validated against the paper's analytic cutoff estimates and published transfer functions.

members.model_name: Radiative Dirac seesaw singlet-doublet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for this radiative Dirac seesaw singlet-doublet model (Z2-odd singlet-doublet Dirac fermion plus inert scalar doublets), so the relic-density and direct-detection scan the paper ran with micrOMEGAs cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model file for the Lagrangian (singlet-doublet Yukawa Y, mass mixing angle theta, inert doublets eta), export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's viable few-hundred-GeV region and the generic singlet-doublet DM literature (arXiv:1704.03417) implementations.

members.model_name: Split fermionic WIMPs with singlet scalar Higgs portal
members.description: No public CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation of the split two-singlet-fermion Higgs-portal model exists, so the coannihilation freeze-out, sigma_SI, and <sigma v>_bb outputs of the main route cannot be computed reproducibly or the Delta = 10/50/100 GeV benchmark scans re-derived.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-fermion plus singlet-scalar Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs for coannihilation freeze-out and direct/indirect cross sections, and validate by reproducing the paper's Delta = 10, 50, 100 GeV scans and the minimal singlet-fermion exclusion in the decoupled-partner limit.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal Dirac-fermion freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in code covers the full IR freeze-in calculation for keV-to-GeV Dirac fermion dark matter through a heavy kinetically mixed dark photon including in-medium plasmon decay, which dominates the yield at low masses; existing tools (micrOMEGAs freeze-in) treat only vacuum annihilation rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or a standalone integrator) with thermal-field-theory plasmon decay and in-medium mixing suppression for the dark-photon portal, validated against the primary paper's observed-relic epsilon(m_chi) target lines.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter
members.description: No public detector exposure/efficiency model exists for macroscopic AQN passages through IceCube (or ANITA/geothermal analogues); the quoted B > 3e24 lower bound assumes high detection efficiency and cannot be re-derived or varied over the nugget mass distribution without it.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct and release an effective-area and trigger-efficiency model for slow massive nugget tracks in IceCube (energy-deposition profile from the heating model folded with DOM response), and rerun the Poisson limit over B and the nugget size distribution instead of the mono-mass, unit-efficiency assumption.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the FOPT bubble-collision particle-production pipeline (field-excitation spectra to nonthermal fermion yield to Omega_DM h^2) even at the level of the paper's prescription; the card lists a particle-production implementation as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a module on top of a CosmoTransitions-class finite-temperature code that takes a user potential, computes (alpha, beta_over_H, wall gamma), evaluates the paper's yield formulas for the y_f phi psi_f psi_f coupling, and outputs Omega_DM h^2 with entropy-dilution bookkeeping.

members.model_name: Scalar nontopological soliton dark matter
members.description: No detector-response or energy-loss model exists for macroscopic soliton transits (multiple-hit or extended tracks) through direct-detection and neutrino experiments, so the quoted 1e8-1e24 GeV search window cannot be turned into exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the soliton dE/dx and cross-section-versus-mass relation for the model's SM coupling variants and implement a transit-rate and signal-efficiency calculation for representative exposures (xenon TPCs, IceCube/Super-K style detectors), following existing macro-DM/Q-ball search formalisms.

members.model_name: 2HDM portal singlet-doublet dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO model files) of the 2HDM-portal singlet-doublet Majorana fermion model exists in the registry, so the micrOMEGAs-style relic calculation and the direct-detection cross sections cannot be run as-is (computational_representation is null and associated code is unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules implementation of the 2HDM (types I/II/lepton-specific/flipped) plus singlet-doublet fermion Lagrangian, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs to compute Omega h^2, sigma_SI, and sigma_SD, and validate against the paper's red relic contours and blind-spot cancellations.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with B-L vector portal
members.description: No implemented calculator produces gamma-ray and antiproton spectra for the two-step cascade chi chi -> Z' Z' followed by Z' decay through the B-L portal, whose B-L-current branching fractions (including neutrino channels) differ from standard direct-annihilation spectra tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute B-L mediator branching fractions analytically, generate rest-frame decay spectra with Pythia or PPPC4DMID tables, and apply the standard boost convolution for the two-step cascade; package this as a MadDM or Hazma-style module keyed to (m_chi, m_Zprime, B-L charges).

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative-seesaw fermion dark matter
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/SARAH/CalcHEP files) exists for the hidden U(1)_H radiative-seesaw model, so the relic density rests on the paper's analytic s-wave estimate; coannihilation, p-wave pieces, and the full inert-scalar channel structure across the normal- and inverted-hierarchy mass windows (50-140 GeV vs 0.2-0.5 GeV) cannot be computed with public freeze-out machinery.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (gauge sector, exotic fermions, inert scalars, neutral-fermion mixing) in SARAH/FeynRules, generate CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs for the relic density plus SPheno/FlavorKit for correlated g-2 and LFV observables, validating against the paper's scan windows.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal fermion freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public implementation exists of the spin-2 portal freeze-in yield through a non-instantaneous reheating background: the Boltzmann integration of R(T) over the inflaton-dominated era with both T_RH and T_max, including the transition between graviton-dominated, off-shell, resonant (narrow-width), and light-mediator regimes, currently requires custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone reheating-era freeze-in integrator (or extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module, which assumes radiation domination) that evolves Y_X over the inflaton-decay background parameterized by (T_RH, T_max), takes the paper's spin-dependent R(T) for scalar/fermion/vector final states as input, and validates against the superheavy-mediator graviton limit and a direct thermal integration across the m_G ~ T resonance.

members.model_name: Fermionic Clockwork FIMP with vector-like lepton portal
members.description: The authors' FeynRules/micrOMEGAs 5.0 implementation of the fermionic Clockwork chain with Z2-odd vector-like leptons is of unknown availability, so the IR-dominated freeze-in yield cannot be recomputed or scanned without reimplementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or reimplement the FeynRules model (Clockwork fermion sites, Majorana masses M_L/M_R, vector-like lepton doublet, and the Y L' H psi_R,N Yukawa), export to CalcHEP, and run the micrOMEGAs 5 freeze-in module, validating against the source relic bands at Y_eff ~ 1e-10 to 1e-13; publish the model files.

members.model_name: Phi_16 dark-thermal-bath degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy core prediction rests on the degenerate-fermion argument alone: no quantitative degenerate-fermion halo model (Jeans or phase-space analysis against dwarf-spheroidal kinematics) is available to turn the cored-halo claim into an evaluable observable for the 0.25-0.37 keV mass range.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a degenerate-fermion hydrostatic halo model (Thomas-Fermi/King-like profiles for a sub-keV fermion with the production-history velocity distribution) and fit it to published dwarf-spheroidal stellar-kinematics datasets in a Jeans-analysis likelihood.

members.model_name: Scotogenic singlet fermion dark matter with two-step freeze-in phase transition
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes freeze-in production of the singlet fermion N_1 through a two-step first-order phase transition, where decay channels open and close as the temporary inert-doublet VEV v_eta(T) and finite-temperature masses evolve; standard micrOMEGAs freeze-in assumes static zero-temperature masses and couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple CosmoTransitions output (phase sequence, T_n, v_eta(T)) to a modified freeze-in Boltzmann solver, e.g. extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or write a dedicated ODE solver with temperature-dependent decay widths and thermal masses for the eta -> N_1 L production channels.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with baryon-number vector portal
members.description: No implemented calculator produces gamma-ray and antiproton spectra for the two-step cascade chi chi -> Z' Z' followed by Z' decay through the baryon-number portal, where quark-only (hadron-rich) branching fractions and light-mediator hadronization for m_Zprime down to 10 GeV are not covered by standard direct-annihilation spectra tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute baryonic-Z' branching fractions to quarks, generate rest-frame hadronic decay spectra with Pythia (validated for the 10-100 GeV mediator mass range), apply the boost convolution for the two-step cascade, and package it as a MadDM-style module keyed to (m_chi, m_Zprime).

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with hypercharge-vector portal
members.description: No implemented calculator produces gamma-ray and antiproton spectra for the two-step cascade chi chi -> Z' Z' followed by Z' decay through the hypercharge (kinetic-mixing) portal, whose mass-dependent dark-photon-like branching fractions to SM fermions must be convolved with boosted decay spectra not covered by standard direct-annihilation tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute kinetically-mixed Z' branching fractions (including hadronic R-ratio corrections at low mediator mass), generate rest-frame decay spectra with Pythia or PPPC4DMID tables, apply the boost convolution for the two-step cascade, and package it as a MadDM-style module keyed to (m_chi, m_Zprime, epsilon).

members.model_name: Coherent-oscillation phi_16 degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy core prediction rests on the degenerate-fermion argument alone: no quantitative degenerate-fermion halo model (Jeans or phase-space analysis against dwarf-spheroidal kinematics) is available to turn the cored-halo claim into an evaluable observable for the 100 eV - 1 keV mass range.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a degenerate-fermion hydrostatic halo model (Thomas-Fermi/King-like profiles for a sub-keV fermion with the production-history velocity distribution) and fit it to published dwarf-spheroidal stellar-kinematics datasets in a Jeans-analysis likelihood.

members.model_name: Free phi_16 decay degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy core prediction rests on the degenerate-fermion argument alone: no quantitative degenerate-fermion halo model (Jeans or phase-space analysis against dwarf-spheroidal kinematics) is available to turn the cored-halo claim into an evaluable observable for the 0.2-0.35 keV mass range.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a degenerate-fermion hydrostatic halo model (Thomas-Fermi/King-like profiles for a sub-keV fermion with the production-history velocity distribution) and fit it to published dwarf-spheroidal stellar-kinematics datasets in a Jeans-analysis likelihood.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV U(1)_T3R Majorana dark matter
members.description: Accelerator and beam-dump reach for the U(1)_T3R mediators cannot be computed with existing dark-photon codes as-is: production and decay tools assume kinetic-mixing couplings, whereas here A' and phi' couple to right-handed u, d, and muon-sector fermions, and neutrino-facility acceptances (COHERENT, CCM, MicroBooNE, SBND, ICARUS, DUNE) are not packaged with the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkCast/FORESEE-style production maps with the U(1)_T3R charge structure (rescaled meson, bremsstrahlung, and heavy-state decay channels for both A' and phi'), and add experiment acceptance modules for the listed neutrino and forward facilities.

members.model_name: Decaying warm dark matter to invisible radiation
members.description: The modified CLASS decaying non-cold (warm mother plus massless daughter) Boltzmann hierarchy used in the primary analysis is not publicly released, so the whole pipeline cannot be rerun or extended without re-implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or re-implement the momentum-binned decaying-neutrino-style hierarchy in public CLASS (building on the existing decaying-CDM ncdm machinery), with the Fermi-Dirac-times-degeneracy initial condition and time-dilated decay terms, and release it with the MCMC configuration.

members.model_name: Multi-component non-thermal flavon portal dark sector
members.description: No public solver evolves the coupled system of out-of-equilibrium flavon production (freeze-in plus coherent oscillations) and sequential multi-species dark-fermion decays chi_i -> chi_j chi_k chi_l / chi_i -> chi_j q q; the paper's yields and two-component approximation exist only as private calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a multi-species Boltzmann yield network with flavon freeze-in and oscillation source terms and FN-charge-parameterized decay chains, either by extending the micrOMEGAs freeze-in framework or as a standalone code validated against the paper's relic-density contours and the sequential two-component limit.

members.model_name: Mass-varying dark matter with rapid mass turn-on
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver module evolves a fermionic species whose mass turns on rapidly at z_t: the authors' CLASS patch for time-varying dark-matter mass is not identifiably released, so the matter power spectrum and CMB spectra for MVDM cannot be recomputed by third parties.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement time-dependent mass support in the CLASS ncdm sector (promote m to m(a) with the card's fast-transition parameterization in the background and perturbation equations) and release it publicly, or obtain and archive the authors' existing CLASS patch; validate by recovering the CDM limit for early transitions and large M/T.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino dark matter with forbidden annihilation
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the Z2-odd right-handed neutrino plus fermion partner plus Higgs-portal scalar Lagrangian exists in a relic-density code, so the forbidden-channel freeze-out Omega_N h^2 with detailed balance across the small splitting delta cannot be computed with public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules and run it through micrOMEGAs (which performs exact thermal averaging over the forbidden threshold) to reproduce the paper's relic band in (m_N, delta, y).

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino dark matter with forbidden annihilation
members.description: No public pipeline models the dark-matter phase-space distribution in the Sgr A* SMBH spike at the high velocities that reopen the forbidden N N -> phi phi channel, nor the resulting velocity-weighted annihilation rate and gamma-ray flux from phi decays.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a semi-analytic spike module (adiabatic spike plus relativistic phase-space distribution following the Shelton et al. 1406.4856 formalism) that convolves the velocity-dependent forbidden cross section with the spike distribution and outputs the Sgr A* photon spectrum for a grid of spike slopes.

members.model_name: Flavor-dependent gauged U(1) inert scalar S dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the flavor-dependent U(1)_{B-L_1} x U(1)_{B-L_2-L_3} model with inert scalar S and vector-like fermions exists for a Boltzmann/recoil code, so precision relic scans covering Z'-resonance and coannihilation regimes (excluded from the paper's simple analytic expression) cannot be run; the card itself lists micrOMEGAs-or-equivalent as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (inert scalar S, vector-like Q'/L', two flavor-dependent Z' bosons, Higgs-portal coupling lambda_HS) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs for relic density and sigma_SI, validating against the paper's a_eff=0, b_eff-dominated relic curve.

members.model_name: Goldstini decaying dark matter
members.description: No public code generates the three-body goldstino -> gravitino + f fbar injection spectra (e+/e-, gamma including final-state radiation, antiprotons) from the dimension-8 goldstini operators; existing decaying-DM spectrum tables assume two-body channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the goldstino effective operators in a FeynRules/MadGraph model (or an analytic three-body phase-space integrator), shower with Pythia to produce e, gamma, and pbar spectra per channel, and tabulate them as a function of m_Gprime and the gravitino mass.

members.model_name: Hidden-charged dark matter with chiral dark radiation
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation covers this model's specific DM-dark-radiation opacity: the hidden-U(1) Coulomb-like scattering of Dirac DM off chiral hidden fermions/pions, with the confinement transition at Lambda ~ 1 eV changing the dark-radiation content, is not mapped onto the ETHOS a_n parameterization in any public modified CLASS/CAMB.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the temperature scaling of the hidden-U(1) DM-DR momentum-transfer rate across the confinement transition, map it onto the ETHOS opacity coefficients, and implement it in an ETHOS-style modified CLASS including the step in dark relativistic degrees of freedom at Lambda.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac transition-dipole freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public freeze-in solver implements the in-medium plasmon-decay production channel (gamma* -> chi1 chi2) together with UV-sensitive dipole-mediated fermion annihilation under an instantaneous low-reheating history (T_RH ~ 5-10 MeV); micrOMEGAs 5 covers only the vacuum fermionic channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (or a standalone Boltzmann integrator) with thermal-field-theory plasmon decay rates for transition dipole operators and a T_RH cutoff on the production integral, validating the R(T) temperature scaling quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: Millicharged excited-state scalar field dark matter halo
members.description: No released numerical solver produces the axially asymmetric ground-plus-first-excited-state millicharged SFDM halo profile; the route depends on the paper's private halo solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Schrodinger-Poisson code such as PyUltraLight or UltraDark.jl to evolve multi-state (ground plus l=1 excited) configurations and release the benchmark halo profiles used for the Fermi-Bubble comparison.

members.model_name: Z3 semi-annihilating inert scalar multiplet model
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files) of the two-complex-inert-multiplet Z3 V_B4 scalar potential exists, so the micrOMEGAs-style semi-annihilation relic calculation, direct-detection cross sections, and indirect-detection rates cannot be run for arbitrary (n1, n2, Y, lambda_A, splittings).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-multiplet potential with its SU(2)_L tensor contractions in FeynRules for general n1, n2, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs with the Z3 discrete symmetry declared so semi-annihilation channels are included, and validate against the paper's relic-compatible mass ranges.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet t-channel portal dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the one-loop EFT matching of the real scalar singlet t-channel portal (Yukawa-like lambda_L/R^f couplings to a single SM fermion via a fermionic mediator) onto nuclear-scattering Wilson coefficients and a direct-detection event rate; computational_representation is null and the paper's pipeline is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's one-loop matching formulas for scalar DM (arXiv:2405.09326, building on arXiv:1606.07001) as a FeynRules/model package feeding the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module or DDCalc, and validate against the paper's unit-coupling rate curves.

members.model_name: QED-like dark sector with heavy scalar messengers
members.description: No public Boltzmann relic-abundance code handles this multi-component dark-fermion sector with a massless dark-photon bath, hidden-sector thermalization, and messenger-mediated annihilation to SM fermions; the primary paper's relic estimates are approximate thermally-averaged cross-section arguments.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a coupled-Boltzmann code such as that used for hidden-sector freeze-out) to track multiple stable dark-fermion species and a dark-photon temperature separate from the SM bath, with messenger-exchange annihilation channels implemented from the model Lagrangian.

members.model_name: Light decoupled techni-dilaton dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the thermal (freeze-in-style) techni-dilaton yield from scattering in the walking-technicolor plasma with F_TD-suppressed couplings; only the coherent-misalignment component is straightforwardly analytic, so the thermal correction to the relic density and its warm subcomponent cannot be evaluated beyond the paper's estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the TD production rates (scale-anomaly gauge-boson and mass-proportional fermion couplings suppressed by 1/F_TD) as collision terms in a freeze-in Boltzmann integrator, e.g. a lightweight standalone solver or a micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY-style module, and combine with the standard misalignment calculation to reproduce the paper's Omega_TD h^2 = 0.11 contours.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay two-dark-particle dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann relic implementation exists for the chi-phi two-dark-particle sector: only one analytic thermal benchmark is quoted, the t-channel dark-sector annihilation is unimplemented in any public code, and the alternative nonthermal production history has no computed yield at all.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (colored scalar phi, two singlet Dirac fermions, complex scalar, lambda couplings) as a FeynRules/UFO model and solve the coupled chi-phi Boltzmann equations in micrOMEGAs or MadDM, including the t-channel exchange channel; add a parameterized nonthermal injection option to cover the non-freeze-out branch.

members.model_name: Vector-like portal scalar dark matter with finite-fermion-mass radiative corrections
members.description: No public code implements the finite-final-state-fermion-mass radiative annihilation rates (2-to-3 internal bremsstrahlung and one-loop annihilation to gauge bosons) for real scalar dark matter with a vector-like fermion t-channel mediator; existing relic and indirect-detection pipelines default to massless-final-state or tree-level approximations, which the paper shows misestimate the viable couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's finite-mass VIB and loop cross-section formulae as a micrOMEGAs improveCrossSection-style plug-in (or a MadDM custom-amplitude module) for the S-eta-f_R model, validated against the published massless limits, and couple it to the standard freeze-out Boltzmann solver so relic matching uses the corrected <sigma v>.

members.model_name: Hidden Higgs portal vector dark matter with two-step cascade annihilation
members.description: No public model implementation or cascade-spectrum generator exists for the two-step X X -> S S, S -> A A, A -> tau tau chain; the gamma-ray spectrum used in the Galactic-center fit is a private paper-level calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and generate the two-step cascade photon spectrum by boosting PPPC4DMID or Pythia8 tau-tau spectra through the S and A rest frames, releasing tabulated dN/dE_gamma(m_X, m_S, m_A) for reuse in indirect-detection fits.

members.model_name: Regurgitated fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the Fermiball formation-cooling-collapse pipeline (trapping of asymmetric dark fermions in false-vacuum remnants, Higgs-portal cooling, collapse to a PBH mass function) that sets M_PBH and the PBH abundance controlling the RDM yield.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's semi-analytic Fermiball equations (remnant population, cooling time, Chandrasekhar-like collapse condition) as a module taking FOPT outputs from gap_1 and emitting M_PBH and the PBH energy fraction, then couple it to a BlackHawk-style evaporation calculation of the final yield.

members.model_name: Regurgitated scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the Fermiball formation-cooling-collapse pipeline (trapping of asymmetric dark fermions in false-vacuum remnants, Higgs-portal cooling, collapse to a PBH mass function) that sets M_PBH and the PBH abundance controlling the RDM yield.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's semi-analytic Fermiball equations (remnant population, cooling time, collapse condition) as a module taking FOPT outputs from gap_1 and emitting M_PBH and the PBH energy fraction, then couple it to a BlackHawk-style evaporation calculation of the final scalar yield.

members.model_name: Y=0 inert-triplet radiative neutrino model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (CalcHEP/LanHEP model files for micrOMEGAs) and no released neutrino/LFV scan code exist for this Y=0 inert-triplet radiative-neutrino model with the D_N1 fermionic DM candidate, so the thermal relic calculation and the published scan counts (4312 NH, 206 IH points) cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full Lagrangian (N_R, vector-like lepton doublets, inert triplet, charged scalar S+) in LanHEP/FeynRules, export micrOMEGAs 5.x model files, and package the neutrino-oscillation/LFV chi-square filter as a reproducible scan script validated against the 4312/206 published scan counts and the 5-percent relic window.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter from two evaporating PBH distributions
members.description: No public code evolves two monochromatic PBH populations with distinct (M_BH, beta) through possibly successive PBH-dominated eras and computes the combined Hawking-produced fermionic DM yield; existing solvers (BlackHawk plus FRISBHEE-type cosmology integrators) assume a single mass distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a FRISBHEE-style Friedmann + Hawking-evaporation integrator to N monochromatic (and eventually continuous) PBH mass functions, tracking entropy injection and matter-radiation transitions from each population, and validate against the paper's two-distribution relic contours and narrowed forbidden mass intervals.

members.model_name: Constrained self-interacting dark matter with dark photon and dark fermions
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation covers this model's dark-photon-mediated chi/dark-fermion scattering through kinetic decoupling; the paper used a private modified CAMB/ETHOS-style calculation and the card records no computational representation.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the chi-f momentum-transfer rate for the massive-dark-photon coupling onto the ETHOS a_n parameterization and implement it in a public ETHOS-branch CLASS, validating T_kd and the damping scale against the paper's analytic scalings.

members.model_name: Singlet Dirac fermion dark matter with Veltman conditions
members.description: The paper's FeynRules/MadGraph5/MadDM implementation of the singlet-fermion-plus-singlet-scalar model with Higgs mixing is described but not publicly released, so no runnable model files exist for the relic-density and sigma_SI step.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the two-scalar Higgs-portal Lagrangian (mixing angle alpha, masses M1/M2, coupling g_S, singlet VEV v_s) in FeynRules and export CalcHEP/UFO model files for micrOMEGAs and MadDM, validating against the paper's resonance and heavy-mass allowed regions.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with survival-based size distribution
members.description: No detector-response model exists for macroscopic nuclear-density nuggets in IceCube/ANITA/ancient-mica; current bounds are approximate recasts of magnetic-monopole flux limits whose signatures differ from AQN tracks and cascades.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive AQN-specific energy-deposition and track/cascade signatures per unit path length as a function of B, and implement them as a detector-response module for IceCube-like volumes and mica track formation, replacing the monopole-search translation.

members.model_name: Resonant U(1)' Z-prime portal Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The LanHEP model files for the anomaly-free U(1)' (B-L and flavor-dependent variants) with the Z3-stabilized Dirac fermion are not publicly available, so the micrOMEGAs relic-density and sigma_SI pipeline cannot be run without rebuilding the model implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the dark-sector Lagrangian with its anomaly-free charge assignments in LanHEP (or FeynRules/UFO) for micrOMEGAs, release the model files, and validate by recovering the paper's resonant scan (M_Zprime 10^-3 to 50 GeV, g_prime 10^-6 to 10^-1, M_chi = 0.45-0.55 M_Zprime) and benchmark relic contours.

members.model_name: ScotoZee model with Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH model files or MicrOMEGAs/CalcHEP implementation of the ScotoZee model (inert doublet plus charged singlet with Majorana singlet fermions) is released, so the spectrum, oblique parameters, and thermal relic-density scan cannot be reproduced despite both frameworks being public.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a SARAH model file for the ScotoZee Lagrangian (Y and f Yukawa sectors, charged-scalar mixing), generate the CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs implementation, and validate against the paper's Fig. 3 relic and direct-detection regions and quoted benchmark textures.

members.model_name: Z8 hybrid scotogenic/type-II seesaw scalar dark matter model
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the Z8 hybrid scotogenic/type-II seesaw model: the SARAH/SPheno/FlavourKit and MicrOMEGAs inputs encoding the Z8^e-mu flavour texture, two inert doublets, singlet fermion, and triplet sector were used by the authors but not released, blocking independent reproduction of the neutrino/cLFV fit and relic scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the model in SARAH from the published Lagrangian and Z8 charge assignments, generate SPheno/FlavourKit and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's quoted relic windows (near 60 GeV and 68-90 GeV) and cLFV benchmark rates before public release.

members.model_name: Hidden sector axion portal dark matter with p-wave freezeout and s-wave three-mediator annihilation
members.description: No public implementation exists of the black-hole spike flux pipeline for this model: spike density profile with adjustable gamma_c, gamma_sp, and spike radius, J-factor within instrument angular resolution, and binned flux comparison to Fermi 3FGL J1745.6-2859c and HESS J1745-290 spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the Gondolo-Silk spike profile with heating/annihilation-plateau options as a small Python module, convolve with the analytic 3-a photon spectrum, and validate against the primary paper's Fermi/H.E.S.S. exclusion contours before releasing it as a reusable spike-flux calculator.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D chiral fermion dark matter
members.description: The paper's micrOMEGAs implementation of the SU(2)_D chiral model (fermion 4-plet, scalar 7-plet, T-prime spectrum, h/h-prime mixing) is private; without public model files the relic-density and spin-independent scattering scans over (m_psi, m_hprime, m_H, m_V, y_D, g_D, theta) cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the model in FeynRules from the published Lagrangian, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's quoted results (e.g. the 280 GeV nonresonant single-component mass limit) before releasing the implementation.

members.model_name: Chilly asymmetrically reheated thermal dark sector
members.description: No public two-sector reheating Boltzmann solver implements the paper's relativistic collision integrals for inflaton-mediated energy transfer with Bose-Einstein/Fermi-Dirac phase-space factors, so the T_HS/T_SM evolution and washout regions cannot be recomputed for new inflaton masses, couplings, or hidden-sector examples.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the paper's collision-term formalism into a released code: a coupled two-sector temperature-evolution solver during and after reheating, using Cubature/Cuba (or equivalent) for the relativistic collision integrals, with the scalar, fermion, and pseudoscalar-gauge example couplings as validation cases against the paper's washout/no-washout regions.

members.model_name: OHe composite dark atom model
members.description: No production-model recast maps LHC stable doubly-charged particle searches onto the O-- constituent, so the collider constraint on m_O is only a qualitative target.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a benchmark Drell-Yan production model for the charge -2 state, simulate it (MadGraph plus a heavy-stable-charged-particle recast such as those in CheckMATE/HSCP analyses), and translate ATLAS/CMS multi-charged-particle limits into a lower bound on m_O to compare with the ~1.25 TeV positron-line region.

members.model_name: Massive spin-2 portal UV freeze-in dark matter in nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No public code solves the coupled decaying-fluid plus radiation reheating system for general pre-BBN equation of state w together with spin-2-mediated freeze-in production, including the transition between the light (m_2 < T_max) and heavy (m_2 > T_max) mediator regimes and the spin-dependent prefactors for scalar, fermion, and vector dark matter; existing freeze-in tools assume instantaneous reheating in radiation domination, so evaluation relies on the paper's regime-by-regime analytic formulae done by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small reusable reheating-era Boltzmann module (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routine) that integrates the two-fluid energy-density equations for user-specified w, evaluates the spin-2 production rate with the full m_2/T dependence so the light/heavy regimes are interpolated rather than patched, and outputs Omega h^2 and the boost factor over (Lambda, m_2, T_RH, T_max/T_RH, w), validated against the paper's benchmarks.

members.model_name: Dark-charge Z6 two-fermion dark matter model
members.description: No implementation of the Z6 dark-charge F5/F6 model (vectorlike fermions, phi7 mediator, Z prime) exists in any public relic code, so the coupled two-component freeze-out that fixes the cold F5 fraction and the depleted F6 fraction feeding the boosted signal cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the F5, F6, phi7, Z prime Lagrangian of the k=6 benchmark in FeynRules/CalcHEP and solve the coupled two-component Boltzmann equations in micrOMEGAs' multi-component mode, covering both the small-coupling boosted benchmark (m7 > m5 + m6, m5 > m6) and the large-coupling coexisting-WIMP regime.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L fermion FIMP with scalar NLOP decay
members.description: No model implementation exists to compute the mixed relic abundance — thermal freeze-in of the fermion FIMP plus scalar _D freeze-out and its late super-WIMP decay contribution — with a public solver; the card records only the paper's equations and no reusable code.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model of the gauged B-L sector (S, Z_BL, N, _D, fermion FIMP) and use micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines for the thermal yield plus its freeze-out routines for Omega_D, adding the analytic _D -> chi N late-decay conversion; validate against the paper's m_D = 100 GeV, M_N = 50 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Leptophilic U(1)_L self-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the anomaly-free U(1)_L construction (Dirac dark matter, light leptophilic Z', exotic fermions, singlet scalar) exists for standard relic-density machinery; the Sommerfeld-corrected Boltzmann evolution was done in private Mathematica code that cannot be reproduced from the paper text.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_L model in FeynRules and run it through micrOMEGAs or MadDM with Sommerfeld enhancement in the light-mediator regime, validating against the paper's quoted 0.1 GeV < m_DM < 500 GeV and 0.1 MeV < m_Zprime < 0.5 GeV viable window.

members.model_name: ScotoZee model with scalar inert dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH/CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files exist for the ScotoZee charged-singlet extension, so the spectrum and relic-density pipeline used in the paper cannot be reproduced without reimplementing the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ScotoZee Lagrangian (inert doublet plus charged singlet plus singlet fermions) in SARAH and release the generated CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model files with a benchmark card reproducing the paper's Fig. 3 relic regions.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with dark-sector freeze-out
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver performs dark-sector freeze-out with full Fermi-Dirac/Bose-Einstein distributions and an effective chemical potential at arbitrary dark-to-visible temperature ratio xi, which is required for the relativistic-freeze-out regime and for the thermalization check of the N/s bath; existing codes assume Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics and/or an SM bath.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a decoupled-sector relic solver (e.g. the micrOMEGAs hidden-sector mode or a DRAKE-style dedicated integrator) to evolve the integrated Boltzmann equation with FD/BE phase-space distributions and a tracked chemical potential, parameterized by (M, m_s, lambda, xi), and validate against the paper's nonrelativistic limit.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter in the dynamical scotogenic model
members.description: No public model implementation (CalcHEP/FeynRules files) of the dynamical scotogenic model including the majoron final states N1 N1 -> JJ and Jh/JH, so the relic-density scan that distinguishes this model from the vanilla scotogenic case cannot be reproduced in micrOMEGAs as released.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file with the singlet fermions, inert doublet, B-L singlet, majoron, and scalar mixing, run micrOMEGAs freeze-out, and validate by recovering the vanilla scotogenic overabundance when the majoron channels are switched off.

members.model_name: Dirac-scotogenic singlet-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists: the LanHEP/micrOMEGAs model files used for the relic-density and direct-detection scans are not released, so the freeze-out with coannihilation and the tree-plus-loop sigma_SI cannot be reproduced or extended without rebuilding the model from the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Z2-odd singlet-doublet fermion plus scalar model in FeynRules/LanHEP, export to micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) for relic density with coannihilation and tree-level sigma_SI, and add the paper's one-loop scattering contributions as a custom cross-section module; validate against the paper's published relic and sigma_SI contours.

members.model_name: Complex scalar singlet t-channel portal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for this complex scalar singlet t-channel portal: the paper used micrOMEGAs privately, and no FeynRules/CalcHEP model files or code for the one-loop direct-detection Wilson-coefficient matching are released, so the route cannot be rerun independently.
members.proposed_resolution: Build and release FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the complex scalar plus fermionic mediator (enabling micrOMEGAs/MadDM relic and coannihilation runs) together with a small module implementing the paper's one-loop Wilson-coefficient matching, validated against the paper's unit-coupling rate curves.

members.model_name: Dirac fermion singlet t-channel portal dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the one-loop EFT matching of the Dirac fermion singlet t-channel portal (Yukawa-like lambda_L/R^f couplings to a single SM fermion via a colored scalar mediator) onto nuclear-scattering Wilson coefficients and a direct-detection event rate; computational_representation is null and the paper's pipeline is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's one-loop matching formulas (arXiv:2405.09326, building on arXiv:1606.07001) as a FeynRules/model package feeding the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module or DDCalc, and validate against the paper's unit-coupling rate curves.

members.model_name: Majorana fermion singlet t-channel portal dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the one-loop EFT matching of the Majorana fermion singlet t-channel portal (Yukawa-like lambda_L/R^f couplings to a single SM fermion via a colored scalar mediator) onto nuclear-scattering Wilson coefficients and a direct-detection event rate; computational_representation is null and the paper's pipeline is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's one-loop matching formulas (arXiv:2405.09326, building on arXiv:1606.07001) as a FeynRules/model package feeding the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module or DDCalc, keeping the Majorana-specific operator structure (no vector current), and validate against the paper's unit-coupling rate curves.

members.model_name: Z4 sequential loop-suppression inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/SARAH source generating CalcHEP and UFO files) exists for the Z4 sequential loop-suppression model, so micrOMEGAs/MadDM relic calculations and MadGraph collider simulations cannot be run for its specific inert-scalar and vector-like-fermion spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement one of the paper's three model realizations in FeynRules or SARAH, export CalcHEP files for micrOMEGAs and a UFO for MadGraph, and validate against the generic Higgs-portal inert-scalar relic curve.

members.model_name: Preheating dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation of the Pauli-blocked decaying-scalar model exists: the original CMBFAST patch was never released, and neither CLASS nor CAMB includes a decaying dark-matter module with the model's epoch-dependent, phase-space-capped decay rate Q(a) and effective equation of state w_eff(a) sourcing a growing neutrino Fermi sphere.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's background and perturbation equations as a CLASS module, extending the existing CLASS decaying-CDM (dcdm/dr) sector to take a time-dependent decay rate Q(a) from the fermionic-preheating solution and to deposit the decay products into a degenerate (Fermi-sphere) neutrino distribution instead of massless dark radiation; validate against the paper's benchmark spectra and the LambdaCDM limit as lambda -> 0.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric leptophilic Higgs singlino dark matter
members.description: No numerical model implementation (e.g. FeynRules/CalcHEP model files usable by micrOMEGAs or MadDM) exists for the four-Higgs-doublet plus singlet leptophilic supersymmetric model, so relic density and annihilation spectra can only be computed with the paper's simplified analytic formulas that neglect coannihilation, resonance effects, and precise g_* evolution near the QCD transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model superpotential and soft terms in FeynRules/SARAH, export to micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) to obtain full numerical freeze-out with coannihilation and resonance effects and tabulated gamma-ray spectra per final state.

members.model_name: Remnant-Z2 Majorana dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the remnant-Z2 Majorana model (chi_minus/chi_plus, rho, Goldstone eta with coannihilation and Goldstone final states) used in the paper is not publicly released, so the thermal relic abundance cannot be recomputed across the scanned parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model Lagrangian (SM plus complex scalar and Dirac fermion with U(1)_DM breaking) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic-density contours in the (M_minus, m_rho, f, z) scan.

members.model_name: Extended Ma model with inert scalar dark matter and preheating symmetry restoration
members.description: No public model implementation (spectrum calculator plus relic-density solver input files) exists for the extended Ma model with singlet scalars, so the eta_R coannihilation relic abundance and its lambda_3, lambda_4, lambda_5 dependence cannot be computed numerically without recoding or digitizing the paper's example curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the extended Ma Lagrangian (inert doublet eta, singlet fermions N_i, singlet scalars) and run it through micrOMEGAs to compute Omega_eta h^2 with full inert-doublet coannihilation, validating against the paper's m_eta = 1.75 TeV example curves.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter freeze-in through a heavy invisible Z prime
members.description: No public freeze-in Boltzmann solver implements the axially coupled fermionic GCS-mediated production rate R(T) ~ T^10 through a noninstantaneous reheating history (T_max/T_RH dependence and boost factor B_F); existing freeze-in tools assume instantaneous reheating, so the relic abundance and its reheating boost cannot be evaluated across the parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the fermionic GCS matrix elements with axial Z-prime coupling (including exact rates valid near the Z-prime and heavy-fermion thresholds, beyond the T^10 approximation) and couple them to a Boltzmann integrator that evolves the inflaton-radiation-DM system through reheating with (T_RH, T_max) as inputs — either as an extension of micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or as a standalone ODE code validated against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 benchmark curves.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D chiral fermion plus T-prime boson dark matter
members.description: No public two-component micrOMEGAs implementation of the SU(2)_D chiral model exists: the coupled Boltzmann evolution of the fermion psi and the lightest T-prime nonsinglet boson (including psi-pair-to-triplet conversion channels) was done privately, so component relic fractions — which also feed the direct-detection rescaling — cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full SU(2)_D model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and use micrOMEGAs' two-dark-sector-particle mode to solve the coupled abundance equations, validating against the paper's fermion-dominated versus triplet-dominated regime statements and releasing benchmark scan tables with component fractions.

members.model_name: Conformal GUT hidden-sector inert dark fermion dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled inflaton - dark fermion - dark scalar - SM radiation Boltzmann network with Higgs-portal reheating that this model requires; the card lists the ODE solver and temperature-dependent g_* table as required but unprovided resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's four-fluid Boltzmann equations as a standalone ODE package (Python/scipy or a micrOMEGAs auxiliary module) with a standard g_*(T) table, validated against the paper benchmarks Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1200 and T_RH_SM > 4 MeV.

members.model_name: U(1)_{e-mu} Dirac leptophilic dark matter with two-loop neutrino masses
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the U(1)_{e-mu} model (Zprime and inert-scalar mediators, Z_3-stabilized Dirac fermion X_1) is private; without public model files neither the relic density nor <sigma v>(v) near the Breit-Wigner pole can be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the model in FeynRules/LanHEP, export CalcHEP model files to micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic scan (0.11 < Omega h^2 < 0.13 near m_X = m_Zprime/2) and the 390 GeV, B = 40.1 benchmark.

members.model_name: Doublet left-right model with right-handed fermion quintuplet dark matter
members.description: The SARAH model files and micrOMEGAs implementation of the DLRM with a right-handed real fermion quintuplet are not publicly released, so the thermal relic scan with W_R/Z_R resonances and coannihilation cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the DLRM + SU(2)_R quintuplet in SARAH (gauge sector, quintuplet gauge interactions, radiative mass splitting), export a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model, validate against the paper's relic resonances near M_WR and M_ZR, and release the model files and scan grids.

members.model_name: SU(2)_X non-Abelian vector dark matter for muon g-2
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model files for the SU(2)_X non-Abelian vector dark matter model (gauge sector, anomaly-canceling fermions E, Eprime, N, Nprime, and Higgs-phi_X mixing) are not publicly released, so the micrOMEGAs relic-density and co-annihilation calculation cannot be reproduced; a low-velocity expansion substitute would miss the threshold-sensitive X Xdagger -> Zprime Zprime channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the SU(2)_X Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files to micrOMEGAs 5.x, and validate by recovering the published M_X = 0.5-2 TeV, g_X = 0.2-0.8 relic/g-2 band and the XENON1T small-mixing constraint.

members.model_name: RPV axiogenesis axion dark matter
members.description: No public solver evolves the coupled system of QCD axion rotation, saxion/PQ radial-mode thermalization, strong-sphaleron chiral-asymmetry transfer, and RPV B-L violation needed to compute the baryon asymmetry and the kinetic-misalignment axion relic abundance for given (f_a, dot(theta), RPV couplings, sfermion masses).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's chemical-potential network and rotation equations of motion as a dedicated Boltzmann/transport code (structure analogous to leptogenesis codes such as ULYSSES), including saxion thermalization criteria and washout of the kinetic-misalignment contribution, validated against the paper's benchmark viable regions.

members.model_name: Fermionic inelastic cosmic-ray-accelerated dark matter
members.description: No public forward model computes the cosmic-ray-accelerated inelastic flux for a two-state fermionic dark sector: upscattering p/He + chi_1 -> chi_2 with sub-GeV splitting Delta, the boosted chi_1 spectrum from chi_2 -> chi_1 + V decay, and attenuation to underground xenon detectors for the vector, axial-vector, and dipole benchmark operators.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the DarkSUSY cosmic-ray-boosted DM module to inelastic two-state kinematics: add the chi_2 production cross sections for the C_v, C_a, Lambda_E, Lambda_M operators with light-mediator form factors, the chi_2 decay boost spectrum, and inelastic Earth attenuation, keyed to the D_eff flux parameterization.

members.model_name: Electron-specific spin-2 mediator with hidden scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code implements spin-2 mediator production in electron fixed-target showers (bremsstrahlung-like emission plus resonant secondary-positron annihilation) folded with positron track-length distributions to produce a missing-energy signal yield.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing fixed-target dark-sector signal package (e.g. the DMG4 GEANT4 module used by NA64) with the paper's spin-2 production cross sections, or implement the analytic cross sections numerically and convolve with published target-material positron track-length tables.

members.model_name: Dark linear seesaw scalar dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH/SPheno/micrOMEGAs model implementation of the dark linear seesaw is available, so the relic-density, direct-detection, and cLFV scan cannot be reproduced or extended without re-deriving the mass matrices, vertices, and tadpole equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model (Z2-odd scalar doublet plus singlet, vector-like fermion, sterile singlets, soft cubic term) in SARAH, generate SPheno and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs outputs, validate against the paper's 45 GeV-2 TeV relic window and MEG cut, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Dark first-order phase transition primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public code maps the dark-sector FOPT Lagrangian parameters (scalar potential, Yukawa g_chi, asymmetry eta_chi) through Fermi-ball formation, cooling, and collapse to the final PBH mass function and abundance (M_PBH, n_PBH, f_PBH); this production stage exists only as the paper's semi-analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a public pipeline that couples CosmoTransitions (or an equivalent finite-temperature bounce solver) for the transition parameters (T_star, alpha, beta) to a coded Fermi-ball module implementing false-vacuum trapping statistics, Fermi-ball charge/mass distribution, Yukawa-energy cooling, and the collapse criterion, outputting M_PBH and f_PBH as functions of the model parameters.

members.model_name: Minimal clockwork neutrinogenesis scalar dark-sector subcomponent
members.description: No solver exists for the momentum distribution and hot fraction f_hot of the secluded sub-MeV clockwork scalar/fermion sector with its feebly coupled clockwork portal, which is the required input to any transfer-function calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-sector temperature ratio and freeze-out phase-space distribution from the clockwork portal rate and 3-to-2 self-interactions, implement it as a kinetic Boltzmann solver, and feed the resulting f(q) and f_hot into the CLASS ncdm module.

members.model_name: Dark-Z-mediated fermionic dark matter with an extra Higgs doublet
members.description: No public model file exists for the hidden U(1)_X Dirac fermion with a light dark Z and an extra Higgs doublet (type-I-like Yukawa structure, kinetic mixing neglected), so the micrOMEGAs relic-abundance and nuclear-recoil calculation used by the paper cannot be reproduced or scanned by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the Lagrangian in FeynRules, export the CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's relic contours near the 2m_X ~ m_Zprime resonance and the quoted annihilation channels.

members.model_name: Decaying dark matter to Lorentz-violating fermions
members.description: No Boltzmann/background code (CLASS, CAMB, or a decaying-DM branch) implements a CDM progenitor decaying into fermions with a Lorentz-violating dispersion, so f(k,z), the background w(z), and perturbations cannot be computed numerically for likelihood comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (building on its existing decaying-CDM and non-cold-relic ncdm machinery) with a custom dispersion relation omega(k;b,m) and a decay source term in the daughter distribution function, parameterized by (tau, b, m_phi, m), then attach standard CMB/BAO/SN and growth likelihoods via Cobaya or MontePython.

members.model_name: Fermionic FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements moduli-portal freeze-in of a fermionic FIMP through non-instantaneous reheating; the coupled inflaton-radiation-FIMP system with (T_R, T_max), chirality-flip-dependent rates, and axial-modulus pole enhancement exists only as the authors' custom code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the real- and axial-modulus fermion rate densities in a public freeze-in solver extended with an inflaton-dominated reheating phase parameterized by (T_R, T_max) — e.g. extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or release a standalone Boltzmann-fluid code — and validate by recovering the radiation-era-only yield and the published relic-density contours.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with Higgs scalar portal
members.description: No implemented calculator produces gamma-ray and antiproton spectra for the two-step cascade chi chi -> phi phi followed by scalar decay through the Higgs portal, whose Yukawa-weighted, mass-dependent branching fractions (b bbar, tau tau, cc, gluons) require convolving HDecay branching ratios with boosted decay spectra not covered by standard direct-annihilation tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Chain HDecay branching fractions for the mixed scalar into Pythia or PPPC4DMID rest-frame spectra per final state, apply the boost convolution for the two-step cascade, and package it as a MadDM-style module keyed to (m_chi, m_phi, mixing angle).

members.model_name: Hylogenesis antibaryonic dark matter
members.description: No event generator or detector recast exists for induced nucleon decay (p Y -> Phi* K+ and variants): the meson spectrum differs from standard nucleon-decay searches, and no efficiency map or likelihood from water-Cherenkov nucleon-decay analyses has been applied to these kinematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a simple IND event generator producing the meson momentum spectrum from DM-nucleon scattering kinematics, then recast Super-Kamiokande p -> K+ nu (and analogous pion-channel) selections with published efficiency and background information to produce limits on sigma_IND versus the portal scale M.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) supersymmetric radiative seesaw dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation exists for the two-component sector: freeze-out of the singlet fermion N_1 with N_2 coannihilation through inert-doublet scalars and sleptons, coupled to a neutralino freeze-out, with the constraint Omega_chi h^2 + Omega_N1 h^2 fixed to the observed abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the model (inert doublets, singlet superfields, anomalous-U(1) charge assignments) in FeynRules/SARAH and export to micrOMEGAs or MadDM, which already handle coannihilation networks; validate against the paper's benchmark effective cross sections for N_1/N_2 coannihilation.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with scalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: No public model implementation of the Dirac-fermion plus Higgs-mixed scalar mediator exists; the paper used MicrOMEGAs 4.3 privately and no repository is identified, blocking rerun of relic-density and annihilation-channel steps.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the renormalizable Lagrangian (g_d s chi-bar chi plus s^2 H-dagger H with mixing angle theta) in FeynRules and export a CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model file, validating Omega h^2 = 0.11 contours and sigma_SI against the paper's scan.

members.model_name: Thermal dark matter through the Dirac neutrino portal
members.description: No public model implementation of the Dirac neutrino-portal Lagrangian (Dirac fermion chi, complex scalar phi, pseudo-Dirac sterile mediator with y_L, y_R, U_alpha4) exists in a relic-density solver, so the thermal target must be recomputed by hand for each parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/LanHEP model file for the chi-phi-N Lagrangian and generate CalcHEP/UFO output for micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute freeze-out to light neutrinos, validating against the paper's Y versus m_chi thermal-target curves.

members.model_name: Tiny-split mirror baryon dark matter with neutron--mirror-neutron oscillation
members.description: No public code computes neutron-star heating from in-medium n-to-mirror-neutron conversion: the calculation requires the conversion rate in degenerate nuclear matter, Fermi-sea refilling energetics, and a coupled thermal-evolution model, none of which is packaged for this model's (epsilon, Delta m) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the in-medium conversion and heating-rate formalism of the related analysis (arXiv:2105.09951) as a module over a standard neutron-star cooling code (e.g. NSCool), with the equation of state as a nuisance input, and compare the predicted late-time temperature to cold pulsars such as PSR J2144-3933 to derive epsilon bounds as a function of Delta m.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free ALP inflaton dark matter for the XENON1T excess
members.description: No public Boltzmann/thermal-history code computes the thermally produced ALP yield, its momentum distribution, and the required late entropy dilution for the anomaly-free ALP-inflaton scenario, so Omega_phi h^2 and the ALP fraction entering every other observable cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ALP-fermion scattering production rates, the inflaton condensate reheating/diffusion evolution, and a parameterized entropy-injection episode in a momentum-resolved Boltzmann solver (e.g. extending the machinery used for keV sterile-neutrino codes such as sterile-dm/LASAGNA-style solvers), outputting Omega_phi h^2 and f(p).

members.model_name: SO(10)-embedded fermion triplet dark matter
members.description: No Sommerfeld-enhancement module for the SU(2)_L fermion triplet (wino-like potential with 166 MeV charged-neutral splitting) is attached to the relic and indirect-detection pipeline; the micrOMEGAs/LanHEP scan is purely perturbative, yet the card states the Fermi-LAT exclusion and the 2.34-2.4 TeV mass window both depend on Sommerfeld effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Hisano-type electroweak Sommerfeld calculation (multi-state Schrodinger solver for the chi0/chi+- system) as a module feeding corrected <sigma v> into the micrOMEGAs freeze-out and into the gamma-ray annihilation rate, validating against published wino/triplet results.

members.model_name: Dark Loops Model 3 scalar-doublet dark matter
