members.description: The Model 3 implementation files (FeynRules/CalcHEP model for the two Z2-odd scalar doublets plus vectorlike singlet fermion) used with micrOMEGAs are not public, so the relic-density and sigma_SI scan and the 42-76 GeV allowed window cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the Model 3 Lagrangian (Yukawa terms y_Q, y_L and the scalar potential quartics) in FeynRules, export a CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model file, validate against the paper's reported 42-76 GeV mass window and portal-coupling scan, and release the files.

members.model_name: Dark Loops Model 5 scalar-singlet dark matter
members.description: No public FeynRules/CalcHEP model implementation of Model 5 (Z2-odd scalar SU(2)L singlets plus vectorlike fermion doublet) exists for micrOMEGAs, so the relic abundance with annihilation and coannihilation, and the sigma_SI input to direct-detection recasts, cannot be recomputed outside the original private setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model file for the Model 5 field content and Z2 charges, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate by reproducing the paper's 30-350 GeV allowed scalar-mass window and the fermion-doublet Z-mediated exclusion.

members.model_name: Dark-FOPT Fermi-ball-collapse primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented integrator applies the compiled monochromatic microlensing/evaporation/CMB/BBN PBH bounds to the extended Fermi-ball-collapse mass function; only monochromatic limits are directly usable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard extended-mass-function recasting integral (Carr et al. method) over a public PBH bounds compilation such as PBHbounds, parameterized by the FOPT bubble-radius-derived mass function, and validate on monochromatic limits.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter from linear non-minimally coupled inflaton decay
members.description: The LanHEP/CalcHEP model files and the beta-scan scripts behind the allowed beta-m_DM region are not public, so the paper's numerical allowed intervals for the fermion case (m_DM ~ 2.7e7 GeV x beta^(1/12)) can only be reproduced by re-deriving the scaling relations by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the linear non-minimal coupling vertices in LanHEP/FeynRules, regenerate the spin-dependent decay widths in CalcHEP, and script the beta scan (inflation observables, heating temperature, yield, relic target) as a small public notebook validated against the paper's quoted mass-beta scalings.

members.model_name: High-scale darkogenesis with leptodark messenger sphaleron transfer
members.description: No quantitative calculation of the dark-number asymmetry produced at the first-order SU(2)_D phase transition exists; the CP-violating interaction of dark fermions with bubble walls is treated only as a set of analytic model requirements, with no transport-equation solver for a hidden-sector sphaleron baryogenesis.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt electroweak-baryogenesis machinery to the dark sector: compute the finite-temperature dark Higgs potential and wall profile with CosmoTransitions, then solve the CP-violating transport equations for the SU(2)_D-charged fermions to obtain the dark asymmetry as a function of dark-sector couplings and wall velocity.

members.model_name: keVin-GeVin warm dark matter
members.description: No numerical Boltzmann solver covers the intermediate GeVin freeze-out regime between the relativistic and nonrelativistic analytic limits, leaving the GeVin abundance (and hence the entropy dilution S_req that sets the keVin relic density) approximate exactly where the M_2 of a few GeV benchmarks sit.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the freeze-out Boltzmann equation with full relativistic Fermi-Dirac statistics and the suppressed Z-mediated cross sections (e.g. via micrOMEGAs with the epsilon-suppressed Z couplings implemented, or a small standalone solver), mapping S_req over the (M_2, epsilon_2, eta) plane.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudo-scalar Yukawa interaction
members.description: No reusable public LanHEP/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files exist for the singlet Dirac fermion plus mixed pseudoscalar model, so the paper's relic-density, Higgs-width, and spectrum pipeline cannot be rerun without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Lagrangian (with the paper's CP/mixing conventions) in LanHEP or FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's g = 0.02, 0.08, 0.48 relic-density benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Smallest non-Abelian chiral dark-sector dark-proton dark matter
members.description: No tool computes the annihilation photon/neutrino spectra for this model's cascade (dark protons to dark pions and dark leptons, then portal decays to SM states) at 10-100 TeV including Sommerfeld enhancement and the pseudoscalar-channel bound-state formation the paper leaves for future work, so observatory limits cannot be recast onto the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a cascade-spectrum module that convolves the dark-hadron annihilation channels and dark-lepton branching ratios with HDMSpectra electroweak-corrected SM spectra, add Sommerfeld and bound-state factors for the dark-pion-exchange potential, and compare to Fermi-LAT/HESS/HAWC/IceCube high-mass limit likelihoods.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L Dirac scotogenic fermion dark matter
members.description: No public SARAH/SPheno/micrOMEGAs model implementation of the gauged B-L Dirac scotogenic model (S_1 Dirac fermion, Z_BL, dark scalars eta, Diracon sector) is identified, so the paper's relic-density and sigma_SI pipeline cannot be rerun as-is.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model Lagrangian (symmetry assignments, scalar potential, Yukawas, Stueckelberg Z_BL mass) in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate by reproducing the paper's Planck-compatible relic contours in the (m_S1, m_BL) plane.

members.model_name: Type Ib seesaw right-handed-neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists for the type-Ib seesaw plus Z2-odd dark scalar/Dirac fermion sector in a freeze-in-capable Boltzmann code, so the relic density from feeble RHN-portal production (y about 1e-5 or below, both the y-only and y-plus-seesaw-Yukawa regimes) cannot be computed numerically or scanned over dark masses.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the type-Ib seesaw with the dark scalar/fermion and portal coupling y in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP, and use the micrOMEGAs freeze-in routines to compute Omega h^2 over (y, dark masses, M, U^2), validating against the paper's claim that freeze-in covers the allowed resonant-leptogenesis region.

members.model_name: Dark-sector vacuum-scalarized non-topological soliton stars
members.description: No numerical solver exists for the coupled Einstein-scalar-fermion equilibrium problem of vacuum-scalarized false-vacuum pockets, so mass-radius curves, M_max, compactness, and tidal Love numbers cannot be computed outside the paper's own benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a shooting-method solver for the paper's action (Thomas-Fermi fermion fluid plus real scalar in GR), extending existing fermion-soliton/boson-star structure codes, and add the metric-perturbation equations needed for k2 tidal response.

members.model_name: Leptophobic U(1)_B fermionic X superpartner cold dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density model implementation exists for the supersymmetric leptophobic U(1)_B sector with a fermionic X superpartner candidate; the card gives only a partial Lagrangian and the boltzmann_solver step names a generic micrOMEGAs-style solver without model files, so resonant annihilation near m_X ~ M_ZB/2 cannot be computed precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the full Lagrangian (Z_B couplings, X-sector masses, widths) from the primary and referenced papers, encode it as a CalcHEP/FeynRules model, and run micrOMEGAs to compute Omega_X h^2 including the Z_B resonance and threshold effects across (m_X, M_ZB, g_B).

members.model_name: Type-I seesaw plus fermionic quintuplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled RG evolution of the SM plus Type-I seesaw plus fermionic SU(2)_L quintuplet system with the seesaw and 9.6 TeV MDM thresholds, so the vacuum-stability contours must be re-derived from the paper's beta functions by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate two-loop RGEs for the SM+Type-I-seesaw+quintuplet field content with PyR@TE or SARAH, add threshold matching at M_R and M_MDM, and release a small ODE-integration script validated against the paper's stability contours.

members.model_name: Type-III seesaw plus fermionic quintuplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled RG evolution of the SM plus Type-III seesaw triplets plus fermionic SU(2)_L quintuplet, including the strong g_2 running that can blow up near 10^15 GeV, so the stability/perturbativity contours must be re-derived from the paper's beta functions by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate two-loop RGEs for the SM+Type-III-seesaw+quintuplet field content with PyR@TE or SARAH, add threshold matching at M_Sigma and M_MDM, and release an integration script that reproduces the paper's stability contours and the g_2 Landau-pole check for triplets below 10^8 GeV.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian Goldstone absorption dark matter
members.description: No absorption-rate pipeline connects this model's non-Abelian Goldstone coupling (via exp(i T pi/Lambda) fermion mass-matrix insertions) to semiconductor and superconductor response functions; existing material-response codes are written for dark-photon or generic scalar/pseudoscalar absorption, not this flavor-generator-dependent coupling.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public material-response code such as DarkELF (or the QEdark energy-loss-function framework) with the Goldstone absorption matrix element for a specified flavor generator, reusing its existing semiconductor and superconductor loss functions to output event rates versus m_pi and Lambda.

members.model_name: Abelian vector dark matter freeze-in through a heavy invisible Z prime
members.description: No public freeze-in Boltzmann solver implements GCS-mediated SM gauge-boson annihilation rates with the steep R(T) ~ T^12 scaling through a noninstantaneous reheating history (T_max/T_RH dependence and boost factor B_F); existing freeze-in tools assume instantaneous reheating, so the relic abundance and its reheating boost cannot be evaluated across the parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the GCS matrix elements (including exact rates valid near the Z-prime and heavy-fermion thresholds, beyond the T^12 approximation) and couple them to a Boltzmann integrator that evolves the inflaton-radiation-DM system through reheating with (T_RH, T_max) as inputs — either as an extension of micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or as a standalone ODE code validated against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Fermionic secluded light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: No acceptance-level recast exists for fermionic X1/X2 pair production in rare K and B decays (missing-energy and displaced X2 -> X1 + pi0/photon topologies) at KOTO, NA62, and Belle II; constraints are applied only at the inclusive branching-ratio level.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the fermionic dark-current three-body decay kinematics and X2 lifetime-dependent displaced-vertex acceptance in a recast framework using published KOTO signal-region efficiencies, the NA62 pi0-invisible limit, and Belle II B -> K nu nu-bar selections.

members.model_name: Inelastic dark-photon Dirac fermion thermal relic for the XENON1T excess
members.description: No public code computes the exothermic chi_2 -> chi_1 electron-recoil spectrum dR/dE_e in xenon for a keV-split sub-GeV Dirac fermion with a light dark-photon mediator; existing DM-electron codes assume elastic scattering.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend QEdark or DarkART with inelastic (exothermic) kinematics — shift the energy-conservation delta by the splitting delta in the ionization rate integral — using the existing xenon atomic ionization form factors, and convolve with the published XENON1T detector efficiency and energy resolution.

members.model_name: Fermion boosted dark matter with annihilation production
members.description: No public rate calculator combines the fermion annihilation boosted-DM flux with DM-electron scattering and the XENON1T SR1 detector response (efficiency and energy resolution), so the 1-7 keV electron-recoil spectrum can only be estimated without detector effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public DM-electron scattering rate code such as wimprates or DarkELF with a boosted-DM monochromatic-velocity flux module and fold in the published XENON1T SR1 efficiency and resolution curves.

members.model_name: Light 2HDM-portal forbidden singlet fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the leptophilic 2HDM plus singlet-scalar plus singlet-fermion setup exists for relic-density codes; the forbidden freeze-out with velocity-suppressed scalar-mediated annihilation near lepton thresholds requires exact thermally averaged cross sections across the threshold, which the card's route leaves with null tool_or_code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs with exact relativistic thermal averaging over the forbidden threshold, validating against the paper's viable m_chi band just below the charged-lepton masses for both Dirac and Majorana variants.

members.model_name: 2HD+a singlet-fermion dark matter
members.description: No consistent public implementation of the loop-induced spin-independent nucleon scattering cross section for the pseudoscalar-mediated singlet fermion in the 2HD+a model, which is the quantity the XENON1T comparison actually constrains since tree-level SI scattering vanishes.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the known one-loop pseudoscalar-mediator SI amplitude (following the published 2HD+a loop calculations) as a model extension in micrOMEGAs or DirectDM/DarkSUSY so that sigma_SI can be evaluated across the scan.

members.model_name: SE6SSM gravitino and lightest neutral exotic fermion dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum generator or relic/direct-detection code implements the modified SE6SSM with conserved matter parity and Z2H symmetry: masses, mixings, effective Higgs/Z couplings, the neutral-exotic-fermion freeze-out abundance, and sigma_SI/sigma_SD are currently obtained only from approximate analytic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SE6SSM variant in SARAH to auto-generate a SPheno/FlexibleSUSY spectrum calculator plus CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, giving a full Boltzmann relic-density calculation for the neutral exotic fermion and tree-level direct-detection cross sections, validated against the paper's Omega_H h^2 ~ 0.1 (mu_11/1 TeV)^2 scaling and Fig. 1 sigma_SI examples.

members.model_name: Multi-component asymmetric cogenesis dark-sector model
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/UFO or CalcHEP files) exists for this Lagrangian, so the annihilation spectra and indirect-detection rates of the residual symmetric S component cannot be evaluated with standard pipelines; the paper evaluates no gamma-ray or cosmic-ray likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-sector Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO model files, and use micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute annihilation spectra of the symmetric S component (including cascades through Z_D), then compare against Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) of the Z3 scotogenic two-inert-doublet plus Dirac-fermion Lagrangian exists, so relic-density scans with coannihilation and automated flavor observables cannot be run with micrOMEGAs/MadDM and rely on the paper's semi-analytic freeze-out.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model (Y1, Y2 Yukawas, inert-doublet scalar potential with the H eta1 H eta2 term) in FeynRules/SARAH, export UFO and CalcHEP files, and validate micrOMEGAs relic output including S1 coannihilation against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 MeV-to-sub-GeV viable band.

members.model_name: Gravitationally produced sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public numerical solver computes gravitational particle production of spin-1/2 singlet fermions (Bogoliubov mode-function integration) including the Planck-suppressed inflaton-fermion operator during inflaton oscillations, for general inflaton potentials, Wilson coefficient C, and reheating/dilution histories; only paper-level analytic estimates exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Package a curved-space Dirac mode-function integrator (in the spirit of existing gravitational-production codes for scalars) that adds the dimension-5 C phi psi-bar psi / M_Pl term to the effective mass, scans (M, C, H_e, T_R, eta_NR), and outputs the nonthermal yield and momentum distribution, validated against the paper's M ~ 2e8 GeV radiation-dominated benchmark.

members.model_name: Z4 fermion FIMP dark matter with singlet scalar mediator
members.description: The paper's LanHEP/micrOMEGAs model implementation of the Z4 fermion-plus-scalar model and its scan scripts were not publicly released, so reproducing the relic contours requires re-implementing the model from the written Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the Z4 model in LanHEP (or FeynRules/CalcHEP), export to micrOMEGAs, validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours for the three mass hierarchies, and publish the model files and scan scripts.

members.model_name: Hierarchical right-handed Majorana neutrino dark matter in quintessential inflation
members.description: No numerical gravitational-particle-production code exists for the hierarchical right-handed neutrinos: the relic abundance rests on a benchmark analytic estimate for a one-Hubble-time inflation-to-kination transition, with no solver for fermionic Bogoliubov coefficients over general transition timescales, H_inf values, and non-minimal curvature couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a background solver for the quintessential-inflation/kination history coupled to a fermionic mode-function (Bogoliubov) integrator parameterized by (M_i, H_inf, transition duration, curvature coupling), validated against the paper's M_3 ~ 1e13 GeV, M_2 ~ 1e11 GeV, M_1 ~ 10 keV benchmark.

members.model_name: Radiative charged-lepton seesaw scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/UFO file) of the Z2-odd scalar plus vector-like-fermion sector exists, so the relic abundance, direct-detection cross section, and leptophilic annihilation spectra cannot be scanned beyond the two quoted benchmarks that are imported from an earlier paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian (f_L, f_R Yukawas, lambda_DM Higgs portal, charged-scalar mixing) in FeynRules, export to micrOMEGAs for the relic and SI cross-section scan, and feed the resulting muon/electron annihilation spectra into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods for the indirect-detection check.

members.model_name: Freeze-in lepton-flavored dark matter with right-handed lepton mediator
members.description: No validated, reusable implementation of the coupled mediator-freeze-out plus DM-freeze-in relic calculation is confirmed: the LFDM_at_MuC repository's contents, inputs, and validation status are unknown on the card, and no model files for standard relic codes are identified.
members.proposed_resolution: Audit and document the LFDM_at_MuC repository against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 contours and tau_med boundary, or implement the model (charged scalar mediator plus neutral fermion with lepton-portal Yukawa) in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module to reproduce the reported upper DM mass near 3.6 TeV.

members.model_name: Moduli-portal UV freeze-in dark matter in nonstandard cosmology
members.description: No public code solves the coupled decaying-fluid plus radiation reheating system for general pre-BBN equation of state w together with moduli-mediated freeze-in production for scalar, vector, and fermion dark matter, including the split between light and integrated-out modulus regimes (con_modulus_regime); existing freeze-in tools assume instantaneous reheating in radiation domination, so evaluation relies on the paper's regime-by-regime analytic formulae done by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small reusable reheating-era Boltzmann module (or extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in routine) that integrates the two-fluid energy-density equations for user-specified w, evaluates the modulus-mediated production rate with full modulus-mass dependence across the light/heavy regimes for each dark matter spin, and outputs Omega h^2 and the boost factor over (Lambda, modulus mass, T_RH, T_max/T_RH, w), validated against the paper's benchmarks.

members.model_name: Two-component SU(2)_R triplet fermion dark matter in broken D-parity left-right symmetry
members.description: The FeynRules/micrOMEGAs implementation of the two-generation SU(2)_R triplet model used for the resonant two-component relic calculation is private; without a public model file the narrow W_R/Z' resonance relic bands cannot be reproduced or rescanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the left-right triplet-fermion model in FeynRules (fields, W_R/Z' couplings, one-loop charged-neutral splitting) and export to micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's M_WR = 3.78-9.40 TeV relic bands and dominant co-annihilation channels.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs pseudo-Dirac sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: No public relic-density implementation covers the pseudo-Dirac U(1)_D dark-Higgs sector: freeze-out with chi_1 chi_2 coannihilation, off-shell dark-photon annihilation to e+e-, and S-containing final states was run through private BayesFITS/modified micrOMEGAs/non-SUSY SPheno tooling.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-Weyl-fermion pseudo-Dirac model with dark photon and dark Higgs in FeynRules/CalcHEP and rerun the freeze-out in micrOMEGAs tracking the chi_1-chi_2 splitting, validating against the paper's Planck-compatible (Omega h^2 = 0.1188) scan and the below-dimuon-threshold lifetime scaling.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet fermion dark matter with scalar triplet
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the singlet-doublet fermion plus hypercharge-2 scalar triplet Lagrangian: the LanHEP/CalcHEP files feeding micrOMEGAs and the MadGraph/PYTHIA event generation are private, so the relic density, Higgs-mediated sigma_SI, and collider signatures cannot be independently recomputed or scanned beyond the paper's benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model (VLF singlet and doublet, Y=2 scalar triplet, Y H psi psi0, y_chi psi Delta psi, y_L L Delta L operators) in FeynRules or LanHEP, export UFO and CalcHEP formats, validate the micrOMEGAs relic density and pseudo-Dirac spectrum against the paper's Planck-compatible regions, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Fermi-ball collapse primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No implementation exists of the model's scalar+Dirac-fermion thermal effective potential, bubble nucleation history, and false-vacuum remnant number density near percolation; all upstream quantities (T_*, alpha, beta/H, remnant density) currently rest on simplified radiation-dominated estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the real-scalar plus Yukawa-coupled fermion model in CosmoTransitions (or PhaseTracer) to compute the finite-temperature potential, bounce action, and percolation temperature, and add a module computing the surviving false-vacuum remnant number density from the bubble nucleation history.

members.model_name: Non-thermal vector-like fermion dark matter from generalized Hilltop reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver exists for reheating-era production of the vector-like fermion in the generalized Hilltop benchmark: the coupled inflaton-radiation-DM system with inflaton decay (y_chi), inflaton-mediated 2-to-2 scattering, and graviton-mediated 2-to-2 scattering was solved with private code, and existing freeze-in tools do not cover gravitational production during reheating.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled reheating Boltzmann equations (inflaton, radiation, and Y_chi from decay plus inflaton- and graviton-mediated scattering) as an open ODE code, or extend an existing public reheating/FIMP framework with the graviton-mediated production rate, and validate against the paper's y_chi and T_R versus m_chi allowed bands.

members.model_name: Non-thermal vector-like fermion dark matter from non-minimal Coleman-Weinberg reheating
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver exists for reheating-era production of the vector-like fermion in the non-minimal Coleman-Weinberg benchmark: the coupled inflaton-radiation-DM system with inflaton decay (y_chi), inflaton-mediated 2-to-2 scattering, and graviton-mediated 2-to-2 scattering was solved with private code, and existing freeze-in tools do not cover gravitational production during reheating.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled reheating Boltzmann equations (inflaton, radiation, and Y_chi from decay plus inflaton- and graviton-mediated scattering) as an open ODE code, or extend an existing public reheating/FIMP framework with the graviton-mediated production rate, and validate against the paper's y_chi and T_R versus m_chi allowed bands for the NM-CW benchmark.

members.model_name: Mixed collisionless dark matter free-streaming model
members.description: No public Boltzmann-code implementation computes the linear transfer function for this model's arbitrary multi-component mixture of decoupled distribution functions (Fermi-Dirac, Bose-Einstein, condensate, WIMP, resonant/non-resonant sterile neutrino) with fractional abundances nu_a; the card only provides the paper's semi-analytic lambda_fs formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Set up CLASS (or CAMB) with multiple ncdm species using tabulated psd files for each f_d,a(y) and fractional Omega_a = nu_a * Omega_dm, validate against the paper's lambda_fs scaling and the CDM-like WIMP-dominated limit, and wrap it as a reusable mixed-DM transfer-function module.

members.model_name: Next-to-new minimal Standard Model singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No public RGE code implements the NNMSM field content (singlet scalar plus SU(3)/SU(2) adjoint fermions, four vector-like doublets, and right-handed neutrino thresholds), so the stability/triviality and Planck-scale MPCP bands defining the allowed m_S-k regions cannot be reproduced without re-deriving the running.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the two-loop NNMSM beta functions with SARAH or PyR@TE, implement threshold matching at M_R and the new-fermion masses, and integrate to the Planck scale to reproduce the stability/triviality and multiple-point-criticality bands.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative inverse-seesaw scalar H2 dark matter
members.description: The hidden U(1)_H radiative inverse-seesaw model implementation used with micrOMEGAs-5.2.4 (Z2-odd scalar spectrum, H2 H2 -> Z' + SM fermion annihilation, and scan filters) is not publicly released, so the H2 relic-density band cannot be independently recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model from the paper's Lagrangian in FeynRules or SARAH, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, validate by reproducing the published allowed band in the (m_H2, m_Z', g'') plane, and release the model files in the registry.

members.model_name: Bouncing multicomponent singlet fermion-pNGB dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the singlet-Dirac-fermion plus pNGB two-component model: the CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files the paper used to solve the coupled bouncing yields are not released, blocking the relic-density step and the model-specific cross sections and spectra downstream.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the low-energy Lagrangian (fermion-pNGB coupling, h_1/h_2 mixing, scalar potential) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and register it as a micrOMEGAs two-component model with semi-annihilation, validating against the paper's 500/700 GeV inverse-hierarchy benchmarks and the Omega_chi + Omega_eta = 0.12 target.

members.model_name: Radiative hybrid inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation solver implements the loop-corrected attractor hybrid potential with its dark-fermion contribution and waterfall transition, so the small-scale curvature peak P_zeta(k) that sets both f_PBH and Omega_GW can only be estimated analytically rather than computed mode-by-mode.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the loop-corrected hybrid potential (inflaton plus waterfall field with dark-fermion Yukawa corrections) in a public multi-field Mukhanov-Sasaki solver (e.g. a MultiModeCode/PyTransport-class code) and compute P_zeta(k) through the waterfall, validated against the primary's n_s about 0.964, r about 0.0087, and peak benchmarks.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation scalar doublet WIMP Case B
members.description: No public calculator exists for W-mediated exoergic bound-state capture with nuclear transmutation in the MeV mass-gap regime: case B has no positron line, its rate depends on nuclear transmutation matrix elements, and the semiclassical approximation is valid only when many bound levels contribute.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a numerical capture-rate code solving for the charged-scalar bound levels in realistic nuclear Coulomb potentials and combining them with W-exchange transmutation matrix elements for the relevant Xe, C, and O targets, output as capture cross section times velocity over (Delta m, m_X, g_eff).

members.model_name: Secluded singlet-fermion WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No numerical relic-density implementation of the singlet-fermion WIMP with singlet-scalar mediator exists; freeze-out through chi chi -> phi phi is only estimated analytically, without early-kinetic-decoupling or hidden-sector temperature effects that matter at tiny Higgs mixing.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs (or extend an existing Higgs-portal singlet model file) including the secluded m_chi > m_phi regime, tracking the dark-sector temperature when lambda_1 is small enough that kinetic equilibrium with the SM fails.

members.model_name: Secluded Dirac WIMP with U(1) prime vector mediator
members.description: No numerical relic-density implementation of the Dirac WIMP with kinetically mixed U(1)-prime mediator exists for this card; the secluded freeze-out (including the near-resonance m_chi ~ m_V/2 exception and dark-sector thermal contact) is treated only with analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model with micrOMEGAs (dark-photon plus Dirac fermion model files exist as templates), scanning m_chi, m_V, e_prime, epsilon, and validating against the card's secluded-regime and resonance validation tests.

members.model_name: USSM-A neutralino dark matter with gauged axion
members.description: No public spectrum-generator or relic-code implementation of the USSM-A anomalous-U(1) model exists: the enlarged neutralino mass matrix with axino-gaugino-Higgsino mixing, the Stueckelberg-scale seesaw effect on the LSP mass, and the co-annihilation spectrum cannot currently be computed with released tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the USSM-A superpotential and anomalous-U(1) sector in SARAH, generate SPheno spectrum code and CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, and validate against the paper's benchmark behaviors (LSP lightening at large M_St, co-annihilation reduction of the relic density).

members.model_name: Next minimal Dirac dark matter model
members.description: No model implementation of the Z2-odd Dirac fermion plus real singlet scalar (two mixed Higgs eigenstates H_L, H_H) exists in a public relic/scattering code per the card, so the p-wave relic density, spin-independent cross section, and annihilation source terms cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic formulae.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (S psi-bar psi Yukawa, S H^dagger H and S^2 H^dagger H portal terms, no singlet VEV) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's CoGeNT/WMAP overlap examples with g = 1.0-1.5 and m_HL in the 10-50 GeV range.

members.model_name: Axion-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the axion-mediated Dirac-fermion Lagrangian (a chi gamma5 chi plus anomaly-induced aFF-dual electroweak operators) exists for a relic-density code, so the thermal relic abundance near the m_a ~ 2 m_chi resonance cannot be recomputed with a modern solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the effective Lagrangian in FeynRules with the dimension-5 anomaly operators, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and compute Omega_chi h^2 with proper treatment of the resonant mediator width, validating against the paper's WMAP-era benchmark points.

members.model_name: Broken U(1) Majorana dark matter with short-lived PGB scenario
members.description: The FeynRules implementation of the U(1)_DM chiral-fermion dark sector used for the micrOMEGAs 3.1 relic scan is not published (no repository URL, availability unknown), so the relic-density route cannot be run without rebuilding the model file.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian (complex scalar Phi, chiral fermion chi, Higgs portal) in FeynRules/CalcHEP format from the published operators and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1199 selection with a current micrOMEGAs release.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector self-interacting dark matter with light vector mediator
members.description: No public solver produces the equilibrium SIDM density profile with a baryonic potential (isothermal Jeans matching) for given sigma_T(v)/m_chi, which sets both the dwarf-core prediction and the inner-Galaxy profile normalizing the gamma-ray signal.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement an isothermal-Jeans SIDM halo solver with a baryonic disk/bulge potential, calibrated against published SIDM N-body simulations, taking (m_chi, m_phi, alpha_X) and an initial NFW halo as inputs.

members.model_name: Boosted two-component pseudoscalar-mediated dark matter
members.description: No pipeline computes the model-specific three-body cascade spectra (phi -> chi chi a with subsequent mediator decays) at PeV energies and propagates the resulting O(10 TeV) positrons and O(100 TeV) photons to compare against cosmic-ray and diffuse-gamma limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the phi decay final-state spectra with HDMSpectra (valid at PeV scales) given the mediator branching fractions, then propagate positrons and photons with GALPROP or DRAGON plus standard diffuse-absorption treatments, and compare against published cosmic-ray and diffuse gamma-ray limits.

members.model_name: Thermally produced dark pair plasma of vectorlike fermions
members.description: No Boltzmann solver handles a mixed dark sector with a subdominant charged fermion fraction tightly coupled to a massless dark photon bath plus a dominant collisionless CDM component, so the CMB high-l response and small-scale cutoff cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS idm_dr/ETHOS implementation to a two-component dark matter setup with fraction epsilon coupled to dark radiation via dark Compton/Coulomb scattering, and validate the T_kin > 640 eV decoupling condition against the paper's analytic estimate.

members.model_name: U(1)_X dark-sector singlet-scalar phi0 dark matter
members.description: The paper's micrOMEGAs 4 / CalcHEP 3.4 implementation of the U(1)_X dark sector (Z-prime, rho, phi0, vector-like fermions) is not publicly released, so the relic-density and cross-section scan cannot be reproduced or extended without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the full model Lagrangian in FeynRules and export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, validating against the paper's reported underabundance and sigma_SI ~ 1e-8 pb benchmarks, and release the model files publicly.

members.model_name: Vector dark matter with fermionic top-partner co-annihilation model
members.description: No public relic-density code implements the coupled Boltzmann system for vector dark matter coannihilating with a colored fermionic top partner, including QCD Sommerfeld enhancement and eta_T/psi_T color-singlet bound-state formation and dissociation, which the card requires for precision relic bands in the compressed regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the V-T-top simplified model in a public freeze-out framework (CalcHEP model files feeding micrOMEGAs, or a DRAKE-style coupled-Boltzmann solver) extended with radiative bound-state capture and thermal dissociation rates for a color-triplet fermion, validated against the 1703.02977 compressed Delta m relic band.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudoscalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: No public model implementation of the Dirac-fermion plus Higgs-mixed pseudoscalar mediator exists; the paper used MicrOMEGAs 4.3 privately and no repository is identified, blocking rerun of relic-density and annihilation-channel steps.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the renormalizable Lagrangian (g_d s chi-bar gamma5 chi plus s^2 H-dagger H with mixing angle theta) in FeynRules and export a CalcHEP/MicrOMEGAs model file, validating Omega h^2 = 0.11 contours against the paper's scan ranges.

members.model_name: Z2-odd scalar dark matter in the N=1 generalized one-loop neutrino-mass model
members.description: No public numerical implementation (FeynRules model file plus micrOMEGAs/MadDM) exists for the N=1 generalized one-loop neutrino-mass model, so the relic density is only available through the paper's d-wave analytic formula under the small-scalar-potential assumption; coannihilation with the charged/CP-odd doublet components and quartic-coupling contributions cannot be scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/UFO model file for the Z2-odd doublets plus vectorlike charged fermions and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) to compute Omega h^2 including coannihilation and scalar-potential channels, validating against the paper's 0.11-0.13 scan window at M_X = 60-80 GeV.

members.model_name: Gauged two-Higgs-doublet scalar D dark matter
members.description: No public G2HDM model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files with the full SU(2)_H x U(1)_X spectrum, W^(p,m) gauge bosons, and heavy fermions) is available for micrOMEGAs, so the relic density with coannihilation and the spin-independent cross section for the scalar D cannot be computed directly; only inert-doublet proxy limits exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full G2HDM Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and run micrOMEGAs for relic density (including coannihilation with Delta, H+, W^(p,m), f^H) and direct detection, validating against the inert-doublet limit where the extra states decouple.

members.model_name: Parafermionic dark matter
members.description: No public relic-abundance solver implements the parafermi-statistics Boltzmann equation (finite maximum occupation order p, modified equilibrium distribution and blocking factors in the collision term); standard codes hard-wire Maxwell-Boltzmann or Fermi-Dirac/Bose-Einstein statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone freeze-out ODE solver (or patch the micrOMEGAs collision-term module) that takes the parafermi order p as a parameter, uses the paper's equilibrium distribution and blocking factors in the thermally averaged collision term with <sigma v> = a + 6b/x, and validate by recovering the p=1 fermion limit and the paper's p>=2 abundance-enhancement benchmarks at 100, 500, and 1000 GeV.

members.model_name: E6 two-component dark matter formalism
members.description: No numerical implementation of the two-component (Weyl fermion + inert-doublet-like scalar) dark sector exists for relic-partition and inelastic direct-detection calculations; the phenomenology step is currently not done at all, and the eV-scale fermion regime requires non-standard (non-freeze-out) production treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Build FeynRules model files for the low-energy E6 dark sector, export to CalcHEP, and use micrOMEGAs in two-component mode for the scalar relic fraction and inelastic nuclear-recoil rates; add a freeze-in/thermalization module for the suppressed eV-scale fermion component.

members.model_name: Neutrino-philic twin two-Higgs-doublet cogenesis
members.description: No public thermal-history solver tracks the twin-sector temperature ratio Tprime/T and Delta N_eff through twin QCD confinement, lifted twin-neutrino decoupling, and MeV dark-photon energy depletion into SM electron-positron pairs.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a hidden-sector entropy-transfer solver (coupled dT'/dT Boltzmann equations with the kinetic-mixing-mediated e+e- depletion rate and the twin g_star'(T') table) and pass the resulting Delta N_eff to the standard CLASS/CAMB Planck N_eff constraint.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D complex vector dark matter with electromagnetic multipole moments
members.description: The relic abundance of the W_D vectors is asserted but never computed: no implementation of the SU(2)_D gauge/Higgs sector exists for a thermal freeze-out scan, leaving whether W_D can be all of the dark matter unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the renormalizable SU(2)_D model (W_D, Phi_D, new fermions) in FeynRules and compute the freeze-out relic density with micrOMEGAs over m_WD, g_D, and the fermion spectrum to identify the viable Omega_DM region.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector Dirac fermion self-interacting dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes freeze-in production of the Dirac fermion D with coupled visible- and hidden-sector temperature evolution; the multi-temperature relic and T_h/T history are only available through the source paper's private formalism.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or write a standalone coupled-Boltzmann code) to evolve separate visible and hidden temperatures with kinetic-mixing energy transfer, outputting the freeze-in yield and T_h/T(z) for the (m_D, m_C, g_X, epsilon) parameter space.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert scalar dark matter with Z2-odd vector-like quarks
members.description: No micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists for this specific scotogenic inert-doublet model with Z2-odd vector-like quarks and singlet Majorana fermions, so the coannihilation-sensitive relic abundance cannot be computed; the paper cites generic inert-doublet results rather than a model-specific scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO model file for the full Z2-odd sector (inert doublet, N_R_i, vector-like quarks) and run micrOMEGAs to compute Omega h^2 including H_I-A_I-H_I^+ coannihilations over the 70-120 GeV scan window.

members.model_name: U(1)_{A Y + B q} vector-portal dark fermion model
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model file or micrOMEGAs module) exists for the specific U(1)_{A Y + B q} charge assignment with Z-Z' mass mixing, so all four routes are planned rather than implemented and every constraint carries recasting_needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules model file for the U(1)_{A Y + B q} Lagrangian (Q = A Y + B q charges, Z-Z' mass mixing, dark fermion with Q_chi = +1) and export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, which then supplies Omega h^2, sigma_SI, and <sigma v> per channel in one pipeline; validate against the paper's ~77 MeV W-mass benchmark and the m_chi ~ M_Z'/2 relic contour.

members.model_name: SU(2)_L quintet fermion minimal dark matter with Higgs inflation
members.description: No public relic-density code computes electroweak-multiplet freeze-out with Sommerfeld enhancement and bound-state formation for the SU(2)_L quintet fermion; the adopted 13.6 TeV thermal mass is taken from a literature computation that cannot be independently rerun or varied.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the electroweak Sommerfeld/bound-state freeze-out formalism for arbitrary SU(2)_L multiplets as an extension module of micrOMEGAs or a standalone Boltzmann solver, validated against the published quintet thermal-mass result.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter with Higgs portal
members.description: No maintained public solver computes Sommerfeld factors and bound-state formation/decay rates for a Dirac fermion with mixed scalar plus pseudoscalar Yukawa couplings to a light scalar mediator, nor the resulting effective Boltzmann equation for freeze-out; the paper's calculation (ground-state BSF, alpha < 0.25) is bespoke and unreleased.
members.proposed_resolution: Package a Yukawa-potential Schroedinger solver for scattering and bound states with the BSF cross sections of the cited formalism (arXiv:1611.08133-style) and couple it to a non-self-conjugate relic Boltzmann integrator (e.g. extend micrOMEGAs or DRAKE with an effective sigma_eff(x) table including BSF and ionization equilibrium), validating against the paper's TeV benchmarks and the alpha < 0.25 validity cut.

members.model_name: Type-II seesaw asymmetric Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No implemented model file or Boltzmann setup exists for this model's asymmetric freeze-out: tracking the residual symmetric chi anti-chi fraction through the resonant h2-mediated annihilation (M_h2 near 2 M_chi) with the asymmetry fixed by the transfer operator.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the singlet Dirac fermion plus Higgs-mixed singlet scalar sector in micrOMEGAs (which supports asymmetric relic evolution) via FeynRules/CalcHEP, and solve the coupled asymmetric Boltzmann equations with the chemical-potential asymmetry as input, scanning the h2 resonance region.

members.model_name: Neutral SU(2)_N vector-boson dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files usable by micrOMEGAs or MadDM) exists for the SU(2)_N gauge extension, so the X_1 relic density and X_1-nucleon cross section can only be estimated with the paper's simplified analytic formulae under equal-mass assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(2)_N Lagrangian (X_1, X_2, Z', exotic h/N/E fermions, eta scalars, generalized R parity) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files, and compute relic density and sigma_SI with micrOMEGAs over the full mediator-mass parameter space.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative inverse-seesaw fermionic dark matter
members.description: The hidden U(1)_H radiative inverse-seesaw model implementation used with micrOMEGAs-5.2.4 (particle content, N1 hidden-gauge annihilation channels, and scan filters) is not publicly released, so the relic-density band for the N1 Majorana fermion cannot be independently recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model from the paper's Lagrangian in FeynRules or SARAH, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, validate by reproducing the published allowed band in the (m_N1, m_Z', g'') plane, and release the model files in the registry.

members.model_name: U(1)_X three-Higgs-doublet neutral fermion dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the three-Higgs U(1)_X model (relic density including the Z-prime resonance/width treatment plus sigma_SD) exists; computational_representation is null and the route lists a 'custom U(1)_X freeze-out/direct-detection scanner' as a required resource, so g_X(M_DM, M_Zprime) is only an approximate analytic relation.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the U(1)_X Lagrangian (Z-prime couplings to the neutral fermion and SM fermions, extended Higgs sector) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs to compute the resonance-region relic density and spin-dependent cross section, replacing the x_f = 20 analytic estimate.

members.model_name: Spin-3/2 effective dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the 14 dimension-six spin-3/2 four-fermion operators exists in any public relic/cross-section code (computational_representation is null); relic curves and SI/SD cross sections come only from the paper's one-operator-at-a-time analytic formulas, so multi-operator scans and precision relic calculations cannot be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO model for the spin-3/2 field with the 14 contact operators in FeynRules and run MadDM (which supports spin-3/2 via UFO) to compute relic density, annihilation spectra, and SI/SD nucleon cross sections for arbitrary operator combinations.

members.model_name: U(1)' extra doublet neutral fermion cold dark matter
members.description: No relic-density model implementation exists for the U(1)' extra-doublet neutral fermion, whose freeze-out involves Z'/Z-mediated annihilation, t-channel gauge-boson channels, and coannihilation with the radiatively split charged partner; the boltzmann_solver step names only a generic micrOMEGAs-style solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the reconstructed U(1)' doublet model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs with coannihilation between the neutral and charged doublet components across (m_DM, M_Z', gauge couplings).

members.model_name: Supersymmetric U(1)' hylogenesis antibaryon dark matter
members.description: No induced-nucleon-decay event generator or Super-Kamiokande detector-level recast exists to convert the baryon-transfer operator into meson spectra with nuclear effects and detector acceptances, which blocks the model's most distinctive observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an IND event generator producing kaon/pion momentum spectra for the hyperon and neutron portals including Fermi motion and nuclear absorption, and recast published Super-K nucleon-decay selections onto the shifted kinematic windows to obtain acceptance-corrected limits.

members.model_name: TeV-scale electroweak multiplet gauge-portal dark matter for Higgs stability
members.description: No public relic-density calculation covers multi-TeV electroweak multiplets (quintuplet/septuplet and fermionic analogues) with Sommerfeld enhancement, bound-state formation, and full coannihilation, which shift the thermal mass target at the tens-of-percent level.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY with Sommerfeld and bound-state factors parameterized by SU(2)_L representation dimension n and hypercharge Y, validated against the published 4.60/9.17 TeV scalar quintuplet/septuplet benchmarks.

members.model_name: Degenerate-particle Majorana dark matter with enhanced internal bremsstrahlung
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs (or equivalent) model implementation exists for the k nearly degenerate Majorana fermions plus charged scalar mediator eta, so the coannihilation relic-density calculation that fixes the allowed Yukawa coupling y_1 cannot be reproduced from released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian (k Majorana fermions chi_i, charged scalar eta, Yukawa couplings y_i to right-handed leptons) in FeynRules/CalcHEP and export a public micrOMEGAs model directory, validating against the paper's coannihilation-enhanced relic-density results as a function of k, Delta_i, and m_eta/m_chi1.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian WIMP multiplet dark matter with dark gluon radiation
members.description: No implementation of the electroweak WIMP multiplet with dark non-Abelian multiplicity factors exists in relic/collider tools, so multiplicity-modified annihilation, indirect-detection, and collider rates cannot be recast against existing searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the multiplet model (spectrum, degeneracy, dark-gluon final states) in micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute multiplicity-adjusted relic, annihilation, and production cross sections, then recast LHC monojet/electroweakino searches and CTA/Fermi indirect limits with the rescaled rates.

members.model_name: Kinetically mixed L_mu-L_tau Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The paper's micrOMEGAs implementation of the kinetically mixed U(1)_{L_mu-L_tau} Dirac-fermion model was not released, so the relic-density contours (including Z' resonance and Z'Z' pair regimes) cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model (Z' with L_mu-L_tau charges, kinetic mixing epsilon with hypercharge, Dirac chi with charge q_chi) in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12 curves in the resonance and Z'-pair regimes.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter in partially composite supersymmetry
members.description: No public spectrum-generator implementation of the partially composite SUSY boundary conditions (composite first/second-generation sfermions, elementary third generation, 5D-dual-derived soft terms), so the superpartner spectrum feeding all downstream cosmology cannot be regenerated across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the model's high-scale soft-term boundary conditions as a SARAH/SPheno or FlexibleSUSY model file (inputs Lambda_IR, F, compositeness fractions) and validate the output spectrum against the paper's benchmark points.

members.model_name: Neutral-current fermionic absorption dark matter
members.description: No public absorption-rate calculator exists for fermionic dark matter absorption via dimension-six neutral-current operators: target-specific nuclear response functions (beyond the coherent approximation) and electronic response/matrix elements for the mass-energy-deposit kinematics are not implemented in any standard direct-detection package, which are built for scattering rather than absorption.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing direct-detection rate framework (e.g. the nuclear-response formalism of WimPyDD/DirectDM for nuclei, and DarkELF/QEdark-style electronic response functions for electron targets) to the fermionic-absorption kinematics with energy deposit set by m_chi, covering xenon, argon, and semiconductor targets and validated against E_R ~ m_chi^2/(2M) and the published electron-target limit shapes.

members.model_name: Primordial dark matter halos from scalar fifth forces
members.description: No solver exists for radiation-era fifth-force collapse with screening: the M_PDMH(beta, m_psi, delta_in, z_in) and mass-radius predictions that feed every downstream observable rest on by-hand scaling-solution and virialization estimates, with screening dominating the uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a spherical-collapse code coupling the dark-fermion fluid to the light scalar with effective coupling beta and an explicit screening prescription during radiation domination, outputting z_form, M_PDMH, and R_PDMH over the beta = 3-30, m_psi > 0.1 MeV window; validate against the paper's fiducial 0.03-16 M_sun window, then check with N-body simulations including the scalar fifth force.

members.model_name: Low-mass weakly coupled B-L gauge boson Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public numerical implementation covers the B-L Dirac-fermion relic calculation across all regimes the paper uses: thermal freeze-out with the Z_BL thermalization condition, freeze-in from SM fermion annihilation, and sequential freeze-in via Z_BL Z_BL -> chi chi; only primary-paper equations exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_B-L model file (Z_BL, chi with charge Q, B-L scalar) in micrOMEGAs, using its freeze-out and freeze-in modules, and add the sequential freeze-in channel and dark-sector thermalization flag as a custom module; validate against the paper's case A/B/B1/B2 limiting formulae.

members.model_name: Asymmetric atomic dark matter with massive dark photon bound-state formation
members.description: The improved numerical bound-state-formation cross sections for capture with emission of a massive (non-Coulombic) dark photon, and the resulting dark-photon decay spectra, exist only as the authors' private calculation; no public code reproduces the Fermi-LAT dwarf limit surface in the dark-photon mass/emitted-energy plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a BSF cross-section calculator for Yukawa-bound dark atoms with massive-mediator radiative capture, couple it to Pythia-generated dark-photon decay spectra and the public Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihood, and validate against the paper's limit surface and bound-state-existence threshold.

members.model_name: Co-interacting conformal two-component dark matter
members.description: No relic-density code implements the dimension-8 derivative conformal operator (partial phi)^2 T/M^4 for a two-component thermal history combining heavy-fermion freeze-out with the ultra-light scalar's oscillation abundance; the enrichment could not reproduce the freeze-out calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the conformal derivative operator and run heavy-component freeze-out in micrOMEGAs (or MadDM), coupling it to an analytic misalignment module for Omega_phi, and validate against the paper's M = few-hundred-GeV-to-1.2-TeV benchmark region at Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12.

members.model_name: Mass-dimension-one fermion non-minimally coupled to electromagnetism
members.description: No public code implements the mass-dimension-one fermion field: standard pipelines (FeynRules -> CalcHEP/MadGraph -> micrOMEGAs/MadDM) assume Dirac/Majorana/scalar/vector fields and cannot handle the MDOF dual-helicity spinor propagator and spin sums, so no automated relic-abundance or collider event generation exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MDOF propagator and spin sums as a custom model in CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs (hand-coded matrix elements or modified helicity-amplitude routines), then use the standard micrOMEGAs freeze-out solver to compute Omega h^2 and freeze-out temperature over the (m, e, g) space, validating against the beta-function and transversality results of arXiv:2305.16848.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation Majorana neutrino dark matter with residual U(1)_F parity
members.description: No public model implementation of the U(1)_F fourth-generation Majorana neutrino model exists for CalcHEP or any relic-density code: the paper used CalcHEP 2.4 privately for annihilation cross sections into Z0 h0, W+W-, and fermion pairs, so the relic-fraction curves r_Omega(m_1, theta) and the scattering cross sections cannot be independently reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Lagrangian (gauge charges, singlet scalars, Y4^nu and Y4^m Yukawas, Z-prime) in FeynRules and export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files, then reproduce the paper's freeze-out relic fraction and sigma_SI/sigma_SD as validation before releasing the model files publicly.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic local U(1) singlet-fermion dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model files exist for the local U(1) neutrinophilic 2HDM with anomaly-canceling singlet fermions, so the source's relic-density and sigma_SI scan (m_DM 50-500 GeV) cannot be reproduced or extended beyond the quoted scan ranges.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the model Lagrangian (Zprime, scalar singlet, neutrinophilic doublet, singlet fermions) in FeynRules/LanHEP, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's 50-500 GeV relic-compatible region and below-XENON100 sigma_SI conclusion.

members.model_name: Leptophilic fermion WIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No public FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model files for this leptophilic fermion-DM scalar-mediator simplified model are identified in the card, so the scan pipeline cannot be rerun without reimplementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the scalar/pseudoscalar leptophilic Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, verify against the paper's relic-density and cross-section benchmarks, and publish the model files in a repository.

members.model_name: Leptophilic fermion WIMP with vector mediator
members.description: No public FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model files for this leptophilic fermion-DM vector-mediator simplified model are identified in the card, so the scan pipeline cannot be rerun without reimplementing the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the vector/axial-vector leptophilic Z prime Lagrangian in FeynRules, export to CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs, verify against the paper's relic-density and cross-section benchmarks, and publish the model files in a repository.

members.model_name: Late-forming PBH from thermal balls and Fermi balls
members.description: Existing PBH constraint codes evaluate f_PBH bounds assuming formation deep in the radiation era; no tool applies CMB accretion, microlensing, and dwarf-heating limits time-dependently for objects that are extended thermal/Fermi balls until a formation redshift z_form after recombination.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a PBHbounds-style constraint package with a formation-redshift argument: switch each constraint on only for z < z_form, add pre-collapse compact-object limits (e.g. microlensing on Fermi balls) and the BBN Delta N_eff < 0.40 dark-radiation bound, producing f_PBH(M_PBH, z_form) exclusion surfaces.

members.model_name: Two-component boosted light dark matter in a neutrinophilic 2HDM
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the neutrinophilic 2HDM with singlet scalar phi3 and vectorlike fermion chi1, so neither the constraint filter (oblique, invisible-width, LEP/LHC) nor the coupled two-component Boltzmann relic calculation with the chi1 chi1 -> phi3 phi3 conversion channel can be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP, solve the coupled freeze-out in micrOMEGAs' two-component mode (validating against the paper's coupled vs uncoupled benchmarks and the 35-60 GeV under-abundant window), and wrap HiggsTools plus oblique/invisible-width checks as the benchmark filter.

members.model_name: Split-Supersymmetry neutralino dark matter
members.description: Default micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY-style relic and annihilation calculations omit Sommerfeld enhancement and electroweak bound-state effects that are O(1) for multi-TeV Wino/Higgsino-dominated neutralinos, precisely the regime that sets the quoted ~2.2 TeV thermal upper mass and the present-day indirect-detection rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the relic-density step with the Sommerfeld-corrected electroweakino annihilation treatments already published for pure Wino/Higgsino limits (nonrelativistic EFT cross sections), interfacing them to the mixed-composition scan instead of the tree-level solver output.

members.model_name: Indirect fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP (or equivalent) model implementation exists for this specific Majorana fermion plus real singlet scalar Higgs-portal model, so the relic-density freeze-out through chi chi -> H1/H2 mediators cannot be computed numerically, including the Sommerfeld-enhanced regime the card flags from light-mediator exchange.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Lagrangian (Majorana chi, singlet phi, Higgs mixing) in FeynRules, export a CalcHEP model file, and run micrOMEGAs for relic density and thermal-contact rates; add the Sommerfeld correction from mediator exchange as a multiplicative factor on the annihilation cross section.

members.model_name: Resonant scalar fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: No public micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP model implementation exists per the card for the Majorana fermion plus mixed-singlet-scalar model, which is required because the narrow resonant escape region near m_chi = m_H1/2 or m_H2/2 demands finite-width thermally averaged annihilation rather than the analytic Breit-Wigner estimate alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and run micrOMEGAs, whose relic solver already handles resonance thermal averaging with full widths; validate by recovering the m_h/2 (about 63 GeV) resonance dip and the small-coupling relic solutions the paper describes.

members.model_name: Ekpyrotic-reheating inflaton-remnant dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann relic-density solver handles freeze-out of the surviving inflaton across the ekpyrotic reheating history, where the negative post-inflation potential gives an equation-of-state phase with w > 1 and a nonstandard expansion rate; the card's relic prediction rests only on the source's rough analytic approximations, and standard codes assume radiation domination at freeze-out.
members.proposed_resolution: Write (or extend micrOMEGAs' user-defined Hubble-rate interface into) a coupled inflaton-radiation-DM Boltzmann code that evolves the two-scalar potential V1(phi)+V2(chi) through the w > 1 ekpyrotic phase into radiation domination, with Yukawa annihilation into fermions, and validate against the source's Case II/III examples at m_phi around 1 TeV.

members.model_name: Natural SUSY higgsino-axion dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the mixed axion/higgsino relic composition: the coupled cosmology of thermally produced axinos, saxion and moduli decays, entropy production, and axion misalignment that sets Omega_chi/Omega_DM is treated by assumption, yet this fraction rescales every direct- and indirect-detection rate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement coupled Boltzmann equations for axino/saxion/moduli energy densities, their decays to neutralinos, neutralino reannihilation, and axion misalignment on top of a micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY spectrum interface, parameterized by PQ scale, axino/saxion masses, and reheating temperature.

members.model_name: Broken U(1) Majorana dark matter with long-lived PGB scenario
members.description: The FeynRules implementation of the U(1)_DM chiral-fermion dark sector used for the micrOMEGAs 3.1 relic scan is not published (no repository URL, availability unknown), so the relic-density route cannot be run without rebuilding the model file.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the Lagrangian (complex scalar Phi, chiral fermion chi, Higgs portal) in FeynRules/CalcHEP format from the published operators and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.1199 selection with a current micrOMEGAs release.

members.model_name: Two-component singlet scalar-fermion dark matter
members.description: The two-component LanHEP/micrOMEGAs implementation (Z2-odd singlet fermion plus singlet scalar with chi chi <-> S S conversion through mixed H1/H2 mediators) is not public, so the coupled Boltzmann relic calculation and cross sections cannot be reproduced without rebuilding the model files.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the model in LanHEP/CalcHEP and run it through the public two-component mode of micrOMEGAs 5.x (which solves coupled Boltzmann equations with conversion), validating against the paper's five benchmark points and Omega_DM h^2 = 0.1199.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_x asymmetric Y dark matter
members.description: No calculator exists in the route for the visible photon/e+e- spectra from Y anti-Y annihilation into kinetically mixed U(1)_x hidden vectors that subsequently cascade to SM states, which is prerequisite to any indirect-detection or CMB bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate hidden-vector cascade spectra by decaying X to SM final states via kinetic mixing in Pythia (or reuse published dark-photon cascade spectrum tables) and boost them into the Y rest frame as a function of m_Y, m_X, and epsilon.

members.model_name: Vector fermion-portal dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/UFO/CalcHEP files) of the hidden-U(1) vector dark matter with vector-like fermion portal exists, so relic density, annihilation cross sections, and collider rates cannot be computed with standard pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_dm Lagrangian (X_mu, vector-like tprime/bprime/tauprime, mixed scalar S) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs for relic/indirect rates and to MadGraph (UFO) for collider production.

members.model_name: Yukawa-coupled quintessence fermion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code implements this Yukawa-coupled quintessence-fermion model (field-dependent fermion mass m(phi)=M-beta*phi with exponential potential): the source's modified CAMB is private, so neither CMB nor matter-power spectra can be computed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled background and perturbation equations in CLASS or CAMB, following existing public coupled-quintessence/interacting-dark-energy patches, parameterized by (beta/M, alpha) and validated against the acoustic-peak and low-l responses reported in the paper.

members.model_name: Light dark photon force dark matter
members.description: No public cascade-spectrum generator produces boosted photon/positron spectra from sub-1.5 GeV dark-photon decays with data-driven hadronic branching fractions (rho/omega/pion resonances), which the Galactic Center fit and AMS-02 comparison both require; the card names only a generic 'cascade or event generator'.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a spectrum module that takes tabulated e+e- R-ratio-based A' branching fractions (as in the dark-photon literature), decays and boosts them to chi chi -> A'A' cascade spectra, and outputs prompt gamma, e+, and ICS-ready injection spectra; implement as an extension to existing indirect-detection spectrum tools (PPPC-style tables or a Pythia-based wrapper with hadronic corrections).

members.model_name: Inflaton dark matter from incomplete decay
members.description: No solver exists for the post-inflationary background evolution with an oscillation-amplitude-dependent inflaton decay width (decay allowed only at large field amplitude), including condensate evaporation and the thermalization of decay products; the relic remnant abundance is currently a rough semi-analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled inflaton-radiation Boltzmann/Friedmann system with a field-amplitude-dependent Gamma(phi) in a background reheating code, and cross-check the perturbative treatment against a nonperturbative lattice reheating simulation (e.g. CosmoLattice) for the Yukawa-coupled fermion channel.

members.model_name: Secretly asymmetric lepton-flavored dark matter with a dark Zprime annihilator
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann/abundance solver for the secretly asymmetric multi-flavor setup: tracking three chi flavor asymmetries through FDM decoupling, Zprime annihilation of the symmetric component, and late heavy-flavor decays that repopulate a symmetric lightest-flavor population.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' asymmetric dark matter mode (or write a dedicated coupled-Boltzmann module) to evolve per-flavor chi asymmetries with a decay term for the heavier flavors, parameterized by (m_chi, Delta m_ij, g_D, flavor lifetimes), outputting the late chi/anti-chi fraction that normalizes indirect-detection rates.

members.model_name: Secretly asymmetric lepton-flavored dark matter with a dark Zprime annihilator
members.description: No cascade photon/positron spectrum has been generated for the chi chi -> Zprime Zprime -> four-light-fermion final state with m_Zprime < m_chi, which is required before Fermi dwarf, CMB energy-injection, and positron limits can be recast onto this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute boosted secondary spectra by convolving PPPC4DMID (or Pythia-generated) Zprime rest-frame f fbar spectra with the mediator boost for the model's m_Zprime/m_chi ratios (e.g. via MadDM's indirect-detection cascade machinery), then feed them into the public Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood and Planck p_ann bound.

members.model_name: Majorana singlet neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No propagation-plus-likelihood capability exists for the predicted high-energy cosmic-neutrino attenuation: absorption of astrophysical neutrinos on the cosmic neutrino background into chi-phi pairs is not implemented in any public neutrino-transport code, and no IceCube diffuse-flux likelihood is wired to it (constraint likelihood_available: unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Add the neutrino-portal annihilation cross section on the CnuB as an absorption channel in a nuSQuIDS-style propagation solver with a parameterized source population, and compare the attenuated spectrum to the public IceCube HESE/diffuse-flux data via a simple flux likelihood.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: No propagation-plus-likelihood capability exists for the predicted high-energy cosmic-neutrino attenuation: absorption of astrophysical neutrinos on the cosmic neutrino background into phi-chi pairs is not implemented in any public neutrino-transport code, and no IceCube diffuse-flux likelihood is wired to it (constraint likelihood_available: unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Add the neutrino-portal annihilation cross section on the CnuB as an absorption channel in a nuSQuIDS-style propagation solver with a parameterized source population, and compare the attenuated spectrum to the public IceCube HESE/diffuse-flux data via a simple flux likelihood.

members.model_name: U(1)_D dark-sector Majorana WIMP model
members.description: No collider event-generation or recast pipeline exists for the TeV-scale dark-sector cascade signatures (charged dark scalar and heavy fermion production decaying to leptons, Higgs bosons, and chi_1 pairs); the card records cross sections only qualitatively and the collider recast as unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Export a UFO model from the FeynRules implementation, generate production of the charged dark scalars and heavy fermions in MadGraph5_aMC@NLO, and recast existing LHC multilepton-plus-missing-energy searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 for the v_2 = 200-300 GeV, M_eta20 = 100-250 GeV window.

members.model_name: Minimal vector-fermion multicomponent dark matter model
members.description: The coupled three-species Boltzmann solver treating annihilation, coannihilation, dark-sector conversion, semi-annihilation, and mass-ordering-dependent decays for X_mu, chi_plus, and chi_minus is a private C++ code with no public repository, so the total relic density for the 2CDM/3CDM regimes cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_X vector-fermion model in FeynRules/CalcHEP and use micrOMEGAs 5's multi-component mode (which supports conversion and semi-annihilation among N dark species) to solve the coupled abundance system, validating against the paper's published scan points.

members.model_name: Leptoquark-portal SU(2)L-singlet vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: The micrOMEGAs implementation of the S3 leptoquark plus Z2-odd vector-like fermion Lagrangian used by the authors is not publicly released (availability unknown, no repository), so the relic-density and cross-section calculation over (M_Psi_L, M_Psi_Q, M_S3, lambda, Delta) cannot currently be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the S3 + Psi_Q/Psi_L Lagrangian in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files into micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's published relic-density contours and coannihilation benchmarks (including the Delta -> 0 limit).

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_X dark-Z Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP/micrOMEGAs model files) exists for this hidden U(1)_X Dirac-fermion model with its extra Higgs doublet and Z-Z' mixing, so the relic-density and DM-nucleon cross-section chain cannot be reproduced without reimplementing the Lagrangian.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's Lagrangian (2HDM-like scalar potential without soft-breaking/lambda_5 terms, U(1)_X gauge boson, vector-like Dirac fermion) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's Planck relic band and quoted low-mass direct-detection windows.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) L_e+L_mu+L_tau axi-Higgs portal fermionic dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the anomalous U(1) L_e+L_mu+L_tau Lagrangian with Wess-Zumino terms, Stueckelberg axion, and axi-Higgs G1; the paper's micrOMEGAs 5.3.41 setup is private, so the Omega h^2 = 0.120 benchmark points cannot be reproduced or the scan extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EFT (pseudoscalar axi-Higgs couplings to electroweak gauge-field duals and to the dark fermion, plus the Z prime sector) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP/UFO model files for micrOMEGAs, and validate against the paper's benchmark tables at m_Zprime = 2.5 and 3.5 TeV.

members.model_name: Fermionic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: No public solver computes gravitational particle production for this fermionic X field: integrating the complex-frequency Dirac mode equations through chaotic inflation and the transition to the Friedmann stage (the regime where parametric resonance is absent for a fermion with negligible inflaton coupling), with smooth matching to avoid artificial particle creation at large m_X.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or release an existing group-internal) fermionic mode-function solver on a numerically computed chaotic-inflation scale-factor history with smooth junctions, validated by reproducing the paper's fermionic n_X versus m_X/m_phi results including the g_s=2 spin-state factor.

members.model_name: Elastic scalar-vector isospin-violating dark matter
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/CalcHEP model files or equivalent) exists for the Dirac DM plus kinetically mixed Z-prime plus Higgs-mixed singlet scalar Lagrangian, so relic-density contours in the m_Zprime-m_phi plane and elastic recoil cross sections with the tuned f_p/f_n cannot be regenerated or scanned beyond the paper's published benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules model for the two-mediator Lagrangian, export to micrOMEGAs to compute the thermal relic density (light-mediator annihilation channels chi chi -> Z'Z', Z'phi, and s-channel fermions) and the target-dependent SI cross section, validating against the paper's relic contours and the ~7.5 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic vector-like fermion doublet dark matter from triplet scalar leptogenesis
members.description: No public implementation exists of the coupled scalar-triplet leptogenesis Boltzmann network that maps CP asymmetries and branching fractions (epsilon_DM, epsilon_L, B_DM, B_L) into the fermion-doublet dark asymmetry and Omega_DM/Omega_B; the calculation lives only in the source paper's private equations.
