members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's triplet-decay Boltzmann equations (decay, inverse decay, and washout terms with dark and lepton branching fractions) as a small public ODE module, e.g. built on the ULYSSES leptogenesis framework extended with a dark-sector branching channel, validated against the paper's Omega_DM/Omega_B ~ 5 benchmark.

members.model_name: Quantum fermionic warm dark matter Thomas-Fermi galaxy model
members.description: The paper's numerical solver for the self-gravitating Thomas-Fermi equations (one-parameter mu(0) family of cored fermionic-WDM halo profiles for a given f(E)) has no identified public release, so the cored-profile predictions and the Willman-I-type m > 1.91 keV bound cannot be recomputed or extended to other dwarfs.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the spherical Thomas-Fermi ODE system for degenerate/semi-degenerate fermions with selectable f(E) (Fermi-Dirac and out-of-equilibrium forms) as a small open-source solver, validated against the paper's quoted core sizes and the m ~ 2 keV compact-dwarf solutions.

members.model_name: E6-inspired exotic-state hot dark matter asymmetry scenario
members.description: No numerical SE6SSM spectrum implementation exists to compute the neutral exotic singlet-fermion masses from the superpotential couplings f_i, ftilde_i and VEVs, so the sub-eV mass condition is only asserted analytically.
members.proposed_resolution: Write an SE6SSM model file in SARAH (generating SPheno/FlexibleSUSY code) including the exotic S_i, H_alpha, D_i and N_i^c supermultiplets, and validate the exotic-fermion mass matrix against the paper's analytic limits.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal fermionic dark matter with a light scalar mediator in neutron-star matter
members.description: No public code implements the dark-matter-admixed neutron-star EoS of this model (effective chiral mean-field hadronic sector plus degenerate dark Fermi gas coupled through the Higgs-mixed light scalar) end-to-end with a TOV and tidal Love-number solver, so mass-radius and Lambda_1.4 predictions cannot be reproduced outside the original group.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's mean-field chiral EoS with the g_phiNN-coupled dark Fermi-gas contribution as a CompOSE-style tabulated EoS module and couple it to an open TOV/Love-number integrator (e.g. the LALSuite or NSTOV-type solvers), validated against the paper's k_F^DM=0.01-0.06 GeV benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Spontaneous-CP scotogenic inert-scalar dark matter model
members.description: No numerical implementation of the full spontaneous-CP scotogenic model (inert doublet plus singlets, right-handed neutrinos, and vector-like fermions under Z4 x Z4-prime) exists in a relic-density/direct-detection calculator; existing inert-doublet implementations do not include the extra CP-sector fields that could shift the mapping.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model Lagrangian in FeynRules/SARAH and export to micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) to compute Omega h^2 and sigma_SI over the M_eta, lambda3, lambda4, lambda_L, Delta M_eta parameter space, validating against published inert-doublet scans in the pure-IDM limit.

members.model_name: Near-threshold feeton B-L gauge boson dark matter
members.description: No code exists (none is cited in the card) that computes the Galactic 511-keV line flux from feeton decay: the near-threshold e+e- branching ratio, nonrelativistic positron injection, positronium formation fraction in ionized gas, and the resulting line morphology have no public implementation for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the analytic feeton decay widths (Gamma(e+e-) with threshold phase-space suppression and Gamma(nu nu-bar)) and couple the positron injection rate to an NFW-profile line-of-sight integral with a positronium-fraction treatment, then compare to INTEGRAL/SPI 511-keV flux and morphology measurements.

members.model_name: U(1)_X millicharged dark fermion freeze-in model
members.description: No public implementation exists for the paper's coupled visible/hidden-sector Boltzmann system (dark fermion and dark photon number densities plus hidden-sector temperature ratio eta) that sets the millicharged freeze-in relic abundance, including plasmon-decay production and dark freeze-out; the eight-benchmark calculation is private and the card has no computational representation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled number-density and hidden-temperature evolution for (m_chi, M_Zp, g_X, epsilon, delta, eta) including plasmon decay and hidden-sector reactions, either as a standalone solver or by extending micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery, validated against the paper's eight benchmarks.

members.model_name: Vectorlike-portal scalar FIMP dark matter
members.description: The paper's freeze-in production rates use closed-time-path finite-temperature field theory with one-loop resummed fermion propagators, evaluated by private VEGAS-based numerical integration; public freeze-in machinery (e.g. micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module) implements only vacuum/Boltzmann or HTL-approximated rates, so the thermally corrected relic density cannot be reproduced with existing tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module (or release a standalone rate library) with the CTP one-loop resummed decay and 2-to-2 production rates for the F f s vertex, parameterized by (m_s, m_F, Delta, lambda, G) in the electroweak-unbroken phase, validated against the paper's Boltzmann-versus-resummed comparisons.

members.model_name: Z2-odd singlet fermion N dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: No numerical implementation exists for the fermion-N relic branch: the loop-suppressed N annihilation through S, the Higgs portal, and heavy N_i, including S-N co-annihilation in the near-degenerate region the analytic formula neglects, is not encoded in any relic-density code (computational_representation is null, no associated code).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z2-odd N + S + N_i Lagrangian in FeynRules and run micrOMEGAs (which handles co-annihilation automatically) to compute Omega_N h^2 across (m_N, m_S, lambda_i, lambda_HS), validating against the paper's loop formula in the hierarchical limit and flagging non-perturbative coupling regions.

members.model_name: Extended DM EFT with fermionic singlet DM
members.description: No numerical model implementation exists for the extended DM EFT with fermionic chi, explicit (pseudo)scalar mediator S, and D=5 operators: computational_representation is null and no code was identified, so relic density and direct-detection rates (including the momentum-suppressed pseudoscalar nuclear response) cannot be scanned beyond the paper's analytic benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Lagrangian with y_S and the D=5 operators (S QLHqR/Lambda, S BB/Lambda, S GG/Lambda, S^2 chi chi/Lambda, |H|^2 chi chi/Lambda) in FeynRules, export a UFO/CalcHEP model, and run micrOMEGAs or MadDM for Omega h^2 and nuclear-recoil rates, validating against the paper's benchmark correlation plots.

members.model_name: Inelastic third-generation B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the inelastic (B-L)_3 scalar model exists: the S/P coannihilation relic density with the off-diagonal Z-prime coupling to third-generation fermions, Higgs-portal cross sections, and present-day annihilation are computed privately in the paper, with no FeynRules/CalcHEP files or micrOMEGAs port released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-singlet U(1) (B-L)_3 scalar sector (S, P, Z' with third-generation charges, h/H mixing) in FeynRules and export to micrOMEGAs, which treats coannihilation automatically; validate against the paper's relic curves at the benchmark splitting m_P - m_S = 0.01 m_S.

members.model_name: Light two-Higgs-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists for the light-2HDM plus real scalar S plus Z2-odd fermion dark matter Lagrangian in any public relic-density framework, so the resonant (m_H ~ 2 m_DM) and forbidden (m_H < m_DM) freeze-out branches cannot be scanned with proper thermal averaging near the resonance.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the alignment-limit 2HDM with the mixed S-H light scalar and Y_chi, Y_l couplings, and run micrOMEGAs (or MadDM) relic scans over the resonant and forbidden branches, including the neglected H-prime state as a cross-check.

members.model_name: Type-X 2HDM secluded Dirac-fermion dark sector
members.description: No public implementation of the secluded-sector coupled Boltzmann system (dark-sector temperature T_D plus DM and mediator number densities) for this Type-X portal EFT, including the fast-expanding cosmology option (n=1, T_r); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the four-Fermi portal and dark-sector conversion operators as a micrOMEGAs model with its two-temperature dark-sector evolution, adding a user-defined H(T) for the fast-expanding branch, and validate against the paper's n=0 and n=1 benchmark plots.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Majorana dark matter
members.description: No implemented numerical relic-density calculation for the Majorana anomaly-canceling fermion: annihilation channels are listed as unknown and only a compact v_B < multi-TeV bound is quoted, with no model file in any freeze-out code.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file for the local U(1)_B x U(1)_L Lagrangian (Z_B, Z_L, S_B, S_L, anomaly-canceling fermions) and run micrOMEGAs or MadDM to compute Omega_DM h^2 across (M_DM, v_B, g_B), replacing the quoted scale bound with an explicit freeze-out scan.

members.model_name: Heavy-Z' effective Dirac-fermion NETDM
members.description: No implemented Boltzmann solve exists for UV freeze-in of Dirac fermion dark matter through the (f gamma_mu f)(chi gamma^mu chi)/Lambda^2 contact operator with explicit reheating-temperature dependence; the route currently relies on the source paper's analytic scaling only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the four-fermion vector operator in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file and run it through the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module with reheating temperature T_RH as an input, or code the single-species yield ODE dY/dx with the analytic collision term directly, validating against the paper's Lambda/T_RH ~ 10^3-10^5 band.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic dark QED with dark muonium
members.description: No public event-generator implementation exists for the dark-QED darkonium benchmark: there is no UFO/FeynRules model with the off-diagonal e_D-mu_D dark-photon current and Higgs portal, and no calculator for dark muonium formation and cascade branching fractions in Higgs decays.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO model of the two-fermion U(1)_D sector with Higgs portal, compute darkonium formation and cascade branching fractions with standard positronium-like NRQED formulae, and implement the decay chain in Pythia's hidden-valley machinery so MadGraph+Pythia can generate Higgs -> Mu_D + A_prime events.

members.model_name: keV U(1)_X dark photon dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public solver is identified for the coupled two-species hidden-sector Boltzmann system (dark photon plus millicharged fermion with hidden-sector temperature evolution) needed to compute the dark-photon freeze-in relic fraction f_Zp and its lifetime; the paper's benchmark calculation is not released and the card has no computational representation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled number-density and hidden-temperature Boltzmann equations for (M_Zp, m_chi, g_X, epsilon, delta) in a freeze-in framework such as micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module or a standalone code, validated against the paper's benchmarks including the f_Zp <= 0.05 ceiling.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 1046838: pure higgsino
members.description: The collider-evaluation chain for this benchmark is not publicly reusable: the paper-era ATLAS 7/8 TeV search selections were implemented in private author code on top of PYTHIA/PGS, and the modified SUSY-HIT decay setup is likewise not released, so the collider observable for the 1 TeV higgsino with 1.7 TeV sfermions cannot be re-run from the card's resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the benchmark point from its published SLHA spectrum with public SOFTSUSY plus SUSY-HIT and evaluate it in a public recasting framework (CheckMATE, MadAnalysis 5, or SModelS) that implements both the paper-era and current LHC electroweakino searches.

members.model_name: One-component non-thermal flavon portal dark matter
members.description: No public solver computes the out-of-equilibrium flavon yield combining UV freeze-in from the SM bath with thermal-correction-driven flavon field oscillations, followed by decay into FN-charged dark fermions; the paper's yield formulas exist only as private calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flavon-SM freeze-in collision terms and the coherent-oscillation yield in a coupled Boltzmann code, either by extending the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module with the FN-suppressed operators or as a standalone yield solver parameterized by (T_R, m_phi, Lambda, Q_FN^DM), validated against the paper's relic contours.

members.model_name: Stable light fermion Higgs-portal dark matter in the five-dimensional weak-scale framework
members.description: No numerical relic-abundance calculation exists for the stable N1 fermion under a low reheating temperature: the freeze-in tail from the SM bath and the near-equilibrium boundary are handled by rough analytic estimates rather than a Boltzmann solver with a truncated/reheating-modified thermal history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Higgs-portal Yukawa model in micrOMEGAs' freeze-in machinery extended with a low-T_reh reheating history (or a standalone Boltzmann code tracking the inflaton-dominated era), and map the (m_N1, Y, T_reh) region that avoids overclosure.

members.model_name: Spin-1/2 relativistic-decay dark matter EFT
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the model's injection history: a heavy fermionic companion decaying via the dimension-five dipole operator to a massive spin-1/2 daughter that is relativistic at injection (redshifting from radiation-like to matter-like) together with the accompanying photon energy injection, so Delta N_eff, the H0 shift, and the free-streaming transfer function cannot be computed precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS's dcdm/dr module to a two-body decay with a massive daughter evolved as an NCDM species with the delta-function decay phase-space distribution (following existing DM-to-DM+DR modified-CLASS implementations), and couple the photon branch to ExoCLASS/DarkAges-style energy-injection treatment for BBN and CMB consistency.

members.model_name: Starobinsky inflaton-decay hidden Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The order-10^7 GeV abundance target rests on analytic order-of-magnitude estimates of scalaron branching during Starobinsky reheating; no numerical reheating solver computes the fermion yield including the xi_h-dependent visible branching and the full scalaron decay history, so the viable mass band cannot be delineated precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Starobinsky-reheating Boltzmann solver evolving the scalaron, radiation, and hidden-fermion number densities with the paper's partial widths (a small extension of existing inflaton-reheating dark-matter production codes), outputting Omega_X h^2 over the (m_X, xi_h) plane with a simple Planck-abundance likelihood on top.

members.model_name: Model A multicomponent radiative-seesaw dark matter
members.description: No calculation pipeline exists for the monochromatic neutrino line from multicomponent semi-annihilation: the neutrino spectrum, halo annihilation rate, and solar capture of the multiple components are not implemented in any public capture/flux code.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the semi-annihilation neutrino-line energy and rate from the lambda_7 and Yukawa couplings, then extend a solar-capture/propagation chain (e.g. Capt'n General plus WimpSim/nusigma or DarkSUSY's neutrino routines) to multicomponent capture and semi-annihilation final states, comparing to IceCube/Super-K line searches.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal Dirac fermion thermal freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No relic-density solver implementation exists for the Z_2-stabilized Dirac fermion coupled to a neutrinophilic scalar mediator: computational_representation is null, no associated code is identified, and con_freezeout_relic_target has likelihood_available: no with recasting needed, so step s2 cannot go beyond the paper's analytic heavy-mediator freeze-out formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Dirac-fermion-plus-neutrinophilic-scalar Lagrangian in FeynRules/CalcHEP and compute the relic density with micrOMEGAs or MadDM, validating against the paper's Planck relic target curve and then extending beyond the m_phi > m_DM and single-flavor-coupling assumptions.

members.model_name: Bottom-loop composite pNGB dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the bottom-loop composite pNGB EFT (derivative Higgs portal plus suppressed non-derivative portal and bottom contact interaction) exists in a standard toolchain, so relic density, direct-detection, and indirect-detection predictions cannot be generated reproducibly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the EFT operators (derivative |H|^2-pNGB coupling c_d, bottom-induced lambda phi^2|H|^2, bottom contact term) in FeynRules, export CalcHEP model files to micrOMEGAs for relic density, sigma_SI, BR(h->invisible), and annihilation spectra, then chain to public DDCalc and Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihoods.

members.model_name: Minimal scoto-seesaw WIMP dark matter completion
members.description: No public model implementation of the minimal scoto-seesaw (type-I seesaw plus Z2-odd fermion f and inert doublet eta) exists for relic-density and direct-detection codes, so the WIMP-nucleon cross section and thermal abundance cannot be computed for either the scalar or fermion lightest-odd-state branch.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/SARAH model file for the scoto-seesaw Lagrangian (Y_f L eta* f, M_f, lambda_3-lambda_5 potential terms), export to micrOMEGAs for freeze-out relic density and to DDCalc for the XENON1T-style spin-independent recoil likelihood, covering both scalar (eta_R/eta_I) and fermion (f-nu_R mixed) dark-matter branches.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: X-ray line and DEBRA diffuse-background decay limits are available only as published exclusion curves for the standard-cosmology relic density; no packaged likelihood exists that rescales the bounds by the model's cosmology-dependent sterile density Omega_s/Omega_DM across targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published X-ray (galaxy, cluster, blank-sky) and DEBRA limits into a single interpolable likelihood in (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) with an explicit linear rescaling by the produced density fraction, documenting target column-density assumptions so bounds update consistently as production changes.

members.model_name: Electrically charged massive particle dark matter
members.description: Terrestrial, heavy-isotope, cosmic-ray, and millicharged-particle bounds on charged relics are only summarized from prior literature; no reusable likelihood or recast exists, and the cosmic-ray bounds rest on Galactic-inflow and magnetic-expulsion assumptions that are not modeled.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive a recast module mapping (m_Ch, q_Ch, local CHAMP flux) to heavy-isotope search and cosmic-ray detector exclusion curves, explicitly parameterizing the Galactic magnetic-expulsion suppression of the local charged-relic density, and publish it as tabulated exclusion likelihoods.

members.model_name: WIMPflation stable inflaton dark matter
members.description: No assembled joint likelihood connects the shared parameter space to both Planck slow-roll observables and xenon direct-detection limits; each constraint is only quoted as literature exclusion statements (likelihood_available: no on all three constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Higgs-portal scalar in DDCalc/micrOMEGAs for sigma_SI limits and combine with the Planck n_s-r contours in a single scan over (potential parameters, m_phi, lambda_phiH), reproducing the quoted m_phi > 900 GeV bound as a validation test.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L inverse-seesaw Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No joint likelihood exists combining the Planck relic-density target, XENON1T/PandaX-II direct detection, LEP/LHC dilepton bounds, and the (g-2)_mu preference; the card explicitly notes the constraints are scan-plot overlays with the 2018 collider curves possibly superseded.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a combined likelihood using DDCalc for XENON1T/PandaX (updatable to current xenon exposures), a ZPEED-style LHC dilepton likelihood evaluated with B-L charges, the LEP contact-interaction bound, a Planck relic-density Gaussian, and the (g-2)_mu band, packaged for global scans.

members.model_name: Visible sterile-neutrino dark matter in low-reheating pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: The cosmological bounds are applied only as figure-level regions: no machine-readable likelihood exists for the BBN N_eff < 3.4 constraint evaluated with the LRT nonthermal sterile distribution, nor for X-ray/decay-photon limits rescaled to the suppressed LRT relic abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the X-ray/decay bound curves, implement the abundance rescaling Omega_s(m_s, theta, T_RH)/Omega_DM against them, and compute N_eff at BBN from the LRT f_s(p) coupled to a BBN code (e.g. PRIMAT or AlterBBN), packaging both as importable likelihood modules.

members.model_name: Pseudo-scalar mediator dark matter with hidden neutrinos
members.description: No assembled CMB+LSS likelihood pipeline exists for constraining this model's enhanced dark-acoustic-oscillation features; existing interacting-DM DAO limits are not a one-to-one likelihood for the pseudoscalar hidden-neutrino benchmark and the card marks recasting as needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Once a Boltzmann implementation exists (gap_1), wire it into a Cobaya/MontePython pipeline with Planck TT,TE,EE+lensing and BAO/LSS likelihoods, adding the model's DAO-scale and interacting-fraction parameters, and recast the existing interacting-DM DAO constraints onto this parameterization.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=0 and singlet scalar
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the relic-density constraint or for the H_1 diphoton/di-Higgs collider comparison; the paper's exclusions are benchmark-plot comparisons that must be re-derived point by point.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the model-implementation output in a Planck relic-density Gaussian likelihood and run the loop-induced H_1 couplings through HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals (or equivalent diphoton/di-Higgs recast) to obtain a reusable joint constraint surface over (M_DM, M_H1, lambda, M_W_R).

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=4 and singlet scalar
members.description: The Z_R-mediated direct-detection constraint (LUX contour, most significant for this maximal B-L case) exists only as an approximate figure-level bound, and no reusable likelihood exists for the relic density or the H_1 diphoton/di-Higgs collider comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the Z_R-exchange nucleon cross section for B-L=4 in the model implementation and evaluate it with a modern direct-detection likelihood (e.g. DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT superseding LUX), add a Planck relic-density Gaussian likelihood, and recast the loop-induced H_1 couplings through HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals to produce a joint (M_DM, M_Z_R, M_W_R, lambda) constraint surface.

members.model_name: MSSM bino-slepton coannihilation dark matter
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood exists for the constraints this card depends on (Xenon-1T spin-independent scattering, the muon g-2 window, and LHC compressed slepton/electroweakino searches); all three are marked likelihood_available: approximate with recasting_needed, so the relic strip cannot be statistically scanned end to end.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a reproducible pipeline coupling a spectrum generator to micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 and sigma_SI, GM2Calc for Delta a_mu, DDCalc for the Xenon-1T likelihood, and SModelS/CheckMATE recasts of the ATLAS/CMS compressed slepton searches, packaged as a joint likelihood over (M1, m_slepton, mu, tan_beta).

members.model_name: MSSM bino-wino coannihilation dark matter
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood exists for the card's constraints (Xenon-1T scattering, muon g-2 window, and CMS/ATLAS compressed electroweakino searches whose quoted 195 GeV limit holds only for Delta m = 20 GeV under specific off-shell decay assumptions); all are marked likelihood_available: approximate with recasting needed, so the compressed bino-wino strip cannot be scanned statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint-likelihood pipeline over (M1, M2, Delta m, mu, tan_beta): spectrum generator plus micrOMEGAs for Omega h^2 and sigma_SI, GM2Calc for Delta a_mu, DDCalc for Xenon-1T, and a CheckMATE/SModelS recast of the compressed-spectrum soft-lepton electroweakino searches that generalizes the CMS limit away from the Delta m = 20 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: GmSUGRA DFSZ axino LSP with long-lived bino NLSP
members.description: The BBN constraint on late bino-to-axino decays is only qualitative in the card: no pipeline maps the neutralino freeze-out abundance, lifetime, and electromagnetic/hadronic decay products onto light-element-yield limits, and the numerical BBN bounds were never recast for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the electromagnetic (and any hadronic) injection spectrum from chi10 -> axino + gamma and feed (Omega_chi h^2, tau_chi, injected energy) into a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN to derive light-element constraints across the f_a/N-lifetime plane.

members.model_name: Majorana FIMP dark matter with charged scalar parent during reheating
members.description: LLP exclusions for the SM-charged scalar parent decaying to chi plus a right-handed lepton are not packaged: published heavy-stable-charged-particle and displaced-vertex searches must be recast with model-specific production cross sections and detector acceptances not encoded in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the charged scalar parent in an existing LLP recast framework (e.g. the LLP Recasting Repository or SModelS displaced/HSCP results) for the muonphilic benchmark, producing exclusion contours in the (m_P, c tau_P) plane that can be overlaid on the relic-density-required decay lengths per reheating history.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter in early matter domination
members.description: No usable likelihood or maintained recast pipeline exists for the direct-detection constraint: the card lists likelihood_available as partial with recasting_needed yes, and the quoted LUX/PandaX-II/XENON1T limits predate current LZ/XENONnT sensitivity.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the sigma_SI(lambda_L, M_DM) prediction from micrOMEGAs in a limit-comparison pipeline using current LZ/XENONnT published exclusion curves (e.g. via DDCalc or the experiments' released limit tables), including relic-fraction rescaling for subcomponent benchmarks.

members.model_name: DBI Galileon reheating thermal gravitino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the joint relic-density, tensor-to-scalar, and BBN/reheating consistency check: con_relic_reheating_planck is only approximate and con_bbn_reheating_gravitino requires recasting unstable-gravitino BBN limits onto this stable light-gravitino benchmark with its specific superpartner spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast module that evaluates (m_3/2, T_R, r_*, M_i) against the Planck relic-density value, the Planck/BICEP tensor likelihood, and re-derived reheating-temperature bounds for a stable gravitino with the benchmark spectrum, replacing the blind application of unstable-gravitino BBN limits.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric SU(2)_R quintuplet dark matter with B-L=2 and singlet scalar
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the relic-density bands, the LUX Z_R-exchange direct-detection contour (only approximate and charge-assignment dependent on the card), or the H_1 diphoton/di-Higgs collider comparison; exclusions are benchmark-plot level.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the Z_R-mediated nucleon cross section for the B-L=2 assignment in the model implementation, run it through a modern direct-detection likelihood (e.g. DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT in place of LUX), add a Planck relic-density Gaussian likelihood, and recast H_1 loop-induced couplings with HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals to obtain a joint constraint surface.

members.model_name: Radiative Dirac seesaw singlet-doublet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood machinery is attached to any of the three observables: the direct-detection likelihood is unavailable, the Planck/forecast N_eff likelihood was not rerun, and no modern electroweak global fit was performed, so the viable region is defined only by digitized curve overlays and the source-era CDF-II target.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the micrOMEGAs output into DDCalc for xenon-experiment spin-independent likelihoods, evaluate Delta N_eff against the Planck 2018+BAO likelihood (and SPT-3G/CMB-S4 forecast Fisher likelihoods) in cobaya/MontePython, and rerun the S,T fit with a current post-CDF electroweak dataset in HEPfit for a joint statistical scan.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric radiative-neutrino two-component dark matter
members.description: No two-component direct-detection recast pipeline exists that rescales the neutralino-nucleon rate by its relic fraction Omega_chi/Omega_DM and applies modern xenon-era likelihoods; only CDMSII/XENON100-era comparisons are in the source.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap DDCalc (or the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module) with a fraction-rescaled local density xi = Omega_chi/Omega_DM and apply current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods to the benchmark neutralino cross sections.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter in a fast-expanding universe
members.description: No usable likelihood or maintained recast pipeline exists for the direct-detection constraint: the card lists likelihood_available as partial with recasting_needed yes, and the quoted LUX/PandaX-II/XENON1T limits predate current LZ/XENONnT sensitivity.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the sigma_SI(lambda_L, M_DM) prediction from micrOMEGAs in a limit-comparison pipeline using current LZ/XENONnT published exclusion curves (e.g. via DDCalc or the experiments' released limit tables), including relic-fraction rescaling for subcomponent benchmarks.

members.model_name: Minimal PQ-NMSSM light singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: All constraints on the card are 2012-era statements without likelihoods: XENON100 SI limits, LHC Higgs-era invisible-width bounds, and an approximate overclosure screening; no modern combined likelihood exists for the light-singlino region.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a modern likelihood from the ATLAS/CMS Run-2 Higgs invisible-branching combination (via Lilith/HiggsTools), DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT SI likelihoods including the sub-m_h/2 mass range, and the Planck 2018 relic-density interval.

members.model_name: nonthermal pure higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: No modern direct-detection recast exists for this model point set: the card carries only the primary-paper sigma_SI estimate for the pure neutral higgsino, with no loop-level cross-section implementation and no current-experiment likelihood (likelihood_available is unknown, recasting_needed is yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the loop-level pure-higgsino spin-independent cross section (electroweak two-loop results available in the literature) in micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY, then confront it with the public LZ/XENONnT likelihoods to replace the dated primary-paper comparison.

members.model_name: nonthermal pure higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: The central viability constraint (BBN plus leptogenesis plus relic-density consistency for heavy gravitino decay) has no packaged likelihood: the paper-level allowed regions in (m_G, T_RH, m_higgsino, m_tilde_1) were derived with hadronic/electromagnetic injection limits that are not available as a reusable public evaluation.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the gravitino-decay energy-injection constraint using a public BBN injection code (e.g. extend ACROPOLIS to the relevant heavy-gravitino hadronic branching ratios or tabulate the Kawasaki-Moroi-type bounds) and package it with the analytic abundance formulas as a joint scan likelihood over (m_G, T_RH, m_LSP).

members.model_name: nonthermal pure wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No modern direct-detection recast exists for this model point set: the card carries only the primary-paper sigma_SI estimate for the pure neutral wino, whose scattering is loop-dominated, with no loop-level cross-section implementation and no current-experiment likelihood (likelihood_available is unknown, recasting_needed is yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the loop-level pure-wino spin-independent cross section (electroweak two-loop results available in the literature) in micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY, then confront it with the public LZ/XENONnT likelihoods to replace the dated primary-paper comparison.

members.model_name: nonthermal pure wino LSP dark matter
members.description: The central viability constraint (BBN plus leptogenesis plus relic-density consistency for heavy gravitino decay) has no packaged likelihood: the paper-level allowed regions in (m_G, T_RH, m_wino, m_tilde_1) were derived with hadronic/electromagnetic injection limits that are not available as a reusable public evaluation.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the gravitino-decay energy-injection constraint using a public BBN injection code (e.g. extend ACROPOLIS to the relevant heavy-gravitino hadronic branching ratios or tabulate the Kawasaki-Moroi-type bounds) and package it with the analytic abundance formulas as a joint scan likelihood over (m_G, T_RH, m_LSP).

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a neutrinophilic vector mediator
members.description: Constraints and projections on the neutrinophilic vector (Higgs/Z/W invisible-width bounds, BBN/SN1987A limits, and DUNE-like mono-neutrino projections) are not packaged as recastable likelihoods in the (m_V, lambda) plane for overlaying relic-density target curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the invisible-width, BBN/SN1987A, and DUNE mono-neutrino exclusion/projection curves into a (m_V, lambda) constraint module the route can query, following the primary paper's overlay figures.

members.model_name: Low-scale inverse-seesaw keV sterile-neutrino freeze-in model
members.description: No ready-to-use X-ray line likelihood recast exists for this model: NuSTAR Galactic-bulge and XMM-Newton blank-sky limits are published as exclusion curves in the sin^2(2theta) convention, but the pipeline mapping the inverse-seesaw |U_4| and the freeze-in relic fraction onto those curves has not been implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a recast layer that converts |U_4| to sin^2(2theta), rescales the line flux by the model's sterile-neutrino fraction of dark matter, and interpolates the published NuSTAR (1908.09037) and XMM-Newton (2102.02207) limit curves as an approximate likelihood.

members.model_name: NMSSM light neutralino LSP dark matter with a 95 GeV Higgs
members.description: No standalone combined likelihood is exported for the scenario: relic density, LZ SI/SD limits, and 95 GeV Higgs signal strengths are applied as scan-level pass/fail cuts inside NMSSMTools/micrOMEGAs/SModelS, so the benchmarks cannot be re-weighted, combined with new data, or used in global fits without redoing the scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the NMSSMTools+micrOMEGAs chain in a public global-fit framework (e.g., GAMBIT or an EasyScan-style pipeline) with proper LZ, HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds, and Planck likelihood terms, and release the scan configuration and chains.

members.model_name: Z3 symmetric complex singlet scalar extension of type-II seesaw
members.description: Direct-detection and LHC constraints are applied only as published limit-curve comparisons after abundance rescaling (likelihood_available no/partial); no statistical likelihood combining XENON1T/PandaX-4T with the post-dilution relic fraction and the ATLAS triplet-scalar bounds exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the micrOMEGAs sigma_SI output, rescaled by Omega_S h^2/0.120, into DDCalc likelihoods for XENON1T/PandaX-4T (and LZ), and encode the ATLAS doubly-charged-scalar mass limits as decay-assumption-dependent hard cuts in the same scan.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a gauged U(1) B-L vector
members.description: Laboratory constraints and projections on the B-L vector (Belle II, FASER/FASER2, LDMX, and existing dark-photon-style searches) are not packaged as recastable likelihoods in the (m_V, g_BL) plane for overlaying relic-density target curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the existing electron/quark-coupled B-L vector exclusion curves and the Belle II/FASER/LDMX projection curves (e.g. via a Darkcast-style recasting layer) into a (m_V, g_BL) constraint module the route can query.

members.model_name: mSUGRA mixed axion/axino dark matter
members.description: The BBN/gravitino constraint on the reheating temperature is applied only as a qualitative rule (heavy gravitino permits high T_R); no structured late-decay BBN constraint grid or likelihood is attached for the m_3/2-T_R plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published gravitino-decay BBN constraint grids (hadronic and electromagnetic injection limits as functions of m_3/2 and abundance) into a reusable T_R-m_3/2 exclusion likelihood and apply it alongside the WMAP/Planck relic-density Gaussian.

members.model_name: Non-thermal higgsino dark matter from late decays
members.description: Direct-detection and compressed-electroweakino collider constraints are not evaluated: sigma_SI from higgsino-gaugino mixing and monojet/disappearing-track reach are only cited from external analyses, with no likelihood or recast in place.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI(M_1, M_2, mu) with micrOMEGAs and evaluate it against LZ/XENONnT likelihoods via DDCalc; recast compressed higgsino searches (soft dilepton, monojet, disappearing track) with SModelS or CheckMATE on the MSSM-like spectrum.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a gauged U(1) L_mu-L_tau vector
members.description: Muon/tau-sector constraints and projections on the L_mu-L_tau vector (neutrino trident, BBN/SN1987A, SHiP, NA62, NA64-mu, M3, DUNE, displaced-decay searches) are not packaged as recastable likelihoods in the (m_V, g_mu) plane for overlaying relic-density target curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the existing L_mu-L_tau exclusion curves (trident, BBN/SN1987A) and the SHiP/NA62/NA64-mu/M3/DUNE projection curves (e.g. via a Darkcast-style recasting layer) into a (m_V, g_mu) constraint module the route can query.

members.model_name: Resonance-enhanced light singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood combines the relic-density condition, the self-scattering target, the Planck f_eff sigma_v / m_chi < 4.1e-28 cm^3/s/GeV bound, and the digitized collider/direct/meson portal limits for the resonant scalar parameter space; the card's combine step imports no external limit grids.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a GAMBIT-style composite likelihood: DRAKE output for Omega h^2, the analytic Planck annihilation term with f_eff(m_chi) tables, and digitized scalar-portal limits (LZ/XENON, LHCb/NA62 meson decays, Higgs invisible width) evaluated over (m_chi, m_phi, theta, C_chi h).

members.model_name: Self-interacting Dirac fermion dark matter with light scalar mediator for dark stars
members.description: No encoded likelihood evaluates the velocity-dependent p-wave plus Sommerfeld annihilation and the loop-suppressed pseudoscalar-coupled sigma_SI of this model against current Planck energy-injection, direct-detection, and indirect-search data; all four card constraints report likelihood_available no.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode sigma_v(v) evaluated at freeze-out, recombination, halo, and minihalo velocities into the Planck p_ann bound (with f_eff for the phi phi -> e+ e- cascade at m_phi ~ 10 MeV), compute the loop-induced spin-independent cross section for the CP-odd coupling and compare to LZ/XENONnT curves, and add mediator-coupling limits from beam-dump and rare-meson-decay data.

members.model_name: Phenomenological early decaying dark matter
members.description: The published bounds (lambda_FS < ~0.5 Mpc; (M_DDM/keV * Y)^2 T_d/yr < ~5e-5) rest on WMAP7/ACBAR/SDSS-DR7-era likelihoods; no modern CMB/LSS likelihood analysis exists for this parameterization, so current constraints are outdated by over a decade of data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the Boltzmann module exists (gap_1), run MCMC constraints with Cobaya or MontePython against Planck 2018, DESI/eBOSS BAO and power-spectrum, and Pantheon+ likelihoods, reporting updated allowed regions in (T_d, mass ratio, Omega_DDM).

members.model_name: Real singlet scalar Higgs-portal dark matter with strong electroweak phase transition
members.description: No machine-readable direct-detection likelihood is attached for the XENON/LUX exclusion of the simultaneous DM+SFOPT region; the card records only the paper's qualitative exclusion statement, and a proper treatment must rescale sigma_SI by the singlet relic fraction for subcomponent points.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire micrOMEGAs sigma_SI output to DDCalc's XENON1T/LZ likelihoods with automatic (Omega_s/Omega_DM) rescaling, and rerun the (m_s, lambda_hs) scan to reproduce and update the source exclusion.

members.model_name: mu-negative 4-2-2 Yukawa-unified neutralino dark matter
members.description: No modern likelihood or recast exists for the mu<0 4-2-2 Yukawa-unified benchmark spectra: the WMAP-era relic/flavor/g-2 cut flow, the post-Higgs (m_h ~ 125 GeV) LHC sparticle limits, and current direct-detection limits have not been applied to this branch (all three constraints have likelihood_available=no and recasting_needed=yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the 4-2-2 scan branch with a modern spectrum generator (ISAJET or SoftSUSY with non-universal gaugino boundary conditions), then chain micrOMEGAs (relic, sigma_SI/SD against LZ/XENONnT limits), FlavBit/SuperIso (B-physics, g-2 with the current Delta a_mu value), HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals (125 GeV Higgs), and SModelS/CheckMATE (LHC gluino/stau/electroweakino limits) into a composite likelihood.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet single-Higgs-inflation dark matter
members.description: Relic-density and XENON100 spin-independent constraints have only 'approximate' likelihoods with recasting_needed partial, so the 50-80 GeV light branch cannot be confronted with modern relic and direct-detection data at likelihood level.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the public micrOMEGAs inert-doublet model over the light branch and attach a Planck-2018 Gaussian relic likelihood plus DDCalc-based LZ/XENONnT spin-independent likelihoods in place of the WMAP-era band and XENON100 limit.

members.model_name: Z3-conserving NMSSM neutralino cosmology scenario
members.description: The combined collider/direct-detection/flavor filters and the Planck relic bound are applied only at source-era (2013) data versions with no packaged likelihoods (likelihood_available: no/partial); modern LZ/XENONnT, LHC Run-2/3 Higgs and sparticle, and updated flavor constraints are not wired into the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the scan with current NMSSMTools/micrOMEGAs versions, attach DDCalc or the published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods for sigma_SI (with the Omega_chi/Omega_obs rescaling the card prescribes), and apply HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals plus SModelS for the collider filters.

members.model_name: CMSSM QUE 10+10 vector-like extension with neutralino dark matter
members.description: The source MultiNest global likelihood (Higgs, flavor, LHC, relic density, muon g-2) is not exported, and the direct-detection constraint is only a source-era LUX hard cut; no likelihood incorporating modern LZ/XENONnT/PandaX limits and the updated muon g-2 value exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the global scan in a public framework (e.g. GAMBIT or a MultiNest pipeline with HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds and FlavorKit), replacing the LUX hard cut with a DDCalc-style SI likelihood using LZ/XENONnT data and the current muon g-2 world average.

members.model_name: Strongly self-interacting vector dark matter via freeze-in
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the late-decay and energy-injection constraints (BBN, CMB, AMS-02, diffuse gamma/X-ray) on the O(keV), long-lived dark Higgs h_2 with a freeze-in abundance; these constraints define the viable region but were only overlaid approximately.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a decaying-relic constraint module that takes (m_h2, tau_h2, Omega_h2) and evaluates BBN photodissociation bounds, Planck CMB energy-injection limits (via ExoCLASS/DarkAges-style deposition), and digitized AMS-02/diffuse X-ray limits as a combined likelihood.

members.model_name: Hadronic up-type minimal scalar FIMP freeze-in model
members.description: The LLP collider exclusion in the m_F versus c_tau_F plane is not reusable: the recast's search efficiency maps (CMS HSCP, disappearing tracks, ATLAS displaced-vertex plus MET) and hadronization assumptions are not packaged as a machine-readable likelihood for rescanning the freeze-in parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the HSCP, disappearing-track, and displaced-vertex plus MET analyses in a public recast framework (MadAnalysis 5 PAD or the LLP Recasting Repository) using the FeynRules model files, validate against the paper's published envelope, and release the efficiency maps as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac SU(2)_L lepton-doublet dark matter with late scalar decay
members.description: The LZ/XENON/PandaX limits are only available as generic WIMP exclusion curves; no dedicated direct-detection likelihood or recast exists for the pseudo-Dirac case where the Z-mediated channel is inelastic and closed by the splitting Delta M and only residual Higgs-mediated scattering remains.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's effective nucleon couplings (loop-level electroweak plus Higgs exchange) in DDCalc or the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module, including the inelastic kinematic threshold as a function of Delta M, and evaluate against the packaged LZ 2022 likelihood.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter in MSSM inverse/linear seesaw extensions
members.description: No modern direct-detection likelihood recast exists for this model: the card compares only to historical XENON100 curves and does not handle subdominant-abundance rescaling or the keV-scale real-imaginary splitting that controls the inelastic Z-exchange channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the micrOMEGAs sigma_SI output to a public direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc with XENON1T/LZ/XENONnT data), adding Omega_snu/Omega_DM rescaling for subcomponent points and a kinematic treatment of the Delta-m-dependent inelastic scattering channel.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet multi-Higgs-inflation dark matter
members.description: The relic-density and light-H0 exclusion constraints carry only 'approximate' likelihoods with no likelihood_reference, so the WMAP-era allowed/excluded regions cannot be recast against modern data without a dedicated likelihood layer.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the micrOMEGAs inert-doublet output in a Planck-2018 Gaussian relic-density likelihood and a modern spin-independent direct-detection likelihood via DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT), replacing the paper's WMAP-era band and XENON100-era limits.

members.model_name: SO(10) split-SUSY neutralino dark matter with non-universal gaugino masses
members.description: The direct-detection comparison uses XENON100/LUX-era limits and a XENON1T projection (likelihood_available: partial); no current-generation xenon likelihood is wired in for the TeV higgsino strip, including the negative-mu blind-spot regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the DarkSUSY spin-independent cross sections through DDCalc with published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, explicitly tracking the blind-spot suppression for negative mu.

members.model_name: ISS-NMSSM right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: The paper's multi-observable scan likelihood (Higgs, B physics, relic density, unitarity, g-2, vacuum stability penalties) is not released as a reusable public likelihood or scan chain, and the accepted-point tables are not published, so the viable ISS-NMSSM region cannot be re-evaluated or updated without rebuilding the whole scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the scan as a GAMBIT- or EasyScan-style public chain wired to the existing SARAH/SPheno + micrOMEGAs + HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals stack, replacing the XENON1T 2018 comparison with current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods (e.g. via DDCalc) and publishing the chi2 definitions and accepted-point samples.

members.model_name: B-L two-Higgs-doublet thermal right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: No xenon direct-detection likelihood implements the model's velocity-suppressed nonstandard nonrelativistic operator from Z-prime exchange; the paper warns conventional SI/SD cross-section limits cannot be applied to the leading operator.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the NR-EFT operator coefficients from the Z-prime interaction, implement them in DirectDM/DDCalc (or micrOMEGAs' NR-operator module) with XENON1T/XENONnT exposure and efficiency, and validate against the paper's statement that limits bite only for g_X greater than about 1.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal dark matter from relativistic bubble expansion
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is recast-required but unbuilt: no likelihood evaluation of the Higgs-mediated spin-independent cross section for the heavy bubble-produced scalar exists that includes the local-density rescaling to the bubble-plus-freeze-out abundance (likelihood_available unknown, applies recast_required).
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the tree-level Higgs-exchange nucleon cross section from lambda_hchi and M_chi, rescale by the computed Omega_chi/Omega_DM at each parameter point, and evaluate against current LZ/XENONnT limits via a public likelihood package such as DDCalc.

members.model_name: Singlet-portal dark matter from bubble-wall production
members.description: The direct-detection constraint on the card applies to the thermal singlet scalar, not to the added stable singlet-portal DM state; no recast exists that maps published nuclear-recoil likelihoods onto the (M_chi, lambda_schi, lambda_hs) parameters of the wall-produced candidate, and the relic contour comparison has no released likelihood (likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-induced DM-nucleon cross section for the stable singlet-portal state through the s/Higgs portal chain, implement the model in micrOMEGAs or a direct-detection recast package, and evaluate it against public LZ/XENONnT likelihoods; publish the relic contours as a simple chi-square against the Planck Omega_DM h^2 target.

members.model_name: Z8 hybrid scotogenic/type-II seesaw scalar dark matter model
members.description: No joint statistical pipeline exists combining the Planck relic-density target, the LZ spin-independent limit, LEP Z-width, LHC Higgs invisible/diphoton data, and MEG/MEG II cLFV bounds for this model; the source applies constraints as sequential pass/fail cuts on scan points rather than a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a GAMBIT-style or standalone composite likelihood using DDCalc for the LZ limit, HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals for the Higgs sector, the LEP Z-width measurement, and published cLFV limits, taking sigma_SI, branching ratios, and Omega h^2 from the gap_1 model implementation.

members.model_name: Electric-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: Neither the reheating-dependent relic-density constraint nor the RG/HB stellar bound is available as a packaged likelihood; only figure-level exclusion curves exist, so combined parameter-space scans can only use digitized hard cuts.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the primary and rel_1908_00553 exclusion curves as interpolable likelihood surfaces in (d_chi, m_chi, T_R), with the stellar bound expressed as a dark-luminosity limit so it can be re-evaluated when stellar modeling improves.

members.model_name: Magnetic-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: Neither the reheating-dependent relic-density constraint nor the RG/HB stellar bound is available as a packaged likelihood; only figure-level exclusion curves exist, so combined parameter-space scans can only use digitized hard cuts.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the primary and rel_1908_00553 exclusion curves as interpolable likelihood surfaces in (mu_chi, m_chi, T_R), with the stellar bound expressed as a dark-luminosity limit so it can be re-evaluated when stellar modeling improves.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant SU(2)_X vector dark matter
members.description: No bundled likelihood exists for the direct-detection relic line: the card marks likelihood_available unknown and recasting partial, with the primary paper's exclusion curve used only as evidence, so the relic-abundance and sigma_SI constraints cannot be evaluated statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the model (CalcHEP/FeynRules model files) in micrOMEGAs to compute Omega_X h^2 including semiannihilation and sigma_SI, then couple to DDCalc for current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods; validate against the primary x_f ~ 25-26 relation and the published direct-detection benchmark curve.

members.model_name: Scalar-field unified dark matter model with fast transition
members.description: No likelihood pipeline confronts the model with data: the sound-speed viability constraint has likelihood_available: no, and the ISW/CMB-galaxy cross-correlation channel relies on WMAP-era context with no modern cross-correlation likelihood applied to UDM parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the Boltzmann module exists, wire it into a Cobaya/MontePython run against Planck CMB, a matter-power/weak-lensing likelihood, and a published ISW-galaxy cross-correlation likelihood to constrain (beta, z_t, c_s^2) directly.

members.model_name: No-scale supergravity neutralino LSP dark matter framework
members.description: The collider/Higgs/flavor and relic constraints on the strips exist only as figure contours from the 2013-era analysis (likelihood_available 'no', recasting_needed 'yes'); no current likelihood combining Run-2/Run-3 LHC limits, Planck 2018 relic density, and direct-detection bounds is attached to the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the constraint overlay with modern public tooling: SModelS or CheckMATE for LHC sparticle limits, HiggsSignals for m_H, micrOMEGAs with DDCalc for relic density and direct detection, driven by a scan framework such as GAMBIT over (m_1/2, M_in, tan_beta, lambda).

members.model_name: Hybrid mediation mixed axion-wino dark matter
members.description: The fraction-rescaled direct-detection check uses only the LUX bound cited by the source with no likelihood evaluation; no recast against current xenon likelihoods exists for the scan points, so which mixed wino-Higgsino compositions survive today is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI for the SPheno/micrOMEGAs scan points, apply the Omega_w/Omega_DM local-fraction rescaling, and evaluate against current xenon-experiment likelihoods via DDCalc (LZ and XENONnT implementations), propagating the assumption that the local wino fraction tracks the cosmological one.

members.model_name: Dark-photon freeze-in Dirac fermion dark matter during early matter domination
members.description: Dark-photon laboratory constraints on the EMD relic-density benchmarks exist only as digitized exclusion curves; no machine-readable likelihood with experiment-specific acceptances for the paper's mass hierarchies (M_Aprime = 10 m_chi, 5 m_chi/3) is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer on top of Darkcast/published fixed-target and collider dark-photon limits that rescales visible-search reach for the model's invisible branching (A_prime -> chi chi open above threshold) and exports epsilon-M_Aprime exclusion likelihoods.

members.model_name: Dirac-scotogenic singlet-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood is packaged for any of the model's constraints: the relic-density comparison is a point target (likelihood_available: no), the XENONnT/LZ comparison is only partial and needs recasting, and no combined likelihood exists for the correlated relic + direct-detection + g-2 + N_eff scan the model's phenomenology relies on.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a composite likelihood in a global-fit framework such as GAMBIT: Planck Omega h^2 as a Gaussian, public XENONnT/LZ SI likelihoods (e.g. via DDCalc), and the standard muon g-2 and LFV likelihood terms, wired to the model implementation from gap_1.

members.model_name: Complex scalar singlet t-channel portal dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is assembled for the loop-induced scattering rate: the paper only compares to compiled exclusion curves, and no pipeline connects the model's Wilson coefficients to current (LZ/XENONnT) or future (DARWIN) detector likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the matched Wilson coefficients into DDCalc or obscura to evaluate published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods and DARWIN projections over the scan range (M_DM 10-1e5 GeV, M_med 100-1e5 GeV, couplings 1e-3 to 4), intersected with the micrOMEGAs relic contour.

members.model_name: Z4 sequential loop-suppression inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is attached to the model: the XENON1T-like SI bound is invoked only as a figure-level limit, with no coupling of the model's Higgs-mediated sigma_SI to a detector likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the micrOMEGAs-computed sigma_SI into DDCalc (or an equivalent public XENON1T/LZ likelihood) with halo-fraction rescaling f = Omega_phi/Omega_DM.

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from out-of-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No X-ray decay-line likelihood is attached to the model: radiative-decay bounds on the active-sterile mixing angle are discussed only qualitatively, and the mixing is a separate parameter not fixed by the production coupling f.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published XMM-Newton, Chandra, and NuSTAR keV line-search limits into a reusable likelihood on the (m_N, sin^2 2theta) plane assuming the sterile neutrino carries the full relic abundance from out-of-equilibrium singlet decays.

members.model_name: Re-annihilating Higgsino-like neutralino from DFSZ axino decay
members.description: The Higgsino-like LSP direct-detection prediction (sigma_chiN above about 1e-45 cm^2) has not been recast against any modern direct-detection likelihood; the card records likelihood_available unknown/no and no applied LUX/XENON/LZ limit.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_chiN over the neutralino composition space with micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY and confront it with current LZ/XENONnT exclusion likelihoods via DDCalc, including rescaling for any subdominant relic fraction.

members.model_name: Remnant-Z2 Majorana dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or recast is implemented for the scalar-mixing-induced sigma_SI: the LUX/XENON constraint is recorded with likelihood_available=no and recasting_needed=yes, and no updated LZ/XENONnT limits have been applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from the two-scalar-exchange amplitude with mixing angle theta and evaluate it in DDCalc (or the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module) against published LZ and XENONnT likelihoods, including the relic-abundance rescaling assumption recorded in the card.

members.model_name: Anapole dark matter
members.description: No current-generation direct-detection likelihood recast exists for the anapole operator: the velocity- and momentum-dependent recoil spectrum has only been compared to paper-era XENON100 limits, not to XENONnT/LZ/PandaX data, and cannot be treated with spin-independent contact-limit tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the anapole operator onto the non-relativistic EFT basis (O8/O9) with DirectDM-style matching and evaluate the recoil spectrum against current xenon-experiment likelihoods in a public tool such as WimPyDD or DDCalc, scanning the relic-density-matched (m_chi, g/Lambda^2) curve.

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from in-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No X-ray decay-line likelihood is attached to the model: the radiative-decay bound on the active-sterile mixing angle is discussed only qualitatively, and the mixing is a separate parameter not fixed by the production coupling f.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published XMM-Newton, Chandra, and NuSTAR keV line-search limits into a reusable likelihood on the (m_N, sin^2 2theta) plane and attach it to the card with the sterile neutrino carrying the full relic abundance from singlet decays.

members.model_name: Secluded U(1)' neutralino dark matter benchmarks

members.proposed_resolution: Once model files exist, chain micrOMEGAs output through DDCalc with current xenon-experiment likelihoods and a Planck Omega h^2 Gaussian to produce quantitative allowed regions for the benchmark family.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) non-universal-Higgs neutralino dark matter
members.description: Direct-detection constraints rest on a CDMS-II-era comparison from a related flipped-SU(5) paper; no modern spin-independent or spin-dependent likelihood (LZ, XENONnT, PandaX-4T) has been evaluated for this variant's sigma_SI and sigma_SD.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI and sigma_SD along the scan with DarkSUSY or micrOMEGAs and evaluate current exclusion likelihoods through DDCalc, applying the DarkSUSY-style local-density rescaling for underabundant points.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5)-UH neutralino dark matter
members.description: Direct-detection constraints rest on a CDMS-II-era comparison from a related flipped-SU(5) paper; no modern spin-independent or spin-dependent likelihood (LZ, XENONnT, PandaX-4T) has been evaluated for this variant's sigma_SI and sigma_SD.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI and sigma_SD along the scan with DarkSUSY or micrOMEGAs and evaluate current exclusion likelihoods through DDCalc, applying the DarkSUSY-style local-density rescaling for underabundant points.

members.model_name: Unbroken local U(1)_X scalar dark matter model
members.description: No machine-usable direct-detection likelihood exists for scalar X: the only bound is a figure-level XENON100 (225 live days) exclusion with likelihood_available: no, and the combined Higgs-portal plus kinetic-mixing recoil rate has not been implemented against any current xenon exposure.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-X spin-independent cross section (separate lambda_HX Higgs-exchange and epsilon-induced photon/Z-exchange terms) in DDCalc or micrOMEGAs and evaluate it against current LZ/XENONnT/PandaX likelihoods, replacing the obsolete XENON100 figure-level bound.

members.model_name: Z2 fermion dark matter from broken local U(1) with bound states
members.description: No direct-detection or dark-photon likelihood/recast is implemented for the model's portal parameter space: the card marks likelihood_available no and the recast step requires external experimental limits that have not been wired to the model's sigma_SI and kinetic-mixing predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the paper's sigma_SI formula into DDCalc/micrOMEGAs direct-detection limit tables (LZ/XENONnT) and overlay published dark-photon epsilon vs m_gamma_prime exclusion compilations, exposing the combined allowed region over (lambda_H, epsilon, m_R, m_gamma_prime, y).

members.model_name: Scalar WIMP dark matter in the simplest scoto-seesaw model
members.description: The registry route applies only the Planck relic band as a likelihood; the XENON1T spin-independent limit used to cut the eta_R parameter space was not digitized or rerun (card: likelihood_available 'no', 'XENON1T curve not included'), so direct-detection viability of scan points cannot be re-evaluated or updated to newer exposures.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the micrOMEGAs sigma_SI output to the public DDCalc likelihood package (which ships XENON1T and successor LZ/XENONnT likelihoods) inside the scan loop, so the direct-detection constraint becomes a proper reproducible likelihood rather than a digitized curve.

members.model_name: Dark Loops Model 5 scalar-singlet dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable combined likelihood or scan-point release exists for the joint flavor + relic + direct-detection + collider constraint region; the card records likelihood_available: no and that no scan points were recovered, so the allowed region can only be read off the paper's figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the global scan with public components (e.g. flavio/smelli for the b -> s l+l- and g-2 likelihood, micrOMEGAs for relic and sigma_SI, published DD curves) and release the scan chain so the 30-350 GeV window is reproducible with post-2022 flavor averages.

members.model_name: NMSSM singlino dark matter benchmark regions
members.description: No detector-level recast or likelihood exists for the compressed, lepton/tau-rich electroweakino and slepton cascade topologies of benchmarks BP1-BP4; the card notes SModelS-style simplified-model results and standard chargino/neutralino or stau searches can miss these decay chains, and likelihood_available is 'no' for the collider constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the BP1-BP4 cascade topologies in a public recast framework (CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with the relevant ATLAS/CMS electroweakino and stau analyses), validating against the published cutflows, and expose the resulting exclusion likelihood so the NMSSMTools/micrOMEGAs scan chain can consume it.

members.model_name: Two-24 type III GMSB gravitino warm dark matter variant

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudo-scalar Yukawa interaction

members.model_name: Gauged B-L Dirac scotogenic fermion dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Interface the micrOMEGAs output with a direct-detection likelihood package for the XENON1T one-ton-year result, recast the LHC dilepton limit onto the (m_BL, g_BL) plane, and compute Delta_N_eff from the Diracon/nu_R decoupling temperature to apply BBN/CMB likelihoods, including subcomponent rescaling of sigma_SI.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter with Type-I seesaw neutrino masses
