members.description: No public XENON1T electron-recoil likelihood or background model is available for this model's spectral constraint-and-fit; the card records only an approximate paper-level treatment with no likelihood table.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a binned Poisson likelihood from the published XENON1T 0.65 tonne-year electron-recoil spectrum with the B0 background model, and update it with XENONnT/LZ electron-recoil data that supersede the original excess.

members.model_name: Dark-charge Z4 two-scalar dark matter model
members.description: No public XENON1T-style electron-recoil likelihood or boosted-dark-matter detector-response module exists that maps the boosted scalar flux and light-Z-prime scattering cross section to a keV-scale electron recoil spectrum with detector efficiency for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a boosted-DM electron-recoil recast module: combine the free-electron/atomic ionization form factors from public DM-electron scattering tools (e.g. QEDark/DarkELF-style inputs) with the published XENON1T electron-recoil efficiency and background model, and expose it as a likelihood over (m2, m3, g_N, m_Zprime, boosted flux).

members.model_name: Fermionic inelastic cosmic-ray-accelerated dark matter
members.description: No packaged direct-detection likelihood exists for high-energy CRDM recoil spectra in xenon: the PandaX-4T constraint is a paper-level recast with no released efficiency-and-exposure likelihood usable for the relativistic inelastic recoil regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a DDCalc-style likelihood module for PandaX-4T (and XENONnT/LZ) high-recoil data with the published efficiency curves, accepting arbitrary relativistic recoil spectra so the inelastic CRDM prediction can be scored statistically rather than by rate-cut recasting.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant Higgs-portal vector FIMP in a fast pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: The xenon direct-detection constraint on light-scalar-mediated nuclear recoils is recorded with likelihood_available: no and undigitized limit curves, so the sin(theta) ~ 1e-5 to 1e-3 band cannot be statistically evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's scalar-mediated spin-independent cross section into DDCalc (which ships XENON1T and projected XENONnT likelihoods) and add the published PandaX-4T limit, producing per-point log-likelihoods rather than digitized exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_X remnant scalar dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or recast handling this model's inelastic gauge-mediated scattering with O(10) GeV splitting combined with a tunable Higgs-portal elastic component; existing xenon limits assume elastic SI scattering.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DDCalc (or an equivalent xenon recast package) with the inelastic kinematic threshold for Delta m up to O(10) GeV plus the elastic Higgs-portal term, and recast LZ/XENONnT limits onto (m_A2, Delta m, lambda_portal).

members.model_name: Heavy invisible Z-prime portal FIMP freeze-in during reheating
members.description: No direct-detection or collider recast exists for the feebly coupled heavy Z-prime portal: the card records likelihood_available no/unknown for all constraints, and no detector-response or cross-section calculation for this benchmark was found, so the laboratory observable cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nucleon-level scattering cross section from the effective Z-prime-gluon operator, then recast it through public direct-detection likelihood machinery (e.g. DDCalc/DirectDM against LZ and XENONnT releases) and map collider mono-jet limits onto the (m_X, m_Zprime, Lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Dirac asymmetric dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is a quoted TeV-scale threshold from earlier model work, not a recast: no Z_B-mediated Dirac-DM nucleon cross section is computed for this model's charges and no current-experiment likelihood is applied, so the M_DM > 1 TeV boundary is not defensible across mediator masses and couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the spin-independent Z_B-exchange cross section as a function of (M_DM, M_ZB, g_B) from the model's baryonic charges and evaluate it against current LZ/XENONnT exposures with a public likelihood tool (e.g. DDCalc), replacing the imported 1 TeV rule of thumb.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated NMSSM light and heavy dark-sector model
members.description: No modern direct-detection likelihood is available for the ~7 GeV Dirac LDM scattering through a 0.2 GeV kinetically mixed mediator; the card's target region is the now-historical 2010 DAMA/CoGeNT window and current low-threshold limits have not been applied (likelihood_available=no, recasting_needed=yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the (m_L, m_X, epsilon, g_X) parameter space against current low-mass results (XENONnT, LZ, PandaX, DarkSide-50, SuperCDMS) using DDCalc or the experiments' published likelihoods, keeping the light-mediator form factor in the cross section.

members.model_name: Asymmetric higgsino dark matter
members.description: The inelastic direct-detection threshold statement (splitting below about 400 keV excluded by Z-mediated scattering) has never been recast onto modern xenon likelihoods; no implementation of the inelastic recoil spectrum for (mu, m0, sigma_n) against XENONnT/LZ/PandaX data exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the inelastic (delta = m0) Z-mediated recoil spectrum with standard halo kinematics in an inelastic-capable rate code (extend DDCalc/WimPyDD with splitting kinematics) and evaluate against published LZ and XENONnT likelihoods to obtain the modern minimum-splitting contour over mu = 200-1000 GeV.

members.model_name: X-portal vector MeV dark matter
members.description: No end-to-end electron-recoil recast pipeline (atomic ionization form factors plus XENON10 detector response and likelihood) exists for the X-portal vector candidate; only qualitative XENON10 consistency is claimed.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine public QEdark/DarkELF xenon ionization form factors with the published XENON10 exposure, threshold, and background model to build a Poisson likelihood over the F_DM=1 X-portal cross section.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with scalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: The critical XENON100/LUX direct-detection comparison has no embedded detector likelihood and is based on outdated limit curves; a modern reusable spin-independent likelihood for the scalar-mediator parameter space is missing.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's sigma_SI(m_d, m_s, g_d, theta) through DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods to replace the cited XENON100/LUX curves and update the excluded region.

members.model_name: Model A: Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light scalar mediator
members.description: The direct-detection constraint on the Higgs-portal coupling lambda_HP is only a quoted literature requirement (about 1e-9 for m_med below 30 MeV); no recast of current xenon-experiment likelihoods with the light-scalar long-range propagator is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LZ/XENONnT limits with the light-mediator form factor 1/(q^2+m_med^2)^2 for Higgs-portal scalar exchange (e.g. via DDCalc or an equivalent rate code) to produce a lambda_HP(m_DM, m_med) likelihood.

members.model_name: Model B': vector-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: The direct-detection constraints on kinetic mixing (epsilon around 3e-10) and the Higgs portal are only quoted literature requirements; no recast of current xenon-experiment likelihoods with the light-vector long-range propagator is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LZ/XENONnT limits with the light-mediator form factor 1/(q^2+m_med^2)^2 for kinetic-mixing vector and Higgs-portal scalar exchange (e.g. via DDCalc or an equivalent rate code) to produce epsilon and lambda likelihoods over (m_DM, m_med).

members.model_name: Model B: scalar-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: The direct-detection constraints on the Higgs-portal couplings are only quoted literature requirements (lambda around 1e-9 for m_med below 30 MeV); no recast of current xenon-experiment likelihoods with the light-scalar long-range propagator is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LZ/XENONnT limits with the light-mediator form factor 1/(q^2+m_med^2)^2 for Higgs-portal scalar exchange (e.g. via DDCalc or an equivalent rate code) to produce portal-coupling likelihoods over (m_DM, m_med).

members.model_name: Model C: p-wave scalar-mediator SIDM with scalar mediator-decay channel
members.description: The direct-detection constraints on the phi and S Higgs-portal mixings are only quoted literature requirements (portal couplings around 1e-9 for m_med below 30 MeV); no recast of current xenon-experiment likelihoods with the light-scalar long-range propagator is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LZ/XENONnT limits with the light-mediator form factor 1/(q^2+m_med^2)^2 for Higgs-portal scalar exchange (e.g. via DDCalc or an equivalent rate code) to produce portal-coupling likelihoods over (m_DM, m_med).

members.model_name: Model D: stable vector-mediator SIDM with scalar annihilation outlet
members.description: With kinetic mixing forbidden by the charge-conjugation symmetry, direct detection proceeds only through the Higgs-portal S, and the quoted portal limits are literature values; no recast of current xenon-experiment likelihoods with the light-scalar long-range propagator for this suppressed-mixing configuration is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LZ/XENONnT limits with the light-mediator form factor 1/(q^2+m_S^2)^2 for Higgs-portal scalar exchange (e.g. via DDCalc or an equivalent rate code) to produce a lambda_HS(m_DM, m_S) likelihood for the kinetic-mixing-free configuration.

members.model_name: Scalar boosted dark matter with semi-annihilation production
members.description: No public XENON1T SR1 electron-recoil likelihood (signal-plus-background, including the tritium hypothesis) is available for fitting the boosted-DM parameters or recasting the loop-induced sigma_e/sigma_N exclusions, whose higher loop order makes the exclusion region especially sensitive to the statistical treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned Poisson likelihood from the published XENON1T SR1 electron-recoil spectrum and background model, plus digitized electron- and nuclear-recoil upper-limit curves, and validate against the paper's 68%/95% fit regions.

members.model_name: Gauged inverse-seesaw inert-scalar dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood combines the XENON1T spin-independent limit and the ATLAS Br(h to invisible) < 0.11 bound for this model's portal coupling; the card carries only quoted exclusion statements, so the direct-detection and invisible-Higgs exclusions cannot be recomputed for new scan points.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's sigma_SI and Br(h invisible) predictions into DDCalc (XENON1T likelihood, extendable to LZ/XENONnT) and a simple Gaussian/limit likelihood for the ATLAS invisible-width bound, packaged as a reusable constraint module for the scan.

members.model_name: Scalar inelastic cosmic-ray-accelerated dark matter

members.model_name: Y=0 inert-triplet radiative neutrino model with bosonic dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or numerical recast exists for the Y=0 BDM Higgs-portal spin-independent cross section; the paper only notes the bound qualitatively, so the current LZ/XENONnT exclusion status of the surviving BDM points is unknown.

members.model_name: Mirror-sector dark neutron WIMP-baryogenesis model
members.description: No direct-detection or collider likelihood/recast exists for any concrete mediator benchmark of this model: the mediator sector is left UV-realization dependent, so neutrino-floor comparisons and TeV-scale collider reach statements remain qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Define one or two simplified-model mediator benchmarks (Higgs-portal scalar and massive B-L vector), implement them in FeynRules, and recast with existing tools: DDCalc-style direct-detection likelihoods for nuclear recoils and LHC heavy-resonance/missing-energy searches via MadGraph plus CheckMATE/Contur.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino freeze-in at stronger coupling
members.description: No machine-readable direct-detection likelihood (LZ/XENONnT/DARWIN curves are only cited, not ingested) is attached to the route, so sigma_SI predictions from the relic-consistent parameter space cannot be automatically confronted with recoil data.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire DDCalc or digitized public LZ/XENONnT exclusion curves (and DARWIN projections) into the pipeline to return exclusion status or likelihood for (sigma_SI, M) over the GeV-to-tens-of-TeV range.

members.model_name: Nearly supersymmetric atomic dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or recast exists for inelastic dark-atom scattering with atomic form factors: the card's kinetic-mixing observable relies on order-of-magnitude benchmark cross sections from related papers rather than detector-level limits on (epsilon, delta, m_atom).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-atom charge-radius and inelastic form factors from the bound-state wavefunctions and implement the inelastic recoil spectrum in a standard direct-detection recast framework (e.g. DDCalc-style xenon likelihoods) to set limits in the (epsilon, delta, mass) plane.

members.model_name: Degenerate leptophilic radiative-neutrino-mass dark matter
members.description: No event-rate plus likelihood pipeline exists for the loop-induced inelastic photon-mediated scattering: the charge-charge/dipole-charge/dipole-dipole recoil spectra with inelastic N1-to-N2 kinematics and detector response have not been implemented, and no modern xenon likelihood (XENON1T actual data, XENONnT, LZ) has been recast onto (M_1, M_2 - M_1, M_eta, Im(h_2^* h_1)).
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's loop form factors into an inelastic-DM rate calculator (extend DDCalc or a WimPyDD-style package with delta-splitting kinematics and dipole/charge nuclear responses) and evaluate against published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods.

members.model_name: Degenerate leptophilic radiative-neutrino-mass dark matter

members.model_name: X-portal scalar MeV dark matter

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model I
members.description: No packaged direct-detection likelihood evaluates the loop-induced photon form factors (b_chi, c_chi, mu_chi) against PandaX-II/XENON1T/LUX; the card marks recasting_needed yes and likelihood_available unknown, and the mapping from these electromagnetic operators to nuclear responses is not provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Match the charge-radius, anapole, and magnetic-moment operators onto the nonrelativistic EFT basis with DirectDM and evaluate them with DDCalc's XENON1T/LUX likelihoods (adding a PandaX-II module), validating against the exclusion contours in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Natural AMSB higgsino-axion dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is available for the relic-fraction-rescaled higgsino SI/SD rates; the LUX comparison is a by-hand limit-curve check with no detector likelihood or nuclear-response uncertainty (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the nAMSB spectrum output to DDCalc (or an equivalent public direct-detection likelihood package) with the xi_chi = Omega_chi h^2/0.12 rescaling applied to LUX/LZ event rates, including nuclear-response uncertainties.

members.model_name: S3 Majorana right-handed-neutrino dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Couple the computed sigma_SD to DDCalc's LUX/PICO-60 likelihood modules (or current LZ/PICO successors) and implement the MEG bound as a one-sided Gaussian/Poisson likelihood in a flavor package such as FlavorKit/SPheno output.

members.model_name: Inelastic dark-photon Dirac fermion thermal relic for the XENON1T excess

members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned Poisson likelihood from the published XENON1T 0.65 tonne-year electron-recoil spectrum and background model (and update to XENONnT ER data, which supersedes the excess), exposing it as a wrapper the recoil-rate code can call.

members.model_name: Fermion boosted dark matter with annihilation production

members.model_name: Scalar boosted dark matter with annihilation production
members.description: No public XENON1T SR1 electron-recoil likelihood (signal-plus-background, including the tritium hypothesis) is available for fitting the boosted-DM parameters or recasting the loop-induced sigma_e/sigma_N exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned Poisson likelihood from the published XENON1T SR1 electron-recoil spectrum and background model, plus digitized electron- and nuclear-recoil upper-limit curves, and validate against the paper's 68%/95% fit regions.

members.model_name: Thermally corrected U(1)_Lmu-Ltau freeze-in scalar dark matter
members.description: The U(1)_Lmu-Ltau laboratory and LZ direct-detection constraints are applied only as approximate overlay summaries; no reusable combined likelihood over (m_Zprime, g_mu_tau, s_theta, sigma_SI) exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published neutrino-trident, COHERENT/CEvNS, Borexino, ATLAS/CMS Z-to-four-muon, Higgs signal-strength, and LZ limits into a combined likelihood module (e.g. within GAMBIT or a standalone overlay package) parameterized by the model's gauge and scalar-mixing parameters.

members.model_name: SU(2) center-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: Direct-detection and Higgs-invisible constraints are applied only as digitized limit curves with component-fraction rescaling; no likelihood pipeline evaluates XENON1T/LZ statistically for the two-component rescaled recoil rate (likelihood_available no on both constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the per-component sigma_SI values, weighted by predicted Omega_i/Omega_DM fractions, into DDCalc's XENON1T and LZ likelihoods, and impose Br(h -> invisible) < 0.13 analytically within the same scan.

members.model_name: Scalar FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: No direct-detection or collider recast exists for the feeble moduli-portal couplings of the scalar FIMP: likelihood_available is no/unknown for all constraints and no recoil or collider rate calculation appears in the read text, so the laboratory observable cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nucleon-level scattering cross section induced by real and axial modulus exchange (via the Higgs and gauge-boson couplings), recast it through public direct-detection likelihoods (e.g. DDCalc against LZ and XENONnT), and map collider null searches onto the (m_X, m_phi, Lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Gauged charged complex scalar dark matter with dark Higgs and dark photon
members.description: The direct-detection comparison for Higgs-mediated scattering of MeV-GeV scalar dark matter lacks a likelihood: standard tools are calibrated for heavier WIMPs, and low-threshold nuclear- and electron-recoil limits relevant near the 10 GeV upper edge and below are only available as published exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize current low-mass exclusion curves (e.g. sub-GeV to 10 GeV nuclear-recoil and Migdal/electron-recoil limits) and wrap them, or the corresponding DDCalc-style detector modules where available, into a reusable likelihood over (m_X, sigma_elastic).

members.model_name: Vector-like lepton dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for any of the model's constraints: the Higgs diphoton fit uses 2012-era data, direct-detection comparisons rely on superseded XENON100/COUPP limits, and the CMS mono-photon spin-dependent bound is not applicable without a dedicated simulation-based recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a combined likelihood using a modern Higgs signal-strength fit (e.g. Lilith or HiggsSignals) for R_gamma_gamma, DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT and PICO likelihoods for SI/SD scattering, and a MadGraph+recast (CheckMATE/MadAnalysis) implementation of compressed-spectrum LEP/LHC charged-lepton searches.

members.model_name: Degenerate millicharged atomic dark matter with hyperfine inelastic scattering
members.description: No inelastic-recoil likelihood exists for the ~15 keV hyperfine (singlet-to-triplet) transition of degenerate atomic dark matter: the only detector comparison is the paper's hand-made CoGeNT/Xenon-era one, so the critical direct-detection observable cannot be evaluated against current experiments.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an inelastic-dark-matter recast pipeline (DDCalc-style likelihood with a mass-splitting delta = E_hf and the paper's hyperfine matrix element in place of the standard SI form factor) to modern xenon-target data (LZ/XENONnT), first validating by reproducing the paper's CoGeNT benchmark at alpha_prime ~ 0.06, m_H ~ 6 GeV, E_hf ~ 15 keV.

members.model_name: Secluded dark matter coupled to a hidden CFT
members.description: No implemented direct-detection recast distinguishes the elastic Dirac case (requiring epsilon_0 of order 1e-6) from the inelastic near-degenerate Majorana-split case that reopens the parameter space; the current treatment is a quoted inequality with OCR-level numerical uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the hidden-vector-mediated nuclear scattering rate (elastic and inelastic kinematics with the mass splitting as a parameter) in DDCalc or an equivalent recast against current xenon-experiment exclusion data.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs complex scalar sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: The electron-recoil direct-detection route lacks an implemented detector-response recast: only approximate XENON10/XENON100-scale sigma_e bounds are quoted, and current SENSEI/DAMIC/XENON1T-S2 low-threshold data with semiconductor and noble-liquid response functions are not applied to this model's parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's (epsilon, alpha_D, m_phi, m_V) points to sigma_e with the standard heavy-mediator form factor and evaluate rates with QEdark/DarkELF material responses against current published SENSEI, DAMIC-M, and XENON electron-recoil likelihoods.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_X vector Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: Direct-detection filtering uses the 2018 XENON1T limit curve without relic-fraction rescaling in a packaged likelihood; a current global fit needs post-2018 limits (LZ, XENONnT) applied with Omega_X/Omega_obs rescaling for the subcomponent regions where the GW signal is detectable.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published LZ/XENONnT efficiency-and-exposure likelihoods (e.g. via DDCalc) with automatic sigma_SI rescaling by the computed relic fraction, and rerun the paper's scan filter.

members.model_name: Electroweak symmetric dark matter ball
members.description: No public detector likelihood exists for macroscopic multi-scatter/track signatures (multi-hit selections, thresholds, and dead-time effects) in XENON1T, BOREXINO, JUNO, or DUNE, nor for the tens-of-MeV bound-state capture energy deposition channel; current reaches are paper-level estimates rather than collaboration likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Poisson multiple-scatter exposure likelihood with experiment-specific geometry, threshold, and trigger models, following the published DEAP-3600 multi-scatter search methodology as a template, and extend it with a capture-energy deposition response model for the liquid-scintillator detectors.

members.model_name: Gauged lepton-number dark-sector CP-violating fermion dark matter
members.description: No likelihoods exist for the model's constraint set: leptophilic Z-prime collider searches, direct detection, and the electron-EDM bound are only quoted parametrically in the paper (likelihood_available is 'no' for both constraints), so no combined viability scan can be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published leptophilic Z-prime search limits (LEP, LHC dilepton), xenon direct-detection limits, and the ACME d_e bound into a joint likelihood over (M_Zprime, gprime, m_chi, q, lambda_SH, eta), including the two-loop EDM estimate from the paper as the EDM observable map.

members.model_name: Effective right-handed sterile-neutrino dark matter with SM gauge interactions
members.description: No public likelihood implements the XENON1T low-energy electron-recoil fit for this model; the allowed (m_N, G_R^l) bands exist only as figures in the paper, blocking numerical recasting and updates with newer xenon (XENONnT/LZ) electron-recoil data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned chi-square likelihood from the released XENON1T SR1 electron-recoil spectrum and background model (and its XENONnT successor), convolving the model dR/dE_R with detector efficiency and resolution, validated against the paper's best-fit bands.

members.model_name: Chiral U(1) B-L scalar dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection, collider, and CDF-motivated oblique-parameter constraints are applied only as digitized curve pass-fail comparisons; no statistical likelihood combines LZ/XENON1T recoil data, ATLAS dilepton Z' limits, and the S,T,U fit for this model's parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a scan-level likelihood by wrapping DDCalc for the LZ/XENON1T spin-independent limits, a ZPEED-style dilepton likelihood for the Z' bounds, and a Gaussian S,T,U electroweak-fit term, then run it over the gap_1 model implementation in a GAMBIT-like or custom scanner.

members.model_name: Superheavy vector-like doublet WIMP from incomplete thermalization
members.description: The direct-detection mass reach (m_DM > 2.7e9 GeV, future reach ~1.3e12 GeV) rests on the source's flux-scaled reinterpretation of XENON1T 2018; no modern detector likelihood with proper efficiencies and halo-model dependence has been run for the ultra-heavy Z-mediated benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark sigma_SI ~ 2.3e-39 cm^2 Z-exchange cross section through a current xenon likelihood (e.g. DDCalc or the released XENONnT/LZ likelihoods) extended to ultra-heavy masses where the rate scales as 1/m_DM, including halo-model variations and published exclusion tables in m_DM.

members.model_name: Secluded Dirac WIMP with U(1) prime vector mediator
members.description: The direct-detection and collider exclusions are frozen at historical XENON/LEP2/Tevatron limits: no modern recast maps the charge-radius nuclear scattering and dark-photon production bounds onto the (m_chi, m_V, epsilon, e_prime) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current LZ/XENONnT spin-independent likelihoods (via DDCalc) using the charge-radius cross section, and map modern dark-photon visible/invisible search limits (e.g. via DarkCast and LHC dark-photon recasts) onto epsilon versus m_V for this model's coupling structure.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic scalar doublet dark matter from triplet scalar leptogenesis
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the inelastic Z-mediated recoil comparison used to test this model: the DAMA versus Xenon100/CDMS-II/CRESST-II Bayesian analysis is private and source-era, and no modern (XENONnT/LZ) recast of the multi-TeV inelastic scalar-doublet region is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an open direct-detection package (e.g. DDCalc or wimprates) with inelastic kinematics for O(keV) splitting at multi-TeV masses and wrap DAMA modulation plus current xenon-experiment likelihoods with explicit halo-velocity-distribution priors.

members.model_name: Z4 two-sector scalar semi-annihilation dark matter
members.description: No modern multicomponent direct-detection likelihood exists that weights each stable Z4 component's normalized SI cross section by its local fraction xi_i; the card's comparison uses only XENON100-era limits with partial likelihood availability.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a DDCalc-based pipeline to sum component-weighted recoil spectra (xi_1 sigma_1 + xi_2 sigma_2 at their respective masses) and evaluate against LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, replacing the source's single-component XENON100-era normalized-cross-section comparison.

members.model_name: Next minimal Dirac dark matter model
members.description: The direct-detection status rests on 2012-era CoGeNT/DAMA target regions and XENON100/CDMSII null results; no modern low-mass likelihood (LZ, XENONnT, SuperCDMS, DarkSide low-threshold analyses) has been applied to the 5-15 GeV Dirac candidate, so present-day viability of the critical recoil observable is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the light-H_L-mediated spin-independent cross section against current low-mass likelihoods using DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT) plus published SuperCDMS/DarkSide-50 low-threshold limits, replacing the historical CoGeNT/DAMA regions as the fit target.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric scalar N1 cogenesis dark matter model
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is available for the 8-10 GeV, sigma_SI about 1e-41 cm^2 target region (likelihood_available is 'no'); the card only records source-era CDMS-Si/CoGeNT versus XENON comparisons, with no modern low-mass likelihood applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the analytic sigma_SI(m_N1, M_X, lambda_i) output of step s1 into a DDCalc-style likelihood covering modern low-mass experiments (e.g. LZ, XENONnT, SuperCDMS) to replace the contested source-era CDMS-Si/CoGeNT interpretation.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn leptoquark-diquark mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection and Higgs-invisible constraints are frozen at 2013 XENON100/126-GeV-Higgs statements; no current likelihood recast exists that weights the Higgs-portal sigma_SI by the scalar subcomponent fraction Omega_1/Omega_DM.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast with current xenon-experiment limits and Higgs invisible-width measurements via a DDCalc-style likelihood, scaling the event rate by the computed local subcomponent fraction over the (m_1, lambda_h, F_a) plane.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn scotogenic mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection and Higgs-invisible statements are 2013-era (XENON100, early 126 GeV Higgs data) and no modern likelihood is attached; current xenon-experiment limits must be applied with the scalar subcomponent fraction Omega_1/Omega_DM as an explicit rescaling parameter.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the Higgs-portal sigma_SI prediction into an existing direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT likelihoods) plus a current Higgs-invisible-width likelihood, with the local-density fraction rescaled by the computed scalar relic fraction.

members.model_name: Annihilation-product direct-detection dark matter
members.description: No likelihood is available for recasting xenon/germanium data onto the relativistic Y signal (con_lux_relativistic_y_scattering has likelihood_available: no), so the 10 MeV-1 GeV LUX-sensitive window cannot be updated to current experiments.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood from published LZ/XENONnT and SuperCDMS efficiency curves and background models, parameterized in (m_X, m_Y, sigma_v, Y-nucleus cross section) with the Galactic-center flux normalization as input.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector self-interacting dark matter with light vector mediator
members.description: Direct-detection bounds on the hidden-visible mixing use LUX/SuperCDMS contact-style recasts (likelihood_available: partial); no likelihood retains the light-mediator 1/(q^2+m_phi^2)^2 propagator shape needed for the peaked low-recoil spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DDCalc-style recasts of current xenon and low-threshold experiments with the light-mediator momentum-dependent cross section in (epsilon, m_phi, m_chi, alpha_X).

members.model_name: Accidental real singlet scalar dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No current xenon direct-detection likelihood is wired to this model; the card's exclusion rests on 2013-era LUX/XENON100 bounds quoted by the primary paper, so the surviving lambda_sh/m_S parameter space under LZ/XENONnT is not evaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from the Higgs-portal coupling with f_N = 0.3 and evaluate it against DDCalc (or the published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods) to produce an updated exclusion in the (m_S, lambda_sh) plane.

members.model_name: GeV-scale mixed sneutrino dark matter with Dirac neutrinos
members.description: No low-mass direct-detection likelihood exists for the ~1 GeV sneutrino: the LUX/SuperCDMS comparison uses source-era limits, and modern low-threshold experiments (which dominate at GeV masses where sigma_SI ~ 1e-42 cm^2) have not been recast against this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a DDCalc-style likelihood framework with current low-threshold datasets (e.g. SuperCDMS HVeV/CRESST-III/XENONnT low-mass analyses, including Migdal-effect channels relevant near 1 GeV) and evaluate it on the model's sigma_SI(m_snu1, theta, A_nu).

members.model_name: U(1)_X dark-sector singlet-scalar phi0 dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection and collider constraint step has no wired-in likelihoods: the LUX tension is quoted from the source without a modern recast, and only a partial monojet likelihood is noted for invisible decays of the 750 GeV resonance, so current exclusions on the parameter space cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the reconstructed model implementation to a public direct-detection likelihood (e.g. DDCalc with LZ/XENONnT data) and recast current ATLAS/CMS monojet and resonance searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis, replacing the historical LUX and 750 GeV-era inputs.

members.model_name: Electron-flavored Dirac dark matter, Model II
members.description: No packaged direct-detection likelihood evaluates the loop-induced photon form factors of this model against PandaX-II/XENON1T/LUX; recasting_needed is yes and the operator-to-nuclear-response mapping is external to the primary text.
members.proposed_resolution: Match the charge-radius, anapole, and magnetic-moment operators onto the nonrelativistic EFT basis with DirectDM and evaluate with DDCalc's XENON1T/LUX likelihoods plus a PandaX-II module, validating against the primary paper's exclusion contours.

members.model_name: Z2-odd scalar dark matter in the N=1 generalized one-loop neutrino-mass model
members.description: No inelastic scalar-doublet direct-detection likelihood exists for this model: the Z-mediated scattering is kinematically suppressed by the CP-even/odd splitting Delta m_RI, and generic elastic WIMP-nucleon limits (e.g. the quoted XENON1T benchmark) cannot be applied without an inelastic recast of the detector response.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing direct-detection recast framework (e.g. DDCalc or a likelihood package with XENON1T/LZ response tables) to inelastic kinematics with splitting Delta m_RI ~ 100 keV plus the residual Higgs-portal elastic channel, producing a joint likelihood in (M_X, Delta m_RI, lambda_HX).

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with inert scalar dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is only partially served: XENON1T/PandaX-II limits are cited but recasting_needed is 'yes' and only a partial likelihood exists, so the sigma_SI prediction cannot be turned into a statistically well-defined constraint on the quartics and mass splitting.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the analytic Higgs-portal sigma_SI into a public direct-detection likelihood package such as DDCalc (XENON1T and later LZ implementations), including the model's mass-splitting-dependent inelastic thresholds where relevant.

members.model_name: Dark U(1)_X Majorana WIMP for b -> s anomalies
members.description: No bundled or portable likelihood exists for either the flavor fit (R_K, R_K*, B_s -> mu mu, B_s mixing — whose world averages have shifted since the paper) or the direct-detection exclusion (only XENON1T benchmark contours were read); both constraints are flagged recasting_needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's Wilson coefficients into flavio/smelli for a current global b -> s ll and B_s-mixing likelihood, and pass the sigma_SI predictions through DDCalc with XENON1T/XENONnT/LZ likelihoods, exposing a combined flavor+relic+direct-detection likelihood over (M_-, g_X, theta_H, m_H2, lambda_q, lambda_l).

members.model_name: Charged-current fermionic absorption dark matter
members.description: No experiment-level likelihood exists for the charged-current absorption event topology (prompt electron plus nuclear recoil with de-excitation or delayed daughter-decay tags) in xenon/argon or neutrino detectors; only qualitative sensitivity reach is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood from published detector data (e.g. XENONnT/PandaX-4T electron-recoil and delayed-coincidence datasets) including a detector response and timing model for the multi-component topology, packaged as a Poisson/profile likelihood over (m_chi, Lambda_CC).

members.model_name: Dark-photon-mediated inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: No packaged XENON1T electronic-recoil spectral likelihood or dark-photon laboratory/cosmology exclusion likelihood is available in the card (likelihood_available partial/no); both the signal-region fit and the viability bounds were not rerun.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D complex vector dark matter with electromagnetic multipole moments
members.description: Experiment-specific likelihoods and efficiency tables for XENON1T, SuperCDMS, PICO-60, and CRESST-III are not bundled with the route, so exclusion contours can only be reproduced approximately from digitized 90% C.L. curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published efficiency curves and exposures into binned Poisson likelihoods for the four experiments and validate against the paper's XENON1T and CRESST-III limit curves before scanning model parameters.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inert scalar dark matter with Z2-odd vector-like quarks
members.description: No statistical likelihoods are implemented for any of the card's constraints (likelihood_available is 'no' for the HL-LHC FCNC sensitivity, XENON1T SI limit, and Higgs signal strengths); comparisons are single-number limit checks requiring manual recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the analytic sigma_SI into DDCalc for a proper XENON1T likelihood, encode the quoted ATLAS/CMS/HL-LHC rare-top BR sensitivity tables as a simple Gaussian/Poisson likelihood, and use Lilith or HiggsSignals for the Higgs signal-strength constraint.

members.model_name: SU(6)/SO(6) composite pNGB singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood exists for the spin-independent pNGB-nucleon cross section; only phenomenology-level bound comparisons are available, including the momentum-suppressed shift-symmetric regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from C_hS and f using standard nucleon matrix elements and wire it into DDCalc-style likelihoods for LZ/XENONnT, including the derivative-portal momentum suppression of the pNGB coupling.

members.model_name: Dark-sector seeded Nelson-Barr scalar WIMP
members.description: No machine-readable LZ/XENONnT/DARWIN likelihood or digitized exclusion contour is attached for the sigma_SI recast; the paper's direct-detection comparison exists only as an undigitized figure.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model's sigma_SI output to DDCalc (or digitized LZ 2022 and projected XENONnT/DARWIN curves) to produce reproducible pass/fail limits over (m_eta1, portal couplings).

members.model_name: Type-II radiative scalar triplet dark matter with vector-like lepton doublets
members.description: No reusable XENONnT solar-neutrino electron-recoil likelihood for transition magnetic moments is available: the paper's chi-square analysis, including solar flux, oscillation, detector efficiency, and energy-smearing assumptions, is not released as code, so the mu_alpha_beta bounds cannot be recomputed or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the XENONnT electron-recoil binned likelihood (published efficiency and resolution curves, B8/Be7/pp solar fluxes with standard oscillation probabilities) as an open module, e.g. within a direct-detection likelihood framework, exposing transition magnetic moments mu_e_mu, mu_e_tau, mu_mu_tau as inputs.

members.model_name: Type-II seesaw asymmetric Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The Higgs-portal parameter space (alpha, lambda_DM, M_h2 at M_chi=7.76 GeV) has only 2019-era LUX/XENON and LHC Higgs contours; no recast against current XENONnT/LZ spin-independent limits and updated Higgs invisible-width/signal-strength measurements exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI and Br_inv from the mixed-scalar couplings and recast with public likelihoods (e.g. DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT and Lilith or HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds for the Higgs sector), reproducing the source's allowed white region as validation.

members.model_name: Composite Inelastic Dark Matter
members.description: No reconstructed DAMA annual-modulation likelihood exists for the CiDM fit, and the XENON10 high-recoil constraint is available only as a published exclusion contour rather than a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Hypercharge Impure Split Dirac Supersymmetry Higgsino dark matter
members.description: No detector-level inelastic direct-detection likelihood for the pseudo-Dirac Higgsino: existing xenon recast codes implement elastic kinematics, so the delta m ~ 200-250 keV inelastic threshold suppression (velocity integral over the upscattering-allowed tail, detector recoil threshold below ~50 keVnr) cannot be evaluated quantitatively against current xenon data.

members.model_name: S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with degenerate CP-even inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No digitized direct-detection likelihood with component-fraction scaling is available: the LUX/XENON comparison is read from the source figure and the recast assumption that recoil rates scale with the local H2^0/H3^0 fractions is not implemented anywhere.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a two-component recoil-rate recast that weights each component's sigma_SI by its relic fraction and feeds it into DDCalc or digitized xenon-experiment likelihood curves, registered against con_degenerate_direct_detection.

members.model_name: Fermionic U(1)_X dark matter with Higgs charge and kinetic mixing
members.description: The direct-detection comparison is a limit-curve overlay: no xenon (LZ/XENONnT) likelihood is wired to the model's isospin-violating sigma_SI prediction (likelihood_available: partial, recasting_needed: yes), so the tuned proton/neutron cancellation region cannot be statistically assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model's per-nucleon couplings (f_p != f_n) to a public direct-detection likelihood package such as DDCalc, which handles isospin-violating couplings, and rerun the epsilon-q_H scan with the current LZ/XENONnT exposures.

members.model_name: U(1)_X three-Higgs-doublet neutral fermion dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is available for the spin-dependent Z-prime scattering signal: the card's only comparison is the 2012-era Xenon100 limit, and modern spin-dependent xenon likelihoods (LZ, XENONnT) have not been recast onto this model's (M_DM, M_Zprime, g_X) parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's sigma_SD onto current published spin-dependent limits using DDCalc (or the LZ/XENONnT public likelihood tables), driven by the sigma_SD output of the gap_1 scanner.

members.model_name: Spin-3/2 effective dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection exclusions rest on XENON100/CDMS-era limits with no likelihood; no recast of the operator-dependent SI and SD cross sections onto modern xenon exposures (LZ, XENONnT) exists for this model's (M, G_i^f, operator) parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Map each operator's nonrelativistic nucleon response onto DDCalc/current LZ and XENONnT likelihoods, reproducing the paper's XENON100 exclusion of flavor-universal operators 5 and 9 as a validation test.

members.model_name: U(1)' extra doublet neutral fermion cold dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is available for the doublet candidate's gauge-mediated spin-independent scattering: the card relies on a rescaled 2011 XENON100 limit (likelihood_available: no) and modern xenon limits were never applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z'- and Z-mediated nucleon cross section in a public direct-detection recast tool such as DDCalc and evaluate against current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, checking the strong Z-exchange bound on an unsplit electroweak doublet.

members.model_name: TeV-scale electroweak multiplet gauge-portal dark matter for Higgs stability
members.description: No ready direct-detection likelihood recast exists for this model family: the loop-level gauge-mediated spin-independent cross section and the lambda_eff Higgs-portal contribution for each candidate multiplet have not been assembled into a current-experiment likelihood pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI per representation (loop-level electroweak plus lambda_eff portal terms) and evaluate against current xenon-experiment limits through a public likelihood tool such as DDCalc, scanning (M_EW, n, Y, lambda_eff).

members.model_name: Scale-free electroweak-baryogenesis singlino dark matter
members.description: The Higgs-resonant singlino region is only checked against paper-era direct-detection prospects (XENON1T testability); no current-generation (LZ/XENONnT) direct-detection recast or likelihood is attached, although the SI cross section itself is analytic.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from the lambda_eff h s s coupling with standard nuclear form factors and compare the (m_s ~ 60 GeV, lambda_eff ~ 0.01) region against published LZ/XENONnT limit curves, optionally via a public direct-detection likelihood package.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal self-interacting dark matter with light scalar mediator
members.description: Direct-detection exclusion of the light-mediator scenario is only partially available: existing LUX/SuperCDMS-style limits assume contact interactions, and no recast with the q^2-dependent light-scalar propagator plus detector efficiency and threshold curves exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DDCalc (or an NREFT framework such as DirectDM+DMFormFactor) with the light-mediator momentum-dependent cross section and published efficiency/threshold curves for current xenon and low-threshold experiments, producing likelihoods in (m_X, m_phi, portal mixing).

members.model_name: Unitarity-consistent spin-1 s-channel Dirac dark matter model
members.description: No implemented statistical recast combines mono-W, monojet, and dijet LHC signal regions with the isospin-violating direct-detection amplitude for this model; the card marks collider and direct-detection likelihoods as not run and the collider likelihood as only partially available, with mono-W signal regions absent from standard recast suites.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS mono-W (hadronic and leptonic) signal regions in a public recast framework such as MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE alongside existing monojet/dijet analyses, and couple the resulting collider likelihood to a direct-detection likelihood evaluated with the model's isospin-violating nucleon couplings for a combined exclusion.

members.model_name: vector-like sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is available for this model: only the original LUX limit curve was used, and the inelastic-splitting suppression of Z exchange requires kinematics beyond a standard elastic SI recast against modern xenon data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Higgs-mediated elastic SI cross section through DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT data, and add an inelastic-DM rate calculation (minimum-velocity shift for Delta m_snu ~ 100 keV) to verify Z-exchange suppression against the same datasets.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1) vector-like quark model with inert scalar dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection constraint uses only the outdated LUX upper limit as a hard cut; no modern (LZ/XENONnT-era) likelihood recast of the loop-induced Z-prime spin-independent scattering exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the loop-induced sigma_SI prediction through DDCalc (or the experiments' published likelihoods) for current LZ/XENONnT exposures, replacing the fixed 2.2e-46 cm^2 LUX cut.

members.model_name: Kinetically mixed L_mu-L_tau Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: Xenon direct-detection limits are published assuming equal proton/neutron couplings, while the kinetic-mixing-induced Z/Z' couplings here are isospin-violating; the card flags this normalization issue and records likelihood_available: no, so no likelihood correctly maps the model's sigma_SI onto XENON1T/XENONnT/DARWIN curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Use DDCalc (or an equivalent xenon likelihood package) with the model's per-nucleon couplings f_p and f_n computed from the mixed Z/Z' vertices, rather than rescaled published sigma_SI curves, and package this as a reusable likelihood for the scan.

members.model_name: Neutral-current fermionic absorption dark matter
members.description: No detector-level likelihood is interfaced for the absorption line signatures: nuclear-recoil constraints exist only as projected sensitivity curves, and the PandaX-4T electron-recoil constraint is available only as a published recast without a reusable likelihood, so limits on Lambda_NC cannot be recomputed for new parameter points or combined across targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Build simplified Poisson/binned likelihoods from public data releases (PandaX-4T low-energy electron recoils; xenon/argon nuclear-recoil efficiency and background tables) for a monoenergetic deposit at the m_chi-set energy, and package them as registry likelihood modules keyed to (m_chi, Lambda_NC).

members.model_name: Low-mass weakly coupled B-L gauge boson Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No ready direct-detection likelihood handles the light-Z_BL regime: the card flags that below the recoil-momentum scale the contact approximation fails, and likelihood_available is unknown for the XENON1T/DarkSide-50/LUX/PandaX-II constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc) with the M_ZBL-dependent propagator form factor (1/(q^2 + M_ZBL^2))^2 and recast the published XENON1T, DarkSide-50, LUX, and PandaX-II limits onto the (g_BL g_chi, M_ZBL, m_chi) space.

members.model_name: Pico-charged particles from dark matter decay
members.description: No XENON1T electron-recoil likelihood exists for the relativistic pico-charged C scattering spectrum, so the bound f < 1.5e-6 (and its sensitivity to the lowest energy bin) cannot be reproduced or updated with XENONnT data.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model I Higgs-coupled Majorana WIMP
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood is implemented for the tree-level Higgs-mediated sigma_SI (likelihood_available is 'no'; the paper only summarizes limit curves), so the direct-detection constraint is a by-eye limit comparison rather than a statistical recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the analytic Higgs-exchange sigma_SI into DDCalc (or the published LZ/XENONnT likelihoods) to obtain proper exclusion statistics over the m_DM and y_1H, y_2H benchmark plane.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV hadrophilic UV freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast pipeline exists for the sub-GeV hadrophilic nuclear-recoil predictions: current flagship direct-detection likelihoods lose sensitivity below ~10 GeV and the future low-threshold targets (1e-45 to 1e-43 cm^2) are only projection curves, not evaluable statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a low-threshold detector recast (e.g. via a DDCalc-style extension with sub-GeV nuclear-recoil response and Migdal channels for existing data, plus parameterized sensitivity curves for proposed kg-year experiments) mapped to the model's sigma_chi-n after relic matching.

members.model_name: SU(6)/Sp(6) composite pNGB complex singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood exists for the spin-independent complex-pNGB-nucleon cross section; only phenomenology-level bound comparisons are available, including the momentum-suppressed shift-symmetric regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_SI from C_hS and f using standard nucleon matrix elements and wire it into DDCalc-style likelihoods for LZ/XENONnT, including the derivative-portal momentum suppression of the pNGB coupling.

members.model_name: Low-reheating dark-photon freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable direct-detection likelihoods are wired to this model: electronic-recoil (DAMIC-M, DarkSide, PandaX, SENSEI, XENON1T) and nuclear-recoil (PandaX, XENON1T) constraints are applied as digitized exclusion curves for the ultralight-mediator (1/q^4 form factor) cross section, preventing statistically consistent parameter scans.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published experimental efficiency/exposure data into reusable likelihoods — e.g. implement the light-mediator form factor in DDCalc/obscura-style electron- and nuclear-recoil rate codes and couple them to the released exclusion data of each experiment.

members.model_name: Inelastic vector-exchange isospin-violating dark matter
members.description: No public direct-detection likelihood implements pseudo-Dirac inelastic scattering (delta ~ 5 keV splitting) with the isospin-violating f_p/f_n ~ -1.5 interference of a kinetically mixed Z-prime and a baryonic vector, evaluated consistently across sodium-iodide, germanium, and xenon targets, so neither the DAMA/CoGeNT window nor the XENON10-style inelastic constraint can be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public DD likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc) with inelastic minimum-velocity kinematics and per-nucleon coupling ratios, add the historical DAMA modulation, CoGeNT, and XENON10 datasets plus modern LZ/XENONnT exposures, and rerun the M ~ 8 GeV, delta ~ 5 keV benchmark fit.

members.model_name: Z3 inert doublet-singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: The relic-plus-direct-detection viability step relies on recasting published XENON1T/PandaX-4T/LZ curves; no current xenon-detector likelihood is connected to the model's predicted sigma_SI and relic-fraction rescaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's sigma_SI and Omega-rescaled local density into DDCalc (or the LZ public likelihood) so the direct-detection constraint is evaluated as a likelihood rather than a digitized-curve cut.

members.model_name: Light-smuon GUTc-NMSSM neutralino dark matter
members.description: The exact scan configuration and combined likelihood are not released: the paper's cuts (Omega h^2 < 0.131, 2023 muon g-2 window, LZ/XENONnT acceptance) are applied as tool-level pass/fail selections with no public combined likelihood or input files, so the surviving light-smuon sample cannot be exactly reproduced or reweighted.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the scan as NMSSMTools input files with the quoted GUT-scale ranges and the m_smuon1 < m_stau1 selection, and package the constraint chain as a composite likelihood (e.g. in a GAMBIT- or EasyScan-style wrapper) so the paper's acceptance cuts become reproducible and reweightable.

members.model_name: Thermal leptophilic Majorana dark matter with CP-even scalar mediator
members.description: Existing bounds (LEP, Belle II invisible-scalar searches, muon g-2, electron recoil, NA64-mu) and future projections (M3, FCC-ee Z-pole, TeV muon collider) exist only as non-reusable recast/projection contours; no machine-readable likelihood or efficiency tables for tau/muon-associated missing-energy searches in this model are available.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the paper's exclusion and projection contours into interpolable limit tables as an interim step, and rebuild the key recasts (Belle II tau tau plus missing energy, NA64-mu missing momentum) with published efficiencies in a MadGraph plus Delphes pipeline to produce reusable per-point likelihoods.

members.model_name: Minimal non-SUSY SO(10) scalar 16 dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is a WMAP-era projection with likelihood_available 'no': the predicted TeV-scale sigma_SI floor has never been confronted with modern xenon exclusion likelihoods, so whether the model's most predictive region survives is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the (M_DM, lambda_eff) plane from the updated scan through the analytic Higgs-exchange sigma_SI and evaluate it against public XENONnT/LZ likelihoods via DDCalc, replacing the historical 2e-43 cm^2 lower-bound target with a current allowed/excluded region.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine radiative neutrino mass model with two dark matter components
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood handles the multi-component setup: applying published single-component limits requires rescaling by the neutralino fraction of the local density, and neither the fractions nor a detector likelihood evaluation exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Once component fractions are available from the model implementation, evaluate current xenon-experiment likelihoods via DDCalc with the neutralino scattering rate scaled by Omega_neutralino/Omega_DM, treating the leptophilic N_1 component as negligible for nuclear recoils.

members.model_name: Indirect fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: Only XENON100-era direct-detection limits and pre-precision Higgs data back the card's constraints (likelihood_available is approximate for both), so the indirect-portal viability region has no modern LZ/XENONnT direct-detection or Higgs signal-strength/invisible-width likelihood attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Higgs-mixing-suppressed spin-independent cross section against current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods via DDCalc, and apply HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals (or Lilith) to the mixing angle and any exotic Higgs decays to update the allowed region.

members.model_name: Resonant scalar fermionic Higgs portal dark matter
members.description: The card's constraints use XENON100-era direct-detection bounds and early 2012 Higgs-signal information with only approximate likelihoods, so no modern Higgs invisible-branching likelihood or LZ/XENONnT direct-detection likelihood is attached to the narrow resonant allowed region, which is precisely the region most sensitive to such updates.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply current ATLAS/CMS Higgs invisible-width limits via HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals to BR(h -> chi chi) below threshold, and recast the mixing-suppressed spin-independent cross section against LZ/XENONnT likelihoods with DDCalc to re-derive the surviving resonance window.

members.model_name: Scotogenic inverse seesaw scalar dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the combined Higgs-invisible-width plus xenon direct-detection selection: the card carries only the 2013 LUX minimum upper limit (7.6e-46 cm^2 at 33 GeV) and a quoted invisible-width bound, with no digitized curves to exclude arbitrary (m_S, lambda_hS) points or to update to current exposures.
members.proposed_resolution: Attach DDCalc (or digitized LUX/XENON1T/LZ likelihoods) for the sigma_SI limit and a public Higgs invisible-width likelihood (Lilith or HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds) to con_scotogenic_higgs_invisible_lux_window, so the allowed Higgs-portal window can be recomputed with current data.

members.model_name: Multicomponent OHe and UU dark atoms
members.description: No DAMA/LIBRA annual-modulation likelihood exists for the OHe radiative-capture signal (few-keV sodium capture), nor a recast framework mapping OHe capture rates onto CDMS/XENON/LUX null results for slowed composite atoms.
members.proposed_resolution: Once capture-rate tables exist (gap_1), implement a detector-level modulation likelihood for DAMA NaI and a temperature-dependent capture recast for cryogenic and xenon experiments, extending an existing direct-detection framework such as DDCalc with a capture-signal channel.

members.model_name: High-scale SUSY light neutral higgsino dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection observable has no experiment likelihood attached: the suppressed SI/SD cross sections are computed analytically but only compared qualitatively to then-current experiments, with no modern (LZ/XENONnT-era) statistical comparison including the neutrino fog.
members.proposed_resolution: Attach a DDCalc-style implementation of current LZ/XENONnT SI and SD likelihoods to the analytic mixing-suppressed cross sections over (mu, M1, M2), reporting exclusion versus neutrino-fog-limited reach.

members.model_name: Bino-right-handed-sbottom co-annihilation model
members.description: The combined LHC compressed-sbottom plus direct-detection constraint has no implemented likelihood: exclusions depend on experiment-specific acceptance maps for near-degenerate spectra (likelihood_available: partial, recasting_needed: yes), so the interplay region near the neutrino floor cannot be evaluated statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC Run 2 compressed-spectrum sbottom searches with CheckMATE or SModelS using the published efficiency maps for small mass splittings, and combine with a DDCalc-based spin-independent likelihood for the loop-induced bino-nucleon cross section into one joint likelihood over (m_X, Delta m).

members.model_name: Bino-right-handed-stop co-annihilation model
members.description: The combined LHC compressed-stop plus direct-detection constraint has no implemented likelihood: exclusions depend on experiment-specific acceptance maps for near-degenerate stop-bino spectra (likelihood_available: partial, recasting_needed: yes), so the interplay region near the neutrino floor cannot be evaluated statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC Run 2 compressed-spectrum stop searches (soft-lepton, monojet, and four-body decay channels) with CheckMATE or SModelS using published small-splitting efficiency maps, and combine with a DDCalc-based spin-independent likelihood into one joint likelihood over (m_X, Delta m).

members.model_name: Charged leptophilic dark electron model
members.description: The laboratory recast step has no likelihoods: the magnetic-moment-induced direct-detection estimate is order-of-magnitude only (no LUX/XENON detector likelihood for the loop-induced coupling) and no LEP/ILC collider recast exists for the charged scalar and dark electron.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-induced magnetic-moment scattering cross section and recast it through public direct-detection likelihoods (e.g. DDCalc with LUX/XENON data), and implement the charged-scalar pair-production channel in a collider recast framework for LEP limits and ILC projections.

members.model_name: Hadrophilic scalar-mediator sequential freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No packaged direct-detection recast handles the light hadrophilic scalar's momentum-dependent (long-range) DM-nucleon cross section; published XENON1T likelihoods and standard recast tools assume contact interactions, so the m_phi-dependent recoil spectrum must be redone by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing direct-detection recast code (e.g. DDCalc) with the 1/(q^2 + m_phi^2)^2 propagator form factor and the paper's scalar-nucleon/pion low-energy matching, exposing (m_chi, m_phi, y_q y_chi) as inputs against XENON1T and CRESST-style likelihoods.

members.model_name: Z3 leptophilic complex scalar dark matter with vector-like lepton mediator
members.description: Direct-detection exclusions rely on comparing the one-loop charge-radius and tree-level Higgs-portal cross sections to published XENON1T upper limits; no detector likelihood is applied (likelihood_available: no), so combined scans and boundary shifts cannot be evaluated properly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the loop-induced charge-radius operator coefficient C(m_e, m_VLL) and the lambda_SH Higgs-portal amplitude as effective couplings in DDCalc (or the public XENON1T/LZ likelihood) to obtain a proper Poisson likelihood over the (m_S, m_VLL, g, lambda_SH) space.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen flavon-portal right-handed-neutrino freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood exists for the flavor and direct-detection constraints: the B-meson-mixing bound v_phi*m_a > ~1.8e5 GeV^2 is only a source-level exclusion tied to one FN charge texture, and con_direct_future has at best a partial likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the flavon contribution to B_d/B_s mixing in a public flavor code (e.g. flavio or smelli) parameterized by the FN charges, and wrap published XENON/LZ spin-dependent limits as a likelihood over (m_N1, sigma_SD), validating against the quoted v_phi*m_a bound.

members.model_name: Light exothermic inelastic dark matter with vector mediator
members.description: No public likelihood packages the XENONnT ER and XENON1T S2-only datasets with the efficiencies and background model needed to reproduce the paper's 95% CL contours; the card marks likelihood_available as partial and the detector response as matching-required, so independent recasts of the inelastic limits are only approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned XENONnT-ER plus XENON1T-S2-only likelihood module from the published efficiency curves, exposure, and fixed ER background normalization, and validate it by reproducing the paper's benchmark limits at m_X = 0.1, 1, 10 GeV across delta_m = 1-30 keV.

members.model_name: Thermal right-handed sneutrino dark matter in the F_D-term hybrid inflation model
members.description: Direct-detection constraints are encoded only as paper-era CDMS-II bounds and SuperCDMS/Xenon1T projections (likelihood_available no, recasting_needed yes); no current-generation likelihood (LZ/XENONnT era) is attached to evaluate the surviving Higgs-pole region.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model's sigma_SI output to an existing direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT data) over the m_N_LSP-coupling plane.

members.model_name: Elastic scalar-vector isospin-violating dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood covering both the historical DAMA/CoGeNT low-mass region and modern xenon/germanium exclusions with free isospin ratio f_p/f_n is available for this model, so the constraint entries can only be checked against 2011-era published contours.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the isospin-violating elastic SI recoil spectrum in DDCalc (or a comparable public DD likelihood package), include current LZ/XENONnT/SuperCDMS datasets alongside the historical DAMA modulation and CoGeNT spectra, and rerun the low-mass fit with modern quenching and threshold treatments.

members.model_name: Fermionic Higgs-portal dark matter with singlet-scalar inflation
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is frozen at a LUX-era xenon bound with no machine-readable likelihood; current LZ/XENONnT results, which dominate the viable resonance regions, are not recast for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Score sigma_SI(m_chi) against current xenon exposures with a public direct-detection likelihood package (DDCalc-type), including the standard nucleon-matrix-element uncertainties the paper fixes.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal fermionic dark matter with a light scalar mediator in neutron-star matter
members.description: No joint likelihood pipeline exists to confront the admixed-star predictions with GW170817 tidal-deformability posteriors, NICER radius measurements, and massive-pulsar mass constraints (card: likelihood_available partial), nor a recast of the same Higgs-portal couplings onto direct-detection, rare-meson, beam-dump, and supernova-cooling limits (likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood layer that ingests public GW170817 posterior samples and NICER PSR J0030/J0740 posteriors over the model's (m_chi, k_F^DM, EoS-parameter) space, and separately map (m_phi, y_phi, g_phiNN) onto existing light-scalar Higgs-portal exclusion compilations (e.g. the 1512.04119-style benchmark limits) to close the direct-search recast.

members.model_name: Light scalar mediator freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No experiment-specific low-threshold direct-detection likelihood (target response, efficiency, backgrounds) is available for the light-scalar-mediator recoil signal, so only approximate curve-overlay recasts of the electron/low-threshold channel are possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap public low-threshold electron-recoil data and response models (e.g. DarkELF/QEDark-style target responses for semiconductor and noble-liquid targets) into a likelihood layer that accepts the light-mediator (1/q^2-enhanced) recoil spectrum and returns exclusions or projected reach.

members.model_name: Extended DM EFT with fermionic singlet DM
members.description: No LHC recast chain or experiment likelihoods are wired up for this model: the card leaves the monojet/Higgs+MET analyses unselected, ships no cutflows or detector simulation, and marks direct-detection likelihoods (LUX/XENON-style) as not bundled, so quantitative exclusion contours cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the recast pipeline: generate monojet and Higgs+MET signal events from the UFO model with MadGraph plus detector simulation in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 against the relevant ATLAS/CMS MET searches, and couple direct-detection predictions to public xenon likelihoods via DDCalc, enforcing the EFT-validity cut on events with momentum transfer near Lambda.

members.model_name: Vector FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: No direct-detection or collider recast exists for the feeble moduli-portal couplings of the vector FIMP: likelihood_available is no/unknown for all constraints and no recoil or collider rate calculation appears in the read text, so the laboratory observable cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nucleon-level scattering cross section induced by real and axial modulus exchange (via the Higgs and gauge-boson couplings), recast it through public direct-detection likelihoods (e.g. DDCalc against LZ and XENONnT), and map collider null searches onto the (m_X, m_phi, Lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Semi-annihilation boosted dark matter interpretation
members.description: No public XENON1T electronic-recoil likelihood (including event timing for modulation searches) is packaged for the BDM-electron recoil spectrum; the route's comparison step can only reproduce benchmark plots rather than derive statistical allowed regions for (m_BDM, v_BDM, sigma_elec, mediator parameters).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned Poisson likelihood over the released XENON1T SR1 ER spectrum with the published background model and detector response, adding a time-binned extension of the same likelihood to test the predicted daily modulation.

members.model_name: Scalar-contact inelastic scalar dark matter EFT
members.description: No public likelihood is identified for exothermic inelastic DM-electron scattering in the XENON1T electron-recoil data for this model (constraint likelihood_available unknown), so the preferred (m_X, delta, Lambda_S) region cannot be independently re-derived or updated to XENONnT/LZ data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an electron-recoil recast using the published XENON1T (and XENONnT/LZ) efficiency and energy-resolution curves, extending existing DM-electron scattering rate tools (e.g. QEDark/DarkELF-style atomic response plus detector smearing) to the exothermic delta ~ 2.8 keV kinematics, and fit as a binned Poisson likelihood.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_I with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood implements the subcomponent-rescaled LZ direct-detection constraint for the B_I Higgsino-like LSP: the card records likelihood_available as partial, and the xi_LSP ~ 0.058 rescaling of sigma_SI against the LZ bound is done only by reading published limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public LZ spin-independent likelihood (e.g. the DDCalc implementation) into the recast chain with an explicit Omega_LSP/Omega_DM rescaling of the local density, so the mu-dependent benchmark points can be tested quantitatively rather than against digitized exclusion curves.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_II with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood implements the subcomponent-rescaled LZ direct-detection constraint for the B_II Higgsino-like LSP: the card records likelihood_available as partial, and the xi_LSP ~ 0.058 rescaling of sigma_SI against the LZ bound is done only by reading published limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public LZ spin-independent likelihood (e.g. the DDCalc implementation) into the recast chain with an explicit Omega_LSP/Omega_DM rescaling of the local density, so the mu-dependent benchmark points can be tested quantitatively rather than against digitized exclusion curves.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_III with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood implements the subcomponent-rescaled LZ direct-detection constraint for the B_III Higgsino-like LSP: the card records likelihood_available as partial, and the xi_LSP ~ 0.058 rescaling of sigma_SI against the LZ bound is done only by reading published limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the public LZ spin-independent likelihood (e.g. the DDCalc implementation) into the recast chain with an explicit Omega_LSP/Omega_DM rescaling of the local density, so the mu-dependent benchmark points can be tested quantitatively rather than against digitized exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Extended DM EFT with scalar singlet DM
members.description: No LHC recast chain or experiment likelihoods are wired up: the monojet/Higgs+MET analyses are unselected with no cutflows or detector simulation, and LUX/XENON-style direct-detection likelihoods are not bundled, so quantitative exclusions on (m_phi_s, m_S, Lambda, couplings) cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate monojet and Higgs+MET events from the UFO model with MadGraph and recast against ATLAS/CMS MET searches in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, and attach public xenon-experiment likelihoods via DDCalc, enforcing the EFT-validity cut for events with momentum transfer near Lambda.

members.model_name: Vector-contact inelastic scalar dark matter EFT
members.description: No public likelihood is identified for exothermic inelastic DM-electron scattering in the XENON1T electron-recoil data for this model (constraint likelihood_available unknown), so the preferred (m_X, delta, Lambda_V) region cannot be independently re-derived or updated to XENONnT/LZ data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an electron-recoil recast using the published XENON1T (and XENONnT/LZ) efficiency and energy-resolution curves, extending existing DM-electron scattering rate tools (e.g. QEDark/DarkELF-style atomic response plus detector smearing) to the exothermic delta ~ 2.8 keV kinematics with vector-current couplings, and fit as a binned Poisson likelihood.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal FIMP freeze-in during reheating
members.description: No direct-detection or collider recast exists for the feebly coupled spin-2 portal: likelihood_available is no/unknown for every constraint and no benchmark cross-section or detector-response table was found, so the laboratory observable cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nuclear-recoil cross section from the massive spin-2 stress-energy coupling to quarks and gluons, recast it through public direct-detection likelihoods (e.g. DDCalc against LZ and XENONnT), and map collider missing-energy limits onto the (m_X, m_h, Lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu Z2 real scalar dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection constraint is a quoted paper-era LUX exclusion line (sigma_p = 1.8e-9 pb, likelihood_available no); no current LZ/XENONnT likelihood for the Higgs-portal sigma_p at m_X ~ 130 GeV is implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the tree-level Higgs-exchange sigma_p against current LZ/XENONnT limits through a public likelihood package such as DDCalc to update the bound on lambda_HX.

members.model_name: Model A multicomponent radiative-seesaw dark matter
members.description: The abundance-weighted spin-independent direct-detection constraint exists only as source-era LUX/XENON1T exclusion curves; no current experiment likelihood is wired to the component-fraction-weighted effective cross section sigma_eff.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the per-component scalar-nucleon cross sections and relic fractions from the multicomponent solver into DDCalc with current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, summing component contributions to the recoil rate.

members.model_name: Decaying warm majoron dark matter
members.description: The Ly-alpha forest constraint is available only as a 5.3 keV thermal-relic-WDM lower bound (XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE); no public flux-power likelihood or emulator accepts the decaying-warm-majoron transfer function directly, so applying the bound requires an ad hoc thermal-equivalent mapping that the card flags as approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast via a general small-scale-suppression Ly-alpha emulator: evaluate the majoron T(k) from the extended Boltzmann code and pass it through an existing Ly-alpha flux-power emulator framework trained on generalized cutoff shapes (alpha-beta-gamma parameterization), calibrating any decay-induced late-time suppression with a small set of dedicated hydrodynamic or N-body runs.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L Dirac-neutrino two-component fermion dark matter
members.description: The Delta N_eff constraint is applied only as the quoted static bound Delta N_eff <= 0.285 with an analytic decoupling estimate; no pipeline folds the g_BL- and M_ZBL-dependent right-handed-neutrino decoupling into a current CMB+BBN likelihood, which the card flags as a leading constraint that was not updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute T_dec(g_BL, M_ZBL) with momentum-averaged collision rates, map to Delta N_eff via the entropy-dilution relation, and evaluate against the Planck 2018 + BAO (and forecast CMB-S4) N_eff posterior in CLASS/MontePython to replace the fixed 0.285 cut.

members.model_name: Non-canonical asymptotically-flat coth-potential unified dark sector
