members.description: No data-comparison pipeline exists for this potential: the paper is a background demonstration with no likelihood table, and no implemented analysis confronts H(z), distances, and P(k) of the coth-potential UDM with CMB, BAO, SN, and LSS data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the perturbation module exists, wrap the model as a Cobaya theory class and run it against Planck 2018, BAO, and Pantheon+ likelihoods plus a linear P(k)/S8 probe to obtain posteriors on (alpha, M, V0, initial conditions).

members.model_name: Non-canonical cascading step-potential unified dark sector
members.description: No data-comparison pipeline exists for this potential: the paper is a background demonstration with no likelihood table, and no implemented analysis confronts H(z), distances, and P(k) of the cascading-step-potential UDM with CMB, BAO, SN, and LSS data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the perturbation module exists, wrap the model as a Cobaya theory class and run it against Planck 2018, BAO, and Pantheon+ likelihoods plus a linear P(k)/S8 probe to obtain posteriors on (alpha, M, V0, step parameters, initial conditions).

members.model_name: Non-canonical Starobinsky-type unified dark sector
members.description: No end-to-end likelihood pipeline exists that confronts this potential's background split (H(z), Omega_kinetic, Omega_potential) and matter power spectrum with CMB/BAO/SN/LSS data; both card constraints have likelihood_available no/unknown and recasting_needed yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the modified CLASS module exists, wrap it in Cobaya with the standard Planck, BAO (BOSS/eBOSS/DESI), Pantheon+ and matter-power likelihoods, sampling alpha, M, V0, potential-shape parameters, and initial phi/phidot.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino hot dark matter subcomponent in an SU(2)_V W-prime model
members.description: No assembled cosmological likelihood pipeline maps this model's right-handed-neutrino sector (m_nuR, T_f, g_starS, N_nuR) onto current CMB and LSS constraints; the card carries only the paper's rough 60 eV / 10 eV estimates and likelihood_available is 'no' for both cosmological constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the nu_R as an extra ncdm species plus Delta_N_eff in CLASS, wire it to the public Planck 2018 + BAO + full-shape LSS likelihoods in Cobaya/MontePython, and add a thin wrapper translating (m_nuR, T_f, g_starS) into the ncdm temperature and mass inputs.

members.model_name: Unified superfluid dark sector
members.description: No likelihood or MCMC pipeline exists for the model: the card records likelihood_available = no for the background/growth constraint, no covariance for the growth-rate observable, and unknown likelihood status for the cluster-core requirement, so only fiducial-curve comparisons are possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS implementation of gap_1 exists, wire it into MontePython or Cobaya with standard Planck, BAO, and fsigma8/RSD likelihoods to obtain posteriors on the energy gap, coupling scale M, and initial state densities.

members.model_name: Mixed cold plus minimal cannibal dark matter
members.description: No survey likelihood is encoded for the model: the percent-level cannibal fraction and phase-timing targets are paper-level regions, not posteriors, and there is no pipeline comparing the predicted matter-power suppression to CMB, BAO, and weak-lensing S8 data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS cannibal module exists, wire it into Cobaya or MontePython with the standard Planck 2018, BAO, and KiDS/DES S8 likelihoods to turn the paper's target regions into real posterior constraints on (m, S_can, lambda, f_can,0).

members.model_name: Minimal decaying dark matter model for the S8 tension
members.description: No published standalone likelihood or end-to-end pipeline maps the model's particle-physics parameters (Lambda, M, T_rh) through the freeze-in yield and decay width to (tau, epsilon, abundance) and jointly fits CMB+BAO+weak-lensing data; the paper's constraints require manual recasting of related DCDM analyses (card: likelihood_available 'partial', recasting_needed 'yes').
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the operator-to-(tau, epsilon, Omega) mapping as a small parameter-translation module wrapped around the public two-body DCDM CLASS branch inside MontePython or Cobaya, and release the chains/likelihood configuration for Planck+BAO+shear.

members.model_name: Electrically charged massive particle dark matter
members.description: The Planck CMB mass bound (m_Ch > ~1e11 GeV for unit charge) is a spectrum-level comparison, not a packaged likelihood: no pipeline connects the CHAMP-modified spectra to the Planck TT/TE/EE likelihood for reproducible posterior bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the modified Boltzmann solver from gap_1 in an MCMC pipeline (Cobaya or MontePython) against the public Planck 2018 TT/TE/EE likelihood, sampling (m_Ch, q_Ch) alongside LCDM parameters, including the millicharge scaling Gamma/H proportional to q_Ch^2/m_Ch.

members.model_name: GUT-scale supersymmetry with pseudo-Dirac Higgsino dark matter
members.description: The inelastic direct-detection constraint is only a quoted 200 keV splitting threshold from the authors' earlier XENON analysis; no public likelihood evaluates the inelastic pseudo-Dirac Higgsino recoil spectrum against XENON-class data for intermediate splittings.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the XENON1T (and successor LZ/XENONnT) data into a likelihood for inelastic nuclear scattering as a function of Delta m0 and mu, e.g. by adding an inelastic-kinematics recoil spectrum module to DDCalc, replacing the single hard threshold with a smooth exclusion.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone hot-and-cold dark matter
members.description: The motivating hot-component target (Delta N_eff = 0.61 +/- 0.30, m_eff = 0.41 +/- 0.13 eV) is a historical source-era fit with no current likelihood (likelihood_available: no), so the thermal pNG HDM parameter space cannot be judged against present CMB and LSS data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the thermal pNG as a massive ncdm species with its decoupling temperature ratio in CLASS/CAMB and run an MCMC recast against Planck 2018 plus BAO and weak-lensing likelihoods (Cobaya/MontePython) to obtain the current allowed (Delta N_eff, m_eff) region.

members.model_name: Axion condensate dark matter with stimulated photon decays
members.description: No survey-specific likelihood exists for the narrow photon line at E_gamma = m_a/2 from stimulated condensate decay, either against the late-time diffuse radio background or as a CMB-era spectral distortion from the recombination scenario; the card's diffuse-background constraint is only an approximate energy-budget estimate (recasting_needed yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast that maps (m_a, g_a_gamma, f_dm, converted fraction, line width) onto measured radio-background data (ARCADE-2-type absolute-temperature measurements and radio survey line sensitivities) and, for the recombination case, onto COBE/FIRAS-class spectral-distortion limits, including redshift and velocity broadening of the line.

members.model_name: Inelastic Dirac Dark Matter
members.description: Cosmological viability (extra dark radiation, entropy transfer, late annihilation/decay energy injection, supernova cooling) is imposed only through approximate paper recasts; no public likelihood chain covers MeV-GeV inelastic dark sectors with long-lived chi_2.
members.proposed_resolution: Chain existing public codes — AlterBBN/PRIMAT for light-element yields, ExoCLASS/CLASS for CMB energy injection and N_eff — into a likelihood module parameterized by (m_1, m_A_prime, alpha_D, Delta, tau_chi2), and add a documented supernova-cooling bound recast for the dark-photon portal.

members.model_name: Mirror-star dissipative mirror-baryon dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the kinetic-mixing viability check: the supernova-cooling and Delta N_eff bounds for a massless dark photon with a 3-5x heavier mirror electron are only quoted (epsilon < ~1e-9), not implemented against current SN and CMB/BBN data for this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute SN1987A cooling and sector-reheating Delta N_eff for the MTH-like charged mirror spectrum and package the result as an epsilon(m_e') exclusion likelihood usable with Planck/BBN N_eff constraints (e.g. as a CLASS extra-fluid module plus a digitized SN bound).

members.model_name: Purely gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: The CMB isocurvature constraint is applied only as a single quoted upper limit S_DM < 9e-6; there is no likelihood that propagates the model's scale-dependent (potentially blue) dark-matter isocurvature spectrum through a Boltzmann code to Planck data, which the card flags as the way small-scale spectra can evade the large-scale bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the model's isocurvature power spectrum shape from the coherent scalar fluctuations, feed it as a CDM-isocurvature initial condition into CLASS or CAMB, and evaluate against the Planck isocurvature likelihood so the constraint becomes a function of (R_chi, m_chi/H_inf, spectral tilt) rather than a fixed threshold.

members.model_name: Kinetically coupled axion-dilaton fuzzy dark matter model
members.description: No MCMC analysis or likelihood pipeline exists for this model: the paper shows example parameter regions only, so quantitative H0/S8 tension relief and allowed regions for (kinetic-function slope, m_phi, f_phi, F) are not established.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the (re)implemented Boltzmann code to Cobaya or MontePython with Planck 2018, BAO, Pantheon, SH0ES, and DES/KiDS S8 likelihoods and run a full posterior scan over the model parameters, releasing the chains.

members.model_name: R-invariant gauge-mediated gravitino warm dark matter
members.description: No BBN calculation or likelihood exists for the late-decaying x_L with T_decay near 100 MeV; the card states no BBN abundance calculation was run, leaving the entropy-production window unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a late-decay BBN code (AlterBBN or ACROPOLIS-class tooling) over the (m_xL, T_decay, hadronic branching) plane to convert the qualitative BBN-safety benchmark into an actual constraint on Delta and T_decay.

members.model_name: Axion dark matter clump photon-resonance model
members.description: No likelihood connects predicted coherent radio emission or merger-triggered bursts to actual radio surveys: the card lists radio transient/line searches as target likelihoods but no survey selection functions, plasma propagation treatment, or detectability pipeline exists for this signal class.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a detectability pipeline that folds predicted burst luminosities and rates through Galactic plasma dispersion/absorption and the published selection functions of radio transient and spectral-line surveys (CHIME, SKA precursors, FRB catalogs), returning survey-level exclusion or discovery likelihoods.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac split SIMP dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the exothermic down-scattering recoil-line signature in low-threshold detectors: existing sub-GeV electron-scattering tools assume elastic kinematics, and the R_0-weighted exothermic rate for keV-to-GeV masses with splitting-set energy deposition is not implemented in any packaged detector recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a sub-GeV detector-response package (QEdark/DarkELF-class electron-recoil rates plus standard nuclear-recoil codes) to exothermic inelastic kinematics with energy release Delta m, weight by the surviving excited fraction R_0, and confront existing xenon/semiconductor limit data.

members.model_name: Trilinear-augmented gaugino mediation gravitino dark matter
members.description: BBN constraints on the long-lived NLSP (con_bbn_long_lived_particles, likelihood_available: no) have not been computed for this model's spectra: the NLSP freeze-out yield, lifetime, and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions were never fed into a light-element cascade calculation for the assigned benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute NLSP relic yields with micrOMEGAs from the SPheno spectra, derive decay spectra into the gravitino, and evaluate light-element constraints with a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS-type), producing an exclusion in the (tau_NLSP, yield) plane per NLSP class.

members.model_name: Scotogenic type-II seesaw inert-doublet dark matter cogenesis model
members.description: The route carries no direct-detection or LFV likelihoods: the Higgs-exchange elastic scattering limit for each benchmark and the LFV branching-ratio constraints are checked only internally, with no exported likelihood or limit curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Attach DDCalc (XENON1T/LZ) likelihoods to the Higgs-mediated elastic cross section of eta_R and export SPheno/FlavorKit LFV observables against MEG-class bounds as standalone likelihood terms.

members.model_name: S3 symmetric inert dark scalar
members.description: Direct-detection and LHC missing-energy limits are only available as inert-doublet-context recasts; no S3-specific pipeline computes sigma_SI from the SARAH spectrum and confronts it with experimental likelihoods, and the card records likelihood_available partial with recasting_needed yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the existing SARAH/SPheno-to-micrOMEGAs chain to compute sigma_SI for accepted S3 points and evaluate it against LUX/XENON-class likelihoods via DDCalc, and run the same spectra through SModelS or CheckMATE for the inert-scalar LHC missing-energy topologies, replacing the borrowed inert-doublet exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced vector dark matter with neutrino decays
members.description: No CMB/BBN likelihood pipeline exists for this model's time-dependent neutrino injection: the constraint is only a window argument (Delta N_eff at recombination but not at BBN), and no Planck or CMB-S4 likelihood has been run against the actual decay history.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the modified CLASS run from the decay-integrator pipeline into a cobaya or MontePython likelihood using the public Planck 2018 likelihood plus a BBN light-element likelihood (e.g. PArthENoPE/PRIMAT abundances), and add a CMB-S4 Fisher forecast for the target Delta N_eff range.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: The Planck isocurvature constraint is imposed via the quoted beta_iso < 0.038 bound rather than by computing the model's scale-dependent isocurvature spectrum and passing it through the Planck likelihood, so the xi lower boundary of the allowed region is only approximate (likelihood_available: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the spectator isocurvature power spectrum from the same mode functions, add it as a CDI-type component in CLASS, and evaluate the actual Planck (or Planck+ACT/SPT) isocurvature likelihood over the (m_chi, xi, H_end) plane instead of applying the scale-independent beta_iso cut.

members.model_name: Dark proton-pion asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: No likelihood exists for the two-component direct-detection signal: the combined dark-proton plus charged-pion recoil spectrum through dark-photon exchange is not encoded against low-mass detector analyses, and dark-photon portal exclusions are read from plots rather than tabulated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood summing the p' and pi'^- recoil contributions (weighted by their equal number densities) against XENON1T-class low-mass analyses, combined with tabulated dark-photon search, supernova, and BBN bounds over (epsilon, m_dark_photon, m_pprime, m_pionprime).

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar Co-SIMP dark matter
members.description: No BBN/CMB likelihood exists for the late-thermalizing sub-MeV dark sector populated by a late phase transition: the card's cosmological constraint has likelihood_available = no and the viability flag is only an approximate criterion on (T_pt, m_phi, Delta N_eff).
members.proposed_resolution: Model the entropy and radiation transfer of the late phase transition and Co-SIMP thermal contact as time-dependent (N_eff, injection) histories, evaluate light-element yields with a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS and CMB response with CLASS, and package the result as a likelihood over (m_phi, T_pt).

members.model_name: Axion-axino dark matter with gravitino-sourced dark radiation
members.description: The dark-radiation constraint on T_R rests on WMAP/ACT/SPT-era N_eff numbers quoted in the 2011 paper; no modern Planck/BAO Delta N_eff likelihood recast has been run for this model, so the quoted 5-sigma exclusion at T_R above about 9e10 GeV is stale.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the paper's analytic Delta N_eff(T_R, m_3/2, m_gluino) formula into a Cobaya or MontePython pipeline with the Planck 2018 plus BAO likelihoods (Delta N_eff as a derived parameter of CLASS/CAMB) and re-derive the T_R upper bound and the leptogenesis-compatibility window.

members.model_name: SU(2)_X hidden-sector vector and monopole dark matter with Higgs portal
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood exists for the two-scalar interference scattering (likelihood_available: no); only 2013-era XENON100/LUX curves are cited, so modern exclusion status in the (m_V, theta, m_phi) space cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current LZ/XENONnT limits with a public direct-detection likelihood (DDCalc-class) using the source's H1/H2-interference sigma_p formula, scanning the scalar spectrum including the destructive-interference region.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated low-energy SUSY with light gravitino dark matter component
members.description: The cosmological gravitino constraint is used only as a quoted pass/fail bound (m_3/2 < 4.7 eV); no CMB-lensing plus cosmic-shear likelihood is wired up that treats the eV gravitino as a thermal hot-relic subcomponent of this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a thermal light-gravitino species (analogous to a massive-neutrino-like component with its own temperature) to CLASS/CAMB and couple it to existing Planck lensing and cosmic-shear likelihoods in Cobaya/MontePython, reproducing the published 4.7 eV bound as a validation test.

members.model_name: Decaying gravitino dark matter with right-handed-neutrino decay products
members.description: The S8/matter-power preference is imported from a phenomenological 2-body DDM fit; no CMB+BAO+SNIa+S8 MCMC has been run directly in the gravitino parameter basis (m_3/2, mass splitting, T_RH, m_gluino) with the particle-physics priors (relic density, BBN spectrum conditions) imposed jointly.
members.proposed_resolution: Reparameterize the public 2-body-decay modified CLASS (DDM branch of 2008.09615) in terms of (m_3/2, m1/m_3/2, T_RH, m_gluino) via the analytic decay-width and relic maps, and run MontePython/Cobaya against Planck, BAO, SNIa, and weak-lensing S8 data with the BBN and relic-density conditions as priors.

members.model_name: Multi Scalar Field Dark Matter
members.description: The paper's modified MontePython likelihood stack and chains are not confirmed public (only the modified CLASS repository is linked), so reproducing the quoted single- and two-field mass bounds or extending them to new data requires rebuilding the sampling setup, priors, and Ly-alpha treatment from the paper description.
members.proposed_resolution: Reassemble and publicly archive the MontePython configuration coupling two_sfdm_class to the Planck 2018, BAO, BBN, Ly-alpha, and SNe likelihoods with the paper's priors, validating against the quoted 95 percent lower bounds (log10(m/eV) around -21.9 single-field, -22.1 two-field).

members.model_name: Kinetic-misalignment majoron dark matter in gauged U(1)Lmu-Ltau
members.description: No dedicated CMB/BAO likelihood exists for dark matter decaying invisibly to neutrinos in this model: the constraint is applied only as a quoted generic tau > 250 Gyr bound, with no pipeline mapping (m_J, f, sum m_nu^2) through tau_J into a Planck/BOSS decaying-DM likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with DM decay to massless/neutrino dark radiation (as in the cited 2203.07440-type analyses), wire it to Planck and BOSS likelihoods in MontePython or Cobaya, and rerun the constraint as a function of tau_J for the majoron benchmark instead of reusing the generic quoted bound.

members.model_name: Dark matter from early decays
members.description: No BBN/CMB-spectral-distortion energy-injection pipeline is attached for the visible branching fraction of the parent decay, so the con_decay_bbn_cmb_reionization consistency region is only transcribed from related gravitino-LSP literature (likelihood_available 'no').
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the model's (tau, parent abundance, B_vis) with existing public injection codes for electromagnetic/hadronic decays during and after BBN (ACROPOLIS/AlterBBN-class BBN networks plus COBE/FIRAS mu- and y-distortion limits) to produce an in-registry exclusion on the visible branching fraction.

members.model_name: Vector-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No numerical BBN/CMB spectral-distortion likelihood is attached for the electromagnetic energy injected by the W_mu parent decay: the tau_X < 10^4 s and energy-release limits are used qualitatively and graphically from the primary paper, with no public likelihood table for this model's photon-injection history.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the (tau_X, zeta) energy-injection recast with a public BBN code with electromagnetic injection (e.g. an AlterBBN/PRIMAT-class calculation) plus COBE/FIRAS mu- and y-distortion limits, parameterized by the parent lifetime and injected photon energy fraction, and expose it as a reusable likelihood on the lifetime-energy plane.

members.model_name: Dark neutron asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the GeV-scale dark-neutron search program: the XENON1T bound is a paper-level adjusted limit (sigma_nprime_p < 4.4e-39 cm^2 at 1.33 GeV) and the dark-photon epsilon versus mass exclusions are read off plots rather than encoded, preventing combined parameter-space scans.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood combining low-mass direct-detection limits (XENON1T-class analyses for a magnetic-moment plus dark-photon-exchange cross section) with tabulated dark-photon beam-dump, supernova, and BBN bounds over (epsilon, m_dark_photon, m_nprime).

members.model_name: 331_R keV sterile-neutrino mixed warm-hot dark matter
members.description: The CMB Delta N_eff bound on the hot nonthermal N1 fraction is applied only as a rough exclusion; no likelihood connecting (alpha, f_NT) to Delta N_eff and the CMB data is provided (con_cmb_alpha has likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive Delta N_eff(alpha, m_N2, T_RH) from the model's decay kinematics and evaluate it against the Planck Delta N_eff likelihood (e.g. via a CLASS + MontePython/Cobaya pipeline), replacing the qualitative alpha > 0 statement with a quantitative posterior.

members.model_name: Fermion-parent non-thermal fermion WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No numerical BBN/CMB spectral-distortion likelihood is attached for the electromagnetic energy injected by the parent decay: the tau_X < 10^4 s and energy-release limits are used qualitatively and graphically from the primary paper, with no public likelihood table for this model's photon-injection history.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the (tau_X, zeta) energy-injection recast with a public BBN code with electromagnetic injection (e.g. an AlterBBN/PRIMAT-class calculation) plus COBE/FIRAS mu- and y-distortion limits, parameterized by the parent lifetime and injected photon energy fraction, and expose it as a reusable likelihood on the lifetime-energy plane.

members.model_name: Decay-product hot dark matter
members.description: No CMB/LSS likelihood analysis exists for the decay-product HDM parameterization; both card constraints have likelihood_available=no, so whether current data can distinguish the model from a thermal sterile neutrino via higher distribution moments is untested.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS ncdm implementation exists, run MCMC fits with public Planck + BAO (and optionally full-shape LSS) likelihoods via Cobaya or MontePython over (mother mass, yield, tau, B_hdm, epsilon/x_2), and forecast future-survey sensitivity to the skewness difference.

members.model_name: Milli-eV scalar dark matter decaying to dark photons
members.description: The FIRAS and low-frequency radio-background constraint on the distorted CMB Rayleigh-Jeans tail is applied only qualitatively: the card records no numerical FIRAS likelihood and notes that absolute low-frequency measurements (ARCADE-2-class data) have large uncertainties, so the viable (m_A', epsilon) window cannot be delimited quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a spectral-distortion likelihood from the public FIRAS monopole residuals plus low-frequency absolute radiometry (ARCADE-2 and long-wavelength surveys), evaluated on the model's converted-photon intensity as a function of x, and use it to map the excluded versus viable (m_A', epsilon, abundance) region.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal dark monopole dark matter
members.description: No multi-scatter direct-detection likelihood exists for macroscopic Higgs-portal monopole transits; XENON1T-style single-hit limits do not apply once the expected number of scatters per crossing exceeds order unity.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Monte Carlo transit simulation with XENON-class detector geometry, energy thresholds, and trigger/deadtime modeling for track-like multi-hit events, following existing multiscatter dark-matter analyses, and release it as a recastable likelihood parameterized by (M, R, sigma_A, local flux).

members.model_name: Decaying warm dark matter to invisible radiation
members.description: No nonlinear-LSS likelihood exists for the warm decaying mother species itself; existing BOSS EFTofLSS limits apply to cold-parent two-body decaying dark matter and require an unvalidated model mapping.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the DWDM transfer functions to an EFTofLSS pipeline (CLASS-PT or PyBird with the BOSS DR12 likelihood) so the warm-mother momentum distribution enters directly instead of mapping onto cold-parent DDM parameters.

members.model_name: Mass-varying dark matter with rapid mass turn-on
members.description: No dedicated Ly-alpha forest likelihood exists for the MVDM suppression shape: the primary bound relies on an extracted linear P(k) under a fiducial cosmology, and thermal-WDM limits are only an approximate recast because the MVDM transfer function differs in shape from thermal WDM at fixed M/T.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast MVDM transfer functions through an existing hydro-calibrated Ly-alpha flux-power emulator built for generalized small-scale suppressions (e.g. the WDM/nCDM alpha-beta-gamma transfer-function parameterizations used with eBOSS/XQ-100/HIRES-MIKE emulators), fitting the emulator's suppression parameters to the MVDM P(k) over the M/T-z_t plane; where the shape falls outside the emulator's training space, run a small set of dedicated hydrodynamical simulations.

members.model_name: Hidden-charged dark matter with chiral dark radiation
members.description: No CMB+H0 likelihood analysis exists for this model's hidden-sector thermal history (constraint con_hidden_dr_neff_h0 has likelihood_available: no); the Delta N_eff ~ 0.59 benchmark and the claimed H0-tension relief have never been fit against Planck plus local-H0 data with the model's parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the modified CLASS implementation exists, run a Cobaya/MontePython MCMC over (N, Lambda, e_D, hidden temperature ratio) against Planck CMB, BAO, and local-H0 likelihoods to produce posterior constraints on the dark-radiation abundance and scattering strength.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Goldstone-mediated sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No quantitative BBN/CMB likelihood exists for late neutrino injection from rho and sterile-neutrino decays in this non-majoron setup: the card records only qualitative bounds (likelihood_available: unknown), and standard majoron limits cannot be copied because the pseudo-Goldstone couples only to sterile neutrinos.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast neutrino-injection BBN constraints (extending an injection code such as ACROPOLIS to pure-neutrino final states) and compute Delta N_eff with a modified CLASS run for the decaying rho/N_{2,3}, producing a pass/fail likelihood over (tau_phi, f, M_Ni).

members.model_name: Leptonic scalar dark matter with scalar dilepton mediator
members.description: The CMB-safety claim (neutrino-only mediator decay avoiding electromagnetic energy injection) and the associated dark-radiation output of zeta -> nu_R nu_R are only qualitatively argued from cited Planck-era bounds; no packaged likelihood evaluates the Sommerfeld-enhanced late-time annihilation injection fraction or the Delta N_eff contribution for this model's parameters (likelihood_available unknown/no on the relevant constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the annihilation-plus-mediator-decay energy deposition chain in an injection code such as ExoCLASS or DarkHistory (tracking any subleading electromagnetic branch), compute the nu_R dark-radiation contribution to N_eff in CLASS/CAMB, and couple both to the Planck likelihood over (m_chi, m_zeta, f_ij).

members.model_name: Hidden vector coherent oscillation dark matter
members.description: No CMB likelihood exists for statistically anisotropic dark-matter isocurvature: the model predicts an isocurvature power spectrum with order-unity angular dependence on the background vector direction (g_S), while Planck isocurvature bounds assume an isotropic template, forcing a rough isotropic-limit recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the anisotropic DM-isocurvature transfer in a modified CLASS/CAMB (off-diagonal a_lm covariance from a quadrupolar g_S template) and build a Planck-based likelihood analogous to existing statistical-anisotropy/quadrupolar-asymmetry analyses, validated against the paper's isotropic-limit S_DM bound.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino portal FIMP fermion dark matter
members.description: No public cosmological likelihood exists for a long-lived dark scalar (tau_phi ~ 1e8-1e10 s) decaying dominantly to light neutrinos: the Planck exclusion and Delta N_eff = 0.12 benchmark are quoted from the source's private energy-transfer treatment, and light-element likelihood tables for the suppressed electromagnetic fraction are not available.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a decaying-species module that injects energy into the neutrino sector (plus a small electromagnetic branch handled by an exoCLASS/DarkAges-style deposition), parameterized by (tau_phi, f_phi, m_phi, branching fractions), and couple it to Planck and BBN (PRIMAT/AlterBBN) likelihoods in Cobaya or MontePython.

members.model_name: Lightest sterile neutrino dark matter in the nuMSM from active-sterile transitions
members.description: No public joint likelihood exists for the X-ray decay-line searches plus Ly-alpha flux power in the (M1, sin^2(2theta)) plane; existing X-ray limits are published exclusion curves needing recast, and the quoted Ly-alpha lower bound was derived under approximate thermal-WDM distribution mappings rather than the exact nonequilibrium DW distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package Chandra/XMM/NuSTAR X-ray line limits as a mass-mixing likelihood module, and couple CLASS transfer functions computed from the exact f_s(q) to a modern Ly-alpha flux-power likelihood (eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES style) in a MontePython/Cobaya pipeline.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino condensate baryon-dark matter model
members.description: The isocurvature constraint is anchored to the WMAP-era beta < 0.26 bound; no modern Planck-level likelihood has been applied to this model's correlated CDM plus baryon isocurvature mixture sourced by the sneutrino and Affleck-Dine phase fields.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's CDM and baryon isocurvature amplitudes and correlations into the standard Planck isocurvature parameterization and evaluate with a CLASS or CAMB plus Planck 2018 likelihood pipeline (e.g. MontePython/Cobaya), updating the allowed H_I range.

members.model_name: Symmetric vector-mediator SIDM with photon kinetic mixing
members.description: No detector-level recast exists for the momentum-dependent recoil spectrum induced by the 1-100 MeV kinetically mixed mediator; the direct-detection-plus-BBN constraint is only approximate (likelihood_available: partial, likelihood_reference null).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public direct-detection likelihood package (DDCalc-class) with the long-range 1/(q^2+m_phi^2)^2 propagator form factor and recast current xenon and low-threshold experiment limits onto the (epsilon, m_phi, m_X) plane, including the BBN mediator-lifetime floor as a prior.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac SU(2)_L lepton-doublet dark matter with late scalar decay
members.description: The requirement that S decays complete after chi freeze-out but before BBN is imposed only as an order-of-magnitude statement on y_s; no BBN light-element likelihood or lifetime contour has been computed for the S mass, abundance, and leptonic decay products of this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the S freeze-out abundance and its decay spectrum into a late-decay BBN code (e.g. ACROPOLIS-class photodisintegration/injection machinery) to derive the allowed tau_S(y_s, M_S) region against observed light-element abundances.

members.model_name: SO(10) extra-generation hot dark matter neutrino model
members.description: The route has an empty likelihoods list: no modern 3+1 oscillation global-fit likelihood or cosmological (Sum m_nu, N_eff) likelihood is wired to the model's (M_R, M, tan beta, texture) parameter space, so the few-eV hot tau neutrino and the large-mixing sterile solution can only be checked against superseded 1998 targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer that maps the diagonalized spectrum onto public 3+1 sterile-neutrino global-fit chi-squares and onto CLASS/CAMB-based Planck Sum m_nu and N_eff likelihoods (via MontePython or Cobaya), replacing the historical target comparison in the phenomenology_compare step.

members.model_name: Twin SIMPs
members.description: BBN/CMB energy-injection safety of the unstable heavier twin mesons (lifetimes around 1e-3 to 1e-2 s) rests on order-of-magnitude arguments; no likelihood evaluates the residual decaying abundance after annihilation into pions against photodissociation and CMB spectral/anisotropy limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the frozen-out heavier-meson abundances from the gap_1 Boltzmann solver and feed lifetime-abundance pairs into existing decaying-particle BBN codes (e.g. AlterBBN-style photodissociation treatments) and DarkHistory/ExoCLASS for CMB injection limits.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic axion-like dark matter
members.description: The most stringent stated constraint — CMB neutrino free-streaming limits on ALP-induced neutrino decay and scattering — has no recast for this model: mapping the Hermitian flavor-basis coupling matrix g_alpha_beta to mass-basis decay/scattering rates and evaluating them against a CMB likelihood has not been done, and no Planck-level neutrino-interaction likelihood run exists on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mass-basis nu_i -> nu_j + a decay and scattering rates from g_alpha_beta using the PMNS rotation, then evaluate the neutrino free-streaming modification with an interacting-neutrino extension of CLASS/CAMB against the Planck likelihood to produce exclusion contours in (m_a, g_alpha_beta) per flavor structure.

members.model_name: Dark massive compact halo object phenomenology
members.description: The CMB accretion bound is only a qualitative analytic recast: no energy-injection likelihood couples the dMACHO population luminosity n_dMACHO * L(z) to the ionization history and CMB anisotropy data, and the extracted mass-radius scaling itself needs re-derivation because the source text mangles the exponent sign.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the ExoCLASS/CLASS exotic-energy-injection module to take the dMACHO hydrostatic-accretion L(z, M, R) as input deposition, and run against Planck likelihoods to produce quantitative mass-radius exclusion contours, cross-checking the paper's quoted scaling.

members.model_name: Extended KSVZ axion model with scalar S1 dark matter and an up-type vector-like quark
members.description: No LHC recast likelihood exists for the VLQ pair-production top-plus-MET signature with coupling-dependent branching ratios: the card states current ATLAS/CMS exclusion contours require dedicated reinterpretation, and no search likelihood is available for the boosted-top-fatjet-plus-MET analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast of the relevant ATLAS/CMS stop-like top+MET searches in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE with BR(VLQ->t S1) as a free parameter, and add the compressed Delta M < m_t region via existing multijet+MET recasts, to yield reusable exclusion likelihoods for this model class.

members.model_name: Composite millicharged absorption-line dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for either signature: neither a radio/mm spectral-line search likelihood (uGMRT/SKA-class bands) for dark-forest features nor a CMB spectral-distortion likelihood tailored to a narrow global absorption line from inelastic composite dark matter.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a narrow-line template likelihood against COBE/FIRAS data (extensible to PIXIE-like forecasts) for the global feature, and adapt existing radio absorption-line survey pipelines to set optical-depth limits per band, published as reusable likelihood modules over (nu_0, tau).

members.model_name: Z3 leptophilic Co-SIMP dark matter for global 21-cm cosmology
members.description: No quantitative sensitivity forecast or likelihood exists for the Dark Ages second-trough discriminator at z~85; the card notes instrument sensitivity for LuSEE Night, DAPPER, and PRATUSH was not forecast.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct Fisher or mock-likelihood forecasts for LuSEE Night/DAPPER/PRATUSH-class instruments (noise plus foreground model over z~50-100) and evaluate the distinguishability of the alpha-dependent second-trough curves.

members.model_name: Sub-keV decaying fermion dark matter in anomaly-free hidden U(1)_X
members.description: The model is only compared to a quoted decaying-dark-matter Hubble-tension fit band (tau_DM ~ 35 Gyr, epsilon = 0.0013-0.229); no likelihood pipeline maps the hidden U(1)_X parameters (g, V_1, m_DM) onto a two-body DCDM cosmological fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Map (g, V_1, m_DM) to (tau_DM, epsilon) analytically and run an existing public two-body decaying-CDM modified CLASS (massive plus massless daughter, Blackadder-Koushiappas parameterization) with Planck, BAO and SH0ES likelihoods in MontePython or Cobaya.

members.model_name: Higgs-philic U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No implemented BBN/CMB energy-injection recast exists for the late-decaying neutralino NNLSP and long-lived NLSP: the card's hadronic-BBN and CMB-lifetime constraints are qualitative, with likelihood_available 'no' and no light-element or injection calculation rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the NNLSP lifetime and hadronic branching fractions into an existing injection framework (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN for BBN light elements; ExoCLASS/CLASS with DarkAges for CMB) and publish the resulting exclusion in the lifetime-versus-injected-energy plane for this benchmark.

members.model_name: A4 seesaw Majoron decaying dark matter
members.description: The CMB lifetime bound Gamma_J < 1.3e-19 s^-1 is a WMAP5-era number; no updated likelihood recast of Majoron decay to neutrinos (dark radiation injection) against Planck-era CMB data exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the CLASS dcdm-to-dark-radiation module over (m_J, Gamma_J, abundance) with the Planck 2018 likelihood in MontePython/Cobaya to replace the WMAP-era lifetime threshold with a current posterior bound.

members.model_name: MiTeVeS Noether-current mimetic dark matter cosmology
members.description: No assembled background-fit pipeline exists that implements the MiTeVeS H(z) with its Noether-current a^-3, stiff a^-6, and dark-energy terms inside a public sampler with the CC + Pantheon + BAO + CMB distance-prior likelihoods and the BBN speed-up prior; the paper's Polychord fit is not public.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MiTeVeS background expansion (Omega_Lambda + Omega_m(1+z)^3 + Omega_r(1+z)^4 + Omega_stiff(1+z)^6 parameterization) as a theory class in Cobaya or MontePython, attach the existing public cosmic-chronometer, Pantheon, BAO, and CMB distance-prior likelihoods, and encode the BBN speed-up bound as a prior.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L decaying Majoron dark matter
members.description: No dedicated CMB+LSS likelihood analysis exists for the I3 decaying component: the exclusion maps rely on transferring conservative published decaying-DM global-analysis bounds, which were derived for a generic dcdm-to-dark-radiation fluid with fixed datasets and may not match the I3-to-active-neutrino perturbation behavior or the paper's stable-plus-decaying two-component setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement I3 as a dcdm species decaying to (free-streaming) neutrino dark radiation at the perturbation level in CLASS or CAMB, map (v_D, v_M) to (f_dcdm, Gamma_dcdm) via the particle_mapping step, and run MCMC against current Planck, BAO, SNe, and weak-lensing likelihoods to replace the bound-transfer with a direct posterior on the VEV plane.

members.model_name: Lepton-number-two ultralight scalar dark matter for neutrinoless double beta capture
members.description: No experimental 0nubb likelihood is packaged for the comparison step: current KamLAND-Zen-class limits and next-generation (LEGEND-1000, nEXO) sensitivities are needed as half-life likelihoods to turn predicted rates into allowed/excluded regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Collect published half-life limits and projected sensitivities for 136Xe and 76Ge into simple Poisson/Gaussian likelihood curves and wire them to the forward model of gap_1, keeping the signal-shape degeneracy with standard 0nubb as an explicit assumption flag.

members.model_name: PQ-inflation QCD axion kinetic-misalignment model
members.description: No CMB likelihood is connected to the route: the n_s, r, and Delta N_eff predictions are only compared to quoted Planck/Keck bounds, and the card records no resolved likelihood files, so precision or future-CMB tests of the correlated inflation plus dark-radiation predictions cannot be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's (n_s, r, Delta N_eff) predictions into the public Planck 2018 plus BICEP/Keck likelihoods via CLASS/CAMB and Cobaya/MontePython, with a CMB-S4-style Delta N_eff forecast module for the reheating branch.

members.model_name: Kinetic-mixing cosmic millicharged-particle background with dark photon
members.description: No reusable experiment-level likelihoods with detector acceptances exist for translating a cosmic millicharged background flux into event yields at fixed-target, neutrino, collider, and direct-detection experiments; only published beam-oriented exclusion curves are available for approximate recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast package that wraps published mCP search efficiencies (e.g. ArgoNeuT, milliQan, SENSEI, XENON-class detectors) as effective likelihoods over (q_chi, m_chi, flux), including terrestrial attenuation of low-velocity relic mCPs, and expose the T_rh mapping as a post-processing layer.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) supersymmetric radiative seesaw dark matter
members.description: No fraction-weighted direct-detection likelihood is set up: the neutralino component must be compared to XENON-class limits after rescaling the local density by Omega_chi/Omega_DM, which the card records as a needed recast with likelihood_available unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Use DDCalc (or the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module) with current xenon-target likelihoods, feeding it the MSSM sigma_chi_N and multiplying the local density by the computed neutralino relic fraction from the freeze-out step.

members.model_name: Spontaneous-baryogenesis scalar cold dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline exists for the model's compensated baryon-plus-CDM isocurvature scenario: the Planck bound quoted by the card applies to an uncorrelated scale-invariant effective CDM isocurvature mode, so the key evasion mechanism (scalar CDM compensating baryon isocurvature, with nonquadratic-potential spectral shapes) cannot be evaluated against CMB data as posed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's correlated/compensated baryon-CDM isocurvature initial conditions (with amplitude and tilt set by H_*, V derivatives, and the scalar CDM fraction) in CLASS or CAMB, and run against the public Planck TT,TE,EE+lowE likelihood to derive bounds valid for the compensated mode rather than reusing the uncorrelated 0.040 limit.

members.model_name: Singlet majoron extension with majoron or sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the two decay signatures: the CMB bound on majoron decay to neutrinos (bound not digitized from the primary figure, per the card) and the X-ray/soft-gamma lifetime limits on the MeV sterile-neutrino branch are both available only as literature exclusion statements.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the CMB constraint on DM decaying to invisible/neutrino final states with CLASS plus the Planck likelihood as a tau(m_J, f) bound, and digitize published MeV-scale X-ray/soft-gamma decay limits into a sin^2(2theta)-versus-m_N1 likelihood curve.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No Ly-alpha forest likelihood exists that accepts the model's nonthermal transfer function; current limits are quoted only via the thermal-WDM m_WDM > 3.3 keV benchmark, which the card flags as requiring a recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the nonthermal transfer function through an existing Ly-alpha framework, e.g. map the model's cutoff onto the area criterion or use a flux-power emulator (Vid Irsic/MIKE-HIRES-based likelihood) evaluated on the CLASS transfer function from the computed f(q).

members.model_name: Z2 fermion dark matter from broken local U(1) with bound states
members.description: CMB and BBN safety of the light dark Higgs and dark photon (late decays and reannihilation-era energy injection) is treated only qualitatively in benchmark selection, with no quantitative energy-injection or N_eff likelihood for the mediator lifetime and abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute mediator lifetimes and decay branching from (lambda_H, epsilon) and evaluate them with existing BBN/CMB injection codes (e.g. an ACROPOLIS-class BBN injection calculation plus Planck f_eff annihilation limits) to turn the qualitative safety check into a quantitative bound.

members.model_name: Model A: Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light scalar mediator
members.description: No wired likelihood chain exists for the CMB/BBN response: the model's p-wave <sigma v>_rec, the phi electromagnetic-decay energy injection, and the phi abundance history are only compared to literature bounds; no f_eff computation, Planck energy-injection likelihood, or BBN photodisintegration cascade is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the Boltzmann-solver outputs (Y_phi, tau_phi, p-wave <sigma v>) to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for f_eff and Planck energy-injection limits and to an ACROPOLIS-class BBN photodisintegration code for the MeV-scale scalar decay history.

members.model_name: Model B': vector-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No wired likelihood chain exists for the CMB/BBN response: the recombination annihilation rate, the electromagnetic energy injection from A' and S decays, and their abundance histories are only compared to literature bounds; no f_eff computation, Planck energy-injection likelihood, or BBN photodisintegration cascade is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the Boltzmann-solver outputs (mediator yields, lifetimes, <sigma v>_rec) to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for f_eff and Planck energy-injection limits and to an ACROPOLIS-class BBN photodisintegration code for the MeV-scale mediator decay histories.

members.model_name: Model B: scalar-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No wired likelihood chain exists for the CMB/BBN response: the recombination annihilation rate, the electromagnetic energy injection from phi and S decays, and their abundance histories are only compared to literature bounds; no f_eff computation, Planck energy-injection likelihood, or BBN photodisintegration cascade is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the Boltzmann-solver outputs (mediator yields, lifetimes, <sigma v>_rec) to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for f_eff and Planck energy-injection limits and to an ACROPOLIS-class BBN photodisintegration code for the MeV-scale scalar decay histories.

members.model_name: Model C: p-wave scalar-mediator SIDM with scalar mediator-decay channel
members.description: No wired likelihood chain exists for the CMB/BBN response of the two-step decay chain: the electromagnetic injection spectrum from phi to S S followed by S to SM decays, the p-wave <sigma v>_rec, and the mediator abundance history are only compared to literature bounds; no f_eff computation, Planck energy-injection likelihood, or BBN photodisintegration cascade is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the cascade injection spectra for phi to S S to SM final states, then couple the Boltzmann-solver outputs to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for f_eff and Planck energy-injection limits and to an ACROPOLIS-class BBN photodisintegration code for the MeV-scale decay chain.

members.model_name: Model D: stable vector-mediator SIDM with scalar annihilation outlet
members.description: No wired likelihood chain exists for the CMB/BBN response: the residual stable A' abundance, the electromagnetic energy injection from Higgs-portal S decays, and N_eff shifts are only compared to literature bounds; no f_eff computation, Planck energy-injection likelihood, or BBN photodisintegration cascade is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the Boltzmann-solver outputs (residual Y_A', Y_S, tau_S) to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory for f_eff and Planck energy-injection limits and to an ACROPOLIS-class BBN photodisintegration and N_eff code for the MeV-scale S decay history.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free ALP inflaton dark matter for the XENON1T excess
members.description: The ALP-inflation consistency claim (f_phi about 10^3 sqrt(m_phi M_P), n=3 potential) is not backed by an implemented CMB likelihood: the two-sinusoid potential and its reheating constraints are not coded into any inflation-fitting pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Add the multi-natural ALP-inflation potential to an ASPIC-style slow-roll module or directly to CLASS/CAMB primordial-spectrum machinery, propagate the reheating efficiency epsilon, and fit n_s and r against the Planck likelihood.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium U(1)_X hidden-sector dark-fermion model
members.description: No cosmological likelihood is available for the time-dependent Delta N_eff produced by the out-of-equilibrium S decay near recombination; published N_eff bounds assume a constant extra relativistic density, so the Hubble-tension benchmark cannot be properly tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decaying-scalar-to-dark-radiation fluid in CLASS/CAMB and run a dedicated MCMC against Planck+BAO+SH0ES likelihoods (e.g. in MontePython or Cobaya) to constrain tau_S, m_S, and the injected Delta N_eff(z).

members.model_name: Right-handed-neutrino-coupled dark matter
members.description: No dedicated likelihood analysis constrains f_chi directly: the quoted f_chi < 0.0045 bound is inherited from Planck+BOSS neutrino-mass limits via an approximate suppression-equivalence, and the future CMB-S4/DESI forecasts were likewise not run through a model-specific pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the extended Boltzmann solver from gap_1 to MontePython or Cobaya with Planck, BOSS BAO, and CMB-lensing likelihoods to run a direct MCMC on (f_chi, m_N, coupling) and validate or replace the neutrino-mass-equivalent bound.

members.model_name: Smallest non-Abelian chiral dark-sector dark-proton dark matter
members.description: The dark-lepton cosmology constraints (Delta N_eff estimates 0.2 versus 2.9 depending on decoupling epoch, and late-decay energy-injection windows) exist only as analytic estimates with likelihood_available: no; nothing evaluates them against actual CMB/BBN data, and the card notes sterile-neutrino bounds do not translate one-to-one.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-sector decoupling temperature and dark-lepton energy density in CLASS to get Delta N_eff against the Planck likelihood, and route the heavy dark-lepton decay channels through an energy-injection code (ExoCLASS/DarkAges plus a BBN injection code) to replace the analytic viability windows with data-level constraints.

members.model_name: Pure fermionic cosmic millicharged-particle background
members.description: No CMB likelihood run exists for this model's reheating-dependent fractional mCP abundance with baryon Coulomb drag: existing dmeff-type CLASS/CAMB analyses assume fixed DM fractions and velocity-power-law cross sections rather than the f_chi(q_chi, m_chi, T_rh) predicted here.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public interacting-DM CLASS/CAMB branch (dmeff with n = -4 Coulomb scattering) to take the model's fractional abundance as input and run the Planck (and forecast CMB-S4) likelihoods over the (q_chi, m_chi, T_rh) plane.

members.model_name: Pure fermionic cosmic millicharged-particle background
members.description: Experiment-specific likelihoods and acceptances for translating a cosmic millicharged background flux into event yields at fixed-target, neutrino, collider, and direct-detection experiments are not public; beam-based and cosmic-background flux assumptions differ and cannot be interchanged without detector modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast package wrapping published mCP search efficiencies (ArgoNeuT, milliQan, SENSEI-class detectors) as likelihoods over (q_chi, m_chi, flux), including terrestrial attenuation and thermalization of slow relic mCPs, so search reach can be mapped onto T_rh.

members.model_name: U(1)_H-stabilized WIMPZILLA with dark radiation
members.description: The N_eff constraint on the hidden photon plus scalar-decay dark radiation is only compared against Planck 2013/WMAP9/BBN point values (likelihood_available: partial, no likelihood_reference); no packaged likelihood maps (Y_phi, m_phi, tau_phi, Delta N_eff,H) to current CMB+BBN N_eff posteriors.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the analytic Delta N_eff formula in a likelihood module that evaluates against the public Planck 2018 (+BAO) N_eff posterior and a modern BBN N_eff determination (e.g. via CLASS/MontePython or cobaya chains), replacing the 2013-era point comparison.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled scalar dark matter from inflationary fluctuations
members.description: No CMB isocurvature likelihood is implemented for this model's strongly scale-dependent (blue, peaked) dark-matter isocurvature spectrum; Planck constraints are published for power-law isocurvature and require recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the computed P_iso(k) into the Planck 2018 CDI isocurvature likelihood (via CLASS/CAMB initial-condition amplitudes and a MontePython/Cobaya likelihood run) rather than power-law-slope translation, and expose the result as a viability likelihood over (m, xi, H_I).

members.model_name: Axi-Higgs ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: The benchmark fit relies on compressed CMB scale parameters (l_a, l_eq, l_D, S_L) rather than full Planck likelihoods, and no public likelihood pipeline exists for this model against full CMB anisotropy, lensing, and weak-lensing data; the uncoupled-ULA CMB fraction limits also require recasting to the coupled axi-Higgs setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the modified Boltzmann code exists (gap_1), run full Planck 2018 TTTEEE+lensing, BAO, weak-lensing, and SN likelihoods through Cobaya on the (m_a, Omega_a, Delta v_rec) parameter space, replacing the compressed-observable fit and directly recasting the ULA CMB fraction constraints for the coupled model.

members.model_name: Higgsed dark photon gravitational-production dark matter
members.description: The CMB isocurvature viability of the k^2-suppressed blue longitudinal spectrum rests on a source-level argument; no Boltzmann-code implementation of vector dark-matter isocurvature transfer or Planck isocurvature likelihood evaluation exists for this model, so the quantitative constraint on the infrared spectrum has never been computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a dark-matter isocurvature mode with the model's k-dependent initial spectrum to CLASS or CAMB, propagate it to the CMB power spectra, and evaluate the Planck isocurvature likelihood over the (H_I, g, m_A_prime) parameter space.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic scalar dark matter
members.description: No public detector likelihood exists for monoenergetic neutrino lines from MeV-to-sub-GeV p-wave scalar DM annihilation in JUNO/Hyper-Kamiokande/DUNE-class detectors, including neutrino backgrounds, oscillations, and flavor composition.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published JUNO/Super-K diffuse-neutrino and DM-annihilation line analyses into a reusable sigma-v versus m_DM likelihood, with p-wave velocity suppression and the model's flavor branching folded in.

members.model_name: QCD-transition sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No Ly-alpha/small-scale-structure likelihood accepts this model's non-thermal, possibly resonant momentum distribution; the card's WDM bound is applied only via an approximate thermal-WDM equivalent mass without any transfer-function run.
members.proposed_resolution: Pipe the solver's f_s(p) into CLASS as a tabulated ncdm species to compute the model transfer function, then evaluate it against an existing public Ly-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator (MIKE/HIRES/eBOSS-based WDM analyses) via the standard area-criterion or direct emulator recast.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric axion dark matter with early stronger QCD
members.description: The CMB constraints are applied as single quoted 2015-era numbers (isocurvature inequality and tensor bound near H about 10^14 GeV) rather than a current CMB isocurvature/tensor likelihood, so the viable window is not evaluated against up-to-date data.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's predicted uncorrelated CDM isocurvature fraction and tensor-to-scalar ratio onto the Planck 2018 (plus BICEP/Keck) beta_iso and r likelihoods via CLASS/CAMB with an isocurvature mode in a standard sampler, replacing the quoted inequalities.

members.model_name: U(1)_X isospin-violating asymmetric Dirac dark matter
members.description: Only an approximate 2013-era LUX/XENON100-versus-CDMS-Si comparison exists; there is no modern global direct-detection likelihood for the isospin-violating (f_n/f_p near -0.7) low-mass window, which is the model's defining observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current xenon (LZ/XENONnT), silicon/germanium low-threshold, and NaI limits with a generalized-couplings direct-detection likelihood (DDCalc-class extended to arbitrary f_n/f_p and light-mediator finite-q corrections near m_h1 = 200 MeV) over the (m_chi, sigma_p, f_n/f_p) space.

members.model_name: Ballistic Dark Matter
members.description: No quantitative likelihood analysis exists for the BDM parameter space: the z_star > 5e4 bound for the all-BDM case is a by-eye comparison to WiggleZ-scale matter power without nuisance parameters, degeneracy marginalization, or Planck/BBN likelihood evaluation.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the BDM-enabled Boltzmann code to Cobaya/MontePython with the Planck 2018, BAO, and full-shape galaxy power spectrum likelihoods (plus a BBN Delta N_eff prior for post-BBN transitions) and run an MCMC over (z_star, transition width, f_BDM).

members.model_name: Z3-symmetric NMSSM light singlino funnel dark matter
members.description: Relic-density and direct-detection viability are imposed as hard scan cuts (0.107 < Omega h^2 < 0.131, fixed sigma_SI/sigma_SD thresholds) rather than through the actual Planck and XENON/LZ-class experimental likelihoods, so blind-spot regions near the cut boundaries cannot be assessed statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the micrOMEGAs outputs in existing public likelihoods — the Planck Omega h^2 Gaussian and DDCalc/LZ-style direct-detection likelihoods as used in GAMBIT — updated to current exposure, replacing the step-function scan cuts.

members.model_name: Portalino-inspired neutrino-portal Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No quantitative BBN/CMB likelihood exists for long-lived Portalinos: the excluded region in (tau_n, m_n, mixing) is drawn from approximate analytic lifetime and radiation-density estimates rather than a computed N_eff and light-element response to late Portalino decays.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the Portalino decoupling and decay history with a thermal-history Boltzmann code coupled to a BBN network (AlterBBN/PRyMordial-class tools plus an N_eff calculation) and interface the result to the Planck N_eff likelihood.

members.model_name: Cold dark matter condensate transition model
members.description: The only constraint is a historical COBE/DASI/MAXIMA/BOOMERANG/CBI + 2dF + HZT/SCP likelihood; no modern CMB/LSS/SN reanalysis pipeline for the condensate parameters (Omega_Q, w_f, z_t) exists, so current exclusions cannot be stated.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the modified CLASS module of gap_1 to Cobaya with Planck 2018, modern BAO, and Pantheon+ likelihoods and rerun the four-parameter scan (Omega_Q, w_f, z_t, H_0) with the other cosmological parameters freed.

members.model_name: Non-SUSY SO(10) triplet fermion dark matter
members.description: The loop-level spin-independent triplet-nucleon cross section and its comparison to LUX/XENON-class data are not implemented; the card only cites related-work statements and records likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the known two-loop electroweak result for hyperchargeless-triplet sigma_SI (wino-like, ~1e-47 cm^2 level) and evaluate it with DDCalc against XENONnT/LZ likelihoods, including the SO(10) scalar-content corrections noted in the card caveats.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector coscattering dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline exists that maps the residual active-state (n2) abundance, lifetime, and visible branching fractions to CMB spectral-distortion, CMB anisotropy energy-injection, N_eff, and BBN constraints for this model; the card records the CMB spectral-distortion likelihood as unavailable and the BBN recast as not run.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a thin wrapper feeding the (abundance, tau_psi, branching fraction) output of the coscattering solver into ExoCLASS/DarkAges for anisotropy energy-injection limits, a CLASS spectral-distortion module compared to FIRAS, and an injection-capable BBN code, packaged as a reusable late-decay likelihood.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric SO(10) mixed LSP-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No modern mixed cold-plus-hot dark-matter likelihood is wired to the model: the hot tau-neutrino fraction Omega_HDM has not been confronted with Planck/BAO/LSS neutrino-mass bounds, which likely exclude much of the historical HDM component, and the card marks the structure-consistency constraint recast_required with no likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Map (m_nu, Omega_HDM, Omega_CDM) onto a standard nuCDM parameterization in CLASS or CAMB and evaluate the public Planck plus BAO/LSS likelihoods (e.g., via Cobaya or MontePython), replacing the qualitative 2006 structure argument.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation scalar doublet WIMP Case B
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the MeV gamma de-excitation signature in EXO-200, KamLAND-Zen, SNO, and Borexino: only published high-energy spectra with conservative background subtraction were used, and gamma-escape and acceptance effects can shift limits by a factor of about two.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published high-energy event spectra, model each detector's response (resolution, gamma-escape probability, fiducial acceptance) with a lightweight Monte Carlo, and package a binned Poisson likelihood over (Delta m, tau, capture rate), extendable to KamLAND-Zen 800 and nEXO-class data.

members.model_name: High-scale-inflation Q-ball dark matter and baryogenesis scenario
members.description: The isocurvature and BBN constraints are applied only as analytic pass/fail cuts using Planck 2014 inputs; no coupling to a current CMB isocurvature likelihood or BBN network exists, so the allowed (H_inf, phi_inf, T_RH) window cannot be re-derived with modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the flat-direction baryon/CDM isocurvature amplitude into the Planck 2018 (or later) isocurvature likelihood via CLASS plus a sampler such as MontePython/Cobaya, and check late-decaying gauge-mediation Q-ball energy injection against a standard BBN code (e.g. AlterBBN/PRIMAT).

members.model_name: Next-to-minimal supergravity-motivated neutralino dark matter
members.description: No reusable combined likelihood exists for the NmSuGra parameter space: the card's constraint set is the 2008 WMAP-upper-bound/CDMS/LEP/muon g-2/b-physics envelope, superseded by Planck, LHC Run 2 SUSY and Higgs results, and LZ-class direct-detection limits, none of which are implemented for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the scan in a modern global-fit pipeline: NMSSMTools/micrOMEGAs for spectrum, relic density and sigma_SI, DDCalc for LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, and updated flavor and Higgs-mass constraints (e.g. via HiggsTools), combined in a GAMBIT-style composite likelihood over (M0, M1/2, A0, tan beta, lambda).

members.model_name: Nonthermal split-spectrum SUSY WIMP dark matter from moduli decay
members.description: No modern CMB likelihood analysis exists for this model's correlated multi-mode isocurvature plus Delta N_eff initial conditions; the primary analysis is WMAP-era and the card marks the Planck recast as unavailable, so current constraints on alpha_iso, cos Delta, and Delta N_eff cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's initial-mode covariance (correlated CDM isocurvature, dark-radiation isocurvature, and adiabatic modes) as initial conditions in CAMB or CLASS, then run Planck 2018 TT/TE/EE+lensing likelihoods through Cobaya or MontePython, scanning modulus mass, T_r, and branching fractions with the paper's prior structures.

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled (pseudo-)scalar dark matter
members.description: No CMB isocurvature likelihood interface exists for the model: Planck CDM-isocurvature bounds are published for power-law spectra, and no recast maps the curvature-coupled scalar's specific large-scale isocurvature spectrum onto a quantitative constraint on (m_phi, xi, H_I, N_tot, phi_e).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model's isocurvature transfer through CLASS with an uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature initial condition and evaluate the Planck (or equivalent) likelihood over the model parameter grid, publishing the resulting exclusion surface as a reusable table.

members.model_name: Neutrino-philic twin two-Higgs-doublet cogenesis
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood or acceptance recast exists for 5.5 GeV twin nucleons scattering through combined Higgs and dark-photon portals at low-threshold experiments (PandaX, XENON-1T, CDMS-lite class); the card only cites projection-level statements.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the twin-nucleon sigma_SI (Higgs-portal plus kinetic-mixing contributions) in DDCalc or an equivalent public direct-detection likelihood package and evaluate against published low-mass efficiency curves.

members.model_name: B-L origin QCD axion dark matter
members.description: The isocurvature constraint on H_inf uses a single quoted source-era bound rather than the full CMB isocurvature likelihood, so the H_inf-F_a-theta_a exclusion cannot be updated or combined with other cosmological data.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's uncorrelated CDM isocurvature amplitude P_ISO(H_inf, F_a, theta_a) into the public Planck isocurvature likelihood via CLASS/CAMB initial conditions in a MontePython or Cobaya pipeline.

members.model_name: Mirror baryon plus PBH-evaporated scalar singlet dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood exists for the mirror-sector cosmology constraint: the N_eff contribution from mirror radiation (x = T'/T) and the mirror-baryon fraction beta are only checked against assumed safety conditions (x < 0.5, 0.1 < beta < 5), and the card records likelihood_available: no with no BBN/N_eff likelihood rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Map (x, beta) to Delta N_eff and an interacting mirror-baryon fluid in a modified CLASS/CAMB run, and evaluate against the Planck lite plus BBN abundance likelihoods to replace the fixed x < 0.5 assumption with an actual posterior over the mirror-sector parameters.

members.model_name: Thermalized boosted milli-charged dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No packaged likelihoods exist for the constraint set: heavy-X nuclear-recoil limits (XENON1T/PandaX/LUX/PICO/CRESST/CDMSlite), electron-recoil searches, and BBN/CMB N_eff plus stellar-cooling bounds are all applied as digitized exclusion contours at two fixed mass ratios rather than as reusable likelihood functions.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood module combining public direct-detection efficiency/exposure data (e.g. via DDCalc-style recasts of the listed experiments) with a CLASS-based Planck N_eff likelihood for f_MCP and a massless dark photon, parameterized in (m_ell, m_X/m_ell, Q, alpha_D, f_MCP).

members.model_name: Baryon-including generalized Chaplygin gas quartessence
members.description: The only constraints are a figure-based 2dF likelihood with WMAP-era priors and related (not model-identical) WMAP/SNIa limits; no reusable likelihood over (alpha, A) for the baryon-including quartessence exists against modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the CLASS implementation from gap_1 to Cobaya/MontePython with Planck 2018, modern galaxy power spectra (BOSS/DESI, linear cuts as in the paper), and Pantheon+ SNe, and rescan the (alpha, A, Omega_b0, h) space to replace the historical contours.

members.model_name: Bulk-shortcut sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: Existing Ly-alpha and X-ray sterile-neutrino WDM bounds are calibrated for thermal or standard resonant-production spectra; no validated procedure maps them onto the (uncomputed) nonthermal shortcut-production distribution, as the card's recast_required constraints note.
members.proposed_resolution: Once f(p) is available, compute T(k) with CLASS's non-cold-relic module and apply a generalized suppression-shape criterion (e.g., the area-criterion recast of Ly-alpha WDM limits) rather than the thermal-mass mapping; pair with standard X-ray decay-line limits at the model's (m_s, theta).

members.model_name: Two-neutrino hot dark matter with a four-neutrino mass pattern
members.description: No runnable likelihood exists for the CHDM structure fit: the 2000-era CMB plus galaxy-survey compilation behind the quoted probabilities (0.09/0.34) is not preserved as software, and no modern-data recast of the two-degenerate-neutrino hot component has been set up.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast with current data: run CLASS with N_massive=2 degenerate neutrinos at the historical parameter point and a free (sum m_nu, Omega_nu) grid through Cobaya/MontePython against Planck 2018 plus BOSS/eBOSS full-shape likelihoods, replacing the unrecoverable source-era compilation.

members.model_name: Neutral SU(2)_N vector-boson dark matter
members.description: Only the historical 2010 CDMS Ge envelope is available for the h-exchange X_1-nucleon scattering; no modern direct-detection likelihood (LZ/XENONnT-class) has been recast onto the (m_X, m_h) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the model cross section is computable (gap_1), recast current LZ/XENONnT spin-independent limits with a standard direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc) to replace the historical CDMS mass window.

members.model_name: Flavor-specific scalar mediator secluded Dirac dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection likelihood exists for this model: the S-wave bound-state-formation injection has not been mapped to a Planck constraint because the scalar's flavor-specific decay branchings and the resulting deposited-energy efficiency f_eff(z) were never computed for this dark sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the scalar branching fractions to mu+mu-, hadrons, and photons from the flavor-specific couplings, derive f_eff(z) with DarkHistory, and impose the Planck p_ann bound via ExoCLASS/CLASS on the combined annihilation-plus-BSF injection rate.

members.model_name: S3 schizophrenic-neutrino right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: The N_eff prediction (Delta N_eff up to about 1 for a 1 TeV Z-prime) has not been confronted with a modern Planck+BAO/BBN N_eff likelihood; the card marks the likelihood as only partial and the recast as needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Map T_D(M_Zprime) to Delta N_eff with standard entropy-conservation formulae and evaluate against the published Planck 2018 plus BAO N_eff posterior (or a CLASS/MontePython run), producing an exclusion on the B-L breaking scale.

members.model_name: Low-scale trinification Majoron dark matter
members.description: No low-threshold direct-detection recast exists for Higgs-mediated scattering of sub-MeV scalar dark matter, where nuclear-recoil energies fall below conventional detector thresholds; the paper only points to the channel without computing limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast electron-recoil and Migdal-effect analyses (e.g. XENON-class and semiconductor low-threshold experiments) for a sub-MeV Higgs-portal scalar with freeze-in-sized lambda_LR, to establish whether any present or planned experiment reaches the relevant cross sections.

members.model_name: Leptophilic scalar dark matter in a gauged U(1)_ model
members.description: No combined likelihood exists for the joint viability constraint (muon g-2, b -> s mu mu Wilson coefficients, relic band, XENON1T-class direct detection, neutrino trident, LHC multileptons); the card records likelihood_available: no and notes that no post-2022 flavor-anomaly global fit or updated direct-detection limit has been applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a joint likelihood using flavio/smelli for the b -> s mu mu Wilson coefficients and delta a_mu with current world averages, updated LZ/XENONnT spin-independent limits for the Higgs-portal coupling, published neutrino-trident bounds on (g_prime, m_Z_prime), and recast LHC multilepton limits, exposed over the full scan parameter vector.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter subcomponent forming dark stars
members.description: The cosmological constraint on (epsilon, xi, m_X, m_e_dark, alpha_D) from dark acoustic oscillations, N_eff, and galaxy morphology is only carried over from cited benchmarks (epsilon <= 0.05, xi = 0.5); no CMB/matter-power likelihood has been rerun for this model's parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Use an existing atomic-dark-matter/ETHOS-type CLASS implementation to compute DAO-suppressed transfer functions over the card's parameter grid and run Planck plus matter-power likelihoods (MontePython/Cobaya) to derive posterior bounds on epsilon and xi specific to this benchmark.

members.model_name: Hybrid two-scalar dark sector
members.description: No dedicated MCMC constraint pipeline exists for the exact hybrid potential: current bounds are only recast from related coupled-dark-energy analyses, and the card notes a dedicated run with Planck+lensing+BAO+SN+RSD+weak-lensing data is required to obtain posteriors on (M, g, lambda, phi_i, chi_i).
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS module exists, interface it with MontePython or Cobaya and run an MCMC over the hybrid-potential parameters against Planck 2018 (TT,TE,EE+lensing), BAO, SNe, and RSD/f sigma8 data, reproducing the coupled-dark-energy bounds as a validation limit.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino dark matter from Higgs-singlet decays
members.description: No collider likelihood covers the singlet-Higgs sector: the invisible-Higgs and displaced-vertex reach quoted for the historical 120 GeV benchmark has not been recast with current LHC Higgs measurements and long-lived-particle searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the H-S mixing and S -> NN branching in a Higgs-sector constraint tool (HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals-class plus current ATLAS/CMS invisible-width limits) and recast relevant displaced-vertex searches for the long-lived singlet decay length.

members.model_name: Flaxino dark matter with stau NLSP
members.description: No packaged BBN light-element likelihood is available for late-decaying charged stau NLSPs in this scenario; the card records only approximate literature bounds, so the BBN safety of near-degenerate stau-flaxino spectra cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model's (tau_stau, stau abundance) plane through public BBN codes that include hadronic/electromagnetic injection and charged-particle catalysis (e.g. AlterBBN/PArthENoPE-class codes with CBBN bound-state corrections), packaged as a likelihood over the card's constrained parameters.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic local U(1) singlet-fermion dark matter
members.description: No quantitative LFV likelihood exists (con_neutrinophilic_lfv_zprime has likelihood_available: no): the claim that anarchical Yukawa choices keep mu->e gamma and related rates below sensitivity is qualitative, with no branching-ratio calculator wired to MEG/Mu2e-class limits for this model's Y_nu and v_2 structure.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop LFV branching ratios in the neutrinophilic 2HDM as functions of Y_nu and v_2 (or adapt an existing 2HDM LFV code) and wrap current MEG-II and future Mu2e limits into a likelihood over the flavor parameters.

members.model_name: Dirac dark photon hidden-sector thermal relic
