members.description: No Ly-alpha forest flux-power likelihood is interfaced to this model's hidden-sector hot-relic transfer functions; the existing 3.3 keV thermal-WDM bound can only be applied through an unvalidated thermal-equivalent recast, and the card records no available likelihood for step s4.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface CLASS-computed transfer functions for the rescaled-thermal hidden-sector distribution to a public Ly-alpha likelihood or emulator (e.g. a lym1d/eBOSS-style flux-power likelihood or the Murgia et al. area-criterion recast), marginalizing over IGM thermal history, and validate against the 3.3 keV thermal-WDM limit in the pure-WDM limit.

members.model_name: Asymmetric right-handed sneutrino dark matter in a supersymmetric neutrinophilic Higgs model
members.description: The loop-induced, neutron-dominated Z-coupling cross section is only compared against a hand-recast LUX-era limit; no modern isospin-violating direct-detection likelihood evaluation (LZ/XENONnT-class) exists for the (M_N2, loop trilinear ratio) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the loop-induced sneutrino-Z effective coupling as neutron/proton-specific couplings in DDCalc (or micrOMEGAs direct-detection module) and evaluate the public LZ and XENONnT likelihoods over the benchmark parameter plane.

members.model_name: Affine-EOS quintessence unified dark fluid
members.description: No likelihood analysis exists for the affine parameters (p_0, alpha): background viability and the sound-speed bound are stated qualitatively (likelihood_available: no/unknown) with no parameter posterior from expansion-history or perturbation data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS implementation of gap_1 exists, run an MCMC (MontePython/Cobaya) with Planck CMB, BAO, and supernova likelihoods over (p_0, alpha, initial scalar trajectory) to produce the first quantitative affine-quintessence constraint.

members.model_name: SU(5) non-universal gaugino-mass neutralino dark matter
members.description: The viability of the WMAP-era allowed regions is not evaluated against modern data: no Planck relic-density target, Run-2 LHC simplified-model limits, or current direct-detection (LZ/XENONnT-class) likelihood is applied to the SU(5) representation benchmarks (con_lhc_and_direct_update is a recast flag only).
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the SOFTSUSY+micrOMEGAs scan against the Planck Omega_CDM h^2 band, pass spectra through SModelS for Run-2 LHC limits, and evaluate sigma_SI with micrOMEGAs plus DDCalc likelihoods for LZ/XENONnT, packaging the combination as a reusable constraint set.

members.model_name: SO(10) GUT inflation model with axion dark matter
members.description: The inflation-scale constraint is applied only as a WMAP5-era n_s ~ 0.96 target with no likelihood (likelihood_available no, recasting_needed yes); the Coleman-Weinberg/Higgs-potential predictions have not been confronted with any modern CMB likelihood including the r-n_s plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute the n_s and r predictions of the Coleman-Weinberg and Higgs-potential cases and evaluate them against the Planck 2018 plus BICEP/Keck likelihoods with Cobaya or MontePython (CLASS backend), scanning the SO(10) breaking-scale inputs.

members.model_name: Gravitationally produced nonthermal X-boson dark matter
members.description: No CMB likelihood exists for this model's specific signatures: a strongly blue-tilted uncorrelated CDM isocurvature spectrum (the quoted alpha < 0.064 bound assumes scale invariance) and local non-Gaussianity sourced by an isocurvature rather than adiabatic mode, for which no Planck-era template recast is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a parameterized blue-tilted CDI spectrum (amplitude and tilt at k0 = 0.002 Mpc^-1) to CLASS and constrain it with the Planck 2018 likelihoods in Cobaya/MontePython, and recast the Planck isocurvature-bispectrum f_NL analysis onto this model's isocurvature-sourced local shape.

members.model_name: Two-real-singlet light scalar dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihoods exist for any of the model's constraints: the direct-detection comparison uses XENON10/CDMS-era published curves, and the LEP light-scalar compatibility has no recast likelihood, so exclusion statements cannot be updated to current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model implementation to DDCalc for current xenon-target (LZ/XENONnT-class) likelihoods on sigma_SI, and run the mixed-scalar spectrum through HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals-class tools for the LEP/LHC light-scalar and heavy-scalar constraints.

members.model_name: Yukawa-coupled quintessence fermion dark matter
members.description: The published constraints rest on Planck-2013 TT + WMAP polarization, Union 2.1 SNIa, and the HST H0 prior; no analysis pipeline with current-generation likelihoods (Planck 2018/ACT, modern BAO and SNIa compilations) exists for this model, so the reported negative-interaction preference cannot be re-evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the CLASS/CAMB module exists, wire it into Cobaya or MontePython with Planck 2018, DESI/BOSS BAO, and Pantheon+ likelihoods and rerun the (beta/M, alpha) posterior, including the fixed-alpha case.

members.model_name: Curvature-induced adiabatic scalar singlet dark matter
members.description: No pipeline connects the model's residual isocurvature fraction to a CMB likelihood: the adiabaticity claim rests on the analytic heavy-field tracking argument and no Planck isocurvature recast exists for the parameter region where tracking becomes marginal.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature transfer for the spectator perturbations (including the light/marginal-tracking regime), implement it as a CDM-isocurvature amplitude in CLASS or CAMB, and constrain (m, xi, H_end) with the Planck adiabatic-plus-isocurvature likelihood in MontePython or Cobaya.

members.model_name: N=1 axion domain-wall decay dark matter
members.description: The route explicitly has no likelihood: existing haloscope analyses (ADMX-class) assume a standard halo model lineshape, and no likelihood exists for a cavity spectrum containing a population-II component broadened by the order-10^3 velocity-dispersion enhancement.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public haloscope lineshape likelihood to a two-component signal model (narrow population I plus broadened population II parameterized by its local fraction and dispersion) and recast existing cavity exclusion data with it.

members.model_name: Chiral vorton dark matter from Witten-type superconducting strings
members.description: No likelihood exists for the vorton overclosure and early-matter-domination constraint: the excluded Gmu band comes from an order-of-magnitude semianalytic argument and has never been recast against modern BBN and CMB data (likelihood_available is 'no' and recasting_needed is 'yes').
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vorton energy-density history as an early-matter-domination component in a Boltzmann code such as CLASS or CAMB and derive posterior bounds on (Gmu, s) from Planck CMB and standard BBN abundance likelihoods, replacing the symbolic excluded band with a statistical constraint.

members.model_name: Dirac heavy thermal hot relic with heavy scalar mediator
members.description: No Ly-alpha forest flux-power likelihood is interfaced to the hidden-sector hot-relic transfer functions of this scalar-mediated Dirac model; the 3.3 keV thermal-WDM limit can only be applied via an unvalidated thermal-equivalent recast, and step s4 has no available likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Connect CLASS transfer functions for the rescaled-thermal hidden-sector distribution to a public Ly-alpha likelihood or emulator (e.g. a lym1d/eBOSS-style flux-power likelihood or the Murgia et al. area-criterion recast) with IGM thermal-history marginalization, validating against the thermal-WDM 3.3 keV bound in the appropriate limit.

members.model_name: Solar-neutrino-boosted bound-state dark matter
members.description: No public bubble-chamber (PICO-class) likelihood or detector-response model exists for the boosted dark-matter recoil spectrum produced by solar-neutrino dissociation; the only constraint is an approximate event-count reinterpretation with low robustness.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a recast module that folds the boosted velocity distribution into the published PICO nucleation efficiency curves and exposure to produce a Poisson likelihood, structured like a DDCalc experiment module but accepting an arbitrary nonthermal incoming flux instead of a halo velocity distribution.

members.model_name: Mirror baryon plus heavy primordial-black-hole multicomponent dark matter
members.description: The mirror-radiation bound is imposed only as the assumed safety condition x < 0.5; no N_eff likelihood has been run mapping the mirror temperature ratio x and mirror-baryon fraction beta onto BBN and Planck constraints for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Map x to delta N_eff with the standard mirror-sector degrees-of-freedom relation, include the mirror-baryon fraction in the background of CLASS or CAMB, and evaluate the Planck+BBN N_eff likelihood (Cobaya/MontePython) to convert the assumed x < 0.5 condition into a posterior bound on (x, beta).

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino superWIMP from late neutralino decay
members.description: The route has no quantitative likelihood step: the exact suppressed transfer function of the decay-produced right-handed sneutrino is never computed (the chain stops at analytic lambda_FS), and both the Ly-alpha bound and the CMB/LSS relativistic-energy-injection bound are applied only through approximate WDM-style and figure-level mappings.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the public two-body decaying-CDM CLASS extension (neutralino lifetime tau and mass splitting Delta map directly onto its parameters) to compute the exact daughter transfer function and neutrino energy release, then constrain it with an area-criterion Ly-alpha WDM likelihood and the Planck CMB/LSS likelihoods in MontePython/Cobaya.

members.model_name: Right-handed Kaluza-Klein neutrino superWIMP from late KK decay
members.description: The route has no quantitative likelihood step: the exact suppressed transfer function of the decay-produced right-handed KK neutrino is never computed (the chain stops at analytic lambda_FS), and both the Ly-alpha bound and the CMB/LSS relativistic-energy-injection bound are applied only through approximate WDM-style and figure-level mappings.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the public two-body decaying-CDM CLASS extension (parent lifetime tau and mass splitting Delta map directly onto its parameters) to compute the exact daughter transfer function and Neff-like energy release, then constrain it with an area-criterion Ly-alpha WDM likelihood and the Planck CMB/LSS likelihoods in MontePython/Cobaya.

members.model_name: Twin Higgs Portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline connects the model's predicted sigma_SI to current/next-generation direct-detection likelihoods or its twin-radiation Delta N_eff to BBN/CMB likelihoods; the card records only cited sensitivity projections, not executed statistical constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the model outputs to DDCalc (LZ/XENONnT exposures and DARWIN projections) for sigma_SI(m_S) and to the Planck N_eff posterior (via CLASS+Cobaya) for the assumed twin spectrum, scanning (m_S, f/v, m_hhat) along the relic-fixed lambda_HS curve.

members.model_name: Two-hidden-sector long-lived dark photon dark matter
members.description: The Delta N_eff constraint on the two hidden-sector temperatures is applied only as a quoted BBN/CMB/BAO bound; no likelihood pipeline propagates the model's redshift-dependent hidden radiation content through a CMB/BBN fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the solved T1(z), T2(z) histories onto a Delta N_eff(z) input for CLASS/CAMB and evaluate against the Planck+BAO likelihood (and PArthENoPE/PRIMAT for BBN), replacing the single-number bound with a proper posterior.

members.model_name: Heavy thermal hot relic dark matter in a cooler hidden sector
members.description: No Ly-alpha forest flux-power likelihood is interfaced to the cooler-hidden-sector hot-relic transfer functions of this framework; the 3.3 keV thermal-WDM bound applies only through a thermal-equivalent recast whose validity across the keV-to-PeV, Tprime/T ~ 1e-1 to 1e-5 parameter space is unquantified, and step s4 records no available likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline that maps (m_DM, Tprime/T) to CLASS ncdm transfer functions and feeds them to a public Ly-alpha likelihood or emulator (e.g. lym1d/eBOSS-style flux power or the Murgia et al. area criterion) with IGM thermal-history marginalization, validated against the thermal-WDM 3.3 keV limit.

members.model_name: One-component non-thermal flavon portal dark matter
members.description: No interfaced BBN likelihood exists for late-decaying flavons with hadronic/visible energy injection; the constraint is applied only as literature exclusion curves, so the lifetime-branching boundary of the viable region cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the flavon lifetime and visible branching fractions to an existing BBN energy-injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS-class light-element solvers), mapping (tau_phi, Br_visible, m_phi) onto light-element likelihoods.

members.model_name: Fuzzy dark matter with repulsive quartic self-interaction
members.description: The modified CLASS module implementing the quartic-FDM effective-fluid sound speed c_s^2(a,k) and the quartic-dominated (radiation-like) background phase is not publicly released; without it neither the matter-power cutoff nor the equality-shift observable can be recomputed or the lambda(m) bound updated with current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's averaged scalar-fluid treatment as a public CLASS extension (natural host: extend AxiCLASS's ultralight-axion fluid module with the lambda phi^4 correction to w(a) and c_s^2(a,k)), validate against the paper's quoted log10(lambda) = -91.86 + 4 log10(m/1e-22 eV) exclusion line, and couple it to MontePython/Cobaya with current Planck and LSS likelihoods.

members.model_name: Ultra-Light Pion and Baryon WIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No detector-level signal model exists for the millicharged-pion and pi0-photon couplings; the paper defers resonant-detector and modified-electrodynamics forecasts to future work, so laboratory observability cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the g_pi_gamma and millicharge signal power in axion-haloscope and light-shining-through-wall setups, and recast existing haloscope/millicharge exclusion data onto the (epsilon, m_pi, F_pi) plane.

members.model_name: Extreme axion dark matter with cosine potential fluid modeling
members.description: The modified axionCAMB implementing the full cosine potential, extreme hilltop initial angles, the effective-sound-speed fluid switch, and the background lookup-table acceleration is described in the paper but not publicly released, so no one else can compute CMB or matter power spectra for extreme axions.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or reimplement the cosine-potential fluid treatment as a public axionCAMB (or CLASS) patch, including the shooting solver for f_a given (m_a, theta_i, Omega_a h^2) and validation against the paper's field-equation comparisons.

members.model_name: Blue axion with two-photon decay
members.description: No public forward model computes COB diffuse intensity and angular power from blue-axion two-photon decay across the card's cold, freeze-out non-cold, and hot-relic abundance cases, including the mixed cold-warm suppression of small-scale power and astrophysical EBL foreground modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a decay-emissivity plus angular-power module using CLASS/CAMB ncdm transfer functions for the non-cold fraction and an EBL foreground model, validated against the HST 606 nm anisotropy bounds of arXiv:2205.01079 and the paper's 5-25 eV exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Kinetically coupled axion-dilaton fuzzy dark matter model
members.description: The modified CLASS implementation evolving the kinetically coupled axion-dilaton background and perturbations (f(chi) kinetic coupling, EDE-like injection, fuzzy-axion power suppression) is not publicly available, so neither the CMB nor matter-power predictions can be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recover or reimplement the two-field sector in public CLASS (starting from AxiCLASS/CLASS_EDE as a template), adding the exponential kinetic function to the background and perturbation equations, and validate against the paper's example with EDE fraction near 0.097 and the roughly 10 percent matter-power step at F = 0.01.

members.model_name: Irreducible freeze-in axion background
members.description: No public, documented freeze-in integrator computes the irreducible axion yield from SM plasma processes (inverse decays, e+e- annihilation, photon conversions with thermal/plasmon effects) for axion-photon and axion-electron couplings with a low BBN-limit reheating temperature; the paper's contours are said to be public but no repository is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the paper's freeze-in Boltzmann integration as a documented module (e.g. extend the micrOMEGAs freeze-in machinery or a standalone Python integrator) taking (m_a, g_a_gamma, g_ae, T_R) and returning the yield, Omega_a and the nonthermal momentum distribution, validated against the published blue contours.

members.model_name: Dark photon dark matter from an oscillating dilaton
members.description: No pipeline connects the resonantly produced, nonthermally peaked dark-photon spectrum to late-time structure observables: the card gives no transfer function, no thermal WDM mapping, and no tool for the enhanced small-scale power or vector solitonic-core phenomenology quoted for m_A ~ 1e-21 eV.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear transfer function from the simulated production spectrum in a Boltzmann solver (CLASS with a nonthermal ncdm/vector fluid module) and run Schrodinger-Poisson-type wave-DM simulations generalized to spin-1 fields to predict halo cores and small-scale power for the ultralight regime.

members.model_name: Modulus-decay axion hot-and-cold dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation propagates the non-thermal, modulus-decay-produced axion momentum distribution (more energetic than the ambient plasma) together with the cold coherent-oscillation component into Delta N_eff, effective HDM mass, and scale-dependent power suppression for this mixed hot-plus-cold axion population.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-produced axion phase-space distribution f(p; m_phi, decay_temperature, branching_fraction) as a custom ncdm species in CLASS alongside a cold axion fluid, then recast against Planck and LSS likelihoods for the (m_a, m_phi, branching) parameter space.

members.model_name: E-model attractor scalar-field dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann or background code implements the E-model attractor potential: the background scan (V0, alpha, rho_i, m -> Omega_m today) and the linear transfer function with the early steep-tracker-wing phase are not covered by existing ultralight-scalar solvers, which assume a harmonic m^2 phi^2 potential from the start.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ultralight-scalar Boltzmann code (axionCAMB or a CLASS scalar-field module) with the E-model potential V(phi)=V0(1-exp[-lambda phi/m_p])^2, evolving the full background field through the tracker and oscillatory regimes and switching to the effective-fluid/harmonic treatment once oscillations are fast, validated against w=0 for n=1 and the kpc Jeans length at m~1e-22 eV.

members.model_name: Tracker-potential scalar-field dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann or background code implements the tracker attractor potential: the background scan (V0, alpha, rho_i, m -> Omega_m today) through the symmetric tracker wings that broaden the initial-condition basin, and the linear transfer function through that early phase, are not covered by existing ultralight-scalar solvers, which assume a harmonic m^2 phi^2 potential from the start.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ultralight-scalar Boltzmann code (axionCAMB or a CLASS scalar-field module) with the tracker potential V(phi)=V0 phi^(2n)/(1-phi^2/(6 alpha m_p^2))^n, evolving the full background field through the tracker and oscillatory regimes and switching to the effective-fluid/harmonic treatment once oscillations are fast, validated against w=0 for n=1 and the kpc Jeans length at m~1e-22 eV.

members.model_name: Light scalar dark matter clumps with angular momentum
members.description: The photon-resonance (Floquet) solver from the cited follow-up paper is not public and has never been applied to non-spherical l > 0 clump profiles, so the predicted angular-momentum-enabled radio resonance cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an open-source Floquet-exponent solver for axion-photon parametric resonance that accepts non-spherical field profiles, validate it on the follow-up paper's spherical no-resonance result, then scan the l > 0 branch in (l, M, g_a_gamma).

members.model_name: Axion dark matter clump photon-resonance model
members.description: No public numerical solver computes photon parametric-resonance (Floquet) growth exponents for finite, non-spherical or rotating axion clump profiles with backreaction and photon escape; only the paper's case-by-case analysis exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Release a mode-equation solver built on the paper's vector-spherical-harmonic decomposition that integrates the coupled axion-photon equations on user-specified clump profiles (spherical and angular-momentum-carrying), outputs growth exponents versus escape rate, and is validated against the primary paper's resonance/no-resonance boundaries.

members.model_name: Generalized three-Higgs-doublet astrophobic QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code computes the thermal axion yield and Delta N_eff for flavor-dependent astrophobic 3HDM coupling patterns; the paper's Y_a(T) evolution including SM decays and scatterings with suppressed nucleon/electron/photon/muon couplings exists only as a private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's production and absorption rates in a momentum-averaged Boltzmann integrator parameterized by the general coupling set (C_e, C_N, C_mu, E/N, f_a), validate against the paper's Delta N_eff curves for the benchmark charge assignments, and release it so any astrophobic variant can be scanned.

members.model_name: Massive dark photon soliton EFT
members.description: No public solver exists for polarized vector Schrodinger-Poisson solitons; existing fuzzy-dark-matter soliton codes are scalar-field only, so the profile input to the Floquet and flux calculations cannot be generated with named public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public scalar Schrodinger-Poisson soliton shooting/relaxation code to a three-component massive vector field, outputting profiles for each polarization state parameterized by (m, soliton mass).

members.model_name: QCD axion hot-and-cold dark matter from saxion decay
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the nonthermal axion population from saxion decay: the card gives only an approximate distribution function, and computing Delta N_eff and the effective HDM mass m_eff self-consistently requires evolving a noncold species with the colder-than-thermal saxion-decay momentum spectrum through the CMB/LSS era.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the saxion-decay axion phase-space distribution f(q) as a function of T_sigma and the branching fraction, and implement it as a custom ncdm species in CLASS (which accepts user-supplied momentum distributions), validating against the analytic Delta N_eff and m_eff limits quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: T-model attractor scalar-field dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann or background code implements the T-model attractor potential: the background scan (V0, alpha, rho_i, m -> Omega_m today) including the flat plateau wings that make initial conditions non-generic, and the linear transfer function through that early phase, are not covered by existing ultralight-scalar solvers, which assume a harmonic m^2 phi^2 potential from the start.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ultralight-scalar Boltzmann code (axionCAMB or a CLASS scalar-field module) with the T-model potential V(phi)=V0 tanh(lambda_1 phi/m_p)^2, evolving the full background field through the plateau and oscillatory regimes and switching to the effective-fluid/harmonic treatment once oscillations are fast, validated against w=0 for n=1 and the kpc Jeans length at m~1e-22 eV.

members.model_name: Mixed axion/axino dark matter for thermal leptogenesis
members.description: No public coupled relic-density solver combines axion misalignment, thermal axino production, and the two nonthermal channels with possible saxion decay and entropy production, which the route lists as required and the paper explicitly omits.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a PQMSSM relic pipeline coupling IsaReD (or micrOMEGAs) neutralino output with the axion misalignment and thermal/nonthermal axino production rates in one Boltzmann code, adding an optional saxion entropy-dilution branch.

members.model_name: Colder freeze-in axino dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the DFSZ freeze-in axino phase-space distribution f(q) (decay and scattering collision terms plus saxion entropy dilution); the distribution feeding CLASS in step s2 comes from the authors' private Boltzmann calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's reduced collision terms for DFSZ 2-body decay, 3-body decay, and 2-to-2 scattering production in a public momentum-dependent freeze-in solver, with a saxion entropy-dilution factor Delta, outputting f(q) tables in CLASS ncdm psd format.

members.model_name: Coleman-Weinberg ultralight scalar dark matter with GeV-scale right-handed neutrinos
members.description: No numerical implementation exists for the dynamically induced thermal-misalignment mechanism: evolving the coherent scalar in its Coleman-Weinberg plus finite-temperature Higgs-portal potential through the electroweak crossover to obtain Omega_phi h^2 and the onset of oscillations; only the paper's semi-analytic A(m_phi) target curve is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated ODE solver for phi(T) using the SM lattice/dimensional-reduction thermal Higgs vev history and the CW-stabilized potential, with comoving-number conservation after oscillation onset, validated against the paper's statement that fixing Omega_DM determines A(m_phi).

members.model_name: Thermal hadronic axion dark matter with low-temperature reheating
members.description: No public code computes thermal hadronic-axion freeze-out, entropy-diluted yield, and axion-to-photon temperature ratio through a low-temperature-reheating history (scalar decay with entropy generation, 10 MeV <= T_rh <= 250 MeV); the primary paper's numerical implementation was never released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled scalar-decay/radiation/axion Boltzmann system from the primary-paper equations with hadronic axion-pion rates in a standalone solver (or extend an existing nonstandard-cosmology relic code to include the axion pion-scattering collision term), outputting T_F, Omega_a h^2, and T_a/T_gamma over the (m_a, T_rh) plane, validated by recovering the standard result for T_rh >> T_F.

members.model_name: Noninteracting WIMP and QCD axion dark matter in an early matter dominated epoch
members.description: The coupled modulus-radiation-axion-WIMP background Boltzmann solver used in the paper is not established as publicly released, so the relic densities and dilution factors that anchor both routes cannot be recomputed with an existing public tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or reimplement the paper's SciPy/BDF coupled-fluid solver as an open Python package, validating against the paper's relic-density and T_D benchmark figures and the radiation-dominated limit.

members.model_name: Stochastic QCD axion dark matter scenario
members.description: No numerical stochastic-inflation (Fokker-Planck/Langevin) solver is available to evolve the axion field distribution through a realistic time-dependent H(t) inflationary background and test whether stochastic equilibrium is reached within the assumed number of e-folds, which is the central validity question for the predicted abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a 1D Fokker-Planck (or lattice Langevin) solver for the axion field probability distribution with a user-specified H(t) from concrete low-scale inflation potentials, parameterized by (m_a, f_a, H_I, N_e), and validate against the analytic equilibrium distribution in the constant-H limit.

members.model_name: High-decay-constant QCD axion dark matter with PBH-seeded UCMHs
members.description: The neutron-star/UCMH transient radio signal is estimated at paper level; existing public neutron-star axion-photon conversion pipelines assume ambient halo dark matter and are not adapted to transient encounters with dense UCMH profiles.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing neutron-star magnetosphere axion-photon conversion code to take a time-dependent UCMH density profile as input and output transient radio flux densities and SKA detectability for given encounter geometries.

members.model_name: Hidden monopole dark matter via axion portal
members.description: No public recast code implements the momentum-dependent, spin-dependent monopole-nucleon cross section induced by the axion portal in direct-detection forecasts (PICO-500), nor the SHiP/beam-dump production and decay acceptance for the MeV-scale axion, so the m_a-f_a exclusion/reach contours cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a direct-detection recast framework such as DDCalc (or a WimPyDD-style rate calculator) with the model's q-dependent spin-dependent form factor and PICO-500 detector response, and digitize/implement SHiP axion production-and-decay acceptance from published sensitivity studies to overlay both on the m_a-f_a plane.

members.model_name: Thermal hadronic axion dark matter with kination
members.description: No public Boltzmann/freeze-out code computes the thermal hadronic-axion yield, freeze-out temperature T_F, and free-streaming scale with a kination expansion history (H proportional to T^3, no entropy production); the primary paper's numerical solution was never released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the primary-paper freeze-out equations with hadronic axion-pion interaction rates in a standalone module (or as a nonstandard-H(T) extension of an existing thermal-axion relic code), parameterized by (m_a, T_kin, g_*S,F), and validate by recovering the standard radiation-domination freeze-out when T_kin is high.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Peccei-Quinn axion-saxion model with thermal saxion effects
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver evolves the axion supermultiplet cosmology of this model: saxion coherent oscillation with thermal deformation and dissipation, thermal axino/saxion yields, saxion decays to axions/gluons, entropy injection, and the resulting axion cold component and Delta N_eff.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a dedicated coupled Boltzmann code (e.g. extending public mixed axion-neutralino freeze-out codes such as the Bae-Baer-Lessa-type setup) with inputs (F_a, T_R, m_sigma, initial saxion amplitude, branching fractions) and outputs (Y_sigma, Y_axino, Omega_a, Delta N_eff, dilution factor), validated against the paper's dissipation on/off limits.

members.model_name: Minimal PQ-NMSSM light singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: No code evolves the model's nonstandard cosmological history: late saxion decay with entropy production diluting the thermal singlino abundance, nonthermal LSP production, and the residual axion misalignment fraction that together set the final multi-component relic density.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple a saxion decay/entropy-injection Boltzmann module (of the mixed axion-neutralino type developed for PQ-augmented SUSY, e.g. Bae-Baer-Lessa style codes) to the micrOMEGAs freeze-out output, with inputs (v_PQ, saxion mass/lifetime, initial amplitude, misalignment angle) and output the diluted LSP plus axion abundance.

members.model_name: Non-sequestered LARGE-volume QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No implemented calculation of the QCD-axion misalignment abundance in the non-sequestered LVS modulus cosmology, where early matter domination and entropy injection from the O(10) TeV volume modulus modify the standard Omega_a(f_a, theta) relation depending on the decay timing relative to the QCD transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public axion relic solver (e.g. a MiMeS-style misalignment code that already handles non-standard expansion histories) with the modulus-dominated background H(T) and entropy-dilution factor derived from the decay_widths step, scanning f_a, theta_i, and T_d.

members.model_name: Planck-scale axion fuzzy-lump dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the model's three hierarchical ultralight axion species with phenomenological depercolation, i.e. species-dependent redshifts at which a dark-energy-like homogeneous condensate converts into pressureless clustering dark matter, so the multi-component linear matter-power suppression cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or CLASS's scalar-field fluid module) to evolve three axion fluids with independent masses and fractions, each with a time-dependent equation-of-state switch at its depercolation redshift, and output the combined transfer function over the r_H/r_B threshold parameterization.

members.model_name: Axion-axino dark matter with gravitino-sourced dark radiation
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver evolves the full PQ sector of this scenario - axion misalignment plus KSVZ/DFSZ axino thermal and freeze-in production, saxion decays to axions/gluons with possible entropy injection, LOSP freeze-out and decay, and gravitino decay to axino plus axion - so the multi-component axion/axino relic density and its consistency with the Delta N_eff prediction cannot be computed end-to-end.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a PQMSSM Boltzmann network (in the style of the mixed axion/neutralino codes of Bae, Baer et al.) with species {axion, axino, saxion, gravitino, LOSP, radiation}, parameterized by f_a, T_R, m_axino, theta_i, saxion branching fractions, and LOSP identity/lifetime, and release it as a standalone module or micrOMEGAs/ULYSSES-style extension.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary axion dark matter from topological defects
members.description: No public abundance calculator combines misalignment, string, and domain-wall contributions with the temperature-dependent QCD axion mass and the fitted defect-simulation quantities, so the mass-window derivation and its sensitivity to simulation inputs cannot be re-evaluated without reimplementing the paper's formulae.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the misalignment-plus-defect abundance formulae with a modern lattice chi(T) into a small public code (e.g. as an extension of a misalignment calculator like MiMeS), taking the defect spectrum fits from gap_1 outputs as swappable inputs and exposing N_DW and bias-term parameters for the wall-decay constraint overlay.

members.model_name: DFSZ freeze-in axino dark matter with bilinear R-parity violation
members.description: No public solver exists for the DFSZ freeze-in axino phase-space distribution: the channel-specific collision-term Boltzmann integration (2-body, 3-body, 2-to-2 with thermal masses) plus saxion entropy dilution is only implemented in the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's reduced collision terms in a public momentum-dependent freeze-in code that outputs f(q) and yield per production channel for given (m_axino, T_R, mu, M_2, f_a) and applies the saxion dilution factor, in a format directly ingestible by CLASS ncdm.

members.model_name: SIMP dark pions through the axion portal
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver evolves the dark-pion number density through 3-to-2 WZW freeze-out while simultaneously tracking axion-mediated kinetic equilibrium (dark-sector temperature evolution and energy exchange with the SM bath); standard relic codes like micrOMEGAs/MadDM only treat 2-to-2 freeze-out with a common temperature.
members.proposed_resolution: Write (or extend micrOMEGAs with) a two-temperature coupled Boltzmann module solving dY_pi/dx with the 3-to-2 collision term plus the axion-pion and axion-SM energy-exchange rates, parameterized by (m_pi, m_a, f_pi, f_a, N_c, N_f), and validate against the paper's thermalized-region boundary.

members.model_name: Inflationary light dark photon dark matter
members.description: No linear perturbation/transfer-function solver handles a massive vector (dark photon) dark matter field with the paper's inflationary near-scale-invariant transverse-mode initial spectrum; existing fuzzy-DM implementations (axionCAMB-type CLASS/CAMB modifications) treat scalar ULDM with misalignment initial conditions only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS/CAMB ultralight-DM module to evolve massive vector perturbations with the paper's I(phi)-produced mode spectrum as initial conditions, outputting the small-scale transfer suppression and an effective half-mode scale.

members.model_name: Sub-dominant axino decay gravitino dark matter
members.description: No transfer-function calculation exists for the mixed cold-gravitino plus relativistic decay-produced gravitino population: the card provides no phase-space distribution (distribution_function_available no) and the sub-3-percent warm-fraction bound is inherited from an approximate dark-radiation/warm-component estimate, not from a Boltzmann hierarchy for this two-population gravitino spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced gravitino momentum distribution f(q) from axino -> gravitino + axion (analytic for two-body decay of a frozen thermal axino population), combine it with the cold freeze-in gravitino component, and feed the tabulated mixed distribution to the CLASS ncdm module to compute the mixed cold+warm matter power spectrum as a function of Y_axino/Y_gravitino, m_axino, and tau_axino.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver evolves an ultralight scalar with a time-dependent effective mass that jumps at trapping (light axion-like phase to heavier trapped phase plus emergent dark energy) in the two-cosine potential; existing fixed-mass modules (axionCAMB, CLASS ULA/fluid implementations) do not cover the trapping transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS scalar-field/fluid module (or axionCAMB) with a background solver for the two-cosine potential and a perturbation sector whose effective sound speed and equation of state switch at z_tr, parameterized by (m, m0, f, c, n, z_tr), validated against the paper's z_tr~5 benchmark and the fixed-mass fuzzy-DM limit.

members.model_name: Invisible QCD axion sector compatible with ARS leptogenesis
members.description: No public ARS leptogenesis kinetic solver includes the PQ-sector interaction rates (axion and radial-mode scattering with the sterile neutrinos via h_N), so the compatibility of the axion sector with the baryon asymmetry rests on leading-rate estimates rather than a density-matrix computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Add h_N-mediated production and scattering rates for the sterile neutrinos (axion and PQ radial-mode channels) to a public ARS density-matrix code (AMIQS-type) and scan (f_a, h_N, m_N) to replace the leading-rate ARS viability condition with a quantitative boundary.

members.model_name: Inflaxion axion dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the kinetically mixed axion-inflaton two-field background equations through inflation, reheating, and onset of oscillations, which is needed to compute the phi_DM displacement and relic abundance beyond the paper's semi-analytic estimates across the (beta, m_a, m_phi, H_inf) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public axion misalignment code such as MiMeS (or write a stiff-ODE two-field solver) to include the derivative kinetic mixing term and the reheaton decay history, validating against the beta positivity interval and the f ~ 1e17 GeV ALP window quoted in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Oscillon-forming axion-like fuzzy dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the mixed transfer function of an ultralight fuzzy ALP condensate plus a relativistic ALP population injected at T_decay with the lattice-derived spectrum; the paper instead adapts two-component cold/warm fitting functions with modified r_osc scaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or CLASS with an effective fuzzy-DM fluid) by adding a non-cold ncdm species whose phase-space distribution is sourced at T_decay from the oscillon-decay spectrum, producing exact linear power spectra for the (m, p, M, r_osc, T_decay) space.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian axion-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public code evolves the non-Abelian axion-inflation system (SU(2) gauge-scalar instability band plus strong backreaction on the m_Q trajectory) to produce the peaked curvature spectrum P_zeta(k); the authors' Julia solver is private, and every downstream quantity (f_PBH, Omega_GW, CMB observables) depends on this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain release of the authors' Julia solver or reimplement it: solve the coupled axion-inflaton and SU(2) background equations with backreaction, evolve the gauge scalar perturbation modes through the |m_Q|<2 instability band, and validate against the paper's benchmark P_zeta peak.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L inflection-point inflation with axion dark matter
members.description: No reusable calculator implements the model's analytic chain (misalignment abundance, isocurvature bound, SN1987A check, RG-improved slow-roll observables); all relations exist only as formulas in the paper, so the routes cannot be run automatically over the (F_a, theta_a, H_inf, potential-parameter) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small model-card notebook encoding the paper's abundance and isocurvature relations plus a numerical slow-roll solver for the RG-improved B-L inflection potential (e.g. building on a generic slow-roll package), exposing F_a, theta_a, H_inf, N as inputs.

members.model_name: Axion cogenesis via kinetic misalignment without isocurvature
members.description: No public solver evolves the rotating Planck-scale PQ field from its inflationary initial conditions (Hubble-induced plus Planck-suppressed potential terms) through kinetic misalignment to the axion relic abundance; both the rotation setup (s1) and the Y_PQ-to-Omega_a h^2 integration (s2) are done with private, paper-specific calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public misalignment code such as MiMeS (or release a standalone ODE package) to evolve the complex PQ field with a quadratic Hubble-induced potential and conserved-charge kinetic-misalignment tracking, taking (f_a, m_a, H_I, T_R, Hubble-induced mass coefficients) as inputs and returning Y_PQ, Omega_a h^2, and the inflationary phase mass m_theta/H_I; validate against the paper's joint-abundance solutions.

members.model_name: mSUGRA mixed axion/axino dark matter
members.description: No coupled Boltzmann solver is wired into the route for the full PQ-augmented cosmology: the three-component relic sum uses separate analytic formulas, without simultaneous evolution of axion, thermal/nonthermal axino, saxion, gravitino, and late neutralino-NLSP decay for the T_R = 1e6-1e9 GeV regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or adapt from the coupled-Boltzmann follow-up literature the card cites) a coupled Boltzmann network for axion, axino, saxion, gravitino, and neutralino number densities as a function of T_R, f_a/N, and m_axino, and couple it to the Isajet spectrum output.

members.model_name: PQMSSM mixed axion/axino cold dark matter
members.description: No reusable public code assembles the full PQMSSM abundance pipeline for scans: the card notes the paper is formula-rich but no code artifact combines Isajet/IsaReD SUGRA-19 neutralino freeze-out with the analytic misalignment-axion, thermal-axino, and nonthermal-axino contributions into Omega_total h^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small scan wrapper that reads Isajet/IsaReD SUGRA-19 output and evaluates the paper's analytic axion misalignment, thermal axino, and mass-ratio-scaled nonthermal axino formulae over (f_a/N, theta_i, m_axino, T_R), applying the WMAP7 abundance and T_R > 10 MeV BBN windows.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter from axionic string radiation
members.description: No public semi-analytic string-axion abundance calculator packages the paper's pipeline (spectrum plus xi plus finite-temperature m_a(T) plus dilution factor Delta into Omega_axion h^2 and an f_a bound), even though the route's required_code_resources list one.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small open-source calculator that takes tabulated (xi, spectrum, m_a(T) fit, Delta, g_*) inputs and returns Omega_axion h^2 with propagated simulation uncertainties, validated by reproducing the paper's Omega proportional to (f_a/1e12 GeV)^1.19 scaling and the f_a <= 3e11 GeV bound.

members.model_name: Companion-axion dark matter model
members.description: The required code resource 'custom relic-abundance notebook or equivalent' for the two-axion misalignment calculation (temperature-dependent masses, mixing between a1 and a2, pre-/post-inflationary case switching, isocurvature amplitude) does not exist as a reusable implementation, so the preferred haloscope mass windows cannot be regenerated for other parameter choices.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's two-axion misalignment formulae (mass matrix diagonalization, temperature-dependent QCD-instanton masses, per-state Omega_i h^2, and the Planck beta_iso < 0.011 isocurvature check) as a documented notebook or small package validated against the paper's preferred-window and isocurvature-angle figures.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from a non-minimal curvaton scenario
members.description: No public solver evolves the non-minimal (axion-like, non-trivial field-metric) curvaton through inflation and its nonlinear post-inflation dynamics and decay to produce the final curvature spectrum P_zeta(k) and its non-Gaussianity; the card notes post-inflation dynamics materially alter the spectrum and lists a curvaton perturbation solver as a required-but-absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public multi-field transport code (PyTransport or MultiModeCode) with the non-trivial field metric and axion-like curvaton potential, and couple it to a delta-N/lattice treatment of post-inflationary curvaton oscillation and decay to output P_zeta(k) and f_NL over the field-metric dip parameters.

members.model_name: Mixed axion and asymmetric dark matter from Higgs dark matter decay
members.description: No quantitative solar model exists that couples a trapped 5 GeV ADM population in the Sun to axion production and coronal photon emission with 11-year solar-cycle modulation; the claimed cycle-correlated signal cannot be forward-modeled or tested with any public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing solar DM capture-and-transport framework (e.g. the capture/thermalization machinery in DarkSUSY or Asteria-style solar axion emission codes) with an ADM trapping profile and a parametrized cycle-dependent modulation, outputting axion luminosity and photon flux versus solar-cycle phase for comparison with solar irradiance and coronal data.

members.model_name: Blue axion dark-portal decay variant
members.description: No public forward model maps a decaying hot/non-cold blue-axion subcomponent (a -> gamma + dark photon) to COB mean intensity and angular power including the small-scale power suppression from the non-cold component; the source analysis pipeline is private and the card's computational_representation is null.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decay-emissivity plus limber angular-power module on top of a CLASS/CAMB non-cold (ncdm) transfer function, parameterized by (m_a, tau_a, hot fraction, temperature), and validate against the published HST 606 nm curves of arXiv:2205.01079.

members.model_name: Kreuzer-Skarke type IIB axiverse dark matter ensemble
members.description: The paper's pipeline from Kreuzer-Skarke topological data (up to h^{1,1}=491) to axion mass, decay-constant, and photon-coupling ensembles is not released as a reusable public code, so the ensemble itself cannot be regenerated or varied (e.g. different QED divisor choices) by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the CYTools-based sampling scripts that construct kinetic matrices, instanton potentials, and electromagnetic charge vectors from KS database entries, with documented conventions for the QED divisor and mass-eigenstate diagonalization.

members.model_name: Stiff-era scalar field dark matter for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation of complex, charge-conserving SFDM with a repulsive quartic and an early stiff phase: linear power-spectrum and CMB constraints on (m_s, lambda_s, transition temperatures) were not computed, and public fuzzy/axion-DM modules assume a real oscillating field without the stiff era.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing scalar-field-DM branch of CLASS or axionCAMB with the complex-field background (stiff, radiationlike, and CDM-like phases from the conserved-charge solution) and its perturbations including the lambda_s sound-speed term, then confront the resulting P(k) and CMB spectra with standard likelihoods.

members.model_name: Two-singlet Peccei-Quinn kinetic Nambu-Goldstone ultralight dark matter
members.description: No numerical solver exists for the two-singlet PQ system with kinetic Nambu-Goldstone modes: the coupled homogeneous background plus inhomogeneous heavy/light mode evolution is treated only in an adiabatic analytic approximation, so the ultralight mass window (10^-32 to 10^-14 eV), the a^-3 scaling, and the transfer-function behavior of the modulus dark matter cannot be computed beyond rough estimates or confronted with CMB/large-scale-structure data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled phi_a/phi_d field equations with kinetic angular-momentum terms as a dedicated background-plus-linear-perturbation code (a standalone stiff ODE solver coupled to a modified CLASS/axionCAMB fluid treatment, analogous to existing ultralight-axion solvers), validate against the paper's adiabatic limit, and output the effective equation of state and transfer function across the quoted mass range.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric DFSZ lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for rotating-PQ-field cosmology in the supersymmetric DFSZ realization: evolving the PQ rotation with saxion dynamics and thermalization, transferring PQ charge to B-L through the Weinberg operator with DFSZ Higgs-sector-mass-dependent transfer rates, and computing the kinetic-misalignment axion yield Y_a; both routes currently rest on the paper's analytic estimates, so only approximate allowed/excluded bands are reproducible.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a public numerical package that integrates the coupled saxion/axion equations of motion with thermalization rates and the B-L transport equations (Weinberg-operator transfer plus sphaleron redistribution) over (f_a, m_S, T_R, m_susy, N_DW, neutrino masses), outputting Y_B and Omega_a h^2 and validated against the paper's quoted DFSZ allowed regions and the ~30 TeV SUSY-scale lower bound.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric KSVZ lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for rotating-PQ-field cosmology in the supersymmetric KSVZ realization: evolving the PQ rotation with saxion dynamics and thermalization, transferring PQ charge to B-L through the Weinberg operator including the superpartner-scattering contributions to the transfer efficiency, and computing the kinetic-misalignment axion yield Y_a; both routes currently rest on the paper's analytic estimates, so only approximate allowed/excluded bands are reproducible.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a public numerical package that integrates the coupled saxion/axion equations of motion with thermalization rates and the B-L transport equations (Weinberg-operator transfer, sphaleron redistribution, and KSVZ heavy-quark and superpartner scattering rates) over (f_a, m_S, T_R, m_susy, N_DW, neutrino masses), outputting Y_B and Omega_a h^2 and validated against the paper's N_DW-dependent SUSY-scale lower bound and DM+baryogenesis band.

members.model_name: Kalb-Ramond-like particle dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the massive antisymmetric-tensor KRLP (dark-photon-like, axion-like, and Higgs-portal operators) exists for automated relic computation; the published cross sections must be hand-coded into a freeze-in integrator for every portal choice.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the paper's appendix cross sections (or the dual pseudovector formulation, which fits the FeynRules/CalcHEP pipeline) as a model package for the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module, validated by reproducing the primary relic-density curves for the dark-photon-like and axion-like portals.

members.model_name: Thermal hadronic axion in nonstandard cosmologies
members.description: No public code computes thermal axion production (gluon- and photon-coupling rates) through nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories (low-temperature reheating, early matter domination, kination); the interaction-rate integration exists only as the primary paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's axion interaction rates and modified Hubble/entropy evolution as an open momentum-averaged Boltzmann solver (e.g. a standalone Python module or an extension of a thermal-relic code) parameterized by m_a, f_a, T_end, and w, validated against the paper's LTR/EMD/kination benchmarks.

members.model_name: Inflaton-coupled ultralight vector dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/structure-formation solver handles an ultralight spin-1 condensate with frozen polarization and a nonthermal preheating-derived spectrum; existing fuzzy-DM machinery (axionCAMB/AxiCLASS, Schrodinger-Poisson solvers) is scalar-only, so the transfer function, half-mode scale, and core predictions rest on an unvalidated scalar analogy.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ultralight-axion Boltzmann code (AxiCLASS or axionCAMB) with a vector effective-fluid treatment sourced by the preheating spectrum, and adapt a Schrodinger-Poisson solver to the multi-polarization vector case to test the fuzzy-scalar analogy for cores and P(k) suppression.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 1 axion dark matter
members.description: No implemented relic-abundance and isocurvature calculator is attached to the route for the pre-inflationary misalignment scenario at f_A ~ 2.6e15-3.0e17 GeV, where the abundance requires tuned theta_i ~ 1e-3 to 1e-2 and the H_I < 1e9 GeV isocurvature bound must be evaluated jointly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard pre-inflationary misalignment abundance formula with anharmonic corrections and the Planck isocurvature amplitude as a small (f_A, theta_i, H_I) module, validating against the paper's Model 1 theta_i and H_I windows.

members.model_name: Explicit chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements this model's coherent axion-neutrino coupling and the late-transition perturbation source, so the CMB, lensing, BAO, and high-redshift-structure likelihoods cannot be evaluated; existing nu-DM scattering implementations cover a physically different interaction.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a fluid treatment of the coherent axion condensate coupled to the neutrino sector plus an injectable late-time perturbation source term, validate that the zero-transition limit recovers LCDM, and connect to Planck/ACT/SPT/BAO likelihoods via MontePython or Cobaya.

members.model_name: Spontaneous chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: The transition condition is judged only by vacuum ordering and rough nucleation estimates; no tunneling/nucleation computation for the finite-temperature axion-neutrino cosine potential with dimension-six/eight Higgs-axion operators has been performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply CosmoTransitions (or a comparable bounce solver) to the derived V_eff(a,T) to compute the nucleation temperature and rate across the (M, lambda, g, m_a, f) parameter space, confirming the quoted T ~ 0.1 MeV-0.01 eV transition window.

members.model_name: Hybrid mediation mixed axion-wino dark matter
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver exists for mixed axion-neutralino cosmology with axino and saxion production and decay, late entropy injection, and coherent axion oscillations; the paper cites private-code results from earlier mixed axion-neutralino studies, so the axion completion of the wino relic (the model's defining prediction) cannot be recomputed for the benchmark scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain release of) a coupled-yield solver for the PQ-augmented MSSM in the style of the cited Bae-Baer-type calculations — evolving neutralino, axion (coherent plus thermal), axino, and saxion abundances with decay and entropy terms, parameterized by (f_a, m_axino, m_saxion, T_R, wino annihilation cross section from micrOMEGAs) — and validate it against the wino-fraction range 0.02-0.32 quoted in the card.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.1 axion dark matter
members.description: No axion relic-abundance and isocurvature calculator is implemented for this route: the misalignment abundance as a function of f_A, theta_i and the isocurvature amplitude as a function of H_I are currently only cited from the source paper, not computable within the registry pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire an existing public misalignment solver (e.g. a MiMeS-style axion field-evolution code) into the route, parameterized by (f_A, m_A, theta_i, H_I, N_DW), and add the standard analytic isocurvature amplitude formula for the pre-inflationary branch.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.2 axion dark matter
members.description: No implemented relic-abundance and isocurvature calculator is attached to the route covering both the pre- and post-inflationary PQ histories allowed for this domain-wall-safe model across f_A ~ 1.3e7-1.5e13 GeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a (f_A, theta_i, H_I, N_DW) module combining the standard misalignment abundance with the Planck isocurvature bound for the pre-inflationary branch and existing string-decay abundance fits for the post-inflationary branch, validating against the paper's f_A/m_A window.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.1 scalar-singlet axion dark matter
members.description: No implemented relic-abundance and isocurvature calculator is attached to the route for the broad singlet-set f_A window with both pre- and post-inflationary PQ-breaking possibilities.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a (f_A, theta_i, H_I, N_DW) misalignment-plus-isocurvature module (with string-decay abundance fits for the post-inflationary branch once gap_1 fixes N_DW), validating against the paper's stated viability condition v_BL below about 1e13 GeV.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.2 scalar-singlet plus 10_F axion dark matter
members.description: No relic-abundance and isocurvature pipeline is connected for this model's singlet PQ-breaking history: mapping (f_A, theta_i, H_I, N_DW) to Omega_a h^2 and the CMB isocurvature amplitude is currently only a recast target with no Boltzmann/isocurvature likelihood rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire an existing axion relic calculator (e.g. a MiMeS-style misalignment solver) to the model's f_A/N_DW output, add the standard pre-inflationary isocurvature amplitude formula, and evaluate against the Planck isocurvature likelihood used by the cited SMASH-type analyses.

members.model_name: cosmological wetting transition scalar dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the two-scalar wetting background and perturbations: the phi-oscillation fluid with its effective sound speed, the chi transition epoch, and the post-transition rolling dark-energy phase are not coded in CLASS or CAMB, so CMB and matter-power predictions (and the claimed CDM-like growth before t_c) cannot be computed or fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in CLASS as a two-field dark sector: an oscillation-averaged effective fluid for phi (mass-dependent sound speed, as in ultralight-axion implementations) switching to a quintessence-like component at the transition, then constrain (T_c, f, M) against Planck plus BAO/growth likelihoods via MontePython or Cobaya.

members.model_name: Nonzero-initial-velocity axion misalignment dark matter
members.description: No public axion relic-abundance solver implements misalignment with nonzero initial field velocity: existing misalignment codes assume dot_theta_i = 0, so the paper's shifted f_a windows cannot be scanned automatically with temperature-dependent m_a(T) and entropy history.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a MiMeS-style misalignment solver (or write a small ODE code) to accept (theta_i, dot_theta_i) initial conditions with QCD-axion and ALP m_a(T), validated against the zero-velocity limit and the primary paper's analytic cases.

members.model_name: Triple-unification ultralight scalar dark fluid
members.description: The route contains no perturbation-level step at all: no Boltzmann/perturbation implementation exists for this non-minimally coupled (xi^2 R^2), symmetry-broken ultralight scalar, so the fuzzy-dark-matter small-scale cutoff and halo-scale phenomenology claimed for m ~ 1e-22 eV cannot be computed for this specific model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing ultralight-scalar Boltzmann module (axionCAMB or the CLASS ultralight-axion/SFDM branch) with the symmetry-breaking potential plus constant V0 offset and the non-minimal R^2 coupling, verify the standard fuzzy-DM transfer-function cutoff is recovered in the minimal-coupling limit, and add a background integrator spanning inflationary, oscillatory matter-like, and V0-dominated epochs.

members.model_name: Finite modular majoron
members.description: No integrator exists for the coupled cosmological history of this model: modulus stabilization by the Coleman-Weinberg potential, modulus decay to majorons, misalignment oscillations, and a possible early-matter-dominated era, all of which set both Omega_J and the dark-radiation contribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a background ODE integrator (rho_modulus, majoron field, radiation, with entropy injection at T_D) parameterized by (f_J, m_J, theta_i, T_R, T_D), validating against the paper's viable regions for f_J near 1e16 GeV, and release it as a small standalone package or an AlterBBN/CLASS-compatible module.

members.model_name: Long-lived axion domain wall dark matter
members.description: The 3D biased-domain-wall lattice simulation and its wall-masking/spectrum-extraction pipeline are private (run on UCR HPCC, no release identified), so the relic-abundance fit and axion spectra cannot be reproduced or re-run at other parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the biased N_DW=2 lattice code (a standard CosmoLattice/LatticeEasy-style scalar-field evolver with the biased periodic potential) together with the wall-masking spectrum analysis, validated against the paper's spectral components and relic contours.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: No public misalignment code implements the inflaton-dominated gravitational-reheating background (attractor exponent k, gravitational or non-minimally-coupled reheating branch) needed to compute Omega_a h^2 and the coupled Omega_GW(f) spectrum for this ALP scenario; existing misalignment calculators assume standard or generic nonstandard expansion histories without the paper's reheating transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public misalignment solver such as MiMeS (which already supports user-defined cosmologies) with the k-parameterized inflaton-oscillation equation of state and gravitational-reheating temperature evolution, and add a module computing the blue-tilted primordial tensor spectrum through the same background so relic-density and GW contours come from one consistent implementation.

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: No public misalignment code implements the inflaton-dominated gravitational-reheating background (attractor exponent k, gravitational or non-minimally-coupled reheating branch) needed to compute the QCD axion Omega_a h^2 with m_a(T) and the coupled Omega_GW(f) spectrum; existing misalignment calculators assume standard or generic nonstandard expansion histories without the paper's reheating transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public misalignment solver such as MiMeS (which supports user-defined cosmologies and the temperature-dependent QCD topological susceptibility) with the k-parameterized inflaton-oscillation equation of state and gravitational-reheating temperature evolution, plus a module computing the blue-tilted primordial tensor spectrum through the same background, so relic-density and GW contours come from one consistent implementation.

members.model_name: Landscape SUSY DFSZ mixed axion-neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled Boltzmann network of axion coherent oscillations, thermal axions, saxions, axinos, gravitinos, neutralinos, and radiation that sets the mixed axion-neutralino relic abundance; the paper's eight-equation code and its IsaReD interface are private.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled axion/saxion/axino/gravitino/neutralino Boltzmann system as a public module (or extension of micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY relic machinery), taking MSSM spectra and freeze-out cross sections from IsaReD or micrOMEGAs and the SUSY DFSZ decay widths and thermal production rates from the published mixed axion-WIMP literature, and validate against the paper's f_a sweet-zone contours.

members.model_name: Adjoint SU(5) KSVZ QCD axion
members.description: No public GUT-threshold solver or released scan data exists for the Adjoint SU(5) spectrum, so the M_GUT-f_a allowed region (and hence the (3-13)e-9 eV axion mass window) cannot be independently regenerated or varied against updated proton-decay and LHC limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-loop gauge-coupling running with Adjoint SU(5) threshold matching (e.g. generate RGEs with PyR@TE or SARAH, or a standalone script following the paper's equations), impose current Super-K/Hyper-K proton-lifetime and LHC colored-multiplet limits, and release the resulting M_GUT-f_a scan.

members.model_name: Non-adiabatically produced gravitational ultra-light scalar dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the gravitationally produced scalar's infrared-enhanced nonthermal distribution N_k(z = k/sqrt(2 m H_R)); the free-streaming suppression relative to CDM cannot be computed as a matter power spectrum without it.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's N_k as a tabulated psd file in CLASS's ncdm module (or an equivalent CAMB axion/ULDM branch for low-mass variants where wave effects matter), validate against the benchmark lambda_fs of about 70 pc, and release the input files.

members.model_name: Large-extra-dimension Kaluza-Klein axion dark matter with trapped solar modes
members.description: No general public integrator couples a standard solar model (temperature/density profiles) to KK-tower Primakoff, photon-coalescence, and transverse-plasmon production rates; the released KKaxionDensity repository only cross-checks the trapped density, so the production step cannot be rerun or varied over solar-model uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the existing KKaxionDensity code (or a solar-axion package in the style of SolarAxionFlux-type tools) with the KK-tower production kernels for Primakoff, coalescence, and plasmon decay, taking a tabulated solar model as input and emitting per-mode production spectra and trapped fractions.

members.model_name: Vector wave dark matter in the nonrelativistic Schrödinger-Poisson limit
members.description: The three-component vector Schroedinger-Poisson solver used for the paper's soliton-merger simulations is not publicly released, so the core nonrelativistic evolution step cannot be rerun, converged, or extended by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or re-implement a 3D multi-component Schroedinger-Poisson solver by extending an existing public scalar fuzzy-DM code (PyUltraLight, AxioNyx, or GAMER) to three equal-mass vector components with spin-density diagnostics, validated against the paper's binary-merger core-mass fractions.

members.model_name: Multi-ultralight-axion mixed dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements the accurate effective-fluid approximation for multiple ultralight axion species plus a CDM component; the paper's multi-ULA code is not stated to be public, and existing public codes (axionCAMB, AxiCLASS) treat a single ULA only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or axionCAMB) to N axion species with independent masses m_i and fractions Omega_ai using the paper's accurate effective-fluid approximation, validating against the published two-ULA transfer functions and the CDM limit.

members.model_name: Coherent-incoherent self-interacting bosonic dark matter framework
members.description: No linear Boltzmann/perturbation module implements the hybrid two-fluid (condensate plus particle) pressure and self-coupling terms needed to produce the model's matter power spectrum; the hydrodynamic-limit results exist only as paper-level calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled condensate and particle fluids with their effective sound speeds and quartic self-coupling g in CLASS (following the axionCAMB/ultralight-axion pattern), parameterized by m, g, and initial condensate fraction, reproducing the related hydrodynamic paper's perturbation examples as validation.

members.model_name: Extra-dimensional brane axion Kaluza-Klein dark matter
members.description: No public code evolves an axion KK tower's production and mass-dependent decays (lifetimes and branching ratios varying across the tower) through the early Universe to output electromagnetic injection histories, relic density, and N_eff; existing decaying-particle cosmology codes handle single species, not towers.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a decaying-particle BBN/injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN-class) to accept a spectrum of species with mass-indexed abundances Y(m) and lifetimes tau(m, Br), integrating over the KK tower parameterized by (n, m, M_*, f_PQ, T_R, Br); validate against the paper's benchmark T_R < 70 MeV and T_R < 350 MeV bounds.

members.model_name: Saxion-diluted gravitino dark matter with neutralino NLSP
members.description: No integrated thermal-history solver tracks leptogenesis yield, thermal gravitino production, NLSP freeze-out, and saxion entropy injection consistently; the card lists the leptogenesis efficiency as only approximate and requires a SUSY spectrum calculator link for the NLSP composition dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Boltzmann pipeline coupling a SUSY spectrum calculator (SoftSUSY/SPheno) for NLSP composition and lifetime with a modified-cosmology abundance solver that evolves saxion, radiation, gravitino, NLSP, and baryon-asymmetry comoving densities through the entropy-injection epoch.

members.model_name: Plateau-potential string axion ultralight dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function code implements the plateau-potential ULA perturbation equations with delayed oscillation and parametric resonance; existing fuzzy-DM modules assume a quadratic potential and cannot produce the resonance-amplified power spectrum near the Jeans scale.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a fuzzy-DM branch of CLASS or axionCAMB with the full V(phi)=(m f)^2 (phi/f)^2/[1+(phi/f)^2]^alpha potential: evolve the background with delayed onset x_osc, add the linear mode equation with the time-dependent effective mass V'' to capture the resonance band, and validate that the standard ULA suppression is recovered as alpha approaches quadratic behavior.

members.model_name: Real scalar condensate freeze-in model
members.description: No numerical implementation exists of the paper's coupled equations for the particle distribution f(k,t) and condensate envelope A(t) with the full set of Markovianized collision operators (including condensate decay, scattering, and stimulated processes); existing freeze-in solvers cannot capture number transfer between the condensate and the particle bath.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's local coupled Boltzmann system as a momentum-binned stiff-ODE solver over (m_phi, m_chi, g, lambda_phi, lambda_chi, initial amplitude), validated against the stated limits: energy conservation without expansion/collisions, pure freeze-in at zero initial amplitude, and pure misalignment at zero portal coupling.

members.model_name: KSVZ axion dark matter with dimension-greater-than-five heavy-quark decays
members.description: The coupled solver for heavy colored Q freeze-out, early matter domination, entropy injection from d>5 operator decays, and the resulting modified H(T) feeding the axion misalignment calculation exists only as the authors' custom private integration; no public code reproduces the (m_Q, d, Lambda) to (T_decay^Q, dilution, Omega_a h^2) pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Q-sector Boltzmann system (strong-annihilation freeze-out, matter domination, d>5 decay width in terms of Lambda and m_Q) as an open cosmology module and couple its H(T) and entropy history to a public misalignment solver such as MiMeS, validating against the paper's benchmarks (theta_i = 0.5 and pi/3) and the recovery of the standard misalignment bound when Q never dominates.

members.model_name: PQ-inflation QCD axion kinetic-misalignment model
members.description: No public code exists for the coupled radial-saxion/angular-axion background evolution of this PQ-inflation model through reheating, including inflaton decays and scattering into heavy quarks, Higgses, and axions and tracking of the Noether PQ charge; the paper's numerical solution is private, so T_reh, Y_theta, and Delta N_eff cannot be recomputed across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a public background-evolution module (an ODE solver for the Einstein-frame PQ field with the pole-inflation potential, PQ-violating rotation source, and perturbative decay/scattering reheating rates) that outputs T_reh, Y_theta, and the axion dark-radiation abundance as functions of f_a, dot_theta_end, and the PQ-violating coefficients, following the kinetic-misalignment formalism of the cited literature.

members.model_name: AMSB axino-LSP mixed axion/axino dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the thermally produced axino relic abundance as a function of f_a/N, m_axino, and T_R for the AMSB spectra considered; the paper relies on benchmark curves, so scanning the mixed axion/axino parameter space cannot currently be automated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published hard-thermal-loop axino production rates from QCD scatterings as a small standalone module (or a micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY extension) taking (f_a/N, m_axino, T_R) plus the Isajet-generated AMSB spectrum, and validate against the paper's T_R versus m_axino benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Ultralight axion fuzzy dark matter with instanton potential and temperature-dependent mass
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver (axionCAMB or CLASS-based ULA code) implements the temperature-dependent axion mass m_a(T) with power-law index n and the anharmonic cosine-potential corrections, so CMB spectra, isocurvature transfer, and the modified matter-power cutoff for this model cannot be computed; the paper explicitly leaves the axionCAMB study out of scope.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB (or the CLASS ULA implementation) with a parameterized m_a(T) = m_a (T_osc/T)^n turn-on and anharmonicity-corrected effective fluid initial conditions from the paper's misalignment solution, validated against the analytic delayed-oscillation suppression scale.

members.model_name: Emergent strong-CP vector dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/transfer-function code covers ultralight spin-1 dark matter near the fuzzy limit with polarization (spin-density) degrees of freedom; existing fuzzy-DM solvers target scalar fields.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an AxiCLASS/axionCAMB-style fuzzy-DM module to a massive vector field, including the three polarization states, and validate the small-scale suppression scale against the scalar fuzzy-DM limit.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with subdominant dressed primordial black holes
members.description: No neutron-star magnetosphere ray-tracing/plasma code is attached to predict the transient radio-line flux, bandwidth, and directionality from axion-photon conversion during a minihalo crossing; the analytic conversion formulae carry order-of-magnitude plasma uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing axion-photon ray-tracing framework for neutron-star magnetospheres (of the kind used for axion radio-line searches) to time-dependent minihalo-crossing density profiles, with anisotropic Goldreich-Julian plasma and refraction included, outputting S_nu(t) and line shape.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with photon-dark-photon gauge-field depletion
members.description: The model-specific lattice code evolving the coupled ALP-photon-dark-photon system with the mixed (g_AX/2f) phi F Xtilde coupling is private; no public repository exists, so the relic-depletion and magnetogenesis results cannot be reproduced or scanned beyond the published benchmarks.
