members.proposed_resolution: Release or re-implement the coupled axion-gauge lattice solver (e.g. as an extension of LATTICEEASY or CosmoLattice adding U(1) x U(1)_dark gauge fields with the three topological couplings), validated against the paper's f ~ 10^15 GeV homogeneous benchmark.

members.model_name: Interacting scalar-field dark matter with quintessence dark energy
members.description: No public CLASS or CAMB implementation exists of the conformally coupled scalar-fluid system, i.e. the time-averaged dark-matter fluid with time-varying w_DM(z), scale-dependent effective sound speed c_eff^2(k,z), non-adiabatic pressure perturbations, and coupled quintessence perturbations delta phi; without it CMB spectra and the matter power spectrum cannot be computed for data comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's averaged background equations and coupled perturbation equations as a CLASS fork (new interacting-fluid species with tabulated w_DM(z), c_eff^2(k,z), and coupling source terms Q_0, Q_1), validating against the uncoupled fuzzy-DM limit when the conformal coupling is switched off; then attach standard Planck/BAO/weak-lensing likelihoods.

members.model_name: Three-Higgs flavored Peccei-Quinn invisible axion model
members.description: No relic-abundance calculation exists for the 3HFPQ axion class: the misalignment/domain-wall contribution as a function of v_PQ, N_DW, and the PQ-breaking epoch is not implemented, so whether a given charge assignment yields the full dark matter density cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard misalignment relic-density formulae (e.g. with a MiMeS-style axion cosmology code) parameterized by (m_a, v_PQ, N_DW, pre- vs post-inflationary PQ breaking), applying published string-wall simulation calibrations for the post-inflationary N_DW = 1 variants.

members.model_name: Light vector dark matter with neutrino contact scattering
members.description: No numerical Boltzmann solver treats thermalization of the misalignment-produced vector condensate and distortion of the neutrino distribution via the dimension-seven neutrino-vector operator in a low-reheating (T_R ~ 5 MeV) cosmology, so the BBN/CMB constraint rests on single-scattering rate estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the coupled momentum-space Boltzmann equations for the nu-X system in a low-reheating background, extending the low-T_R neutrino thermalization framework of arXiv:1411.6005 with the s^2-scaling collision term, and map the result onto N_eff and BBN abundances.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled ultra-light axion cold dark matter
members.description: No public Einstein-Boltzmann code includes the xi R phi^2 non-minimal coupling for an ultralight axion: the paper's custom recast is not packaged, and existing ULA solvers lack the non-minimal background and perturbation terms, so P(k), Phi(k,a), and the dark-radiation fraction cannot be regenerated across (xi, m_phi, initial-condition) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or CLASS's scalar-field module) with the non-minimally coupled background and linear perturbation equations, including a WKB/effective-fluid switch in the rapid-oscillation regime and support for adiabatic, isocurvature, and mixed initial conditions; validate by recovering the xi=0 ULA limit and reproducing the primary paper's power spectra.

members.model_name: Dark inflaxion
members.description: No implemented solver evolves the coupled a0 field, decaying a1 inflaton, and radiation densities through reheating for this model; the a0 relic abundance depends on the model-linked initial conditions and the g_a-dependent expansion history, so generic single-ALP misalignment calculators do not apply directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's background equations as a small ODE system (a0, a1, radiation with a1 -> photons decay at rate set by g_a), scanning (M_c, m_phi, g_a, initial displacements) and validating against the paper's abundance curves and the 59-61 e-fold benchmark.

members.model_name: Natural AMSB higgsino-axion dark matter
members.description: No public coupled-Boltzmann solver covers the SUSY DFSZ axion/axino/saxion/neutralino/gravitino system needed to compute the full mixed dark-matter abundance; the eight coupled equations the paper identifies were never run for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the eight coupled Boltzmann equations (WIMP, axion, axino, saxion, radiation, gravitino) of the Bae-Baer-Lessa-style mixed axion-neutralino cosmology as a public module interfaced to IsaReD/Isajet spectra, parameterized by PQ scale f_a, axino and saxion masses, and reheating temperature.

members.model_name: QCD axion hilltop dark matter from heavy-axion phase shift
members.description: No public numerical calculator covers hilltop QCD-axion misalignment with the phase-shift initial condition: the abundance for theta_i near pi requires solving the axion field equation with the full anharmonic (log-divergent) enhancement and the temperature-dependent QCD axion mass, which the card handles only via the paper's analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing misalignment solver (e.g. a public axion relic code solving the field equation with the dilute-instanton-gas or lattice-QCD chi(T)) to hilltop initial conditions theta_i -> pi, including the heavy-axion phase-shift mapping from inflationary parameters to theta_i, and validate against the paper's Omega h^2 = 0.12 at f_a ~ 3e9 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Fuzzy dark fluid unified scalar
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the unified dark fluid's background and linear perturbations with the Mexican-hat potential and non-minimal R^2 gravitational coupling, so CMB/LSS observables can only be compared through quoted summary bounds rather than computed spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the CLASS scalar-field/quintessence sector (or the AxiCLASS ultralight-axion module) with the model's Mexican-hat potential, V0 term, and non-minimal R^2 coupling, including field perturbations through the oscillatory regime via an effective-fluid treatment, then attach the standard Planck and LSS likelihoods.

members.model_name: Axi-Higgs ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann-solver implementation couples the rolling ultralight axion to a time-dependent Higgs VEV shift Delta v(z): existing varying-electron-mass CLASS/CAMB modifications treat the shift as constant through recombination, and ultralight-axion codes (e.g. axionCAMB-style) do not include the Higgs coupling, so the correlated early/late effects central to this model cannot be forward-modeled.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS (or CAMB) by adding the axi-Higgs scalar field to the background and perturbation equations, feeding its Delta v(z) into a modified recombination module (HyRec/RecFast with electron-mass rescaling) so the sound horizon, damping scale, and scale-dependent growth are computed consistently from (m_a, C, a_initial).

members.model_name: QCD axion hybrid-inflation dark matter
members.description: No public implementation exists of the two-axion hybrid-inflation dynamics (background trajectory through the waterfall and the coupled curvature/isocurvature perturbations), including the prolonged-waterfall regime where superhorizon evolution matters; this blocks both the dynamically fixed theta_i and the CMB spectral-index bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-axion potential (multi-natural inflation plus V_QCD(a - r_mix phi)) in a multi-field transport code such as PyTransport or MultiModeCode, extending it to track the waterfall instability; validate by reproducing the paper's figure-level f_phi > ~2.1e7 GeV and f_a > ~7.5e7 GeV CMB-compatible bands and the single-field low-n_s limit.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric axion dark matter with early stronger QCD
members.description: No numerical solver evolves the axion zero mode and its fluctuation delta_theta through the intermediate stronger-QCD epoch with a time-dependent axion mass m_a(t) and evolving f_a; the isocurvature suppression factor rests on analytic order-of-magnitude estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard misalignment/axion-cosmology solver to integrate the mode equations for theta and delta_theta with a parameterized stronger-QCD mass history m_a(Lambda_QCD_early(t)), the intermediate transition time, and the f_a(t_I) to f_a(t_0) relaxation, outputting the damping factor and Omega_a over the (H_tI, f_a_t0, Lambda_QCD_early) space.

members.model_name: PQ-augmented MSSM mixed axion/neutralino cold dark matter
members.description: No public coupled Boltzmann solver exists for the PQMSSM mixed-CDM abundance calculation: simultaneous evolution of axino, saxion, gravitino, and neutralino yields with late decays, neutralino re-annihilation, entropy dilution, and dark-radiation production. The published treatments (the paper's algorithm and the follow-up coupled-equation work) rely on private code layered on Isajet/IsaReD.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled Boltzmann network of the mixed axion/neutralino papers (yields, decay temperatures T_D and T_e, entropy injection, re-annihilation condition, Delta N_eff from saxion -> aa) as a public module that takes Isajet/IsaReD or micrOMEGAs neutralino spectra and annihilation rates as input and scans over f_a/N, T_R, m_axino, theta_i, and saxion branching fractions.

members.model_name: Light asymmetric Bose gas dark matter with present-day condensate
members.description: No Boltzmann/linear-perturbation implementation exists for a conserved-charge complex-scalar Bose gas with a present-day condensate: existing ultralight-scalar modules (axionCAMB, CLASS fuzzy-DM extensions) assume a real, charge-symmetric field without chemical potential, so the model's linear matter power suppression cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS ultralight-scalar/fluid module with the condensate-plus-thermal two-component equations of state and sound speeds derived from the paper's Bose-Einstein distributions (chemical potential and condensed fraction as extra parameters), outputting transfer functions over the sub-eV mass range.

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled massive vector dark matter
members.description: No inflationary mode solver exists for the non-minimally curvature-coupled massive vector: transverse and longitudinal polarization spectra as functions of (m_X, xi_vector, H_I, N_tot, reheating history) are unavailable, which cuts off every downstream quantity (isocurvature power, small-scale density contrast, induced-GW source).
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a numerical solver for the transverse and longitudinal vector mode equations on a parameterized inflation-plus-reheating background (extending existing dark-photon inflationary-production codes to nonzero xi_vector), validated against the minimally coupled vector misalignment limit and the paper's scalar-like identification for the homogeneous mode.

members.model_name: Electroweak symmetric dark matter ball
members.description: No public solver exists for finite-charge non-topological soliton solutions of a complex Higgs-portal scalar with an electroweak-symmetric interior (coupled phi and Higgs profiles), which is needed to map (lambda_hphi, lambda_phi, mu_phi, Q) to M_DMB, R_DMB, and energy per charge.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a shooting/relaxation ODE solver for the coupled scalar-Higgs bounce-like profile equations at fixed charge Q (a straightforward extension of standard Q-ball profile solvers), validate against the primary paper's numerical soliton profiles, and release it with an interpolation table over the coupling space.

members.model_name: Type-II seesaw electroweak-mass axion-like dark matter
members.description: No oscillation code implements the ALP-neutrino matter potential lambda_a_nu of this type-II seesaw model in dense ALP backgrounds, and no standardized dense-ALP environment (axion-star density profile) module exists to feed it, so the smoking-gun oscillation signature can only be reproduced as the paper's single benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend nuSQuIDS or GLoBES with an ALP-induced flavor-dependent matter potential proportional to the neutrino mass matrix and triplet mixing, coupled to a parameterized axion-star/local-ALP-density profile, scanning (lambda_a_nu, m_a, f_a, local ALP density).

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/transfer-function code computes linear power spectra for general N-field ULA mixtures with arbitrary masses m_i and fractions f_i; existing ULA solvers handle one (or few) axion species and are benchmarked on the single-field case.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB or AxiCLASS to loop over N ULA species with independent (m_i, f_i), using the effective-fluid oscillation-averaged treatment per field, and verify the single-field transfer function is recovered at N=1.

members.model_name: Heavy QCD axion dark matter from sterile-axion avoided level crossing
members.description: No public two-field axion background solver exists for the sterile-QCD axion avoided level crossing: the coupled oscillation equations with the temperature-dependent QCD axion mass must be solved numerically to cover nonadiabatic transitions and to scan (m_sterile, mixing angle, theta_S,0) beyond the paper's adiabatic analytic scaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled two-axion equations of motion with the lattice-QCD chi(T) susceptibility (extending a MiMeS-style single-axion misalignment solver to a two-field mass matrix), validated against the no-transfer limit at zero mixing and the adiabatic near-total-transfer regime.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with curvature-induced PQ breaking
members.description: No public numerical solver exists for the curvature-modified axion misalignment evolution: the coupled evolution of the axion in the time-dependent Hubble-induced mass plus temperature-dependent QCD potential (adiabatic relaxation) needed to obtain Omega_a h^2 and the surviving isocurvature amplitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an ODE integrator for the axion field with the paper's curvature-induced mass term and a lattice-QCD topological-susceptibility fit (Borsanyi et al. style chi(T)), and validate by recovering the paper's viable (f_a, theta_I) regions including the GUT-scale f_a ~ 1e16 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Axion trapping by cosmic string wakes
members.description: No reusable semi-analytic code implements the cosmic-string wake evolution through a first-order QCD transition (straight and wiggly strings) together with the axion trapping/release density profile, so the sheet-like isocurvature prediction cannot be regenerated or scanned over string velocity, wake overdensity, and QCD parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's semi-analytic wake and interface-collapse model as a small standalone code taking (string tension/velocity, wake dimensions, T_QCD, axion 1/k^2 spectrum) as inputs and outputting the released sheet density profile, validating against the paper's straight-string numbers.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with quasi-flat stochastic inflationary misalignment
members.description: No public stochastic-inflation Fokker-Planck solver evolves the QCD axion misalignment-angle probability distribution through a realistic finite-duration inflation with time-dependent H(N), which is the central ingredient replacing the equilibrium stochastic-window assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a Fokker-Planck / Langevin lattice solver for a spectator axion in stochastic inflation, parameterized by f_a, the inflationary potential (or H(N) trajectory), and inflation duration, validated against the constant-H equilibrium limit and the paper's quasi-flat regime.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with early matter domination
members.description: No public relic-abundance solver computes QCD axion misalignment plus string/domain-wall production through an early matter-dominated expansion history with entropy injection; the card's EMDE Boltzmann/relic calculation exists only as the paper's private solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing axion relic-abundance code (e.g. the misalignment module used in public axion codes such as AxionNet-style solvers or a lightweight standalone ODE code) with a coupled matter-radiation-decay background (rho_M, rho_R, T_R as parameters) so Omega_a(f_a, theta_i, T_R) can be evaluated on a grid.

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled (pseudo-)scalar dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary mode-function solver exists for a spectator scalar with a non-minimal xi R phi^2 coupling: the superhorizon evolution, stochastic distribution, and resulting density-fluctuation spectrum P_delta_phi(k) as functions of (m_phi, xi, phi_e, H_I, N_tot, reheating history) must currently be assembled by hand from the paper's analytic approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a numerical spectator-field mode solver (Bunch-Davies initialized mode functions evolved through a parameterized inflation-to-reheating background), parameterized by (m_phi, xi, H_I, N_tot, reheating model), validated against the minimal misalignment xi=0 limit and the paper's de Sitter analytics, and including a field-excursion check for negative xi.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion extended model E_I with vectorlike matter and mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No tool on the card treats the coupled saxion/axino/axion/neutralino cosmology: saxion and axino decays can inject entropy, dilute or augment both relic components, and produce dark-radiation axions constrained by Delta N_eff, but the route computes the axion and neutralino abundances independently with a simple two-component sum.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a micrOMEGAs-style relic pipeline with a coupled Boltzmann solver tracking neutralino, axion (misalignment plus thermal), saxion, and axino energy densities with their decay widths and entropy injection, parameterized by f_A, saxion/axino masses, and the reheating temperature, validated against the mu=250 GeV benchmark fraction of about 0.058.

members.model_name: Kalb-Ramond gravitational axion dark matter from heavy sterile fermions
members.description: The vacuum-lifetime condition on f_b/m_N relies on a rough analytic bounce estimate in the source appendix; no numerical implementation of the dimension-six-truncated KR one-loop potential in a bounce solver exists to map the metastability boundary across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the one-loop KR-axion effective potential in CosmoTransitions (or FindBounce) and compute the bounce action as a function of f_b/m_N and the string mass scale, validating against the source's long-lifetime limit for f_b >> m_N.

members.model_name: QCD axion-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/entropy-history solver implements the coupled QCD-axion-mediated dark sector: freeze-out into axions, freeze-in from SM collisions, and freeze-in from axion annihilations with T_RH-dependent thermalization hierarchies must currently be pieced together from the paper's regime-by-regime analytic formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a hidden-sector-capable relic code (e.g. the micrOMEGAs hidden-sector module or a DRAKE-style two-temperature solver) with the axion-mediated collision terms and separated-sector entropy tracking, outputting Omega_chi h^2 and Delta N_eff continuously across the freeze-out/freeze-in boundary.

members.model_name: ULAP oscillon dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function solver handles a mixed dark-matter component of dense oscillons plus a homogeneous ultralight field; existing fuzzy-DM solvers (axionCAMB-type) assume a purely homogeneous wave-like component, so the modified small-scale power spectrum cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB (or CLASS with an ultralight-axion module) with an oscillon component modeled as a cold clumpy species with an initial isocurvature/Poisson power contribution parameterized by the lattice-derived oscillon mass function and energy fraction.

members.model_name: Axiogenesis rotating QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No public numerical solver exists for the rotating PQ-field cosmology of this model: initiation of rotation by the P^n/M^(n-4) operator, thermal friction/damping of the radial mode, PQ-charge depletion after the electroweak epoch, and delayed axion trapping at the QCD transition are only captured by the paper's analytic scalings.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a numerical equation-of-motion solver for the complex PQ field with thermal potential and friction terms, evolving charge density from rotation onset through weak sphaleron freeze-out and QCD trapping, and validate against the paper's overproduction factor of about 140 at f_a = 1e8 GeV, T_ws = 130 GeV.

members.model_name: Darkly charged mirror-sector relics in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: No multi-component hidden-sector relic calculator exists for the mirror pi'/e'/p' system, which requires coupled Boltzmann evolution with a mirror-sector temperature ratio, axion-mediated thermal contact and decoupling, and mirror QCD confinement rearranging abundances after heavy-quark freeze-out.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a hidden-sector Boltzmann code (micrOMEGAs hidden-sector mode or a DRAKE-style solver) with two-temperature evolution and a confinement-epoch abundance rearrangement module, parameterized by Lambda_QCD', v_EW', alpha_QED', and the temperature ratio.

members.model_name: FASER fermionic dark-sector cascade model
members.description: No forward-detector simulation covers this model's full chain: gluon-portal X-prime production in the ATLAS forward line, the X-prime to dark-sector cascade, propagation of long-lived X to 480 m, and FASER acceptance/efficiency for displaced multi-lepton pairs plus missing momentum, so event yields and an event-count likelihood cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public FORESEE forward-physics package with the gluon-coupled axion-like X-prime production mode and the X-prime -> X -> Y + eta-like cascade decay chain, attach FASER Run III geometry and efficiency maps, and wrap the resulting signal yields in a Poisson event-count likelihood with the paper's background assumptions.

members.model_name: FASER scalar dark-sector cascade model
members.description: No forward-detector simulation covers the scalar cascade chain: gluon-portal X-prime production at the ATLAS IP, the X-prime to scalar dark-sector cascade, long-lived scalar X propagation to 480 m, and FASER acceptance/efficiency for displaced multi-lepton pairs plus missing momentum, so event yields and an event-count likelihood cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public FORESEE forward-physics package with the gluon-coupled axion-like X-prime production mode and the scalar X -> Y + eta-like cascade with its branching ratios, attach FASER Run III geometry and efficiency maps, and wrap the yields in a Poisson event-count likelihood.

members.model_name: Dark-confining axiverse heavy axion dark matter
members.description: No public code solves the coupled dark-glueball/radiation/axion system in which long-lived dark glueballs drive an early matter-dominated era whose entropy release dilutes the misalignment abundance of the keV-MeV heavy axion; the abundance is currently obtained only from rough analytic dilution estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Write an ODE integrator (or extend an existing early-matter-domination relic code) for the coupled glueball, radiation, and coherent-axion energy densities, parameterized by (Lambda_D, f_a, theta_i, glueball lifetime), returning diluted Omega_a h^2 and T_RH, and validate against the paper's overproduction-without-dilution limit.

members.model_name: QCD axion-ALP mass mixing with explicit PQ symmetry breaking
members.description: No public code evolves the coupled QCD-axion/ALP system with temperature-dependent mass mixing and an explicit PQ-breaking potential through level crossing, so eigenvalue evolution, adiabaticity, and the final Omega_a and Omega_A abundances all rest on the authors' private numerics.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public misalignment solver such as MiMeS (or write a standalone coupled-EOM integrator) to two axion fields with the V_mix + V_PQ potential, using published lattice chi(T) for the QCD axion mass, tracking adiabatic versus non-adiabatic eigenstate transfer, and validate against the paper's R_m regions and abundance-suppression benchmarks.

members.model_name: Flaxino dark matter with stau NLSP
members.description: No numerical relic-abundance implementation exists for the flaxino: thermal production after thermal inflation plus nonthermal stau-decay contributions, including flaton-sector entropy release and branching to axions, are only covered by the primary paper's approximate analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flaxino production Boltzmann equations (axino-like thermal scattering rates rescaled by F_a plus frozen-out stau decay injection) in a micrOMEGAs- or DarkSUSY-style relic module extended with the thermal-inflation reheating and entropy-dilution history, validated against the primary paper's benchmark abundance estimates.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled relativistic BEC dark matter
members.description: No self-consistent halo-profile solver exists for the non-minimally coupled relativistic BEC: the primary calculation perturbs a fixed NFW input with the L^2 G_mu_nu derivative coupling instead of solving the coupled condensate (Gross-Pitaevskii/Madelung) plus modified Poisson system with a condensation criterion, so the claimed critical L = r_s/6 core behavior is unverified.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing scalar-field-dark-matter halo solver (a Schrodinger-Poisson/Gross-Pitaevskii code of the PyUltraLight class) with the Einstein-tensor derivative-coupling term in the Newtonian limit and a density-triggered condensation criterion, and solve for equilibrium profiles as a function of L, m, and self-coupling.

members.model_name: Axion-curvaton primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No second-order induced-GW integrator is bundled for this model, and the axion-curvaton case is non-standard: the scalar perturbations source tensors around curvaton decay rather than at horizon reentry in radiation domination, so public radiation-era induced-GW kernels (SIGWfast-class codes) do not directly apply.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the induced-GW transfer kernel for curvaton-decay-era sourcing (delayed sourcing between curvaton oscillation and decay) and implement it as an extension of a public second-order induced-GW integrator such as SIGWfast, taking the model's blue curvaton P_R(k) and decay epoch as inputs and returning Omega_SGW(f).

members.model_name: Reheating-induced inflaxion axion dark matter
members.description: No public code evolves the kinetically mixed axion-inflaton system through low-scale reheating with a temperature-suppressed axion potential, so the reheating-induced displacement (the input to the abundance formula) can only be estimated with the paper's analytic approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public misalignment code with temperature-dependent mass support (e.g. MiMeS) or write a scipy-based two-field background ODE module that adds the dimension-four kinetic mixing kappa and the reheaton decay width, outputting the axion displacement and T_osc over the (kappa, f, m_a0, T_max) hierarchy.

members.model_name: Axion kination dark matter from kinetic misalignment
members.description: The modified CLASS version implementing the early matter and kination expansion eras (used with MontePython in the paper) is not public, and no released Boltzmann code supports this axion-rotation expansion history, so CMB/BBN allowed regions cannot be independently recomputed or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a CLASS patch that parameterizes the background with (T_MK, T_KR, Delta N_eff) for a rotating-axion fluid, couple it to MontePython/Cobaya with Planck and BAO likelihoods, and add a BBN module (e.g. via PArthENoPE or PRIMAT tables) for the light-element consistency check.

members.model_name: Charged scalar field dark matter with dark photon
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver module implements linear perturbations of a charged complex scalar field with dark U(1) coupling; existing CLASS/axionCAMB fuzzy-DM implementations cover only the neutral real-field case, so the model-specific transfer function cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing CLASS scalar-field-DM branch (or axionCAMB) with the paper's covariant complex-field perturbation equations including the dark U(1) gauge sector, and validate against the neutral-SFDM limit.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Peccei-Quinn Dirac-neutrino axion-axino dark matter
members.description: The combined axion-plus-axino relic density and Delta N_eff are computed only with approximate branch-dependent analytic formulae; no numerical Boltzmann implementation of the flaton/thermal-inflation cosmology (flaton decay, entropy release, axino production from flaton and neutralino decays) exists to map the narrow viable window precisely.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled background equations (flaton oscillation and decay, radiation, axino and RH-sneutrino number densities) as a numerical evolution code, validating against the paper's analytic branch formulae, and update the Delta N_eff prediction against Planck 2018 posteriors.

members.model_name: Two-axion 1 Hz ALP dark matter with low-scale inflation
members.description: No implemented forward model evolves the coupled two-axion system (1 Hz ALP plus QCD axion) through low-scale inflation and reheating to compute Omega_a h^2 from (m_a, f_a, f_QCD, H_inf, misalignment angles); the card's only route is a placeholder data transform with no relic-abundance step.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a coupled background ODE solver for the two-axion potential with mixing during and after ultra-low-scale inflation (a small standalone Python/Mathematica code, or an extension of existing axion misalignment codes such as the MiMeS misalignment solver) parameterized by H_inf, e-fold count, and the two decay constants.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_I with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public coupled-Boltzmann code tracks the saxion/axino decay history, entropy injection, and Delta N_eff from axion dark radiation for the SUSY DFSZ B_I setup; the card's caveats note this cosmology can modify the simple axion-plus-neutralino abundance accounting, but the mixed-abundance calculation used in the literature is not publicly released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain and release) a coupled Boltzmann network evolving axion, neutralino, saxion, and axino energy densities with their decay widths and entropy dilution, interfaced with a micrOMEGAs-class relic calculation, and validate it against the paper's mu=250 GeV benchmark (Omega_LSP/Omega_DM about 0.058) and the variant f_A window.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_II with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public coupled-Boltzmann code tracks the saxion/axino decay history, entropy injection, and Delta N_eff from axion dark radiation for the SUSY DFSZ B_II setup; the card's caveats note this cosmology can modify the simple axion-plus-neutralino abundance accounting, but the mixed-abundance calculation used in the literature is not publicly released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain and release) a coupled Boltzmann network evolving axion, neutralino, saxion, and axino energy densities with their decay widths and entropy dilution, interfaced with a micrOMEGAs-class relic calculation, and validate it against the paper's mu=250 GeV benchmark (Omega_LSP/Omega_DM about 0.058) and the variant f_A window.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_III with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public coupled-Boltzmann code tracks the saxion/axino decay history, entropy injection, and Delta N_eff from axion dark radiation for the SUSY DFSZ B_III setup; the card's caveats note this cosmology can modify the simple axion-plus-neutralino abundance accounting, but the mixed-abundance calculation used in the literature is not publicly released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or obtain and release) a coupled Boltzmann network evolving axion, neutralino, saxion, and axino energy densities with their decay widths and entropy dilution, interfaced with a micrOMEGAs-class relic calculation, and validate it against the paper's mu=250 GeV benchmark (Omega_LSP/Omega_DM about 0.058) and the variant f_A window.

members.model_name: Line-motivated resonantly produced sterile neutrino N1 dark matter
members.description: No unified public X-ray likelihood exists for the 7.1 keV benchmark that jointly treats the reported 3.55 keV detections (clusters, M31, Milky Way) and the strongest non-detection limits with consistent instrument responses and halo D-factors; the card records a disputed constraint landscape with only partial likelihood availability.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint spectral likelihood over the archival XMM/Chandra/Hitomi datasets (and XRISM velocity-resolved spectra as they arrive) with shared nuisance parameters for halo profiles and instrumental lines, released as an XSPEC/3ML-compatible module returning constraints in the (m_s, sin^2 2theta) plane.

members.model_name: Axi-Higgs ultralight axion cosmology
members.description: No likelihood exists that confronts the axi-Higgs late-time Higgs-VEV relaxation history v(t)/v0, parameterized by (m_a, C, initial displacement), with atomic-clock frequency-ratio drift limits and quasar absorption-line constraints on electron-mass variation; the primary paper flags this channel as future testability without extracting any quantitative bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Compile published clock frequency-ratio drift limits (e.g. Yb/Cs, Al+/Hg+) and quasar mu = m_p/m_e variation measurements into a redshift-binned likelihood on Delta m_e/m_e(z), and evaluate it on the oscillating-plus-relaxing v(t) trajectory output by the axi-Higgs background solver.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine L-ball resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter scenario
members.description: X-ray line constraints on (m_s, sin^2 2theta) are only discussed qualitatively; no digitized exclusion contours or packaged flux likelihood accompany the card, so the viable-region claim cannot be re-evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the current combined X-ray limits (NuSTAR/Chandra/XMM blank-sky and M31 stacks) into a mass-mixing exclusion table and package it as a likelihood keyed to the model's decay rate, rescaled by the resonantly produced abundance.

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric dark matter with a dark photon portal
members.description: No likelihood exists for the Super-K constraint on neutrinos from decaying dark nucleons: the route ends in an approximate pass/fail against a quoted flux bound with no spectral flux table or detector response model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the Galactic-plus-extragalactic neutrino flux from dark-nucleon decay (lifetime and spectrum from gap_3), and recast the published Super-K diffuse-neutrino and DSNB-search limits with public effective areas into a lifetime bound as a function of dark-nucleon mass.

members.model_name: keV Miracle sterile neutrino from singlet Higgs decay
members.description: No reusable X-ray line likelihood grid over (m_s, sin^2 2theta, sterile fraction) is available; only literature limit curves and the 3.5 keV candidate-line discussion are quoted in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR line limits into a flux likelihood parameterized by line energy and target, and wrap it with the analytic decay-rate formula; the mixing angle is a free parameter here since abundance is set by S decays, so the likelihood must cover the full (m_s, sin^2 2theta) plane.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L thermal sterile neutrino with entropy dilution
members.description: No importable X-ray line likelihood grid in (m_s, sin^2 2theta, sterile fraction) exists for this card; X-ray decay constraints are applied by quoting literature limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published XMM-Newton/Chandra/NuSTAR blank-sky and stacked-cluster line searches into a tabulated likelihood over line energy and decay flux, with the sterile fraction as a linear flux rescaling, and attach it to the registry as a reusable X-ray line likelihood.

members.model_name: Abelian Z' sterile-neutrino progenitor dark matter variants
members.description: No reusable X-ray line likelihood (with marginalization over halo column density and decay branching) is available for the radiative decay of the keV sterile state; only published exclusion curves under simple assumptions exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Package XMM-Newton/Chandra M31, Milky Way, and cluster line searches into a public likelihood over (M_s, sin^2 2theta, f_DM) with a documented column-density prior, so subcomponent and small-mixing scenarios can be scored consistently.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino freeze-in/dark-freeze-out dark matter in a singlet scalar portal sector
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood or spectral analysis pipeline is available to compare the predicted 3.55 keV flux to cluster, galaxy, and blank-sky data; the card records the mixing benchmark but likelihood_available is unknown and no target column-density modeling is bundled.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a decaying-DM X-ray likelihood in the (m_psi, sin^2 2theta) plane from published XMM-Newton, Chandra, and NuSTAR line searches with standard D-factor models for the stacked targets, and apply it to the 7.1 keV benchmark and surrounding parameter space.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L low-reheating sterile neutrino production
members.description: No reusable X-ray line likelihood grid over (m_s, sin^2 2theta, sterile fraction) is available; only literature limit curves and the 3.5 keV candidate-line discussion are quoted in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR line limits into a flux likelihood parameterized by line energy and target, and wrap it with the analytic decay-rate formula rescaled by the sterile dark-matter fraction.

members.model_name: Symmetry-restored 2HDM plus 7.1 keV sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: X-ray constraints on the suppressed first-column Yukawas are applied qualitatively; no packaged X-ray line likelihood in (M1, mixing) is linked to the card (con_xray_yukawa_suppression likelihood_available: unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published sterile-neutrino X-ray line searches (XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR stacked and blank-sky analyses, including the 3.5 keV literature) into a reusable likelihood grid over line energy and flux, then map onto (M1, sum|Y_nu,i1|^2) via the paper's mixing relation.

members.model_name: Generalized three-Higgs-doublet astrophobic QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No quantitative stellar-cooling or SN1987A likelihood exists for the astrophobic coupling patterns; the relaxed bounds on f_a are applied as quoted scaling limits, so partially suppressed variants (photon- or muon-suppressed) cannot be constrained self-consistently.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published stellar-cooling (RGB/WD/HB) and SN1987A bounds as likelihood functions in the multi-coupling space (C_e, C_p, C_n, C_mu, g_a_gamma) rather than single-coupling limits, so each 3HDM charge assignment can be scored directly.

members.model_name: PBH sterile neutrinogenesis of sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public X-ray line likelihood covers the sterile-neutrino decay signal as a function of (m_s, sin^2 2theta, f_s) with astrophysical background modeling, so the 3.5 keV target region and XRISM-era sensitivity cannot be evaluated statistically for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Package existing blank-sky, M31, and cluster X-ray line search data into a reusable likelihood over line energy and flux with target J/D-factors, parameterized so the decay rate scales with sin^2 2theta and the abundance with f_s.

members.model_name: Vector dark matter with electron magnetic dipole coupling
members.description: No reusable detector likelihood or recast package exists for MDM vector-DM electronic absorption: Si, Ge, Xe, and Ar exclusion limits are available only as summarized curves, without the exposure and threshold tables needed to turn EXCEED-DM rates into a d_M exclusion curve.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published Si/Ge/Xe/Ar absorption limits and collect per-experiment exposure, efficiency, and threshold tables; package them with the updated EXCEED-DM MDM rate module as a Poisson-count likelihood so d_M(m_V) limits can be recomputed for arbitrary parameter points.

members.model_name: Colder freeze-in axino dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood is available for the 3.5 keV decay signal; the lifetime/mixing target is compared only against literature values (con_xray_axino_lifetime, likelihood_available: no, robustness low).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decaying-dark-matter X-ray flux model (line energy, tau_axino, target column densities) interfaced to published XMM-Newton cluster and Andromeda line-search likelihoods so theta_axino_nu and tau_axino can be constrained statistically.

members.model_name: Ultralight scalar dark matter coupled to Majorana neutrinos
members.description: No packaged 0nu-beta-beta likelihood exists for the time-modulated half-life signature: con_0nubb_half_life records likelihood_available: no, and neither the KamLAND-Zen half-life limit nor the sensitivity of experiments to a periodic modulation of the decay rate is encoded with nuclear-matrix-element uncertainties, so the laboratory constraint can only be applied as a hand recast of quoted limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood module that maps (m_phi, g_phi_ee, phi_0) to isotope-specific half-life and modulation amplitude using published phase-space factors and a marginalized set of nuclear matrix elements, calibrated to the KamLAND-Zen limit and extendable to time-binned event-rate analyses of future ton-scale experiments.

members.model_name: keV sterile neutrino dark matter in a minimal extended seesaw A4 model
members.description: No X-ray line-flux likelihood exists for the keV sterile-neutrino radiative decay signal in this model; the card records only summary mixing-angle bounds from XMM-Newton/Chandra/Suzaku/Swift/NuSTAR with no halo-profile marginalization or line-flux recast implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published X-ray mixing-angle exclusion curves (or wrap public stacked-observation likelihoods such as the NuSTAR/XMM blank-sky analyses) into a line-flux likelihood in (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) with marginalization over the Milky Way and cluster density-profile uncertainty.

members.model_name: Vector dark matter with electron electric dipole coupling
members.description: No reusable detector likelihood or recast package exists for EDM vector-DM electronic absorption: Si, Ge, Xe, and Ar exclusion limits are available only as summarized curves, without the exposure and threshold tables needed to turn EXCEED-DM rates into a d_E exclusion curve.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published Si/Ge/Xe/Ar absorption limits and collect per-experiment exposure, efficiency, and threshold tables; package them with the updated EXCEED-DM EDM rate module as a Poisson-count likelihood so d_E(m_V) limits can be recomputed for arbitrary parameter points.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: No electroweak precision likelihood is attached to the triplet anchor sector: the claimed W-mass shift toward the CDF measurement has not been confronted with a global fit, so the parameter space consistent with precision data (and with the standard m_W average versus CDF) is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the oblique parameters and tree-level rho/W-mass shift from the triplet vev v2 and heavy lepton triplets, then evaluate against a public global electroweak fit (HEPfit or Gfitter inputs) to map allowed (M_Sigma, v2) regions under both the CDF and PDG-average W-mass choices.

members.model_name: Earth-shielded plasma dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the target datasets: the DAMA electron-recoil annual-modulation comparison and the CRESST-III low-threshold recast lack public binned likelihoods with detector response, atomic electron binding effects, and backgrounds for a kinetically mixed dark-plasma flux.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct a binned DAMA/LIBRA modulation likelihood from published data tables with the NaI electron-recoil response and atomic binding (RRPA-style) form factors for dark-electron scattering, and add a CRESST-III low-threshold module, exposing both as functions of (epsilon, v_c, n_e_prime).

members.model_name: Hidden-sector keV fermion warm dark matter
members.description: No keV-scale kink-search beta-spectrum likelihood with realistic detector response exists for evaluating the |U_e4|^2, |U_e5|^2 branches in tritium spectra; only the analytic spectral formula is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a kink-search likelihood using the published KATRIN/TRISTAN keV-sterile sensitivity model (response matrix, resolution, endpoint systematics) applied to the two-branch spectrum with masses M_1, M_2.

members.model_name: Extra-dimensional sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood is attached to the card (likelihood_available is unknown and the constraint text notes no full X-ray likelihood or exact exclusion curve), so the decay-line constraint on (M_s, theta_s) cannot be evaluated quantitatively or rescaled for a sub-dominant DM fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published galaxy/cluster X-ray decay-line limits (e.g. stacked cluster and M31/blank-sky analyses) into a reusable likelihood on the sin^2(2theta)-M_s plane with an explicit DM-fraction rescaling, and register it against con_xray_wdm_mixing.

members.model_name: DFSZ freeze-in axino dark matter with bilinear R-parity violation
members.description: Target-specific X-ray line likelihoods (Perseus, Andromeda, cluster stacks) are not bundled, so lifetime/mixing bounds for the 3.5 keV line are only partially applied (xray_line_decay_bounds, likelihood_available: partial, recasting needed).
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the analytic decay-flux step to published XMM-Newton/Chandra line-search likelihoods per target, constraining tau_axino and the bRPV mixing jointly with neutrino-mass consistency.

members.model_name: fractional cold-plus-warm sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No reusable X-ray line likelihood grid over (m_s, sin^2 2theta, sterile fraction) is available; only literature limit curves and the 3.5 keV candidate-line discussion are quoted, and fractional abundance rescaling must be applied consistently.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR blank-sky and stacked-object line limits into a flux likelihood parameterized by line energy, and wrap it with the analytic decay-rate formula rescaled by the sterile dark-matter fraction.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a neutrinophilic vector mediator
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the keV sterile-neutrino X-ray decay line against the cluster, M31, Milky Way, and NuSTAR datasets the card cites; only published exclusion curves are available for by-hand overlay.

members.model_name: Broad-mass PBH-Lambda dark matter universe

members.model_name: Quadratically coupled scalar ultralight dark matter EFT

members.model_name: Nucleon-coupled boson star dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood or machine-readable data tables exist for the HEAO-1, INTEGRAL, and COMPTEL diffuse hard-X-ray/soft-gamma spectra against which the boson-star flux must be compared; the card lists the diffuse photon likelihood as unavailable and the comparison as not rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the HEAO-1, INTEGRAL, and COMPTEL diffuse-emission spectra into energy-binned data products and wrap them in a simple chi-square/upper-limit likelihood module taking a predicted diffuse flux as input, validated by recovering the paper's f_* ~ 1e-9 strongest limits.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino dark matter with light-scalar neutrino self-interaction after quintessential inflation
members.description: X-ray line-search constraints (NuSTAR Galactic-center and related datasets) exist only as published upper-limit curves assuming standard production and DM fraction; no packaged likelihood lets the registry rescale them consistently for this model's relic fraction and halo modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the NuSTAR and complementary X-ray line-search flux limits into a registry likelihood module parameterized by (M1, sin^2(2 theta_1), f_N1, D-factor) so mixing-angle exclusions can be recomputed for arbitrary relic fractions.

members.model_name: Decaying axion-like dark matter direct-collapse model
members.description: No statistical framework connects per-halo direct-collapse success to the observed high-redshift SMBH population: halo abundance, collapse duty cycle, and seed-growth modeling needed to turn the mechanism into a testable seed-abundance prediction are absent.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a semi-analytic population model (halo mass function plus collapse criterion from the extended chemistry code) predicting DCBH seed number densities versus z, and compare against quasar luminosity-function data in a simple Poisson likelihood.

members.model_name: Baryon-number-violating Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood maps (lambda_1, lambda_prime_12, m_X, m_chi) to the neutron-antineutron oscillation lifetime and Super-Kamiokande dinucleon-decay limits with proper nuclear matrix elements; the card's leading constraint con_dinucleon_nnbar_bvn has likelihood_available: no and no nuclear matrix-element treatment was run.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood that runs the B=2 operator coefficients from the TeV matching scale to 2 GeV, contracts them with published lattice-QCD n-nbar matrix elements, applies the nuclear suppression factors for bound dinucleons, and compares to Super-K dinucleon and free-neutron oscillation limits, exposing tau_nnbar as a derived quantity.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric model with keV right-handed-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood is implemented for the N1 -> nu gamma signal; the card uses only an approximate lifetime/mixing stability criterion without cluster or Milky Way halo-profile uncertainties propagated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published sterile-neutrino X-ray limits (NuSTAR, XMM-Newton blank-sky, Chandra) into a likelihood on the (m_N1, sin^2(2theta)) plane, reusing the standard decaying-DM flux formalism with documented halo-profile priors.

members.model_name: Inelastic dark-photon Dirac fermion thermal relic for the XENON1T excess
members.description: The CRESST low-threshold nuclear-recoil bound has not been reanalyzed for exothermic inelastic kinematics; the card notes the elastic bound may shift for this model, leaving the leading nuclear-scattering constraint uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published CRESST low-threshold oxygen-recoil data with the exothermic nuclear scattering rate (splitting delta released into the recoil) using the public CRESST data release, producing an exclusion curve in (M_chi, epsilon, delta).

members.model_name: High-scale FOPT scotogenic FIMP right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: GW exclusion is imposed only through a conservative one-year LVK O3 SNR > 1 threshold with approximate sensitivity curves; no proper LVK stochastic-background likelihood is attached, so the boundary of the excluded high-scale FOPT region in (alpha_*, beta/H_*, T_n) is not statistically defensible.
members.proposed_resolution: Replace the SNR threshold with a likelihood built on the public LVK O3 isotropic stochastic-search cross-correlation data (e.g. via the pygwb analysis framework), evaluating the model's Omega_GW h^2 template per parameter point and extending the same machinery to projected ET/DECIGO sensitivities for forecasts.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: No sensitivity likelihood exists for the model's critical signature, monoenergetic neutrinos from N anti-N annihilation at JUNO/Hyper-Kamiokande/DUNE; the paper's reach statement is qualitative and no detector-level analysis with neutrino backgrounds and oscillations is linked.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published sub-GeV dark-matter-to-neutrino annihilation limits and forecasts (existing Super-K/JUNO/HK sensitivity curves for monoenergetic neutrino lines) into a likelihood over (m_DM, sigma v, flavor composition) matching the model's neutrino-flavor branching from the fitted Yukawas.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic scalar dark matter
members.description: No cLFV or neutrinoless-double-beta-decay likelihood was rerun; the mu -> e gamma prediction from the neutrino-fit Yukawa vectors is not connected to a MEG/MEG-II likelihood or global flavor fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in SARAH/SPheno with FlavorKit to compute BR(mu->e gamma) and 0nubb amplitudes over the neutrino-fit parameter space, and attach the published MEG-II limit as a one-sided likelihood.

members.model_name: QCD-transition sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line-search likelihood is available for the sterile-neutrino decay line; the card's constraint is a 2002 Virgo non-detection statement flagged as needing modern recasting, with likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood module from published modern X-ray line limits (XMM-Newton/Chandra/NuSTAR blank-sky and stacked-cluster sin^2(2theta) vs m_s curves), interpolating them into a reusable exclusion function over the 1-50 keV mass range including lepton-number-dependent abundance mapping.

members.model_name: Low-scale darkogenesis with perturbative baryon transfer
members.description: No search or recast exists for the baryon-violating p + X -> anti-X + pi+ process; the paper explicitly states standard proton-lifetime limits with charged leptons do not apply, and no detector efficiency or likelihood is available for a single-pion-plus-missing-energy signature with these kinematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Super-Kamiokande single-charged-pion nucleon-decay-style analyses with the modified pion momentum spectrum of DM-induced scattering, folding in detector efficiency maps to produce a rate limit as a function of the transfer scale and superpartner masses.

members.model_name: Hierarchical right-handed Majorana neutrino dark matter in quintessential inflation
members.description: No X-ray decay-line likelihood is interfaced for the 10 keV N1 benchmark: the mixing bound sin^2(2 theta) < 1e-11 is a summarized literature limit, with no exposure- and J-factor-resolved likelihood enabling a quantitative recast or a NuSTAR-reach forecast.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt published sterile-neutrino X-ray line likelihoods or limit tables from NuSTAR/XMM blank-sky and Galactic-center analyses, combine with standard halo J-factors and the sterile-neutrino radiative decay-rate formula, and package the result as a reusable (M_1, sin^2(2 theta)) likelihood in the registry.

members.model_name: Z2-breaking complex singlet pseudo-Goldstone scalar dark matter
members.description: Only approximate projection-level constraints exist for the Higgs-factory leg: the card records no packaged likelihood mapping the model's one-loop Higgs-coupling and S/T/U shifts onto CEPC/FCC-ee/ILC global-fit precision, so the complementarity claim cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the one-loop hZZ-coupling shift and oblique parameters as functions of (M_2, theta, v_s) and fold them into the published CEPC/FCC-ee global-fit covariance (e.g. via a Gaussian likelihood over the projected coupling precisions) to draw exclusion/discovery contours.

members.model_name: Dark population transfer sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: X-ray decay-line limits are invoked without any digitized exclusion contour or flux likelihood, so the claimed weakening of the constraint for weakly mixed N2 cannot be quantitatively re-evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published keV-scale X-ray line limits (Chandra/Suzaku/NuSTAR compilations cited by the card's related papers) into a (m_s, theta) exclusion table rescaled by the N2 abundance fraction, and package it as a registry likelihood.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7 keV sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the 3.57 keV X-ray line in the (m_s, sin^2(2 theta), DM column density) plane: the card records only qualitative flux/mixing consistency with unknown likelihood availability and dominant instrument/background systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decaying-DM line likelihood from stacked XMM-Newton/Chandra (and NuSTAR blank-sky) spectra with instrument response and astrophysical-line background models, returning a joint flux likelihood versus sin^2(2 theta) at fixed m_s = 7.14 keV.

members.model_name: U(1)_R lepton-number model with keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood exists for the 3.5 keV target: the card records likelihood_available = no, and comparing the (M_N^R, sin^2(2 theta_14)) plane against XMM-Newton M31/Perseus/stacked-cluster fluxes requires a recast with halo mass-profile and instrumental-response modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decay-flux calculator (standard radiative decay rate times line-of-sight DM column densities for M31, Perseus, and stacked clusters) and wrap published XMM-Newton flux measurements and upper limits into a Gaussian/profile likelihood over mass and mixing.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7.1 keV sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood is attached (likelihood_available: no); the 3.55 keV line and non-detection bounds are used only as a mass-mixing target rather than as a flux likelihood with profile uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a decaying-DM X-ray line likelihood in the (M_1, sin^2 2theta) plane from XMM-Newton/NuSTAR/eROSITA stacked and blank-sky analyses, with dark-matter column-density priors for the cluster/M31/Perseus targets.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with solar-flare triggering
members.description: No likelihood connects predicted AQN event-energy distributions to solar data: comparisons to the quiet-Sun EUV/soft-X-ray budget (~1e27 erg/s) and to MWA radio impulses at 98-160 MHz are order-of-magnitude consistency checks with no instrument selection functions, backgrounds, or statistical model (both card constraints have likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Build an event-rate likelihood that folds the predicted per-event energy and altitude distributions through EUV/X-ray (SDO/AIA-type) and MWA low-frequency detection thresholds and solar-background models, using the proposed cross-band clustering statistic for the radio channel, and release it against the existing event catalogs.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet fermionic UV/IR freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No reusable public likelihood exists for the XMM-Newton Milky Way center 3.5 keV line flux; the paper's comparison is a flux-window match, and treating the feature as a signal versus an upper limit changes the inference.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a likelihood from published XMM-Newton (and Chandra/NuSTAR) 3.5 keV flux measurements and upper limits, with a switch between signal-fit and upper-limit modes, packaged so line-flux predictions from any decaying or cascade-annihilating model can be scored.

members.model_name: Superconformal attractor inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No detector likelihood or forecast pipeline exists to turn the predicted induced-GW spectrum into a quantitative detectability statement for ALIA/DECIGO-band instruments; the card lists the GW detector likelihood as unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a forecast likelihood from published ALIA/DECIGO power-law-integrated sensitivity curves and an SNR integral over the model Omega_GW(f), packaged so the route can report detectability per parameter point.

members.model_name: Effective right-handed sterile-neutrino dark matter with SM gauge interactions
members.description: The radiative-decay channel is only checked against the age-of-the-Universe bound (tau_N > 4.4e17 s); no instrument-level x-ray line likelihood (XMM-Newton, Chandra, NuSTAR blank-sky) is recast onto the flavor-dependent couplings G_R^l, although such searches would be far stronger.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's N -> nu gamma rate (photon energy m_N/2) onto published sterile-neutrino x-ray line flux limits from XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR halo searches, converting sin^2(2theta)-style limits into bounds on G_R^l versus m_N.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with scalar-mediated neutrino NSI
members.description: X-ray decay-line constraints (M31, Galactic Center, empty-sky, DEBRA) exist only as summarized envelopes; no packaged likelihood as a function of (m_s, sin^2(2theta), f_s) is available for automated scanning.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published X-ray line/non-observation envelopes and package them as an f_s-rescalable interpolated likelihood mask over the (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) scan plane.

members.model_name: S3 symmetric two-Higgs-doublet vector-like lepton dark matter
members.description: The 1 TeV ILC missing-energy sensitivity exists only as private cut-based and TMVA-BDTD significance projections; there is no released analysis code or likelihood allowing the VLL reach to be recomputed for other benchmarks or updated detector/luminosity assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the analysis as a recast module (e.g. a MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE-style implementation of the 1l+2j+MET, dilepton, 4l, and 4j+MET selections with the Delphes ILD card and BDT training configuration), validated by reproducing the paper's significance tables for BP1-BP4.

members.model_name: Jovian captured GeV dark matter toy model
members.description: No public time-series likelihood exists for the low-energy Borexino event rate, so the claimed 96 percent CL Jupiter-correlated modulation cannot be refit or tested against the captured-DM flux prediction with detector response and solar/detector systematics included.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a binned timing likelihood from the published 2011-2021 Borexino low-energy rate data with a parameterized detector-response and background-modulation model, or obtain the collaboration's internal time-series likelihood, and interface it to the Jupiter-flux prediction.

members.model_name: Linear-seesaw mixed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No LFV likelihood exists for the charged-lepton flavour-violating decays driven by Y_nu and the linear-seesaw Y_SL term, whose LFV pattern differs from the inverse seesaw; the card records only paper-era bounds and no rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute mu->e gamma, mu->3e, and mu-e conversion with SPheno/FlavorKit output from the SARAH linear-seesaw implementation and compare against current MEG II/SINDRUM limits as a likelihood over the scanned flavour textures.

members.model_name: Scalar-decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No X-ray line likelihood over (m_s, theta) accompanies the card, and the scalar-decay mechanism leaves the active-sterile mixing angle unspecified, so the radiative-decay observable can only be checked by eye against published Chandra/Andromeda-type exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize existing X-ray line-search exclusion curves (Chandra/XMM/NuSTAR classes of analyses) into a reusable likelihood over sterile-neutrino mass and mixing, treating theta as an independent input parameter alongside the scalar-decay abundance.

members.model_name: Dressed primordial black holes in particle dark matter
members.description: The FRB lensing channel lacks an optical-depth and time-delay likelihood for extended dressed lenses: CHIME-like burst samples constrain point masses, and no public tool maps the effective lens mass M_PBH^eff of a dressed halo into an FRB lensing rate bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an FRB lensing optical-depth calculation to the dressed-lens Einstein-radius/effective-mass mapping from the related work, and recast the existing CHIME FRB non-detection statistics into f_PBH bounds for the 10-10^3 M_sun dressed window.

members.model_name: Quantum-environment dark neutrino dark matter component
members.description: No public likelihood or reproducible amplitude-analysis pipeline exists for testing pure-dephasing residuals (environment dimension M and dephasing strength) against polarized pion-nucleon scattering data; the card lists the polarized-target amplitude likelihood as required but likelihood_available is no/unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an open amplitude-fit pipeline on the SAID/GWU partial-wave database for polarized pi-N scattering below ~1080 MeV that includes the Kraus dephasing map (M, dephasing parameters) as fit parameters and returns a likelihood over (M, dephasing strength), reproducing the M=4 inference as a validation test.

members.model_name: R-parity violating axino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray flux likelihood exists for the axino -> gamma + nu decay line: the mass-lifetime window (tau_DM ~ 2e27-2e28 s at 3.5 keV) is only an interval quoted from the line reports, with likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a decaying-DM line-flux calculator (D-factor integrals for the XMM-Newton cluster and M31 fields) coupled to a spectral likelihood built from the public X-ray data, returning constraints directly in (m_axino, tau_DM).

members.model_name: Leptoquark-assisted right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No reusable X-ray line/lifetime likelihood is attached to the card (likelihood_available is partial and no likelihood was rerun), so the decay-line constraint is applied only as a quoted tau_N1 > 1e28 s threshold rather than a proper flux likelihood over the mass-mixing plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Package published stacked-cluster and blank-sky X-ray line search results (XMM-Newton, NuSTAR, eROSITA) into a decaying-DM line-flux likelihood in the (M_R1, sin^2 2theta) plane and connect it to the analytic lifetime step.

members.model_name: Long-lived stau coannihilation neutralino dark matter scenario
members.description: No likelihood exists for comparing predicted D, T, He3, He4, Li6, and Li7 abundances from the CBBN network against observed light-element abundances including nuclear-rate and observational (e.g. lithium depletion, Li6 systematics) uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a light-element abundance likelihood (Gaussian or profiled over nuclear-rate nuisance parameters) over the CBBN network outputs, using current recommended primordial D/H, He4, and Li7/H determinations, and expose it as a route-level likelihood asset.

members.model_name: Density-dependent baryon-DM cooling interaction model
members.description: No rotation-curve likelihood exists for this model: nothing maps (m, sigma_int(n,v), baryon distribution) through the equilibrium heat equation to predicted rotation curves and compares them to MDAR data (e.g. SPARC-type samples) with per-galaxy systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a numerical equilibrium solver for the DM pressure profile given an observed baryon distribution (generalizing the paper's analytic solution to arbitrary Sigma_b(R)), and wrap it in a likelihood over the SPARC rotation-curve/MDAR dataset with mass-to-light and distance nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Z2-odd scalar dark matter in the N=1 generalized one-loop neutrino-mass model
members.description: No global likelihood combines the LFV decays, flavor-changing Z decays, muon g-2, and S/T oblique constraints for this model's Yukawa and mass parameters; the card records only 95% CL cut-based bounds (likelihood_available: partial) and states a global likelihood was not reconstructed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's one-loop contributions in a flavor/precision framework (e.g. SPheno+FlavorKit or flavio) and assemble a combined likelihood over mu->e gamma, LFV Z branching ratios, (g-2)_mu, and electroweak S/T fits, replacing the current hard 95% CL cuts.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with B-L vector NSI
members.description: X-ray decay-line constraints (M31, Galactic Center, empty-sky, DEBRA) exist only as summarized envelopes; no packaged likelihood as a function of (m_s, sin^2(2theta), f_s) is available for automated scanning.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published X-ray line/non-observation envelopes and package them as an f_s-rescalable interpolated likelihood mask over the (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) scan plane.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with neutrinophilic vector NSI
members.description: X-ray decay-line constraints (M31, Galactic Center, empty-sky, DEBRA) exist only as summarized envelopes; no packaged likelihood as a function of (m_s, sin^2(2theta), f_s) is available for automated scanning.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published X-ray line/non-observation envelopes and package them as an f_s-rescalable interpolated likelihood mask over the (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) scan plane.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition
members.description: No public X-ray decay-line likelihood with target J/D-factor data is available to test the M_1 = 7 keV, sin^2(theta) = 5e-11 benchmark and the surrounding mass-mixing plane for this production scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published X-ray line search results (clusters, M31, blank-sky) with target density profiles into a reusable likelihood over (M_1, sin^2 2theta, Omega_N/Omega_DM), applicable to any production mechanism including this one.

members.model_name: Bulk-shortcut sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No short-baseline oscillation likelihood implements the energy-dependent shortcut mixing: LSND/MiniBooNE fits in the card are representative only, so the allowed (E_res, theta) region and the small-mixing WDM tension cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the shortcut-modified oscillation probability in an existing short-baseline fitting framework (e.g., a GLoBES-based or public MiniBooNE/LSND data-release fit) and rerun the 3+1 analysis with E_res as an extra parameter.

members.model_name: Bosonic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: The UHECR constraint on the card is a historical SUGAR anisotropy recast with likelihood_available 'no'; no modern end-to-end likelihood combines superheavy-X decay fragmentation spectra, a Galactic-halo decay template, and current Auger/TA exposure and composition data to constrain (m_X, tau_X, Omega_X).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a pipeline using HDMSpectra for X decay spectra at m_X above 1e13 GeV, a Milky-Way halo decay template with CRPropa propagation, and published Auger flux/photon-fraction/anisotropy limits, packaged as a tau_X-versus-m_X exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced superheavy X-particle dark matter
members.description: No end-to-end UHECR pipeline or likelihood exists for rare X decays: decay spectra, propagation, and modern Auger flux/composition/photon limits have not been combined into a constraint on (m_X, tau_X, Omega_X) for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Chain HDMSpectra decay spectra for m_X near 10^13 GeV into a propagation code (CRPropa or SimProp) and recast against current Auger spectrum, composition, and photon-fraction limits, delivering a tau_X(m_X, Omega_X) exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: CP/PQ scotogenic inert-doublet dark matter with axion component
members.description: No scotogenic neutrino-mass and lepton-flavor-violation likelihood has been run for this model's complex Yukawa couplings h_alpha_j; the flavor consistency of the Z2-odd sector (mu->e gamma etc.) is asserted but not numerically evaluated (step s4 validation not run).
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the low-energy scotogenic sector in an existing spectrum-plus-flavor pipeline (e.g. SARAH/SPheno with FlavorKit, or a dedicated scotogenic scan code) and scan h_alpha_j, M_Nj, lambda_5 against neutrino oscillation data and MEG/Mu2e LFV bounds jointly with the dark-matter constraints.

members.model_name: U(1)_X three-Higgs-doublet neutral fermion dark matter
members.description: No combined flavor/electroweak-precision likelihood exists for the three-Higgs U(1)_X sector (meson mixing, charged-lepton flavor violation, EW precision); the card marks recasting_needed: yes and likelihood_available: no, and the OCR-lossy flavor formulas were not promoted, so the non-DM consistency of any DM benchmark cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-derive the meson-mixing, LFV, and oblique-parameter expressions for the three-doublet U(1)_X Higgs sector from the primary paper and implement them as a flavio/HEPfit-style constraint module evaluated jointly with the DM benchmark scan.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1) vector-like quark model with inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No reusable flavor likelihood is available for the loop-induced C9 and B_s mixing constraints (likelihood_available: no); the paper applied them only as scan cuts, so viability cannot be re-evaluated with a global fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Express the model's one-loop Wilson coefficients (C9, B_s mixing amplitude) as functions of f, M_a, m_Zprime and wrap them in flavio/smelli to obtain a global b -> s l l plus B_s mixing likelihood.

members.model_name: Extra U(1)_X right-handed Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: The active-sterile neutrino mixing requirement that underpins the co-annihilation link (con_neutrino_mixing_coannihilation) has no attached likelihood, so the connection between oscillation data and the (mixing angle, chi_2-chi_1 mass gap) parameters is only qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Attach the public NuFIT chi-squared tables (and sterile-mixing bounds where relevant) as a likelihood on the loop-generated neutrino mass and mixing parameters of the model, propagated to the S_1R-S_2R mixing angle used in the co-annihilation rate.

members.model_name: Dark-confining axiverse heavy axion dark matter
members.description: No assembled, reusable likelihood exists for the model's monochromatic keV-MeV decay line (a -> gamma gamma, and e+e- above threshold): existing XMM-Newton/Chandra/NuSTAR/INTEGRAL/COMPTEL limits and Athena/AMEGO/e-ASTROGAM projections exist only as published curves that must be recast by hand for each (m_a, tau_a).
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published decaying-dark-matter lifetime limits across keV-MeV into a tabulated tau_min(m_a) likelihood module (separately for the photon and e+e- channels), so the line-flux prediction from (m_a, f_a, C_agamma, C_aee) can be scored automatically against current limits and future-telescope sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Z_3 complex scalar asymmetric dark matter from semi-annihilation
members.description: No assembled exclusion pipeline (recast tables or detector likelihood) exists for the Higgs invisible width and spin-independent recoil limits applied to this Z3 scalar plus eta-mediator field content; the card flags recasting_needed and no likelihood_reference.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in a FeynRules/CalcHEP model file, then chain HiggsTools for BR(h->invisible) limits and DDCalc for current SI recoil likelihoods, validating against the scalar-singlet portal limit with semi-annihilation couplings off.

members.model_name: R-parity neutralino dark matter in a split-SUSY SO(10) GUT
members.description: No likelihood connects the analytic proton-decay lifetimes to current Super-K limits and projected Hyper-K/JUNO sensitivities; the comparison is stated only as qualitative testability of benchmark regions (con_so10_proton_decay_tests, likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the published Super-K exclusion and Hyper-K/JUNO projected sensitivities for the relevant channels (p -> K+ nu, p -> e+ pi0) as simple lifetime likelihoods and evaluate the benchmark partial lifetimes, including an uncertainty budget for hadronic matrix elements and threshold corrections.

members.model_name: BEC/SFDM self-interacting ultralight scalar dark matter for cluster collisions
members.description: No quantitative merger-morphology likelihood exists for confronting simulated BEC/SFDM collision outcomes with the Bullet Cluster and Abell 520 data; the card records the cluster comparison as qualitative with likelihood_available: no and low robustness.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a forward-model comparison pipeline that projects simulated dark-matter, gas, and galaxy distributions into weak-lensing convergence and X-ray maps and defines an offset/morphology likelihood against the published Bullet Cluster and Abell 520 reconstructions, including merger-geometry nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Sub-eV scalar dark matter through the super-renormalizable Higgs portal
members.description: No diffuse-photon-background likelihood is connected to the loop-induced phi -> gamma gamma decay line; the paper notes gamma-background constraints qualitatively but extracts no contour in (m_phi, x).
members.proposed_resolution: Map the analytic lifetime onto published decaying-dark-matter monochromatic-photon limits (cosmic optical/X-ray background and line searches) as a tabulated lifetime-versus-mass bound; low priority since the decay is negligible in the sub-eV regime the model targets.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario A
members.description: No X-ray decay-line likelihood is wired to the model: the radiative decay rate follows analytically from M_1 and sin^2(2theta), but there is no packaged likelihood mapping (M_1, mixing) to existing X-ray line search limits for this card.
