members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard N_1 -> nu gamma decay-rate formula and interface it to published X-ray line limits (stacked galaxy/cluster and blank-sky sterile-neutrino searches) as a tabulated sin^2(2theta) vs M_1 exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: Vector fermion-portal dark matter
members.description: No runnable Galactic Center excess likelihood is bundled (likelihood_available: partial); the 20-40 GeV preferred window rests on source-era fits that cannot be re-evaluated for this model's b bbar/tau tau admixture.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a chi-square likelihood from published GC-excess spectra with correlated systematics (e.g. the Calore-Cholis-Weniger covariance) and evaluate the model's predicted spectrum over (m_X, m_psi, g_Xf).

members.model_name: ISS(2,3) sterile-neutrino dark matter from small lepton-number violation
members.description: No machine-readable X-ray line likelihood is bundled for the keV radiative-decay signal; the card only cites literature limits qualitatively (con_iss23_xray_stability: likelihood_available partial, recasting_needed yes), so exclusion in the (m_DM, sin^2 2theta) plane cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the standard stacked X-ray (e.g. NuSTAR/XMM/Chandra blank-sky and cluster) limit curves on sin^2 2theta versus m_DM into a reusable likelihood table and wire it into the s3 recast step.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic thermal dark matter Model II
members.description: No public, reusable DUNE near-detector mono-neutrino forward simulation and likelihood exists for this Z3 semi-annihilating neutrinophilic model: the signal event generation (charged-current scattering with dark-sector radiation), background templates, and charge-identification-dependent selections behind the paper's Poisson binned log-likelihood projection are not released, so the DUNE reach cannot be independently evaluated or extended beyond the paper's benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutrinophilic mediator model in a neutrino-beam event generator (e.g. a GENIE/NuWro extension or MadGraph with DUNE flux inputs), rebuild the wrong-sign-lepton and missing-pT background templates for the liquid and gas argon near detectors, and package the binned Poisson log-likelihood with configurable detector-performance assumptions.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic thermal dark matter Model III
members.description: No public, reusable DUNE near-detector mono-neutrino likelihood exists for this neutrinophilic model: the signal event generation (missing transverse momentum plus wrong-sign charged leptons in liquid/gas argon), background templates, and charge-identification/detector-response assumptions live only inside the paper's private projection.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutrinophilic scalar-mediator radiation process in a neutrino event generator (GENIE with a BSM module, or a MadGraph/UFO implementation convolved with the DUNE flux), fold in published DUNE near-detector performance parameters for p_T^miss and lepton charge ID, and release a binned Poisson log-likelihood validated against the paper's democratic and hierarchical flavor-benchmark reach contours.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation helium-bound dark atom scenario
members.description: No public likelihood exists for anomalous-helium isotope searches or dark-atom direct searches applicable to this model (all three card constraints have likelihood_available: no), so even a completed transport calculation cannot be turned into quantitative exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published anomalous-helium/heavy-isotope search limits and package them as an abundance-versus-mass-and-charge exclusion likelihood module that consumes the terrestrial number density predicted by the transport calculation of gap_1.

members.model_name: Invisible dilaton misalignment dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast exists mapping MICROSCOPE weak-equivalence-principle data and atomic-clock oscillation searches onto the quadratic, oscillating, composition-dependent coupling of the invisible dilaton; published alpha bounds apply to linear dilaton couplings and are not plug-and-play for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the Eotvos-parameter and clock-frequency-shift signal templates for a quadratically coupled oscillating condensate including the screening factor, then recast the published MICROSCOPE WEP limit and existing atomic-clock dark-matter likelihoods into (m_phi, Lambda_f) space, releasing the mapping as a lightweight likelihood module.

members.model_name: Fermionic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: The UHECR constraint on the card is a historical SUGAR anisotropy recast with likelihood_available 'no'; no modern end-to-end likelihood combines superheavy-X decay fragmentation spectra, a Galactic-halo decay template, and current Auger/TA exposure and composition data to constrain (m_X, tau_X, Omega_X).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a pipeline using HDMSpectra for X decay spectra at m_X above 1e13 GeV, a Milky-Way halo decay template with CRPropa propagation, and published Auger flux/photon-fraction/anisotropy limits, packaged as a tau_X-versus-m_X exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: Nearly totally dissipative self-interacting dark matter SMBH-seeding model
members.description: No likelihood exists for comparing the predicted SMBH seed catalog to high-redshift quasar luminosity functions, the M_BH-sigma relation, or the cosmic SMBH mass density; the paper makes only qualitative comparisons with unpackaged observational systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from published z>=6 quasar luminosity-function measurements (e.g. SHELLQs/SDSS compilations) and local SMBH demographics, including duty-cycle and Eddington-ratio nuisance parameters, so that (sigma/m, f_diss, M0) can be constrained statistically.

members.model_name: Z8 x Z22 flavonic dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood or digitized exclusion curve exists for mapping the axial flavon's two-photon decay (meV-keV mass range) onto the 16-yr INTEGRAL/SPI light decaying dark matter limits; only a qualitative figure-level comparison was possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published INTEGRAL/SPI lifetime-versus-mass exclusion curves (arXiv:2209.06299) into a tabulated likelihood module for photon-line decays, and apply it to the (m_a, g_a_gamma_gamma) plane implied by the (N, f) flavour benchmarks.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario B
members.description: The X-ray decay constraint on the FN-predicted active-sterile mixing is only qualitative: no digitized keV X-ray line-limit tables or likelihood are attached to compare the computed N_1 -> nu gamma lifetime against observations target by target.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sin^2(2theta) from the FN Yukawa textures, evaluate the radiative width analytically, and confront it with a compiled table of published X-ray line limits (XMM-Newton, Chandra, NuSTAR, eROSITA) interpolated in (M_1, sin^2(2theta)).

members.model_name: Hidden photon misalignment cold dark matter
members.description: The FIRAS spectral-distortion exclusion on resonant hidden-photon conversion exists only as an undigitized plot-level contour in the primary paper, so no quantitative likelihood in the (m_gamma_prime, chi) plane can be applied in the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the FIRAS mu/y exclusion contour, or better, recompute it as a proper likelihood by folding the conversion-probability calculation through the FIRAS monopole-spectrum residuals, and store the result as a (m_gamma_prime, chi) likelihood table in the registry.

members.model_name: Spin-flipped gauged U(1) model with singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No reusable flavor likelihood exists for the variant's loop-induced b-s-Z-prime coupling including the possible scalar-leptoquark C9prime = -C10prime contributions; the card records likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes for con_spinflipped_flavor_constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the variant's one-loop Wilson-coefficient matching (C9, C9prime, C10prime as functions of f-prime, m_Qprime, m_Zprime) as a flavio/smelli model wrapper and evaluate the global b -> s l l plus B_s mixing likelihood over the variant parameter space.

members.model_name: Liouville-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: No FRB-lensing likelihood exists that converts a compact-object mass function and fraction f_DM into constraints or forecasts from observed FRB catalogs; the route's optical-depth calculation is a forecast mapping with no statistical pipeline for current CHIME/ASKAP FRB samples.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an FRB millisecond-lensing likelihood module: point-lens optical depth over the observed FRB redshift distribution with instrumental time-resolution selection, taking (M_L, f_DM) grids as input and validated against published FRB compact-object constraints.

members.model_name: Majoron-assisted semi-annihilating Z3 scalar dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the box-shaped neutrino spectrum from Majoron decay at Hyper-Kamiokande or for the boosted-DM/neutrino coincidence signature at DUNE; only paper-level projections are available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an event-rate recast using published Hyper-K/Super-K effective areas and atmospheric-neutrino backgrounds for a box spectrum parameterized by (m_chi, m_J), and extend the published DUNE semi-annihilation study into a reusable likelihood over (m_chi, <sigma v>_semi, scattering cross section).

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic thermal dark matter Model IB
members.description: No public, reusable DUNE near-detector mono-neutrino forward simulation and likelihood exists for this neutrinophilic model: the signal event generation (charged-current scattering with dark-sector radiation), background templates, and charge-identification-dependent selections behind the paper's Poisson binned log-likelihood projection are not released, so the DUNE reach cannot be independently evaluated or updated for other parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutrinophilic mediator model in a neutrino-beam event generator (e.g. a GENIE/NuWro extension or MadGraph with DUNE flux inputs), rebuild the wrong-sign-lepton and missing-pT background templates for the liquid and gas argon near detectors, and package the binned Poisson log-likelihood with configurable detector-performance assumptions.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw mixed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No LFV likelihood exists for the charged-lepton flavour-violating decays driven by Y_nu and the inverse-seesaw mu_S term; the card records only paper-era bounds with texture-dependent applicability and no rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute mu->e gamma, mu->3e, and mu-e conversion with SPheno/FlavorKit output from the SARAH implementation and compare against current MEG II/SINDRUM limits as a likelihood over the scanned flavour textures.

members.model_name: Inelastic dark matter with a dark photon mediator
members.description: No public detector-level likelihood or recast module exists for the BaBar monophoton acceptance or the Belle II displaced photon-plus-dilepton/hadron vertex search applied to long-lived chi_2 decays; exclusions depend on unpublished escape-probability, veto, and trigger assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the BaBar monophoton and Belle II displaced-vertex analyses as recast cards in a long-lived-particle framework (e.g. a MadGraph event chain with parameterized detector geometry, photon/veto acceptances, and displaced-vertex trigger efficiencies), and publish the resulting efficiency maps as reusable likelihoods over (epsilon, m_A', m_chi1, Delta, alpha_D, c tau_chi2).

members.model_name: Type-I non-degenerate 2HDM+a dark matter benchmark model
members.description: No validated LHC recast exists for the non-degenerate type-I 2HDM+a cascade and missing-energy benchmark topologies (h+MET, Z+MET, top-associated MET, visible heavy-Higgs cascades); existing degenerate type-II limits cannot be reused directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS Run 2 mono-Higgs, mono-Z, tt+MET and heavy-Higgs search analyses in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE, validate against at least one published mono-Higgs or mono-Z cutflow as the card's validation tests specify, and wire in the public simplified likelihoods where available.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet freeze-in dark matter in fast-expansion cosmology
members.description: No public collider recast or likelihood exists for the boosted W/Z/h plus missing-momentum jet-substructure MVA search; the FeynRules/MadGraph model files used by the authors are not public, so the quoted LHC mass reach cannot be reused or reinterpreted.
members.proposed_resolution: Publish the FeynRules/UFO model files and implement the boosted-boson-plus-MET selection as a recast analysis in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE, including a simplified-likelihood surface over (m_2, c_tau, branching fractions).

members.model_name: Non-thermal WIMP baryogenesis model
members.description: The LHC bound on the colored psi/parent state is an approximate reinterpretation of gluino searches; no dedicated recast likelihood for the model's actual production cross section and u+MET-like decay topology exists (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vectorlike color-triplet psi in MadGraph/FeynRules and recast current jets+MET searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, producing an exclusion likelihood in the (m_phi/m_psi, m_chi) plane to replace the borrowed gluino floor.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free leptophobic axial Z-prime Dirac dark matter
members.description: No public, up-to-date collider likelihood for the leptophobic Z': the dijet/dilepton/monojet exclusions are a paper-internal recast of pre-2019 ATLAS/CMS data, with only partial likelihood availability, so production-grade constraints cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable recast of current full-Run-2 dijet, dilepton, and monojet searches (e.g. in CheckMATE, MadAnalysis 5, or Contur using the UFO model from gap_1), including the radiatively generated kinetic-mixing dilepton channel, and expose it as a likelihood over (m_Zprime, m_chi, g_B, m_s).

members.model_name: Right-sneutrino FIMP dark matter with long-lived stau NLSP
members.description: No public detector-level recast or likelihood exists for the long-lived stau HSCP signature of this model: the beta/time-of-flight/dE/dx selection is done with private benchmark-level cuts on Delphes output, and CMS HSCP limits are applied only as quoted mass bounds rather than as a reusable statistical implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CMS heavy-stable-charged-particle search (time-of-flight and dE/dx selections with published efficiency maps) in a public LLP recasting framework such as the LLP Recasting Repository or HackAnalysis on top of the existing MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes chain, and expose it as an event-count likelihood for stau benchmarks.

members.model_name: GmSUGRA DFSZ axino LSP with long-lived bino NLSP
members.description: No public recast or reusable likelihood exists for the HL-LHC non-pointing/displaced-photon plus missing-transverse-momentum search applied to slepton cascades ending in a long-lived bino decaying to axino plus photon; the paper's detector-level efficiencies are private and only an approximate likelihood is noted.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the displaced-photon selection (timing/pointing plus MET cuts) in a public LLP recasting framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis with Delphes, validate against the paper's benchmark signal yields, and publish efficiency maps over (m_chi10, m_slepton_R, tau_chi).

members.model_name: Neutron dark-decay light-scalar dark matter model
members.description: The route's constraints are applied only as pass-fail bands (2-solar-mass cut, neutron lifetime discrepancy, invisible-Higgs interval) with likelihood_available 'no' or 'unknown' throughout; there is no combined likelihood over (m_chi, m_phi, theta, z_chi, z_n) using actual bottle/beam lifetime data, NICER/pulsar mass-radius posteriors, and LHC invisible-Higgs measurements.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a global likelihood: a Gaussian bottle-vs-beam neutron-lifetime likelihood for Br(n -> chi phi), published NICER and radio-pulsar mass(-radius) posteriors applied to the TOV output of gap_1, and the ATLAS/CMS invisible-Higgs branching likelihood, packaged for a standard sampler (e.g. as a GAMBIT or Cobaya module).

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_e scotogenic pattern-A fermion dark matter
members.description: No collider likelihood or recast tables exist for the flavor-specific B-3L_e Z' with its nonstandard lepton-flavor charges; the TeV-scale dilepton bound is only a qualitative simplified-narrow-resonance statement in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the ATLAS/CMS dilepton resonance searches for the exact B-3L_e charge assignment using generator-level cross sections from MadGraph5_aMC@NLO with the released model files and a Z'-recast framework (ZPEED-style), publishing exclusion tables in the (M_Z', g') plane.

members.model_name: Trilinear-augmented gaugino mediation gravitino dark matter
members.description: No maintained public recast of current-luminosity CMS/ATLAS heavy-stable-charged-particle searches with efficiency maps applicable to the stau-NLSP benchmarks; the card only has the Run 1 recast plus a less detailed early 13 TeV reinterpretation, so collider viability of stau-NLSP points cannot be evaluated against present data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full-Run-2 CMS HSCP search (efficiency maps and signal-region likelihood) in a long-lived-particle recast framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 LLP, and apply it to the MadGraph+Pythia stau samples from step s3.

members.model_name: Two-component Majorana FIMP with scalar mediator
members.description: No recast of LHC heavy-stable-charged-particle searches (efficiency and acceptance maps for Drell-Yan-produced long-lived charged scalars) is available; the card lists the collider constraint as likelihood_available no, so only the quoted benchmark lower mass m_eta = 430 GeV can be used.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS HSCP searches for a Drell-Yan-produced charged scalar in a recasting framework such as SModelS or CheckMATE, including lifetime-dependent acceptance, to convert the benchmark limit into a coupling- and lifetime-dependent exclusion.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_tau scotogenic pattern-C fermion dark matter
members.description: No flavor-specific Z' dilepton recast exists: the LHC bound is recorded only as 'above the TeV scale' under simplified narrow-resonance and universal-coupling assumptions, while the B-3L_tau charge assignment gives tau-rich and quark (B-charge) couplings whose branching fractions change the excluded (M_Z', g') region, as the constraint's caveats state.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published ATLAS/CMS dilepton (and ditau) resonance searches with the exact B-3L_tau charges and widths, producing exclusion tables in the (M_Z', g') plane that also feed the suppressed Z'-portal contribution to the relic calculation.

members.model_name: Split fermionic WIMPs with singlet scalar Higgs portal
members.description: No collider recast or likelihood exists for the Higgs/scalar-portal sector of this model (Higgs signal strengths, invisible/exotic decays, and heavy scalar searches), leaving the collider route a placeholder that cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute mixed-scalar production rates and branching fractions (including invisible decays to psi_1) as functions of (m_s, theta, g_1) and confront them with Higgs signal-strength and heavy-scalar search likelihoods via HiggsTools (HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals successors), adding invisible-decay limits where m_s < 2 m_1 channels close.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter with L=2 masses
members.description: No collider recast of heavy-stable-charged-particle and long-lived-particle searches has been implemented for the dominantly right-handed stau or neutralino NLSP spectra of this model, leaving the charged-track observable unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast ATLAS/CMS HSCP and displaced/long-lived searches for the 300-900 GeV NLSP benchmarks using SModelS long-lived results or a MadGraph+Pythia simulation with the published HSCP efficiency maps, producing exclusion contours in the (M_NLSP, tau_NLSP) plane.

members.model_name: Mirror Twin Higgs reheaton baryogenesis atomic dark matter
members.description: No model-specific collider recast or likelihood exists for the TeV-scale top-philic color-triplet scalar phi_A with Y_phi = -1/3; the card notes no detector-level collider likelihood is encoded.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO model for the visible color triplet with its top-philic and right-handed-neutrino couplings, simulate production in MadGraph, and recast existing LHC squark/leptoquark searches with SModelS or CheckMATE to obtain mass-coupling limits.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_mu scotogenic pattern-B fermion dark matter
members.description: No collider likelihood or recast tables exist for the flavor-specific B-3L_mu Z' with its muon-philic charge assignment; the TeV-scale dilepton bound quoted in the paper is a simplified narrow-resonance statement rather than a reusable exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast ATLAS/CMS dilepton (especially dimuon) resonance searches for the exact B-3L_mu charges using MadGraph5_aMC@NLO cross sections from the released model files in a ZPEED-style framework, publishing exclusions in the (M_Z', g') plane.

members.model_name: Vector-portal scalar light dark matter in neutrino beams
members.description: No public packaged detector likelihood (signal efficiencies, background model, binned counts) exists for sub-GeV dark-matter scattering searches at MiniBooNE, T2K, or SHiP, so BdNMC elastic and NC pi0-like event distributions cannot be converted into statistical exclusions or sensitivities.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recasting likelihood from the published MiniBooNE dark-matter-run data release and T2K/SHiP background estimates, and package it as a module that consumes BdNMC event distributions and returns exclusion contours in (m_chi, m_V, epsilon, alpha_D).

members.model_name: SIMP dark pions through the axion portal
members.description: Beam-dump, collider, and supernova ALP limits are only available as published exclusion curves for specific coupling bases; no recast pipeline maps this model's ALP coupling choice, lifetime, and branching ratios onto those searches, so the laboratory observable cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer on an existing ALP-limit framework (e.g. extend a DarkCast/ALPINIST-style package) that takes the paper's ALP-SM coupling structure, computes tau_a and branching fractions, and re-derives beam-dump/collider/supernova exclusions with correct acceptance and lifetime weighting.

members.model_name: Self-interacting forbidden vector dark matter with a cannibally co-decaying phase
members.description: Constraints on the light Higgs-mixed scalar S (9-114 MeV, mixing theta) are assembled from per-experiment recasts with no packaged combined likelihood over beam-dump, rare-meson, and lifetime constraints, so the surviving (m_S, theta) region and NA62 projections cannot be re-evaluated systematically.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Higgs-mixed scalar production and decay in an intensity-frontier recast framework (e.g. add the model to a DarkCast-style scalar-portal limit compilation or SensCalc) with digitized likelihoods for the beam-dump and K/B-meson searches used in the paper plus the NA62 beam-dump configuration.

members.model_name: Fermionic Clockwork FIMP with vector-like lepton portal
members.description: No collider recast or likelihood exists for pair-produced Z2-odd vector-like leptons and Clockwork gears decaying to the FIMP plus Higgs or electroweak bosons; the source discussion of LHC and 100 TeV reach is purely qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate electroweak pair production of the vector-like leptons with MadGraph+Pythia using the FeynRules model from gap_1 and recast ATLAS/CMS multilepton/electroweakino plus missing-energy searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, giving exclusion contours in the (M_D, m) plane.

members.model_name: Excited-bound-state t-channel superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No dedicated collider recast exists for the long-lived colored charged mediator in the cosmologically favored lifetime and compression region; limits are only mapped approximately from adjacent t-channel LLP studies.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast HSCP, displaced-vertex, and soft-object searches for the down-type colored scalar with SModelS/CheckMATE LLP modules over (m_tilde_q, Delta m, tau_mediator), targeting the superWIMP-viable lifetime band.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet dark matter with vector-like quark UV completion
members.description: No public likelihood exists for B -> K(*) + invisible with two-body dark-scalar-pair (phi phi) kinematics: the analysis relies on neutrino-like three-body efficiency maps as a proxy, and Belle II/BaBar signal efficiencies for the phi phi missing-mass spectrum have not been rerun or released in reusable form.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-current b -> s phi phi differential rate (with lattice B -> K(*) form factors) in flavio or EOS, convolve with the published Belle II q^2-binned efficiency maps to build a likelihood over (C_d^S,sb, C_d^P,sb, m_phi), and validate against the paper's quoted branching windows.

members.model_name: Compressed NMSSM singlino-higgsino co-annihilation dark matter scenario
members.description: No analysis-level likelihood exists for the ATLAS/CMS compressed-electroweakino soft-lepton searches applied to this spectrum, where higgsino-like states decay through 5-10 GeV splittings and a final few-GeV transition to the singlino LSP adds remnants too soft for SModelS simplified-model topologies to capture faithfully.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS and CMS soft-lepton plus missing-energy analyses in a full recasting framework (MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE with MadGraph+Pythia event generation of the two-step higgsino-to-singlino cascade) and combine with the experiments' published pyhf/simplified likelihoods to give a point-by-point signal likelihood for the excess-compatibility claim.

members.model_name: Light fermionic dark sector with dark photon and dark Higgs
members.description: No public missing-energy recast likelihood exists for this multi-state dark sector: BaBar/NA64 exclusions and Belle II projections are quoted only as epsilon reach scales for a minimal invisible dark photon, while the model's chi_2 de-excitation and dark-Higgs associated-production topologies change signal acceptance.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct acceptance maps for BaBar single-photon, NA64 missing-energy, and Belle II searches using published efficiencies (e.g. via a DarkCast-style rescaling extended to semi-visible final states with chi_2 -> chi_1 + X and V S associated production), and package them as likelihood tables over (epsilon, m_V, M_chi1, M_chi2, M_S).

members.model_name: Decay-induced freeze-in baryogenesis scalar dark matter
members.description: No recast likelihood package exists for LHC displaced-lepton searches applied to the long-lived vectorlike leptons; the card cites only an illustrative existing exclusion (F_1 up to about 400-500 GeV) that is benchmark- and flavor-dependent.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast ATLAS/CMS displaced-lepton and heavy-stable-charged-particle searches for pair-produced vectorlike leptons over the (M_i, c*tau_Fi) plane using MadGraph plus a public LLP recasting framework, and publish the efficiency tables as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Gauged L_mu-L_tau complex-scalar self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No reusable recast/likelihood code exists for the light L_mu-L_tau Z prime laboratory constraints in this model: NA64-e missing-energy limits (loop-induced electron coupling with model-dependent invisible branching), neutrino trident and CCFR bounds, and the muon g-2 band must each be re-derived by hand for the dark-charge q, m_Zprime, gprime point being tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the L_mu-L_tau Z prime with dark-sector branching ratios in a fixed-target/precision recast framework (e.g. a DarkCast-style or GAMBIT-style module) that encodes the NA64-e, neutrino-scattering, and g-2 exclusions as functions of (m_Zprime, gprime, BR_invisible), including the one-loop electron coupling.

members.model_name: Gauged L_mu-L_tau Dirac self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No reusable recast/likelihood code exists for the light L_mu-L_tau Z prime laboratory constraints in this model: NA64-e missing-energy limits (loop-induced electron coupling with model-dependent invisible branching), neutrino trident and CCFR bounds, and the muon g-2 band must each be re-derived by hand for the dark-charge q, m_Zprime, gprime point being tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the L_mu-L_tau Z prime with dark-sector branching ratios in a fixed-target/precision recast framework (e.g. a DarkCast-style or GAMBIT-style module) that encodes the NA64-e, neutrino-scattering, and g-2 exclusions as functions of (m_Zprime, gprime, BR_invisible), including the one-loop electron coupling.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino dark matter with forbidden annihilation
members.description: No recast exists mapping future lepton-collider Higgs-portal scalar sensitivities onto the (lambda_Hphi, m_phi) thermalization floor identified by the paper, so the collider-visibility observable cannot be quantitatively evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published light-scalar Higgs-mixing projections (e.g. ILC/FCC-ee exotic Higgs decay and scalar-strahlung studies, as in 1710.01585) into limits on lambda_Hphi versus m_phi and overlay the thermal-equilibrium lower bound.

members.model_name: Composite neutrino-portal dark matter from a light hidden sector
members.description: Existing ATLAS/CMS HNL search acceptances do not cover this model's topologies: associated dark-matter production changes missing momentum and cut efficiencies for prompt, displaced, and long-lived composite singlet neutrinos, and no adapted recast or MATHUSLA/HL-LHC projection pipeline exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dedicated recast: generate N production with associated DM in MadGraph with a UFO of the effective model, pass through Delphes-based re-implementations of the ATLAS/CMS prompt and displaced HNL searches (MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE recast databases), and add a decay-in-volume estimate for MATHUSLA-type far detectors as a function of (m_N, U_N, c tau_N).

members.model_name: Scalar-decoupled light-higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public recast of the ATLAS/CMS compressed-electroweakino soft-lepton and disappearing/displaced-track searches is valid for the finite-gaugino MSSM mass splittings of this scenario; simplified pure-higgsino limits overstate the reach and the relevant detector efficiencies are not packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS soft-lepton and disappearing-track analyses in a public recast framework (CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5) with efficiency maps parameterized in (M_C1, Delta M_plus, Delta M_0), driven by SLHA spectra from a standard MSSM spectrum calculator, and validate against the published simplified-model exclusions.

members.model_name: Well-tempered singlet-quintuplet fermion WIMP
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the displaced-lepton and disappearing-track searches on the compressed quintuplet spectrum; the card marks likelihood_available no for both collider constraints and the source bound (five-plet masses below about 280 GeV) is a one-off recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track and displaced-lepton analyses for pair-produced quintuplet states in a long-lived-particle recast framework (CheckMATE, HackAnalysis, or the SModelS LLP database), parameterized by M, theta, and M-m, and validate against the quoted 280 GeV bound.

members.model_name: Well-tempered singlet-triplet fermion WIMP
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the disappearing-track and soft-dilepton searches on the compressed singlet-triplet spectrum; both collider constraints are marked likelihood_available no and the source exclusions are one-off recasts sensitive to soft-lepton reconstruction thresholds.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track and compressed-spectrum soft-dilepton analyses in a recast framework (CheckMATE, MadAnalysis 5 PAD, or SModelS with its LLP database), parameterized by M, theta, and M-m, validating against the source-paper exclusion of the small-mixing relic strip.

members.model_name: Down-scattering excited Dark Matter
members.description: Collider constraints on the charged scalars X1 and X2 rest on a quoted CMS 7 TeV HSCP bound; no modern LHC recast (Run 2 HSCP and charged-scalar searches) is implemented for this spectrum, and the card marks likelihood_available as no.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV HSCP and long-lived charged-particle searches for the X1 (long-lived, ~3.8 TeV) and X2 (sub-TeV) states using an existing recast framework such as SModelS or CheckMATE with the model's production cross sections from MadGraph.

members.model_name: Goldstini decaying dark matter
members.description: No collider recast exists for goldstini signatures: LOSP decays to goldstino/gravitino with missing energy or displaced objects have no public model implementation or mapped LHC analysis, so the collider route cannot produce exclusions even for a chosen spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Define benchmark superpartner spectra, implement the goldstini couplings in a UFO model for MadGraph/Pythia/Delphes, and recast current ATLAS/CMS missing-energy and displaced-vertex searches in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5.

members.model_name: 750 GeV complex-scalar portal keV freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or modern recast exists for the collimated photon-pair signature (s -> aa -> 4 gamma mimicking diphotons): the constraint is a historical 750 GeV geometric cut with likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: partial.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the light-pseudoscalar collimated-photon topology with a MadGraph plus detector-simulation (Delphes) pipeline including photon-pair merging at ECAL angular resolution, and confront it with current ATLAS/CMS high-mass diphoton and photon-jet search likelihoods.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Goldstone-mediated sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No experiment-specific recast quantifies the suppression of canonical heavy-neutral-lepton signals at DUNE/SHiP-like searches when exotic N -> rho decays dominate: existing HNL sensitivity curves assume active-mixing-only decay widths and there is no likelihood including the exotic branching fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public HNL sensitivity framework (e.g. the decay-volume geometry codes used for SHiP/DUNE projections) to include the rho decay channel in the total width and visible branching ratios, and re-derive exclusion contours in (M_N2,3, mixing, f).

members.model_name: U(1)_D pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark-Higgs bound states
members.description: No LHC likelihood is wired in for the darkonium resonance signal: the visible-resonance cross section from s2 has no recast pipeline against ATLAS/CMS dilepton/dijet resonance searches including acceptance and branching-ratio assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast public ATLAS/CMS narrow dilepton and dijet resonance limits (cross section times branching ratio versus mass) into a likelihood over (m_chi, epsilon, alpha_D), including the visible-versus-dark branching fraction computed from the model's decay channels.

members.model_name: Scalar Clockwork FIMP Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: No collider recast or likelihood exists for the displaced b-jets plus missing energy signature of TeV-scale gear decays a1 -> h a0 at the LHC or a 100 TeV collider; the source discussion is qualitative only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement gear pair/associated production in MadGraph with the Clockwork UFO model, compute gear decay lengths, and recast existing long-lived-particle displaced-jet searches using CheckMATE or MadAnalysis LLP modules; extend to 100 TeV projections.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino condensate baryon-dark matter model
members.description: The long-lived NLSP collider signature has no detector-level treatment: no route step computes tau_NLSP for the very weak lambda_N regime and no LHC long-lived-particle search likelihood or recast exists for this scenario (the card explicitly flags the absence of a detector-level likelihood).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive tau_NLSP(lambda_N, m_NLSP, m_N) analytically from the N H_u L operator and recast existing LHC displaced-vertex and heavy-stable-charged-particle searches (e.g. via CheckMATE or SModelS long-lived-particle results) onto the (lambda_N, m_NLSP) plane.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet single-Higgs-inflation dark matter
members.description: The LEP/electroweak/Higgs constraint set (m_H0, m_A0, m_H+ exclusions and the invisible width) has likelihood_available 'no' and recasting_needed 'yes', with no packaged recast of LEP neutralino-search limits onto inert-scalar spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals (HiggsTools) to the invisible-width prediction and encode the published LEP inert-doublet recast (m_H0/m_A0 splitting plane) as a digitized exclusion likelihood for the collider_route.

members.model_name: Leptonic minimal scalar FIMP freeze-in model
members.description: No machine-readable efficiency maps or reusable likelihood for the HSCP, disappearing-track, and displaced-lepton recasts that define the m_F versus c_tau_F exclusion envelope; the paper's recast cannot be reproduced or updated from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the recast in the MadAnalysis 5 or CheckMATE long-lived-particle modules using the published ATLAS/CMS efficiency tables for HSCP, disappearing-track, and displaced-lepton searches, validating against the primary paper's leptonic exclusion figure.

members.model_name: Light-vector-meson dark pion SIMP model
members.description: No reusable likelihood or recast exists for confronting the model's semi-visible/emerging-jet and displaced-vertex signatures with ATLAS/CMS dark-shower searches over the (m_pi, m_rho, epsilon) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the existing ATLAS/CMS emerging-jet and displaced-vertex searches in a public framework (MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE-style) using the gap_2 shower samples, and publish efficiency maps over lifetime and mass ratio.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal vector millicharged dark matter
members.description: No digitized exclusion curves or likelihood exist for recasting BaBar/NA64 invisible dark-photon searches (and Belle II/LDMX projections) into this model's near-resonant (epsilon, m_Aprime, e_D) parameter space; the card records the bounds only qualitatively with an ambiguous coupling normalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published BaBar and NA64 invisible-A' exclusion curves, verify the invisible branching ratio is near unity across the scanned e_D range, and recast via Darkcast-style rate rescaling into the EDGES-motivated parameter plane, packaging the result as a reusable exclusion map or approximate likelihood.

members.model_name: SO(10) split-SUSY neutralino dark matter with non-universal gaugino masses
members.description: Collider viability is enforced by approximate LEP thresholds and gluino-mass cuts rather than simplified-model likelihoods, which is unreliable for the compressed higgsino-like chargino/neutralino spectra that dominate the surviving dark-matter strip.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the weak-scale spectra through SModelS/CheckMATE including soft-lepton and disappearing-track electroweakino searches to replace the flat LEP/LHC cuts with per-point exclusion likelihoods.

members.model_name: CP-even sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: No implemented LHC 2l+MET electroweakino recast exists for compressed Higgsino spectra decaying to a sneutrino LSP; the claim that favored regions survive direct searches is qualitative and cannot be checked against current or future data.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate Higgsino-like chargino/neutralino production with the modified decay chains to the sneutrino LSP (MadGraph plus Pythia) and recast the ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum dilepton+MET searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, producing exclusion contours in the (m_chargino, m_snu1) plane.

members.model_name: B-L two-Higgs-doublet thermal right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: Collider exclusions on the B-L/U(1)_X Z-prime are only figure-level in the paper; no machine-readable ATLAS/CMS dijet, dilepton, top-pair, and monojet recast grid exists for this model's charge assignments and branching ratios.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the relevant ATLAS/CMS resonance limits and build a ZPEED-style fast Z-prime exclusion code parameterized by (m_Zprime, g_X, branching ratios), cross-checking qualitatively against the paper's exclusion overlays.

members.model_name: Charged-meson vector-portal inelastic dark matter benchmark
members.description: The visible/invisible dark-photon constraint recast (NA64, E141, BaBar) under the model's mixed 50/50 branching benchmark is only an approximate curve rescaling because the original experimental likelihoods are unavailable, so exclusion contours for non-benchmark branching fractions cannot be computed reliably.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public dark-photon recasting tool such as DarkCast to handle arbitrary visible/invisible branching splits of V1 (and the two-mediator V1/V2 case), using the published NA64 missing-energy and E141/BaBar visible-search yields to build branching-dependent limits.

members.model_name: d_R t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: No recast likelihood exists for the LHC constraints on the (3,1)_{1/3} colored mediator across its prompt jets+MET, long-lived-particle, and mediator bound-state resonance regimes; the card records likelihood_available: no and that search efficiencies were not reproduced, so the compressed and small-coupling regions cannot be statistically evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO implementation of the d_R model for MG5_aMC@NLO and recast the relevant ATLAS/CMS jets+MET, heavy-stable-charged-particle/LLP, and dijet bound-state resonance searches in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE, exposing the result as an (m_X, Delta m, g_DM) exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: q_L t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: No recast likelihood exists for the LHC constraints on the (3,2)_{1/6} colored mediator across its prompt jets+MET, long-lived-particle, and mediator bound-state resonance regimes; the card records likelihood_available: no and that search efficiencies were not reproduced, so the compressed and small-coupling regions cannot be statistically evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO implementation of the q_L model for MG5_aMC@NLO and recast the relevant ATLAS/CMS jets+MET, LLP, and dijet bound-state resonance searches in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE, exposing the result as an (m_X, Delta m, g_DM) exclusion likelihood covering both doublet components.

members.model_name: u_R t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: No recast likelihood exists for the LHC constraints on the (3,1)_{2/3} colored mediator across its prompt jets+MET, long-lived-particle, and mediator bound-state resonance regimes; the card records likelihood_available: no and that search efficiencies were not reproduced, so the compressed and small-coupling regions cannot be statistically evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO implementation of the u_R model for MG5_aMC@NLO and recast the relevant ATLAS/CMS jets+MET, LLP, and dijet bound-state resonance searches in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE, exposing the result as an (m_X, Delta m, g_DM) exclusion likelihood.

members.model_name: Branon dark matter with thermal and misalignment production
members.description: Collider constraints exist only as an undigitized figure-level LEP-II single-photon plus Tevatron-I monojet exclusion; no machine-readable f-M contour or modern mono-photon/monojet likelihood recast is available for the branon EFT.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the gap_1 UFO model, recast current LHC mono-photon and monojet analyses with MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE (restricted to EFT-valid kinematics) and digitize the historical LEP-II/Tevatron contour as a validation target, publishing the resulting f-M exclusion as a reusable interpolated likelihood.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter in supersymmetric U(1)_R U(1)_{B-L} seesaw model
members.description: The collider bound on M_Zprime/v_R is a historical ATLAS translation (recasting_needed yes, likelihood_available no); no current LHC dilepton Z-prime search recast to the BLR gauge couplings exists on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS high-mass dilepton limits into the BLR Z-prime coupling structure to update the m_Zprime-to-v_R translation used to bound the relic-pole scan.

members.model_name: Constrained NMSSM singlino LSP with stau-NLSP coannihilation
members.description: No implemented recast likelihood exists for the 7 TeV ATLAS/CMS multilepton, ditau, and jets+MET selections applied to singlino-LSP cascades with soft taus from the small stau-neutralino splitting; cMSSM efficiency tables cannot be reused because the extra bino-to-singlino cascade softens MET and adds visible objects.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS SUSY analyses (7 TeV originals or, preferably, modern 13 TeV multilepton/ditau+MET successors) in a public recast framework such as MadAnalysis5-PAD or CheckMATE, generate cNMSSM singlino-cascade event samples with the NMSSMTools+MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes chain, and validate against the efficiency-ratio pattern reported in the paper.

members.model_name: A4 Dirac-neutrino FIMP dark matter
members.description: No wired likelihood connects the model's (lambda_H_eta, m_eta) plane to LHC Higgs invisible/exotic-width data or its A4 flavon alignment to global neutrino oscillation fits; the card records qualitative consistency statements only, so precision exclusion of the collider and flavor parameter space cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the mother scalar onto the standard scalar-singlet Higgs-portal parameterization and evaluate it with a public Higgs-likelihood package (Lilith/HiggsTools-style invisible-width likelihood), and implement the A4 alignment's predicted (theta_23, delta_CP) correlation against a current NuFIT chi-square surface, exposing both as reusable likelihood modules for this card.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) light neutralino/slepton coannihilation scenario
members.description: No collider or g-2 likelihood is implemented for the scan: LHC compressed-spectrum slepton/electroweakino search limits and the muon g-2 comparison are quoted only at source level, and the paper's non-universal spectra invalidate direct reuse of CMSSM exclusion contours.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a constraint module combining GM2Calc for Delta a_mu against the current experimental average with SModelS/CheckMATE recasts of ATLAS/CMS compressed slepton and electroweakino searches applied point-by-point to the flipped-SU(5) SLHA spectra.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation U-antiquark dark atoms
members.description: The collider constraint is only a quoted ~1 TeV R-hadron mass floor from older LHC searches; no current recast or likelihood exists for a stable charge +2/3 fourth-generation U (anti)quark hadronizing into heavy stable charged hadrons, which the card flags as requiring recast before use.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the latest ATLAS/CMS heavy stable charged particle (HSCP/R-hadron) searches for a stable up-type fourth-generation quark, generating signal samples with MadGraph+Pythia using standard R-hadron hadronization and charge-exchange scenarios, and publish the resulting m_U exclusion as a reusable limit table.

members.model_name: Alternative [SU(3)]^4 leptonic-color dark matter model
members.description: The Z prime dilepton constraint rests on 2016 13 TeV limits translated by hand with benchmark c_u,d coefficients and B_ll ~ 0.044; no current ATLAS/CMS Run-2/Run-3 high-mass dilepton likelihood has been recast onto this model's (m_Zprime, g_R, g_X) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the latest full-Run-2 ATLAS/CMS dilepton resonance searches (e.g. via the published sigma x B limit curves in a recasting framework such as ZPEED-style code or MadGraph plus the experiments' HEPData limits) onto the alternative left-right Z prime couplings to obtain an up-to-date exclusion in m_Zprime versus couplings.

members.model_name: Semi-constrained NMSSM singlino-like neutralino LSP benchmark lines
members.description: No implemented recast likelihood exists for ATLAS/CMS jets+MET searches applied to sNMSSM benchmark lines where the bino-to-singlino cascade reduces 2/3-jet+MET efficiencies by factors of 1/3 to 1/7; cMSSM exclusion contours and efficiency tables cannot be reused directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the jets+MET analyses (7 TeV originals or modern 13 TeV successors) in MadAnalysis5-PAD or CheckMATE, run the NMSSMTools+MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes chain over the three benchmark lines, and validate the recast against the paper's 1/3-1/7 efficiency-drop envelope and 0.9-0.75 M_1/2 bound reductions.

members.model_name: Super-Natural MSSM with nonthermal axino dark matter
members.description: The LHC heavy-stable-charged-particle bound on the long-lived stau is only quoted from ATLAS plots; no efficiency-map-based likelihood is connected for this spectrum, including the intermediate 100 m - 30 km decay-length variants where detector-stable and displaced regimes mix.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS HSCP searches for direct-plus-cascade stau production using published efficiency maps (e.g. via the SModelS long-lived-particle database) with the lifetime-dependent in-detector decay fraction from c tau_stau.

members.model_name: CP-odd sneutrino dark matter in the NMSSM with Type-I seesaw
members.description: No implemented LHC 2l+MET electroweakino recast exists for compressed Higgsino spectra decaying to a CP-odd sneutrino LSP; the claim that favored regions survive direct searches is qualitative and cannot be checked against current or future data.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate Higgsino-like chargino/neutralino production with the modified decay chains to the sneutrino LSP (MadGraph plus Pythia) and recast the ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum dilepton+MET searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, producing exclusion contours in the (m_chargino, m_snu1) plane.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant Higgs-portal vector FIMP in a fast pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No detector-level likelihood or acceptance model is stored for the light-scalar long-lived-particle reach at FASER, MATHUSLA, DUNE, and SHiP; only the paper's projection curves exist, so facility reach cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Use FORESEE for the FASER reach of the Higgs-mixed light scalar and construct geometry-plus-lifetime acceptance models for MATHUSLA, DUNE, and SHiP from their published sensitivity documents, exposing reach as a function of (sin theta, m_h2).

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_X remnant scalar dark matter
members.description: No LHC recast exists for the pp -> Z'Z' -> 4-lepton topology with a few-hundred-MeV kinetically mixed Z' produced through heavy-scalar decay; the paper explicitly leaves the collider analysis to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in MadGraph with the kinetic-mixing decay table, simulate the collimated lepton-pair signature, and recast existing ATLAS/CMS multilepton and dark-photon searches (e.g. via CheckMATE/Contur) into limits on (m_Zprime, epsilon, heavy scalar mass).

members.model_name: Dark-Z-mediated fermionic dark matter with an extra Higgs doublet
members.description: No recasting pipeline or likelihood exists for the long-lived dark-Z displaced-vertex signal: mapping (lifetime, production rate) to ATLAS/CMS Run 3 and SHiP reach requires detector acceptance and efficiency maps for MeV-scale displaced lepton pairs that are only available as the source paper's projection, not as a reusable tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-Z production and displaced-decay signature in an LLP recasting framework (e.g. MadGraph event generation plus the SHiP/ATLAS displaced-vertex efficiency maps as used in existing dark-photon LLP recasts), reproducing the quoted 7-150 MeV LHC and 2m_e-15 MeV SHiP reach windows.

members.model_name: SUSY 4-2-2 GUT neutralino dark matter with lepton-flavor violation
members.description: The collider selection uses static gluino/Higgs/B-physics cuts from the paper; no up-to-date recast of LHC electroweakino, smuon, and stau searches exists for the light electroweak spectra favored by the muon g-2 condition.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the surviving SLHA spectra through SModelS and CheckMATE/MadAnalysis 5 implementations of current ATLAS/CMS slepton, stau, and electroweakino searches to replace the legacy mass cuts with proper per-point exclusions.

members.model_name: Parallel-universe dark atomic matter with Higgs mixing
members.description: No current collider likelihood is available on the card for the mixed two-Higgs system: the constraints use only 8 TeV ATLAS/CMS inputs (BR_inv < 0.65, old signal strengths), and evaluating today's exclusions requires a combined signal-strength plus invisible-width fit that treats the two unresolved mass eigenstates coherently.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the theta-scaled coupling pattern of the h1/h2 pair in HiggsTools (HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds) or Lilith, summing overlapping-peak contributions, and confront it with Run 2 signal-strength combinations and current invisible-Higgs limits (BR_inv of order 0.1).

members.model_name: R-invariant new-inflation gauge-mediated gravitino dark matter
members.description: No modern LHC recast exists for the GMSB spectra of this scenario; the primary text is pre-LHC and con_lhc_gmsb_spectrum has likelihood_available unknown, so collider viability of the benchmark cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Once benchmark spectra exist (gap_1), recast current LHC SUSY searches with public recast tools such as SModelS or CheckMATE for both neutralino- and stau-NLSP limiting cases.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu global U(1) B-L complex scalar dark matter
members.description: Charged-scalar mass bounds and the Higgs diphoton modification are only summarized at paper-era values (likelihood_available unknown); no current LHC charged-scalar search recast or Higgs signal-strength likelihood is implemented for the h+/k++ sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS doubly- and singly-charged scalar searches for the Zee-Babu states and evaluate the H->gamma gamma shift against current signal-strength data using a public Higgs-fit package such as HiggsSignals or Lilith.

members.model_name: SU(5) U(1)_X Z-prime portal right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihood or model-specific recast exists for LHC dilepton limits on the SU(5) U(1)_X Z-prime with x_H = -4/5: the paper rescales sequential-Z-prime limit curves approximately, and both the relic band and the dilepton bound carry recasting_needed = yes with no digitized limit product.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_X model with x_H = -4/5 as a FeynRules/UFO file, compute pp -> Z' -> l+l- with MadGraph at NLO parton luminosities, and confront the latest ATLAS/CMS 139 fb^-1 dilepton limit curves using a dedicated Z-prime dilepton likelihood tool such as ZPEED, releasing the resulting alpha_X(m_Z') bound as a digitized product.

members.model_name: Mirrored GUT composite asymmetric dark baryon model
members.description: The beam-dump and SN1987A dark-photon constraints on the mirrored dark photon are not digitized or implemented; the card only quotes the paper's statement that epsilon=10^-7-10^-10 with m_A_prime of O(10-100) MeV is safe, with likelihood_available 'no'.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model into an existing dark-photon constraint framework such as DarkCast, adjusting branching fractions for decays into dark hadrons, and produce digitized exclusion curves in the (m_A_prime, epsilon) plane for this model's spectrum.

members.model_name: Mirrored GUT composite asymmetric dark baryon model
members.description: No acceptance or likelihood tooling exists to map MATHUSLA/FASER/SeaQuest/Belle-II/LHCb visible dark-hadron decay projections, derived for a related composite-ADM benchmark with epsilon~1e-4, onto the mirrored-GUT benchmark with epsilon=10^-7-10^-10 and its specific dark hadron lifetimes.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute dark-hadron production rates and lab-frame lifetimes from the spectrum module and kinetic mixing, then rerun the related study's detector-acceptance geometry (decay-volume Monte Carlo) for this parameter region to obtain reach curves valid at small epsilon.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with right-handed scalar mediator Model 1
members.description: LHC colored-mediator searches and neutral-meson-mixing constraints have no flavor-texture-specific recast for this model, so mediator bounds exist only as generic statements rather than exclusions on (M, Yukawa) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC pair-production/dijet searches for the (3,1)_{2/3} scalar and compute meson-mixing observables for candidate flavor textures with an existing flavor tool (e.g. flavio) extended by the model's Wilson coefficients.

members.model_name: Z2 x Z2 two-inert-doublet 3HDM two-component dark matter
members.description: The distinguishing collider signatures (h -> H1 H2 cascades, multilepton/dijet plus missing energy from the doubled inert spectrum) have no recast: LHC search efficiencies and likelihoods for these two-component compressed-spectrum final states are not encoded in any public recasting framework for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS electroweakino-like and mono-X analyses for the inert-3HDM benchmarks in MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE (reusing existing validated analysis cards), and publish efficiency maps over the (m_H1, m_H2, Delta m) plane so exclusion limits can be interpolated without full simulation.

members.model_name: High-scale darkogenesis with leptodark messenger sphaleron transfer
members.description: Constraints on the chiral leptodark messenger sector rest on 2010-era LEP mass limits and a degenerate-limit S parameter estimate; no modern LHC electroweak-production recast, current precision-electroweak fit, or invisible-Z-width/monojet likelihood has been applied to the messenger and mixing parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the leptodark doublet/singlet sector in FeynRules/UFO, recast current LHC slepton- and electroweakino-like searches and monojet analyses (CheckMATE/MadAnalysis), and evaluate S,T,U with splittings against current global electroweak fit values.

members.model_name: Leptophobic U(1)_B fermionic X superpartner cold dark matter
members.description: No collider recast exists for the leptophobic Z_B mediator in this model: the card states no collider simulation was performed and likelihood_available is unknown for the dijet/monojet constraint, so the collider exclusion output of the recasting step cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO model of the leptophobic Z_B with kinetic mixing epsilon, generate dijet and monojet signals in MadGraph+Pythia, and recast current LHC searches with CheckMATE or Contur across (M_ZB, g_B, epsilon, m_X).

members.model_name: Leptophobic U(1)_B scalar X cold dark matter
members.description: No collider recast exists for the leptophobic Z_B mediator in this model: the card states no collider simulation was performed and likelihood_available is unknown for the dijet/monojet constraint, so the collider exclusion output of the recasting step cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO model of the leptophobic Z_B with kinetic mixing epsilon, generate dijet and monojet signals in MadGraph+Pythia, and recast current LHC searches with CheckMATE or Contur across (M_ZB, g_B, epsilon, m_X).

members.model_name: Natural AMSB higgsino-axion dark matter
members.description: Collider constraints on the compressed light-higgsino spectrum and wino same-sign-diboson signatures rest on projected reach studies, not on a recast likelihood; the card marks the collider reach recast unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current LHC soft-dilepton (compressed higgsino) and electroweakino searches for the nAMSB spectra using SModelS or CheckMATE, and encode HL-LHC/ILC projections as reusable likelihood surfaces in (mu, M_2, Delta m).

members.model_name: Gauged inverse-seesaw right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No LHC dilepton Z prime search likelihood or recast is available for the B-L Z prime mediator; the card carries only source-level exclusion statements without an ATLAS/CMS acceptance map or likelihood, so updated collider limits on (M_Zprime, g_B-L) cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the current ATLAS/CMS high-mass dilepton searches for the B-L Z prime using an existing dilepton recast framework such as ZPEED or a MadGraph plus MadAnalysis5 pipeline, producing a reusable likelihood in the (M_Zprime, g_B-L) plane.

members.model_name: Vector-like lepton decay freeze-in dark photon dark matter
members.description: No reusable detector-level recast or likelihood exists for Drell-Yan VLL pair production decaying to a charged lepton plus invisible A_H; only the paper's approximate recast of 13 TeV 139/fb analyses is available, and it cannot be re-evaluated for other branching-ratio or splitting choices.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS slepton-style lepton-plus-MET and multilepton searches in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE with public efficiency maps, generate the VLL pair-production signal from the explicit U(1)_H model, validate against the paper's 139/fb exclusion curves, and expose limits as a function of M_E, M_AH, and BR(E to A_H).

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with scalar mediator Model 2
members.description: LHC colored-mediator searches and neutral-meson-mixing constraints have no flavor-texture-specific recast for this model, so mediator bounds exist only as generic statements rather than exclusions on (M, Yukawa) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC pair-production/dijet searches for the (3,1)_{1/3} scalar and compute meson-mixing observables for candidate flavor textures with an existing flavor tool (e.g. flavio) extended by the model's Wilson coefficients.

members.model_name: Broken-Z2 mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: The 2005-era LHC Higgs projections have never been replaced by a modern signal-strength recast: the two-mixed-Higgs mirror sector (m_-, m_+, mixing angle, v2/v1) is not implemented in any public Higgs likelihood, so con_mirror_higgs_lhc_precision cannot be evaluated against post-discovery data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mirror two-Higgs mixing model (rescaled couplings plus invisible/mirror decay widths) in HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds or Lilith and fit m_-, m_+, mixing angle, and v2/v1 to current LHC signal-strength and invisible-width data.

members.model_name: Non-universal supersymmetric U(1)_prime neutralino dark matter
members.description: No reusable detector-level likelihood or implemented recast exists for the Z-prime mediated electroweakino multilepton and ditau signatures with family-dependent U(1)_prime charges; the primary paper provides benchmark selection cuts and graphical exclusions that must be digitized for quantitative reuse.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS ditau, dilepton, and electroweakino multilepton analyses as validated CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 recast cards, drive them with the SARAH/SPheno UFO model for the non-universal charge assignment, and publish the resulting exclusion likelihood over (M_Zprime, g_prime Q_E3, BR(Zprime -> chi chi)).

members.model_name: Z-portal CP-violating 3HDM dark matter
members.description: No recast analysis or machine-readable likelihood exists for the inert-scalar cascade signatures at the LHC, which are the only complementary probe given the suppressed direct/indirect rates in the zero-Higgs-portal benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate inert-scalar pair and cascade production in MadGraph with the 3HDM UFO model and recast existing LHC electroweakino/slepton-like searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, publishing the resulting exclusion likelihood for the benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Freeze-in lepton-flavored dark matter with right-handed lepton mediator
members.description: No reusable likelihood or detector simulation exists for the muon-collider prompt lepton and long-lived charged-track/displaced-lepton signatures; the paper's prospective 5-sigma discovery criterion and LLP counting depend on unfixed detector geometry, timing, and backgrounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the paper's event-simulation and selection chain as a parameterized recast (signal efficiency maps over m_med, tau_med, branching fractions for a reference muon-collider detector), so exclusions/reach can be re-evaluated as detector designs firm up.

members.model_name: Gauged charged complex scalar dark matter with dark Higgs and dark photon
members.description: No public likelihood exists for the Belle II B+ -> K+ + invisible measurement combined with KOTO and Higgs-invisible bounds in a form usable for this model's two-body (K+ H1) and three-body (K+ X Xbar) contributions; the card marks likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned likelihood from the published Belle II q^2 spectrum for B+ -> K+ nu nubar, including the SM prediction B_SM = 4.97e-6, and add KOTO/B0 -> K0 invisible exclusions as auxiliary constraints so mixed two-body/three-body dark-sector signals can be fit consistently.

members.model_name: Two-component SU(2)_R triplet fermion dark matter in broken D-parity left-right symmetry
members.description: No disappearing-track recast exists for charged SU(2)_R triplet partners with GeV-scale splittings and 0.1-1 m decay lengths produced via W_R/Z'; the s3 step has null tool_or_code and the card notes no detector efficiency simulation was performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the published ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track efficiency maps through MadAnalysis5 or SModelS to the model's chargino-like pair and associated production cross sections computed from the FeynRules model, scanning tau_charged over the quoted ns lifetimes.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with vector mediator Model 3
members.description: LHC searches for the colored vector mediator and neutral-meson-mixing constraints have no flavor-texture-specific recast for this model, so mediator bounds exist only as generic statements rather than exclusions on (M, coupling) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast LHC pair-production/dijet searches for the (3,2)_{1/6} vector and compute meson-mixing observables for candidate flavor textures with an existing flavor tool (e.g. flavio) extended by the model's Wilson coefficients.

members.model_name: Adagio dark-photon thermal relic dark matter
members.description: No assembled recast pipeline maps the Adagio-shifted relic-consistent (epsilon, alpha_D, m_A', m_chi) parameter space onto invisible dark-photon search likelihoods; existing published exclusions assume standard-cosmology thermal targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Use Darkcast plus published NA64/BaBar/Belle II invisible-mode limits, recomputing the relic-target contour with the modified-cosmology cross section from gap_1 and the benchmark branching ratios (invisible decay for 2 m_chi < m_A').

members.model_name: Local baryon-number anomaly-cancellation Majorana dark matter
members.description: ATLAS/CMS dijet and missing-energy search likelihoods are not implemented for this benchmark; the collider exclusion exists only as the primary paper's own recast, which cannot be rerun or extended from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the 13 TeV ATLAS/CMS dijet resonance and mono-jet/missing-energy searches for the Z_B and Cucuyo-Higgs signal using CheckMATE or Contur on events generated from the UFO model, reproducing the paper's exclusion boundary and adding HL-LHC projections.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative inverse-seesaw scalar H2 dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast exists for SM Higgs exotic decays into the model's GeV-scale hidden states (h -> HH, h -> Z'Z'); the paper provides no branching-ratio limit and the card records the collider observable as an implication only.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the exotic Higgs branching ratios from the model couplings and confront them with LHC exotic-decay limits via HiggsTools/HiggsBounds, adding a recast of light-resonance decay searches for 1-10 GeV Z' and scalar final states.

members.model_name: TeV-scale Majorana fermion dark matter with a massive vector portal
members.description: No detector-level likelihood or acceptance exists for the mono-photon plus missing-energy search at CLIC (sqrt(s)=3 TeV) or the 14 TeV LHC projection; the source rates are parton-level with backgrounds and efficiencies unmodeled.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate signal and SM-background mono-photon events with MadGraph/WHIZARD plus Delphes using a CLIC detector card and an HL-LHC card, and build a binned missing-energy likelihood (e.g. via MadAnalysis or CheckMATE) covering the M_med = 3 TeV near-resonance benchmark scan.

members.model_name: TeV-scale scalar dark matter with a massive vector portal
members.description: No detector-level likelihood or acceptance exists for the mono-photon plus missing-energy search at CLIC (sqrt(s)=3 TeV) or the 14 TeV LHC projection; the source rates are parton-level with backgrounds and efficiencies unmodeled, and the scalar case relies mainly on CLIC where coverage is weakest.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate signal and SM-background mono-photon events with MadGraph/WHIZARD plus Delphes using a CLIC detector card and an HL-LHC card, and build a binned missing-energy likelihood (e.g. via MadAnalysis or CheckMATE) covering the M_med = 3 TeV near-resonance benchmark scan.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation scalar doublet WIMP Case B
members.description: The collider constraint rests on the CMS 7 TeV 5 fb^-1 heavy-stable-charged-particle search only; no implemented recast covers electroweak scalar-doublet charged-state production with lifetime dependence, and Run 2/3 HSCP and long-lived-track searches are not applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement Drell-Yan production of the charged scalar doublet member in MadGraph and recast current ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV HSCP and disappearing-track searches (via existing long-lived-particle recast frameworks) as a function of (m_X, tau), updating the m_X > 210 GeV bound.

members.model_name: PAMELA-favored NMSSM neutralino with light pseudoscalar resonance
members.description: The correlated light-a1 collider prediction lacks an updated recast: post-2009 BaBar Upsilon -> gamma a1(-> mu mu) results and later LHC exotic-Higgs-decay searches are not incorporated beyond the NMHDECAY source-era constraint set.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the NMSSMTools/NMHDECAY constraint chain with the final BaBar radiative-Upsilon dimuon limits and LHC h -> a1 a1 -> 4mu search likelihoods, mapping them onto the sub-GeV M_a1 and Br(h1 -> a1 a1) plane of the benchmark corner.

members.model_name: E6SSM inert neutralino dark matter
members.description: The benchmark predicts more than 95 percent exotic SM-like Higgs branching to inert neutralinos, but no HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds or LHC invisible/exotic-decay recast has been applied, so present-day viability of the defining collider signature is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute BR(h -> chi chi) and soft-dilepton modes across the benchmark region and run HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds plus current ATLAS/CMS invisible-Higgs limits to map the surviving parameter space.

members.model_name: Next minimal Dirac dark matter model
members.description: The LEP H_LZZ light-Higgs bound and LHC Higgs-sector constraints on the 10-50 GeV mixed scalar are only qualitative on the card (likelihood_available: no), so there is no quantitative collider likelihood for the mixing parameter that the viable region depends on.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the light scalar's mixing-suppressed couplings in HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals, which include the digitized LEP H(Z -> Hll) limits for a 10-50 GeV scalar, and combine with current SM-like Higgs signal-strength fits to bound the mixing factor claimed at 0.980-0.990.

members.model_name: S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with softly split H2^0 inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No LHC Higgs invisible-width likelihood is applied; the card only records the quoted 5e-4 Scenario 2b branching value, so collider consistency of other parameter points cannot be tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate Br(h -> H2 H2) from the rebuilt model files and apply a public Higgs invisible-width likelihood (e.g. Lilith or HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds with current ATLAS/CMS invisible limits) for con_split_h2_higgs_width.

members.model_name: Accidental real singlet scalar dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No LHC Drell-Yan dilepton likelihood or recast exists for the Z_B-L mediator in this scale-invariant spectrum, so the dark-Higgs portal viability region (which the card says is pushed to few-TeV DM by the Z_B-L limit) cannot be re-derived with modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the latest ATLAS/CMS high-mass dilepton searches for the B-L gauge coupling and mass (e.g. with a ZPEED-style Z' dilepton likelihood adapted to B-L charges) and propagate the bound into the dark-Higgs portal relic region.

members.model_name: GeV-scale mixed sneutrino dark matter with Dirac neutrinos
members.description: No current Higgs-invisible-width likelihood is wired into the route: the theta constraint is applied only as a 10 percent branching-ratio inequality from source-era ATLAS searches, not as a likelihood over BR_h_inv usable in a global fit with modern (few-percent) limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Attach a Higgs-coupling likelihood via Lilith or HiggsTools (HiggsSignals) with current ATLAS/CMS invisible-width results, mapping (theta, A_nu, m_snu1, m_chi10) to BR_h_inv through the card's tree-level width formula.

members.model_name: Leptoquark-assisted right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Only 8 TeV first-generation leptoquark limits are quoted; no recast of current 13/14 TeV LHC leptoquark searches exists for the modified branching pattern where the leptoquark also decays to right-handed-neutrino channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the leptoquark model in MadGraph/Pythia and recast current ATLAS/CMS first-generation leptoquark pair-production searches (e.g. via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis) as a function of BR(S -> e j) versus BR(S -> N q).

members.model_name: Majorana fermion dark matter with 750 GeV quark-coupled pseudoscalar portal
members.description: The collider leg of the joint fit relies on the historical 750 GeV diphoton excess; no modern statistical recast of ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV diphoton, dijet, and invisible-width searches exists for the quark-produced spin-zero portal with its correlated partial widths (Gamma/M of order 10^-2).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the simplified q-qbar-coupled pseudoscalar mediator as a FeynRules/UFO model and recast current high-mass diphoton, dijet, and monojet/invisible-width searches with MadGraph plus a recasting framework (MadAnalysis5-PAD or CheckMATE), returning a likelihood over (M, Gamma/M, partial widths).

members.model_name: Vector-like lepton mediated heavy dark photon freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No detector-level recast or reusable likelihood exists for the compressed VLL to A_H plus soft-lepton signature; the collider constraint is only an approximate recast whose acceptance degrades rapidly as M_E - M_AH shrinks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum soft-lepton plus missing-energy analyses (slepton/electroweakino-style searches) in MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE with published efficiency maps, and produce exclusion curves as a function of M_E and the M_E - M_AH splitting for the VLL pair-production topology.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal real scalar dark matter with vector-like leptons
members.description: No dedicated collider recast exists for compressed vector-like leptons nearly degenerate with the invisible scalar: LEP and LHC bounds are borrowed from slepton-analogy arguments without a validated acceptance calculation for VLL production and soft decay products.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast ATLAS/CMS compressed-slepton soft-lepton plus MET searches for doublet/singlet VLL Drell-Yan production using CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with the gap_1 UFO model, mapping exclusions onto the (m_E1, Delta m) plane of the favored region.

members.model_name: Minimal light lepton portal dark matter
members.description: The Run-2 slepton-like and mono-Z+MET exclusions and HL-LHC projections exist only as the source's approximate recast; no validated reinterpretation of the public ATLAS/CMS analyses with model-specific branching fractions and flavor structure is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS slepton and mono-Z searches in a public recast framework (MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE) using events from the gap_1 model files, and reproduce the source exclusion contours before extending to other flavor structures.

members.model_name: Minimal light lepton portal dark matter
members.description: No dedicated LHC search or public likelihood exists for the distinctive same-sign charged-scalar production channel H+H+jj predicted by the large quartic couplings; only qualitative HL-LHC projections are given.
