members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing same-sign dilepton plus MET analyses onto the H+H+jj -> same-sign leptons plus chi chi topology and derive a phenomenological likelihood, proposing a dedicated HL-LHC analysis with the projected sensitivity.

members.model_name: Singlet-extended light lepton portal dark matter
members.description: The Higgs-invisible bound on the scalar mixing and the branching-fraction-dependent LHC electroweak scalar search limits exist only as source-level statements; no rerunnable likelihood (Higgs invisible width plus slepton-like, mono-Z, and same-sign search recasts with the singlet-modified branching fractions) is bundled with the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute BR(h->ss) and extra-scalar branching fractions from the model file, apply the Higgs-invisible constraint through Lilith or HiggsSignals, and recast the ATLAS/CMS Run-2 slepton-like, mono-Z, and same-sign analyses with MadAnalysis5 or CheckMATE for singlet-extension benchmarks.

members.model_name: Nonthermal wino dark matter in UV-insensitive anomaly-mediated NMSSM extension
members.description: No quantitative collider likelihood for the long-lived charged wino exists on the card: the disappearing-track observable is recorded as a recast route with likelihood_available unknown and no modern LHC efficiency map applied to this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track searches using published efficiency maps in a public recast framework (MadAnalysis 5 or CheckMATE LLP modules), with production cross sections and tau_chargino computed from the model's Delta m_wino near 165 MeV.

members.model_name: Neutral SU(2)_N vector-boson dark matter
members.description: No current LHC recast exists for the associated Z' = X_3, Z-Z' mixing, and enhanced Higgs-sector production; the collider allowed region rests on pre-LHC precision bounds (m_Z' > ~900 GeV, mixing < few x 1e-4).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS dilepton Z' searches and Higgs signal-strength/exotic-Higgs analyses onto the SU(2)_N parameter space using the gap_1 model implementation with a collider recast framework such as MadGraph plus CheckMATE or Contur.

members.model_name: S3 three-Higgs-doublet model with degenerate CP-even inert scalar dark matter
members.description: No current Higgs invisible-width likelihood is evaluated; Scenario 1a's quoted 34.8 percent invisible branching indicates collider constraints can be decisive, but the card carries no quantitative collider likelihood to apply.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute Br(h -> H2 H2, H3 H3) from the rebuilt model files and confront it with a public Higgs invisible-width likelihood (Lilith or HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds with current ATLAS/CMS limits) for con_degenerate_higgs_width.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1) radiative inverse-seesaw fermionic dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast exists for SM Higgs exotic decays into the model's GeV-scale hidden states (h -> HH, h -> Z'Z' with subsequent hidden/SM cascades); the paper provides no branching-ratio limit and the card records the collider observable as an implication only.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the exotic Higgs branching ratios from the model couplings and confront them with the global undetermined-BR fit and dedicated LHC exotic-decay searches via HiggsTools/HiggsBounds, adding a recast of light-resonance decay searches for 1-10 GeV Z' and scalar final states.

members.model_name: S3 schizophrenic-neutrino right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No modern LHC Z-prime likelihood has been recast for the B-L gauge boson of this model; the card quotes only the qualitative 2010-era statement that a TeV Z-prime is LHC-accessible.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS high-mass dilepton Z-prime search limits onto the B-L coupling-mass plane and package the exclusion curve as a likelihood usable alongside the relic scan.

members.model_name: U(1)' extra doublet neutral fermion cold dark matter
members.description: No collider recast exists for the Z' mediator and charged doublet partner: the card states no collider simulation was performed and likelihood_available is unknown for the collider constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a UFO model of the Z' plus extra doublet, generate dijet/monojet and charged-partner production in MadGraph+Pythia, and recast current LHC searches with CheckMATE or Contur.

members.model_name: pMSSM gravitino LSP model set
members.description: Collider coverage of the gravitino model set rests on private fast-simulation recasts of 7/8 TeV ATLAS analyses; the HSCP, displaced/late-decay, and other non-MET searches that dominate gravitino-LSP sensitivity lack public, up-to-date recast implementations.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the search set in public recast frameworks (CheckMATE/MadAnalysis with Delphes, plus dedicated long-lived-particle recast tools such as SModelS LLP or HSCP efficiency maps) and update from 7/8 TeV to current LHC analyses.

members.model_name: Kinetically mixed L_mu-L_tau Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No reproducible likelihood or recast code exists for the combined flavor/collider constraint set (neutrino trident, B_s mixing, b -> s mu mu band, and epsilon-dependent LHC dilepton limits); the primary's overlay is a hand-combined summary the card marks as only partially available.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the flavor side with flavio/smelli (trident, B_s mixing, b -> s mu mu global fit for the L_mu-L_tau Wilson coefficients) and recast LHC dilepton searches with a public recast tool as a function of (m_Zprime, g_l, epsilon), then combine into one likelihood module for the joint scan.

members.model_name: Extra U(1)_X right-handed Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: The ATLAS extra-gauge-boson constraint on (M_X, g_X) is available only as source-paper contours, not as a reusable likelihood or digitized limit data, so the collider compression of the dark-matter window cannot be re-evaluated for other charge assignments or branching structures.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the ATLAS dilepton Z-prime cross-section limits and implement the U(1)_X mediator recast in a dedicated Z-prime limit tool (ZPEED-style) or via MadGraph plus a recasting framework, publishing the resulting (M_X, g_X) likelihood grid.

members.model_name: R-parity-conserving minimal SUSY U(1)_X gaugino-singlet neutralino dark matter
members.description: No reusable LHC dilepton recast or likelihood exists for the U(1)_X Z-prime with general x_H charge assignments and a model-dependent invisible width into neutralinos and right-handed neutrinos; the source only reads off published narrow-resonance bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma(pp -> Z') x BR(ll) with MadGraph for the x_H-parameterized charges and model branching ratios, and package the ATLAS 139/fb and CMS 140/fb dilepton limit tables as an interpolated likelihood over (m_Zprime, alpha_gX, x_H).

members.model_name: Conversion-driven t-channel mediator dark matter
members.description: No public recasting workflow with validated efficiencies exists for the LHC LLP signatures of this model (HSCP, disappearing-track, displaced-vertex, missing-energy) in the soft-decay-product regime with an approximately 44 percent charged R-hadron fraction; the source recast is paper-internal and likelihood_available is only partial.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the colored-mediator pair production plus R-hadronization pipeline in MadGraph+Pythia and add the relevant ATLAS/CMS HSCP, disappearing-track, DV, and MET analyses (with soft-track efficiency maps) to an LLP recasting framework such as SModelS-LLP, CheckMATE, or MadAnalysis5, releasing the efficiency tables for small Delta m.

members.model_name: Type-II 2HDMS with pseudoscalar singlet dark matter
members.description: No implemented collider recast exists for the invisible/MET signatures: the HL-LHC monojet and 2j+MET reach statement is a cut-and-count estimate for one representative benchmark with no simulation run and no reusable likelihood (con_2hdms_hllhc_met is recast_required).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate MadGraph monojet and 2j+MET samples for the 2HDMS benchmark grid and recast existing ATLAS/CMS MET analyses with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, producing a parameter-space exclusion/projection likelihood instead of a single-point estimate.

members.model_name: Type-II 2HDM with real singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No dedicated collider recast exists for the Type-II 2HDM+S invisible/MET signatures; the card's collider constraint is only qualitative, drawn from related Higgs-portal studies, and states that exact exclusions require a dedicated recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate 2HDM+S signal events with MadGraph using the gap_1 model files and recast LHC mono-X, invisible-Higgs, and heavy-Higgs-to-invisible searches with CheckMATE or Contur to produce exclusion contours in (m_DM, lambda_S1, lambda_S2, tan_beta).

members.model_name: Type-X 2HDM with real singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No dedicated collider recast exists for the Type-X 2HDM+S invisible/MET signatures; the card's collider constraint is only qualitative, drawn from related Higgs-portal studies, and states that exact exclusions require a dedicated recast, with the lepton-specific Type-X structure changing the relevant search channels (e.g. tau-rich final states).
members.proposed_resolution: Generate 2HDM+S signal events with MadGraph using the gap_1 model files and recast LHC mono-X, invisible-Higgs, and tau-enriched heavy-scalar searches with CheckMATE or Contur to produce exclusion contours in (m_DM, lambda_S1, lambda_S2, tan_beta).

members.model_name: Minimal non-SUSY SO(10) scalar 16 dark matter
members.description: No detector-level collider recast exists for the long-lived inert charged scalar: the displaced-vertex-plus-missing-energy signature in the small-mixing, small-mass-gap regime has no efficiency map or likelihood, and the card's collider constraint is a discovery-oriented target rather than an exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate charged-scalar pair and associated production with MadGraph using the gap_1 model files, decay with the lifetime set by (Delta M, s), and recast against ATLAS/CMS displaced-vertex and disappearing-track long-lived-particle searches using an LLP-capable framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 with published efficiency maps.

members.model_name: Light gravitino dark matter scenarios
members.description: LHC constraints on gravitino-LSP spectra are only partially usable: prompt-photon, delayed/non-pointing photon, kinked-track, and metastable charged-particle searches require model-specific recasting per NLSP identity, and no ready likelihood covers the compressed or detector-stable NLSP cases flagged in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement recasts of the relevant ATLAS/CMS displaced-photon and heavy-stable-charged-particle searches in a public LLP recasting framework (e.g. CheckMATE or MadAnalysis with long-lived-particle efficiency maps), parameterized by m_NLSP, c*tau_NLSP, and NLSP identity (neutralino vs stau).

members.model_name: Two-singlet light cold dark matter model
members.description: No Higgs invisible-width or LHC signal-strength recast exists for this pre-Higgs-discovery model, even though the S_1-Higgs mixing and the open h -> S_0 S_0 channel for m_0 below m_h/2 make these among the strongest constraints on the light-mass region.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the invisible and exotic Higgs decay widths and the mixing-angle suppression of signal strengths in the rotated (h, S_1) basis, then apply current ATLAS/CMS invisible-branching-ratio and coupling-fit limits (e.g. via Lilith or HiggsTools) to the scan.

members.model_name: U(1)' right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No detector-level recast or likelihood exists for the LFV multilepton plus missing-energy and displaced-sneutrino LHC signatures (likelihood_available: no, applies: recast_required); no numeric exclusion has been extracted for the benchmark cascades.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast pipeline: generate benchmark cascade events with the gap_1 model files in MadGraph/CalcHEP + PYTHIA, then apply existing LHC multilepton and displaced-vertex search selections through CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5 recast cards with Delphes-level detector efficiencies.

members.model_name: Accidental complex scalar Z3 dark matter in scale-invariant local B-L
members.description: No packaged recast of current LHC Z_B-L dilepton-resonance limits and the Higgs-invisible-width bound onto this model's (m_ZBL, m_S, lambda_h, lambda_sphi) parameter space exists; the card records only the 2015 qualitative tension statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Map current ATLAS/CMS dilepton Z' cross-section limits onto the B-L coupling-mass plane and compute the analytic invisible Higgs branching ratio for lambda_h, packaging both as bounds over the card's input parameters.

members.model_name: Real scalar dark matter with 750 GeV gluon portal mediator
members.description: The collider observable rests on the historical 750 GeV excess; no modern statistical recast of 13 TeV diphoton and dijet searches exists for the gluon-fusion-produced spin-zero portal, whose gluon-dominated total width is precisely the regime the card notes is squeezed by dijet limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the gluon-coupled scalar mediator plus real-scalar DM as a FeynRules/UFO model and recast current high-mass diphoton and dijet resonance searches (MadGraph with MadAnalysis5-PAD or CheckMATE), producing a joint likelihood over (M, Gamma/M, g_g, g_phi).

members.model_name: Real scalar dark matter with 750 GeV quark-coupled portal mediator
members.description: No current collider likelihood exists for the 750 GeV quark-coupled portal: the diphoton input is the historical excess and the dijet constraint is a Run-1 quote, so the width/branching-ratio consistency condition (Gamma/M down to O(10^-3)) has never been recast against full Run-2 data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast full Run-2 ATLAS/CMS high-mass diphoton and dijet resonance searches for a 750 GeV q qbar-produced spin-zero mediator (e.g. generate signal with MadGraph and apply published limits or a CheckMATE-style recast), replacing the historical-excess input with proper upper-limit likelihoods on the partial widths.

members.model_name: Feebly coupled leptophilic Majorana dark matter
members.description: Only an approximate recast of CMS/ATLAS long-lived charged-particle and disappearing-track searches exists for this charged-scalar mediator: detector-efficiency maps and a reusable likelihood for slepton-like LLPs in the compressed (Delta m ~ 2 GeV) regime with soft leptons are not available (likelihood_available: approximate, likelihood_reference null).
members.proposed_resolution: Add the relevant heavy-stable-charged-particle and disappearing-track efficiency maps to SModelS or the LLP Recasting Repository for a singly charged scalar decaying to chi plus a soft lepton, parameterized in (m_phi, Delta m, c tau), and publish the resulting acceptance-times-efficiency likelihood.

members.model_name: Charge-radius photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public statistical likelihood or recast module exists for the intensity-frontier (FASER/beam-dump displaced-decay and electron-scattering) signatures of the charge-radius iDM model; only projection-level sensitivity curves from the author code are available, so parameter-space exclusions cannot be combined with other constraints in a global fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Looking_forward_to_photon_coupled_LLPs event-yield output in a Poisson counting likelihood with published detector acceptances and backgrounds (e.g. as a FASER recast module in a framework like HEPLikelihoods or GAMBIT ColliderBit), operator-by-operator to keep the AM/CR coupling dimension distinct.

members.model_name: Electric-dipole photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public statistical likelihood or recast module exists for the intensity-frontier (FASER/beam-dump displaced-decay and electron-scattering) signatures of the electric-dipole iDM model; only projection-level sensitivity curves from the author code are available, so parameter-space exclusions cannot be combined with other constraints in a global fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Looking_forward_to_photon_coupled_LLPs event-yield output in a Poisson counting likelihood with published detector acceptances and backgrounds (e.g. as a FASER recast module in a framework like GAMBIT ColliderBit), keeping the EDM two-body chi_1 -> chi_0 gamma decay mode distinct from the CR/AM three-body mode.

members.model_name: Magnetic-dipole photon-coupled inelastic dark matter
members.description: No public statistical likelihood or recast module exists for the intensity-frontier (FASER/beam-dump displaced-decay and electron-scattering) signatures of the magnetic-dipole iDM model; only projection-level sensitivity curves from the author code are available, so parameter-space exclusions cannot be combined with other constraints in a global fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Looking_forward_to_photon_coupled_LLPs event-yield output in a Poisson counting likelihood with published detector acceptances and backgrounds (e.g. as a FASER recast module in a framework like GAMBIT ColliderBit), keeping the MDM two-body chi_1 -> chi_0 gamma decay mode distinct from the CR/AM three-body mode.

members.model_name: Bino-higgsino-tempered singlino NMSSM dark matter
members.description: No public recast implementation exists for the ATLAS photon-rich electroweakino searches (soft photons from compressed chi_i -> gamma chi_1 decays with multilepton or b-jet objects), so LHC/HL-LHC exclusions on the singlino-bino coannihilation spectra cannot be evaluated numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS photon electroweakino analysis in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with validated Delphes photon thresholds for the compressed regime, and validate against the overlap regions quoted in the paper's figures.

members.model_name: Fermionic Higgs-portal dark matter with singlet-scalar inflation
members.description: The EWPT and LHC heavy-scalar mixing limits on (theta, m_s) are taken from the paper's 2015-era recast; no current combined collider likelihood for the mixed-singlet scalar is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply HiggsTools (HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals) plus an updated oblique-parameter fit to the (theta, m_s) plane and export the allowed-region flag or likelihood used by the combined scan.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw GMSB gravitino dark matter with L H_u inflation
members.description: The card notes modern long-lived-particle collider limits were not recast: the heavy-stable-charged-particle exclusion for a 1 TeV stau with 10 s lifetime is quoted from an old CMS search, with no current LHC Run 2/3 recast or reusable likelihood attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS full-Run-2 heavy-stable-charged-particle searches for the benchmark stau mass and lifetime using SModelS long-lived-particle results or a CheckMATE implementation of the HSCP analyses.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation WIMP Case A
members.description: The collider constraint rests on the CMS 7 TeV 5 fb^-1 heavy-stable-charged-particle search only; no implemented recast covers scalar charged-excitation production with the lifetime dependence of the track signature, and Run 2/3 HSCP searches are not applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the charged scalar pair-production model in MadGraph and recast current ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV HSCP and disappearing/long-lived track searches (e.g., via existing long-lived-particle recast frameworks) as a function of (m_X, tau), replacing the 2012 CMS bound.

members.model_name: CMSSM Q-ball bino co-genesis dark matter
members.description: No reproducible collider likelihood for the co-genesis parameter plane: only the 2014 ATLAS 8 TeV, 20 fb^-1 jets+MET contour is reproduced at paper level, with no analysis implementation packaged and no update to current 13 TeV ATLAS/CMS searches, so the surviving blue co-genesis region cannot be delineated against present data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the co-genesis CMSSM scan through a public recast framework (CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with implemented ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV jets plus missing-ET searches), feeding SOFTSUSY spectra and standard cross-section tools, to produce an updated exclusion likelihood on the (m_0, M_1/2) plane.

members.model_name: Baryonic-vector scalar light dark matter benchmark
members.description: No public detector likelihood or background model exists for hadronic (NC pi0-like) dark-matter scattering searches at MiniBooNE, T2K, or SHiP, so BdNMC event distributions cannot be turned into statistically meaningful exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recasting likelihood from the published MiniBooNE dark-matter-run and T2K neutral-current pi0 data releases (efficiencies, backgrounds, binned counts) and package it as a module that consumes BdNMC event distributions.

members.model_name: Inelastic third-generation B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No recastable LHC ditau constraint exists for the (B-L)_3 mediator: the card carries only the primary paper's statement that the benchmark is consistent with current searches, with no production-cross-section times branching-ratio recast in the (m_Z_prime, g_(B-L)_3) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published ATLAS/CMS heavy-resonance ditau searches for a Z-prime with third-generation B-L couplings (b-quark-initiated production) into a tabulated exclusion contour in (m_Z_prime, g_(B-L)_3), stored as a registry data product alongside the analytic R_tau bound.

members.model_name: Light two-Higgs-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: No laboratory recast maps existing muon-philic light-scalar searches (muon g-2, beam dumps, B-factory and meson-decay searches) onto this model's (m_H, Y_l, mixing angle) parameter space to test whether the couplings needed for the relic target survive.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published muon-coupled light-scalar limits (g-2 preferred regions, NA64-mu type projections, meson and collider bounds) into a likelihood over the light-scalar mass and Y_l, joined with the relic-scan output.

members.model_name: 750 GeV complex-scalar portal Majorana WIMP
members.description: Collider constraints are anchored to the historical 750 GeV diphoton-excess context with only approximate likelihoods; no recast of the monojet/dijet/diphoton (including s -> aa -> collimated 4 gamma) signatures against current Run-2/Run-3 LHC searches exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the scalar-resonance production and monojet/dijet/diphoton topologies with MadGraph plus CheckMATE/MadAnalysis against current ATLAS/CMS search likelihoods, replacing the 2016 excess-era cuts.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic dark QED with dark muonium
members.description: No public event-level likelihood or validated recast exists for the low-missing-energy multi-lepton-jet final state from prompt darkonium decays; the y_X versus m_Aprime reach is available only as figure-level limits from the paper's own recast of LHC lepton-jet searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS prompt lepton-jet and exotic-Higgs-decay analyses as Rivet or CheckMATE recast cards validated against the published limits, and release the resulting likelihood over (y_X, m_Aprime, alpha_D, epsilon) for prompt A_prime decays.

members.model_name: Zee-Babu Z2 real scalar dark matter
members.description: No current Higgs signal-strength likelihood is implemented for the charged-scalar loop shift in H -> gamma gamma (the card notes a current fit is outside the batch and paper-era inputs are used).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the charged-scalar loop amplitudes into a public Higgs signal-strength fitting tool (HiggsSignals or Lilith) with current LHC Run 2/3 data to constrain lambda_Hh, lambda_Hk, m_h+, m_k++.

members.model_name: U(1)_X-charged Z2-odd scalar dark matter in a lepton-specific two-Higgs-doublet model
members.description: No recast pipeline or likelihood exists for the LHC t-tbar resonance constraint on the leptophobic Z-prime in this model; the card records only a qualitative source comparison with likelihood_available 'partial' and recasting_needed 'yes'.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the ATLAS/CMS t-tbar resonance cross-section limits used by the source, compute sigma(pp -> Z' -> t tbar) over the (M_Zprime, g_X) plane with MadGraph using the rebuilt model files, and package the comparison as a reusable mask/likelihood.

members.model_name: pMSSM neutralino LSP model set
members.description: The collider filter on the neutralino pMSSM model set is a private fast-simulation recast of early 7/8 TeV ATLAS MET and non-MET analyses with no per-point public likelihood, so present-day exclusion statements over the model set cannot be reproduced or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the collider stage on public recast tooling (MadGraph plus Delphes with CheckMATE/MadAnalysis analysis implementations, complemented by SModelS simplified-model limits) using current LHC analyses, and publish per-point coverage likelihoods for the model set.

members.model_name: Zprime-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The collider constraint rests on a source-era 8 TeV monophoton recast; no validated 13/14 TeV monophoton-plus-MET recast with detector acceptance exists for the Chern-Simons Zprime mediator, which the card flags as the leading constraint channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate monophoton-plus-MET events for the Zprime model with MadGraph using the gap_1 model files and recast current ATLAS/CMS Run 2 monophoton analyses in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, including a validity check of the effective Chern-Simons operators at collider energies.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile neutrino dark matter with active-neutrino self-interactions
members.description: No implemented likelihood exists for the constraint overlay: X-ray line searches, BBN mediator bounds, and kaon-decay/DUNE laboratory limits are only compiled as figure regions from the paper, with likelihood_available set to no for both constraint entries.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a composite likelihood: published X-ray line flux limits mapped to sin^2(2theta) vs m4 via the standard radiative decay rate, an N_eff/BBN term for the few-MeV scalar coupled to neutrinos (e.g. computed with a BBN code including the phi thermal population), and digitized K+ -> mu + nu phi limits, exposed over (m4, theta, m_phi, lambda_phi).

members.model_name: Flavor-blind Z-prime mediated complex scalar MeV dark matter
members.description: No BBN light-element likelihood is implemented for this specific benchmark: the card's BBN/CMB constraint applies to broader light-WIMP classes and explicitly requires branch-by-branch recasting to the flavor-blind Z-prime scalar, which has not been done.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the solver output (time-dependent T_gamma/T_nu and expansion history) to a public BBN code such as PRIMAT, PArthENoPE, or AlterBBN to compute helium and deuterium yields and build a light-element likelihood for the benchmark's branching ratios.

members.model_name: Bose-Einstein-condensed scalar field dark matter
members.description: There is no current-data likelihood for the SFDM expansion-history constraint: the quoted bounds on m and lambda/(mc^2)^2 derive from 2013-era BBN abundances and CMB equality values, and the card flags that recasting is needed before the allowed region can be trusted.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the gap_1 background solver to current Planck CMB and PRIMAT/PArthENoPE-style BBN likelihoods in Cobaya, sampling (m, lambda/(mc^2)^2) directly so the N_eff(t) and z_eq shifts are constrained by modern data rather than the historical 68% regions.

members.model_name: Neutrino-interacting asymmetric dark matter with a charged mediator
members.description: The laboratory/astrophysical portal constraints (heavy-neutral-lepton searches, active-sterile mixing, BBN/CMB N_eff for the MeV-scale sector) have only a partial, flavor-averaged treatment; the card notes a precision bound needs flavor-specific mixing and decay tables and no combined likelihood is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a combined constraint module from public heavy-neutral-lepton limit compilations and BBN/CMB N_eff bounds for MeV-scale sectors, computing the model's flavor-dependent U_i4 mixing pattern and mostly invisible heavy-neutrino branching ratios so laboratory limits are applied to the correct visible fraction.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter with Chern-Simons photon-current coupling
members.description: No CMB birefringence likelihood is wrapped for the model: the Planck PR4 alpha measurement is used only as a quoted target band, with no machine-usable posterior connecting (M_chi, M, asymmetry) to the measured rotation angle.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the published Planck PR4 isotropic birefringence measurement (0.30 +/- 0.11 deg, foreground-improved 0.36 +/- 0.11 deg) as a Gaussian likelihood on alpha and chain it to the analytic alpha(M_chi, M, asymmetry) formula from step s1.

members.model_name: Millicharged co-interacting dark photon dark matter
members.description: The CMB spectral-distortion constraint is applied as phenomenological |y| and |mu| bounds with likelihood_available 'no'; there is no computation of the distortion Green's-function response to the redshift-dependent photon injection from A'-chi-enhanced conversion in this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's conversion-driven energy-injection history in a spectral-distortion Green's-function code (e.g. extend CosmoTherm or the SZpack/Green's-function distortion machinery) and wrap COBE/FIRAS mu and y limits as a likelihood over (m_A', epsilon, f_chi, g_d).

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal Dirac-fermion dark matter
members.description: No quantitative CMB/BBN energy-injection likelihood exists for the late NLSP decays with neutrino-rich final states; the paper's constraints are plot-level and the card notes the numerical likelihood was not reconstructed.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the NLSP decay spectra through ACROPOLIS for BBN and ExoCLASS/DarkAges deposition functions for CMB, adding a neutrino-injection branch, and package the result as a tau_NLSP-m_NLSP likelihood.

members.model_name: THDM sterile-neutrino-portal scalar-singlet dark matter
members.description: No quantitative CMB/BBN energy-injection likelihood exists for late NLSP decays with neutrino-rich final states; the card records only plot-level constraints and notes the numerical likelihood was not reconstructed.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the NLSP decay spectra through ACROPOLIS for BBN and ExoCLASS/DarkAges deposition functions for CMB, including a neutrino-injection branch, delivering a reusable tau_NLSP-m_NLSP likelihood surface.

members.model_name: Light thermal pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: The sub-10-MeV BBN/Neff bound is only quoted from the literature; no dedicated light-dark-sector BBN/Neff recast exists for this model's thermal history, and the card warns sub-10-MeV targets should not be used without one.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a dedicated light-sector cosmology calculation with a public BBN/Neff code (e.g. AlterBBN/PRIMAT combined with a dark-sector temperature-evolution solver) including the pseudo-Dirac states and dark photon in the thermal bath, to derive the model-specific low-mass floor.

members.model_name: Visible sterile-neutrino dark matter in scalar-tensor pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public numeric likelihoods exist for the constraint set used by the model: the BBN N_eff < 3.4 bound, X-ray/pre-recombination photon-injection decay limits, and TRISTAN/HUNTER/PTOLEMY/KATRIN sensitivity curves are all figure-level inputs that must be digitized to test the scalar-tensor parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published BBN, X-ray, and laboratory-reach contours in the (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) plane and package them as a joint likelihood module that consumes the scalar-tensor abundance rescaling, reusing existing X-ray line-search flux limits where available.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with dark-photon late-time magnetogenesis
members.description: No packaged likelihoods exist for the photon-mixing constraints: the X-ray bound on g_AA/f and the CMB spectral-distortion bound on g_AX/f in the presence of the predicted B_X background are applied as single quoted numbers, not as recastable likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a photon-ALP-dark-photon mixing recast that propagates the model's B_X background through the COBE/FIRAS spectral-distortion likelihood and existing astrophysical X-ray ALP-conversion datasets, producing exclusion contours in (g_AA/f, g_AX/f, B_X).

members.model_name: Type I seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection likelihood has been recast for a 16 keV S decaying to nu + gamma: the tau_S > 1e25 s requirement is quoted from a related source without computing the energy-deposition efficiency for ~8 keV photon injection, so the critical lifetime constraint is a pass/fail proxy rather than an evaluated likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the DarkAges/ExoCLASS energy-deposition tables to soft keV photon injection from S -> nu gamma, couple to the Planck decaying-DM likelihood to obtain tau_S(m_S) bounds, and complement with X-ray line-search limits (e.g. blank-sky XMM/NuSTAR recasts) at E_gamma ~ m_S/2.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational dark matter from curvature-perturbation PBHs
members.description: No likelihood or public sensitivity module exists for the MHz-GHz stochastic induced-GW signal, since detectors in this band are only proposed; the route ends at a spectrum with nothing to compare against quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published projected sensitivity curves of proposed high-frequency GW detectors (levitated sensors, bulk acoustic wave, Gertsenshtein-conversion searches) into a reusable power-law-integrated sensitivity/likelihood module for Omega_GW(f) in the MHz-GHz band.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal Dirac-fermion freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The stellar-cooling, CMB energy-injection, and lab (sigma_e) constraints exist only as figure-level exclusion curves; no packaged likelihoods are recorded for any of the three constraints, preventing statistically combined scans of the (epsilon, alpha_D, m_chi, m_Aprime) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the digitized stellar bound, the Planck p_ann annihilation likelihood mapped through the model's late-time <sigma v>, and published sigma_e limits (XENON, SENSEI, DAMIC, accelerator recasts) as interpolable likelihood surfaces keyed to the route's derived quantities.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal complex-scalar freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The stellar-cooling, CMB energy-injection, and lab (sigma_e) constraints exist only as figure-level exclusion curves; no packaged likelihoods are recorded for any of the three constraints, preventing statistically combined scans of the (epsilon, alpha_D, m_phi, m_Aprime) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the digitized stellar bound, the Planck p_ann annihilation likelihood mapped through the scalar's velocity-suppressed late-time <sigma v>, and published sigma_e limits (XENON, SENSEI, DAMIC, accelerator recasts) as interpolable likelihood surfaces keyed to the route's derived quantities.

members.model_name: Axion Quark Nugget dark matter with magnetar-triggered FRB scenario
members.description: No FRB population likelihood exists for the AQN trigger hypothesis: the model is compared to FRB energies, durations, frequencies, and the energy-distribution slope only by qualitative consistency, without an impact-rate-based population model or catalog selection effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the AQN impact rate (from B, rho_DM, magnetar population synthesis) into a public FRB population framework such as frbpoppy, forward-model the predicted energy/duration/rate distributions with CHIME/FRB selection functions, and release the resulting catalog likelihood over (B, trigger efficiency).

members.model_name: Type III seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: No CMB energy-injection likelihood has been recast for a 1 keV S decaying to nu + gamma: the tau_S > 1e25 s requirement is quoted from a related source without computing the energy-deposition efficiency for ~0.5 keV photon injection, so the critical lifetime constraint is a pass/fail proxy rather than an evaluated likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the DarkAges/ExoCLASS energy-deposition tables to sub-keV photon injection from S -> nu gamma, couple to the Planck decaying-DM likelihood to obtain tau_S(m_S) bounds, and complement with soft-X-ray line-search recasts at E_gamma ~ m_S/2.

members.model_name: Forbidden leptophilic Dirac-fermion dark matter with scalar mediator
members.description: No implemented likelihoods exist for the future probes that test the surviving parameter space: CMB-S4 annihilation sensitivity, next-generation beam-dump reach, and high-luminosity e+e- collider limits on the leptophilic scalar mediator are quoted projections without recast pipelines.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the CMB-S4 p_ann forecast, published beam-dump projection curves, and e+e- mediator-production sensitivities as likelihood modules over (m_chi, m_phi, delta, alpha_ll_S, alpha_chi_S), interpolating the digitized curves and folding in the temperature-suppressed forbidden annihilation rate for the CMB channel.

members.model_name: Stable scalar mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihood or recast module exists for the CMB, BBN, supernova-cooling, and beam-dump constraints on the visibly-decaying dark Higgs h2 in the (m_h2, sin theta, tau_h2) plane, on which the model's cosmological viability hinges.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published light-scalar bounds (BBN energy-injection, Planck CMB, SN1987A cooling, beam-dump exclusions) into a constraint module keyed to (m_h2, mixing, lifetime), and combine with DDCalc-style direct-detection limits for the joint allowed-region evaluation.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay Dirac fermion plus photon dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood or detector-acceptance recast exists for a monochromatic 0.782-1.664 MeV photon from n -> chi gamma in beam or ultracold-neutron experiments; existing radiative-decay and visible-branch searches were not designed for this exact final state and their efficiencies have not been mapped onto (m_chi, Br_dark).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published UCN and beam neutron-decay photon spectra (e.g. the UCNtau-style radiative search data cited via arxiv:1905.01912-era analyses) into an efficiency-corrected limit on Br(n -> chi gamma) as a function of E_gamma across the 0.782-1.664 MeV window, and release it as a tabulated likelihood.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac Higgs-portal dark matter with excited-state decay
members.description: The Delta N_eff signature has no forecast likelihood: the CMB-S4 constraint entry is 'recast_required' with likelihood_available 'unknown', and since the predicted shift (1e-4) is far below CMB-S4's ~0.03 sensitivity, no existing pipeline can quantify what future experiment or combination would test this signature.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Fisher/MCMC forecast module (e.g. in MontePython or cobaya with CMB-S4 and post-S4 noise specifications) that maps (tau_chi1, Delta m, branching) to a Delta N_eff posterior, establishing the exposure needed to reach the 1e-4 level and providing the missing forecast likelihood for this channel.

members.model_name: Vector SIMP dark matter in SU_X(2) x U(1)_Z' gauge model
members.description: All constraints on this model are event-count exclusion contours or qualitative CMB/IGM comparisons; no machine-readable likelihood exists for the beam-dump limits, the LDMX projection, or the p-wave energy-injection bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the 90% C.L. LSND/MiniBooNE/NA64 contours and the LDMX projection into interpolated likelihood functions, and recast Planck/IGM-temperature energy-injection limits to the model's p-wave thermally averaged cross section, releasing them as a small likelihood package.

members.model_name: Low-reheat Standard Model neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The BBN constraint on MeV-scale reheating with a keV active-neutrino dark-matter component is not available as a runnable likelihood (con_low_reheat_bbn: likelihood_available no, recasting_needed yes); the paper's BBN compatibility statement rests on older cosmological inputs and has not been rerun with modern light-element data.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the low-reheat neutrino thermalization solution to a modern BBN code (PRIMAT or PArthENoPE) with current D/H and He-4 measurements, and release the resulting T_RH-m_nu likelihood following the methodology of the Planck-era reheating-floor analyses.

members.model_name: Warm dark matter from long-lived Majorana fermion decays
members.description: The dark-radiation branch is constrained only by the source-era Planck N_eff value (3.36 +/- 0.34); no current CMB/BBN likelihood for a late-decaying parent injecting nonthermal neutrinos and dark radiation has been applied, so the N_eff and BBN limits on tau2 and M1/M2 are outdated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute Delta N_eff(tau2, M1/M2) from the decay energy budget and evaluate it against the current Planck (plus BBN abundance) likelihoods for extra radiation and late electromagnetic/neutrino injection, updating the source-era bound.

members.model_name: Scalar-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No numerical BBN/CMB spectral-distortion likelihood is attached for the photon emitted in S -> B_mu + photon; the lifetime cap tau_X < 1e4 s and energy-release bounds are taken conceptually and graphically from the paper (likelihood_available: approximate/no).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the electromagnetic-injection constraint with a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with photodisintegration) plus COBE/FIRAS mu- and y-distortion Green's-function limits, parameterized by (tau_X, zeta), and expose it as a likelihood over the model's lifetime-energy plane.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter with a stable vector mediator
members.description: No CMB energy-injection recast exists for this model's two-species annihilation (psi psi -> Z_D h_D plus residual Z_D Z_D -> h_D h_D) where visible energy arrives only after dark-Higgs decay; the required f_eff depends on species abundances, h_D visible branching, and recombination-era Sommerfeld enhancement.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute channel-weighted f_eff(z) with DarkHistory (or ExoCLASS) using h_D decay spectra for each mass point, include the Sommerfeld factor at recombination velocities, and compare to the Planck p_ann constraint to produce excluded regions in the mass-coupling plane.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV U(1)_T3R Majorana dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast pipeline exists for the combined sub-GeV direct-detection bounds (XENON1T boosted-DM, CRESST-III, CDEX-1B) and Planck energy-injection constraint applied to this model's inelastic/isospin-violating two-mediator scattering and channel-dependent annihilation (likelihood_available: no on all cosmological/direct-detection constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module: compute sigma_SI with the scalar/vector mediator form factors, interface to published XENON1T/CRESST-III/CDEX-1B efficiency curves, and couple the annihilation-channel classification (p-wave, co-annihilation, invisible) to ExoCLASS/DarkHistory f_eff tables for the Planck injection bound.

members.model_name: Light-right-handed-neutrino lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter (freeze-out)
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood or digitized exclusion contours exist for combining Y_B, Omega_a h^2, and Delta N_eff in this model's (f_a, m_S, m_N, y_N) space; the dark-radiation constraint comparison is only a quoted Delta N_eff > 0.17 label and the baryon-yield underproduction region was not digitized.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the primary paper's allowed/excluded contours and wrap the standard Planck+BBN Delta N_eff likelihood (and CMB-S4 forecast at sigma(Delta N_eff) ~ 0.06) into a scan-ready likelihood over (f_a, m_a, m_S, m_N, y_N, Y_theta).

members.model_name: Z4 late-decaying dark matter
members.description: Visible-decay flux limits for the near-degenerate splitting regime (delta_m near 2 m_e, very soft e+e- or neutrino-only final states) exist only as un-digitized figure contours in the source literature; the card records likelihood_available: partial and un-recast exclusion regions for the charged-lepton decay channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and recast the soft-lepton and neutrino decay-flux constraints (Galactic and extragalactic, plus CMB energy-injection limits for the e+e- branch) into a lifetime-vs-branching likelihood keyed to (delta_m, tau_chi_star, branching fractions).

members.model_name: ALP catastrogenesis dark matter
members.description: The final constraints step uses approximate CMB GW limits, astrometry forecasts, and abundance cuts as hard boundaries; no composed likelihood exists that evaluates a (m_a, V, N, epsilon_b, T_ann) point against the very-low-frequency GW data and the f_ALP <= 1 and T_ann > 5 eV consistency requirements.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint likelihood combining published CMB B-mode/temperature bounds on Omega_GW at ultra-low frequencies, Gaia/Roman astrometry GW sensitivity curves, and the ALP abundance target, wrapped so that the semi-analytic Omega_GW(f) and Omega_a predictions can be scanned with a standard sampler.

members.model_name: Gauged global string QCD axion model
members.description: CMB angular-power constraints on string tension have not been recast for this model's mixed Y-junction network of global, heavy-core, and gauge strings; the primary paper invokes G_mu bounds only qualitatively, so no quantitative allowed region in (v_1, v_2, e) exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the simulated network's string abundance and effective tension spectrum onto the unconnected-segment-model templates used in Planck string analyses and rerun the CMB likelihood to derive quantitative G_mu limits for the hybrid network.

members.model_name: Left-right mirror symmetric sterile Dirac fermion CDM
members.description: The domain-wall CMB safety check rests on an order-of-magnitude Delta T/T scaling with no domain-wall network simulation or CMB anisotropy likelihood for dark Z2M breaking at v_0 ~ 0.1 MeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a scaling-regime domain-wall network simulation (or apply published wall-network CMB constraints such as Zeldovich-type bounds recomputed for this wall tension) to replace the order-of-magnitude estimate with a quantitative Planck-based bound on v_0.

members.model_name: Two-component asymmetric dark matter via bound states and freeze-in decay
members.description: No BBN/CMB energy-injection likelihood exists for late bound-state decays into boosted light dark matter with associated visible entropy injection near the BBN epoch; the card flags the timing but implements no likelihood (con_late_decay_bbn_injection has likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast that maps Gamma_B, T_decay, and visible branching assumptions onto existing BBN codes (AlterBBN/PArthENoPE) and CMB energy-injection machinery (ExoCLASS/DarkHistory), producing exclusion contours in the (Gamma_B, m_heavy/m_light, coupling) space.

members.model_name: Bino-to-gravitino non-thermal dark radiation model
members.description: No numerical BBN/CMB spectral-distortion likelihood is attached for the photon injected in the bino-to-gravitino decay; the lifetime cap tau_B < 1e4 s and energy-release bounds are taken conceptually and graphically from the paper (likelihood_available: approximate/no).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the electromagnetic-injection constraint with a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with photodisintegration) plus COBE/FIRAS mu- and y-distortion Green's-function limits, parameterized by (tau_B, zeta), and expose it as a likelihood over the model's lifetime-energy plane.

members.model_name: CMSSM LD 5+5 vector-like extension with neutralino dark matter
members.description: The global likelihood is not reusable: the source MultiNest scan combined a now-outdated LUX hard cut, source-era flavor/Higgs data, and pre-2021 muon g-2 inputs into a private likelihood, so surviving regions cannot be re-evaluated against modern LZ/XENONnT/PandaX direct detection or the current a_mu value.
members.proposed_resolution: Reassemble the global likelihood from public components — DDCalc-style LZ/XENONnT SI likelihoods replacing the LUX hard cut, current HiggsSignals/HiggsBounds datasets, FlavorKit observables, Planck Omega h^2, and the updated muon g-2 world average — and rerun the scan with MultiNest or a modern sampler over the CMSSM+LD parameters.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-inflaton scalar dark matter from dark-sector preheating
members.description: The CMB constraint on T_reh with dark preheating was obtained by recasting the published Starobinsky reheating parameterization, not by rerunning a CMB likelihood; there is no joint likelihood connecting the preheating-modified N_star to Planck/BICEP-Keck data.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the analytic N_star(T_reh, coupling) to (n_s, r) map as a theory module in Cobaya/MontePython and sample against the Planck 2018 plus BICEP/Keck likelihoods to get proper posterior bounds on T_reh and the couplings.

members.model_name: Fast-decaying axino gravitino dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the m_axino-m_3/2 region classification: the overclosure/reheating bound is a hard analytic cut against the quoted abundance normalization and the BBN checks are approximate literature tables, so the narrow Region III viability cannot be quantified statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's thermal-yield and lifetime formulas as a scan code over (m_axino, m_3/2, f_a, T_R, superpartner spectrum) with a joint likelihood combining the Planck Omega_DM h^2 measurement and tabulated BBN late-decay bounds, replacing the figure-level allowed/excluded regions.

members.model_name: Interacting cold dark matter-dark radiation drag model
members.description: The cosmological constraint rests on Planck 2015 TT+lowP, CFHTLenS, and Planck SZ summary statistics partly inferred assuming LCDM; no model-consistent likelihood analysis with current CMB, BAO, and weak-lensing data exists, so the reported preference for nonzero drag cannot be treated as current evidence.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the inference in Cobaya/MontePython with Planck 2018 (or ACT/SPT) likelihoods, DESI/BOSS BAO, and full KiDS/DES weak-lensing likelihoods evaluated on the model's own matter power spectrum instead of LCDM-derived S8 summaries.

members.model_name: Dark-baryon self-destructing dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for SDDM visible-energy decay topologies (one to three lepton pairs with fixed invariant masses and directionality) in large neutrino detectors; detector-specific efficiencies, exposures, and backgrounds for Super-K, Borexino, SNO+, and DUNE are absent from the model paper, so limits in the rate-per-volume versus mass/lifetime plane cannot be set.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Super-K boosted-dark-matter and dinucleon-decay searches into an SDDM event-rate-per-volume likelihood: build detector geometry/exposure models, apply published multi-lepton reconstruction efficiencies and atmospheric-neutrino backgrounds, and release limits in the m_V versus daughter-mass plane as a reusable likelihood module extensible to SNO+ and DUNE.

members.model_name: U(1) L_mu-L_tau Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihood exists for the combined Planck relic-band plus PICO-60/LUX spin-dependent constraints on this model; the card notes only contour-level information is available and figure contours would need digitizing.
members.proposed_resolution: Once a model implementation exists, build a composite likelihood combining a Gaussian Planck Omega h^2 term with the published PICO-60 exposure limit (e.g. via DDCalc's spin-dependent likelihood machinery) instead of digitized exclusion contours.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D chiral fermion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood is packaged for the constraints applied to this model: the XENON1T bound and LZ/XENONnT projections have no likelihood on the card, the relic-plus-perturbativity limit is only approximate, and the Higgs-invisible-width exclusion below about 57 GeV exists only as a paper statement requiring recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's sigma_SI output into DDCalc's XENON1T/LZ likelihoods, add a Gaussian Planck Omega h^2 term, and recast the ATLAS/CMS Higgs invisible branching-ratio limit through the sin^2(theta)-scaled invisible width formula to form a composite reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: MeV complex-scalar thermal dark matter with pseudoscalar lepton portal
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood maps the solver output (N_eff, light-element abundances, Omega_chi h^2) onto the mass/branching plane; the card records likelihood_available as unknown/none for both cosmological constraints, so bounds are currently read off published figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the three-sector solver output to PRIMAT or PArthENoPE for light-element abundances and to the Planck N_eff posterior (e.g. via Cobaya/MontePython), producing a reusable likelihood over (m_chi, BR_EM, BR_nu, sigma_v).

members.model_name: Simplified spin-1 dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: No machine-readable likelihoods exist for any constraint on this model: beam-dump/LDMX limits are event-count contours only, XENON1T/XENON10 electron-transition limits require operator-dependent recasting to the b5/b7 spin-1 matrix elements, and CMB/IGM energy-injection bounds are applied as published exclusion curves for other partial-wave assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode digitized 90% C.L. beam-dump contours and recast the XENON electron-recoil limits to the spin-1 b5/b7 cross sections (e.g. via QEdark-style form factors), and map the b_i-dependent annihilation partial waves onto Planck p_ann and IGM-temperature likelihoods, packaging all of them as reusable interpolated likelihood functions.

members.model_name: Higgs portal scalar dark matter with gravitational reheating production
members.description: No forecast likelihood exists for the production-channel discrimination route: the mapping from future CMB B-mode measurements to H_inf and from primordial-GW spectral measurements to T_R is stated only qualitatively, with no experiment covariance or inflation-model likelihood encoded.
members.proposed_resolution: Build Fisher/mock likelihoods for LiteBIRD/CMB-S4 r-measurements (giving H_inf) and a DECIGO-like primordial GW spectrum (giving T_R via the reheating-induced spectral knee) for a chosen inflation model, then propagate the posteriors onto the abundance contours from gap_1.

members.model_name: CMSSM gravitino dark matter with thermal and NLSP-decay production
members.description: No public BBN/CMB energy-injection likelihood reproduces the paper's constraint: the BBN code with hadronic injection and adopted light-element ranges is private, and no machine-readable CMB spectral-distortion bound is supplied for the (tau_NLSP, E_em, E_had, Omega_NLSP) inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS) with hadronic cascade yields and stau bound-state catalysis, couple it to updated light-element abundance likelihoods and the FIRAS mu/y distortion bound, and expose it as a function of (m_NLSP, m_3/2, B_h, Omega_NLSP h^2).

members.model_name: SU(2)_D chiral fermion plus T-prime boson dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the two-component constraints: the xenon spin-independent bound and the two-species relic-consistency condition are available only as paper-level statements (likelihood_available no/approximate), with no packaged abundance-weighted direct-detection likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a composite likelihood combining a Gaussian Planck term on the summed Omega h^2 with DDCalc XENON1T/LZ likelihoods evaluated on the fraction-weighted sum of the two components' recoil spectra.

members.model_name: U(1)_{e-mu} Dirac leptophilic dark matter with two-loop neutrino masses
members.description: The CMB energy-injection bound on the Breit-Wigner-enhanced annihilation is applied only as a quoted B_CMB threshold (e.g. B_CMB > 40.32 excluded at 400 GeV); no tool computes the velocity-averaged enhancement at recombination-era velocities for this model and folds it through a Planck likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive <sigma v>(v) over the CMB-era velocity distribution for the resonant Zprime propagator and feed the resulting p_ann into ExoCLASS or DarkHistory with the Planck 2018 injection likelihood, scanning the resonance parameters a_x and m_Zprime - 2 m_X.

members.model_name: Pure-scalar inelastic coannihilation dark matter model
members.description: No public displaced-vertex likelihood or recast exists for the s2 long-lived-particle signature: the route carries only the paper's HL-LHC projection with no attached likelihood, and detector acceptances were not rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing ATLAS/CMS Run-2 displaced-vertex plus missing-energy searches for this topology using the LLP modules of MadAnalysis 5 or CheckMATE, and encode the HL-LHC 3 ab^-1 projection as an efficiency map over (m2, c tau_s2, production cross section).

members.model_name: SU(3) x U(1) ten-plet accident dark matter
members.description: No reusable likelihoods exist for any of the model's observables: the Delta N_eff bound, the multi-component relic plus halo-morphology constraints, and the direct-detection recast are all stated as unavailable in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the analytic Delta N_eff prediction in a Planck/BBN N_eff likelihood (e.g. via a MontePython/Cobaya likelihood module), and package the direct-detection recast against published xenon exclusion curves once gap_3 closes, giving a joint likelihood over (m_DM, g_D, lambda_H, T_prime_over_T).

members.model_name: Two-flavor chiral composite asymmetric dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection recast or likelihood exists for GeV-scale composite dark baryons scattering through a ~100 MeV dark photon: the light-mediator momentum dependence and detector thresholds for ~1 GeV dark matter are outside standard heavy-mediator WIMP pipelines, and the card records likelihood_available no.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DDCalc/DarkBit-style recoil machinery with a light-mediator propagator form factor and low-threshold XENONnT/LZ/DARWIN efficiency curves for m_DM near 1 GeV, exposing a likelihood in (m_DM, m_A_prime, epsilon, alpha_D).

members.model_name: Three-flavor chiral composite ADM with B-L portal
members.description: No direct-detection recast or likelihood exists for multi-component GeV dark baryons with nonzero U(1)_D charges scattering off protons via a ~100 MeV dark photon; light-mediator momentum dependence, multi-component abundances, and low thresholds are outside standard WIMP pipelines and likelihood_available is no.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a DDCalc/DarkBit-style recoil calculator with a light-mediator form factor, per-component abundance weighting over the dark baryon octet, and XENONnT/LZ/DARWIN efficiency curves for few-GeV dark matter.

members.model_name: KSVZ axion dark matter with dimension-greater-than-five heavy-quark decays
members.description: The BBN/CMB check is currently only the coarse T_decay^Q > 3 MeV temperature cut; no likelihood propagates the hadronic and electromagnetic injection from GeV-scale colored-relic decays with model-dependent final states into light-element and CMB constraints for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the Q decay spectra (per operator choice of q_L, d_R, u_R couplings) through a public late-decay BBN code such as ACROPOLIS/AlterBBN, extending it with hadronic-injection treatment where needed, to replace the 3 MeV proxy with an actual tau_Q-branching-ratio likelihood.

members.model_name: R-invariant new-inflation gauge-mediated gravitino dark matter
members.description: No packaged BBN/CMB energy-injection likelihood is available for this model's late NLSP decays; only related-literature gravitino-DM bounds exist and require recasting onto the new-inflation GMSB benchmark (con_bbn_cmb_late_decays: likelihood_available partial, recasting_needed yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark's (tau_NLSP, zeta_EM, zeta_had) through a public BBN energy-injection code such as ACROPOLIS, and wrap the resulting light-element and CMB bounds as a reusable likelihood over (m_3/2, T_R, NLSP parameters).

members.model_name: Cosmologically stable axino-gravitino co-dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the cosmological region classification in the m_axino-m_3/2 plane: the thermal overclosure/reheating bound is imposed as a hard analytic cut against a fixed rho0/s0 = 4e-10 GeV normalization, and the BBN/structure comparisons are approximate literature tables rather than an implemented constraint pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's thermal-yield formulas as a scan code over (m_axino, m_3/2, f_a, T_R, superpartner spectrum) and attach a joint likelihood combining the Planck Omega_DM h^2 measurement with tabulated BBN late-decay bounds, replacing the figure-level allowed/excluded classification.

members.model_name: Majoronic dark radiation with residual-dark-parity scalar dark matter
members.description: The constraint scan uses only historical inputs (2013-era N_eff hints of 3.6-3.8, LUX first result, early Higgs signal data); no likelihood pipeline against current Planck 2018 N_eff, LZ/XENONnT direct detection, and modern Higgs invisible-width limits exists, so the model's present viability cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the parameter scan with the muon-epoch Majoron decoupling Delta N_eff prediction tested against the Planck 2018 (and forthcoming CMB-S4) N_eff likelihood, sigma_SI against public LZ likelihoods via DDCalc, and Gamma_h_inv against current ATLAS/CMS invisible-width limits.

members.model_name: X-portal vector MeV dark matter
members.description: No assembled CMB energy-injection and BBN/N_eff likelihood recast for p-wave MeV annihilation to e+e- in this model; the cosmological mass window is currently an analytic estimate rather than a statistical constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the velocity-dependent energy-injection history with DarkHistory/ExoCLASS, the N_eff shift with AlterBBN, and couple both to the Planck likelihood for the model's e+e--dominated final states.

members.model_name: Thermal dark matter through the Dirac neutrino portal
members.description: Rare-decay missing-energy constraints (E949/NA62 K+ -> pi+ + invisible, tau and meson decays) lack a reusable recast with experiment-specific efficiencies and spectra for an invisibly decaying pseudo-Dirac sterile mediator.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that convolves the model's K/tau missing-energy spectra with published E949 and NA62 signal-region efficiencies, packaged as a likelihood over (m_4, U_alpha4) with invisible branching fraction as input.

members.model_name: Primordial extremal black holes with dark electromagnetism
members.description: Existing diffuse-gamma (COMPTEL/EGRET), BBN, and CMB injection limits apply to ordinary evaporating PBHs; no recast pipeline maps them onto the PeBH two-stage history (initial evaporation to the near-extremal state plus residual remnant emission) with the initial-to-remnant mass rescaling the source prescribes.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer that takes the charged-remnant injection history from the extended Hawking code and rescales published f_PBH(M) evaporation constraints (and energy-injection BBN/CMB bounds) to f_eBH as a function of remnant mass and initial mass function, recovering the source's ~1.4e9 g BBN transition scale as validation.

members.model_name: Model A': Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light vector mediator
members.description: The cosmological and laboratory end-point constraints are not wired up as evaluable likelihoods for this model: Planck energy-injection, BBN photodisintegration/N_eff, and light-mediator direct-detection limits exist only as quoted exclusion statements, although public tools cover each physics ingredient.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline feeding the s2 outputs (mediator yield, lifetime, <sigma v>_rec with Sommerfeld enhancement) into DarkHistory/ExoCLASS for CMB energy injection, ACROPOLIS for BBN photodisintegration and N_eff, and DDCalc-style likelihoods for the kinetic-mixing nuclear-recoil rate.

members.model_name: Scalar-vector inelastic coannihilation dark matter model
members.description: No implemented recast pipeline exists for the displaced inelastic-DM searches (HL-LHC displaced vertices, FASER forward decays, STCF-style low-mass searches); the route attaches no public likelihood and only qualitative reach statements from related work.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate A prime-mediated s1 s2 production with MadGraph+Pythia and build acceptance maps for displaced decays: use FORESEE for the FASER forward geometry and MadAnalysis 5/CheckMATE LLP modules for central displaced-vertex searches, packaged as an efficiency grid over (m2, Delta, epsilon, g_D, c tau_s2).

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with right-handed scalar mediator Model 1
members.description: BESIII and LHCb hyperon branching-ratio likelihoods are not packaged and experiment-specific efficiency models are unavailable, so laboratory limits can only be applied as a single quoted 90% CL upper bound rather than a proper likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a packaged likelihood from the published BESIII invisible-hyperon search (BR < 7.4e-5) and LHCb hyperon analyses, including an efficiency model per hyperon species, in a recasting framework so Wilson coefficients map directly to exclusion significance.

members.model_name: Alternative U(1)_X Dirac right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The constraint overlays use published exclusion curves rather than current experiment likelihoods: no up-to-date joint recast (latest LHC dilepton dataset, current xenon-experiment likelihoods, Planck Delta N_eff posterior) exists for this model's parameter bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a joint scan using public recast machinery: current dilepton resonance limits applied to the X boson (e.g. a ZPEED-style recast with the paper's charges), DDCalc for spin-independent limits, and the Planck N_eff likelihood, over (m_chi, m_X, g_X, x_H).

members.model_name: Near-continuum Z-portal dark matter
members.description: CMB constraints on late decays of above-gap continuum states require energy-injection likelihoods that integrate over a continuum of lifetimes and injection spectra weighted by the spectral density; existing decaying-dark-matter injection tools only treat a single species with a single lifetime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkHistory or ExoCLASS with an injection term integrated over the continuum lifetime distribution tau(mu) and abundance rho(mu), then evaluate Planck energy-injection likelihoods to bound the allowed spectral-density and portal-coupling region.

members.model_name: Resonant pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No CMB (or BBN photodissociation) energy-injection likelihood accepts the strongly velocity-dependent resonant annihilation rate of this model; standard Planck p_ann limits assume a constant s-wave cross section and cannot be applied blindly, as the card itself notes.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the redshift-dependent <sigma v>(v(z)) from the resonant thermal history into ExoCLASS or DarkHistory to compute the recombination-era injection and rerun the Planck anisotropy likelihood; add a BBN photodissociation check for the small-delta_R edge using the same injection history.

members.model_name: Resonant pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No accelerator recast exists for the resonant inelastic-dark-matter target: beam-dump and collider dark-photon limits must be remapped to the model's epsilon-g_D plane with the near-threshold m_A = 2 m_chi(1+delta_R) kinematics, semi-visible/displaced chi_2 decay modes, and the CMB-allowed coupling targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a dark-photon recast framework (e.g. DarkCast plus experiment acceptance maps) with the inelastic chi_1-chi_2 branching structure and chi_2 lifetime, and recompute existing beam-dump/collider exclusions along the resonant relic-target curve.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with photon-dark-photon gauge-field depletion
members.description: No recast maps the predicted magnetic and dark-photon spectra of the heavier ALPs (m_phi ~ 10^-12-10^-8 eV, large g_X = g_AX couplings) onto the X-ray photon-ALP conversion and CMB spectral-distortion bounds, which were derived for late-time ultralight magnetogenesis with different spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the constraint mapping for the paper's spectra: propagate the produced B and dark-photon backgrounds through photon-ALP-dark-photon mixing to compute X-ray conversion signals and mu/y distortions, then compare against COBE/FIRAS and X-ray survey limits as a reusable likelihood over (m_phi, f, g_A, g_AX).

members.model_name: Low-reheating visible sterile-neutrino hot dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No machine-readable likelihoods exist for the constraints that define the viable region: the BBN Delta N_eff bound at low T_R, and the radiative-decay X-ray/DEBRA/SN1987A bounds recast to a hot sterile subcomponent with fraction f_s; only qualitative excluded regions from the proceedings are recorded.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a radiative-decay flux calculator (Gamma_rad from m_s, sin^2 2theta, scaled by f_s) interfaced to current diffuse X-ray background and cluster limits, and encode the low-reheating BBN Delta N_eff bound as a likelihood, replacing the digitized historical exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Negative-m0-squared mSUGRA gravitino superWIMP dark matter
members.description: The BBN/CMB viability of late slepton decays is undetermined (likelihood_available unknown; the paper defers detailed cosmology): no public likelihood evaluates electromagnetic plus hadronic injection and charged-slepton bound-state catalysis for the model's tau_NLSP and Y_NLSP.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the analytic decay yields to a public BBN injection code (e.g. extend ACROPOLIS with hadronic yields and stau/selectron catalyzed BBN) plus the FIRAS spectral-distortion bound, returning allowed regions in (m_3/2, m_NLSP, Y_NLSP).

members.model_name: Composite accidental QCD axion
members.description: No quantitative likelihood or recast pipeline exists for the ultralight-ALP byproducts (CMB polarization precession for 1e-33 to 4e-28 eV masses and black-hole superradiance for 1e-18 to 1e-10 eV); the paper only quotes mass windows.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published CMB birefringence constraints and black-hole spin/superradiance exclusion regions onto the (m_ALP, f_PQ) plane of the specific composite constructions that produce extra singlet ALPs.

members.model_name: Bosonic forbidden light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: No BBN/CMB likelihood is available for MeV-scale thermal scalar dark matter with a temperature-dependent forbidden annihilation rate; the m_1 above a few MeV and CMB-safe late-annihilation requirements are only rough analytic filters on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate N_eff and light-element yields with an MeV-DM-capable BBN code (e.g. an AlterBBN/PRyMordial-type extension with the thermalized S1-phi sector) and fold the exponentially suppressed <sigma v>(z) into the standard Planck energy-injection (p_ann) likelihood.

members.model_name: Fermionic secluded light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: No BBN/CMB likelihood covers this MeV-scale p-wave secluded scenario: the effects of the thermalized X1-phi sector on N_eff and light elements, the pre-BBN phi decay requirement, and the velocity-suppressed recombination-era annihilation are only rough analytic filters on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine an MeV-DM-capable BBN code (AlterBBN/PRyMordial-type with the X1-phi sector and phi lifetime injection) with the Planck p-wave energy-injection treatment to produce a joint likelihood over (m_1, m_phi, y_phi, theta).

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with scalar mediator Model 2
members.description: BESIII and LHCb hyperon branching-ratio likelihoods are not packaged and experiment-specific efficiency models are unavailable, so laboratory limits can only be applied as a single quoted 90% CL upper bound rather than a proper likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a packaged likelihood from the published BESIII invisible-hyperon search (BR < 7.4e-5) and LHCb hyperon analyses, including an efficiency model per hyperon species, in a recasting framework so Wilson coefficients map directly to exclusion significance.

members.model_name: SESM general-scalar-potential inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection likelihood handles the model's inelastic kinematics: XENON1T nuclear-recoil and XENONnT electron-recoil constraints were applied at benchmark level with an effective coupling, and no released likelihood evaluates inelastic Higgs/Z-mediated recoil spectra with a mass splitting Delta m.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an open direct-detection package (e.g. DDCalc or a wimprates-based pipeline) with inelastic up/down-scattering kinematics and atomic ionization form factors for xenon, and wire in the public XENON1T nuclear-recoil and XENONnT electron-recoil data as a Poisson/profile likelihood over (M_S1, Delta m, eta).

members.model_name: Type-III radiative inert-doublet scalar dark matter
members.description: No digitized limit curves or likelihoods are assembled for the joint fit: the Planck relic band, the LZ spin-independent upper limit, and the XENONnT/Borexino/TEXONO/Super-K neutrino magnetic-moment bounds are only quoted, not packaged as evaluable constraints over the model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Use DDCalc for the LZ likelihood, a Gaussian Planck relic band, and digitized published mu_nu exclusion curves from XENONnT/Borexino/TEXONO to build a joint likelihood over (M_R1, splittings, quartics, Yukawas, M_Sigma), including relic-fraction rescaling of the direct-detection bound.

members.model_name: Z3 scotogenic neutrinophilic scalar dark matter
members.description: The BBN/CMB excess-radiation bound is only quoted from minimal-model literature; no dedicated Delta N_eff calculation or likelihood exists for this model's neutrino-coupled thermal history with the extended-scenario cancellations the paper invokes.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the model-specific neutrino-sector heating with a nudec_BSM-style decoupling code including S1, S2, and N, and interface the resulting Delta N_eff to Planck and BBN (AlterBBN/PRyMordial) likelihoods.

members.model_name: Low-reheat stable massive neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood implements the modern BBN/CMB lower bound on T_RH (about 4.1-4.7 MeV in the cited Planck-era analysis); con_neutrino_low_reheat_floor has likelihood_available: partial and recasting_needed: yes, so the historical near-1-MeV window cannot be statistically tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published low-reheat neutrino-thermalization plus BBN/Planck analysis (arXiv:1511.00672-style) into a reusable T_RH likelihood module combining N_eff and light-element data, shared across the low-reheat model family.

members.model_name: Locally scale-invariant vector-field cold dark matter
members.description: The only quantitative constraint, M_S < 400 eV or M_S > M_Pl, is quoted from prior literature with no likelihood (likelihood_available: no for both card constraints); no CMB or LSS likelihood pipeline can currently be run for this model, so the disfavored intermediate-mass window cannot be rederived or updated with modern data.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the perturbation module of gap_1 exists, wire it into a standard cosmological sampler (Cobaya/MontePython with Planck, BAO, and growth likelihoods) to refit the Weyl-vector mass M_S, the coupling f, and phi_0, replacing the quoted background-era bound with a perturbation-level exclusion.

members.model_name: Many-copy Standard Model hidden-baryon dark matter
members.description: No Delta N_eff/BBN likelihood is connected to the hidden-sector radiation density predicted by modulated reheating into N Standard Model copies; the BBN consistency check is currently a qualitative energy-budget argument.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the predicted hidden-sector radiation density to an effective Delta N_eff and evaluate it against a standard BBN/CMB likelihood (e.g. an AlterBBN or PArthENoPE-based Delta N_eff grid plus the Planck N_eff posterior), wiring the reheating branching ratios in as inputs.

members.model_name: Millicharged atomic dark matter with elastic nuclear scattering
members.description: The critical direct-detection observable is compared only to Xenon100-era published limits via an effective proton cross section; no detector-response module or modern recoil-spectrum likelihood exists for the screened atomic form-factor scattering, so present-day exclusions on epsilon cannot be stated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the momentum-dependent screened form factor as a nonstandard interaction in a direct-detection recast framework (DDCalc or an NREFT-based likelihood pipeline) and evaluate current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, validating against the paper's epsilon contours at alpha_prime = x_e = 0.1.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs complex scalar sub-GeV dark matter
