members.description: No CMB/BBN energy-injection likelihood covers the metastable dark Higgs with lifetime of order 0.01-10 s decaying to e+e-; the card's cmb_bbn_filter is an approximate flag, so late electron-photon reheating and recombination-era injection constraints are not quantitatively applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the metastable S abundance, lifetime, and electromagnetic injection spectrum into ACROPOLIS for BBN and ExoCLASS/DarkAges for recombination-era CMB constraints, and add the s-wave annihilation p_ann limit from the Planck likelihood.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs pseudo-Dirac sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: No CMB/BBN energy-injection likelihood exists for the long-lived dark Higgs (tau_S of order 1 s or longer, decaying to e+e-) combined with recombination-era s-wave annihilation of the pseudo-Dirac pair; the card's filter step is only a qualitative flag.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the metastable S abundance and electromagnetic injection and evaluate it with ACROPOLIS (BBN) and ExoCLASS/DarkAges plus the Planck p_ann bound (CMB), noting that pseudo-Dirac coannihilation suppresses the recombination-era s-wave rate.

members.model_name: Leptophilic light flavon hot-relic model
members.description: No reusable BBN/CMB electromagnetic energy-injection likelihood is bundled for the decaying pseudo-Goldstone flavon: the allowed regions in (m_eta, tau_eta, Omega_eta h^2) are read off published plots, not computed from a likelihood over the two-photon injection history.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the eta abundance and lifetime with an energy-deposition code (e.g. exoCLASS/DarkAges or Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi-style BBN injection tables) to build a likelihood over the (m_eta, tau_eta, Omega_eta,0 h^2) grid covering BBN through recombination photon injection.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with vector mediator Model 3
members.description: BESIII and LHCb hyperon branching-ratio likelihoods are not packaged and experiment-specific efficiency models are unavailable, so laboratory limits can only be applied as a single quoted 90% CL upper bound rather than a proper likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a packaged likelihood from the published BESIII invisible-hyperon search (BR < 7.4e-5) and LHCb hyperon analyses, including an efficiency model per hyperon species, in a recasting framework so Wilson coefficients map directly to exclusion significance.

members.model_name: Dark-dimension dark graviton dark matter
members.description: No likelihood recasts CMB/BBN energy-injection and N_eff constraints onto a decaying multi-component graviton tower whose mass distribution evolves in time; existing decay constraints assume a single decaying species with fixed mass and lifetime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an energy-injection framework (e.g. DarkHistory or ExoCLASS) to accept a time-dependent superposition of decaying species drawn from the tower solver output, and combine with BBN photodissociation limits and Planck N_eff to produce exclusion contours in (T_i, m_KK, visible branching fraction).

members.model_name: Hidden self-interacting Dirac dark matter with scalar-mediated first-order phase transition
members.description: The visible-portal recast route has no implemented pipeline mapping portal coupling and mediator lifetime onto CMB energy-injection, BBN, and direct-detection limits for a late-decaying light dark scalar.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mediator decay spectrum in ACROPOLIS for BBN and ExoCLASS/DarkAges for CMB energy injection, and add a portal-suppressed nucleon cross-section map for direct-detection recasting, scanned over (epsilon, tau_phi, m_phi).

members.model_name: Nonthermal decay-produced dark matter for the Hubble tension
members.description: No BBN/CMB energy-injection likelihood exists for the viable lifetime band: constraints on visible energy release at tau ~ 10^2-10^4 s were cited from generic late-decay studies but never recomputed for this model's branching fractions and abundance, so con_decay_bbn_cmb is a recast target without a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Run ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN for electromagnetic/hadronic injection and an ExoCLASS-style CMB energy-injection calculation over a (tau, f m_chi_prime/m_chi, visible branching) grid, and package the resulting light-element and CMB exclusion contours as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Split-neutrino right-handed sneutrino inflaton dark matter
members.description: The CMB constraint on the flat-direction inflaton uses only the amplitude and tilt normalization quoted in the 2012 primary paper; no Planck-era likelihood evaluation of (h, m_phi, A) exists (likelihood_available: no for cmb_flat_direction_inflation_target).
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the NH_uL flat-direction potential in a slow-roll inflation pipeline (e.g. an ASPIC-style module) and confront the predicted (A_s, n_s, r) with the Planck 2018 likelihood to map the allowed (h, m_phi, A) region.

members.model_name: Symmetric light-mediator self-interacting dark matter benchmark
members.description: No public direct-detection likelihood implements the light-mediator recoil spectrum with the momentum-transfer form factor F(q) for an MeV-scale mediator; standard contact-operator WIMP limits cannot be applied to this benchmark, and the paper provides only illustrative projected contours.

members.model_name: Thermally produced dark pair plasma of vectorlike fermions
members.description: No cluster-merger morphology likelihood exists (the card lists both the merger-morphology and mixed-DM CMB likelihoods as unavailable), so simulated dark-clump offsets cannot be statistically compared to weak-lensing and X-ray data for Abell 520/3827 and the Bullet Cluster.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a summary-statistic likelihood on lensing-peak/X-ray-peak/galaxy-centroid offsets from published Abell 520, Abell 3827, and Bullet Cluster reconstructions, with simulation-based forward modeling of the offset distribution over cluster initial-condition systematics.

members.model_name: Type-I seesaw Majoron warm dark matter completion
members.description: The CMB lifetime bound tau_J > 50-160 Gyr is only quoted from a pre-Planck analysis under a thermal-Majoron abundance mapping; no current-data likelihood exists to re-derive the bound for this completion's actual abundance, mass, and distribution (likelihood_available: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Run the gap_2 solver against Planck 2018 TTTEEE+lensing likelihoods (via MontePython or Cobaya) scanning (m_J, tau_J, abundance) to produce an updated, reusable lifetime-abundance exclusion surface replacing the quoted 2007-era bound.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1) Higgs-portal singlet-doublet fermion dark matter
members.description: The complete-model inflation consistency check (s4) has no implemented likelihood: the SO(10) inflaton potential coefficients are compared only to Planck 2018 central values of n_s and A_s rather than evaluated against the Planck inflation posterior jointly with the GUT-threshold and dark-matter parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the slow-roll predictions (n_s, r, A_s) as functions of the SO(10) potential coefficients and evaluate them against the published Planck 2018 inflation chains (or a Gaussian approximation to the n_s-r posterior), sharing parameters with the GUT-threshold sector.

members.model_name: FIMPzilla scalar dark matter from a conformal sector
members.description: The CMB tensor-to-scalar constraint on H_I (and hence T_R under efficient reheating), the model's principal experimental handle, is applied as an approximate exclusion curve rather than a proper likelihood interface to current r bounds.

members.model_name: Scalar-tensor dynamical relaxation of the dark-matter-to-baryon ratio
members.description: The viability checks are frozen at WMAP-era approximations (10 percent BBN expansion deviation, CMB shift parameter R_0, Cassini beta_b bound) with likelihood_available no; no modern BBN, Planck, LSS, or SN Ia likelihood evaluation exists for the modified expansion and growth histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the gap_1 solver to an AlterBBN-style BBN code with modified H(T), and to Planck CMB, BAO/LSS, and SN Ia likelihoods in a standard sampler (Cobaya/MontePython), replacing the shift-parameter and 10-percent-H rules of thumb.

members.model_name: Deeply bound uuddss sexaquark dark matter
members.description: No likelihoods exist for the model's constraint set: nuclear-stability/deuteron-decay (SNO/Super-K), neutron-star, and DM-baryon scattering (CMB and direct-detection) limits are quoted only as compiled exclusion statements with likelihood_available no.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a composite likelihood over (m_S, lambda, sigma_Sb): recast published Super-K/SNO nucleon- and deuteron-decay lifetime limits into the S decay/conversion rates, and reuse the public Planck DM-baryon scattering likelihood machinery for sigma_Sb.

members.model_name: Extremal Kerr black hole dark matter from Hawking evaporation
members.description: No recast tool or likelihood exists for direct detection of neutral Planck-mass extremal Kerr relics: the flux estimate reuses charged-relic detector assumptions that the card itself flags as inapplicable, and no detector-response model or track-search likelihood covers gravitational-only macroscopic relics.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive an event-rate model for Planck-mass relics from the local flux (rho_DM/M_EKBH times v_DM) with the relic's actual geometric/gravitational cross section, and wrap it as an exposure-based likelihood for large-area track detectors and paleo-detector searches, separating charged-analogue and neutral cases.

members.model_name: pMSSM gravitino LSP model set
members.description: The BBN/CMB/diffuse-background late-decay constraint is applied via approximate digitized hadronic and electromagnetic injection curves with approximate decay-product mapping (notably for colored NLSP hadronization and neutrino limits), not a public likelihood in (tau_NLSP, abundance, branching fractions).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a public likelihood interpolating modern BBN injection bounds (Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi-type curves, or ACROPOLIS extended to hadronic injection and long lifetimes) over NLSP lifetime, yield, and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions, including a colored-NLSP hadronization treatment.

members.model_name: Three-scalar inelastic scalar dark matter model for muon g-2 and XENON1T
members.description: No machine-readable likelihoods exist for the route's statistical step: the XENON1T electron-recoil excess fit, the muon g-2 Gaussian target, and the Planck p_ann energy-injection bound with model-specific visible branching fraction are all unimplemented.

members.model_name: R-parity-conserving minimal SUSY U(1)_X gaugino-singlet neutralino dark matter
members.description: The BBN effective-radiation bound on right-handed-neutrino decoupling is applied only as a quoted threshold; no Delta N_eff likelihood connecting v_X, g_X, and the Z-prime-mediated decoupling temperature to BBN/CMB data is available.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic local U(1) singlet-fermion dark matter

members.model_name: Asymmetrically reheated Twin Higgs Portal scalar dark matter
members.description: No likelihood is wired up for any of the model's constraints (all three carry likelihood_available: no): the diluted sigma_SI is not connected to detector likelihoods, and the Delta N_eff target is not connected to Planck or CMB-S4 forecast likelihoods.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken Z2 singlet scalar dark matter with domain walls
members.description: No recast pipeline converts the QG-induced S_2 decay (heavy scalar decaying via Higgs mixing to photons, e+e-, and neutrinos) into CMB energy-injection lifetime limits and SKA-band radio synchrotron sensitivity for this model's mass and Lambda_QG range.

members.model_name: Global U(1)_DM-remnant Z3 scalar WIMP

members.model_name: Inflaton dark matter from incomplete decay

members.model_name: Leptophobic Zp Majorana dark matter simplified model

members.model_name: PBH-remnant dark matter from matter-era mini-PBH production

members.model_name: Two-state unified superfluid dark sector

members.model_name: Dimension-six extended-inverse-seesaw Majoron dark matter

members.model_name: Three degenerate light mixed sneutrino dark matter

members.model_name: Logarithmic-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter

members.model_name: Light two-Higgs-doublet fermion dark matter

members.model_name: Low-reheat WIMP dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent unintegrated Boltzmann equation for chi produced from neutrino annihilation through the light mediator (including reannihilation reprocessing), tabulate f(q), and pass it to CLASS as an ncdm species to obtain the linear transfer function.

members.model_name: KOTO two-scalar P dark matter
members.description: The present-day phase-space distribution of P is not derived (card lists distribution_type and structure formation as unknown): a 10-125 MeV scalar produced by freeze-in near T_R ~ 10-100 MeV can retain a warm momentum distribution, and without f(p) no transfer function or Lyman-alpha/satellite comparison can be made, even though the card itself notes hot-relic masses in this range would be structure-formation excluded.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) for the low-reheating freeze-in population (and the neutrino-portal freeze-out variant), feed it into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold relic to get the linear transfer function, and recast onto published WDM Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite-count limits via the half-mode mass.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with dark-sector freeze-out
members.description: The sterile-neutrino momentum distribution at freeze-out has not been propagated to a linear matter power spectrum, so no transfer function, free-streaming scale, or Lyman-alpha comparison exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model's Fermi-Dirac distribution with effective chemical potential and temperature ratio xi into the CLASS ncdm module as a tabulated f(q), compute T(k) and the half-mode scale over the (M, xi) plane, and map onto thermal-WDM Lyman-alpha bounds for the constraint recast.

members.model_name: Sub-keV decaying fermion dark matter in anomaly-free hidden U(1)_X
members.description: No nonthermal momentum distribution f(q) and linear transfer function have been computed for the Phi_6-decay-produced sub-keV fermion; only a delta-function free-streaming estimate (lambda_FS ~ 0.3-0.5 Mpc) exists, so Lyman-alpha and satellite-count constraints cannot be applied beyond a thermal-WDM proxy the card explicitly warns against.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the collisionless Boltzmann equation for decay-produced dark matter to obtain f(q) (analytic solutions for two-body decay production exist), feed it to CLASS as a tabulated ncdm phase-space file to compute T(k), and recast Lyman-alpha limits via the Murgia-Viel {alpha, beta, gamma} transfer-function parameterization; the same f(q) sharpens the BBN/N_eff radiation-density check.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: The semi-relativistic gravitationally produced ALP population has no derived late-time momentum distribution or transfer-function treatment, so its free-streaming imprint on linear structure (and any hot-fraction bound) cannot be evaluated; the card lists the linear structure-formation behavior as unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the phase-space distribution f(p) of the gravitationally produced ALPs from the 2-to-2 graviton-exchange production integrals in the reheating background, feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold (ncdm) subcomponent alongside the cold misalignment field, and recast Lyman-alpha/hot-DM-fraction bounds on the resulting suppressed power spectrum.

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: The semi-relativistic gravitationally produced axion population has no derived late-time momentum distribution or transfer-function treatment, so its free-streaming imprint on linear structure (and any hot-fraction bound) cannot be evaluated; the card notes no late-time transfer-function likelihood exists for this component.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the phase-space distribution f(p) of the gravitationally produced axions from the 2-to-2 graviton-exchange production integrals in the reheating background, feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold (ncdm) subcomponent alongside the cold misalignment field, and recast Lyman-alpha/hot-DM-fraction bounds on the resulting suppressed power spectrum.

members.model_name: CMSSM gravitino dark matter with thermal and NLSP-decay production
members.description: The mixed cold-plus-warm gravitino structure impact is only qualitative: no decay-produced gravitino momentum distribution f(q) has been derived and inserted into a Boltzmann solver, so no transfer function, half-mode mass, or thermal-WDM mapping exists for the NTP component (thermal_wdm_mapping available false).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for gravitinos from delayed two-body NLSP decay (redshifted decay-time distribution), implement it as a CLASS ncdm species mixed with the cold TP fraction, compute the suppression of the linear power spectrum, and compare against Lyman-alpha WDM-style bounds via existing emulators.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free axion dark matter in a 3HDM with B-L Higgs fields
members.description: No model-specific transfer-function calculation exists for a thermally produced keV axion fraction; the card only uses the 5.3 keV thermal-relic WDM bound as a proxy, which the card itself flags as invalid for a mixed misalignment-plus-thermal momentum distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermal axion phase-space distribution f(p) for the model's production channels, feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold (ncdm) species mixed with cold misalignment axions, and recast against Lyman-alpha flux-power data via an existing WDM-style emulator or area-criterion mapping.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in composite dark-pion dark matter
members.description: The dark-pion phase-space distribution and linear transfer function have not been derived, so warm-DM and Lyman-alpha screens cannot be applied quantitatively; the card records no f(q), no free-streaming length, and no thermal-WDM mapping.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) from the COFI production plus confinement history, feed it to CLASS as a non-cold relic to obtain the transfer function and half-mode scale, and map onto existing Lyman-alpha WDM bounds/emulators to produce a quantitative (m_DM, m_gap) exclusion.

members.model_name: AMSB axino-LSP mixed axion/axino dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the TP axino thermal-like distribution and the NTP distribution from neutralino two-body decay, compute mixed C+WDM transfer functions with CLASS for the resulting phase-space input, and recast against existing Lyman-alpha mixed cold/warm dark-matter fraction bounds to replace the 50-percent-warm heuristic.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated NMSSM light and heavy dark-sector model
members.description: The phase-space distribution of the nonthermally produced LDM from late ONLSP decay has not been derived (distribution_function_available=no, all structure_formation entries unknown), so whether the light component free-streams enough to suppress small-scale power cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for the decay-produced LDM from the ONLSP lifetime and two-body kinematics (including redshifting after decay), and feed it to CLASS as a non-cold relic to compute the transfer function and check against Lyman-alpha warm-dark-matter bounds.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector glueball dark matter in a late-modulus low-reheat cosmology

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the glueball phase-space distribution f(p) from the modulus-decay injection and hidden-sector cannibal evolution, implement it as an ncdm species in CLASS/CAMB (the card already lists an optional CLASS/CAMB warm-component calculation as a required resource), and extract the suppression scale for comparison with Lyman-alpha and dwarf-galaxy limits.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational scalar singlet dark matter with a diluter

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the Hawking-spectrum f(p) for the scalar including redshifting through the PBH- and diluter-dominated eras, compute the transfer function with CLASS using the custom distribution, and compare to Lyman-alpha WDM bounds.

members.model_name: Fermionic UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination

members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated phase-space Boltzmann equation for the dimension-6 production kernel in RD and EMD histories, tabulate f(p) over the Delta_EMD = 1 to 1e4 scan, and feed it to CLASS as a custom ncdm distribution to obtain exact transfer functions.

members.model_name: Scalar UV freeze-in baryogenesis with early matter domination

members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated phase-space Boltzmann equation for the dimension-5 production kernel in RD and EMD histories, tabulate f(p) over the Delta_EMD = 1 to 1e4 scan, and feed it to CLASS as a custom ncdm distribution to obtain exact transfer functions.

members.model_name: Negative-m0-squared mSUGRA gravitino superWIMP dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the post-dilution keVin phase-space distribution, insert it as a tabulated ncdm f(p) in CLASS/CAMB to compute the linear transfer function, and evaluate it against a Lyman-alpha WDM likelihood or emulator to replace the rescaled bound over the (M_1, S_req) plane.

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced phase-space distribution from the VLL width using standard freeze-in kinematics (or compute it with a tool like the CLASS-compatible freeze-in distribution machinery), map to a free-streaming scale, and compare against Lyman-alpha warm-dark-matter bounds for the light-M_AH benchmark points.

members.model_name: Superweak sterile-neutrino dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for Z-prime-mediated freeze-in production of N1 to obtain f(p), derive the resulting transfer-function suppression (or a validated thermal-WDM equivalent mass), and check it against Lyman-alpha warm-dark-matter bounds.

members.description: The MESA modifications used to generate mirror-star benchmark profiles (rescaled opacities, nuclear reaction rates, and equation of state for the Mirror Twin Higgs particle content) are not public, so mirror-star radius/core-temperature predictions cannot be scanned over mirror-sector parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a MESA extension with mirror microphysics parameterized by v'/v and the mirror electron mass, and publish grids of mirror-star profiles over mass, age, and composition.

members.model_name: Simplified light FIMP with entropy-modified decay production
members.description: The parameter-to-transfer-function pipeline (collision-term solver plus the neural-network maps) is distributed only as undocumented arXiv ancillary files with no repository, tests, or pinned dependencies (reproducibility_level: partial), so the route cannot be rerun reliably by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the paper's collision-term integrator and neural-network weights as a documented public repository with examples that reproduce the A_3.5keV = 0.46 and N_sat = 63 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal secluded dark matter
members.description: No transport code computes TeV-PeV astrophysical neutrino attenuation and regeneration on the relic secluded-neutrino population as a function of m_phi, g_nu, theta_s, and source redshift distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend nuSQuIDS (or a comparable neutrino propagation code) with the secluded-sector nu-nu_s scattering cross sections and a relic-background target density to output absorbed spectra for standard source populations.

members.model_name: Neutron dark-decay light-scalar dark matter model
members.description: No public TOV/equation-of-state code implements the dark-matter-admixed neutron-star setup of this model — neutron-to-chi conversion equilibrium with scalar-mediated dark self-repulsion (z_chi) and Higgs-induced neutron-dark repulsion (z_n) — so the neutron-star constraint cannot be re-evaluated for new parameter points or equations of state.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's chemical-equilibrium condition and repulsion terms in an open TOV solver (e.g. extend a CompOSE-compatible EoS pipeline) parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, z_chi, z_n) over a family of nuclear equations of state, and validate against the paper's benchmark maximum-mass curves.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino self-interacting dark matter in double focus point BLSSM
members.description: No public tool computes the velocity-dependent sneutrino self-scattering cross section sigma_V/m(v) from the BLSSM spectrum: the light bilepton mediator (1-4 MeV against a 1-10 GeV sneutrino) puts the Yukawa scattering deep beyond the Born regime, and existing beyond-Born treatments (partial-wave solvers, the CLASSICS approximations) are standalone and not interfaced to SARAH/SPheno output.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the public CLASSICS semi-analytic Yukawa cross sections (or a numerical partial-wave Schroedinger solver) in a module that reads the SPheno/SARAH BLSSM spectrum (m_snu, m_eta1, effective coupling from T_eta/Y_eta) and returns sigma_V/m at v = 30, 900, 2000 km/s, validated against the paper's benchmarks.

members.model_name: Non-Self-Conjugate ultra-light scalar dark matter with neutrino mediator
members.description: No propagation code exists that goes beyond the homogeneous exponential attenuation: redshift evolution of the ultralight-scalar number density n_DM(z), energy redshifting of UHE neutrinos, and a realistic source-distance distribution are not implemented anywhere per the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a one-dimensional optical-depth integrator over redshift using the analytic u-channel cross section, n_DM(z) = rho_DM(z)/m_phi (rescaled by the scalar fraction f_phi), and AGN/GRB source-evolution functions, validated against the paper's exponential curves in the local limit.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational dark matter from curvature-perturbation PBHs
members.description: No configured pipeline computes the Hawking-emitted phase-space distribution of a generic purely gravitationally coupled particle chi with greybody and spin factors for the light (M_PBH < 1e9 g) PBHs of this model; the card uses simplified analytic yields.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure BlackHawk (or an equivalent public greybody evaporation code) with an added massive spin-s BSM degree of freedom to output the chi number yield and emitted momentum spectrum over the M_PBH, m_chi grid used by the card.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal Dirac-fermion freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public stellar energy-loss calculator computes chi pair emission from RG/HB stellar plasmas through the heavy dark-photon portal (plasmon decay and electron bremsstrahlung with in-medium photon dispersion), which is the dominant low-mass constraint for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable stellar-cooling module that folds the portal production rates with standard MESA RG/HB profiles and applies the standard dark-luminosity criteria, calibrated to reproduce the rel_1908_00553 keV-scale exclusions for benchmark m_Aprime = 3 m_DM and alpha_D choices.

members.model_name: Heavy dark-photon portal complex-scalar freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public stellar energy-loss calculator computes complex-scalar pair emission from RG/HB stellar plasmas through the heavy dark-photon portal (plasmon decay and electron bremsstrahlung with in-medium photon dispersion), which is the dominant low-mass constraint for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable stellar-cooling module that folds the portal production rates (with scalar final-state phase space) into standard MESA RG/HB profiles and applies standard dark-luminosity criteria, calibrated to reproduce the rel_1908_00553 keV-scale exclusions for benchmark m_Aprime = 3 m_DM and alpha_D choices.

members.model_name: Axion Quark Nugget dark matter with magnetar-triggered FRB scenario
members.description: The solar EUV/soft-X-ray test relies on quoted energy-budget coincidences (L_corona ~ 1e27 erg/s); there is no quantitative emission code for anti-nugget annihilation in coronal plasma producing spectra that could be fit to quiet-Sun data.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a model of anti-nugget annihilation emission in the solar corona (annihilation depth, spectral shape, nanoflare statistics) as a function of B and rho_DM, and compare it statistically to SDO/AIA and soft-X-ray quiet-Sun observations rather than to the integrated power alone.

members.model_name: Minimal PQ-NMSSM light singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: The minimal PQ-NMSSM singlet sector (tadpole/mass terms from PQ breaking instead of the Z3 kappa S^3 term) is implemented only in a private modification of NMSSMTools 3.1.0; the spectrum, mixings, and benchmark contours cannot be reproduced with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PQ-NMSSM superpotential (lambda S H_u H_d + mu_S^2 S, no singlet self-couplings) in a public spectrum chain — either the general-NMSSM mode of NMSSMTools or SARAH-generated SPheno — and validate against the paper's benchmark invisible-width and sigma_SI contours.

members.model_name: Earth-shielded plasma dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the Earth-shielded velocity distribution: the collisional cutoff v_c and the annual/diurnal time dependence of the shielding factor from dark-electron Coulomb scattering on an Earth-bound dark-ion (mirror-helium) profile are handled only by the paper's private semi-analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a transport/Monte Carlo solver that propagates halo mirror electrons through a parameterized Earth-bound density profile n_He_prime(r) with dark-Coulomb (Rutherford) cross sections, outputting the detector-frame shielded distribution and its sidereal/annual time dependence; validate against the benchmark v_c near 30000 km/s for surface densities of 1e12-1e13 cm^-3.

members.model_name: Astrophysical Q-ball dark matter
members.description: No numerical boundary-value solver for Q-ball field profiles beyond the thin-wall limit, needed to obtain mass density, M_Q, and R_Q from the scalar potential and to apply the stability filter.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a shooting/relaxation ODE solver for the radial Q-ball equation over the (potential parameters, omega) space, validated against the analytic thin-wall limit and the stability criterion dM/dQ, and release profile tables of M_Q(Q), R_Q(Q), and rho(r).

members.model_name: Optically thin mirror-star nugget emission model
members.description: The radiative-transfer treatment covers only optically thin nuggets; the optically thick part of the (M_nugget, Gamma_heat) scan is explicitly deferred by the paper, so signal predictions are unavailable in that regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the published Cloudy-based pipeline with a stellar-atmosphere-style optically thick radiative-transfer solution for high-mass nuggets, matching onto the optically thin results at the regime boundary of the existing scan.

members.model_name: Extra-dimensional sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No public beta-decay recast tool covers this model's regime: evaluating the KATRIN/TRISTAN kink signature requires an experiment-specific response model (resolution, molecular final states, backgrounds) plus summation of multiple kink contributions from the dense KK tower, none of which is available per the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a KK-tower-summed sterile admixture spectrum in a public KATRIN/TRISTAN-like beta-spectrum response code, taking the mixing matrix from step_kk_spectrum and returning kink amplitudes/positions with a sensitivity likelihood for con_beta_decay_sensitivity.

members.model_name: Exothermic Yukawa-potential interacting dark matter
members.description: No public cross-section calculator handles inelastic Yukawa scattering between split dark states (up- and down-scattering with splitting delta), including the quantum coupled-channel and resonant regimes where the classical analytic fit used by the paper breaks down.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing partial-wave Yukawa sigma_T(v) solver to a two-state coupled-channel Schroedinger calculation parameterized by (m_chi, m_phi, alpha_d, delta), releasing tabulated elastic and inelastic transfer cross sections that reduce to the YIDM elastic result as delta goes to 0.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated low-energy SUSY with light gravitino dark matter component
members.description: No spectrum-generator implementation exists for the vector-mediated SUSY-breaking boundary conditions (U(1) D-term sector with E6-inspired matter), so soft masses and the Higgs-mass prediction cannot be computed from (F, charges, messenger scale) with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vector-mediation model in SARAH and generate a SPheno (or FlexibleSUSY) module encoding the tree-level vector-mediated soft terms as high-scale boundary conditions, validated against the paper's benchmark spectra with m_3/2 ~ 1-2 eV and m_h ~ 125 GeV.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter from linear non-minimally coupled inflaton decay
members.description: The LanHEP/CalcHEP model files and the beta-scan scripts behind the allowed beta-m_DM region are not public, so the paper's numerical allowed intervals for the scalar case (m_DM ~ 5.3e-6 GeV x beta^(5/4)) can only be reproduced by re-deriving the scaling relations by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the linear non-minimal coupling vertices in LanHEP/FeynRules, regenerate the spin-dependent decay widths in CalcHEP, and script the beta scan (inflation observables, heating temperature, yield, relic target) as a small public notebook validated against the paper's quoted mass-beta scalings.

members.model_name: Kinetic-misalignment majoron dark matter in gauged U(1)Lmu-Ltau
members.description: No numerical solver or parameter scanner exists for the rotating B-L scalar condensate history: the trapping temperature, the persistence of rotation through the leptogenesis epoch, and the transition to coherent majoron oscillation are handled only by the paper's analytic n=6 benchmark, yet the route requires a 'parameter scanner for rotating scalar history'.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an ODE solver for the complex scalar in its radial potential plus explicit c_n S^n/M^(n-4) breaking term coupled to the thermal background, tracking Y_B-L, the trapping temperature, and Omega_J h^2 across (S_i, m_S, n, f), and validate by recovering the paper's Y_B ~ 9e-11 and n=6 viable regions including the rotation-halting exclusion.

members.model_name: Mirror-star-forming mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: No public mirror-star stellar-structure code exists; the benchmark profiles rely on private adaptations of SM stellar modeling, so radius and core temperature cannot be scanned over mirror-sector parameters (mirror Higgs vev, mirror electron mass).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend MESA with rescaled mirror microphysics (opacities, nuclear rates, and equation of state rescaled for the mirror QED/QCD parameters of the asymmetrically reheated MTH benchmark) and release the resulting mirror-star model grids.

members.model_name: Reheating-produced nuMSM sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver of the HNL density-matrix kinetic equations covers this model's setup: N2/N3 oscillation baryogenesis with an operator-set initial HNL abundance at reheating; the step is currently done with private/paper-level numerics, so the BAU observable cannot be scanned in a registry pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public density-matrix leptogenesis solver for GeV-scale HNL oscillations to accept a nonzero initial N_I density matrix set by (A_IJ, T_R, Lambda), and validate against the vanishing-initial-abundance nuMSM limit.

members.model_name: Weakly coupled B-L gauge-boson freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Testing ARS compatibility requires a leptogenesis kinetic solver that includes the new B-L gauge-scattering equilibration terms for N2/N3; public ARS density-matrix codes implement only Yukawa-mediated rates, so the 'B-L interactions too slow to erase the asymmetry' condition is checked only by leading-rate estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Add thermally averaged B-L gauge-boson production/scattering rates for the sterile states to a public ARS density-matrix solver (AMIQS-type code) and rerun the baryon-asymmetry scan over (g_B-L, m_V, Yukawas) to delimit the safe region quantitatively.

members.model_name: Low-reheat Standard Model neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No public kinetic-equation solver reproduces active-neutrino production during MeV-scale reheating (weak collision integrals plus entropy injection from the decaying field); the paper's f_nu(p,t) code is private, so users must rely on the published abundance fits and effective-temperature parameterization rather than recomputing spectra at arbitrary T_RH.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the low-reheat neutrino kinetic equations in a public momentum-resolved code (e.g. extend pyBBN or a LASAGNA-style solver with a decaying-field entropy source), validated against the paper's n_nu/n_eq fit and the departure-from-equilibrium onset below T_RH of about 8 MeV.

members.model_name: Compressed-stau No-Scale F-SU(5) bino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum calculator implements the No-Scale F-SU(5) framework with vector-like flippon multiplets and No-Scale boundary conditions; the paper used a proprietary SuSpect modification, so the chain from (M_1/2, M_V) to the sparticle spectrum, bino fraction, and 0-2 GeV stau-neutralino mass gap cannot currently be reproduced publicly.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the flippon field content and No-Scale F-SU(5) boundary conditions in SARAH/SPheno (or release the modified SuSpect), including the flippon-modified RGEs, and validate against the benchmark spectra tabulated in arXiv:1311.1164.

members.model_name: Minimal U(1)' strictly anomaly-mediated wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No public spectrum calculator implements the strict anomaly-mediated U(1)' model: the U(1)' D-term contributions to scalar masses, the extra singlet superfields, and the charge-assignment dependence (q_L) that fix m_LSP/m_3/2 and the Higgs mass are handled only by paper-level estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)'-extended strict-AMSB boundary conditions (anomaly-mediated soft terms plus U(1)' D-term shifts for given charge assignments) as a model file in SARAH/SPheno or a SoftSUSY extension, validating against the paper's m_LSP about 3.3e-3 m_3/2 relation and Higgs-mass discussion.

members.model_name: A4 discrete dark matter scalar WIMP model
members.description: No scan pipeline implements the combined flavor and scalar-sector filter for this model: fitting the A4 Yukawa parameters to neutrino oscillation data and charged-lepton masses while imposing the Higgs mass, boundedness, perturbativity, and the >300 GeV non-DM scalar cuts must be built before viable DM parameter points can be certified.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a chi-squared scan over the A4 Yukawa and potential parameters using public NuFIT oscillation chi-squared tables as the likelihood, with analytic boundedness/unitarity conditions and the Higgs-mass constraint as filters, validated by reproducing the paper's benchmark table.

members.model_name: Inflaton-produced scalar dark matter
members.description: No public numerical pipeline evolves the chi mode functions through T-model inflation and reheating (tachyonic excitation plus post-inflation production from inflaton oscillations) to output the nonthermal phase-space distribution f_chi(k) as a function of (m_chi, lambda/xi, m_phi, T_reh); the calculation currently exists only as the paper's in-house analytic/numerical approximations.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a Bogoliubov/mode-function solver (Mathieu-type mode equation on the T-model inflaton background with m_eff^2 = m_chi^2 + lambda phi^2 + R/6) that tabulates f_chi(q) and its moments over the parameter grid, validated against the paper's quoted <q^2> asymptotics.

members.model_name: Framed Standard Model hidden-sector dark matter candidates
members.description: No numerical implementation of the Framed Standard Model framon action, RG running, and Z-G/Higgs mixing exists, so the hidden-sector spectrum (17 MeV, sub-8 MeV, and TeV states) and mixing elements cannot be computed reproducibly from zeta_S and the RGE inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the FSM RGE mass functions and mixing-matrix solution as a standalone spectrum code (analogous to a SARAH/SPheno-style spectrum generator for this non-standard framework), validated against the published fit values for zeta_S near 2 TeV.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac transition-dipole freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public calculator exists for the Solar upscattering flux of the heavier pseudo-Dirac state: chi1 -> chi2 inelastic dipole scattering on Solar constituents, propagation, and the resulting excited-state flux at Earth are available only as the paper's private semi-analytics.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Solar dark-matter scattering Monte Carlo such as DaMaSCUS-SUN to inelastic transition-dipole (EDM/MDM) cross sections with O(keV) splitting, outputting the excited-state flux at Earth as a function of (m_DM, delta, d_chi, mu_chi).

members.model_name: Speed-breaker inflationary primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the speed-breaker (base-plus-localized-bump/dip) potentials exists in a Mukhanov-Sasaki solver, so the exact curvature power spectrum — which cannot be computed in slow-roll because the feature violates it locally — cannot be reproduced or scanned over feature height, width, and location.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the V(phi)=V_b(phi)[1+delta(phi)] Gaussian-bump family (with the KKLT and alpha-attractor base potentials) in an existing exact-perturbation solver such as PyTransport or a stand-alone Mukhanov-Sasaki integrator, and validate against the paper's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: SU(5) inflection-point inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The SU(5) nonminimal inflection-point inflaton potential is not implemented in any public inflationary perturbation solver, so the enhanced P_zeta(k) spike — the single input driving M_PBH, f_PBH, and Omega_GW(f) — cannot be recomputed or scanned; only the paper's benchmark tables exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Einstein-frame SU(5) singlet potential with nonminimal coupling xi phi^2 R in a numerical mode-evolution code (PyTransport or MultiModeCode style) that handles ultra-slow-roll near the inflection point, validating against the benchmark n_s, r ~ 0.025, and quoted spike amplitude.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter
members.description: The singlet-doublet Majorana model implementation used for annihilation event generation (MadGraph model files with the lambda, lambda-prime, m_D, m_N mixing sector and off-shell WW*/tt* channels) is not identified as publicly released, so the implemented route cannot be reproduced or extended by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Recreate the singlet-doublet model in FeynRules and publish the UFO/CalcHEP files, validating 2-to-2 static-limit rates and the three-body W f f-prime and t b W channels against the primary paper's benchmarks.

members.model_name: Singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter
members.description: The modifications to WimpSim that propagate the model's three-body annihilation event records through the Sun to detector-level neutrino and muon spectra are private, so the off-shell-threshold spectral shapes cannot be regenerated from public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the event-record injection in the public WimpSim (or a modern equivalent such as the charon/HDMSpectra-based solar pipelines), reproducing the primary paper's Super-K and DeepCore detector comparisons, and release the patch.

members.model_name: SO(10) split-SUSY neutralino dark matter with non-universal gaugino masses
members.description: No public spectrum-generation pipeline implements the SO(10) generalized-gravity-mediation boundary conditions (non-universal gaugino ratios M1:M2:M3 plus threshold corrections) down to the weak-scale split-SUSY spectrum, so the paper's GUT-filtered scan cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the SO(10) high-dimensional-operator gaugino-mass ratios as boundary conditions in FlexibleSUSY or SARAH/SPheno with split-SUSY matching, and validate by reproducing the paper's M2-mu relic strips for M_S = 30-200 TeV.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic axion-like dark matter
members.description: No public long-baseline oscillation code implements the time-dependent matter potential induced by a coherent Galactic ALP background with derivative coupling g_alpha_beta, including the transition between coherent and stochastic-phase regimes across the m_a range and a DUNE-like experimental likelihood with systematics, so the primary sensitivity forecast cannot be reproduced or turned into constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend GLoBES (or a nuSQuIDS-based propagator) with an ALP potential term H_ALP(t) = g_alpha_beta a0 m_a cos(m_a t) sampled over the experiment exposure, with stochastic field-amplitude averaging for m_a above the coherence threshold, coupled to the public DUNE GLoBES configuration files; validate by recovering the paper's sensitivity contours down to g ~ 1e-12 eV^-1.

members.model_name: Inflection-point inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The exact background-plus-Mukhanov-Sasaki solver used to compute the ultra-slow-roll-enhanced P_R(k) for the sextic inflection-point potential is custom and unreleased, so the pipeline's first step is not reproducible as published.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the potential in a public single-field mode-by-mode solver (e.g. MultiModeCode or a PyTransport/aspic-style integrator) with exact background evolution through the ultra-slow-roll phase, validating against the slow-roll-failure comparison in the primary paper.

members.model_name: Twin waterfall scalar preheating dark matter
members.description: No public solver reproduces the preheating particle production of the stable waterfall scalar chi_2 during the tachyonic waterfall transition, which is the sole production channel (chi_1 decays to chi_2 pairs are kinematically blocked); the relic line over H_I ~ 2e8-1e10 GeV and lambda_H ~ 0.1-1e-7 rests on the source's un-released mode-equation calculation whose backreaction treatment the card flags as changing the result.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an open mode-function solver for the twin-waterfall transition (Bogoliubov evolution of chi_2 modes in the time-dependent chi_1 background, cross-checked with a CosmoLattice-style lattice run including backreaction), validated against the source waterfall-DM relic line with m_X = 1.2 m_1 and m_1 = 100 H_I, then chain it to the analytic reheating dilution step.

members.model_name: Electric-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: No public stellar energy-loss calculator exists for electric-dipole-coupled dark matter emission from red giants and horizontal-branch stars; the RG/HB dark-luminosity computation currently requires bespoke in-medium rate calculations on stellar profiles.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable stellar-cooling module that convolves dipole-operator production rates (plasmon decay, Compton-like and bremsstrahlung processes with in-medium photon dispersion) with standard MESA RG/HB stellar profiles, calibrated to reproduce the published keV-scale RG/HB bounds.

members.model_name: Magnetic-dipole freeze-in fermion dark matter
members.description: No public stellar energy-loss calculator exists for magnetic-dipole-coupled dark matter emission from red giants and horizontal-branch stars; the RG/HB dark-luminosity computation currently requires bespoke in-medium rate calculations on stellar profiles.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable stellar-cooling module that convolves magnetic-dipole production rates (plasmon decay and bremsstrahlung-like processes with in-medium photon dispersion) with standard MESA RG/HB stellar profiles, calibrated to reproduce the published keV-scale RG/HB bounds.

members.model_name: Composite millicharged absorption-line dark matter
members.description: No forward-model code exists for the dark forest: a halo line-of-sight calculator that turns transition data, halo density/velocity profiles, and state occupation into absorption spectra tau_nu(nu) toward background radio/mm sources.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a semi-analytic dark-forest pipeline combining a standard halo model (mass function, NFW profiles, Maxwellian velocities) with a line radiative-transfer module producing tau_nu and equivalent widths, validated against the primary paper's example line strengths and optical-depth scalings.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant QCD-like hidden-sector pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the classically scale-invariant multi-field inflaton dynamics (scalaron plus singlet S in the Jordan/Einstein frame) exists to compute the river-valley trajectory and its scalar/tensor perturbations for this specific potential.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's Jordan-frame potential and non-minimal couplings in an existing multi-field transport code such as PyTransport or MultiModeCode, verify the effective single-field river-valley reduction, and validate against the paper's r = 0.0017-0.0044 range for 50-60 e-foldings.

members.model_name: Pure SU(N) glueball dark matter with dark SU(N) stars
members.description: The dark SU(N) star mass-radius relation is only known in the large-N quartic-potential and time-averaged approximations; the Einstein-Klein-Gordon DSS solver listed as a required code resource does not exist for the glueball effective potential, limiting the accuracy of DSS masses, radii, and hence f_max.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing numerical boson-star Einstein-Klein-Gordon solver to the effective scalar glueball potential V(phi) with large-N scaling, and recompute the DSS mass-radius curve and contact frequency across the (m, N) plane, validating against the paper's analytic limits.

members.model_name: No-scale U(1) B-L hybrid-inflation gravitino dark matter
members.description: No reusable public calculator exists for the metastable cosmic-string SGWB spectrum Omega_GW(f) as a function of G mu_CS and sqrt(kappa) in this model's window (sqrt(kappa) about 7.4-9.0); the paper's semi-analytic spectrum calculation is not released as code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the metastable-string loop spectrum (monopole-pair breaking with the standard loop-production functions) as a public module, e.g. by extending the metastable-string templates in PTArcade or packaging the Buchmuller-Domcke-Schmitz-type calculation with configurable loop and decay modeling.

members.model_name: Nonminimally coupled scalarized cold-dark-matter field
members.description: No public modified-TOV neutron-star structure solver exists for this nonminimal coupling, so scalarized mass-radius, ADM-mass, and surface-gravity predictions cannot be generated across equations of state and coupling parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing DEF-scalarization TOV shooting code to the F(phi)R coupling and potential of this model, scanning central density, EOS, and coupling parameters to tabulate ADM mass, radius, surface gravity, and scalar charge.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from hybrid-inflation waterfall dynamics with higher-dimensional inflaton terms
members.description: No public code computes the small-scale curvature power spectrum generated during the hybrid-inflation waterfall transition including the quadratic and cubic inflaton-potential terms; the paper relies on its own classical equation-of-motion numerics, so P_zeta(k) cannot be regenerated across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement mode-by-mode numerical integration of the coupled inflaton-waterfall perturbations (or a stochastic delta-N treatment of the waterfall) for the potential with mu_1, mu_2, mu_3 terms, e.g. as an extension of a multi-field inflation solver such as PyTransport, and release it with the paper's tuned benchmark for validation.

members.model_name: Primordial black-hole dark matter from stiff-era reheating collapse
members.description: No available code computes the scalar-induced GW spectrum Omega_GW(f) through a stiff era with arbitrary 1/3 < w <= 1 including the transition matching onto radiation domination; existing public induced-GW solvers are built for radiation-dominated kernels and the paper's own implementation is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend SIGWfast (or implement the second-order tensor Green-function kernels) for general constant w with mode matching at T_r, validating against the paper's w=1 spectra and the analytic radiation-era limit.

members.model_name: Dynamical dark matter MATHUSLA toy ensemble
members.description: No implemented MATHUSLA acceptance pipeline exists for the DDM toy ensemble: computing per-component decay probabilities in the surface-detector volume from the parent production and boost distributions is currently a paper-level projection with assumed zero background and perfect efficiency.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the parent-particle production in MadGraph/Pythia and fold the resulting chi_n boost spectra through the public MATHUSLA benchmark-geometry acceptance maps (as in the MATHUSLA physics-case study 1806.07396), summing over ensemble components with the scaling-law lifetimes.

members.model_name: Two-component boosted dark matter interpretation
members.description: No public forward-model code propagates a directional boosted chi_B flux through the Earth overburden with electron-scattering energy loss and detector orientation to predict the attenuated recoil spectrum and its daily modulation; the primary paper uses average rock densities and typical momentum-transfer-per-scatter estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing boosted/cosmic-ray dark-matter Earth-transport Monte Carlo (e.g. a DarkProp-style attenuation code) to vector-mediated chi_B-electron scattering, adding a layered Earth density profile, source-direction geometry, and detector-latitude time dependence to output attenuation factors and daily-modulation templates.

members.model_name: Conformal B-L pseudo-Goldstone dark matter
members.description: No assembled forward-model pipeline converts (m_DM, tau_DM) into a Galactic plus extragalactic neutrino flux for this model: the flux_model step has null tool_or_code and requires external halo, electroweak-cascade, and exposure assumptions not packaged anywhere.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine HDMSpectra (electroweak-corrected nu spectra for heavy DM decay) with standard NFW D-factor and cosmological line-of-sight integrals in a small script that outputs the differential neutrino flux per (m_DM, tau_DM) point.

members.model_name: Bino-like neutralino dark matter from modulus decay in the MSSM
members.description: No public code computes the effective three- and four-body modulus decay branching ratios into MSSM sparticle cascades ending in the bino-like LSP as a function of the sparticle spectrum, which the card identifies as the limiting calculation for B_DM.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the modulus with its W^a W_a and H_1 H_2 couplings in a FeynRules/SARAH model file and use CalcHEP or MadGraph to compute the higher-order partial widths over MSSM spectra, packaging the effective B_DM as a scan-ready module.

members.model_name: R-symmetric GUT Higgs inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No released implementation of the R-symmetric GUT Higgs no-scale-like supergravity potential exists for a public multifield transport code, so the ultra-slow-roll background trajectory and enhanced P_R(k) — on which both observables depend exponentially — cannot currently be reproduced from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the paper's Einstein-frame two-field potential (superpotential with the leading S H^3 term plus |S|^4 and |S|^6 Kahler corrections) in a public transport package such as PyTransport or CppTransport, and validate against the paper's benchmark n_s, r, A_s, and P_R(k) peaks.

members.model_name: Non-singular-bounce generated primordial black hole dark matter scenario
members.description: No public code implements the loop-corrected and resummed primordial scalar power spectrum of the contraction/non-singular-bounce plus SR-USR-SR history, so the spectrum — the input to every downstream observable — cannot be regenerated for sound speeds, USR durations, or transition wavenumbers other than the paper's examples.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's EFT mode functions and one-loop regularization/renormalization/resummation formulas in a released numerical package parameterized by (c_s, A, N_Total, transition wavenumber), validated against the quoted peak amplitudes A = 1e-3 to 1e-2 and the 0.88 <= c_s <= 1 scan.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter with radiative decay
members.description: No reusable public pipeline couples the sterile-neutrino decay X-ray background to primordial gas chemistry: the paper's benchmark H2/cooling results come from a private gas-evolution code, so the first-star collapse-threshold observable cannot be re-evaluated at other parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay X-ray flux (from m_s, theta, f_s and the halo/IGM geometry) as an ionization and heating source in a public primordial chemistry solver such as Grackle or KROME within a one-zone top-hat collapse model, reproducing the paper's benchmark minimum cooling halo masses as validation.

members.model_name: Pure gravity mediation neutral wino dark matter
members.description: The loop-level wino-nucleon scattering prediction (sigma_SI ~ 1e-46-1e-48 cm^2 including two-loop gluon contributions) exists only as published formulas, with no public code producing Wilson coefficients for the heavy-Higgsino/scalar decoupling limit.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the Hisano et al. electroweak-loop matching (including two-loop gluon operators) into a small public module feeding DirectDM/DDCalc, parameterized by m_wino and M_SUSY with nucleon matrix-element inputs.

members.model_name: Hidden U(1)_H bosonic H2 dark matter for radiative neutrino mass
members.description: The joint neutrino-oscillation fit, LFV branching-ratio computation, and loop-induced Z' leptonic branching-ratio calculation were performed with private scan code; no public tool reproduces the correlated f_ij scan that selects allowed points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the radiative neutrino-mass loop and the one-loop Z'-lepton vertex in a SARAH/SPheno (FlavorKit) model or a standalone public scan package, imposing current oscillation best fits, l_i -> l_j gamma limits, and the g < 4 perturbativity cut to reproduce the paper's branching-ratio scatter.

members.model_name: Primordial extremal black holes with dark electromagnetism
members.description: No public Hawking-emission code computes spectra for near-extremal dark-U(1)-charged Reissner-Nordstrom black holes (suppressed temperature, dark-photon greybody factors), which are needed both for the residual emission of surviving remnants and for the burst spectrum of non-extremal merger products.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a BlackHawk-style Hawking-spectrum code to the dark-Reissner-Nordstrom metric, adding near-extremal temperature suppression, charged-particle greybody factors, and the dark-photon emission channel, validated against the ordinary Schwarzschild limit at zero charge.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with right-handed scalar mediator Model 1
members.description: No public implementation of the baryon-ChPT form factors and exclusive amplitudes for hyperon dark decays (invisible, pionic, radiative) induced by the d_R d_R chi-u_R dimension-six operators of Model 1; branching fractions currently require redoing the paper's calculation by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's ChPT amplitudes for B -> chi(+pi/gamma) as a small open-source package (Wilson coefficients in, exclusive branching fractions out), validated against the paper's quoted rates, so it can be reused across the Model 1-3 operator basis.

members.model_name: Primordial black-hole dark matter from multi-field sharp-turn inflation
members.description: There is no validated public pipeline that evolves the two-field sharp-turn/step benchmarks to P_R(k); the paper's perturbation solver is private and sharp features stress the time-stepping of generic transport codes.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the turn-rate-pulse parameterization (N_turn, eta_perp, Delta N) in PyTransport or MultiModeCode, validate against the paper's benchmark P_R(k) peaks and the three-turn/four-turn statements, and release the configuration.

members.model_name: Post-recombination superheavy scalar dark matter decaying to gravitons
members.description: No public code computes graviton-photon (inverse Gertsenshtein) conversion probabilities along lines of sight through realistic Galactic magnetic-field and plasma models; only the ALP-photon analogue is implemented, and the conversion probability dominates the flux prediction's uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the gammaALPs mixing-matrix framework, which already ships Jansson-Farrar-type Galactic field and electron-density models, to the spin-2 graviton-photon mixing case, and propagate the sub-PeV decay spectrum to sky-averaged conversion probabilities with field-model variations.

members.model_name: Negative-m0-squared mSUGRA gravitino superWIMP dark matter
members.description: The negative-m_0^2 mSUGRA boundary condition is only implemented in the authors' private ISAJET modification, so no public spectrum generator is documented to evolve m_0^2 < 0 inputs to non-tachyonic weak-scale spectra with correct NLSP identification for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Add m_0^2 < 0 GUT-scale input handling (with weak-scale tachyon vetoing) to a maintained public spectrum generator such as SoftSUSY or SPheno and validate against the paper's Model A/B benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: U(1)_H-stabilized WIMPZILLA with dark radiation
members.description: No public calculator exists for the nonthermal superheavy WIMPZILLA abundance in this model's m_DM ~ 10^12-10^14 GeV, T_R ~ 10^9 GeV window; the card inherits the abundance from cited literature estimates, so the relic observable cannot be recomputed across the (m_DM, T_R, inflationary-history) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard gravitational/inflationary superheavy-production formulas from the cited WIMPZILLA literature (hep-ph/9802238 lineage) as a small numerical module parameterized by m_DM, T_R, and H_inf, and validate it against the quoted 10^12-10^14 GeV abundance window.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with scalar mediator Model 2
members.description: No public implementation of the baryon-ChPT form factors and exclusive amplitudes for hyperon dark decays (invisible, pionic, radiative) induced by Model 2's left/right quark-chi operators (O_ab, Ostar_ab); branching fractions currently require redoing the paper's calculation by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's ChPT amplitudes for B -> chi(+pi/gamma) as a small open-source package (Wilson coefficients in, exclusive branching fractions out), validated against the paper's quoted rates, covering both chiralities of the Model 1-3 operator basis.

members.model_name: Higgsed dark photon gravitational-production dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the gravitationally produced longitudinal dark-photon spectrum with a Higgsed, time-dependent mass history m_A_prime(t); existing gravitational-production results cover the Stueckelberg or decoupled-Higgs limits, so the two-peak energy-density spectrum and relic mass window cannot be recomputed or scanned without rebuilding the paper's mode-equation integrator.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a longitudinal-mode ODE integrator over inflation and reheating parameterized by H_I, g, t_c, and the dark-Higgs VEV time law, validated by recovering the Stueckelberg spectrum in the small-g limit and the paper's quoted mass window at H_I = 1e14 GeV.

members.model_name: Singlet scalar dark matter from waterfall preheating and decay
members.description: No public solver exists for the mode-equation preheating calculation of S production during the waterfall transition (time-dependent effective mass m_S,eff^2 = m_S,0^2 + lambda_S chi_1(t)^2); the relic prediction relies on the source's un-released numerical treatment, and its assumption caveat warns that different waterfall dynamics or backreaction shift the relic line.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an open mode-function solver for particle production across the waterfall transition (Bogoliubov mode equations with the chi_1(t) background, or a lattice run in CosmoLattice for the tachyonic regime with backreaction), validated against the source benchmarks at H_I = 1e6 and 1e8 GeV with lambda_H = 1e-2, and couple its yield to the perturbative chi_1 -> S S decay source term.

members.model_name: Dark-quark-nugget dark binaries with a long-range dark force
members.description: No reusable semi-analytic code exists for primordial dark-binary formation and merger-rate evolution of macroscopic dark matter (dark quark nuggets) including an attractive long-range dark force and model-dependent charge-to-mass assignments; the calculation is currently done only via the paper's bespoke analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the standard primordial-black-hole binary-formation semi-analytic formalism into a public code that adds dark-charge configurations and the extra 1/r dark force to the three-body decoupling and torque calculation, parameterized by (M, f, alpha, charge-to-mass ratio, initial separation distribution), outputting merger-rate histories R(z).

members.model_name: Scalar-graviton soft-core halo dark matter
members.description: No forward-model and fitting pipeline exists that combines the scalar-graviton soft-core profile P_h(r) with galaxy-specific baryonic components and fits observed rotation curves; the profile has only been verified as a vacuum solution, so its parameters (R_h, rho_h(0)) have never been confronted with galaxy data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the soft-core profile as a halo component in a SPARC-based rotation-curve fitting framework (ODE solution for P_h plus standard disk/bulge/gas decompositions), and fit the galaxy sample to produce per-galaxy posteriors on R_h and rho_h(0) and a survey-level goodness-of-fit likelihood.

members.model_name: Secluded dark matter coupled to a hidden CFT
members.description: The saturated Sommerfeld boost factor from a tower of hidden mediators (masses m_n, couplings alpha_n) has no numerical implementation; only single-mediator approximations plus analytic tower arguments exist, limiting the reliability of the low-velocity annihilation prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Numerically solve the Schroedinger equation with the summed Yukawa potential of the KK/composite vector tower to obtain velocity-dependent and saturated boost factors, validated against the single-mediator Hulthen limit.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet fermionic UV/IR freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No code computes the effective line-of-sight density rho_eff for annihilation through a long-lived pseudoscalar that propagates an astrophysical decay length before decaying to photons, which is the distinctive morphology ingredient of the 3.5 keV cascade prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard J-factor calculator (e.g. CLUMPY or a custom line-of-sight integrator over a Milky Way halo model) with a displaced-decay kernel that convolves the annihilation profile with the pseudoscalar decay length, following the primary paper's rho_eff treatment.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with vector mediator Model 3
members.description: No public implementation of the baryon-ChPT form factors and exclusive amplitudes for hyperon dark decays (invisible, pionic, radiative) induced by the Fierzed quark-chi operators of the Model 3 vector mediator; branching fractions currently require redoing the paper's calculation by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's ChPT amplitudes for B -> chi(+pi/gamma) as a small open-source package (Wilson coefficients in, exclusive branching fractions out), validated against the paper's quoted rates, so it can be reused across the Model 1-3 operator basis.

members.model_name: Two-form-field inflationary primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public pipeline maps the inflaton-dependent two-form kinetic function I(phi) to the sourced small-scale curvature spectrum and the associated Omega_GW(k): the mode-function integration on the Starobinsky background, the source convolution integrals, and the two-form-specific GW diagrams exist only as the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a numerical solver for two-form mode growth under I(phi)^2 H^2 coupling with the sourced curvature and tensor convolution integrals (extending an existing inflationary perturbation code or SIGWfast-style induced-GW framework), validated by recovering the A about 3.2e-4, f_PBH=1 benchmark and the paper's Omega_GW peaks.

members.model_name: Solo-bumpy inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: PBHbounds constraints are compiled for monochromatic mass functions, and although the single-bump mass function is peaked, the finite-width f_PBH(M) still requires an extended-mass-function recast that is not wired into the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the PBHbounds pipeline with the standard Carr-et-al extended-mass-function method, integrating the predicted f_PBH(M) against each digitized monochromatic constraint curve to produce combined exclusions.

members.model_name: High-scale-inflation Q-ball dark matter and baryogenesis scenario
members.description: No public Q-ball property calculator exists for this scenario: the mass-charge relations M(Q) and R(Q) for gauge-mediation and new-type Q balls, stability against nucleon decay, evaporation/decay temperatures, and fragmentation charge estimates are scattered analytic formulae with no reusable implementation, which the card itself lists as a required code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the gauge-mediated and new-type Q-ball M(Q), R(Q), stability, decay-temperature, and fragmentation-charge formulae (with lattice-calibrated fragmentation coefficients from the literature) as a small public module parameterized by (M_F, m_3/2, lambda_G, lambda_N, T_RH), validated against the paper's Q_N ~ 1e23-1e31 and m_3/2 window.

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model I with (1,1,3)_D Dirac fermion
members.description: No implemented two-loop RGE pipeline for the SO(10) -> SU(4)_C x SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R breaking chain with the Model I (1,1,3)_D dark and Higgs field content, so M_int and M_GUT (and their threshold sensitivity) cannot be recomputed independently of the source paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the intermediate-scale field content in a two-loop RGE generator such as SARAH or PyR@TE, validate against the source Table scales (M_int ~ 10^8.08 GeV), and expose M_int(M_GUT) with threshold-correction bands as a reusable module.

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model I with (1,1,3)_D Dirac fermion
members.description: No proton-decay lifetime calculator exists for this model's dimension-six operators at the two-loop-determined M_GUT, so the proton-decay viability step is done only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gauge-boson-mediated d=6 proton-decay Wilson coefficients for this breaking chain, run them to the proton scale, combine with lattice nucleon matrix elements, and compare tau(p -> e+ pi0) against Super-Kamiokande limits and Hyper-Kamiokande projections.

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model II with (15,1,1)_W Weyl fermion
members.description: No implemented two-loop RGE pipeline for the SO(10) -> SU(4)_C x SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R chain with the Model II (15,1,1)_W dark multiplet and left-right Higgs content, so M_int (~10^13.66 GeV) and the raised M_GUT cannot be recomputed with controlled threshold corrections.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the field content in a two-loop RGE generator such as SARAH or PyR@TE, validate against the source Table scales, and expose M_int and M_GUT with threshold-correction uncertainty bands as a reusable module.

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model II with (15,1,1)_W Weyl fermion
members.description: No proton-decay lifetime calculator exists for this model's gauge-mediated dimension-six operators at the raised M_GUT > 10^15 GeV, so proton-decay viability is assessed only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the d=6 proton-decay Wilson coefficients for this breaking chain, run them to the proton scale, combine with lattice nucleon matrix elements, and compare tau(p -> e+ pi0) against Super-Kamiokande limits and Hyper-Kamiokande projections.

members.model_name: SU(2)_L quintet fermion minimal dark matter with Higgs inflation
members.description: The RG-improved Higgs-inflation prediction (n_s = 0.9672, r = 0.0031) including quintet and right-handed-neutrino threshold effects and a consistent reheating-determined e-folding number exists only as the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-loop SM RGEs extended with the quintet and seesaw contributions (generated with PyR@TE or SARAH), match to the RG-improved effective potential in the Einstein frame, and compute slow-roll n_s and r with the reheating-consistent e-fold count, validating against the paper's benchmark values.

members.model_name: Nonthermal sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No X-ray decay-line flux pipeline (decay rate, target D-factors, instrument response) is attached to the card, so the mass-mixing X-ray exclusion can only be transcribed from literature curves rather than re-evaluated for arbitrary (m_s, sin^2 2theta, Omega_s).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the required 'X-ray decay-flux calculator': radiative decay rate as a function of m_s and mixing, folded with published diffuse-background and M31/cluster D-factors and flux limits, packaged so the exclusion curve can be regenerated for any production scenario.

members.model_name: Bosonic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: No public solver computes gravitational particle production for this bosonic X field: the Bogolyubov mode-equation integration for a minimally or conformally coupled scalar (xi=0 or 1/6) through chaotic inflation and the transition to the Friedmann stage, with smooth matching to avoid the artificial-particle problem the paper warns about at large m_X.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or release an existing group-internal) mode-function solver that evolves the scalar field equations on a numerically computed chaotic-inflation scale-factor history with smooth junctions, validated by reproducing the paper's n_X versus m_X/m_phi curves for xi=0 and xi=1/6.

members.model_name: Nonthermal wino dark matter in UV-insensitive anomaly-mediated NMSSM extension
members.description: No public spectrum generator implements the UV-insensitive anomaly-mediated NMSSM with vector-like D and L fields, so the wino-LSP region, EWSB viability, and charged-neutral splitting rest on the paper's analytic scan rather than a reproducible numerical spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the superpotential and AMSB soft terms of the vector-like NMSSM extension in SARAH and generate a SPheno spectrum module, validating against the paper's viable-EWSB and wino-LSP contours.

members.model_name: Deflected anomaly-mediated bino neutralino dark matter
members.description: Deflected-AMSB boundary conditions (F_phi, A_X, deflection parameter d, N_f messenger thresholds) are not implemented in any current public spectrum generator; the original scan relied on ISAJET/ISASUGRA-era running that cannot be pinned or reproduced as-is.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the deflected-AMSB high-scale soft terms with messenger-threshold corrections as a model file in SoftSUSY or SPheno (both accept general non-universal boundary conditions), validate against the paper's WMAP contour regions, and pin versions.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino WDM halo model
members.description: No public halo-model implementation includes this paper's WDM-calibrated ingredients (suppressed mass function, softened concentration-mass relation, modified subhalo terms) needed to produce the nonlinear P(k) and halo statistics for DW sterile-neutrino masses.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public halo-model code (e.g. halomod/pyHMcode or HMcode) with the paper's WDM mass-function, concentration, and subhalo calibrations, parameterized by the filtering mass M_f, and validate against the paper's 0.5-10 keV examples.

members.model_name: Superheavy scalar dark matter from R^2 inflation
members.description: No mode-function/Bogoliubov solver exists for gravitational particle production of a scalar with a scalaron-dependent effective mass at the end of R^2 inflation, so the occupation number, number density, and velocity dispersion of the superheavy relic cannot be computed beyond the paper's analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a numerical mode-equation solver on the Starobinsky R^2 background (evolve the scalaron and scale factor, solve the scalar mode functions through the nonadiabatic mass transition, extract Bogoliubov beta_k), following the standard gravitational-production framework of Chung-Kolb-Riotto/Ema et al., and validate against the paper's 1e16 GeV viable-abundance benchmark.

members.model_name: Type-III seesaw plus darkon Higgs-portal dark matter
