members.description: No public code implements the coupled RG evolution of the SM plus Type-III seesaw triplets plus darkon singlet, including the positive lambda_SH contribution to the Higgs-quartic beta function and the triplet threshold, so the vacuum-stability windows must be re-derived from the paper's formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate two-loop RGEs for the SM+Type-III-seesaw+singlet field content with PyR@TE or SARAH, include threshold matching at M_Sigma and M_S, and release an integration script validated against the paper's lambda_SH stabilization benchmark (lambda_S=0.1, lambda_SH>=0.031).

members.model_name: Long-lived scalar A neutrino-portal dark matter
members.description: Above M_A of about 8 TeV the card notes three- and four-body decays dominate, but no spectrum generator exists for these multi-body neutrino-portal final states including electroweak showering, so the simple line interpretation breaks down in the heavy-mass regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the three- and four-body decay matrix elements from the primary paper in a spectrum generator and convolve with HDMSpectra electroweak fragmentation to produce neutrino (and secondary gamma) spectra for M_A above 8 TeV up to the PeV benchmarks.

members.model_name: Unitarity-consistent spin-1 s-channel Dirac dark matter model
members.description: No public gauge-invariant UFO model implements the unitarity-safe spin-1 completion (restricted g_u^L = g_d^L couplings, induced WWZ-prime triple gauge vertex, or dark-Higgs mass generation), so mono-W event generation with arbitrary isospin-breaking couplings reproduces the spurious energy-growing amplitudes the paper corrects.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing spin-1 DMsimp-style FeynRules/UFO implementation with the WWZ-prime interaction proportional to g_u^L - g_d^L and an optional dark-Higgs sector, validate that the high-energy mono-W growth cancels, and release the UFO for MadGraph5_aMC@NLO.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant SU(2)_DM vector dark matter with leptogenesis
members.description: No quantitative ARS leptogenesis solver is set up for this model; the phi > 2.5 TeV lower bound rests on transferring Akhmedov-Rubakov-Smirnov results rather than solving the sterile-neutrino density-matrix equations for the scale-invariant scalar/Yukawa sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing ARS density-matrix code (kinetic equations for oscillating right-handed neutrinos) to this model's Y_D, Y_M structure and singlet-scalar-dependent M_N, and rederive the BAU-viable region of the hidden vev.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from EEFToI dispersion enhancement
members.description: No public mode-function solver handles the EEFToI dispersion relation with a transient negative quartic term stabilized by a sextic term, so the enhanced curvature power spectrum P_R(k) cannot be computed for new coefficient choices; every downstream quantity (mass function, f_PBH, induced GWs) depends on it.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated numerical integrator for the Mukhanov-Sasaki equation with omega^2(k, tau) including the time-dependent quartic and sextic spatial-derivative terms, with WKB initial conditions and an automatic check of the EFT-subdominance criterion, validated against the paper's benchmark spectra.

members.model_name: Gauged U(1)_R superheavy LSP dark matter
members.description: No spectrum calculation exists for the gauged U(1)_R SUGRA model at superheavy soft-mass scales (10^10-10^12 GeV): public SUSY spectrum codes target TeV-scale MSSM spectra and do not implement the Green-Schwarz-induced gaugino masses and inflatino/U(1)_R-gaugino mixing that determine the LSP identity.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in SARAH and generate a SPheno module implementing the U(1)_R vector multiplet, Green-Schwarz gaugino-mass terms, and inflatino mixing, then run RGEs to the 10^10-10^12 GeV soft scale to determine the LSP composition and mass for each Kaehler benchmark.

members.model_name: Long-lived radion dark matter in Randall-Sundrum cosmology
members.description: No solver exists for the post-inflation Randall-Sundrum radion background: evolving R(t) and Omega_R(t) through stabilization with the potential V(R) and brane matter densities, needed to determine the relic fraction and check overclosure/premature matter domination, is currently done only by hand in the primary.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated ODE integrator for the Einstein-frame scalar-tensor background (radion plus brane radiation/matter with couplings A(R), B(R)), scanning M_R, R_initial, and stabilization epoch, validated against the primary's matter-like scaling and the tau_R ~ 1.2e7 yr (GeV/M_R)^3 lifetime branch.

members.model_name: Resonant MSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with technically natural N2-N3 degeneracy
members.description: No public code solves the nuMSM kinetic equations that generate the required low-temperature lepton asymmetry (L/B ~ 3e5) from oscillations and decays of nearly degenerate GeV-scale N2/N3, so the input asymmetry for resonant N1 production cannot be computed from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a density-matrix kinetic-equation solver for the nuMSM (M, delta m_phys, Yukawa textures as inputs; late-time lepton asymmetry as output), building on published resonant-leptogenesis formalisms for GeV-scale HNLs.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant pseudoscalar WIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the classically scale-invariant scalar/Agravity sector: RG-improved running of the singlet quartics, Higgs portal, and non-minimal gravitational couplings f0/f2, and the resulting pseudo-Goldstone inflaton trajectory and mass spectrum, exist only in the source paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the model's RGEs (SARAH/RGBeta for the matter sector, adding the Agravity beta functions from the source literature) and code an RG-improved potential minimizer plus single-field slow-roll solver that outputs the mass spectrum, n_s, and r as functions of the input couplings.

members.model_name: Despicable dark relic non-minimally coupled scalar dark matter
members.description: No public solver evolves mode functions of a non-minimally coupled spectator scalar (xi R phi^2) through an oscillating-inflaton reheating background with tachyonic bursts, so the occupation spectrum entering everything downstream can only be reproduced by reimplementing the paper's private numerics.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a stiff-ODE mode-function solver that takes (xi, m_phi, H_inf, H_reh, reheating equation of state w) and outputs the tachyonic occupation spectrum n_k, validating against the paper's abundance contours for quadratic and quartic reheating; a linear-mode module on top of a lattice reheating code such as CosmoLattice would also serve.

members.model_name: Curvature-induced adiabatic scalar singlet dark matter
members.description: No public background solver evolves the non-minimally coupled singlet (m^2 chi^2 + xi R chi^2 + lambda chi^4) through inflation, reheating, and the quartic-to-quadratic oscillation transition to output Omega_chi h^2; the paper's integrator is private and tied to its two inflation templates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a released ODE integrator for the coupled inflaton-plus-spectator background (parameterized by m, xi, lambda, H_end, H_reh, and reheating equation of state), reproducing the paper's Omega_chi h^2 = 0.12 examples for MeV mass and |xi| of order one, and packaged so alternative inflation potentials can be swapped in.

members.model_name: Stable gravitationally produced superheavy scalar dark matter after non-minimal inflation
members.description: No public numerical code computes gravitational production of a conformally coupled superheavy scalar through the rapid post-inflationary Hubble-rate spikes of quartic non-minimal inflation; the exponentially suppressed Bogolyubov coefficient for m_chi > H_infl currently rests on the paper's analytic approximation and unreleased numerics, and the abundance is exponentially sensitive to this step.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or build a mode-function solver that evolves the chi field equation on the numerically computed non-minimal-inflation background (inflaton evolution with xi from 1 to about 100), extracts Bogolyubov coefficients through the spike phase, and scans m_chi/H_infl and reheating histories; validate against the paper's analytic exponential-suppression limit.

members.model_name: Axion-like dark matter coupled to ADR sterile neutrinos
members.description: No public QKE solver evolves the active-sterile density matrix with both an altered-dispersion-relation potential and a time-dependent sterile mass sourced by the oscillating scalar condensate; the primary paper's scans used an unreleased implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing momentum-dependent QKE code (e.g. LASAGNA or FortEPiaNO) with two new potential terms: the parameterized ADR potential epsilon-term and the m_s(t) contribution from the Bessel-function condensate solution, then validate against the primary paper's suppressed-population regions.

members.model_name: Complex scalar dark fluid
members.description: No halo-profile solver or rotation-curve fitting pipeline exists for the quadratic-regime complex-scalar (boson-star-like) halos of this model, so the claimed spiral-galaxy rotation-curve success cannot be tested against data.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the static Einstein-Klein-Gordon (or Newtonian Gross-Pitaevskii limit) equations for the rotating complex scalar in the quadratic-potential regime to produce circular-velocity profiles as functions of (m, omega, central density), then fit them to a standard rotation-curve compilation such as SPARC with a chi-square/likelihood pipeline.

members.model_name: SU(5) Goldstino split-SUSY Bino-Wino neutralino dark matter
members.description: No named public spectrum code implements the SU(5) Goldstino gaugino-mass boundary conditions with split-SUSY threshold matching needed to run GUT-scale ratios to the weak-scale M1, M2, M3 and neutralino mixing.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Goldstino-loop GUT boundary conditions as a model file in FlexibleSUSY (or the SoftSUSY split-SUSY mode) with split-SUSY matching at m_SUSY, validating against the paper's M1/M2 near-degeneracy surfaces.

members.model_name: Chiral vorton dark matter from Witten-type superconducting strings
members.description: No model-specific superconducting-string stability solver exists to evaluate whether chiral Witten-type vorton loops are classically and quantum-mechanically stable on cosmological timescales; both stability steps are currently done, at best, by hand-comparison to non-universal detailed-vorton papers.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a field-theoretic vorton stability code that solves the current-carrying loop equations of state for given carrier mass, loop charge, and potential parameters, computes the classical stability region (e.g. via the Carter-Peter equation-of-state criterion), and estimates quantum charge-loss/tunneling rates, exposing a stable-lifetime region in (Gmu, carrier mass, N) space.

members.model_name: No-Scale F-SU(5) Golden Point neutralino dark matter
members.description: The modified F-SU(5) spectrum generator (adapted SuSpect RGEs with flipped SU(5) x U(1)_X two-step unification, TeV vector-like multiplets, and no-scale M0=A=B_mu=0 boundary conditions) is not public, so the Golden Point spectrum feeding all downstream observables cannot be reproduced with released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the F-SU(5) field content and vector-like multiplet thresholds in SARAH to generate a SPheno spectrum module (or publish the modified SuSpect routines), enforce the no-scale boundary conditions at M_F, and validate against the published Golden Point (M_1/2=455.3 GeV, tan beta=15.02, Omega h^2=0.1123).

members.model_name: Hidden-condensate matter-parity-violating gravitino dark matter
members.description: No pipeline computes precision tau_NLSP and tau_3/2 from a full supersymmetric spectrum with the induced bilinear matter-parity violation; the card relies on approximate analytic lifetime formulae tied to a reference spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model point in a public RPV-capable spectrum and decay calculator (SPheno/SARAH with bilinear RPV) to compute NLSP decay widths, and add the supergravity gravitino RPV decay widths as a small post-processing module.

members.model_name: Fermionic Higgs-portal dark matter with singlet-scalar inflation
members.description: No public solver for the RGE-improved two-scalar inflationary sector: computing n_s, r, and the stability/monotonicity flag from (lambda_h, lambda_s, lambda_sh, y_chi, xi_h, xi_s) along the Higgs or singlet inflation axis requires reimplementing the paper's one-loop running plus non-minimal slow-roll analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the model's one-loop RGEs with SARAH/RGBeta, add the Einstein-frame potential with non-minimal couplings, and code a slow-roll solver that returns n_s, r, and vacuum-stability flags per scan point, validated against the paper's resonance-region benchmarks.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw GMSB gravitino dark matter with L H_u inflation
members.description: No public implementation of the type-III-seesaw GMSB model exists for computing BR(mu to e gamma) from the messenger Yukawa matrix Y_D, so the LFV messenger-mass window (3.21e11-2.28e12 GeV) cannot be independently reproduced or updated to MEG II sensitivity.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(5)-adjoint type-III messenger sector in SARAH and use the generated SPheno/FlavorKit code to compute BR(mu to e gamma) as a function of (M, Y_D, neutrino hierarchy), validating against the paper's quoted two-messenger window.

members.model_name: VAS supergravity a4 quartic-superpotential asteroid PBH dark matter
members.description: No released numerical pipeline solves the VAS a4 inflationary background and Mukhanov-Sasaki perturbations for the quoted superpotential W=A[a0+T^2+a3 T^3+a4 T^4+S(T+b2 T^2)]; the paper's benchmark-specific integration is not public, so P_R(k) — the input to every downstream step — cannot currently be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the VAS a4 scalar potential in a public single-field inflation solver (e.g. PyTransport, MultiModeCode, or a bespoke background+Mukhanov-Sasaki integrator) and validate against the quoted n_s=0.9636, r=0.0208, and the P_R peak slightly above 1e-2 at k~1e13 Mpc^-1.

members.model_name: VAS supergravity b3 quartic-superpotential asteroid PBH dark matter
members.description: No released numerical pipeline solves the VAS b3 inflationary background and Mukhanov-Sasaki perturbations for the quoted superpotential W=A[a0+T^2+a3 T^3+S(T+b2 T^2+b3 T^3)]; the paper's benchmark-specific integration is not public, so P_R(k) — the input to every downstream step — cannot currently be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the VAS b3 scalar potential in a public single-field inflation solver (e.g. PyTransport, MultiModeCode, or a bespoke background+Mukhanov-Sasaki integrator) and validate against the quoted n_s=0.9616, r=0.0216, and the P_R peak slightly above 1e-2 at k~1e13 Mpc^-1.

members.model_name: Smooth-crossover primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The scalar-induced GW spectrum through the crossover was computed with a non-public Julia code; no public induced-GW integrator handles the fully time-dependent w(t) and c_s^2(t) background this model requires.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain public release of the paper's Julia induced-GW code, or extend SIGWfast's kernel computation to arbitrary tabulated w(t)/c_s^2(t) thermal histories, validating on the pure-radiation limit and the paper's model A/B detector-band shift.

members.model_name: Charged-excitation WIMP Case A
members.description: No public calculator exists for exoergic WIMP-nucleus bound-state capture cross sections in the MeV mass-gap regime: the semiclassical approximation is only valid when many bound levels contribute, and outside that regime realistic nuclear charge distributions and wave functions are required.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a numerical capture-rate code solving the Schrodinger problem for the charged excitation in the nuclear Coulomb potential with realistic charge form factors for Xe, C, and O targets, computing level-resolved capture cross sections times velocity as a function of (Delta m, m_X, couplings) and validated against the paper's semiclassical limit.

members.model_name: Baryonic-vector scalar light dark matter benchmark
members.description: The nuclear-response modeling needed to convert the baryonic-vector dark-matter flux into quasi-elastic and deep-inelastic neutral-pion-like event distributions in mineral-oil or argon detectors is not covered by BdNMC alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface BdNMC fluxes with a neutrino-interaction generator's nuclear model (e.g. GENIE or NuWro form factors and final-state interactions) adapted to the baryonic-current vertex, to produce detector-level QE/DIS pi0-like distributions.

members.model_name: N2HDM Dark Doublet Phase
members.description: The NLO electroweak corrections to h_125 -> H_D H_D in the N2HDM dark doublet phase, shown in related work to be sizable for heavy dark charged scalars, exist only as a private calculation, so the precision invisible-Higgs constraint near BR < 0.11 cannot be evaluated with public tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the arXiv:2104.03184 one-loop electroweak corrections to the dark-scalar invisible width as a public extension of N2HDECAY (or a standalone module), validated against the published m_H_D near 62 GeV benchmark scans.

members.model_name: Hidden-SU(N) confinement induced scalar dark matter
members.description: No parameter-space scanner implements the model's analytic chain end-to-end (confinement-induced mass, T_osc = Lambda_N relic curve, lifetime map) over (Lambda_N, M, lambda_phi, QCD coupling ratio), so the viable eV-MeV region can only be read off the paper's figure rather than recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small scan notebook encoding the source's analytic mass, relic, and decay-rate formulas, validated by reproducing the paper's viable-region figure including the M < M_P reference condition, and expose it as the route's model-card calculator.

members.model_name: Three-24 type III GMSB gravitino cold dark matter
members.description: The mu -> e gamma prediction (BR > 1e-14) has no route or implemented pipeline from the type III seesaw Yukawa/messenger structure to a branching ratio comparable with current MEG II limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the type III seesaw GMSB model in SARAH/SPheno with FlavorKit to compute BR(mu -> e gamma) over the messenger-scale and Yukawa parameter space and compare against the current MEG II bound.

members.model_name: CMSSM with GUT-scale right-handed neutrino and neutralino-sneutrino coannihilation
members.description: No public spectrum generator implements the nuCMSSM RGE system used here: the GUT-scale right-handed neutrino with large y_N and universal RHN soft terms whose running drives the left tau sneutrino nearly degenerate with the neutralino LSP, which is the mechanism that creates the coannihilation strip.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the CMSSM-plus-one-RHN model in SARAH and generate a two-loop SPheno spectrum generator (or patch SOFTSUSY with the y_N/M_N RGE terms and RHN soft masses), validating by recovering the source's sneutrino coannihilation strip and the m_h = 114.4 GeV contour.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw GMSB gravitino dark matter with messenger inflation
members.description: The LFV/perturbativity leg of the exclusion (no viable three-messenger mass window) cannot be independently verified because no public code computes BR(mu to e gamma) for the type-III-seesaw GMSB messenger Yukawa sector; only the paper's own recast exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Reuse a SARAH/SPheno-FlavorKit implementation of the type-III-seesaw GMSB messenger sector (the same implementation needed for the viable L H_u branch card) to recompute the LFV and perturbativity windows as a function of messenger count and neutrino hierarchy.

members.model_name: N MACHOs
members.description: Microlensing and femtolensing constraints on N-MACHOs are proxied by monochromatic point-lens PBH limits; no likelihood exists that folds in the OGLE and Subaru/HSC survey detection efficiencies, finite-source and finite-lens-size effects, and an extended N-MACHO mass function in the 10^-16 to 10^-8 solar-mass window.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an event-rate likelihood from the published OGLE 5-year and Subaru/HSC M31 efficiency curves plus GRB femtolensing data, generalized to arbitrary lens mass functions and finite lens radii from the polytropic M-R relation, validated by recovering the published monochromatic PBH bounds.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector phase-transition axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: No microlensing likelihood exists for extended AU-scale lenses in this scenario; point-MACHO limits are not directly applicable and survey efficiencies were never assembled.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from published EROS/OGLE/HSC-Subaru microlensing survey efficiency functions with finite-size and extended-lens magnification corrections for the predicted (M_m, R_m, f_MC) population.

members.model_name: Light scalar dark matter clumps with angular momentum
members.description: No microlensing event-rate calculator or likelihood handling extended (finite-size) clump lenses is available; published Subaru HSC limits assume pointlike lenses, and the card's compactness constraint says extended clumps weaken direct application of those limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public HSC/OGLE microlensing event-rate code with finite-lens-size magnification for the angular-momentum-modified R_90(M, l) relation and standard-halo kinematics, producing exclusion curves in (M, R_90, halo fraction).

members.model_name: Cosmological gauge field dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or constraint mapping exists connecting the predicted CGF dark-star mass-radius population to observational compact-object data (microlensing, GW merger catalogs), so the dark-star branch of the route ends without any data comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: After unit verification, map the TOV mass-radius solutions onto existing compact-object constraint machinery: recast microlensing (OGLE/Subaru-HSC) and LIGO/Virgo subsolar or exotic-compact-object search limits as bounds on the CGF dark-star abundance fraction.

members.model_name: Early matter-dominated primordial black hole dark matter with non-Gaussian clustering
members.description: The constraint on f_PBH*sqrt(tau_NL) is applied only as a quoted approximate rewriting of the Planck CDM isocurvature bound; there is no implemented likelihood that ingests the clustered-PBH isocurvature spectrum (with its C_2 and scale dependence) into a Planck analysis, so precise, prior-robust allowed regions and BBN-consistent T_R joint constraints cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PBH-induced CDM isocurvature spectrum as an initial-condition option in CLASS/CAMB parameterized by (f_PBH, tau_NL, C_2, M_PBH) and constrain it with the Planck isocurvature likelihood in Cobaya, adding the BBN T_R > few MeV consistency check on the early matter-dominated reheating.

members.model_name: Heavy scalar dark matter from primordial-black-hole superradiance
members.description: The BBN/CMB filtering of the PBH parameter space (M_i below about 1e9 g, beta, injected relativistic energy) is done by overlaying literature exclusion curves rather than by any likelihood, so the allowed-region boundaries carry uncontrolled precision (card notes dedicated BBN/CMB/N_eff constraints are needed).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Hawking energy-injection constraints as a likelihood by feeding BlackHawk emission spectra for spinning PBHs into a BBN code (e.g. ACROPOLIS-style photodisintegration treatment) and a Delta N_eff calculation, producing a (M_i, beta, a_star) likelihood surface for the pre-BBN evaporation window.

members.model_name: Generalized no-scale inflation with PBH dark matter
members.description: No integrated likelihood exists for the final comparison step: PBH abundance constraint compilations, the NANOGrav 15-year stochastic-GW likelihood, LISA/Taiji/TianQin-band sensitivities, and Planck/BICEP-Keck n_s/r bounds are not wired into a single pipeline that scores a given (alpha, potential-parameter) point.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine a public PBH-bounds compilation (PBHbounds-class), the PTArcade interface to the NANOGrav 15-year data, interferometer power-law-integrated sensitivity curves, and the Planck n_s/r constraint into one joint likelihood evaluated on the outputs of the Mukhanov-Sasaki plus SIGW pipeline.

members.model_name: Halo axion-star QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No finite-size-lens microlensing recast pipeline exists that convolves the axion-star density profile (and its minihalo environment) with EROS/MACHO/OGLE/MOA event-selection efficiencies and finite-source effects to produce excluded dark-matter fractions as a function of M_AS and R_AS.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an extended-lens microlensing calculator that computes magnification light curves for the solved axion-star profiles, folds in published survey efficiency curves and cadences from EROS/MACHO/OGLE/MOA, and outputs an exclusion likelihood on the axion-star fraction; validate by recovering point-lens limits in the compact-radius limit.

members.model_name: Rolling-PQ axion-bubble PBH seed model
members.description: No likelihood or recast pipeline connects the clustered PBH/minicluster population to high-redshift quasar angular correlations and CMB isocurvature bounds; existing axion-bubble clustering limits were derived without the rolling-PQ large-scale suppression, and a PBH-to-quasar occupation and merger/accretion model is needed to compare with SMBH abundance data.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the z~6 quasar angular-correlation and isocurvature likelihoods from the cited clustering analyses with the rolling-transfer power spectrum as input, and build a light PBH-seed occupation plus accretion/merger growth module (calibrated on standard SMBH-seed semi-analytic models) to map f_PBH and the PBH mass function onto quasar abundance and clustering statistics.

members.model_name: Post-inflation PQ-breaking axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: No microlensing likelihood with survey selection functions and an extended-lens (finite-size) treatment exists for the predicted AU-scale minicluster population, including the special hundreds-of-solar-mass regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published EROS/OGLE/HSC-Subaru efficiency functions into a likelihood over (M_m, R_m, f_MC) with extended-lens magnification corrections replacing the point-lens approximation.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubbles from hidden SU(N)_H PQ breaking
members.description: No observational likelihood exists for the predicted clustered axion-minicluster population; existing minicluster microlensing analyses (e.g. HSC/OGLE) assume standard post-inflationary minicluster spectra, not the rare high-density bubble-seeded population, and the card notes no minicluster likelihood was found.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing microlensing (HSC, OGLE) and photometric-survey minicluster constraints for the bubble-seeded mass-and-density spectrum produced by gap_1's calibrated collapse model, packaging the result as a likelihood over (f_a, N, bubble fraction).

members.model_name: PBH sterile neutrinogenesis sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No implemented X-ray decay-line likelihood rescales published sterile-neutrino sin^2(2theta) limits by the PBH-produced fraction f_s and combines them with the Dodelson-Widrow subdominance condition, so the X-ray observable is only a qualitative bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the public X-ray line limits (e.g. NuSTAR, XMM blank-sky) as a likelihood in (m_s, sin^2(2theta)) rescaled by f_s, and add the analytic Dodelson-Widrow yield as the subdominance constraint, giving a joint mixing-angle recast for the PBH-production scenario.

members.model_name: High-decay-constant QCD axion dark matter with PBH-seeded UCMHs
members.description: No likelihood exists for either the transient haloscope sensitivity boost (likelihood_available: no) or for recasting OGLE/astrometric microlensing limits onto UCMH-dressed PBH lenses with extended envelopes (likelihood_available: partial, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood computing finite-size lens magnification for UCMH density profiles against OGLE event rates, and a time-domain haloscope likelihood that folds stream encounter probability into ADMX/ABRACADABRA exclusion statistics.

members.model_name: Q-ball dark matter from Model A solitosynthesis
members.description: No macroscopic-dark-matter recast likelihood exists that maps the predicted Q-ball mass/flux distribution (with its extended, non-monochromatic charge spectrum) onto microlensing compact-object limits, the DEAP-3600 multiple-scatter search, and proposed gravitational direct-detection sensitivities as a function of (m_Q, sigma_nucleus, local flux).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that convolves the predicted Q-ball charge/mass distribution with published exclusion curves (Subaru HSC/EROS/MACHO-type microlensing above ~1e23 g, DEAP-3600 multiple-scatter efficiency vs sigma_nucleus, gravitational-detector projections), using extended-mass-function weighting rather than monochromatic limits.

members.model_name: Q-ball dark matter from Model B solitosynthesis
members.description: No macroscopic-dark-matter recast likelihood exists that maps the predicted Model B Q-ball mass/flux distribution onto microlensing compact-object limits, the DEAP-3600 multiple-scatter search, and gravitational direct-detection projections as a function of (m_Q, sigma_nucleus, local flux) for an extended charge spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module convolving the predicted charge/mass distribution with published exclusion curves (microlensing above ~1e23 g, DEAP-3600 efficiency vs sigma_nucleus, gravitational-detector projections) using extended-mass-function weighting rather than monochromatic limits.

members.model_name: Scalar nontopological soliton dark matter
members.description: Existing microlensing and accretion limits are published for monochromatic compact-object mass functions; no implemented likelihood recasts them onto the extended, formation-dependent NTS mass functions this model predicts.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard extended-mass-function recast (Carr et al.-style integral constraint method) over digitized EROS/OGLE/Subaru-HSC and accretion bounds as a reusable likelihood taking an arbitrary NTS mass function and f_NTS.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine baryogenesis
members.description: The CMB isocurvature constraint is applied only as the single-number Planck bound beta_iso < 0.035 at k = 0.002 Mpc^-1; no likelihood exists that treats the model's blue-tilted, scale-dependent P_iso(k) = f_PBH^2 P_PBH(k) consistently across the full Planck k-range.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PBH-number-density isocurvature transfer in CLASS/CAMB with the model's P_PBH(k) shape and evaluate against the Planck likelihood (e.g. via MontePython/Cobaya) to replace the fixed beta_iso pivot-scale bound with a proper scale-dependent constraint on f_PBH^2 xi_star.

members.model_name: Astrophysical Q-ball dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable EROS-2/OGLE-IV survey-efficiency tables or event-rate likelihood usable for extended Q-ball lenses; existing MACHO/PBH limits are published only as point-lens f_DM exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize EROS-2 and OGLE-IV detection-efficiency curves and exposure, build an event-rate Poisson likelihood over a standard halo model that accepts arbitrary magnification thresholds from the finite-size kernel, and validate by recovering the published point-lens f_DM limits.

members.model_name: Mirror-star-forming mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: No microlensing survey likelihood is available for mirror-star populations: existing compact-object limits assume delta-function mass functions and standard halo distributions, not the disk-like, extended mass functions expected for a dissipative mirror sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published OGLE/EROS event-rate likelihoods and LSST microlensing forecasts with the event-duration distribution computed for parameterized mirror-star mass functions and disk/halo spatial distributions, releasing the efficiency-convolved likelihood as a reusable module.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubble dark matter with primordial black holes
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the clustering-induced PBH isocurvature and CMB axion-isocurvature constraints specific to the bubble scenario; the card imports headline exclusion numbers (e.g. f_PBH < 7e-10 for f_a = 1e16 GeV) without an evaluable constraint module over (f_a, H_inf, theta_i, bubble fraction).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the bubble-clustering isocurvature power spectrum and the pre-inflationary axion isocurvature amplitude as functions of the model parameters, and evaluate them against Planck isocurvature and large-scale-structure limits in a reusable likelihood module coupled to a PBHbounds-style constraint compilation.

members.model_name: Pre-inflationary QCD axion minicluster scenario
members.description: No microlensing likelihood is packaged for extended axion-minicluster lenses from this scenario; point-lens EROS/Subaru-HSC limits overstate sensitivity, and the recast requires the scenario-specific mass function and density profiles as inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an event-rate calculator for finite-size lenses following the existing minicluster-microlensing formalism (arXiv:1707.03310), parameterized by the simulated mass function and profiles, and package EROS and Subaru HSC constraints as a likelihood on f_MC.

members.model_name: LED instantly evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: The direct-detection concept for boosted PBH-emitted dark particles rests on a CDEX electron-scattering analysis built for 4D PBH emission spectra; no recast to LED higher-dimensional emission spectra (or to this model's assumed scattering interaction) exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute the boosted dark-matter flux at Earth from the LED emission spectrum, specify a benchmark DM-electron cross section, and recast the published CDEX-style electron-recoil likelihood with the modified flux and spectrum.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian axion-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No aggregated PBH-abundance constraint likelihood (microlensing, evaporation, CMB accretion, mergers) or induced-GW detector likelihood is attached to the route, so viability of f_PBH(M) and Omega_GW(f) predictions cannot be evaluated automatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire a public PBH-constraint compilation (PBHbounds-style f_PBH(M) curves) and GW sensitivity/upper-limit curves (LISA, PTA, LVK) into a constraint-aggregation step returning pass/fail or likelihood values for each benchmark.

members.model_name: LIGO-mass primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood confronts the PBH capture-channel prediction with modern gravitational-wave catalogs: the route's likelihood step is planned, and the population discriminants (dark-matter-tracing spatial bias, absent counterparts, mass spectrum, eccentricity, stochastic background) have no coded population model within existing LVK inference frameworks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the halo-capture PBH channel (rate density, mass spectrum, redshift evolution, eccentricity distribution) as a population model in a public GW population-inference framework and fit it jointly with astrophysical-binary foreground models against the current LVK catalog, adding the stochastic-background and counterpart-absence terms.

members.model_name: Gravitational dark matter from extended primordial-black-hole evaporation
members.description: There is no BBN/CMB likelihood coupled to FRISBHEE outputs for extended PBH mass/spin distributions: the pre-BBN timing requirement and Delta N_eff bound are applied as monochromatic-style thresholds, while the card stresses that a late-evaporating high-mass tail can dominate the BBN risk and detailed light-element yields were not calculated.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface FRISBHEE's time-dependent entropy and radiation injection histories with a BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) and a Planck N_eff likelihood, so that distribution-tail-dependent light-element and Delta N_eff constraints are evaluated statistically rather than by a single evaporation-temperature cut.

members.model_name: Inflaton-curvaton sound-speed-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists to confront the predicted SIGW anisotropy with detector data or forecasts (NANOGrav/LVK upper limits, DECIGO/LISA sensitivity to anisotropic backgrounds), and the PBH abundance comparison lacks a packaged likelihood that propagates the extended mass function through the constraint compilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood layer combining public PBH bound data tables via the standard extended-mass-function recast with a stochastic-GW anisotropy sensitivity model (angular response of DECIGO/LISA and PTA upper limits), so (Omega_GW, C_ell, f_PBH) benchmarks can be scored consistently.

members.model_name: Ultra-slow-roll KKL-potential primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No PBH constraint-curve likelihood or PTA stochastic-background likelihood has been connected to this model's f_PBH(M) and Omega_GW(f) outputs; constraints are currently qualitative window statements (recasting_needed yes, likelihood_available partial, no PTA likelihood rerun).
members.proposed_resolution: Pipe the computed Omega_GW(f) through the public NANOGrav/EPTA free-spectrum likelihoods (PTArcade/ceffyl-style) and evaluate f_PBH(M) against a digitized mass-dependent PBH constraint compilation, including a Planck scalar-amplitude consistency check at the pivot scale.

members.model_name: Classically conformal B-L double-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for either observable: PBH mass-fraction constraints (evaporation, microlensing, CMB accretion, dynamics) are available only as a review-level compilation requiring recast (likelihood_available: no), and the SIGW comparison is forecast-only against planned BBO/DECIGO sensitivity curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a machine-readable f_PBH(M) exclusion likelihood from the standard PBH-constraint compilations (extended mass-function method) and package digitized BBO/DECIGO/LISA/ET sensitivity curves as a signal-to-noise forecast module for the computed Omega_GW spectrum.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from a non-minimal curvaton scenario
members.description: PBH mass-fraction constraints are recorded only as an undigitized figure comparison and no likelihood is attached; the extended f_PBH(M) mass functions of this scenario need a proper recast against the monochromatic bound compilations before exclusion statements are quantitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Hook the predicted f_PBH(M) into the public PBHbounds constraint compilation using the standard extended-mass-function recasting integral, and add PTA/LISA sensitivity comparisons for the corresponding SIGW spectra.

members.model_name: Spinning primordial black hole dark matter from early matter domination
members.description: No public likelihood exists to compare the predicted spinning-PBH merger stochastic background Omega_GW(f) against LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA stochastic-search upper limits; the primary source reports enhanced detectability without rerunning any detector likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood module that folds the model's Omega_GW(f) (from the analytic merger-rate chain with spin-enhanced waveforms) through the public LVK stochastic-background sensitivity curves and cross-correlation upper limits, exposing (M_min, M_max, a_star, f_PBH) as parameters.

members.model_name: Speed-breaker inflationary primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline recasts the predicted PBH mass function f(M) against the compiled f_PBH constraint landscape or re-runs CMB large-scale consistency for the feature model; the CMB spectral-index check and the extended-mass-function PBH bounds are only qualitative in the source.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the computed P_R(k) to CLASS/CAMB plus the public Planck likelihood for the CMB-scale check, and apply the extended-mass-function method to a maintained PBH-constraint compilation (PBHbounds-style) to convert narrow-band mass functions into f_PBH exclusions.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from strongly supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: No likelihood or systematic recast exists for confronting this model's extended (possibly multi-peak) PBH mass function with the compiled evaporation, lensing, accretion, dynamical, and GW constraint windows, which are published as monochromatic f_PBH(M) curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard extended-mass-function recasting integral (Carr et al. procedure) over the compiled monochromatic PBH bounds, wrapped as a likelihood taking the predicted dn/dM from the nucleation-history pipeline as input.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from strongly supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: No detector-level stochastic gravitational-wave likelihood is available for the supercooled-transition and PBH-era GW spectra; the card provides only spectral targets (alpha, beta_PBH) without a computed spectrum-to-detector comparison.

members.model_name: Rapid-turn multifield inflation seeded primordial black holes
members.description: No joint likelihood exists that applies extended-mass-function PBH abundance constraints, scalar-induced gravitational-wave limits, and PBH binary merger-rate data to this model's outputs; existing monochromatic PBH bounds cannot be applied directly to the rapid-turn mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood layer that convolves f_PBH(M) with the compiled mass-dependent constraint curves (PBHbounds-style compilation) using the extended-mass-function method, plus an induced-GW spectrum calculator (SIGWfast-class) compared to PTA/LVK sensitivity and a merger-rate likelihood with an explicit binary-formation model.

members.model_name: Quantum-well stochastic-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No PBH observational constraint overlay is connected to the predicted mass function: both card constraints have likelihood_available = no, and microlensing, CMB-accretion, dynamical, and gravitational-wave f_PBH(M) limits were not digitized, so the model's f_PBH prediction cannot be confronted with data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a constraint-overlay module that convolves the model's extended mass function with digitized f_PBH(M) exclusion curves (e.g. the public PBHbounds compilation), using the standard extended-mass-function recasting formula, and expose it as a likelihood over (Delta_phi, V_0, k(N=0)).

members.model_name: Massive primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public Ly-alpha forest flux-power likelihood or emulator exposes the PBH Poisson isocurvature amplitude (f_PBH M_PBH) as an input parameter; the existing high-resolution MIKE/HIRES bound is a published result, not a reusable likelihood, and its reionization/thermal priors cannot be varied.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing forest flux-power emulator (trained on Sherwood/Nyx-class hydrodynamic grids) with a white-noise isocurvature amplitude parameter added to the linear input spectrum, and couple it to the public eBOSS/MIKE/HIRES flux-power likelihoods with marginalizable IGM thermal-history nuisances.

members.model_name: Massive primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The CMB accretion bound exists only as a recast target: no assembled pipeline connects a PBH accretion-luminosity model for this mass range to the Planck likelihood, and the conservative accretion prescription is the dominant uncontrolled uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble an ExoCLASS/CLASS energy-injection run with the disk/spherical accretion luminosity prescriptions of the cited Planck analyses, scanning (M_PBH, f_PBH, accretion efficiency) against the public Planck TT,TE,EE likelihood in Cobaya or MontePython.

members.model_name: Planet 9 axion-star dark matter subcomponent
members.description: The HSC/OGLE microlensing constraint on Earth-mass axion stars requires a recast with finite-size/extended-lens corrections for dilute axion-star profiles, and no public event-rate likelihood for an axion-star mass function has been run for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public compact-object microlensing event-rate code with the extended-lens magnification of dilute axion-star density profiles, apply it to the Subaru HSC and OGLE event samples, and release the resulting likelihood over (M_AS, f_AS, m_a).

members.model_name: Primordial dark matter halos from scalar fifth forces
members.description: No microlensing likelihood handles extended lenses with the PDMH mass-radius relation R ~ 100 (M/M_sun)^(2/3) AU; the viable-window boundaries are read off from point-lens survey thresholds plus an extended-lens argument rather than computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement extended-lens magnification profiles for the assumed nonsingular isothermal PDMH density profile and recompute EROS/MACHO/OGLE/HSC event-rate likelihoods as a function of (M_PDMH, R_PDMH, f_DM), following the extended-lens treatment of the cited 1707.03310 framework.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from EEFToI dispersion enhancement
members.description: No assembled likelihood exists that confronts this model's extended PBH mass function with the heterogeneous multi-channel abundance limits (lensing, dynamical, accretion, GW) or its induced-GW spectrum with stochastic-background searches; the card lists constraint likelihood_available as only partial.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer that applies the standard extended-mass-function method to a public PBH constraint compilation (PBHbounds-style curves) and couples a SIGWfast-type second-order GW calculation to existing stochastic-background upper limits (e.g. LIGO/Virgo O3, PTA).

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No clustering-aware likelihoods exist for recasting LIGO/Virgo merger-rate data, microlensing surveys, or CMB accretion limits onto (f_PBH, M_PBH); published homogeneous-PBH bounds are not valid once PBHs are significantly clustered, and both card constraints have likelihood_available no.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing public assets — the LVK compact-binary rate posteriors, EROS/OGLE/Subaru-HSC microlensing likelihoods, and Planck PBH-accretion constraints — by inserting clustering-corrected line-of-sight densities and merger rates, packaging the result as a (f_PBH, M_PBH, xi) likelihood module.

members.model_name: Spiked extended primordial black-hole mass-function dark matter
members.description: No microlensing likelihood exists for this extended-plus-spike PBH mass function: HSC (M31) and OGLE bounds are published as monochromatic exclusion curves, and the event-rate convolution over f_PBH(M) with the surveys' detection-efficiency functions has not been implemented for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the HSC and OGLE detection-efficiency and event-rate curves and implement the standard extended-mass-function recast (integrating dR/dM against f_PBH(M) and re-deriving the exclusion from the published event counts), packaged as a mass-function-agnostic microlensing recast module.

members.model_name: QCD-epoch primordial black hole dark matter with aborted-PBH baryogenesis
members.description: No PBH binary-formation and merger-rate model coupled to a gravitational-wave catalog likelihood exists for this scenario's tens-to-hundreds solar-mass, QCD-epoch mass function, so the predicted mass-gap merger signal cannot be confronted with LVK data or combined with the baryon-abundance target.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a merger-rate forward model (early-binary and cluster channels) taking the QCD-epoch PBH mass function as input, and recast it through a public GW population-inference likelihood (e.g. GWTC hierarchical population tools) jointly with the eta_b constraint.

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment dark matter in a PBH-dominated epoch
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the joint constraint set (pre-BBN PBH evaporation requirement, PBH-diluted axion abundance band, and Delta N_eff CMB sensitivity); all card constraints are marked likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the abundance and Delta N_eff outputs in a simple Gaussian/limit likelihood against Planck Omega_c h^2 and Planck+future (CMB-S4) Delta N_eff posteriors, plus a hard BBN-evaporation prior on M_in, packaged as a MontePython/Cobaya likelihood module.

members.model_name: PBH-remnant dark matter from radiation-era mini-PBH production
members.description: No likelihood module exists for the joint early-universe consistency check: BBN energy injection and extragalactic photon-background constraints on promptly evaporating mini PBHs combined with Planck constraints on n_s and running; both route likelihoods are recorded as unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a constraint module that couples BlackHawk-generated Hawking spectra to a decaying-particle BBN code (e.g. extend ACROPOLIS to evaporating-PBH injection) and photon-background limits, and wrap Planck 2018 n_s/alpha_s chains as a Gaussian likelihood, exposing both as functions of (M, M_rem, beta).

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from step-feature single-field inflation
members.description: No recast machinery convolves the model's broad, oscillatory-spectrum-derived PBH mass function f_PBH(M) with mass-dependent PBH constraint curves, nor compares the oscillatory Omega_GW(f) against LVK/PTA stochastic-background likelihoods; only monochromatic-bound and benchmark comparisons are currently possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an extended-mass-function recast over a PBHbounds-style constraint compilation (Carr et al. convolution method) and a joint likelihood comparing the induced-GW spectrum with published LIGO/Virgo stochastic upper limits and PTA free-spectrum posteriors, parameterized by step amplitudes/positions.

members.model_name: Galileon ultra-slow-roll primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The microlensing (EROS-2/MACHO) constraint on the near-solar and 10^4 solar-mass PBH benchmarks has not been recast for the model's actual mass function; the enrichment did not digitize an exclusion curve and the card marks recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the EROS-2 (and complementary OGLE/dynamical) f_PBH(M) exclusion curves and convolve them with the extended Galileon PBH mass function beta(M) to produce a proper f_PBH bound for each w benchmark.

members.model_name: QCD axion domain-wall primordial-black-hole subcomponent model
members.description: No machine-readable microlensing likelihood exists that applies EROS/OGLE efficiencies and Gaia DR4/Roman projections to the model's generated (non-monochromatic) PBH mass function; current comparisons use monochromatic or narrow-mass recasts of published exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an event-rate likelihood that convolves the model PBH mass function with published OGLE/EROS survey efficiency curves and a standard Galactic model (extending public PBH-bound compilation codes to extended mass functions), and add Gaia DR4 and Roman projected sensitivities for forecasting.

members.model_name: Primordial quark-object dark matter
members.description: No public microlensing likelihood that maps an arbitrary compact-quark-object mass function and halo model to LMC/bulge survey event rates; only MACHO/EROS-era summary limits exist and the card marks the constraint as recast_required with likelihood_available partial.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing compact-halo-object microlensing machinery (e.g., the PBH microlensing constraint pipelines built on MACHO/EROS/OGLE efficiency curves) to accept an extended quark-object mass function and Milky Way halo model, exposing an event-rate likelihood.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from running-inflaton perturbations in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No likelihood or constraint-recast machinery is attached to the card (constraint entry is a placeholder with likelihood_available unknown): the extended PBH mass function with EMD cutoffs cannot currently be confronted with evaporation, microlensing, and CMB-accretion abundance bounds, which are published for monochromatic mass functions.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer applying the standard extended-mass-function method to public compilations of monochromatic f_PBH(M) bounds (e.g. the PBHbounds compilation), taking the model's f(M) from the formation pipeline and returning excluded regions in (dn/dlnk, T_reh) space.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from blue spectator-field perturbations in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No likelihood or constraint-recast machinery is attached to the card (constraint entry is a placeholder with likelihood_available unknown): the extended PBH mass function with EMD cutoffs cannot currently be confronted with evaporation, microlensing, and CMB-accretion abundance bounds, which are published for monochromatic mass functions.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer applying the standard extended-mass-function method to public compilations of monochromatic f_PBH(M) bounds (e.g. the PBHbounds compilation), taking the model's f(M) from the formation pipeline and returning excluded regions in (A_s, n_s, T_reh) space.

members.model_name: VAS supergravity a4 quartic-superpotential asteroid PBH dark matter
members.description: No likelihood stack is attached for the recasting step: Planck/BICEP n_s-r constraints, asteroid-mass PBH window bounds, and LISA/DECIGO sensitivity curves are all cited qualitatively (likelihood_available: no on all three constraints) with no machine-readable benchmark tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's (n_s, r) into the public Planck+BICEP/Keck likelihoods via Cobaya, compare f_PBH(M) against a maintained bound compilation such as PBHbounds, and evaluate Omega_GW(f) against published LISA/DECIGO power-law-integrated sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: VAS supergravity b3 quartic-superpotential asteroid PBH dark matter
members.description: No likelihood stack is attached for the recasting step: Planck/BICEP n_s-r constraints, asteroid-mass PBH window bounds, and LISA/DECIGO sensitivity curves are all cited qualitatively (likelihood_available: no on all three constraints) with no machine-readable benchmark tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the model's (n_s, r) into the public Planck+BICEP/Keck likelihoods via Cobaya, compare f_PBH(M) against a maintained bound compilation such as PBHbounds, and evaluate Omega_GW(f) against published LISA/DECIGO power-law-integrated sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Smooth-crossover primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No assembled pipeline confronts the template's outputs with data: PBH abundance/evaporation constraint curves are not digitized into the workflow and no LISA/DECIGO/BBO sensitivity or PBH likelihood is packaged for the (A, crossover scale, c_s^2_min) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire f_PBH(M) into a public PBH-constraint compilation (PBHbounds-style, including asteroid-mass-window evaporation limits) and Omega_GW(f) into standard LISA/DECIGO/BBO power-law-integrated sensitivity curves, producing an automated observational-status verdict per template point.

members.model_name: Trapped-vacuum-bubble primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood is available for either the PBH abundance window or the CMB-scale inflation constraints; the mass-function-dependent PBH bounds are quoted as compilations, and the broad two-channel mass function has not been recast through extended-mass-function constraint machinery.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard extended-mass-function recasting of public PBH constraint compilations (asteroid-window evaporation, microlensing, CMB accretion bounds) for the two-channel mass function, and attach the Planck slow-roll observable constraints (A_s, n_s, r) as a simple Gaussian likelihood on the potential parameters.

members.model_name: Mirror baryon plus heavy primordial-black-hole multicomponent dark matter
members.description: The heavy-PBH component is only checked against review-quoted monochromatic mass windows; no likelihood-level recast of evaporation, microlensing, accretion, and dynamical PBH constraints exists for the model's f_PBH = 1 - beta/5.33 fraction, extended mass functions, or clustering, so the 10^17-10^23 g allowed range is not quantitatively established.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the current f_PBH(M) constraint curves in a public compendium (PBHbounds-style), apply the standard extended-mass-function recasting method of the cited Carr et al. review, and evaluate the joint constraint as a function of (beta, M_PBH, mass-function width) to produce likelihood contours for the mirror+PBH budget.

members.model_name: Modulated p=4 hilltop inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No modern constraint recast or likelihood exists for this benchmark: the card marks both constraints likelihood_available=no, so current PBH mass-window bounds, updated Planck running-of-running posteriors, and induced-GW sensitivity cannot be applied to (f, Lambda^4, beta_s).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast likelihood combining a current f_PBH(M) constraint compilation (e.g. PBHbounds), Omega_GW computed from the model P_R(k) with a public scalar-induced-GW code (e.g. SIGWfast) compared against PTA/LISA sensitivities, and updated Planck constraints on (n_s, alpha_s, beta_s).

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy phase-space-density constraint on the DW sterile neutrino has no likelihood (likelihood_available: unknown), and the halo-history dependence of the coarse-grained Q_cg evolution is uncalibrated, leaving the Tremaine-Gunn-style bound qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a phase-space likelihood comparing the primordial Q of f_DW(y) with measured dwarf-spheroidal phase-space densities, using WDM simulations to calibrate how much Q_cg degrades during halo assembly.

members.model_name: Late Sommerfeld-enhanced dark-matter conversion to dark radiation
members.description: No dwarf-galaxy self-interaction likelihood exists for the velocity-dependent sigma_T/m_chi(v) prediction; the route only supports an approximate threshold comparison at a single 30 km/s benchmark rather than a proper halo-population recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood over published dwarf and low-surface-brightness halo fits (e.g. Jeans/isothermal SIDM halo-model inferences of sigma/m at measured velocity dispersions) that consumes sigma_T/m_chi(v) curves, replacing the single-velocity threshold cut.

members.model_name: Singlet-SUSY singlino self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The SIDM small-scale-structure observable is evaluated only against the phenomenological 0.1-10 cm^2/g target window at v = 200 km/s; no simulation-calibrated halo prediction or astrophysical likelihood connects this model's velocity-dependent cross section to dwarf, LSB, or cluster data (simulation_calibrated is 'no', likelihood_available is 'no').
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model's velocity-dependent sigma(v)/m through an SIDM halo-modeling framework calibrated on SIDM N-body simulations (e.g. isothermal Jeans modeling of rotation curves and cluster profiles) to build a likelihood over the dwarf-to-cluster velocity range instead of a fixed target interval.

members.model_name: U(1)' dark-photon self-interacting dark matter from a MeV first-order phase transition
members.description: The dwarf-to-cluster SIDM comparison uses target cross-section ranges rather than a likelihood: no public pipeline maps the CLASSICS sigma/m(v) curve onto halo rotation-curve, core-size, and cluster data with astrophysical (baryonic and halo-formation) marginalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple sigma/m(v) to a calibrated SIDM halo model (isothermal-Jeans or SIDM-adapted concentration-mass emulator) and build a joint likelihood over published dwarf/LSB rotation curves and cluster core measurements, replacing the O(1)-O(10) and 0.2 cm^2/g targets with posterior constraints on (m_DM, m_Aprime, g').

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino self-interacting dark matter in double focus point BLSSM
members.description: The dwarf and cluster self-interaction constraints used by the card exist only as quoted target ranges (0.1-10 cm^2/g at 30 km/s, 0.1-1.25 at 2000 km/s, 0.1-0.47 at 900 km/s) with no public likelihood, so the allowed region can only be delimited by hard cuts rather than a statistical fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood for sigma_V/m(v) from published SIDM halo inferences (dwarf/LSB rotation curves and merging/relaxed cluster analyses, e.g. the Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu data points), parameterized in (m_snu, m_phi, effective coupling), and release it as a reusable SIDM constraint module.

members.model_name: Two-component hidden U(1)_D scalar dark matter
members.description: The self-interaction motivation is filtered only through qualitative sigma_self/m targets; no halo-shape or small-scale-structure likelihood connects the light component's dark-photon-mediated self-scattering to dwarf/cluster observables (card: no halo-shape likelihood attached).
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt the standard velocity-dependent SIDM cross-section calculation for a light-mediator Yukawa potential and compare against the compiled dwarf/LSB/cluster sigma/m constraints (e.g. the Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu data points) packaged as a simple likelihood over (m_Zprime, alpha_D, m_light).

members.model_name: Lepton-quarticity self-interacting Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood connects a velocity-dependent scalar-mediated self-interaction cross section sigma/m(v) to dwarf, galaxy, and cluster halo observations; the sigma/m ~ 1 cm^2/g target and 0.1 cm^2/g halo-shape floor are literature ranges, not an evaluable statistical constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood mapping (m_DM, m_S, y_chi) through the Yukawa transfer cross section into halo predictions via calibrated SIDM N-body/isothermal-Jeans modeling (e.g. extending existing SIDM rotation-curve and cluster-shape fitting pipelines), covering the dwarf-to-cluster velocity range.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition rescued self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: The SIDM small-scale-structure requirement is imposed only as a target band in sigma_T/m_DM with no halo-scale likelihood and no simulation calibration for this velocity-dependent light-mediator model (simulation_calibrated: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's velocity-dependent sigma_T/m through an existing SIDM halo-modeling framework (isothermal-Jeans or gravothermal-fluid fits calibrated on published SIDM N-body suites) against dwarf and cluster rotation-curve/density-profile datasets to replace the target band with a quantitative likelihood.

members.model_name: Two-real-singlet self-interacting scalar dark matter model
members.description: The self-interaction constraint is only an approximate astrophysical target range (about 1 cm^2/g at dwarf/Milky-Way scales, below 0.1 cm^2/g at clusters); no quantitative likelihood maps halo density-profile data onto the model's sigma/m(v) curve.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from published rotation-curve and cluster core datasets (dwarf-to-cluster halo samples used in SIDM fits) parameterized directly in sigma_T/m as a function of velocity, so any velocity-dependent SIDM model, including this one, can be scored quantitatively instead of against rough target bands.

members.model_name: Optically thin mirror-star nugget emission model
members.description: No search likelihood exists for the predicted mirror-star HR-diagram locus: the Gaia DR3 comparison is illustrative only, with no selection function, white-dwarf contamination model, or statistical machinery to turn candidate counts (or their absence) into bounds on (rho_core, M_nugget, Gamma_heat).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a Gaia DR3 candidate-search likelihood over the published color-magnitude locus with a G<30 completeness/selection model and a white-dwarf population contamination model, so that follow-up non-confirmation converts into exclusion regions over the paper's scan parameters.

members.model_name: SU(2)_X hidden-sector vector and monopole dark matter with Higgs portal
members.description: The long-range dark-photon self-interaction constraint rests on an approximate halo bound with stated order 1-10 uncertainty and no likelihood; there is no simulation-calibrated mapping or likelihood from the massless-mediator (velocity-dependent, Sommerfeld-enhanced) sigma_T/m_V to dwarf, cluster, and CMB data for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dark-Coulomb SIDM constraint pipeline: compute screened transfer cross sections with halo velocity averaging, calibrate the halo-observable mapping against existing long-range-force SIDM simulations (or run a small suite for the massless-mediator scaling), and combine with published dwarf/cluster core and CMB energy-injection likelihoods to bound alpha_X versus m_V.

members.model_name: MeV singlet-scalar SIMP dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: Cluster self-interaction constraints are applied as fixed sigma/m cuts (Bullet ~1 cm^2/g, Abell 1-3 cm^2/g) with mutually exclusive preferred regions and no velocity-dependent halo-level likelihood, leaving the SIDM interpretation of this model unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a joint likelihood over dwarf-to-cluster velocity scales from published SIDM halo analyses (rotation curves, cluster cores, merging clusters), evaluated at the model's velocity-independent contact cross section, so Bullet and Abell inputs are combined statistically instead of as disjoint cuts.

members.model_name: Self-interacting forbidden vector dark matter with a cannibally co-decaying phase
members.description: The SIDM comparison stops at the 0.1-10 cm^2/g target band: no likelihood maps the model's velocity-independent sigma_SI/m_X onto dwarf, LSB, and cluster halo data, and the card notes no simulation calibration for this constant-cross-section scenario across all halo masses.
members.proposed_resolution: Use existing constant-cross-section SIDM N-body calibrations to build an isothermal-Jeans or emulator-based halo likelihood over dwarf rotation curves, halo shapes, and cluster mergers, and evaluate whether a velocity-independent cross section can satisfy dwarf and cluster data simultaneously.

members.model_name: Velocity-dependent SIDM thermally coupled through millicharged dark matter
members.description: No public statistical likelihood exists for the velocity-dependent SIDM halo-core observable; the dwarf-to-cluster sigma_T/m window is a compiled phenomenological target, so the model's critical small-scale-structure observable can only be checked pass/fail.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood for velocity-averaged sigma_T/m from isothermal-Jeans fits to dwarf and LSB rotation curves plus cluster core measurements (Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu-style analysis), released as a reusable module taking sigma_T(v)/m as input.

members.model_name: Single keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The X-ray radiative-decay constraint is recorded only as an analytic envelope bound on the mixing sum; no packaged X-ray line-search likelihood (with halo J/D factors and instrument response for Chandra/Suzaku/XMM stacks) is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Package published X-ray line flux limits (dwarf spheroidal, Milky Way, and cosmic X-ray background analyses) as a reusable likelihood over (m_4, mixing sum) with explicit J/D-factor priors, so the analytic decay-rate step feeds a statistical constraint instead of a quoted envelope.

members.model_name: Composite sterile Dirac neutrino warm dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published X-ray flux limits (Chandra/XMM/NuSTAR blank-sky and M31/dwarf compilations) into a digitized likelihood in the (m_d, theta_d, f_sterile) plane that scales with the abundance fraction output by the production solver.

members.model_name: Freeze-twin electron and positron dark matter
members.description: The self-interaction constraint is applied only as a qualitative sigma/m ~ 1 cm^2/g threshold: no velocity-dependent transfer-cross-section calculation for twin-electron Bhabha scattering through the massive twin photon is confronted with cluster and dwarf SIDM likelihoods.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the velocity-dependent momentum-transfer cross section for e'-e'bar scattering (Born/classical/resonant regimes as appropriate for m_gamma_prime/m_e_prime) and evaluate it against published SIDM halo-scale constraints (Bullet Cluster, cluster ensembles, dwarf rotation curves) using an existing SIDM constraint compilation.

members.model_name: Spontaneously broken U(1)' asymmetric self-interacting dark matter

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from pion decays after the QCD phase transition
members.description: No likelihood exists for either constraint on the card: the CMB-abundance/dwarf-spheroidal phase-space bound and the X-ray decay-line bound are both quoted as exclusion statements with likelihood_available: no, so mass-mixing scans cannot be evaluated statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a public likelihood layer: recast existing X-ray line search limits (XMM/Chandra M31 and cluster stacks) into a decay-rate likelihood in (m_s, |U_ls|^2), and implement the dwarf-spheroidal primordial phase-space-density bound as a likelihood over the computed f_s(q).

members.proposed_resolution: Adopt or build a velocity-binned sigma_T/m likelihood from published dwarf rotation-curve and cluster ensemble fits (Kaplinghat-style SIDM halo-model inference) and map the model's sigma_T/m(v) curve onto it.

(arXiv:2007.15522), marginalizing over halo concentration and baryonic-feedback nuisance parameters, packaged as a module usable downstream of CLASSICS.

members.model_name: Super-Resonant Dark Matter
members.description: The halo self-interaction comparison uses inherited SIDM target cross-section ranges rather than a likelihood: no implemented statistical pipeline maps the model's resonant sigma/m(v) over (m, y, delta) onto dwarf, low-surface-brightness, and relaxed-cluster data.
