members.description: No public likelihood exists for the model's two decisive comparisons: a Fornax-like dwarf-spheroidal Jeans likelihood for soliton-core fits (the primary constraint preserves no likelihood) and an HFF ultra-faint lensed-galaxy luminosity-function likelihood that takes a fuzzy-DM-suppressed halo mass function as input.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dwarf-spheroidal Jeans likelihood (soliton+NFW-envelope profile, marginalizing stellar anisotropy and baryonic mass) against the Fornax phase-space data, and reconstruct the HFF constraint as a UV-luminosity-function likelihood fed by the fuzzy-DM half-mode-suppressed halo mass function with lensing-magnification and selection systematics as nuisance parameters.

members.model_name: Self-interacting Higgs-portal singlet scalar dark matter in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No quantitative likelihood exists for the self-interaction observable sigma_self/m_s: halo-shape and cluster SIDM constraints are cited as literature bounds, and the card records detector and halo likelihoods as not reconstructed, so the recast step cannot produce statistically meaningful limits in the nonstandard cosmology.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble an interpolated likelihood module from published SIDM posteriors on sigma/m (dwarf, LSB, and cluster halo fits) and combine it with DDCalc-based direct-detection likelihoods inside a GAMBIT-style scan of the singlet parameters with the early-matter-domination relic calculation.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector Dirac fermion self-interacting dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: The dwarf-to-cluster SIDM constraint exists only as target cross-section bands from the literature (likelihood_available: no); there is no halo-level likelihood connecting sigma_T/m(v) predictions of this dark-photon model to rotation-curve and cluster data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood from published SIDM halo fits (e.g. the Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu dwarf-to-cluster dataset) that accepts an arbitrary sigma_T/m(v) curve, so the model's velocity-dependent prediction can be scored rather than compared to bands by eye.

members.model_name: Hidden supersymmetric N=1 Yang-Mills dark sector
members.description: The self-interaction constraint is applied only as a generic 2 cm^2/g Bullet Cluster cutoff; no velocity-dependent SIDM halo/cluster likelihood is attached that could exploit the model's predicted velocity dependence across dwarf-to-cluster scales.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published SIDM constraints (merging-cluster analyses and halo-profile inferences across dwarf, group, and cluster velocity scales) into a tabulated likelihood over sigma/m(v) and evaluate the gVY-predicted cross section against it.

members.model_name: QCD axion-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: None of the model's three constraint classes has a likelihood: BBN/CMB Delta N_eff, globular-cluster/red-giant/SN1987A cooling, and halo SIDM limits are all applied as quoted thresholds (likelihood_available no across the card), preventing statistically meaningful parameter scans.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a composite likelihood over (f_a, m_chi, g_a_chi, T_RH): reuse public Planck/BBN N_eff posteriors, published R/R2 and red-giant cooling likelihood parameterizations for the KSVZ/DFSZ couplings, and published sigma_T/m constraints from dwarf-to-cluster halo analyses.

members.model_name: Light Self-Interacting Dark Matter (LSIDM) model
members.description: No SIDM halo likelihood exists to confront the predicted velocity-dependent sigma_T/m with data: the card's SIDM constraint is a literature target band (likelihood_available: no) and no halo-simulation-calibrated likelihood over dwarf-to-cluster scales was run.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published Kaplinghat-Tulin-Yu halo-inferred sigma_T/m(v) points for dwarfs, LSBs, and clusters into a Gaussian likelihood over the model's predicted velocity-dependent cross-section curve, optionally cross-checked against SIDM N-body-calibrated halo models (e.g. the isothermal Jeans method).

members.model_name: A4 split-seesaw keV sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The X-ray test uses only the source-era analytic mixing bound theta^2 < 1.8e-5 (1 keV/m_s)^5; no current X-ray line likelihood (XMM-Newton/Chandra/NuSTAR/eROSITA blank-sky and stacked-object limits) is wired to the model's (m_s, theta^2) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published sterile-neutrino decay-line limits (NuSTAR Galactic-center/blank-sky, XMM stacked dwarfs and M31) into a tabulated likelihood over (m_s, sin^2 2theta) scaled by the model's relic fraction, and evaluate the A4 split-seesaw points against it.

members.model_name: L_mu - L_tau scotogenic freeze-in two-component dark matter
members.description: No reusable public likelihood exists for a monochromatic 3.5 keV dark-matter decay line: the card only carries an approximate flux-window target from the primary paper, while current constraints (stacked XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR/eROSITA observations, including blank-sky non-detections) are scattered across analyses with disputed status.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decay-line likelihood module that combines published 3.5 keV detection fluxes and blank-sky/dwarf non-detection limits into a joint likelihood on Gamma(N2 -> N3 gamma) x (Omega_N2/Omega_DM), parameterized by line energy and halo line-of-sight integrals, packaged for registry-wide reuse on any decaying keV-splitting model.

members.model_name: Mirror dark plasma steady-state halo model
members.description: No galaxy-by-galaxy rotation-curve likelihood exists for confronting the predicted cored profiles with data; the LITTLE THINGS dwarfs are cited only as context and no statistical fit of the model to rotation curves has been performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood over SPARC and LITTLE THINGS rotation curves restricted to the model's validity domain (isolated, star-forming galaxies), fitting the solver's v_halo(r) plus the measured baryonic components with epsilon and the SN heating normalization as shared parameters.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter subcomponent forming dark stars
members.description: No population model or likelihood connects a dark-star-formed black-hole mass function to gravitational-wave merger rates and compact-object bounds, so the mass-gap prediction cannot be tested against LVK catalogs, MACHO microlensing, or ultra-faint-dwarf heating limits at likelihood level.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a semi-analytic dark-star binary population-synthesis model (halo-dependent formation efficiency, pairing, and merger delay times) and add it as a subpopulation channel in an LVK population-inference framework (e.g. gwpopulation), alongside recasts of MACHO and dwarf-heating limits for the epsilon-weighted compact-object fraction.

members.model_name: Two-component baryon-scattering dark matter for cool-core cluster heating
members.description: No public likelihood connects the predicted baryon-DM heating rate to observed cool-core cluster thermodynamics; the heat-balance comparison against Chandra/XMM cooling-time and temperature profiles exists only as a source-level estimate, and the Bullet Cluster/dwarf-evaporation self-interaction bounds on the dark U(1) thermalization realization have not been recast for this two-component setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood over a sample of cool-core clusters comparing dQ_b/dt to bremsstrahlung cooling rates from archival Chandra/XMM thermodynamic profiles, and recast published merging-cluster and dwarf-evaporation self-interaction limits into bounds on the (m_chi, m_psi, alpha_D) kinetic-equilibrium parameter space.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino dark matter from Higgs-singlet decays
members.description: The X-ray radiative-decay constraint is not encoded as a likelihood: published telescope line limits in the keV band exist but have not been wired to this model's (m_s, theta) with the abundance scaling the card notes (subcomponent abundance weakens the bound).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published X-ray line limits (e.g., stacked cluster/dwarf and blank-sky keV-band searches) into a sin^2(2 theta) versus m_s exclusion function scaled by the model's computed sterile abundance fraction.

members.model_name: Resonant MSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with technically natural N2-N3 degeneracy
members.description: No packaged X-ray line likelihood exists to convert stacked XMM/Chandra/NuSTAR observations into a bound on the N1 mixing angle theta versus M_1 for this model; the card records the X-ray likelihood as unavailable and only literature exclusion curves are cited.
members.proposed_resolution: Package published X-ray line search results (blank-sky XMM/NuSTAR and dwarf/cluster stacks) into a reusable sin^2(2theta)-vs-M_1 likelihood module with explicit dark-matter-distribution systematics, applicable to any decaying keV dark-matter candidate.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled relativistic BEC dark matter
members.description: No rotation-curve or lensing likelihood exists for NMC-BEC cored profiles: step s3 requires fitting predicted effective density profiles to dwarf and galactic halo data with a baryonic component, and neither datasets nor a statistical pipeline are attached to the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a rotation-curve likelihood against a public compilation such as SPARC (plus stacked dwarf kinematics), fitting the NMC-BEC profile family with standard stellar mass-to-light nuisance parameters, reusing an existing rotation-curve fitting framework rather than writing one from scratch.

members.model_name: Axion-curvaton primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the PBH abundance bounds near the LIGO mass range (microlensing, Eridanus II, CMB accretion); the card marks likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes, since bounds quoted for monochromatic spectra must be recast for this model's extended mass function and the CMB accretion bounds are disputed.

members.model_name: Resonant self-interacting dark matter with dark deuteron bound states
members.description: No calibrated likelihood or simulation suite maps the resonant velocity-dependent cross section sigma_elastic(v)/m of this large-scattering-length model onto dwarf, LSB, and cluster halo observables; current comparisons use order-of-magnitude SIDM target values with unquantified baryonic and halo-model systematics.

members.model_name: Heavy asymmetric fermion dark matter with Higgs-mixed scalar portal white-dwarf ignition
members.description: No likelihood exists that confronts predicted white-dwarf ignition or destruction rates with data: the card's only constraint entry is a placeholder with likelihood_available unknown, and no statistical comparison to observed old massive white dwarfs or the Type Ia supernova rate is available for this model.

members.model_name: Boson-decay sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy phase-space-density (Tremaine-Gunn-style) constraint on the boson-decay distribution has no likelihood (likelihood_available: unknown), and the evolution of the coarse-grained Q_cg is halo-history dependent, so the comparison is currently only an order-of-magnitude argument.

members.model_name: PQ Dirac-neutrino model with scalar WIMP and axion dark matter

members.model_name: Millicharged co-interacting dark photon dark matter

members.model_name: Blue axion with two-photon decay

members.proposed_resolution: Package the HST anisotropy curve, the LORRI intensity 16.37 +/- 1.47 nW m^-2 sr^-1, and a FIRAS photon-injection recast (following the arXiv:2012.07292 low-mass treatment, e.g. via a spectral-distortion Green's-function solver) as likelihood modules over (m_a, tau_a, abundance fraction), plus a LIM forecast likelihood reproducing the 1e29/1e27 s reaches.

members.model_name: Electromagnetically coupled ALP misalignment dark matter targets

members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published limit and projection curves from community compilations of ALP-photon bounds into approximate per-experiment likelihood tables (treating each curve as a 95 percent CL boundary with documented assumptions on local density and line shape), and couple them to a misalignment relic solver so target-band membership becomes a joint likelihood evaluation.

members.model_name: KSVZ axion dark matter with spectator PQ-field domain-wall solution

members.proposed_resolution: Derive the suppressed isocurvature power spectrum from the spectator background (delta a / a_i with S_I-enhanced effective decay constant during inflation), implement it as an uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature component in CLASS/CAMB, and evaluate against the Planck beta_iso likelihood (e.g. via MontePython/Cobaya), jointly with the misalignment Omega_a h^2 target.

members.model_name: Dark Axion Portal mixed axion-dark-photon dark matter
members.description: The 30-400 eV axion component's haloscope observability cannot be assessed: the batch did not reproduce haloscope sensitivity curves and the route lists the haloscope likelihood as unavailable, with no digitized sensitivity overlay for axion-photon conversion in this unusually high mass window.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Peccei-Quinn axion-saxion model with thermal saxion effects

members.model_name: Planck-scale axion fuzzy-lump dark matter

members.model_name: Anthropic fuzzy axion dark matter from inflationary Brownian misalignment
members.description: No statistical framework exists for the black-hole superradiance test at the goldilocks mass: turning ~10^7 M_sun SMBH spin measurements into a population-level detection/exclusion likelihood for an axion with GUT-scale f_phi, marginalizing over accretion-history and spin-measurement systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple an existing superradiance cloud-evolution calculator (e.g. SuperRad) to a hierarchical Bayesian SMBH spin-population model with self-consistent accretion priors, and publish spin-gap exclusion curves as a reusable likelihood in the m_phi-f_phi plane.

members.model_name: SU(5) x U(1)_PQ axion-inflation dark matter model
members.description: The route has no ingested likelihoods: the Planck inflation posterior (for n_s, r, alpha_iso at k = 0.05 Mpc^-1), the axion relic/isocurvature band, and the Super-K/Hyper-K p -> e+ pi0 lifetime limit are only used as quoted ranges, so joint parameter-space evaluation of the shared (f_a, xi, lambda, M_R8) space cannot be done statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the public Planck 2018 inflation chains (or the plik-lite likelihood via Cobaya/MontePython) for the (n_s, r, alpha_iso) comparison and encode the published Super-K p -> e+ pi0 limit and Hyper-K sensitivity as one-dimensional lifetime likelihoods in the registry constraint format.

members.model_name: Landau-Ginzburg self-interacting scalar dark matter
members.description: No rotation-curve or core-size likelihood exists for the model's density-dependent-sound-speed solitonic cores; the paper's comparison to galactic data is qualitative, so (m, lambda_4, Lambda) cannot be constrained statistically.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood that fits the hydrostatic c_s(rho) core profiles plus an outer NFW envelope and baryonic components to a public rotation-curve sample such as SPARC, constraining the effective coupling and the 60 kpc core-size ceiling.

members.model_name: 2hdSMASH DFSZ axion-majoron dark matter
members.description: None of the card's four constraints has a usable likelihood (likelihood_available is no or partial throughout), so SN1987A cooling, axion overabundance, inflation, and heavy-Higgs limits can only be applied as hard literature cuts rather than in a joint statistical scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a composite likelihood combining the SN1987A f_a bound, an Omega_a h^2 abundance target, Planck/BICEP inflation posteriors on (n_s, r, A_s), and collider heavy-Higgs limits via HiggsBounds, exposed in a global-fit framework such as GAMBIT.

members.model_name: Defect-free dark photon dark matter
members.description: No assembled likelihood or detector-response recast exists connecting the model's cold dark-photon abundance to specific direct-detection datasets (radio-telescope monochromatic searches, haloscopes, heliospheric probes); the card records detector likelihoods as not extracted and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a recast pipeline from public dark-photon limit compilations (AxionLimits-style digitized curves plus published FAST/LOFAR/SKA1 sensitivity formulas) that maps (m_Aprime, epsilon, local density, coherence properties from the production spectrum) to exclusion/target statements.

members.model_name: Large-mass quartic self-interacting scalar dark-matter soliton
members.description: No galactic-center stellar-dynamics likelihood exists to quantitatively test the predicted soliton central density profile: the paper only asserts consistency, and the card marks likelihood_available as no with the mapping from stellar kinematics to an allowed central dark-matter density left as an assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a likelihood for the enclosed-mass profile near supermassive black holes from published S-star orbit fits and nuclear-star-cluster kinematics (Milky Way and selected external galaxies), including a marginalized baryonic mass model, and evaluate the soliton density profile against it.

members.model_name: Kreuzer-Skarke type IIB axiverse dark matter ensemble
members.description: No joint likelihood exists for the photon-coupling observables of a multi-axion population — CMB birefringence, X-ray spectral oscillations, helioscope and supernova bounds are available only as digitized single-axion exclusion curves, and the card notes experimental curves were not even digitized for this scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the AxionLimits compilation into a programmatic likelihood layer that evaluates each mass eigenstate's (m_a, g_agamma, f_s) against birefringence, X-ray oscillation, helioscope, and SN limits and combines them into an ensemble-level pass/fail or chi-square per KS toy model.

members.model_name: Thermal QCD axion hot dark matter with domain-wall cold axions
members.description: The motivating HDM target (Delta N_eff = 0.61 +/- 0.30, m_eff = 0.41 +/- 0.13 eV) is a historical fit with likelihood_available = 'no'; there is no current cosmological likelihood implementing the thermal-axion hot component, so the model cannot be tested against present CMB/LSS data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the thermal QCD axion as an extra non-cold relic (ncdm species with its decoupling-set temperature ratio) in CLASS or CAMB and recast the Delta N_eff / m_eff constraint with current Planck + BAO + weak-lensing likelihoods in Cobaya or MontePython, mapping the posterior back onto f_a.

members.model_name: Composite pNGB dark matter from vacuum-misalignment asymmetry
members.description: No stellar-cooling or supernova energy-loss likelihood exists for the light U(1)_X pseudoscalar with anomaly-induced electroweak couplings; the card only quotes bound-level statements (f > O(100) TeV for m_eta < 9 keV) without a reusable constraint object.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published stellar-evolution (HB/RGB) and SN 1987A axion-like-particle emission calculations onto the (m_eta, f) plane using the template anomaly coefficients, and package the result as a tabulated likelihood with a future-supernova sensitivity projection.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 1 axion dark matter
members.description: No axion direct-search likelihood is included for this model's ultralight window m_A ~ 1.9e-11 to 2.2e-9 eV, where NMR-type searches (CASPEr) rather than standard haloscopes apply, so the g_aX predictions cannot be confronted with experimental exclusions or projections.
members.proposed_resolution: Overlay the model's g_a_gamma, g_ae, and g_aN predictions on a maintained exclusion compilation (AxionLimits-style database including CASPEr, helioscope, and stellar-cooling curves) and package the comparison as a per-coupling likelihood or hard-cut recast.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with time-varying Peccei-Quinn scale
members.description: No combined constraint pipeline maps the model's (f_PQ^0, n_r/n_a, thermalization rate) onto digitized CAST, stellar-cooling, supernova, and cosmological axion limits; the narrow f_PQ ~ 1e8 GeV window from the primary paper exists only as an undigitized figure.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast that combines AxionLimits-style digitized CAST and stellar/SN g_agamma bounds with a radial-mode cosmology module (dark-radiation and thermalization constraints as a function of n_r/n_a), reproducing and then generalizing the primary paper's allowed f_PQ window.

members.model_name: AMSB axion-wino dark matter from heavy axino decay
members.description: Direct and indirect wino-detection constraints exist only as paper reach curves; no machine-readable experiment likelihood is available for sigma_SI and indirect rates rescaled by the local wino fraction in the mixed axion/wino scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the wino direct-detection prediction through a public likelihood package such as DDCalc with current xenon-experiment likelihoods, adding a local-fraction rescaling parameter xi_wino for the mixed axion/wino composition.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.1 axion dark matter
members.description: Neither a CMB isocurvature likelihood nor axion haloscope/helioscope/NMR direct-search likelihoods are connected to the route; constraints con_so10_relic_history (likelihood_available: no) and con_so10_coupling_bounds (partial) are recorded only as recast targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the model's (m_A, g_a_gamma, g_ae, g_aN) output with a maintained axion search-limit database (AxionLimits-style exclusion curves for ADMX, IAXO, ARIADNE targets) and with the Planck isocurvature likelihood in Cobaya/MontePython, using the source paper's coupling normalization.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.2 axion dark matter
members.description: No axion search likelihood is included for the m_A ~ 3.8e-7 to 0.5 eV window, where haloscope, helioscope, and fifth-force limits and projections should constrain the model's g_aX couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Overlay the model's g_a_gamma, g_ae, and g_aN predictions on a maintained exclusion compilation (AxionLimits-style database including ADMX-type haloscopes, IAXO/CAST, and stellar-cooling curves) and package the comparison as a per-coupling likelihood or hard-cut recast.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.1 scalar-singlet axion dark matter
members.description: No axion direct-search likelihood is included for the model's broad QCD-axion mass range, so the g_aX predictions cannot be confronted with haloscope, helioscope, or stellar-cooling exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Overlay the model's g_a_gamma, g_ae, and g_aN predictions on a maintained exclusion compilation (AxionLimits-style database of haloscope, helioscope, and stellar-cooling curves) and package the comparison as a per-coupling likelihood or hard-cut recast.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.2 scalar-singlet plus 10_F axion dark matter
members.description: Axion haloscope/helioscope/NMR and stellar-cooling exclusions are recorded only as recast targets; no likelihood exists that takes the model's predicted (m_A, g_a_gamma, g_ae, g_aN) window and returns quantitative search constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood layer over a public axion-limit compilation (AxionLimits-style digitized exclusion curves for ADMX, CAST, stellar cooling) that interpolates limits at the model's SO(10)-predicted coupling ratios and returns exclusion status per (m_A, f_A) point.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter from string-network radiation
members.description: No released likelihood or pipeline converts the string+misalignment+domain-wall axion number density into a target m_a with quantified uncertainty for laboratory search planning; abundance matching is currently a by-hand estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the mass-abundance relation as a small public code that takes the emission-spectrum parameters (q, xi) and QCD topological susceptibility chi(T) as inputs and returns Omega_a h2(m_a, f_a) with an uncertainty band, exposing a Gaussian relic-abundance likelihood against the Planck Omega_DM h2 measurement.

members.model_name: Dark-QCD pi-axiverse
members.description: No likelihood or recasting module maps existing haloscope, axion-photon, and oscillating-fine-structure-constant search limits onto a multi-component pi-axion mixture in which each species carries its own mass, parity assignment, photon coupling, and local density fraction; published limits assume a single axion making up all local dark matter.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast layer on top of a public axion-limit compilation (AxionLimits-style datasets plus experiment-specific likelihoods where released) that rescales each experiment's reach by the species' local fraction rho_i/rho_DM and separates parity-odd and parity-even coupling channels, exposing exclusion in the (epsilon, F_pi, m_i) space.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood package exists for this model's constraint set: the haloscope exclusion/projection curves are only plotted, and the BBN/CMB Delta N_eff bound on the integrated GW energy is applied approximately rather than through a packaged likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the digitized axion-photon exclusion curves from the public AxionLimits compilation plus a Delta N_eff likelihood (Gaussian on the quoted 0.3 current / 0.06 CMB-S4 bounds applied to the integrated Omega_GW) into a scriptable constraint module over (m_a, f_a, c_gamma, k, T_RH).

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment during gravitational reheating
members.description: No machine-readable likelihood package exists for this model's constraint set: the haloscope exclusion/projection curves are only plotted, and the BBN/CMB Delta N_eff bound on the integrated GW energy (which rules out the minimal reheating branch) is applied approximately rather than through a packaged likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the digitized axion-photon exclusion curves from the public AxionLimits compilation plus a Delta N_eff likelihood (Gaussian on the quoted 0.3 current / 0.06 CMB-S4 bounds applied to the integrated Omega_GW) into a scriptable constraint module over (f_a, c_gamma, k, T_RH, xi_h) with the minimal-branch exclusion flagged automatically.

members.model_name: Post-inflation N_DW=1 QCD axion dark matter with string-wall decay production
members.description: No haloscope or astrophysical-cooling likelihood exists on the card to evaluate the predicted m_a ~ 1e-3 to 1e-2 eV window; the recasting step requires an explicit KSVZ/DFSZ coupling choice that the primary simulation does not fix, and both quoted constraints have likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood module that maps (m_a, F_a) to g_agamma for the KSVZ and DFSZ benchmark couplings and evaluates published haloscope exclusion data and stellar/SN1987A cooling bounds over the predicted mass window, releasing it as a reusable axion-window likelihood.

members.model_name: String-axiverse misalignment dark matter parameterization
members.description: No packaged pipeline connects the string-prior parameterization (M_susy, S, theta_i) through the uncorrelated axion isocurvature amplitude to a current Planck isocurvature likelihood; the paper's analysis used a quoted Planck 2015 bound rather than a reusable likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure CLASS with an uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature mode scaled to the axion fraction, couple it to the Planck 2018 likelihood in MontePython (the sampler already used by the paper), and expose the string-prior parameters as sampling parameters.

members.model_name: Adjoint SU(5) KSVZ QCD axion
members.description: No machine-readable exclusion or projection likelihood exists for the ABRACADABRA-like axion-photon search or the CASPEr-Electric nucleon-EDM search in this model's (3-13)e-9 eV window; the comparison is currently a figure-level overlay of digitized projection curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published ABRACADABRA and CASPEr-Electric sensitivity curves (or take them from the AxionLimits compilation) and package them as simple exclusion/projection likelihoods in (m_a, g_agamma) and (m_a, g_aD) usable by the registry pipeline.

members.model_name: Large-extra-dimension Kaluza-Klein axion dark matter with trapped solar modes
members.description: No public spectral likelihood exists for the SphinX quiet-Sun deep-solar-minimum x-ray data against which the trapped KK-axion two-photon decay spectrum must be compared; the current exclusion is a flux-overshoot argument without a quiet-Sun background model or statistical treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a binned Poisson/Gaussian likelihood from the SphinX 1-6 keV quiet-Sun spectrum with a parameterized quiet-Sun thermal background, taking the trapped-nugget decay-line forest (summed over KK modes weighted by trapped density) as the signal template; release it as a standalone module keyed to (g_agamma, R, delta).

members.model_name: Anomaly-free axion dark matter in a 3HDM with B-L Higgs fields
members.description: No implemented XENON1T electron-recoil likelihood for the axio-electric signal of a keV anomaly-free axion with fractional local DM abundance; the card records that no XENON1T fit was rerun and the constraint is only a literature target.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the public XENON1T (and updated XENONnT) electron-recoil data release with the axio-electric cross section parameterized by (m_a, g_ae, f_a_DM), reproducing the published ALP fit of the excess as a validation point.

members.model_name: Anomaly-free axion dark matter in a 3HDM with B-L Higgs fields
members.description: No X-ray decay-line pipeline encoding halo D-factors and instrument response exists for the threshold/mixing-induced g_agamma of this anomaly-free axion, so the keV a -> gamma gamma line prediction cannot be compared quantitatively to X-ray line searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a decay-line flux model (NFW/cored D-factors for the Galactic halo and clusters) and recast published XMM-Newton/NuSTAR/Chandra blank-sky line limits, with eROSITA/XRISM/ATHENA projections, as a likelihood over (m_a, g_agamma).

members.model_name: Extra-dimensional brane axion Kaluza-Klein dark matter
members.description: No modern likelihood recasts the summed two-photon decay flux of the long-lived KK axion population against current keV-MeV diffuse X-ray/gamma background data and CMB spectral-distortion limits; the card records only source-era analytic bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a line-plus-continuum decaying-DM photon-background likelihood from current diffuse X-ray/gamma measurements (Chandra/NuSTAR/INTEGRAL/COMPTEL-class compilations) and COBE-FIRAS mu/y limits, taking the tower-summed injection history from the gap_1 tool as input and returning bounds in the (T_R, Br, f_PQ) plane.

members.model_name: BrickRed KSVZ axion with colored neutrino-mass mediators
members.description: No likelihood or imported exclusion data exists for comparing the BrickRed (m_a, g_a_gamma) bands to CAST, ADMX, HAYSTAC, CAPP, RBF and projected IAXO/MADMAX sensitivities, or for the Planck isocurvature and black-hole-superradiance filters; all three constraints are marked likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the community-digitized axion exclusion curves (AxionLimits-style compilation) plus the Planck isocurvature amplitude bound and published superradiance mass bands, and wrap them as step-function/Gaussian likelihoods over (m_a, g_a_gamma, H_I, f_a) so BrickRed charge assignments can be scored automatically.

members.model_name: AMSB axino-LSP mixed axion/axino dark matter
members.description: The ADMX-like axion-detection prospect at large f_a/N has no likelihood attached: the card supplies no haloscope sensitivity mapping for the axion-dominated regions, and detectability depends on the relic axion fraction Omega_a/Omega_DM which the route computes only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate published ADMX (and successor haloscope) exclusion limits in (m_a, g_agammagamma) rescaled by the model's local axion fraction from gap_1's abundance code, giving a reusable likelihood for the axion-dominated large-f_a/N region.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark-photon depletion model
members.description: The model's Delta N_eff and modified axion isocurvature predictions are not interfaced to Planck (or forecast CMB-S4) likelihoods, so the neff_dark_radiation_bound and axion_isocurvature_bound_relaxed constraints are applied only as quoted literature limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the depletion-model outputs (Delta N_eff, isocurvature amplitude after depletion) as derived parameters in a Cobaya/MontePython pipeline using the public Planck N_eff and isocurvature likelihoods, plus a CMB-S4 Fisher forecast at sigma(Delta N_eff) ~ 1e-2.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with Peccei-Quinn breaking during warm inflation
members.description: No pipeline connects the model's scale-dependent axion isocurvature spectrum (suppressed at CMB scales, few-percent on small scales) to the Planck isocurvature likelihood; the card's Planck constraint has likelihood_available unknown and recasting_needed partial, so viability in the (f_a, N_c) plane is asserted rather than computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's isocurvature power spectrum as a CDM-isocurvature initial condition in CLASS/CAMB and evaluate it against the Planck 2018 TTTEEE isocurvature likelihood via Cobaya/MontePython, scanning transition e-fold and f_a.

members.model_name: Axionlike dark matter electroweak cogenesis model
members.description: No likelihood exists for the photophobic-longevity and electron-EDM consistency constraint: the card records likelihood_available=no and only qualitative excluded regions in (m_phi, f, ALP-photon coupling, ALP-Higgs mixing).
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published ALP-photon astrophysical bounds (AxionLimits compilations) and the ACME/JILA electron-EDM limits into a joint likelihood over (m_phi, f, theta_mix, anomaly charges), evaluated for the photophobic UV charge assignments the paper sketches.

members.model_name: DFSZ axion model with electroweak-scale scalar sector
members.description: The astrophysical axion constraints are available only as a hard 10^8-10^17 GeV window on f_a, with no likelihood over (f_a, couplings) that reflects the DFSZ-specific photon and electron couplings.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published stellar-cooling, SN 1987A, and haloscope exclusion curves into a joint likelihood evaluated at the DFSZ g_agamma and g_ae predictions, replacing the flat f_a window in the recast.

members.model_name: Hadronic axion hot dark matter in the hadronic axion window
members.description: No packaged likelihood exists for the hadronic-axion window: the stellar/solar/supernova constraint set (hadronic_axion_window) has likelihood_available 'no', and the modern thermal-axion cosmology bound is only 'partial', so the modern_bound_overlay recasting step cannot be run as a joint likelihood over (f_a, m_a, C_a) including the reheating-history dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published thermal-axion CMB/LSS posterior chains (Planck+LSS thermal axion analyses) and the stellar/solar/supernova exclusion curves into a MontePython/Cobaya likelihood module parameterized by (m_a, f_a, C_a, T_reheat), with a switch between standard and low-reheating thermalization histories.

members.model_name: QCD axion hilltop dark matter from heavy-axion phase shift
members.description: No packaged CMB isocurvature likelihood is available for the recast: the card only carries the scalar bound P_S < 8.4e-11, whereas hilltop initial conditions produce enhanced, potentially non-Gaussian isocurvature whose constraint should come from an actual Planck isocurvature likelihood rather than a single-number cut.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Planck uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature likelihood (beta_iso constraint) as a callable module mapping (f_a, theta_i, H_inf) -> P_S -> delta-chi2, including the non-Gaussian hilltop correction to the isocurvature statistics derived in the hilltop-axion literature.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ late-decaying gravitino/axino dark matter
members.description: No detector-level recast connects the predicted MeV axion flux from late gravitino/axino decay to an inverse-Primakoff event rate and exclusion in Hyper-Kamiokande or liquid-xenon experiments: existing axion analyses target solar keV axions, not a monochromatic MeV cosmic flux, and the card records no likelihood for con_late_decay_bbn_axion_final_state.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the inverse-Primakoff cross section on water and xenon at MeV energies, fold in the decay-produced axion flux for the lifetime contours (10^12 s to 10^22 s), and recast published Hyper-K/Super-K and XENONnT/LZ single-scatter data into an exclusion in the (tau, R, g_agamma) plane, packaged as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with radiative, thermal, and geometric PQ-field corrections
members.description: Only an approximate analytic H_I/S_i isocurvature bound exists (likelihood_available is partial); there is no recast of the evolving-PQ-field isocurvature spectrum into the Planck isocurvature likelihood for mixed cold/warm axion components.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the model's isocurvature power spectrum from the PQ-field evolution and map it onto the Planck CDI-isocurvature likelihood (e.g. via CLASS + MontePython/Cobaya), including the ALP dark-matter fraction as a nuisance direction.

members.model_name: PQ-augmented MSSM mixed axion/neutralino cold dark matter
members.description: No modern likelihood pipeline exists for the route's constraints: the relic target is the quoted WMAP7 value rather than a Planck-era likelihood, the BBN bound is a hard T_D > 2 MeV threshold instead of a reaction-network calculation of hadronic/electromagnetic injection from axino/saxion decays, and the Delta N_eff constraint requires an un-performed recast (all three constraints have likelihood_available no or partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Replace the WMAP7 target with the Planck 2018 Omega_DM h^2 likelihood, couple the computed axino/saxion decay temperatures and hadronic branching fractions to a BBN injection code (e.g. AlterBBN or PRIMAT with late-decay modules) to replace the 2 MeV threshold, and map the predicted Delta N_eff onto the Planck N_eff posterior.

members.model_name: SUSY axion hybrid-inflation model with saxion-diluted axion dark matter
members.description: No BBN/N_eff likelihood exists for an MeV-scale saxion matter-domination-and-decay history with a nonthermal relativistic axion component, so both the bbn_check and radiation_branching steps reduce to threshold triage instead of quantitative exclusion contours in (T_sigma, B_sigma_to_aa).
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the saxion decay history with a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PArthENoPE) modified for late entropy injection plus a Planck Delta N_eff likelihood, or digitize published low-reheating-temperature BBN constraints and free-streaming Delta N_eff bounds into a reusable likelihood parameterized by (T_sigma, B_sigma_to_aa).

members.model_name: Vector coherent-oscillation dark matter with curvaton-generated curvature perturbations
members.description: No public likelihood evaluates a nearly scale-invariant, statistically anisotropic dark-matter isocurvature spectrum (the model's smoking-gun signature) against CMB data; the card's cons_2303_cmb_iso_aniso is only 'approximate' and the route caveat notes a modern likelihood update is needed for current exclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the quadrupolar (g_*-type) anisotropic isocurvature transfer in a modified CLASS/CAMB plus a Planck-likelihood MCMC recast, extending the existing Planck axion-isocurvature and statistical-anisotropy analyses to the correlated anisotropic CDM-isocurvature case parameterized by (m_A, H_inf, R_A, Gamma_chi).

members.model_name: Heavy QCD axion dark matter from sterile-axion avoided level crossing
members.description: No CMB isocurvature likelihood evaluation exists for this model: the sterile-axion fluctuations inherited through the level crossing have not been propagated to an isocurvature amplitude, and the card records likelihood_available unknown with no full CMB scan performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Evolve the spatial perturbation modes through the crossing with the same two-field solver as gap_1 (the card notes they obey the same linear equations as the homogeneous fields), compute the CDM isocurvature fraction as a function of H_I and theta_S,0, and constrain it with the public Planck isocurvature likelihood.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with curvature-induced PQ breaking
members.description: No axion isocurvature likelihood is wired in: the constraint is applied only as the quoted Planck isocurvature-fraction number, with no mapping from the model's predicted beta_iso and axion DM fraction to a proper CMB likelihood including inflationary priors on H_I.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the predicted uncorrelated CDM isocurvature amplitude into the standard Planck 2018 isocurvature parameterization and evaluate it with an existing CLASS/CAMB plus Planck likelihood pipeline (MontePython/Cobaya), optionally adding future CMB tensor sensitivity curves for the joint r-plus-haloscope test.

members.model_name: Gravity-reheating QCD axion relic
members.description: No public GW forecast pipeline computes the primordial tensor spectrum through the gravity-governed reheating epoch that fixes the axion relic and evaluates it against ET/BBO/DECIGO noise curves, so the headline forecast (ET probing 1e9 <= f_a <= 1e14 GeV at SNR > 10 for xi = 1) cannot be reproduced or extended to other (theta_i, xi, T_rh) choices.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the tensor transfer function for the model's reheating equation of state (shared with the paper's RHN scenario), couple it to the misalignment abundance calculation so that f_a and the GW spectrum are computed from the same history, and wrap with published mission PSDs in a Fisher/MCMC forecast code.

members.model_name: Axion trapping by cosmic string wakes
members.description: No CMB/LSS likelihood exists for sheet-like axion isocurvature fluctuations or for the associated subdominant string-wake contribution; the route lists only a 'future CMB/LSS isocurvature or defect likelihood' and both constraints have likelihood_available no.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the evolved sheet statistics exist, derive their contribution to the matter power spectrum and CMB anisotropies and implement it as a template likelihood against Planck string/isocurvature bounds and small-scale structure data, updating the WMAP-era defect limit cited in the card.

members.model_name: Model-independent string QCD axion with domain wall number one
members.description: No implemented joint likelihood combining CMB isocurvature bounds and the axion relic-density target for this construction; the card's constraints rest on BICEP2-era numbers and the route's likelihood step is a planned recast only, so current-data exclusion contours in (H_inf, f_a, misalignment angle) cannot be produced.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the analytic isocurvature amplitude and the defect-plus-misalignment Omega_a h^2 prediction into a Cobaya/MontePython pipeline using the public Planck CDM-isocurvature likelihood and the Planck Omega_DM h^2 measurement, replacing the BICEP2-era tensor inputs with current Planck/BK constraints.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with quasi-flat stochastic inflationary misalignment
members.description: No likelihood pipeline maps the non-equilibrium (quasi-flat) end-of-inflation axion distribution into isocurvature power P_S and confronts it jointly with Planck isocurvature and tensor (r_0.002) constraints; only equilibrium-distribution isocurvature bounds exist in the literature.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature power spectrum from the quasi-flat theta_end distribution (including the hilltop enhancement), feed it as a CDM-isocurvature component into CLASS/CAMB, and build a recast against the public Planck 2018 + BK inflation likelihood over (f_a, H_end).

members.model_name: PQ-extended MSSM axino dark matter with thermal inflation
members.description: No likelihood mapping exists between this model's axion subcomponent (cold misalignment plus possible hot axions from flaton decay) and the thermal hot-axion cosmological limits cited in the card, which apply to fully thermalized eV axions rather than the model's mixed population.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the model's thermal-axion fraction after flaton decay and entropy dilution, then recast it through an existing hot-dark-matter fraction likelihood (Planck-era thermal-axion analyses implemented in MontePython/Cobaya) instead of applying the eV thermal-axion mass bound directly.

members.model_name: USSM-A neutralino dark matter with gauged axion
members.description: No likelihood exists for the combined constraint set: the WMAP-era relic-density comparison has not been updated to Planck, and the CAST helioscope bound on the axion-gauge coupling is not digitized into a usable exclusion in the (m_a, M_St) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a simple joint likelihood using the Planck 2018 Omega_c h^2 measurement as a Gaussian target and digitized CAST (plus modern helioscope/haloscope) exclusion curves mapped onto the model's M_St-suppressed coupling.

members.model_name: Axion-mediated singlet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The collider constraint rests on the paper's 8 TeV monophoton recast with only a partial likelihood; no Run 2 (13 TeV) monophoton-plus-MET recast of the axion-like mediator with its electroweak branching structure is implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate mediator-plus-photon production with MadGraph using the FeynRules EFT model and recast current ATLAS/CMS 13 TeV monophoton searches via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, including invisible and electroweak-boson decay branches of the mediator.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn scotogenic mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: No haloscope likelihood exists for the axion component in the mixed regime: ADMX-class sensitivity assumes the axion is all of the local dark matter, and no packaged likelihood rescales the reach by the axion fraction Omega_a/Omega_DM predicted jointly with the WIMP component.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble published ADMX (and other haloscope) exclusion curves into a likelihood parameterized by (m_a, g_agammagamma, local axion fraction), with the fraction supplied by the misalignment estimate of step r1.

members.model_name: String axion dark matter coexisting with O(10) solar-mass primordial black holes
members.description: The Planck isocurvature bound is applied only as the analytic scaling H_inf < 1e9 GeV (f_a/1e16 GeV)^0.405 quoted from the literature; no CMB isocurvature likelihood is rerun for this axion-fraction and double-inflation spectrum, so the bound cannot be updated or applied when the axion is subdominant.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the axion isocurvature amplitude for the model's (f_a, theta, H_inf) in CAMB/CLASS with an uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature mode and run against the Planck likelihood, parameterized by the axion dark-matter fraction so the bound generalizes beyond the all-axion assumption.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with early matter domination
members.description: No CMB isocurvature likelihood recast exists for the EMD-modified relation between (f_a, theta_i, H_I) and the axion isocurvature fraction; the existing bounds assume standard cosmological history and cannot be copied directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the EMD-modified isocurvature amplitude beta_iso(f_a, theta_i, T_R, H_I) using the gap_1 relic solver, then evaluate it against the Planck isocurvature likelihood (uncorrelated CDM isocurvature mode in the standard Planck chains) to produce exclusion contours in the (H_I, f_a) plane.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion extended model E_I with vectorlike matter and mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood exists for the final recast step: the LZ spin-independent limit is not reproduced as a likelihood for the xi_LSP-rescaled Higgsino cross section, and the compiled CAST/ADMX/haloscope axion-photon curves used for the E_I g_Agamma target are not digitized into a usable exclusion function.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the LZ limit via a public direct-detection likelihood package (e.g. DDCalc-style) with the local-fraction rescaling xi_LSP = Omega_LSP/Omega_DM applied to the event rate, and digitize the standard axion-photon limit compilation into (m_A, g_Agamma) exclusion curves evaluated at the E_I E/N value.

members.model_name: Kalb-Ramond gravitational axion dark matter from heavy sterile fermions
members.description: No likelihood exists for recasting the KR axion into ALP cosmology constraints: both card constraints have likelihood_available no/unknown, so relic-density, structure, and isocurvature bounds can only be compared by eye against generic ALP exclusion plots.
members.proposed_resolution: Once gap_1 supplies (m_b, Omega_b_axion, isocurvature amplitude), wire these into existing public ALP constraint compilations (AxionLimits-style curves plus the Planck isocurvature likelihood) as a composite likelihood over (m_N, f_b, initial displacement).

members.model_name: ULAP oscillon dark matter
members.description: No public Ly-alpha flux-power likelihood is available to constrain the oscillon-modified ULAP power spectrum; published FDM bounds (m_FDM > 20-37.5 x 1e-22 eV) assume standard homogeneous fuzzy-DM transfer functions and cannot be applied without recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the XQ-100 plus HIRES/MIKE flux-power analysis with hydrodynamical simulations (or an emulator such as a LaCE-type framework) run on oscillon-modified initial power spectra, marginalizing over the IGM thermal history as in the original FDM analysis.

members.model_name: DFSZ axion-Higgs model with small singlet-doublet coupling
members.description: Astrophysical axion constraints (stellar cooling, SN1987A, haloscopes) are applied only as a quoted lower scale on v_phi; no likelihood over (m_a, g_agamma, g_ae, g_aN) exists for the DFSZ coupling pattern, so the constraint cannot enter a joint fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published bound curves compiled in AxionLimits into approximate likelihoods for the DFSZ E/N = 8/3 coupling pattern (including the tan-beta dependence of g_ae), packaged as a function of (f_a, tan beta).

members.model_name: Planet 9 axion-star dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No radio line-search likelihood or sensitivity pipeline exists for a narrow axion-decay line from a single localized outer-Solar-System source: the card records FAST/SKA detectability only as quoted sensitivity estimates with likelihood_available: no and no telescope pipeline run.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a point-source narrow-line sensitivity model for FAST and SKA1-Low/Mid (system temperature, bandwidth matched to the line width, integration time) and wrap it as a likelihood over (m_a, f_a, r_9), reusing existing radio axion-line search frameworks developed for neutron-star axion searches.

members.model_name: Axiogenesis rotating QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or recast module maps the favored small-f_a window (1e6-1e8 GeV) onto haloscope/helioscope exclusions with this model's anomaly coefficients, nor onto collider constraints for the 1-10 TeV states invoked to raise the weak transition temperature.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the digitized g_a_gamma and axion-matter-coupling exclusions from the public AxionLimits compilation into a likelihood keyed to (m_a, anomaly coefficients), and add LHC electroweak-state search limits for the 1-10 TeV spectrum variants.

members.model_name: Darkly charged mirror-sector relics in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: No CMB energy-injection likelihood exists for Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation of mirror charged relics into the heavy QCD axion; the current bound is a generic <sigma v> constraint scaled with an assumed f_eff = 0.1 and (Omega_i/Omega_DM)^2, not a Planck recast for axion-to-hadronic deposition.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the axion decay cascade spectra (e.g. with HDMSpectra-style tools for hadronic final states), derive f_eff(z) with DarkHistory or ExoCLASS including the velocity-dependent Sommerfeld factor, and build a Planck ionization-history likelihood for each relic component.

members.model_name: Misaligned axion Chern-Simons condensate model
members.description: No packaged pipeline maps (m_a, g, axion fraction) to CMB EB/TB spectra and a birefringence likelihood for this model; the con_cmb_birefringence_recast constraint is marked recast-required with only a partial likelihood and no model-specific beta(z,nu) computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Once beta(z) is derived (gap_1), implement the rotation in a modified CLASS/CAMB polarization module and recast the published Planck/WMAP isotropic-birefringence rotation-angle posteriors (Minami-Komatsu-style EB analyses) into a likelihood over g and m_a.

members.model_name: Ultralight real pNGB dark matter for strong-gravity scenarios
members.description: The CMB isocurvature constraint on the pre-inflationary scenario is applied only as an approximate H_I/v_Phi restriction; no isocurvature likelihood has been evaluated for the model's (theta_i, v_Phi, H_I) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the model's predicted uncorrelated CDM isocurvature amplitude onto the Planck beta_iso likelihood (standard axion-isocurvature recast) to obtain quantitative allowed regions in (m_eta, v_Phi, H_I).

members.model_name: PQ inflation axion dark matter with higher-dimensional operators
members.description: No assembled likelihood pipeline exists that confronts this model's joint predictions (tensor-to-scalar ratio, axion isocurvature fraction, theta_min quality violation, domain-wall consistency) with Planck CMB and neutron-EDM data; the card records likelihood_available no/partial and recasting_needed yes for the corresponding constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that maps (f, xi, lambda, g, l, N_DW) to (r, beta_iso, theta_min) and evaluates them against the public Planck inflation/isocurvature likelihoods and the published neutron-EDM bound on theta, packaged for a sampler such as Cobaya or MontePython.

members.model_name: Palatini-Higgs QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline connects the Palatini-Higgs spectator-axion parameters (H_*, v_PQ, theta_i) to the Planck cold-dark-matter isocurvature likelihood; only the paper's analytic comparison to published beta_iso limits exists, so the critical CMB isocurvature observable cannot be evaluated numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a thin Cobaya/CosmoMC theory module that computes the axion isocurvature amplitude beta_iso(H_*, v_PQ, theta_i) from the standard spectator-field formula and evaluates it against the public Planck likelihood with a CDM-isocurvature extension of CAMB/CLASS.

members.model_name: Reheating-induced inflaxion axion dark matter
members.description: No isocurvature likelihood recast exists for this low-scale inflaxion scenario: the card flags likelihood_available 'partial' with recasting_needed 'yes', so the claimed isocurvature relief cannot be quantitatively confronted with Planck.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the model's dark-matter isocurvature amplitude as a function of H_inf and the reheating-fixed misalignment angle, then map it onto the Planck 2018 beta_iso bound (directly, or via a CLASS+MontePython run with CDM isocurvature initial conditions).

members.model_name: Minimal PQ axion model for five-texture-zero fermion mass matrices
members.description: The combined f_a window from black-hole superradiance, SN1987A, and neutron-EDM considerations is a quoted range with no reproducible likelihood, so the astrophysical constraint on this model cannot be re-evaluated or combined statistically with search data.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published SN1987A axion-nucleon cooling limits and black-hole superradiance exclusions using this model's derived coupling ratios, encoding them as parameterized likelihood curves in f_a alongside the neutron-EDM bound instead of a fixed interval.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dynamical decay constant
members.description: No route connects the model's central prediction (modified axion isocurvature perturbations for high-scale inflation) to CMB data: the card contains no isocurvature observable, derived spectrum, or comparison against the Planck isocurvature bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature power amplitude for the dynamical-f scenario (fluctuations imprinted at f_inf and rescaled by the subsequent f evolution) and evaluate it against the public Planck CDM-isocurvature likelihood as a function of (H_inf, f_inf/f0, n).

members.model_name: Two-axion 1 Hz ALP dark matter with low-scale inflation
members.description: No likelihood exists for the model's direct-detection signature: an m_a ~ 1e-15 eV ALP oscillating at 1 Hz with photon, gluon/EDM, nucleon, and lepton couplings; the card's single constraint entry is a placeholder with likelihood_available unknown and no packaged experimental comparison for the 1 Hz frequency window.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood over (m_a, g_agamma, g_d, g_aN, g_ae) in the 1e-15 eV window from published low-frequency haloscope, nuclear-EDM (CASPEr-electric), co-magnetometer, and torsion-balance limits, e.g. by wrapping the digitized exclusion data compiled in AxionLimits into interpolated likelihood curves.

members.model_name: Geometric-baryogenesis QCD axion cold dark matter
members.description: No assembled CMB isocurvature likelihood evaluation exists for this model: the allowed axion CDM fraction as a function of (f_a, theta_osc, H_inf, M) is asserted from the quoted Planck bound rather than computed, so the overclosure/isocurvature constraint region cannot be mapped quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the axion isocurvature amplitude analytically from (H_inf, f_a, theta_osc), map it onto the Planck 2018 beta_iso constraint via a Cobaya/CosmoMC run with the standard uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature parameterization, and tabulate the allowed (f_a, theta_osc, H_inf) region for the registry.

members.model_name: Mirrored Dirac neutrino dark matter with B-prime-minus-L-prime annihilation
members.description: No likelihood or digitized exclusion contours exist for the heavy-axion beam-dump (CHARM), collider, and cosmological constraints in the (M_a, f_a) plane, or for mapping them onto the mirror-neutrino parameter space; both linked constraints report likelihood_available: no and recasting_needed: yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the primary paper's beam-dump/collider/cosmology contours in the (M_a, f_a) plane, wrap them as a binary-exclusion likelihood module, and combine with the relic-density likelihood so the full route can be scanned over (m_nu', v'/v, M_a, f_a, alpha_B'-L').

members.model_name: Low-reheat invisible axion dark matter
members.description: No public likelihood implements the modern BBN/CMB lower bound on T_RH (about 4.1-4.7 MeV in the cited Planck-era analysis); con_axion_low_reheat_floor has likelihood_available: partial and recasting_needed: yes, so the relaxed f_PQ region near very low T_RH cannot be statistically bounded.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published low-reheat neutrino-thermalization plus BBN/Planck analysis (arXiv:1511.00672-style) into a reusable T_RH likelihood module combining N_eff and light-element data, shared across the low-reheat model family.

members.model_name: Nonthermal sub-keV light dark matter fraction from radiative decays
members.description: The momentum distribution of the boosted decay-produced sub-keV component (born relativistic, redshifting through radiation domination) has not been derived in a form usable by a Boltzmann solver, so the mixed cold+hot transfer function for this scenario cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the analytic f(q) for two-body decay production during radiation domination as a function of tau and m_parent/m_DM, tabulate it into the CLASS ncdm module alongside a dominant CDM component, and compute the mixed transfer function and Delta N_eff self-consistently.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter with a long-range dark fifth force
members.description: No nonlinear perturbation-theory or simulation framework exists for dark-sector fifth forces with DM-baryon equivalence-principle violation, which the card identifies as required before galaxy power-spectrum and higher-point statistics from DESI/Euclid-like surveys can be used.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the beta-dependent perturbation-theory kernels including relative DM-baryon density and velocity modes, implement them in an EFT-of-LSS pipeline (CLASS-PT or PyBird style), and cross-check with a small suite of N-body simulations that include the dark-only fifth force.

members.model_name: Early mass-varying sterile-neutrino nugget dark matter with kination-diluted scalar EDE
members.description: The microphysical nugget-formation dynamics (m_D, lambda, m_phi, m_psi1) and the phenomenological fluid transition used in the MCMC are related but not identical idealizations; no derived mapping exists from the Lagrangian parameters to the effective w(z), c_s^2(z), transition width, and the fraction of EDE energy entering kination versus nuggets.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid parameters by evolving the coupled sterile-neutrino-scalar equations through the instability (linear perturbation theory plus a spherical-collapse or lattice treatment of nugget condensation), including the modified scalar potential required for kination rather than matter-like oscillation, and tabulate the resulting w(z) and energy partition for use in the Boltzmann solver.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in quark-portal dark matter
members.description: No derivation exists of the confined keV-scale dark-matter momentum distribution from the CFT energy density after QCD-induced conformal breaking; the paper tracks energy density only, so the model-specific f(q) needed for a precision warm-DM recast is absent.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive or parameterize the confinement mapping — e.g. assume dark-sector self-thermalization at the gap scale with a parameterized mean momentum and width, bracketed by extreme energy-partition scenarios — and tabulate the resulting f(q) as input to a Boltzmann solver, checking sensitivity of the transfer function to the ansatz.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter with Chern-Simons photon-current coupling
members.description: For the 5 keV warm benchmark no momentum distribution or linear transfer function exists (distribution_function_available: no, thermal_wdm_mapping unavailable), so the small-scale structure implications mentioned by the paper cannot be evaluated against warm-dark-matter bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a concrete asymmetry-generation/production history for the 5 keV benchmark, derive f(p), compute the transfer function with CLASS/CAMB, and map to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass to apply existing Ly-alpha and subhalo-count bounds.

members.model_name: Messenger-inflation minimal GMSB gravitino superWIMP
members.description: No linear transfer function exists for the decay-produced gravitino population: the card gives only an analytic free-streaming length for gravitinos injected at tau_B ~ 1 s with relativistic momenta, but the actual non-thermal f(q) (set by two-body NLSP decay kinematics convolved with the decay-time distribution) has never been fed through a Boltzmann code, so the smooth_cutoff transfer-function shape and half-mode mass are unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) from bino -> gravitino + photon/Z kinematics with the exponential decay-time distribution, implement it as a non-cold species in the CLASS/CAMB ncdm sector, and compute the transfer-function suppression and half-mode mass as functions of (m_B, m_3/2, tau_B).

members.model_name: Messenger-inflation minimal GMSB gravitino superWIMP
members.description: Hadronic and electromagnetic branching fractions of the late bino NLSP decay are not tabulated in the card, so the BBN safety statement rests solely on the tau_B < 1 s benchmark; corners of the spectrum with longer lifetimes cannot be checked against photodissociation and hadrodissociation constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the bino -> gravitino + gamma/Z/h branching ratios and the resulting EM/hadronic energy injection across the GMSB parameter space, and evaluate them with a public BBN injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS-class solver) rather than the lifetime-threshold criterion.

members.model_name: Minimal nonminimal-coupling inflaton dark matter
members.description: The structure-formation lower mass floor (m_phi > ~10 keV) is only cited, not derived: the nonthermal momentum distribution of preheating-produced inflaton quanta is never computed, so no transfer function exists to check the floor for this specific production mechanism.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract the inflaton occupation spectrum f(k) from the lattice simulations of gap_1, redshift it to late times, and feed it as a tabulated non-cold relic distribution into CLASS/CAMB to compute the linear power suppression and a proper mass floor.

members.model_name: Non-thermal WIMP baryogenesis model
members.description: The nonthermal WIMP momentum distribution from parent decay (initial energy ~ m_phi/2) is not tracked; the paper omits the momentum-dependent treatment, so free-streaming effects on small-scale structure are unquantified (structure_formation fields all unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p,z) for decay-produced WIMPs redshifting and scattering through reheating, compute the free-streaming length and transfer function with a modified CLASS non-cold-relic module, and verify the claim that momentum dependence does not change the abundance results.

members.model_name: Radiative seesaw warm N_1 dark matter with N_2 entropy dilution
members.description: The post-dilution N_1 momentum distribution f(p) is not derived (card: distribution_function_available = no), so the free-streaming cutoff and transfer function for this diluted thermal relic cannot be computed beyond a sterile-neutrino mass analogy.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by evolving the decoupled thermal N_1 spectrum through the N_2 entropy-injection epoch (redshifting plus dilution in a momentum-resolved Boltzmann calculation), then feed the resulting f(p) into CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold dark matter species to obtain model-specific transfer functions.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L low-reheating sterile neutrino production
members.description: The full sterile-neutrino momentum distribution from subthermal U(1) B-L gauge-boson-mediated production below the B-L breaking temperature has not been derived; the card records only an approximate distribution and the statement that the low-energy average momentum is close to the keV Miracle case, which is insufficient for production-specific transfer functions.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent production Boltzmann equation with massive B-L gauge-boson scattering rates, integrating from T_R downward and including entropy dilution from disappearing degrees of freedom, to obtain f(p) as a function of (T_R, T_B-L, m_s, gauge coupling), validated by recovering the quoted T_R ~ 5e13 GeV abundance requirement.

members.model_name: Non-cold fermionic dark matter from primordial black hole evaporation
members.description: The Delta N_eff estimate uses the relativistic-limit formula only; there is no calculation tracking the emitted species' energy density through the relativistic-to-nonrelativistic transition, which the card notes overstates the CMB effect.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute rho_DM(a) directly from the derived f(q) distribution and feed it to CLASS as an ncdm species so the CMB radiation-density contribution is evaluated self-consistently instead of via the relativistic-limit Delta N_eff formula.

members.model_name: Cosmological gauge field dark matter
members.description: CGF cosmological perturbation equations beyond the leading classical order are not derived, so there is no way to propagate the w=0 CGF fluid into CMB/LSS precision observables; the card's own constraint states falsification requires calculating fluctuations, and no Boltzmann-code implementation of the CGF fluid exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linearized perturbation equations for the oscillating classical SU(2) gauge-field fluid (effective sound speed and anisotropic stress) and implement it as a generalized-dark-matter fluid species in CLASS or CAMB, then compare against Planck background and perturbation data.

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP with right-handed sneutrino NLSP
members.description: The non-thermal momentum distribution of gravitinos produced in late right-handed sneutrino decay is not derived (distribution_function_available is 'no'); the card characterizes the warm component only by a single free-streaming length of about 6 Mpc and a fraction, which is insufficient input for a Boltzmann-code transfer-function calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gravitino phase-space distribution f(q) from the exponential decay of a nonrelativistic sneutrino population (standard late-decay redshifted-monochromatic form with lifetime tau_snu_R) and supply it as a tabulated ncdm distribution to CLASS/CAMB for the warm component alongside a cold thermal-scattering component.

members.model_name: Light freeze-in dark matter from thermal two-body scalar decay
members.description: The unintegrated momentum distribution f(p) of chi from thermal two-body scalar decay is not derived; the paper only solves integrated number and energy Boltzmann equations, and the distribution depends on the unspecified spectrum (m_phi, m_psi), blocking any transfer-function computation.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for freeze-in from thermal two-body decay (a known semi-analytic calculation for decay-produced FIMPs) to obtain f(q) as a function of m_phi/m_chi and g_*_dec, and package it as a CLASS ncdm psd input table.

members.model_name: Goldilocks gravitino dark matter from neutralino decays
members.description: The nonthermal phase-space distribution f(q) of gravitinos from late two-body neutralino decays has never been derived and propagated to a linear transfer function for this model; only an approximate free-streaming length lambda_FS is used, so the actual small-scale power suppression shape is unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) analytically for monochromatic two-body decay with exponential decay-time distribution during radiation domination, tabulate it as a CLASS ncdm distribution over the (m_chi, m_gravitino, tau_chi) plane, and compute transfer functions to replace the lambda_FS proxy.

members.model_name: Mixed axion/axino dark matter for thermal leptogenesis
members.description: The axino phase-space distribution f(q) combining thermal production with nonthermal neutralino-NLSP-decay and gravitino-cascade components has not been derived, so the mixed cold/warm/hot transfer function cannot be computed and only crude m_axino and fraction flags stand in for structure-formation predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for each axino production channel (thermal scattering/decay spectrum, decay kinematics of the neutralino NLSP and gravitino cascades with redshifting), sum weighted by the channel abundances, and feed it to CLASS/CAMB as one or more non-cold (ncdm) species to compute the mixed transfer function and half-mode scale.

members.model_name: Type I seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: The phase-space distribution of the decay-produced keV-scale S has not been derived (card: distribution_function_available 'no', no transfer function or thermal-WDM mapping), so free-streaming and structure-formation viability of a 16 keV Higgs-decay freeze-in candidate cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for S pairs from relativistic h -> SS decay during freeze-in using standard decay-produced FIMP results, evolve it through CLASS as a non-cold relic to obtain the transfer function, and map to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass for comparison with existing Ly-alpha and subhalo-count bounds.

members.model_name: Coleman-Weinberg ultralight scalar dark matter with GeV-scale right-handed neutrinos
members.description: The isocurvature-suppression claim is only sketched as a mechanism: no quantitative isocurvature power spectrum from thermal erasure of initial conditions has been derived, so the CMB-facing observable cannot be compared to Planck isocurvature limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the residual scalar isocurvature amplitude as a function of inflationary Hubble scale and the thermal relaxation history, then compare against Planck isocurvature constraints via a CLASS run with a correlated CDM-isocurvature mode.

members.model_name: Decoupled self-interacting real scalar dark matter
members.description: The card gives the phase-space distribution (Bose-Einstein with chemical potential) but no route step or derived pipeline maps it to a linear transfer function, free-streaming length, or half-mode mass, so the warm/cold classification promised as a derived quantity cannot be computed quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate the frozen-out f(q) with temperature and chemical potential and feed it to the CLASS non-cold dark matter (ncdm) module with a custom distribution file to obtain T^2(k) and the half-mode scale across the (m, lambda, T_dark, mu) parameter space.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw freeze-in long-lived S dark matter
members.description: The phase-space distribution of the decay-produced 1 keV S has not been derived (card: distribution_function_available 'no', no transfer function or thermal-WDM mapping); for a 1 keV decay-produced candidate the free-streaming scale is potentially in tension with Ly-alpha bounds, but this cannot be assessed without the distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for S pairs from relativistic h -> SS decay during freeze-in using standard decay-produced FIMP results, evolve it through CLASS as a non-cold relic to obtain the transfer function, and map to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass for comparison with existing Ly-alpha and subhalo-count bounds.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector dark matter with two-Higgs-doublet scalar portal
members.description: The XENON1T comparison uses only optimistic unsuppressed spin-independent scattering; no derivation or recast covers velocity- or momentum-suppressed portal-induced nuclear scattering across the model's spin and operator classes.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nonrelativistic effective operators for each vertex class connecting portal mixing to nuclear scattering and evaluate suppressed cases with a public direct-detection framework such as DDCalc or WimPyDD against XENON1T/LZ likelihoods.

members.model_name: Hot and heavy phase-transition-produced scalar dark matter
members.description: The full nonthermal phase-space distribution f_X(p) from bubble-wall pair production is only approximate on the card (distribution_function_available: approximate); without the complete distribution, the CLASS NCDM run in step s3 and every downstream small-scale-structure statement rest on the single-velocity v(t_eq) proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full emitted momentum spectrum from the anti-adiabatic wall-crossing amplitude integrated over the incoming thermal flux and wall geometry, redshift it through the reheating history, and tabulate f_X(q) in the psd format CLASS ncdm accepts.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: The final confined dark-matter momentum distribution after SM-induced conformal breaking is not derived; the paper tracks CFT energy density only, so no f(q) exists to feed a Boltzmann solver for structure-formation checks away from the cold 1-10 MeV benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive or model the mapping from CFT energy density to the post-confinement PGB momentum spectrum (e.g. a thermalized dark-sector ansatz at the gap scale with parameterized deviations), tabulate f(q), and feed it to CLASS's non-cold-relic module to compute the transfer function.

members.model_name: Leptophilic Sommerfeld-enhanced WIMP toy model
members.description: The exact relation between the effective decoupling temperature and the smallest-protohalo cutoff mass M_cut has not been derived for strongly resonant cases where asymptotic free streaming is reached near or after matter-radiation equality, so the quoted O(10^-10) to O(10) M_sun cutoffs are only approximate in exactly the most extreme regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear matter power cutoff for late (post-equality) effective decoupling by solving the full perturbed Boltzmann hierarchy with the model's velocity-dependent annihilation and self-scattering terms in an ETHOS-parameterized modified CLASS, replacing the standard T_kd-to-M_cut fitting formulae in this regime.

members.model_name: Warm dark matter from long-lived Majorana fermion decays
members.description: The full daughter phase-space distribution f(q) from three-body chi_2 -> chi_1 f fbar decays occurring over an extended lifetime (tau2 > 1 s) has never been derived for this model — only a free-streaming-length estimate exists — so no nonthermal transfer function can be computed and thermal-WDM mass bounds cannot be honestly recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-space Boltzmann equation for chi_1 injection from redshift-distributed chi_2 decays with the three-body spectrum, tabulate f(q) over (M1/M2, tau2), and feed it to CLASS as a non-cold-dark-matter species to obtain the linear power suppression and half-mode scale.

members.model_name: Decay-product hot dark matter
members.description: Decays occurring during the CMB era (tau > 5.2e10 s) are excluded from the source's reduced-parameter treatment; the perturbation-level effect of CMB-era decays on anisotropies has not been derived, so the model cannot be evaluated in that lifetime regime.
