members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full time-dependent decay source terms for the daughter phase-space perturbations and implement them in a modified CLASS (extending existing decaying-CDM modules to hot daughters), performing the dedicated CMB power-spectrum study the paper calls for.

members.model_name: Decaying warm dark matter to invisible radiation
members.description: The Boltzmann hierarchy neglects inverse decays and scattering, yet the posterior preference lies partly in the relativistic-decay regime where inverse processes matter, so the favored parameter region is not reliably evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the inverse-decay collision integrals for the phi nu nu interaction at background and perturbation level, add them to the modified CLASS hierarchy, and recheck the favored relativistic-decay parameter region of the primary MCMC.

members.model_name: Memory-burdened PBH evaporation dark matter cogenesis
members.description: The phase-space distribution f(p) of dark matter emitted during the memory-burdened (slowed) evaporation phase is only approximate; existing Hawking-emission codes implement semiclassical evaporation and do not include the k,q-suppressed phase, so the input needed for the transfer-function step does not exist for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Hawking-spectrum code such as BlackHawk with the memory-burden prescription (mass-loss rate suppressed by (M/M_in)^(-k) beyond onset fraction q) to output the time-integrated emitted f(p) including redshifting through entropy injection, then pass it to CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution.

members.model_name: DFSZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: The full axino phase-space distribution f(p) for the mixed thermal-plus-NLSP-decay population is not available (card: distribution_function_available approximate, only benchmark present velocities), so the transfer-function step cannot be fed a real input and free-streaming is judged only by a velocity heuristic.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p,t) for both populations — a redshifted thermal spectrum from production at T_R and a decay-injected spectrum from the NLSP lifetime and mass ratio — and tabulate it as a psd file for the CLASS ncdm sector to compute the mixed cold-warm transfer function over (m_axino, f_a, T_R, NLSP identity).

members.model_name: Moduli-produced wino or higgsino neutralino dark matter
members.description: The model-specific wino/higgsino kinetic-decoupling calculation in a low-reheat plasma (T_kd relative to T_rh, and the resulting k_fs and k_d damping scales) is flagged as required but not implemented; only the qualitative wash-out conclusion is recorded.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the standard neutralino elastic-scattering-rate and kinetic-decoupling formalism (as implemented in DarkSUSY) to the modified temperature-scale-factor relation of a moduli-reheating history, deriving T_kd(T_rh, m_chi) and the damped transfer function for wino and higgsino benchmarks.

members.model_name: Inverse-seesaw sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter with dynamical lepton-number breaking
members.description: The Majoron Delta N_eff prediction lacks a coupled thermalization calculation: the paper itself notes a detailed simultaneous treatment of scalar/Majoron thermalization via lambda_1H is beyond its scope, leaving the CMB observable at order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the phi_1/phi_2/J sector thermalizing through the Higgs portal to obtain Delta N_eff(lambda_1H, v1, v2), then evaluate it against Planck N_eff posteriors with a CLASS-based Majoron cosmology run including late J -> nu nu decays.

members.model_name: Thermal unparticle unmatter dark matter
members.description: Only background-level (constant-w) constraints exist for unmatter: the density-perturbation equations of the thermal unparticle fluid (effective sound speed and anisotropic stress from the continuous spectral density) have not been derived, so no perturbation-level CMB/LSS constraint on Omega_U and d_U can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive c_s^2(d_U) and the perturbation closure for the unparticle fluid from its spectral-density thermodynamics, implement it as a generalized dark fluid in CLASS, and run a Planck plus BAO plus SNIa fit (e.g. with Cobaya) over (Omega_U, d_U), superseding the CMB-shift-parameter-only analysis.

members.model_name: Two-component asymmetric dark matter via bound states and freeze-in decay
members.description: The full nonthermal phase-space distribution f(p) of the boosted light component injected by late bound-state decays is not derived (distribution_function_available no; the decay step yields momentum injection but 'not a complete f(p)'), preventing free-streaming and small-scale structure assessment.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p,t) analytically from the two-body decay source term convolved with the bound-state decay history and redshifting, then feed it as a non-cold species (CLASS ncdm with tabulated psd) to obtain the transfer function and an effective free-streaming/half-mode scale.

members.model_name: 7.1 keV sterile-neutrino dark matter with low-scale leptogenesis
members.description: The full momentum distribution f(p) of sterile neutrinos produced by out-of-equilibrium singlet-scalar decay at T ~ 100 GeV is only approximately known for this model; the primary paper explicitly leaves the detailed free-streaming/velocity analysis beyond scope, blocking any quantitative small-scale-structure statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p,T) by solving the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for freeze-in from decays of an initially thermal scalar (standard decay-produced freeze-in formalism), including entropy dilution from T_prod ~ 100 GeV to today, and tabulate it as a psd file for the CLASS ncdm module.

members.model_name: Preheating-produced sterile-neutrino fermionic dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal Bogoliubov momentum spectrum has not been propagated to any late-time constraint: no free-streaming length, transfer function, or thermal-WDM mapping is derived from it, so the spectrum's only current use is qualitative (the card's structure-formation block is entirely unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Redshift the derived f(k) spectra to today, compute the free-streaming scale and linear transfer function with a Boltzmann code that accepts non-cold distribution functions (CLASS ncdm with tabulated psd), and derive the effective thermal-WDM mass mapping across the (M_R, M_i, tau, H_dS) parameter space.

members.model_name: Composite millicharged absorption-line dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the composite model's binding energy, ionized fraction, and dark-radiation content onto the effective parameters of existing atomic-dark-matter Boltzmann codes has not been derived, so CMB anisotropy and matter-power constraints on the ionized regime cannot be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dictionary from (E_binding, epsilon, dark-sector temperature ratio, dark fine-structure analogue) to the atomic-DM parameterization used in the cited atomic-dark-matter literature, then run the existing public atomic-DM CLASS extension to obtain CMB and matter-power predictions and compare the DAO scale against the related-paper examples.

members.model_name: E6-inspired custodial SUSY model with two dark-matter candidates
members.description: For the eV-scale inert-neutralino variant there is no derivation of the hidden-state thermal decoupling history through the heavy Z-prime (decoupling temperature, temperature ratio, resulting Delta N_eff and hot-DM fraction), so the hot-dark-matter recast in step s3 cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the Z-prime-mediated interaction rates and decoupling temperature of the light inert neutralinos as a function of M_Z' and the singlet VEV, compute their temperature ratio and Delta N_eff, and evaluate the hot fraction with CLASS ncdm against Planck CMB plus BAO likelihoods.

members.model_name: Dark-photon freeze-in Dirac fermion dark matter during early matter domination
members.description: The card provides only the number-density yield, not the full nonthermal momentum distribution f(p) of chi produced during the EMD era, so the free-streaming length, linear transfer function, and any EMDE-enhanced microhalo prediction cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by solving the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for freeze-in during the parameterized EMD (including entropy injection redshifting), then feed it to a Boltzmann code (CLASS with a non-cold relic distribution) to obtain the transfer function and small-scale cutoff/enhancement.

members.model_name: A4 seesaw Majoron decaying dark matter
members.description: The Majoron relic abundance is normalized by a free parameter beta with no derivation of the production mechanism or phase-space distribution f(p); for the quoted 0.12-0.17 keV thermal mass window the free-streaming behavior is critical, yet the card's structure-formation entries are all unknown, so relic-density and structure observables cannot be evaluated from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the Majoron thermalization and decoupling history in the seesaw scalar sector (fixing beta), compute f(p), and feed it to CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution to obtain the transfer function and check keV-scale free-streaming against Ly-alpha/structure bounds.

members.model_name: S3 x Z2 sterile-neutrino dark matter model
members.description: No calculation exists of the S3 x Z2 sterile-neutrino relic abundance and momentum distribution from its actual production channels (feeble scalar-sector Yukawas and the dimension-5 L N_s D phi operator); public sterile-neutrino codes implement only mixing-driven thermal production, so the model's warm/cold classification and DM fraction are undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the freeze-in Boltzmann equation at the distribution-function level for N_s production via the S3 x Z2 scalar and Yukawa couplings (e.g. extend a freeze-in phase-space code or write a dedicated momentum-dependent solver as done for scotogenic FIMPs), outputting f(p) and Omega h^2 over the keV-MeV mass range; feed f(p) into CLASS to obtain the transfer function.

members.model_name: Doublet left-right model with right-handed fermion quintuplet dark matter
members.description: Delta N_eff from Dirac right-handed-neutrino decoupling is computed only with an instantaneous rate-versus-Hubble estimate rather than a full thermal-history solution, a precision limitation the card itself flags and which matters for the CMB-S4 Delta N_eff = 0.06 target.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a neutrino-decoupling Boltzmann code (e.g. a nudec_BSM- or FortEPiaNO-style solver) with W_R/Z_R-mediated right-neutrino interaction rates to compute Delta N_eff(M_WR, g_R) through the QCD transition, replacing the instantaneous-decoupling estimate.

members.model_name: MiTeVeS Noether-current mimetic dark matter cosmology
members.description: Linear cosmological perturbation theory for MiTeVeS (scalar/vector/mimetic sector sound speed, closure relations, and growth equations) has not been derived, and consequently no Boltzmann-solver implementation exists, so no large-scale-structure or growth prediction can be made; the paper explicitly defers perturbations to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linearized field equations for the mimetic scalar-vector sector around FLRW (including the effective sound speed c_s and any anisotropic stress), then implement them in a modified Einstein-Boltzmann code such as a CLASS or hi_class extension to output the matter power spectrum and growth rate for comparison with clustering data.

members.model_name: SU(3) x U(1) ten-plet accident dark matter
members.description: The spin-independent scalar-nucleon cross section for the six-state ten-plet multiplet through the Higgs portal has not been computed, so LZ/XENON-class direct-detection limits cannot be applied to this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the per-component Higgs-portal scalar-nucleon cross section (standard scalar-portal formula weighted by the multiplet composition and local abundance fractions from the multi-component relic calculation) and recast published xenon-experiment limits onto the (m_DM, lambda_H) plane.

members.model_name: BSTV scalar-field oscillation cold dark matter
members.description: The soft-boson non-accumulation condition is stated only qualitatively via a de Broglie-wavelength argument; no linear transfer function or clustering calculation for the oscillating q quanta exists to quantify where the scalar CDM does or does not cluster on galaxy scales.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the perturbation equations for the oscillating scalar amplitude in the evolving quadratic effective potential and compute its Jeans/de Broglie suppression scale as a function of boson mass, giving a quantitative galactic-accumulation criterion.

members.model_name: MSM sterile-neutrino WDM from heavier-field decay
members.description: The decay-produced sterile-neutrino momentum distribution from the heavier MSM field is only available as an approximate analytic form; a Boltzmann-level computation of f(q) for the specific parent decay history (parent abundance, decay rate, entropy evolution) is missing.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the decay-production Boltzmann equation for the parent field (following existing public FIMP/decay-spectrum solvers such as the Merle-Totzauer approach) and tabulate f(q) for direct input into the CLASS/CAMB ncdm module.

members.model_name: Kination non-equilibrium Majorana dark matter production
members.description: The nonthermal dark-matter momentum distribution f(p) from out-of-equilibrium production during kination has not been derived (the card tracks number density only and marks distribution_function_available no), so the free-streaming scale and small-scale cutoff k_cut for this branch cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by solving the unintegrated production Boltzmann equation over the kination era (production kinematics from the radiation bath, then redshifting through reheating), and implement the result as a non-cold ncdm species in CLASS to obtain the transfer-function cutoff.

members.model_name: Cosmic-selection-rule SU(N)d glueball dark matter
members.description: The model's linear structure-formation behavior is entirely uncomputed (transfer function and CDM-likeness unknown, no glueball f(p)); evaluating the dark-radiation/structure observable requires mapping the pre-confinement relativistic dark-gluon epoch and the post-confinement glueball fluid onto CMB and LSS perturbation variables, which no existing interacting-dark-radiation implementation covers with a confinement transition.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS-based interacting-dark-radiation (ETHOS-like) implementation with a time-dependent transition at the dark confinement temperature, converting self-coupled dark-gluon radiation with temperature ratio T_dark/T_SM into a cold or warm glueball fluid, then compare against Planck and LSS data.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No implementation of the exact nonthermal dark matter momentum distribution combining the freeze-in component (from mediator decays and scatterings) and the late superWIMP decay component; the card records only an approximate phase-space treatment, and the Ly-alpha constraint currently relies on a thermal-WDM proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full phase-space distribution f(q) by integrating the unintegrated freeze-in and superWIMP decay Boltzmann equations (as done in tools like the FIMP module of micrOMEGAs or a dedicated code in the style of Ballesteros et al. freeze-in distribution calculations), then feed it to CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species to obtain the model-specific transfer function.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter from Q-ball decay
members.description: No linear transfer function exists for the nonthermal scalar spectrum produced by Q-ball decay, whose injection momentum is set by the Q-ball angular frequency rather than a thermal bath, so the thermal-WDM 5.3 keV bound cannot be applied without recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced phase-space distribution f(q) for scalars emitted from Q-ball decay at the decay temperature and pass it to the CLASS/CAMB non-cold-relic (ncdm) module as a tabulated distribution to obtain model-specific transfer functions across the (m_chi, K, Q) parameter space.

members.model_name: Interacting scalar-field dark matter and early dark energy
members.description: The coupling Q = beta phidot^2 psidot^2 is imposed at the conservation-equation level without a microscopic action, and the card flags possible stability and prior pathologies of the perturbed energy-transfer terms outside the worked examples; no derived stability/viability conditions delimit the (m_phi, lambda_phi, beta) space over which the Boltzmann solution is trustworthy.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gauge-consistent perturbed energy-momentum transfer and its no-ghost/gradient-stability conditions for this coupling (following the interacting-dark-energy instability literature), encode the resulting viability bounds as hard priors in the MCMC, and add runtime stability checks to the public modified CLASS.

members.model_name: Low-reheating warm neutralino dark matter
members.description: The full nonthermal neutralino phase-space distribution f(p) from scalar-decay cascades is not derived; the card only gives the single warmness parameter r_chi, which is insufficient input for a Boltzmann transfer-function calculation or a defensible mapping to thermal-WDM limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by integrating the decay-injection spectrum (scalar decay to SUSY cascades to neutralinos) over the scalar decay history without the instantaneous-decay approximation, and tabulate it as a psd file for CLASS/CAMB non-cold-relic (ncdm) input.

members.model_name: Two-24 type III GMSB gravitino warm dark matter variant
members.description: No gravitino phase-space distribution f(q) has been derived for the two-24 keV-range regime from its actual production channels (thermal-plasma scattering during reheating plus MSSM/stau decays), so the warm small-scale cutoff cannot be computed and the mapping to an equivalent thermal WDM mass is unanchored.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gravitino momentum distribution by integrating the thermal scattering production rate over the reheating history and adding the NLSP-decay component, following standard nonthermal-relic phase-space calculations, and tabulate f(q) as an ncdm input for CLASS.

members.model_name: Nearly supersymmetric atomic dark matter
members.description: No linear transfer function exists for this model: the dark plasma undergoes dark acoustic oscillations and Coulomb-coupled damping before dark recombination, but the card records transfer_function_shape and all structure-formation entries as unknown, with no phase-space distribution or Boltzmann-hierarchy implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the tight-coupling dark-photon/dark-baryon perturbation equations for this sector and implement them in CLASS via an ETHOS-like parameterization (dark-radiation interaction rates from alpha_D and constituent masses), producing P(k) with the dark-acoustic-oscillation scale and Silk-like damping.

members.model_name: U(1)_B-L right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No momentum distribution f_N(p) has been derived for N_1 produced by thermal freeze-out followed by entropy dilution from heavy RHN decay (with possible Z_B-L-mediated interactions), so the free-streaming input to structure-formation constraints is undefined for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the redshifted post-dilution N_1 spectrum semi-analytically (thermal spectrum at freeze-out diluted by the computed S ~ 160 entropy factor), tabulate it, and feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold-dark-matter psd file to obtain the linear transfer function.

members.model_name: FIMP dark matter from flavon portals
members.description: No full non-thermal momentum distribution f(q) for the FIMP including both flavon-decay and scattering production channels; the paper's free-streaming length is a decay-only indicative estimate, so linear-power suppression predictions are unreliable.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) by integrating the unintegrated freeze-in Boltzmann equation with both S/h_S/A_S decay and 2->2 scattering source terms (standard freeze-in distribution formalism), then feed the tabulated distribution into CLASS as a non-cold ncdm species to get the exact transfer function instead of a free-streaming-length proxy.

members.model_name: Low-reheat stable massive neutrino dark matter
members.description: The model's phase-space distribution f(p) and resulting transfer function have not been derived (distribution_function_available: unknown, structure_formation largely unknown), so the warm-versus-cold classification and free-streaming character listed among the route's derived quantities cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) from the low-reheat production calculation (output of the gap_1 solver), feed it to the CLASS/CAMB NCDM module to obtain T(k) and the free-streaming scale across the (m_nu, T_RH) plane, and record the resulting cutoff scales on the card.

members.model_name: Scalar FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: The card states the scalar FIMP has a nonthermal momentum distribution but no distribution function is supplied (distribution_function_available: no) and no thermal-WDM mapping or transfer-function estimate exists, so whether the model behaves like CDM on small scales cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f_X(p, T) of moduli-portal freeze-in through reheating (following existing freeze-in phase-space calculations), derive the free-streaming length and an equivalent thermal-WDM mass, and feed the resulting transfer function to CLASS/CAMB for small-scale structure constraints.

members.model_name: Leptophilic light flavon hot-relic model
members.description: The non-thermal momentum distribution of the freeze-in-produced eta is not derived (distribution_function_available: no), so the mixed hot+cold transfer function cannot be computed accurately for the freeze-in regime at large v_phi.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for freeze-in production through the charged-lepton couplings to obtain f_eta(q), and feed it into a Boltzmann solver's non-cold species (CLASS ncdm with a tabulated distribution) to get the subcomponent transfer function.

members.model_name: Scalar-extended accidental composite dark matter
members.description: The composite-state matrix elements needed for direct detection — electromagnetic dipole and charge-radius moments of dark baryons with charged constituents, and the Higgs-portal nucleon coupling of hybrid states — are not derived for this model class.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-baryon electromagnetic form factors and Higgs-portal couplings using naive dimensional analysis anchored to the lattice spectrum of gap_1, then match onto the standard nonrelativistic direct-detection EFT operators so existing tools (e.g. DirectDM plus DDCalc-style limit codes) can produce exclusion curves.

members.model_name: R-parity violating axino warm dark matter
members.description: The axino phase-space distribution f_axino(q) from thermal production after reheating (as a function of T_R, f_a, m_axino) is only approximate and never tabulated, yet it is the required input for the transfer-function step and for any warmness statement beyond a crude thermal-WDM analogy.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for axino production from thermal-bath scatterings (freeze-in/thermal-production treatment as in the related 1707.06418-style calculations) over the (T_R, f_a) benchmark region and release tabulated f(q) files consumable by CLASS ncdm.

members.model_name: Generative-sector first-order phase-transition asymmetric dark matter
members.description: The bubble-wall velocity and sound-wave source efficiency for the generative-sector transition are assumed rather than computed, and the card flags that detector reach depends on sound-wave lifetime, wall velocity, and efficiency assumptions; no model-specific calculation of these quantities exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the wall velocity and friction for the generative-sector particle content with a hydrodynamic wall-velocity solver (WallGo-class), and adopt updated sound-wave lifetime/efficiency fits from hydrodynamic simulations in the GW amplitude formulae.

members.model_name: Stable fermion dark matter from decays of gravitationally produced superheavy particles
members.description: The full decay-product phase-space distribution f(q) for S from chi -> S S (including the redshifting of the decay-injected momentum for the relevant y and T_dec range) has not been derived, so no linear transfer function or free-streaming suppression scale exists beyond the paper's rough nonrelativistic-by-1-keV criterion.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) analytically for two-body decays of the nonrelativistic chi population as a function of y, m_S/m_chi, and decay time, tabulate it as a non-cold-dark-matter distribution file, and run CLASS or CAMB in ncdm mode to obtain the model's transfer function and half-mode scale across the parameter space.

members.model_name: Melting cosmic string scalar-field dark matter
members.description: No linear transfer function or phase-space characterization exists for the scalar dark matter produced at the inverse phase transition; the card marks nonthermal momentum distribution yes but all structure-formation fields unknown, so whether the ~15 eV oscillating field behaves as cold dark matter is unverified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the post-transition scalar field power spectrum and effective sound speed from the inverse-phase-transition dynamics (lattice or perturbative calculation of field inhomogeneities at oscillation onset) and map it to a linear matter transfer function in a Boltzmann code.

members.model_name: Planck-mass regular black-hole remnant dark matter
members.description: Only a representative 0.1c recoil speed exists; the full Hawking-recoil velocity distribution from the final evaporation stage of the regular metric, and the resulting remnant free-streaming length and matter-power suppression, have not been derived, blocking the coldness/structure-formation observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute final-stage emission spectra for the regular black-hole family (extend BlackHawk with the regular metric's greybody factors and finite-temperature endpoint), build the recoil velocity distribution over formation times, and feed it as a non-cold-DM momentum distribution into CLASS/CAMB to obtain the transfer function and free-streaming bound.

members.model_name: Mirror baryon plus PBH-evaporated scalar singlet dark matter
members.description: No late-time phase-space distribution has been derived for the Hawking-emitted scalar singlet (Schwarzschild PBHs, 0.1 g to 1e9 g, m_chi up to 1e9 GeV), which is the required input for the CLASS-style NCDM transfer-function recast against small-scale-structure limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the instantaneous Hawking emission spectrum for a spin-0 particle from Schwarzschild PBHs (e.g. with BlackHawk-class greybody factors), redshift it through evaporation and free-streaming to obtain f(q) today, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm module via a tabulated psd file to produce the transfer function for the WDM-equivalent recast of arXiv:2004.14773.

members.model_name: Kaluza-Klein gauge boson dark matter from brane-world quantum gravity
members.description: No momentum distribution or coldness criterion has been derived for the gravitationally produced KK vector, and its isocurvature spectrum in the non-standard brane-world expansion is uncomputed, leaving the structure-formation behavior (transfer function, small-scale power) entirely unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the mode-by-mode spectrum of the inflationary-produced massive vector (transverse and longitudinal modes) under the brane-world expansion law, derive the present-day momentum distribution and isocurvature power, and check the result against CMB isocurvature and small-scale structure coldness requirements.

members.model_name: Scale-free electroweak-baryogenesis singlino dark matter
members.description: The baryon-asymmetry calculation is incomplete: the CP-violating sources are deferred by the paper and the washout/BAU-survival estimate depends on an unquantified hierarchy between nucleation and roll temperatures, so no quantitative BAU prediction can be attached to a parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the CP-violating sources for the vector-like sector across the bubble wall and solve the standard electroweak-baryogenesis transport equations (VEV-insertion or WKB formalism) for the benchmark wall width L_w T ~ 30, packaging the result as a reusable BAU calculator for this model class.

members.model_name: Z2-stabilized scalar dark matter from preheating and reheating
members.description: No full nonthermal momentum distribution f(p) of the scalar is derived from the preheating dynamics; the card tracks only energy-density ratios and a dark temperature, so free-streaming and phase-space quantities needed for structure-formation constraints cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract the scalar occupation-number spectrum directly from the LATTICEEASY output and evolve it through the decoupled dark-sector era (including 4-to-2 redistributions) to obtain a tabulated f(p) today, suitable for use as a CLASS ncdm input.

members.model_name: Starobinsky inflaton-decay hidden scalar dark matter
members.description: The full phase-space distribution f(p) of the scalar pair-produced by scalaron decay over the extended Starobinsky reheating period — including the xi_X- and xi_h-dependent production history and subsequent redshifting — is not available (distribution_function_available is no), leaving only a characteristic-momentum L_FS estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by integrating the scalaron decay rate over the reheating history (standard inflaton-decay distribution techniques give a quasi-analytic result), parameterized by (m_X, xi_X, xi_h), in a form usable as a CLASS/CAMB ncdm input table.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV hadrophilic UV freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in phase-space distribution f(p) for chi produced at low reheating is not computed, so the linear transfer function is unknown and the Ly-alpha/LSS lower bound on m_chi (down to ~10 keV) can only be guessed via invalid thermal-WDM mappings.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) from the unintegrated freeze-in production integral including the low-reheat history, feed it to CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution to compute the transfer function, and recast against Ly-alpha constraints using an existing area-criterion or emulator-based bound.

members.model_name: Z3 scalar dark matter with semi-production freeze-in
members.description: The relic calculation closes the Boltzmann hierarchy with a thermal-shape ansatz at a separate dark-sector temperature; the full momentum-level distribution solution, which the authors explicitly leave to future work and which the semi-production rate depends on, has not been derived or implemented, and no resulting transfer function exists for structure-formation statements (all linear entries are unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f(p) of the Z3 scalar during semi-production (extending momentum-resolved freeze-in solvers), quantify the error of the moment ansatz on Omega h^2, and output f(p) so a CLASS non-cold-relic run can determine whether the model imprints any small-scale suppression.

members.model_name: Two-component boosted light dark matter in a neutrinophilic 2HDM
members.description: The model-specific boosted phi3 flux from present-day chi1 annihilation, its energy-dependent electron and nuclear scattering cross sections, and the resulting detector recoil spectra have not been derived, so existing boosted-DM search limits cannot be recast onto this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the galactic boosted phi3 flux from the chi1 annihilation rate and halo J-factor, compute H/h-mediated phi3-electron and phi3-nucleus cross sections at boost factors of 1e3-1e4 including Earth attenuation, and recast published boosted-DM likelihoods from Super-K/XENON-class analyses onto the (m_phi3, coupling) plane.

members.model_name: Heavy dark baryons in a hidden MSSM-like sector
members.description: The uncorrelated baryon and dark-baryon isocurvature spectra from independent Affleck-Dine phase fluctuations are known only at order-of-magnitude level with equal phase masses assumed; the exact O(1) coefficients and the unequal BAD/DAD phase-mass dependence needed to set Boltzmann-solver initial conditions are underived.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature power spectra of the two AD phase fields during inflation (including spectral tilt from m_phase/H_I and independent phase masses for the visible and dark AD fields), yielding amplitude and tilt formulas that can be passed directly to CLASS/CAMB as uncorrelated baryon and CDM isocurvature initial conditions.

members.model_name: U(1)_D dark-sector Majorana WIMP model
members.description: The loop/off-shell-photon-mediated chi_1-nucleon scattering amplitude is only sketched diagrammatically in the source; without the full amplitude no direct-detection cross section or exclusion can be derived for the DAMA/XENON-class experiments the paper mentions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-level photon-penguin chi_1-proton scattering amplitude (analogous to the gamma-Goldstone annihilation topology with the photon attached to a proton), express it as effective electromagnetic form-factor operators, and evaluate recoil rates with standard direct-detection formalism to compare against current xenon limits.

members.model_name: Despicable dark relic non-minimally coupled scalar dark matter
members.description: The dark-sector thermalization history (2-to-2 kinetic and 4-to-2 number-changing equilibration from the initial nonthermal tachyonic spectrum, and the resulting dark temperature and freeze-out) is treated with instantaneous-equilibration estimates; no momentum-space Boltzmann treatment exists to determine when the approximations fail and what the relic spectrum is when equilibrium is not reached.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for the phi distribution with lambda phi^4 2-to-2 and 4-to-2 collision terms starting from the gap_1 tachyonic spectrum (extending existing dark-freeze-out/cannibal-sector Boltzmann codes), mapping out in (xi, lambda, m_phi) where instantaneous chemical equilibrium is a valid approximation.

members.model_name: Starobinsky inflaton-decay massive Abelian vector dark matter
members.description: The phase-space distribution f(q) of the scalaron-decay-produced massive vector is not available (distribution_function_available: no), so the free-streaming and transfer-function calculation cannot go beyond the rough L_FS estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced momentum distribution for two-body scalaron decay through the Starobinsky reheating history (standard inflaton-decay f(q) techniques) and supply it as a tabulated non-cold-DM distribution to CLASS/CAMB ncdm modules to compute the model's transfer function.

members.model_name: Dark group warm dark baryon model
members.description: The post-confinement dark-baryon momentum distribution is not derived (distribution_function_available: no; thermal_wdm_mapping unavailable); only an analytic free-streaming scale of about 0.6 Mpc is quoted, which is insufficient input for a Boltzmann computation of the transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-baryon phase-space distribution after confinement of the secluded thermal dark sector (thermal distribution at T_D with mass ~ Lambda_c) and establish the mapping to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass so existing WDM bounds can be reused.

members.model_name: Long-range scalar-interacting dark matter with screening species
members.description: The cosmological evolution of the relativistic screening species, and hence the redshift dependence of the screening length r_s(z) that the simulations need as input, is not derived; the card flags production of the screening population as an unresolved difficulty and no linear-theory (Boltzmann) treatment of the scale-dependent growth is provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the coupled scalar-plus-screening-species background and linear perturbation equations and implement them as a modified CLASS species, yielding r_s(z) and consistent initial conditions/transfer functions for the N-body step.

members.model_name: Near-threshold feeton B-L gauge boson dark matter
members.description: The phase-space distribution of inflationary-produced feetons is not provided (distribution_function_available: no) and every structure-formation field is unknown, so no transfer function or free-streaming assessment exists to check whether the ~1 MeV nonthermal vector behaves as cold dark matter on observable scales.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the primordial momentum distribution and power spectrum of the longitudinal vector modes produced during inflation (Graham-Mardon-Rajendran-type calculation for m_f ~ 1 MeV, H_inf ~ 1.6e11 GeV), then feed the resulting f(p) or transfer function into a modified CLASS/CAMB run to verify CDM-like behavior and any small-scale isocurvature bump.

members.model_name: Vector FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: The card states the vector FIMP has a nonthermal momentum distribution but no distribution function is supplied (distribution_function_available: no) and no thermal-WDM mapping or transfer-function estimate exists, so whether the model behaves like CDM on small scales cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f_X(p, T) of moduli-portal freeze-in through reheating (following existing freeze-in phase-space calculations), derive the free-streaming length and an equivalent thermal-WDM mass, and feed the resulting transfer function to CLASS/CAMB for small-scale structure constraints.

members.model_name: DFSZ axino dark matter in the Kim-Nilles mechanism
members.description: The momentum-space phase-space distribution f(q) of freeze-in DFSZ axinos produced through the Kim-Nilles axino-Higgsino-Higgs (mu/f_a) and axino-top-stop (m_t/f_a) channels is not derived; without it neither the warmness of light axinos nor the transfer-function suppression can be computed for this specific channel mix.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent freeze-in Boltzmann equation for the two-body Higgs/Higgsino decay and stop-scattering collision terms (following the treatment used for freeze-in axino distributions in the related 1707.06418-style analyses), tabulate f(q) versus m_axino, f_a, mu, and the Higgs/Higgsino/stop spectrum, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm module to obtain the model-specific transfer function.

members.model_name: Ultra-Light Pion and Baryon WIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: No structure-formation pipeline exists for the mixed multi-field system of three dark pions plus superheavy dark baryons; halo and boson-star profiles for such pion/baryon admixtures are not calibrated by any simulation or solver referenced in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Schroedinger-Poisson solver such as PyUltraLight or AxioNyx to three coupled scalar fields with an additional cold particle component, and calibrate mixed halo/boson-star density profiles across the m_pi < 1 eV ULP regime.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced dark photon dark matter with Proca-star substructure
members.description: No public Proca/vector Schroedinger-Poisson simulation pipeline exists that evolves inflation-seeded small-scale vector isocurvature perturbations through collapse into Proca-star solitons and compact halos; the paper's numerical simulations are not released, so soliton and compact-halo mass functions cannot be regenerated across (m, H_I).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public wave-dark-matter Schroedinger-Poisson solver (e.g. PyUltraLight, AxioNyx, or GAMER's fuzzy-DM module) to three vector field components with initial conditions drawn from the inflationary longitudinal-mode power spectrum, and release calibrated soliton and compact-halo mass functions versus m and H_I.

members.model_name: B-L gauged Peccei-Quinn axion dark matter
members.description: No defect-network simulation exists for the post-inflationary PQ/fiveness breaking histories of this model, in particular the 10:1 relatively-prime charge structure whose string-domain-wall decay can dominate the axion abundance; the paper explicitly leaves one domain-wall-resolution scenario to detailed numerical simulations, so the dominant-DM corner of parameter space cannot be quantitatively evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of the coupled string-domain-wall network for the two-scalar (phi, phi_prime) fiveness potential with the 10:1 charge assignment, following the methodology of existing axion-string network simulations, and extract the network decay contribution to Omega_a h^2 and the domain-wall collapse condition as functions of F_A and the phase-transition ordering.

members.model_name: Late-PQ-phase-transition axion parametric-resonance dark matter
members.description: No public lattice/field-evolution simulation exists for saxion parametric resonance after a late PQ phase transition, including the thermal PQ potential, backreaction, and dissipation into SM fields, so the axion yield and momentum spectrum rest on analytic scaling estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the radial PQ-field potential with its thermal correction and the y P psi psi dissipation channel in a public lattice code such as CosmoLattice or LATTICEEASY, scan (f_a, m_s, T_c, n), and output the axion number density and momentum spectrum at the end of resonance.

members.model_name: Axion condensate dark matter with stimulated photon decays
members.description: No calibrated axion minicluster/axion-star population model (mass function, density profiles, and fraction of clumps satisfying the strong-resonance condition) is available to convert the per-clump burst estimate into predicted event rates and constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine existing post-inflationary axion lattice/N-body simulation results for minicluster mass functions and internal densities with the paper's resonance condition (growth rate times clump light-crossing time) to construct a population model, then fold it through radio-transient survey sensitivities.

members.model_name: Kinetically coupled axion-dilaton fuzzy dark matter model
members.description: The S8/weak-lensing comparison uses linear theory only; no nonlinear prescription or emulator exists for the matter power spectrum of a percent-level fuzzy-axion fraction coexisting with CDM in this two-field cosmology, which weak-lensing scales require.
members.proposed_resolution: Run mixed CDM plus ultralight-axion nonlinear evolution (e.g. AxioNyx-style or hybrid N-body with an axionEmu/axionHMcode-type halo-model calibration) for small fractions F around 0.01 and build a nonlinear correction usable in the weak-lensing likelihood.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector phase-transition axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: No field-theory simulation exists of axion evolution during a slow (H Delta t ~ 1) first-order hidden-sector phase transition with bubble nucleation and a discontinuous m_a(T); the density-contrast spectrum that seeds miniclusters rests on a toy bubble model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the axion field with stochastic bubble nucleation and position-dependent oscillation onset, parameterized by (H Delta t, Delta s/s_plus, Lambda), and extract the resulting density-contrast power spectrum and minicluster seed mass function.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector phase-transition axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: Minicluster survival, tidal disruption, and internal profiles from formation through the present-day Galactic halo are uncalibrated for this scenario (card marks present-day mass function as future work), so the compact fraction f_MC and lens profiles entering constraints are unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of minicluster collapse and subsequent tidal evolution in a Milky Way potential, initialized from the phase-transition density-contrast spectrum, to predict the z=0 minicluster mass-radius distribution and surviving compact fraction.

members.model_name: Axion dark matter clump photon-resonance model
members.description: The Galactic axion-clump population is uncharacterized: no clump mass function, spatial distribution, or merger/encounter rate is provided or simulated, so neither the steady radio source counts nor the merger-transient rate can be predicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Schrodinger-Poisson / N-body simulations of axion clump (minicluster/axion-star) formation and mergers to derive a Milky-Way clump mass function, encounter rate, and post-merger remnant properties, parameterized by axion mass and self-coupling sign for reuse in the population route.

members.model_name: Massive dark photon soliton EFT
members.description: No calibrated soliton population model exists for vector fuzzy dark matter: predicting the expected number, mass function, and survival fraction of polarized solitons in galactic halos requires vector-field cosmological/halo simulations that have not been run or cited in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Run vector Schrodinger-Poisson halo simulations (extending scalar fuzzy-DM simulation codes to spin-1 fields) to calibrate a soliton mass function and polarization-state statistics, including depletion by resonant electromagnetic decay.

members.model_name: QCD axion hot-and-cold dark matter from saxion decay
members.description: The cold-axion abundance from N_DW = 1 string-wall network annihilation (setting the quoted f_a of (2.0-3.8)e10 GeV) depends on the network axion emission spectrum, which is only estimated from older field-theory simulations; the card marks the nonlinear calibration as unknown and the route step as simulation-calibrated only in a dated sense.
members.proposed_resolution: Recalibrate the string-wall axion emission using modern large-scale field-theoretic lattice simulations of post-inflation PQ-breaking networks (adaptive-mesh string simulations plus domain-wall annihilation runs), and fold the updated instantaneous emission spectrum into the semi-analytic abundance formula used in step s2.

members.model_name: Fuzzy dark matter from infrared confining dynamics
members.description: The finite-temperature axion mass m_a(T) from the infrared SU(3)_theta dynamics is only known from a dilute-instanton-style expression valid above a confinement-scale threshold; its behavior across the transition, which controls the oscillation onset and hence the relic band, has no lattice or otherwise controlled calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform a lattice calculation of the topological susceptibility of the SU(3)_theta sector with the model's light dark-quark content across the confinement transition (analogous to QCD chi(T) lattice studies), and feed the resulting m_a(T) into the misalignment calculation.

members.model_name: Rolling-PQ axion-bubble PBH seed model
members.description: The fractions of hidden-monopole branches that set which regions end in the alternate axion minimum, and hence the bubble statistics, are only estimated; the paper itself states they should be determined by dedicated numerical calculations of the hidden U(1)_H monopole-induced potential dynamics.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice or numerical field-evolution simulations of the axion in the temporary Witten-effect potential across the two minima to calibrate the branch fractions entering the bubble-probability calculation, replacing the analytic estimate used in the paper.

members.model_name: Post-inflation PQ-breaking axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: The initial axion density-fluctuation spectrum from post-inflation strings and domain walls is uncalibrated for this model's general temperature-dependence exponent n (0-20); existing string-network simulations target the QCD axion case, leaving the minicluster seed spectrum uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend lattice simulations of PQ string/domain-wall networks through the oscillation epoch for generic ALP m_a(T) exponents n, extracting the initial density-contrast distribution that feeds the minicluster collapse estimate.

members.model_name: Post-inflation PQ-breaking axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: The present-day minicluster population (surviving fraction f_MC, tidally processed mass-radius distribution, and Solar-neighborhood encounter statistics) is left as future work, blocking both lensing constraints and the direct-detection intermittency prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of minicluster collapse near matter-radiation equality and their tidal evolution in a Milky Way halo, delivering the z=0 (M_m, R_m, f_MC) distribution and local encounter-rate statistics for haloscope signal modeling.

members.model_name: KSVZ axion dark matter with spectator PQ-field domain-wall solution
members.description: The domain-wall/string-wall-network avoidance for N_DW > 1 rests on analytic scaling conditions (n >= 5, m >= 2n-1, spectator not re-randomizing the axion); no lattice field simulation of the coupled P-S-axion system verifies that dangerous defects indeed never form or collapse before the QCD epoch.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the PQ field P and spectator S with the S^m P mixing operator through PQ breaking and the onset of S oscillation (extending existing axion string-wall network simulation codes), scanning (n, m, N_DW, lambda_s) to confirm the analytic uniform-displacement and collapse conditions.

members.model_name: Noninteracting WIMP and QCD axion dark matter in an early matter dominated epoch
members.description: Nonlinear formation, survival, and present-day properties of axion miniclusters seeded by EMDE-enhanced perturbations are not simulation-calibrated (the card marks simulation_calibrated no), so the linear threshold estimate cannot be turned into a predicted minicluster mass function or detectability statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with the EMDE-enhanced axion power spectrum at T_D in the 1-50 MeV range to calibrate the minicluster mass function, concentrations, and tidal survival, following the methodology of existing post-inflationary minicluster simulations.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary axion dark matter from topological defects
members.description: The relic-abundance prediction rests on dynamic-range-limited lattice simulations of the post-inflationary string-wall network; the extrapolation of the area parameter, scaling behavior, and mean radiated axion energy to the physical log(F_a/H) is the dominant systematic and shifts the predicted N_DW=1 mass window m_a=(0.8-1.3)e-4 eV.
members.proposed_resolution: Run high-dynamic-range string-wall simulations with adaptive mesh refinement (extending public AMR frameworks of the GRChombo/Buschmann-et-al type to N_DW>=1 wall networks), publish the radiated axion spectra and area-parameter scaling fits as data products, and quantify exact-scaling versus logarithmic-deviation systematics.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: Inhomogeneous trapping is not modeled: different patches of the universe can settle into different local minima of the two-cosine potential, producing domain walls and modified perturbations that the homogeneous background treatment cannot capture.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice scalar-field simulations of the two-cosine potential through the trapping epoch (adapting existing axion-string/domain-wall lattice codes) to quantify the fraction of Hubble patches trapped in adjacent minima and the resulting domain-wall energy density versus (c, n, z_tr).

members.model_name: keV hidden photon dark matter for XENON1T and stellar cooling
members.description: The small-scale structure prediction of the nonthermal (inflationary/misalignment) production mechanism is uncomputed: no transfer function or clump mass function exists for the potentially very large small-scale inhomogeneities the card flags, so obs_hp_nonthermal_abundance cannot be evaluated beyond the homogeneous abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the vector-field perturbation spectrum from inflationary fluctuation production with curvature coupling (lattice or linear mode evolution for the massive vector), derive the resulting isocurvature power spectrum and clump mass function, and connect to small-scale-structure and direct-detection substructure bounds.

members.model_name: Kinetically misaligned audible axion dark matter
members.description: No public lattice or mode-evolution code covers tachyonic dark-photon production from a kinetically rotating (finite-velocity) ALP including nonlinear backreaction and energy backtransfer, so the ALP relic abundance is bounded rather than computed and the GW spectrum shape is only estimated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public lattice code such as CosmoLattice with a rotating complex PQ field coupled to a dark U(1) gauge field, simulate the kinetic-misalignment benchmarks of the paper, and tabulate the resulting dark-photon spectra, GW spectra, and residual ALP energy density over the (m_phi, f_phi, S_i, alpha) space.

members.model_name: Mixed cold dark matter and ultralight axion halo model
members.description: No mixed CDM+ULA simulation suite spans the model's applicability range (m_ax 1e-33 to 1e-21 eV, subdominant fractions of a few percent to ~25%), so the axionHMcode halo model is uncalibrated in nonlinear P(k), the halo cutoff mass M_cut, and soliton behavior at small ULA fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a grid of mixed-DM simulations combining N-body CDM with a Schrodinger-Poisson or Madelung ULA solver (extending AxioNyx or a PIC-based ULA code) over (m_ax, Omega_ax/Omega_d), and fit calibration residuals for axionHMcode's profiles, bias, and cutoff-mass prescriptions.

members.model_name: Axion-like scalar dark matter miniclusters
members.description: No public simulation pipeline maps a late second-order axion-like phase transition into a ScaM mass function and density profiles; the paper's initial-condition generator and N-body collapse runs are private and only qualitatively described.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing axion-minicluster simulation chain (lattice/field evolution of the scalar through the transition to set isocurvature initial conditions, then Gadget-style N-body collapse through matter-radiation equality) parameterized by transition temperature and scalar potential, releasing the resulting M_ScaM mass function and profile fits.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter from axionic string radiation
members.description: No public, large-dynamic-range axionic string-network simulation output (scaling parameter xi and radiated axion spectrum with controlled log(f_a/H) extrapolation) is attached to this card; the primary 512^3 lattice result leaves order-of-magnitude systematics in the string-radiated abundance and hence in the f_a bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt or rerun modern adaptive-mesh-refinement PQ field-theory simulations of the string network (including the N_DW=1 string-wall collapse epoch), publish xi(log), the instantaneous emission spectrum, and an explicit large-log extrapolation with uncertainty bands, and store these as tabulated calibration products for the abundance step.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary ALP dark matter with white-noise isocurvature
members.description: The white-noise isocurvature spectrum is derived in the harmonic approximation with axion strings, domain walls, and minicluster formation explicitly neglected, and no simulation-calibrated correction to the isocurvature normalization and cutoff scale exists for this generic ALP mass-temperature model (n, b).
members.proposed_resolution: Run post-inflationary lattice field simulations of the ALP field with the temperature-dependent mass m_a(T) parameterized by (n, b), including string/domain-wall decay, and extract the corrected isocurvature power normalization, spectral cutoff, and minicluster fraction as fitting functions to feed the CLASS initial conditions.

members.model_name: ALP catastrogenesis dark matter
members.description: No dedicated field-theory simulations of biased ALP string-wall networks exist in the late-annihilation (T_ann below ~100 eV) regime, so the GW spectral shape, the network annihilation dynamics, and the nonrelativistic ALP emission spectrum are all taken from scaling estimates calibrated elsewhere.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of biased N-vacua domain-wall networks (extending existing axion string-wall simulation codes or a CosmoLattice-class solver) across a grid of epsilon_b and sigma values, and publish fitted templates for Omega_GW(f) and the emitted ALP momentum spectrum as functions of (T_ann, sigma, epsilon_b).

members.model_name: 2hdSMASH DFSZ axion-majoron dark matter
members.description: No axion string/domain-wall network simulation exists for the 2hdSMASH N_DW > 1 defect cosmology with bias-term destabilization, so the axion relic abundance beyond misalignment and the domain-wall viability condition rest on analytic estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing lattice axion-defect simulation frameworks (post-inflationary PQ string-wall network codes) to N_DW > 1 with an explicit PQ-breaking bias term, scanning v_S over the paper's 3.1e9-5.9e10 GeV range to output Omega_a h^2 and wall-annihilation epochs.

members.model_name: Gauged global string QCD axion model
members.description: No cosmological field-theory simulation exists for the two-scalar U(1)_Z x U(1)_PQ defect network with heavy-core global strings, gauge strings, and Y-junctions; the scaling density xi, loop distribution, and crucially the axion emission spectrum from heavy-core strings are all unquantified, so the enhanced-relic claim (m_a > 1e-5 eV as all of DM) rests on an assumed scaling regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend existing axion-string lattice simulation frameworks to evolve the two complex scalars plus the U(1)_Z gauge field with hierarchical VEVs, measure the Y-junction scaling parameters, loop distribution, and per-string axion emission spectrum, and feed these into the semi-analytic relic calculator to sharpen the opened axion mass window.

members.model_name: Thermal QCD axion hot dark matter with domain-wall cold axions
members.description: The cold axion abundance from post-inflation string-wall network annihilation (including the N_DW >= 2 biased-wall case) is only estimated semi-analytically; no calibrated defect-network simulation result is attached to the card, so Omega_axion_CDM from step s2 carries order-of-magnitude uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run (or import spectra from) lattice field-theory simulations of axion string-wall networks around the QCD epoch, extract the emitted-axion spectrum and wall-annihilation time as functions of N_DW, f_a and the PQ bias term, and package the result as a fitting formula that replaces the current string-wall abundance estimate in step s2.

members.model_name: variant axion model with domain-wall-safe PQ charges
members.description: The claim that meV variant axions can be the dominant dark matter rests on the post-inflationary string-wall decay abundance, which carries order-of-magnitude simulation uncertainty; no converged N_DW = 1 string-wall network simulation pins down Omega_a(m_a) well enough to decide whether the cooling-preferred window is a full-DM or subcomponent scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Use large-scale field-theory string-wall network simulations with controlled log(f_a/H) extrapolation (the ongoing adaptive-mesh axion-string simulation program) to narrow the cold-axion yield for N_DW = 1, and propagate the resulting Omega_a(m_a) band into the registry's relic-density and isocurvature checks for this model.

members.model_name: Higgs-like scalar dark matter miniclusters
members.description: No public simulation pipeline exists for Higgs-like second-order phase-transition minicluster formation: neither the initial-condition generator (roll-off-time fluctuation field from the Higgs-like potential) nor the calibrated N-body collapse runs near matter-radiation equality are released, so the ScaM mass function and density profiles cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Higgs-like roll-off fluctuation field as an initial-condition module (filtered white noise mapped to overdensity, as described in the paper) and rerun the collapse with a public N-body code such as Gadget-4, releasing the resulting mass function and profile fits parameterized by transition temperature and quartic coupling.

members.model_name: Higgs-like scalar dark matter miniclusters
members.description: Milky Way survival of generic ScaMs against stellar encounters is only estimated by analogy with axion-minicluster disruption simulations, which assume different (denser) profiles; no ScaM-specific tidal-survival calculation exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun stellar-encounter disruption Monte Carlo simulations (following the arXiv:2011.05377 methodology) with ScaM profiles from the N-body collapse runs, producing a survival fraction S(M, rho, orbit) usable as a correction in the lensing likelihood.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with survival-based size distribution
members.description: No public code implements AQN formation from axion domain-wall collapse at the QCD epoch and subsequent early-universe survival, so the surviving baryon-charge distribution dN/dB (B_min, slope alpha, B_cut) cannot be computed from model inputs (m_a, T_form).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's domain-wall collapse and plasma-annihilation survival semi-analytics as a public code parameterized by (m_a, T_form, initial distribution), validated against the quoted T_form ~ 41 MeV and B_min ~ 1e24 survival benchmarks.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dark photon-fermion nonlinear sector
members.description: No nonlinear simulation exists of an axion superradiant cloud coupled to a massless dark photon through a F' F' / f'_a with f'_a near 1e11 GeV, so the claimed damping of spin-down (tachyonic dark-photon production threshold, energy escape versus reabsorption, cloud saturation amplitude) rests on analytic estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1 field-theory simulations of the coupled axion-dark-photon system on a Kerr background (extending existing axion-photon superradiance lattice codes to a massless hidden vector) to calibrate the saturation amplitude and effective spin-down rate as functions of m_a, f'_a, and black-hole spin.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with time-varying Peccei-Quinn scale
members.description: No lattice or mode-function calculation exists for parametric-resonance decay of the complex PQ field with a temperature-tracking f_PQ and thermal portal scalar, so the axion and radial-mode number densities and the axion momentum spectrum needed for the abundance and coldness test are only rough analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PQ-field plus portal-scalar potential with its finite-temperature corrections in a public lattice code such as CosmoLattice (or a linearized mode-function solver for the early stage), scan (f_PQ^0, g, lambda_S, initial displacement), and output tabulated axion/radial spectra and n_r/n_a.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.1 axion dark matter
members.description: Model 2.1's post-inflationary target window has N_DW=3, so the relic abundance is set by a long-lived string-wall network whose decay requires an explicit bias term; no simulation-calibrated prediction of the axion yield from a biased N_DW=3 wall network exists for this route.
members.proposed_resolution: Run (or adopt from the lattice literature) field-theory simulations of biased N_DW=3 string-wall networks to extract the axion emission spectrum and wall-decay time as functions of the bias parameter, and package the result as a fitting function for the relic calculator of gap_1.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 2.2 axion dark matter
members.description: For the post-inflationary history this model permits, the axion abundance from string-wall network decay with the reduced domain-wall number is not simulation-calibrated, leaving an order-unity uncertainty in the predicted m_A giving the full relic density.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt or extend published post-inflationary axion string-wall lattice simulation results (spectral-index-calibrated emission fits) for the N_DW value of this construction, and propagate the quoted systematic band into the relic prediction rather than a single misalignment estimate.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.2 scalar-singlet plus 10_F axion dark matter
members.description: The post-inflationary scenario with reduced but possibly nonunity domain-wall number has no quantitative axion-abundance prediction: string-wall network emission for this model's N_DW is not computed, and the card notes such histories require an explicit domain-wall solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt published lattice string-wall network simulation results (axion emission spectra as a function of N_DW and wall-bias term) to this model's domain-wall number, or run a dedicated field-theory lattice simulation of the PQ-breaking network to obtain the post-inflationary abundance and minicluster spectrum.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter from string-network radiation
members.description: No public, reusable lattice string-network simulation code with cleaned numerical outputs (string density xi, emission spectrum) is available; the paper's simulation is private and limited to modest m_r/H scale separations.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the PQ-scalar lattice simulation (e.g. building on public codes such as jaxions or CosmoLattice-style field solvers) with adaptive-mesh refinement to push m_r/H, and publish the attractor xi(log) and instantaneous emission spectrum F(k) as tabulated data products.

members.model_name: Nonzero-initial-velocity axion misalignment dark matter
members.description: The topological-defect (string and domain-wall) relic contribution for post-inflationary PQ breaking is uncalibrated: no defect-network simulation output with a converged decay spectrum is available to add to the nonzero-velocity misalignment abundance, so post-inflationary parameter scans are incomplete.
members.proposed_resolution: Run (or adopt converged results from) large-scale axion string/domain-wall network simulations for N_DW = 1 and tabulate the emitted axion spectrum as a correction term to the misalignment abundance, parameterized so it can be combined with the nonzero-velocity result.

members.model_name: SU(2)_R axiogenesis with QCD axion kinetic-misalignment dark matter
members.description: The axion yield from the rotating PQ field carries an unquantified order-one uncertainty from parametric-resonance fluctuation production and axion self-scattering thermalization; no lattice or nonlinear field simulation of the rotating complex PQ field in this kinetic-misalignment regime backs the analytic estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run classical lattice field-theory simulations (e.g. with a CosmoLattice-class code) of the rotating complex PQ field including the higher-dimensional PQ-breaking potential, tracking fragmentation, parametric resonance, and self-scattering to calibrate the axion number yield as a function of f_a and Y_P.

members.model_name: Friendly coupled axion dark matter pair
members.description: No public 3+1D lattice-simulation pipeline exists for the coupled two-axion potential with nearby masses and hierarchical decay constants, including autoresonant energy transfer, oscillon formation and lifetimes, and convergence-checked final component abundances; homogeneous autoresonance estimates are explicitly unreliable in the nonlinear regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public scalar-field lattice code (e.g. CosmoLattice or AxioNyx) with the coupled two-axion potential over (mu, F/f, initial angles), add an oscillon finder and per-field abundance extraction, and run a resolution-convergence study reproducing the paper's abundance-equilibration benchmarks.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter from Peccei-Quinn-field parametric resonance
members.description: No public lattice-simulation campaign extracts the full axion momentum distribution from PQ radial-field parametric resonance across the model's quartic and quadratic potentials and the f_a = 1e8-1e11 GeV range; only a single internal LATTICEEASY check of number density and N_p = O(100) is reported, so the spectrum needed for the LSS recast does not exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Run LATTICEEASY (or CosmoLattice) simulations of the oscillating PQ field for a grid of (S_i, m_S,i, potential shape), extract and publish tabulated axion f(p) spectra including the saxion-thermalization dilution history, parameterized for downstream Boltzmann use.

members.model_name: QCD-axion domain-wall PBH mixed dark matter scenario
members.description: No public simulation of the N_DW=1 axion string-wall network with PQ breaking during inflation and late horizon re-entry provides the closed-wall area fraction and closed-wall size distribution; the key input F_closed of about 0.8 is a quoted percolation result that cannot be independently reproduced or varied.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a field-theory lattice simulation (or a calibrated percolation study) of the N_DW=1 string-wall network at horizon re-entry with inflation-stretched initial phase correlations, outputting the closed-wall fraction and size spectrum as a function of the re-entry configuration for public reuse.

members.model_name: Long-lived axion domain wall dark matter
members.description: The relic formula is extrapolated from the constant-thickness N_DW=2 benchmark; no simulations cover time-dependent QCD wall thickness, N_DW>2, or full complex-field string-wall networks, which the card flags as needed for the QCD-axion and general-ALP application.
members.proposed_resolution: Run complex-PQ-field lattice simulations with a temperature-dependent axion mass (time-dependent wall thickness) and N_DW>=2 biased potentials to test whether the benchmark scaling and abundance fit survive in the physical QCD/ALP regime.

members.model_name: Post-inflation N_DW=1 QCD axion dark matter with string-wall decay production
members.description: No public, large-dynamical-range lattice simulation of N_DW=1 axion string-wall network collapse backs the card's relic prediction; the private simulation's compressed dynamical range and extrapolated string/wall scaling parameters and epsilon_w dominate the quoted uncertainty on Omega_a,tot h^2 and the F_a window.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the PQ-field lattice simulation with a released code at larger dynamical range (adaptive-mesh or large static grids), publish the string scaling parameter, wall area parameter, and wall-decay spectrum epsilon_w with convergence tests, and propagate the calibrated values into the abundance formula.

members.model_name: Nonrelativistic axion EFT dark matter
members.description: No public solver couples the matched (and, for dense condensates, resummed) axion EFT effective potential to self-gravity to produce axion-star profiles and stability indicators; existing ultralight-dark-matter GPP codes implement gravity-only or simple-quartic dynamics, not this model's higher-order resummed V_eff.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson solver (PyUltraLight-style pseudo-spectral, or a stationary shooting code) to take the paper's resummed V_eff(psi*psi) as input, and validate the dilute limit against known quartic axion-star mass-radius relations before scanning (m_a, f_a).

members.model_name: Massive majoron misalignment dark matter in a lepton-number breaking phase-transition model
members.description: No numerical model of the post-transition string/domain-wall network exists for this scenario, so the defect contribution to the majoron relic abundance (majoron radiation from strings, wall annihilation) and the viability of specific explicit-breaking operators are judged only qualitatively, leaving the misalignment abundance estimate uncontrolled.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of the global/gauged U(1)_L string network with the explicit-breaking bias term (axion-string-network methodology adapted to majorons) to compute the defect-radiated majoron spectrum and wall-decay timescales as functions of the breaking operator, and package the result as a correction factor on Omega_J(m_J, v_L, theta_J).

members.model_name: Multi-ultralight-axion mixed dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure-formation simulations for multi-ULA (and mixed ULA+CDM) cosmologies are lacking, so the halo and subhalo mass-function predictions rest on uncalibrated semi-analytic Press-Schechter mappings.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of nonlinear simulations for two-ULA and ULA+CDM mixtures (N-body with multi-ULA initial transfer functions, plus targeted Schrodinger-Poisson or fuzzy-DM-solver runs where wave effects matter) to calibrate the halo-mass-function cutoff against the semi-analytic prediction.

members.model_name: Coherent-incoherent self-interacting bosonic dark matter framework
members.description: No cosmological solver exists that co-evolves the coherent condensate (Gross-Pitaevskii) with the incoherent higher-momentum component (kinetic equation) under a shared gravitational potential including the order-g^2 collisional transfer terms; existing fuzzy-DM wave solvers evolve only a pure condensate.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public pseudo-spectral Schroedinger-Poisson code (e.g. AxioNyx or PyUltraLight-class solvers) with a coupled N-body or Vlasov module for the incoherent component plus the g^2 condensate-particle exchange terms, and validate against the CDM and pure-FDM limiting cases listed in the card's validation tests.

members.model_name: BrickRed KSVZ axion with colored neutrino-mass mediators
members.description: For post-inflationary PQ breaking the axion relic abundance from string/domain-wall decay is not calculable within the card's analytic misalignment estimate, so the defect-contribution flag in compute_relic_filters cannot be turned into a quantitative Omega_a h^2 for that history.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt calibrated string/domain-wall axion-emission results from existing large-scale lattice field simulations of post-inflationary PQ networks (parameterized as a defect enhancement factor over misalignment for N_DW=1) and add that parameterization to the relic-filter step; a new simulation campaign is not needed if published calibrations are ingested.

members.model_name: KSVZ axion dark matter with dimension-greater-than-five heavy-quark decays
members.description: The post-inflationary string/domain-wall axion production contribution is omitted from the abundance contours because no calibrated defect-emission result exists for an early-matter-domination expansion history; existing axion-string simulations assume radiation domination, so the defect branch of the constraint cannot be evaluated for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run axion string/domain-wall network simulations (or extend published scaling-network emission fits) with a matter-dominated background during Q domination to calibrate the defect-sourced axion spectrum and abundance, providing a correction factor to the misalignment-only Omega_a h^2 contours.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark-photon depletion model
members.description: No public simulation handles the tachyonic/parametric axion-dark-photon energy transfer including dark-photon backscattering into axions; the primary calculation assumes small backscattering and its own validity constraint (backscattering_numerical_validity) marks strong-coupling points untrustworthy.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1D lattice simulations of the axion plus dark U(1) gauge field with the temperature-dependent QCD axion mass and enhanced a F_D F_Dtilde coupling (e.g. extend CosmoLattice's axion-gauge module), mapping the depletion factor and Delta N_eff over (f_a, theta_i, coupling hierarchy) including full backreaction.

members.model_name: Two-component ultralight axion dark matter
members.description: No calibrated nonlinear simulation capability exists for two-component ultralight-axion dark matter across mass ratios and density fractions: halo mass function, coexisting-soliton structure, and granularity for mixed (m_1, m_2, Omega_1:Omega_2) are known only from isolated related-literature benchmarks, and the card marks nonlinear structure simulation_calibrated: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of two-field Schroedinger-Poisson simulations (extending GAMER or AxioNyx wave-DM solvers to two wavefunctions with a shared potential) initialized from MASTER transfer functions, spanning mass ratios 10-100 and minor fractions 0-0.5, and calibrate fitting functions for the halo mass function and soliton-halo relation in the mixed case.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with Peccei-Quinn breaking during warm inflation
members.description: The PQ field dynamics through the thermal transition during warm inflation — in particular the tachyonic growth phase and whether the symmetry is restored after inflation — is only treated semi-analytically; no lattice or numerical field-evolution result exists to validate the transition timing and the resulting axion fluctuation spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the complex PQ scalar coupled to the warm-inflation thermal bath (extending existing PQ phase-transition lattice codes with a T(N) background and dissipation term) to compute the tachyonic dynamics, check post-inflation non-restoration, and extract the axion isocurvature spectrum versus transition e-fold N_c.
