members.model_name: DFSZ axion model with electroweak-scale scalar sector
members.description: The axion relic density from topological-defect (string and domain-wall) decay is not calculable for this model with any public tool; the defect contribution in the post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenario carries order-of-magnitude uncertainty, leaving Omega_a h^2 undetermined beyond the misalignment estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a parameterized defect-decay emission spectrum calibrated to large-scale axion-string network simulations, implement it alongside a standard misalignment solver, and propagate the simulation spread as a systematic band on Omega_a h^2(f_a); track convergence of ongoing community string simulations for the N_DW = 6 DFSZ domain-wall structure.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with photon-dark-photon gauge-field depletion
members.description: The post-inflationary inhomogeneous scenario (epsilon ~ 10^4-10^6, string/domain-wall initial conditions) is only qualitative because current lattice resolution cannot resolve the relevant spectra; relic abundance and B_0 windows may shift with proper string-network initial conditions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run high-resolution lattice simulations with string-network initial conditions (adaptive-mesh or large static grids as in modern axion-string studies) coupled to the gauge sector, to quantify how initial inhomogeneity changes the depletion factor and magnetic spectrum.

members.model_name: Axion-monodromy scalar clump dark matter from parametric resonance
members.description: No simulation-calibrated clump mass function or aggregation history exists for delayed parametric-resonance fragmentation of the axion-monodromy field; collapse times and soliton seed properties are only rough analytic scaling estimates, so the predicted clump population is uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1D nonlinear simulations of the oscillating scalar with the mass-plus-cosine monodromy potential in a radiation-dominated background, adapting an existing lattice code (e.g. CosmoLattice) for the resonant growth phase and a Schroedinger-Poisson solver (e.g. PyUltraLight/AxioNyx-class codes) for soliton formation and aggregation, and extract a clump mass-radius function versus (m0, M_I, f, T_g).

members.model_name: Polynomial self-interacting scalar clump dark matter
members.description: No simulation-calibrated prediction exists for the nonlinear fragmentation and ballistic aggregation of the tachyonically unstable scalar into clumps; the clump mass-radius distribution over (m, c1, c2, rho_I, T_cs) is only an analytic scaling estimate, leaving the population prediction and its relic-fraction normalization uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate the phi^4-minus/phi^6-plus scalar in an expanding radiation-era background with a lattice code (e.g. CosmoLattice) through fragmentation, then follow soliton collisions and aggregation with a nonrelativistic Schroedinger-Poisson solver, and fit a clump mass function and survival fraction versus the instability temperature T_cs.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with radiative, thermal, and geometric PQ-field corrections
members.description: No public numerical code evolves the corrected PQ-field system (Coleman-Weinberg + thermal + curvature terms) with saxion oscillations, parametric resonance, and tachyonic production to output cold/warm axion and saxion yields; both upstream route steps are done only by in-paper numerics.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a dedicated PQ-field evolution solver (homogeneous-mode ODEs plus linear mode functions for resonance/tachyonic bands, or an adapted CosmoLattice run for the nonlinear regime) parameterized by f_a, lambda, H_I, S_i, reheating temperature, thermal couplings, and curvature couplings, releasing yields and momentum spectra on a benchmark grid.

members.model_name: SUSY axion hybrid-inflation model with saxion-diluted axion dark matter
members.description: The topological-defect (string and domain-wall) axion contribution to the relic abundance at f_a near 1e15 GeV with N=1 and subsequent saxion entropy dilution is uncalibrated; the route caveat says it can only be bracketed, leaving an order-unity uncertainty on Omega_a h^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt published axion string-network simulation emission spectra (extrapolated in log(f_a/H)) to this scenario by adding the saxion matter-dominated epoch and dilution factor to the semi-analytic defect-emission abundance formula, and propagate the simulation scatter as a bracketed systematic on Omega_a h^2.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric instanton-generated ultralight axion
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation is uncalibrated for this model: the card marks halo and subhalo mass-function effects as expected-but-unsupplied and simulation_calibrated as unknown, so predictions at and below ~10 kpc rely on linear-theory extrapolation.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate a halo/subhalo mass-function suppression fitting function from existing fuzzy-DM Schroedinger-Poisson simulation suites over m_a = 1e-22 to 1e-21 eV, including sub-unity axion fractions per the route's validation test.

members.model_name: Clockwork axion with defect-network cosmology
members.description: No field-theory or Nambu-Goto simulation of the clockwork defect network (strings and gear-mode domain walls with clockwork-suppressed tension) exists to calibrate the network scaling density, axion emission efficiency, and emission spectrum; the route currently rests on analytic estimates whose validity breaks down in the high-f regime where Delta N_eff > 0.1 is claimed.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of the N+1 clockwork scalar system through the PQ phase transition (extending existing axion-string simulation frameworks to nearest-neighbor clockwork potentials), extract the network scaling parameters and the emitted-axion spectrum as functions of N, q, and the gear mass spectrum, and fit a calibrated emission model to replace the analytic estimate.

members.model_name: Electroweak symmetric dark matter ball
members.description: The soliton formation efficiency and charge distribution from dark-matter-number trapping by expanding bubbles in a first-order electroweak phase transition are uncertain, so the present-day ball mass function and local flux normalization entering the encounter rate are not calculable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the complex scalar field during a first-order electroweak phase transition (with the transition parameters obtained from a CosmoTransitions-style effective-potential analysis) to extract the trapped-charge and soliton mass distributions as a function of the asymmetry and portal coupling.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle coupled to a light dark photon
members.description: No public, validated lattice pipeline exists for the coupled ALP-dark-photon system (phi X Xdual/4f with alpha_D ~ 10-100) through nonlinear backreaction, so the dark-photon spectrum, ALP depletion factor, and GW anisotropic-stress source are only available as analytic/linear templates; the paper's improved Python simulation is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the axion-dark-photon Chern-Simons coupling in CosmoLattice (which already supports abelian gauge fields) or publicly release the paper's solver, and run a grid over (alpha_D, m_X/m_a, initial misalignment) to tabulate GW spectra and ALP depletion factors validated against the published audible-axion template scaling.

members.model_name: Multifield ultralight dark matter
members.description: No public multifield Schroedinger-Poisson solver exists for N independent ultralight scalar fields with equal or different masses; the primary-paper simulation code is private, blocking reproduction of halo granularity and soliton structure for arbitrary (N, m_i).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public Schroedinger-Poisson code (e.g. PyUltraLight, AxioNyx, or a GAMER wave-DM branch) to evolve N coupled wavefunctions sourcing a common gravitational potential, and validate against the paper's N=1 limit and equal-mass granularity suppression.

members.model_name: Axion trapping by cosmic string wakes
members.description: The post-QCD nonlinear evolution of the released sheet-like axion overdensities to low redshift is uncomputed (route caveat: post-QCD nonlinear evolution is unresolved), so there is no prediction of the present-day morphology, mass, or abundance of the sheets that any survey could target.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body or Press-Schechter-style seeded-collapse simulations initialized with the sheet-like isocurvature profiles from the wake code, tracking fragmentation into axion miniclusters/sheets down to z=0 and outputting their mass function and clustering.

members.model_name: Model-independent string QCD axion with domain wall number one
members.description: No public, calibrated simulation or emulator for the N_DW=1 axion string-wall network: the defect-decay axion spectrum and its relic-abundance factor A_xi are taken from private lattice runs with large dynamic-range extrapolation, so the post-inflation defect contribution to Omega_a h^2 cannot be recomputed for this model's f_a range.
members.proposed_resolution: Run modern lattice field-theory simulations of the string-wall network for N_DW=1 (following the Hiramatsu/Kawasaki-style setups cited via arXiv:1202.5851) across the f_a in 1e10-1e12 GeV window, and release a fitted emulator mapping (f_a, N_DW=1) to the radiated axion spectrum and relic abundance with quantified extrapolation systematics.

members.model_name: Condensed-phase axion/ALP dark-matter cooling scenario
members.description: No validated calculation or field simulation exists for axion/ALP Bose-Einstein condensate formation with the long-range gravitational correlation required to cool primordial hydrogen; the card treats the condensed phase and its hydrogen momentum-exchange rate as an assumption whose validity is flagged as debated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run self-gravitating scalar-field (Schrodinger-Poisson) simulations of the axion subcomponent through z ~ 200-20 to quantify condensate coherence length and the gravitationally mediated axion-hydrogen momentum-exchange rate, and publish the resulting cooling rate as a fitting function usable in thermal-history codes.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with early matter domination
members.description: Nonlinear formation, mass function, and late-time tidal survival of axion miniclusters seeded by EMDE-enhanced small-scale perturbations (including the homogenized-field T_R < 58 MeV regime) have not been simulated, so the initial M_mc estimates cannot be propagated to present-day observables.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with the EMDE-enhanced axion perturbation spectrum (analogous to existing post-inflationary minicluster simulations) through matter-radiation equality, then couple to a semi-analytic tidal-stripping model to obtain the surviving minicluster mass function and compactness distribution.

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled (pseudo-)scalar dark matter
members.description: The nonlinear collapse and survival of the small-scale density clumps implied by the peaked fluctuation spectrum are unsimulated: no calibration exists for the clump mass function, density profiles, or tidal survival, leaving the small-scale clumpiness observable qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations seeded with the model's peaked isocurvature spectrum, following the axion-minicluster simulation methodology, to calibrate a clump mass function and survival fraction, and derive the transfer-function/halo-model quantities the card's structure_formation block leaves unknown.

members.model_name: B-L origin QCD axion dark matter
members.description: The staged B-L/PQ symmetry-breaking history can produce a string-domain-wall network (despite effective N_dw=1) whose viability under post-inflationary restoration is asserted but not simulated; no defect-network simulation exists for this two-stage breaking pattern with Z6R structure.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of the sequential B-L and PQ phase transitions (or adapt existing axion string-wall network codes) parameterized by the breaking order, T_max, and reheating history, to map which histories avoid stable walls and to quantify any defect contribution to the axion abundance.

members.model_name: O(N) axion-like angular dark matter production model
members.description: The O(N) lattice code used to compute defect evolution and axion-like number density is private, and its results carry unresolved string-core and finite-dynamic-range extrapolation systematics, so the production efficiency for the physical rapid-mass-turn-on regime cannot be independently recomputed or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the described C++ lattice implementation, or reimplement the O(N) potential with temperature-dependent explicit breaking in a public lattice framework (e.g. CosmoLattice or jaxions), and run adaptive-mesh or larger-dynamic-range simulations to control the string-core extrapolation of n_a.

members.model_name: Axion dark matter with dark-Higgs early-dark-energy trapping
members.description: The explosive tachyonic production of dark photons from axion oscillations, including backreaction and the resulting axion depletion that sets both the dark-matter abundance and the trapping dark-photon bath, is treated only with semi-analytic approximations; no nonlinear simulation calibrated for this axion-dark-photon-dark-Higgs system exists on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1D lattice simulations of the coupled axion-dark-photon-dark-Higgs system (e.g. by extending CosmoLattice's gauge-field sector) over the m_phi-f_phi plane, and calibrate a semi-analytic depletion/production module against them for use in parameter scans.

members.model_name: PQ inflation axion dark matter with higher-dimensional operators
members.description: No lattice simulation exists of the post-inflation resonant amplification, PQ symmetry restoration, and subsequent axion string/domain-wall network for this model, so the defect contribution to Omega_a and the final (inhomogeneous) axion field configuration are unquantified beyond the paper's qualitative argument.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1D classical lattice simulations (CosmoLattice or equivalent) of the PQ field after inflation for benchmark (g, l, xi, f) points to determine the restoration criterion and defect formation, then attach existing axion string-network scaling results (arXiv:1507.00119-style extrapolations) to convert defect densities into an axion abundance with quantified N_DW dependence.

members.model_name: QCD axion-ALP mass mixing with explicit PQ symmetry breaking
members.description: Possible domain-wall formation triggered by level crossing in the two-axion system is only noted qualitatively; no field-theory lattice simulation of the two-field potential with explicit PQ breaking exists to determine whether defects form and with what energy budget.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice field simulations of the coupled axion/ALP fields across the level-crossing epoch for representative (N_H, r_m, R_m) benchmarks to determine domain-wall formation, network evolution, and contribution to the energy density.

members.model_name: Hidden Peccei-Quinn Higgs double-field axion-inflation model
members.description: The axionic-string/domain-wall relic abundance for this model's specific PQ-breaking history rests on a qualitative dilution argument; no lattice simulation of the hidden-PQ field with its explicit breaking terms has been run to confirm defects are non-catastrophic.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a PQ-field lattice simulation (adapting existing axion-string network codes) for the model's breaking epoch and domain-wall number N, or, for the pre-inflationary branch, formalize the analytic dilution bound in N_e and verify the H_inf < 2 f_a/N condition across the viable parameter space.

members.model_name: Low-scale hypercolor axion-domain-wall dark sector
members.description: No axion string-wall network simulation exists for a domain-wall network destabilized by a low-scale hypercolor instanton bias; existing lattice defect simulations assume the standard QCD-only potential, so the wall-decay axion abundance and the upper f_a bound carry uncalibrated network and emission-spectrum uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend existing axion string-wall lattice simulation setups (e.g. the Kawasaki-Saikawa type field-theory simulations) to include a subdominant HC-instanton bias term in the axion potential, and fit the resulting wall decay time and axion emission spectrum as functions of Lambda_HC and f_a.

members.model_name: Charged scalar field dark matter with dark photon
members.description: No numerical Schrodinger-Poisson / Klein-Gordon-Poisson simulation exists for charged SFDM halos with excited 'atomic' states and dark-photon coupling; the paper's halo-state occupation results rest on analytic toy solutions only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Schrodinger-Poisson solver (e.g. PyUltraLight- or AxioNyx-class codes) to a two-component complex field coupled to a dark U(1) gauge field, and simulate ground/excited-state halo configurations to test the atomic-halo ansatz.

members.model_name: Two-component wave dark matter with distinct boson masses
members.description: No public cosmological solver evolves two gravitationally coupled ultralight scalar wave functions with distinct masses; the primary simulations exist but are unreleased and cover only 75/25 fractions with mass ratios 3:1 and 1:3, so soliton coexistence and rotation curves cannot be predicted elsewhere in the (m_major, m_minor, f) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public wave-dark-matter simulation code (e.g. the GAMER ELBDM spectral solver or PyUltraLight) to two coupled Schrodinger fields sharing one Poisson potential, validate against the published 3:1 concentric-soliton and 1:3 no-minor-soliton results, and scan mass ratios and fractions to fit a two-component core-halo relation.

members.model_name: Trapped-axion resonant dark photon production
members.description: No lattice or nonlinear mode-solver calculation exists for the trapped-axion release benchmark: the dark-photon spectrum, backreaction on the axion condensate, final axion/dark-photon energy ratio, and the predicted reduction of polarization asymmetry are all uncomputed for the delayed-release (H_release << m_a) regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3+1D lattice simulations of the coupled axion-dark-photon system (extending an existing axion-gauge-field lattice framework such as CosmoLattice) initialized from the trapped-then-released axion configuration, scanning alpha/f_a, m_a/H_release, and trapping-potential heights, and output the dark-photon spectrum, polarization fractions, and final energy partition.

members.model_name: Inhomogeneous dilaton oscillaton dark matter
members.description: Whether inhomogeneous dilaton regions actually gravitationally cool into long-lived oscillatons — the mechanism the galactic dark-matter component depends on — has never been simulated for this model: existing oscillaton/boson-star collapse results use minimally coupled scalars with simple potentials, not the non-minimal curvature coupling and trough-tail dilaton potential with m_phi ~ 20-270 MeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public numerical-relativity or Newtonian scalar-collapse code (e.g., GRChombo or an axion-star solver) with the scalar-tensor non-minimal coupling and the dilaton trough potential, evolve representative post-reheating overdensities, and measure cooling efficiency, oscillaton lifetimes, and the resulting mass-radius relation.

members.model_name: N=1 axion domain-wall decay dark matter
members.description: No public high-dynamic-range simulation of the N=1 string-wall network reaches physically relevant v_a/m_a; the wall-decay Lorentz factor gamma (7 measured at v_a/m_a=500, about 60 extrapolated) and the radiated axion spectrum that set both the relic contribution and the population-II velocity dispersion are extrapolations with order-of-magnitude uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run modern adaptive-mesh or large-lattice field-theory simulations of the post-QCD N=1 string-wall network (in the style of recent AMR axion-string codes) to larger log(v_a/m_a), extracting the wall-decay axion energy spectrum and a fitted scaling law for gamma versus v_a/m_a.

members.model_name: N=1 axion domain-wall decay dark matter
members.description: The minicluster fate of the two axion populations is uncomputed: the card marks halo/subhalo effects 'not calculated' and simulation_calibrated 'no', so the fraction of wall-decay (population II) axions that avoid minicluster binding and their tidal-stripping history in the Galactic halo — the inputs to both the smooth-component observable and the local cavity phase space — are unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of minicluster formation seeded by the two-population initial phase space (cold population I plus high-dispersion population II) and follow tidal disruption in a Milky-Way potential to output the local smooth density fraction and velocity distribution of each population.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dynamical decay constant
members.description: The overclosure condition from enhanced perturbations (validity domain avoid_domain_wall_overclosure) is only an analytic criterion: whether field fluctuations exceeding the axion period at QCD potential turn-on produce domain walls or axion miniclusters requires a nonlinear field simulation that does not exist for the dynamical-f case.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the axion field with the time-dependent kinetic coefficient through the QCD mass turn-on to map the (f_inf/f0, n, theta_i) region that forms domain walls or overdense miniclusters, calibrating the analytic overclosure boundary.

members.model_name: High-tension string-theory QCD axion-string dark matter
members.description: Existing axion-string network simulations are field-theory codes at logarithmically enhanced tension and cannot reach the high-tension string-theory regime (large mu_eff, reconnection probability P <= 1, modulus-regulated cores), so the string-radiated axion spectrum and GW background rely on extrapolated scaling relations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend Nambu-Goto or field-theory string-network simulations with an effective high-tension, low-reconnection parameterization (mu_eff, P) and a domain-wall collapse module near the QCD epoch, calibrating the axion emission spectrum and Omega_GW(f) to replace the scaling-relation estimates.

members.model_name: Non-cold fermionic dark matter from primordial black hole evaporation
members.description: No released pipeline connects the Hawking-emission spectrum and evaporation-history redshifting to the CLASS ncdm f(q) input; the paper's implementation is private, so the transfer-function route cannot be reproduced end to end.
members.proposed_resolution: Write and release a small converter that takes BlackHawk (or analytic) emission spectra, applies the radiation- vs PBH-dominated redshifting branches, and outputs a CLASS-ready tabulated psd file, validated against the paper's transfer-function fits.

members.model_name: Heavy scalar dark matter from primordial-black-hole superradiance
members.description: No public code solves the coupled system of Kerr PBH mass, spin, superradiant bound-state occupation, and DM number density used by the paper; the dedicated superradiance solver is not released, and existing PBH codes (BlackHawk, FRISBHEE, ULYSSES) omit the superradiance channel entirely.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public PBH-cosmology framework (FRISBHEE or the ULYSSES PBH modules, with BlackHawk-style Kerr greybody evolution) by adding the analytic superradiance rate equations for the dominant scalar bound levels, and validate against the paper's factor-of-few to factor-20 enhancement contours in (M_i, a_star, mu).

members.model_name: PBH sterile neutrinogenesis of sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The abundance calculation assumes a monochromatic PBH mass function and instantaneous evaporation; no implemented calculation handles extended mass functions and time-resolved evaporation for the sterile-neutrino yield and spectrum, which shifts both f_s and the warmness bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Use or extend a public PBH evaporation code (BlackHawk-style time-dependent greybody emission) coupled to a background Friedmann solver to integrate sterile-neutrino production over extended mass functions and non-instantaneous reheating, outputting f_s and f(p) directly.

members.model_name: Halo axion-star QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No public Schrodinger-Poisson boundary-value solver is configured for halo axion stars, i.e. solitons embedded in an axion minicluster or PBH-seeded minihalo with an external gravitational potential and halo-density boundary conditions, as required to obtain the modified mass-radius relation M_AS(m_a, M_halo, M_PBH).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public Schrodinger-Poisson soliton solver (e.g. PyUltraLight or a standalone boundary-value soliton profile code) to include a fixed external PBH point-mass potential plus minicluster halo boundary conditions, and validate against the paper's halo axion-star mass-radius relation.

members.model_name: Rolling-PQ axion-bubble PBH seed model
members.description: No public semi-analytic pipeline computes the axion-bubble population for a rolling PQ radial field: stochastic inflationary axion fluctuations with the c_I-dependent suppression, the probability of landing in the rare Witten-effect minimum, and the resulting PBH mass function and f_PBH at horizon reentry.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's Gaussian P(N, theta) bubble statistics with the rolling-PQ transfer as a standalone code (stochastic spectator-field evolution during inflation plus a Press-Schechter-style collapse criterion with threshold at horizon reentry), validated against the paper's benchmark f_PBH = 3e-9 window 1.15 < c_I < 1.76 at f_a = 1e16 GeV.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubbles from hidden SU(N)_H PQ breaking
members.description: No code maps the model parameters (f_a, N, theta_i distribution, bubble fraction) to Omega_a, the bubble statistics, f_PBH(M), and a comparison against compact-object constraints; the route's required PBH-constraint recast is currently unimplemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's vacuum-selection probability and misalignment formulae in a small pipeline that outputs f_PBH(M_PBH) and feeds it to the public PBHbounds constraint compilation (supermassive-window limits from CMB accretion, dynamical friction, and mu-distortions), validating against the quoted O(5e5) M_sun minimum PBH mass at f_a ~ 1e16 GeV.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporated non-thermal WIMPy baryogenesis dark matter
members.description: The model-specific Boltzmann system (PBH evaporation source plus B- and CP-violating WIMP reannihilation) exists only as the authors' unreleased modification of ULYSSES, with no pinned version, environment, or example inputs, so the relic-density and Y_B benchmarks cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Publish (or reimplement) the WIMPy-baryogenesis equation set as an ULYSSES model module with pinned dependencies, validated against the paper's M_in = 1e6 g, TeV-DM benchmark trend and its semi-analytic relic expression.

members.model_name: Poisson primordial-black-hole dark matter with small-scale velocity floor
members.description: Existing PBH accretion energy-injection pipelines (ExoCLASS/DarkHistory-style codes coupled to Planck likelihoods) assume only baryon-DM relative streaming for the effective velocity and do not include the Poisson-discreteness PBH velocity distribution, so the velocity-floor correction to CMB and dark-ages injection bounds cannot be propagated self-consistently.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing PBH accretion energy-deposition code (e.g. the ExoCLASS PBH-accretion module or DarkHistory) to average the Bondi rate over the Maxwell-Boltzmann PBH velocity distribution with the paper's sigma_PBH(f_PBH, M_PBH, z), then rerun the Planck likelihood to produce corrected f_PBH(M_PBH) bounds.

members.model_name: High-decay-constant QCD axion dark matter with PBH-seeded UCMHs
members.description: No public calculator maps an enhanced small-scale P_zeta(k) to a PBH mass function and f_PBH for collapse during an early matter-dominated era; standard radiation-era PBH abundance codes do not cover the pressureless-collapse regime this scenario requires.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing PBH-abundance code (peak-theory/Press-Schechter PBH calculators) with the matter-dominated collapse criterion including angular-momentum and inhomogeneity suppression factors, parameterized by the EMD duration and T_rh2.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine baryogenesis
members.description: No public implementation exists of the stochastic Affleck-Dine field pipeline mapping AD potential parameters and phi_c to the high-baryon-bubble distribution, PBH mass function f(M), f_PBH, and correlation function xi(x); the whole forward model currently lives only in the paper's semi-analytic derivations.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's stochastic (Fokker-Planck/peaks-style) bubble statistics and QCD-transition collapse formulas as a numerical code that takes the AD potential parameters and inflationary Hubble scale as inputs and outputs f(M), f_PBH, xi(x), and P_PBH(k), validated against the paper's benchmark spectra and limiting-case analytics.

members.model_name: Astrophysical Q-ball dark matter
members.description: No finite-size lensing code that maps an extended Q-ball density profile to a projected surface density, magnification curve, and microlensing event duration outside the point-lens regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an extended-lens magnification calculator (Abel-projected surface density plus lens-equation solve with finite source size), following existing finite-size PBH/boson-star microlensing recasts, and verify it reduces to the point-lens light curve as R_Q -> 0.

members.model_name: Broad-mass PBH-Lambda dark matter universe
members.description: No public forward-model pipeline exists that takes a broad PBH birth mass function through the Poisson-enhanced high-z halo mass function, HOD assignment, star-formation/accretion emissivity, and projection to CIB/CXB angular power, source counts, and tau; the paper's emcee+HOD implementation is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the paper's pipeline as a public code: compute the PBH Poisson-plus-adiabatic power spectrum, feed it to a Press-Schechter/Sheth-Tormen halo mass function, attach the paper's HOD and emissivity prescriptions (f_*, f_esc, IMF, accretion efficiency as free parameters), and project with Limber integrals to P_ij(q), counts, and tau, validating against the paper's background figures.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from stiff reheating with a broken-power-law scalar spectrum
members.description: No public end-to-end pipeline maps the broken-power-law parameters plus reheating history (A_0, n_0, k_*, w_re, T_re, delta_c) jointly to f_PBH(M), the induced Omega_GW(f) including the stiff-to-radiation transition, and the NANOGrav 15-year likelihood; every non-likelihood step of the route has tool_or_code null and the route status is planned, so the paper's Bayes-factor result cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing scalar-induced-GW code (e.g., SIGWfast-type kernel integrator) with the sudden and smooth stiff-to-radiation transition transfer functions, couple it to a reheating-era PBH abundance module, wrap both as a custom deterministic signal in PTArcade/enterprise, and release the joint scan configuration with the microlensing/CMB f_PBH bounds applied.

members.model_name: Dissipative dark cosmology with early matter dominance and delayed compact objects
members.description: Microlensing survey exclusions (Subaru/HSC, OGLE, EROS-2, MACHO, Kepler) are only available as point-lens limits, but DarkCOs have radii around 1e2-1e5 m; no tool computes finite-lens-size detection efficiencies and rescaled f(M) bounds for this model, and no survey likelihood is packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement extended-lens magnification (finite lens and finite source) in a microlensing efficiency calculator, reweight the published survey efficiencies for R_DarkCO in the 1e2-1e5 m range, and package the result as an f(M_DarkCO, R_DarkCO) likelihood following the existing extended-lens recast literature.

members.model_name: Evaporating primordial black-hole dark matter as varying dark energy
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation of the evaporating-PBH coupled matter-radiation fluids exists, so only background distances and CMB shift parameters can be used; full CMB anisotropy and matter-power perturbation constraints on (M_in, f_PBH, alpha) cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PBH mass-loss source term and the sourced radiation component as coupled species in CLASS or CAMB (background plus linear perturbations), then run against the full Planck anisotropy likelihood instead of shift parameters.

members.model_name: LED delayed evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: No public numerical code integrates the full LED black-hole history for this scenario: formation rate from plasma collisions at reheating, the DEBH accretion-dominated growth phase, and higher-dimensional Hawking evaporation with dark-sector emission, as functions of M_*, n, and T_RH.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a PBH evaporation code such as BlackHawk/FRISBHEE with n-extra-dimension Schwarzschild-Tangherlini thermodynamics and greybody factors, adding a plasma-collision formation-rate module and the accretion-growth equation for the delayed-evaporation branch.

members.model_name: LED instantly evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: No public numerical code integrates LED black-hole formation from plasma collisions at reheating with higher-dimensional Hawking evaporation and dark-sector particle yield as functions of M_*, n, and T_RH, so the IEBH relic-abundance window cannot be recomputed or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a PBH evaporation code such as BlackHawk/FRISBHEE with n-extra-dimension Schwarzschild-Tangherlini thermodynamics and greybody factors plus a plasma-collision formation-rate module, and validate by recovering the 4D limit and the paper's quoted reheating-ratio window.

members.model_name: Inflaton-curvaton sound-speed-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public PBH abundance calculator handles the non-Gaussian probability tail (local f_NL from the curvaton) on the narrow SSR-peaked curvature spectrum, even though f_PBH is exponentially sensitive to that tail and to delta_c.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a peaks-theory/Press-Schechter PBH abundance module that takes the SSR resonant P_R(k) plus a local-f_NL-deformed PDF and threshold delta_c = 0.7 as inputs, validating against the paper's f_PBH near 1 benchmark at 0.1 Hz and against published non-Gaussian PBH abundance results.

members.model_name: Classically conformal B-L double-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No inflationary power-spectrum solver is set up for the classically conformal B-L Coleman-Weinberg double-inflation potential; the PBH-forming enhanced spectrum is inherited from a cited benchmark and cannot be varied over the model's own parameters (v_phi, g_BL, inflationary benchmark).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the B-L Coleman-Weinberg two-stage potential in a numerical mode-by-mode inflation solver (e.g. MultiModeCode or the CLASS/CAMB primordial-module interface) and validate against the cited benchmark k_peak ~ 1e14 Mpc^-1 before scanning model parameters.

members.model_name: Axion-like scalar dark matter miniclusters
members.description: No lensing event-rate calculator handles the low internal densities and extended profiles of ScaMs, so microlensing/variability constraints and future-survey sensitivities in the 1e-7 to 1e2 solar-mass window cannot be evaluated (point-lens MACHO limits do not apply directly).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a finite-size-lens event-rate code (extending published axion-minicluster microlensing methodology from the 1707.03310-style analyses) that takes the ScaM mass function, rho_ScaM profiles, and f_ScaM and outputs rates for OGLE/HSC-style and future cadence surveys.

members.model_name: Planck-mass primordial black-hole relics from warm inflation
members.description: No public perturbation solver computes the primordial curvature power spectrum P_R(k) for warm inflation with the paper's dissipation coefficient and thermal-noise sourcing, which is the input every downstream quantity (PBH abundance, Planck-relic density, induced GW spectrum) depends on.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a public warm-inflation background plus stochastic-perturbation solver (mode-by-mode integration of the Langevin-sourced perturbation equations with dissipation coefficient Upsilon(T,phi)), packaged so its P_R(k) output feeds standard PBH-abundance and induced-GW formulas; validate against the paper's benchmark producing M_PBH near 10^3 g.

members.model_name: Speed-breaker inflationary primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No induced-GW calculator or merger-SGWB recast is set up for the model's benchmarks: second-order scalar-induced Omega_GW(f) from the amplified spectrum and the PBH-binary merger background needed to compare with PTA and LIGO SGWB limits were not computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the computed P_R(k) through a public scalar-induced GW code (SIGWfast-class kernel integration), add a PBH binary merger-rate model for the merger SGWB, and compare against published PTA and LIGO O-run SGWB sensitivity curves and upper limits.

members.model_name: Microscopic horizonless relic dark matter
members.description: No public calculator maps the enhanced curvature spectrum (A_0, k_0, n) through collapse-threshold statistics and PBH-to-remnant mass loss to the microscopic relic abundance f_DM(M_relic), which is required to interpret both the abundance observable and the Hawking-evasion constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing PBH abundance code (peaks-theory/Press-Schechter threshold machinery) with a parameterized remnant branch: initial PBH mass function from the benchmark spectrum, an evaporation-suppression or remnant-mass relation M_relic(M_PBH), and output f_DM, released alongside the SGWB pipeline so both share the same spectrum parameters.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from strongly supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: No public implementation of the semi-analytic pipeline mapping a supercooled first-order-transition nucleation history (beta/H_I, H_I t_*, V^(1/4)) through the false-vacuum-domain distribution to the PBH mass function and f_PBH, including both horizon-crossing and subhorizon collapse channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Release a code implementing the paper's thin-wall nucleation and collapse formalism as a parameterized module (inputs beta/H_I, H_I t_*, V^(1/4); output dn/dM and f_PBH), validated against the published beta/H_I ~ 3.8 exponential-nucleation benchmark and the V^(1/4)=10^5-10^8 GeV asteroid-mass window.

members.model_name: Sub-horizon-collapsed primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public code propagates the sub-horizon collapse parameter f_H through the PBH binary merger rate to the isotropic SGWB spectrum and its angular power spectrum C_l(f); the card lists the merger-rate model and SGWB anisotropy calculator as required but unimplemented resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the f_H-shifted mass function and formation redshift in an existing PBH merger-rate framework (early-binary formation rate a la Ali-Haimoud et al.) and couple it to an astrophysical-SGWB anisotropy formalism (Cusin-Cusin/Contaldi-type line-of-sight C_l calculation) to output Omega_gw(f) and C_l(f) versus f_H.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from late B-L phase-transition patches
members.description: No public end-to-end pipeline maps the classically scale-invariant B-L potential parameters to the late-nucleating-patch PBH abundance: the bounce/nucleation calculation and the delayed-patch collapse probability (currently a rough beta/H ~ 8 criterion) are not implemented in any released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple CosmoTransitions (or BubbleDet-era successors) evaluating the B-L finite-temperature effective potential to a module implementing the late-patch survival probability P(t_n) and PBH collapse criterion, outputting f_PBH(M_PBH) as a function of (T_RH, beta/H, potential parameters), validated against the paper's f_PBH=1 window.

members.model_name: Modified Affleck-Dine primordial black hole subcomponent model
members.description: No public solver computes the stochastic Affleck-Dine field distribution and the high-lepton-bubble volume fraction for a time-dependent Hubble-induced mass history (c1 early, c2 late); this quantity normalizes the entire PBH seed abundance and correlation function.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a stochastic-inflation Fokker-Planck (or lattice Langevin) solver for the AD flat-direction potential with piecewise Hubble-mass coefficients c1/c2, outputting the bubble probability and its spatial correlation as functions of (c1, c2, phi_c, M_F, T_RH), validated against the paper's benchmark suppression results.

members.model_name: Modulated linear chaotic inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation-spectrum solver implements the modulated p=1 chaotic potential, so the numerical P_R(k) on CMB-to-PBH scales (beyond the slow-roll n_s expansion) cannot be reproduced or scanned; the paper's own numerical solution is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement V(phi) = linear chaotic p=1 plus periodic modulation in a public mode-equation solver (MultiModeCode or PyTransport, or as an external primordial-spectrum module for CLASS), parameterized by (Lambda^4, modulation period f, modulation amplitude), and validate against the paper's n_s(k_PBH)=5.85 and beta_s bounds.

members.model_name: Dark massive compact halo object phenomenology
members.description: No public implementation exists of the spherically symmetric hydrostatic accretion calculation onto an extended dMACHO (density/temperature/ionization profile and luminosity L(z) as functions of M and R); existing PBH-accretion codes assume point-mass Bondi accretion and cannot reproduce the extended-object radius dependence.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the primary paper's hydrostatic accretion ODEs (spherical hydrostatic equilibrium with heating, cooling, and ionization) as a public solver parameterized by (M, R, mass profile, ambient gas density and temperature), validated against the paper's L(z) and molecular-cloud flux examples.

members.model_name: QCD-epoch first-principle primordial-black-hole dark matter population
members.description: No public code maps a sampled curvature power spectrum P_R(k) through QCD-epoch equation-of-state-dependent collapse thresholds and critical-collapse scaling to the PBH mass function f(m); the paper's first-principle formation machinery is private, blocking regeneration of the population for new spectrum parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a formation module that tabulates the QCD-era equation of state, the corresponding collapse threshold delta_c(M_H), and the critical-collapse relation, taking (A, n_s, M_min, M_max) as inputs and returning f(m), validated against the paper's published mass functions.

members.model_name: QCD-epoch first-principle primordial-black-hole dark matter population
members.description: All-dark-matter claims for the asteroid-mass ultra-slow-roll mapping cannot be evaluated because no recasting machinery convolves this broad, multi-featured mass function with the compiled monochromatic multi-messenger PBH bounds (evaporation, microlensing, CMB accretion, dynamical), whose statuses the card notes are themselves evolving.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the standard extended-mass-function recast method to a maintained bound compilation (PBHbounds-style curves), integrating f(m)/f_max(m) over the QCD-shaped and USR-mapped mass functions to produce allowed f_PBH windows with per-constraint provenance flags.

members.model_name: Supercool radiative-symmetry-breaking phase-transition PBH dark matter
members.description: No public calculator implements the late-blooming PBH mass and abundance from patch-to-patch false-vacuum decay statistics, and f_PBH is exponentially sensitive to the transition-tail assumptions, so M_PBH and f_PBH cannot be independently evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the late-blooming formalism (survival probability of late-nucleating Hubble patches, overdensity threshold, horizon-mass collapse) as a module taking (T_n, beta/H_n, alpha) from the effective-potential step, and quantify sensitivity to the decay-rate tail by varying the nucleation-rate expansion.

members.model_name: Modulated quadratic chaotic inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation-spectrum solver implements the modulated p=2 chaotic potential, so the numerical P_R(k) on CMB-to-PBH scales (beyond the slow-roll n_s expansion) cannot be reproduced or scanned; the paper's own numerical solution is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement V(phi) = quadratic chaotic p=2 plus periodic modulation in a public mode-equation solver (MultiModeCode or PyTransport, or as an external primordial-spectrum module for CLASS), parameterized by (Lambda^4, modulation period f, modulation amplitude), and validate against the paper's n_s(k_PBH)=2.84 and beta_s bounds.

members.model_name: Lognormal primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public PBH accretion energy-injection module covers this model's broad lognormal, stellar-mass spectrum: existing Planck accretion bounds are computed for monochromatic masses and depend strongly on the accretion efficiency and PBH-baryon relative-velocity prescription, so the CMB constraint statistic cannot be evaluated for the lognormal benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an exotic-energy-injection Boltzmann pipeline (e.g. the ExoCLASS/DarkAges branch of CLASS) with a PBH-accretion luminosity module parameterized by accretion efficiency and relative velocity, integrated over an arbitrary d f_PBH/d ln M, and expose the mass-function-weighted Planck constraint statistic.

members.model_name: Lognormal primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No merger-rate forward model exists for this card: the gw_rate step has null tool_or_code, so there is no code that converts the lognormal mass function plus a PBH clustering model into a LIGO/Virgo binary-black-hole merger-rate distribution for comparison with observed rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a semi-analytic PBH binary-formation and merger-rate calculator (early-universe binary formation plus late-time capture) that takes d f_PBH/d ln M and a clustering parameterization as input and outputs differential merger rates in component masses for direct comparison with LIGO/Virgo population inferences.

members.model_name: MST-EFT primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public PBH mass-function calculator handles the equation-of-state-dependent collapse threshold delta_c(w, c_s) needed for this model's favored 0.2 <= w <= 1/3 window; abundance results are exponentially sensitive to this threshold.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard Press-Schechter/peak-theory PBH abundance code with the w-dependent threshold prescriptions (Musco-type) tabulated over the model's w and c_s ranges, and validate against the radiation-era w = 1/3 limit named in the card's validation tests.

members.model_name: PBH-reheated scalar-field unification dark matter
members.description: No background-evolution integrator exists for the coupled scalar-field plus PBH plus radiation system with a general unification potential, so PBH density growth during the kination-like era (and hence the evaporation epoch) is only computed with idealized analytic scalings.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Friedmann-Boltzmann background solver for the scalar field, PBH matter component, and Hawking-produced radiation (e.g. by extending a public PBH-cosmology solver such as FRISBHEE to include a rolling scalar with an arbitrary unification potential), parameterized by V(phi), beta, and V_end^(1/4).

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter seeded by multifield inflation
members.description: No public implementation of this two-field nonminimally coupled potential in a multifield inflation solver, so the USR-amplified P_R(k) — the input to the CMB, PBH, and induced-GW steps — cannot be regenerated independently of the paper's private MCMC pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Einstein-frame two-field system (curved field-space metric from the nonminimal couplings plus the dimension-4 potential) in PyTransport or MultiModeCode, and validate against the paper's quoted n_s region and P_R peak amplitude ~1e-3.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass PBH dark matter from running-index inflation in early matter domination
members.description: No public forward-model code maps running-index parameters (alpha_s, beta_s) plus early-matter-domination history (T_R, H_MD) to a PBH mass function including the anisotropy and angular-momentum collapse suppression used in the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small pipeline that builds P_zeta(k) from the running-index expansion, applies the published matter-era collapse probability with anisotropy/spin suppression, integrates to M(f_PBH) over the reheating history, and validates against the paper's benchmark T_R = 1e4 GeV asteroid-mass solution.

members.model_name: Gauss-Bonnet-corrected single-field-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public code solves the inflationary background and curvature perturbations for a scalar field with a smeared-step Gauss-Bonnet coupling xi(phi) R_GB^2 through the fixed-point ultra-slow-roll regime, so the primordial power spectrum that seeds both the PBH abundance and the induced GW background can only be taken from the paper's two benchmarks rather than scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Gauss-Bonnet-modified background and Mukhanov-Sasaki mode equations (with the modified sound speed and friction terms) in an extension of a public inflation spectrum solver such as PyTransport or MultiModeCode, parameterized by the natural-inflation potential plus (phi_c, xi_0, xi_1), and validate against the paper's benchmark spectra and f_PBH totals.

members.model_name: Spinning-PBH evaporation Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: No public pipeline computes the induced stochastic gravitational-wave background for a spin-dependent PBH-dominated era: the doubly peaked ISGWB spectrum (from scalar perturbations amplified during PBH domination plus the abrupt spin-dependent evaporation transition) is not implemented in any released code coupled to the FRISBHEE background history.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the induced-GW kernel integrals for a PBH-dominated-to-radiation transition (extending a public scalar-induced-GW code such as SIGWfast) with the equation-of-state history and spin-dependent evaporation time taken from FRISBHEE/BlackHawk, and validate against the doubly peaked spectra in the source paper before comparing to LISA/ET sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Memory-burden primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public evaporation/injection pipeline implements the memory-burden lifetime and suppressed late emission: BlackHawk assumes semiclassical Hawking evaporation throughout, and downstream BBN/CMB constraint codes therefore have no valid input for this model, leaving the relaxed light-PBH window (1e6-1e9 g) unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend BlackHawk with a switchable post-half-decay memory-burden mode (lifetime scaling t_H^(n), suppressed spectra from gap_1), pipe the resulting injection histories into DarkHistory/ExoCLASS and standard BBN injection codes to recompute f_PBH(M, n) exclusion curves, and validate by recovering the standard Hawking exclusions in the n = 0 limit.

members.model_name: Thermal-inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public code maps thermal-inflation parameters (m, H/m, g, V0) to the enhanced curvature spectrum P_R(k) and the resulting critical-collapse PBH mass function f_PBH(M); the calculation exists only as the paper's private numerical integral, so the model cannot be scanned beyond the quoted benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small standalone integrator that solves the mode equations through the thermal-inflation and fast-roll phases to get P_R(k), then feeds it into a standard Press-Schechter/critical-collapse mass-function module, validated against the m~600 TeV, H/m~0.30 all-DM benchmark.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from an early stiff/kination epoch
members.description: No implemented pipeline maps a small-scale curvature spectrum P_zeta(k) through the stiff-era mass mapping to f_PBH(M) and then applies extended-mass-function recasting against current evaporation, microlensing, and CMB-accretion bounds; the card names a required PBH mass-function integrator and bounds recast that do not yet exist for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a mass-function integrator with the paper's M(k, w, T1) mapping and Press-Schechter beta(M), couple it to the public PBHbounds curve compilation, and apply the standard Carr-et-al extended-mass-function recast to produce allowed/excluded (w, T1, P_zeta) regions.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with subdominant dressed primordial black holes
members.description: No extended-lens solver plus recast pipeline exists to translate naked-PBH microlensing and cosmological-lensing exclusions to PBHs dressed with truncated r^-9/4 axion minihalos in the (f_PBH, M_PBH) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement magnification curves for the projected truncated r^-9/4 profile in an extended-lens microlensing code, propagate the disruption-adjusted minihalo mass distribution, and recast published survey event-rate likelihoods, verifying recovery of the naked-PBH limit as M_halo goes to 0.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with Peccei-Quinn breaking during warm inflation
members.description: The predicted few-percent small-scale axion density contrast has no forward model to minicluster observables: nonlinear collapse of these isocurvature seeds into miniclusters, their mass function, and any observational comparison (microlensing, pulsar timing) are absent from the card (simulation_calibrated: no, no linked constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed small-scale isocurvature spectrum into N-body or Press-Schechter-style minicluster formation modeling (adapting existing post-inflation axion minicluster simulation pipelines to this initial spectrum) to predict a minicluster mass function, then compare against microlensing constraints.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from delayed vacuum decay in first-order phase transitions
members.description: No public code implements the delayed-vacuum-decay PBH pipeline (late-nucleation probability, overdensity growth of false-vacuum Hubble patches, and resulting f_PBH and M_PBH as functions of transition temperature and nucleation-rate parameters); the mechanism exists only as the paper's analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the mechanism as a public calculator taking (T_PT, beta/H, alpha) — optionally sourced from CosmoTransitions for concrete potentials — and returning f_PBH(M) and the companion GW spectrum, validated against the paper's 1e20 g all-DM and 45 M_sun benchmarks.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational scalar singlet dark matter with a diluter
members.description: No numerical solver has been run for the coupled Friedmann-Boltzmann system of PBH evaporation, radiation, and the long-lived N_3 diluter; the relic abundance and the T5 turning-point temperature rely on instantaneous-decay analytic estimates whose error is uncontrolled.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public PBH-evaporation cosmology solver (FRISBHEE/ULYSSES-class code) to include the N_3-dominated era and continuous entropy injection, outputting Omega_DM h^2 and the exact era-transition temperatures.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational scalar singlet dark matter with a diluter
members.description: No packaged cosmic-string stochastic GW spectrum code exists that includes both the PBH-dominated and the N_3-diluter-dominated early matter eras, and no detector likelihood has been applied beyond benchmark overlays on sensitivity curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard cosmic-string loop GW calculation to the staged expansion history with two matter eras, release it parameterized by (Gmu, T_ev, T5), and evaluate against LISA/ET/BBO power-law-integrated sensitivities or mock-data likelihoods.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal FIMP dark matter with primordial black hole evaporation
members.description: The coupled Boltzmann system for neutrino-portal freeze-in (Littlest-Seesaw dark-sector collision terms for y_DS-mediated scattering and decays) combined with the ULYSSES PBH evaporation source term exists only as unreleased custom code; no public tool computes the mixed freeze-in plus Hawking yield with entropy dilution for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's freeze-in collision terms as a ULYSSES extension (or a micrOMEGAs freeze-in model file coupled to BlackHawk/ULYSSES greybody-weighted PBH source terms), taking (y_DS, m_chi, m_phi, m_N, M_in, beta) and returning Omega_DM h^2 with entropy dilution, validated against the paper's benchmark contours and the M_in <= 1e9 g BBN window.

members.model_name: Dark-FOPT Fermi-ball-collapse primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public end-to-end pipeline exists for PBH-transit PTA sensitivity: the Monte Carlo sampler of PBH positions/velocities and the Doppler/Shapiro SNR analysis used in the paper are private, and public PTA likelihood codes (enterprise-style stochastic-background analyses) do not handle single-object transit signals or extended mass functions.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Monte Carlo Galactic PBH phase-space sampler and Doppler/Shapiro residual generator as an open package, validate against the paper's monochromatic sensitivity curves, and couple it to real PTA pulsar catalogs and noise models from the enterprise framework to replace the SNR-threshold criterion with a proper likelihood.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass primordial black-hole dark matter from a quadratic curvaton with vanishing mean
members.description: No public code maps the mixed inflaton-curvaton parameters (H, m^2/H^2, Gamma) through the non-Gaussian compaction-function probability distribution to the PBH mass function f(M) and f_PBH; the calculation exists only as formulas in the paper and is sensitive to the collapse threshold C_c and window-function choices.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's nonlinear delta-N statistics and compaction-threshold collapse mapping (C_c = 0.55 baseline, with threshold and window variations exposed as options) as a reusable PBH mass-function code, validated against the published f_PBH ~ 0.1 and f_PBH ~ 1 benchmarks.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black hole dark matter from radiation-era collapse
members.description: No public code implements the rare-peak (peaks-theory) clustering calculation that maps a PBH formation threshold and peak height nu to the initial PBH two-point function xi_PBH and power spectrum P_PBH(k) for a monochromatic mass function, so the core clustering step must be reimplemented from the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a small peaks-theory module (BBKS-style thresholded-peak correlation functions on the radiation density field) parameterized by (M_PBH, B(t), nu), validated against the paper's two-point function, and release it as a registry utility; extend later to broad mass functions.

members.model_name: Axion-monodromy scalar clump dark matter from parametric resonance
members.description: No finite-size (extended-lens) microlensing recast exists for the scalar clumps: survey limits are published as point-lens PBH constraints, and the card notes an extended-lens calculation with a clump abundance and halo spatial distribution is required before any survey exclusion or null forecast can be stated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a point-lens microlensing survey pipeline (Subaru HSC M31, OGLE/EROS cadences) with magnification curves for extended soliton density profiles parameterized by (M_clump, R_clump), convolve with a Milky Way/M31 halo clump population model from gap_1, and recompute event-rate limits including finite-source effects.

members.model_name: Polynomial self-interacting scalar clump dark matter
members.description: No extended-lens microlensing recast is available for the finite-size scalar clumps: existing survey limits assume point lenses, and the null-signal claim cannot be turned into a quantitative survey statement without magnification curves for extended soliton profiles plus a halo clump distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a point-lens microlensing survey likelihood (Subaru HSC M31, OGLE/EROS) with finite-lens finite-source magnification for soliton density profiles parameterized by (M_clump, R_clump), combined with a Milky Way/M31 halo population model derived from the gap_1 mass function.

members.model_name: Large-extra-dimension primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No public code computes higher-dimensional PBH evolution for the ADD setup: the greybody factors, temperature-mass relation, accretion history, and primary/secondary evaporation spectra as functions of n and M_* exist only in the unreleased CosmoLED code, and public evaporation tools (BlackHawk) are restricted to 4D black holes.
members.proposed_resolution: Publicly release CosmoLED, or extend BlackHawk with n-extra-dimension Myers-Perry/brane greybody factors, the higher-dimensional T_BH(M, n, M_*) relation, and radiation-era accretion, validated by reproducing the paper's n=2, M_*=10 TeV surviving-mass window of about 10^21-10^22 g.

members.model_name: Modified Higgs-inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The inflaton background plus Mukhanov-Sasaki mode-equation solver for the Gaussian-dip modified Higgs-inflation potential exists only as private author code, so the enhanced curvature power spectrum P_R(k) cannot be independently reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dip-modified Einstein-frame Higgs potential in a public single-field perturbation solver (e.g. PyTransport or a standalone Mukhanov-Sasaki integrator) and validate against the paper's quoted n_s, r, and PBH mass range.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from co-decaying dark matter
members.description: No public solver for the co-decaying dark-sector thermal history: coupled equations for A freeze-out, B decay rate Gamma_B, dark-sector entropy ratio, and the duration N_dur of the early matter-dominated epoch, which set all downstream PBH predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the co-decay Boltzmann system (n_A, n_B, dark and SM radiation, Gamma_B decay term) as a standalone ODE integrator or as an extension of a generic early-matter-dominated-era code, validated against the paper's analytic A-fraction abundance expression.

members.model_name: Superheavy Hawking-radiation dark matter from black-hole domination
members.description: The Boltzmann code the paper used for PBH/radiation energy-density evolution is not stated to be public (associated_code has no repositories), so there is no public end-to-end calculator mapping (M_i, rho_BH_i/rho_R_i, m_DM, spins) to Delta N_eff and Omega_DM h^2 for parameter scans beyond the analytic benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's coupled PBH-radiation background equations and Hawking yield formulae as a small public module (or as an extension of an existing public PBH evaporation spectrum code), validated against the paper's Delta N_eff about 0.03-0.2 range and abundance contours, and couple its Delta N_eff output to current Planck/CMB-S4 Neff likelihoods.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass primordial black holes from double-well inflation
members.description: No public implementation of the double-well inflation model (Jordan-frame non-minimal coupling, non-canonical kinetic factor, Coleman-Weinberg-like Z2 potential) exists in any background plus Mukhanov-Sasaki solver, so the PBH-producing curvature power spectrum cannot be regenerated from the model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Einstein-frame transformed potential and field-space factor in an existing public single-field perturbation solver (a Mukhanov-Sasaki mode-by-mode integrator), validating against the paper's quoted P_R,max of order 1e-2, N_I=31-37, N_II=18-24 benchmarks and CMB n_s/r values.

members.model_name: LED Planckeon black-hole remnant dark matter
members.description: No public numerical code computes the LED black-hole formation rate from plasma collisions and evolves the population through evaporation to the remnant endpoint as functions of M_*, n, and T_RH, so the Planckeon relic density condition cannot be recomputed or scanned over parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a PBH evaporation code such as BlackHawk/FRISBHEE with n-extra-dimension Schwarzschild-Tangherlini thermodynamics, a plasma-collision formation-rate module, and an evaporation cutoff at M_* leaving one stable remnant per black hole, validating against the 4D limit and the paper's abundance relation.

members.model_name: Multi-bumpy inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No inflationary perturbation-solver setup exists for the multi-bumpy potential: computing P_R(k) through several successive slow-roll-violating bump crossings requires a numerical Mukhanov-Sasaki integration that the card leaves with tool_or_code null, and both PBH and SIGW predictions hang on this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the power-law-times-Gaussian-bumps potential in a public mode-by-mode Mukhanov-Sasaki solver (e.g. a PyTransport/BINGO-class inflation perturbation code), verifying the paper's peak locations and amplitudes for the three-bump benchmark.

members.model_name: Multi-bumpy inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: PBHbounds constraints are compiled for monochromatic mass functions, while this model predicts several distinct PBH mass peaks; no extended-mass-function recasting tool is wired into the route, so multi-peak f_PBH(M) cannot be confronted with the constraint envelope self-consistently.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the PBHbounds pipeline with the standard Carr-et-al extended-mass-function method, integrating the predicted multi-peak f_PBH(M) against each digitized monochromatic constraint curve to produce combined exclusions.

members.model_name: Solo-bumpy inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No inflationary perturbation-solver setup exists for the solo-bumpy potential: computing P_R(k) through the slow-roll-violating bump crossing requires a numerical Mukhanov-Sasaki integration that the card leaves with tool_or_code null, and both the PBH and SIGW predictions hang on this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the power-law-times-Gaussian-bump potential in a public mode-by-mode Mukhanov-Sasaki solver (e.g. a PyTransport/BINGO-class inflation perturbation code), verifying the paper's asteroid-mass and solar-mass benchmark peak scales and amplitudes.

members.model_name: Dressed primordial black holes in particle dark matter
members.description: No public wave-optics amplification-factor calculator handles the dressed-PBH extended lens with the steep rho_h proportional to r^-9/4 accreted-halo profile; existing diffraction-integral codes target point-mass or standard (SIS/NFW) profiles, so the event-by-event dPBH vs bare-PBH waveform discrimination cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public wave-optics diffraction-integral code to accept the dressed-PBH density profile parameterized by (M_PBH, M_h, R_h), tabulating F(f) over the LIGO/ET/CE band for the 10-100 M_sun window and verifying recovery of the bare point-mass limit.

members.model_name: Kerr primordial-black-hole evaporated non-cold dark matter
members.description: The pipeline handles only monochromatic PBH mass and spin distributions; extended formation-era mass/spin distributions, which modify the evaporation history and the combined emitted spectrum, are explicitly deferred and unsupported in the released FRISBHEE workflow.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend FRISBHEE to evolve a binned extended PBH mass and spin distribution (e.g. lognormal or critical-collapse shapes), superposing the per-bin emitted spectra into a single f_DM(q) and Delta N_eff for the downstream CLASS step.

members.model_name: Sgoldstino-stabilized alpha-attractor non-oscillatory PBH dark matter model
members.description: Scalar-induced gravitational-wave estimators assume radiation domination; the kination era changes the induced-GW kernel and spectrum amplitudes/frequencies, and no tool computes Omega_GW for this model's kination-modified history or its evaporating-PBH early-matter variants.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public induced-GW code such as SIGWfast with kination-era Green's-function kernels and the model's expansion history, then recast against LISA/PTA/ET sensitivity curves alongside the PBHbounds constraint compilation.

members.model_name: Sgoldstino-stabilized canonical Kahler non-oscillatory PBH dark matter model
members.description: Scalar-induced gravitational-wave estimators assume radiation domination; the kination era changes the induced-GW kernel and spectrum amplitudes/frequencies, and no tool computes Omega_GW for this model's kination-modified history or its evaporating-PBH early-matter variants.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public induced-GW code such as SIGWfast with kination-era Green's-function kernels and the model's expansion history, then recast against LISA/PTA/ET sensitivity curves alongside the PBHbounds constraint compilation.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from transient constant-roll inflation
members.description: No public pipeline maps the transient constant-roll curvature power spectrum plus its squeezed bispectrum to a PBH mass function beta(M) and a scalar-induced Omega_GW(f): existing abundance calculators assume Gaussian or simple fNL statistics, while PBH abundance is exponentially sensitive to the model's non-Gaussian tail.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the paper's analytic P_R(k) and bispectrum to a non-Gaussian PBH abundance calculation (compaction-function/threshold statistics with the constant-roll tail, extending an open abundance code) and to a public induced-GW integrator such as SIGWfast, parameterized by (eta, phase duration, transition times, H_inf) with explicit collapse-threshold and reheating settings.

members.model_name: Planet 9 axion-star dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public Solar-System capture code exists for macroscopic axion stars: the capture probability of a 5-15 Earth-mass axion star into a 300-1000 AU Planet 9 orbit is currently an order-of-magnitude analytic estimate depending on the poorly known low-relative-velocity tail of the axion-star phase-space distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a three-body capture Monte Carlo (Sun-Neptune or Sun-passing-star perturber) sampling axion-star masses and a Galactic-halo velocity distribution, validated against existing free-floating-planet and PBH capture-rate calculations, and output capture probability as a function of M_AS, Omega_AS/Omega_DM, and velocity-dispersion parameters.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No binary-population code exists that computes PBH binary formation, hardening, disruption, and merger rates inside the evolving clustered environment; the card notes binary disruption is only modeled analytically, so the cluster-modified merger rate cannot be forward-modeled to LIGO/Virgo.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a PBH binary population-synthesis module that takes the simulated (or analytic) cluster population as input, evolves early- and late-Universe binary channels with three-body perturbations and cluster encounters, and outputs a merger-rate density R_PBH(z; M_PBH, f_PBH).

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment dark matter in a PBH-dominated epoch
members.description: No public integrated solver evolves the coupled Friedmann-Boltzmann system of a spinning, evaporating PBH population (monochromatic M_in, beta, a_star) together with the temperature-dependent QCD axion misalignment field, so the entropy-diluted Omega_a h^2 and the PBH-emitted axion Delta N_eff cannot be recomputed outside the paper's private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine BlackHawk greybody/spin emission spectra with a Friedmann-Boltzmann PBH-domination solver (FRISBHEE-style) and add a module tracking m_a(T) axion oscillation onset and entropy dilution, outputting Omega_a h^2(m_a, f_a, theta_i, M_in, beta, a_star) and Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Axion-curvaton primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented PBH mass-function calculator is bundled that maps the model's P_R(k) to an extended PBH mass spectrum including critical-collapse scaling and window-function variants; the card flags these choices as order-one systematics that shift the mass peak and the PTA mass reach.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Press-Schechter/peaks PBH abundance module taking P_R(k), collapse threshold delta_c, and window-function choice as inputs, with critical-collapse scaling M = K M_H (delta - delta_c)^gamma included as a switchable option, and quantify the window/critical-collapse systematic band.

members.model_name: Double-inflation parametric-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented PBH mass-function calculator is bundled that maps the model's P_R(k) to an extended PBH mass spectrum including critical-collapse scaling and window-function variants; the card flags these choices as order-one systematics that shift the mass peak and the PTA mass reach.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Press-Schechter/peaks PBH abundance module taking P_R(k), collapse threshold delta_c, and window-function choice as inputs, with critical-collapse scaling M = K M_H (delta - delta_c)^gamma included as a switchable option, and quantify the window/critical-collapse systematic band.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from slow reheating
members.description: No pipeline applies the compiled monochromatic PBH constraints (microlensing, evaporation, dynamical, CMB, gravitational-wave) to the slow-reheating extended mass function with its delta_c-dependent M_min/M_max cutoffs; the card's key constraint entry is marked recasting_needed: yes and the primary paper explicitly leaves the observational abundance evaluation undone.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the slow-reheating d f_PBH/dM in an extended-mass-function recast (Carr et al. procedure) on top of a maintained monochromatic bounds compilation such as PBHbounds, parameterized by (T_reh, sigma(M), delta_c), and output allowed f_PBH as a function of reheating parameters.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from slow reheating
members.description: No merger-rate model exists for PBHs formed during slow reheating: converting the extended mass function and f_PBH into a LIGO/Virgo merger-rate prediction requires binary-formation and clustering modeling that must account for the enhanced small-scale clustering of matter-era-formed PBHs, which standard radiation-era merger-rate formulae do not cover.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend published analytic PBH binary formation rates (Ali-Haimoud/Raidal-type calculations) to extended mass functions with initial clustering statistics appropriate to matter-dominated formation, and compare the resulting rate against the LIGO/Virgo compact-binary population.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with primordial black-hole early matter domination
members.description: No validated public release of the coupled PBH-radiation-axion solver (background evolution with evaporation and entropy injection plus the axion equation of motion with QCD temperature-dependent mass) is confirmed; the AXIONPBH material referenced by the paper was not fetched or validated, so the abundance route cannot be run independently.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain and validate the AXIONPBH code against the paper's density plots, or extend FRISBHEE's PBH-evaporation background module with an axion misalignment sector using the standard dilute-instanton m_a(T), and release it publicly.

members.model_name: Galileon ultra-slow-roll primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public code maps Covariantized Galileon coefficients c_i, sound speed c_s, and USR transition location to the enhanced curvature power spectrum P_zeta(k); standard Boltzmann/inflation pipelines (CLASS/CAMB, generic slow-roll solvers) do not implement Galileon SR/USR/SR mode evolution.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a numerical Mukhanov-Sasaki-type mode solver for the Galileon EFT (effective c_s(tau) and z(tau) from the c_i) that reproduces the paper's sharp-transition benchmarks and outputs P_zeta(k) on the scales relevant for PTA and PBH formation.

members.model_name: QCD axion domain-wall primordial-black-hole subcomponent model
members.description: No public code computes the number density and size/shape statistics of self-enclosed N_DW=1 axion domain walls from post-inflationary string-wall network evolution (including the early-matter-domination option and the string density parameter whose uncertainty exponentially suppresses the PBH abundance), so the closed-wall abundance step cannot be run outside the authors' in-house calculation.
