members.proposed_resolution: Package a wall-counting module that takes percolation statistics from existing lattice string-wall network simulations (e.g. field-theoretic axion-string simulation outputs) and outputs the closed-wall size distribution as a function of f_a, N_DW, and the expansion history, calibrated against the primary paper's f_PBH(f_a) bands.

members.model_name: Cosmological strangelet macro dark matter
members.description: No tool exists to recast monochromatic macro-DM limits onto the extended post-evaporation strangelet mass function dn/dM, i.e. to integrate flux, energy-deposition, and lensing optical-depth constraints over an arbitrary mass distribution and return the allowed distribution weight.
members.proposed_resolution: Write an extended-mass-function constraint integrator that convolves the surviving dn/dM with each digitized constraint's response (flux-limited, energy-threshold, or lensing optical depth), following the standard extended-mass-function recast formalism used for PBH constraints, and validate against the paper's monochromatic mass windows.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from running-inflaton perturbations in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No implemented forward-model pipeline exists that maps the running-inflaton curvature spectrum (A, n, dn/dlnk) plus the early-matter-domination history (T_reh, M_min, M_max) to a PBH mass function f(M); the matter-era collapse probability beta ~ 0.056 sigma^5 with the optional sigma^(3/2) inhomogeneity suppression is only an analytic estimate in the paper, and the card's single recovery route contains no computational step for it.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a numerical PBH-abundance module that integrates the primordial spectrum with running over the EMD horizon-crossing window, applies the matter-dominated collapse probability including the angular-momentum/inhomogeneity suppression factors, and outputs f(M) with the M_min/M_max cutoffs; this could be built as an extension of existing PBH abundance codes that currently assume radiation-era formation thresholds.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from blue spectator-field perturbations in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No implemented forward-model pipeline exists that maps the blue spectator-field curvature spectrum (A_s, n_s, alpha_s) plus the early-matter-domination history (T_reh, M_min, M_max) to a PBH mass function f(M); the matter-era collapse probability beta ~ 0.056 sigma^5 with the optional sigma^(3/2) inhomogeneity suppression is only an analytic estimate in the paper, and the card's single recovery route contains no computational step for it.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a numerical PBH-abundance module that integrates the blue spectator spectrum over the EMD horizon-crossing window, applies the matter-dominated collapse probability including the angular-momentum/inhomogeneity suppression factors, and outputs f(M) with the M_min/M_max cutoffs; this could be built as an extension of existing PBH abundance codes that currently assume radiation-era formation thresholds.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle misalignment dark matter in a PBH-dominated epoch
members.description: No public code couples an evaporating-PBH cosmology (monochromatic mass, spin-dependent greybody Hawking emission, entropy injection) to the ALP misalignment field evolution, so the diluted Omega_a h^2 and the PBH-emitted relativistic-ALP Delta N_eff cannot be reproduced outside the authors' private Boltzmann implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public PBH-cosmology solver (FRISBHEE, or BlackHawk-supplied emission spectra fed into a Friedmann-Boltzmann integrator) with the coherent ALP field equation and oscillation-onset tracking in the PBH-dominated background, parameterized by (m_a, f_a, theta_i, M_in, beta, a_star), and validate against the paper's benchmark abundance and Delta N_eff curves.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from radiative-symmetry-breaking first-order phase transitions
members.description: No public code computes the late-blooming PBH dark-matter fraction from supercooled RSB transition parameters: the mapping from (alpha, beta/H_n, percolation history, phi_0) to f_PBH exists only as semi-analytic literature formulas applied by hand in the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the late-blooming collapse formalism (patch nucleation statistics, vacuum-domination duration, overdensity growth, and collapse criterion) as a reusable calculator taking (g, g_tilde, lambda, phi_0, g_star) inputs, validated against the paper's mapped 1e-10 < f_PBH <= 1 regions, and couple it to a public PBH mass-window constraint compilation for the exclusion overlay.

members.model_name: PBH dark-matter subcomponent from running-index inflation in radiation domination
members.description: No public pipeline maps running-index parameters (alpha_s, beta_s) through radiation-era collapse to a PBH mass function and binary-merger rate in the 4-40 solar-mass integration window used by the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the curvature-spectrum-to-mass-function calculation (Press-Schechter with delta_c = 0.42) coupled to a standard early-universe binary-formation rate prescription, validated against the paper's beta_s = 0.023-0.026 benchmark strip.

members.model_name: Planck-mass black-hole remnant dark matter from evaporation
members.description: No PBH evaporation calculator is attached: the companion Delta N_eff prediction of 0.03-0.2 per light species depends on greybody factors and the PBH spin distribution built up during the black-hole-dominated era, and the route also cannot handle mass functions broader than monochromatic without numerical integration of the evaporation history (both flagged in the card's caveats and required_code_resources).
members.proposed_resolution: Integrate a spin-aware greybody evaporation code for the PBH-radiation-remnant system that outputs T_RH, the hidden-species energy density (hence Delta N_eff per species), and the remnant number density for arbitrary initial mass functions, validated against the card's monochromatic limiting formulas in both domination regimes.

members.model_name: Modulated p=4 hilltop inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No public inflationary perturbation-spectrum solver implements the modulated p=4 hilltop potential, so the numerical P_R(k) on CMB-to-PBH scales (beyond the slow-roll n_s expansion) cannot be reproduced or scanned; the paper's own numerical solution is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement V(phi) = hilltop p=4 plus periodic modulation in a public mode-equation solver (MultiModeCode or PyTransport, or as an external primordial-spectrum module for CLASS), parameterized by (Lambda^4, modulation period f, modulation amplitude), and validate against the paper's n_s(k_PBH)=4.91 and beta_s bounds.

members.model_name: Double-inflation red-tilted primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented PBH mass-function calculator is bundled that maps the model's P_R(k) to an extended PBH mass spectrum including critical-collapse scaling and window-function variants; the card flags these choices as order-one systematics that shift the mass peak and the PTA mass reach.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Press-Schechter/peaks PBH abundance module taking P_R(k), collapse threshold delta_c, and window-function choice as inputs, with critical-collapse scaling M = K M_H (delta - delta_c)^gamma included as a switchable option, and quantify the window/critical-collapse systematic band.

members.model_name: Running-mass inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implemented PBH mass-function calculator is bundled that maps the model's P_R(k) to an extended PBH mass spectrum including critical-collapse scaling and window-function variants; the card flags these choices as order-one systematics that shift the mass peak and the PTA mass reach.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a Press-Schechter/peaks PBH abundance module taking P_R(k), collapse threshold delta_c, and window-function choice as inputs, with critical-collapse scaling M = K M_H (delta - delta_c)^gamma included as a switchable option, and quantify the window/critical-collapse systematic band.

members.model_name: Dark-fermion-production relaxion warm dark matter
members.description: The dark fermion's post-dilution phase-space distribution f(p) is not derived: the card records only an approximate thermal form, so the transfer-function cutoff rests on a thermal-equivalent m_WDM mapping the paper itself flags as approximate, and no model-specific transfer function exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) for a fermion decoupling relativistically at T_d with g_star(T_d) and subsequent entropy dilution by factor S (a rescaled Fermi-Dirac spectrum with shifted temperature), feed it to CLASS as a non-cold-DM species, and tabulate the resulting transfer function and half-mode scale over (m_psi, T_d, S).

members.model_name: Twin sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The model-specific visible branching fraction Br(N_B -> SM photons + ...) as a function of the inter-sector mixing M_AB has not been computed, so the suppressed X-ray/gamma-ray line flux cannot be quantitatively recast against NuSTAR-style line limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-induced N_B -> nu gamma (SM) radiative decay rate through the M_AB sterile-mixing portal in the seesaw limit, tabulate the visible branching over (M_NB, M_AB, mixing angles), and insert it into the standard sterile-neutrino line-flux formula against published line-search limit tables.

members.model_name: Late Sommerfeld-enhanced dark-matter conversion to dark radiation
members.description: The perturbation treatment is only a generic parameterization: the card notes perturbations are model dependent beyond the background, and the conversion source term has not been derived from the actual Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation rate of the Dirac-fermion/light-vector model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the conversion rate Gamma(z) and its perturbation from the velocity-averaged Sommerfeld-enhanced cross section of the specific model, mapping (m_chi, m_med, alpha, T_kd) onto the phenomenological (zeta, a_t) parameters, and encode the mapping in the Boltzmann implementation.

members.model_name: FIMP Dirac singlet dark matter in extended neutrino 2HDM
members.description: The FIMP phase-space distribution from N1 decays is only approximate on the card, and no linear transfer function has been computed for this decay-produced keV fermion, so the warm/hot classification cannot be turned into a quantitative small-scale power suppression.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-thermal f(q) from the N1 decay kinematics as a function of K1 and Br_chi, feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold (ncdm) species with a tabulated distribution, and compute the transfer-function cutoff across the paper's parameter scan.

members.model_name: Z3 sterile-neutrino portal scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: Photon spectra for the secluded NN and semi-annihilation N+fermion and h+scalar final states are approximated by W+W--like proxies in the paper; no dedicated gamma-ray spectra for the sterile-neutrino cascade decays in this model have been computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the N decay chains (conservative electron-flavor choice) and shower the NN, N, and h channels with Pythia or HDMSpectra to produce per-channel dN_gamma/dE tables, replacing the W+W- proxy in the H.E.S.S./CTA comparison.

members.model_name: Decaying warm majoron dark matter
members.description: The radiative branching ratio Br(J -> photons) is left uncomputed by the paper, so the predicted far-ultraviolet photon line from subdominant radiative decay cannot be quantified or compared to diffuse-background data.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the loop-induced J -> gamma gamma rate from the seesaw model's charged-fermion couplings for the quoted keV mass window and publish it as an analytic branching-ratio formula usable in decaying-DM photon-flux estimates.

members.model_name: Fuzzy dark matter from infrared confining dynamics
members.description: The theta-sector thermal history is assumed rather than computed: no Boltzmann treatment exists of theta-hadron annihilation/decay into the light fermions n, of the evolution of T'/T through the dark confinement transition, or of the resulting time-dependent Delta N_eff, all of which the card flags as high-extrapolation-risk assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the coupled Boltzmann/entropy-transfer equations for the SU(3)_theta sector (hadron annihilation to n n, hidden g*'(T') across confinement), for example by extending a dark-sector thermal-history code in the style of hidden-sector Delta N_eff trackers, to replace the benchmark T'/T = 1/4 assumption with a computed history.

members.model_name: Z3 sterile-neutrino portal fermion WIMP dark matter
members.description: Photon spectra for the secluded NN and semi-annihilation N+scalar final states are approximated by W+W- proxies in the paper; no dedicated gamma-ray spectrum for cascade decays of electroweak-scale sterile neutrinos in this model has been computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the N decay chains (conservative electron-flavor choice) and shower them with Pythia or HDMSpectra to produce per-channel dN_gamma/dE tables, replacing the W+W- proxy in the H.E.S.S./CTA comparison.

members.model_name: Fourth-family Dirac-neutrino Z' WIMP
members.description: The loop/RG-induced effective couplings of the fermiophobic Z' to light quarks, and the corresponding nucleon-level matrix elements needed to compute sigma_SI for xenon targets, have not been derived for this model (the card explicitly flags them as needed for recasting).
members.proposed_resolution: Run the Z' couplings from the matching scale to the nuclear scale with an EFT running/matching package (e.g. DirectDM plus wilson) to obtain nucleon-level Wilson coefficients, then feed them to a rate calculator such as DDCalc.

members.model_name: Sub-GeV inelastic dark photon thermal relic
members.description: The Galactic regeneration of the excited state — the halo-integrated chi_1 chi_1 -> chi_2 chi_2 upscattering rate and steady-state chi_2 population given the Milky Way velocity distribution and chi_2 lifetime — has only an approximate treatment, and the resulting MeV gamma-ray flux normalization is correspondingly uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and implement a halo-model calculation of the local chi_2 fraction: integrate the velocity-dependent upscattering cross section over an NFW-plus-velocity-distribution Milky Way model with chi_2 decay/downscattering losses, and validate the paper's approximate re-equilibration regime; release as a small flux code feeding J-factor-weighted spectra.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition fermion dark matter
members.description: No gauge-invariant derivation exists for fermion particle production from runaway bubble collisions; the primary paper removes unphysical gauge-dependent contributions with an ad hoc prescription and explicitly states a rigorous resolution is lacking, so the predicted psi_f yield carries uncontrolled theory systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the bubble-collision production rate for a Yukawa-coupled fermion in a manifestly gauge-invariant framework (e.g. a real-time lattice or Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin treatment of the colliding field configurations in R_xi gauge with explicit cancellation checks), and quantify the shift relative to the paper's prescription across the wall-gamma and m_chi range.

members.model_name: Pseudo-sakharon long-lived dark matter
members.description: Hadronic decay spectra and branching fractions for S -> d dbar at m_S ~ 20 GeV have not been computed (explicit card caveat), so the photon, e+/e-, and neutrino injection spectra needed for CMB and indirect-detection limits do not exist for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate S -> d dbar fragmentation spectra with Pythia (or take the d dbar channel tables from PPPC4DMID) at the benchmark m_S = 20 GeV and across the weak-scale mass range, producing dN/dE for gamma, e+-, p-bar, and nu final states.

members.model_name: Dirac scotogenic freeze-in dark matter with gauged U(1) B-L
members.description: The FIMP phase-space distribution f(p) from off-shell B-L Z'-mediated gauge-scattering freeze-in under the low-reheating hierarchy (T_RH ~ 4 MeV - 5 GeV) has not been derived or implemented; the card records distribution_function_available: no, so warmness is judged only through a thermal-WDM proxy.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f(p,T) with the SM-fermion annihilation collision term through the effective Z' operator and a T_RH cutoff (following existing FIMP distribution-function frameworks), then feed the tabulated f(p) into CLASS's ncdm sector to obtain the model's transfer function and thermal-equivalent WDM mass.

members.model_name: Inflaxion axion dark matter
members.description: The phi_DM decay rates inherited from the reheaton couplings (to photons, hidden photons, or fermions in L_c) have not been derived per coupling choice as reusable formulas, so the joint reheating-temperature versus dark-matter-lifetime window cannot be evaluated outside the paper's example figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mixing-suppressed decay widths of the light eigenstate for each candidate coupling operator in L_c (a F F-dual, fermion couplings) as functions of (beta, m_a, m_phi, f), and package them with the corresponding T_reh estimate as a small calculator module for parameter scans.

members.model_name: Two-component scalar FIMP with charged-fermion mediator
members.description: The differential photon spectrum dN/dE for the loop-induced three-body decay phi_2 -> phi_1 gamma gamma through the charged fermion mediator has not been derived in reusable form; only the total width and a monochromatic-line approximation are available, while the card notes the two-photon final state broadens the feature.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the full one-loop three-body matrix element for phi_2 -> phi_1 gamma gamma (e.g. with FeynCalc/Package-X) and publish the resulting normalized dN/dE as a function of m1, m2, and m_psi for direct use in gamma-ray recasts.

members.model_name: Phi_16 dark-thermal-bath degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: No tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) exists for Q_{B-L}=8 fermions produced by decay of the nonrelativistic phi_16 dark thermal bath; the paper provides only characteristic momenta and a free-streaming-length estimate, which is insufficient for a Boltzmann-solver transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(p) for a thermal-bath mother scalar decaying after becoming nonrelativistic (thermal parent spectrum convolved with two-body decay kinematics and redshifting), tabulate it, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm sector (psd_file) to compute T(k) and refine Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Coherent-oscillation phi_16 degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: No tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) exists for the Q_{B-L}=8 fermions produced by decay of the coherently oscillating phi_16 condensate; the paper provides only characteristic momenta and a free-streaming-length estimate, which is insufficient for a Boltzmann-solver transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(p) for the condensate-decay history (monochromatic injection redshifted through the oscillation and decay epochs), tabulate it, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm sector (psd_file) to compute T(k) and refine Delta N_eff, following existing scalar-decay WDM distribution derivations.

members.model_name: Free phi_16 decay degenerate fermion dark matter from broken U(1)_{B-L}
members.description: No tabulated phase-space distribution f(p) exists for Q_{B-L}=8 fermions produced by decay of free, never-thermalized nonrelativistic phi_16 particles from inflaton decay; the paper provides only characteristic momenta and a free-streaming-length estimate, which is insufficient for a Boltzmann-solver transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced f(p) for the free-decay history (inflaton-decay phi_16 spectrum redshifted to nonrelativistic momenta, convolved with two-body decay kinematics), tabulate it, and feed it to the CLASS ncdm sector (psd_file) to compute T(k) and refine Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Hidden-fermion-assisted gravitino dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal momentum distribution of gravitinos from late stau or hidden-fermion X decays is not available (distribution_function_available is no), so the warm fraction f_WDM and free-streaming scale lambda_FS cannot be propagated to a linear transfer function.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced gravitino phase-space distribution f(q) from two-body decay kinematics redshifted from the decay epoch, and feed it to CLASS or CAMB as a tabulated non-cold dark matter species to compute mixed cold/warm transfer functions.

members.model_name: Leptonic fermion dark matter with scalar dilepton mediator
members.description: The one-loop effective Higgs portal coupling lambda_eff of the fermion dark matter (generated by f_L, f_R and the scalar dilepton loop) is only qualitatively estimated as 'very small'; no explicit loop calculation exists to turn the loop-suppressed direct-detection prediction into a quantitative nuclear recoil rate.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop chi-chi-Higgs matching (loop of zeta and neutrinos with couplings f_L, f_R, lambda_02) analytically or with an automated loop tool, then feed sigma_SI into a standard direct-detection recast such as DDCalc against current xenon limits.

members.model_name: Millicharged excited-state scalar field dark matter halo
members.description: The relativistic Lorentz-factor distribution of the scattering SFDM component is not derived from the model; the flux calculation assumes an ad hoc power law with free normalization K and index p, which controls the predicted gamma-ray spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the boosted-component distribution from a specified production or acceleration mechanism within the SFDM halo (e.g. from excited-state transition dynamics or a specified early-universe production history), replacing the (K, p) power-law ansatz with model-determined parameters.

members.model_name: Z3 semi-annihilating inert scalar multiplet model
members.description: Sommerfeld corrections from electroweak gauge-boson exchange, which the card lists as shaping both freeze-out and present-day rates for heavy large multiplets, are not provided by micrOMEGAs-class solvers and have not been computed for this two-multiplet Z3 spectrum with its coannihilating charged states.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute coupled-channel electroweak Sommerfeld factors (Hisano-type) for the phi1/phi2 multiplet spectrum including mass splittings, and patch them into the thermally averaged annihilation, semi-annihilation, and coannihilation rates of the Boltzmann solver and into present-day sigma_v for the gamma-ray recast.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay two-dark-particle dark matter
members.description: The neutron-star mass constraint cannot be evaluated: no dark-sector equation of state has been derived for this two-particle (fermion plus repulsive/self-interacting scalar) sector, and no two-fluid TOV computation exists to map it to a maximum neutron-star mass M_max.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the zero-temperature EOS of the chi-phi sector as a function of lambda and the mass splitting, then integrate it in a two-fluid TOV solver coupled to a standard nuclear EOS with neutron-to-dark conversion in beta equilibrium, and compare M_max against observed ~2 M_sun pulsars.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal dark matter with neutrino-mediated self-interactions
members.description: The Delta N_eff lower mass floor (~9 MeV) rests on an estimate; the full neutrino-decoupling calculation including MeV-scale dark states thermally coupled to neutrinos has not been done, which limits the precision of the CMB-S4 reach statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a neutrino-decoupling code (e.g. FortEPiaNO or NUDEC_B.C.) with the dark fermion/scalar pair coupled to the chosen neutrino flavor, recompute N_eff(m_DM, m_partner), and interface the result with Planck and CMB-S4 forecast likelihoods.

members.model_name: Two-singlet Peccei-Quinn kinetic Nambu-Goldstone ultralight dark matter
members.description: The normalization of the long-range spin-dependent force is not derived: the induced NG-mode coupling to Standard Model fermions (through the phi_a^2 H_u H_d portal and phi_d-phi_a mixing) has no quantitative expression, so the predicted force cannot be mapped onto laboratory spin-force exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective NG-fermion coupling and force range as functions of f_a and the angular-momentum constants, then recast onto existing monopole-dipole and dipole-dipole force-search compilations (torsion-balance, comagnetometer, and ARIADNE-class limits).

members.model_name: Regurgitated fermion dark matter
members.description: The dark scalar finite-temperature potential is left agnostic, so the FOPT parameters (T_*, beta/H_*, transition strength) that feed Fermiball formation and the gravitational-wave prediction cannot be computed for any concrete benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify one or more benchmark renormalizable finite-temperature potentials for phi, compute the bounce action and transition parameters with CosmoTransitions, and tabulate (T_*, beta/H_*, alpha) over the dark-sector coupling space.

members.model_name: Regurgitated fermion dark matter
members.description: The loop-level effective DM-nucleon interaction for the fermion RDM candidate (dark Yukawa y_phi plus Higgs portal lambda_phi) has not been matched onto nucleon operators, so no sigma_N prediction exists to recast against direct-detection limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform the one-loop matching of the psi-phi-Higgs-portal system onto the spin-independent nucleon effective operator (standard Higgs-exchange loop calculation), and express sigma_N as a function of (y_phi, lambda, m_DM, m_phi) for the recast step.

members.model_name: Regurgitated scalar dark matter
members.description: The dark scalar finite-temperature potential is left agnostic, so the FOPT parameters (T_*, beta/H_*, transition strength) that feed Fermiball formation and the gravitational-wave prediction cannot be computed for any concrete benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify one or more benchmark renormalizable finite-temperature potentials for phi, compute the bounce action and transition parameters with CosmoTransitions, and tabulate (T_*, beta/H_*, alpha) over the dark-sector coupling space.

members.model_name: Y=0 inert-triplet radiative neutrino model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: The loop-level spin-independent direct-detection cross section for the N_R-dominant fermionic DM is not derived anywhere in the card or source (the paper only argues tree-level Z-portal avoidance qualitatively), so the direct-detection constraint con_fdm_zportal_direct_detection_condition cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop effective DM-quark operators (photon/Z/Higgs penguins and box diagrams with charged scalars and leptons) following standard leptophilic-DM loop calculations, then recast against current SI/SD limits with DDCalc for the relic-compatible scan points.

members.model_name: Littlest Seesaw right-handed-neutrino-portal FIMPzilla dark matter
members.description: The gravitational production contribution for the superheavy (~1e10 GeV) dark fermion at large T_RH is omitted, and the card flags high extrapolation risk: the RHN-portal yield alone may not be the full relic abundance near the maximal reheating temperature.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the gravitational particle-production yield for the dark Dirac fermion using standard superheavy-DM gravitational production formalisms as a function of T_RH and m_chi, and add it as a floor contribution in the Boltzmann integration.

members.model_name: Inflaton-coupled ultralight vector dark matter
members.description: The time evolution of the couplings g''(t) and g'''(t) after reheating, and the resulting depletion of Y_mu through decays to fermion pairs, are stated by the source to be required for the correct abundance but have never been derived.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the running/effective evolution of g'' and g''' as the inflaton bath dilutes, compute the Y_mu -> f fbar depletion rate against the Hubble rate, and fold the surviving abundance into the preheating calculation of gap_1.

members.model_name: Dark-baryon self-destructing dark matter
members.description: The baryon-number-violating transition cross section for converting the stable dark baryon into the unstable dark meson on nuclei is not derived from the composite dark-sector dynamics; the dimension-six operator's coefficient and the bound-state matrix elements are unspecified, leaving the overall event-rate normalization undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive sigma_transition from the scalar-mediated bound-state wavefunctions: compute the overlap matrix element between dark-baryon and dark-meson states for the dimension-six dark-fermion-neutron operator, expressing the result as a function of binding energy, constituent masses, and the operator scale, and publish it as a parameterized rate module for the Earth-transition step.

members.model_name: Familon-like WISPy pseudo-Goldstone dark matter
members.description: The thermal-population avoidance constraint has no quantitative implementation: the freeze-in/thermalization production rate of relativistic pseudo-Goldstones from fermion-current couplings as a function of f_X and reheating temperature is not derived or coded, so the hot-component bound cannot be checked (likelihood_available: unknown, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermal production rate from derivative fermion-current couplings (standard freeze-in collision integrals), compute the resulting hot fraction and Delta N_eff versus (f_X, T_R), and encode the exclusion where the thermal component violates hot dark matter or dark radiation bounds.

members.model_name: Electromagnetically interacting Elko dark matter
members.description: The Elko-nucleon electromagnetic scattering amplitude induced by the tensor photon coupling has not been derived, so no direct-detection cross section or gamma-ray annihilation spectrum can be computed and the direct/indirect recast target cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-relativistic EFT matching of the Elko tensor photon operator onto nucleon-level operators (analogous to magnetic-dipole/anapole dark matter treatments), map to the standard NREFT basis used by XENON/LUX likelihood tools, and compute the gamma-ray annihilation spectrum for comparison with Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods.

members.model_name: Dilaton forbidden dark matter
members.description: No derivation or recast pipeline exists for the dilaton-SM contact-operator phenomenology: for any chosen operator basis O_SM and scale M_*, the collider production, nuclear-scattering, and annihilation-product rates, and the dilaton thermal-equilibrium/decay condition that the relic calculation assumes, have not been computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Fix a minimal set of SM-singlet contact operators (e.g. Higgs-portal-like and gauge-boson operators), derive the dilaton production/decay and DM scattering rates for each, verify the dilaton-SM equilibration condition during freeze-out, and recast against existing collider and direct/indirect-detection limits with standard tools (MadGraph for collider, DDCalc-class for direct detection).

members.model_name: Decaying dark matter to Lorentz-violating fermions
members.description: The linear perturbation theory of the Lorentz-violating daughter fermion gas (effective sound speed, anisotropic stress, and clustering behavior of a component whose w(k,z) depends on the k/b momentum scale) has never been derived, so the growth-and-smoothing constraint cannot be formulated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the perturbed Boltzmann hierarchy for a fermion with dispersion omega(k) modified by the condensate scale b, including the decay source term from the parent, and reduce it to effective fluid equations (c_s^2, sigma) usable in a Boltzmann code.

members.model_name: Fermionic FIMP dark matter through a moduli portal
members.description: The card states the fermionic FIMP has a nonthermal momentum distribution but no distribution function is supplied (distribution_function_available: no) and no thermal-WDM mapping or transfer-function estimate exists, so whether the model behaves like CDM on small scales cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f_X(p, T) of moduli-portal freeze-in through reheating (following existing freeze-in phase-space calculations), derive the free-streaming length and an equivalent thermal-WDM mass, and feed the resulting transfer function to CLASS/CAMB for small-scale structure constraints.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Dirac asymmetric dark matter
members.description: The symmetric-component annihilation cross section has never been computed: the card records that the asymmetric relic interpretation requires efficient annihilation (e.g. into Z_B h_B) but that no cross section was calculated, so it is unverified whether the symmetric Dirac component actually annihilates below the asymmetric floor anywhere in the (M_DM, g_B, v_B) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_B x U(1)_L model in FeynRules and compute the symmetric-component freeze-out (Z_B h_B, Z_B Z_B, and fermionic channels) with a standard relic code such as micrOMEGAs or MadDM, mapping where the residual symmetric abundance is subdominant to the asymmetry.

members.model_name: Planck-suppressed Higgs-coupled oscillating scalar dark matter
members.description: No quantitative laboratory signal prediction is derived for the ultralight (1e-6 to 1e-4 eV) Higgs-coupled scalar: the paper only states nuclear recoil is hopeless at g ~ 1e-16, and the appropriate coherent-field signatures (Higgs-portal-induced oscillations of fermion masses, fifth-force/equivalence-principle effects) are left uncomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the scalar-Higgs mixing-induced couplings to electrons and nucleons from the dimension-6 operator and compare the predicted oscillating-constant and Yukawa-force signals to atomic-clock, MICROSCOPE/Eot-Wash, and haloscope-style ultralight-scalar limits at the relevant masses.

members.model_name: Randall-Sundrum bulk-scalar oscillating dark matter
members.description: No quantitative laboratory signal prediction is derived for the ultralight warp-suppressed zero mode: the paper only states nuclear recoil is hopeless at g ~ 1e-16, and coherent-field signatures (Higgs-portal-induced oscillations of fermion masses, fifth-force/equivalence-principle effects) are left uncomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the zero-mode couplings to electrons and nucleons from the brane-localized phi^2 h^2 interaction after electroweak breaking and compare the predicted oscillating-constant and Yukawa-force signals to atomic-clock, MICROSCOPE/Eot-Wash, and other ultralight-scalar limits at 1e-6 to 1e-4 eV.

members.model_name: Phase-transition depopulated fermionic dark matter
members.description: The loop-level spin-independent N-nucleon scattering cross section for this leptophilic Majorana-fermion plus Z2-odd scalar-doublet model has not been derived or implemented, so direct-detection null results (LUX, PandaX-II, XENON1T) cannot be recast onto (Y, M_N, M_eta).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop photon-penguin and Z/Higgs-penguin induced effective N-quark operators for the N-L-eta Yukawa structure (following existing loop-level singlet-fermion calculations), implement the resulting sigma_SI in a DDCalc-style recast against XENON1T, and scan the benchmark region sum|Y_a|^2 ~ 1e-7.

members.model_name: Out-of-equilibrium U(1)_X hidden-sector dark-fermion model
members.description: The model-specific linear transfer function has never been derived: the dark-fermion-pseudoscalar/scalar momentum-transfer rate has not been mapped onto an ETHOS-type dark-matter-dark-radiation parameterization, so no P(k) exists for the late-kinetic-decoupling regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the angular-averaged momentum-transfer cross section for D scattering off the massless pseudoscalar bath, map it to ETHOS (a_n, alpha_l) coefficients including the T_h/T temperature ratio, and compute transfer functions in an ETHOS-modified CLASS.

members.model_name: Dark-FOPT Fermi-ball-collapse primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: The map from dark-FOPT potential parameters to the PBH mass function and abundance (fermion filtering into false-vacuum pockets, Fermi-ball formation, and the microphysics-dependent cooling/collapse criterion) exists only as the paper's phenomenological treatment, with no public implementation and an uncertain cooling criterion.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the filtering/Fermi-ball/collapse chain as a module taking CosmoTransitions-style outputs (T_*, alpha, beta/H_*, bubble radius distribution) plus the dark-fermion asymmetry and Yukawa, including the cooling criterion, so mass-function parameters are derived rather than free inputs; validate against the paper's benchmark mass functions.

members.model_name: High-scale darkogenesis with leptodark messenger sphaleron transfer
members.description: The Delta N_eff contribution of the massless z fermions is not computed; BBN safety is asserted only under a qualitative cooler-hidden-sector assumption with no hidden-to-visible temperature-ratio evolution.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hidden-sector temperature ratio xi(T) from separate comoving entropy conservation after decoupling before the QCD transition, compute Delta N_eff at BBN and recombination, and compare with Planck/BBN Delta N_eff bounds.

members.model_name: Dark-sector vacuum-scalarized non-topological soliton stars
members.description: No quantitative formation calculation exists: solitosynthesis/solitogenesis abundance and the resulting soliton-star mass function are not derived, so f_DM and the mass spectrum feeding the microlensing population step cannot be predicted from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the soliton mass function and relic fraction by extending Fermi-ball/solitosynthesis formation calculations (charge-fluctuation statistics plus phase-transition history) to this Yukawa-coupled scalar-fermion sector, with accretion evolution to the stable branch.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian Goldstone absorption dark matter
members.description: No quantitative production/abundance model exists for the Goldstone relic: the card gives no distribution function and only the qualitative statement that thermalization overcloses, so the thermal-production bound in (m_pi, Lambda, T_R) space needed to define the viable target region cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the freeze-in production rate of the Goldstone multiplet from SM fermions as a function of Lambda and T_R (a standard collision-integral calculation), yielding the overclosure/thermalization boundary and the relic momentum distribution as closed-form or tabulated results.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) inflaton-scalar dark matter unification
members.description: The proton-lifetime prediction of about 5e35 years is quoted without the model-specific GUT threshold corrections, RG running with the vector-like fermion spectrum, or decay branching ratios needed for a testable prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive tau_p for this flipped SU(5) x U(1)_X spectrum with two-loop gauge running including the vector-like fermions, threshold matching at M_GUT, and lattice nucleon matrix elements, producing channel-by-channel lifetimes comparable to Super-K/Hyper-K limits.

members.model_name: Angular-momentum-stabilized self-destructing dark positronium
members.description: The nuclear-scattering cross section for angular-momentum-changing transitions of the high-l dark positronium-like state (high-l to low-l de-excitation via the kinetically mixed vector) is not derived beyond proof-of-principle, so the Earth transition probability that sets all event rates cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the inelastic bound-state form factors for l-changing transitions (dark-atom matrix elements between n,l states under nuclear Coulomb-like scattering through the kinetically mixed mediator) and implement them in a small Earth-transit code that convolves the halo DM flux with the PREM Earth density profile to output transition probability versus arrival direction.

members.model_name: Z2 Fraternal Twin Higgs right-handed twin tau WIMP
members.description: The photon and antiproton spectra from twin-tau annihilation are not computable with standard tools: annihilation proceeds into twin bottoms and long-lived twin glueballs that decay to SM states through the Higgs portal, a cascade absent from SM-final-state spectrum tables like PPPC4DMID, so the indirect-detection signal cannot be predicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the twin-hadronization and twin-glueball spectrum for the fraternal twin QCD sector, compute the glueball Higgs-portal decay branching fractions, and shower the resulting SM final states with Pythia to produce gamma-ray and antiproton injection spectra as functions of (m_tau_prime, twin confinement scale, portal mixing).

members.model_name: SE6SSM gravitino and lightest neutral exotic fermion dark matter
members.description: In the parameter regions where tree-level Higgs/Z couplings are tuned small, electroweak loop corrections set the sigma_SI floor, but the loop computation (known for MSSM-like Higgsino/wino dark matter, arXiv:1104.0228) has not been derived for the SE6SSM neutral exotic fermion with its extra U(1)N and exotic states.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the Hisano-type electroweak two-loop/one-loop direct-detection calculation to the SE6SSM exotic-fermion quantum numbers, including Z' and exotic Higgs contributions, and add it as a loop-level correction to the effective a_q, d_q couplings.

members.model_name: Two-step Majoron-scalar gravitational production of fermionic dark matter
members.description: The dark-matter phase-space distribution f_chi(p) from two-step production (gravitationally produced scalar parents decaying to fermions during/after reheating) has not been derived; without it the warmness, free-streaming scale, and any structure-formation recast of the sub-MeV benchmark are undefined.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for the parent scalar spectrum from gravitational production with inflaton power k, convolve with the two-body decay kernel (standard FIMP-from-decay spectrum machinery) to obtain f_chi(p), and feed the result into the CLASS ncdm sector to compute the transfer function and free-streaming scale.

members.model_name: Freeze-in dark matter from a light thermal fermion mediator
members.description: The mediator lifetime tau_psi and its cosmological/collider consequences are only qualitative handles: no lifetime calculation in a specified UV realization exists, so BBN, CMB, and LHC displaced-vertex constraints cannot be evaluated for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: For the right- and left-handed fermion-mediator UV examples sketched in the paper, derive the mediator decay width and lifetime, then recast existing BBN/CMB energy-injection bounds and LHC long-lived-particle searches (e.g. via a displaced-vertex recast in a public reinterpretation framework) onto (m_psi, tau_psi).

members.model_name: Broken-Z2 mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: The mirror-radiation prediction Delta N_nu ~ 1.4 is a minimal thermodynamic estimate that ignores entropy transfer during the two sectors' QCD phase transitions and mirror-gluon entropy leakage; no calculation exists that tracks the coupled SM and mirror thermal histories through decoupling at T_M ~ 2-6 GeV with heavier mirror fermion thresholds.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the coupled entropy evolution of the two sectors through their respective QCD transitions and fermion thresholds (extending standard g_star(T) tabulations to the shifted mirror spectrum), producing Delta N_eff(T_M, mirror fermion masses) that can be fed to the standard Planck/BBN N_eff likelihood.

members.model_name: Type-II extended 2HDM QCD axion dark matter
members.description: The model-specific axion-photon coupling has not been derived: the electromagnetic-to-color anomaly ratio E/N of this extended Type-II 2HDM with U(1)_{B_i-L_i} and two PQ-charged singlets is never computed, so the model cannot be placed on the (m_a, g_a_gamma) haloscope plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute E/N from the PQ charge assignments of the Type-II fermion content (including the B_i-L_i charged leptons and right-handed neutrinos) using the standard anomaly-coefficient formula, and record g_a_gamma(F_a) with the model-independent chiral correction E/N - 1.92.

members.model_name: Local baryon-number anomaly-cancellation Majorana dark matter
members.description: The gamma-line signature is transferred from a related anomaly-free model (arXiv:1904.01017) and the loop-induced chi chi -> gamma gamma rate has not been derived for the 2405.03749 benchmark, so the line target cannot be quantitatively evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-level annihilation cross section into gamma gamma (quark and exotic-fermion loops with Z_B/scalar exchange) for this model's spectrum, then compare against Fermi-LAT and H.E.S.S. line-search limits using their published limit curves.

members.model_name: Superheavy asymmetric thermal dark matter with late entropy dilution
members.description: The compact-object channel (pulsar collapse, type-Ia ignition from 0.1-100 PeV asymmetric DM capture) has no capture, thermalization, and collapse-rate calculation in the card; the route caveat explicitly states a separate capture and collapse calculation is required and none is implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the neutron-star/white-dwarf capture rate, thermalization time, and self-gravitating collapse criterion for the PeV asymmetric Dirac fermion with the vector-mediator cross section sigma_0 = alpha_DM^2/m_DM^2, following existing asymmetric-DM capture formalisms, and package it as an analytic module mapping (m_DM, sigma_0, eta_DM) to collapse constraints.

members.model_name: E6 two-component dark matter formalism
members.description: No concrete low-energy benchmark spectrum has been derived: the paper leaves fits of the E6 breaking vevs, seesaw-scale Yukawas, and scalar mass-matrix entries to future work, so the fermion mass, neutral scalar splitting Delta m, and charged-state splittings entering both observables are not calculable from stated inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the E6 27_F/27_S field content and breaking chain in SARAH to generate an SPheno spectrum module, deriving RGE-evolved low-energy mass matrices and mixing angles for a small set of benchmark vev hierarchies.

members.model_name: Light two-Higgs-doublet scalar forbidden dark matter
members.description: The one-loop radiative annihilation amplitude (SS to photon plus lepton pair or gamma-gamma through the muon loop) that produces the model's key MeV gamma-ray signature has not been derived, so no spectral prediction exists to compare with future MeV telescopes.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-level radiative annihilation cross section and photon spectrum for the leptophilic light-scalar mediator just below threshold, then fold it with published MeV telescope sensitivity curves (COSI, e-ASTROGAM/AMEGO-type) for a detectability forecast.

members.model_name: Kaluza-Klein gauge boson dark matter from brane-world quantum gravity
members.description: No rate calculation exists mapping the Planck-suppressed KK-vector coupling to the SM energy-momentum tensor onto gamma-ray or collider observables, so the branon search limits (which assume the unabsorbed branon EFT) cannot be recast onto this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the KK-vector annihilation/decay and collider missing-energy cross sections from the effective 4D massive-vector action with M_P-suppressed couplings, then recast the existing branon gamma-ray telescope and LEP/LHC missing-energy analyses onto the (f, m_X) plane with the corrected coupling structure.

members.model_name: Low-scale trinification Majoron dark matter
members.description: The two-loop Majoron-photon effective coupling g_Agamma is only estimated, not calculated, so the indirect-detection photon-line/diffuse-background constraint for the sub-MeV Majoron cannot be set at better than order-of-magnitude precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform the two-loop calculation of the Majoron-photon coupling in the 3331 trinification field content (analogous to published two-loop Majoron electromagnetic-coupling calculations in seesaw models) and map tau(A -> gamma gamma) onto existing keV-MeV decaying-DM X-ray/gamma-ray line limits.

members.model_name: Stueckelberg U(1)_X scotogenic fermion dark matter
members.description: The radiatively induced Z-prime couplings to quarks — which control both the XENON1T direct-detection prediction and the visible annihilation final states for a Fermi-LAT dwarf recast — are not available as a reusable parameterized result, only as paper-level statements.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-induced Z-prime-quark effective couplings as functions of (g_X, m_Zprime, inert-scalar and Yukawa parameters), encode them in the model implementation, and connect the resulting sigma_N and annihilation spectra (via PPPC4DMID/HDMSpectra-style tables) to the public XENON1T/LZ limits and Fermi-LAT dwarf joint likelihood.

members.model_name: Mass-dimension-one fermion non-minimally coupled to electromagnetism
members.description: The annihilation and scattering cross sections of the mass-dimension-one fermion with its non-minimal electromagnetic coupling (e [gamma_mu,gamma_nu] F^{mu nu}) have not been derived: the primary paper stops at renormalization-group results, so there is no rate input for freeze-out, collider missing-energy, or direct-detection predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive tree-level MDOF-pair annihilation into photons/charged SM particles and MDOF-SM scattering amplitudes using the paper's Feynman rules and the Wigner-degenerate spin sums, evaluated with running couplings e(mu) from the published one-loop beta function.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No linear perturbation theory or Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the coupled system of a degenerate right-handed-neutrino background plus its ultralight (about 1e-19 eV) condensate Higgs mode, so the transfer function, small-scale power suppression, and half-mode mass are all unknown on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid/perturbation equations for the condensate (sound speed and quantum-pressure terms analogous to fuzzy/superfluid dark matter) plus the degenerate fermion component, and implement them in a modified CLASS (e.g. extending the axionCAMB/ultralight-scalar module) to produce transfer functions over the viable parameter space.

members.model_name: Vector-like quark color-superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No linear perturbation theory or Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the degenerate vector-like-quark background plus its condensate Higgs mode, so the transfer function, small-scale power effect, and half-mode mass are all unknown on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid/perturbation equations for the CFL condensate Higgs mode (sound speed, quantum pressure, self-coupling terms) plus the degenerate fermion component and implement them in a modified CLASS ultralight-scalar/superfluid module to produce transfer functions across the broad viable mass range.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated O'Raifeartaigh R-ball dark matter
members.description: The R-ball lifetime against gravitino/gaugino emission is only estimated with simplified thick-wall surface/interior decay arguments; a controlled soliton decay-rate calculation for the gauge-mediated R-symmetric and R-breaking variants is missing, and the lifetime is the quantity that decides whether R-balls survive as dark matter at all.
members.proposed_resolution: Numerically solve the R-ball soliton profile in the O'Raifeartaigh potential and compute fermion evaporation and loop-induced decay rates channel by channel (gravitino, gaugino, gauge-boson emission), extending Cohen-Coleman-Georgi-Manohar-style surface-evaporation calculations to the thick-wall gauge-mediated regime.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric flavour-vacuum dark matter
members.description: The flavour-vacuum framework provides only homogeneous background stress-energy expectation values; no cosmological perturbation equations (sound speed, anisotropic stress, clustering behavior) have been derived for the fermionic condensate, so it cannot be propagated through CMB or large-scale-structure observables beyond the background.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear-perturbation stress-energy of the Blasone-Vitiello flavour vacuum on an FRW background (effective sound speed and anisotropic stress of each sector), reducing it to a generalized-dark-matter parameterization that can be dropped into the GDM module of CLASS or CAMB.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay Dirac fermion model
members.description: No cosmological production or relic-abundance calculation exists for the dark Dirac fermion chi (the card marks relic calculation_type unknown and the route caveat states it is not calculated), so chi cannot be assessed as a dark-matter component or confronted with any cosmological observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive chi's early-universe production through the U(1)' Zprime portal (freeze-out or freeze-in depending on e_prime) and compute Omega_chi h^2 by implementing the UV completion in micrOMEGAs, mapping the (M_Zprime, e_prime, m_chi) space against the observed abundance.

members.model_name: Charged scalar field dark matter with dark photon
members.description: No quantitative derivation exists of the photon upscattering/emission rate from halo excited states as a function of dark charge q and kinetic mixing epsilon, so the proposed Fermi-Bubble signal cannot be forward-modeled at all.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-photon-mediated energy-transfer rate from excited SFDM halo states to starlight/CMB photons (transition rates between halo states times photon conversion probability for given epsilon), producing an emissivity map that can be compared to gamma-ray data.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Q-ball dark matter from condensate fragmentation
members.description: There is no implemented survival calculation combining surface fermionic evaporation, finite-temperature erosion, and charge leakage to evolve a Q-ball charge distribution from formation to today; the card notes these were not numerically recomputed and survival is asserted only at order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and code the Cohen-Coleman-Georgi-Manohar surface evaporation rate together with finite-temperature potential corrections and thermal charge erosion into a charge-distribution evolution solver taking the gap_1 output as input and returning the surviving relic abundance and evaporated charge Delta Q.

members.model_name: Fermionic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: The isocurvature perturbation spectrum of the gravitationally produced fermionic X component has not been derived for this model, so the s4 likelihood step has no model-side input to compare against CMB isocurvature bounds despite a partial data-side likelihood existing.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the X-density isocurvature power spectrum from the fermionic mode functions as a function of m_X/H_I, following the related isocurvature-constraint literature, and map it onto the Planck CDI amplitude parameter for use with the existing Planck isocurvature likelihood.

members.model_name: Quantum fermionic warm dark matter Thomas-Fermi galaxy model
members.description: The primordial phase-space distribution f(E) since decoupling is explicitly left outside the paper's scope and no production mechanism is specified, so the input distribution to the Thomas-Fermi equation and the linear free-streaming cutoff (quoted only as ~50 kpc) cannot be derived rather than assumed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(E) for concrete benchmark production channels (thermal relic with entropy dilution, Dodelson-Widrow or resonant sterile-neutrino production) and feed each distribution both to the Thomas-Fermi solver and to a Boltzmann code (CLASS with a non-cold relic given the tabulated psd) to compute the matching transfer function and free-streaming scale.

members.model_name: E6-inspired exotic-state hot dark matter asymmetry scenario
members.description: The phase-space distribution of the decay/asymmetry-produced sub-eV exotic fermions is not derived (distribution_function_available: no), so their transfer-function and Delta N_eff imprint cannot be fed to a CMB/LSS Boltzmann code beyond a crude thermal-species approximation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the momentum distribution f(q) of the exotic fermions from their production and decoupling history and pass it to CLASS/CAMB as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) species, then constrain with the standard Planck+BAO likelihoods.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal fermionic dark matter with a light scalar mediator in neutron-star matter
members.description: The in-star dark matter content is put in by hand as a constant density (rho_chi/rho_n = 1e-3) and constant Fermi momentum; no capture/accretion calculation predicts the dark matter profile inside the star for this feebly coupled scenario, which the card flags as a high-extrapolation-risk assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the accreted/captured dark matter mass and radial profile from the model's sigma_chi-N cross section using standard neutron-star capture formalism (Goulding/Bell-type capture rates for light scalar mediators) and replace the constant-density ansatz with a two-fluid TOV profile.

members.model_name: Secluded composite hidden-baryon dark matter
members.description: The hidden meson/glueball branching fractions and Standard Model decay spectra through the dimension-8 connector operator have never been derived beyond the parametric width scaling, so the mediator-lifetime constraint cannot be recast onto BBN/CMB energy-injection or indirect-detection limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the M prime and glueball partial widths and SM final-state spectra from the (G prime)^2 (SM)^2 / m_f^4 operator for representative connector charges, then feed the lifetimes and injected spectra into existing BBN/CMB energy-injection tools (e.g. ACROPOLIS, ExoCLASS) to produce an actual exclusion in the (Lambda_prime, m_f) plane.

members.model_name: Dodelson-Widrow sterile neutrino dark matter with active-neutrino self-interactions
members.description: No public quantum kinetic solver evolves sterile-neutrino production with a light-scalar-mediated active-neutrino self-interaction, i.e. the modified in-medium mixing potential and phi-mediated scattering/on-shell decay collision terms of the paper's master equation; only standard-DW codes (sterile-dm, LASAGNA) are public.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Dodelson-Widrow quantum kinetic code (e.g. sterile-dm) with the phi-induced thermal self-energy and the scattering plus on-shell phi decay/inverse-decay production rates over (m_phi, lambda_phi, active flavor), validating against the paper's m4 = 7.1 keV S-shaped abundance contour and case A/B/C spectra.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public resonant sterile-neutrino production solver supports a non-standard pre-BBN expansion history: existing quantum-kinetic/Boltzmann codes (e.g. sterile-dm for Shi-Fuller production) hard-code the standard H(T), so the model's central parameterization of a modified Hubble rate above T_tr cannot be scanned with existing tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Shi-Fuller solver (sterile-dm or an averaged-Boltzmann reimplementation) to take a parameterized H(T) with power-law index and transition temperature T_tr as inputs, tracking lepton-asymmetry depletion and entropy conservation, and validate against the paper's example cosmology wedges in the mass-mixing plane.

members.model_name: Twin sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver evolves the coupled SM and twin-sector baths with twin-sector Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino production (including twin matter potentials), N_A freeze-out and out-of-equilibrium decay, and the resulting entropy injection and T_B/T_A history; the paper's calculation is in-house and unreleased.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (sterile-dm/DW-solver class) with a second gauge-sector bath: add twin matter potentials, coupled T_A(t)/T_B(t) evolution, and a decaying-N_A entropy-injection module, validated against the paper's Omega_NB = Omega_DM contours and pre-BBN injection timeline.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter in non-standard pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production solver computes non-resonant freeze-in in non-standard pre-BBN expansion histories; existing Dodelson-Widrow codes (sterile-dm class) hard-code standard radiation domination and cannot scan H(T), T_tr, or entropy-producing low-reheating histories.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Dodelson-Widrow solver (or implement the paper's closed-form production kernels) with a parameterized pre-BBN module taking H(T), T_tr, and entropy injection as inputs, outputting f_s(p) and Omega_s h^2 over the (m_s, sin^2 2theta) plane for kination, scalar-tensor, and low-reheating cosmologies.

members.model_name: nuMSM sterile-neutrino dark matter with fermion-number-violating leptogenesis effects
members.description: The N1 momentum distribution from resonant production boosted by the FNV-generated lepton asymmetry is not computed; the card records only an approximate distribution with no free-streaming length, so warm-DM structure predictions cannot be derived quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the time-dependent lepton asymmetry output of the kinetic solver into a public resonant sterile-neutrino production code (sterile-dm class) to obtain f(p) for N1 over the 1-50 keV mass window.

members.model_name: Neutrino-coupled ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: The early-universe sterile-production Boltzmann calculation that yields Delta N_eff in the presence of the oscillating scalar background exists only as the paper's private computation; no public solver handles active-sterile production with a phi(t)-dependent mass splitting through BBN and neutrino decoupling.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public sterile-neutrino production/decoupling solver (e.g. a LASAGNA-style momentum-averaged quantum kinetic code) to include the time-dependent induced Majorana mass from the cosmological scalar amplitude, validated against the paper's Planck Delta N_eff = 0.28 and BBN Delta N_eff > 0.5 contours.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine L-ball resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter scenario
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino kinetic solver couples Shi-Fuller resonant production to a time-dependent lepton asymmetry L_nue(T) released by L-ball decay; existing public resonant-production codes assume a primordial (pre-existing) asymmetry, and the paper's numerical framework was not released, with the stationary-point approximation additionally limiting validity below m_s ~ 10-20 keV.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public resonant sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) to accept an externally supplied L_nue(T) injection history from L-ball decay, solving the full momentum-dependent quantum kinetic equation to remove the stationary-point restriction, and validate against the paper's abundance contours and free-streaming lengths.

members.model_name: Visible sterile-neutrino dark matter in low-reheating pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public Boltzmann code computes non-resonant active-sterile freeze-in in a low-reheating-temperature pre-BBN cosmology; existing Dodelson-Widrow solvers such as sterile-dm assume standard radiation domination, so the suppressed abundance and modified momentum distribution f_s(p) for T_RH ~ 5 MeV cannot be regenerated without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm) with the low-reheating Hubble rate, entropy-injection temperature history, and matter-potential evolution below T_RH, outputting f_s(p) and Omega_s over the m_s-sin^2(2theta)-T_RH grid and validating against the paper's T_RH = 5 MeV suppression.

members.model_name: Visible sterile-neutrino dark matter in scalar-tensor pre-BBN cosmology
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production Boltzmann solver supports a non-standard scalar-tensor pre-BBN expansion history; the extra momentum-dependent factor in f_s(p) relative to the active-neutrino distribution must currently be reconstructed by hand from the primary paper's equations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Dodelson-Widrow production code (e.g. sterile-dm or a LASAGNA-style quantum-kinetic solver) to accept a user-supplied H(T), parameterized by the scalar-tensor transition temperature and enhancement factor, and output f_s(p), Omega_s, and N_eff.

members.model_name: Gauge-singlet-Higgs decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public code implements the coupled singlet-Higgs thermal history plus sterile-neutrino production from S decays (in- and out-of-equilibrium regimes with entropy dilution); the calculation exists only as the paper's private analytic/numerical treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the S freeze-out and S -> NN decay kinetic equations in a public sterile-neutrino production framework (e.g. extend a sterile-DM production code of the sterile-nu/DW family or write a standalone momentum-grid Boltzmann integrator) parameterized by (m_S, lambda_HS, f, B), validated against the paper's B~0.01-0.1, f=(1-5)e-8 abundance examples.

members.model_name: Abelian Z' sterile-neutrino progenitor dark matter variants
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production from massive Z' decays with the vector-decay collision term and in-medium active-sterile mixing, so the relic abundance, momentum distribution f(q), and MeV-era N_eff contribution of this progenitor mechanism cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (sterile-dm-style momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver) with the Z' -> N nu decay collision term, thermal Z' abundance evolution, and in-medium mixing angles, outputting f(q), Omega_s h^2, and Delta N_eff as functions of (M_Zprime, g', theta, M_s).

members.model_name: keV sterile neutrino dark matter in a minimal extended seesaw A4 model
members.description: No end-to-end production pipeline connects the MES A4 model parameters (mass matrices, active-sterile mixing, lepton asymmetry) to a sterile-neutrino momentum distribution, relic density, and transfer function; the card names only a generic 'sterile-neutrino production solver' with no implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap an existing public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm for resonant/non-resonant oscillation production) with an interface that takes the MES A4 seesaw output (m_s, sin^2(2theta), lepton asymmetry) and returns f(p), Omega_s h^2, and a CLASS-ready momentum distribution.

members.model_name: keV sterile neutrino dark matter from singlet scalar decays
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled momentum-dependent Boltzmann equations of the freeze-in/frozen-out singlet scalar and the sterile neutrino it decays to (including the FIMP, in-equilibrium, out-of-equilibrium, and intermediate regimes with varying g_*), so f_N(p,t) and Omega_N h^2 cannot be regenerated outside the authors' private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper's master equation for f_N(p,t) sourced by the scalar distribution as an open momentum-grid Boltzmann code (or extend an existing freeze-in framework in the style of sterile-dm/DarkSUSY modules), including full g_*(T) evolution, validated against the paper's published abundance contours and double-peaked spectra.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a neutrinophilic vector mediator
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production with the neutrinophilic vector's modified neutrino self-interaction rates and thermal potential; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement only Standard Model interaction rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) with the paper's V_T(m_V, lambda, T) and Gamma(m_V, lambda, T) for a neutrino-only-coupled vector, solving df_4/dz on a momentum grid to output f_4(x,z) and Omega_4 h^2 over (m4, sin^2 2theta, m_V, lambda), validated against the paper's relic target curves.

members.model_name: Low-scale inverse-seesaw keV sterile-neutrino freeze-in model
members.description: No public finite-temperature freeze-in Boltzmann solver exists for keV sterile-neutrino production via two-body heavy-neutrino decays plus mixing-mediated production near the electroweak scale, including thermal self-energy corrections to neutrino mixing; the card's route lists this solver as required with tool_or_code null.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing freeze-in framework (e.g. the micrOMEGAs freeze-in module or a sterile-neutrino production code in the sterile-dm/Ghiglieri-Laine tradition) with temperature-dependent self-energies and heavy-neutrino decay source terms for the (2,3) inverse-seesaw spectrum, outputting the sterile-neutrino yield versus temperature.

members.model_name: Single keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No assembled pipeline maps the production mechanism (non-resonant, resonant with lepton asymmetry, or entropy-diluted) to the sterile-neutrino momentum distribution and then to a linear transfer function; the card relies on crude thermal-equivalent WDM mass mappings instead of the actual non-thermal f(q).
members.proposed_resolution: Couple an existing sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. a Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller solver such as sterile-dm) to CLASS non-cold-dark-matter species, feeding the computed f(q) for each production scenario directly into the Boltzmann hierarchy to output model-specific transfer functions.

members.model_name: Composite sterile Dirac neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No production solver covers this model's non-standard sterile-neutrino production histories: resonant production with a large lepton asymmetry at low reheating temperature and direct inflaton-decay production; existing public codes for resonant Shi-Fuller production assume a standard high-temperature radiation-dominated history.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public resonant-production code (e.g. sterile-dm) with a low-reheat background evolution and an inflaton-decay source term to output full momentum distributions f(p) over the (m_d, theta_d, lepton asymmetry, T_R) space.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a gauged U(1) B-L vector
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production with B-L vector-modified thermal potentials and scattering rates; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement only Standard Model interaction rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) with the paper's V_T(m_V, g_BL, T) and Gamma(m_V, g_BL, T) formulas, solving df_4/dz on a momentum grid to output f_4(x,z) and Omega_4 h^2 over the (m4, sin^2 2theta, m_V, g_BL) space, validated against the paper's relic target curves.

members.model_name: Constrained nuMSM resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic solver evolves the N2,3 density-matrix equations from sphaleron freeze-out down to T about 100 MeV with the required near-degeneracy (Delta M below 1e-6 eV at M about 2 GeV), so the lepton asymmetry that drives resonant N1 production and links it to the BAU cannot be computed end to end.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public leptogenesis-via-oscillations density-matrix code to the low-temperature regime, adding hadronic-plasma susceptibilities and rates below the QCD transition and stiff-degeneracy-safe integration, validated against the published |mu_alpha| about 8e-6 benchmark.

members.model_name: Decay-product hot dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation of the decay-produced daughter momentum distribution: the CMB spectra and matter power spectrum for this model's nonthermal HDM admixture (including the skewness-level departure from a thermal or Dodelson-Widrow sterile-neutrino distribution) have never been computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's analytic daughter distribution f(q) as a tabulated psd file for the CLASS ncdm sector (or the CAMB nu_mass distribution interface), parameterized by mother lifetime tau, branching B_hdm, and hierarchy parameter epsilon/x_2, and validate against the Delta N_eff and m_hdm_eff moment mapping.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from pion decays after the QCD phase transition
members.description: No public production code computes the pion-decay sterile-neutrino distribution: existing sterile-neutrino transport codes implement Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller production and do not include the post-QCD charged-pion source term with finite-temperature pion mass and decay-constant tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm/Dodelson-Widrow class of solvers) with the paper's pion-decay collision term, packaging chiral-perturbation-theory finite-temperature f_pi(T) and m_pi(T) tables, and output tabulated f_s(q) suitable for a CLASS ncdm phase-space file.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with a gauged U(1) L_mu-L_tau vector
members.description: No public phase-space Boltzmann solver computes sterile-neutrino production with L_mu-L_tau vector-modified thermal potentials and muon/tau-flavor scattering rates; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement only Standard Model interaction rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm solver of Venumadhav et al.) with the paper's flavor-dependent V_T(m_V, g_mu, T) and Gamma(m_V, g_mu, T), solving df_4/dz on a momentum grid to output f_4(x,z) and Omega_4 h^2 over (m4, sin^2 2theta, m_V, g_mu), validated against the paper's relic target curves.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino-portal ultralight scalar dark matter with time-varying neutrino masses
members.description: No sterile-neutrino production solver includes the ultralight-scalar-induced time-varying potential g phi(t) in the active-sterile mixing; existing quantum-kinetic codes assume static vacuum mixing plus standard thermal potentials, so Delta N_eff for this model cannot be computed numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-production quantum-kinetic code (LASAGNA or a sterile-dm-style density-matrix solver) with an additional time-dependent diagonal potential term g phi(t) sourced by the coherently oscillating scalar background, and validate against the paper's benchmark Delta N_eff of about 0.01.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter via scalar-mediated neutrino self-interactions
members.description: The relic-density target itself is not computable with existing public tools: sterile-neutrino production codes implement standard Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller quantum kinetic equations, but none includes the scalar-mediated secret neutrino self-interaction thermal potential and collision terms that set the (m_4, theta, m_phi, lambda) relic target, so the parameter regions quoted by all observables cannot be independently regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino quantum-kinetic solver (e.g. the sterile-dm / LASAGNA class of codes) with the phi-mediated self-energy and scattering kernel, solve for the nu_4 yield and momentum distribution across the keV-MeV mass and keV-GeV mediator range, and release the relic-target scan (the distribution also enables downstream structure-formation checks).

members.model_name: Scalar-driven sterile-neutrino dark matter with an ultralight scalar
members.description: No public solver computes scalar-driven sterile-neutrino production: the coupled evolution of the ultralight scalar background with the momentum-resolved Boltzmann equation for f_N(p,t) under a time-dependent in-medium effective mixing angle exists only as the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public DW production code (sterile-dm-style) with a classical scalar field module: evolve phi(t) through misalignment, feed the scalar-dependent Majorana mass into the effective mixing, and output f_N(p) plus the present-day sin^2(2 theta_eff), validated against the paper's benchmark table (y ~ 1e-18) and the 92 keV DW comparison limit.

members.model_name: One-to-one resonantly produced mixed sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production solver implements the paper's one-to-one scenario: resonant Shi-Fuller transformation of a single active flavor with three independent initial lepton numbers (L_e, L_mu, L_tau) producing the full nonthermal spectrum f_s(q); existing public codes cover restricted flavor/asymmetry configurations.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public sterile-dm code (Venumadhav et al.) to general flavor-dependent lepton asymmetries and one-to-one channel selection, outputting f_s(q) tables directly consumable by CLASS, validated against the paper's spectra and Omega_s h^2 grid.

members.model_name: Three-to-one resonantly produced mixed sterile-neutrino dark matter
