members.description: No public solver computes the resonant Shi-Fuller production spectrum for the three-to-one case in which all three active flavors transform simultaneously into one sterile state with flavor-dependent lepton numbers; existing public codes handle single-flavor resonant production only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public single-flavor resonant production code (e.g. sterile-dm) to evolve three active-sterile channels with independent lepton numbers L_e, L_mu, L_tau, including the full 4x4 mixing treatment flagged as future work, and release the resulting f_s(q) spectra on the (m_s, sin^2 2theta, L_alpha) grid.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic solver covers resonant active-sterile conversion with flavor-dependent lepton asymmetries, finite-temperature potentials, and damping across the full mass-mixing-asymmetry space; existing codes (sterile-dm-type) use simplified single-flavor or averaged-asymmetry treatments, as flagged by the card's common-active-asymmetry assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-dm/LASAGNA-style quantum kinetic code to track per-flavor lepton asymmetries with modern finite-temperature potentials and damping rates, validated against the paper's cooler-than-NRP spectra and relic contours in (m_s, sin^2(2theta), L).

members.model_name: Pseudo-Goldstone-mediated sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver computes the N1 relic abundance from rho-mediated N_i N_i -> N_1 N_1 scattering and late rho/N_{2,3} decays across the paper's heavy, intermediate, and light pseudo-Goldstone regimes; existing sterile-neutrino production codes implement Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller oscillation production and do not cover this hidden-sector mechanism.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a coupled Boltzmann code for the N1, N2/3, and rho number densities (and momentum distributions) with the tree-level rho-mediated collision terms, parameterized by (m_phi, f, M_Ni), spanning all three regimes identified in the paper; validate against analytic freeze-in/decay limits.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino portal FIMP fermion dark matter
members.description: No detector-level recast exists for the displaced-vertex reach of a sterile neutrino with m_N < m_W whose branching includes the invisible N -> chi phi mode, nor a combined Higgs-invisible recast for this spectrum; the card notes detector acceptance and production modeling were not reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in a MadGraph5 UFO, generate sterile-neutrino production with the modified branching ratios, and recast against existing displaced-vertex HNL analyses (ATLAS/CMS long-lived-particle searches and MATHUSLA/FASER projections), adding the Higgs invisible width as an analytic constraint on lambda_Hphi.

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public solver reproduces the paper's resonant (Shi-Fuller) sterile-neutrino production with quantum-field-theoretic finite-temperature rates in a lepton-asymmetric plasma, including asymmetry depletion, QCD-crossover rates, and general flavour patterns of the nuMSM asymmetry; the private numerical integration also assumes equal active asymmetries and below-equilibrium density.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the production code as a public module (extending existing resonant sterile-neutrino production solvers such as sterile-dm-class codes with the QFT rates and flavoured lepton asymmetries), with back-reaction included and output f(p) tabulated in the format CLASS/CAMB ncdm input expects.

members.model_name: Thermal-effects freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public momentum-dependent Boltzmann code computes freeze-in production of keV sterile neutrinos from HNL, Higgs, and weak-boson decays with the paper's thermal self-energy corrections; existing sterile-neutrino tools implement oscillation (Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller) production only, and the paper itself used a coarse integration with the full scan left to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's finite-temperature production rates Gamma_s(T,p) in a momentum-grid freeze-in solver (extending a framework like sterile-dm or a ULYSSES-style density-matrix code) to output f_DM and the full distribution function over the seesaw parameter space.

members.model_name: SO(10) extra-generation hot dark matter neutrino model
members.description: Evaluating the BBN/N_eff caveat (bbn_sterile_neutrino_caveat, likelihood_available unknown) requires solving quantum kinetic equations for active-sterile thermalization with sin^2 2theta_s about 0.82 and a possible primordial lepton asymmetry of order 1e-5, and no such solver is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply an existing sterile-neutrino quantum-kinetic solver (LASAGNA-type momentum-averaged or full-momentum code) to this model's mixing parameters with and without the lepton-asymmetry loophole, outputting Delta N_eff for the BBN codes and the cosmology likelihood.

members.model_name: Relativistically decoupled warm dark matter with arbitrary distribution function
members.description: The paper's semi-analytic transfer-function formalism for arbitrary relativistically decoupled distributions exists only as formulae with a numerical recipe; there is no released code, and a CLASS-based ncdm computation resolving the high-k acoustic oscillations has not been validated against it.
members.proposed_resolution: Package the paper's transfer-function recipe as a small public code and cross-validate against CLASS runs using tabulated ncdm distribution functions with boosted precision (high l_max_ncdm and momentum-grid resolution) for Dodelson-Widrow and boson-decay example spectra.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with Dodelson-Widrow modification of a non-trivial initial abundance
members.description: No public numerical implementation of the DW Boltzmann solution acting on an arbitrary pre-existing sterile-neutrino distribution f_ini(p): existing sterile-neutrino production codes solve pure DW (f_ini=0) and do not output the combined damped-plus-DW spectrum, nor pipe it into a Boltzmann code as a tabulated non-cold-DM distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public DW production code (sterile-dm-type solver with standard-model active-neutrino opacities) to accept a user-supplied f_ini(p) (e.g. a scalar-decay spectrum), integrate the gain/loss terms of the paper's formal solution, and emit the final f_N(p) as a CLASS ncdm psd table.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated secret-neutrino sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic (Boltzmann) solver computes keV sterile-neutrino production including scalar-mediated active-neutrino self-interactions, i.e. the modified thermal potential V_T, the enhanced interaction rate, on-shell phi-mediated production in the light-mediator regime, and the resulting momentum distribution f_nu_s(x,z); existing Dodelson-Widrow codes (e.g. sterile-dm, LASAGNA-type solvers) do not include the secret-interaction sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Dodelson-Widrow-style quantum-kinetic solver (e.g. the sterile-dm code of Venumadhav et al. or a LASAGNA-type density-matrix solver) with the phi-mediated self-interaction collision terms, the phi thermal potential, and phi thermalization/decay in the light-mediator regime, outputting f_nu_s(x,z), Omega_s h^2, and Delta N_eff over the (m_4, sin^2 2theta, m_phi, lambda_phi) space.

members.model_name: Frozen-in scalar decay production of keV sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the frozen-in scalar yield Y_phi(T) and the resulting decay-produced sterile-neutrino momentum distribution f_N1(p) with full decay kinematics and evolving g*; both steps currently rely on the source papers' private coupled Boltzmann code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs' freeze-in module (which already gives the scalar production rate through the Higgs portal) with a momentum-level decay-injection solver, or implement the coupled f_phi/f_N1 Boltzmann equations in a public code in the style of sterile-dm/DRAKE, outputting a CLASS-ready ncdm distribution table and validated against the paper's abundance bands.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated self-interacting sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the sterile phase-space distribution f_s(p) and relic abundance for Dodelson-Widrow production modified by scalar-mediated sterile self-interactions (including resonant mediator and number-changing regimes); the primary paper's solver is private and public codes handle only the canonical non-interacting case.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm) with the phi-mediated nu_s nu_s collision terms and number-changing processes over the keV-GeV mediator scan, releasing f_s(p) and Omega_s h^2 as functions of (m_s, theta, y, m_phi), validated against the paper's production-regime benchmarks.

members.model_name: Asymmetric higgsino dark matter
members.description: No public numerical solver exists for the higgsino-antihiggsino density-matrix evolution through the low-temperature electroweak transition (oscillations driven by the m0 splitting, thermal damping, WW/ZZ annihilation, and expansion); the paper's analytic estimates cannot deliver the surviving asymmetric and regenerated symmetric densities that both detection observables depend on.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the quantum kinetic (density-matrix) equations for oscillating asymmetric dark matter — following the formalism of the oscillating-ADM literature — as a dedicated ODE solver over (mu, m0, T_EWPT, Y_h), outputting the symmetric fraction versus time and validating against the paper's analytic limits.

members.model_name: Shi-Fuller resonant sterile-neutrino WDM spectrum model
members.description: The route lacks an integrated calculator for the resonant (lepton-asymmetry-driven) Shi-Fuller momentum distribution; the card carries only an approximate analytic mapping, while precision recasts need the strongly non-thermal quantum-kinetic spectrum as a function of mass and asymmetry.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple an existing public resonant-production quantum-kinetic solver (sterile-dm-class code) to the pipeline so it tabulates f(q) over the (m_SF, lepton asymmetry) grid and feeds the CLASS/CAMB ncdm module directly.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino dark matter with light-scalar neutrino self-interaction after quintessential inflation
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes keV sterile-neutrino production via active-sterile oscillations with a light-scalar-mediated active-neutrino self-interaction (scalar thermal potential plus on-shell exchange collision terms), so f_N1(p) and Omega_N1 cannot be reproduced or scanned outside the paper's private calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the Venumadhav et al. sterile-dm framework or a LASAGNA-style density-matrix solver) with the scalar-mediated interaction rate, its finite-temperature potential, and the on-shell phi-exchange term, validated against the paper's 50 keV benchmark relic abundance.

members.model_name: Low-reheating visible sterile-neutrino hot dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No public quantum-kinetic/Boltzmann solver computes active-sterile oscillation production in a low-reheating cosmology (T_R ~ 5 MeV); existing sterile-neutrino production codes assume a standard high-temperature thermal history, leaving only the paper's approximate f_s(E,T) scaling formula.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino kinetic code (e.g. a sterile-dm or LASAGNA-type solver) to start integration at a specified reheating temperature with matter effects and flavor structure, parameterized by (m_s, sin^2 2theta, T_R, active flavor, lepton asymmetry), and validate against the paper's Omega_s h^2 ~ sin^2 2theta m_s T_R^3 scaling.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric model with keV right-handed-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann solver implements thermal N1 production via TeV-scale SU(2)_R gauge interactions followed by N2/N3 entropy dilution; the card relies on approximate Dodelson-Widrow scaling and sudden-decay dilution, which it flags as high extrapolation risk.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm code of Venumadhav et al. or a custom momentum-dependent Boltzmann solver) with W_R/Z_R-mediated scattering rates and a coupled diluter-decay sector to track the N1 abundance and spectrum through entropy release.

members.model_name: QCD-transition sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No production solver covers this model's defining regime: contemporaneous sterile-neutrino production, dilution, and plasma evolution through the QCD transition with variable transition order and T_crit (100-200 MeV) and nonzero lepton number; existing public codes assume a fixed lattice-QCD equation of state.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. sterile-dm) to accept alternative finite-temperature QCD equations of state, including a first-order-transition branch with entropy dilution, parameterized by T_crit and transition order, and output f_s(p) plus Omega_s h^2 on a (m_s, sin^2(2theta), L) grid.

members.model_name: Axion-assisted resonance sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production code includes the axion-assisted temperature-dependent matter potential from the singlet vev; existing DW/Shi-Fuller solvers must be modified to compute the momentum-dependent distribution f_s(p,T) and Omega_s h^2 through the engineered resonance.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public momentum-dependent sterile-neutrino production solver (e.g. the sterile-dm code of Venumadhav et al. or a DW-style quasi-classical Boltzmann integrator) to accept a user-supplied V_eff(T) built from (g_a, m_a, <phi>(T)), validated by recovering the paper's benchmark of lower mixing than DW at fixed relic abundance.

members.model_name: Dark population transfer sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public code evolves the coupled system of scattering-induced-decoherence production of N1, internal dark-sector thermalization via scalar-mediated self-interactions (G_phi), and the number-changing N1 -> 3 N2 population transfer down to the final T_DS and N2 relic abundance; the paper's numerical evolution was not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's reduced T_DS evolution plus 2-to-2, 1-to-3 (and optional 2-to-4) rate network as an open-source module — e.g. building on a public sterile-neutrino production framework (LASAGNA/sterile-dm-style kinetics) extended with the dark-sector collision terms — and validate by reproducing the primary parameter-region boundaries including the m_N1 > 3 m_N2 threshold.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7 keV sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No reusable public solver is identified for resonant (Shi-Fuller) sterile-neutrino production in a lepton-asymmetric plasma: the momentum-dependent f(p/T) and Omega_s h^2, including quark-hadron-transition sensitivity for L_4 ~ 4.6-10, come only from the paper's approximate internal calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt or extend a public resonant-production Boltzmann/QKE solver (sterile-dm-class code) covering m_s, sin^2(2 theta), L_4 with switchable quark-hadron equation-of-state treatments, validated against the paper's L_4 = 7 distribution and abundance.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7.1 keV sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the paper's improved resonant-production rate equations (finite-temperature spectral functions, plasma charge neutrality, hadronic susceptibilities) exists, so the non-equilibrium spectrum f_N(k) and required lepton asymmetry cannot be reproduced without re-deriving the solver.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public resonant sterile-neutrino production code of the sterile-dm type with the paper's improved rate coefficients and hadronic-plasma inputs, validating against the published lepton-asymmetry-versus-abundance results for the 7.1 keV benchmark.

members.model_name: Self-interacting sterile-neutrino dark matter with heavy scalar mediator
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver covers active-to-sterile conversion with sterile-sector self-interactions through a heavy mediator, including the in-medium self-interaction potential, the resonance criterion, and the runaway production phase; the calculation exists only as the authors' private numerical solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm/LASAGNA family of momentum-resolved quantum-kinetic solvers) with a G_phi-parameterized sterile self-energy term and heavy-mediator contact self-scattering collision integrals, validating against the paper's runaway threshold theta_c and overproduction results.

members.model_name: Effective right-handed sterile-neutrino dark matter with SM gauge interactions
members.description: No calculator exists for the relic abundance of these keV right-handed sterile neutrinos: the thermal freeze-out estimate overproduces, and the required entropy-dilution or matter-dominated/kination history is not solved, so Omega_N h^2 and the diluted momentum distribution (needed for warm-DM free-streaming bounds) cannot be computed for a given (m_N, G_R).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm/DarkHistory-style Boltzmann treatments) with G_R-mediated decoupling plus a parameterized dilution sector (diluter mass/lifetime or kination onset), outputting Omega_N h^2 and f(p) after dilution for structure-formation recasts.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with scalar-mediated neutrino NSI
members.description: No public Boltzmann/quantum-kinetic solver computes sterile-neutrino production including complex-scalar-mediator-induced neutrino interaction rates and thermal potentials together with parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories H(T); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm quantum-kinetic solver) to add scalar-mediator collision rates and finite-temperature potentials (m_phi, lambda_phi) and a user-supplied H(T), outputting Omega_s and f_s(p) on the paper's 10 GeV to 0.1 MeV integration range; validate against the paper's over/underproduction boundaries.

members.model_name: Three-level neutrino-laser majoron dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code solves the coupled three-level neutrino decay kinetics with quantum-statistical stimulated-emission terms needed to compute the boson occupation number and the cold/hot fractions; the paper's own numerical solution is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement momentum-binned quantum kinetic equations for f_nu_tau, f_nu_mu, f_nu_e, and f_phi including 1+f Bose-enhancement factors and inverse decays, extending an existing public neutrino kinetic solver (LASAGNA/FortEPiaNO-class framework), validated against the paper's factor-three electron-neutrino enhancement and its insufficient cold-boson fraction.

members.model_name: Scalar-decay sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public implementation of the singlet-scalar-decay production calculation exists: the quantum kinetic equation yielding the low-momentum-enhanced f_0(y) is available only through the primary paper, under a simplified scalar thermal history and small-Yukawa assumption, so scanning (m, M, <S>, Y, T_dec) is not currently possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-decay kinetic equation as a public module (or add a scalar-decay production channel to an existing sterile-neutrino production solver), tracking the scalar's thermal history rather than assuming equilibrium, and output tabulated f(p) in CLASS/CAMB ncdm format validated against the primary paper's f_0(y), lambda_fs = 488 kpc, and k_fs = 0.013/kpc benchmarks.

members.model_name: Leptoquark-assisted right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No coupled Boltzmann/kinetic-equation solver includes leptoquark-mediated production of right-handed neutrinos alongside oscillation-generated lepton asymmetry and thermal corrections, so the N1 relic density, momentum distribution, and baryon asymmetry cannot be computed; the primary paper defers exactly this calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public nuMSM-style sterile-neutrino kinetic code (e.g. the resonant-production solvers of the sterile-dm / Ghiglieri-Laine type) with leptoquark scattering collision terms and reheating-temperature dependence, evolving N1 abundance, lepton asymmetry, and the full N1 momentum distribution together; feed the resulting distribution to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold relic for the structure-suppression prediction.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with B-L vector NSI
members.description: No public Boltzmann/quantum-kinetic solver computes sterile-neutrino production including B-L-vector-mediator-induced neutrino interaction rates and thermal potentials together with parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories H(T); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm quantum-kinetic solver) to add mediator-induced collision rates and finite-temperature potentials for a gauged B-L vector and a user-supplied H(T), outputting Omega_s and f_s(p) on the paper's 10 GeV to 0.1 MeV integration range; validate against the paper's over/underproduction boundaries.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with neutrinophilic vector NSI
members.description: No public Boltzmann/quantum-kinetic solver computes sterile-neutrino production including neutrinophilic U(1)_np vector-mediator-induced neutrino interaction rates and thermal potentials together with parameterized nonstandard pre-BBN expansion histories H(T); the paper's solver is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the sterile-dm quantum-kinetic solver) to add neutrinophilic-vector collision rates and finite-temperature potentials and a user-supplied H(T), outputting Omega_s and f_s(p) on the paper's 10 GeV to 0.1 MeV integration range; validate against the paper's over/underproduction boundaries.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition
members.description: No sterile-neutrino production integrator handles active-to-sterile conversion in a spatially inhomogeneous plasma with domain-crossing resonances; public resonant-production codes (sterile-dm class solvers for homogeneous Shi-Fuller production) cannot represent per-crossing conversion probabilities in matter-antimatter domains.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a homogeneous resonant sterile-neutrino production code with a domain-ensemble layer: sample neutrino trajectories through domains with the simulated size distribution, apply Landau-Zener crossing probabilities per resonance, and integrate to Omega_N and f_N(p) over the transition duration.

members.model_name: Bulk-shortcut sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No quantum kinetic solver includes the brane-shortcut effective potential: existing sterile-neutrino production codes (Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller-type solvers such as sterile-dm or LASAGNA) implement standard matter potentials only, so the sterile abundance and nonthermal momentum distribution f(p) cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino quantum-kinetic code (e.g., a sterile-dm or LASAGNA-class solver) with the shortcut term E_res(T) in the effective Hamiltonian and active-neutrino repopulation, outputting Omega_s h^2 and f(p) over the (m_s, theta, epsilon) space.

members.model_name: Neutrino self-interaction assisted sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the sterile-neutrino phase-space distribution f_nu4(E,T) for freeze-in production via active-sterile oscillations with self-interactions enhanced by the neutrinophilic scalar: the card gives only an integral form for the distribution, and without a solver for the in-medium mixing and interaction-rate history the Boltzmann step s1 has no model-specific input.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Dodelson-Widrow quantum-kinetic production code (e.g., a sterile-dm-style solver) with the scalar-mediated neutrino self-interaction rate and in-medium potential, output tabulated f(p) suitable for the CLASS ncdm module, and validate against the related analysis's 37 keV bound setup.

members.model_name: sterile-neutrino dark matter from light vector boson decay
members.description: No public numerical solver exists for sterile-neutrino production from MeV-GeV vector-boson decay followed by active-sterile oscillation, including in-medium thermal corrections and possible resonance; the calculation lives only in the paper's private code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the source's vector-decay production Boltzmann equations as a public module, e.g. by extending an existing sterile-neutrino production code (sterile-dm/LASAGNA-style momentum-dependent quantum kinetic solver) with the Z-prime decay source term and L_mu-L_tau thermal potentials, outputting f(q) and Omega_s h^2 over the (M_Zprime, g_prime, m_s, theta) grid.

members.model_name: ISS(2,3) sterile-neutrino dark matter from small lepton-number violation
members.description: No public sterile-neutrino production solver is linked to the card for computing the Dodelson-Widrow relic abundance of the ISS(2,3) mostly sterile state, including the sterile-sector hierarchy and optional late entropy dilution; the card records only the analytic abundance scaling with no numerical Boltzmann solve rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing public sterile-neutrino quantum-kinetic production code (the sterile-dm/DW-production class of solvers) to the ISS(2,3) mixing structure, adding an optional entropy-dilution factor, and expose Omega h^2(m_DM, sin^2 2theta, hierarchy) as a registry module.

members.model_name: Inelastic Dirac Dark Matter
members.description: No public recast pipeline implements chi_2 displaced-decay and scattering acceptances (detector geometry, visible-energy thresholds, lifetime dependence) for fixed-target, beam-dump, and flavor-factory experiments in the i2DM parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement i2DM in a public dark-sector sensitivity framework (e.g. a SensCalc- or FORESEE-style geometry/acceptance code driven by the i2DM FeynRules model), encoding LSND, MiniBooNE, Belle II, ICARUS/SBN, LDMX, and SeaQuest geometries and cuts, and validate against the paper's exclusion curves.

members.model_name: Twin bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: No recast pipeline exists for the model's LHC signatures in the displaced-vertex regime, where small visible-twin neutralino mixing gives macroscopic stau/higgsino decay lengths outside the coverage of standard prompt electroweakino recasts.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate events in MadGraph with the mixing-controlled lifetimes and recast against ATLAS/CMS displaced-vertex and long-lived-particle searches using the LLP modules of MadAnalysis or CheckMATE, mapping exclusions onto the (mu, m_stau, mixing) plane.

members.model_name: R-invariant gauge-mediated gravitino warm dark matter
members.description: No modern LHC recast exists for the R-invariant gauge-mediation spectrum with a gluino lighter than the wino (300 GeV to 1 TeV benchmarks); the 2010-era collider discussion has not been mapped onto current gluino search results.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the messenger-scale spectrum with a SUSY spectrum calculator, then recast current ATLAS/CMS gluino simplified-model searches using SModelS or CheckMATE for the model's decay topologies, including the light-gravitino LSP final state.

members.model_name: Symmetry-restored 2HDM plus 7.1 keV sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The joint flavor/collider scan of the mass-powered texture (R_K, R_D, B_s mixing, muon g-2, charged-Higgs searches) has no implementation: existing 2HDM flavor tools do not contain this Yukawa ansatz, so the correlated constraints that define the model's viable region cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the mass-powered Yukawa matrices as a general-2HDM parameter point generator and drive existing tools (flavio or SuperIso for flavor observables, HiggsBounds/HiggsTools for scalar searches), scanning texture exponents n_q, n_l and scalar masses with current data.

members.model_name: nonthermal pure higgsino LSP dark matter
members.description: No collider recast is implemented for the nearly degenerate higgsino-chargino system in this B-L scenario: charged-track and monojet signatures require a dedicated compressed-spectrum/long-lived-particle recast, and the card provides only qualitative prospects with no tool_or_code or exclusion contour.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the higgsino simplified-model point grid in an LHC recast framework such as CheckMATE or SModelS, including disappearing-track and monojet plus missing-energy analyses, and produce exclusion contours in (m_higgsino, Delta m_chi).

members.model_name: nonthermal pure wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No collider recast is implemented for the nearly degenerate wino-chargino system in this B-L scenario: charged-track and monojet signatures require a dedicated compressed-spectrum/long-lived-particle recast, and the card provides only qualitative prospects with no tool_or_code or exclusion contour.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the wino simplified-model point grid in an LHC recast framework such as CheckMATE or SModelS, including disappearing-track and monojet plus missing-energy analyses, and produce exclusion contours in (m_wino, Delta m_chi).

members.model_name: Vector-mediated low-energy SUSY with light gravitino dark matter component
members.description: No collider recast exists for the vector-mediated spectrum: minimal gauge-mediation exclusions cannot be applied directly (per the card's stated assumption), and the model's GMSB-like decay chains to a light gravitino have not been confronted with LHC direct-search results.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the gap_1 spectrum-generator output (SLHA files with gravitino-LSP decay chains) into SModelS and CheckMATE to recast existing LHC GMSB searches over the (F, messenger scale, charge) parameter space.

members.model_name: Minimal left-right symmetric keV right-handed neutrino dark matter
members.description: No packaged pipeline exists that maps the MLRSM parameters (v_R, M_W_R, M2, M3, theta, Y_Delta_ee) to the 0nubb amplitude with propagated nuclear-matrix-element uncertainties and to LHC dilepton/heavy-neutrino exclusions; both recasts are currently done point-by-point in the literature.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module combining published MLRSM 0nubb master formulas with tabulated NME sets (propagating their spread as a nuisance) and the ATLAS/CMS W_R->lN dilepton limits, exposing a joint likelihood over the card's input parameters.

members.model_name: Vector SIMP dark matter in SU_X(2) x U(1)_Z' gauge model
members.description: The beam-dump and LDMX signal chain (production cross sections, detector geometry, scattering) for this vector dark matter model exists only as the authors' private modified-BdNMC Monte Carlo; the public BdNMC release does not cover complex-vector DM in this gauge sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend public BdNMC (or an equivalent fixed-target MC) with the X/X_3/Z' production and scattering channels of the SU_X(2) x U(1)_Z' model and package the LDMX 8 GeV missing-momentum projection as a reusable sensitivity module, validated against the paper's y-vs-m_X reach plots.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet dark matter with vector-like quark UV completion
members.description: No collider recast capability exists for the Z2-odd vector-like quarks Q and D decaying to a SM quark plus invisible phi: standard vector-like quark searches assume decays to W/Z/h + quark, so the model's jets-plus-missing-energy topology has never been mapped to LHC limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the Z2-odd VLQ model and recast ATLAS/CMS squark-like jets + MET searches with MadGraph plus CheckMATE or MadAnalysis to set limits in the (m_Q, m_D, m_phi, Yukawa) space.

members.model_name: Very supersymmetric co-decaying dark sector
members.description: The correlated double-displaced-vertex collider signature (superpartner decay into the hidden sector followed by hidden-scalar decay back to the SM) has no implemented detector-acceptance recast; the card lists LLP detector acceptance tools as required but unimplemented for this topology.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the MSSM+Phi model in FeynRules/MadGraph, generate colored-superpartner cascades with the epsilon-controlled hidden decays, and recast ATLAS/CMS displaced-vertex plus MATHUSLA/CODEX-b acceptances with an LLP recasting framework to map the (epsilon, c tau_phi) plane.

members.model_name: Leptophilic flavor-violating Zprime portal Majorana dark matter
members.description: No packaged, reusable recast chain exists for the flavor-violating leptophilic Zprime collider and cLFV/LFUV constraints: the paper's benchmark rates and coupling exclusions are computed ad hoc, and standard recast frameworks do not cover off-diagonal leptonic Zprime final states at lepton colliders or muTRISTAN-style machines.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a MadGraph/CalcHEP-based recast module from the published FeynRules model that maps (m_Zprime, g_L, g_R, g_chi) to cLFV branching ratios, LFUV observables, and LHC/lepton-collider cross sections, and package the existing charged-lepton constraints (e.g. via flavio/smelli-style likelihoods) as a coupling-space likelihood.

members.model_name: Dark anti-proton and dark pion asymmetric dark matter
members.description: No model-specific collider implementation exists for the exotic Higgs decays into the dark sector: the exotic-Higgs branching-ratio formula was not extracted and no event-level model (needed to confront LHC and future e+e- Higgs-factory searches) is available, leaving the highlighted Higgs-factory signal unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the h to dark-sector branching ratios from the |H prime|^2|H|^2 portal and kinetic mixing, implement the dark Higgs plus dark photon sector in FeynRules/MadGraph, and recast current LHC exotic-Higgs-decay searches plus projected e+e- Higgs-factory sensitivities into the (epsilon, m_Aprime, dark-Higgs parameter) space.

members.model_name: ISS-NMSSM right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: No Monte Carlo recast of ATLAS/CMS dilepton-plus-MET electroweakino searches exists for the ISS-NMSSM decay pattern (chargino to lepton plus sneutrino, neutralino invisible), so the collider constraint is qualitative and the obs_lhc_dilepton_met observable cannot be turned into exclusion contours.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate electroweakino production with MadGraph+Pythia using the SARAH UFO model and recast the 13 TeV 2l+MET analyses with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 recast cards, scanning (m_chargino, m_snu1) over the accepted DM/g-2 points.

members.model_name: Charged-meson vector-portal inelastic dark matter benchmark
members.description: No public end-to-end beam simulation covers charged-pion and charged-kaon three-body decays to a dark photon: the paper's MG5_aMC decay sampling and the MiniBooNE charged-meson flux parameterizations it feeds on are not released, so the dark-matter flux at the detector cannot be recomputed for new parameter points or facilities.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the MG5_aMC model implementation of the pi/K three-body decays together with the focused charged-meson flux parameterization, or extend an existing public beam-dump dark-sector generator (BdNMC-style) to include charged-meson three-body production with the longitudinal-mode enhancement.

members.model_name: Electromagnetically interacting Elko dark matter
members.description: No public collider-simulation implementation of the mass-dimension-one Elko electromagnetic tensor coupling exists: the FeynRules model and the modified DHELAS routines needed for Elko spinor kinematics were private to the primary authors, so the 8 TeV monophoton recast cannot be reproduced or updated to 13 TeV data.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the Elko free Lagrangian and g_e lambda_bar [gamma^mu,gamma^nu] lambda F_mu_nu operator as a public FeynRules/UFO model with custom HELAS-style helicity routines for mass-dimension-one spinors, validate against the published 8 TeV exclusion, then recast current 13 TeV ATLAS/CMS monophoton searches with MadAnalysis or CheckMATE.

members.model_name: Dark-charge Z6 two-fermion dark matter model
members.description: The beam-dump, neutrino-electron scattering, stellar-cooling, and SN1987A bounds on the light Z prime have not been recast for the model's hyperdark charge assignment (1/3 + 2n), so con_z6_light_zprime_low_energy cannot be applied quantitatively and the OCR-degraded bound numbers in the card cannot be checked.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkCast with the U(1)_N charge vector including the hyperdark charge parameter n to map existing dark-photon and light-mediator limits into the (g_N, m_Zprime, n) space, and overlay the stellar-cooling and SN1987A bounds from the light-vector literature.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L fermion FIMP with scalar NLOP decay
members.description: No implemented collider recast maps lambda_SD and the heavy-Higgs spectrum into HL-LHC VBF invisible-H2 sensitivity for this model; the paper's benchmark reach cannot currently be reproduced or extended to other masses and mixings.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the extended Higgs sector in MadGraph via the same FeynRules model and recast ATLAS/CMS VBF+missing-energy heavy-scalar searches (e.g. through CheckMATE or MadAnalysis recast databases), producing sensitivity curves in (M_H2, sin_alpha, lambda_SD) validated against the paper's reach plots.

members.model_name: Alternative [SU(3)]^4 leptonic-color dark matter model
members.description: No hemionia spectroscopy or production tool exists: the flagship future e+e- collider observable relies on SU(2)_l-confined bound states of half-integer-charged hemions (Lambda_l ~ 0.4 MeV, m_x ~ 100 GeV), but there is no code to compute their spectrum, wavefunctions, production cross sections, or decay signatures.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a quarkonium-style potential model (Coulombic SU(2)_l potential with alpha_l(M_Z)=0.065 plus confinement at Lambda_l) for hemionium bound states, derive e+e- production cross sections of the vector states, and package it as a spectroscopy/rate calculator that can feed future-collider sensitivity studies.

members.model_name: Quasi-Yukawa-unified 4-2-2 neutralino dark matter with non-universal gaugino masses
members.description: The collider/flavor viability step relies on 2015-era LHC cuts (m_h window, m_gluino >= 1 TeV, rare-B intervals); no current LHC recast of the 4-2-2 QYU spectra (gluino ~4.2 TeV, stop ~2 TeV, compressed coannihilation regions) has been set up, so modern collider exclusion of benchmark points cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current ATLAS/CMS SUSY searches on the QYU benchmark spectra using SModelS or CheckMATE fed by the ISAJET/SoftSusy SLHA output, and update the flavor cuts with current HFLAV values via SuperIso.

members.model_name: Dark-charge Z4 two-scalar dark matter model
members.description: The beam-dump, neutrino-electron scattering, stellar-cooling, and SN1987A bounds on the light Z prime have not been recast for this model's specific U(1)_N charge assignments, so the shared-portal constraint con_z4_light_zprime_bounds cannot be applied quantitatively (likelihood_available: unknown, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the DarkCast recasting framework with the U(1)_N charge vector of this model to translate existing dark-photon beam-dump and low-energy limits into the (g_N, m_Zprime) plane, and add the stellar-cooling/SN1987A bounds from the light-mediator literature.

members.model_name: Anapole dark matter
members.description: No collider implementation of the dimension-six anapole operator exists: there is no event-generator model file or mono-X recast, and the low EFT cutoff (2.2-340 GeV for g=1) requires explicit validity handling, so the collider observable cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the anapole operator, generate mono-photon and mono-jet missing-energy samples in MadGraph, and recast current LHC/LEP mono-X searches with per-event EFT-validity cuts that disable the limit when the momentum transfer exceeds Lambda.

members.model_name: Mini-Split supersymmetry with neutralino LSP dark matter
members.description: No validated public recast pipeline maps Mini-Split electroweakino spectra onto current LHC disappearing-track and soft-pion searches; existing recast frameworks carry only partial long-lived-particle efficiency maps, so paper-era collider bounds cannot be updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement current ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track efficiency maps in a public recast tool (CheckMATE or SModelS LLP module), drive it with MadGraph/Pythia wino Drell-Yan production, and validate against anomaly-mediated wino benchmark exclusions.

members.model_name: Majoronic dark radiation with residual-dark-parity scalar dark matter
members.description: The predicted displaced-vertex Higgs decays (four-muon and two-muon plus missing energy through the long-lived sub-GeV scalar) lack lifetime and detector modeling; no recast exists mapping the scalar mass-mixing plane onto LHC displaced-vertex search results.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the light-scalar lifetime from its Higgs mixing, simulate h -> ss -> displaced dimuon events with MadGraph/Pythia, and recast against published LHCb and ATLAS/CMS displaced-vertex and exotic-Higgs-decay searches over the (M_S, mixing angle) plane.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No implemented collider recast pipeline for the long-lived colored mediator: R-hadron and displaced-top limits are taken from published stop/R-hadron recasts with no detector simulation run and no likelihood available for this model's lifetime-mass plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in an LLP recast framework such as SModelS (LLP module) or MadAnalysis5/CheckMATE with lifetime reweighting, validating against the published 1250 GeV detector-stable R-hadron limit and adding displaced-top signal regions for intermediate lifetimes.

members.model_name: DFSZ axion model with electroweak-scale scalar sector
members.description: No DFSZ-specific collider recast exists: the extra-Higgs exclusions quoted in the card are borrowed MSSM/2HDM limits, and the model's charged, CP-even, and CP-odd scalar production and decay rates with the PQ singlet admixture have not been implemented in a recast chain.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the DFSZ scalar spectrum and Yukawa pattern (2HDM Type-II-like with PQ-singlet mixing) as effective-coupling input to HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals (HiggsTools), and validate against the paper's benchmark m_H+ and m_A regions before scanning.

members.model_name: Negative-m0-squared mSUGRA gravitino superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No public recast pipeline exists for the metastable charged-slepton collider signature: converting NLSP mass, lifetime (seconds to months), and production cross sections into detector-level highly-ionizing-track and time-of-flight yields requires HSCP efficiency modeling not packaged in standard recast tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published ATLAS/CMS heavy-stable-charged-particle search efficiency maps as a recast module (e.g. within CheckMATE or SModelS long-lived-particle results) fed by MadGraph/Pythia slepton production for the model's spectra.

members.model_name: Two-24 type III GMSB gravitino warm dark matter variant
members.description: No implemented collider recast maps the detector-stable stau NLSP benchmarks (tau_stau ~ 10^3-10^4 s) onto modern LHC heavy-stable-charged-particle and stopped-particle searches; the detector_recast step has no tool and no current exclusion is extracted.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the two-24 GMSB spectrum with SOFTSUSY/SPheno, compute stau production cross sections, and recast against ATLAS/CMS HSCP and stopped-particle analyses via SModelS long-lived-particle results or a CheckMATE/MadAnalysis implementation.

members.model_name: Spread Supersymmetry with wino LSP dark matter
members.description: No validated recast maps the spread-SUSY spectrum onto current LHC disappearing-track and displaced-gluino searches; the ~10 cm charged-wino and 0.1 mm-10 cm gluino decay lengths need experiment-specific long-lived-particle efficiency maps not fully available in public frameworks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track and displaced-vertex efficiency maps in a public LLP recast framework (CheckMATE/SModelS), generate spread-SUSY signal samples with MadGraph/Pythia including gluino cascades, and validate against published wino and gluino LLP exclusions.

members.model_name: Baryon-number-violating Majorana fermion dark matter
members.description: There is no model implementation (FeynRules/UFO) of the color-triplet scalars X_alpha with couplings X u^c chi and X* d^c d^c, so LHC monojet/monotop cross sections and existing-search recasts cannot be computed for the (m_X, lambda, lambda_prime) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules, export a UFO to MadGraph for monojet/monotop and pair-production signal generation, and recast the cited LHC missing-momentum searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 to produce exclusion contours in m_X versus couplings.

members.model_name: Top-philic Majorana dark matter with colored t-channel mediator
members.description: No public recast module covers long-lived colored-mediator (R-hadron) signatures with the detector-scale lifetimes arising in the small-coupling conversion-driven region, including the prompt/long-lived boundary.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the ATLAS/CMS R-hadron and heavy-stable-charged-particle search efficiency maps in SModelS-LLP or CheckMATE, with lifetime-dependent signal efficiencies interpolated across c-tau, and validate against the paper's 300 fb^-1 reach estimate.

members.model_name: Multipartite SU(2)_N freeze-in vector-boson dark matter
members.description: No collider UFO model or LLP recast exists for the long-lived charged and neutral eta states, so the charged-track and displaced-vertex signatures the FIMP realization predicts cannot be simulated or compared to LHC searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the SU(2)_N scalar sector, generate eta pair production with MadGraph+Pythia, and recast against existing HSCP and displaced-vertex searches using published efficiency maps in an LLP recasting framework such as MadAnalysis 5 or HackAnalysis.

members.model_name: Z2 Fraternal Twin Higgs right-handed twin tau WIMP
members.description: No implemented collider recast exists for the visible Y=2 charged scalar decaying to leptons; the card relies on HL-LHC projection statements from the paper, so current LHC limits and future reach cannot be evaluated per parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate charged-scalar pair production and leptonic decays in MadGraph from the FeynRules model of gap_1 and recast existing multilepton/slepton-like LHC searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, scanning the lepton-flavor coupling choices that control the branching fractions.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter with general neutralino NLSP
members.description: No collider recast capability exists for displaced or detector-stable neutralino NLSP decays to gravitinos with composition-dependent visible final states, so cosmologically allowed lifetime windows cannot be translated into LEP/LHC exclusions or prospects.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the long-lived neutralino-to-gravitino signature (displaced photons/Z/h plus missing energy) in an existing long-lived-particle recasting framework with published detector efficiency maps, scanning composition and m_3/2.

members.model_name: U(1) flavor symmetric vector-like fermion dark matter
members.description: No collider recast implementation exists for the model's charged and heavy neutral vector-like lepton states: the collider route has no tool, no signal simulation, and no mapping of LHC electroweakino/vector-like-lepton searches onto the (M1, M2, Delta M, theta_d) spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vector-like doublet-singlet spectrum in FeynRules/MadGraph, generate Drell-Yan pair-production samples of the charged and heavy neutral states, and recast current ATLAS/CMS slepton/electroweakino and disappearing-track searches (relevant for the compressed Delta M regime) using CheckMATE or MadAnalysis.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs complex scalar sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: The modified BdNMC routines used for dark-Higgs meson production and downstream visible decay in proton beam dumps (LSND, MiniBooNE, SBND, E137-like) are not public, so the long-lived dark-Higgs beam-dump yield cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the public BdNMC event generator with dark-Higgs production via dark bremsstrahlung/meson decays and the loop-induced S -> e+e- displaced decay, reproducing the paper's finding that existing proton beam dumps sit below the thermal target.

members.model_name: Light-dark-Higgs pseudo-Dirac sub-GeV dark matter
members.description: The modified BdNMC routines for dark-Higgs production and displaced visible decay in proton beam dumps are private, so the dark-Higgs long-lived-particle handle for the pseudo-Dirac branch cannot be recomputed with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend public BdNMC with dark-Higgs production channels and the loop-induced S -> e+e- displaced decay, and combine with a reinterpretation of NA64/BaBar/LDMX missing-momentum curves for invisible V -> chi_1 chi_1 (chi_2) decays including the mass splitting.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant U(1)_X singlet fermion dark matter
members.description: The collider route (invisible Higgs, h2 searches, triple-Higgs deviation, A_X production) has no implemented recast: scalar-mixing limits are translated only approximately in the paper and the route is marked planned with 'HiggsBounds-like scalar recast' listed as a required but absent resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-scalar effective couplings (theta^2-scaled h2 production, BR(h1->invisible)) in HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals and add the CMS invisible-Higgs and LHC ZZ resonance likelihoods, reproducing the paper's quoted theta^2 examples as validation.

members.model_name: STFM singlet FIMP with triplet next-to-lightest odd particle
members.description: No public recast pipeline covers the long-lived triplet NLOP collider signatures for this model: the disappearing-track exclusion is only quoted from the primary paper, and the MATHUSLA far-detector event yield requires production cross sections and a detector acceptance model not provided with the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the STFM in MadGraph and recast ATLAS/CMS disappearing-track searches (e.g. via SModelS or HackAnalysis efficiency maps) plus a MATHUSLA geometric-acceptance simulation, validating against the quoted 580 GeV charged-triplet exclusion.

members.model_name: STFM triplet WIMP with singlet-assisted nonthermal freeze-in
members.description: No public collider recast pipeline exists for the STFM charged-triplet disappearing-track signature; the 580 GeV exclusion is only quoted from the primary paper and cannot be re-evaluated for other parameter points or future luminosities.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement STFM triplet production in MadGraph and recast the ATLAS 136 fb^-1 disappearing-track search using published efficiency maps (e.g. via SModelS or HackAnalysis), validating against the quoted 580 GeV bound.

members.model_name: Gravity-mediated supersymmetric GUT neutralino LSP dark matter
members.description: Future 100 TeV collider coverage of the benchmark spectra is asserted only by comparing gluino masses to generic simplified-model reach curves; no detector-level recast exists for the model's actual gluino and electroweakino decay chains, whose Wino/Higgsino details the paper defers.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate the selected benchmark points with MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes at 100 TeV using the ISAJET spectra and decay tables, and validate the reach claim against published FCC-hh sparticle search projections.

members.model_name: Scalar-extended accidental composite dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists to recast collider and precision constraints: charged dark-partner production, leptoquark-like hybrid dark mesons, and LFV/CP amplitudes from dark Yukawa products have never been encoded for any public recasting framework.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the low-lying composite spectrum with its SM charges and Yukawa mixings, recast LHC long-lived/charged-particle and leptoquark searches via MadAnalysis or CheckMATE, and encode the LFV/CP amplitudes in a flavor code such as flavio for coupling-product limits.

members.model_name: Approximate-PQ electroweak supersymmetry with singlino LSP dark matter
members.description: The approximate-PQ singlet model (S H1 H2 superpotential with pseudo-Goldstone G and singlino LSP) is not implemented in any public spectrum generator or collider recast chain, so LEP/LHC cascade and exotic-Higgs constraints can only be borrowed qualitatively from related NMSSM studies.
members.proposed_resolution: Build the model in SARAH/SPheno (or adapt NMSSMTools to the approximate-PQ coupling limit) to generate spectra and branching ratios, then recast LEP and LHC searches with CheckMATE/SModelS for the extra singlet cascade stage and light-scalar decays.

members.model_name: Next-to-minimal supergravity-motivated neutralino dark matter
members.description: No implemented LHC recast covers the NmSuGra collider-reach observable: existing simplified-model recast databases (SModelS/CheckMATE) are MSSM-oriented and only partially cover NMSSM spectra with singlino admixture, and no recast for these benchmarks is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Pass NMSSMTools spectra through SModelS for simplified-model coverage and supplement singlino-enriched cascade topologies with dedicated CheckMATE/MadAnalysis recasts of Run-2 electroweakino and squark/gluino searches.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric scalar N1 cogenesis dark matter model
members.description: No collider implementation of the X-sector exists: there is no UFO/SLHA model file for the iso-singlet color-triplet X, Xbar states with baryon-number-carrying decays, so LHC colored-particle searches cannot be recast onto (M_X, lambda_i, lambda_prime_ij).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the X superfield sector and recast modern LHC colored-particle and dijet-resonance searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5, scanning M_X and the decay topology assumptions flagged in con_colored_mediator_lhc.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn scotogenic mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: No collider model implementation (Lagrangian-level model file plus cross-section/branching grid) exists for the heavy KSVZ quark and the scotogenic Z2-odd colored/scalar sector, so LHC missing-energy searches cannot be recast onto this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the KSVZ quark plus Z2-odd sector, generate pair-production and decay events with MadGraph plus Pythia, and reinterpret existing squark-like and leptoquark jets-plus-MET searches with a recast tool such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis.

members.model_name: Asymptotically safe triplet minimal dark matter
members.description: No recast implementation of the CMS 13 TeV disappearing-track search with full tracker acceptance exists for the N_F-copy triplet (chargino-like) signature; the primary exclusion M_DM < 620 GeV for N_F > 20 was obtained without rerunning the acceptance.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the CMS disappearing-track analysis in a public recast framework (CheckMATE or HackAnalysis) with the triplet charged-neutral splitting and lifetime, scale production by N_F, and re-derive the exclusion including full-Run-2 luminosity.

members.model_name: SU(6)/SO(6) composite pNGB singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: The dark-top-partner top-plus-MET constraint relies on SUSY stop-search limits whose production cross sections and branching fractions differ from this model; no model-specific LHC recast has been performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate T pair production and T -> t S decays with MadGraph5 using the gap_1 model files and recast ATLAS/CMS stop searches via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 to obtain model-specific exclusions in the (m_T, m_S, theta_L) plane.

members.model_name: DFSZ axion-Higgs model with small singlet-doublet coupling
members.description: The PQ-constrained 2HDM scalar sector with the small singlet-doublet coupling regime is not implemented in any spectrum/collider-constraint tool, so the heavy-Higgs indirect probe cannot be confronted with LHC Higgs data (card lists 'LHC Higgs-sector likelihood unavailable').
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the PQ-restricted 2HDM potential (with the singlet-decoupling relations of the small-c regime) as a 2HDMC or ScannerS model variant and pass the spectrum through HiggsTools (HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals) for the collider likelihood.

members.model_name: Dynamical R-parity breaking SUSYLR unstable gravitino dark matter
members.description: The displaced-vertex collider observable has no dedicated forward-model step or recast: no tool maps the SUSYLR spectrum and |U| ~ 1e-6 to 1e-7 mixing to NLSP decay lengths and modern LHC displaced-vertex search sensitivity.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute NLSP production and decay lengths for benchmark SUSYLR spectra and recast ATLAS/CMS displaced-vertex and long-lived-particle analyses using a CheckMATE/MadAnalysis LLP implementation.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric U(1)' hylogenesis antibaryon dark matter
members.description: No model implementation (e.g. UFO) of the vector-like color-triplet and X baryon-transfer mediators exists for collider recasting, and the mapping from monojet/dijet limits to the hylogenesis operator depends on unmodeled SUSY-breaking insertions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mediator sector in FeynRules/UFO, generate signals in MadGraph, and recast modern ATLAS/CMS monojet and vector-like-quark searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis, including the SUSY-breaking operator-generation dependence as an explicit parameter.

members.model_name: Scalar singlet-triplet Z2 dark matter model
members.description: No event-level collider implementation or LHC recast exists for the S2/S+- electroweak cascade signatures, so the collider observable (relaxed scenarios with splittings above the W threshold) cannot be evaluated beyond kinematic classification.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the model UFO, simulate pp production of S+S- and S2S+ with MadGraph plus Pythia, and recast LHC electroweakino/compressed-spectrum searches with a public recast framework (CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5) over the (m_1, Delta_21, Delta_c1, theta) space.

members.model_name: Complex singlet scalar model with stable pseudoscalar A dark matter
members.description: The one-loop electroweak correction to the h125 -> AA invisible width (few-percent effect, needed as LHC invisible-width precision improves) exists only as the authors' private FeynArts/FeynCalc/LoopTools implementation with model-specific counterterms and renormalization schemes; no released code reproduces the NLO widths.
members.proposed_resolution: Release the CxSM NLO invisible-width calculation as a public package (e.g. integrate it into the ewN-style NLO tools built on the same FeynArts/FeynCalc/LoopTools chain, or publish the model files and counterterm definitions), validated by reproducing the paper's few-percent correction factors in scenarios I and II.

members.model_name: SU(6)/Sp(6) composite pNGB complex singlet dark matter with dark top partners
members.description: The dark-top-partner top-plus-MET constraint relies on SUSY stop-search limits whose production cross sections and branching fractions differ from this model; no model-specific LHC recast has been performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate T pair production and T -> t S decays with MadGraph5 using the gap_1 model files and recast ATLAS/CMS stop searches via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 to obtain model-specific exclusions in the (m_T, m_S, theta_L) plane.

members.model_name: Muon-specific real scalar dark matter in a modular A4 hidden U(1)_H quark-lepton model
members.description: No model implementation (FeynRules/UFO) or completed recast exists for the charged mediator E decaying to muon plus scalar DM, so the slepton-like mu + missing-transverse-momentum constraint on the O(100 GeV) relic/g-2 region cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO model of the E-phi_u_R sector, generate Drell-Yan E+E- production with MadGraph5, and recast the ATLAS/CMS slepton searches implemented in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis 5, scanning the (m_E, m_phi) plane including the compressed splitting region below about 50 GeV.

members.model_name: Vector-like quark color-superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No dedicated collider/flavor recast exists for low-mass electroweak-singlet vector-like quarks with suppressed visible mixing or nonstandard decays; standard LHC VLQ limits assume ordinary decay channels and the batch did not digitize the mass-limit tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the electroweak-singlet VLQ model in MadGraph/FeynRules and recast LHC VLQ and long-lived/hidden-decay searches with MadAnalysis or CheckMATE, combined with CKM-unitarity and FCNC constraints via a flavor-fit package (e.g. flavio/smelli), as a function of m_VLQ and mixing.

members.model_name: MSSM bino-smuon/selectron co-annihilation dark matter with decoupled staus
members.description: No collider recast implementation is identified for the compressed bino-smuon/selectron spectra (Delta m ~ 20 GeV): the route lists a 'collider recast framework' as required, but no tool covering LHC/LEP compressed electroweak slepton/chargino searches for this scenario is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum slepton and electroweakino search regions in a public recast tool (SModelS, CheckMATE, or MadAnalysis5 PAD) and validate against the exclusion filters quoted in arXiv:2104.03290.

members.model_name: MSSM bino-stau co-annihilation dark matter with universal slepton masses
members.description: No collider recast implementation is identified for the compressed bino-stau spectra (Delta m ~ 15 GeV): the route lists a 'collider recast framework' as required, but no tool covering LHC/LEP compressed stau/slepton/chargino searches for this scenario is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum stau and electroweakino search regions in a public recast tool (SModelS, CheckMATE, or MadAnalysis5 PAD) and validate against the exclusion filters quoted in arXiv:2104.03290.

members.model_name: MSSM bino-wino co-annihilation dark matter
members.description: No collider recast implementation is identified for the compressed bino-wino spectra (Delta m ~ 10-30 GeV): the route lists a 'collider recast framework' as required, but no tool covering LHC/LEP compressed wino-like chargino/neutralino searches (soft leptons, disappearing-track-adjacent topologies) for this scenario is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relevant ATLAS/CMS compressed electroweakino search regions in a public recast tool (SModelS, CheckMATE, or MadAnalysis5 PAD) and validate against the exclusion filters quoted in arXiv:2104.03290.

members.model_name: SU(5) non-universal gaugino-mass neutralino dark matter
members.description: No implemented modern-LHC analysis exists for the model's characteristic heavy-Higgs-in-SUSY-cascade signature (chi_2 -> chi_1 + H/A/h from squark/gluino cascades); the source projections are pre-LHC-era and the s3 simulation step names no concrete framework or Run-2 backgrounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate benchmark representation-24 and mixed-representation points with MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes and recast Run-2 ATLAS/CMS H/A -> bb and tau tau plus missing-energy cascade searches in CheckMATE or MadAnalysis to obtain current sensitivity.

members.model_name: Hylogenesis antibaryonic dark matter with induced nucleon decay
members.description: No collider recast exists for the neutron-portal operator: the card lists monojet missing-energy signatures as a constraint target but records no exclusion table, no likelihood, and notes that a simplified-model recast is needed when mediator masses X1, X2 approach collider energies.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutron-portal operator X u^c d^c d^c and the explicit heavy Dirac mediator realization as a UFO model, generate monojet plus missing-energy signals in MadGraph, and recast against ATLAS/CMS monojet analyses with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 to produce limits on M versus dark-state masses.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 374345: gravitino superwimp
members.description: The paper-era LHC search pipeline for this benchmark (custom ATLAS implementations on PYTHIA/PGS with Prospino K-factors), including the lepton-rich colored-sparticle cascades with a detector-stable sneutrino NLSP, is private and built on the obsolete PGS simulation, so the collider status cannot be reproduced or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark spectrum in a modern public framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with Delphes, implementing current multi-lepton plus missing-energy searches alongside the paper-era ATLAS analyses.

members.model_name: Minimal SUSY SO(10) benchmark with bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: The compressed bino-smuon spectrum (small LSP-NLSP splitting required for co-annihilation) is poorly covered by the simplified-model recast the paper used (SModelS 1.0.4); a dedicated recast against soft-lepton and compressed-electroweakino LHC searches is needed to evaluate the collider observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 against ATLAS/CMS compressed-spectrum slepton and electroweakino searches (soft dilepton plus missing-energy analyses), which are implemented in those frameworks for exactly this mass-degenerate regime.

members.model_name: Techni-Pati-Salam semi-integer-baryon-number composite dark matter
members.description: No model implementation exists for collider recasting of the heavy exotic-baryon-number states: the paper gives only qualitative cascade final states (top, bottom, lepton plus the stable dark state), with no spectrum-dependent event-generator model or recast of LHC heavy-resonance searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a simplified-model FeynRules/UFO implementation of the exotic composite states and their PC4F-induced decays (with masses and couplings from the lattice spectrum once available), generate events with MadGraph, and recast existing LHC heavy-resonance and missing-energy searches with MadAnalysis or CheckMATE.

members.model_name: Mixed moduli-anomaly mediated MSSM with nonthermal neutral-Higgsino dark matter
members.description: Modern collider status of the light stop plus nearly degenerate Higgsino spectrum cannot be evaluated because public recast tools only partially cover compressed-Higgsino signatures (soft dileptons, disappearing tracks) and no implemented recast exists for this model's spectrum (route step s4 has null tool_or_code).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model's stop and Higgsino simplified spectra in an existing recast framework (e.g. add the relevant ATLAS/CMS soft-lepton and disappearing-track analyses to CheckMATE or use SModelS compressed-electroweakino results), scanning M0, mu, and m_stop1 over the natural range.

members.model_name: axino LSP superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No concrete collider recast exists for the long-lived charged-slepton NLSP trapping signature: the stopped-particle yield and delayed-decay distribution that would identify the axino LSP are discussed only qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing LHC HSCP search efficiencies and stopping-power simulations for the slepton mass-lifetime plane in an LLP recasting framework, adding a trap-geometry acceptance calculation for the delayed-decay measurement.

members.model_name: Asymmetric inelastic dark QED with dark muonium
members.description: The fixed-target reach for the heavier mu_D state is currently only routing guidance: the related coannihilation fixed-target framework was built for a different spectrum, and no recast maps its production and visible-decay yields onto the two-flavor dark-QED benchmark with splitting Delta.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the arXiv:1703.06881 inelastic/coannihilation fixed-target formalism to this model's masses and off-diagonal coupling, computing epsilon-dependent production and mu_D visible-decay yields for existing and planned electron and proton beam-dump experiments, and validate against the related paper's published reach.

members.model_name: Secretly asymmetric lepton-flavored dark matter with a scalar annihilator
members.description: No collider recast exists for the flavored scalar mediator: the card marks the constraint recast_required with a heavy-m_phi benchmark but no UFO/model implementation, mediator spectrum, or flavor branching fractions, so LHC lepton-plus-missing-energy limits cannot be mapped onto (m_phi, lambda, flavor alignment).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO implementation of the three-flavor chi plus phi plus S sector, generate events with MadGraph, and recast slepton-like dilepton-plus-MET and mono-lepton searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis for a grid of mediator spectra and flavor alignments.

members.model_name: Three-24 type III GMSB gravitino cold dark matter
members.description: No implemented collider recast maps the detector-stable stau NLSP (tau_stau ~ 10^3-10^4 s) of this GMSB spectrum onto modern LHC heavy-stable-charged-particle and stopped-particle searches; the card's llp_recast step has no tool and no modern exclusion is extracted.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the type III GMSB spectrum with a public SUSY spectrum calculator (SOFTSUSY/SPheno), compute stau production cross sections, and recast against ATLAS/CMS HSCP and stopped-particle analyses via SModelS long-lived-particle results or a CheckMATE/MadAnalysis implementation.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 2342344: bino squark coannihilation
members.description: The collider-evaluation chain for this benchmark is not publicly reusable: the paper-era ATLAS 7/8 TeV search selections were implemented in private author code on top of PYTHIA/PGS, and the modified SUSY-HIT decay setup is likewise not released, so the compressed-squark-plus-1.3-TeV-gluino collider observable cannot be re-run from the card's resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the benchmark point from its published SLHA spectrum with public SOFTSUSY plus SUSY-HIT and evaluate it in a public recasting framework (CheckMATE, MadAnalysis 5, or SModelS) covering paper-era and current compressed-spectrum squark and gluino searches.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 2387564: bino a funnel
members.description: The collider-evaluation chain for this benchmark is not publicly reusable: the paper-era ATLAS 7/8 TeV search selections were implemented in private author code on top of PYTHIA/PGS, and the modified SUSY-HIT decay setup is likewise not released, so the 1.4 TeV squark plus heavy-Higgs collider observable cannot be re-run from the card's resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Rebuild the benchmark point from its published SLHA spectrum with public SOFTSUSY plus SUSY-HIT and evaluate it in a public recasting framework (CheckMATE, MadAnalysis 5, or SModelS) covering paper-era and current squark searches and heavy-Higgs (A -> tau tau) searches relevant to the funnel mediator.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 2750334: well tempered bino higgsino
members.description: The paper-era LHC search pipeline for this benchmark (custom ATLAS search implementations on PYTHIA/PGS with Prospino K-factors) is private and built on the obsolete PGS detector simulation, so the collider status of the electroweak-dominated 2750334 spectrum cannot be reproduced or updated.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the benchmark spectrum (from the published SLHA files) in a modern public recasting framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis5 with Delphes, implementing current electroweakino and slepton searches alongside the paper-era analyses.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 401479: bino stop coannihilation
members.description: The paper-era LHC search implementations (2012 ATLAS selections in PYTHIA/PGS plus custom author code) that validated this benchmark are private, so the compressed bino-stop collider topology cannot be re-evaluated or updated against modern data from the card alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the paper-era ATLAS analyses, and add modern compressed-stop searches, in a public recasting framework such as MadAnalysis5, CheckMATE, or SModelS, using the benchmark spectrum from SOFTSUSY plus SUSY-HIT decays.

members.model_name: Two-state inelastic self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The cosmological excited-state abundance f_excited is assumed (near 1) rather than computed: the card flags excited-state survival under early-universe down-scattering as an unsolved model-building requirement, leaving the simulations' key initial condition uncalculated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the coupled Boltzmann network for psi1/psi2 with the Yukawa-mediated up/down-scattering and annihilation rates, tracking f_excited(z) from the nonthermal parent-decay production through recombination, to map (Delta/m_chi, alpha, m_mediator, production history) onto the simulation initial state fractions.

members.model_name: Type-I non-degenerate 2HDM+a dark matter benchmark model
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent direct-detection cross section for pseudoscalar-mediated Dirac DM in the type-I 2HDM+a is not implemented in any tool linked from the card, so the direct-detection leg of the complementarity observable cannot be evaluated numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive (or adapt from the existing 2HDM+a loop literature) the one-loop SI scattering amplitude for the type-I Yukawa structure, implement it as a micrOMEGAs/MadDM extension for the Pseudoscalar_2HDMI model, and couple the output to DDCalc-style experimental likelihoods.

members.model_name: Radiative Dirac seesaw singlet-doublet Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The right-handed-neutrino Delta N_eff is computed only in the instantaneous-decoupling approximation; no momentum-averaged Boltzmann treatment of the Dirac-neutrino decoupling through the inert-doublet-mediated interactions has been done for this model, which shifts the predicted Delta N_eff at the precision level targeted by SPT-3G/CMB-S4.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the number-density Boltzmann equation for the right-handed neutrinos with the model's Y_Nl-mediated collision rates (following the treatment of arXiv:2103.05648 cited by the card), tracking the dark-sector-to-photon temperature ratio through SM entropy transfers to obtain Delta N_eff beyond instantaneous decoupling.

members.model_name: Winding string freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The abundance calculation is derived only under near-instantaneous reheating; no derivation of the freeze-in yield for extended reheating histories exists, so the mapping between the CMB tensor bound on H_i and the allowed parameter band cannot be evaluated away from that assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the freeze-in yield during a matter-dominated reheating phase with general T_max > T_rh (standard UV freeze-in techniques), parameterized by (H_i, T_rh, inflaton equation of state), and propagate it into the tensor-bound filter.

members.model_name: Spin-2 portal fermion freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in momentum distribution f(p) of X produced during reheating is not derived (the card records distribution_function_available: no and all structure-formation entries unknown), so whether light-m_X regions behave as warm rather than cold dark matter cannot be assessed.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f(p,T) with the spin-2 production collision term over the reheating history, extract the free-streaming length as a function of (m_X, m_G, Lambda, T_RH, T_max), and map onto the standard thermal-WDM transfer-function bound.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Nelson-Barr gravitino LSP dark matter
members.description: The gravitino momentum distribution f(q) from decay and inverse-decay production during the low-reheating inflaton-oscillation era has not been derived; only an integrated abundance formula exists, so the free-streaming constraint relies on an unvalidated thermal-WDM equivalence.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation for gravitino production from MSSM superparticle decays and inverse decays through reheating (T_RH below m_soft), obtaining f(q) as a function of m_3/2, T_RH, and T_dec,3/2.

members.model_name: QCD-like dark-pion forbidden dark matter model
members.description: The dark-baryon relic contribution is only a QCD-scaling estimate; no nonperturbative calculation of dark-baryon annihilation for the N_c=3 dark sector exists, leaving the second dark-matter component's abundance uncontrolled.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark-baryon annihilation cross section with a nonperturbative treatment (rearrangement/bound-state formation modeled on QCD baryon-antibaryon data rescaled to Lambda_d, or a dedicated lattice estimate) and add it to the freeze-out network.
