members.model_name: Compressed-stau No-Scale F-SU(5) bino neutralino dark matter
members.description: The compressed benchmarks thermally underproduce the relic density and invoke late moduli decay to restore it, but the card provides no quantitative moduli-decay cosmology (decay temperature, branching to neutralinos, entropy production), so the relic-density consistency and the rescaling of indirect rates for subcomponent scenarios cannot be evaluated (con_fs5_relic has likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and implement a late-moduli-decay Boltzmann module (parameterized by moduli mass, reheat temperature, and neutralino branching fraction) coupled to the MicrOMEGAs freeze-out output, and scan it against the Planck relic target for the compressed 0-2 GeV mass-gap benchmarks.

members.model_name: Minimal U(1)' strictly anomaly-mediated wino LSP dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal wino abundance from gravitino decay is computed with an approximate yield formula carrying explicit gamma_G uncertainty and no treatment of wino reannihilation (with Sommerfeld-corrected cross sections) at the gravitino decay epoch, which broadens the quoted m_3/2 100-430 TeV all-dark-matter band.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled gravitino-wino Boltzmann system numerically, using the modern thermal gravitino production rate to pin down gamma_G and including Sommerfeld-enhanced wino annihilation during and after gravitino decay, to replace the analytic band with a calibrated relic-density surface over (m_3/2, T_rh, q_L).

members.model_name: SU(3)_D triple-Higgs dark matter with vector bound states
members.description: Sommerfeld enhancement and radiative bound-state-formation cross sections have not been derived for this model's specific structure (three nearly degenerate psi_i species interacting through a massive non-Abelian V8 with all other dark gluons heavy); only a related published calculation for a different gauge structure exists as a recast target.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the published unbroken-mediator BSF formalism (arXiv:1604.01776-type) to the massive-V8 Yukawa potential with the psi_i multiplet structure, deriving velocity-dependent Sommerfeld factors and capture cross sections, and package them as a module usable in both freeze-out and halo-annihilation calculations.

members.model_name: Two-dark-vector DSMEFT/DLEFT dark matter
members.description: Hadronic-level production rates for freeze-in at low reheating temperatures are unresolved: the card notes that matching the DSMEFT operators onto hadronic states near and below the QCD scale has not been carried out, leaving the relic curve uncertain for low T_RH.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the DLEFT-to-chiral-perturbation-theory matching for the triple-field-strength operators (photon-photon-dark and hadronic channels) and add the resulting collision terms to the freeze-in integration for T_RH near or below the QCD phase transition.

members.model_name: Framed Standard Model hidden-sector dark matter candidates
members.description: The relic abundance of framonic C-ons is entirely qualitative: no production mechanism calculation (thermal history, composite formation, decay chains) exists, so the candidates cannot be assigned a predicted abundance or momentum distribution for any cosmological comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hidden-sector thermal history and freeze-out/formation abundance of the lightest neutral C-ons (including hidden confinement and binary composite formation), producing an Omega h^2 estimate and phase-space distribution as functions of zeta_S and the mixing portal strength.

members.model_name: Dark 't Hooft-Polyakov monopole dark matter from first-order SU(2)_D phase transition
members.description: Monopole-antimonopole annihilation after production is not modeled, so in the large-production-rate regime the number-density estimate can substantially overpredict the surviving monopole abundance (the card flags this omission with high extrapolation risk).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the diffusive-capture monopole-antimonopole annihilation Boltzmann equation (Zeldovich-Khlopov/Preskill style) in the dark-sector plasma with U(1)_D long-range interactions, and apply it as a post-processing correction to the bubble-collision yield.

members.model_name: Vector Scotogenic HNL dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in boundary regime, where the relic abundance is produced by vector-doublet decays at large mass splitting, has no coupled Boltzmann treatment; the card flags that this requires going beyond the standard freeze-out calculation, leaving relic predictions in the separated-mass regime unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the vector-doublet and HNL number densities across the freeze-out/freeze-in transition, e.g. using micrOMEGAs' freeze-in mode extended with the vector-decay term, and map the boundary in the (Delta M, lambda_l) plane.

members.model_name: Thermal-effects freeze-in sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Production above the electroweak crossover via 2-to-2 scatterings is not computed (the paper's thermal decay-rate treatment applies only below T_SSB about 160 GeV), leaving the high-temperature contribution to the abundance and spectrum of heavy-HNL scenarios undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the symmetric-phase 2-to-2 and 1-to-2 production rates (following established thermal leptogenesis/HNL rate calculations at T > T_SSB) and add them to the same freeze-in solver so the abundance is complete across the crossover.

members.model_name: Composite pNGB dark matter from vacuum-misalignment asymmetry
members.description: The cosmological evolution through the vacuum-realignment transition (finite-temperature vacuum rotation, X-asymmetry washout, and transfer into the Z2-odd pNGBs) is deferred by the primary paper, so the relic density is only a mechanistic estimate with no quantitative thermal-history calculation for the SU(6)/Sp(6) template.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the finite-temperature effective potential of the template model (e.g. with CosmoTransitions-style tooling for the pNGB potential), solve the coupled asymmetry-transfer Boltzmann equations across T_HL to T_*, and publish the resulting Omega_DM(f, M_DM, lambda, T_HL) map.

members.model_name: d_R t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent DM-nucleon cross section for a Majorana singlet coupled to right-handed down-type quarks via a colored scalar is not implemented in the model's pipeline; the card notes the NLO direct-detection recast (per arXiv:2010.07559) was not rerun, and only tree-level spin-dependent scattering is trivially available.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive/port the one-loop (and NLO QCD) Wilson coefficients for sigma_SI in the d_R t-channel model from arXiv:2010.07559 and implement them in micrOMEGAs or DDCalc so that g_DM fixed by the SE/BSF relic calculation maps directly onto current xenon-experiment limits.

members.model_name: q_L t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent DM-nucleon cross section for a Majorana singlet coupled to left-handed quark doublets via a colored scalar doublet is not implemented in the model's pipeline; the card notes the NLO direct-detection recast (per arXiv:2010.07559) was not rerun, so robust sigma_SI limits cannot be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive/port the one-loop (and NLO QCD) Wilson coefficients for sigma_SI in the q_L t-channel model from arXiv:2010.07559 and implement them in micrOMEGAs or DDCalc so that g_DM fixed by the SE/BSF relic calculation maps directly onto current xenon-experiment limits.

members.model_name: u_R t-channel colored co-annihilation Majorana dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent DM-nucleon cross section for a Majorana singlet coupled to right-handed up-type quarks via a colored scalar is not implemented in the model's pipeline; the card notes the NLO direct-detection recast (per arXiv:2010.07559) was not rerun, so robust sigma_SI limits cannot be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive/port the one-loop (and NLO QCD) Wilson coefficients for sigma_SI in the u_R t-channel model from arXiv:2010.07559 and implement them in micrOMEGAs or DDCalc so that g_DM fixed by the SE/BSF relic calculation maps directly onto current xenon-experiment limits.

members.model_name: Gravitational-anomaly neutrino-condensate cold dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No calculation of the condensation dynamics after the meV phase transition: whether relic neutrinos bind, form a superfluid, or annihilate into Goldstones, and the resulting cold-neutrino fraction f_nu_cold and phase-space distribution (the card records distribution_function_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the post-transition Boltzmann/condensation equations for relic neutrinos with the Goldstone coupling g, solving for the bound-state vs superfluid vs annihilation outcome as a function of (Lambda_G, m_1, g), and output f_nu_cold and a momentum distribution for the cold component.

members.model_name: B-L charged scalar dark matter triggering nucleon decay
members.description: The relic abundance for this interaction-dominance scenario is not computed (calculation_type unknown): the freeze-out or freeze-in yield through the higher-dimensional B/L operators is missing, so the local DM flux normalizing the induced-decay rate is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermal history for the benchmark operators of gap_1 (freeze-out if couplings allow equilibrium, otherwise freeze-in), e.g. by implementing the operators in micrOMEGAs to obtain Omega h^2 and the allowed DM fraction versus (m_chi, Lambda).

members.model_name: cosmological wetting transition scalar dark matter
members.description: The spontaneous-baryogenesis claim is qualitative: no transport/Boltzmann calculation converts the phi-dot baryon-current chemical potential into a predicted baryon asymmetry, so the baryogenesis observable cannot be evaluated or the coupling constrained.
members.proposed_resolution: Set up the standard spontaneous-baryogenesis calculation for this potential: specify the B-violating interaction and its rate, solve the chemical-potential-biased Boltzmann equation through the phi evolution, and express eta_B as a function of the derivative coupling and thermal history.

members.model_name: Remnant-Z2 Majorana dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: Delta N_eff = 0.39 rests on an assumed instantaneous Goldstone decoupling just before muon annihilation (g_star = 57/4); no actual Goldstone decoupling calculation from the model's collision terms exists, so Delta N_eff is not predicted as a function of model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the eta-SM elastic and annihilation collision rates through the mixed scalars, solve the Goldstone temperature evolution (a momentum-integrated Boltzmann equation is sufficient) to obtain the decoupling temperature as a function of theta, m_rho, and v_phi, and map the result to Delta N_eff(theta, m_rho, v_phi) for CMB comparison.

members.model_name: U(1)H-stabilized superheavy WIMPZILLA with dark radiation
members.description: The specific nonthermal WIMPZILLA production channel setting the 1e12-1e14 GeV relic abundance is not calculated in the paper or represented on the card, so the superheavy relic abundance cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the relic abundance for a concrete production mechanism (gravitational production at the end of inflation or preheating, following Chung-Kolb-Riotto-style calculations) as a function of m_DM and the reheating temperature, and add it as an explicit route step.

members.model_name: Inflationary dark matter in the luminogenesis model
members.description: The luminogenesis abundance chain — inflaton decay to the 20 representation, dark asymmetry generation, conversion of a fraction to luminous matter, and freeze-out of the symmetric component through the U(1)_DM dark photon — is asserted but not implemented as a quantitative Boltzmann calculation, so the predicted dark/luminous ratio cannot be checked.
members.proposed_resolution: Write down and solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for inflaton decay, dark-to-luminous conversion via the scalar 15 fields, and dark-photon-mediated annihilation of the symmetric component, verifying Omega_DM/Omega_b against the observed ratio as a function of M_DUT and mu_DM.

members.model_name: Higgs Parity mirror-electron dark matter
members.description: The viable relic abundance relies on non-thermal production from an unspecified inflaton/parent decay with suppressed mirror up-quark branching; no quantitative Boltzmann calculation of the e_prime yield, the mirror-baryon fraction, and the T_RH < m_u_prime/40 condition exists beyond order-of-magnitude estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a benchmark parent-decay model and derive the coupled Boltzmann equations for parent decay, mirror-electron yield, and mirror-QCD hadron production as functions of (T_RH, B_e_prime, m_u_prime), producing a reusable analytic abundance formula with quantified mirror-baryon contamination.

members.model_name: Gauged B-L decaying Majoron dark matter
members.description: The I3 relic abundance entering the abundance-lifetime-VEV mapping rests on an assumed freeze-out temperature near the top-quark mass rather than a solved Boltzmann freeze-out in the gauged B-L model, and the thermal-equilibrium history of I3 with the SM bath is itself marked unknown, so Omega_I3(v_D, v_M) carries an uncontrolled systematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the gauged B-L scalar and right-handed-neutrino sector in a relic-density code such as micrOMEGAs (model files via FeynRules/CalcHEP) and solve the I3 freeze-out/freeze-in explicitly across the (v_D, v_M) plane, replacing the fixed freeze-out-temperature ansatz.

members.model_name: SU(3) x U(1) ten-plet accident dark matter
members.description: The multi-component relic-density calculation for the six degenerate accident scalars, including semi-annihilation and coannihilation channels induced by the remnant U(1)_3 x U(1)_8 gauge interactions and the possible Higgs portal, has not been derived; the paper only asserts the SU(3) analysis is analogous to the SU(2) five-plet case.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full set of (semi-)annihilation and coannihilation cross sections for the ten-plet accident multiplet and implement the coupled multi-species Boltzmann system in micrOMEGAs (which supports multi-component setups and semi-annihilation) via a LanHEP/FeynRules model file for the SU(3) x U(1) scalar sector.

members.model_name: EZSSM bino dark matter with inert-Higgsino up-scattering
members.description: Standard coannihilation codes assume chemical equilibrium among the bino and inert Higgsinos, but here the relic density hinges on whether Z-mediated inelastic up-scattering off the SM bath stays efficient through freeze-out; no derived coupled-Boltzmann treatment tracking the bino and inert-Higgsino number densities separately with explicit up-scattering rates is available to test the card's mass-splitting window.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the coupled Boltzmann system with explicit bino-to-inert-Higgsino up-scattering collision terms (as a function of Delta m and R_Z12) alongside the coannihilation terms, e.g. as a custom module layered on micrOMEGAs output, and map where the standard equilibrium approximation breaks down across the splitting window.

members.model_name: Randall-Sundrum bulk-scalar oscillating dark matter
members.description: Zero-mode dominance is only argued qualitatively: no numerical calculation of the inflationary excitation and post-inflation relic abundance of the TeV-scale Kaluza-Klein tower exists, leaving the rs_kk_mode_suppression validity condition unverified across the warp-factor range.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the mode-by-mode evolution of the lowest KK scalars through inflation and reheating, including their brane-induced inflationary masses and stronger Higgs couplings, to compute their relic densities and delimit the (g5, kL, H_inf) region where the zero mode dominates.

members.model_name: Z2-odd fermion dark matter annihilating to Majorana sterile neutrinos
members.description: The one-loop Higgs-portal operators generated by lambda_H and y_chi (scaling as lambda_H^2 y_chi^4) have not been derived for this model, so the spin-independent nucleon cross section and Higgs invisible width cannot be evaluated and the direct-detection/invisible-Higgs recast cannot produce exclusion curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the one-loop matching of the chi-chi-Higgs effective operator following the cited similar-model calculation, then feed the resulting Wilson coefficient into standard direct-detection recast tools (DDCalc or the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module) and current Higgs invisible-width limits.

members.model_name: Near-continuum Z-portal dark matter
members.description: The cosmological production mechanism and relic abundance of the near-continuum scalar modes are not computed for this variant; the paper assumes the modes form cold dark matter, leaving the per-state abundance distribution across the spectral density undetermined and blocking any late-decay or halo-signal normalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the gapped-continuum freeze-out formalism from the earlier Continuum Dark Matter papers (2105.07035/2105.14023) to the regulated near-continuum spectral density and Z-portal coupling, deriving the relic abundance and its distribution over states above the gap.

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric techni-baryon dark matter from technicolor assisted leptogenesis
members.description: The asymmetry transfer is an illustrative minimal chemical-potential estimate; no coupled Boltzmann treatment of the CP-violating ultra-heavy Higgs decays, washout, and sphaleron freeze-out near T_c exists to establish whether the required 1e-2 asymmetry suppression for TeV-scale m_S is actually realized.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the full network of Boltzmann equations for H_1 decays, lepton and technibaryon asymmetries, and sphaleron redistribution across the electroweak crossover, adapting an existing leptogenesis solver (e.g. ULYSSES) with added technibaryon chemical potentials.

members.model_name: Composite accidental QCD axion
members.description: No calculation exists for the relic abundance of the accidentally stable composite baryons of the confining SU(N_c) sector (and post-inflationary defect network evolution), so the cosmological viability flag of step s4 can only be evaluated qualitatively outside the pre-inflationary low-reheating branch.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the confinement-scale freeze-out abundance of the composite dark baryons for representative SU(N_c) choices (extending standard freeze-out machinery such as micrOMEGAs-style Boltzmann solving with dark-confinement cross sections), and specify the T_RH dilution condition as a function of f_PQ.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) inflaton-scalar dark matter unification
members.description: The reheating history through the metastable Z2-breaking vacuum is only sketched (details deferred; validity entry marks high extrapolation risk), so the reheating temperature and the consistency of the inflaton-to-dark-matter handoff are not calculable from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the inflaton decay rate through the metastable Z2-breaking vacuum, solve the coupled inflaton-radiation Boltzmann equations for T_reh, and verify Z2 restoration after reheating; this also fixes the e-fold number N feeding the n_s and r predictions.

members.model_name: Z2-breaking complex singlet pseudo-Goldstone scalar dark matter
members.description: In the pseudo-Goldstone cancellation region the tree-level spin-independent cross section that micrOMEGAs returns is not the physical prediction: the surviving rate comes from one-loop and momentum-suppressed contributions, so XENON1T comparisons near a_1 -> 0 are unreliable without the loop-level amplitude for this Z2-breaking variant.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the published one-loop pseudo-Goldstone dark-matter sigma_SI calculations (developed for the symmetric complex-singlet model) to include the a_1 soft-breaking term, and add the resulting effective DM-nucleon coupling to the micrOMEGAs direct-detection module.

members.model_name: Lepton-number asymmetric dark matter with gamma-ray triangles
members.description: No quantitative asymmetric-relic calculation links the assumed asymmetry eta_DM and the annihilation cross section to N_D pairs to the residual antiparticle fraction, so the ADM consistency constraint (adm_relic_asymmetry_requirement) and the indirect-flux normalization rest on an unverified assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled asymmetric freeze-out Boltzmann equations (following the standard asymmetric-WIMP framework already cited by the card) for this model's DM DM -> N_D N_D cross section, mapping which (eta_DM, f, m_DM, m_S) combinations leave the particle component dominant at the observed abundance.

members.model_name: Scalar-extended accidental composite dark matter
members.description: The dark-glueball and metastable dark-meson cosmology (lifetimes, number-changing freeze-out, BBN energy injection) is imposed only as a qualitative tau_GB < 1 s requirement, with no model-specific calculation for the scalar-extended spectra classified here.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the existing dark-glueball relic and decay literature to these models by computing glueball and dark-pion lifetimes through the Higgs portal and dimension-five operators for each viable representation, and check energy injection against standard BBN codes (e.g. AlterBBN or ACROPOLIS-style injection limits).

members.model_name: Logotropic dark fluid
members.description: The effective sound speed c_s,eff and entropy-perturbation closure of the unified logotropic fluid are not uniquely derived (the card marks c_s,eff as closure-dependent), so the linear perturbation system is not fully specified before any Boltzmann implementation can be written.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the perturbation equations and rest-frame sound speed from the paper's Gross-Pitaevskii/Klein-Gordon scalar-field realization of the logotropic EOS, fixing the adiabatic-vs-entropy closure explicitly, and publish the resulting c_s,eff(k,a) prescription for benchmark A=2.13e-9.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric SO(10) mixed LSP-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The LSP identity, mass, and soft-SUSY-breaking spectrum are unspecified, so the cold-component relic density Omega_LSP cannot be computed even though standard relic solvers exist; the card explicitly flags the unspecified LSP as high extrapolation risk.
members.proposed_resolution: Define benchmark soft-breaking spectra consistent with the SO(10) chain using a spectrum generator (SoftSUSY or SPheno with GUT-scale boundary conditions), then compute Omega_LSP and the LSP composition with micrOMEGAs or DarkSUSY for each benchmark.

members.model_name: PAMELA-favored NMSSM neutralino with light pseudoscalar resonance
members.description: The nonthermal relic density is only sketched: the late-decaying gravitino/modulus cosmology that must set Omega_DM for a 135-301 pb annihilation cross section is not quantitatively specified or computed anywhere in the route.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify the decaying-field mass, abundance, and decay temperature, and solve the standard post-decay Boltzmann equation (annihilation-dominated regime) to verify that the observed relic density and the required present-day <sigma v> are simultaneously attainable for the benchmark points.

members.model_name: Split-neutrino right-handed sneutrino inflaton dark matter
members.description: The perturbative reheating and thermalization history after NH_uL flat-direction inflation has not been computed with any identified tool; the quoted T_R ~ 1e6 GeV for m_phi ~ 1 TeV and the claim of efficient B-L thermalization of the sneutrino remain unverified, and T_R feeds both the relic calculation and the inflation consistency.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the inflaton decay rate from the h N H_u L superpotential coupling and solve the coupled inflaton-radiation Boltzmann equations (a small dedicated ODE code) to obtain T_R(h, m_phi) and verify B-L thermalization of the sneutrino.

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model I with (1,1,3)_D Dirac fermion
members.description: The loop-level NETDM production amplitude through intermediate-scale exchange is only known up to unknown order-one coupling factors, leaving order-of-magnitude uncertainty in the relic-density prediction and the required T_RH.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the explicit loop production amplitude from the SO(10)-descended couplings of the (1,1,3)_D multiplet to the intermediate Higgs/gauge fields, replacing the order-one placeholder factors with computed couplings, and package it as a NETDM yield calculator over (M_DM, M_int, T_RH).

members.model_name: SO(10) NETDM Model II with (15,1,1)_W Weyl fermion
members.description: The tree-level NETDM production amplitude via intermediate-scale Higgs exchange is parameterized by unknown order-one coupling factors, leaving order-of-magnitude uncertainty in the relic abundance and required reheating temperature.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the explicit Higgs-portal production amplitude for the (15,1,1)_W singlet component from the SO(10)-descended couplings, replacing the order-one placeholders, and package a NETDM yield calculator over (M_DM, M_int, T_RH).

members.model_name: Boosted two-component pseudoscalar-mediated dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal production mechanism setting the PeV phi relic abundance is unspecified beyond a reheating-temperature dependence, so the (f_phi, f_chi) relic decomposition entering every signal normalization is not computable from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive an explicit phi production calculation (e.g. freeze-in or inflaton-decay production as a function of T_RH) and couple it to a standard freeze-out computation for chi (implementable in micrOMEGAs from the given Lagrangian), yielding f_phi and f_chi as functions of the card's input parameters.

members.model_name: Long-lived stau coannihilation neutralino dark matter scenario
members.description: The three- and four-body stau decay widths (stau -> neutralino + multi-body tau/neutrino final states) for mass splittings below the tau mass, which set the BBN-era lifetime, are not implemented in any tool identified by the card and must be computed model-specifically together with the compressed-spectrum coannihilation yield.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the sub-threshold multi-body stau decay width (including left-right stau mixing and the optional lepton-flavor-violating channel) as a small standalone module, and couple it to a micrOMEGAs compressed-spectrum relic calculation to produce (tau_stau, Y_stau) as functions of (m_stau, m_neutralino, Delta m).

members.model_name: Minimal scotogenic model with fermionic dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced inelastic N1-nucleus scattering that can arise for nearly degenerate N1,N2 with complex Yukawas is flagged in the card but not derived, so the direct-detection channel cannot be evaluated in that corner of parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop (photon/Z-penguin and box) N1-quark effective operators including the N1-N2 splitting, and implement them in micrOMEGAs' direct-detection module to recast XENON/LZ inelastic limits versus the N1-N2 mass splitting.

members.model_name: Type-I seesaw Majoron warm dark matter completion
members.description: The Majoron production mechanism and resulting phase-space distribution f(p) are not specified in the card (production 'not specified in detail', no distribution function), so the abundance-lifetime mapping and the warm free-streaming scale that drive both observables cannot be computed from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the Majoron relic abundance and momentum distribution for the natural production channels of this completion (freeze-in via the Higgs-singlet portal lambda_H_sigma and thermal production at the lepton-number-breaking scale with subsequent dilution), yielding tabulated f(p) as a function of m_J and the breaking scale for input to the Boltzmann step.

members.model_name: chameleon scalaron dark matter in F(R) gravity with R^2 correction
members.description: No relic-abundance derivation exists connecting the BBN-era scalaron oscillation amplitude to the present-day dark matter density: the card records can_produce_all_dark_matter as unknown and no calculation determines the initial displacement needed to match Omega_DM h^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the scalaron energy density evolution from the onset of oscillations (including the environment-dependent mass changing through the QCD and e+e- epochs, which violates naive a^-3 scaling) to today, expressing Omega_phi h^2 as a function of the R^2 coefficient and initial displacement, using the gap_1 integrator.

members.model_name: Nonthermal wino dark matter in UV-insensitive anomaly-mediated NMSSM extension
members.description: The relic abundance uses the instantaneous gravitino-decay approximation with a tree-level annihilation cross section; a full Boltzmann treatment of gravitino decay plus wino reannihilation (including Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation to W pairs) is not implemented, and the card flags that it can shift the preferred T_RH/m_wino contours.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled gravitino-wino Boltzmann equations numerically (e.g. by extending micrOMEGAs or a standalone solver with a gravitino source term and Sommerfeld-corrected wino cross section) and recompute the Omega_wino h^2 = 0.095-0.13 band in the (T_RH, m_wino) plane.

members.model_name: Dynamical R-parity breaking SUSYLR unstable gravitino dark matter
members.description: The gravitino abundance rests on the source's linear-in-T_R scaling with an unspecified inflationary-dilution history; no numerical production calculation including NLSP decay regeneration and entropy dilution is available for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard hard-thermal-loop gravitino production rates in a small Boltzmann module with explicit reheating and dilution parameterization, adding the NLSP freeze-out-and-decay contribution, to replace the order-of-magnitude scaling.

members.model_name: Superheavy scalar dark matter from R^2 inflation
members.description: The entropy/reheating normalization needed to convert the produced comoving number density into today's relic density is unspecified (the card marks reheating-temperature dependence unknown), leaving Omega_X h^2 undetermined even once the production spectrum is known.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the entropy injection history from scalaron decay in the same R^2 background (the reheating temperature follows from the scalaron width to Standard Model fields) and fold it into the redshift step so the relic density is a closed function of m_X and the fixed scalaron mass.

members.model_name: Two-portal fermionic dark matter model
members.description: The one-loop DM-nucleon elastic cross section that controls direct-detection evasion exists only as the paper's analytic result and is absent from micrOMEGAs/CalcHEP tree-level pipelines, so recoil limits cannot be scanned automatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the paper's one-loop sigma_chiN expression as a standalone module (function of m_chi, mediator masses, g-prime, mixing angle) callable alongside micrOMEGAs in parameter scans, cross-checking the loop-suppression benchmarks quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: Neutral-current fermionic absorption dark matter
members.description: The relic-abundance calculation is explicitly postponed in the primary paper: the relativistic decoupling temperature, the required entropy dilution from the heavy particle's late decay, and its BBN-safe lifetime window are not worked out, so whether a given (m_chi, Lambda_NC) point yields the full dark matter abundance cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the chi decoupling temperature from the neutral-current operators, solve the standard entropy-dilution Boltzmann system for the heavy parent's decay, and delimit the dilution factor and parent lifetime consistent with BBN, yielding an abundance surface over (m_chi, Lambda_NC, dilution parameters) that can be attached as a relic-density route.

members.model_name: Inhomogeneous Chaplygin-gas gravitational-condensate dark matter
members.description: The mapping from initial Chaplygin-gas perturbations to the condensed CDM-like fraction as a function of redshift is only an approximate spherical-collapse prescription with an acoustic-horizon threshold; there is no calculable module giving the condensed fraction and its scale dependence from (A, B, initial spectrum), which the residual-fraction fit (about 0.08) presupposes.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and code the generalized spherical-collapse model with acoustic-horizon halting into a module that integrates over the initial overdensity distribution to output the condensed fraction versus redshift and scale, validated against the source estimate of about 8 percent residual gas, feeding directly into the gap_1 Boltzmann implementation.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with lepton-number violating transfer operators
members.description: The XXLH_u transfer operator and symmetric-component annihilation sector are defined only at framework level; without a normalized benchmark Lagrangian (doublet, singlet Higgs, or dark gauge completion) the direct, indirect, and collider signatures cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Fix an explicit UV completion of the XXLH_u operator with a specified annihilation mediator, and implement it as a FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model file so annihilation rates and search signatures become quantitative.

members.model_name: Inelastic vector-exchange isospin-violating dark matter
members.description: The surviving relic fraction of the excited state chi+ - which controls whether exothermic down-scattering contributes to the recoil signal - is not computed; it requires solving the coupled chi+/chi- Boltzmann system including the chi+ chi+ -> chi- chi- self-scattering depletion listed on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the two-state Boltzmann equations tracking chi+ depletion through self-scattering and decays down to freeze-out of the interconversion rate, as a function of delta, m_Zprime, m_B, and couplings, and propagate the resulting chi+ fraction into the recoil-spectrum calculation.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken Z2 singlet scalar dark matter with domain walls
members.description: The card specifies no relic-production mechanism for S_2 (production and relic-density calculation are 'unknown'), so the assumed S_2-dominated abundance that normalizes all decay observables is undetermined within the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the S_2 abundance from the tree-level potential's Higgs-portal and S_1-S_2 quartic couplings (freeze-out or freeze-in as coupling size dictates) using micrOMEGAs with the two-singlet model implemented, mapping which (m_DM, coupling) regions realize Omega h^2 = 0.12.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine radiative neutrino mass model with two dark matter components
members.description: The Affleck-Dine LH_u flat-direction baryon asymmetry is imposed only as a qualitative consistency requirement: no derived mapping from (lambda, M, T_R, A-term phases) to the final baryon asymmetry is packaged with the model, so the joint consistency of relic density, LFV, and baryogenesis cannot be checked in a scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and code the standard Affleck-Dine lepton-asymmetry estimate for the LH_u direction lifted by W_nr = lambda (L H_u)^2 / M (flat-direction potential, oscillation temperature, ellipticity from CP-violating A terms) as a fast semi-analytic module callable inside the parameter scan.

members.model_name: pMSSM Snowmass benchmark 374345: gravitino superwimp
members.description: The card provides no computed sneutrino NLSP lifetime, gravitino production abundance, or decay-produced gravitino phase-space distribution, so the superWIMP relic density and its consistency with BBN and diffuse photon/neutrino limits cannot be evaluated from the card contents (the source scan's checks are inherited, not reproduced).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the sneutrino-to-gravitino decay width and lifetime for m_3/2 near 400 GeV and m_sneutrino = 580 GeV, compute the NLSP freeze-out yield with micrOMEGAs, apply the superWIMP relation Omega_3/2 = (m_3/2/m_NLSP) Omega_NLSP, and check the electromagnetic/hadronic energy injection against standard BBN constraint codes (e.g. the Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi tables or AlterBBN-based injection limits).

members.model_name: E7 nonlinear-sigma focus-point Higgsino dark matter
members.description: No concrete nonthermal production history (e.g. moduli or gravitino decay with specified decay temperature) is specified for the Higgsino relic abundance, so Omega_chi h^2 cannot be computed and the direct-detection rate normalization (full DM vs subcomponent) is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt an explicit late-decaying-modulus parameterization (decay temperature T_dec, branching to Higgsinos), solve the reheating-era Boltzmann equations with the Higgsino annihilation cross section from micrOMEGAs, and scan (mu, T_dec) for regions saturating Omega h^2 = 0.12; propagate the resulting DM fraction into the sigma_SI comparison.

members.model_name: Z2-stabilized Higgs-portal unparticle dark matter
members.description: The equilibrium phase-space distribution and thermal history of the unparticle in the relativistic regime for general scaling dimension 1 < d_U < 2 have not been derived (the paper assumes WIMP-like Boltzmann suppression valid only near d_U = 1, flagged as high extrapolation risk), so the relic calculation cannot be extended across the claimed d_U range.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermal number density, equilibrium distribution, and collision term for an unparticle operator of general d_U from its spectral density, matching onto the standard WIMP result as d_U approaches 1, and encode the resulting d_U-dependent correction factors in the gap_1 relic implementation.

members.model_name: Hidden-condensate matter-parity-violating gravitino dark matter
members.description: The hidden pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone relic abundance Omega_PNG h^2 from SU(2) condensation is only estimated at paper level; no calculation of the hidden-sector thermal history and pseudo-NG freeze-out exists that could feed the overclosure check.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hidden-sector temperature evolution and pseudo-NG annihilation cross sections after SU(2) condensation, then solve the hidden-sector Boltzmann equation (e.g. with micrOMEGAs' hidden-sector/two-temperature machinery or a custom integrator) parameterized by Lambda and the visible-hidden temperature ratio.

members.model_name: Miracle-less WIMP with gauged B-L entropy dilution
members.description: The leptogenesis route step is only a qualitative compatibility check: the paper defers the flavored Boltzmann analysis, so the claimed correlation between successful baryogenesis from N2/N3 and the GW-observable turning-frequency window is not quantitatively derived for this entropy-diluting cosmology.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve flavored leptogenesis Boltzmann equations (e.g. with ULYSSES) including the dilution of the lepton asymmetry by N1 entropy injection, mapping the (M_N1, Y_N1, M_N2,3) region where the observed baryon asymmetry survives, and overlay it on the M_DM-f_delta plane.

members.model_name: Solar-neutrino-boosted bound-state dark matter
members.description: The local bound-state fraction f_B, which normalizes the entire boosted flux, is assumed to be order one rather than computed; no early-universe calculation of chi-chi recombination into the bound state B under the dark Yukawa force exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the asymmetric constituent abundance and dark recombination/ionization through phi exchange in the regime m_phi < alpha_D m_chi, deriving f_B(m_chi, alpha_D, m_phi) to replace the order-one assumption in the flux normalization.

members.model_name: Majorana t-channel mediator freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in rate network includes only thermal-mass-corrected 1-to-2 decays; the 2-to-2 scattering contributions (gauge-boson-mediated and Yukawa processes) flagged as a missing network in the card have not been derived for this thermal-mass treatment, leaving the yield uncertain in regimes where scatterings compete with decays.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermally corrected 2-to-2 collision terms for eta/f-mediated production of X (following the plasma-corrected freeze-in formalism of the cited src_1902 approach) and add them to the source term alongside the 1-to-2 decays to quantify when the decay-only approximation holds.

members.model_name: Secretly asymmetric lepton-flavored dark matter with a scalar annihilator
members.description: The loop-induced dark-matter-nucleon and dark-matter-electron scattering cross sections from the lepton-flavored mediator (photon-penguin-type diagrams through the phi-lepton loop) are not derived or implemented for this model, so the claimed null direct-detection signal cannot be checked quantitatively against current experiments.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop effective chi-photon (charge-radius/anapole) operators from the lambda_ij phi chi_i e_j^c interaction, implement them in a direct-detection rate code (e.g. DDCalc or a micrOMEGAs model file), and compare with LZ/XENONnT likelihoods across (m_chi, m_phi, lambda).

members.model_name: Xogenesis with baryon-number violating transfer operators
members.description: The XXudd transfer operator and the pseudoscalar/vector symmetric-annihilation sector are given only at framework level; no benchmark Lagrangian with normalized couplings exists from which direct, indirect, or collider signatures of the symmetric-component removal can actually be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Write down one or two explicit UV completions (squark-mediated XXudd with a specified pseudoscalar or Z' annihilation sector), fix operator normalizations, and implement them as FeynRules/micrOMEGAs model files so annihilation cross sections and collider signatures become computable.

members.model_name: Three-24 type III GMSB gravitino cold dark matter
members.description: The relic-density route relies only on the paper's order-of-magnitude reheating scaling with no numerical gravitino thermal-production calculation tied to an updated three-24 GMSB spectrum; the required SUSY spectrum calculator link-up is listed but not implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute benchmark spectra with SOFTSUSY/SPheno for the three-24 messenger boundary conditions and evaluate the gravitino yield with the standard hard-thermal-loop thermal-production rates (Bolz-Brandenburg-Buchmuller type) implemented as a small numerical module.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with a new gauge-group sphaleron
members.description: The new non-Abelian gauge sector is specified only at framework level: no benchmark with fixed M_W', g_R, generation charge assignments, and singlet-doublet mixing exists from which annihilation rates, collider signatures, and the recast of W' mass bounds onto T_D can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Define an explicit chiral gauge extension (e.g. a left-right variant with specified charges and the X1,X2,X3 mixing structure), normalize its couplings, and implement it in FeynRules plus micrOMEGAs and a collider recast framework so W' bounds and dark matter signatures become quantitative.

members.model_name: Decaying warm majoron dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal majoron phase-space distribution (from misalignment-like production or entropy-diluted scenarios mentioned in the paper) has not been derived, so all structure-formation predictions rest on the thermal-distribution assumption that the card marks as high extrapolation risk.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) for the paper's cited nonthermal production channels (freeze-in-like decoupling and entropy-dilution histories) analytically or with a momentum-dependent Boltzmann calculation, and feed the resulting distributions into the extended CLASS ncdm sector in place of the thermal ansatz.

members.model_name: Baryon-triality DFSZ axion and light-axino dark matter model
members.description: The freeze-in axino momentum distribution f(p) from PQ-suppressed weak scattering production is not derived (the card records distribution_function_available: no), so the warm transfer cutoff and mixed-DM matter power cannot be computed beyond rough free-streaming estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated freeze-in Boltzmann equation for axino production from MSSM scattering with PQ-suppressed couplings, tabulate f(p) over (m_axino, f_a, T_RH), and feed it to CLASS as an ncdm species alongside a cold axion fluid.

members.model_name: Light radion freeze-in dark matter in an RS/SBSI model
members.description: The nonthermal radion momentum distribution f(p) from proton-bath freeze-in is not specified, and the proposed BEC/condensate and UV-completion production mechanisms that could raise the abundance to the full dark-matter value are explicitly left to future work, so the cold-versus-hot classification and any full-abundance scenario cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the freeze-in phase-space distribution f(q) from the radion-nucleon production integral around T ~ 230 MeV via the unintegrated collision term, and work out the misalignment/BEC condensate abundance as a function of initial displacement and epsilon, giving a two-component (cold condensate + hot freeze-in) abundance formula.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced dark photon dark matter with Proca-star substructure
members.description: Tidal survival of solitons, fuzzy envelopes, and low-density compact halos inside galactic hosts is only argued qualitatively (environment dependent), so the present-day substructure abundance entering any gravitational probe is not quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive tidal-stripping and disruption criteria for Proca-star plus fuzzy-halo profiles (semi-analytically, validated with idealized host-orbit simulations from the extended solver of gap_1) and publish survival fractions versus host mass and orbital radius.

members.model_name: Dark Axion Portal mixed axion-dark-photon dark matter
members.description: The freeze-in dark-photon momentum distribution f(p) is not available (distribution_function_available: no), so the warm/hot behavior of the ~10 percent eV-scale dark-photon component and its small-scale power suppression are only discussed qualitatively, with no transfer function and no simulation calibration.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for axion-mediated gluon-fusion UV freeze-in to obtain the dark-photon f(p), feed it into the CLASS ncdm module alongside the cold axion component to get the mixed cold+warm transfer function, and compare against Ly-alpha bounds on hot subcomponents.

members.model_name: Noninteracting WIMP and QCD axion dark matter in an early matter dominated epoch
members.description: The WIMP small-scale cutoff (kinetic-decoupling temperature and free-streaming scale) entering k_cut cannot be derived because the WIMP elastic-scattering microphysics is left unspecified in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a benchmark WIMP elastic-scattering cross section on the radiation bath and derive T_kd and the free-streaming cutoff in the EMDE background analytically, propagating them into the k_cut and M_minicluster estimates.

members.model_name: Dissipative axion dark matter
members.description: The thermal friction coefficient Gamma is treated as a constant free parameter; the mapping from the underlying axion-dark non-Abelian gauge microphysics (the (alpha/16 pi f) phi F tilde-F operator and the dark-sector sphaleron rate) to a temperature-dependent Gamma(T_dark) is not derived, so posteriors on Gamma cannot be translated into particle-physics parameters and the constant-Gamma validity domain is untested.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive Gamma(T_dark) from the dark non-Abelian sphaleron rate (Gamma proportional to alpha^5 T_dark^3 / f^2 in the standard thermal-friction literature), implement the resulting temperature dependence in the gap_1 Boltzmann module, and re-fit to test the constant-weak-Gamma assumption flagged in the card's validity domain.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Peccei-Quinn axion-saxion model with thermal saxion effects
members.description: The thermally produced saxion abundance is only approximated by analogy with axino production; an exact thermal saxion production/dissipation rate in the SUSY PQ plasma (including the thermal-log potential regime) has not been derived for this setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the saxion thermal production rate from the colored PQ-sector couplings using hard-thermal-loop resummed finite-temperature field theory, following the methods used for axino thermal production, and tabulate it as a function of T_R, F_a, and the PQ Yukawas.

members.model_name: Kinetic-misalignment majoron dark matter in gauged U(1)Lmu-Ltau
members.description: No linear-perturbation treatment exists for the eV-scale coherently oscillating majoron field: the card records no transfer function or small-scale power prediction, so CMB/LSS perturbation-level constraints on this field-like DM cannot go beyond the background decay effect.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid description (effective sound speed and any kinetic-misalignment-specific isocurvature or white-noise component) of the oscillating majoron and implement it as a CLASS species, analogous to existing axion/ULDM CLASS extensions, to obtain a transfer function and perturbation-level CMB/LSS constraints.

members.model_name: Saxion-decay axino warm dark matter with axion dark radiation
members.description: The small-scale cutoff of decay-produced axinos is only estimated via an approximate free-streaming-length mapping to a 1-4 keV thermal WDM mass; no exact linear transfer function has been computed from the actual nonthermal two-body-decay momentum distribution for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced axino phase-space distribution f(q) (two-body saxion decay with lifetime tau_s), feed it to the CLASS ncdm module as a tabulated distribution, and compute the exact transfer function and half-mode mass across the m_s, tau_s, m_axino/m_s parameter space.

members.model_name: Two-cosine emergent dark-energy dark matter
members.description: The mapping between pre-trapping and post-trapping dark-matter perturbations needed to translate CMB-era axion isocurvature constraints to present-day parameters is not derived; standard axion isocurvature bounds assume the field observed today is the field at recombination.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature transfer through the trapping transition (how delta-phi fluctuations map onto the trapped heavy component) as a function of z_tr, then recast Planck isocurvature amplitude limits in the (H_inf, f, theta_i, z_tr) plane.

members.model_name: Light-right-handed-neutrino lepto-axiogenesis axion dark matter (freeze-in)
members.description: The axion relic abundance and baryon asymmetry are not evaluated in the entropy-producing regions of parameter space: the card records that regimes where the saxion fails to thermalize before rotation-matter domination require a new evaluation of dilution that the source did not pursue, leaving those regions unpredictable.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the modified kinetic-misalignment abundance and Y_B including saxion-domination entropy injection, by solving the coupled saxion energy-density, thermalization, and charge-yield evolution across the m_S-f_a plane and publishing corrected thermalization/dilution boundaries.

members.model_name: 5D U(1) repulsive-axion ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: The relic abundance from coherent oscillations, cosmic strings, or other nonstandard production is not computed for this specific 5D Wilson-line construction, so the abundance constraint (con-ultralight-relic-abundance) cannot be evaluated and the dark-matter fraction entering halo predictions is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the misalignment and string-decay relic abundance for the Wilson-line axion potential (temperature dependence set by the 5D charged-matter loops), parameterized by m, f, and initial amplitude, following standard axion-cosmology relic calculations.

members.model_name: Milli-eV scalar dark matter decaying to dark photons
members.description: The initial nonthermal scalar relic abundance and its momentum distribution are unspecified (production via misalignment or cosmic strings is only sketched, distribution_function_available unknown), so the normalization of the dark-photon injection rate that feeds every downstream observable is undetermined within the model itself.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the milli-eV scalar's relic abundance for the misalignment and cosmic-string production channels as a function of (m_a, f_a) using standard axion-like-particle abundance formulae, and record the resulting Omega_a(m_a, f_a) relation as a card-level input to the decay-rate step.

members.model_name: Anthropic fuzzy axion dark matter from inflationary Brownian misalignment
members.description: The mapping from the anthropic Brownian-misalignment ensemble (H_I, f_phi, drift-set initial angle distribution) to a predicted isocurvature amplitude for recasting against published CMB isocurvature bounds is not derived in reusable form; existing Planck isocurvature constraints assume standard single-angle misalignment.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the axion isocurvature power spectrum for the Brownian quasi-de Sitter initial condition as a function of (H_I, f_phi, Omega_phi/Omega_dm), feed it through the AxionCAMB isocurvature module, and recast the Planck CDI-mode likelihood onto the model parameters.

members.model_name: Hidden vector coherent oscillation dark matter
members.description: The card gives no linear structure-formation characterization: whether the oscillating vector condensate behaves as CDM on observable scales, its effective sound speed/quantum-pressure cutoff, and any transfer-function suppression are all marked unknown, so no matter-power observable can be forward-modeled.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid equations for the oscillating vector condensate (transverse plus longitudinal components) in the Compton-wavelength-averaged limit, obtain the transfer function and effective Jeans scale as a function of m, and implement them as a species in CLASS following existing ultralight-scalar (axionCAMB-style) treatments generalized to spin 1.

members.model_name: Mixed axion and asymmetric dark matter from Higgs dark matter decay
members.description: The mixed inventory (6 eV thermal hot axions with Omega about 0.32, 3.2e-2 eV coherent warm axions, 5 GeV ADM) has no derived phase-space distribution functions or transfer-function inputs, so the claimed BBN-to-CMB bookkeeping cannot be promoted to a CLASS/CAMB run against precision cosmology.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the momentum distributions for the thermal axion (standard thermal relic f(q)) and the coherent warm component, implement them as ncdm species with a CDM ADM component in CLASS, and run against the Planck likelihood to test the claimed Omega_axionHDM about 0.32, which is in strong tension with existing hot-dark-matter bounds.

members.model_name: Fast-decaying axino gravitino dark matter
members.description: The coldness of the decay-produced gravitino population is asserted only through the order-of-magnitude T_NR ~ keV estimate; the phase-space distribution f(q) of gravitinos from TeV-scale axino decays is not derived, so the claimed CDM-like transfer function is unverified at the boundary of Region III.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the two-body decay-produced gravitino momentum distribution from the frozen thermal axino population (analytic for axino -> gravitino + axion), tabulate f(q), and feed it to the CLASS non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) module to compute the transfer function and confirm where in the m_axino-m_3/2 plane the suppression scale stays below observable scales.

members.model_name: Fast-decaying axino gravitino dark matter
members.description: The saxion overclosure, BBN, and dark-radiation checks are recorded as external requirements (recasting_needed yes) with no computed saxion abundance, lifetime, or branching history for this setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the coherent-oscillation and thermal saxion abundance and decay widths as functions of f_a and the SUSY-breaking scale, then propagate the entropy injection and Delta N_eff through the region scan against Planck N_eff and BBN bounds.

members.model_name: Ultralight axion dark matter from a dark SU(3)d confining phase transition
members.description: The Ly-alpha lower bound on ULA mass applies only to canonical ULA transfer functions; no model-specific transfer function exists for an axion whose mass turns on at the T_d ~ 10 keV confinement transition, so the critical small-scale-structure constraint at m_a ~ 1e-20 eV cannot be applied as a hard exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Modify axionCAMB or AxiCLASS to include the late mass generation at the dark confinement epoch, compute the resulting transfer function, and recast the existing Ly-alpha forest ULA analysis onto the (m_a, f_a, Lambda_a) parameter space.

members.model_name: Explicit chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: The late first-order transition window (z ~ 37-385) is established only by comparing vacuum energies; no bubble-nucleation rate or tunneling action has been computed for the Higgs-axion-destabilized potential, so whether and when the transition actually completes is undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the O(3)/O(4) bounce action for V_eff(a,T) with a tunneling solver such as CosmoTransitions across the (M, lambda, g, m_a, f) parameter space, mapping where the nucleation rate exceeds Hubble in the 0.1 MeV to 0.01 eV window.

members.model_name: Explicit chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: The loop-induced ALP-neutrino coupling bounds from rare-meson/collider data are derived for ALP masses above ~100 MeV and cannot be applied to this sub-eV misalignment axion without a dedicated recast of the loop-level EFT matching to the light-axion regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the loop-induced charged-lepton and electroweak constraints on the m0 nu_L nu_R exp(i a/f) operator in the sub-eV axion mass regime and translate them into limits on (m0, f) directly comparable to the fifth-force prediction G/G_N.

members.model_name: Spontaneous chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: No perturbation model exists that maps the late (z ~ 37-385) first-order axion-sector transition onto a post-recombination matter perturbation source term (bubble/fluctuation spectrum), so the paper's central structure-formation claim is only qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the density-fluctuation power spectrum sourced by bubble nucleation and collision in the finite-temperature axion-neutrino potential, parameterized by transition redshift, latent heat, and bubble size, following standard first-order-phase-transition perturbation treatments.

members.model_name: SO(10) U(1)_PQ Model 3.1 scalar-singlet axion dark matter
members.description: The domain-wall number and PQ-quality-protecting discrete symmetry of the singlet-S realization are not derived on the card, so the post-inflationary branch of the abundance prediction (string-wall fate, minicluster phenomenology) cannot be specified even in principle.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive N_DW and the accidental/discrete PQ-protecting symmetry explicitly for the SO(10)-singlet-S charge assignment (following the paper's anomaly conventions) and record which PQ histories are self-consistent before wiring in a relic calculator.

members.model_name: Post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter from string-network radiation
members.description: No validated extrapolation scheme exists for taking the simulated axion emission spectrum shape q(log m_r/H) from accessible scale separations (log ~ 6-8) to the physical QCD axion regime (log ~ 70), which changes the relic abundance by orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and calibrate a large-log extrapolation model: fit the log-dependence of the spectral index q and string density xi across an extended suite of AMR simulations, with an effective-string (Nambu-Goto plus backreaction) analytic model to anchor the asymptotic behavior, and propagate the fit uncertainty as a band on Omega_a h2(m_a).

members.model_name: KOTO two-scalar P dark matter
members.description: The SN1987A constraint is an order-of-magnitude rescaling of axion cooling bounds rather than a dedicated calculation: the emission of scalars coupled to d/s quark bilinears from a protoneutron star (including trapping at larger couplings) has not been derived for this model, so the excluded low-mass P band has unquantified boundaries.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the P and S emissivity from nucleon bremsstrahlung and pion conversion in a protoneutron-star profile, including the trapping regime, following modern SN1987A axion-coupling analyses, to replace the cross-section-rescaling estimate with a defensible cooling bound in the (m_P, Lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Long-lived axion domain wall dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the nonthermal post-decay axion spectrum (peaks near k ~ m_a and k ~ 3.68 m_a) to late-time small-scale structure - transfer function, minihalo mass function - is not computed, leaving the minihalo observable and all structure-formation fields unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Evolve the simulated post-decay axion density field to matter-radiation equality with linear perturbation theory plus a Press-Schechter (or N-body) treatment of the O(1) isocurvature overdensities to predict a minihalo mass function, following existing axion-miniclusters pipelines.

members.model_name: Nonrelativistic axion EFT dark matter
members.description: The stationary nonrelativistic EFT does not capture relativistic axion emission or collapse of dense axion stars, so the dense-star equation-of-state target cannot be followed through instability without additional theory input.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the axion-number-violating and relativistic corrections to the EFT (or match directly to relativistic field simulations of the chiral potential, GRChombo-style) to describe emission and collapse of dense condensates beyond the stationary approximation.

members.model_name: Large-extra-dimension Kaluza-Klein axion dark matter with trapped solar modes
members.description: The primordial cosmological relic abundance and present-day phase-space distribution of the KK axion tower are not derived (card marks relic density, free-streaming, transfer function, and all structure-formation entries unknown, with high extrapolation risk), so the model cannot be assessed as a full dark-matter candidate or evaluated against any cosmological or structure-formation observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the early-universe production (misalignment plus thermal emission into the KK tower) and mode-by-mode decay history to obtain Omega_a(f_PQ, R, delta) and f(p) today, then map the resulting mixed cold-plus-keV component onto a non-cold-relic transfer function computable with a Boltzmann code supporting multiple massive relics.

members.model_name: Hidden axion dark matter from saxion decay
members.description: No linear transfer function has been computed for the nonthermal, decay-produced axion momentum distribution from saxion decay; the card explicitly warns that thermal-WDM mass mappings are misleading, so the free-streaming proxy L_fs cannot be converted into a defensible power-spectrum cutoff.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the two-body decay phase-space distribution f(q) for saxion-produced axions (delta-function injection at p = m_s/2 redshifted through the decay epoch) and feed it to the CLASS/CAMB non-cold-relic (ncdm) module with a tabulated distribution to compute the model-specific transfer function over the (m_a, m_s, f_a) space.

members.model_name: Cosmologically stable axino-gravitino co-dark matter
members.description: The saxion sector is unconstrained by any computed history: the saxion overclosure, BBN, and Delta N_eff checks are recorded as external requirements (recasting_needed yes) with no derivation of the saxion abundance, lifetime, or decay branchings for this supersymmetric QCD axion setup.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the coherent-oscillation and thermal saxion abundance and its decay widths (to gluons, axions, Higgses) as functions of f_a and the SUSY-breaking scale, then propagate the resulting entropy injection and Delta N_eff through the same region scan and compare to Planck N_eff and BBN bounds.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark-photon depletion model
members.description: No perturbation calculation exists through the depletion epoch: the amplified small-scale axion power P_a(k) and its evolution into minicluster seeds, and the residual isocurvature spectrum, are only qualitative in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mode-by-mode axion perturbation evolution through tachyonic production (linearized around the lattice background from gap_1), then feed the resulting P_a(k) into standard minicluster mass-function machinery (Press-Schechter on the enhanced spectrum or N-body seeding runs).

members.model_name: Emergent strong-CP vector dark matter
members.description: No concrete nonthermal production calculation exists for the ultralight vector: the card gives no abundance calculation, no momentum distribution, and only mentions a generic tachyonic instability, so the relic density and the input to any structure-formation transfer calculation are undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the relic abundance and initial power spectrum for at least one explicit production mechanism (e.g. tachyonic instability from a dark-Higgs sector or misalignment-like vector production), yielding the initial conditions needed by a transfer-function calculation.

members.model_name: Electroweak axion mixed fuzzy and cold dark matter
members.description: The proton-decay rates implied by the B+L-breaking operators that generate the EW axion mass are not derived for this model: branching ratios and operator coefficients as functions of the flavor charges and gravitino mass are delegated to cited work, so the nucleon-decay prediction cannot be confronted with data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective proton-decay operators from the model's B+L-breaking terms with the paper's flavor-symmetry charges, evaluate rates with standard lattice/chiral-Lagrangian nucleon matrix elements, and compare channel-by-channel with published Super-Kamiokande limits and JUNO/Hyper-K sensitivities.

members.model_name: Dark inflaxion
members.description: The isocurvature perturbation spectrum of the frozen a0 mode during a1-driven inflation has not been derived, even though a light spectator ALP at H_* ~ 5e12 GeV generically acquires isocurvature fluctuations that Planck constrains; the card flags multifield/isocurvature effects as unresolved.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the a0 isocurvature power (H_*/2pi fluctuations mapped through the misalignment abundance) including the KK-mixing correlation between a0 and a1 initial values, and confront it with the Planck cold-DM isocurvature bound to cut the viable (g_a, initial displacement) space.

members.model_name: Axionlike-particle dark matter produced by primordial magnetic fields
members.description: The ALP momentum distribution f(p) produced by photon-axion conversion in the evolving PMF background is not tabulated (the card only records that ALPs inherit the photon temperature at conversion, T_phi/T about 0.33), so the linear transfer function and free-streaming cutoff cannot be computed with a Boltzmann code; no thermal-WDM mapping is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) by integrating the conversion rate over the PMF history for a grid of (m_phi, g, B_i, lambda_i), tabulate it, and feed it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) tabulated phase-space distribution to obtain the transfer function and half-mode scale.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ late-decaying gravitino/axino dark matter
members.description: The BBN safety of the late decay rests on the unrelaxable assumption that the axionic final state dominates; the subdominant branching into visible SM particles (via Higgs/Higgsino mixing) has not been derived for this model, so the BBN/CMB energy-injection bound on the lifetime contours cannot be checked even though generic injection tools exist.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gravitino/axino branching fractions into electromagnetic and hadronic final states from the DFSZ couplings and feed them into an existing energy-injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS for BBN, ExoCLASS/DarkAges for CMB) to bound the allowed lifetime-branching region.

members.model_name: Thermal-misalignment scalar dark matter
members.description: The linear transfer function of the thermally-misaligned scalar is not computed (card lists transfer_function_shape as unknown), so its deviation from canonical fuzzy-DM suppression across the 10^-22 eV to keV mass range cannot be verified before applying small-scale-structure bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Run axionCAMB or AxiCLASS over the model's scalar-mass range, checking that the late thermal-misalignment production leaves the standard ULA transfer function unchanged, and tabulate half-mode scales for the registry.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with radiative, thermal, and geometric PQ-field corrections
members.description: The warm-axion phase-space distribution f(p) and the resulting linear transfer function for the source-specific nonthermal spectrum have not been derived (transfer_function_shape is unknown and the card states no transfer function was computed), so small-scale suppression cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract f(p) from the production simulation (gap_1) and feed it to CLASS as a non-cold-dark-matter species alongside a CDM component, tabulating transfer functions and half-mode scales versus warm fraction and axion mass.

members.model_name: QCD axion hybrid-inflation dark matter
members.description: The axion isocurvature power P_S and thermal-axion Delta N_eff in this construction are not computed to a form that can be compared with CMB limits; the card structures isocurvature as a required recast with no likelihood-ready prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the isocurvature transfer of the light QCD-axion direction from the perturbation solution of gap_1, compute the CDM isocurvature fraction as a function of f_a, H_inf, and theta_i near pi, add the thermal-axion Delta N_eff from standard gluon-scattering production rates, and feed both into the Planck isocurvature/N_eff likelihood.

members.model_name: Locally scale-invariant vector-field cold dark matter
members.description: No linear cosmological perturbation theory exists for the Weyl-vector CDM component: the paper works only at the homogeneous FRW level with time-averaged S_i oscillations, so the effective sound speed, anisotropic stress, and gravitational slip of the oscillating vector field are underived, and no Einstein-Boltzmann code (CLASS/CAMB or any scalar-vector-tensor extension) implements this locally scale-invariant theory.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linearized field equations for perturbations of phi, S_mu, and the metric about the oscillating background, time-average them to obtain an effective-fluid description (sound speed c_s^2(k,a) and anisotropic stress, analogous to the ultra-light axion / coherent-field treatments), and implement that effective fluid as a new species in CLASS or hi_class alongside a background ODE solver for H(a) with subleading oscillation corrections.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with solar-flare triggering
members.description: The nugget baryon-charge distribution — a required input listed in the route's code resources — is not derived: predictions currently assume ad hoc distributions peaking near B ~ 1e25 within the allowed 1e23-1e28 window, and the constraint card warns that transient rates must be evaluated over a mass distribution rather than a single B.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive a calibrated B-distribution from AQN formation modeling (axion domain-wall collapse at the QCD transition), parameterize it with a small number of shape parameters consistent with the macroscopic-DM constraint window, and propagate it as a prior through the solar-transient pipeline.

members.model_name: Gravity-reheating QCD axion relic
members.description: The CMB isocurvature constraint has not been derived for this specific gravity-reheating history: the quoted bound (E_I above 3.8e14 GeV excluded for f_a = 1e16 GeV) comes from a generic pre-inflationary PQ-breaking mapping, not from the axion abundance and H_inf relation of this model, so the complementarity claim cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the axion isocurvature amplitude using this model's misalignment abundance (with its reheating-modified T_osc) and inflation scale, then evaluate it against the Planck uncorrelated CDM isocurvature likelihood (standard CLASS/CAMB + Planck chains machinery) over the (f_a, theta_i, xi, T_rh) space.

members.model_name: Majoron-axion cold dark matter
members.description: The two-loop Majoron-axion couplings to photons, quarks, and gluons are only schematic estimates that neglect some gauge/Goldstone contributions and use unspecified neutrino Yukawa and Majorana mass matrices, so f_a and g_a cannot be computed reliably for any concrete parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform the complete loop evaluation of the effective a-gamma-gamma, a-q-q, and a-G-Gtilde vertices including gauge and Goldstone diagrams for representative benchmark Yukawa/Majorana matrices consistent with observed neutrino masses, and publish the resulting f_a(M, Y_nu) mapping as reusable analytic formulas or a small numerical package.

members.model_name: Majoron-axion cold dark matter
members.description: No relic-abundance calculation exists for the Majoron-axion: the cold-dark-matter claim rests on standard axion reasoning by analogy, with no misalignment (or other production) computation for m_axion ~ 1e-8 eV with Majorana scale near M_W, and no isocurvature or string/domain-wall analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the standard misalignment formalism (temperature-dependent mass from the nonperturbative estimate, initial displacement scan) to compute Omega_a h^2 over the (M, m_axion) plane, including pre/post-inflationary scenario branches and isocurvature/topological-defect contributions, and encode it in an existing axion relic calculator or a short standalone code.

members.model_name: USSM-A neutralino dark matter with gauged axion
members.description: The gauged-axion sector lacks a worked cosmology: the physical axion mass depends on an unspecified extra potential, and no misalignment-abundance, defect-history, or axion-photon-coupling calculation exists for the Stueckelberg gauged axion in this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gauged-axion mass and effective photon coupling from the Im b F F operator for representative UV potentials, then compute the misalignment relic contribution and defect constraints with standard axion-cosmology machinery (e.g. adapt AxionLimits-style coupling conventions and a misalignment solver).

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn leptoquark-diquark mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: The axion relic fraction rests on the simple misalignment estimate with reheating below F_a; no computation of the coupled axion-WIMP thermal history (entropy release from the PQ sector, Delta N_eff, radial-mode decays) exists to make the mixed-fraction prediction robust across the F_a window.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann system for the axion, radial PQ scalar, and scalar WIMP by adapting an existing axion relic code (e.g. a MiMeS-style misalignment solver extended with entropy injection), scanning F_a, theta_a, and T_R.

members.model_name: Kalb-Ramond gravitational axion dark matter from heavy sterile fermions
members.description: No cosmological production history or relic-abundance calculation exists for the KR gravitational axion: the initial misalignment, the temperature dependence of the RHN-induced one-loop potential, and the resulting Omega_axion and isocurvature amplitude have never been derived, so the DM candidacy rests only on vacuum-lifetime viability.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the post-leptogenesis thermal history of the KR-axion potential (when the RHN-induced mass turns on relative to H), then compute misalignment production and isocurvature with a standard ALP relic solver (e.g. a MiMeS-style oscillation code) fed with the model's V(b,T).

members.model_name: DFSZ axion-Higgs model with small singlet-doublet coupling
members.description: No axion relic-abundance calculation exists for this card: the route lists 'axion relic fraction' as a derived quantity and 'initial axion abundance' as an input, but no forward-model step computes the misalignment (plus possible string/domain-wall) production, so full-DM viability versus f_a cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a relic-abundance step using standard misalignment formulas or a public solver such as MiMeS, covering both pre- and post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenarios over the allowed f_a >= 1e9 GeV range, and record the resulting Omega_a h^2(f_a, theta_i).

members.model_name: Axiogenesis rotating QCD axion dark matter
members.description: The PQ-charge-to-baryon conversion coefficient c_B is only bracketed (0.1-0.15 times c_W) and no finite-temperature sphaleron transport calculation is attached, leaving an order-one uncertainty that propagates directly into both Y_B and the axion abundance target.
