members.proposed_resolution: Derive c_B by solving the coupled transport equations for PQ charge, quark chiral asymmetries, and B+L near T_ws, adapting existing electroweak-baryogenesis transport machinery, including the crossing of Yukawa-equilibration thresholds.

members.model_name: Minimal SVS 3-3-1 invisible axion dark matter
members.description: No misalignment relic-abundance calculation exists for this specific 3-3-1 axion, so the local axion dark-matter fraction entering haloscope power estimates is undetermined; the card explicitly flags that the relic-density calculation for the model was not performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the standard vacuum-misalignment relic formula with the QCD axion mass-temperature relation to the model's f_a ~ v_phi in the 10^9-10^12 GeV range, scanning the initial misalignment angle to derive the axion fraction that normalizes haloscope signal predictions.

members.model_name: SO(10) GUT inflation model with axion dark matter
members.description: The axion relic abundance for this SO(10) construction is never actually derived: the card fixes only M_B-L ~ 10^11-10^12 GeV, with calculation_type unknown, no misalignment-angle treatment, no pre- versus post-inflationary PQ-breaking determination given the GUT-scale inflation, and no isocurvature check against the same CMB data used for n_s.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive Omega_a h^2 with the standard misalignment formula (plus string/domain-wall contributions if PQ breaks after inflation) as a function of M_B-L using an existing axion relic code such as MiMeS, determine whether PQ breaking precedes the model's ~10^16 GeV inflation, and evaluate the resulting axion isocurvature amplitude against Planck limits.

members.model_name: Hidden Peccei-Quinn Higgs double-field axion-inflation model
members.description: The axion relic abundance under this model's nonstandard pre-QCD dynamics — a time-dependent effective PQ scale and explicit PQ-violating terms active early — has not been derived, so the claimed escape from the f_a < 1e12 GeV overclosure bound is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and solve the misalignment equation of motion with the model's f_a(t) history and early explicit PQ-breaking potential, extending a standard semi-analytic axion relic module (temperature-dependent QCD axion mass from lattice susceptibility) to time-dependent f_a, and map the viable (f_a, theta_i) region.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-induced scalar coherent-oscillation dark matter
members.description: No derived mapping exists from the Starobinsky-specific production (Hubble-induced displacement via negative nonminimal coupling with a quartic-dominated early oscillation phase) to effective initial conditions for an ultralight-axion Boltzmann solver, so the scale-dependent-growth transfer function in the fuzzy regime cannot be computed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective misalignment angle, oscillation-onset epoch, and equation-of-state history (quartic-to-mass transition) as functions of (m_X, xi_X, lambda_X), then feed them as initial conditions to AxiCLASS (or CLASS with a fluid approximation) to obtain the linear power suppression for the 10^-19 eV benchmark.

members.model_name: Axion kination dark matter from kinetic misalignment
members.description: The warmness constraint that excludes part of the kinetic-misalignment parameter space is only an estimate: no distribution function or linear transfer function exists for axion dark matter produced by rotation fragmentation, so the boundary of the viable dark-matter region is imprecise.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the axion momentum distribution from rotation fragmentation (lattice simulation of the rotating complex field or analytic parametric-resonance treatment) and map it to a transfer-function cutoff in a Boltzmann code to replace the order-of-magnitude warmness bound.

members.model_name: Dimension-six extended-inverse-seesaw Majoron dark matter
members.description: No relic-abundance calculation exists for the Majoron in this model: the card records that the paper never performs the freeze-out computation (full_or_subcomponent unknown), leaving the normalization of all late-decay and portal signals undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the extended scalar sector in FeynRules/CalcHEP and compute the Majoron abundance with micrOMEGAs for the Higgs-portal freeze-out regime (and a misalignment/freeze-in treatment for ultralight benchmarks), mapping Omega_J h^2 over (m_J, theta_h, v_sigma).

members.model_name: Minimal PQ axion model for five-texture-zero fermion mass matrices
members.description: No model-specific relic-abundance calculation exists for this texture-zero PQ model: the domain-wall number implied by its non-universal PQ charges has not been computed, and the abundance is quoted only through generic invisible-axion misalignment bounds (3e9 GeV < f_a < 1e12 GeV) rather than a benchmark computation over the model's full 0.8e6-2.8e17 GeV f_a window.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute N_DW and the color/electromagnetic anomaly coefficients from the four-doublet PQ charge assignment, then evaluate the misalignment relic density for the pre-inflationary case and apply published string-domain-wall network simulation results for the post-inflationary case, flagging the N_DW > 1 domain-wall-problem region explicitly.

members.model_name: Axion-like dark matter coupled to ADR sterile neutrinos
members.description: The relic abundance of the axion-like condensate is never computed: the card treats the dark-matter background as an assumed input (phi_0, m_phi), so whether the scalar can constitute all of dark matter, and its linear structure-formation behavior, are unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform the standard misalignment relic calculation for the scalar (Omega_phi from phi_0 and m_phi), including any back-reaction from the feeble sterile coupling, and check the resulting (m_phi, phi_0) region against the values needed for sterile-mass suppression; for ultra-light m_phi, evaluate the linear transfer function with an ULDM Boltzmann code such as axionCAMB.

members.model_name: Axionic see-saw multi-axion dark matter framework
members.description: The axionic see-saw specifies the Lambda_1-Lambda_4 potential hierarchy but not the cosmological initial conditions (inflationary scale H_infl, initial misalignment angles, PQ-breaking epoch relative to inflation, topological-defect content) needed to turn the four-axion system into a unique prediction for Omega_a h^2 and the isocurvature fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the coupled evolution of the four mass-eigenstate axions during and after inflation for the see-saw potential, parameterized by H_infl and the initial angle vector, producing the misalignment abundance and isocurvature amplitude as explicit functions of the Lambda_i hierarchy that can be fed to axionCAMB and a Planck isocurvature likelihood run.

members.model_name: Non-universal U(1)_X Peccei-Quinn DFSZ axion dark matter
members.description: The normalized axion coupling table for this non-universal U(1)_X charge assignment (electromagnetic and color anomaly coefficients E/N and DFSZ-like axion-electron/nucleon couplings) has not been derived, so the candidate cannot be placed on standard axion mass-coupling exclusion plots or compared to haloscope/helioscope limits.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the orthogonalized PQ current and anomaly coefficients from the paper's charge restrictions and VEV hierarchy following DFSZ conventions, publish the resulting (m_a, g_agamma, g_ae, g_aN) table, and overlay it on standard axion limit compilations (e.g., the AxionLimits database).

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dynamical decay constant
members.description: No relic-abundance and perturbation-spectrum calculation is implemented for misalignment production with a time-dependent decay constant f(a) ~ a^-n: the standard misalignment formula does not apply because the kinetic term f(t)^2 (partial theta)^2 evolves between inflation and the QCD epoch, including anharmonic hilltop effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a standard axion misalignment solver (mode-by-mode integration of the axion equation of motion with the temperature-dependent QCD mass) to include a power-law f(a) kinetic coefficient, outputting Omega_a h^2 and the enhanced axion perturbation spectrum over (f0/N, f_inf/f0, n, theta_i, H_inf).

members.model_name: axino LSP superWIMP dark matter
members.description: The card provides no Lagrangian and unknown portals for the axino, so the mapping from model parameters (axion decay constant f_a, axino mass, NLSP identity) to the NLSP lifetime and electromagnetic/hadronic branching fractions that all cosmological constraints depend on is not derived; the route currently treats tau_NLSP as a free input.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive NLSP-to-axino partial widths and branching fractions from the standard KSVZ/DFSZ axino-gaugino-gauge-boson effective couplings for the neutralino and slepton NLSP cases, and add them as an analytic front-end step feeding tau_NLSP into the existing chain.

members.model_name: Mirrored Dirac neutrino dark matter with B-prime-minus-L-prime annihilation
members.description: The precise Delta N_eff contribution from mirror-sector decoupling through the heavy axion portal (and from a light unbroken B'-L' gauge boson) is not calculated; the card only cites a qualitative M_a > 1 GeV bound to avoid BBN/CMB dark-radiation tension.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mirror-sector decoupling temperature as a function of M_a and f_a, compute the entropy-diluted mirror bath temperature and resulting Delta N_eff (including a light B'-L' boson when unbroken), and compare against Planck and BBN Delta N_eff posteriors.

members.model_name: Type-X extended 2HDM axion-like dark matter
members.description: The Type-X ALP mass, couplings, and lifetime are underived: without the QCD gluon anomaly the pseudoscalar's potential must come from the model's Planck-suppressed PQ-violating operators, but no explicit m_a(F_a) relation, photon/lepton couplings, or decay-width calculation exists, blocking both the misalignment abundance and the cosmological-stability check.
members.proposed_resolution: Enumerate the leading Planck-suppressed PQ-violating operators allowed by the Type-X charge assignment and U(1)_{B_i-L_i}, derive m_a and the ALP-photon/lepton couplings from them, compute the decay width to check cosmological stability, and only then run the standard ALP misalignment formula against the Planck relic-density band.

members.model_name: Heavy-scalar-decay non-thermal warm dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear predictions (subhalo mass function, satellite counts) rely on thermal-WDM-calibrated simulations through an approximate half-mode-scale matching; no N-body simulations exist for the broader, higher-momentum-peaked decay-produced spectra, so the mapping's validity outside the studied f(q) grid is uncontrolled.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small suite of cosmological N-body simulations initialized with the modified-CLASS nonthermal transfer functions (and thermal velocities drawn from f(q)) for a few benchmark m_nonthermal values, and calibrate the subhalo mass function against the thermal-WDM equivalents to validate or correct the half-mode mapping.

members.model_name: Two-state inelastic self-interacting dark matter
members.description: All existing simulations for this benchmark are dark-matter-only; the card notes baryonic feedback is a major missing ingredient for mapping the predicted cores and satellite depletion onto observed Milky Way dwarfs.
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in hydrodynamical simulations of Milky Way-like halos with the inelastic two-state scattering module coupled to an established galaxy-formation model (e.g. Auriga/IllustrisTNG physics in Arepo), spanning the benchmark (sigma/m, Delta/m_chi) grid.

members.model_name: Early mass-varying sterile-neutrino nugget dark matter, simple CDM-transition variant
members.description: Nonlinear collapse of the unstable sterile-neutrino fluid into nuggets is not simulated anywhere; the sharp small-scale cutoff in the matter power spectrum and the halo/subhalo mass function effects are only discussed qualitatively, so the shape and scale of the cutoff transfer function are uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dedicated simulations of the scalar-mediated instability (coupled fermion-fluid plus scalar-field dynamics, e.g. an adapted cosmological hydrodynamics or N-body plus scalar solver) to obtain the post-formation nugget mass spectrum and the calibrated cutoff transfer function as a function of m_phi and z_F.

members.model_name: Dissipative dark matter from multiple Standard Model sectors
members.description: No cosmological hydrodynamic simulations exist for the N_sec-copy dissipative dark sector, so satellite abundance/planarity, the field-galaxy velocity function, and baryon-correlated halo structure predictions rest on idealized steady-state arguments (the card marks simulation_calibrated partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a galaxy-formation hydrodynamics code (e.g. GIZMO or AREPO) with a second dissipative fluid carrying dark-electromagnetic cooling and kinetic-mixing supernova heating, and run zoom-in simulations of Milky-Way-like and dwarf halos across the N_sec, epsilon parameter plane.

members.model_name: Dark Dimension KK-graviton dark matter
members.description: No N-body simulations or calibrated nonlinear prescription exist for kick-velocity dark gravitons, which the paper states is beyond its scope; this forces the conservative linear-scale cut (k_NL,0 ~ 0.09 Mpc^-1) in the KiDS analysis and blocks any subhalo or Milky-Way satellite predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with initial conditions and late-time velocity kicks matching the tower decay history (in the style of existing decaying-DM recoil simulations), calibrate a halofit-like nonlinear correction and subhalo mass-function suppression versus v0, enabling full-scale weak-lensing and satellite-count likelihoods.

members.model_name: Neutrino portal secluded dark matter
members.description: The combined effect of a damped initial power spectrum plus velocity-dependent self-interactions (1-10 cm^2/g at dwarf velocities) on satellite counts, subhalo mass functions, and dwarf central densities is uncalibrated by simulations for this model class.
members.proposed_resolution: Run ETHOS-style N-body simulations with the model's truncated transfer function and a velocity-dependent SIDM cross section to calibrate the subhalo mass function and core-size relations, then fit a semi-analytic halo-response model for parameter scans.

members.model_name: Hidden dark matter cosmology (HiDM)
members.description: No N-body simulations calibrate the nonlinear (sub)halo mass function for HiDM initial conditions (the card states simulation_calibrated: no), so the transition-dependent suppression mass scale M_sup and satellite/lensing predictions rest on linear-theory extrapolation.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small suite of cosmological N-body simulations (with thermal-velocity or suppressed-power initial conditions drawn from the HiDM transfer functions) spanning R_eq^T, and fit a halo/subhalo mass-function suppression formula analogous to existing WDM calibrations.

members.model_name: Pseudoscalar-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the linear DAO cutoff to nonlinear halo and subhalo mass functions is not simulation-calibrated for this model (card: simulation_calibrated no); existing ETHOS N-body calibrations cover only a few benchmark parameter points, not this pseudoscalar-mediator parameter region.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small suite of ETHOS-style cosmological zoom simulations spanning the model's T_kd/M_cut range and fit a (sub)halo mass-function suppression formula in terms of the DAO scale and damping envelope, enabling satellite-count predictions without per-point simulations.

members.model_name: Pseudovector-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the linear cutoff mass M_cut to nonlinear subhalo and dwarf-satellite abundances is not simulation-calibrated for this model (simulation_calibrated: no; route caveat notes nonlinear halo predictions require additional simulations).
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with the model's oscillatory suppressed power spectra across a grid of T_kd/M_cut values to calibrate the subhalo mass function and satellite counts, or validate an existing ETHOS-simulation-calibrated fitting function against this model's transfer-function shapes.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the linear cutoff mass M_cut to nonlinear subhalo and dwarf-satellite abundances is not simulation-calibrated for this model (simulation_calibrated: no; route caveat notes nonlinear halo predictions require additional simulations).
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with the model's oscillatory suppressed power spectra across a grid of T_kd/M_cut values to calibrate the subhalo mass function and satellite counts, or validate an existing ETHOS-simulation-calibrated fitting function against this model's transfer-function shapes.

members.model_name: Vector-mediated neutrino-interacting Dirac dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the linear cutoff mass M_cut to nonlinear subhalo and dwarf-satellite abundances is not simulation-calibrated for this model (simulation_calibrated: no; route caveat notes nonlinear halo predictions require additional simulations).
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with the model's oscillatory suppressed power spectra across a grid of T_kd/M_cut values to calibrate the subhalo mass function and satellite counts, or validate an existing ETHOS-simulation-calibrated fitting function against this model's transfer-function shapes.

members.model_name: Scalar field dark matter in the Thomas-Fermi self-interaction regime
members.description: No cosmological simulations of SFDM-TF structure formation exist to calibrate the halo mass function cutoff shape, the subhalo mass function, and the core-envelope profiles in realistic environments; existing results come from idealized isolated-collapse runs and the card leaves the full subhalo treatment to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological hydrodynamical-fluid simulations of SFDM-TF (Thomas-Fermi pressure added to a collisionless-Boltzmann or SPH solver, as in the paper's formalism) over a grid of R_TF from parsec to kiloparsec scales, calibrating the HMF filter/barrier, subhalo abundance, and core-envelope scaling used in steps s3 and s4.

members.model_name: Partially interacting dark-atom dark matter with dark acoustic oscillations
members.description: Nonlinear predictions for DAO-damped, oscillatory transfer functions are not supplied (nonlinear block 'partial', analysis restricted to k <= 0.12 h/Mpc), so quasi-linear and small-scale data cannot be used and the halo/subhalo mass function response below the DAO scale is uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized with DAO transfer functions across a grid of (f_int, r_DAO, damping strength), and fit a halofit-style nonlinear correction plus halo mass function suppression that extends the usable k range beyond the linear cut.

members.model_name: Exothermic Yukawa-potential interacting dark matter
members.description: No structure-formation simulations exist for exothermic self-interacting dark matter in this model's regime: N-body runs implementing velocity kicks from down-scattering are needed to predict low-mass-halo evaporation, core formation, and the subhalo mass function, which the card can only describe qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological zoom-in N-body simulations with a Monte Carlo inelastic-scattering module (extending existing SIDM implementations in AREPO or GADGET) over a grid in (sigma_T/m_chi, delta, excited-state fraction), calibrating a semi-analytic evaporation model against the runs.

members.model_name: Multi Scalar Field Dark Matter
members.description: No nonlinear structure-formation capability exists for multi-field ultralight scalar dark matter: existing Schrodinger-Poisson/fuzzy-DM simulation codes evolve a single field, so halo and subhalo mass functions, soliton structure with two interfering species of different m_i and fraction R, and a properly nonlinear Ly-alpha treatment are all unavailable, leaving constraints linear-only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public fuzzy-dark-matter solver (AxioNyx or PyUltraLight class) to N gravitationally coupled scalar fields with independent masses and density fractions, simulate representative (m_1, m_2, R) benchmarks, and calibrate halo mass functions and soliton profiles for use in small-scale-structure recasts.

members.model_name: Kinetic recoupling dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear predictions are uncalibrated: the card states halo and subhalo mass-function effects are expected to track the modified P(k) but no N-body simulations with recoupling initial conditions exist, so nonlinear probes (weak lensing, subhalo counts) can only be used approximately.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of cosmological N-body simulations seeded with recoupling transfer functions across the (T_kd, T_rec, T_kd_prime) grid to calibrate the halo/subhalo mass function and nonlinear power response, fit with a half-mode-style transfer parameterization.

members.model_name: Dark matter from early decays
members.description: No N-body simulations are calibrated to the decay-produced nonthermal daughter spectrum, so subhalo abundance, concentration suppression, and the Q-limited constant-density cores are only qualitative expectations (the closest related simulations study late decays with 20-40 km/s kicks, not this early-decay regime).
members.proposed_resolution: Run WDM-style cosmological and Milky Way zoom N-body simulations with initial conditions from the decay-model transfer function plus thermal velocities drawn from the analytic f_DM(q), scanning (alpha_c, Q), and fit subhalo mass function and concentration-mass corrections.

members.model_name: U(1) late-decaying dark matter
members.description: No public simulation-calibrated mapping exists from (epsilon, tau_chi_star) to dwarf-cusp softening and subhalo disruption for this model's regime: the cited external simulations cover selected windows (epsilon ~ 5e-5 to 7e-5, tau ~ 1-30 Gyr) and the card's benchmark epsilon ~ 1e-5 lies in an uncalibrated small-kick regime, with baryonic feedback degeneracies unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Run an N-body suite with two-body decays imparting v_kick = epsilon*c over a grid spanning epsilon ~ 1e-5 to 1e-4 and tau ~ 0.1-100 Gyr, and calibrate a halo-response emulator (profile change and subhalo mass function) including a baryonic-feedback comparison set.

members.model_name: MDM U(1)_X cold dark matter with sterile-neutrino hot component
members.description: The nonlinear predictions are uncalibrated (simulation_calibrated: no): no N-body/SIDM simulations exist for the combined ~1e9 Msun protohalo cutoff and velocity-dependent self-interaction of this MeV-mediator model, so halo/subhalo mass function and cluster-consistency statements remain analytic targets.
members.proposed_resolution: Run ETHOS-style cosmological zoom simulations seeded with the gap_1 transfer functions and the model's velocity-dependent sigma(v)/m, calibrating the subhalo mass function and dwarf/cluster halo profiles for confrontation with Milky Way satellite and cluster data.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from pion decays after the QCD phase transition
members.description: The small-scale-structure prediction stops at a few-kpc free-streaming estimate: no nonlinear N-body calibration exists for halo/subhalo statistics of this low-momentum-enhanced nonthermal distribution, and no thermal-WDM mapping is provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute linear transfer functions from the tabulated f_s(q) with CLASS ncdm, fit a half-mode mass and effective thermal-WDM mapping, and validate against a small suite of nonthermal-WDM N-body simulations to calibrate the subhalo mass function used by satellite-count and lensing likelihoods.

members.model_name: Two-body decaying cold dark matter to warm dark matter and dark radiation
members.description: No nonlinear structure-formation pipeline exists for this scenario: subhalo abundance, concentration, and dwarf-galaxy limits on daughter kick speeds (v_k of 3e-5 to 2e-3 c over lifetimes up to about 100 Gyr) are only mapped qualitatively from linear theory, with no simulation-calibrated likelihood (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with two-body decay velocity kicks (extending existing decaying-DM simulation codes that inject v_k at rate Gamma) across the S8-favored region, calibrate a subhalo mass-function suppression model, and connect it to Milky Way satellite-count likelihoods with baryonic marginalization.

members.model_name: Gauged L_mu-L_tau complex-scalar self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The mapping from this model's velocity-dependent cross section to actual halo core observables is only calibrated for generic SIDM: no simulations exist for the combined asymmetric-relic plus attractive/repulsive Yukawa regime of this L_mu-L_tau model, and the card records subhalo_mass_function_effect and simulation_calibrated as unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological zoom-in N-body simulations with the velocity-dependent Yukawa cross section sigma(v) predicted at the model's benchmark (m_Zprime ~ 10 MeV, q gprime set by relic abundance), calibrating core sizes and subhalo abundances against the existing constant-cross-section SIDM suites to validate the sigma_V/m mapping assumed in the constraint.

members.model_name: Gauged L_mu-L_tau Dirac self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The mapping from this model's velocity-dependent cross section to actual halo core observables is only calibrated for generic SIDM: no simulations exist for the combined asymmetric-relic plus attractive/repulsive Yukawa regime of this L_mu-L_tau Dirac model, and the card records subhalo_mass_function_effect and simulation_calibrated as unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological zoom-in N-body simulations with the velocity-dependent Yukawa cross section sigma(v) predicted at the model's benchmark (m_Zprime ~ 10 MeV, q gprime set by relic abundance), calibrating core sizes and subhalo abundances against the existing constant-cross-section SIDM suites to validate the sigma_V/m mapping assumed in the constraint.

members.model_name: One-to-one resonantly produced mixed sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Subhalo abundance is estimated from the linear transfer function with a simple mass threshold; no nonlinear-simulation-calibrated subhalo mass function exists for mixed CDM plus resonantly-produced sterile spectra, making the Milky-Way satellite comparison unreliable near the viability boundary.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of zoom N-body simulations (or calibrate a semi-analytic model such as Galacticus/SatGen) over a grid of sterile fraction f and spectrum warmth, and fit a subhalo-mass-function suppression formula parameterized by the mixed transfer function shape.

members.model_name: Three-to-one resonantly produced mixed sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Subhalo abundance predictions for mixed CDM plus resonantly produced sterile spectra rest on a linear-power threshold estimate; no N-body-calibrated subhalo mass function or semi-analytic model is calibrated for these nonthermal mixed cold-warm transfer functions, and no thermal-WDM mapping is valid.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of cosmological zoom simulations (or recalibrate an existing semi-analytic subhalo model such as SatGen/Galacticus) using CLASS transfer functions for a grid of sterile fractions f and spectra, and fit a subhalo mass function correction as a function of f and spectral warmness.

members.model_name: nuMSM lepton-asymmetry resonant sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure predictions (halo and subhalo mass functions) are uncalibrated for the strongly non-Fermi-Dirac resonant spectra; the paper explicitly states that simulations with the non-equilibrium spectra are still needed, so dwarf-halo and satellite-count comparisons rely on approximate thermal mappings.
members.proposed_resolution: Run WDM-style N-body simulations initialized with the exact resonant f(p)-derived transfer functions across the viable (M_1, n_L/s) grid and calibrate a subhalo-mass-function fitting formula usable in satellite and lensing likelihoods.

members.model_name: Relativistically decoupled warm dark matter with arbitrary distribution function
members.description: No nonlinear simulation calibration exists for initial power spectra with WDM acoustic oscillations near k ~ 2 k_fs; halo and subhalo mass-function effects at the ~1e8 solar-mass scales the paper maps them to are uncalibrated, and existing WDM N-body suites use monotonic thermal cutoffs only.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of N-body (and hydrodynamic, for Ly-alpha) simulations initialized with oscillatory transfer functions drawn from the paper's formalism, including thermal velocities from the corresponding f_0(p), to calibrate halo/subhalo mass functions and provide the training set for the gap_1 emulator.

members.model_name: Reduced Relativistic Gas warm dark matter with phenomenological photon-baryon interaction
members.description: The advertised small-scale power suppression from RRG warmness is only a qualitative motivation: no linear transfer function is computed on the card, no thermal-WDM mass mapping is valid, and no nonlinear simulation calibrates the halo or subhalo mass-function effect.
members.proposed_resolution: After the CLASS implementation of gap_1, compute the linear P(k) cutoff as a function of b, establish an effective mapping to the thermal-WDM half-mode scale, and calibrate the nonlinear halo/subhalo mass function with a small suite of N-body simulations using RRG initial transfer functions.

members.model_name: Pure SU(N)_x hidden gluino LSP
members.description: Nonlinear effects of the late-coupled hidden gluino subcomponent on halo and subhalo mass functions are uncalibrated (simulation_calibrated: no), limiting the structure constraint to linear theory.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized from the modified transfer functions of the fractional interacting component (as done for ETHOS models) to calibrate halo and subhalo mass-function suppression versus f_x and the drag decoupling scale.

members.model_name: Light magnetic dipole dark matter
members.description: The predicted protohalo cutoff at thousands of solar masses has no simulation-calibrated mapping from the damped linear power spectrum to surviving minihalo/subhalo abundances, so the small-scale observable cannot be confronted with substructure probes beyond the analytic M_min estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body zoom simulations (or recalibrate existing acoustic-damping-cutoff simulation suites of the ETHOS type) with initial conditions from the dipole late-KD transfer function to calibrate the minihalo mass function near M_min.

members.model_name: Self-interacting warm dark matter
members.description: No nonlinear structure-formation simulations are calibrated for SI-WDM (the card records simulation_calibrated: no): halo and subhalo mass-function suppression is inferred from the linear cutoff by WDM analogy, and the combined effect of the modified linear spectrum plus late-time self-scattering at sigma/m up to 0.1 cm^2/g on halo profiles and substructure is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized from siwdm-class transfer functions with an SIDM scattering module (as in Arepo/Gadget SIDM implementations) using the model's velocity-dependent cross sections, and calibrate halo/subhalo mass functions and concentrations against the standard WDM and SIDM suites.

members.model_name: Dark SU(N) scalar glueball dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation for glueball dark matter is uncalibrated: the card marks halo and subhalo mass-function effects as unknown with no simulation calibration, so the low-Lambda regime where cannibal (3-to-2) and elastic self-interactions are strong has no simulated predictions for halo profiles or small-scale structure.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological N-body simulations with SIDM modules extended to the glueball case (elastic self-scattering plus number-changing 3-to-2 interactions at low confinement scale) to calibrate halo profiles and subhalo mass functions across the viable Lambda-xi_T space.

members.model_name: Swampland-motivated fading dark matter
members.description: No calibrated nonlinear model exists for the dark-sector attractive fifth force and late-time mass fading (the card lists simulation_calibrated: no and only qualitative statements about halos and satellite tidal tails), so S8/weak-lensing comparisons beyond linear theory and any small-scale predictions are uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with a scalar-mediated dark-sector fifth force and time-dependent particle masses (extending modified-gravity/coupled-quintessence N-body codes such as MG-Gadget- or ISIS/RAMSES-type solvers) and calibrate a halo-model or emulator correction for the nonlinear matter power spectrum.

members.model_name: Non-thermally produced WIMP dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear consequences of the free-streaming cutoff (Local Group subhalo counts, inner halo smoothing) are asserted but uncalibrated; the paper itself states detailed halo effects require high-resolution simulations, and simulation_calibrated is 'no'.
members.proposed_resolution: Run WDM-style cosmological zoom N-body simulations seeded with the model's suppressed initial power spectra (handling artificial fragmentation as in modern WDM work) to calibrate the subhalo mass function and halo-profile response as a function of r_c.

members.model_name: Cool atomic dark matter subcomponent
members.description: Nonlinear structure predictions (halo mass function, subhalo mass function, nonlinear P(k), calibrated sigma8/weak-lensing observables) for cool ADM with f_adm up to 0.1 and a roughly 60 Mpc suppression scale have never been computed; the card records simulation_calibrated: no and step s4 has no tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological N-body simulations initialized from the ADM-modified linear transfer functions across a grid in (f_adm, T_d^0, B_d/T_d^0), and calibrate a nonlinear P(k)/halo-mass-function correction (e.g. a halofit-style or emulator fit) usable in weak-lensing sigma8 analyses.

members.model_name: Cosh-potential scalar-field dark matter
members.description: The kpc-scale cutoff prediction (r_c ~ 1.2 kpc) is only a semi-analytic equilibrium estimate: no nonlinear scalar-field/Schroedinger-Poisson simulations calibrate how the cosh-model cutoff maps to halo profiles, substructure counts, or rotation curves (nonlinear simulation_calibrated: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Run Schroedinger-Poisson (or self-interacting scalar-field) halo-formation simulations initialized with the cosh-model transfer function from gap_1, and calibrate the relation between m_phi, the r_c core/cutoff scale, and the subhalo mass function against existing FDM simulation results.

members.model_name: ETHOS-4 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: All reported ETHOS-4 small-scale predictions come from dark-matter-only zoom simulations; the card flags baryonic effects (satellite disruption by the disc, core creation/contraction) as an assumed-away systematic with high extrapolation risk, so satellite counts and central densities carry an unquantified baryonic uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run full-physics hydrodynamical zoom simulations of a Milky Way analogue with the ETHOS-4 initial power spectrum and velocity-dependent self-scattering, and use them to calibrate baryonic correction factors for the subhalo V_max function and core densities used in the satellite comparison.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7 keV sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear predictions for Milky Way satellite abundance, radial distribution, and profiles are only partially simulation-calibrated and lean on approximate thermal-WDM equivalent masses (1.7-2.9 keV), whereas the resonant transfer-function shape differs from thermal WDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Milky Way zoom-in simulations (or extend a WDM-calibrated subhalo mass-function emulator with a transfer-function-shape parameter) using the exact resonant transfer functions for the L_4 benchmarks, delivering suppressed SHMF and Vmax functions usable by satellite likelihoods.

members.model_name: Ballistic Dark Matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation with BDM's oscillatory transfer function and ballistic initial velocities has never been simulated (halo and subhalo mass function effects are recorded as not studied), so small-scale and quasi-linear observables cannot be modeled beyond linear theory.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations (e.g. Gadget-4 or SWIFT) initialized with BDM transfer functions and post-transition velocity perturbations for representative (z_star, f_BDM) points, to calibrate how the acoustic features and ballistic velocities evolve into the nonlinear regime.

members.model_name: Dark-atom self-interacting dark matter with dark acoustic oscillations
members.description: No public simulation suite or emulator for nonlinear structure with DAO initial conditions plus velocity-dependent dark-atom self-scattering; the paper's N-body runs cover only selected benchmarks and are not released, so halo mass functions, subhalo statistics, and core sizes cannot be predicted across the (alpha_D, m_H, xi) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a grid of cosmological N-body simulations using an existing velocity-dependent SIDM scattering module (Gadget/Arepo-type implementations) seeded with atomic-DM DAO transfer functions, and calibrate an emulator for the halo/subhalo mass function suppression and core radii as functions of r_DAO and sigma_T/m(v).

members.model_name: ETHOS-1 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The ETHOS-1 satellite predictions come from dark-matter-only zoom simulations; baryonic effects (disk disruption, reionization suppression) are flagged as likely to push the already strongly suppressed subhalo population below observed counts, and no hydrodynamic zoom simulations of MW analogues with ETHOS-1 physics exist to settle this.
members.proposed_resolution: Run MW-analogue zoom simulations combining the ETHOS-1 initial power spectrum and self-scattering with a galaxy-formation model (e.g. the AREPO/IllustrisTNG or an EAGLE-type module), quantifying satellite survival and central densities with baryons.

members.model_name: ETHOS-2 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The ETHOS-2 satellite predictions come from dark-matter-only zoom simulations; baryonic effects (disk disruption, reionization suppression) are flagged as able to alter satellite survival and central densities, and no hydrodynamic zoom simulations of MW analogues with ETHOS-2's combined damping plus self-interaction physics exist to settle this.
members.proposed_resolution: Run MW-analogue zoom simulations combining the ETHOS-2 initial power spectrum and self-scattering with a galaxy-formation model (e.g. the AREPO/IllustrisTNG or an EAGLE-type module), quantifying satellite survival and central densities with baryons.

members.model_name: ETHOS-3 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The velocity-dependent Yukawa self-scattering module used in the AREPO zoom simulations is private, so the nonlinear predictions (subhalo V_max functions, core densities) cannot be regenerated or extended to new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement elastic velocity-dependent (Yukawa transfer cross section) DM self-scattering in a public N-body code (e.g. the public AREPO or GADGET-4 SIDM branches), calibrated to reproduce the published ETHOS-3 subhalo abundance and core-density results.

members.model_name: Thermal wino dark matter with inelastic kinetic decoupling
members.description: The subhalo mass function, concentration-mass relation, and tidal survival near the wino free-streaming cutoff (M_fs ~ 1e-7 M_sun) are computed with an analytic model that is not calibrated by N-body simulations resolving the DAO-plus-cutoff initial power spectrum, leaving the annihilation boost factor with uncontrolled uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in N-body simulations seeded with the wino DAO/free-streaming transfer function down to the cutoff mass, calibrate the subhalo mass function, concentrations, and tidal-stripping survival, and distill the results into an emulator or fitting functions for boost-factor calculations.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear halo phenomenology of the condensate Higgs mode (density profiles, core formation, subhalo abundance) is explicitly left for future work and no simulation calibration exists for this BCS-condensate regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run superfluid/fuzzy-dark-matter-style structure simulations (Schrodinger-Poisson or SPH-superfluid solvers) with the model's derived Higgs-mode mass and quartic self-coupling to calibrate profile and subhalo predictions against dwarf-scale data.

members.model_name: Vector-like quark color-superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear halo phenomenology of the condensate (profiles, cores, subhalo abundance) is explicitly left for future work and no simulation calibration exists for this color-superconducting condensate regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run superfluid/scalar-field structure simulations (Schrodinger-Poisson or superfluid-hydro solvers) using the derived Higgs-mode mass and quartic coupling to calibrate halo profile and substructure predictions.

members.model_name: XC charged dark matter with a light C particle
members.description: No cosmological or zoom-in simulations exist that include the model's long-range self-scattering plus dissipative processes (dark Bremsstrahlung, Thomson scattering, recombination/ionization cooling by free C particles), so halo morphology, subhalo abundance, and cluster-merger predictions cannot be made beyond analytic cooling-timescale estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body plus two-fluid hydrodynamic zoom-in simulations with a dark cooling function tabulated from the model's Bremsstrahlung/Compton/recombination rates (analogous to existing dissipative-SIDM simulation programs), scanning the (m_X, m_C, alpha_D) benchmarks near the viable dissipative region.

members.model_name: Charged leptophilic dark electron model
members.description: The nonlinear predictions (satellite abundance, halo cores from attractive velocity-dependent self-interactions) are only partially simulation-calibrated; no simulation suite or emulator covers the combined late-kinetic-decoupling cutoff plus attractive light-scalar SIDM regime of this model, and cluster-scale SIDM bounds need a dedicated velocity-dependent recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with the ETHOS-like initial power-spectrum cutoff and a velocity-dependent attractive Yukawa self-interaction cross section (dwarf-to-cluster velocities), calibrating a subhalo mass function and core-density emulator usable with Milky Way satellite-count and cluster likelihoods.

members.model_name: Nearly totally dissipative self-interacting dark matter SMBH-seeding model
members.description: Collapse is calibrated only in isolated NFW halos, so there is no cosmological tdSIDM simulation from which dwarf-galaxy density-profile/kinematic predictions or strong-lensing substructure signatures can be derived for this nearly-totally-dissipative regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological zoom-in simulations with the dissipative-SIDM module (f_diss near 1, sigma/m around 0.05 cm^2/g, including velocity-dependent variants) for dwarf- and lens-scale halos to calibrate density profiles and subhalo mass functions for downstream lensing and dwarf-galaxy recasts.

members.model_name: Majoron-assisted semi-annihilating Z3 scalar dark matter
members.description: There is no simulation-calibrated model connecting the semi-annihilation self-heating rate to dwarf-galaxy core sizes; the paper's core-formation claim rests on an uncalibrated halo thermalization estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body/hydro simulations with an injected per-particle heating term parameterized by (m_chi, <sigma v>_semi, energy release per event), analogous to SIDM gravothermal studies, and fit a semi-analytic core-size relation usable for dwarf and Milky Way satellite halos.

members.model_name: U(1)' dark-photon self-interacting dark matter from a MeV first-order phase transition
members.description: No PTA stochastic-background likelihood is connected to the model's dark U(1)' phase-transition parameters; the paper compares the analytic GW spectrum to the nHz band by eye, so no statistical statement against NANOGrav/EPTA/PPTA/CPTA data is possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the FOPT spectrum Omega_GW(f; T_*, alpha, beta/H_*, v_w) in an existing public PTA analysis framework (PTArcade/ENTERPRISE with the NANOGrav 15-yr free-spectrum posteriors), sampling jointly with the CosmoTransitions map from potential parameters to transition parameters.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational dark matter from first-order-phase-transition PBHs
members.description: No likelihood or public sensitivity module exists for the MHz-GHz stochastic GW background from the phase transition; detectors in this band are only proposed, leaving the route's final comparison without a quantitative target.
members.proposed_resolution: Collect published projected sensitivities of proposed high-frequency GW detectors into a reusable power-law-integrated sensitivity/likelihood module for Omega_GW(f) in the MHz-GHz band applicable to FOPT spectral templates.

members.model_name: Massive dark photon from axion tachyonic production
members.description: No likelihood exists for the predicted chiral stochastic GW background: the route only overlays templates on prospective detector sensitivity curves, with no machine-readable PTA/interferometer stochastic-search likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Omega_GW(f) template into existing public stochastic-background likelihoods (NANOGrav/EPTA free-spectrum and LVK isotropic stochastic searches) as a registry likelihood over (m_a, f_a, alpha_D, m_X).

members.model_name: Feebly coupled U(1)_X hidden-sector dark fermion dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the model's Omega_GW(f) output in existing stochastic-background statistical tools — PTPlot/LISA SNR calculations for future detectors and the released NANOGrav/EPTA free-spectrum likelihoods for the low-frequency tail — as a parameter-point likelihood over (m_D, m_Aprime, g_x, epsilon, xi_0, lambda_h, v_w).

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition rescued self-interacting fermion dark matter

members.model_name: Kinetically misaligned audible axion dark matter

members.model_name: Ultralight tensor dark matter from a massive Fierz-Pauli spin-2 field

members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's tensor residual templates (gravitational effect at 2m and universal-coupling effect at m, with tensor angular response and polarization-ratio priors) as a deterministic signal in a standard PTA analysis framework (enterprise-style) and run against PPTA DR2 / IPTA data to produce genuine tensor-ULDM upper limits on h_osc and alpha_coupling.

members.model_name: Superheavy right-handed-neutrino dark matter with zombie co-annihilation in extended B-L

members.proposed_resolution: Couple a public cosmic-string SGWB spectrum calculator (Blanco-Pillado-Olum or Lorenz-Ringeval-Sakellariadou loop distributions) to the model's v_R -> Gmu mapping, and evaluate the spectrum with current PTA free-spectrum likelihoods (e.g. via PTArcade/ceffyl) and published interferometer power-law-integrated sensitivity curves, propagating loop-model choice as a systematic.

members.model_name: Dark photon dark matter from cosmic string loop decay

members.proposed_resolution: Recast the predicted Omega_GW(f) through the NANOGrav 15-yr free-spectrum posterior (PTArcade/ceffyl-style), apply the LVK O3 isotropic stochastic-background bound at 25 Hz for the high-frequency tail, and impose published black-hole superradiance exclusion tables on the ultralight dark-photon mass, combining them into one likelihood over (m, v, g, alpha).

members.model_name: R-parity neutralino dark matter in a split-SUSY SO(10) GUT
members.description: The metastable cosmic-string gravitational-wave prediction has no model-specific spectrum calculation or PTA likelihood recast: the PTA-favored region is described qualitatively and con_so10_pta_string_region has likelihood_available: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the stochastic GW spectrum for the model's M_B-L and sqrt(kappa_GUT) values using a metastable-string template and evaluate it against the NANOGrav 15-yr and IPTA data with a public PTA likelihood framework such as PTArcade/enterprise, mapping the posterior onto the (M_B-L, kappa) benchmark plane.

members.model_name: Extremely supercooled singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No PTA spectral likelihood is bundled with the route: the predicted bubble-collision Omega_GW(f) is compared only to the reported nano-Hertz band and model-independent fits, so the GW observable cannot be turned into a statistical constraint or posterior on (m_s, lambda_s, lambda_hs).
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the computed Omega_GW(f) with the public PTA free-spectrum posteriors referenced as model-independent fits (NANOGrav/EPTA-style violin data), building a wrapper that maps route outputs (T_p, alpha, beta/H, v_w) to the likelihood and propagates the phase-transition parameter uncertainties.

members.model_name: Axion-curvaton primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No PTA stochastic-background likelihood is bundled, and the card's PTA exclusion status rests on pre-2017 EPTA/PPTA/NANOGrav sensitivity curves; a recast against modern PTA data releases is required to update the model's exclusion/projection.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap a public PTA likelihood (enterprise or PTArcade with the NANOGrav 15-yr and EPTA DR2 datasets, plus SKA projections) around the computed Omega_SGW(f), so the route returns a current exclusion or detection-prospect statement instead of the primary paper's curve comparison.

members.model_name: Double-inflation parametric-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No PTA stochastic-background likelihood is bundled, and the card's PTA exclusion status rests on pre-2017 EPTA/PPTA/NANOGrav sensitivity curves; a recast against modern PTA data releases is required to update the model's exclusion/projection.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap a public PTA likelihood (enterprise or PTArcade with the NANOGrav 15-yr and EPTA DR2 datasets, plus SKA projections) around the computed Omega_SGW(f), so the route returns a current exclusion or detection-prospect statement instead of the primary paper's curve comparison.

members.model_name: Trapped-axion resonant dark photon production
members.description: No likelihood exists to compare the predicted stochastic GW background and Delta N_eff from trapped-axion dark-photon production against PTA/interferometer sensitivities and CMB dark-radiation bounds; kinetic-mixing bounds on a massive dark photon also require recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood step from published pieces: evaluate the predicted Omega_GW(f) against NANOGrav/EPTA free-spectrum posteriors and LISA/ET power-law-integrated sensitivity curves, use the Planck N_eff posterior for the Delta N_eff component, and recast existing dark-photon kinetic-mixing exclusion tables for the massive stable case.

members.model_name: Ultralight L_mu-L_tau vector dark matter
members.description: No public PTA likelihood implements the deterministic vector-ULDM signal (vector gravitational-potential time delay plus muon-charge-sourced Doppler oscillation) for L_mu-L_tau dark matter; the primary fit is a binned chi-square on published angular correlations rather than a full timing-residual likelihood, so the alpha <= 0.477 region cannot be verified or updated on future PTA data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the vector-ULDM correlation curve and Doppler source term as a deterministic signal model in ENTERPRISE/PTArcade against the NANOGrav 15-year data set, fitting m, g, and rho_dm jointly with the SMBHB background and validating against the paper's alpha interval.

members.model_name: Galileon ultra-slow-roll primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The claimed NANOGrav15/EPTA compatibility of the induced GW spectrum rests on a visual band comparison; no PTA likelihood evaluation of the model's Omega_GW(f) has been performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the computed Omega_GW(f) into an existing public PTA analysis framework (e.g. the NANOGrav 15 yr free-spectrum posteriors via PTArcade-style recasting) to obtain posterior constraints on the Galileon amplitude, peak scale, and w.

members.model_name: Miracle-less WIMP with gauged B-L entropy dilution
members.description: No detector likelihoods exist for the cosmic-string GW spectral break: the card's gw_detector_reach_mass_window and cmb_cosmic_string_tension_bound constraints both report likelihood_available 'no', so the M_DM-f_delta prediction can only be compared to digitized sensitivity curves, not evaluated statistically against PTA data or LISA/ET/CE forecasts.
members.proposed_resolution: Build an Omega_GW(f) likelihood module that takes the broken-power-law string spectrum and evaluates it against published PTA free-spectrum posteriors (NANOGrav/EPTA) and standard LISA/ET/CE noise curves with power-law-integrated sensitivity, e.g. as a cosmic-string template within an existing stochastic-background inference framework such as PTArcade or SGWBinner-style codes.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from radiative-symmetry-breaking first-order phase transitions
members.description: Detector constraints on the predicted GW spectrum are applied only as sensitivity-curve comparisons: neither a PTA (NANOGrav/EPTA/PPTA/CPTA) likelihood for the transition spectrum nor a LIGO/Virgo O3 stochastic-background likelihood is packaged for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the supercooled-transition GW spectrum as a template in existing PTA new-physics analysis pipelines for the 2023 datasets and evaluate the LVK O3 isotropic stochastic-background likelihood on the same spectrum, replacing the ruled-out/compatible sensitivity-band statements with posterior contours in (phi_0, g, g_tilde, lambda).

members.model_name: High-tension string-theory QCD axion-string dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood recasts the predicted relic abundance and stochastic GW spectrum against data: the overclosure exclusion is a hand comparison and no detector-band (PTA/LISA/interferometer) likelihood exists for the network-collapse GW signal.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relic-density comparison and a GW recast against published PTA and LISA power-law-integrated sensitivity curves as a likelihood over (m_a, f_a, mu_eff, P, T_coll), reusing the spectrum templates from the network simulation gap.

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP dark matter with right-handed sneutrino NLSP
members.description: The BBN constraint on late Bino visible-energy injection exists only as literature bound curves read off by the authors; no machine-readable energy-injection likelihood over (tau_B, B_had Y_B E_vis) is available for this model's decay chain.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the benchmark decay chains with a public BBN energy-injection code such as ACROPOLIS (hadronic and electromagnetic modes) and package the resulting light-element bounds as a reusable likelihood over (m_B, m_snuR, m_3/2, tau_B, B_had).

members.model_name: Goldilocks gravitino dark matter from neutralino decays
members.description: No BBN likelihood exists for late electromagnetic and hadronic energy injection from neutralino-to-gravitino decays in this scenario; the card records only pass/fail comparisons against 2007-era decay-constraint plots, with hadronic branching fractions the dominant untreated uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast with ACROPOLIS for electromagnetic injection and extend to hadronic injection using published Kawasaki-Moroi constraint grids, wrapping the result as a likelihood in (tau_chi, zeta_EM, zeta_had) with modern light-element abundance measurements.

members.model_name: Z' portal thermal squeezeout dark-baryon model
members.description: The BBN bound on late glueball decay is imposed only as a decay-before-BBN cutoff; no hadronic/electromagnetic energy-injection likelihood has been run, although the highest-mass benchmarks sit exactly at this boundary.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the glueball decay spectra through the Z' portal and evaluate light-element constraints with a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS, turning the tau_0++ boundary into a proper likelihood over (tau_0++, glueball abundance).

members.model_name: Coleman-Weinberg ultralight scalar dark matter with GeV-scale right-handed neutrinos
members.description: No recast likelihood maps this model's (A, m_phi, m_N, theta) space onto existing fifth-force/light-scalar exclusion curves, heavy-neutral-lepton search limits, and the BBN bound on long-lived GeV-scale RHNs; the card lists likelihood_available as unknown and recasting_needed as yes for these constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published fifth-force (Eot-Wash/MICROSCOPE-type) and scalar-Higgs-mixing limits plus HNL exclusion compilations, express them as bounds on the induced scalar-matter coupling from A and on (m_N, theta), and package them as a joint likelihood over the model parameters with the BBN lifetime cut.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino dark matter with L=2 masses
members.description: The BBN constraint on late NLSP decays is applied only as a hard tau_NLSP <= 100 s cut; no light-element yield likelihood over the NLSP lifetime-abundance plane, including hadronic and electromagnetic cascades, is available for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a late-decay BBN cascade code (ACROPOLIS or an AlterBBN-based injection setup) over the (tau_NLSP, NLSP yield, decay branching) grid for the higgsino-neutralino and stau NLSP cases and release the resulting light-element likelihood, replacing the 100 s hard cut.

members.model_name: No-scale SU(5) gravitino LSP dark matter with shifted hybrid inflation
members.description: No likelihood implementation exists for the BBN/gravitino-cosmology reheating window: the card's con_bbn_reheat constraint (2e6 < T_r < 2e9 GeV) is stated as a window with likelihood_available 'no' and recasting_needed 'yes', so the reheating bound cannot be folded into a statistical scan of (T_r, m_3/2, m_g).
members.proposed_resolution: Build a T_r-dependent BBN likelihood by mapping late-decaying-particle and thermal-gravitino BBN bounds (e.g. from AlterBBN or PRIMAT abundance calculations combined with published gravitino-cosmology exclusion curves) into a smooth likelihood over (T_r, m_3/2), and couple it to the analytic relic formula.

members.model_name: Feebly gauged B-L freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The FASER reach and BBN survival of the long-lived Z' are quoted only qualitatively; no model-specific LLP reach or BBN energy-injection constraint exists for a B-L Z' with an additional invisible Z' -> N N branching in the g_B-L ~ 1e-7 to 1e-6 window.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the FORESEE B-L Z' benchmark with the Z' -> N N branching and model lifetimes to produce quantitative FASER/FASER2 sensitivity curves, and compute the BBN constraint on late Z' decays with an energy-injection code such as ACROPOLIS.

members.model_name: Light fermionic dark sector with dark photon and dark Higgs
members.description: The BBN consistency requirement on the secluded regime (long-lived dark Higgs or slow-annihilating relics spoiling light-element abundances) is asserted qualitatively on the card with likelihood_available: no; no quantitative lifetime-versus-abundance BBN bound has been recast for this spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the dark-Higgs lifetime and abundance at BBN across the scan and apply published BBN energy-injection bounds for MeV-GeV late decays (e.g. with AlterBBN or the standard Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi injection grids), yielding a pass/fail surface for the secluded points.

members.model_name: Hidden-fermion-assisted gravitino dark matter
members.description: No modern BBN energy-injection likelihood is wired up for late stau LOSP decays in this scenario; the card carries only the approximate paper-era BBN bound, and neutralino LOSP variants would additionally need a hadronic/electromagnetic injection recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the LOSP abundance and lifetime through a current BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with electromagnetic/hadronic cascades and stau bound-state catalysis) to produce a pass/fail or chi-square surface over (tau_LOSP, LOSP yield).

members.model_name: DFSZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: BBN viability of the neutralino or stau NLSP decays is enforced only through quoted lifetime thresholds (about 1 s typical, about 5e3 s severe for stau bound states); no light-element abundance code is configured with the model's electromagnetic/hadronic injection and stau-helium bound-state catalysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with the NLSP yield, lifetime, and visible branching fractions from the spectrum point, adding the catalyzed-BBN treatment for the stau NLSP case, and replace the lifetime cut with a light-element likelihood.

members.model_name: Very supersymmetric co-decaying dark sector
members.description: The BBN bound on late hidden-scalar decays is only a qualitative timing cut (decay after neutrino decoupling is shaded as excluded); there is no quantitative BBN energy-injection likelihood specific to the model's hadronic/electromagnetic final-state mix that could soften or sharpen the boundary.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with decaying-particle modules) over the (Gamma_phi, m, abundance) plane using the scalar's Higgs-mixing-determined branching fractions, and release the resulting exclusion surface as a tabulated likelihood.

members.model_name: Thermal unparticle unmatter dark matter
members.description: The BBN constraint is only the proxy criterion rho_U(T_BBN) < rho_gamma(T_BBN); no light-element likelihood has been evaluated for the extra unparticle energy density with equation of state w_U during BBN (con_bbn_unparticle_density: likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Add the unparticle component with density scaling rho_U ~ a^{-3(1+w_U)} to a public BBN code such as AlterBBN or PArthENoPE and derive light-element bounds on r_U(T_BBN) as a function of d_U and T_D, replacing the photon-density proxy.

members.model_name: Nonthermal gravitino dark matter from pseudo-moduli decay
members.description: The BBN viability check for late pseudo-moduli and nonthermal NLSP decays uses approximate decay-temperature cuts rather than a machine-readable late-decay energy-injection likelihood in the (T_d, Y_NLSP, branching) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable likelihood from a public late-decay BBN injection code (e.g. an ACROPOLIS-style calculation over lifetime, yield, and electromagnetic/hadronic branching), tabulated so route-level scans can consume it directly.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter from gauge-mediated Q-ball decay
members.description: No quantitative BBN likelihood is configured for this scenario: viability cuts on the MeV-scale decay temperature, residual NLSP abundance, and thermal-gravitino reheating bound are applied only as analytic pass/fail conditions from the 2011 paper, with no light-element abundance code evaluating the actual injected energy.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN) with the Q-ball decay temperature T_D and the residual NLSP electromagnetic/hadronic injection as source terms, and turn the current pass/fail cut into a light-element likelihood over (Q, M_F, m_3/2).

members.model_name: Light hidden fermion assisted gravitino dark matter
members.description: No implemented BBN energy-injection recast for the late LOSP and gravitino decays: the coupling lower bound lambda_X is taken from the paper's stau bound-state example (tau < 2e3 s) and does not cover neutralino LOSPs or general hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a public late-decay BBN code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with the model's tau_LOSP, injected energy, and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions per LOSP identity, including bound-state catalysis for the charged stau case, to produce a reusable likelihood over (lambda_X, m_LOSP, m_X, m_3/2).

members.model_name: Asymmetric vector-mediator SIDM with photon kinetic mixing
members.description: No current direct-detection recast exists for the kinetically mixed light-vector portal with q-dependent (long-range) recoil spectra: the card cites only experiment-generic bounds with partial likelihood availability and no digitized limits applied to this benchmark's momentum-dependent cross section.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the epsilon-mediated nucleon scattering with the (q^2 + m_phi^2)^-2 propagator form factor in DDCalc or a DarkBit-style pipeline and evaluate against current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, jointly with the BBN mediator-lifetime floor on the mixing.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine high-baryon bubbles
members.description: The residual-HBB BBN constraint is applied only as the rough requirement eta_b^B/eta_b^ob <~ 1; no inhomogeneous-BBN calculation or likelihood exists for light-element yields from surviving high-baryon regions of the predicted size and density distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public BBN code (PRIMAT or AlterBBN) to inhomogeneous baryon patches with the HBB size/eta_b^in distribution, including post-BBN diffusion and mixing, and turn the resulting D/H and He-4 predictions into a likelihood on the residual-HBB parameters.

members.model_name: Triple-unification ultralight scalar dark fluid
members.description: No BBN light-element abundance likelihood is connected to the scalar dark-fluid parameterization (rho_phi proportional to a^-n plus decay time); the paper's 95 percent C.L. ratios are OCR-transcribed with ambiguous normalization and cannot be reproduced or updated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple AlterBBN's modified-cosmology mode (dark density with index n and decay history) to a modern D and He-4 observational abundance likelihood (PRIMAT/PArthENoPE-style error budget) in an MCMC over (rho_phi(1 MeV), n, decay time), and re-derive the upper-limit ratios quoted in the paper.

members.model_name: Dirac fermion WIMP from modulus-dominated nonstandard cosmology
members.description: The BBN constraint is applied only as a sharp analytic T_RH > 4 MeV floor; no light-element likelihood for the modulus-dominated low-reheating history is available on the card (likelihood_available is no and recasting is needed).
members.proposed_resolution: Couple a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) to a modulus-reheating background evolution to produce a reusable likelihood in (m_phi, tau_phi, T_RH), replacing the fixed 4 MeV floor.

members.model_name: Symmetric scalar-mediator SIDM with Higgs mixing

members.proposed_resolution: Implement the theta_h Higgs-mixing nucleon coupling with the (q^2 + m_phi^2)^-2 light-mediator form factor in DDCalc or a DarkBit-style pipeline, evaluate against current LZ/XENONnT likelihoods, and impose jointly the theta_h > 1e-5 BBN mediator-decay floor from the card's validity domain.

members.model_name: Colored t-channel mediator freeze-in plus superWIMP dark matter
members.description: No BBN likelihood for late hadronic decays of the metastable colored mediator; the card notes BBN cascade bounds were cited but never rerun for this model's lifetime and hadronic energy injection.

members.model_name: Gravity-mediated gravitino dark matter with moduli-stabilized 5D supergravity
members.description: The BBN safety of late sneutrino-NLSP and Higgsino-NNLSP decays to gravitinos is argued only qualitatively from abundances; no quantitative BBN energy-injection recast or likelihood is set up for this model's decay spectra and lifetimes.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute NLSP/NNLSP lifetimes, hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions, and pre-decay yields from the spectrum-generator output, then feed them into a public BBN injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN-style injection module) to produce quantitative exclusion contours over (r_1, r_2, m_3/2, T_R).

members.model_name: Type Ib seesaw right-handed-neutrino portal freeze-in dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the (M, U^2) exclusion and sensitivity curves from public HNL limit compilations (existing digitized PS191/CHARM/NuTeV/LHC bounds, BBN lifetime bounds, and published SHiP/FCC-ee projections) into a machine-readable constraint set, adapted to the type-Ib pseudo-Dirac mixing pattern.

members.description: No branching-fraction-resolved BBN energy-injection likelihood is interfaced for the semi-stable eta states; the dominant constraint on the model is currently only a qualitative lifetime cut because hadronic versus electromagnetic branching fractions are not tabulated and no likelihood grid exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute eta branching fractions into hadronic and electromagnetic channels from the model's decay formulae, then run ACROPOLIS (or interpolate Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi tables) on the (tau_eta, m_eta, yield, branching) grid to produce a reusable exclusion surface, validating against the paper's exclusion of hadronic lifetimes above 100 s.

members.proposed_resolution: Compute the Y decay branching ratios and injection spectra in the SE6SSM and run them through a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN) to replace the 1 s timing cut, and recast the LZ result with a public direct-detection likelihood package such as DDCalc.

members.model_name: Superweak sterile-neutrino dark matter

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter

members.model_name: STFM triplet WIMP with singlet-assisted nonthermal freeze-in
members.description: The BBN constraint on late singlet-NLOP decays (hadronic injection for lifetimes above ~100 s) is applied only as an approximate cut from primary-paper plots; no quantitative BBN energy-injection likelihood exists for this model's decay spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the singlet-NLOP visible decay spectra and evaluate them with a public late-decay BBN code such as ACROPOLIS to produce a lifetime-yield exclusion likelihood against current light-element data.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine Q-ball gravitino dark matter in gauge-mediated MSSM
members.description: No BBN light-element likelihood is set up for late NSP decays to gravitinos in this scenario: the allowed (m_3/2, tau_NSP, NSP species) region is only quoted from earlier gravitino-LSP literature, and no electromagnetic/hadronic cascade calculation was run for the model's stau/sneutrino/neutralino NSP cases.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute NSP decay spectra (electromagnetic and hadronic branchings) for each candidate NSP species and interface (Y_N, tau_NSP, spectra) to a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS with a light-element abundance likelihood, reproducing the sub-GeV gravitino allowed range as validation.

members.model_name: LCSUGRA Bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: The BBN reheating-temperature bound from unstable gravitino decays is only an analytic paper-era limit; no BBN abundance likelihood as a function of (m_3/2, T_R, hadronic branching ratio) is available (route likelihoods note 'BBN abundance likelihood not included', recasting_needed: yes).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the required BBN gravitino-yield module by interfacing gravitino production/decay yields with a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) and modern light-element abundance likelihoods, parameterized in m_3/2, T_R, and hadronic branching fraction.

members.model_name: Secluded WIMP with right-handed neutrino mediator
members.description: No BBN likelihood exists for the metastable N_R mediator: the decay-before-BBN requirement is imposed as a rough lifetime cut with no calculation of electromagnetic/hadronic injection from N_R decays to neutrino and Higgs final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the N_R branching fractions and injected spectra from the Y_nu portal and feed them into a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN to produce a lifetime-abundance exclusion likelihood in the (m_NR, Y_nu) plane.

members.model_name: Superheavy asymmetric thermal dark matter with late entropy dilution
members.description: No BBN likelihood or consistency code is applied to the late entropy-injection decay: the T_RH >= 10 MeV floor is imported as a fixed literature cut rather than computed for this model's decaying-state lifetime, branching, and dilution factor zeta up to 1e10.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the entropy-dump scenario through a public BBN injection code (e.g. AlterBBN or ACROPOLIS-style low-reheating modules), parameterized by the decaying state's lifetime, hadronic/electromagnetic branching, and zeta, to produce a model-specific BBN-allowed region and likelihood.

members.model_name: chameleon scalaron dark matter in F(R) gravity with R^2 correction
members.description: No BBN likelihood exists for scalaron dark matter: existing BBN codes do not accept the scalaron-induced shifts of nucleon masses and fundamental couplings as time-dependent inputs, so the R^2/scalaron-mass bound remains a qualitative estimate rather than a light-element likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) to take time-dependent nucleon-mass and coupling variations sourced by the scalaron trajectory from gap_1, and build a D/H and Y_p likelihood over (R^2 coefficient, m_phi, delta phi), calibrated against the trace-coupling translation of the related chameleon papers.

members.model_name: Neutralino dark matter from heavy gravitino decay
members.description: The BBN constraint on hadronic showers from late gravitino decay relies on transfer calculations (astro-ph/0408426-type) whose hadronic-injection tables are not packaged as a public likelihood; without them the (m_3/2, tau_3/2, B_h, gravitino abundance) exclusion cannot be recomputed for this model's parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS to hadronic cascades (or release the Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi hadronic transfer tables in reusable form) and wrap it with a light-element abundance likelihood taking (m_3/2, tau_3/2, B_h, Y_3/2) as inputs.

members.model_name: AMSB nonthermal wino dark matter from gravitino decay
members.description: The BBN constraint on gravitino decay timing is only an approximate lifetime comparison: no pipeline evaluates photo- and hadro-dissociation limits from the gravitino's actual hadronic branching fractions and abundance across the (T_R, m_3/2) plane for these AMSB spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the analytic gravitino abundance, lifetime, and Isajet-derived cascade branching fractions into a public BBN energy-injection code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN-style photodissociation modules) to produce a proper excluded region in (T_R, m_3/2) replacing the approximate timing argument.

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter in partially composite supersymmetry
members.description: BBN constraints on late NLSP decays are applied only as conservative lifetime screens (tau_NLSP below O(0.1-100) s); no hadronic/electromagnetic cascade computation or light-element likelihood has been run for the neutralino and stau NLSP cases, and stau catalyzed BBN is not treated.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the NLSP abundance, lifetime, and branching-dependent energy injection with a public BBN injection code (ACROPOLIS, or Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi tables) and add a bound-state catalysis treatment for the stau NLSP case, producing exclusions in the (m_NLSP, m_3/2, T_R) plane.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated gravitino dark matter with messenger-threshold production and pseudo-moduli entropy dilution
members.description: No BBN constraint recast exists for the long-lived light higgsino (lifetime of order 1 s, m_higgsino ~ 300 GeV benchmark) decaying in this GMSB gravitino scenario; the card carries only the paper's benchmark safety statement, so the m_3/2 upper edge of the 100 MeV-1 GeV window cannot be quantitatively constrained.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the late-decay BBN bound with a public injection code such as ACROPOLIS (or the Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi late-decay grids), inputting the higgsino abundance, lifetime, and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions as functions of m_3/2 and m_higgsino, to replace the benchmark-only safety statement with a bound over the full parameter window.

members.model_name: CMSSM with GUT-scale right-handed neutrino, gravitino LSP, and sneutrino NLSP
members.description: No BBN or collider likelihood is wired to the route: the (mostly invisible) sneutrino-to-gravitino decay needs a quantitative BBN energy-injection check, and the compressed-spectrum missing-energy signature has no recast against LEP/LHC searches (likelihood_available no, recasting_needed yes for both constraints).
members.proposed_resolution: Apply an existing decaying-particle BBN code (e.g. ACROPOLIS) to the sneutrino lifetime and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions, and recast current compressed-spectrum electroweak SUSY searches on the sneutrino-neutralino mass plane with CheckMATE/SModelS.

members.model_name: Kinetic-mixing Z' portal FIMP dark matter
