members.description: The BBN constraint on a light, long-lived Z' (m_Z' < 2 m_chi) is only a naive tau < O(100) s lifetime cutoff; no light-element-network likelihood for the Z' abundance, lifetime, and visible branching fractions is available for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the model through a public late-decay BBN code (ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with decaying-particle injection), feeding it the frozen-in Z' abundance, lifetime, and electromagnetic/hadronic branching ratios as functions of epsilon and m_Z' to replace the lifetime cut with a light-element likelihood.

members.model_name: Super-weak sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The BBN guardrail on the light Z' (avoiding pion-producing decays and extra MeV-scale energy injection) is stated only qualitatively; no BBN network run or likelihood exists for this model's mediator mass and coupling range.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Z' decay channels and thermal abundance in a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT with an injection module) to derive a quantitative exclusion in the (M_Zprime, g_z) plane, replacing the qualitative pion-threshold argument.

members.model_name: Type III seesaw GMSB gravitino dark matter with L H_u inflation
members.description: BBN consistency for the long-lived stau NLSP (m_stau about 1 TeV, tau about 10 s decaying to a 10 GeV gravitino) is asserted at the paper's analytic-estimate level; no BBN likelihood or constraint code is wired into the route to test the electromagnetic/hadronic energy injection and bound-state effects of the stau.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the stau decay injection with an existing public BBN code (ACROPOLIS for late electromagnetic injection, cross-checked against the Kawasaki-Moroi-type charged-relic bounds including stau bound-state catalysis) over the benchmark (m_stau, tau_stau, m_3/2) region.

members.model_name: Type-X 2HDM secluded Dirac-fermion dark sector
members.description: No quantitative BBN light-element likelihood is connected to the late-decaying mediator: only a qualitative one-second lifetime criterion is used, so the bbn_decay_before_one_second constraint cannot be evaluated as a proper exclusion in (C_l, m_med).
members.proposed_resolution: Run the mediator's electromagnetic and neutrino injection through a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN, tabulating the excluded region in mediator lifetime versus abundance, and attach the result as a likelihood to the route.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal supersymmetric hylogenesis variant
members.description: The BBN constraint on the light pseudoscalar is only a crude lifetime cut (tau_a < 1 s) rather than a proper light-element abundance calculation for GeV-scale electromagnetic/hadronic injection, so the exclusion boundary in (m_a, theta_aA) is approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the pseudoscalar decay spectrum through a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN to replace the one-second lifetime criterion with an actual light-element likelihood over (m_a, tau_a).

members.model_name: High-scale SUSY gravitino dark matter with light higgsino NLSP
members.description: No BBN constraint likelihood exists for late higgsino-NLSP decays to gravitino plus electromagnetic/hadronic showers: the route can compute the NLSP lifetime and energy injection analytically but has no implemented mapping from (lifetime, injected energy, abundance) to a light-element allowed region.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a BBN energy-injection recast using a public injection code such as ACROPOLIS (or digitized Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi-type exclusion contours), taking the higgsino NLSP yield, lifetime, and hadronic/electromagnetic branching fractions as inputs and returning a light-element likelihood over (mu, m_3/2, T_reh, M3).

members.model_name: Light thermal pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark photon mediator
members.description: The NLO calculation covers only selected mediator-to-DM mass ratios, small mass splittings, and the benchmark Lorentz structure; larger splittings and other Lorentz structures are explicitly left to future work, so recasts outside the benchmark cannot be performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the NLO matrix-element derivation to general pseudo-Dirac mass splittings and alternative mediator Lorentz structures, parameterized by (m_Aprime/m_chi, delta, alpha_D), and tabulate correction factors for recasting.

members.model_name: Self-Conjugate ultra-light scalar dark matter with neutrino mediator
members.description: The neutrino-DM cross section is derived only in the local heavy-mediator limit s,u << M_I^2, which breaks down for lighter mediators or center-of-mass energies near M_I where the s-channel can resonate; the self-conjugate s/u-channel cancellation in the massless-neutrino limit also needs the full propagator structure to be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full tree-level cross section with complete s- and u-channel propagators and mediator width (Breit-Wigner near sqrt(s) ~ M_I), including finite neutrino-mass corrections that lift the self-conjugate cancellation, and validate it against the paper's local-limit formula.

members.model_name: CP-even sgoldstino wave-like dark matter
members.description: The equivalence-principle comparison in the low-mass window (m_phi below about 1.5e-18 eV) is quoted from generic scalar/dilaton results; the model-specific mapping from torsion-balance limits onto sgoldstino parameters, which depends on the electromagnetic composition charges of test bodies, has not been derived.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the composition-dependent charges induced by the sgoldstino photon coupling for the standard test-body materials (following the dilaton-charge formalism of Damour-Donoghue) and recast the MICROSCOPE/Eot-Wash equivalence-principle limits into the m_phi-M_gamma/F plane.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_tau scotogenic pattern-C fermion dark matter
members.description: The correlated LFV predictions are not computable from the card: BR(mu -> e gamma) and conversion rates from the scotogenic Yukawas h'_li and the inert-scalar spectrum have no attached implementation, even though the same Yukawas fix the neutrino texture and the annihilation channel, making LFV the central cross-check of the mechanism.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the standard scotogenic one-loop radiative-decay and mu-e conversion formulas from the cited LFV literature (or generate them automatically via SARAH/FlavorKit from the gap_1 model implementation), taking the texture-fit Yukawas as input and comparing against current MEG/MEG II limits.

members.model_name: Q-ball dark matter from Model B solitosynthesis
members.description: The exact Model B stability inequalities are degraded in the extracted source text (validity_domain notes degraded mathematical notation), and the metastable Q-ball / Q-cloud regime is not followed, so the precise stable-charge window entering the relic and detection calculations is not machine-usable from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-derive the Model B stability conditions (coupling-ratio threshold and stable/metastable charge ranges) directly from the potential V(S, phi) with a numerical Q-ball profile solver, and record the exact inequalities and Q_min(lambda, lambda_S, mu_S) on the card.

members.model_name: Dark matter pearls with low-tension vacuum domain walls around voids
members.description: No quantitative derivation exists of the vacuum-phase properties from the Multiple Point Criticality framework: the wall tension S, the nucleon potential drop Delta V, and especially the phase-dependent shifts of alpha and the proton-electron mass ratio are only order-of-magnitude or qualitative, so no observable has a sharp model prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the wall tension and in-phase particle properties from an explicit effective potential with two degenerate vacua (e.g. a QCD-like or scalar-field realization), and compute Delta alpha/alpha and Delta mu/mu in the new vacuum from the shifted condensates, producing closed-form predictions as functions of the model parameters.

members.model_name: No-scale SU(5) gravitino LSP dark matter with shifted hybrid inflation
members.description: The card's gravitino relic formula keeps only the dominant QCD (gluino) production terms; electroweak and top-Yukawa contributions to thermal gravitino production are not included, biasing the Omega_3/2 h^2 = 0.126 overclosure boundary in the (T_r, m_3/2, m_g) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the full gauge-group thermal gravitino production rate (QCD plus SU(2)_L and U(1)_Y plus top-Yukawa terms, as derived in the Pradler-Steffen/Rychkov-Strumia literature) in the route's abundance calculator and re-derive the viable T_r window for the no-scale SU(5) spectrum.

members.model_name: Axion cogenesis via kinetic misalignment without isocurvature
members.description: The PQ-charge-to-baryon-asymmetry conversion (axiogenesis/lepto-axiogenesis) depends on model-dependent sphaleron and lepton-number transport coefficients that are not derived in reusable form for this scenario's operator choices, so Y_B cannot be computed for a general point without redoing the transport analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and tabulate the transport/conversion coefficients c_B for the relevant B-L violating operators (following the lepto-axiogenesis literature cited by the card) as functions of T_R and the operator scale, and package them as a lookup usable with the gap_1 solver output.

members.model_name: Ultra-slow-roll KKL-potential primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: The mapping from this model's USR-enhanced curvature spectrum to f_PBH(M) uses an assumed Gaussian statistics and collapse threshold, while the card notes non-Gaussianity and stochastic USR effects can shift the abundance by orders of magnitude; the model-specific non-Gaussian curvature PDF has not been derived or folded into the abundance calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-Gaussian curvature/compaction distribution for the KKL USR feature via the delta-N or stochastic-inflation formalism, and compute f_PBH(M) with a threshold-statistics (peak/compaction) calculator using that distribution instead of the Gaussian baseline, propagating the same statistics into the SIGW normalization.

members.model_name: CP-violating AKS Higgs-resonance scalar dark matter
members.description: The electron-EDM cancellation mechanism (Barr-Zee diagrams from CP-mixed Higgs bosons interfering destructively with charged-scalar dark-sector loops) has no reusable formula-level implementation, and the paper's sign and phase conventions were lost in the extracted text.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-derive and code the Barr-Zee and dark-sector (S+/N_R loop) contributions to d_e for the AKS field content with complex lambda_5, validate the benchmark cancellation against the paper, and package it as a callable EDM module.

members.model_name: Quadratically coupled scalar ultralight dark matter EFT
members.description: Experiment-specific response functions mapping the tensor Wilson coefficients c_2 and c_4 onto published Lorentz- and rotation-symmetry test observables (sidereal/annual modulation amplitudes in the halo rest frame) are missing, so the apparent-Lorentz-violation channel cannot be recast beyond order-of-magnitude estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the matching of the c_2 and c_4 induced QED background onto the Standard Model Extension coefficient basis used by published Lorentz tests, tabulate the resulting per-experiment modulation response for a boosted halo velocity distribution, and release the recast tables alongside the EFT conventions.

members.model_name: KSVZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: The KSVZ thermal axino production rate from QCD scatterings and decays is only known to order-of-magnitude precision near the strongly coupled QCD scale, and no public implementation of the yield calculation exists for this model's (f_a, T_R, m_gluino) parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the gauge-invariant resummed thermal-field-theory axino production rate (including the low-T_R decay contributions) as a small public module parameterized by T_R, f_a, m_gluino, and squark masses, benchmarked against the source yield curves.

members.model_name: SU(5) x U(1)_PQ axion-inflation dark matter model
members.description: The proton-lifetime prediction ignores GUT-scale threshold corrections in the gauge-coupling unification estimate, an acknowledged omission that directly shifts the quoted 8e34-3e35 yr tau_p window used to compare with next-generation detectors.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive one-loop threshold corrections from the SU(5) scalar multiplet spectrum (including M_R8, M_R3 splittings) and rerun the two-loop RGEs with matching at each mass scale to produce a corrected tau_p band.

members.model_name: CP-violating AKS heavy scalar dark matter
members.description: The electron-EDM cancellation mechanism (Barr-Zee diagrams from CP-mixed Higgs bosons interfering destructively with charged-scalar dark-sector loops) has no reusable formula-level implementation, and the paper's sign and phase conventions were lost in the extracted text.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-derive and code the Barr-Zee and dark-sector (S+/N_R loop) contributions to d_e for the AKS field content with complex lambda_5, validate the benchmark cancellation against the paper, and package it as a callable EDM module.

members.model_name: QED-like dark sector with heavy scalar messengers
members.description: Hadronic matrix elements of the dimension-nine baryon-number-violating operators that mediate K_L, B0, and neutron invisible decays are not computed for this model; the card notes they and narrow phase-space windows dominate the numerical rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the relevant baryon- and meson-to-dark-sector matrix elements with lattice QCD (adapting existing proton-decay/neutron-antineutron matrix-element calculations to these dim-9 operators) or with QCD sum rules, and package them with the phase-space integration as a small public branching-ratio code.

members.model_name: Benchmark FIMP freeze-in warm dark matter model
members.description: The radiative x-ray decay channel is only motivated: no explicit decay operator, radiative lifetime, or branching ratio is derived for the benchmark FIMP, so the x-ray line flux cannot be predicted and no line-search likelihood can be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify the operator inducing the radiative decay (e.g. a loop-level dipole from the Yukawa sector or the axino-like mapping), derive the lifetime as a function of m_chi and the feeble couplings, and compare the predicted line flux against published X-ray line limits (XMM-Newton/NuSTAR/eROSITA blank-sky bounds).

members.model_name: Gravitino dark matter from gauge-mediated Q-ball decay
members.description: The gravitino yield hinges on the small Q-ball branching ratio to gravitinos, which in the primary treatment is only an unsaturated-channel estimate with acknowledged model sensitivity; no implemented calculation of the Q-ball decay rates into gravitinos versus quarks exists in the registry pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the refined Q-ball decay-rate computation from the related follow-up work (card reference 1209_5781) as an analytic module giving B_3/2(omega_Q, m_3/2, M_F), and propagate its uncertainty band into Y_3/2 and Omega_3/2 h^2.

members.model_name: B-L charged scalar dark matter triggering nucleon decay
members.description: No benchmark operator choice and matching exists for the chi-induced neutron transition: the chi^2n O_{B-L=2n} operators are not reduced to a specific dimension and flavor structure, and the corresponding nucleon-level matrix elements have not been matched from quark-level operators for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Select lowest-dimension benchmark operators consistent with the B-L selection rule, and match them to nucleon-level transition amplitudes using existing lattice-QCD proton-decay matrix elements and chiral perturbation theory, following the induced-nucleon-decay formalism of the related literature (arXiv:1312.0011).

members.model_name: OHe composite dark atom model
members.description: The OHe-nucleus interaction potential (including the dipole Coulomb barrier that must prevent deep nuclear capture) has never been derived from a controlled quantum few-body calculation; all detector and Galactic excitation phenomenology depends on this unknown input.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform a dedicated nuclear few-body calculation (e.g. folding-potential or ab initio cluster methods for a heavy charge -2 core bound to He interacting with Na, I, and Ge nuclei) to derive the OHe-nucleus potential, bound-state spectrum, and low-energy radiative-capture and excitation cross sections.

members.model_name: Nonminimally coupled scalarized cold-dark-matter field
members.description: The radial and angular perturbation equations for scalarized stars in this exact coupling have not been derived or solved, so it is unknown which scalarized branches are stable and can be compared to observations (con_2208_stability_requirement).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear perturbation equations for this F(phi)R model following the scalar-hair stability formalism of the related work (rel_2007_09864) and implement a numerical mode solver to classify stable scalarized branches before observational comparison.

members.model_name: MST-EFT primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: The scalar-induced GW kernel for general post-inflation equation of state with effective sound speed c_s between 1 and 1.17 is not covered by standard radiation-era induced-GW implementations.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive and implement the general-(w, c_s) induced-GW transfer kernel as an extension of SIGWfast, cross-checking the w = 1/3, c_s = 1 limit against the existing implementation.

members.model_name: Interacting hot neutrino dark matter
members.description: The SN1987A optical-depth bound on neutrino self-scattering is only summarized from earlier work; no recast exists mapping the modern SN1987A data onto this model's s-scaling and 1/s-scaling cross-section parameterizations, though the card flags recasting as needed.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the optical depth of SN1987A neutrinos scattering on the cosmic neutrino background for both energy scalings of sigma_nunu, express the bound in the same lambda_mfp(T_nu=10 eV) variable used for the damping calculation, and add it as a prior in the likelihood pipeline.

members.model_name: Non-adiabatically produced gravitational ultra-light scalar dark matter
members.description: The production calculation exists only for an instantaneous de Sitter-to-radiation transition; the abundance and momentum distribution for realistic finite-duration reheating histories have not been derived, which the card flags as the leading production uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Generalize the Bogoliubov mode-matching calculation to a parameterized reheating stage (equation of state w_reh and duration N_reh), deriving N_k(m, H_dS, H_R, w_reh, N_reh) and quantifying the shift in the abundance benchmark and free-streaming length.

members.model_name: Present-decaying lepton-number SUSY Q-ball dark-matter subcomponent
members.description: The pion multiplicity and branching per unit charge when the pion channels open near the end of the Q-ball lifetime is not derived, leaving the normalization of the 67.5 MeV line and charged-pion bremsstrahlung continuum uncertain relative to the lepton channels.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hadronic branching of Q-ball surface evaporation as the mass-per-charge crosses the pion threshold, extending the standard saturated surface-evaporation rate calculation to multi-species final states, and tabulate photon yields per unit charge for use in the flux step.

members.model_name: Extra-light-modulus dilution of nonthermal LSP dark matter in mirage mediation
members.description: No phase-space distribution is derived for LSPs produced in gravitino decays after dilution, so the CDM-like structure-formation assumption (con_no_wdm_mapping) is asserted rather than demonstrated and no free-streaming scale can be quoted.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the LSP momentum distribution from gravitino decay kinematics plus redshifting and residual scattering, compute the free-streaming length for the 100-2000 GeV benchmarks, and confirm it lies far below observable structure-formation scales.

members.model_name: Axionlike dark matter electroweak cogenesis model
members.description: The hidden-sector sphaleron friction coefficient is never derived from a concrete hidden non-Abelian gauge sector (coupling, temperature ratio, confinement scale), leaving the pre-EWPT attractor and hence the relic normalization as an unspecified phenomenological input.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive Gamma_friction(T) from the hidden SU(N) sphaleron rate (Gamma_sph ~ alpha_hidden^5 T_hidden^4 scaled by the anomaly coupling 1/f^2) for a benchmark hidden sector including its thermal history and decay back to the SM, and publish it as a parameterized module usable by the evolution integrator of gap_1.

members.model_name: SO(10)-embedded fermion triplet dark matter
members.description: The proton-decay observable cannot be evaluated because the required SO(10) GUT-threshold spectrum is not reconstructed: the raw one-loop prediction tau_p = 4.2e24 yr is excluded, and no parameterized threshold-correction analysis exists to map allowed heavy spectra onto viable proton lifetimes.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive two-loop RGEs with explicit threshold matching for the 45_F/leptoquark spectrum and scan heavy-state masses (e.g. with a SusyTC/REAP-style or bespoke RGE code) to produce a defensible band of M_U and tau_p consistent with Super-K/Hyper-K.

members.model_name: Nucleon-coupled boson star dark matter
members.description: The ISM emission model covers only warm/hot ionized phases with a common electron-proton temperature; the acceleration and emission response of neutral ISM phases and the collisionless electron-proton non-equilibration regime have not been derived, and the flux assumes a single boson-star mass and fraction for the whole Galactic population.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the analytic emissivity derivation to neutral ISM phases and a two-temperature (electron/proton) treatment of the collisionless regime, and generalize the population flux formula from a single (M_*, f_*) to a boson-star mass function.

members.model_name: Yukawa-potential interacting dark matter
members.description: The classical transfer cross-section fit breaks down where the de Broglie wavelength exceeds the mediator force range, so quantitative sigma_T(v) is unreliable in the quantum/resonant part of the parameter space flagged by the card's validity domain.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_T(v) by non-perturbative partial-wave analysis of the Yukawa (or Hulthen-approximated) potential in the quantum and resonant regimes and package it as a fast calculator or lookup table covering the full (alpha_d m_chi/m_phi, m_chi v/m_phi) plane.

members.model_name: Dark-quark-nugget dark binaries with a long-range dark force
members.description: Near-merger inspiral for strong dark-force / high-frequency benchmarks lacks a post-Newtonian or numerical-relativity-style treatment; the available analytic radiation formulas break down where the card's validity note says PN corrections matter, degrading the predicted high-frequency SGWB spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive PN-corrected energy-flux expressions for binaries with both gravitational and scalar/vector dark-charge radiation (extending existing scalar-tensor PN literature to the attractive dark-charge case), and validate the late-inspiral spectrum against numerical two-body integrations for representative (alpha, M) benchmarks.

members.model_name: Scalar-graviton soft-core halo dark matter
members.description: The lensing observables of the scalar-graviton halo are underived: because the halo is a modified-gravity field configuration rather than particle CDM, light deflection need not track the effective density that sets rotation curves, and no lensing potential has been computed for the soft-core solution.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the null-geodesic deflection in the static scalar-graviton halo metric of the unimodular bimode theory, express the effective lensing convergence for the soft-core solution, and compare it to the dynamical mass to obtain a testable lensing-versus-dynamics prediction.

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled massive vector dark matter
members.description: The stability analysis of the longitudinal polarization is missing: the paper notes a negative kinetic term over a finite momentum range with the non-minimal coupling and defers the analysis, so no criterion exists to delimit the (xi_vector, H_I, k) domain where the mode spectra and abundance can be trusted.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the longitudinal-mode quadratic action with the non-minimal coupling (e.g. in a Stueckelberg formulation), map the regions of ghost/gradient instability in (xi_vector, H_I, physical momentum), and encode the result as an explicit validity mask consumed by the mode solver of gap_1.

members.model_name: CGF cosmological SU(2)-weak gauge-field dark matter stars
members.description: The metastable radius-transition observable has only order-of-magnitude energy (about 1e41 J) and timescale (about 1e10 s) estimates with no transition-rate or trigger mechanism, so no event-rate prediction or electromagnetic/gravitational signature model exists to compare against transient surveys.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the tunneling/perturbation-induced transition rate between the multiple-radius branches of the TOV solutions for M > 5.09e6 solar masses, and model the emission channel of the released gravitational energy so the signal can be recast against transient-survey data.

members.model_name: Dark-dimension dark graviton dark matter
members.description: The intra-tower decay widths depend on an unknown dark-dimension inhomogeneity parameter that has not been derived from the compactification geometry, so the dominant decay channels and cascade timescales are inputs rather than predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive graviton-to-graviton decay widths as a function of the metric inhomogeneity of the dark dimension (e.g. perturbative computation of KK-number-violating couplings for a warped or deformed circle) and publish them as a parameterized rate table for the cascade solver.

members.model_name: Dark-sector seeded Nelson-Barr scalar WIMP
members.description: theta_bar corrections and Nelson-Barr quality are handled with qualitative loop/operator-order estimates; no explicit higher-loop calculation of the induced theta_bar from the dark-sector Yukawas exists to confirm the nEDM-driven theta_bar < 1e-10 requirement across the WIMP-viable parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the leading two-loop contributions to the down-quark mass-matrix phase from the B, D_i, and dark-scalar sector and evaluate theta_bar numerically over the relic-viable scan points, mapping where the quality condition fails.

members.model_name: Majorana Majoron ALP dark matter
members.description: The anomaly-induced a-Z-gamma coupling and possible inverse-Primakoff-like laboratory signals are only sketched qualitatively in the primary paper; no derived coupling values or recast against existing ALP search limits exist for this Majoron.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive g_aZgamma and the effective photon coupling from the electroweak chiral anomaly for this lepton-number charge assignment, then recast published ALP photon-coupling limits (helioscope, haloscope, astrophysical) onto the (m_a, f_a) plane.

members.model_name: Deeply bound uuddss sexaquark dark matter
members.description: The compact-S overlap with two-baryon and nuclear states — controlling the transition amplitude lambda, the S lifetime, nuclear conversion rates, and the post-QCD breakup rate — is unknown to orders of magnitude; all stability and relic-preservation conclusions hinge on assumed effective hadronic matrix elements.
members.proposed_resolution: A lattice-QCD computation of the uuddss binding energy and of the S <-> BB' overlap/transition matrix elements (extending existing H-dibaryon lattice programs to the deeply bound compact configuration), supplemented by quark-model estimates to bracket the wavefunction-overlap suppression.

members.model_name: Spin-3/2 effective dark matter
members.description: No EFT-validity/unitarity cutoff has been derived for the spin-3/2 contact operators (eft_cutoff is null and the card notes no cutoff was extracted), so the mass-coupling range over which the relic and detection predictions can be trusted is undefined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive perturbative-unitarity bounds on each of the 14 operators (partial-wave analysis of the 2-to-2 amplitudes, which grow with energy for spin-3/2) and record the resulting validity domain Lambda(M, G_i^f) on the card.

members.model_name: U(1)' extra doublet neutral fermion cold dark matter
members.description: The complete anomaly-free U(1)' charge assignment for the extra SU(2)_L doublet and its anomaly-canceling partners is not preserved in the card (lagrangian_available: partial, no charge table), so the candidate's Z' and Z couplings needed by every downstream step are not fully specified.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct the full anomaly-free charge table and Yukawa mass terms from the primary paper and its references, and write out the neutral-doublet couplings to Z', Z, and W as an explicit parameterized Lagrangian.

members.model_name: SUSY SU(2)_H confinement model with Z2- and R-parity dark matter
members.description: The low-energy effective theory below the SU(2)_H confinement scale — mass spectrum and couplings of the fifteen mesonic superfields and the Z2/R-parity-odd states, including the identity of the lightest odd-sector particles — is not derived beyond a single benchmark, so no forward model has defined inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Write down the full confined-phase superpotential and soft terms for the mesonic superfields, diagonalize the parity-odd mass matrices over the model parameters (not just the benchmark), and publish the spectrum calculation so the DM candidate(s) and their couplings are explicit functions of the inputs.

members.model_name: Scalar hexaquark S dark matter
members.description: No nuclear-stability calculation exists for the predicted m_S = 1.18-1.24 GeV window: the double-weak conversion rates of nucleon pairs in nuclei (especially oxygen) into S, and the corresponding dibaryon lifetime, have not been computed with realistic nuclear matrix elements and compactness suppression.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute nn/pp/pn -> S conversion matrix elements in oxygen and other benchmark nuclei using a nuclear shell-model or ab-initio treatment combined with the hexaquark wavefunction-overlap suppression factor, following the Farrar-style compact-sexaquark formalism, and publish exclusion curves in (m_S, S-nucleon coupling).

members.model_name: Complex scalar dark fluid
members.description: The effective sound speed and pressure perturbation of the internally rotating complex scalar with V = m^2 phi^2 + A exp(-B|phi|) have not been derived, so Chaplygin-gas matter-power caveats cannot be legitimately transferred and the unified-fluid perturbation behavior is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the perturbation equations for the complex scalar in the rotating-phase ansatz, obtaining the effective c_s^2(k,z) and nonadiabatic pressure in both the quadratic-dominated (matter-like) and exponential-dominated (dark-energy-like) regimes, following the standard quintessence/UDM perturbation formalism.

members.model_name: Primordial quark-object dark matter
members.description: No quantitative stability calculation for macroscopic u/d/s quark objects: the MIT-bag stability argument is extrapolated from ~20-quark systems with no equation of state valid at astrophysical quark numbers, so the minimum stable mass and survival of primordial quark objects cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive a strange-quark-matter equation of state and stability window as a function of baryon number using modern perturbative-QCD-matched bag or NJL-model calculations (as done in the strange-quark-star literature), and publish the resulting stability flag as a small standalone module parameterized by (B, m_s, quark number).

members.model_name: Mixed moduli-anomaly mediated MSSM with nonthermal neutral-Higgsino dark matter
members.description: No momentum distribution has been derived for the Higgsinos produced in the gravitino-decay chain at T_R about 100 MeV (phase_space distribution_function_available unknown), so the free-streaming/kinetic re-equilibration check that certifies the population as cold dark matter is missing.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(p) for Higgsinos from two-body gravitino decay including redshift and electroweak scattering with the MeV-scale plasma, compute the resulting free-streaming length, and record whether any warm-component correction to the relic interpretation is needed.

members.model_name: Tunneling-stabilized self-destructing bound-state dark matter
members.description: The two-minimum potential is purely phenomenological: the tunneling lifetime of the metastable state and the matter-scattering cross section for excitation over the barrier into the promptly annihilating configuration are not computed from specified mediator dynamics, so the event-rate normalization and the tau_parent versus detector-lifetime separation are undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the bound-state quantum mechanics of the two-minimum potential numerically: compute WKB/instanton tunneling rates as a function of R and h_b R, and calculate nuclear-scattering-induced transition matrix elements between the metastable, delocalized, and inner states, packaging the result as a parameterized transition-rate module for the Earth-transition step.

members.model_name: Superheavy proton-like dark matter decaying through virtual black holes
members.description: The parton-level final states and fragmentation of the virtual-black-hole baryon-number-violating decay of the composite X (three superheavy constituent quarks) are not derived, so no injection spectrum exists to feed a propagation code.
members.proposed_resolution: Define benchmark quark/lepton final states consistent with the source's virtual-black-hole quantum-number restrictions and compute the QCD plus electroweak fragmentation spectra at M_X ~ 1e12 GeV with HDMSpectra, releasing tabulated dN/dE for p, gamma, and nu.

members.model_name: N MACHOs
members.description: No binary-formation and merger-rate model exists for N-MACHOs, and no waveform assessment distinguishes their neutron-star-like compactness at nonstandard masses from primordial black holes, so the gravitational-wave channel cannot be evaluated even at order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt PBH early- and late-universe binary-formation rate derivations to the N-MACHO mass function and halo distribution, and compute inspiral-merger signatures (tidal deformability from the polytropic equation of state) to estimate detectable merger rates for ground-based and future detectors.

members.model_name: Early matter-dominated primordial black hole dark matter with non-Gaussian clustering
members.description: The merger-rate implication of large-scale PBH clustering is only noted qualitatively; no forward model exists that maps the early-matter-domination clustering power P_PBH(k) into PBH binary formation and a LIGO/Virgo-comparable merger rate for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the clustered-PBH binary formation rate by extending standard early-universe PBH binary formation calculations to include the non-Gaussian clustering enhancement (local density and tidal environments drawn from the C_2-enhanced correlation function), validated with small N-body realizations of clustered PBH initial conditions.

members.model_name: PBH sterile neutrinogenesis of sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: The multimessenger discriminator is only qualitative: no quantitative gravitational-wave spectrum is derived for the PBH formation scenario and the PBH-dominated era (including the transition to radiation domination) that would accompany sterile neutrinogenesis at the benchmark M_PBH and beta values.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the induced and Poisson-fluctuation GW spectra for a PBH-dominated era with the paper's monochromatic mass function (1 g to 2e7 g benchmarks), producing Omega_GW(f) predictions comparable to LISA/ET sensitivity curves alongside the sterile-neutrino parameter space.

members.model_name: Scalar nontopological soliton dark matter
members.description: The dark-binary gravitational-wave channel lacks a binary formation and merger-rate calculation for NTSs with an additional attractive dark force, and no GW search likelihood exists for the resulting sub-microlensing-mass compact binaries.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the NTS binary capture and merger rate as a function of dark force strength and mass function (adapting PBH-binary formation formalism), then recast LIGO/Virgo subsolar-mass and continuous-wave search sensitivities into limits on the predicted merger rate.

members.model_name: Evaporating primordial black-hole dark matter as varying dark energy
members.description: The Delta N_eff ~ 0.35 estimate for the ultralight 1e9 g PBH population uses an instantaneous-neutrino-decoupling approximation that the card itself flags as needing a more accurate treatment, and no BBN-consistent calculation of the energy injection around neutrino decoupling exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Redo the energy-injection calculation with a full neutrino-decoupling transport treatment (extending a code of the FortEPiaNO/nudec_BSM class with the PBH evaporation source) and couple it to a BBN code such as PRIMAT or PArthENoPE to bound light-element effects for M ~ 1e9-1e10 g.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubble dark matter with primordial black holes
members.description: The heavy axion-minicluster population lacks a quantitative mass function and density-profile prediction, and the card notes minicluster lensing efficiencies are not equivalent to point-PBH lensing, so microlensing limits cannot be recast onto the model's compact-object population.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the minicluster mass and concentration distribution from the non-collapsing bubble statistics, then compute finite-source/extended-lens magnification and detection efficiencies for EROS, OGLE, and HSC cadences to convert survey point-lens limits into constraints on the minicluster fraction.

members.model_name: LED delayed evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: Induced gravitational-wave constraints on early black-hole-dominated eras are derived for four-dimensional PBHs; no recast exists to LED black-hole populations with modified mass-temperature-lifetime relations, so the ultralight-PBH GW bound cannot be applied to this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the induced-GW spectrum from a transient LED black-hole-dominated era using the higher-dimensional lifetime and evaporation-history relations, and map the published 4D exclusion regions onto the (M_*, n, T_RH/M_*, initial abundance) parameter space.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian axion-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No CMB-scale viability calculation exists for this model: the source leaves the analysis of scalar amplitude, n_s and r at CMB pivot scales for a potential that both fits Planck/BICEP/Keck and preserves the small-scale instability crossing to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: For candidate axion potentials, compute the CMB-scale background observables (A_s, n_s, r including the chromo-natural gauge-field contributions) with the same solver used for the PBH peak, and confront them with published Planck/BICEP/Keck constraints.

members.model_name: Curvaton sound-speed-resonance primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH abundance is computed with Gaussian statistics and a fixed collapse threshold delta_c, but curvaton-sourced perturbations are intrinsically non-Gaussian and the narrow resonant peak makes f_PBH exponentially sensitive to the assumed statistics; no derivation of the non-Gaussian formation probability for the SSR curvaton spectrum exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-Gaussian PDF of the density (compaction-function) fluctuations for the curvaton conversion mechanism and apply critical-collapse statistics with thresholds calibrated on numerical-relativity collapse simulations of narrowly peaked spectra, releasing the result as a mass-function calculator parameterized by (k_star, xi, curvaton fraction).

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from late B-L phase-transition patches
members.description: The PBH mass function is treated as monochromatic; the extended mass spectrum implied by the distribution of late-nucleation times has not been derived, and evaporation/microlensing constraints on the all-DM window shift for extended distributions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the PBH mass function from the nucleation-time distribution of surviving false-vacuum patches (convolving patch size at collapse with the horizon mass), then recast the asteroid-mass-window constraints using the standard extended-mass-function weighting applied to compiled bounds (e.g. the PBHbounds compilation).

members.model_name: ALP-triggered supercooled-phase-transition primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: PBH formation is treated only in a monochromatic, instantaneous-reheating approximation; the extended PBH mass function and non-instantaneous reheating/dilution corrections needed to robustly evaluate f_PBH — and to test whether the NANOGrav-preferred region truly overcloses — are not derived.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the delayed false-vacuum-decay calculation to the full late-patch statistics, deriving an extended PBH mass function and adding prolonged-reheating and entropy-dilution branches, then rerun the f_PBH=1 contour and the NANOGrav overclosure check.

members.model_name: Modified Affleck-Dine primordial black hole subcomponent model
members.description: The CMB mu-distortion constraint on 10^4 M_sun PBH formation is only argued qualitatively to be evaded by the highly non-Gaussian bubble statistics; no quantitative recast of spectral-distortion limits for the model's bubble profiles exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the photon-diffusion energy release from the model's non-Gaussian high-lepton-bubble density profiles and compare to FIRAS mu-distortion limits (and PIXIE-class forecasts), following the non-Gaussian PBH distortion formalism of arXiv:2107.03580.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter from two evaporating PBH distributions
members.description: The BBN, gravitational-wave, and inflation bounds are applied to each PBH population separately as a simplified approximation; no derived combined constraint treatment exists for a two-population scenario where entropy injection from one population dilutes or reshapes the bound on the other (the card flags this simplification for precision recasts).
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the BBN energy-injection bound and the induced/PBH-relic GW bounds self-consistently for the joint (M_BH1, M_BH2, beta_1, beta_2) history, including the second population's entropy dilution of the first's signals, and encode the result as exclusion functions on the beta-M planes.

members.model_name: Modulated linear chaotic inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No pipeline maps this model's computed P_R(k) to a PBH abundance beta and mass function: the card records only an order-of-magnitude P_R ~ 1e-3 formation threshold, with no collapse-threshold prescription, window-function choice, or extended-mass-function treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive beta(M) and f_PBH(M) from the solver's P_R(k) using a stated Press-Schechter or peaks prescription with an explicit collapse threshold delta_c and window function, including the extended mass function needed for constraint comparison, packaged as a small semi-analytic module downstream of the gap_1 solver.

members.model_name: primordial black holes from scalar-field fragmentation
members.description: The claim of large PBH spins from matter-era formation is qualitative; no spin distribution as a function of formation parameters is derived, so the distinctive spin observable cannot be compared with GW population data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the PBH spin distribution from tidal-torque and cluster angular-momentum statistics during matter-era collapse (extending existing matter-domination PBH spin calculations to the soliton-cluster case) and output a predicted a* distribution versus M_PBH.

members.model_name: Modulated quadratic chaotic inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No pipeline maps this model's computed P_R(k) to a PBH abundance beta and mass function: the card records only an order-of-magnitude P_R ~ 1e-3 formation threshold, with no collapse-threshold prescription, window-function choice, or extended-mass-function treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive beta(M) and f_PBH(M) from the solver's P_R(k) using a stated Press-Schechter or peaks prescription with an explicit collapse threshold delta_c and window function, including the extended mass function needed for constraint comparison, packaged as a small semi-analytic module downstream of the gap_1 solver.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter seeded by multifield inflation
members.description: The PBH abundance is exponentially sensitive to the curvature-perturbation tail, but no calculation of the non-Gaussian P(zeta) tail from this model's multifield USR phase exists; Gaussian threshold-collapse estimates leave f_PBH uncertain by orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the nonperturbative zeta distribution via stochastic delta-N on the two-field USR trajectory and feed it into a compaction-function threshold-collapse mass-function calculation, replacing the Gaussian Press-Schechter estimate.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from hybrid-inflation waterfall dynamics with higher-dimensional inflaton terms
members.description: The mapping from the nearly Gaussian waterfall P_zeta(k) peak to the PBH mass function and f_PBH lacks the extended-mass-function and non-Gaussian-tail treatment the card itself flags as required; only a source-level delta-function proxy is recorded.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the PBH mass function from the waterfall spectrum using peaks theory or Press-Schechter with nonlinear compaction-function thresholds and the model's actual perturbation statistics, producing an extended mass function psi(M) rather than a delta-function abundance.

members.model_name: Charged Planck-scale relic dark matter
members.description: The relic abundance f_CPR is treated as a free input: there is no implemented calculation from an initial PBH mass function through Hawking evaporation with a Planck-scale halt and stochastic charge acquisition to the present-day charged-relic abundance and charge distribution (the route lists 'PBH mass-function calculation' as a required but absent resource).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public PBH evaporation code (BlackHawk-type) with a Planck-mass evaporation floor and a stochastic charged-emission random walk to output f_CPR and the relic charge distribution as functions of the initial mass function, checked against the ordinary full-evaporation limit.

members.model_name: Memory-burden primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: Beyond the soft-quanta (E ~ 1/r_g) assumption, no quantitative emission-spectrum prescription d^2N/dE dt exists for the memory-burden stage, so the electromagnetic and hadronic injection history of a half-decayed PBH cannot be computed even within the phenomenological ansatz.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive, within the entropy-suppression ansatz, a parameterized greybody-weighted emission spectrum for the post-half-decay stage (rate suppressed by S^-n, quanta of order 1/r_g), publish it as a species-by-species spectrum table parameterized by (M, n), and propagate the ansatz uncertainty as a nuisance parameter.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation hidden-sector dark matter cogenesis model
members.description: The full redshifted Hawking-emission phase-space distribution f(q) for the hidden-sector DM (including grey-body factors, spin dependence, and the PBH mass-loss history) has not been derived or implemented, so the linear transfer function and small-scale power suppression are known only via a mean-momentum estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the emitted DM spectrum with BlackHawk for M_0 ~ 10^5 M_Pl including grey-body factors, redshift it through the entropy-dilution history, and feed the resulting f(q) into the CLASS ncdm module to obtain the transfer function and half-mode mass.

members.model_name: Primordial extremal black holes with dark electromagnetism
members.description: The binary merger rate R_merge of oppositely charged PeBHs, which sets the predicted rate of Hawking-burst transients, is not computed anywhere: no population model exists that includes the attractive dark-Coulomb interaction in binary formation and coalescence.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the standard early-universe PBH binary-formation formalism to charged pairs by adding the dark-electromagnetic force to the two-body dynamics and charge-pairing statistics of the initial distribution, yielding R_merge(M_eBH, f_eBH, charge distribution) as a semi-analytic model.

members.model_name: Primordial black-hole dark matter from multi-field sharp-turn inflation
members.description: The probability distribution of curvature perturbations from sharp-turn amplification is not derived beyond a near-Gaussian assumption, yet the PBH abundance is exponentially sensitive to the non-Gaussian tail; no tool or derivation fixes the tail statistics for this model's narrow peaks.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the full perturbation PDF for the sharp-turn benchmarks using delta-N or stochastic-inflation methods for the two-field system, and propagate it through a threshold-collapse (compaction-function) abundance calculation including QCD equation-of-state corrections to delta_c.

members.model_name: Supergravity axion-monodromy sharp-turn primordial black-hole dark matter model
members.description: The PBH abundance is computed with a Gaussian RD-era Press-Schechter estimate, but the non-Gaussianity of curvature perturbations generated by the transient sharp turns has not been derived for this supergravity axion-monodromy model, and f_PBH is exponentially sensitive to the tail of the perturbation PDF.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the curvature-perturbation bispectrum and tail statistics for the sharp-turn trajectory using PyTransport's non-Gaussianity module (or a stochastic/lattice delta-N calculation), then propagate the non-Gaussian PDF through a compaction-function threshold-collapse abundance calculation in place of the Gaussian Press-Schechter estimate.

members.model_name: Nucleon-coupled boson star dark matter
members.description: The Subaru-HSC microlensing constraint applies only after a dedicated recast mapping boson-star density profiles onto the extended-lens profiles used in the microlensing analysis; the card marks this recast as required but not performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute finite-size lensing magnification light curves for Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson boson-star profiles across the paper's (m, M_*, lambda) grid and recast the Subaru-HSC M31 event-rate limits onto the boson-star fraction f_*.

members.model_name: Multi-waterfall hybrid-inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH abundance is only a rough threshold estimate: the exponentially sensitive mapping from the multi-waterfall curvature spectrum to f_PBH, including the non-Gaussian statistics of the stochastic waterfall perturbations and a proper collapse threshold, is explicitly deferred by the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full one-point PDF of the coarse-grained curvature perturbation from the stochastic-delta-N solution (first-passage statistics) and feed it through a critical-collapse/compaction-function abundance calculation to obtain f_PBH(M) with quantified uncertainty, replacing the order-of-magnitude criterion.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass primordial black-hole dark matter from a quadratic curvaton with vanishing mean
members.description: The scalar-induced gravitational-wave signal accompanying the PBH-forming perturbations is only asserted qualitatively: no computation of the induced GW spectrum including the strongly non-Gaussian (chi-squared-like) curvaton statistics, and no PTA/LISA detector likelihood, is provided for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the induced GW spectrum from the model's P_zeta(k) including the non-Gaussian source contributions using established SIGW formalism, implement it as a spectral template, and compare it against PTA and LISA sensitivity via existing stochastic-background likelihood tools.

members.model_name: Modified Higgs-inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: PBH abundance and PTA-overproduction conclusions assume Gaussian curvature perturbations with a fixed collapse threshold delta_c = 0.414; the non-Gaussian corrections generated by the dip dynamics, to which the exponentially sensitive abundance is vulnerable, have not been derived for this potential.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the local non-Gaussianity of curvature perturbations across the dip (delta-N or stochastic-inflation calculation) and propagate it through the PBH formation probability, checking the PBH/PTA joint-consistency region against the Gaussian result.

members.model_name: Two-form-field inflationary primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH abundance is computed with a Gaussian Press-Schechter/compaction template although curvature perturbations sourced quadratically by two-form fields obey chi-squared-like non-Gaussian statistics to which the exponentially tail-sensitive f_PBH is uncontrolled; type-II perturbations are also neglected.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full non-Gaussian probability distribution of the compaction function for the two-form-sourced perturbations and redo the threshold-collapse abundance (including type-II perturbations), calibrating the collapse threshold against existing numerical-relativity results for peaked spectra.

members.model_name: Cubic Kähler nonminimal supergravity PBH dark matter model
members.description: The PBH abundance step assumes Gaussian density fluctuations with a Gaussian window, but ultra-slow-roll enhancement generically produces non-Gaussian tails that can change f_PBH by orders of magnitude; no model-specific non-Gaussian collapse-fraction derivation exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-Gaussian curvature-perturbation PDF for this model (delta-N or stochastic-inflation calculation on the transport-code background) and recompute beta and the M_PBH mass function with threshold statistics in compaction-function form.

members.model_name: Sextic Kähler nonminimal supergravity PBH dark matter model
members.description: The PBH abundance step assumes Gaussian density fluctuations with a Gaussian window, but ultra-slow-roll enhancement near the balanced false/true-vacuum structure generically produces non-Gaussian tails that can change f_PBH by orders of magnitude; no model-specific non-Gaussian collapse-fraction derivation exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-Gaussian curvature-perturbation PDF for this model (delta-N or stochastic-inflation calculation on the transport-code background) and recompute beta and the M_PBH mass function with threshold statistics in compaction-function form.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass primordial black holes from double-well inflation
members.description: No precise PBH mass-function calculation exists for this model: the paper uses an order-of-magnitude formation estimate, while f_PBH depends exponentially on the peak height and on collapse-threshold, spectral-shape, and non-Gaussianity choices (the card notes extended mass functions and non-Gaussianity are not handled).
members.proposed_resolution: Compute f_PBH(M) from the model's P_R(k) with modern compaction-function/peak-theory threshold statistics, including the ultra-slow-roll/constant-roll non-Gaussianity of the curvature perturbation, to replace the order-of-magnitude estimate with an extended mass function.

members.model_name: Double-inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No PBH mass-function calculator is attached that maps the double-inflation curvature power spectrum to the two-peak mass function with controlled collapse-threshold and non-Gaussianity treatment; the card flags the step as sensitive to both assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a peaks-theory/Press-Schechter PBH formation module taking P_zeta(k) and delta_c as inputs, with the collapse threshold and window-function choices exposed as systematic parameters, and validate by recovering the paper's 1e-13 M_sun and O(10) M_sun peaks.

members.model_name: Radiative hybrid inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: Non-Gaussianity of the waterfall-enhanced perturbations is not developed in the paper, yet the PBH abundance is exponentially sensitive to the tail of the density distribution and to the collapse threshold, so f_PBH(M) computed with Gaussian statistics carries an uncontrolled systematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the non-Gaussian statistics of the curvature perturbation through the waterfall transition (e.g. via the delta-N formalism or stochastic-inflation lattice methods applied to this potential) and propagate them into the PBH collapse fraction with compaction-function thresholds.

members.model_name: Gravitational-genesis two-component dark matter
members.description: The phase-space distribution function of the particle component produced by PBH Hawking evaporation (including redshifting of momenta emitted over the evaporation history) has not been derived for this model, so the mixed cold-relic plus warm-particle NCDM transfer function cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the greybody Hawking emission spectrum for the dark particle as a function of PBH mass (e.g. with BlackHawk-style evaporation spectra), integrate over the evaporation history with cosmological redshifting to obtain f(q) today, and feed it to CLASS as a tabulated ncdm distribution alongside a cold PBH-relic fluid component.

members.model_name: Planck-mass regular black-hole remnant dark matter
members.description: No calculation fixes the number density of microscopic regular black holes produced during inflation or reheating, so the remnant relic abundance is undetermined and the candidate cannot be compared to the observed dark matter density.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing PBH formation machinery (critical-collapse thresholds with a parameterized primordial power spectrum, or the cited reheating collision mechanism) to the microscopic-mass regime, and publish Omega_remnant as a function of the inflationary/reheating parameters and formation time.

members.model_name: PBH dark matter from transient constant-roll inflation
members.description: The perturbativity conclusion rests on representative cubic-action one-loop terms only; the complete one-loop correction to the enhanced spectrum (including quartic interactions and boundary terms for a smooth constant-roll transition) has not been derived, leaving the validity of the tree-level P_R(k) uncertain at the claimed PBH-forming amplitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the full one-loop power spectrum for the transient constant-roll insertion, including all cubic and quartic vertices and smooth-transition boundary terms, and publish the resulting perturbativity bound as a cut on (eta, duration, P_R peak) usable by the gap_1 pipeline.

members.model_name: Primordial dark matter halos from scalar fifth forces
members.description: The claimed suppression of CMB energy injection relative to PBHs is qualitative: no accretion-luminosity model exists for extended, non-compact solar-mass halos, so the PBH Planck bound cannot be quantitatively recast onto PDMHs.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the gas accretion rate and radiative efficiency for an extended isothermal-profile halo (replacing the Bondi-onto-horizon treatment of PBH studies), then feed the resulting energy-injection history into an ExoCLASS/HYREC-type ionization module with the Planck temperature/polarization likelihood.

members.model_name: QCD-epoch primordial black hole dark matter with aborted-PBH baryogenesis
members.description: The local baryon asymmetry produced in an aborted-PBH hot spot is computed only with an approximate Boltzmann treatment; a quantitative calculation of sphaleron rates and the effective Standard Model CP violation in the transiently reheated hot-spot environment is missing, so the eta_b normalization (the factor 2-3 times f_PBH) is uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the out-of-equilibrium sphaleron transition rate and CP-violating source in the expanding/cooling hot-spot background (extending electroweak-baryogenesis transport-equation machinery to this geometry) and validate against the primary paper's approximate treatment.

members.model_name: Axion-curvaton primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The LIGO-mass merger observable requires mapping (M_PBH, f_PBH) to a binary black-hole merger rate, but the card provides no binary-formation model and no route step covers this mapping; the card caveats that the merger-rate mapping depends on PBH binary-formation assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a merger-rate step implementing the standard early-universe PBH binary-formation rate calculation (Sasaki et al.-type, with cluster-formation channel as an alternative) for the model's extended mass function, and compare to the LIGO/Virgo observed BBH merger-rate density.

members.model_name: Double-inflation parametric-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The LIGO-mass merger observable requires mapping (M_PBH, f_PBH) to a binary black-hole merger rate, but the card provides no binary-formation model and no route step covers this mapping; the card caveats that the merger-rate mapping depends on PBH binary-formation assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a merger-rate step implementing the standard early-universe PBH binary-formation rate calculation (Sasaki et al.-type, with cluster-formation channel as an alternative) for the model's extended mass function, and compare to the LIGO/Virgo observed BBH merger-rate density.

members.model_name: Galileon ultra-slow-roll primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH abundance is computed only with a linear overdensity relation and Gaussian Press-Schechter thresholding; the nonlinear compaction-function and non-Gaussian (USR-induced) corrections, which can shift f_PBH by orders of magnitude, are not derived for this Galileon spectrum or its w-dependent thresholds.
members.proposed_resolution: Redo the abundance calculation with the nonlinear compaction function and threshold statistics (peaks-theory or compaction-based formalism) including the USR non-Gaussianity of zeta for each w in 0.16-1/3, and publish the corrected f_PBH(M) mapping for the paper benchmarks.

members.model_name: QCD axion domain-wall primordial-black-hole subcomponent model
members.description: No gravitational-wave spectrum has been derived for the specific wall network of this PBH calculation; the card only imports GW context from a related axion-wall paper with a different setup, so the GW observable cannot be evaluated for the same cosmology (same f_a, early matter domination) that sets the PBH abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the stochastic GW spectrum sourced by the same N_DW=1 string-wall network and closed-wall collapses used in the PBH abundance calculation, using standard domain-wall GW emission estimates parameterized by sigma_dw and the collapse-time distribution, then compare against PTA and interferometer sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Trapped-vacuum-bubble primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No forward model exists from the two-channel PBH mass function to gravitational-wave observables; the primary paper computes no merger-rate or stochastic-background signal, so the gravitational-wave probe cannot be evaluated for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the standard early-binary PBH merger-rate formalism and scalar-induced gravitational-wave calculation to the broad two-channel mass function and enhanced curvature spectrum, producing detector-band signal predictions for asteroid-mass benchmarks.

members.model_name: Modulated p=4 hilltop inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: No pipeline maps this model's computed P_R(k) to a PBH abundance beta and mass function: the card records only an order-of-magnitude P_R ~ 1e-3 formation threshold, with no collapse-threshold prescription, window-function choice, or extended-mass-function treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive beta(M) and f_PBH(M) from the solver's P_R(k) using a stated Press-Schechter or peaks prescription with an explicit collapse threshold delta_c and window function, including the extended mass function needed for constraint comparison, packaged as a small semi-analytic module downstream of the gap_1 solver.

members.model_name: Double-inflation red-tilted primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The LIGO-mass merger observable requires mapping (M_PBH, f_PBH) to a binary black-hole merger rate, but the card provides no binary-formation model and no route step covers this mapping; the card caveats that the merger-rate mapping depends on PBH binary-formation assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a merger-rate step implementing the standard early-universe PBH binary-formation rate calculation (Sasaki et al.-type, with cluster-formation channel as an alternative) for the model's extended mass function, and compare to the LIGO/Virgo observed BBH merger-rate density.

members.model_name: Running-mass inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The LIGO-mass merger observable requires mapping (M_PBH, f_PBH) to a binary black-hole merger rate, but the card provides no binary-formation model and no route step covers this mapping; the card caveats that the merger-rate mapping depends on PBH binary-formation assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a merger-rate step implementing the standard early-universe PBH binary-formation rate calculation (Sasaki et al.-type, with cluster-formation channel as an alternative) for the model's extended mass function, and compare to the LIGO/Virgo observed BBH merger-rate density.

members.model_name: Two-state inelastic self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The Arepo module implementing two-state inelastic (endothermic/exothermic) self-scattering is author code with no extracted public repository, so the simulation step of the only route cannot be reproduced or extended to new (sigma/m, Delta/m_chi, f_excited) points by others.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain public release of the authors' Arepo inelastic-SIDM patch, or reimplement the two-state velocity-dependent scattering kernel (elastic, up-scattering, and exothermic down-scattering with velocity kicks) in a public N-body code with an existing SIDM module such as Gadget-4 or the public Arepo, validated against the paper's five-times-elastic-equivalence benchmark.

members.model_name: Bose-Einstein-condensed scalar field dark matter
members.description: No public background solver implements the complex SFDM with conserved U(1) charge and quartic self-interaction: the stiff, radiationlike, and CDM-like phase transitions that set N_eff and z_eq must be reproduced from the primary-paper equations, since standard CLASS/CAMB scalar-field modules do not cover this charge-conserving, self-interacting condensate.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a standalone FRW + Klein-Gordon background integrator (or a CLASS background extension) taking (m, lambda/(mc^2)^2, Q) as inputs, using the fast-oscillation effective-fluid approximation in the oscillatory regime and validating against the quoted phase-transition redshifts and the m >= 2.4e-21 eV/c^2 bound.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter from late pseudo-WIMP decays
members.description: Public CLASS DCDM implementations cover decay to dark radiation or to a single massive daughter, but not this model's combined final state of massive self-interacting daughters with a tunable subdominant dark-radiation fraction F and daughter kick velocity.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the massive-daughter DCDM branch of CLASS (Abellan et al. type) with a branching fraction F into dark radiation and the daughter phase-space distribution from the mass splitting delta, then rerun the MontePython CMB/BAO/SN scans to reproduce the paper's two preferred regions.

members.model_name: Ultralight scalar dark matter coupled to Majorana neutrinos
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for neutrinos coupled to the coherent ultralight scalar background: the CMB constraint is derived from the simplified free-streaming proxy T_nu > g_phi*phi, and no CLASS/CAMB module treats the induced neutrino-plasma screening mass and the loss of neutrino anisotropic stress for this g_phi_ab coupling, so the exclusion boundary cannot be computed at Planck precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with an interacting-neutrino sector for a coherent scalar background (modifying the neutrino Boltzmann hierarchy with the scalar-induced scattering/damping rate and time-varying effective mass, analogous to existing neutrino self-interaction implementations), and attach the Planck TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing+BAO likelihood via MontePython or Cobaya, validating against the paper's approximate exclusion boundary.

members.model_name: Dissipative axion dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann code implements the DADM system: an oscillating axion field with an extra thermal-friction term Gamma in its Klein-Gordon equation, coupled at background and perturbation level to a self-interacting dark-radiation fluid sourced by Gamma dot phi^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Modify CLASS (or CAMB) by adding the friction term to the scalar-field/fluid equations and a coupled self-interacting dark-radiation fluid with the corresponding perturbation source terms, using an effective-fluid treatment of the oscillating axion; validate by reproducing the paper's Gamma < 2.69 km/s/Mpc posteriors and S8 = 0.795 +/- 0.011, then release publicly with a MontePython/Cobaya interface.

members.model_name: Selective p-wave Sommerfeld two-level self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No public solver exists for the two-level Majorana p-wave Sommerfeld problem: computing S_p(v) across the resonance islands requires a coupled-channel Schroedinger solution with mass splitting Delta and light scalar/pseudo-Goldstone mediators, which per-paper private code handled but no released tool covers.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or extend an existing multi-state Sommerfeld coupled-channel code to include the p-wave partial wave with off-diagonal mediator potentials, parameterized by (m_chi1, Delta, m_eta, alpha), validated against the paper's 780 GeV benchmark and resonance islands; the same solver yields the velocity-dependent sigma_T/m_chi.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay Dirac fermion plus photon dark matter
members.description: No public TOV/equation-of-state code implements a two-fluid neutron-star model with an in-medium n -> chi conversion channel and parameterized dark-sector self-interactions, which is required to turn the 0.7 M_sun maximum-mass argument into a quantitative constraint on this model's parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an open-source TOV solver (e.g. one built on standard nuclear EOS tables) with a chemical-equilibrium chi component and a repulsive dark self-interaction strength parameter, then publish maximum-mass curves versus (m_chi, self-interaction strength) validated against the 0.7 M_sun no-interaction limit.

members.model_name: Self-interacting Dirac fermion dark matter with light scalar mediator for dark stars
members.description: No public dark-star stellar-structure solver implements the paper's Lane-Emden-style model with SIDM annihilation heating, mediator decay-length energy deposition, and the parametrized SIDM-to-baryon mass ratio, so luminosity and radius predictions cannot be reproduced or scanned.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release the polytropic dark-star structure solver described in the paper (hydrostatic equilibrium with annihilation heating balancing gas cooling, mediator decay-length energy-deposition condition), validated against the m_chi = 100 GeV, z~20 benchmark, and attach a JWST magnitude forecast via the public JWST exposure-time calculator.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter via scalar-mediated neutrino self-interactions
members.description: No public supernova sterile-emissivity calculator exists for this model: computing nu_4 production and escape luminosity in the core requires in-medium active-sterile conversion with the phi-mediated self-interaction opacity, trapping/free-streaming regimes, and realistic density/temperature/chemical-potential profiles, none of which is packaged as a released code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an emissivity module that evaluates the paper's in-medium mixing and interaction rates on public core-collapse profile tables (e.g. Garching-style SN profiles), handles trapped and free-streaming asymptotics, and applies the Raffelt-style energy-loss criterion; validate by recovering the minimal sterile-neutrino SN limit in the lambda -> 0 limit, and later upgrade to full transport for precision.

members.model_name: Z4 Dirac-neutrino scalar self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No numerical implementation of the Z4 Dirac-neutrino dark sector exists for computing the relic abundance and velocity-dependent self-scattering cross section together: the eta_1 eta_1 -> eta_2 eta_2 relic calculation and the eta_2-mediated sigma/m(v) are cited from prior SIDM literature and were never scanned for this model's scalar potential.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in FeynRules/micrOMEGAs for the relic calculation (including Sommerfeld enhancement from the light eta_2) and couple it to a standard Yukawa-potential transfer-cross-section solver to map (m_chi, m_phi, coupling) to Omega h^2 and sigma/m(v) over the quoted 100-200 GeV / 10-100 MeV ranges.

members.model_name: Large-mass quartic self-interacting scalar dark-matter soliton
members.description: No public solver exists for the steady-state quartic scalar-field soliton profile and accretion flux around a Schwarzschild black hole (from near-horizon boundary conditions out to the soliton radius), so tau_acc and the inner density profile cannot be scanned over (m, lambda_4, M_BH) beyond the paper's private benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release the paper's steady-state relativistic scalar-field ODE system (quartic self-interaction on a Schwarzschild background with ingoing flux boundary condition at the horizon) as a documented numerical solver, validating that it reproduces the paper's maximal-flux solutions and Hubble-time-exceeding soliton lifetimes.

members.model_name: Kreuzer-Skarke type IIB axiverse dark matter ensemble
members.description: No public code evolves the cosmology of an O(100)-axion KS ensemble consistently — vacuum realignment beyond the quadratic approximation, Primakoff freeze-in/freeze-out, heavy-axion decays to photons and lighter axions, and self-interaction redistribution — which the route lists as a required 'multi-axion Boltzmann/abundance code'.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a multi-axion background/abundance module that solves the coupled axion field and number-density equations with anharmonic misalignment corrections, thermal Primakoff rates, and decay chains, taking CYTools mass/coupling spectra as input and emitting per-eigenstate Omega_a h^2, decay epochs, and Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Symmetric vector-mediator SIDM with photon kinetic mixing
members.description: No implemented calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m_X(v) of the Yukawa dark-photon potential across the Born, classical, and resonant regimes for this model's m_X, m_phi, alpha_X space, nor a model implementation for the secluded freeze-out abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard partial-wave/Hulthen-approximation Yukawa sigma_T(v) calculator (Tulin-Yu style) as a reusable module, and encode the X-Xbar-to-phi-phi secluded annihilation model in micrOMEGAs or MadDM to replace the benchmark relic scaling.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal dark matter with neutrino-mediated self-interactions
members.description: No public code computes the non-perturbative transfer cross section for the singular attractive/repulsive 1/r^5 two-neutrino-exchange potential; the paper's phase-shift/shooting solver is private, so sigma_T/m_DM cannot be reproduced or scanned by third parties.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a partial-wave solver for power-law long-range potentials (extending existing SIDM cross-section codes built for Yukawa potentials to regulated r^-5 profiles with the neutrino-mass IR cutoff), validated against the paper's Fig. 1 bands.

members.model_name: Interacting cold dark matter-dark radiation drag model
members.description: The modified CLASS with the coupled CDM plus self-interacting dark-radiation-fluid perturbation equations (N_fluid, Gamma_0 with Gamma proportional to T^2) is not confirmed to be publicly available, so the route's Boltzmann step cannot be run from the card's resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Port the two-parameter drag model onto a maintained public interacting-DM CLASS branch (ETHOS-type parameterization with n=2 momentum-transfer scaling and fluid dark radiation), validating against the paper's LCDM limit and gauge cross-checks.

members.model_name: Asymmetric vector-mediator SIDM with photon kinetic mixing
