members.description: No public calculator covers the velocity-dependent repulsive-Yukawa transfer cross section sigma_T/m_X(v) across the Born, classical, and resonant regimes for this benchmark's (m_X, m_phi, alpha_X) space; the card's route validity note explicitly requires regime-aware cross sections that only exist as scattered literature fitting formulas.
members.proposed_resolution: Package a numerical partial-wave solver for the repulsive Yukawa potential (with the standard Born/classical fitting formulas as fast limits) into a public module that returns sigma_T/m_X(v) over the sub-GeV to multi-TeV mass range and 1-100 MeV mediator window, validated against the primary-paper benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Gravitational-anomaly neutrino-condensate cold dark matter subcomponent
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation of a relic-neutrino species that converts from free-streaming hot to a bound/superfluid cold subcomponent at a meV-scale transition, so the CMB free-streaming window and the late-time structure-formation effect cannot be computed beyond qualitative statements.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS or CAMB with a transitioning neutrino fluid parameterized by (transition redshift from Lambda_G, cold fraction f_nu_cold, residual Goldstone dark-radiation component), analogous to existing self-interacting-neutrino CLASS modifications, and confront it with Planck likelihoods to firm up the 4-256 meV window.

members.model_name: Nonminimally coupled scalarized cold-dark-matter field
members.description: No cosmological background integrator implements this model's nonminimal F(phi)R coupling plus self-interaction potential from inflationary initial conditions to today, so the approach to phi_v and the CDM-like oscillation abundance (Omega_CDM fraction) remain only qualitatively supported.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the specific F(phi) and V(phi) in an existing scalar-tensor Boltzmann/background code (hi_class or EFTCAMB) or a dedicated stiff ODE integrator, evolving phi(t) through radiation domination to compute the relic CDM fraction as a function of m, f_B, and the oscillation onset.

members.model_name: Interacting hot neutrino dark matter
members.description: The modified COSMIC Boltzmann code used for the diffusion-damped P(k) was never released, and no public Boltzmann solver implements the imperfect-fluid closure (viscosity plus heat conduction) for a strongly self-interacting 20-30 eV neutrino, so the model's central transfer-function prediction cannot be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the self-interacting massive-neutrino sector in CLASS using a relaxation-time (interacting neutrino) modification with the paper's transport coefficients, parameterized by lambda_mfp(T_nu) for both s-scaling and 1/s-scaling cross sections, and validate against the paper's 3-7 Mpc damping scales for lambda_mfp = 0.01-0.1 Mpc and the zero-viscosity acoustic limit.

members.model_name: Symmetric scalar-mediator SIDM with Higgs mixing
members.description: No public calculator covers the velocity-dependent attractive-Yukawa transfer cross section sigma_T/m_X(v) across Born, classical, and resonant regimes for this benchmark: the attractive scalar-mediated potential develops scattering resonances at specific (m_X, m_phi, alpha_X) that the route's regime-aware validity note requires but no packaged code on the card provides.
members.proposed_resolution: Package a numerical partial-wave solver for the attractive Yukawa potential, including the resonant regime, into a public module returning sigma_T/m_X(v) over the benchmark (sub-GeV to multi-TeV, 1-100 MeV mediator) space, validated against the primary-paper benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Self-interacting boosted two-component dark matter
members.description: No public calculator exists for the solar chi_A population and boosted chi_B flux including capture on nuclei via the kinetically mixed X, self-capture from the sigma_AA self-interaction, evaporation, and energy loss of the boosted chi_B on its way out of the Sun.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing solar-capture framework (e.g. the capture/evaporation machinery in DarkSUSY or the public Asteria/capture-rate codes) with a self-capture term proportional to sigma_AA/m_A and a chi_B production-and-propagation module, validated against the paper's m_A=20 GeV, m_B=0.2 GeV benchmark flux.

members.model_name: Parallel-universe dark atomic matter with Higgs mixing
members.description: No dark-recombination or dark-atom interaction model exists for this sector (listed as a required_code_resource): the ionized fraction, dark-atom formation history, dark acoustic oscillations, and self-interaction cross sections needed to turn the scenario into linear-power-spectrum and halo predictions are all uncomputed (structure_formation fields are unknown).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a Boltzmann code (CLASS) with an atomic-dark-matter module — dark hydrogen/nuclei recombination via a rescaled RECFAST treatment parameterized by (alpha_dark, m_e_dark, m_p_dark, T_dark/T_visible) — to produce transfer functions, Delta_N_eff, and dark-atom scattering cross sections for this multi-component sector.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated self-interacting sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: No forward model exists for DSNB spectral dips from scalar-mediated sterile self-interactions: the related-paper dip calculation must be re-derived for the scalar mediator's cross section and combined with a DSNB flux model and future-detector response, none of which are packaged.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the scalar-mediated nu-nu_s scattering optical depth over the relic sterile background, convolve with a standard DSNB flux model, and fold in Hyper-Kamiokande/JUNO sensitivity forecasts, validating against the related vector-case benchmark before recasting.

members.model_name: ETHOS-4 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The two collaboration-internal codes in the chain — the modified CAMB producing DM-dark-radiation transfer functions and the AREPO elastic self-scattering module — have no public release recorded on the card, so the full pipeline from (m_chi, m_phi, g_chi, g_DR, xi) to halo catalogues is not independently runnable.
members.proposed_resolution: Replace the private linear stage with a public ETHOS-class implementation of interacting DM-dark-radiation (the ETHOS n=2/4 opacity parameterization in a public Einstein-Boltzmann code) validated against the paper's published ETHOS-4 transfer function, and release or substitute a public velocity-dependent self-scattering N-body module validated against the reported sigma_T/m_chi panel.

members.model_name: String moduli star compact-object dark matter
members.description: No public solver produces moduli-star equilibrium configurations (M(R), compactness) for the string-motivated potential V = m^2 phi^2/2 + lambda_3 phi^3/3 + g phi^4/4 in the dense, strongly self-interacting regime; only dilute analytic scalings are supported.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing static boson-star solver (Einstein-Klein-Gordon shooting code) to include the cubic and quartic moduli self-interactions, mapping out the M(R) and compactness branches over (m, lambda_3, g) and validating against known mini-boson-star limits.

members.model_name: Self-interacting scalar field dark matter
members.description: The linear prediction rests on a CMBFAST-era calculation; no maintained Boltzmann implementation of the cosh-potential self-interacting SFDM (m_phi ~ 1.1e-23 eV, lambda ~ 20.3, V0 ~ 36.5 eV^4) is wired into this card's pipeline, so the k_cut ~ 4.5 h/Mpc prediction is unverified at modern precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt and validate an existing CLASS SFDM extension (Urena-Lopez-style scalar-field dark matter module) with the cosh potential V = V0[cosh(lambda kappa phi) - 1], reproduce the z=50 damped density contrast and k_cut ~ 4.5 h/Mpc of the primary paper, and export the transfer function for downstream halo and likelihood steps.

members.model_name: Late-decoupling Lorentz-violating fermion dark-sector component
members.description: No Boltzmann/background code supports this model's ingredients: a species with a helicity-dependent Lorentz-violating dispersion relation, self-interactions maintaining equilibrium until a low-redshift nonrelativistic decoupling at z_dec ~ 0.2-0.6, and a momentum-dependent equation of state passing through negative pressure; standard non-cold-DM sectors in CLASS/CAMB assume standard dispersion and early decoupling, so neither f(k,z) evolution nor CMB/BAO/SN/growth likelihood evaluation can currently be run.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public Einstein-Boltzmann code with a custom species: generalize the ncdm sector to an arbitrary tabulated dispersion relation omega(k; m, b) with a time-dependent collision term switching off at z_dec, evolve the background and perturbations (using the gap_1 derivation), validate against the paper's w(z) and distance-to-last-scattering toy curves, then attach standard CMB/BAO/SN and growth likelihoods to convert the 1-10 percent Omega_phi viability statement into a fitted bound on (m, b, z_dec, Omega_phi).

members.model_name: Dissipative dark electromagnetism model
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function implementation covers this model's DM coupled to a massless self-interacting dark photon including full dark Silk damping; only the conservative analytic DAO cutoff mass is available (step s2 validity note).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS/ETHOS-style DM-dark-radiation module to the two-component H-L plasma with recombination to dark atoms and massless dark-photon diffusion, outputting the linear power spectrum and M_min including Silk damping as a function of alpha_D, m_H, m_L, xi.

members.model_name: Agnostic vector-portal self-interacting dark matter
members.description: There is no packaged combined recast of nuclear plus electron recoil data for light-mediator (F_DM ~ 1/q^2) SIDM: DDCalc covers the nuclear side but the SENSEI/XENON10/XENON1T electron-recoil constraints enter only as digitized published curves, preventing a self-consistent joint epsilon limit across the sub-GeV to multi-GeV range.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine DDCalc for nuclear recoils with a QEdark-style electron-recoil rate calculation using the light-mediator dark-matter form factor, wrapping both in a single likelihood over (m_chi, m_V, epsilon, alpha_D) validated against the primary paper's epsilon limit panels.

members.model_name: Self-interacting scalar field dark matter soliton model
members.description: No public code packages the self-interacting GPP soliton solver plus scaling machinery used in the paper, so the soliton profiles, mass-radius relation, and circular-velocity curves for arbitrary (m, lambda) cannot be regenerated without reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the quartic-self-interaction GPP boundary-value problem as a small open-source shooting/relaxation solver (validated against the paper's lambda_ini 0.4-3.5 scan) and expose profiles and velocity curves as tabulated functions of (m, lambda, s).

members.model_name: Degenerate millicharged atomic dark matter with hyperfine inelastic scattering
members.description: No code computes the dark recombination history and photon-baryon drag (millicharge plus atomic Compton scattering) for this equal-mass atomic model, so the CMB observable and the self-interaction consistency checks rest on approximate extrapolations of generic millicharged-DM constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a dark-recombination module (dark Saha/Peebles equations in alpha_prime and the degenerate constituent masses) plus millicharge and atomic-Compton momentum-exchange rates to CLASS's interacting-DM/ETHOS machinery, and evaluate the model against Planck rather than rescaled historical millicharged-DM bounds.

members.model_name: ETHOS-1 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The velocity-dependent DM self-scattering module used with AREPO for the ETHOS-1 runs is not publicly released, so the nonlinear leg of the pipeline (halo catalogues, subhalo profiles, core densities) cannot be reproduced or extended with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the elastic isotropic velocity-dependent self-scattering scheme in a public N-body code (e.g. the SIDM modules of GIZMO or a Gadget-4 fork), validated against the published ETHOS-1 subhalo V_max functions and core densities.

members.model_name: Self-interacting Higgs-portal singlet scalar dark matter in an early matter-dominated era
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver computes the singlet-scalar yield combining Higgs-portal freeze-out or freeze-in with 4-to-2 cannibal self-annihilations in an early matter-dominated background with entropy dilution; the paper's numerical solution is not released, so the relic-density map over (m_s, lambda_hs, lambda_s, H_EW/m_h, T_end) cannot be reproduced with existing tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend micrOMEGAs (or a DRAKE-style dedicated solver) with a user-defined H(T) and entropy history for early matter domination and add the 4-to-2 collision term for the quartic singlet self-interaction, validating against the paper's freeze-out, freeze-in, and cannibal parameter-space bands.

members.model_name: Self-interacting warm dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann solver implements a validated self-interacting warm-dark-matter perturbation hierarchy; the original modified CMBFAST relaxation-time collision term is unreleased and its tight-coupling/weak-coupling treatment and possible gauge-mode contamination were disputed (astro-ph/0106228, 2002.05778).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement an elastic self-scattering collision term in CLASS that damps multipoles l>=2 while conserving the l=0,1 moments (ETHOS-style), verify the tight-coupling limit against the published comment, and reproduce the claimed k_max shift from 1.1 to 1.7 Mpc^-1 at m = 1 keV.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal self-interacting dark matter with light scalar mediator
members.description: No packaged calculator exists for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of the light-scalar Yukawa mediator across Born, classical, and resonant regimes; regime selection is currently done by hand per parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the published Tulin-Yu Hulthen and classical fitting formulas, with partial-wave numerics in the resonant regime, as a reusable module keyed on (m_X, m_phi, y_X, v), validated against the published cross-section grids.

members.model_name: ETHOS-2 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The velocity-dependent DM self-scattering module used with AREPO for the ETHOS-2 runs is not publicly released, so the nonlinear leg of the pipeline (halo catalogues, subhalo profiles, core densities) cannot be reproduced or extended with public code.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement the elastic isotropic velocity-dependent self-scattering scheme in a public N-body code (e.g. the SIDM modules of GIZMO or a Gadget-4 fork), validated against the published ETHOS-2 subhalo V_max functions and core densities.

members.model_name: Late-decay self-interacting dark matter production mechanism
members.description: No public CLASS implementation exists for the pseudo-WIMP late-decay history (S -> SIDM plus a small dark-radiation branch) with self-interacting daughter perturbations; the paper's modified CLASS/MontePython setup is not released, so the H0/S8 fit cannot be independently reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the existing CLASS decaying-CDM (DCDM/DR) module to a two-branch decay with an SIDM daughter species and a tunable small dark-radiation fraction, publish the patch with a MontePython likelihood configuration, and validate against the source paper's reported regime-B/C posterior shifts.

members.model_name: Axion dark matter with dark-Higgs early-dark-energy trapping
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the dark-Higgs EDE background with nonthermal trapping until near matter-radiation equality followed by decay into self-interacting dark radiation, so CMB spectra, the H0 posterior, and the Delta N_eff ~ 0.37 estimate cannot be confronted with a modern precision likelihood fit.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS_EDE or AxiCLASS with the trapped dark-Higgs potential, the trapping-release time set by the dark-photon bath, and a fluid treatment of the resulting self-interacting dark radiation (perturbations with negligible free-streaming), then run MCMC against Planck/BAO/SH0ES-era likelihoods to fit f_EDE, z_c, and Delta N_eff directly.

members.model_name: BEC/SFDM self-interacting ultralight scalar dark matter for cluster collisions
members.description: No linear perturbation solver or calibrated transfer function exists for this self-interacting BEC/SFDM model: the card provides no thermal-WDM mapping, no half-mode mass, and the small-scale cutoff is mapped only qualitatively from the wave/quantum-pressure scale.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear cosmological perturbation equations for the complex scalar with quartic self-interaction and implement them in a modified CLASS (AxiCLASS-style scalar-field module extended with the lambda term) to produce T(k), the cutoff scale, and a half-mode mass across the (m, lambda) plane.

members.model_name: Reproductive freeze-in self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No transfer-function calculator maps the RFI final state (nonthermal f(p), evolving dark-to-SM temperature ratio, residual self-scattering) onto linear matter power, so the free-streaming and dark-acoustic-oscillation scales are only rough analytic estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an ETHOS-style modified CLASS to accept the RFI phase-space distribution and self-interaction rate from the s2 solver as input, computing P(k) with both free-streaming suppression and dark acoustic oscillations across the RFI parameter space.

members.model_name: Self-interacting ultra-light axion-like Bose-Einstein-condensate dark matter
members.description: No public Boltzmann/linear-perturbation code evolves ultralight axion-like BEC perturbations with quartic self-interactions, i.e. the scale- and time-dependent effective sound speed c_eff^2(k,z) with lambda_s = -m^2/(24 f^2); existing ULA codes (axionCAMB, AxiCLASS) treat only the free field.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS (or axionCAMB) with the paper's BEC fluid equations including the self-interaction pressure term, outputting delta_m(k,z), c_eff^2(k,z), and transfer functions over (m, lambda_s), and validate against the paper's stability examples and the free-field limit.

members.model_name: Nearly totally dissipative self-interacting dark matter SMBH-seeding model
members.description: The end-to-end tdSIDM pipeline — the GIZMO dissipative-SIDM collision module used for collapse calibration and the semi-analytic merger-tree/SMBH-seeding code — is not publicly packaged, so the collapse criteria and seed catalogs cannot be reproduced or rescanned in (sigma/m, f_diss).
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or re-implement the dissipative (inelastic, f_diss ~ 1) collision module in a public N-body code (GIZMO or Arepo SIDM implementations) and release the calibrated collapse-timescale fit plus the merger-tree seeding code as a package parameterized by (sigma/m, f_diss, c_vir, z_form, M0).

members.model_name: Liouville-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: No public Einstein-Klein-Gordon boson-star solver implements the Liouville self-interaction potential; the paper's equilibrium solutions (mass-radius curves, M_max, compactness versus m_phi and coupling) are not released as code or digitized tables, so downstream lens-mass and GW-source predictions cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Liouville potential in an open static boson-star shooting code (a small extension of standard EKG solvers), publish the mass-radius and compactness tables as functions of (m_phi, 1/f^2, central field value), and validate against the paper's benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Logarithmic-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: No public Einstein-Klein-Gordon boson-star solver implements the logarithmic self-interaction potential (paired attractive/repulsive terms with a net attractive force); the paper's equilibrium mass-radius, M_max, and compactness results are not released as code or tables, blocking regeneration of lens-mass and GW-source predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Add the logarithmic potential to an open static boson-star shooting code, publish mass-radius and compactness tables as functions of (m_phi, 1/f^2, central field value), including the stable-branch boundary for the net-attractive case, validated against the paper's benchmark curves.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino self-interacting dark matter in double focus point BLSSM
members.description: The CMB/BBN safety of the scenario hinges on the retarded decay of right-handed neutrinos in the bilepton decay chain, but no released energy-injection calculation exists for this specific decay chain, so the bbn_cmb_decay condition is only checked qualitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the electromagnetic/hadronic injection spectra of the eta_1 -> nu_R nu_R -> SM decay chain as a function of Y_nu and mediator lifetime, and run them through DarkHistory (CMB) and standard BBN injection codes to map the allowed lifetime window.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_e scotogenic pattern-A fermion dark matter
members.description: No released texture-scan code maps current neutrino oscillation data and the Planck sum-of-masses bound onto the pattern-A one-zero-texture parameter space, so the viable-texture filter that gates the DM and LFV phenomenology cannot be refreshed against new data.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a small scan script that samples current global-fit oscillation posteriors (NuFIT), imposes the pattern-A zero condition and sum m_nu < 0.12 eV, and outputs allowed (sum m_nu, m_ee) regions for direct reuse in the route.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_tau scotogenic pattern-C fermion dark matter
members.description: The pattern-C texture viability scan is not reproducible: the mapping from the charge assignment and oscillation data to allowed inverted-hierarchy regions, sum m_nu, Dirac-phase correlations, and m_ee has no attached code, and the card flags both data-version dependence and possible flavor-label corruption in the extracted text, so the parameter filter feeding all downstream phenomenology cannot be regenerated.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a texture-scan tool that imposes the pattern-C one-zero condition on the one-loop scotogenic mass matrix, samples current oscillation global-fit chi2 grids, applies the Planck sum m_nu < 0.12 eV cut, and outputs the allowed (Yukawa, phase, m_ee) regions, verifying the pattern-to-hierarchy mapping against the paper as the route's validation test requires.

members.model_name: U(1) B-3L_mu scotogenic pattern-B fermion dark matter
members.description: No released texture-scan code maps current neutrino oscillation data and the Planck mass-sum bound onto the pattern-B one-zero texture, so the inverted-hierarchy viability filter that gates the DM and LFV parameter space cannot be refreshed against updated data.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a scan script sampling current NuFIT oscillation posteriors, imposing the pattern-B zero condition and sum m_nu < 0.12 eV, and outputting allowed (sum m_nu, m_ee) regions for both hierarchies to confirm the inverted-hierarchy-only claim.

members.model_name: Multipole vector dark matter below the GeV scale
members.description: No public stellar/SN emissivity calculator exists for pair production of neutral complex vectors through off-shell-photon multipole couplings; the Sun/HB/RGB/SN1987A bounds rest on the paper's approximate energy-loss criteria with escape assumed and no trapping treatment.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the in-medium photon-mediated V V* production rate (including plasmon effects) for each form factor, integrate over standard solar, HB, RGB, and SN1987A proto-neutron-star profiles, and add a trapping/optical-depth calculation to make the bounds robust at larger couplings.

members.model_name: SU(3)_D triple-Higgs dark matter with vector bound states
members.description: No runnable collider implementation of the SU(3)_D model exists: there is no FeynRules/UFO model file or event-level pipeline for spin-1 psi_1 psi_2 bound-state resonance production and decay through the kinetically mixed V1, so the LHC reach cannot be recomputed or recast beyond the source figures.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the SU(3)_D Lagrangian plus an effective bound-state production vertex (normalized by the s1 wavefunction at origin) in FeynRules/UFO, generate resonance signals in MadGraph, and recast against ATLAS/CMS dilepton and dijet resonance limits with narrow-width acceptance corrections.

members.model_name: Quartic U(1)-breaking 2hdSMASH axion dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation exists for the quartic U(1)-breaking 2hdSMASH (Type-II 2HDM plus complex PQ singlet plus three right-handed Majorana neutrinos), so the combined RGE running, boundedness-from-below, perturbative-unitarity, and Planck-scale-validity filter that gates all benchmarks cannot be reproduced or extended.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 2hdSMASH field content and scalar potential (including the lambda_12S quartic U(1)-breaking term) in SARAH to generate two-loop RGEs and a SPheno spectrum module, then script the boundedness/unitarity/Planck-scale-validity scan over the tiny-portal benchmark region and release it with the registry.

members.model_name: 2hdSMASH DFSZ axion-majoron dark matter
members.description: No public 2hdSMASH implementation (SARAH model files, RG+inflation scan scripts, benchmark generation) is released, so the Planck-scale stability validation and the inflation-collider benchmark correlation cannot be reproduced or extended without rebuilding the pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the 2hdSMASH scalar potential and Yukawa sector as public SARAH/PYR@TE model files, wire them to SPheno plus HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals, and add an inflation module that scans xi_i and quartics against the Planck A_s, n_s, and r constraints.

members.model_name: PBH-seeded WIMP ultracompact minihalo boost scenario
members.description: Energy-injection codes for CMB/IGM constraints implement homogeneous annihilation only; the redshift-dependent UCMH boost to the annihilation luminosity after matter-radiation equality is not implemented in any public deposition/thermal-history pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend DarkHistory or ExoCLASS with a boost-factor module B(z) computed from the UCMH abundance and profile model, then propagate to ionization and temperature histories and constrain with Planck optical-depth and IGM temperature data.

members.model_name: Antimatter macroscopic dark matter
members.description: The CMB bound on sigma_X/M_X is a translated WIMP annihilation energy-injection constraint, not a native calculation: no energy-deposition code has been run with the anti-macro injection history (baryon-annihilation rate tracking the baryon density, with the appropriate injected photon/pion spectrum and deposition efficiency eta instead of the assumed constant 0.4).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the anti-macro annihilation energy-injection rate and nucleon-annihilation final-state spectrum in DarkHistory or ExoCLASS, compute redshift-dependent deposition efficiencies, and derive a Planck-likelihood bound on sigma_X/M_X to replace the order-of-magnitude translated limit.

members.model_name: Scalar s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No implemented BBN/N_eff calculation exists for a light mediator that decays to SM neutrinos around neutrino decoupling; the con_bbn_cmb_neff constraint is applied only as a qualitative energy-density argument near T ~ 10 MeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a neutrino-decoupling/BBN code (e.g. nudec_BSM-style decoupling solver or ACROPOLIS for late injections) to include a neutrino-philic scalar with mass m_phi and width Gamma_phi, outputting N_eff and light-element shifts as a function of (m_phi, g_nu, mediator abundance).

members.model_name: Dark SU(N) scalar glueball dark matter
members.description: No public solver implements the lattice-informed glueball-Polyakov-loop thermal effective theory: constructing the temperature-dependent potential for N=3,4,5 and evolving the glueball field/energy density through the strong first-order confinement transition (including 3-to-2 cannibal interactions) was done with private code, so the Omega_g h^2 band cannot be recomputed for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement and release the thermal effective-theory pipeline: code the glueball plus Polyakov-loop effective potential with the paper's lattice-motivated coefficients (keeping the full potential rather than a single phi^5 interaction), couple it to a standard cosmological background, evolve through the confinement transition, and validate against the published Omega_g h^2 = 0.12 band and the Delta N_eff xi_T limits.

members.model_name: Hybrid axion and massive relic particle dark matter model
members.description: No public end-to-end pipeline couples a modern BBN network to both ingredients of this model at once: the time-dependent photon cooling that shifts eta between BBN and recombination and the nonthermal photodisintegration from radiative X decays; existing cascade codes assume a standard photon thermal history, so the paper's small allowed zeta_X-tau_X island cannot currently be reproduced or rescanned with updated reaction rates and abundance data.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public photodisintegration code (ACROPOLIS) or AlterBBN to accept a parameterized photon-cooling factor modifying the eta(t) and photon-temperature history between BBN and recombination, run it over the zeta_X-tau_X plane with JINA REACLIB rates, and validate by reproducing the paper's allowed island and its photon-cooling-only deuterium overproduction.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine high-baryon bubbles
members.description: No code evolves the Affleck-Dine field and Q-ball formation (fragmentation, charge partition, stability in gravity- vs gauge-mediated SUSY breaking) to predict the HBB size distribution parameters (c_I, Delta) and interior quantities (eta_b^in, Y_Q^in) from fundamental AD-potential inputs; the card lists this solver as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine stochastic inflationary evolution of the AD phase (Fokker-Planck or lattice sampling of Hubble-induced mass flips) with existing lattice results for AD fragmentation into Q-balls to build a solver mapping (lambda, n, mediation scheme, N_CMB) to the HBB distribution and interior baryon/Q-ball content.

members.model_name: Pseudoscalar s-channel neutrino-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No implemented BBN/N_eff calculation exists for a light mediator that decays to SM neutrinos around neutrino decoupling; the con_bbn_cmb_neff constraint is applied only as a qualitative energy-density argument near T ~ 10 MeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a neutrino-decoupling/BBN code (e.g. nudec_BSM-style decoupling solver or ACROPOLIS for late injections) to include a neutrino-philic scalar with mass m_phi and width Gamma_phi, outputting N_eff and light-element shifts as a function of (m_phi, g_nu, mediator abundance).

members.model_name: Y-interacting fourth-generation heavy neutrino dark matter
members.description: The early-ionization observable rests on an order-of-magnitude WMAP-era statement; no pipeline propagates the energy injected by N recombination and annihilation products below T < 2000 K into the ionization history and a Planck-era CMB constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the redshift-dependent recombination/annihilation energy-injection rate of this model as an exotic-injection source in DarkHistory or ExoCLASS, compute the perturbed free-electron fraction, and constrain it with the Planck CMB likelihood, superseding the qualitative WMAP-era ionization claim.

members.model_name: Inflationary dark matter in the luminogenesis model
members.description: The DUT-scale inference uses paper-era Planck 2013/2015 and BICEP2/Keck numbers with no interface to a modern inflation likelihood, so the allowed M_DUT range is not evaluated against current n_s and r constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the Coleman-Weinberg slow-roll predictions in a small module that evaluates them against current public Planck+BICEP/Keck (n_s, r) posteriors, propagating the updated allowed region to M_DUT and mu_DM.

members.model_name: Dark U(1)_D Breit-Wigner leptophilic dark matter model
members.description: No public code computes the CMB-era effective annihilation rate for Breit-Wigner resonant annihilation with m_Z' ~ 2 m_chi and propagates it through the Planck energy-injection likelihood; existing tools (ExoCLASS, DarkHistory) assume constant s-wave or simple p-wave <sigma v>, so the claimed Breit-Wigner escape from the Planck bound is unverified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermally averaged velocity-dependent <sigma v>(z) across the resonance (including the resonance width and kinetic-decoupling history) and add it as a velocity-dependent injection template in ExoCLASS or DarkHistory, then evaluate the Planck annihilation likelihood on the fitted benchmark.

members.model_name: Decaying super-heavy dark matter explanation of IceCube PeV neutrinos and baryon asymmetry
members.description: No decay-spectrum generator is identified for the super-heavy regime: the neutrino dN/dE from X -> qq hadronization and leptonic cascades at M_X = 1e7-1e11 GeV requires fragmentation plus electroweak final-state showering far above the validity of standard PPPC4DMID-style tables, and the card lists a 'DM decay neutrino-spectrum generator' as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Integrate a public super-heavy spectrum code such as HDMSpectra (DGLAP-evolved SM fragmentation up to the Planck scale) to produce dN/dE_nu for the paper's hadronic and leptonic channels, and feed it into the analytic Galactic-plus-extragalactic flux integrals.

members.model_name: Multi-waterfall hybrid-inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public stochastic-inflation solver handles the multi-field O(N)-symmetric waterfall phase (coupled Fokker-Planck/Langevin dynamics for the inflaton plus N waterfall fields), which is the source of the curvature spectrum for every prediction on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a stochastic-delta-N code (e.g. StocDeltaN or an equivalent Langevin lattice/importance-sampling framework) to N O(N)-symmetric waterfall fields with the paper's hybrid potential, releasing it with the single-waterfall limit and the CMB-amplitude check as validation tests.

members.model_name: Power-law tachyon quartessence condensate
members.description: The condensate collapse fraction — the quantity that decides quartessence viability — has no dedicated solver: the primary result rests on a preliminary spherical top-hat estimate with a finite-redshift divergence treated as collapse.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a spherical-collapse code that evolves top-hat overdensities in the tachyon fluid with density-dependent sound speed c_s(delta, a) and acoustic horizon d_s(a), reproducing the paper's <1% simple-Chaplygin condensate check as validation, and compute F_collapse over the (n, V_n, delta_in) grid.

members.model_name: Bosonic forbidden light dark matter with meson-decay portals
members.description: No acceptance-level recast machinery exists for K_L -> pi0 + invisible and B -> K + invisible signatures of pair-produced S1/S2 dark scalars (including displaced visible S2 daughters) at KOTO, NA62, and Belle II; current bounds are applied only at the branching-ratio level.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the three-body meson-decay kinematics of the S1/S2 dark current in a recast framework using the published KOTO signal-region efficiency maps, the NA62 pi0-invisible bound, and Belle II B -> K nu nu-bar efficiencies, including the S2 lifetime-dependent displaced-decay acceptance.

members.model_name: Gravitational preheating scalar dark matter
members.description: No public model implementation of the five Planck-suppressed dimension-six inflaton-DM operators exists for CosmoLattice, so the resonant production regime with backreaction and rescattering (where analytic Whittaker-Hill estimates fail and rho_s/rho_phi can reach order 50 percent) cannot be recomputed or scanned over Wilson coefficients and inflaton potentials.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the C_1-C_5 operator set as a public CosmoLattice model file (derivative couplings via the standard field-space metric interface, non-derivative phi^4 s^2 and phi^2 s^4 as potential terms), together with a documented convergence/resolution study for the resonance bands, and release scan scripts over (C_4, phi_0, m_phi).

members.model_name: Cubic Kähler nonminimal supergravity PBH dark matter model
members.description: No public implementation of the two-field nonminimal supergravity potential (cubic Kahler term eta_3 with tuned saddle-point crossing) exists in a multifield transport code, so the background trajectory and USR-enhanced P_R(k) that feed every downstream observable cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Einstein-frame two-field potential and field-space metric in PyTransport or CppTransport, add a root-finder for the eta_3 saddle-point tuning, and validate against the paper's benchmark P_R(k) peak and CMB-scale n_s and r.

members.model_name: Sextic Kähler nonminimal supergravity PBH dark matter model
members.description: No public implementation of the two-field nonminimal supergravity potential (sextic Kahler term eta_6 with eta_4 tuned to balance false and true vacua) exists in a multifield transport code, so the background trajectory and USR-enhanced P_R(k) that feed every downstream observable cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Einstein-frame two-field potential and field-space metric in PyTransport or CppTransport, add a tuning routine for the eta_4/eta_6 vacuum balance, and validate against the paper's benchmark P_R(k) peak and CMB-scale n_s and r.

members.model_name: Double-inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: No implementation of the double-inflation background and perturbation calculation exists in the registry pipeline: the two curvature-power peaks (inflection-point enhancement plus post-pre-inflation oscillation effects) must currently be taken from the source paper rather than recomputed from potential parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the pre-inflation, new-inflation, and stabilization potentials in a public inflationary perturbation solver (e.g. MultiModeCode or PyTransport) and validate against the paper's two power-spectrum peaks before scanning potential parameters.

members.model_name: Z3 complex scalar inflaton-dark-matter model
members.description: The Planck-scale vacuum-stability/perturbativity/unitarity filter (step s1) that defines the viable scan region has no implementation on the card: two-loop RGEs for the extended scalar sector and the boundary matching to the inflationary plateau must be set up before the source scan can be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate the model's RGEs with SARAH or PyR@TE, run couplings from the electroweak to the Planck scale, and apply standard bounded-from-below, perturbativity, and unitarity conditions as a scan filter feeding steps s2 and s3.

members.model_name: Sgoldstino-stabilized alpha-attractor non-oscillatory PBH dark matter model
members.description: No public pipeline implements the sgoldstino-stabilized alpha-attractor supergravity potential in a coupled background plus Mukhanov-Sasaki solver able to resolve the ultra-slow-roll power-spectrum peak and track the subsequent kination phase.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's superpotential/Kahler potential (with finite sgoldstino stabilization scale f_0, Lambda, V_0) in a public inflation solver such as an extended PyTransport or a custom stiff-ODE background plus mode-by-mode MS integrator, validating P_zeta(k) against the primary benchmark peak and CMB-scale normalization.

members.model_name: Sgoldstino-stabilized canonical Kahler non-oscillatory PBH dark matter model
members.description: No public pipeline implements the sgoldstino-stabilized canonical Kahler supergravity potential in a coupled background plus Mukhanov-Sasaki solver able to resolve the ultra-slow-roll power-spectrum peak and track the subsequent kination phase.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's superpotential and canonical Kahler potential (with finite sgoldstino stabilization scale f_0, Lambda, V_0) in a public inflation solver such as an extended PyTransport or a custom stiff-ODE background plus mode-by-mode MS integrator, validating P_zeta(k) against the primary benchmark peak and CMB-scale normalization.

members.model_name: Asymmetric atomic dark matter with massive dark photon bound-state formation
members.description: No public dark-recombination solver computes the residual ionized fraction x_D for asymmetric atomic DM with a massive dark photon, even though the indirect signal scales quadratically with x_D.
members.proposed_resolution: Code a Peebles-style effective three-level dark-recombination calculation generalized to massive-mediator binding energies and dark temperature ratio T_D/T_CMB, outputting x_D(z) as a reusable module validated against the atomic-DM literature results (arXiv:1209.5752).

members.model_name: PQ inflation axion dark matter with higher-dimensional operators
members.description: No public solver implements the PQ-inflation background and perturbation dynamics with the nonminimal Ricci coupling and Planck-suppressed U(1)_PQ-breaking operators; the paper's numerical field-equation solutions are private, so the inflationary trajectory, curvature spectrum, r, and the |g|-l exclusion bounds cannot be independently recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the complex PQ field with nonminimal coupling xi and the leading dimension-l PQ-breaking operator in a public two-field inflation code (e.g. PyTransport or a dedicated Einstein-frame solver), validating against the paper's r ~ 0.004 prediction and its |g|-l exclusion contours.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Q-ball dark matter from condensate fragmentation
members.description: Existing BBN/CMB energy-injection codes assume spatially homogeneous injection, but the model's constraint hinges on emission being localized around rare macroscopic Q-balls; no tool treats inhomogeneous, source-localized energy injection during BBN and recombination, so the paper's localization argument cannot be tested quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public injection code (ACROPOLIS-style BBN cascade treatment) with a diffusion-transport module for pointlike sources, parameterized by Q-ball number density, emission spectrum, and tau_Q, to produce homogenized effective limits or confirm the localized-injection escape.

members.model_name: Minimal supersymmetric U(1)_x hidden-sector LSP
members.description: No cascade-spectrum calculator is in place for hidden neutralino annihilation into U(1)_x vectors whose visible decay products depend on the unspecified kinetic-mixing branching, so continuum photon and CMB injection yields cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify the epsilon-dependent X decay table, generate SM cascade spectra with Pythia or published dark-photon spectrum tables as functions of m_chi_x, m_X, and epsilon, and feed them to the recast step.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubbles from hidden SU(N)_H PQ breaking
members.description: The collapse of high-density axion bubbles (large theta_i domains selected by the hidden SU(N)_H vacuum structure) into PBHs and miniclusters is only estimated semi-analytically; the collapse threshold, PBH mass function, and minicluster mass spectrum at the QCD epoch are uncalibrated for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dedicated lattice/N-body simulations of large-misalignment axion overdensities through the QCD mass turn-on (extending existing large-misalignment minicluster simulations) to calibrate the collapse threshold delta_c and the bubble-to-PBH/minicluster mass functions as functions of f_a, N, and the bubble theta_i distribution.

members.model_name: Poisson primordial-black-hole dark matter with small-scale velocity floor
members.description: The analytic velocity-floor scaling is simulation-calibrated only near recombination; its extrapolation through the strongly nonlinear Poisson-seeded clustering regime down to z ~ 20, and its sensitivity to non-Poisson (clustered) initial conditions and extended mass functions, are unvalidated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of discrete PBH populations (Poisson and clustered initial conditions, monochromatic and extended mass functions) from recombination to z ~ 10-20, measuring sigma_PBH(z) and cluster occupation statistics to calibrate or replace the analytic scaling in the accretion recast.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine baryogenesis
members.description: Merger-rate predictions for initially strongly clustered PBHs are uncalibrated: many PBHs form three-body and many-body systems for which the standard isolated-binary formation and disruption estimates fail, so no reliable mapping from (f(M), xi_star) to a LIGO-Virgo merger rate exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of early PBH clusters with the model's clustered initial conditions (mass spectrum plus xi(x)), following binary formation, hardening, and disruption through cluster evaporation, and fit a merger-rate correction factor as a function of xi_star and cluster multiplicity for use in LIGO-Virgo rate comparisons.

members.model_name: Broad-mass PBH-Lambda dark matter universe
members.description: The enhanced early minihalo collapse from broad-mass PBH Poisson seeding is only partially simulation-calibrated (simulation_calibrated: partial), so the z > 15 halo mass function feeding the HOD step carries uncalibrated systematic uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with discrete broad-mass-spectrum PBH particles as seeds (resolving Poisson and seed-effect modes) to calibrate the high-redshift halo mass function and its PBH occupation against the analytic Poisson-enhanced prescription used in the pipeline.

members.model_name: Mirror-star-forming mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: No simulation or calibrated semi-analytic model of dissipative mirror-baryon cooling, fragmentation, and star formation exists to predict the Galactic mirror-star population (number density, mass function, spatial distribution), which sets both the Gaia discovery reach and the microlensing lens density.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic simulations (or adapt atomic-dark-matter cooling semi-analytics) of a subdominant dissipative mirror sector with mirror-photon cooling functions computed from the MTH-benchmark spectrum, outputting a mirror-star mass function and Galactic spatial distribution parameterized by the mirror fraction and mirror microphysics.

members.model_name: QCD axion bubble dark matter with primordial black holes
members.description: No numerical simulation calibrates the collapse of rare large-amplitude axion bubbles through the QCD-potential oscillation epoch into PBHs, so the collapse threshold, collapse probability, and resulting PBH mass function are known only from analytic scaling estimates in the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Run spherically symmetric GR collapse simulations (Misner-Sharp/Hernandez-Piran type PBH-formation codes) with the temperature-dependent QCD axion potential and bubble initial profiles from the early PQ-breaking term, mapping the collapse threshold and PBH mass as functions of f_a, bubble amplitude, and bubble size, then fold in the bubble statistics for a calibrated mass function.

members.model_name: Companion-axion dark matter model
members.description: No lattice/defect-network simulation exists for the two-axion companion potential in the post-inflationary scenario: the string-wall network contribution to the relic abundance, the bias-driven domain-wall collapse dynamics, the resulting stochastic GW spectrum shape, and the PBH mass function and abundance are all only rough analytic estimates in the primary paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing axion string-wall lattice simulation frameworks (e.g. CosmoLattice or the Buschmann-et-al-style field simulations) to the coupled two-axion instanton potential with the vacuum-degeneracy-lifting bias term, extracting the defect-network relic contribution per axion, Omega_GW(f) around the nanohertz band, and the PBH collapse fraction and mass spectrum versus (epsilon, sigma_i, m_i).

members.model_name: ALP catastrogenesis dark matter
members.description: PBH formation from collapsing closed domain walls is treated only at order-of-magnitude level; there is no calibrated mass function or formation probability for PBHs from string-wall annihilation, which is the entire content of the pbh_from_wall_annihilation observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate closed-wall collapse with numerical relativity (or calibrated Israel-junction plus critical-collapse treatments) over the relevant sigma and horizon-size distribution drawn from the network simulations of gap_1, and derive a PBH mass function and abundance formula parameterized by (T_ann, sigma).

members.model_name: Recycled ultra-heavy dark matter
members.description: The PBH mass function from collapsing false-vacuum pockets is treated in a simplified way, with no simulation-calibrated mapping from pocket distribution to PBH masses and formation rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity or hydrodynamic simulations of trapped-pocket collapse across the benchmark T_* and v_w range and fit a calibrated PBH mass function usable in the evaporation and GW steps.

members.model_name: Spinning primordial black hole dark matter from early matter domination
members.description: No calibrated numerical simulation exists for PBH formation during an early matter-dominated era that outputs the joint mass-spin distribution psi(m_PBH, a_star) from spectator-field overdensities; the near-maximal spin benchmark rests on semi-analytic angular-momentum arguments with unverified numerical assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dedicated numerical-relativity or high-resolution N-body collapse simulations of nonspherical overdensity collapse in a pressureless (matter-dominated) background, parameterized by the spectator-field power-spectrum amplitude and tilt and the matter-era duration, and calibrate a fitting function for the joint mass-spin distribution.

members.model_name: PBH-seeded WIMP ultracompact minihalo boost scenario
members.description: No simulation-calibrated model of WIMP density profiles around sub-Earth-mass PBH seeds, including tidal disruption and survival in the Galactic halo, exists; the boost factor of up to 1e5 rests on uncalibrated semi-analytic radial-infall profiles.
members.proposed_resolution: Run high-resolution N-body/zoom simulations of WIMP accretion onto sub-Earth-mass PBHs through kinetic decoupling and free streaming, plus tidal-stripping evolution in a Milky Way potential, and release fitted profile and survival-fraction parameterizations as a public module.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from late B-L phase-transition patches
members.description: GW spectral predictions for the very strong, supercooled first-order transitions required for f_PBH=1 are preliminary: bubble-collision spectral fits are calibrated in weaker-transition regimes, and curvature-induced GWs sourced by the PBH-forming overdensities are left uncalculated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice/hybrid hydrodynamic simulations of strongly supercooled transitions at beta/H of order 10 to recalibrate the bubble-collision spectral shape, and compute the second-order curvature-induced GW contribution from the late-patch density perturbations semi-analytically.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass PBH dark matter from string-wall catastrogenesis
members.description: No field-theory simulation of biased U(1)-to-Z_N string-wall network annihilation calibrates the closed-wall collapse probability and resulting PBH mass function, which the card identifies as the dominant uncertainty in the predicted M_PBH and f_PBH and hence in whether the asteroid-mass f_PBH=1 band is real.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of a complex scalar with Z_N-breaking bias through network formation and annihilation, measuring the distribution of closed-wall sizes and the fraction collapsing within their Schwarzschild radius, and fit a collapse-probability and PBH-mass-function parameterization in terms of N, bias, tension, and T_ann for use in the semi-analytic step.

members.model_name: primordial black holes from scalar-field fragmentation
members.description: The PBH mass-function normalization hinges on the uncalibrated collapse probability of rare overdense Q-ball/oscillon clusters during the soliton matter era: delta_c is assumed and the prefactor K absorbing angular-momentum and anisotropy effects is speculative, leaving the predicted f_PBH uncertain by orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Run targeted numerical simulations of collapsing rare soliton-cluster overdensities in a matter-dominated background — lattice fragmentation runs (e.g. CosmoLattice-class codes) to fix the soliton mass distribution, followed by N-body/GR collapse studies with angular momentum to calibrate delta_c and K, analogous to existing matter-era PBH collapse calibrations.

members.model_name: Ultralight axion dark matter from a dark SU(3)d confining phase transition
members.description: No numerical collapse calculation connects the dark confinement transition at T_d ~ 10 keV to primordial 10^9 solar-mass SMBH seed formation; the route relies on a semi-analytic horizon-scale argument with no simulation of the collapse or of the resulting PBH mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity or radiation-hydrodynamics simulations of horizon-scale overdensity collapse during a first-order dark confinement transition, parameterized by transition strength and duration, to obtain a PBH mass function and formation probability.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from Affleck-Dine high-baryon bubbles
members.description: The collapse threshold and PBH formation efficiency for high-baryon isocurvature bubbles (QCD-softened equation of state or Q-ball-dominated interiors) are not calibrated by numerical-relativity or hydrodynamic simulations; standard curvature-perturbation thresholds do not directly apply to this seed type.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity/hydro simulations of horizon reentry for top-hat baryon-isocurvature bubbles through the QCD transition (and for Q-ball-dominated interiors), extracting delta_c and the M_PBH/M_H collapse efficiency to replace the assumed horizon-mass mapping.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with subdominant dressed primordial black holes
members.description: Minihalo growth around PBHs and Milky Way disruption are treated with optimistic isolated secondary-infall and circular-orbit analytic disk-shocking approximations; no N-body simulation of this dressed-PBH population calibrates the surviving minihalo mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of axion minihalo formation around O(1-10) M_sun PBHs and their tidal/disk-shocking evolution on realistic eccentric orbits in a Milky Way potential, and fit a calibrated survival function M_halo(R, orbit) replacing the circular-orbit analytic maps.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from slow supercooled first-order phase transitions
members.description: The PBH abundance depends on the far tail of the density-contrast distribution generated by slow supercooled bubble nucleation, but the primary only fits tails from finite numbers of realizations; no simulation campaign or public code characterizes the false-vacuum-fraction perturbation statistics (including non-Gaussianity) at the rare-fluctuation level that sets f_PBH.
members.proposed_resolution: Run large ensembles of bubble-nucleation realizations (extending the primary's improved nucleation-time treatment) to directly sample the density-contrast distribution to the PBH-forming tail as a function of beta/H_0 and T_reh, and release the resulting tail parameterization as a reusable curvature-spectrum/PDF module.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine high-B-bubble PBH dark matter
members.description: No quantitative calculation connects the Affleck-Dine potential parameters (g, Phi_1, C_M, gamma, M_0) to the actual PBH/HBB abundance f_PBH(M): the collapse of high-baryon-density bubbles at the QCD confinement transition is treated with an assumed collapse criterion rather than simulated, leaving the mapping from fundamental parameters to the compact-object population uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run relativistic hydrodynamic simulations of overdense baryon bubbles crossing the QCD epoch with a realistic QCD equation of state (adapting existing PBH-formation critical-collapse codes) to calibrate the collapse threshold and the fraction of bubbles forming PBHs versus surviving compact HBB objects, as a function of bubble size and baryon density.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from co-decaying dark matter
members.description: PBH formation from collapsing dark substructure during the EMDE is estimated with analytic collapse and sphericity arguments only; no numerical simulation calibrates the collapse threshold, collapse fraction beta(M), or the nonmonochromatic mass-function shape in the co-decay regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of perturbation growth and halo collapse during an early matter-dominated epoch that ends with B decay (following existing EMDE microhalo simulation techniques), including angular momentum and asphericity, to calibrate beta(M) and f_PBH(M) against the analytic model.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes with QCD color charge
members.description: No calculation exists of how a near-extremal QCD-color-charged PBH dresses into a color-neutral object through the QCD confinement transition and whether it survives; the card explicitly leaves no-hair, cosmic-censorship, and post-confinement color-screening cloud dynamics unresolved, so the surviving DM population is unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Run real-time classical Einstein-Yang-Mills / non-Abelian plasma simulations of a charged black hole embedded in a hot QGP through the confinement epoch (extending existing numerical-relativity plus lattice-inspired effective-plasma codes), parameterized by Q_extr, m_D, and T_c, to output survival probability and dressed-object properties.

members.model_name: interacting hidden-sector nucleon compact-star dark matter
members.description: No calculation exists of the hidden-nucleon compact-star population: formation efficiency, mass function, and the fraction of halo dark matter locked in compact stars are all unspecified, so neither microlensing limits nor GW/tidal observables can be confronted with data.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a dissipative dark-sector collapse calculation: model hidden-pion cooling of hidden-nucleon gas, apply a Rees-Ostriker-style fragmentation criterion or run dissipative-dark-matter N-body/hydro simulations to predict the compact-object mass function and halo fraction as functions of m_f, m_pi_h, and the hidden baryon asymmetry.

members.model_name: Massive primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The evaporation of low-occupancy PBH microhalos (N_PBH below about 10^3) rests on analytic relaxation estimates with only partial simulation calibration; no simulation suite tracks PBH-cluster relaxation and survival from formation to z=0 for this massive-PBH regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run collisional N-body simulations (NBODY6-class or GADGET with softening chosen to resolve two-body relaxation) of Poisson-seeded PBH microhalos across a grid of M_PBH and occupancy N_PBH, calibrating an evaporation-time fitting function for the surviving substructure population.

members.model_name: Clustered primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No cosmological N-body simulation suite follows the initially Poisson-distributed PBH population from matter-radiation equality to low redshift to validate the analytic clustering evolution xi(x,z), cluster occupancy, and the minimum core radius r_s, which the primary paper flags as required before firm conclusions.
members.proposed_resolution: Run direct-summation or tree N-body simulations (e.g. an adapted GADGET-class or NBODY6-class code with PBH discreteness noise in the initial conditions) for a grid of (M_PBH, f_PBH), evolving from equality to z~0, and calibrate xi(x,z), cluster mass functions, and r_s against the analytic model.

members.model_name: O(N) axion-like angular dark matter production model
members.description: No pipeline maps the defect-sourced axion density power spectrum P_a(k) into minicluster formation and observational forecasts; the recasting step from simulation output to small-scale-structure observables is not performed at all in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations initialized from the lattice-derived P_a(k) and phase-space output to obtain the minicluster mass function and density profiles, then connect to microlensing and pulsar-timing observables with existing minicluster forecast machinery.

members.model_name: QCD-epoch primordial black hole dark matter with aborted-PBH baryogenesis
members.description: No refined numerical-relativity determination of the QCD-epoch collapse thresholds delta_c (PBH formation) and delta_baryo (aborted-collapse hot spot) as functions of curvature profile and the QCD equation of state; the whole eta_b-f_PBH link rests on the small, currently uncertain separation between these two thresholds.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of numerical-relativity collapse simulations across curvature-profile shapes with the lattice-QCD equation of state, tabulating delta_c, delta_baryo, and hot-spot peak temperature versus profile and horizon mass, and release the results as a public threshold/mass-function library.

members.model_name: QCD axion misalignment dark matter in a PBH-dominated epoch
members.description: The predicted enhancement of axion minicluster masses in a PBH-dominated epoch (post-inflation PQ breaking) is not calibrated by any simulation or halo-level likelihood, so obs_qcd_axion_miniclusters cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice/N-body simulations of axion field collapse with the PBH-modified expansion history (early matter domination plus evaporation reheating) to calibrate the minicluster mass function versus M_in and beta, following existing early-matter-domination minicluster simulation methodology.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with primordial black-hole early matter domination
members.description: No dedicated axion-minicluster simulations exist for a PBH early-matter-dominated cosmology; the card states such simulations are lacking, so the predicted shift to heavier miniclusters from delayed oscillation onset remains qualitative and has no likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Run axion-field lattice simulations of density-perturbation growth and minicluster collapse with the modified H(T) and entropy-injection history from the PBH background solver, mapping the minicluster mass function versus (M_BH, beta).

members.model_name: QCD axion domain-wall primordial-black-hole subcomponent model
members.description: PBH formation efficiency from the collapse of aspherical self-enclosed axion domain walls is not covered by any public simulation suite; the fraction of walls that compactify inside their Schwarzschild radius instead of radiating away as axions controls f_PBH and is currently taken from rough semi-analytic collapse criteria.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a targeted campaign of numerical-relativity or field-theory collapse simulations of closed domain walls with varying asphericity and tension sigma_dw proportional to m_a(T) f_a^2, in both radiation-dominated and early-matter-dominated backgrounds, and fit a formation-efficiency function epsilon(shape, sigma_dw, H) usable in the abundance pipeline.

members.model_name: Primordial quark-object dark matter
members.description: No simulation or semi-analytic model of the fragmentation of a surviving quark-gluon-plasma phase at the QCD transition into a mass function of quark objects; without it the model has no predicted compact-object mass spectrum or abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological QCD-transition simulations (or adapt existing first-order-phase-transition bubble/droplet fragmentation codes such as those used for quark-nugget and PBH formation studies) to produce a parameterized quark-object mass function n(M) versus transition parameters.

members.model_name: Smooth-crossover primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH collapse threshold during a smooth crossover with time-dependent softened w and c_s^2 rests on spherical-collapse prescriptions outside their calibrated regime; the abundance is exponentially sensitive to this threshold and the source itself flags that very soft equations of state need dedicated simulations.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Musco-style numerical-relativity collapse simulations across the crossover template (varying c_s^2_min, crossover width, and mass scale) and fit a threshold formula delta_c(w(t), c_s^2(t)) usable in the semi-analytic mass-function step, including non-spherical checks for the softest cases.

members.model_name: Trapped-vacuum-bubble primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: Full numerical-relativity simulations of type-II gravitational collapse of trapped vacuum bubbles have not been performed; the bubble-channel PBH mass is fixed only up to an order 1-10 mass factor F, leaving the bubble-channel mass function normalization and shape approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run general-relativistic collapse simulations (Misner-Sharp or full NR) of supercritical trapped-bubble initial data in the type-II regime to calibrate the bubble-mass factor F and the critical-collapse scaling of the bubble-channel mass function.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from radiative-symmetry-breaking first-order phase transitions
members.description: The late-blooming PBH abundance rests on an uncalibrated semi-analytic collapse probability: no numerical simulation of overdense-patch collapse during a strongly supercooled first-order transition validates the collapse threshold or the resulting mass function in this regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform numerical (general-relativistic or gradient-expansion) collapse simulations of late-percolating vacuum-dominated patches for representative alpha > 100, small beta/H_n benchmarks to calibrate the collapse threshold and efficiency entering the semi-analytic f_PBH formula.

members.model_name: Light radion freeze-in dark matter in an RS/SBSI model
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function pipeline exists for a mixed cold-plus-hot radion component, which is needed to turn the Lyman-alpha bound on the allowed hot fraction into a quantitative constraint on the freeze-in radion abundance.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the derived f(q) into CLASS as a non-cold dark-matter (ncdm) species with a cold CDM remainder, compute the suppressed transfer function, and compare against existing mixed cold+hot dark-matter Lyman-alpha fraction limits or a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator.

members.model_name: Bose-Einstein-condensed scalar field dark matter
members.description: No linear perturbation (transfer-function) capability exists for this self-interacting complex SFDM: the small-scale suppression observable is routed with only the homogeneous background chain, and existing fuzzy-dark-matter perturbation codes (AxiCLASS-type) treat a real, non-self-interacting axion field, not a quartically self-interacting condensate with a conserved charge.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS-based fuzzy-dark-matter perturbation module with the effective sound speed of the self-interacting condensate (including the lambda-dependent self-interaction pressure term), producing linear transfer functions and a half-mode scale as a function of (m, lambda/(mc^2)^2) that can feed standard Lyman-alpha and subhalo-count constraint pipelines.

members.model_name: Inelastic freeze-in pseudo-Dirac dark matter
members.description: No linear Boltzmann treatment exists for the mixed cold/warm population created by late chi2 decay: the daughter chi1 receives a v_kick ~ Delta/m_chi, giving a two-component transfer function that the card only estimates via free-streaming-length comparisons to thermal WDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a two-state decaying-DM species whose daughter is born with the three-body recoil momentum distribution (analogous to existing DCDM-with-kick implementations), compute the mixed transfer function, and recast against Lyman-alpha and subhalo-mass-function constraints.

members.model_name: N-superpartner NLSP decay to stable N plus light gravitino
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for this model's late invisible NLSP decay into two dark-sector daughters (light gravitino plus stable ~GeV singlet N), needed to compute Delta N_eff and the daughter phase-space distributions beyond the paper's median-velocity estimate; the card lists a 'Boltzmann solver for decaying dark matter/dark radiation' as a required but absent code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public CLASS decaying-CDM module (two-body decay to a massless plus a massive daughter, as used in Lyman-alpha decaying-DM analyses like 2102_12498) to the multi-component case where both daughters are dark, tracking the full decay-produced momentum distribution of gravitino and N and outputting Delta N_eff(a) and the nonthermal transfer function.

members.model_name: Axion-SU(2) inflation vector boson dark matter
members.description: The small-scale-structure requirement (T_osc > 1.3e6 GeV, z_T > 5.5e6) is a quoted estimate: no Boltzmann-code implementation of the dark-radiation-to-matter transition of the coherent SU(2) condensate exists to compute the linear power suppression and make the oscillation-onset bound quantitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the oscillating vector condensate as a species in CLASS/CAMB with an equation of state transitioning from radiation-like to matter-like at T_osc, compute the transfer-function cutoff, and confront it with Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite constraints instead of the quoted threshold.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with dark-photon late-time magnetogenesis
members.description: The Lyman-alpha floor at m_phi about 1e-21 eV is imported from pure ultralight-ALP results, but no Boltzmann-code implementation computes this model's transfer function and Delta N_eff with coherent energy transfer from the ALP condensate to dark-photon radiation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend axionCAMB or a CLASS ultralight-axion branch with a time-dependent energy-drain term into a free-streaming dark U(1) radiation component, then recast the resulting suppression cutoff against existing Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints and Planck Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Feebly interacting U(1)_B-L gauge boson warm dark matter
members.description: No pipeline maps the decay-produced nonthermal momentum distribution of the keV B-L vector to Lyman-alpha forest constraints; only thermal-WDM bounds exist, which the card notes cannot be applied naively to this distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the scalar-decay f(q) into CLASS as a non-cold (ncdm) species with a tabulated phase-space distribution, compute the linear transfer function, and map to thermal-WDM-equivalent bounds via the half-mode scale or an area criterion against existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulators.

members.model_name: Multiple Kaluza-Klein dark matter from stringy throats
members.description: No Boltzmann-code configuration exists for the multi-component mixed cold/warm/hot KK population plus possible dark radiation: no transfer function has been computed for this model, and the eV-scale tail's Delta_N_eff and BBN-expansion contribution has never been evaluated against data (both card constraints have likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the f_i(q) tables from gap_1 into a multi-species non-cold-dark-matter Boltzmann setup (e.g. multiple ncdm sectors in CLASS/CAMB, one per long throat, plus a dark-radiation fluid for sub-eV modes) to produce T(k) and Delta_N_eff(F_X, T_in,tunn, m_X_i), then confront with CMB, BBN, and small-scale power (Lyman-alpha-style) constraints in place of the quoted WMAP-era overclosure bound.

members.model_name: Scalar-parent non-thermal vector WIMP dark radiation model
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the sharply boosted, decay-produced vector dark-matter subcomponent (delta-function-like f(p) at gamma ~ M_X/2M_DM, injected at tau_X); the matter-power suppression is estimated only analytically, so the f < 0.01 WMAP9/Lyman-alpha bound cannot be recomputed or updated with current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-body-decay momentum distribution as a tabulated ncdm species in CLASS (injection at time tau_X with Lorentz factor set by M_X/M_DM, fraction f), validate against the paper's analytic growth-suppression estimate, and rederive the f bound against modern Planck plus Lyman-alpha power-spectrum data.

members.model_name: Bino-to-gravitino non-thermal dark radiation model
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver implementation exists for the sharply boosted, decay-produced gravitino subcomponent (delta-function-like f(p) at gamma ~ M_B/2M_G, redshifting after tau_B); the matter-power suppression is currently estimated only analytically, so the f < 0.01 WMAP9/Lyman-alpha bound cannot be recomputed or updated with current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-body-decay momentum distribution as a tabulated ncdm species in CLASS (injection at time tau_B with Lorentz factor set by M_B/M_G, fraction f), validate against the paper's analytic growth-suppression estimate, and rederive the f bound against modern Planck plus Lyman-alpha power-spectrum data.

members.model_name: Ultralight coherent vector field dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann code evolves ultralight massive-vector (Proca) perturbations with the wave-regime effective sound speed, anisotropic stress, and coupled scalar-vector-tensor modes; scalar fuzzy-DM modules (e.g. AxiCLASS-style) do not capture the mode mixing, so no matter transfer function or Jeans-cutoff prediction can be computed for quantitative constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with a coherent massive vector-field species implementing the paper's averaged background and perturbation equations (regime-dependent c_s, gravitational slip, SVT coupling), validate against the analytic particle-regime CDM limit and the paper's wave-regime solutions, then connect the output P(k) to existing CMB/LSS/Lyman-alpha likelihoods.

members.model_name: Kinetically produced massive dark-photon vector dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for the linear transfer function of a massive dark photon with the peaked nonthermal momentum distribution of this model, so the structure-formation constraint is applied only as the crude k_peak/(a_eq m_X) coldness ratio instead of a matter power spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the peaked dark-photon distribution f(k) into the CLASS ncdm module (tabulated phase-space distribution) to compute transfer functions, map the suppression scale to existing Lyman-alpha and subhalo WDM-style bounds, and validate against the paper's coldness criterion.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-inflaton scalar dark matter from dark-sector preheating
members.description: No pipeline exists that maps the nonthermal preheating-produced chi phase-space distribution to a linear matter transfer function and structure-formation (e.g. Lyman-alpha, Milky Way satellite) bounds; the paper's m_chi >~ 30 eV limit relies on an approximate thermal-WDM mapping the card itself flags as not a thermal identity.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated lattice f(q) into CLASS as a non-cold dark matter species (ncdm with tabulated distribution), compute the model transfer function on the (m_chi, coupling ratio, T_reh) grid, and recast against existing Lyman-alpha and satellite-count WDM likelihoods via half-mode-mass matching.

members.model_name: Light magnetic dipole dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-solver treatment exists for dipole DM-photon/baryon coupling at sub-proton masses: the CMB/Lyman-alpha transport bound quoted was derived for DM heavier than the proton, and the card notes a quantitative light-mass large-scale-structure recast is missing, so the M_min cutoff and the scattering bound rely on analytic estimates and unsafe mass extrapolation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS dmeff/ETHOS-style DM-baryon scattering module with the dipole momentum-transfer cross section (its velocity/momentum dependence and Coulomb-log behavior) valid for m_chi below the proton mass, compute T(k) through late kinetic decoupling, and run Planck plus Lyman-alpha (e.g. eBOSS/MIKE-HIRES emulator) likelihoods.

members.model_name: Foamy dark matter from ALP monodromies
members.description: No pipeline converts the lattice-produced nonthermal ALP momentum distribution (momenta up to ~10 m_a, frozen in comoving momentum) into a linear transfer function and Lyman-alpha matter-power constraint; the paper's cold-by-equality criterion is only a rough velocity cut and thermal-WDM bounds cannot be applied directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the tabulated lattice occupation numbers into CLASS as an ncdm species with an arbitrary distribution function, compute the suppressed matter power spectrum, and recast against Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints via an area-criterion or emulator-based comparison calibrated on thermal-WDM limits (rel_astro-ph0501562 template).
