members.model_name: Radion misalignment dark matter in a five-dimensional weak-scale framework
members.description: The card states the radion has a smooth-cutoff transfer function with small-scale suppression and a Jeans scale that can erase structure (simulation_calibrated: no), but no linear perturbation solver or structure-formation route exists for this model; whether the radion can be all of the dark matter therefore cannot be tested against small-scale structure data, and no ultralight-scalar Boltzmann setup including its self-interactions and subcomponent fraction is attached.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing ultralight-axion Boltzmann implementation (axionCAMB- or CLASS-style scalar-field fluid treatment) to the radion case with its mass, self-interaction, and free density fraction as inputs, producing the transfer-function cutoff needed to confront Lyman-alpha and subhalo-count structure constraints and to bound the full-DM region of validity_structure.

members.model_name: Pure SU(N) glueball dark matter with dark SU(N) stars
members.description: No relic-abundance and structure-constraint pipeline exists for dark SU(N) glueballs as a function of (m, N, dark-to-SM temperature ratio): the confinement-transition thermal history, 3-to-2 glueball cannibalism, self-interaction cross section, and damping/transfer-function scale were never computed for this card, so the warm self-interacting window and Bullet Cluster/Lyman-alpha bounds cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a glueball Boltzmann solver with lattice-informed SU(N) equation of state and 3-to-2 interaction rates (following the lattice-informed dark Yang-Mills relic studies cited on the card), parameterized by (m, N, xi = T_dark/T), and map its output distribution to a transfer function via CLASS ncdm plus a self-interaction cross-section estimate for cluster bounds.

members.model_name: OHe composite dark atom model
members.description: No Boltzmann-code implementation exists for OHe acoustic coupling to the plasma until T_dec ~ 1 keV, so the small-scale power suppression is only qualitative and cannot be confronted with Lyman-alpha, satellite-count, or lensing data.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend CLASS with an ETHOS-style dark-matter-baryon/photon interaction term parameterized by (sigma_OHe, m_O, T_dec) to compute the OHe transfer function, then map the resulting cutoff onto existing Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite likelihoods.

members.model_name: Dark-QCD pi-axiverse
members.description: No linear structure-formation computation exists for the multi-component ultralight pi-axion mixture: existing ultralight-axion Boltzmann codes (axionCAMB, AxiCLASS) handle one ULA species, while this model needs several simultaneous species with different masses and fractions to evaluate the fuzzy-component suppression.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS or axionCAMB to N simultaneous ultralight scalar species with independent (m_i, Omega_i), compute the mixed transfer function for benchmark pi-axiverse spectra, and compare against Lyman-alpha and subhalo bounds on ultralight components.

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from out-of-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No Boltzmann transfer-function pipeline exists for the out-of-equilibrium singlet-decay spectrum: the route stops at lambda_fs, while the Lyman-alpha comparison needs the full linear power suppression from the warmer nonthermal n(x) computed from the frozen-out S distribution, which is more constraining here than in the equilibrium case.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate the out-of-equilibrium decay distribution n(x) (from the frozen-out S abundance, rescaled by the dilution factor xi) and feed it into the CLASS ncdm sector as a custom phase-space distribution to compute transfer functions and half-mode masses across (m_N, m_S, f).

members.model_name: Chilled sterile neutrino dark matter from in-equilibrium singlet decays
members.description: No Boltzmann transfer-function pipeline exists for this model's nonthermal chilled sterile-neutrino spectrum: the route stops at the single free-streaming scale lambda_fs, while the Lyman-alpha comparison requires the full linear power suppression computed from the equilibrium-decay n(x) including entropy dilution.
members.proposed_resolution: Tabulate the paper's equilibrium-decay distribution n(x) (rescaled by the dilution factor xi) and feed it into the CLASS ncdm sector as a custom phase-space distribution to compute the model's transfer function and half-mode mass across (m_N, m_S, f).

members.model_name: Decaying axion-like dark matter direct-collapse model
members.description: No public one-zone collapse plus primordial-chemistry code includes an in-situ Lyman-Werner source from dark-matter decay with the paper's alpha_sh-parameterized self-shielding reduction, so the H2-suppression and direct-collapse criterion cannot be re-evaluated across the 22.4-27.2 eV ALP parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public primordial-chemistry network (KROME or Grackle) in a one-zone collapse model with a DM-decay LW emissivity term proportional to the halo density profile and an alpha_sh-scaled H2 self-shielding function, validated against the paper's quoted viable mass window.

members.model_name: Axionic mirage mediation axino dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function calculation exists for decay-produced axinos with this model's nonthermal momentum spectrum; only an effective free-streaming-scale proxy is available, which the card flags as insufficient for precision Lyman-alpha recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the decay-produced axino phase-space distribution f(q) from the NLSP decay kinematics and feed it to CLASS as a tabulated non-cold-dark-matter (ncdm) species to obtain the model transfer function, replacing the order-of-magnitude lambda_FS estimate.

members.model_name: Metastable conformal dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann/transfer-function implementation exists for the nonthermal freeze-in phase-space distribution of the conformal scalar; the Lyman-alpha mass floor rests on an approximate thermal-WDM equation-of-state mapping whose validity the card flags.
members.proposed_resolution: Insert the model's freeze-in distribution f(q) (from Higgs/top-dominated production at T_RH) into the CLASS ncdm module, compute the linear transfer function directly, and rederive the Lyman-alpha mass floor by half-mode matching to published thermal-WDM constraints instead of the equation-of-state mapping.

members.model_name: Density-dependent baryon-DM cooling interaction model
members.description: Existing CMB/LSS baryon-DM scattering machinery (CLASS/CAMB modules for sigma proportional to v^n) cannot represent a density-dependent cross section sigma_int proportional to 1/(n v^2), so the z ~ 100 thermalization estimate and the possible 21-cm and Lyman-alpha signatures cannot be computed beyond the paper's order-of-magnitude scaling.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a CLASS baryon-DM interaction module to accept a cross section depending on local density as well as velocity (using the background plus perturbative density in the momentum-exchange rate), compute the post-recombination baryon temperature history and matter power, and feed 21-cm global-signal codes and a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator for constraints.

members.model_name: Muon-coupled thermal-misalignment scalar dark matter
members.description: No public code or digitized data reproduces the combined exclusion overlay (fuzzy-DM Lyman-alpha, black-hole superradiance, pulsar-binary scalar radiation, NS mergers, muon storage rings) in the scalar mass-coupling plane; the route currently relies on the primary paper's undigitized figure compilation.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published exclusion curves (or recompute them from the cited limit papers) and implement a probe-overlay module that evaluates each bound as a function of (m_phi, y_mu_phi), validated against the primary paper's figure.

members.model_name: Relativistic Bose-Einstein condensate scalar dark matter cosmology
members.description: No linear Boltzmann/perturbation solver exists for this three-component relativistic BEC cosmology (uniform gas, condensate, collapsed component with quartic self-interaction), so no transfer function can be produced for LSS or Lyman-alpha comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing scalar-field-dark-matter CLASS branch (e.g. an SFDM/axionCAMB-style implementation) with the quartic self-interaction sound speed and phenomenological condensation source terms, outputting T(k) over the m = 1e-24 eV to 1 eV range discussed in the card.

members.model_name: Two-component wave dark matter with distinct boson masses
members.description: No linear-theory pipeline computes the combined two-component transfer function: existing ultralight-axion Boltzmann treatments (axionCAMB/AxiCLASS-type) handle one mass, and the primary simulations instead adopt CDM-like initial power with an ad hoc Jeans-scale cutoff.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend AxiCLASS/axionCAMB to two ultralight scalar species with independent masses and mass fractions, producing the combined suppressed transfer function to seed simulations and Lyman-alpha recasts.

members.model_name: Rotating Bose-Einstein-condensate cold dark matter with possible vortices
members.description: No linear-theory pipeline computes the transfer function and small-scale cutoff for a self-interacting BEC dark matter fluid as a function of (m, g); the card records a smooth-cutoff suppression with no half-mode mass and explicitly no thermal-WDM mapping, so CMB/LSS and Lyman-alpha style constraints cannot be placed on the parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the BEC effective sound speed (quantum pressure plus g-dependent self-interaction pressure) in a Boltzmann code, extending the existing ultra-light axion treatments in CLASS/axionCAMB to nonzero g, and tabulate transfer functions and half-mode masses over the (m, g) plane.

members.model_name: Subdominant decaying particle X direct-collapse dark-sector model
members.description: No public one-zone collapse plus primordial-chemistry code includes an in-situ Lyman-Werner source from decaying particle X (including the three-body parabola spectrum) with alpha_sh-parameterized self-shielding reduction, so the H2-suppression and direct-collapse outcome cannot be re-evaluated over (f_X, m_X, tau_X).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public primordial-chemistry network (KROME or Grackle) in a one-zone collapse model with a redshift-dependent X-decay LW emissivity term and an alpha_sh-scaled H2 self-shielding function, reproducing the paper's z ~ 50-4 decay-epoch examples.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone hot-and-cold dark matter
members.description: The cold pNG abundance from domain-wall annihilation rests on analytic scaling estimates with unquantified network uncertainty; no field-theoretic simulation of this Z_n-biased Higgs-portal potential calibrates the wall area parameter, annihilation epoch, or the emitted pNG momentum spectrum (which sets whether the component is truly cold).
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice field-theory simulations of the biased Z_n domain-wall network (Hiramatsu-Kawasaki-Saikawa style) for the cosine potential with Higgs-portal parameters, extracting the scaling area parameter, annihilation time, and pNG emission spectrum as functions of F, m_a, and the bias.

members.model_name: Minimal nonminimal-coupling inflaton dark matter
members.description: No public preheating simulation setup exists for this nonminimally coupled inflaton-Higgs system; the LATTICEEASY runs behind the leftover-quanta yield Y ~ 1e-3 are summarized but not released, so the decisive overabundance bound cannot be reproduced or extended across (xi_phi, lambda_phi, lambda_hphi).
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the preheating stage in a public lattice code (LATTICEEASY or CosmoLattice) with the Einstein-frame potential and Higgs-portal coupling of the paper, publish the input configurations and the resulting inflaton yield tables over the unitarity-allowed xi_phi range.

members.model_name: Mirror-star dissipative mirror-baryon dark matter
members.description: The local mirror-star population (number density, mass function, and distance distribution) is not predicted, so per-object detectability cannot be converted into expected Gaia/X-ray candidate counts or into constraints from non-detection.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate dissipative cooling and star formation of the subdominant mirror-baryon component in a Milky Way environment (or adapt atomic-dark-matter cooling semi-analytics) to output a solar-neighborhood mirror-star luminosity function feeding the survey-comparison step.

members.model_name: Axion Quark Nugget dark matter with magnetar-triggered FRB scenario
members.description: No simulation exists of a macroscopic AQN impact on a magnetar: the chain from nugget-driven Mach shock to triggered magnetic reconnection and coherent radio emission rests on an assumed trigger efficiency, so the predicted FRB energetics and the neutron-star heating signal cannot be computed from (B, impact velocity, field geometry).
members.proposed_resolution: Run localized relativistic MHD (and, for the emission mechanism, PIC) simulations of a supersonic macroscopic impactor perturbing a magnetar magnetosphere, parameterized by nugget baryon charge B, impact speed, and surface field, to calibrate the reconnection-trigger efficiency and released-energy scaling used in the semi-analytic chain.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled gravitational scalar dark matter
members.description: For xi above roughly 70 the analysis stops because backreaction and inflaton-condensate fragmentation during resonant production are not captured by the linear mode-function treatment, leaving the large-xi parameter space unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice simulations (e.g. CosmoLattice with the xi chi^2 R coupling added) of spectator-scalar resonance and backreaction on the T-model background to extend Omega_chi h^2 and f(q) predictions to xi > 70.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter from linear non-minimally coupled inflaton decay
members.description: The yield is computed assuming purely perturbative two-body decay of the inflaton condensate; no lattice or non-perturbative preheating calculation exists for the linear non-minimal coupling beta M_P phi R to quantify how parametric/tachyonic production of the light scalar corrects the abundance and momentum distribution, a risk the card's validity domain explicitly flags.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a lattice preheating study (e.g. with CosmoLattice extended to the Einstein-frame interactions induced by the linear non-minimal coupling) of inflaton fragmentation and scalar particle production for representative beta in the O(0.1)-O(100) range, and publish correction factors to the perturbative yield and spectrum.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet dark matter with U(1)' cosmic-string production
members.description: The branching fraction of U(1)' cosmic-string energy loss into odd-sector particles versus gravitational radiation is uncalibrated (card lists it as the dominant uncertainty and status unknown), so the injection normalization q0 and the Gmu bound cannot be fixed from the string tension.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Abelian-Higgs field-theory simulations of the U(1)' string network (or adopt published network simulations spanning particle- vs GW-dominated decay) to calibrate the particle-emission branching fraction as a function of string tension, and propagate it into the q0 parameterization.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal dark monopole dark matter
members.description: The preheating monopole abundance (and the associated dark-radiation energy density) rests on an approximate parametric-resonance estimate; no lattice simulation of defect production in the dark SU(2)-Higgs sector coupled to the inflaton exists to calibrate the yield that normalizes all observables.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice preheating simulations (e.g. extend CosmoLattice or LatticeEasy to the dark SU(2) gauge-Higgs system with the inflaton coupling) to count monopole number density and dark-photon energy density as functions of H_end, T_RH, g, and f, and fit a calibrated abundance formula.

members.model_name: Right-handed sneutrino condensate baryon-dark matter model
members.description: The abundance-ratio prediction assumes perturbative decay of both d=4 condensates; no lattice or numerical simulation of flat-direction fragmentation (e.g. into Q-balls) validates that the analytic scaling of the sneutrino and H_u L^2 condensates survives nonlinear dynamics.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the two d=4 flat-direction condensates (as done for Affleck-Dine fragmentation studies) over the paper's soft-mass and coupling window to check for fragmentation and correct the analytic Omega_DM/Omega_B relation.

members.model_name: Kinetically produced massive dark-photon vector dark matter
members.description: No public lattice or mode-evolution code covers tachyonic dark-photon production from the kinetically rotating ALP including backreaction, so the full dark-photon spectrum entering Omega_X, T_NR, and the GW signal is approximated by a narrow peak at k_peak rather than computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public lattice code such as CosmoLattice with a rotating complex PQ field coupled to a dark U(1) gauge field and tabulate the produced dark-photon spectra and GW spectra over (alpha, S_i, k_peak) for the vector-DM benchmarks.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-inflaton scalar dark matter from dark-sector preheating
members.description: No public, validated lattice/spectral simulation setup exists for this Starobinsky-inflaton plus sterile-scalar dark-preheating model that reproduces the paper's backreaction time, inflaton energy depletion, and chi phase-space distribution for the benchmark coupling ratios 10^4-10^6.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Starobinsky potential with the phi^2 chi^2 coupling in CosmoLattice (or LATTICEEASY), evolve through resonance and backreaction, validate against the paper's quoted energy-depletion fractions (0.22, 0.15, 0.07), and export the chi occupation-number spectrum as a tabulated f(q).

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with survival-based size distribution
members.description: Solar-corona/flare energy deposition and galactic annihilation emission (511 keV line and diffuse continuum) from antinugget annihilation are modeled only by application-specific, non-public one-off calculations, with no reusable emission code taking dN/dB and the antinugget fraction as inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a public emission module that combines the line-of-sight interaction integral I_AQN with a surface-annihilation spectral model, calibrated against the existing solar-corona simulation (EUV power ~1e27 erg/s) and applied to Galactic bulge geometry for the 511 keV and continuum predictions.

members.model_name: Dark matter pearl vacuum-bubble model
members.description: No public stopping/propagation code exists for macroscopic pearls: terminal velocity, stopping depth, and traversal time through atmosphere, rock, and detector shielding (including the ~1400 m DAMA overburden penetration-time requirement) must currently be estimated by hand.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a macro-dark-matter overburden Monte Carlo (adapting existing macro-DM/CDEX-style overburden propagation codes) with electron-cloud drag and material-specific stopping power parameterized by (R, M_pearl, v), outputting stopped-pearl rates and annual-modulation phase at detector depth.

members.model_name: Dissipative-inflation primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: The stochastic inflaton-radiation solver with a transient peaked dissipation coefficient — needed to generate the curvature power distribution over many noise realizations — is private to the source paper, so the head of the forward chain cannot be run for any new (dissipation strength, duration, inflaton potential) point.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or reimplement a Langevin solver for the coupled inflaton-radiation-metric perturbation system with a parameterized peaked dissipative coefficient Upsilon(phi), sampling the thermal noise over many realizations and outputting the full P(zeta) distribution, validated against the paper's published peaked spectra.

members.model_name: Foamy dark matter from ALP monodromies
members.description: The classical-statistical lattice simulation of monodromy ALP fluctuation growth (quadratic-plus-cosine potential) exists only as the authors' unreleased custom C++ code, so fluctuation spectra, occupation numbers, and the equation of state cannot be regenerated across the (m_a, f, kappa, initial displacement) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Reimplement the monodromy potential V = m^2 phi^2/2 + Lambda^4 cos(phi/f) in a public lattice code such as CosmoLattice (or obtain and release the authors' code), reproducing the paper's O(1) fluctuation scale and equation-of-state evolution as validation, then scan wiggle strength and initial displacement.

members.model_name: False-vacuum-island primordial black hole scenario
members.description: The false-vacuum-island collapse is modeled only with fitting formulae and a standard collapse threshold delta_c; no numerical-relativity or lattice simulation has calibrated the collapse efficiency and mass-function width for accumulating delayed-decay islands, on which f_PBH depends exponentially.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity (or at least full GR Misner-Sharp) collapse simulations of late-decaying false-vacuum islands in a radiation background to calibrate delta_c, collapse efficiency, and the mass-function width, replacing the monochromatic assumption in the abundance formula.

members.model_name: Parallel-universe dark atomic matter with Higgs mixing
members.description: The conversion of the assumed dark-to-visible strong-coupling ratio (about 5) into dark nucleon masses and dark nuclear binding energies is a phenomenological scaling with no lattice calculation behind it, so the predicted m_p_dark/m_p ~ 5 and hence the abundance ratio carry uncontrolled uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run (or reuse) lattice QCD calculations at a rescaled confinement scale Lambda_dark to obtain the dark hadron spectrum and light dark-nuclei binding energies as a function of alpha_s_dark/alpha_s, and tabulate the result for the abundance step.

members.model_name: Scalar dark matter from Q-ball decay
members.description: The Q-ball charge distribution from fragmentation of the oscillating complex scalar condensate has not been simulated; the abundance and decay-temperature estimates rest on a single Gaussian-profile Q ball, and the route caveat states the result is sensitive to the charge distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D classical lattice simulations of the U(1)-charged scalar condensate fragmentation (extending a scalar-field lattice code such as CosmoLattice) for the logarithmic potential with |K| ~ 1e-4 to extract the Q-ball charge spectrum, and fit it as an input distribution replacing the single-charge Gaussian approximation.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter with solar-flare triggering
members.description: The AQN energy-deposition step relies on private solar-atmosphere simulations from a related paper covering only limited trajectories and a single coronal plasma model; there is no public simulation pipeline that samples annihilation altitude and energy injection over the full baryon-charge window 1e23 <= |B| <= 1e28, impact-parameter range, and velocity distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend and publicly release the related-paper AQN solar-atmosphere simulation code, coupling nugget annihilation rates to a standard transition-region/coronal plasma model, and run a grid over B, entry velocity, and impact parameter to tabulate height-dependent energy injection for downstream event modeling.

members.model_name: SU(5) x U(1) hybrid-inflation primordial black hole dark matter model
members.description: No solver is in place for the waterfall-phase curvature power spectrum P_R(k) of this SU(5) x U(1) hybrid-inflation potential, including quantum diffusion of the waterfall fields over the 17-21 e-fold benchmarks; this spectrum is the input to every downstream observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the inflaton-waterfall two-field system in a transport-method code (PyTransport/CppTransport) supplemented by a stochastic/lattice treatment of the waterfall diffusion regime, and validate by recovering the BP2/BP3 peak amplitudes near P_R ~ 1e-2 at k ~ 1e13-1e14 Mpc^-1.

members.model_name: Affleck-Dine Q-ball gravitino dark matter in gauge-mediated MSSM
members.description: No simulation-calibrated prediction of the Q-ball charge distribution from Affleck-Dine condensate fragmentation exists for this gauge-mediated D-term inflation setup; survival against thermal evaporation (Q > ~1e18) is judged only from rough analytic scaling, so whether Q-balls survive to source NSPs cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice simulations of AD condensate fragmentation (in the style of existing Kasuya-Kawasaki-type Q-ball lattice studies) over the gauge-mediated flat-direction potential, parameterized by the cutoff M and reheating temperature T_re, and release a fitted charge-distribution function Q(M, T_re) with the resulting baryon asymmetry.

members.model_name: PQ-extended MSSM axino dark matter with thermal inflation
members.description: The baryogenesis and moduli-dilution consistency of the thermal-inflation history (Affleck-Dine leptogenesis along the LH_u flat direction after flaton decay) was never numerically reproduced, so the claimed simultaneous solution of the moduli, baryon-asymmetry, and dark-matter constraints rests on analytic estimates only.
members.proposed_resolution: Numerically evolve the coupled flaton and LH_u flat-direction equations of motion through the end of thermal inflation (an ODE lattice-averaged treatment in the style of existing Affleck-Dine codes), outputting n_B/s and the moduli dilution factor Delta as functions of (f_a, T_d) to confirm the paper's viable window.

members.model_name: ULAP oscillon dark matter
members.description: Oscillon formation and abundance are demonstrated only at benchmark points (p=2.5, 4 with phi_i/F=2/3) using a non-public lattice code; no cosmological oscillon abundance or mass function across the (m, F, p, phi_i/F) parameter space exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a radiation-era lattice scan with a public code (CosmoLattice or LatticeEasy) over p, phi_i/F, and fluctuation amplitude for the non-cosine ULAP potential, tabulating oscillon number density, mass function, and energy fraction for downstream cosmology.

members.model_name: Pico-charged particles from dark matter decay
members.description: No simulation or transport code models the Galactic dynamics of pico-charged (q_C ~ 1e-11 e) relativistic particles: magnetic trapping in the disk, cooling to v_f, spatial distribution, and annihilation morphology, on which both the local C density at detectors and the 511 keV line prediction depend.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a propagation model for millicharged/pico-charged particles in Galactic magnetic-field models (e.g. adapting GALPROP-style diffusion machinery with Larmor-scale trapping and the paper's cooling channel on Y), outputting the steady-state C phase-space density near Earth and the annihilation rate map, validated against the v_f=0.08c and disk-retention benchmarks.

members.model_name: SO(2N) baryonic glueball dark matter
members.description: The O(1) strong-dynamics constants of SO(2N) pure Yang-Mills at moderately large N (baryonic glueball mass coefficient a, critical-temperature coefficient b, string-tension coefficient c_mu) are not computed, leaving all abundance and GW predictions uncertain at the O(1) level.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice simulations of SO(2N) pure Yang-Mills (e.g. N in the 4-12 range with large-N extrapolation) to determine the baryonic glueball spectrum, deconfinement temperature, and string tension in units of Lambda, publishing the coefficients as tabulated inputs for the registry.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from slow reheating
members.description: The collapse probability during the matter-dominated reheating phase is not simulation-calibrated: the card flags critical-collapse behavior in a matter era as uncertain (possible low-mass tail below M_min), and beta(M) in matter domination depends on anisotropy and angular-momentum suppression factors known only from approximate analytic arguments.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity simulations of nonspherical collapse of overdensities in a matter-dominated (oscillating scalar condensate) background across the transition to radiation domination, calibrating the collapse threshold, anisotropy/spin suppression of beta(M), and the presence of a critical-collapse low-mass tail.

members.model_name: Neutron dark decay Dirac fermion model
members.description: No public neutron-star cooling code includes the dark URCA-like channels n -> chi nu anti-nu and chi + n reactions, so the claimed compatibility with neutron-star thermal evolution cannot be checked quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the dark-channel emissivities from the effective n-chi couplings and add them to a public neutron-star cooling code (e.g. NSCool), comparing cooling curves against observed neutron-star temperatures across the allowed m_chi window.

members.model_name: Fourth-generation helium-bound dark atom scenario
members.description: No public calculation of terrestrial transport, thermalization, and nuclear/atomic scattering of helium-bound fourth-generation dark atoms exists, so the abundance cannot be mapped to underground-detector and anomalous-isotope signatures; the card explicitly notes no accumulation or nuclear-scattering simulation was run.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a dark-atom transport code: compute the helium-shell elastic cross sections for the charged heavy-hadron bound states, then propagate the local flux through the Earth's crust and detector overburden with a slow-down/thermalization Monte Carlo, following the O-helium/CHAMP transport formalism already in the stable-charged-relic literature, parameterized by relic charge, mass, and abundance.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic thermal dark matter Model IA
members.description: No public forward-model exists for the DUNE mono-neutrino signal: generating dark-sector radiation off charged-current neutrino scattering (missing transverse momentum plus wrong-sign lepton), the SM background templates, and the near-detector response needed to evaluate the paper's Poisson binned likelihood for the (m_chi, m_phi, lambda_alpha_beta, y_IA) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the neutrinophilic-mediator radiation matrix elements on top of a standard neutrino event generator (GENIE or NuWro) with the DUNE flux, apply liquid/gas argon near-detector smearing, charge-identification, and background selections matching the paper's assumptions, and package the binned Poisson log-likelihood for both democratic and hierarchical flavor benchmarks.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: No event-level simulation exists for neutrinophilic-scalar production in the DUNE near detector (missing-pT and wrong-sign-lepton topologies); the FeynRules/MadGraph model file, DUNE beam flux interface, and detector response model have not been assembled for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a FeynRules/UFO model for the charge-two scalar coupled to neutrinos, generate nu-nucleus scattering with mediator emission in MadGraph (or GENIE-interfaced workflow) using published DUNE near-detector fluxes, and recast the existing neutrinophilic-scalar sensitivity analyses to this model's coupling structure.

members.model_name: Secluded composite hidden-baryon dark matter
members.description: No nonperturbative calculation of the hidden non-Abelian sector's hadron spectrum (B prime, M prime, glueball masses) or of the B prime/anti-B prime annihilation cross section to hidden mesons exists; the greater-than-10-TeV mass floor rests on an unsuppressed-annihilation parametric estimate the card rates low robustness.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice gauge-theory simulations of the hidden confining group (or match to existing dark-QCD/pure-glue lattice results scaled by Lambda_prime) to obtain the baryon and meson spectrum and a calibrated B prime annihilation cross section, replacing the naive geometric estimate in the abundance calculation.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition vector dark matter
members.description: No public joint likelihood exists that confronts the model's correlated predictions (Planck relic abundance plus the FOPT stochastic GW spectrum against LISA/pulsar-timing-class detector sensitivities) in one statistical framework; the card notes no unified likelihood is provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood combining a Gaussian Planck relic-density term with existing public GW sensitivity machinery (power-law-integrated curves and SNR calculations of the PTPlot/LISA-tools type) over the (m_V, g_D, alpha, beta_over_H, T) parameter space.

members.model_name: Axion rotation Poltergeist dark matter
members.description: No SGWB detector likelihood or SNR pipeline exists for the predicted Poltergeist spectrum (LISA/DECIGO/BBO-band), and the BBN consistency cut is applied as a hard temperature floor rather than through a BBN likelihood, so the observable parameter region is projection-only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement standard power-law-integrated sensitivity and SNR integrals against published LISA/DECIGO/BBO noise curves for the model's Omega_GW(f), and couple a simple N_eff/BBN energy-density check (e.g. via a modified CLASS or AlterBBN run) to replace the hard T > 2.5 MeV floor.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition fermion dark matter
members.description: No public joint likelihood exists that confronts the model's correlated predictions (Planck relic abundance plus the FOPT stochastic GW spectrum against LISA/pulsar-timing-class detector sensitivities) in one statistical framework; the card notes no unified likelihood is provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood combining a Gaussian Planck relic-density term with existing public GW sensitivity machinery (power-law-integrated curves and SNR calculations of the PTPlot/LISA-tools type) over the (m_chi, y_chi, alpha, beta_over_H, T) parameter space.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition scalar dark matter
members.description: No public joint likelihood exists that confronts the model's correlated predictions (Planck relic abundance plus the FOPT stochastic GW spectrum against LISA/pulsar-timing-class detector sensitivities) in one statistical framework; the card notes no unified likelihood is provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a likelihood combining a Gaussian Planck relic-density term with existing public GW sensitivity machinery (power-law-integrated curves and SNR calculations of the PTPlot/LISA-tools type) over the (m_S, lambda_S, alpha, beta_over_H, T) parameter space.

members.model_name: CP-symmetric complex-singlet WIMP with strong first-order electroweak phase transition
members.description: GW detectability is assessed only through an approximate SNR>10 threshold against projected sensitivity curves; no reusable likelihood for the phase-transition stochastic background (marginalizing over wall velocity, T_n, alpha, beta/H_*) exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the sound-wave/turbulence spectral templates and published LISA/Taiji/TianQin noise curves into a Fisher or full likelihood module (e.g. extending PTPlot/cobaya-style SGWB likelihoods) parameterized by (T_n, alpha, beta/H_*, v_w).

members.model_name: Scotogenic sterile-neutrino FIMP dark matter with scalar-doublet mass splitting
members.description: The gravitational-wave observable has only detector sensitivity curves (likelihood_available: no); there is no SNR-based likelihood for comparing the predicted Omega_GW(f) against LISA/DECIGO/U-DECIGO projections.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the standard power-law-integrated sensitivity curves and SNR formalism (e.g. via PTPlot-style or GWSC utilities) into a projected-detection likelihood over Omega_GW(f) for the space interferometers named on the card.

members.model_name: Fermion-mediated dark matter from bubble expansion
members.description: The GW forecast lacks a model-linked likelihood: the split of the signal between bubble-collision and sound-wave contributions depends on the unresolved runaway-versus-terminal-wall branch, and no pipeline maps the computed transition parameters onto LISA/BBO/DECIGO/ET sensitivity with that uncertainty propagated.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed (alpha, beta/H, T_reh, gamma_w) from the phase-transition step into standard collision and sound-wave spectral templates and compute signal-to-noise against public LISA/BBO/DECIGO/ET curves (PTPlot-style), carrying the wall-branch ambiguity as a systematic band.

members.model_name: Recycled ultra-heavy dark matter
members.description: No sensitivity curve or likelihood exists for the predicted MHz-GHz gravitational-wave signal; current GW detectors and public likelihood pipelines do not cover this ultra-high-frequency band.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement projected sensitivity curves for proposed ultra-high-frequency GW detectors as a forecast likelihood module and connect it to the FOPT spectrum templates for the model's T_* range.

members.model_name: Microscopic horizonless relic dark matter
members.description: No stochastic-background likelihood exists that confronts the relic-formation Omega_GW(f) with ground-based detector data while marginalizing over the compact-binary astrophysical foreground that limits detectability in the same band.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a cross-correlation SGWB likelihood using public LVK O-series data products and Einstein Telescope projected noise curves, with a power-law compact-binary foreground component jointly fit with the scalar-induced signal parameterized by (A_0, k_0, n).

members.model_name: Sub-horizon-collapsed primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: No detector likelihood or sensitivity forecast exists for comparing the predicted SGWB spectrum and especially its anisotropy to data: the card's constraint is marked recast_required with no published likelihood, and anisotropy discrimination between f_H = 1 and f_H < 1 requires dedicated LIGO/LISA anisotropic-SGWB forecasts.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a likelihood wrapping the LVK isotropic stochastic-search cross-correlation data and the directional (spherical-harmonic) search upper limits, plus LISA anisotropy Fisher forecasts, taking (f_H, M_PBH, f_PBH) to a joint constraint on Omega_gw(f) and C_l(f).

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from late B-L phase-transition patches
members.description: No stochastic-GW detection likelihood (signal versus astrophysical foregrounds for LISA/ET/BDECIGO) is packaged for this bubble-collision spectrum, so the detectability claim rests on comparison to sensitivity curves only.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the predicted Omega_GW(f) template in an existing stochastic-background forecasting framework (e.g. PTPlot-style power-law-integrated sensitivity plus a foreground model for galactic binaries and compact-binary backgrounds) to produce SNR and parameter-recovery likelihoods.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dark photon-fermion nonlinear sector
members.description: No public statistical likelihood exists for recasting stellar black-hole spin/mass measurements against a model-dependent, suppressed superradiance rate; existing exclusion analyses assume minimal (unsuppressed) boson clouds and cannot be rescaled without the underlying spin-measurement posteriors and age/accretion priors.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a reusable likelihood from published black-hole spin/mass posteriors (X-ray binary and gravitational-wave catalogs) that takes an arbitrary spin-down-rate function as input, so suppressed-rate models like this one can be recast without redoing the astrophysical analysis.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal dark matter from relativistic bubble expansion
members.description: The GW forecast lacks a model-linked likelihood: the split between bubble-collision and sound-wave contributions depends on the unresolved runaway-versus-terminal-wall branch, and no pipeline maps the computed transition parameters onto LISA/BBO/DECIGO/ET sensitivity with that uncertainty propagated.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed (alpha, beta/H, T_reh, gamma_w) from the phase-transition step into standard collision and sound-wave spectral templates and compute signal-to-noise against public LISA/BBO/DECIGO/ET curves (PTPlot-style), carrying the wall-branch ambiguity as a systematic band.

members.model_name: Z_3 pseudo-Goldstone complex-singlet dark matter
members.description: GW detectability is judged only against LISA/DECIGO/BBO sensitivity curves; no signal-to-noise or detector likelihood evaluation is wired into the route, so the GW observable yields only a qualitative forecast.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a PTPlot-style SNR computation over the LISA (and DECIGO/BBO) noise curves for the predicted Omega_GW(f), turning the sensitivity-curve comparison into a quantitative detectability statistic.

members.model_name: Self-interacting bosonic dark matter core in neutron stars
members.description: No packaged likelihood pipeline maps two-fluid mass-radius and tidal-deformability predictions onto pulsar-mass measurements and GW170817 posteriors for dark-core neutron stars; the card records likelihood_available no/partial and recasting_needed yes for both constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast module that samples the public LIGO/Virgo GW170817 posterior (LALInference samples) and the PSR J0348+0432 mass likelihood inside a Bayesian EOS-inference framework, extending the EOS parameterization with sigma_D/m_D^3 and the dark-core mass fraction as free parameters.

members.model_name: String moduli star compact-object dark matter
members.description: No likelihood connects moduli-star predictions to gravitational-wave or compact-object survey data; the route lists no likelihoods and both constraints have likelihood_available no/unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Once waveforms exist, recast LIGO/Virgo exotic-compact-object search pipelines (subsolar-mass and BH-mimicker analyses) into a population likelihood over the moduli-star mass function, and add a stochastic-background likelihood against LVK O3/O4 isotropic-background limits.

members.model_name: Scalar singlet dark matter with two-step electroweak phase transition
members.description: No combined likelihood exists for the model's joint constraint set: the direct-detection comparison uses source-era LUX/PandaX limits without the required relic-fraction rescaling against modern LZ/XENONnT data, and the GW detectability statement is a sensitivity-curve overlay rather than an SNR-based detector likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a scan-level likelihood combining a DDCalc-style SI module with LZ/XENONnT data rescaled by Omega_c h^2/0.12, a Planck relic-density constraint, and a LISA/DECIGO/BBO SNR calculator consuming the CosmoTransitions (T_n, alpha, beta/H) output.

members.model_name: Gravitational right-handed-neutrino FIMP dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood combines the BBN gravitational-wave dark-radiation bound and the Planck tensor-to-scalar constraint for gravitational-reheating histories with general inflaton potential power k and non-minimal gravitational coupling; the card records only the paper-level consistency condition, so the viable RHN FIMP region cannot be statistically delimited.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the k-dependent reheating expansion history and its gravitational-wave dark-radiation contribution as a Delta-Neff module coupled to an existing BBN code (e.g. AlterBBN or PRIMAT) and the Planck r likelihood in MontePython/Cobaya, scanning (M_N1, k, reheating scale, non-minimal coupling).

members.model_name: Gravity-portal stable right-handed-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No public forecast pipeline exists for the model's key observable: the primordial GW spectrum shaped by the gravity-portal reheating history evaluated against BBO/DECIGO/ET/CE/LISA noise curves with mock catalogs, needed to reproduce the SNR > 10 window 5e6-1.6e7 GeV in M_DM.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the inflationary tensor spectrum transfer through the model's reheating equation of state, combine with published mission PSDs and foreground models in a Fisher/MCMC wrapper (GWFish/gwent-style), and release it with the (M_DM, T_rh, xi, n) parameterization used in the paper.

members.model_name: Hierarchical right-handed Majorana neutrino dark matter in quintessential inflation
members.description: The CMB-spectrum/graviton consistency of kination reheating is only a qualitative Yukawa cut: no implemented constraint propagates the gravitationally produced graviton background and N3 decay history to a quantitative CMB spectral limit or space-based GW sensitivity comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the kination-era blue-tilted graviton spectrum from the background solver of gap_1, apply the standard N_eff/CMB bound on primordial GW energy density, and compare against LISA-class sensitivity curves to produce a quantitative allowed region in (M_3, sum |h_3|^2, H_inf).

members.model_name: Curvature-coupled massive vector dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or forecast interface exists for the model's endpoints: the CMB isocurvature comparison lacks a recast onto the Planck CDM-isocurvature likelihood, and the second-order stochastic gravitational-wave signal lacks an implemented pipeline from the vector isocurvature spectrum to detector sensitivity curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Interface the computed large-scale isocurvature power with CLASS plus the Planck isocurvature likelihood, and feed the small-scale density-fluctuation spectrum into an existing scalar-induced-GW calculator (e.g. SIGWfast-style integration) compared against LISA-class sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Reheaton-decay nonthermal Dirac fermion dark matter with kination and early matter domination
members.description: No packaged stochastic gravitational-wave likelihood exists for the kination-plus-reheaton-processed inflationary tensor spectrum; the paper only computes SNR visibility contours against sensitivity curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the analytic Omega_GW(f) with its w_kin and Gamma_S-dependent break frequencies as a signal model in a standard stochastic-background analysis pipeline with power-law-integrated LISA/ET/BBO sensitivity or mock-data likelihoods.

members.model_name: Generative-sector first-order phase-transition asymmetric dark matter
members.description: The GW observability claim rests on published space-interferometer sensitivity curves that are not bundled as likelihoods, so no quantitative detection statistic (SNR or posterior) can be computed for the predicted spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a LISA/DECIGO/BBO SNR calculator (PTPlot-style power-law-integrated sensitivity curves plus foreground models) that consumes the (T_n, alpha, beta/H, v_w) output of the phase-transition pipeline.

members.model_name: Minimal dark U(1)_X vector WIMP model
members.description: The multimessenger comparison stops at overlaying projected sensitivity curves: no statistical likelihood is implemented for the LZ/DARWIN spin-independent recoil rate, the collider invisible-Higgs/scalar-mixing bounds, or the LISA-band GW signal-to-noise for this dark U(1) model's parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in micrOMEGAs with DDCalc to obtain LZ/XENON likelihoods for sigma_A'N, recast CMS/ATLAS invisible-Higgs and scalar-mixing limits on lambda_p and m_phi, and compute LISA/BBO/DECIGO SNR-based likelihoods for the CosmoTransitions-derived GW spectra (e.g. via PTPlot-style sensitivity integrals), combining them into one scan-ready pipeline.

members.model_name: Ultralight real pNGB dark matter for strong-gravity scenarios
members.description: No superradiance likelihood is available for the real pNGB with its potential-induced self-interactions; the card only quotes the external [1.3, 17] x 1e-13 eV real-boson interval, which cannot be re-evaluated or extended across the O(1e-20 to 1e-10) eV target range.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the LIGO/Virgo superradiance SGWB search and BH spin-measurement constraints with a black-hole population model, including the quartic self-interaction set by m_eta/v_Phi (which can quench superradiance), to produce an exclusion in (m_eta, v_Phi) rather than a fixed quoted mass interval.

members.model_name: PBH-remnant dark matter from kination/runaway-quintessence production
members.description: No integrated likelihood module exists that jointly evaluates the Planck 2018 inflationary constraints (n_s, alpha_s, P_R normalization), the BBN bound on kination-enhanced stochastic gravitational-wave energy density, pre-BBN evaporation consistency, and the remnant Omega_rem = Omega_DM condition for a given attractor potential (route step s4 lists both likelihoods as unavailable).
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a constraint pipeline that wraps the public Planck 2018 likelihood (or its n_s-alpha_s Gaussian summary) together with an Omega_GW-at-BBN Delta N_eff bound and the analytic evaporation-before-BBN and remnant-abundance conditions, exposing the inflaton-potential parameters, beta, M, and M_rem as inputs.

members.model_name: Atomic dissipative dark matter with dark black holes
members.description: No reusable public likelihood exists for hierarchical inference of the DBH population parameters (f, M_min, slope) against the LIGO/Virgo compact-binary catalog including sub-solar-mass selection effects; the paper's Bayesian analysis was not released and the card records only partial likelihood availability.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the DBH mass-spectrum model in a public hierarchical GW population-inference code (gwpopulation-style) with LVK injection-campaign selection functions extended to the sub-solar regime, and release it as a reusable likelihood updated to current observing runs.

members.model_name: Scalar Quartic bubble-filtered sudden freeze-out dark matter
members.description: Detector reach is assessed only by eye against projected LISA/BBO/DECIGO sensitivity curves; no quantitative signal-to-noise or projected-likelihood implementation exists to turn the abundance-compatible GW spectra into statistically meaningful detectability regions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard stochastic-background SNR integral against the public LISA/BBO/DECIGO noise curves (PTPlot-style), including astrophysical-foreground assumptions, and expose it as a projected likelihood over (alpha, beta/H_*, v_w, T_*).

members.model_name: PBH dark-matter subcomponent from running-index inflation in radiation domination
members.description: No merger-rate population likelihood exists for this scenario: the card's LIGO/Virgo comparison is a heuristic f_PBH^LIGO window rather than an inference against the observed binary-black-hole catalog with mass-dependent selection effects.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a population likelihood from the public LIGO/Virgo transient-catalog posterior samples and injection-based selection functions, taking the model's predicted mass function and merger-rate density as the population prior.

members.model_name: N MACHOs
members.description: No quantitative N-MACHO formation calculation exists: the conversion of hidden-sector particles into compact objects via cooling and collapse in high-density regions (ultra-compact minihalos or an early matter-dominated era) is only sketched, so neither the mass function nor the compact fraction f_compact can be predicted from (N, sector abundances).
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic/cooling collapse simulations (or a calibrated semi-analytic cooling-versus-free-fall model) of SM-copy hidden sectors in ultra-compact minihalo and early matter-dominated environments, outputting a mass function and formation efficiency parameterized by N and sector energy fractions.

members.model_name: Six-flavor quark matter nugget dark matter
members.description: The nugget mass function rests on an unmodeled phase-transition history: no calculation exists of bubble nucleation, pocket size R_i, and pocket trapping for a first-order six-flavor QCD transition under electroweak supercooling, nor of nugget evaporation/survival during cooling, leaving the benchmark M_nugget ~ 1e10 g and R_nugget ~ 1e2 cm uncertain by orders of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the supercooled electroweak transition for the benchmark scalar potential with CosmoTransitions (nucleation temperature, bubble spacing), then run hydrodynamic simulations of quark-pocket shrinkage and baryon-number trapping through the six-flavor QCD transition, coupled to an evaporation-rate derivation, to produce a predictive nugget mass function beta(M_nugget).

members.model_name: Early matter domination with nearly degenerate daughter WIMP dark matter
members.description: No calibrated N-body or semi-analytic model exists for the formation, internal structure, and late-time tidal survival of EMD microhalos seeded by this model's enhanced power spectrum with daughter velocity dispersion included.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of zoom N-body simulations of microhalo formation from EMD-enhanced power spectra (varying T_RH, f_b, and cutoff scale), calibrate a semi-analytic microhalo mass function, concentration, and tidal-survival model on them, and release it as a fitting-function module.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter
members.description: No validated N-body/hydrodynamic or radiative-transfer pipeline implements the environment-dependent AQN-baryon coupling (card caveat: no such pipeline supplied; simulation_calibrated: no), so the claimed morphology changes in dense environments and any small-scale-structure predictions remain qualitative speculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the AQN geometric drag/annihilation coupling as an effective dark-matter-baryon interaction module in a cosmological hydro code (e.g. an AREPO/GIZMO subgrid model scaling as n_baryon * v * pi R^2 * kappa) and run zoom-in simulations of galactic centers and dense clouds to produce falsifiable structure predictions.

members.model_name: Earth-shielded plasma dark matter
members.description: The density and geometry of the captured Earth-bound dark-matter component, which dominate the shielding uncertainty, are assumed rather than computed: no capture-and-accumulation simulation predicts n_He_prime(R_E) or its asphericity from the halo plasma parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Simulate capture, thermalization, and hydrostatic accumulation of dark ions in and around the Earth (dissipative dark-plasma fluid or N-body-with-cooling treatment) as a function of epsilon and halo composition, to predict the Earth-bound density profile and its day-night geometry instead of assuming 1e12-1e13 cm^-3 at the surface.

members.model_name: Optically thin mirror-star nugget emission model
members.description: The local mirror-star number density is unpredicted: no simulation of dissipative atomic/twin-baryon cooling, fragmentation, and mirror-star formation efficiency connects the underlying dark-sector parameters to a population, so per-object spectra cannot be converted into expected Gaia or X-ray detection rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic simulations of dissipative atomic-dark-matter collapse (extending existing atomic-DM cooling simulation work) to derive a mirror-star formation efficiency and mass function versus atomic-DM fraction, yielding a local number-density prior for the search likelihood.

members.model_name: Scalar-decay-produced cold dark matter after low-temperature reheating
members.description: The predicted microhalo mass function and present-day survival fraction are not simulation-calibrated: the Press-Schechter estimate at Earth-mass to 0.1 solar-mass scales and the claim that many early-forming microhalos survive tidal disruption in galactic halos are unverified.
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in N-body simulations seeded with the reheating-enhanced power spectrum for representative T_RH values to calibrate the microhalo mass function, concentrations, and tidal-survival fractions to z=0.

members.model_name: Dissipative dark cosmology with early matter dominance and delayed compact objects
members.description: The fragmentation of cooling primordial dark halos into dark compact objects versus sub-solar black holes, and the resulting mass function, rests on a rough analytic cooling estimate; no hydrodynamic simulation with dark-Bremsstrahlung/Compton cooling through the massive dark photon calibrates M_DarkCO, R_DarkCO, or the compact fraction f.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dark-sector hydrodynamic collapse simulations by extending an existing SPH/moving-mesh code (GIZMO or AREPO) with cooling functions for the (m_X, m_A_D, alpha_D) dark plasma, mapping initial halo mass and EMDE duration to a calibrated compact-object mass function.

members.model_name: Co-decaying dark matter with enhanced small-scale structure
members.description: Survival of EMDE-produced compact microhalos from formation to z=0 under tidal disruption is not established; the paper itself flags dedicated N-body survival simulations as a prerequisite for robust signal predictions, and no calibrated semi-analytic survival model exists for this enhanced-power scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in N-body simulations initialized with the co-decay EMDE-enhanced power spectrum (varying k_cut/k_RH), track tidal stripping in Milky-Way-like hosts, and calibrate a semi-analytic microhalo mass-concentration-survival model from the results.

members.model_name: Landau-Ginzburg self-interacting scalar dark matter
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation with a density-dependent sound speed is not simulation-calibrated (simulation_calibrated: no; halo and subhalo mass-function effects unknown), so core formation, mass functions, and departures from the idealized spherical hydrostatic solutions are unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological hydrodynamic-style simulations of the effective scalar fluid (SPH or moving-mesh with the c_s(rho) barotropic equation of state, or Gross-Pitaevskii solvers in the strong-interaction regime) to calibrate halo mass functions and core-halo relations.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter with cosmological dark magnetic fields
members.description: The conversion observable takes the cosmological dark magnetic field B_D as a free input: no derivation or simulation predicts the dark magnetogenesis mechanism, field strength, coherence length, or its evolution in the dark plasma, so P(g->gamma_D) cannot be turned into a prediction rather than a parameter scan.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dark-sector magnetohydrodynamics simulations (adapting existing primordial-magnetic-field MHD codes to the U(1)_D plasma with dark recombination) for candidate magnetogenesis mechanisms, delivering B_D spectra and dark plasma frequencies as functions of (alpha_D, xi, E_B) to feed the conversion formula.

members.model_name: Comprehensive asymmetric mirror dark matter
members.description: No calibrated calculation of the low-energy self-scattering cross section of dark neutrons and dark hydrogen/helium atoms in the mirror dark-QCD sector exists; the card relies on an approximate size-scaling estimate, so sigma/m and its velocity dependence are not quantitatively predicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Rescale lattice-QCD nucleon-nucleon scattering results (effective-range parameters) to the mirror confinement scale for the dark-neutron regime, and compute dark-atom elastic cross sections with existing atomic-dark-matter scattering codes rescaled to the dark electroweak scale, for both v'_EW regimes identified in the card.

members.model_name: Asteroid-mass PBH dark matter from running-index inflation in early matter domination
members.description: The matter-era collapse threshold and suppression factors (anisotropy and angular momentum) that set f_PBH are calibrated only by limited semi-analytic arguments, and the card flags high sensitivity to the high-k cutoff and collapse prescription.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity or high-resolution N-body simulations of nonspherical collapse in a pressureless (early-matter-dominated) background across the relevant sigma(M) range to calibrate the formation probability and cutoff dependence used in the semi-analytic model.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes from delayed vacuum decay in first-order phase transitions
members.description: The nearly monochromatic mass function rests on the horizon-mass collapse approximation with delta_c = 0.45; no numerical simulations of the collapse of late-decaying false-vacuum patches exist to calibrate the threshold, the mass-to-horizon ratio, or the width of the mass function.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity or 1+1D general-relativistic hydrodynamics simulations of a false-vacuum Hubble patch decaying late into the surrounding radiation fluid, extracting the effective collapse threshold and extended mass function versus nucleation delay.

members.model_name: Power-law tachyon quartessence condensate
members.description: No nonlinear simulation calibrates the condensate formation: the Newtonian spherical proxy cannot capture non-spherical collapse, pressure gradients, baryon coupling, or the final condensate mass function, and the card flags that a full simulation could shift the collapse threshold and fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological hydrodynamic/k-essence-fluid simulations (an Eulerian fluid solver with the tachyon equation of state and variable sound speed, including baryons) to calibrate the condensate fraction, collapse threshold, and resulting halo mass function against the semi-analytic estimates.

members.model_name: Exact-parity mirror-baryon dark matter thermodynamic model
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation with self-collisional, dissipative mirror baryons (cooling, mirror-atom formation, halo collapse) is not computed in the paper and no calibrated simulation suite for dissipative mirror-baryon dark matter is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological hydrodynamic simulations with a dissipative mirror-baryon fluid (mirror atomic cooling functions rescaled from the ordinary sector at temperature ratio x), scanning (x, beta), to calibrate halo profiles, mass functions, and mirror-disk formation for structure-formation observables.

members.model_name: Supercooled FOPT primordial black hole dark matter with magnetogenesis
members.description: The present-day IGMF prediction (about 20 pG at 0.001-0.01 Mpc) assumes maximally helical MHD decay; no MHD simulation campaign covers the decay of FOPT-generated fields with partial or zero helicity for this scenario, so the magnetogenesis observable cannot be robustly evaluated across the helicity parameter the route itself lists as an input.
members.proposed_resolution: Run magnetohydrodynamic decay simulations (e.g. with the public Pencil Code) initialized with the bubble-collision field spectra of this transition across a grid of fractional helicities, and fit B_0(lambda_0) evolution tracks to replace the maximally-helical scaling assumption.

members.model_name: Dipolar dark matter from gravitational polarization
members.description: Cluster-scale and lensing behavior of the dipolar medium is unvalidated: the analytic galactic MOND limit and first-order cosmology do not cover intermediate scales, and the paper defers clusters (including the role of the monopolar density) to an unperformed numerical study.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a numerical solver for the coupled dipolar-fluid plus baryon system in cluster configurations (a modified Poisson solver with the polarization susceptibility and monopolar component), and compare predicted lensing and hydrostatic masses against cluster datasets such as merging-cluster lensing maps.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition Friedberg-Lee-Sirlin Q-ball dark matter
members.description: The charge-trapping step — the distribution of old-phase remnant volumes during bubble percolation and the resulting per-remnant trapped X charge, which fixes the Q-ball charge and number density — exists only as a rough analytic estimate; no simulation or dedicated semi-analytic code of bubble nucleation, percolation, and remnant collapse with conserved X charge exists for this mechanism.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D scalar-field lattice (or hydrodynamic bubble-percolation) simulations of the strongly first-order transition with an advected conserved X charge to calibrate the remnant-volume and trapped-charge distributions, and package the result as a semi-analytic fit of Q and n_Q versus (T_c, eta_X, wall velocity).

members.model_name: Dressed primordial black holes in particle dark matter
members.description: Survival of the accreted r^-9/4 halos against tidal stripping and late-time galactic evolution is unmodeled, leaving the low-redshift lens profile (and hence all lensing predictions) systematically uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations of dressed PBHs orbiting in Milky Way-like potentials to quantify stripping of the accreted halo, and publish a survival-fraction correction to (M_h, R_h) as a function of environment and redshift for use in the lensing step.

members.model_name: Thermally produced dark pair plasma of vectorlike fermions
members.description: No two-component N-body/hydro cluster-merger simulation capability exists in which a 10-40 percent U(1)_D-charged dark-plasma fraction with collective collisionless-shock physics evolves alongside dominant collisionless dark matter, so dark-clump morphology and lensing/X-ray offsets for Abell 520/3827 and Bullet Cluster analogs cannot be predicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-plasma subcomponent as an effective magnetohydrodynamic-like fluid (with shock capturing calibrated to plasma microphysics) inside an existing cluster-merger code such as GADGET-4 or AREPO, and run a merger suite over epsilon, m_D, and alpha_D with Bullet Cluster and Abell 520 initial conditions.

members.model_name: Density-dependent baryon-DM cooling interaction model
members.description: No hydrodynamic or kinetic galaxy simulation includes elastic baryon-DM heat exchange with a density-dependent cross section sigma_int proportional to 1/(n v^2), so whether realistic disk galaxies actually relax to the MDAR equilibrium (rather than the assumed static solution) is untested; the route's agent_notes call full simulations the missing piece.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a density- and velocity-dependent baryon-DM momentum/energy exchange term (a drag-plus-thermalization operator with sigma_int(n,v) from the master relation) to an SPH or moving-mesh galaxy-formation code such as AREPO or GIZMO, and run isolated and cosmological zoom disk-galaxy simulations to test convergence to the MDAR over a Hubble time.

members.model_name: Thermalized boosted milli-charged dark matter subcomponent
members.description: The halo-thermalization, negligible-cooling, and no-dark-disk assumptions that set the boosted velocity distribution (validity_domain 'thermalization_region') are not calibrated by any simulation of a 5 percent dissipative millicharged subcomponent, leaving the predicted signal kinematics unverified across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Run dissipative dark-sector hydrodynamic/N-body simulations (in the style of double-disk dark matter or PIC dark-plasma studies) of a two-species charged subcomponent in a Milky Way halo to map where thermalization and the isothermal profile hold and correct f(v) where they fail.

members.model_name: Two-body interacting superfluid dark matter around black holes
members.description: The zero-temperature, static, spherical, DM-only profile omits baryons, stellar scattering, AGN disks, and accretion refinements, which the source explicitly defers; without them the profile cannot support observational exclusions near the black hole.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic or semi-analytic galactic-nucleus models adding a realistic baryon potential, stellar heating, and accretion to the P_2 superfluid equation of state, and quantify the resulting shift of the inner profile relative to the idealized Lane-Emden solution.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter from matter-antimatter separation at the QCD phase transition
members.description: Within the assumed first-order QCD scenario, no simulation of the matter-antimatter domain and QGP droplet dynamics exists — the QGP volume fraction F(t), domain size distribution, and dissipation timeline before BBN are only rough analytic estimates, yet they set both the production rate and the BBN survival condition.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic/lattice-inspired simulations of droplet shrinking and domain dissipation at T ~ 200 MeV for the assumed Omnes-type phase diagram, parameterized by domain size and local baryon asymmetry, delivering F(t) and size distributions as tabulated inputs to the production calculation.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter subcomponent forming dark stars
members.description: No hydrodynamic simulations of dissipative atomic-dark-matter cooling and fragmentation exist to calibrate the dark-star mass function; the 30-300 solar-mass window rests on Jeans-mass estimates with order-of-magnitude uncertainties, which dominates the uncertainty in the predicted mass-gap black-hole population.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic collapse simulations (e.g. a GIZMO/AREPO fork) with a dark atomic and molecular cooling module parameterized by (epsilon, m_X, m_e_dark, alpha_D, xi), following fragmentation to the opacity limit to calibrate the dark-star initial mass function against the analytic Jeans window.

members.model_name: Three-body interacting superfluid dark matter around black holes
members.description: The zero-temperature, static, spherical, DM-only profile omits baryons, stellar scattering, accretion, and finite-temperature corrections, which the source explicitly defers; without these the profile cannot support observational exclusions near the black hole.
members.proposed_resolution: Run hydrodynamic or semi-analytic galactic-nucleus models that add a realistic baryon potential, stellar heating, and accretion onto the black hole to the P_3 superfluid equation of state, and quantify the shift in r_deg and the inner profile relative to the idealized Lane-Emden solution.

members.model_name: Singlet-SUSY singlino self-interacting dark matter
members.description: No released pipeline implements this model's singlet-sector finite-temperature effective potential in CosmoTransitions or converts the resulting phase-transition parameters into a GW spectrum and LISA/TianQin/Taiji SNR; the paper's scan scripts are private, so the FOPT and GW forecasts cannot currently be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's one-loop plus daisy finite-temperature singlet potential as a CosmoTransitions model class, extract alpha, beta/H, and T_n at the dark-sector temperature ratio T_f/T_SM = 0.47, and apply standard sound-wave/bubble-collision spectral fits with published LISA, TianQin, and Taiji sensitivity curves to reproduce the SNR contours.

members.model_name: Stable particle dark matter from hot-big-bang black-hole evaporation
members.description: The high-reheat CMB target (high-frequency gravitational-wave background from the near-Planckian thermal plasma contributing to N_eff) has no step in the forward-model chain and no calculational pipeline or likelihood: the card marks the likelihood as unknown and recasting as needed, so the observable cannot currently be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the thermal-plasma graviton-emission calculation to obtain Omega_GW(T_RH) integrated over the expansion history, convert it to Delta N_eff, and compare against the Planck N_eff posterior and forecast CMB-S4-class sensitivities as a simple likelihood step appended to the route.

members.model_name: Axion rotation Poltergeist dark matter
members.description: No public scalar-induced gravitational-wave solver handles the Poltergeist source: a rapid matter-to-kination equation-of-state transition of the axion-rotation fluid with its time-dependent sound speed and slower GW redshifting relative to the kination background; the source's numerical induced-GW calculation is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public scalar-induced-GW spectrum code (e.g. SIGWfast-style kernel integrators) to accept a time-dependent equation of state and sound speed c_s(t) through the matter-to-kination transition, parameterized by the transition temperature and sharpness derived from (m_S, f_a, Y_theta, d), and validate against the source's Omega_GW spectra.

members.model_name: Dark proton-pion asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: The dark first-order phase transition's gravitational-wave signal is only identified as an opportunity: no computation of alpha_pt and beta/H from the dark two-Higgs-doublet potential exists for this variant, so the LISA/BBO/DECIGO prediction cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-sector two-Higgs-doublet finite-temperature potential in CosmoTransitions (or a comparable bounce solver), extract alpha_pt and beta/H, and convert to Omega_GW(f) using standard sound-wave and turbulence spectral fits.

members.model_name: Hot and heavy phase-transition-produced scalar dark matter
members.description: No gravitational-wave spectrum calculation exists for the specific fast-wall transitions that set this model's relic abundance: step s4 has no tool, and existing spectral fits are calibrated outside the strongly supercooled, ultra-relativistic-wall regime the production mechanism requires.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute Omega_GW(f) for the source benchmarks with the LISA-CWG spectral templates (bubble-collision plus sound-wave/turbulence fits parameterized by alpha_PT, beta/H, wall velocity) as implemented in PTPlot-style tooling, validating the collision-dominated supercooled branch against dedicated hybrid/lattice simulation results.

members.model_name: Dark neutron asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: The dark first-order electroweak-like phase transition is never solved quantitatively: no computation of the transition strength alpha_pt and inverse duration beta/H from the dark two-Higgs-doublet potential exists, so the advertised LISA/BBO/DECIGO gravitational-wave signal cannot be predicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the dark-sector two-Higgs-doublet finite-temperature potential in CosmoTransitions (or a comparable bounce solver), extract alpha_pt and beta/H over the viable parameter space, and map them to Omega_GW(f) with the standard sound-wave/turbulence spectral fits.

members.model_name: Inflaton-curvaton sound-speed-resonance primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No public code computes the scalar-induced gravitational-wave anisotropy angular power spectrum C_ell sourced by local-type non-Gaussianity for a peaked spectrum; existing public SIGW calculators cover only the isotropic Omega_GW(f).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public SIGW spectrum calculator (SIGWfast-type) with the f_NL-modulated anisotropy formalism of the cited SIGW-anisotropy literature, outputting C_ell as a function of (epsilon, k_0, f_NL) for the SSR spectrum.

members.model_name: Planckeon remnant dark matter from hot-big-bang black holes
members.description: The high-reheat CMB target for Planckeons (high-frequency gravitational-wave/N_eff signature of the near-Planckian plasma) has no forward-model step, no calculational pipeline, and an unknown likelihood, so the only observational handle beyond the abundance target cannot currently be evaluated; remnant stability itself is an open quantum-gravity question, not a capability gap.
members.proposed_resolution: Reuse the thermal-plasma graviton-emission pipeline needed for the companion HBBH evaporation model: compute Omega_GW(T_RH), convert to Delta N_eff, and compare against the Planck N_eff posterior and forecast next-generation CMB sensitivities as an appended likelihood step.

members.model_name: Gravitational-portal right-handed-neutrino dark matter during reheating
members.description: No calculator is provided for the primordial gravitational-wave spectrum enhanced during stiff (k>4) gravitational reheating, so the BBN dark-radiation exclusion of minimal reheating cannot be re-derived quantitatively or mapped across the (k, T_RH, xi_h) parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the standard transfer-function calculation of the inflationary tensor spectrum through a stiff-fluid reheating phase (redshifting with the paper's equation-of-state parameter k), integrate rho_GW at BBN, and compare against the standard Delta N_eff bound as a simple likelihood.

members.model_name: Massive majoron misalignment dark matter in a lepton-number breaking phase-transition model
members.description: No implemented calculation of the gravitational-wave spectrum from the first-order U(1)_L-breaking transition exists for this model: the card provides only a peak-frequency scaling, with no computation of the transition strength alpha, inverse duration beta/H, or the bubble-collision/sound-wave/turbulence amplitudes at T_L around 10^11 GeV needed to compare against detector sensitivities.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-scalar (S_1, S_2) lepton-number-breaking finite-temperature effective potential in CosmoTransitions to compute alpha, beta/H, and bubble-wall parameters, then feed these into the standard sound-wave/turbulence/collision spectral templates (PTPlot-style) to produce Omega_GW(f) across the parameter space of v_L and T_L.

members.model_name: Pre-early-matter-domination freeze-in dark matter
