members.proposed_resolution: Perform the one-loop matching (operators scaling as lambda_H^2 y_chi^4 per the card) following the cited similar-model computation, verify the normalization against that reference as the route's validation test requires, then feed the resulting effective coupling into standard direct-detection likelihood machinery and current Higgs invisible-width limits.

members.model_name: Mirror-sector dark neutron WIMP-baryogenesis model
members.description: The dark-neutron nuclear matrix elements and form factors for scattering through Higgs/dark-Higgs, B-L, or heavy scalar mediators are not derived; without them the direct-detection cross section for the composite dark neutron cannot be computed beyond order-of-magnitude estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive dark-neutron sigma terms and form factors by rescaling QCD lattice/chiral-perturbation results to the dark confinement scale and detuned dark-quark Yukawas, for each candidate mediator operator, and publish them as inputs to the scattering calculation.

members.model_name: Two-component SU(2)_R triplet fermion dark matter in broken D-parity left-right symmetry
members.description: The claimed direct-detection null signal rests on a kinematic argument only; the card notes a dedicated off-shell/loop-induced nuclear recoil cross-section calculation for the neutral triplet components was not provided.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the loop-level and off-shell W_R-mediated effective neutralino-nucleon operators for the SU(2)_R triplet (analogous to published wino-nucleon loop calculations) and compare the resulting sigma_SI to the xenon neutrino floor to make the null-signal claim quantitative.

members.model_name: STFM triplet WIMP with singlet-assisted nonthermal freeze-in
members.description: The loop-level spin-independent triplet-nucleon cross section sigma_SI is not derived or implemented for this model (the STFM triplet has no tree-level elastic scattering), so direct-detection limits cannot be quantitatively applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the known Hisano-type electroweak two-loop/one-loop calculation of wino-like triplet-nucleon scattering to the STFM (including scalar-triplet mixing contributions), and feed the resulting sigma_SI into DDCalc-style detector-response recasting.

members.model_name: SU(2) triplet fermion dark matter with type III seesaw Higgs inflation
members.description: The loop-level electroweak elastic scattering cross section of the zero-hypercharge triplet on nuclei is not computed on the card, so the suppressed direct-detection prediction cannot be evaluated quantitatively against experiments.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt the Hisano-type loop-level electroweak multiplet-nucleon scattering results for the wino-like triplet, evaluate at M_DM = 2.4 TeV, and compare against current xenon-experiment limits.

members.model_name: Fermionic dark matter with pseudoscalar mediator for electroweak baryogenesis
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent direct-detection cross section for the pure pseudoscalar coupling is not calculated, leaving the claimed null direct-detection signal unverified against loop and CP-mixing effects flagged in the card's caveats.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the one-loop induced scalar nucleon coupling for the gamma5 mediator interaction using effective-operator running tools (DirectDM plus DDCalc style pipeline) and compare against current xenon limits over the scan ranges.

members.model_name: Charged-current fermionic absorption dark matter
members.description: No public tables or code exist for the nuclear matrix elements of charged-current dark-matter absorption (chi + n -> p + e-) across relevant detector isotopes (xenon, argon, neutrino-detector targets), including isotope thresholds and transition strengths.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute charged-current absorption matrix elements with established nuclear shell-model or QRPA machinery (the same frameworks used for beta-decay and neutrinoless-double-beta matrix elements) for the leading target isotopes, and release them as tables keyed to m_chi and operator Lorentz structure.

members.model_name: Dark-photon-mediated inelastic scalar dark matter
members.description: The xenon electron-recoil rate for exothermic inelastic scattering with a 2-3 keV splitting requires atomic ionization form factors evaluated at the down-scattering kinematics; existing public atomic-response tables assume elastic halo-DM kinematics and do not cover this regime directly.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a public xenon atomic ionization code (QEdark or DarkART) to inelastic kinematics by shifting the energy-conservation delta function by the splitting delta and re-tabulating ionization factors K(E_R, q) over the relevant momentum-transfer range, then validate against the primary paper's 2-3 keV recoil peak.

members.model_name: Lowest-energy higgson WIMP
members.description: The spin-independent Xe cross section (quoted at 1e-48 to 1e-47 cm^2) is only an inert-doublet analogy; the loop-level calculation of gauge-mediated higgson-nucleon scattering, where electroweak two-loop contributions are known to dominate for gauge-only WIMPs, has not been performed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Carry out a Hisano-style electroweak loop calculation of the SI higgson-nucleon cross section for a scalar with second-order W/Z couplings and package the result as a function of m_h for comparison with LZ/XENONnT/DARWIN projections.

members.model_name: Radiative seesaw minimal dark matter Majorana quintuplet model
members.description: The loop-induced N_R^0-nucleus spin-independent cross section is only quoted as a future-detection target; no implemented calculation (electroweak two-loop Wilson coefficients plus nuclear form factors) exists for this quintuplet on the card, so the recoil rate cannot be confronted with concrete detector sensitivities.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the Hisano et al. electroweak-multiplet effective-theory results for the n=5 Majorana multiplet to obtain sigma_N with QCD corrections, and feed the result into a standard recoil-rate calculator (e.g. DDCalc) for comparison with XENONnT/LZ/DARWIN projections.

members.model_name: SU(2) fiveplet fermion dark matter with type I seesaw Higgs inflation
members.description: The loop-level electroweak elastic scattering cross section of the zero-hypercharge fiveplet on nuclei is not computed on the card, so the suppressed direct-detection prediction cannot be evaluated quantitatively against experiments.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt the Hisano-type two-loop electroweak multiplet-nucleon scattering formalism, evaluate it for the fiveplet at M_DM = 4.4 TeV, and compare against current xenon-experiment limits.

members.model_name: Scalar hexaquark S dark matter
members.description: No calculation of the S-hexaquark-nucleon elastic scattering cross section sigma_S-nucleon exists: the compact uuddss composite couples through flavor-singlet scalar exchange (sigma/f0(980)/glueball), and neither the couplings nor the composite form factor have been derived, so XENON/SuperCDMS limits cannot be mapped onto the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the S-nucleon amplitude with QCD sum rules or lattice QCD for the scalar-singlet couplings g_{S S sigma/f0/G}, fold in the hexaquark compactness form factor, and publish sigma_S-nucleon(m_S, r_S) so standard light-DM detector recasts can be applied.

members.model_name: Complex vector condensate dark matter with magnetic dipole coupling
members.description: Published vector electromagnetic-multipole direct-detection limits assume incoherent particle dark matter scattering; no derivation exists of the recoil signal (or its absence) for a coherent homogeneous condensate, so the direct-detection observable cannot be evaluated for the condensate benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the detector response to a coherent oscillating vector condensate with a magnetic-dipole photon coupling (including the local coherence length and occupation numbers), determine in which (M, lambda) regime the particle-gas recoil limits apply, and recast the published XENON1T/CRESST-III multipole limits into the paper's coupling convention there.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model II leptophilic Majorana WIMP without tree-level Higgs coupling
members.description: The loop-induced spin-independent DM-nucleon cross section of the leptophilic model (no tree-level Higgs coupling; photon/Higgs loops through scalar lepton partners) is not derived into a usable recast, so the direct-detection suppression claim cannot be quantitatively compared to detector limits (card caveat: 'Loop-level rates require a dedicated recast').
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one- and two-loop photon- and Higgs-mediated effective nucleon operators for the muon-partner loops (following standard leptophilic-WIMP loop analyses), run them through DirectDM for RG evolution to nuclear scales, and evaluate limits with DDCalc against LZ/XENONnT data.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated O'Raifeartaigh R-ball dark matter
members.description: The messenger-loop elastic scattering cross section sigma_RN of visible matter off an R-ball has never been computed (the source paper explicitly leaves it for future work), so the direct-detection observable cannot be evaluated even at order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the one-loop messenger-induced effective coupling between Standard Model nucleons and the X-condensate interior, then build the coherent macroscopic R-ball-nucleus cross section as a function of charge R and radius, and compare against macroscopic-dark-matter direct-detection and cosmic-ray detector limits.

members.model_name: Fraternal twin Higgs cogenesis
members.description: The Higgs-portal coupling and nuclear-recoil form factors of the composite triple-bottom twin baryon (twin-QCD sigma terms and matrix elements) are not derived, so the direct-detection cross section for the 5.5 GeV twin baryon cannot be computed beyond order of magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the twin-baryon Higgs coupling by rescaling SM-nucleon sigma terms to the twin-QCD scale set by f/v (or by a dedicated heavy-quark twin-baryon estimate), then feed sigma_SI into standard low-mass direct-detection rate formulas and existing likelihood machinery such as DDCalc.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet scalar dark matter in the Dirac scotogenic model
members.description: The one-loop electroweak gauge-mediated spin-independent scattering cross section for doublet-dominated eta1 (including singlet mixing through the trilinear A term) has not been computed; the primary only expects it to be 'challenging', yet it is the decisive viability test against the quoted xenon bound of 6.5e-48 cm^2.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt the established Hisano-et-al electroweak one-loop direct-detection formalism (as applied to the inert doublet model) to eta1 with arbitrary doublet-singlet mixing, implement it on top of the gap_1 model files, and confront the result with the LZ likelihood via DDCalc.

members.model_name: Bottom-loop composite pNGB dark matter
members.description: The bottom-loop-induced non-derivative portal coupling lambda is only estimated at isolated benchmarks (about 3e-4 for M_b = 8 TeV); no systematic matching calculation gives lambda as a function of (M_b, f, breaking pattern) across the parameter space, which controls the direct-detection prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform the one-loop matching of the bottom-partner sector onto the phi^2|H|^2 operator within the SO(7)/SO(6) construction, and publish lambda(M_b, f) tables or a fitting function usable in the model implementation of gap_1.

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric dark matter with a dark photon portal
members.description: The dark-nucleon decay width via the B-L portal operator is only an effective-operator scaling estimate: the hadronic matrix element between the dark nucleon and dark-pion-plus-neutrino final state has not been derived for any concrete dark-hadron spectrum, so the quoted M_* > 1e8.5 GeV limit cannot be sharpened or generalized.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the portal-operator matrix elements with naive dimensional analysis anchored to lattice QCD proton-decay matrix elements rescaled to the dark confinement scale, for the specific dark gauge group and quark content, producing a decay-width formula with quantified uncertainty.

members.model_name: Millicharged Dirac dark matter with hidden-scalar depletion
members.description: The hidden-scalar depletion sector is not fully specified: the paper finds simple loop decay of phi insufficient before BBN, and no calculation exists of the phi lifetime/decay channels checked against BBN and CMB energy-injection limits for the parameter space that yields f_DM ~ 0.3-2 percent.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive explicit phi depletion/decay channels (e.g. 3-to-2 cannibalization or portal decays), compute the lifetime and injected energy, and check them with an energy-injection code such as DarkHistory or ExoCLASS across the (m_scalar, scalar_lifetime) plane.

members.model_name: U(1)_D pseudo-Dirac dark matter with dark-Higgs bound states
members.description: The CMB energy-injection constraint from S-wave bound-state formation is only a recast target: sigma_BSF v and the injected-energy deposition efficiency have not been derived for this model's dark-Higgs-mediated pseudo-Dirac spectrum and mediator decay chains, so the CMB bound cannot be applied as an exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive sigma_BSF v for the chi_1 chi_2 system with the h_D-mediated Yukawa potential following the published p-wave BSF calculation, compute f_eff for the resulting h_D/V decay products with DarkHistory or the ExoCLASS deposition functions, and evaluate against the Planck energy-injection likelihood.

members.model_name: Global-U(1) pseudo-Dirac dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: The predicted Delta N_eff from the Goldstone bath is only reported as a figure-level trend: the visible-dark decoupling history fixing xi(T_dec) has not been extracted or recomputed, so the BBN/CMB radiation-density test cannot be applied numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute Delta N_eff(T_dec) via standard entropy-conservation bookkeeping for the dark sector (chi, rho, eta degrees of freedom) and compare against the Planck N_eff posterior, replacing the undigitized figure values with a closed-form table.

members.model_name: Comprehensive asymmetric mirror dark matter
members.description: The kinetic-decoupling temperature between the visible and mirror sectors (through the Higgs/neutron-portal interactions) is only partially solved in the source, so T_D/T_V and hence Delta N_eff cannot be computed from model parameters without an ad hoc decoupling assumption.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the sector energy-exchange rate for the Higgs-portal and effective neutron-portal operators, solve the coupled temperature evolution equations to find the decoupling temperature as a function of portal couplings, and feed the result into the existing entropy-conservation calculation of T_D/T_V.

members.model_name: Large-extra-dimension Kaluza-Klein axion dark matter with trapped solar modes
members.description: The LUX axioelectric context limit constrains g_Ae while the hadronic KK benchmark is photon-coupled; the loop-level mapping from the model's g_agamma and KK spectrum to an effective g_Ae has not been derived, so the direct-detection constraint cannot be applied without recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the loop-induced electron coupling for the hadronic KK modes and recast the LUX (and successor xenon) axioelectric limits onto (g_agamma, m_a_n), documenting where the limit is simply inapplicable.

members.model_name: Lepton-number-two ultralight scalar dark matter for neutrinoless double beta capture
members.description: The capture calculation in the Bose-Einstein condensate regime is not derived: for the number densities needed for testable rates the free-particle perturbative capture picture breaks down (validity domain flags high extrapolation risk), and the condensate-induced in-medium Majorana mass treatment has not been developed into a controlled rate calculation.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the 0nubb rate in the condensate phase by treating the scalar as a classical mean field sourcing an effective in-medium Majorana mass term, matching it onto the standard 0nubb master formula with an effective m_bb(n_phi, g), and establish the crossover criterion between free-capture and condensate regimes.

members.model_name: Mirror-baryon asymmetric dark matter from Dirac leptogenesis
members.description: The mirror-sector thermal history is not derived: Tprime/T evolution and the surviving light mirror degrees of freedom under the invoked Yukawa and QCD-scale Z2 breaking are unspecified, so Delta N_eff cannot be computed numerically even though the qualitative constraint direction is clear.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mirror-sector entropy and decoupling history for specified Z2-breaking benchmarks (or an asymmetric-reheating parameterization of Tprime/T), compute Delta N_eff(Tprime/T, mirror light content), and feed it into the standard Planck/BBN N_eff likelihood.

members.model_name: EFT single-field sharp-transition PBH dark matter
members.description: The card interprets 10^2-10^3 g PBHs as a present-day dark-matter subcomponent, but no evaporation/late-time survival treatment is provided: PBHs at these masses Hawking-evaporate long before today, so the formation-time f in 0.001-0.5 has no derived mapping to present-day abundance or to BBN/CMB evaporation constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Add an evaporation stage to the route using BlackHawk (or equivalent) to evolve the 10^2-10^3 g mass function, derive the surviving abundance and evaporation products, and confront the formation fraction beta(M_PBH) with the standard BBN/CMB/entropy-injection bounds on evaporating PBHs.

members.model_name: Heavy-moduli nonthermal LSP dark matter scenario
members.description: No reusable parameterization exists for the Affleck-Dine Q-ball charge, formation efficiency, and decay yield of LSPs as a function of (M, v, chi_0, phi_0); the paper only reports narrow viable regions from its own scan, so the overproduction/dilution check cannot be re-evaluated for new parameter points.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive (or fit from existing Affleck-Dine lattice results) an analytic Q-ball charge and decay-temperature parameterization on the (M, v, chi_0, phi_0) space and publish it as a lookup table or module feeding the nonthermal yield calculator of gap_1.

members.model_name: Dipolar dark matter from gravitational polarization
members.description: The second-order cosmological perturbation theory of the dipolar medium has never been derived: the dipole moment cannot be absorbed into an effective velocity field at second order, but the resulting stress terms and the predicted CMB non-Gaussian signatures are uncomputed, leaving the model's only distinctive cosmological observable unpredicted.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the second-order dipolar stress-energy perturbations in FLRW (extending the paper's first-order reduction), express the deviation from CDM as a bispectrum/fNL-type template, checking recovery of Lambda-CDM at first order.

members.model_name: Secluded dark matter coupled to a hidden CFT
members.description: The photon/electron injection spectra and energy-deposition efficiency f for annihilation and late hidden-vector decays cascading through the hidden CFT/KK tower are not derived, so CMB energy-injection and BBN bounds can only be copied from ordinary secluded-WIMP results rather than recast for this model's distributed hidden-sector branchings.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the cascade decay chains through the KK vector tower to SM final states, compute the resulting e+/photon spectra, and feed them into DarkHistory/ExoCLASS for a Planck-era energy-injection likelihood and into standard BBN injection codes for the late-decay bound.

members.model_name: Adagio dark-photon thermal relic dark matter
members.description: The required return of the effective Planck mass to its late-time value before BBN is only stated qualitatively; no quantitative radion/extra-dimensional stabilization computation of M_P(T) and T_* exists, so obs_bbn_transition cannot be confronted with light-element data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the radion/extra-dimension evolution giving M_P(T) through the transition, then evaluate light-element abundances with a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) run with the modified expansion history to bound T_* and the transition energy budget.

members.model_name: Annihilation-product direct-detection dark matter
members.description: The model-specific CMB energy-deposition efficiency f_eff for hidden-sector Y final states has not been computed, so the generic f_eff = 0.2-1 benchmarks cannot be mapped onto this model's annihilation channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute f_eff(m_X) with DarkHistory/ExoCLASS for the specified Y decay or scattering channels, then apply the standard Planck annihilation p_ann likelihood to <sigma v>.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector self-interacting dark matter with light vector mediator
members.description: The CMB energy-deposition efficiency f_eff for annihilation to light vector mediators decaying to e+ e- has not been computed for this benchmark, so the Planck energy-injection constraint can only be applied via generic light-force estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute f_eff(m_chi) with DarkHistory/ExoCLASS for the cascade chi chi -> phi phi -> 4e including the exact mediator branching fractions, then apply the Planck p_ann likelihood.

members.model_name: interacting hidden-sector nucleon compact-star dark matter
members.description: The BBN mass window (1 MeV < m_pi_h < 0.4 m_f) rests on an assumed hidden-sector temperature equal to the SM bath; no Delta N_eff calculation as a function of the hidden-to-visible temperature ratio has been performed, so the cosmological bound is not quantitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Track hidden-sector entropy through its confinement transition to compute xi = T_h/T_SM and the hidden-pion contribution to Delta N_eff at BBN and CMB epochs, then compare against Planck/BBN Delta N_eff likelihoods to replace the qualitative m_pi_h > 1 MeV requirement.

members.model_name: Interacting quintessence cold dark matter
members.description: Existing Planck+RSD interacting-dark-energy constraints are expressed for fluid models with assumed momentum-transfer and sound-speed choices; the mapping from those fluid parameters onto the scalar-model parameters (alpha, beta, Omega_Q0) has not been derived, so published limits cannot be recast onto this model even approximately.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective fluid description (equation of state, sound speed, energy/momentum transfer rates) of the two-scalar system in the tracking and attractor regimes and match it to the fluid interacting-DE parameterization used in the Planck/RSD analysis, giving a translation table for the coupling constraints.

members.model_name: Bolon coupled dark matter from dilatation anomaly
members.description: The linear perturbation equations for the coupled cosmon-bolon system in the oscillation-averaged regime (effective fluid with time-dependent bolon mass and late cosmon coupling) are not available in the card's source material, so neither the transfer-function cutoff nor the effective DM-DE coupling can be computed from first principles.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the WKB/time-averaged effective-fluid perturbation equations for the bolon around its partial minimum, including the cosmon coupling lambda and the time-dependent mass m_chi(t), and express the result as an effective sound speed plus an interacting-DE energy-momentum transfer Q usable by standard solvers.

members.model_name: Scale-invariant hidden-sector pion cold dark matter
members.description: The effective hidden-pion Lagrangian coefficients (pion-singlet-Higgs couplings, sigma_h and H2 masses and widths) are only sketched via QCD-scaled chiral relations; no quantitative matching of the strongly coupled hidden sector onto an effective annihilation and scattering Lagrangian exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the hidden chiral Lagrangian with the singlet messenger spurion explicitly, matching pion masses and couplings to Lambda_h, lambda_k, and lambda_SH at NLO; where sigma_h resonance effects matter, import lattice results for QCD-like SU(N) theories rescaled to the hidden confinement scale.

members.model_name: Mirror dark plasma steady-state halo model
members.description: The microphysics of how ordinary supernova energy is transferred into the dark plasma (the heating kernel entering H(r)) is flagged in the card as uncertain, leaving the normalization of the heating rate assumption-driven rather than derived from the kinetic-mixing parameter.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the epsilon-dependent dark-photon emission from supernova cores and the subsequent absorption/thermalization efficiency in the mirror plasma, producing a heating kernel H(r; epsilon, SN rate) with quantified uncertainty to replace the local-heating-dominance assumption.

members.model_name: Misaligned axion Chern-Simons condensate model
members.description: The renormalized Chern-Simons condensate is computed only in Minkowski spacetime at leading order in g; no derivation exists of the induced E dot B condensate and photon polarization rotation angle beta(z) in an expanding FRW background with the thermal photon bath redshifting, which is the quantity every CMB observable needs.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the paper's linear-response susceptibility calculation to an FRW background below the EFT cutoff, deriving beta(z) from the oscillating a(t) condensate including the vacuum-subtraction renormalization, and validate against the paper's high-temperature Minkowski limit.

members.model_name: Superheavy lepton dark matter decaying through virtual black holes
members.description: The final-state composition and injection spectrum of the virtual-black-hole-mediated L -> 3f decay at M_L ~ 1e12 GeV is not derived; without a specified branching into leptons/neutrinos the electroweak-cascade spectra at Earth cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Fix benchmark final-state assignments (e.g. flavor-democratic 3-lepton states) from the virtual-black-hole quantum-number arguments, then compute the fragmentation and electroweak-shower spectra with HDMSpectra, which is designed for decaying DM up to near-Planck masses.

members.model_name: Anomalous U(1) L_e+L_mu+L_tau axi-Higgs portal fermionic dark matter
members.description: The claimed direct-detection relaxation rests on absent tree-level quark/gluon couplings, but loop-induced or UV-completion-induced DM-quark operators (e.g. through Z prime kinetic mixing or anomalous triangle diagrams) have not been derived, so the null-signal prediction is unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the leading loop-level DM-nucleon effective operators from the Wess-Zumino and Z prime sectors, run them to nuclear scales with DirectDM, and compare the resulting cross section to current LZ/XENONnT limits to bound the size of the relaxation claim.

members.model_name: Z3 semi-annihilating dark matter for global 21-cm cosmology
members.description: The energy deposited in the gas is modeled by a single constant fraction f with no spectrum- and redshift-dependent deposition-efficiency calculation for the DM + DM -> DM + SM final states; the card notes a spectrum-dependent calculation could replace this parameterization and no deposition table is included.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute injected SM spectra for representative semi-annihilation final states and process them through DarkHistory (or the Slatyer f_c(z) deposition tables) to replace the constant f with channel-resolved deposition efficiencies into heating, ionization, and excitation.

members.model_name: Pati-Salam Goldstino split-SUSY Wino dark matter
members.description: The gluino lifetime in the heavy-scalar Pati-Salam spectrum was never computed, and no implemented BBN/CMB constraint check exists for the long-lived gluino cosmology bound (con_pati_salam_gluino_cosmology, likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive tau_gluino(M3, m_SUSY) from the standard split-SUSY dimension-six decay operators and feed the resulting hadronic energy injection into an existing BBN energy-injection code to map the excluded (M3, m_SUSY) region.

members.model_name: Mirrored neutron dark matter in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: The mirror-hadronic matrix elements of the dimension-six Planck-suppressed B/B'-violating operators that set the n' decay lifetime are neglected in the primary estimate, leaving tau_n' uncertain at the order-of-magnitude level.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the matrix elements by rescaling lattice-QCD nucleon-decay matrix elements to the mirror confinement scale (NDA scaling in f_pi' and m_N'), propagating the result into the tau_n' ~ 1e28 s benchmark formula.

members.model_name: Millicharged dark matter subcomponent with L_mu-L_tau vector depletion
members.description: No reusable statistical likelihood exists for the global 21-cm absorption depth (EDGES-based) applicable to millicharged baryon-cooling models; the card records no combined likelihood for the route.

members.model_name: Hidden dark matter cosmology (HiDM)
members.description: No forward model or likelihood connects HiDM small-halo suppression to the global 21 cm absorption signal; the primary paper flags large astrophysical uncertainties and does not build this likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple HiDM matter power spectra to a seminumeric cosmic-dawn code (21cmFAST-style) with marginalized star-formation parameters to produce global-signal predictions, and compare against EDGES/SARAS-class measurements.

members.model_name: Axion quark nugget dark matter
members.description: No likelihood or defined data vector exists for the proposed AQN broadband energy-injection signals (diffuse UV, EBL, radio, EDGES-like 21-cm absorption); the card explicitly states these connections are proposed interpretations with no likelihood supplied, so the diffuse-radiation observable cannot be statistically evaluated at all.
members.proposed_resolution: Define per-band data vectors (GALEX diffuse-UV maps, EBL measurements, ARCADE-2/LWA radio monopole, EDGES/SARAS 21-cm) with a forward model combining the AQN flux, an ISM/CGM gas-density model, and the electrosphere emissivity, and build a joint likelihood with the astrophysical foregrounds marginalized.

members.model_name: Poisson primordial-black-hole dark matter with small-scale velocity floor
members.description: No 21 cm or low-redshift accretion likelihood exists that includes the PBH internal velocity floor: the paper argues existing z ~ 20 accretion bounds (21 cm, dwarf-galaxy environments) are too strong when internal velocities are neglected, but no likelihood was rerun and no packaged recast exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a 21 cm global-signal/power-spectrum likelihood for accreting PBHs (interfacing the velocity-averaged injection history with a dark-ages thermal-history code such as 21cmFAST or a global-signal solver, constrained by EDGES/SARAS limits and forecast HERA sensitivity) and re-derive the low-redshift f_PBH bounds with sigma_PBH included.

members.model_name: Oscillon-forming axion-like fuzzy dark matter
members.description: The SKA-era 21 cm anisotropy signature from oscillon Poisson fluctuations has no forecast machinery: no power-spectrum module for the oscillon shot-noise contribution and no associated instrument likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the oscillon Poisson-power term (set by r_osc and the oscillon mass scale k_osc) in a 21 cm power-spectrum code (21cmFAST-class) and build a Fisher/likelihood forecast for SKA-like noise curves.

members.model_name: Bino-wino co-annihilation dark matter in high-scale SUSY
members.description: No likelihood exists for the mixed cold+warm small-scale power suppression at k_fs ~ 10^3-10^4 Mpc^-1; the card explicitly notes no 21 cm likelihood is supplied for the proposed z ~ 30-200 tomography probe.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a high-redshift 21 cm power-spectrum likelihood (or Fisher forecast module) for suppression at k ~ 10^3-10^4 Mpc^-1, parameterized by warm fraction r_warm and free-streaming scale k_fs, usable for this and other mixed cold+warm models.

members.model_name: Milli-eV scalar dark matter decaying to dark photons
members.description: No global 21 cm likelihood exists that accepts an excess Rayleigh-Jeans radio background of the model's redshift- and frequency-dependent shape: the EDGES-motivated absorption-depth comparison cannot be evaluated beyond order-of-magnitude statements without jointly modeling astrophysical spin-temperature evolution and the injected photon occupation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public global-signal code (ARES or 21cmFAST global-signal mode, which already support excess-radio-background terms) to take the model's converted-photon occupation dn/domega(z) as input, and wrap it with an EDGES-like data likelihood marginalizing over astrophysical spin-temperature parameters.

members.model_name: Spinning primordial black hole dark matter from early matter domination
members.description: Energy-injection constraints (global 21-cm, gas heating, CMB, gamma-ray, 511-keV) on the spinning low-mass PBH tail exist only as monochromatic-mass exclusion curves in related papers; no public pipeline integrates the model's extended matter-era mass function with spin-dependent Hawking spectra against these data.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple BlackHawk Kerr evaporation spectra to an energy-deposition code (DarkHistory or ExoCLASS) and a global 21-cm/IGM-heating likelihood, with the extended psi(m, a_star) mass function marginalized rather than assumed monochromatic.

members.model_name: Five-dimensional Dirac dark photon fermion dark matter
members.description: No implemented late-time energy-injection likelihood (Planck CMB p_ann and 21 cm) evaluates the velocity- and redshift-dependent sigma_v(v,z) produced by the KK-tower interference, which is exactly the quantity the model tunes to evade s-wave bounds; the card marks likelihood_available no with recasting_needed yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_v(v,z) from the KK-tower amplitude, thermally average over the cosmological velocity distribution, and feed the resulting redshift-dependent injection into ExoCLASS/DarkHistory to confront the Planck p_ann bound and published 21 cm limits per benchmark.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal scalar millicharged dark matter
members.description: No likelihood exists for the cosmic-dawn absorption target: the EDGES-motivated fraction/coupling window is recorded only as a qualitative parameter region (likelihood_available: no, recasting_needed: yes), with no statistical treatment of the EDGES amplitude, its contested systematics, or competing non-detections.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a global 21-cm likelihood that marginalizes over foreground/systematic models for the EDGES low-band data (and can incorporate subsequent global-signal measurements), returning a posterior on the excess-cooling amplitude that the baryon-cooling forward model can be scored against instead of the fixed f_DM 0.003-0.02 window.

members.model_name: Five-dimensional Majorana dark photon fermion dark matter
members.description: No implemented late-time energy-injection likelihood (Planck CMB p_ann and 21 cm) evaluates this model's velocity-suppressed late-time annihilation from the axial/p-wave structure and KK interference; the card marks likelihood_available no with recasting_needed yes, so the claimed evasion of s-wave bounds is unverified numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_v(v,z) from the axial KK-tower amplitudes, thermally average over cosmological velocities, and feed the redshift-dependent injection into ExoCLASS/DarkHistory to test benchmarks against the Planck p_ann bound and published 21 cm limits.

members.model_name: Two-step Majoron-scalar gravitational production of fermionic dark matter
members.description: No 21-cm likelihood or emulator exists to test the predicted small-scale suppression of the sub-MeV two-step scenario; the paper proposes cosmic 21-cm observability but the card supplies no data likelihood (con_twostep_warmness has likelihood_available no).
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the CLASS transfer-function output to an existing 21-cm framework (e.g. 21cmFAST-based emulators of the cosmic-dawn signal with suppressed small-scale power) and build a forecast/likelihood module parameterized by the half-mode scale, validated against published WDM 21-cm sensitivity studies.

members.model_name: Condensed-phase axion/ALP dark-matter cooling scenario
members.description: No public EDGES global-signal likelihood with foreground and systematic marginalization is identified in the card (likelihood_available is unknown/none), so the cooling scenario can only be compared to the absorption trough qualitatively.

members.model_name: Late-decay two-component millicharged dark matter model
members.description: No 21 cm global-signal likelihood is attached: the EDGES absorption-depth target is used only as a benchmark, with no foreground-marginalized likelihood and no incorporation of the SARAS 3 non-detection.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a global 21 cm likelihood combining the EDGES flattened-Gaussian absorption measurement with SARAS 3 constraints, marginalizing over astrophysical spin-temperature coupling parameters using an ARES or 21cmFAST-based global-signal emulator.

members.model_name: Dark atoms with massive dark photon and millicharged subcomponent
members.description: No public combined likelihood exists for a percent-level millicharged subcomponent with a massive dark photon: CMB DM-baryon scattering limits and cosmic-dawn 21-cm cooling predictions both require a dedicated fractional-subcomponent recast that the card notes is unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend the fractional interacting-DM branch of CLASS (dmeff-type Coulomb v^-4 scattering) to take f_e from the dark-recombination solver, run it against the Planck likelihood in MontePython/Cobaya, and couple the same scattering term to a global 21-cm code (e.g. a Zeus21/21cmFAST baryon-cooling module) for the cosmic-dawn signal.

members.model_name: Heavy dark baryons in a hidden MSSM-like sector
members.description: No likelihood analysis exists for the model's specific signature of jointly uncorrelated baryon plus dark-matter isocurvature; the constraint is applied only via the quoted Planck matter-isocurvature bound, which was derived for standard single-mode CDI templates.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a Planck (and forecast CMB-S4/21-cm) likelihood analysis with CLASS/CAMB in Cobaya or MontePython, sampling the two uncorrelated baryon and CDM isocurvature amplitudes and tilts predicted by the AD phase spectra, to replace the quoted benchmark bound with a proper posterior on (H_I, m_phase/H_I, M).

members.model_name: ELDER self-interacting dark matter with 21-cm heating and cooling
members.description: No global 21-cm likelihood exists for the T_21 target: the constraint is the raw EDGES interval T_21 = -500 +200/-500 mK at z=17.2 with no marginalization over foregrounds or astrophysical spin-temperature modeling, and competing measurements (SARAS 3) are not incorporated.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a global-signal likelihood that jointly treats EDGES and SARAS 3 data with foreground and Ly-alpha coupling nuisance parameters, exposing T_21(z) as the model input so ELDER coupling posteriors replace the fixed-interval target.

members.model_name: ELDER self-interacting dark matter with 21-cm heating and cooling
members.description: No CMB consistency recast is implemented for the ELDER parameter region: Planck limits on sigma = sigma0 v^-4 DM-baryon scattering with a sub-unity interacting fraction have not been mapped onto the mass and coupling range targeted by the 21-cm fit.

members.model_name: Z3 semi-annihilating dark matter for global 21-cm cosmology
members.description: No global 21-cm likelihood is available for the SADM scenario: the EDGES trough is used as a visual target, no joint EDGES/SARAS 3 likelihood is encoded, and no Dark Ages instrument forecast for LuSEE Night/DAPPER/PRATUSH exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode a joint EDGES/SARAS 3 global-21-cm likelihood with astrophysical and radio-background nuisance parameters, and build Fisher/mock forecasts for Dark Ages instruments over z~50-100 to quantify the f-dependent second-trough discriminating power.

members.model_name: Subcomponent millicharged Dirac dark matter with neutrino annihilation
members.description: No joint likelihood exists over (m_chi, epsilon, f_chi, sigma_v_nu) combining Planck bounds on the baryon-scattering DM fraction, N_eff/BBN constraints, and 21 cm global-signal data (EDGES amplitude, SARAS3 non-detection), so the viable 21 cm motivated corner cannot be statistically delimited.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble a joint likelihood: Planck DM-baryon scattering fraction limits, a Planck N_eff/BBN term (PRIMAT-based), and a global-signal term built from published EDGES/SARAS3 analyses, wired to the forward-model outputs of the freeze-out and cooling modules.

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in quark-portal dark matter
members.description: No curated likelihood or structured bound compilation exists for cluster-scale self-interaction (sigma_self/m_DM) to test the PGB self-scattering estimate; the card records only externally cited merger bounds requiring compilation.

members.model_name: Real scalar split SIMP dark matter

members.model_name: Conformal freeze-in Higgs-portal dark matter

members.description: The N_eff/BBN/CMB bound on the neutrinophilic mediator window is only qualitative in the card: no dedicated cosmological likelihood maps (m_phi, lambda) for this scalar-mediated neutrino self-interaction onto Planck/BBN data, so the intermediate-mediator evasion claim cannot be quantified.

members.model_name: Hidden vector coherent oscillation dark matter

members.model_name: Light-vector-meson dark pion SIMP model

members.model_name: Comprehensive asymmetric mirror dark matter
members.description: No packaged likelihood pipeline exists to confront the model's Delta N_eff and sigma/m predictions with data; the BBN/CMB bound and the 0.7-2.0 cm^2/g cluster/ellipticity bounds are recorded only as quoted numbers requiring recasting.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mirror thermal history in a CLASS/CAMB N_eff parameterization evaluated against the public Planck likelihood, and package the published cluster-merger and halo-shape SIDM constraints as a velocity-binned likelihood on sigma/m.

members.model_name: Melting-domain-wall ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: The superradiance test of the ultralight scalar mass window is only qualitative: no recast of black-hole spin measurements or boson-cloud GW searches onto this model's M_phi range (with its production-mode dependence) has been performed, and no exclusion curve or likelihood is available.

members.model_name: Scalar-mediated secret-neutrino sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: No packaged joint likelihood exists for the model's constraint set: X-ray line limits on sin^2(2theta) as a function of m_4, Planck/BBN Delta N_eff bounds applied to the coupled phi-neutrino thermal history, and laboratory meson-decay/DUNE bounds on (m_phi, lambda_phi); the card lists all three as likelihood_available: partial with recasting needed.

members.model_name: Unbroken local U(1)_X scalar dark matter model
members.description: No calibrated likelihood exists for long-range dark-Coulomb self-interactions from the massless dark photon: the alpha_X bound is a rough analytic estimate against a single 35 cm^2/g benchmark, and standard SIDM halo-shape/cluster analyses (and simulations) are calibrated for contact or Yukawa-screened scattering, not an unscreened 1/v^4 Coulomb cross section with strong forward enhancement.

members.description: No proper SPARC rotation-curve likelihood exists for self-interacting SFDM solitons: the paper's DM-only analysis fixes the disk mass-to-light ratio, omits the NFW envelope fit, and replaces statistics with overshoot and factor-of-two peak-velocity criteria.

members.model_name: Quartic self-interacting superfluid scalar dark matter with core fragmentation

members.model_name: Generative-sector first-order phase-transition asymmetric dark matter

members.model_name: Co-interacting conformal two-component dark matter

members.proposed_resolution: Recast published cluster-merger and cluster-lensing SIDM analyses into a likelihood parameterized by (f_subcomponent, sigma/m(v)), using the gap_2 simulation outputs to map co-interaction parameters onto the observables those analyses actually bound.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No implemented joint likelihood combines the Delta N_eff bound (CMB+BAO/BBN) with the sigma/m < 0.1 cm^2/g self-interaction criterion for the condensate parameters; the route's likelihood step has never been run and the self-interaction bound is only quoted, not recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the gap-equation outputs in a small driver that maps (m_nuR, y_nu, mu, T_creation) to (Delta N_eff, sigma_self/m) and evaluate against the public Planck+BAO Delta N_eff posterior (via cobaya/MontePython) together with a recast astrophysical self-interaction bound.

members.model_name: Vector-like quark color-superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No implemented likelihood combines the Delta N_eff bound (CMB+BAO/BBN) with the sigma/m < 0.1 cm^2/g self-interaction criterion for the condensate parameters; the card records likelihood_available partial/no and no likelihood step was run.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a driver mapping (m_VLQ, mu, alpha_s, T_creation) to (Delta N_eff, sigma_self/m) via the gap equation and evaluate against the public Planck+BAO Delta N_eff posterior (cobaya/MontePython) plus a recast astrophysical self-interaction bound.

members.model_name: Phion self-interacting scalar dark matter
members.description: The halo-scale target is only the original 1 kpc - 1 Mpc mean-free-path interval: no calibrated SIDM structure likelihood (halo shapes, cluster mergers, rotation-curve diversity) has been applied to the phion's essentially velocity-independent quartic self-scattering cross section.
members.proposed_resolution: Map (m_phi, g) to sigma/m and confront it with existing SIDM constraints calibrated on constant-cross-section N-body simulations (cluster sigma/m < ~1 cm^2/g bounds, Bullet Cluster, halo-shape analyses), packaging the comparison as a simple sigma/m likelihood over the phion parameters.

members.model_name: Reshuffled SIMP Model A
members.description: No likelihood or calibrated recast exists to confront the fraction-weighted two-component self-interaction cross section sigma_self/m_DM with cluster observations; the Bullet Cluster and Abell 3827 bounds are cited only qualitatively and existing SIDM constraints assume a single component.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective single-fluid sigma/m for the reshuffled X/N mixture as a function of component fractions and map it onto published cluster SIDM constraints (Bullet Cluster, merging-cluster offsets), packaging the comparison as a simple likelihood over (m_X, Delta m/m, Lambda); assess where the multi-component nature requires dedicated two-component SIDM simulations.

members.model_name: Reshuffled SIMP Model B
members.description: No public likelihood exists for confronting the fraction-weighted multi-component self-interaction cross section sigma_self/m_DM with cluster observations (Bullet Cluster, Abell 3827); the card marks the cluster constraint likelihood as unknown and recasting as required, with the paper deferring to future observations and simulations.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a recast likelihood mapping the component-fraction-weighted sigma_self/m_DM onto published Bullet Cluster and Abell 3827 merging-cluster bounds, extended to multi-component dark matter where each component scatters with its own cross section.

members.model_name: Pseudo-Dirac split SIMP dark matter
members.description: No calculator exists for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section of a split pseudo-Dirac pair scattering through an off-diagonal dark-photon coupling, including inelastic 11-to-22 thresholds, exothermic 22-to-11 down-scattering, excited-state population weighting, and beyond-Born (partial-wave) effects needed to compare dwarf and cluster velocities.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing SIDM partial-wave/Hulthen-approximation code to the two-state coupled-channel Schrodinger problem with mass splitting Delta m and off-diagonal potential, and tabulate population-weighted sigma_T/m versus velocity for dwarf, Milky Way, and cluster regimes.

members.model_name: Real scalar split SIMP dark matter
members.description: No public velocity-dependent SIDM cross-section calculator includes the inelastic 12->12 and 11->22 channels with mass-splitting thresholds and an excited-state population weight, which are required to map (Delta m, R_0, m_V, g_V) to effective sigma/m at dwarf and cluster velocities.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement and release a coupled-channel Schroedinger solver for the two-state dark-photon potential (as in the inelastic-SIDM literature), returning population-averaged transfer cross sections versus velocity, and validate against the Born and classical limits used in the paper.

members.model_name: Asymmetric condensed dark matter
members.description: No Boltzmann-code setup exists for the model's mixed phase space: a cold zero-mode condensate (masses down to ~1e-12 eV where wave effects may matter) coexisting with a relativistically decoupled hot boson cloud carrying a chemical potential; the transfer-function step s3 that quantifies the dwarf-erasure bound is therefore unimplemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement in CLASS a two-component setup: the condensate as CDM (or an axionCAMB-style fluid for the lightest masses) plus an ncdm species with the Bose-Einstein distribution at T_d including the chemical potential, parameterized by (m, q, T_d).

members.model_name: Two-real-singlet self-interacting scalar dark matter model
members.description: No solver is identified for the velocity-dependent self-scattering cross section sigma/m(v) across Born, classical, and resonant regimes, which is required for a light ~20 MeV scalar mediator where perturbative formulas can fail.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a partial-wave Schrodinger solver for the attractive Yukawa potential generated by the light singlet mediator (following standard SIDM transfer-cross-section treatments), tabulate sigma_T/m over the dwarf-to-cluster velocity range 10-1000 km/s, and verify the paper's target of ~1 cm^2/g at dwarf velocities falling below 0.1 cm^2/g at cluster velocities.

members.model_name: Stable scalar mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: No packaged numerical solver is available for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T(v)/m_chi in the nonperturbative attractive (and Majorana-basis repulsive) Yukawa regime with an MeV-scale stable mediator, which is precisely the regime needed for dwarf-scale 0.1-10 cm^2/g values.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a partial-wave Schrodinger solver for the S-mediated Yukawa potential (cross-checked against Hulthen and classical-regime approximations) covering dwarf (~30 km/s) to cluster (~1000 km/s) velocities, and tabulate sigma_T(v)/m over the m_chi, m_S, g_Y space.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal freeze-in scalar with hierarchical lepton couplings
members.description: No public stellar-energy-loss calculator exists for the keV lepton-portal scalar with hierarchical couplings: photon inverse decay, Primakoff, and Bremsstrahlung production in white dwarfs, red giants, and the Sun must be integrated over stellar profiles, with careful treatment when m_phi is comparable to stellar temperatures.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the thermal emission rates for the mu/tau-dominated coupling texture including Boltzmann suppression near keV masses, integrate them over standard stellar models (e.g. MESA white-dwarf and red-giant profiles), and release the calculator in the style of existing axion stellar-loss codes.

members.model_name: Mirror-star-forming mirror baryon dark matter
members.description: No implemented Gaia catalog-search pipeline exists for the predicted faint, hot, underluminous HR-diagram outliers, including selection function, completeness, and rejection of white-dwarf and astrophysical impostors, together with per-candidate X-ray follow-up sensitivity calculations.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a pipeline on the Gaia archive (astroquery) that selects parallax-confirmed underluminous hot sources against the white-dwarf cooling sequence, models contaminants and completeness, and couples the candidate list to Chandra/XMM exposure calculators for the predicted core-temperature X-ray component.

members.model_name: Dark cluster microhalo clumps
members.description: No public code implements dark-cluster transit heating in compact stars: overburden stopping, energy deposition within the white-dwarf/neutron-star trigger volume as a function of (M, R, sigma_T/m_chi), and the resulting ignition probability.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's clump-transit heating and ignition-criterion equations (trigger-length thresholds from Timmes-Woosley-type ignition conditions) as an open-source module taking (M, R, f_chi, sigma_T/m_chi) and tabulated WD/NS profiles, validated against the published Planck-mass to asteroid-mass excluded region.

members.model_name: Symmetric vector-mediator SIDM with Z-boson mass mixing
members.description: No regime-aware calculator of the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m_X(v) for this model's Yukawa self-scattering covering the classical, resonant, and Born regimes for both the repulsive X-X/anti-X-anti-X and attractive X-anti-X channels of the symmetric benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a partial-wave Schroedinger solver for the attractive and repulsive Yukawa potentials (Tulin-Yu-Zurek-style parameterization in alpha_X, m_X, m_phi, v), with analytic Born/classical limits stitched in, and average over dwarf and cluster velocity distributions.

members.model_name: Global-U(1) pseudo-Dirac dark matter with Goldstone dark radiation
members.description: The scalar-mediated Yukawa self-scattering sigma_T/m_chi (target 0.1-1 cm^2/g at 10 km/s while evading cluster bounds) requires a nonperturbative/resonant partial-wave treatment in parts of parameter space, for which no calculator is identified on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_T(v) on a (m_chi, m_rho, alpha_d) grid with a numerical partial-wave Yukawa solver (extending public Hulthen-approximation/partial-wave codes into the resonant regime) and tabulate results at dwarf and cluster velocities for the cluster-bound check.

members.model_name: Model A': Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light vector mediator
members.description: No public solver on the card computes the velocity-dependent A-prime-mediated transfer cross section sigma_T/m_DM(v) across the Born, classical, and resonant regimes; analytic formulae cover only the nonresonant regimes, so the dwarf-to-cluster velocity dependence central to this SIDM model cannot be evaluated over the full (m_DM, m_med, alpha_D) space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement (or adopt and validate) a numerical partial-wave Schroedinger solver for the attractive/repulsive Yukawa potential, stitch it to the Born and classical analytic limits, and release velocity-averaged sigma_T tables over the model's parameter space.

members.model_name: Model A: Dirac self-interacting dark matter with a light scalar mediator
members.description: No packaged calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of the attractive Yukawa potential from light scalar phi exchange that consistently spans the Born, classical, and resonant regimes; the resonant regime needs a numerical partial-wave Schroedinger solution, so quoted 0.1-10 cm^2/g targets cannot be mapped precisely onto (m_DM, m_med, y_phi).
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published partial-wave solver and fitting functions for attractive Yukawa scattering (Tulin-Yu-type regime matching plus Hulthen resonant approximation) into a registry-level sigma_T/m(v) module taking (m_DM, m_med, dark coupling) and returning dwarf-to-cluster velocity averages.

members.model_name: Model B': vector-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No packaged calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of A'-mediated self-scattering that spans the Born, classical, and resonant regimes and averages the attractive (chi chi-bar) and repulsive (chi chi) channels of Dirac dark matter; without it the 0.1-10 cm^2/g targets cannot be mapped precisely onto (m_DM, m_med, g').
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published partial-wave solver and fitting functions for attractive plus repulsive Yukawa scattering (Tulin-Yu-type regime matching with channel averaging for Dirac DM) into a registry-level sigma_T/m(v) module returning dwarf-to-cluster velocity averages.

members.model_name: Model B: scalar-mediator SIDM with an extra scalar annihilation channel
members.description: No packaged calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of the attractive Yukawa potential from light scalar phi exchange that consistently spans the Born, classical, and resonant regimes; the resonant regime needs a numerical partial-wave Schroedinger solution, so quoted 0.1-10 cm^2/g targets cannot be mapped precisely onto (m_DM, m_med, y_phi).

members.model_name: Model C: p-wave scalar-mediator SIDM with scalar mediator-decay channel
members.description: No packaged calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of the attractive Yukawa potential from light scalar phi exchange that consistently spans the Born, classical, and resonant regimes; the resonant regime needs a numerical partial-wave Schroedinger solution, so quoted 0.1-10 cm^2/g targets cannot be mapped precisely onto (m_DM, m_med, y_phi).
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published partial-wave solver and fitting functions for attractive Yukawa scattering (Tulin-Yu-type regime matching plus Hulthen resonant approximation) into a registry-level sigma_T/m(v) module taking (m_DM, m_med, dark coupling) and returning dwarf-to-cluster velocity averages.

members.model_name: Model D: stable vector-mediator SIDM with scalar annihilation outlet
members.description: No packaged calculator for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section sigma_T/m(v) of A'-mediated self-scattering that spans the Born, classical, and resonant regimes and averages the attractive (chi chi-bar) and repulsive (chi chi) channels of Dirac dark matter; without it the 0.1-10 cm^2/g targets cannot be mapped precisely onto (m_DM, m_med, g').
members.proposed_resolution: Wrap the published partial-wave solver and fitting functions for attractive plus repulsive Yukawa scattering (Tulin-Yu-type regime matching with channel averaging for Dirac DM) into a registry-level sigma_T/m(v) module returning dwarf-to-cluster velocity averages.

members.model_name: Light Self-Interacting Dark Matter (LSIDM) model
members.description: No implementation exists for the velocity-dependent N self-scattering cross section through the MeV-scale Z': the resonant/classical light-mediator regimes require partial-wave or Hulthen-approximation solutions of the Yukawa scattering problem to map (m_N, m_Zprime, g_D) onto sigma_T/m at dwarf through cluster velocities.
members.proposed_resolution: Code the standard Tulin-Yu partial-wave solver (with Hulthen analytic approximation for the s-wave resonant regime) for the attractive/repulsive Yukawa potential set by g_D and m_Zprime, outputting velocity-averaged sigma_T/m on dwarf, LSB, and cluster velocity grids.

members.model_name: Cosmological strangelet macro dark matter
members.description: No stellar capture calculator exists for nuclear-density strangelets: capture rates on main-sequence stars, white dwarfs, and neutron stars, and the subsequent conversion/heating phenomenology, have not been implemented for an extended strangelet mass distribution.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing compact-object DM capture-rate formalisms (geometric cross-section limit with gravitational focusing, as used in PBH/macro capture literature) into a calculator taking dn/dM, an NFW halo density and velocity distribution, and stellar targets, outputting capture and conversion rates per stellar population.

members.model_name: Heavy asymmetric fermion dark matter with Higgs-mixed scalar portal white-dwarf ignition
members.description: No implemented forward-model pipeline maps (m_X, sigma_nX, lambda_X, m_phi, theta_h, a) to white-dwarf capture, thermalization, collapse, and Type Ia ignition predictions: the paper's capture/collapse timescales are analytic estimates, the card lists no associated code, and the sole route is a placeholder data transform with no physics steps.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a compact-object capture code for super-heavy DM (extending the Bramante-style multi-scatter capture formalism used for neutron stars/white dwarfs, e.g. building on the Asteria capture framework) that computes capture rate, thermalization time, self-gravitating collapse threshold, and ignition energy deposition as functions of m_X in 10^6-10^16 GeV, sigma_nX, and white-dwarf mass, for the Higgs-mixed scalar mediator cross section.

members.model_name: Heavy asymmetric fermion dark matter with vector portal white-dwarf ignition
members.description: No implemented forward-model pipeline maps (m_X, sigma_nX, alpha_X, m_V, epsilon, xi) to white-dwarf capture, thermalization, collapse, and Type Ia ignition predictions for this dark-photon-mediated model: the paper's capture/collapse timescales are analytic estimates, the card lists no associated code, and the sole route is a placeholder data transform with no physics steps.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a compact-object capture code for super-heavy DM (extending the Bramante-style multi-scatter capture formalism, e.g. building on the Asteria capture framework) computing capture rate, thermalization time, self-gravitating collapse threshold, and ignition energy deposition versus m_X in 10^6-10^16 GeV and sigma_nX, including the in-medium screening of the ultralight (m_V ~ 1e-12 eV) kinetically mixed dark photon in white-dwarf matter, which modifies the effective nucleon/electron cross section.

members.model_name: Long-range dark nuggets
members.description: No public code evaluates the compact-star ignition criterion for long-range Yukawa dark nuggets: converting the Yukawa potential energy and assumed short-range scattering into heat deposited within the white-dwarf/neutron-star trigger volume as a function of (M_X, R_X, alpha_y, mu).
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's transit-heating and trigger-length ignition conditions as an open module coupling the analytic Yukawa focusing/potential formulas to tabulated WD/NS structure profiles, validated by reproducing the published forty-decade excluded mass range.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter from late pseudo-WIMP decays
members.description: No cosmological SIDM simulations exist with late-decay initial conditions, so the claimed dwarf-scale improvements and ultra-SIDM SMBH-seeding effects of dark matter produced by Gyr-scale decays are not calibrated against any halo-structure prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Run velocity-dependent SIDM N-body simulations (Yukawa cross section from m_A, g, m_chi) that start from decaying-CDM initial conditions with the appropriate tau_S and kick velocity, and calibrate a halo-profile model for the SIDM and uSIDM regimes.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal self-interacting freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The model's central prediction — velocity-dependent self-interactions solving small-scale-structure tensions — is not simulation-calibrated (simulation_calibrated: no): no SIDM structure-formation simulation or calibrated halo model exists for this specific classical-regime cross section (alpha_D 0.1-0.9, m_Y 2-7 MeV, m_X 60-500 GeV), so quantitative core-size, profile, and subhalo predictions are unavailable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological zoom-in SIDM N-body simulations (e.g. with the SIDM modules of GIZMO or Arepo) sampling the classical-regime sigma_T(v)/m curves of this model, or calibrate the existing isothermal-Jeans/gravothermal halo models to this velocity dependence to produce testable density-profile predictions from dwarf to cluster scales.

members.model_name: Mirror Twin Higgs reheaton baryogenesis atomic dark matter
members.description: No hydrodynamic simulations exist for a dissipative twin-atomic subcomponent at f_aDM up to about 0.2 with this model's dark cooling parameters, so dark-disk formation, dissipative collapse, and dwarf-galaxy morphology predictions cannot be computed and the self-interaction constraint has no likelihood (likelihood_available: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in galaxy-formation simulations including a dissipative dark-atom fluid with dark Coulomb cooling (extending existing dissipative-DM simulation frameworks), scanning f_aDM and the dark fine-structure/binding-energy parameters, and derive dark-disk and dwarf-kinematics constraints as a recastable likelihood.

members.model_name: Atomic dark matter model
members.description: No N-body/hydrodynamic simulations with velocity-dependent atomic self-interactions (atom-atom, ion-atom) exist to calibrate the halo-ellipticity and collisionality constraint, which the card flags as approximate and possibly overstated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run SIDM-style N-body simulations (e.g., extending existing velocity-dependent SIDM implementations in Arepo/Gadget) with the atomic momentum-transfer cross section sigma_T(v) including its resonant low-velocity structure and partial ionization, and recalibrate halo-shape and dwarf-to-cluster collisionality bounds against them.

members.model_name: Super-Resonant Dark Matter
members.description: The mapping from the sharply peaked resonant sigma/m(v) to actual halo density profiles is not simulation-calibrated (card: simulation_calibrated unknown); existing SIDM N-body calibrations assume smooth velocity dependence, not a narrow s-channel resonance at halo velocities.
members.proposed_resolution: Run SIDM N-body simulations (e.g. with the Arepo or GIZMO SIDM modules) using the model's resonant velocity-dependent cross section for representative dwarf, LSB, and cluster halos to calibrate the cross-section-to-profile mapping used in the halo comparison.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M1
members.description: The dwarf-galaxy core/too-big-to-fail response to the S-mediated F self-interactions is not simulation-calibrated (simulation_calibrated: no); sigma/m is not even quoted as a likelihood-ready value, so the self-interaction observable cannot be confronted with dwarf data.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the velocity-dependent self-scattering cross section from the F-F-S coupling, then run SIDM N-body zoom simulations (or apply calibrated isothermal-Jeans halo modeling) combining the interaction cutoff initial conditions with sigma/m(v) to predict dwarf core sizes and subhalo central densities.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic singlet dark matter DS_M2
members.description: No simulation-calibrated prediction or likelihood exists for the dwarf-galaxy core response of the S-mediated F self-interactions; the card gives only a model-building-level sigma/m scale with simulation_calibrated: no.
members.proposed_resolution: Run SIDM N-body/hydro halo-response simulations (or apply calibrated SIDM halo models such as isothermal-Jeans fits) for the velocity-dependent sigma/m(v) predicted by the light-scalar-mediated self-interaction, and couple them to existing dwarf rotation-curve/dispersion likelihoods.

members.model_name: Z4 late-decaying dark matter
members.description: The mapping from recoil-kick parameters to nonlinear halo response (cusp softening, halo expansion, subhalo disruption) is only partially simulation-calibrated (simulation_calibrated: partial), and no dedicated N-body suite covers the Z4 benchmark regime of epsilon ~ 1e-5 kicks with Gyr lifetimes.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a grid of cosmological zoom N-body simulations with late two-body decays parameterized by (v_kick, tau), covering the dwarf and Milky Way subhalo scales, and fit calibrated halo-profile and subhalo-survival response functions usable in the likelihood of gap_1.

members.model_name: Chameleon-controlled density-dependent dark matter interactions
members.description: No structure-formation simulations or halo-shape/core likelihood exist for a self-interaction cross section that depends on both velocity and ambient density through the chameleon field; constant-cross-section SIDM bounds (sigma/m < 0.1 cm^2/g at 10 km/s) are only proxies.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement sigma(v, rho) scattering in an existing SIDM N-body code (e.g. the GIZMO or Arepo SIDM modules), run dwarf-to-cluster zoom simulations over the chameleon parameter space, and calibrate a halo-shape/core-size likelihood against cluster lensing and X-ray shape data.

members.model_name: Asymmetric dark matter nuggets with scalar and vector forces
members.description: Halo self-interaction bounds used to cap M_fo are calibrated for elastic (hard-sphere-like) SIDM; no structure-formation simulations calibrate the effect of exothermic nugget fusion and dissipation on dwarf and cluster halos, so the sigma/M ~ 1 cm^2/g comparison scale is only approximately applicable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with a dissipative/exothermic SIDM module (energy release per fusion event and fusion cross section as parameters) on dwarf-to-cluster halos, and derive corrected sigma/M exclusion curves as a function of velocity and dissipated energy fraction.

members.model_name: Vector wave dark matter in the nonrelativistic Schrödinger-Poisson limit
members.description: Only idealized binary and O(10)-soliton mergers have been simulated; there is no cosmological vector-wave-DM simulation with production-motivated initial power spectra, nor a calibrated halo-population and stellar-heating model that maps merger outcomes onto dwarf cores, stream heating, and substructure statistics.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological-volume three-component Schroedinger-Poisson simulations (using the gap_1 solver) with misalignment- and gravitational-production initial spectra to calibrate a vector core-halo relation, granule potential power spectrum, and stellar diffusion/heating coefficients analogous to the scalar fuzzy-DM ones.

members.model_name: Dark first-order phase transition primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH-triggered white-dwarf detonation criterion (BHL accretion shock ignition during a transit) is not calibrated by hydrodynamic simulations, leaving order-unity to order-of-magnitude uncertainty in the predicted SN Ia rate for asteroid-mass PBHs.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 1D/2D hydrodynamic simulations of PBH passage through carbon-oxygen white dwarfs (local heating from BHL accretion versus conduction/expansion losses, i.e. a Timmes-Woosley-style critical-hot-spot analysis) across the 1e-15 to 1e-10 M_sun window and publish a calibrated ignition-probability function of (M_PBH, WD mass, velocity).

members.model_name: Large Volume Scenario string ultralight axion
members.description: The nonlinear regime is uncalibrated for this model: the card marks halo and subhalo mass-function effects as expected-but-unsupplied and simulation_calibrated as unknown, so dwarf-galaxy-scale predictions below ~10 kpc rest on linear-theory extrapolation.
members.proposed_resolution: Use existing fuzzy-DM Schroedinger-Poisson simulation suites (or published fits from them) to calibrate a halo/subhalo mass-function suppression fitting function over m_a = 1e-22 to 1e-21 eV, including sub-unity axion fractions as required by the route's validation test.

members.model_name: Heavy-Majoron three-to-two Z3 scalar dark matter variant
members.description: The predicted halo-core morphology in the strong-self-interaction regime is uncalibrated: the card marks simulation_calibrated: no, and existing SIDM simulations assume elastic constant-or-velocity-dependent scattering, not the combination of near-unitarity self-scattering with residual 3-to-2 self-heating that this branch requires for core formation.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body SIDM simulations extended with an energy-injection term for residual 3-to-2 annihilations (extending a GIZMO/Arepo SIDM module), spanning the model's sigma_self/m_chi and injection-rate range, to calibrate dwarf-galaxy core sizes and check consistency with cluster-scale bounds.

members.model_name: Yukawa-potential interacting dark matter
members.description: No simulation suite or calibrated gravothermal emulator maps the velocity-dependent Yukawa cross section sigma_T(v)/m_chi to halo density-profile evolution across the (m_chi, m_phi, alpha_d) parameter space, including halo-to-halo scatter and baryonic feedback; the paper's core-formation claim rests on collision-rate estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Run an SIDM N-body suite (e.g. the GIZMO or Arepo SIDM modules, which accept velocity-dependent cross sections) over a grid of v_peak and normalization values from dwarf to cluster scales, and calibrate a gravothermal/isothermal-Jeans emulator for core size versus sigma_T(v)/m_chi and halo age.

members.model_name: CP-violating spin-0 mediator self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: The self-interaction observable is judged only against a generic 0.1-10 cm^2/g dwarf window and a <1 cm^2/g cluster bound; no structure-formation simulations or calibrated halo models exist for this model's specific velocity-dependent sigma_T(v) profile (the card marks simulation_calibrated no).
members.proposed_resolution: Run (or recast existing) velocity-dependent SIDM N-body simulations, or apply a calibrated isothermal-Jeans halo model, using the model's Yukawa sigma_T(v) to derive dwarf and cluster density-profile predictions and sharpen the crude cross-section-window criterion into system-by-system constraints.

members.model_name: Higgs-singlet higher-dimensional-operator ultralight axion
members.description: Nonlinear fuzzy-DM predictions are uncalibrated for this card (halo and subhalo mass-function effects marked unknown/uncalibrated), especially for the subcomponent case where the axion is only a fraction of the dark matter.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Schroedinger-Poisson (or calibrated N-body with FDM initial conditions) simulations across m_a = 1e-22 to 1e-21 eV and axion fractions below unity, fitting halo/subhalo mass-function and dwarf-core suppression relations usable in dwarf-galaxy and substructure comparisons.

members.model_name: Cold wavelike Bose-Einstein condensate dark matter
members.description: The primary GAMER Schrodinger-Poisson simulations omit baryonic feedback, so the soliton core-mass relation and granule statistics used for dwarf-profile inference are uncalibrated in the presence of baryons, which the card flags as able to shift the inferred boson mass.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of Schrodinger-Poisson simulations with baryons and feedback (extending GAMER's wave-DM solver coupled to its hydro module) over the m_B range 1e-23 to 1e-21 eV to recalibrate the soliton core-halo relation and granule power for use in dwarf Jeans fits.

members.model_name: Darkly charged mirror-sector relics in a visible heavy QCD axion model
members.description: Halo-shape and dwarf-core constraints on long-range dark-QED self-interactions rest on uncalibrated analytic ellipticity arguments; no simulations of darkly charged dark matter including dark plasma effects (screening, collective instabilities) exist to calibrate the constraint in the (alpha_QED', m_DM) plane, and no quantitative halo-ellipticity likelihood is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with long-range Coulomb-like dark scattering and plasma effects across the alpha_QED' and m_DM range, calibrate ellipticity and core-formation responses, and package them with modern halo-shape data (NGC720-class ellipticals, dwarf kinematics) into a likelihood.

members.model_name: Velocity-dependent SIDM thermally coupled through millicharged dark matter
members.description: The light-mediator direct-detection recast (mediator factor F_med convolved with XENON1T efficiency and nuclear form factors) exists only as a paper recipe, with no reusable code to apply it to current or future xenon/argon exposures.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the momentum-dependent light-mediator propagator in an existing recoil-rate package (DDCalc or WimPyDD) with experiment efficiency tables, validating against the paper's XENON1T conversion for m_phi = 20 MeV.

members.model_name: Dark-brane Dirac fermion radion-mediated dark matter
members.description: No direct-detection recast exists for radion-mediated scattering in the 0.15-10 GeV mass range: the sigma_N scales as 1/m_r^4 with a light (about 0.1 m_chi) mediator, so contact-interaction limit tables from XENON1T, DarkSide-50, and CRESST cannot be applied without a mediator-mass-dependent form-factor treatment for both nuclear and electron recoils.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public direct-detection likelihood package (DDCalc or an equivalent limit-recasting code) with the light-mediator propagator factor (q^2 + m_r^2)^-2 and low-threshold experiment efficiencies, then map the excluded region in (m_chi, m_r) against the paper's quoted lower bounds on m_r.

members.model_name: Five-dimensional Dirac dark photon fermion dark matter
members.description: Dark-photon intensity-frontier and direct-detection recasts for the multi-mode KK tower are missing: existing public recast machinery assumes a single dark photon with standard epsilon-scaled couplings, whereas here the lightest two gauge KK modes carry boundary-condition-dependent couplings and visible/invisible branching fractions.
