members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the paper's benchmark tables and allowed-region plots into a machine-readable point list (input parameters m_16, m_10, M_2, M_3, A_0, tan_beta, sign(mu) plus spectra), or regenerate the scan with the documented ISAJET 7.80 setup and archive the accepted points.

members.model_name: Millicharged dark matter subcomponent with a massless dark photon
members.description: Existing CERN/FNAL LSW limits and projected Dark SRF sensitivity contours in (epsilon, m_chi, e_D, n_chi,local) space exist only as figures in the primary paper (ReachPlot1e3, ReachPlotNX) and have not been digitized into machine-readable sensitivity tables or a likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published LSW exclusion and Dark SRF projection contours into tabulated sensitivity curves, and wrap them with the analytic cavity signal-power formula as a reusable recast/likelihood module keyed to laboratory mCP density as input.

members.model_name: R-symmetric GUT Higgs inflation PBH dark matter
members.description: The benchmark parameter tables were not reliably preserved by OCR, so the superpotential couplings, Kahler coefficients, and initial conditions defining the two all-dark-matter benchmark points are not machine-readable in the registry.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-extract the benchmark tables from the original arXiv:2402.13924 PDF and store the parameter values as structured registry data before any numeric reproduction.

members.model_name: BSTV scalar-field oscillation cold dark matter
members.description: The outer-solar-system anomalous-acceleration prediction is tied to the historical Pioneer signal; no modern ephemeris or spacecraft-tracking constraint has been recast onto the scalar-vector coupling parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast current planetary-ephemeris and spacecraft Doppler bounds on constant anomalous accelerations (post-thermal-recoil Pioneer analyses) onto the model's coupling parameters.

members.model_name: FNPQ DFSZ type-II flavored axion dark matter
members.description: No digitized haloscope (ADMX and successors) and stellar/astrophysical exclusion curves or packaged likelihood are available in the card to compare against the specific FNPQ coupling line g_a_gamma(m_a) with E/N=28/15; the paper's constraints were quoted, not rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the ADMX Phase IIa/Gen-2 and stellar-cooling limit curves in the (m_a, g_a_gamma) plane (e.g. from the published exclusion figures), implement the E/N=28/15 FNPQ coupling line as a one-line analytic module, and package an interpolated exclusion/likelihood test over 5e10 < f_a < 1e15 GeV.

members.model_name: Minimal SUSY SO(10) benchmark with bino-like neutralino dark matter
members.description: No benchmark input files (SLHA-style GUT-scale input cards with the flavor-dependent soft terms and SO(10) Yukawa-fit inputs) are released, so the paper's sparticle spectrum cannot be reproduced through SOFTSUSY without reverse-engineering the benchmark tables.
members.proposed_resolution: Parse the paper benchmark tables into SLHA input cards for SOFTSUSY 3.7.3, verify against the printed spectrum, and store the validated cards in the registry as the reproducibility artifact for this model.

members.model_name: Super-weak sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The NA64 missing-energy bound translated to the super-weak coupling, g_z^max(M_Zprime), exists only as an undigitized figure in the primary paper, so the main laboratory exclusion cannot be applied numerically to model points.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published NA64 dark-photon epsilon(m_A') limit and redo the translation to U(1)_z charges analytically (rescaling the electron coupling), producing a tabulated g_z^max(M_Zprime) curve for the registry.

members.model_name: Near-threshold feeton B-L gauge boson dark matter
members.description: The card carries only a placeholder recovery route, observable, and constraint: the model's actual observational channels (Galactic 511-keV line from the near-threshold e+e- branch, low-energy neutrino flux from feeton -> nu nu-bar decay, and the B-mode falsification of the inflationary production scenario) were never extracted into structured routes, so no real forward-model chain is encoded to evaluate.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the full enrichment pipeline on the primary paper (2310.05420) to encode dedicated routes for the 511-keV line flux, the diffuse neutrino flux from feeton decay, and the H_inf/B-mode consistency check, each with explicit forward-model steps and constraint links.

members.model_name: keV U(1)_X dark photon dark matter subcomponent
members.description: The card itself is a recovery placeholder: its single constraint is a limitation record, its route performs no physics, and related-paper citation enrichment (real observables, constraints, likelihood references for the keV dark-photon window such as X-ray and stellar-cooling limits) was never completed.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the normal enrichment pipeline on paper 2312_03837 for this variant to populate genuine observables, constraints, and routes from the paper text and its citation network before gap analysis is treated as final.

members.model_name: QCD-like dark-pion forbidden dark matter model
members.description: The order and thermodynamics of the dark SU(3) three-flavor confinement/chiral transition with the paper's quark masses are unknown, so no gravitational-wave spectrum can be computed for the exact model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a finite-temperature lattice study of the SU(3) dark sector at the relevant m/Lambda_d to determine the transition order and latent heat, then map (alpha_PT, beta/H) through standard phase-transition GW templates (e.g. PTPlot/CosmoTransitions-style pipelines) to observatory sensitivities.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-inflaton scalar dark matter from dark-sector preheating
members.description: No model-specific stochastic gravitational-wave spectrum has been computed for the Starobinsky dark-preheating fragmentation; the GW observable is currently a qualitative recast from related preheating studies with different potentials.
members.proposed_resolution: Use the gravitational-wave module of a lattice code (e.g. CosmoLattice GW extraction) on the same preheating simulation as gap_1 to compute Omega_GW(f) for the benchmark couplings, then redshift to today and compare with high-frequency detector concepts.

members.model_name: SU(2)_ell asymmetric dark matter with first-order phase transition
members.description: The nearly degenerate Z2-related vacua of the SU(2)_ell scalar potential can form domain walls, but no calculation or simulation of the wall network's formation, annihilation time as a function of the vacuum-energy splitting Delta V, and gravitational-wave contribution exists for this model, leaving obs_vacuum_domain_wall_caveat unevaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply the standard biased-domain-wall evolution formalism (wall tension from the computed potential, annihilation temperature set by Delta V versus tension, and existing lattice-calibrated Omega_GW fitting formulae for collapsing wall networks) to the m12_squared parameter space, adding the wall signal and cosmological-safety bound to the GW pipeline.

members.model_name: Pure SU(N) glueball dark matter with dark SU(N) stars
members.description: No calculation exists of the formation, abundance, and binary merger rate of dark SU(N) stars from primordial perturbations, so the gravitational-wave observable cannot be turned into a detection forecast or likelihood even where f_max falls in the LIGO/LISA bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Run structure-formation simulations (or semi-analytic Press-Schechter-style collapse estimates) of the self-interacting glueball fluid to obtain a DSS mass function and binary fraction, then fold the resulting merger-rate density into standard compact-binary GW search sensitivity pipelines.

members.model_name: Long-lived axion domain wall dark matter
members.description: No calibrated gravitational-wave spectrum Omega_GW(f) from the collapsing biased wall network exists: the lattice simulation lacks a transverse-traceless stress-energy extraction, so only order-of-magnitude analytic estimates of the stochastic background are possible.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a GW module (TT-projected anisotropic-stress evolution, as in CosmoLattice's GW extension) to the domain-wall simulation and calibrate a spectral template in (sigma_DW, t_decay, epsilon) covering the collapse phase.

members.model_name: Plateau-potential string axion ultralight dark matter
members.description: No lattice simulation of the plateau-axion field's nonlinear fragmentation exists, so the resonance duration, oscillon formation, and the sourced gravitational-wave spectrum are only qualitative; the linear estimates cease to be valid exactly where the observables become interesting.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a campaign of 3+1D expanding-background lattice simulations (e.g. in CosmoLattice) of the attractor plateau potential over a grid of (alpha, phi_i/f, x_osc), extracting fragmentation time, oscillon abundance and lifetimes, and the stochastic GW spectrum with energy-conservation checks.

members.model_name: Axiverse early-collapse QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No dedicated simulation of a two-axion (mixed mass eigenstate) string-domain-wall network with heavy-axion-triggered early collapse exists to calibrate the string-radiated QCD-axion yield and the emitted gravitational-wave spectrum; the card relies on analytic scaling estimates and a MiMeS-style misalignment piece only.
members.proposed_resolution: Run field-theory lattice simulations of a two-axion string-wall system parameterized by (Q_ni, Lambda_2, f_a1, f_a2), extending existing single-axion axion-string network codes to include the second potential term, and extract the axion emission spectrum, collapse temperature T_coll, and Omega_GW(f) template.

members.model_name: Cosmic-selection-rule SU(N)d glueball dark matter
members.description: The compact-object gravitational-wave observable cannot be evaluated: no calculation exists of whether and how strongly self-interacting glueballs in this parameter space form compact dark objects, nor of the resulting merger rate and strain signal.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt existing dissipative/self-interacting dark-matter collapse simulations and boson-star structure calculations to the glueball scalar potential to determine the compact-object mass function, then fold into standard compact-binary merger-rate and LIGO/LISA sensitivity estimates.

members.model_name: String moduli star compact-object dark matter
members.description: Numerical-relativity simulations of dense moduli-star dynamics, mergers, and oscillating configurations, needed to predict gravitational-wave morphology and the stochastic-background amplitude, do not exist for this potential; only characteristic frequencies are estimated analytically.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Einstein-Klein-Gordon numerical-relativity merger and perturbation simulations (e.g. with the public GRChombo or Einstein Toolkit scalar-field infrastructure) for representative (m, lambda_3, g) benchmarks, extracting waveforms and per-event GW energy to normalize a stochastic-background estimate given a population model.

members.model_name: Multi-waterfall hybrid-inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: The defect-sourced gravitational-wave component (textures/global defects of the broken O(N) waterfall sector) claimed as LISA-observable has no calculational tool on the card; only the scalar-induced component maps onto existing calculators.
members.proposed_resolution: Run classical lattice field-theory simulations of the O(N) waterfall sector after the transition (or adapt existing global-defect GW scaling results) to compute the texture-sourced Omega_GW(f) for the model's symmetry-breaking scale, and combine it with the SIGWfast-class induced-GW spectrum.

members.model_name: SO(10) pseudo-Goldstone dark matter with 126_H and 16_H singlets
members.description: No public, simulation-calibrated code exists for the gravitational-wave spectrum of domain walls bounded by strings from the staged Z2 breaking (126_H strings later bounded by 16_H walls); the prediction rests on the paper's semi-analytic loop-distribution and collapse-time model, whose network-modeling uncertainties the card flags as dominating the observational translation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the walls-bounded-by-strings spectrum (loop distribution, wall tension, collapse time t_*) as a reusable Omega_GW(f; Gmu, sigma_wall) module, and calibrate its loop/network parameters against dedicated field-theory lattice simulations of hybrid string-wall networks.

members.model_name: Dark photon dark matter from cosmic string loop decay
members.description: No calibrated string-network simulation covers the nearly-global gauged U(1) regime of this model: the loop production function and the cusp/kink gravitational-wave versus massive-dark-photon emission branching are both taken from assumptions the source itself flags as uncertain, so neither the loop distribution (s1) nor Omega_GW(f) (s3) can be computed reliably.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Abelian-Higgs lattice field-theory string-network simulations in the small-gauge-coupling (nearly global) limit, extract the loop production function and the partition of loop energy loss between gravitational waves and massive dark-photon radiation as a function of m and v, and fit a loop-emission parameterization that plugs into the analytic abundance and Omega_GW formulas.

members.model_name: Liouville-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: No merger waveforms exist for binary boson stars with the Liouville potential: GW detectability is asserted only from equilibrium mass and compactness, with no numerical-relativity or perturbative waveform model to distinguish these mergers from black-hole binaries in LIGO/Virgo searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity binary boson-star mergers for a few benchmark compactness values of the Liouville potential (extending existing complex-scalar BNS-style NR setups), and fit an inspiral-merger template or at least tidal-deformability corrections usable in LIGO/Virgo parameter estimation.

members.model_name: Logarithmic-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: No merger waveforms exist for binary boson stars with the logarithmic potential: GW detectability is inferred only from equilibrium mass and compactness, with no numerical-relativity or perturbative waveform model to distinguish such mergers from black-hole binaries in LIGO/Virgo searches.
members.proposed_resolution: Run numerical-relativity binary boson-star mergers for benchmark compactness values of the logarithmic potential (extending existing complex-scalar NR merger setups) and fit inspiral-merger templates or tidal-deformability corrections usable in LIGO/Virgo parameter estimation.

members.model_name: Light radion freeze-in dark matter in an RS/SBSI model
members.description: No digitized ALP-like photon-decay exclusion curves (WMAP, EBL, galactic X-ray) or short-range fifth-force exclusion curves are attached to the card, so the radion lifetime and coupling cannot be numerically compared against the constraints the paper invokes.
members.proposed_resolution: Import digitized decaying-ALP X-ray/EBL/WMAP limits (e.g. from the public AxionLimits compilation) rescaled by the radion's sub-unity dark-matter fraction, and digitize the standard Yukawa-parameterized fifth-force exclusion plot; store both as reusable limit files keyed to (m_radion, g_radion).

members.model_name: Neutrino-coupled ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: The combined exclusion contours in the (m_phi, y_phi) plane, including the headline y_phi ~ 1e-30 fuzzy-regime reach, exist only as figures in the primary paper and are not available as machine-readable data for reuse or validation.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the paper's combined exclusion figure per flavor/channel and store the contours as tabulated (m_phi, y_phi) curves in the registry for validation of the gap_1 and gap_2 pipelines.

members.model_name: CP-even sgoldstino wave-like dark matter
members.description: The experiment-specific sensitivity curves needed to bound M_gamma/F are not available as machine-readable products: the atomic-clock, optical-spectroscopy, and radio-frequency oscillating-alpha limits are cited only as published figures requiring original data extraction, so the recasting step cannot be run numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the digitized scalar-photon (d_e-type) exclusion curves from the public AxionLimits/scalar-DM compilations plus the cited spectroscopy papers, and implement the linear mapping between the generic d_e coupling and the sgoldstino M_gamma/F (and hence sqrt(F)), with f_phi rescaling for subcomponent scenarios.

members.model_name: Stochastic QCD axion dark matter scenario
members.description: Astrophysical exclusion curves (SN1987A, stellar cooling, black-hole superradiance) and low-mass haloscope/spin-precession sensitivity curves are only quoted qualitatively; no digitized limit curves are attached to the card for overlaying on the stochastic window in the (m_a, f_a) plane.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the relevant digitized exclusion and projection curves from the public AxionLimits compilation (stellar cooling, SN1987A, superradiance, CASPEr, DM Radio, ABRACADABRA) and store them as (m_a, g_a) limit data mapped onto the stochastic (m_a, f_a) window with standard QCD-axion coupling relations.

members.model_name: Mirror electron sequential freeze-in dark matter
members.description: Bounds on fractionally charged mirror-hadron relics exist only as qualitative flux and terrestrial estimates with order-of-magnitude uncertainties acknowledged by the paper; no compiled, quantitative limit set on exotic charged-hadron abundance versus mass is available for a reproducible viability check.
members.proposed_resolution: Compile existing fractionally-charged-particle and anomalous-heavy-isotope search results into a structured abundance-versus-mass exclusion table (AxionLimits-style repository) applicable to mirror up-quark bound states, with documented assumptions about their terrestrial accumulation.

members.model_name: ALP cogenesis
members.description: No curated, up-to-date set of experimental limit curves and (where published) likelihoods for axion photon, nucleon, and electron couplings is attached to the model, so the cogenesis m_a-f_a coupling bands can only be compared against the 2020-era bounds redrawn in the primary paper rather than a maintained global recast including newer results such as the ORGAN Phase 1a/1b windows.
members.proposed_resolution: Ingest a maintained digitized limit compilation (AxionLimits-style curves for CAST, ADMX, ABRACADABRA, ORGAN, CASPEr, LUX, stellar-cooling bounds and IAXO/DM Radio projections) into registry limit tables keyed to g_a_gamma, g_aNN, g_aee, and implement a small overlay/recast script that intersects them with the analytic cogenesis bands as functions of m_a and the anomaly coefficients.

members.model_name: QCD axion hilltop dark matter from heavy-axion phase shift
members.description: Digitized experiment sensitivity curves (ORGAN, MADMAX, TOORAD, IAXO) in the (m_a, g_a_gamma) plane are not attached to the card, so the meV-window search overlay cannot be evaluated numerically for arbitrary axion-photon coupling assumptions.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the machine-readable reach curves from the public AxionLimits compilation for ORGAN, MADMAX, TOORAD, and IAXO and store them as registry data products, with the KSVZ/DFSZ coupling band parameterized so the overlay can be recomputed for any anomaly coefficient.

members.model_name: Type-II extended 2HDM QCD axion dark matter
members.description: No haloscope exclusion-curve data is integrated: the card quotes only experiment mass windows (ADMX 2.7-4.2 micro-eV, CAPP, MADMAX, KLASH, ABRACADABRA), not coupling-limit curves, so covered/excluded flags cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Ingest the publicly maintained AxionLimits compilation of haloscope g_a_gamma(m_a) exclusion and projection curves into the registry comparison step and score the model's g_a_gamma(F_a) line (from gap_1) against it.

members.model_name: FNPQ DFSZ type-I flavored axion dark matter
members.description: The ADMX haloscope and stellar/astrophysical axion exclusion curves are not digitized or connected to the FNPQ coupling line (E/N = 28/15), so the model's (m_a, g_a_gamma) trajectory cannot be quantitatively compared to existing and projected search reach; no likelihood is available for any constraint on the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the community AxionLimits digitized exclusion/projection curves (ADMX phases, stellar and helioscope bounds) and overlay the FNPQ line g_a_gamma(f_a; E/N=28/15) with the relic-preferred f_a interval, upgrading to the published ADMX likelihoods where releases exist.

members.model_name: Minimal SVS 3-3-1 invisible axion dark matter
members.description: The route to haloscope/helioscope comparisons stops at step s3 because no digitized g_a_gamma(m_a) exclusion curves or limit database are attached to the card; the ADMX 2.81-3.31 micro-eV curve and the review-level stellar/cosmological compilations exist in the literature but are not available as machine-readable assets for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Ingest a public digitized axion-limit compilation (AxionLimits-style g_a_gamma vs m_a curves for ADMX, IAXO, ABRACADABRA, MADMAX and stellar bounds) into the registry and implement a simple coupling-vs-limit comparison for the 3-3-1 anomaly-ratio benchmarks.

members.model_name: SUSY DFSZ axion base model B_I with mixed axion/neutralino dark matter
members.description: The axion-photon exclusion curves and projections (CAST, ADMX, CAPP, HAYSTAC, QUAX, ORGAN, IAXO) used to test the B_I g_Agamma target are only available as compiled plots in the source; no digitized limit tables are attached to the card, so the E/N=2-suppressed coupling cannot be checked programmatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the community-maintained digitized axion-photon limit compilation (AxionLimits-style tables) for the relevant haloscope/helioscope experiments and attach it as machine-readable limit data keyed to (m_A, g_Agamma), evaluated at the variant's E/N.

members.description: The axion-photon exclusion curves and projections (CAST, ADMX, CAPP, HAYSTAC, QUAX, ORGAN, IAXO) used to test the B_II g_Agamma target are only available as compiled plots in the source; no digitized limit tables are attached to the card, so the E/N=2-suppressed coupling cannot be checked programmatically.

members.description: The axion-photon exclusion curves and projections (CAST, ADMX, CAPP, HAYSTAC, QUAX, ORGAN, IAXO) used to test the B_III g_Agamma target are only available as compiled plots in the source; no digitized limit tables are attached to the card, so the E/N=2-suppressed coupling cannot be checked programmatically.

members.model_name: Millicharged dark matter subcomponent with L_mu-L_tau vector depletion
members.description: No public code computes the cosmic-dawn baryon/dark-matter coupled thermal history for a millicharged subcomponent (fraction f_DM with Coulomb-like velocity-dependent scattering) through to the global 21-cm brightness temperature; the scattering_cooling step has no implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled T_b, T_chi, v_rel evolution equations for f_DM-fraction Coulomb-type (v^-4) scattering as a standalone ODE module or an extension of a global 21-cm code such as 21cmFAST/ARES, validated against the Munoz-Loeb published cooling curves.

members.model_name: Millicharged Dirac dark matter with hidden-scalar depletion
members.description: No public code computes the cosmic-dawn baryon/dark-matter coupled thermal history for a millicharged subcomponent (fraction f_DM with Coulomb-like velocity-dependent scattering) through to the global 21-cm brightness temperature; the scattering_cooling step has no implementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the coupled T_b, T_chi, v_rel evolution equations for f_DM-fraction Coulomb-type (v^-4) scattering as a standalone ODE module or an extension of a global 21-cm code such as 21cmFAST/ARES, validated against the Munoz-Loeb published cooling curves.

members.model_name: Charge-sequestration charged-X dark matter
members.description: No public recombination/thermal-history code includes a stable sequestered negative charge epsilon_X r_X in the charge-neutrality condition, so the suppressed free-electron fraction x_e(z), earlier baryon cooling T_g(z), and resulting global 21 cm brightness temperature T_21 cannot be computed with released tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend HyRec or the RECFAST module in CLASS to solve the recombination network with x_p = x_e + epsilon_X r_X and the modified Compton/adiabatic cooling of the gas, then feed x_e(z), T_g(z) into a global 21 cm calculator (e.g. ARES) to produce T_21(z) at cosmic dawn; validate against the epsilon_X r_X ~ 1e-4 benchmark of the paper.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal vector millicharged dark matter
members.description: No public packaged code maps a millicharged DM subcomponent (f_DM about 0.003-0.02, epsilon about 1e-6 to 1e-4, m_V of 13.6-80 MeV) with velocity-dependent Coulomb-like scattering on hydrogen, electrons, and protons to a global 21-cm brightness-temperature prediction at z ~ 17; the route's key step is a semi-analytic cooling model that is not released.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public global-21cm framework (e.g. ARES or a released Munoz-Loeb-type DM-baryon fluid code) with the fraction-dependent millicharged drag/heating terms, including relative-velocity dependence and the residual-electron coupling, exposing (f_DM, epsilon, m_V) as inputs and returning T21(z).

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal scalar millicharged dark matter
members.description: No public forward model converts (f_DM, epsilon, m_phi) into a global 21-cm brightness temperature for a millicharged subcomponent: the velocity-dependent Coulomb-like scattering with hydrogen, residual electrons, and protons must be evolved through recombination to cosmic dawn together with baryon temperature and bulk relative velocities, and no such code is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the DM-baryon fluid cooling equations with the sigma proportional to v^-4 millicharged cross section (Munoz-Loeb-style treatment including relative bulk velocities and Coulomb heating of the DM subcomponent) coupled to a global-signal astrophysics model, exposing f_DM, epsilon, and m_phi as inputs and T21(z about 17) as output.

members.model_name: Z3 leptophilic Co-SIMP dark matter for global 21-cm cosmology
members.description: No public release of the Co-SIMP-modified RECFAST thermal-history and CLASS perturbation code implementing the DM + e -> DM + DM + e heat-exchange terms (parameters <sigma v>_2to3, alpha, sigma_int), so none of the 21-cm or CMB/BAO predictions can be reproduced.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-implement the paper's Co-SIMP energy-exchange terms as a public patch: add the 2-to-3 electron-coupled cooling term to the RECFAST/HyRec thermal equations and the sigma_int, alpha dependence to the CLASS baryon temperature and perturbation sector, validated against the paper's EDGES band and near-flat Planck/BAO posteriors.

members.model_name: Condensed-phase axion/ALP dark-matter cooling scenario
members.description: No public 21 cm thermal-history/global-signal code includes an axion-BEC hydrogen cooling term, so T_gas(z) and T_21(z) with the extra cooling cannot be computed end-to-end for comparison with EDGES-like profiles.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a parameterized extra-cooling term (amplitude, onset redshift, scaling) to a public global-signal code such as ARES or a RECFAST/21cmFAST-based thermal-history module, and expose (m_a, Omega_a/Omega_DM, z_cool) as inputs.

members.model_name: ULAP oscillon dark matter
members.description: No public 21 cm forest forward model and likelihood exists for this scenario: the pipeline from P(k) with an oscillon Poisson component to minihalo mass functions, absorption-line abundances, and a statistical comparison against (currently nonexistent) z~10 forest data is not implemented anywhere the card can point to, and the required high-redshift radio-loud background sources have not yet been observed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a 21 cm forest minihalo calculator (press-Schechter-style mass function from the modified P(k), minihalo optical-depth profiles as a function of T_IGM, line-abundance statistics) and wrap it as an SKA-era forecast likelihood, upgradable to a data likelihood once high-redshift radio-loud sources are detected.

members.model_name: Late-decay two-component millicharged dark matter model
members.description: No public thermal-history solver evolves a two-component dark sector with late Z1 -> chi chi decay after recombination sourcing a millicharged daughter population that cools baryons through v^-4 Coulomb-like scattering; the paper's ODE integration is private.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public DM-baryon temperature-evolution code (the Munoz-type millicharged 21cm cooling codes or CLASS with the dmeff/interacting-DM module) with a decay source term for n_chi(z) set by tau_Z1 and the Z1-2chi splitting, evolving T_b, T_chi, and the relative bulk velocity self-consistently.

members.model_name: Subpercent minicharged dark matter
members.description: The velocity-modulated 21-cm fluctuation observable has no forward model: computing T21_rms requires sampling the Maxwellian v_chi_b streaming-velocity distribution across patches inside a 21-cm semi-numerical code, which is not implemented for the minicharged-subcomponent cooling.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the patch-level thermal-history solver from gap_1 to 21cmFAST by tabulating T_b(z; v_chi_b) over the streaming-velocity distribution and generating T21 fluctuation maps and power spectra at z ~ 17.

members.model_name: ELDER self-interacting dark matter with 21-cm heating and cooling
members.description: No thermal-history solver combines velocity-dependent DM-baryon heat exchange with ELDER-specific 2->2 elastic self-scattering and 3->2 cannibal self-annihilation heating in the dark-sector temperature equations through cosmic dawn.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing public DM-baryon T_chi/T_b ODE solver (Munoz-Loeb-style cosmic-dawn code or the interacting-DM branch of 21cmFAST) with the 3->2 number-changing heating term and 2->2 self-thermalization, parameterized by m_chi, sigma0, n, and the two self-couplings.

members.model_name: Z3 semi-annihilating dark matter for global 21-cm cosmology
members.description: The modified RECFAST/CLASS implementation of Z3 semi-annihilation energy injection (sigma_int, f) and the accompanying excess radio-background parameterization used for the EDGES fit are not publicly released, so the 21-cm and CMB/BAO predictions cannot be recomputed.
members.proposed_resolution: Release or re-implement a public patch adding the SADM energy-injection term to the RECFAST/HyRec thermal equations and the sigma_int, f dependence to CLASS, together with the ARCADE-2-style radio-background module, validated against the paper's M_DM = 50 and 100 GeV EDGES curves and the Planck/BAO consistency result.

members.model_name: Subcomponent millicharged Dirac dark matter with neutrino annihilation
members.description: No maintained public code propagates the velocity-dependent (v^-4) millicharged-baryon scattering of a small subcomponent through gas thermal evolution to the cosmic-dawn 21 cm brightness temperature, including the baryon-DM relative-velocity distribution and consistency with the freeze-out-derived fraction.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt an existing baryon-DM thermal-evolution implementation (the Munoz-type coupled gas/DM temperature equations used in modified 21cmFAST/global-signal codes) to take (m_chi, epsilon, f_chi) from the freeze-out module and output T_gas(z) and the global 21 cm brightness temperature.

members.model_name: Sterile right-handed-neutrino dark matter from RHN oscillations
members.description: The full N1 momentum distribution from nonresonant RHN-RHN oscillation production is not derived or tabulated; the card gives only an approximate average momentum (p1/T about 2.8 with subsequent entropy redshifting), which is insufficient input for a Boltzmann transfer-function calculation and for a precise free-streaming bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the momentum-dependent density-matrix/Boltzmann equations for RHN oscillation production (extending a sterile-neutrino production code such as sterile-dm from the active-sterile Dodelson-Widrow source to the heavy-RHN oscillation source), tabulate f(p) including pre-QCD entropy dilution, and pass it to CLASS as an ncdm distribution.

members.model_name: Extra-dimensional sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No relic-abundance and momentum-distribution calculation exists for the full KK tower of sterile neutrinos: the paper only quotes single-mode Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller scalings, while the model requires summing production over many nearly degenerate KK modes with mode-number-suppressed mixings, which the paper explicitly leaves beyond scope.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public sterile-neutrino production Boltzmann code (e.g. the Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller solver in sterile-dm) to sum production over the KK tower with mode-dependent mixings theta_n and optional lepton asymmetry, outputting Omega_s and the nonthermal f(p) needed to normalize decay-line and WDM constraints.

members.model_name: A4 Froggatt-Nielsen seesaw sterile-neutrino warm dark matter model
members.description: No relic-production calculation is committed to for the keV sterile neutrino: the card uses the Dodelson-Widrow abundance relation only as a guideline, and no phase-space distribution f(p) is available, which is the required input for both the abundance and the free-streaming/Ly-alpha prediction.
members.proposed_resolution: Select and solve an explicit production mechanism (non-resonant DW, Shi-Fuller resonant, or freeze-in from a heavy scalar) with a public sterile-neutrino production solver such as the Venumadhav et al. sterile-dm code, outputting Omega_s and f(p) as functions of M_s and theta_s for the FN-predicted parameter region.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter with radiative decay
members.description: No production-specific momentum distribution f(q) is available for this card: the paper lists oscillation, Higgs-decay, and low-scale-inflaton production but tabulates no distribution, so the production-aware transfer function needed for the free-streaming observable cannot be computed for the non-oscillation mechanisms.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute f(q) with the public sterile-dm code for the oscillation (Dodelson-Widrow/Shi-Fuller) channel, derive the decay-kinematics f(q) for Higgs and inflaton production analytically, and feed each into the CLASS ncdm module to produce tabulated transfer functions over (m_s, production mechanism).

members.model_name: Effective A4 model with one keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter state
members.description: The relic-production mechanism for the added keV sterile state is unspecified (Dodelson-Widrow is only a guideline), so neither Omega_s nor the momentum distribution f(p) needed for the transfer-function cutoff is actually computed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Fix a production scenario compatible with the effective A4 setup (non-resonant DW, resonant production, or scalar freeze-in as the card's allowed-regions text suggests) and solve the production Boltzmann equation with an existing public sterile-neutrino production code, delivering Omega_s(m_s, theta_s) and f(p).

members.model_name: Super-weak U(1) sterile neutrino dark matter (freeze-in variant)
members.description: The nonthermal N1 phase-space distribution f(q) from out-of-equilibrium Z-prime production and decay has not been derived; the paper solves only integrated abundances, so the warmth of the keV freeze-in spectrum and its half-mode scale are unknown and all structure-formation statements on the card are 'unknown'.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the unintegrated Boltzmann equation for f(q,T) with the Z-prime decay source term (as done in existing sterile-neutrino codes like sterile-dm for the DW/Shi-Fuller cases), then feed the resulting f(q) into CLASS's ncdm sector to obtain the transfer function and half-mode mass.

members.model_name: Gauge B-L radiative neutrino mass multipartite dark matter
members.description: The production mechanism, relic fraction, and momentum distribution f(p) of the keV S prime warm component are underived: the card gives only a seesaw-suppressed mass and loop-suppressed active mixing, with distribution_function_available unknown, so its warm-dark-matter phenomenology has no defined input.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive S prime production in this model (Dodelson-Widrow-like production through the loop-induced active mixing and/or freeze-in via the B-L gauge boson), solve the momentum-dependent Boltzmann equation with a sterile-dm-style code to obtain the warm fraction and f(p), and map the result to a thermal-equivalent transfer-function cutoff.

members.model_name: U(1)_R lepton-number model with keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The relic production mechanism and momentum distribution f(p) of the sterile-neutrino neutralino eigenstate are not calculated anywhere on the card, so neither the relic abundance nor the warm-DM free-streaming cutoff can be evaluated for the U(1)_R model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dominant production channel in the U(1)_R setup (non-resonant Dodelson-Widrow oscillation production at the quoted mixing, checked with the public sterile-dm code, plus any freeze-in through the Higgs/neutralino sector), output the abundance and f(p), and feed the distribution to CLASS's ncdm sector for the transfer function.

members.model_name: Bulk-shortcut sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The cosmological evolution of the brane-shortcut parameter epsilon(T) (equivalently E_res(T)) under early-Universe density and temperature is only asserted qualitatively; without this function neither BBN equilibration nor resonant sterile production can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive epsilon(T) from the paper's brane-fluctuation metric in a radiation-dominated FRW background, publishing a parameterized E_res(T) that can be fed into a quantum kinetic production calculation.

members.model_name: A4 split-seesaw keV sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The card provides no production mechanism, relic abundance calculation, or momentum distribution for the keV sterile neutrino (relic fraction unknown, f(p) not provided, structure-formation entries all unknown), so the predicted X-ray flux normalization, which scales with the N1 abundance, and any warm-dark-matter assessment are undetermined.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the N1 abundance and phase-space distribution for the split-seesaw parameter point, e.g. compute Dodelson-Widrow production at the bounded mixing with the public sterile-dm transport code or derive the model's non-thermal production channel (heavy-state/flavon decays), then record Omega_s h^2 and f(p) so the X-ray flux and free-streaming scale can be normalized.

members.model_name: Sterile-neutrino dark matter from Higgs-singlet decays
members.description: The sterile-neutrino momentum distribution is only available as the paper's approximate near-thermal spectrum (p_s ~ 0.76 T after dilution); no computed f(p) combines the S-decay population with the subdominant oscillation component and exact g_*(T) redshifting, which the free-streaming recast needs as input.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the Boltzmann equation with the S -> NN decay source term plus the Dodelson-Widrow oscillation term (extending a public sterile-neutrino production code such as sterile-dm with a decay source) to output f(p) over the (h, m_S, theta, m_s) space.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario A
members.description: The sterile-neutrino production momentum distribution f_N(p) for the FN scenario (nonthermal production or thermal production with entropy dilution from N_2/N_3 decays) is not derived, so the free-streaming cutoff cannot be computed and thermal-WDM/Dodelson-Widrow bounds cannot be recast onto this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the sterile-neutrino production Boltzmann equation for the chosen FN-compatible production history (e.g. adapt the public sterile-dm/DW-production framework or a scalar/heavy-state decay spectrum calculation, including entropy dilution from heavier sterile decays) to obtain f_N(p), then feed it to a CLASS/CAMB ncdm module as a tabulated distribution.

members.model_name: Froggatt-Nielsen keV sterile-neutrino dark matter, Scenario B
members.description: No momentum distribution f_N(p) has been computed for the keV FN sterile neutrino under any concrete production scenario (Dodelson-Widrow, resonant, or thermal-plus-entropy-dilution) consistent with the (4,1,0) charge assignment, so the Boltzmann input for structure constraints is undefined.
members.proposed_resolution: For the mixing angles implied by the FN textures, compute f_N(p) with a public sterile-neutrino production code (e.g. the Venumadhav et al. sterile-dm solver for non-resonant/resonant production, or a diluted-thermal spectrum for the entropy-dilution branch) and tabulate it as a CLASS ncdm psd input.

members.model_name: Fuzzy dark matter with repulsive quartic self-interaction
members.description: No nonlinear structure-formation calibration exists for repulsive quartic self-interacting fuzzy dark matter: the paper's bound uses linear observables only, and the card records unknown halo/subhalo mass-function effects with simulation_calibrated no, so nonlinear probes (Lyman-alpha, subhalo counts, solitonic cores with repulsive pressure) cannot be exploited.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Schrodinger-Poisson (or Gross-Pitaevskii-Poisson, including the quartic term) simulations over a grid of (m, lambda) to calibrate the halo mass function, soliton-halo relation, and small-scale power suppression, and fit a transfer-function/HMF parameterization usable by Lyman-alpha emulators and subhalo likelihoods.

members.model_name: Extreme axion dark matter with cosine potential fluid modeling
members.description: No hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha forest simulations or emulator exist for cosmologies with tachyonically enhanced small-scale power near the axion Jeans scale; existing Lyman-alpha emulators and likelihoods are calibrated on CDM-like or power-suppressed (WDM/fuzzy-axion) spectra, so the eBOSS comparison remains a qualitative linear-MPS estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha simulations with initial conditions from the extreme-axion transfer functions over the m_a = 1e-23 to 1e-22.5 eV, hilltop-angle, and axion-fraction grid, and build a flux-power-spectrum emulator usable with the eBOSS/DESI Lyman-alpha likelihoods.

members.model_name: Minimal atomic dark matter
members.description: No nonlinear structure-formation pipeline exists for minimal atomic dark matter: there are no simulations spanning the (f_D, r_DAO, alpha_D, m_pD, m_eD) space that evolve the DAO-suppressed initial conditions with dissipative dark-atom cooling, so the Lyman-alpha forest, subhalo mass function, halo-shape, and dark-disk observables warned about for f_D > 0.1 cannot be evaluated and the high-f_D posterior remains unconstrained at small scales.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body plus hydrodynamical simulations initialized with class_twinadm transfer functions, adding a dark-atom cooling/chemistry module for the dissipative component; calibrate an ETHOS-style halo and subhalo mass-function parameterization and a Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator on the runs, then recast existing Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite/SHMF likelihoods onto (f_D, r_DAO).

members.model_name: Two-body decaying cold dark matter with warm and dark-radiation daughters
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation for this two-body DCDM-to-WDM-plus-DR scenario is uncalibrated (simulation_calibrated: no), so full-shape weak-lensing likelihoods and the Lyman-alpha flux-power test cannot be applied; only linear P(k) and compressed S8 priors are usable.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with late-time decays imparting the epsilon-dependent velocity kick to daughter particles across the (Gamma^-1, epsilon) plane, calibrate a nonlinear P(k) prescription or emulator on them, and couple it to hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha flux-power modeling so full weak-lensing and Lyman-alpha likelihoods replace the compressed S8 priors.

members.model_name: Mirror matter dark matter with cooler mirror sector
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation with dissipative, chemically complex mirror baryons has never been simulated (simulation_calibrated: unknown), leaving halo mass functions, mirror-object formation, and the nonlinear input to Lyman-alpha and reionization predictions uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run cosmological hydrodynamic simulations including mirror-baryon cooling and mirror atomic chemistry (adapting existing dissipative-dark-sector simulation frameworks) to calibrate nonlinear clustering and reionization-era predictions for cool mirror sectors with x < 0.2.

members.model_name: ETHOS-4 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: No hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha forest recast exists for the ETHOS cutoff shape: the card states the DAO/damped cutoff differs from thermal WDM so WDM flux-power limits cannot be applied directly, and the paper performed no hydrodynamical simulations, leaving the strongest external constraint on r_DAO and r_SD unevaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a grid of hydrodynamical simulations (or extend an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator) with ETHOS transfer functions spanning the DAO amplitude and damping scale, then evaluate the flux power spectrum against high-resolution quasar-spectra likelihoods to set cutoff bounds specific to oscillatory ETHOS-type suppression.

members.model_name: Non-thermal sterile hot dark matter from inflaton or moduli decay
members.description: The nonlinear response to the nonthermal hot sterile fraction is uncalibrated (halo and subhalo mass-function effects unknown, simulation_calibrated: no), and the route caveat notes that exact small-scale recasts such as Lyman-alpha are not possible; existing Lyman-alpha emulators are calibrated on thermal WDM or massive-neutrino histories, not this broader, higher-peaked f(q).
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body/hydrodynamical simulations with the decay-produced f(q) as a fractional non-cold species over the preferred (m_eff, Delta N_eff) region to calibrate the nonlinear and Lyman-alpha flux response, or validate a mapping of the distribution's first moments onto existing massive-neutrino/WDM emulator grids.

members.model_name: ETHOS-1 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: No hydrodynamical simulations tailored to the ETHOS-1 DAO/Silk-damped cutoff exist for the Lyman-alpha forest; the card states thermal-WDM limits cannot be applied directly because the cutoff shape differs, so the Lyman-alpha constraint on (a4, r_DAO, r_SD) cannot currently be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Lyman-alpha hydrodynamical simulations (or train an emulator such as a modified Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator) on ETHOS-class transfer functions with DAO features, mapping the flux power spectrum over the (a4, xi) plane for comparison to eBOSS/HIRES data.

members.model_name: ETHOS-2 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: No hydrodynamical simulations tailored to the ETHOS-2 DAO/Silk-damped cutoff exist for the Lyman-alpha forest; the card states thermal-WDM limits cannot be applied directly because the cutoff shape differs, so the Lyman-alpha constraint on (a4, r_DAO, r_SD) cannot currently be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Lyman-alpha hydrodynamical simulations (or train an emulator such as a modified Lyman-alpha flux-power emulator) on ETHOS-class transfer functions with DAO features, mapping the flux power spectrum over the (a4, xi) plane for comparison to eBOSS/HIRES data.

members.model_name: ETHOS-3 interacting dark-matter dark-radiation benchmark
members.description: The Lyman-alpha forest constraint on the ETHOS-3 cutoff cannot be applied because no hydrodynamical simulations or emulator exist for the oscillatory DAO/Silk-damped initial spectrum, whose cutoff shape differs from thermal WDM.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a grid of hydrodynamical Lyman-alpha simulations (or extend an existing WDM/nCDM flux-power emulator) over ETHOS damping parameters (r_DAO, r_SD, a4) and attach it to a standard Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood.

members.model_name: Late-time dark matter to dark radiation conversion (DMDR)
members.description: No nonlinear treatment of the DMDR matter power spectrum exists: the card records simulation_calibrated no and unknown halo-scale effects, so weak-lensing analyses must discard nonlinear scales (the source's linear-only DES scale cuts) and Lyman-alpha or thermal-SZ recasts of the conversion history cannot be performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations with the DMDR background and a decaying-CDM-style energy transfer (extending existing decaying-dark-matter simulation pipelines) to calibrate a halofit/emulator correction for P_nl(k,z) as a function of converted fraction and rate, unlocking full-scale DES/KiDS and Lyman-alpha recasts.

members.model_name: Generalized ultra-light axion-like cosmological field
members.description: The generalized effective-fluid approximation (w(a), c_s^2(k,a)) for n=2 and n=3 potentials is uncalibrated against exact Klein-Gordon evolution near the transition redshift z_c at the precision of current CMB data, so f_zc posteriors carry an unquantified approximation error.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement exact linear Klein-Gordon evolution (or a Passaglia-Hu-style accurate effective-fluid scheme) alongside the fluid module in AxiCLASS/modified CLASS for n=1,2,3, map the C_ell and P(k) error as a function of z_c and n, and correct or bound the fluid-based constraints.

members.model_name: Line-motivated resonantly produced sterile neutrino N1 dark matter
members.description: The N1 momentum distribution, required lepton asymmetry L_6, and derived half-mode mass differ depending on whether Venumadhav16 or Ghiglieri15 production code is used and on the CAMB vs CLASS solver choice, and the paper shows thermal-relic WDM mappings can misestimate the true N1 power spectrum; no calibrated cross-code error budget exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform a controlled code-comparison of the Venumadhav16 and Ghiglieri15 production calculations (fixed neutrino-interaction rates, fixed cosmology) coupled identically to CLASS ncdm input, publish the resulting (m_s, sin^2 2theta, L_6) -> f(p) and M_hm tables with quantified systematic bands, and deprecate the thermal-WDM equivalent-mass shortcut for resonant spectra.

members.model_name: Down-scattering excited Dark Matter
members.description: The BBN bound on the late-decaying charged X1 is applied only as quoted lifetime windows; the detailed injection depends on the decay products and on charged bound-state Li-6 catalysis, which the card flags as uncomputed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the X1 electromagnetic/hadronic injection and catalyzed BBN with an existing photodisintegration/BBN-injection code (ACROPOLIS-class plus a CBBN bound-state treatment), scanning (m_X1, tau_X1, Omega_X1) to replace the quoted tau < 10^5 s window with a model-specific bound.

members.model_name: A4 Dirac-neutrino FIMP dark matter
members.description: The BBN constraint on the eta lifetime is encoded only as a crude decay-before-one-second timing cut with a Y >~ 10^-13 bound; no energy-injection BBN calculation calibrated to this model's hadronic/electromagnetic decay products exists, so the true lower edge of the viable coupling window is uncertain.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a public BBN energy-injection code (ACROPOLIS-class) with the eta abundance, lifetime, and branching into visible-sector by-products from the Higgs-portal coupling to replace the one-second timing approximation with a light-element likelihood bound on Y.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5) non-universal-Higgs neutralino dark matter
members.description: The scan's relic-density selection and mass/B-physics filters are WMAP-era; Planck relic density, the 125 GeV Higgs mass, and current LHC sparticle and flavor limits were never applied, so the surviving parameter regions are not calibrated to current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the flipped-SU(5) scan with a modern toolchain (Isajet or SoftSUSY plus DarkSUSY/micrOMEGAs, FeynHiggs-class Higgs-mass calculation) imposing the Planck Omega h^2 band, m_h = 125 GeV within theory uncertainty, and current LHC and flavor constraints before reusing any benchmark.

members.model_name: Flipped SU(5)-UH neutralino dark matter
members.description: The scan's relic-density selection and mass/B-physics filters are WMAP-era; Planck relic density, the 125 GeV Higgs mass, and current LHC sparticle and flavor limits were never applied, so the surviving parameter regions are not calibrated to current data.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the flipped-SU(5)-UH scan with a modern toolchain (Isajet or SoftSUSY plus DarkSUSY/micrOMEGAs, FeynHiggs-class Higgs-mass calculation) imposing the Planck Omega h^2 band, m_h = 125 GeV within theory uncertainty, and current LHC and flavor constraints before reusing any benchmark.

members.model_name: MSM sterile-neutrino WDM from heavier-field decay
members.description: The Press-Schechter halo mass function used for the delayed-structure observable is not simulation-calibrated for this variant's decay-produced cutoff spectrum (card marks simulation_calibrated: partial and caveats that PS needs calibration).
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate a sharp-k/smooth-k mass-function barrier against a small suite of N-body simulations run with decay-produced transfer functions over z=4-12, and release the fit as a drop-in replacement for the PS step.

members.model_name: Interacting scalar-field dark matter and early dark energy
members.description: The matter-power observable extends to mildly nonlinear weak-lensing and galaxy-clustering scales, but the card records halo and subhalo mass-function effects as unknown with no simulation calibration, so no nonlinear prescription exists for the coupled SFDM-EDE matter power spectrum needed for S8-type comparisons.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate the nonlinear response by running N-body simulations initialized with the modified-CLASS linear spectra and scale-dependent growth for representative (m_phi, beta, f_EDE) points, and fit a halofit/HMcode-style correction or emulator valid over the sampler's prior range.

members.model_name: Symmetric ultraheavy atomic dark matter freeze-out through rearrangement
members.description: Existing dark-acoustic-oscillation Boltzmann extensions (ETHOS/atomic-DM CLASS variants) have not been mapped to this model's parameter point (ultraheavy atoms, residual millicharged dark-electron subcomponent, dark-photon radiation temperature), so the linear transfer function and any DAO signature remain unquantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Map (m_A, alpha_D, xi) to the ETHOS or atomic-dark-matter CLASS parameterization, run the modified Boltzmann code to obtain the matter transfer function, and verify recovery of CDM when the dark-radiation coupling is negligible as the route's validation test requires.

members.model_name: Jovian captured GeV dark matter toy model
members.description: The benchmark spin-dependent cross section near 1e-24 cm^2 sits in the strongly interacting regime where naive rescaling of direct-detection and cosmic-ray-boosted limits fails; no public attenuation/saturation treatment covers a 1-4 GeV subcomponent with f_DM around 1e-4 at such large cross sections.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing Earth-shielding/attenuation code (verne or DaMaSCUS class) to spin-dependent scattering at subcomponent fractions and geometric-saturation cross sections, and re-derive the boosted-DM and underground-detector exclusion contours for this regime.

members.model_name: Kinetically coupled early dark energy and scalar field dark matter
members.description: The S8/structure-growth comparison uses only the linear matter power spectrum with no nonlinear prescription calibrated for SFDM suppression plus dark-energy drag (simulation_calibrated: no); standard halofit-type corrections are calibrated on CDM and may misestimate the DES-Y3 comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate a nonlinear correction for KCS cosmologies, e.g. by running N-body simulations with the KCS linear transfer function and modified growth (or adapting an FDM-aware emulator) and fitting a halofit-style modification valid at the m_phi ~ 1e-22 eV suppression scale.

members.model_name: Multiple Kaluza-Klein dark matter from stringy throats
members.description: No phase-space distribution f_i(p) has been derived for the hidden-throat KK populations: each throat can be thermal or non-thermal, relativistic or non-relativistic at production, and the card explicitly leaves f_of_p_or_q, free_streaming_length, and velocity_dispersion_today unspecified, so the cold/warm/hot classification of each component cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive per-throat momentum distributions by solving the hidden-sector thermal history: tunneling injection spectrum, intra-throat self-interaction thermalization, and freeze-out of the lightest KK mode, parameterized by (h_i, M_i, m_X_i, T_in,tunn); output f_i(q) tables plus derived free-streaming lengths and a validity-flagged thermal-WDM equivalent mass per component.

members.model_name: 5D U(1) repulsive-axion ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: No rigorous mapping exists from the coherent-field repulsive quartic to particle-like self-interaction cross-section bounds, so Bullet-Cluster-type limits (con-bullet-cluster-self-interaction) can only be applied through an approximate contact-repulsion recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective momentum-transfer opacity of a coherent condensate with quartic lambda4_eff in cluster-merger conditions and recast published Bullet Cluster sigma/m limits into the (m, f, lambda4_eff) plane.

members.model_name: Landau-Ginzburg self-interacting scalar dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the field-theoretic self-interaction (lambda_4 phi^4 or X^2/Lambda^4) to an effective cluster-scale scattering bound is only approximate and un-normalized, so the Bullet-Cluster-style collisionless constraint cannot be applied quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the normalized conversion from the coherent-field effective pressure to an equivalent sigma/m (or drag term) relevant to merging clusters, then recast published cluster-merger self-interaction bounds onto lambda_4 and Lambda.

members.model_name: Mirrored GUT composite asymmetric dark baryon model
members.description: No dark-sector spectrum calculator exists for the confining SU(3)_D sector: dark baryon and dark meson masses as functions of Lambda_QCD_prime and dark quark masses are only estimated by scaling from visible QCD, which is inadequate for quantitative portal and self-interaction predictions.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark hadron spectrum by rescaling existing lattice-QCD results for the required quark-mass ratios (or run dedicated Nf=2 SU(3) lattice spectroscopy), and package it as a spectrum module mapping (Lambda_QCD_prime, dark quark masses) to dark baryon/meson masses.

members.model_name: keV sterile-neutrino dark matter with light-scalar neutrino self-interaction after quintessential inflation
members.description: The supernova constraint on the MeV-scale scalar coupled to active neutrinos is only flagged, not recast: no derived exclusion exists for the benchmark m_phi ~ 100 MeV and coupling lambda in this model's parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast published SN1987A neutrino self-interaction and scalar-emission analyses into the (m_phi, lambda) plane of this model, including trapping and free-streaming regimes, and store the resulting exclusion contour as a registry constraint table.

members.model_name: SU(3) center-stabilized scalar dark matter
members.description: The chi self-interaction cross section per mass from the Z3-preserving cubic and quartic scalar potential terms has not been derived, so the small-scale-structure observable has no computable prediction (structure_formation fields are all unknown and no route step produces sigma/m).
members.proposed_resolution: Derive sigma_T/m for chi-chi scattering from the post-breaking scalar potential (cubic phi^3 and gauge-boson exchange contributions) as a function of g_D and the scalar couplings, then map it onto existing SIDM halo-shape and cluster-merger bounds on sigma/m.

members.model_name: Density-dependent baryon-DM cooling interaction model
members.description: Cluster-merger constraints exist only as constant-cross-section SIDM bounds; the model-specific mapping from Bullet-Cluster-type observations to the baryon-DM energy-exchange rate Gamma with density-dependent sigma_int(n,v) and realistic cluster baryon fractions has not been derived, so the quoted 0.5-2 cm^2/g scale cannot be applied.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the per-passage energy-exchange integral for a merging cluster with the model's sigma_int(n,v) evaluated on observed gas-density and velocity profiles of Bullet-like systems, and calibrate the resulting bound with a small set of idealized merger simulations including the drag term.

members.model_name: Light Self-Interacting Dark Matter (LSIDM) model
members.description: No dedicated CMB/N_eff treatment exists for the model's neutrino-dominated energy injection: the quoted Planck s-wave annihilation bound uses visible-channel f_eff, while Z' -> nu nu injection near recombination and its N_eff imprint for an MeV-scale mediator coupled to active neutrinos have not been computed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the effective f_eff for the model's branching-weighted final states using Slatyer's transfer functions for the subdominant visible component, and evaluate the N_eff shift from MeV-scale Z'-neutrino interactions with a CLASS run modified for neutrino self-interaction/heating, then apply the Planck injection and N_eff likelihoods.

members.model_name: Non-Abelian WIMP multiplet dark matter with dark gluon radiation
members.description: The model-specific DM-dark-gluon momentum-transfer collision term (with the milli-weak non-Abelian coupling and self-interacting, zero-viscosity dark radiation) has not been derived and mapped onto a Boltzmann-solver parameterization, so CMB spectra and the matter power suppression cannot be computed beyond the order-of-magnitude growth argument.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive Gamma_DM-DR(T) for the non-Abelian dark-gluon bath, map it onto the ETHOS a_n coefficients, and implement it in an ETHOS-modified CLASS with the dark radiation treated as a perfect fluid (self-interacting, no free-streaming) to output CMB and P(k).

members.model_name: Late-decay self-interacting dark matter production mechanism
members.description: The momentum distribution f(q) of the decay-produced SIDM component and its free-streaming or transfer-function imprint are not derived (distribution_function_available and free_streaming_length are unknown/null), so the linear perturbation treatment of the daughter species is incomplete.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the decay-produced phase-space distribution from the two-body S -> SIDM kinematics as a function of tau_S and the symmetry-breaking parameter, and feed it into the CLASS extension of gap_1 as a non-cold daughter distribution (analogous to non-thermal WDM treatments of decay-produced dark matter).

members.model_name: Relativistic Bose-Einstein condensate scalar dark matter cosmology
members.description: The condensation and collapse rates (Gamma, Gamma') coupling the uniform boson gas, BEC, and localized dark-matter components are fixed purely phenomenologically; without a derivation from the scalar Lagrangian and gravitational-condensation microphysics, the three-component background history and the epoch of first collapse cannot be predicted, only parameterized.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the condensation rate from gravitational-relaxation/kinetic theory of the self-interacting scalar (condensation timescale as a function of m, lambda, and density) and the collapse rate from the paper's own instability analysis, replacing the free rates with functions of (m, lambda) that close the background equations.

members.model_name: Cold natural hidden-sector confinement dark matter
members.description: The card's only route stops at reading the card itself: no forward model maps (xi_i, Lambda_i, m_phi) to any concrete observable such as the small-scale-structure signature the observable channel names, glueball/dark-baryon self-interaction cross sections, or residual dark-radiation Delta N_eff from unconfined hidden sectors.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the model's transfer function and free-streaming scale for the cold composite relic (expected near-CDM given xi_i << 1), the self-interaction cross section sigma/m ~ Lambda_i^-3 for glueballs, and the Delta N_eff contribution of non-confining sectors, then encode these as proper observables and route steps checkable against CLASS/ETHOS-style pipelines and Planck N_eff bounds.

members.model_name: Confined colored relic dark matter
members.description: The stable composite spectrum, abundance fractions f_i, and residual self-interaction cross sections of the surviving H_X hadrons and quarkonia are not derived, so halo-scale self-interaction predictions cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the heavy-light hadron spectrum and low-energy H_X-H_X scattering lengths from the Cornell-potential model (or dark-sector chiral effective theory) as functions of m_X, m_q, Lambda_D, and map to sigma/m for comparison with SIDM halo constraints.

members.model_name: PQ Dirac-neutrino model with scalar WIMP and axion dark matter
members.description: The axion relic abundance from topological defects (strings/domain walls) in this DFSZ-like model is not computed, so the Omega_a h^2 versus f_a mapping — and hence the allowed scalar WIMP fraction — is only known in the misalignment-only limit.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt published string-network simulation calibrations of axion emission and implement the model's post-inflationary scenarios in a public axion-abundance calculator (e.g. extend MiMeS with a defect-contribution parameterization) so the axion fraction can be scanned jointly with the scalar sector.

members.model_name: Generalized three-Higgs-doublet astrophobic QCD axion dark matter
members.description: Thermal axion production rates across the QCD crossover (pion/kaon scattering versus quark-gluon rates) are method-dependent in exactly the low-f_a regime the astrophobic construction targets, leaving an uncontrolled systematic on T_d and Delta N_eff.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt continuous QCD-crossover rate interpolations informed by chiral perturbation theory validity limits and lattice-informed treatments (as developed in the recent thermal-axion literature), and propagate the rate-scheme spread as a systematic band on the predicted Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Axion rotation Poltergeist dark matter
members.description: The kinetic-misalignment abundance relation C m_a Y_theta = 0.44 eV carries an undetermined order-one coefficient C (set to 1 as reference), so the axion dark-matter abundance and hence the (m_a, Y_theta) mapping is uncalibrated at the O(1) level.
members.proposed_resolution: Determine C by numerically evolving the rotating axion field through the transition from rotation to oscillation (lattice or homogeneous field simulation of the kinetic-misalignment capture into the potential minima), scanned over the relevant m_a, f_a, Y_theta range, and publish the fitted C(m_a Y_theta) calibration.

members.model_name: Axion-like scalar dark matter miniclusters
members.description: Present-day ScaM survival is estimated only by analogy with axion-minicluster stellar-disruption simulations, which the card notes may not transfer to generic ScaM profiles with different tidal resilience.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun stellar-encounter disruption Monte Carlo simulations (2011.05377-style) using ScaM density profiles from the collapse simulations, producing a survival fraction S(M_ScaM, rho_ScaM, orbit) calibration table for the lensing recast.

members.model_name: variant axion model with domain-wall-safe PQ charges
members.description: The SN 1987A axion-nucleon bound entering the fit is explicitly indicative (g_ap^2 + g_an^2 < 3.6e-19) with large nuclear-medium and supernova-simulation uncertainties, so the upper edge of the allowed meV window is not a calibrated constraint for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast modern SN 1987A axion-emissivity calculations (state-of-the-art nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung rates with medium corrections, applied to current core-collapse simulation profiles) into a coupling-space likelihood or bound with quantified uncertainty bands for the variant-axion g_ap/g_an ratios.

members.model_name: Fibre-inflation open-string QCD axion dark matter
members.description: The favored ultralocal case has PQ symmetry unbroken during inflation, so the QCD-axion relic abundance at f_QCD ~ 5e10 GeV receives post-inflationary contributions from axion string and domain-wall decay; the card provides no calibrated abundance calculation beyond the misalignment estimate, so the claim that this axion accounts for all dark matter cannot be evaluated quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Combine the standard realignment abundance formula with published axion-string-network simulation results (emission-spectrum calibrations from large-scale field-theory simulations) to build an Omega_a(f_QCD, theta_i) module for the post-inflationary scenario, applied at the paper's f_QCD ~ 5e10 GeV benchmark.

members.model_name: Fragmenting non-periodic-potential axion-like dark matter
members.description: The minihalo mass function relies on modified Press-Schechter assumptions applied to resonance-enhanced, non-Gaussian small-scale spectra without N-body calibration, so halo abundances, collapse redshifts, and profiles carry uncontrolled uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Run zoom-in N-body simulations seeded with the lattice-generated spectra (as done for axion miniclusters) to calibrate the mass function, concentration-mass relation, and survival of the dense minihalos against the Press-Schechter predictions.

members.model_name: Ultralight axion fuzzy dark matter with instanton potential and temperature-dependent mass
members.description: The mapping between solitonic core sizes and the linear suppression scale is calibrated by Schroedinger-Poisson simulations only for the standard constant-mass fuzzy-DM cutoff; the paper notes this relation shifts when the mass is temperature dependent, leaving core-based constraints uncalibrated for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of Schroedinger-Poisson halo simulations initialized with the delayed-oscillation transfer functions to recalibrate the core-halo mass relation as a function of the mass-turn-on index n.

members.model_name: Hadronic axion hot dark matter in the hadronic axion window
members.description: The thermal_abundance step relies on the 1998 pion-nucleon scattering estimate, whose chiral-perturbation-theory rates are uncalibrated near the QCD crossover where an f_a around 1e6 GeV axion decouples, so Omega_a and rho_a/rho_nu at BBN carry uncontrolled systematic uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt modern smooth-interpolation axion-pion thermalization rates across the QCD crossover (post-2021 recalculations of the axion production rate) and tabulate n_a/s versus f_a for use in the BBN and structure steps, validating against the primary paper's 0.1-0.2 Omega_a benchmark.

members.model_name: Geometric-baryogenesis QCD axion cold dark matter
members.description: The relic abundance uses only the leading analytic misalignment scaling; the temperature-dependent axion mass from lattice-QCD topological susceptibility and anharmonicity corrections for order-one theta_osc are not applied, which shifts the predicted Omega_a at the tens-of-percent level exactly where the full-CDM benchmark lives.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the misalignment evolution numerically with the lattice-calibrated chi(T) axion mass (e.g. Borsanyi et al. susceptibility tables) and anharmonic correction factors, replacing the power-law scaling in the s2 step for benchmark points near theta_osc ~ 1.

members.model_name: Low-reheat invisible axion dark matter
members.description: The relaxed f_PQ upper bound of about 1e16 GeV rests on the primary paper's older temperature-dependent axion mass and analytic dilution approximations; the abundance has not been recalibrated with modern lattice-QCD topological susceptibility chi(T) in the low-reheat expansion history.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the misalignment calculation with a public solver supporting arbitrary expansion histories (e.g. MiMeS) using lattice-QCD chi(T), a matter-dominated reheating era with entropy injection, and anharmonic corrections, and update the f_PQ(T_RH, theta_1) contours on the card.

members.model_name: Millicharged dark matter subcomponent with L_mu-L_tau vector depletion
members.description: The L_mu-L_tau mediator parameter space (g_LmuLtau, m_Zprime) needed for the depletion annihilation to neutrinos is not confronted with existing bounds (neutrino trident production, Borexino, Delta N_eff from a light Z' coupled to neutrinos) in a form usable by the route; the mediator-specific constraint recast is missing.
members.proposed_resolution: Collect the published L_mu-L_tau exclusion curves (CCFR trident, Borexino, BBN/N_eff) as machine-readable bounds and overlay them on the (g_LmuLtau, m_Zprime) region that achieves f_DM ~ 0.3-2 percent via chi chi -> nu nu annihilation computed with a micrOMEGAs model file.

members.model_name: Coupled quintessence cold dark matter
members.description: The paper reports posteriors and Bayesian evidences but releases no chains or reusable likelihood products, so the route's validation test (recovering the reported constraints) can only be checked against published summary numbers rather than full posterior distributions.
members.proposed_resolution: Regenerate and publish MCMC chains for the qCDM stable branch with the reimplemented Boltzmann patch under the Planck+BAO+Pantheon+R19 data combination, archiving chains and evidence values for registry validation.

members.model_name: Coupled vacuum cold dark matter
members.description: No chains or reusable likelihood products are released for the coupled-vacuum scan, so route validation can only compare against published summary constraints rather than full posteriors.
members.proposed_resolution: Regenerate and archive MCMC chains and MCEvidence values for the coupled-vacuum branch under Planck+BAO+Pantheon+R19 using the reimplemented Boltzmann patch, for registry-level validation.

members.model_name: Leptophilic flavor-violating Zprime portal Majorana dark matter
members.description: The FeynRules/CalcHEP model files are described in the text but were only planned for upload, so the model definition step cannot currently be reproduced from a public artifact.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain or re-implement the FeynRules model (leptophilic flavor-violating Zprime plus Majorana chi) and publish the UFO/CalcHEP files on a model database so the micrOMEGAs and collider steps are reproducible.

members.model_name: Dark Sink freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The electron-recoil exclusion curves (PandaX, DAMIC-M, SENSEI, DarkSide, XENON1T) needed to close the direct-detection route are not packaged with the model: the paper overlays published limits, no data tables or detector likelihoods are provided, and the ultralight-mediator F_DM ~ 1/q^2 form-factor convention must be applied consistently.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the published DM-electron scattering limits in the light-mediator (F_DM = (alpha m_e/q)^2) convention from the experiments' data releases into a limit database interfaced with the FreezeIn code output, so sigma_e(m_DM) predictions are scored automatically.

members.model_name: Bimetric nonstandard-cosmology WIMP/FIMP dark matter
members.description: The primary paper's allowed-region contours in the <sigma v>-m_DM plane for selected deformation parameters and initial density ratios have not been digitized, so there is no quantitative validation target for a reimplementation of the relic-density and BBN-recovery recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the primary paper's allowed-region figures for a few benchmark (lambda, initial density ratio) choices and store them as validation curves against which the reimplemented pipeline's contours are compared.

members.model_name: N2HDM Full Dark Matter Phase
members.description: The paper's FDP scan results are not released as machine-readable products: no parameter-grid files, allowed-point samples, or digitized XENON1T/relic exclusion curves accompany the card, so registry-level evaluation requires re-running the full ScannerS + MicrOMEGAs + HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals scan from scratch.
members.proposed_resolution: Reproduce the scan with public ScannerS (N2HDM FDP phase), MicrOMEGAs 5.x two-component mode, and HiggsBounds/HiggsSignals over the nine listed input parameters, and export the parameter grid, component relic fractions, and rescaled SI cross sections as registry data products.

members.model_name: SO(10) non-universal-gaugino neutralino dark matter
members.description: The source is a conference paper providing no machine-readable scan output; the WMAP-allowed regions and exclusion contours for each SO(10) representation exist only as published figures, so validation tests (recovering the WMAP band and coannihilation diagonal) require re-running the scan from scratch.
