members.proposed_resolution: Regenerate the representation-by-representation scan with SOFTSUSY+micrOMEGAs over the card's input parameters (SO(10) representation, m0, m1/2, tan beta, sign(mu)) and archive the grid as machine-readable tables in the registry.

members.model_name: SU(2)_D isospin-charged gauge-boson dark matter
members.description: Benchmark parameter values and the viable (m_V+, mass-splitting, v_D) corridor exist only as figure-level information in the source paper; no tabulated benchmark points or cross-section tables are on the card, limiting reproducibility and validation of any reimplementation.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the paper's relic-density and direct-detection figures (or obtain author tables) into machine-readable benchmark points with (g_D, m_V+, m_V0/m_V+ - 1, v_D, theta_h, m_s) and target values, and store them as the route's validation_tests reference data.

members.model_name: Bino-higgsino-tempered singlino NMSSM dark matter
members.description: The paper's scan benchmark cards (SLHA input files for the blind-spot and coannihilation regimes) are not released, hindering validation of the registry pipeline against the published relic-density, sigma_SI, and branching-fraction benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct SLHA benchmark cards from the paper's quoted parameter values (e.g. the M1 ~ 90 GeV, sigma_SI ~ 1e-48 cm^2 blind-spot point) using NMSSMTools, and verify Omega h^2 and radiative branching fractions against the paper figures.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dynamical decay constant
members.description: The card itself is a recovery placeholder: observables, constraints, and the routing block are schema-preserving stubs (single placeholder ids, direct_detection channel assigned by default), so no genuine constraint extraction from the paper or related literature backs the routing.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the standard enrichment pipeline on the primary paper and citation set to produce real observable entries (isocurvature, relic density, haloscope coupling at f0/N ~ 1e10-1e11 GeV) and constraints before capability aggregation uses this card.

members.model_name: Nonthermal sub-keV light dark matter fraction from radiative decays
members.description: No implemented pipeline connects the parent decay (E_gamma = 1.59-2.22 MeV, tau ~ 2e4 s) to a nonthermal-nucleosynthesis code, so the predicted lithium reduction and its compatibility with deuterium is asserted from the injection window rather than computed; the card notes no BBN cascade code was run and likelihood_available is 'no'.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a public electromagnetic-injection BBN code such as ACROPOLIS over the (E_gamma, tau, f m_parent/m_DM) plane for monochromatic photon injection, and wrap the output in a light-element abundance likelihood (Li7, D/H) to replace the analytic window.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporation gravitational dark matter from first-order-phase-transition PBHs
members.description: No configured pipeline computes the Hawking-emitted phase-space distribution of a generic purely gravitationally coupled particle chi including greybody and spin factors for the light pre-BBN-evaporating PBHs of this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Configure BlackHawk (or an equivalent public greybody evaporation code) with an added massive BSM degree of freedom to output the chi yield and emitted momentum spectrum across the M_PBH, m_chi plane.

members.model_name: Mixed axion/axino dark matter for thermal leptogenesis
members.description: The BBN energy-injection constraint on the long-lived neutralino NLSP (lifetime, hadronic branching, abundance) is applied only by comparison to literature limit curves; no implemented pipeline computes light-element yields for the scanned PQMSSM points.
members.proposed_resolution: Wire the neutralino NLSP lifetime, abundance, and branching fractions from the spectrum calculation into an existing BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS to produce point-by-point light-element pass/fail and the allowed T_R window.

members.model_name: Decaying gravitino dark matter with right-handed-neutrino decay products
members.description: The BBN consistency of late gluino NLSP decay is judged only by the T_MSSM > 10 MeV rule of thumb; no public hadro-dissociation BBN likelihood covers hadronic energy injection from a 10-20 TeV gluino decaying to gluon plus gravitino.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS, which currently handles electromagnetic injection) with hadronic-cascade dissociation rates, or interface the Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi hadronic constraint tables, to compute light-element abundances as a function of gluino mass, abundance, and lifetime.

members.model_name: KSVZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: No BBN recast pipeline exists that takes the neutralino or stau NLSP lifetime, yield, and electromagnetic/hadronic decay spectra into axino final states and evaluates light-element constraints; the card records the BBN step as a recast never performed and no likelihood available.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the NLSP decay injection spectra for the neutralino-to-axino-photon/Z and stau-to-axino-tau channels and feed (tau_NLSP, Y_NLSP, spectra) into a public BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS, exposing the result as a likelihood over (tau_NLSP, Y_NLSP).

members.model_name: Antimatter macroscopic dark matter
members.description: The BBN helium-3 overproduction constraint is an order-of-magnitude scaling with no nuclear-network calculation; photofission tails, lithium production, and the full post-BBN annihilation-on-helium-4 chain are explicitly deferred by the paper.
members.proposed_resolution: Add anti-macro annihilation source terms (nucleon disintegration of 4He, hadronic and electromagnetic showers, photofission) to a public BBN network code such as AlterBBN or PRIMAT and compute 3He/H, D/H, and Li yields versus sigma_X/M_X for comparison with primordial-abundance data.

members.model_name: Exact-parity mirror-baryon dark matter thermodynamic model
members.description: No mirror-sector BBN network calculation exists to turn the computed T_prime(T) and mirror degrees of freedom into mirror helium and heavy-element abundances, which the card identifies as needed inputs for structure formation and for the DAMA/LIBRA mirror-heavy-element interpretation.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) to run the nuclear network at the mirror temperature T_prime = x*T with mirror baryon density beta*Omega_b and the modified expansion rate from both sectors, outputting mirror He-4 and metal abundances as functions of (x, beta).

members.model_name: Long-lived stau coannihilation neutralino dark matter scenario
members.description: No public catalyzed-BBN (CBBN) reaction network exists that includes stau-nucleus bound-state formation, internal-conversion Be7/Li7 destruction, and stau-He4 bound-state production of n, D, T, and Li6; existing CBBN networks are private modifications of standard BBN codes.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) with charged-relic bound-state formation rates and the internal-conversion and bound-state nuclear reaction rates from the CBBN literature, parameterized by (tau_stau, Y_stau, m_stau), and release it as a reusable module.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal self-interacting dark matter with light scalar mediator
members.description: The BBN constraint is applied only as a crude tau_phi < 1 s screen; no BBN network computation exists for an MeV-scale scalar decaying dominantly to active or sterile neutrinos in this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public BBN code (AlterBBN or PRIMAT) with energy injection from late phi decays to neutrinos, mapping the allowed (m_phi, tau_phi, branching) region into a light-element likelihood replacing the 1 s rule of thumb.

members.model_name: Vector Scotogenic HNL dark matter
members.description: No collider recast with detector simulation exists for the model's prompt same-flavor-dilepton-plus-MET signature or the near-degenerate long-lived charged-vector regime with soft or displaced leptons; acceptances are currently taken from source-quoted ATLAS/CMS contexts without simulation.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the UFO from the model-implementation gap, simulate vector-doublet pair production with MadGraph+Pythia+Delphes and recast ATLAS slepton-like SFOS+MET searches (e.g. via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis PADs) plus the CMS displaced-muon search, scanning tau_V across the near-degenerate regime.

members.model_name: Higgs portal to dark QED
members.description: No dedicated recast exists for displaced dark-photon decays from exotic Higgs production in this dark-QED model: mapping (epsilon, m_Aprime, y_X) to LLP or lepton-jet acceptance requires detector geometry and efficiency modeling for LHC main detectors and a MATHUSLA-style surface detector that has not been done for this Higgs mono-dark-photon channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model in a FeynRules/UFO file, generate exotic Higgs decays h -> chi chi + A' with MadGraph/Pythia, and recast through an existing LLP framework (e.g. the MATHUSLA acceptance maps and ATLAS/CMS displaced-lepton-jet efficiency parameterizations) to produce acceptance grids in (m_Aprime, epsilon, y_X).

members.model_name: KOTO two-scalar P dark matter
members.description: No public detector-acceptance simulation exists for the K_L -> S P, S -> pi0 P displaced two-scalar topology at KOTO (or its NA62 charged-kaon analogue): the signal acceptance depends on the S lifetime and decay-vertex distribution inside the KOTO fiducial volume, and without it the BM1-BM4 benchmarks cannot be quantitatively confronted with the kaon data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a fast Monte Carlo of the KOTO beamline and calorimeter geometry using the acceptance maps and single-event-sensitivity grids published by the KOTO collaboration, parameterized in (m_S, m_P, tau_S), and validate it against the K_L -> pi0 nu nubar acceptance the collaboration quotes.

members.model_name: Three-flavor chiral composite ADM with B-L portal
members.description: No production-and-acceptance simulation exists for visible displaced decays of the composite dark hadrons at MATHUSLA, FASER, SeaQuest, and LHCb/Belle-II: the card only transfers benchmarks from a related paper, and no event-level dark-shower model of this specific N_f=3 spectrum has been implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Encode the dark hadron spectrum and kinetic-mixing decay lengths in the Pythia Hidden Valley module, generate dark-shower events, and run detector acceptance recasts for the lifetime-frontier and fixed-target experiments at epsilon ~ 10^-4.

members.model_name: Emergent strong-CP vector dark matter
members.description: No collider recast exists for the higher-dimension spin-density operator coupling to G-Gtilde with heavy colored UV states; only an order-of-magnitude few-hundred-GeV estimate from generic monojet operators is available.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the effective operator (or a benchmark UV completion with heavy colored states) in a FeynRules/MadGraph model, simulate monojet plus missing-momentum production, and recast ATLAS/CMS monojet searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis to bound M_*.

members.model_name: Peccei-Quinn leptoquark-diquark mixed axion-WIMP dark matter
members.description: No collider recast (event generation, detector simulation, or cross-section grid) exists for the heavy KSVZ-quark and leptoquark/diquark cascade topologies decaying to Z2-odd scalars, so the LHC missing-energy observable has no quantitative reach or exclusion.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate signal events with MadGraph/Pythia from the gap_1 UFO and reinterpret existing squark-like jets-plus-MET and leptoquark searches with a recast framework such as CheckMATE or MadAnalysis, producing limits on m_Q and the colored-scalar masses versus branching ratios.

members.model_name: Lowest-energy higgson WIMP
members.description: No collider event simulation exists for higgson pair production via vector boson fusion; the ~1 fb HL-LHC estimate is transplanted from inert-doublet/double-Higgs studies without model-specific signal or background modeling.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the UFO model file exists (gap_1), run MadGraph plus Pythia and Delphes for VBF higgson pair production with missing-energy selections at 14 TeV and 3000 fb^-1 to produce a defensible cross section and significance estimate.

members.model_name: Neutrino self-interaction assisted sterile-neutrino freeze-in dark matter
members.description: No public forward-model exists for the FPF signature of the neutrinophilic mediator: missing-pT and apparent tau-neutrino event rates at FASER2/FLArE-like detectors are available only as the paper's projected reach contours, with no released event-level simulation or reusable likelihood (con_fpf_mediator_reach: likelihood_available partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Build an FPF event-rate pipeline convolving public far-forward LHC neutrino fluxes with mediator scattering cross sections, apply a parameterized FLArE/FASER2 detector response, and package a projected Poisson likelihood validated against the paper's 0.3-20 GeV mediator reach contours.

members.model_name: Inert-doublet scalar dark matter assisted by a Y=1 vector-like triplet lepton
members.description: No detector-level long-lived-particle recast exists for displaced decays of the doubly charged, singly charged, and neutral triplet leptons; benchmark c-tau values of 0.1-100 m require LHC displaced-vertex and MATHUSLA efficiency and background modeling that was not run.
members.proposed_resolution: Generate events in MadGraph/Pythia and apply published LHC displaced-vertex and MATHUSLA acceptance maps (or Delphes-based LLP efficiency parameterizations) over the M_N, lambda_N, mass-splitting grid to obtain displaced-vertex acceptances.

members.model_name: Thermal right-handed sneutrino dark matter in the F_D-term hybrid inflation model
members.description: The invisible-Higgs and SUSY-cascade collider signature has no event-level implementation: no benchmark event simulation, no recast against LHC invisible-Higgs branching limits, and no collider likelihood exists for the sneutrino-LSP final states.
members.proposed_resolution: Use the SARAH/UFO model files to simulate Higgs-to-sneutrino and cascade production in MadGraph, then recast current ATLAS/CMS invisible-Higgs branching-fraction limits and compressed-SUSY searches with CheckMATE or MadAnalysis.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal complex scalar thermal freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No public forward-model exists for the FPF signature: charged-current neutrino events with large missing transverse momentum and apparent tau-neutrino excesses at FASER2/FLArE-like detectors are only available as the paper's projected reach contours, with no released event-level simulation or reusable projected likelihood (con_fpf_mediator_reach is likelihood_available: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Build an FPF event-rate pipeline: convolve public far-forward LHC neutrino fluxes with mediator-production and scattering cross sections for this model, apply a parameterized FLArE/FASER2 detector response (hadronic energy resolution, missing-pT reconstruction), and package the result as a projected Poisson likelihood validated against the paper's 0.3-20 GeV reach contours.

members.model_name: Neutrino-portal Dirac fermion thermal freeze-out dark matter
members.description: No public forward-model exists for the FPF signature of the neutrinophilic mediator: charged-current events with large missing transverse momentum and apparent tau-neutrino excesses at FASER2/FLArE-like detectors are available only as the paper's projected reach contours, with no released event-level simulation or reusable likelihood (con_fpf_mediator_reach is likelihood_available: partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Build an FPF event-rate pipeline that convolves public far-forward LHC neutrino fluxes with the mediator scattering cross sections, applies a parameterized FLArE/FASER2 detector response (hadronic energy resolution, missing-pT discrimination), and packages a projected Poisson likelihood validated against the paper's 0.3-20 GeV mediator reach contours.

members.model_name: keV Miracle sterile neutrino from singlet Higgs decay
members.description: Lyman-alpha and satellite-count structure limits are calibrated for thermal WDM transfer functions, so the cooled nonthermal Higgs-decay distribution (p/T ~ 0.76 at low temperature) can only be constrained via the approximate thermal-equivalent-mass mapping, which the card flags as production dependent and shape-lossy precisely where the 7 keV benchmark sits near the m_WDM > 2.2-3.6 keV bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Evaluate the exact Higgs-decay transfer function with CLASS ncdm using the paper's closed-form f(x), then recast it directly through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator extended beyond thermal-WDM shapes (adding a transfer-function-shape parameterization such as alpha-beta-gamma fits), rather than relying on equivalent masses.

members.model_name: Self-interacting dark matter from late pseudo-WIMP decays
members.description: Lyman-alpha, halo-concentration, and cluster bounds on the daughter kick velocity are imported from plain decaying-CDM analyses; no constraint exists that is calibrated for daughters whose self-scattering suppresses free streaming, so the quoted mass-splitting ceilings are only conservative estimates.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast Lyman-alpha flux-power constraints (e.g. via an emulator-based decaying-DM analysis) including daughter self-interactions, using linear Boltzmann transfer functions from the extended DCDM code as input.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L low-reheating sterile neutrino production
members.description: Lyman-alpha and satellite structure limits are calibrated for thermal WDM, so the cooled nonthermal low-reheat distribution can only be compared through an approximate thermal-WDM-equivalent mapping borrowed from the keV Miracle case rather than a production-specific likelihood.
members.proposed_resolution: Once the derived f(p) is available, run CLASS ncdm to get the exact transfer function and recast it through an existing Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood or emulator extended to non-thermal transfer-function shapes (e.g. alpha-beta-gamma parameterization), together with satellite-count constraints.

members.model_name: fractional cold-plus-warm sterile neutrino dark matter
members.description: Lyman-alpha forest and Milky Way satellite constraints are calibrated on pure thermal-WDM transfer functions, so fractional cold-plus-warm sterile-neutrino suppression (shallower plateau, production-specific shape) can only be judged through an approximate thermal-equivalent-mass mapping the card flags as losing shape information.
members.proposed_resolution: Recalibrate the Lyman-alpha flux-power likelihood (and satellite-count/strong-lensing subhalo constraints) directly on CWDM transfer functions, either by extending existing hydrodynamic-simulation emulators with a two-parameter (f_WDM, k_fs) suppression template or by running a targeted CWDM simulation grid.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken fermionic FIMP with domain walls
members.description: The Lyman-alpha mass floor (m_DM > ~15 keV) is imported from a cited study assuming a different freeze-in momentum spectrum; no recast exists for this model's mixed UV/IR production histories, so the small-scale-structure constraint on the v_s-m_DM plane is not actually evaluable across parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the model-specific f(q) from gap_1 into CLASS as a non-cold relic to compute the linear transfer function, then apply the standard half-mode/WDM-equivalent mapping or an existing Lyman-alpha flux emulator to set the mass floor as a function of T_RH, Lambda_FI, and v_s.

members.model_name: Lepton-number-two ultralight scalar dark matter for neutrinoless double beta capture
members.description: The ultralight-scalar structure-formation bound on (m_phi, eta) is invoked but not computed: no transfer-function calculation is included, so the maximum allowed dark-matter fraction at m_phi ~ 1e-20 eV, where fuzzy-DM constraints are severe, is not quantified for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast existing ultralight-DM fraction constraints by running axionCAMB (or the CLASS ultralight-axion module) over the (m_phi, eta) plane and applying published CMB, Lyman-alpha, and subhalo bounds on the suppressed power spectrum, producing an eta_max(m_phi) curve for the registry.

members.model_name: Resonantly produced 7.1 keV sterile neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The mapping from the nonthermal resonant spectrum to nonlinear structure observables (halo/subhalo mass functions, Lyman-alpha flux power) is not simulation-calibrated; existing WDM constraints are calibrated on thermal-relic spectra and a thermal surrogate can misstate the warmness constraint.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the CLASS-computed transfer function for the resonant spectrum into a generalized suppression parameterization (e.g. the Murgia alpha-beta-gamma form), and calibrate against a small suite of N-body/hydro simulations so Lyman-alpha and Milky Way satellite likelihoods can be applied to non-thermal spectra.

members.model_name: Misaligned axion Chern-Simons condensate model
members.description: The structure-formation floor on the ultralight axion fraction (con_ultralight_axion_structure_floor) is only a generic review-level bound, not recast for this model's mass-fraction parameter space; the card's transfer-function shape is unknown so the mapping is not yet quantitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Run axionCAMB (or the ULA branch of CLASS) over the model's (m_a, axion fraction) grid and recast existing CMB plus Lyman-alpha ultralight-axion bounds onto the misalignment parameter space, since the condensate behaves as a standard ULA for structure formation.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with a dark photon-fermion nonlinear sector
members.description: The cosmological dark-fermion sector is only assumed: no production mechanism or relic-abundance calculation for the charged dark fermions is specified, so the early-universe dark-photon plasma mass that protects the axion abundance cannot be computed from model parameters (q, m_psi).
members.proposed_resolution: Specify and solve a dark-fermion production mechanism (e.g. freeze-in through the dark gauge coupling or gravitational production), derive the fermion number density and induced plasma frequency versus temperature, and verify the axion-survival condition across the m_a-f'_a plane together with the misalignment relic-density calculation.

members.model_name: Decaying super-heavy dark matter explanation of IceCube PeV neutrinos and baryon asymmetry
members.description: The baryogenesis sector has no microscopic decay model: the CP/baryon-violation parameter epsilon is a free phenomenological input with no Lagrangian-level derivation linking it to the same X decay operators that set the IceCube neutrino flux, so the joint neutrino-plus-baryogenesis explanation cannot be promoted beyond a consistency estimate or confronted with washout and sphaleron constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a minimal UV completion (e.g. B-violating X decay through heavy colored scalars with interfering tree and loop amplitudes), derive epsilon from its couplings, and solve the accompanying Boltzmann equations for washout so that the IceCube-fit (M_X, tau_X) and the Planck baryon density constrain one common parameter set.

members.model_name: Model I final-bound-state real scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: The C-to-Standard-Model portal is assumed but never specified, so the bound-state binding energies, transition rates, and resulting SM particle spectrum for the indirect-detection observable cannot be computed; no route step covers obs_model_i_final_state_spectrum.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a concrete portal (e.g. kinetic mixing of the light vector V with hypercharge), derive the B decay and level-transition rates, generate SM final-state spectra with PPPC4DMID or HDMSpectra, and compare to Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and CMB-injection likelihoods.

members.model_name: Model II final-bound-state complex scalar WIMP dark matter
members.description: The visible portal of the C sector is not completed in the model, so the SS*BV forbidden-DM indirect-detection signal cannot be turned into a predicted SM particle flux: no halo-environment rate, emission spectrum, or detector comparison exists for obs_model_ii_forbidden_indirect.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a concrete C/V-to-SM portal (e.g. kinetic mixing of V), compute the SS*BV rate at halo velocities and the V and bound-state decay spectra with PPPC4DMID or HDMSpectra, and recast against Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal and CMB energy-injection likelihoods.

members.model_name: Late-decoupling Lorentz-violating fermion dark-sector component
members.description: Linear perturbation theory for the coupled fermion-condensate system has never been derived: the effective sound speed and anisotropic stress of the late-decoupling fermion fluid near the k=b group-velocity transition, and the stability and isotropy of perturbations of the time-like Lorentz-violating condensate itself (flagged in vector_like_perturbation_stability_context), are both underived, so no growth or matter-power prediction can even be formulated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linearized equations for the chiral fermion fluid with dispersion omega(k) set by b_mu (yielding c_s^2(k,z) and the free-streaming behavior driven by the near-unity group velocity at the acceleration epoch) together with the condensate perturbation equations, and establish the ghost/gradient stability region in (m, b, coupling scale) before any data comparison.

members.model_name: Composite asymmetric techni-baryon dark matter from technicolor assisted leptogenesis
members.description: No benchmark technicolor implementation is specified: the techni-baryon S has unknown spin and statistics, no techni-hadron spectrum, and no technifermion charge assignments, so collider cross sections and even basic DM properties (form factors, self-interactions) cannot be computed for the recast step s4.
members.proposed_resolution: Define one or two explicit SU(N_TC) benchmark models (technifermion representations, charges, N_TC), compute the techni-hadron spectrum by scaled-up QCD or existing lattice results for the chosen representation, and implement the spectrum in a FeynRules/UFO model for MadGraph-based LHC recasting with tools like CheckMATE or SModelS.

members.model_name: U(1)_X dark-sector singlet-scalar phi0 dark matter
members.description: The nonthermal production mechanism required for phi0 to be all of dark matter in the diphoton-compatible region (m_phi0 above ~375 GeV, thermal relic orders of magnitude underabundant) is unspecified, so neither the relic abundance nor the resulting momentum distribution can be computed for the full-DM interpretation.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify and derive a concrete nonthermal channel consistent with the U(1)_X sector (e.g. late decay of the rho scalar, Z-prime, or vector-like fermions into phi0, or UV freeze-in through the Higgs portal), parameterize it by the parent lifetime and branching fraction, and solve the corresponding Boltzmann equations as an extension of the existing micrOMEGAs setup.

members.model_name: Nonlinear charged dark matter with K-mouflage screening
members.description: The microphysics is underspecified for early-universe evaluation: the nonlinear function L(Y,Z) is left arbitrary, the dark matter particle's spin/statistics are unspecified, and the asymmetric genesis mechanism setting the surviving charge density is explicitly deferred, so the relic abundance and any early-universe consistency checks cannot be computed from model parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a benchmark completion: choose an explicit L(Y,Z) (e.g. Born-Infeld-like) and a fermionic carrier, derive an asymmetric-dark-matter genesis giving the required charge density, and check early-universe dark-radiation and dark-recombination constraints for the massless dark photon.

members.model_name: Tsallis-statistics WIMP freeze-out
members.description: The framework specifies no concrete particle model (mediator, spin, annihilation final states), so no gamma-ray spectrum can be computed and the dwarf-spheroidal indirect-detection recast of the suppressed q0>1 cross-section targets cannot be performed.
members.proposed_resolution: Embed the Tsallis freeze-out in benchmark simplified models (e.g. s-wave annihilation to b bbar and tau+ tau-), generate spectra with standard tabulations (PPPC4DMID or MadDM), and recast against the combined Fermi-LAT/MAGIC dwarf-spheroidal likelihoods used as context in the card.

members.model_name: Long-range dark nuggets
members.description: The heating channel is under-specified for evaluation: the limits assume unspecified short-range scattering dominates energy deposition during transits (flagged high extrapolation risk), so the deposited energy cannot be computed from the stated Lagrangian L = g_n n n phi + g_X X phi alone.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nugget-nucleon energy-transfer cross section from an explicit constituent model (e.g. scalar-bound fermion nuggets with phi exchange), parameterize the deposition efficiency, and propagate it as an explicit parameter in the ignition calculation instead of the maximal-heating assumption.

members.model_name: Stable light fermion Higgs-portal dark matter in the five-dimensional weak-scale framework
members.description: The optional weakly gauged fermion-number extension has no concrete benchmark: charges, dark-photon mass and coupling, and the N1 N1 -> dark photon annihilation cross section are unspecified, so the higher-T_reh viability region cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Write down the gauged-U(1) fermion-number Lagrangian with explicit charge assignments and dark-photon parameters, derive the N1 annihilation cross section to dark photons, and add the channel to the relic solver of gap_1 together with dark-radiation (N_eff) bookkeeping.

members.model_name: Millicharged co-interacting dark photon dark matter
members.description: The Bullet Cluster self-interaction bound on the A'-chi co-interacting system is a generic momentum-exchange estimate, not calibrated by any cluster-merger simulation that includes a light-boson bath scattering off a subdominant fermion component.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective drag/momentum-transfer cross section for the two-component A'+chi fluid and calibrate it against existing merging-cluster SIDM simulation results, replacing the order-of-magnitude estimate with a validated exclusion contour in (f_chi, g_d).

members.model_name: Conformal hidden-QCD dark meson model
members.description: The hidden SU(3) chiral phase transition is treated only with an NJL effective Lagrangian scaled from QCD, and this effective-QCD treatment is flagged as the dominant systematic on the transition strength and hence the GW prediction; no lattice or other first-principles calibration exists for this hidden sector with vector-like fermions.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate the NJL parameters against lattice simulations of SU(3) gauge theory with three light fundamental fermions at finite temperature (order and latent heat of the chiral transition), and propagate the calibrated potential into the bounce and GW pipeline as a systematic band.

members.model_name: FOPT-generated ultra-light PBH evaporation scalar dark matter
members.description: The (M_in, beta_PBH) output of the FOPT Fermi-ball/false-vacuum collapse step rests on analytic formation-efficiency assumptions; no simulation-calibrated public tool computes the PBH mass and abundance from a given dark-sector FOPT potential, which propagates uncertainty into both the GW and relic routes.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple a CosmoTransitions/PhaseTracer calculation of the dark-sector FOPT (nucleation rate, T_n, alpha_PT, beta_over_H) to a calibrated Fermi-ball collapse module, validated against published lattice/hydrodynamic studies of false-vacuum remnant collapse, and release it as a reusable (potential -> M_in, beta_PBH) tool.

members.model_name: Confining dark-baryon inverse-seesaw dark matter model
members.description: Dark-hadron masses and annihilation/decay matrix elements of the SU(3)_D sector with a single vector-like quark flavor are known only from dimensional analysis, making the relic-density and signal-rate predictions order-of-magnitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Perform a lattice calculation (or adapt existing lattice results for SU(3) with heavy fermions) of the baryon and meson spectrum and the baryon-annihilation matrix elements as functions of m_q/Lambda_D, and publish them as a parameterized spectrum model.

members.model_name: Non-thermal wino LSP dark matter
members.description: The paper's self-consistent GALPROP v50.1p configuration (diffusion, energy losses, magnetic field, halo profile, background source spectra) is not released, and the card notes recasts require the propagation configuration, not only the particle model, so the published PAMELA/Fermi comparisons cannot be reproduced or validated.
members.proposed_resolution: Reconstruct a B/C-, synchrotron-, and antiproton-consistent propagation configuration in modern GALPROP or DRAGON2, validate it against the paper's stated checks (B/C, WMAP haze, antiprotons), and archive the configuration files alongside the model card.

members.model_name: Smallest non-Abelian chiral dark-sector dark-proton dark matter
members.description: Dark-hadron inputs to the relic calculation (m_p_D/F_pi_D, g_A, dark pion and eta-prime spectrum, dark-nucleon annihilation matrix elements including multi-pion channels) are only estimated by scaling SM QCD, so the 10-100 TeV thermal mass window carries uncontrolled composite-sector uncertainties.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice gauge theory for the dark SU(3) sector with this fermion content to compute the hadron spectrum, F_pi_D, g_A, and dark-nucleon scalar/annihilation matrix elements, and feed them into a dedicated dark-chiral-perturbation-theory freeze-out code.

members.model_name: Fermi-ball dark matter from a quartic dark-sector phase transition
members.description: The Fermi-ball population step depends on bubble nucleation dynamics and the fermion trapping/filtering efficiency at the bubble wall, which are taken as analytic estimates from a generic quartic thermal potential with no nucleation computation or simulation-calibrated trapping fraction backing the (T_*, beta/H_*, trapping) inputs.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the nucleation rate, T_*, and beta/H_* for the quartic thermal potential with CosmoTransitions, and calibrate the dark-fermion trapping fraction with 1D bubble-wall/fermion-reflection simulations of the kind used for filtered-dark-matter studies, replacing the order-of-magnitude trapping assumption.

members.model_name: AMSB nonthermal wino dark matter from gravitino decay
members.description: The indirect-detection rates omit the Sommerfeld enhancement of wino annihilation, which the card flags as a caveat and which changes TeV-scale wino annihilation cross sections by large factors relative to the tree-level tool-chain output.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply published Sommerfeld-corrected wino annihilation cross sections (electroweak ladder resummation results available in the literature as fitting functions of m_chi1) as a correction layer on the DarkSUSY tree-level rates before the indirect-detection recast.

members.model_name: split-seesaw B-L thermal sterile neutrino with entropy dilution
members.description: No first-order B-L phase-transition calculation exists for this model: the entropy-dilution factor Delta ~ O(1e2) and the momentum redshift factor are assumed inputs rather than outputs of the U(1)_B-L scalar potential, so the abundance and coldness cannot be predicted from Lagrangian parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the B-L breaking potential in CosmoTransitions (or a comparable bounce/effective-potential code) to compute the transition strength, latent heat, and entropy release as functions of the B-L gauge coupling and breaking scale, yielding Delta and the reheating of the SM bath.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition vector dark matter
members.description: No gauge-invariant derivation exists for massive-vector particle production from runaway bubble collisions; the longitudinal-mode contribution is currently estimated through the Goldstone equivalence theorem with an ad hoc gauge-artifact subtraction that the primary paper says lacks a rigorous resolution, so the predicted V_mu yield carries uncontrolled theory systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the bubble-collision production rate for a vector coupled through lambda_V |phi|^2 V_mu V^mu in a manifestly gauge-invariant framework (e.g. a real-time treatment in unitary and R_xi gauges with explicit cross-checks of the longitudinal-mode contribution against the equivalence-theorem estimate), and quantify the shift across the wall-gamma and m_V range.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition scalar dark matter
members.description: No gauge-invariant derivation exists for scalar particle production from runaway bubble collisions; the primary paper removes unphysical gauge-dependent contributions with an ad hoc prescription and explicitly states a rigorous resolution is lacking, so the predicted phi_s yield carries uncontrolled theory systematics.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the bubble-collision production rate for a quartic-coupled scalar (lambda_s phi^2 phi_s^2 / 4) in a manifestly gauge-invariant framework (e.g. a real-time lattice treatment of the colliding field configurations with explicit gauge-cancellation checks), and quantify the shift relative to the paper's prescription across the wall-gamma and m_S range.

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated Affleck-Dine Q-ball dark matter with seed PBHs
members.description: Existing CMB spectral-distortion constraints (FIRAS-based mu/y limits with Green's-function thermalization) assume nearly Gaussian adiabatic curvature perturbations; no calculation exists of the distortion signal from rare, highly non-Gaussian high-baryon isocurvature bubbles, so the model's claimed evasion of the P_zeta < 1e-4 bound cannot be tested.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mu/y distortion from dissipating baryonic-isocurvature bubble profiles using the Green's-function thermalization method (e.g. extend CosmoTherm or the public sd Green's-function tables) with the HBB abundance and size distribution as input, and compare against FIRAS limits.

members.model_name: Complex singlet scalar dark matter with restored CP and Z2
members.description: No quantitative transport-equation calculation of the baryon asymmetry from the dimension-6 top CPV operator during the singlet-assisted phase transition exists in the card's routing, so the baryogenesis side of the joint scan (a derived quantity of the route) cannot be evaluated with a public tool.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the CP-violating source from the Lambda-suppressed top operator across the computed bubble-wall profile and solve the standard WKB/VEV-insertion electroweak-baryogenesis transport equations, packaged as a scan module coupled to the CosmoTransitions output.

members.model_name: Low-mass CP-violating effective inert-doublet dark matter
members.description: The baryon asymmetry from the H_2 field-strength CP-violating operator is computed only via rough analytic estimates: no transport-equation (WKB or VEV-insertion) calculation with a computed bubble-wall profile exists for this operator, and the EDM comparison lacks RG and operator-basis control, so the BAU side of the joint relic-BAU claim carries uncontrolled uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the CPV source term for the |H_2|^2 V Vdual operator in a transport-equation framework using the wall profile from a finite-temperature computation, solve the diffusion network for the BAU over the 55-70 GeV window, and match tilde c_2 onto the electron-EDM basis with one-loop RG running against current and projected eEDM limits.

members.model_name: Techni-Pati-Salam semi-integer-baryon-number composite dark matter
members.description: The relic mechanism assumes a strongly first-order electroweak phase transition in the composite pNGB Higgs sector, but no finite-temperature calculation of the TPS transition strength exists; without it the asymmetry-sharing link between dark matter and baryons is unverified.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the finite-temperature effective potential of the composite pNGB Higgs sector (chiral-Lagrangian or holographic treatment with lattice-informed low-energy constants) and evaluate the transition order and strength, e.g. feeding the effective potential into CosmoTransitions.

members.model_name: High-mass effective inert-doublet derivative-operator dark matter variant
members.description: The baryon asymmetry from the H_1 CP-violating field-strength operator is only a rough analytic estimate: no transport-equation calculation of the CPV source across the bubble wall exists for this operator, and the matching onto the electron-EDM operator basis lacks RG running, so the BAU-versus-EDM tension is not quantitatively controlled.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the CP-violating source term for the H_1 field-strength operator in a WKB/VEV-insertion transport-equation framework with the computed wall profile, solve the diffusion network for the BAU, and match tilde c_1 onto the low-energy EDM basis with one-loop RG running to compare against current and projected electron-EDM bounds.

members.model_name: Local baryon-and-lepton-number Majorana dark matter
members.description: The GW-extension route cannot be evaluated because the scalar potential of the S_B/S_L sector is not specified for this benchmark, so no phase-transition or defect GW spectrum can be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify the S_B/S_L scalar potential and symmetry-breaking pattern, determine whether strings, walls, or a first-order transition arise, and compute Omega_GW(f) with CosmoTransitions plus standard sound-wave/defect spectral templates at (v_B, v_L).

members.model_name: Six-flavor quark matter nugget dark matter
members.description: No quantitative rate and signature model exists for the proposed transient probes: photon emission from nugget collisions with compact stars and with other nuggets is described only qualitatively, with no derived energy-deposition spectrum, event rate, or detectability estimate for the 6FQM benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the energy deposition and photon light curve for a 1e10 g, 1e2 cm nugget impacting a neutron star or white dwarf surface, combine with the halo flux calculation into a per-survey transient rate, and identify which existing transient surveys bound or could detect the predicted events.

members.model_name: Left-right mirror symmetric sterile Dirac fermion CDM
members.description: No mapping exists from the phi^0-mediated N1 self-scattering amplitude to the velocity-dependent SIDM transfer cross section sigma_T/m needed to confront halo-scale self-interaction constraints; the source explicitly defers this to future work.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute sigma_T/m for N1-N1 scattering via light phi^0 exchange (Born/classical/resonant regimes as in standard light-mediator SIDM analyses) over the benchmark m_N1 and m_phi0 range, and recast against published dwarf-to-cluster SIDM cross-section constraints.

members.model_name: Mirrored GUT composite asymmetric dark baryon model
members.description: The velocity-dependent dark-baryon self-interaction cross section sigma/m from dark-meson exchange is not computed anywhere in the card (status 'unknown'), so the small-scale-structure observable cannot be evaluated against dwarf and cluster halo constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the dark nucleon-nucleon potential from dark-meson exchange (rescaling chiral-EFT nucleon-nucleon machinery to the dark confinement scale), solve the Schrodinger equation for the velocity-dependent transfer cross section, and compare against the standard dwarf-to-cluster sigma/m(v) constraint compilation.

members.model_name: Z2 fermion dark matter from broken local U(1) with bound states
members.description: The velocity-dependent self-interaction cross section (elastic and chi1-chi2 inelastic up-scattering through R and transverse/longitudinal A' exchange) is never derived for halo velocities, so the model's SIDM phenomenology named in the card cannot be confronted with small-scale-structure constraints.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled-channel Schrodinger problem for chi1chi1 -> chi1chi1 and chi1chi1 -> chi2chi2 scattering with the model's Yukawa-plus-vector potentials over dwarf-to-cluster velocities, and map sigma_T/m onto published SIDM constraints, reusing existing inelastic-SIDM coupled-channel machinery.

members.model_name: Symmetric ultraheavy atomic dark matter freeze-out through rearrangement
members.description: The velocity-dependent dark-atom elastic self-scattering cross section (and hence sigma/m on dwarf-to-cluster velocity scales) has not been derived for this ultraheavy symmetric atom, so the small-scale-structure observable cannot be reduced to a testable halo cross section.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute partial-wave atom-atom scattering (elastic plus hyperfine/inelastic channels) as a function of alpha_D, m_p/m_e, and relative velocity, following existing atomic-dark-matter scattering calculations, and tabulate sigma_T/m over halo velocity scales for recasting against SIDM halo constraints.

members.model_name: QCD axion-mediated Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The self-scattering treatment neglects the potentially sizable Sommerfeld enhancement for pseudoscalar axion exchange, so sigma_T/m_chi in the low-velocity dwarf-galaxy regime is not reliably computed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the nonperturbative self-scattering cross section by solving the Schrodinger equation with the axion-exchange pseudoscalar potential (adapting existing SIDM Yukawa-potential partial-wave codes to the pseudoscalar/tensor structure) and tabulate sigma_T(v) over the halo velocity range.

members.model_name: Big-Bang Dark Nucleosynthesis nuclear dark matter
members.description: The self-interaction constraint on dark nuclei is not computable: the geometric elastic, fusion, and fission cross sections at late times have not been mapped onto a sigma/m(v) that halo-scale SIDM bounds can be applied to, and the linear transfer function of the composite population is unknown.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the effective sigma/m for the final A distribution from the geometric scaling laws (including inelastic fusion channels) and compare against dwarf and cluster SIDM bounds; check the pre-aggregation dark-sector coupling era for acoustic damping of the linear power spectrum with a CLASS-style interacting-dark-matter run.

members.model_name: Low-scale hypercolor axion-domain-wall dark sector
members.description: The velocity-dependent self-interaction cross section sigma/m(v) for HC glueballs/glueballinos scattering via glueball exchange has not been derived; without a dark-hadron potential model the SIDM halo recast (core/cusp impact, dwarf-scale constraints) cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive a Yukawa-like effective potential from glueball exchange between HC bound states (mediator mass ~ Lambda_HC glueball mass, coupling from large-N or lattice glueball self-couplings), solve the Schrodinger scattering problem for sigma_T(v), and map onto standard SIDM halo constraints on sigma/m at dwarf and cluster velocities.

members.model_name: Dark SU(3) scalar glueball dark matter
members.description: The glueball self-scattering cross section per mass sigma/m_gb has not been computed from the low-energy glueball EFT, so halo-scale SIDM constraints (dwarf-to-cluster, Bullet Cluster) cannot be recast onto the (Lambda, xi_T) parameter space and no self-interaction likelihood exists for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the 2-to-2 scalar glueball elastic cross section from the lattice-normalized glueball EFT self-couplings (sigma proportional to 1/(Lambda^2) times coupling factors), map sigma/m_gb onto the standard SIDM constraint plane, and recast published cluster/dwarf self-interaction bounds onto Lambda.

members.model_name: Dark-fermion-production relaxion warm dark matter
members.description: The entropy dilution factor S that rescues the factor-of-10^3 overabundance is a free multiplicative parameter with no specified entropy-injection sector, so the relic abundance prediction is not closed and BBN consistency of the dilution epoch cannot be checked.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a concrete dilution mechanism (e.g. late decay of the companion relaxion-sector scalar before BBN), compute S from its mass, coupling, and decay temperature with standard entropy-injection Boltzmann equations, and propagate the associated heating of f(p) into the structure-formation step.

members.model_name: Ultralight axion dark matter from a dark SU(3)d confining phase transition
members.description: The dark glueball decay or annihilation mechanism is unspecified, so the glueball relic abundance and its contribution to Delta N_eff or matter overclosure cannot be computed, leaving the glueball-viability output of the constraint step unevaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a glueball disposal channel (e.g. dimension-8 operators to SM photons or decay into lighter axions), then compute the glueball freeze-out and decay history with a dark-sector Boltzmann calculation to obtain the surviving glueball density and Delta N_eff.

members.model_name: Explicit chiral-breaking axion-neutrino misalignment dark matter
members.description: No model exists for the density-fluctuation spectrum sourced by the late transition — the bubble collision and axion-field rearrangement dynamics after recombination have not been translated into a matter perturbation source term, leaving the paper's central observable qualitative.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the post-transition axion density-contrast power spectrum from bubble nucleation statistics (bubble size distribution and wall energy release) in the linear-cosmology background, producing an initial-condition transfer that can be handed to a Boltzmann code.

members.model_name: Dynamical dark matter MATHUSLA toy ensemble
members.description: The card provides no phase-space distribution and no structure-formation characterization for the mixed cold/warm ensemble (all linear and nonlinear fields are unknown), so no matter-power or halo-abundance observable can even be defined for this parameterization.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive per-component momentum distributions for representative production mechanisms (misalignment vs freeze-out) under the DDM scaling laws and implement the multi-component species in CLASS to obtain transfer functions, extending the decaying-CDM CLASS branches to a spectrum of lifetimes.

members.model_name: String moduli star compact-object dark matter
members.description: No quantitative formation and population model exists that converts an initial moduli-field abundance and early matter-era perturbation growth into a present-day moduli-star mass function and dark-matter fraction; relic abundance is entirely unspecified.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive a semi-analytic formation model adapting the axion-miniclister/oscillon formation literature: evolve moduli density perturbations through an early matter-dominated era, apply a Press-Schechter-style collapse criterion, and calibrate the condensation efficiency with 3+1 scalar-field lattice simulations to output a compact-object mass function and f_DM.

members.model_name: Singlet majoron extension with majoron or sterile-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The majoron-DM branch has no specified production mechanism: the paper states ordinary freeze-out, freeze-in, and misalignment underproduce the majoron for 1-100 GeV sterile neutrinos, and the card leaves the required exotic production route undefined, so no abundance calculation can even be set up for this branch.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify at least one concrete UV production completion (e.g. majoron misalignment with an explicit soft-breaking potential, or production from lepton-number scalar decays after a first-order transition), derive its abundance formula, and only then implement it in a Boltzmann solver.

members.model_name: Scalar-graviton soft-core halo dark matter
members.description: No cosmological production or perturbation framework exists for the coherent scalar-graviton field: the card records all linear structure-formation, abundance, and thermal-history entries as unknown, so the model currently cannot be evaluated against any cosmological observable beyond z=0 halo phenomenology.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the background evolution and linear perturbation equations of the scalar-graviton mode in an FRW spacetime for the unimodular bimode theory (the analog of misalignment production and an effective sound speed), a prerequisite for any future CLASS-type implementation of CMB and matter-power predictions.

members.model_name: FNPQ DFSZ type-I flavored axion dark matter
members.description: The card specifies no concrete resolution of the N>1 DFSZ stable-domain-wall problem (inflationary dilution versus an explicit PQ-breaking bias), so the cosmological viability check in the route and the choice between misalignment-only and string/wall-augmented abundance predictions cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive, for this model's charge assignments, the maximal Planck-suppressed or explicit PQ-breaking bias term consistent with strong-CP quality, and apply published biased-domain-wall network simulation results (annihilation time and axion emission) to determine the viable (f_a, bias) region; alternatively fix the pre-inflationary-breaking branch and propagate the corresponding isocurvature bound.

members.model_name: Millicharged dark matter subcomponent with L_mu-L_tau vector depletion
members.description: The multi-channel exclusion curves (CMB millicharge damping, BBN, SN1987A, SLAC and other laboratory bounds) that define the surviving EDGES window are not available in machine-readable form, so the constraint_overlay step is only approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published exclusion curves in the (epsilon, m_chi, f_DM) plane from the source papers and assemble them into a machine-readable combined-bound product attached to the registry.

members.model_name: Millicharged Dirac dark matter with hidden-scalar depletion
members.description: The multi-channel exclusion curves (CMB millicharge damping, BBN, SN1987A, SLAC and other laboratory bounds) that define the surviving EDGES window are not available in machine-readable form, so the constraint_overlay step is only approximate.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published exclusion curves in the (epsilon, m_chi, f_DM) plane from the source papers and assemble them into a machine-readable combined-bound product attached to the registry.

members.model_name: Charge-sequestration charged-X dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable, recast compilation of the CMB millicharge limits, stellar/supernova cooling bounds, and collider/beam-dump/direct-detection exclusions exists in the (m_X, epsilon_X, f_X) parameterization needed to delimit the sub-eV, MeV, and heavy multicharged windows for the charge-sequestration scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published Planck millicharge, stellar/SN cooling, and laboratory exclusion curves cited by the paper, recast them to (m_X, epsilon_X) at fixed dark-matter fraction f_X, and package the overlay as a reusable constraint module for the route.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) L_mu-L_tau charged scalar dark matter
members.description: The L_mu-L_tau mediator-plane constraint set (BABAR 4-mu, neutrino trident, LHC, BBN/Delta N_eff exclusions, and the muon g-2 and Hubble-tension preferred bands) is attached to the card only as the primary paper's figure; no machine-readable contours in the (m_Z_prime, g_mu_tau) plane are stored for automated overlay.
members.proposed_resolution: Import or digitize the standard published L_mu-L_tau constraint compilation (BABAR e+e- -> 4mu, CCFR neutrino trident, LHC Z -> 4mu, BBN/Delta N_eff, and the (g-2)_mu 2-sigma band) into tabulated (m_Z_prime, g_mu_tau) curves stored as registry data products.

members.model_name: Non-thermal vector-like fermion dark matter from generalized Hilltop reheating
members.description: The card's numerical inputs are unreliable at the digit level: OCR garbles inequality symbols and dataset labels, and the paper's benchmark tables and m_chi-y_chi-T_R allowed-region plots have not been digitized, so the constraint overlay cannot be reproduced as recastable bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract the benchmark parameter tables, exact coupling inequalities, and the named 2018 CMB n_s-r likelihood combination directly from the published PDF, and digitize the parameter-space contours into machine-readable allowed-region tables for the registry.

members.model_name: Non-thermal vector-like fermion dark matter from non-minimal Coleman-Weinberg reheating
members.description: The card's numerical inputs are unreliable at the digit level: OCR garbles inequality symbols and dataset labels, and the paper's benchmark tables and m_chi-y_chi-T_R allowed-region plots have not been digitized, so the constraint overlay cannot be reproduced as recastable bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract the benchmark parameter tables, exact coupling inequalities, and the named 2018 CMB n_s-r likelihood combination directly from the published PDF, and digitize the parameter-space contours into machine-readable allowed-region tables for the registry.

members.model_name: Chaotic braneworld inflaton-remnant dark matter
members.description: The card's numeric bounds on the allowed preheating coupling g and the M_5 window are unreliable because inequality signs and powers of ten are degraded in the OCR-extracted source text, so the viable parameter region cannot be reused quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-extract the coupling and M_5 inequalities directly from the published arXiv:0906.5021 source (or rederive them from the phi_* = m/g abundance condition and the CMB-fixed m/M_5 relation) and update the card's numeric fields.

members.model_name: Light scalar mediator freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The stellar-cooling and BBN/N_eff bounds that dominate the viable parameter space are only stated qualitatively; no digitized constraint compilation on the Higgs-mixed scalar coupling (g_f or theta versus m_phi) is attached to the card, so the allowed windows cannot be drawn quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published stellar energy-loss (sun, HB stars, red giants, SN) and BBN/N_eff exclusion curves for a light Higgs-mixed scalar into constraint tables in the (m_phi, theta) plane for direct use in scans.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector phase-transition axion minicluster dark matter
members.description: The stochastic gravitational-wave background from the slow, strongly coupled hidden-sector transition is not computed anywhere in the route (the card lists the GW calculator as an unavailable required resource), so obs_hidden_phase_transition_gw cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt standard phase-transition GW spectrum calculations (bubble-collision/sound-wave templates as in CosmoTransitions-style analyses) to the slow H Delta t ~ 1, large latent-heat regime, mapping (T_*, Delta s/s_plus, H Delta t) to a predicted spectrum and detector band.

members.model_name: CP-conserving complex singlet scalar dark matter with biased domain walls
members.description: No end-to-end public implementation ties the cxSM potential parameters to a joint numerical evaluation: a micrOMEGAs model file for the CP-conserving cxSM plus a wrapper feeding the domain-wall GW template into PTA stochastic-background likelihoods and the LZ spin-independent recast has not been released (route status planned, all recast steps have tool_or_code null).
members.proposed_resolution: Build the cxSM CalcHEP/FeynRules model file for micrOMEGAs, implement the biased-wall Omega_GW(f) template as a custom signal in a PTA analysis framework (e.g., PTArcade/ENTERPRISE with NANOGrav 15-yr data), and add the sigma_SI output to an LZ limit comparison, releasing the scan scripts.

members.model_name: Spontaneously broken U(1)' asymmetric self-interacting dark matter
members.description: The dark U(1)' first-order phase transition is not implemented anywhere: no finite-temperature effective potential for the S_1/S_2 dark Higgs sector is coded, so the nucleation temperature, latent heat alpha_PT, beta/H, and the resulting GW peak frequency and amplitude cannot be computed beyond the paper's order-of-magnitude benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the two-dark-Higgs finite-temperature potential in CosmoTransitions (or an equivalent bounce solver), compute T_n, alpha_PT, and beta/H over the MeV-scale transition benchmark, and feed them into standard sound-wave/bubble-collision GW spectral templates compared against PTA and microHz-band sensitivities.

members.model_name: QCD-axion domain-wall PBH mixed dark matter scenario
members.description: No calculator exists for the stochastic gravitational-wave spectrum Omega_GW(f) emitted by collapsing axion domain walls bounded by strings in this late-re-entry scenario, so the GW observable cannot be compared quantitatively to detector sensitivities.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the GW emission from wall-bounded-by-string collapse (quadrupole estimate calibrated by the lattice simulation of gap_1) and package it as an Omega_GW(f; T_en, f_a, m_a) template comparable to PTA and space/ground interferometer sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Primordial black hole dark matter from an early stiff/kination epoch
members.description: No released calculator computes the first- plus second-order stochastic GW spectrum through a constant-w stiff era ending at T1: existing induced-GW codes assume radiation domination, so the kination-enhanced spectra and their frequency breaks must currently be reproduced by hand from the paper's semi-analytic formulas, and only sensitivity-curve overlays (no likelihoods) exist for comparison.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public scalar-induced GW code (e.g. SIGWfast) with the general-w Green's-function kernel and the stiff-to-radiation transition at T1, validate against the paper's T1 = 490 GeV benchmark spectra, and connect the output to LVK stochastic-search and PTA free-spectrum likelihoods plus the Omega_GW h^2 < ~2e-7 radiation-density bound.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric SO(10) mixed LSP-neutrino dark matter
members.description: The cosmic-string and hybrid-inflation structure-seeding observable has no quantitative pipeline: the string tension implied by the B-L breaking scale M_G has not been propagated through a string-network CMB/gravitational-wave calculation or compared to current CMB and PTA bounds.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute G mu from the model's M_G, run an unconnected-segment-model string code (CMBACT-class) for the CMB contribution and a standard stochastic-background calculation for the string gravitational-wave spectrum, and compare against published Planck string bounds and PTA limits.

members.model_name: Quantum-gravity-broken Z2 singlet scalar dark matter with domain walls
members.description: No public calculator produces the domain-wall stochastic gravitational-wave spectrum Omega_GW(f) with its PTA likelihood for the biased S_1 wall network: wall tension from (v_1, lambda_1), bias from the Lambda_QG-suppressed operators, T_ann, and the lattice-calibrated spectral shape are not wired into any reusable pipeline.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the lattice-calibrated scaling-law domain-wall spectrum (Hiramatsu-Kawasaki-Saikawa parameterization) as a function of (v_1, lambda_1, Lambda_QG), and evaluate it against NANOGrav 15-yr/IPTA data through PTArcade's new-physics likelihood, including the BBN wall-decay safety cut.

members.model_name: Axion kination dark matter from kinetic misalignment
members.description: No public pipeline computes the triangular stochastic-GW feature from a primordial tensor spectrum transferred through matter-kination eras and evaluates it against detector sensitivities; both the transfer calculation for general (T_MK, T_KR) and the LISA/PTA/ground-interferometer likelihood evaluation are absent.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement a GW transfer-function calculator that numerically evolves tensor modes across the matter-kination-radiation sequence, package the resulting Omega_gw(f; T_MK, T_KR, r) template, and interface it with stochastic-background analysis tools (LISA SGWB pipelines, PTA free-spectrum fits) including astrophysical foregrounds.

members.model_name: Double-inflation red-tilted primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No second-order induced-GW integrator is bundled to map the extended red-tilted second-stage curvature spectrum to Omega_SGW(f) over the broad frequency range relevant for PTA exclusion; the card records only the primary paper's analytic computation with no numerical recomputation.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a public second-order induced-GW integrator (SIGWfast-class) and wire it to the model's parameterized extended red-tilted P_R(k) (amplitude, tilt, cutoff scales), validating against the primary paper's broad SGW spectra.

members.model_name: Running-mass inflation primordial black-hole dark matter
members.description: No second-order induced-GW integrator is bundled to map the running-mass curvature spectrum (peaked by large higher-order spectral runnings) to Omega_SGW(f) across the wide PTA frequency range; the card records only the primary paper's analytic computation with no numerical recomputation.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a public second-order induced-GW integrator (SIGWfast-class) and wire it to the running-mass P_R(k) parameterized by n_s and its runnings, validating against the primary paper's SGW spectra.

members.model_name: Mirror-star dissipative mirror-baryon dark matter
members.description: No released code implements the SM capture/self-capture rate and the captured-nugget thermal structure (ionization, opacity, temperature across optically thin/thick regimes), which is the step converting stellar profiles and epsilon into observable luminosities.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's capture and nugget thermal-balance equations as an open-source module taking MESA-style profiles, ISM density, and epsilon as inputs and returning nugget size, temperature, and opacity, validated against the paper's benchmark luminosities and >100-light-year reach.

members.model_name: Single keV sterile-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: No detector response and background model exists for the beta-endpoint capture signature: the card computes the ideal capture rate and line position but notes that target activity, energy resolution, and backgrounds were not modeled, so laboratory sensitivity cannot be quantified.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a beta-spectrum endpoint simulation (KATRIN/PTOLEMY-style response convolution with target activity and resolution parameters for tritium and 106Ru) and derive projected sensitivity contours in (m_4, |V_e4|^2).

members.model_name: Lepton-number-two ultralight scalar dark matter for neutrinoless double beta capture
members.description: No implemented forward model maps (m_phi, eta, g, rho_DM) to the scalar-capture rate and effective 0nubb half-life per isotope: the primary paper gives only a benchmark 136Xe scaling estimate, and the nuclear-matrix-element dependence is not encoded anywhere runnable.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the paper's capture-rate formulas as a small numerical code that takes published 0nubb nuclear matrix element tables (QRPA/shell-model values for 136Xe, 76Ge, 100Mo) and detector energy resolution, outputting half-life versus (m_phi, eta, g) for each isotope.

members.model_name: Dark baryon model with right-handed scalar mediator Model 1
members.description: No public code computes the in-medium hyperon dark-decay emissivity in a proto-neutron star for this model; the SN1987A bound is applied only via the analytic L_d < 3e52 erg/s criterion with unmodeled in-medium rates.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement in-medium hyperon abundances and dark-decay widths on public proto-neutron-star simulation profiles (e.g. Garching-style models) and apply the Raffelt luminosity criterion, packaged as a reusable SN1987A cooling module for dark-baryon operators.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model I Higgs-coupled Majorana WIMP
members.description: No public code computes relativistic dark-matter capture and kinetic-plus-annihilation heating in neutron stars for a muon-coupled Majorana WIMP, including Pauli blocking, general-relativistic corrections, equation-of-state-dependent muon fractions, and multi-target (nucleon plus muon) scattering; the paper's heating results cannot be reproduced from released tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relativistic capture formalism of the Bell-Busoni-Robles-Virgato type as an open code with selectable neutron-star equations of state (e.g. BSk or QMC families) providing radial neutron, proton, and muon profiles, taking the model's per-target cross sections from step s1 as input and outputting capture rate and equilibrium surface temperature.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model II leptophilic Majorana WIMP without tree-level Higgs coupling
members.description: No public code computes relativistic dark-matter capture and heating in neutron stars for a leptophilic Majorana WIMP scattering off the star's muon population (plus loop-suppressed nucleon channels), including Pauli blocking, general-relativistic corrections, and equation-of-state-dependent muon fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the relativistic capture formalism of the Bell-Busoni-Robles-Virgato type as an open code with equation-of-state families (BSk/QMC) supplying radial muon and nucleon number densities, taking the model's per-target cross sections as input and returning capture rates and equilibrium surface temperatures.

members.model_name: PBH-evaporated non-thermal WIMPy baryogenesis dark matter
members.description: No microscopic Lagrangian for the B- and CP-violating annihilation sector is specified, so the CP asymmetry epsilon_CP and the washout rates that can erase Y_B are free parameters rather than derived quantities, leaving the washout_baryogenesis constraint unevaluable model-by-model.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt a concrete WIMPy-baryogenesis benchmark model (e.g. the exotic-quark plus pseudo-Dirac mediator setup of the original WIMPy baryogenesis literature), derive epsilon_CP and the inverse/washout reaction rates from its couplings, and feed them into the Boltzmann module instead of free parameters.

members.model_name: DFSZ axino cold dark matter
members.description: The DFSZ thermal axino production rate itself carries an order-of-magnitude uncertainty in the card, from the treatment of higgsino-decay versus scattering contributions across reheating temperatures, which propagates directly into the relic-density bands.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the DFSZ axino thermal production rate with consistent finite-temperature field theory (hard-thermal-loop resummation of the Higgs/higgsino channels analogous to gauge-scattering treatments in the KSVZ case) and publish the yield Y(T_R, f_a, mu, tan beta) as a tabulated module.

members.model_name: LSP dark matter in Affleck-Dine hilltop supernatural inflation
members.description: The LSP sector is unspecified beyond a wino/gaugino example: no SUSY spectrum, annihilation cross section, or gravitino mass relation is fixed, so the dark-matter side of the route cannot be evaluated quantitatively for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Define one or more benchmark MSSM spectra (e.g. wino LSP at 100 GeV - 3 TeV with fixed m_3/2) consistent with the paper's reheating windows, so that sigma_v and gravitino yields become computable inputs for micrOMEGAs/DarkSUSY.

members.model_name: Right-handed neutrino superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: The paper forgoes a production model: no mechanism is specified that generates the required degenerate right-handed-neutrino background with order-unity mu/T, so the relic abundance is only phenomenologically parameterized and cannot be tied to fundamental parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct and solve a concrete production scenario (e.g. leptogenesis-like asymmetric generation or a scalar decay channel producing the degenerate nu_R sea), deriving mu and T_creation from initial conditions so the abundance and Delta N_eff become predictions rather than inputs.

members.model_name: Vector-like quark color-superconducting condensate dark matter
members.description: No production mechanism is specified for the required degenerate vector-like-quark background: the formation history (mu, T_creation) is assumed rather than derived, leaving the relic abundance only phenomenologically parameterized.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct a concrete cosmological production scenario (e.g. asymmetric generation of VLQ number tied to the baryon asymmetry, or out-of-equilibrium decay of a heavy scalar) and solve the corresponding Boltzmann equations so mu and T_creation follow from initial conditions.

members.model_name: Extremely supercooled singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: No validated derivation of the entropy-dilution factor exists for singlet dark matter that freezes out before an extremely supercooled electroweak phase transition (T_f > T_p with T_p near 1 GeV): the card flags that previously published dilution formulas may not apply here and that a specific dynamic study of freeze-out during vacuum-energy domination and post-percolation reheating to T_reh is still missing, so the post-transition relic density cannot be reliably computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Solve the coupled Boltzmann equations for the singlet number density through the vacuum-domination epoch, bubble percolation, and reheating (including possible re-annihilation if T_reh approaches T_f), deriving a dilution factor D(T_f, T_p, T_reh, alpha) valid in the extreme-supercooling limit, and package it as a module downstream of the transition solver.

members.model_name: Heavy asymmetric fermion dark matter with Higgs-mixed scalar portal white-dwarf ignition
members.description: No concrete production cosmology is specified for the super-heavy asymmetric X abundance (the paper explicitly leaves the cosmological model parameters to future work), so relic-density consistency, the required primordial asymmetry, and survival of the asymmetric population against annihilation cannot be checked for any benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct an explicit super-heavy asymmetric dark matter cosmology (asymmetry generation plus late-decaying-field depletion of the symmetric component and mediator decay before BBN) and derive the allowed (m_X, asymmetry) region that yields Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12, so registry benchmarks can be tied to a viable production history.

members.model_name: Heavy asymmetric fermion dark matter with vector portal white-dwarf ignition
members.description: No concrete production cosmology is specified for the super-heavy asymmetric X abundance (the paper explicitly leaves the cosmological model parameters to future work), so relic-density consistency, the required primordial asymmetry, and survival of the asymmetric population against annihilation through the light U(1)_D mediator cannot be checked for any benchmark.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct an explicit super-heavy asymmetric dark matter cosmology (asymmetry generation plus late-decaying-field depletion of the symmetric component, with the dark photon decaying to SM states before BBN) and derive the allowed (m_X, asymmetry, epsilon) region that yields Omega_DM h^2 = 0.12, so registry benchmarks can be tied to a viable production history.

members.model_name: Subcomponent millicharged Dirac dark matter with neutrino annihilation
members.description: The mediator generating the required neutrino annihilation channel is unspecified in the model, so laboratory, fixed-target, and astrophysical constraints on that sector cannot be evaluated or recast against the freeze-out-required sigma_v_nu.
members.proposed_resolution: Construct at least one explicit UV completion (e.g. a light B-L or neutrinophilic scalar/vector mediator) that yields the needed sigma_v_nu, and check its couplings against existing neutrino-portal laboratory and astrophysical limits.

members.model_name: Unified superfluid dark sector
members.description: The nonlinear equations for the two-phase (superfluid core plus normal envelope) structure are derived but not solved, and simulation_calibrated = no, so halo and subhalo mass-function effects and cluster-scale predictions are uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run nonlinear structure-formation simulations of the two-state superfluid (SPH-like two-fluid or Gross-Pitaevskii-based solver in the condensed regions) to calibrate core sizes, halo mass functions, and the cluster normal-phase fraction against the paper's fiducial parameters.

members.model_name: Dark photon dark matter from an oscillating dilaton
members.description: No 3+1D nonlinear lattice simulation of the dilaton-vector system W(phi) F F with a Proca mass exists to capture backreaction, condensate depletion efficiency, vortex formation, and the final dark-photon spectrum; the route explicitly lists this as a required code resource and current abundance numbers are order-of-magnitude only.
members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public lattice field-theory code (e.g. CosmoLattice, which supports gauge and scalar fields) with the dilatonic kinetic function W(phi)=exp(phi/M) and a massive vector, and scan the (m_A/m_phi, phi_0/M, M) space around the m_A=m_phi/2 resonance to calibrate transfer efficiency and final spectra.

members.model_name: ALP dark matter with dark-photon late-time magnetogenesis
members.description: No public lattice code covers the coupled ALP-dark-photon-photon system with cosmic plasma conductivity across the 1e-21 to 1e-17 eV mass window; the amplification benchmarks (B_X, dark-photon spectrum) come from private lattice runs at a few g_XX values.
