members.proposed_resolution: Extend a public lattice framework such as CosmoLattice with a massless dark U(1) coupled through g_XX phi X Xtilde and an effective conductivity term for the visible photon, scanning g_XX and m_phi to replace the fixed benchmark scalings with a tabulated B_X(m_phi, f, g_XX) surface.

members.model_name: Dark matter pearls with low-tension vacuum domain walls around voids
members.description: No domain-wall network simulation exists for void-scale, low-tension (S^(1/3) ~ 10-100 MeV) walls pinned to the cosmic web; the wall energy density, spacing, and induced CMB anisotropy/large-scale-structure morphology are estimated only by dimensional analysis.
members.proposed_resolution: Run scalar-field domain-wall network simulations (extending existing wall-network lattice codes) with tension and initial conditions tied to void-scale spacing, and post-process to CMB isotropy and void-boundary statistics for comparison with LSS survey data.

members.model_name: Scalar portal dark matter from inverse phase transition
members.description: The domain-wall GW forecast relies on assumed scaling of a network whose tension decreases and vanishes at symmetry restoration; existing lattice calibrations of wall GW emission (constant-tension networks) do not cover this melting-wall regime, so the predicted peak strain and spectral shape carry uncontrolled uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice field-theory simulations of the Z2 scalar with the temperature-dependent potential through the inverse transition (extending standard domain-wall simulation setups a la Hiramatsu-Kawasaki-Saikawa to time-dependent tension), extracting the GW emission efficiency and peak-frequency scaling as functions of g and lambda/N^2.

members.model_name: Miracle-less WIMP with gauged B-L entropy dilution
members.description: The GW spectrum with a turning frequency relies on cosmic-string loop-network parameters (loop distribution, cusp emission efficiency) fixed by assumption; the cusp-emission bound that excludes M_DM below about 10 MeV inherits the same uncalibrated network modeling, and no simulation-calibrated spectrum for string networks evolving through an N1 matter-dominated era exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate the loop number density and emission spectrum through an early-matter-dominated era using Nambu-Goto string-network simulations (extending existing loop-distribution suites to a matter-radiation-matter expansion history) and publish the resulting break-shape templates parameterized by T_N1 and Gmu.

members.model_name: CP-conserving complex singlet scalar dark matter with biased domain walls
members.description: No lattice simulation of the biased Z2 domain-wall network for the cxSM scalar potential exists; the GW spectrum and annihilation time rest on scaling-regime estimates calibrated for generic potentials, and the card flags that different network evolution changes the annihilation time and GW amplitude.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice field-theory simulations of the biased complex-singlet potential (extending existing Z2 domain-wall codes of the Hiramatsu/Saikawa type) across the |a_1| and v_S benchmark range, and fit an updated GW spectral template (peak amplitude, frequency, spectral slopes) for the PTA band.

members.model_name: Dark-brane Dirac fermion radion-mediated dark matter
members.description: The dark-brane confinement/deconfinement first-order phase transition that sources the nanoHz GW signal has no model-specific calculation in this pipeline: the radion effective potential, nucleation rate, and transition strength (alpha, beta/H) for Lambda_1 about 8-30 GeV are imported from related literature rather than computed, so the PTA observable cannot be evaluated as a function of the card's input parameters.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the finite-temperature radion effective potential for the TeV-dark-brane interval, obtain bounce action and nucleation parameters with CosmoTransitions, feed (alpha, beta/H, T_reh) into standard sound-wave/bubble-collision GW spectral templates, and compare with the NANOGrav 15-year free-spectrum likelihood (e.g. via PTArcade).

members.model_name: Abelian-Higgs string-decay dark matter scenario
members.description: The NG-like loop fraction f_NG of Abelian-Higgs networks is only bounded (f_NG <= 0.1, simulation-motivated) rather than measured: existing field-theory lattice simulations lack the dynamic range to quantify the percent-to-ten-percent long-lived loop subpopulation on which the entire NANOGrav interpretation and correlated GW predictions rest.
members.proposed_resolution: Run large-dynamic-range Abelian-Higgs lattice simulations (adaptive-mesh or block-mesh refinement at critical coupling) that track loop formation and lifetimes to calibrate f_NG and the loop-size distribution feeding the SGWB calculator.

members.model_name: Melting-domain-wall ultralight scalar dark matter
members.description: No lattice field simulation of a melting domain-wall network (Z2 scalar with temperature-dependent potential and feeble portal coupling) exists to calibrate the GW spectral normalization, peak structure, and high-frequency tail; the PTA prediction rests on an analytic scaling-network estimate the paper itself flags as uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of the Z2 scalar with the paper's temperature-dependent potential through wall formation, melting, and decay (both direct and inverse transition histories), extract the GW power spectrum, and fit a calibrated spectral template parameterized by T_i and the wall-tension history.

members.model_name: Dilaton forbidden dark matter
members.description: The possible first-order dark confinement phase transition and its stochastic GW background are not computable: no finite-temperature effective potential or lattice input exists for the near-conformal SU(3) N_f=8 dEFT sector to determine the transition order and (alpha, beta/H, T_*).
members.proposed_resolution: Construct the finite-temperature dilaton effective potential (informed by lattice studies of the near-conformal gauge theory), determine the transition order and nucleation parameters with CosmoTransitions, and feed the resulting (alpha, beta/H, T_*) into standard FOPT GW spectral templates.

members.model_name: Ultralight real pNGB dark matter for strong-gravity scenarios
members.description: No string-plus-domain-wall network calculation exists for this complex-singlet pNGB model, so the post-inflationary relic abundance (the >~1e-16 eV condition) and the defect-sourced SGWB spectrum in PTA/astrometry bands are only order-of-magnitude statements borrowed from other models.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice defect-network simulations of the complex singlet with the soft-breaking term (biased-domain-wall setup parameterized by v_Phi, m_eta, and the domain-wall number), extract the wall/string decay contribution to Omega_eta and the SGWB spectrum, and fit a semi-analytic scaling model usable across the strong-gravity mass range.

members.model_name: SO(2N) baryonic glueball dark matter
members.description: Cosmic-string network evolution and loop production at very small intercommutation probability (P ~ 1e-3 to 1e-1) are uncalibrated: the extended VOS treatment used in the paper lacks support from dedicated Nambu-Goto simulations, so the predicted PTA-band GW spectrum carries large systematic uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Run Nambu-Goto string-network simulations scanning intercommutation probability down to P ~ 1e-3 to calibrate the VOS model parameters and loop distribution, then feed the calibrated spectra into existing PTA cosmic-string likelihood machinery (enterprise/PTArcade-style analyses) as a P-dependent template.

members.model_name: LED instantly evaporating black-hole dark matter production
members.description: Induced gravitational-wave constraints on transient black-hole-dominated eras are derived for four-dimensional PBHs and require recasting to LED black holes with modified mass-temperature-lifetime relations before they can bound this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the induced-GW signal from an early LED black-hole-dominated era using the higher-dimensional lifetime relations and map published 4D exclusion regions onto the (M_*, n, T_RH/M_*, initial abundance) space.

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition Friedberg-Lee-Sirlin Q-ball dark matter
members.description: The gravitational-wave counterpart observable is only an extension: the transition parameters alpha and beta/H and the stochastic GW spectrum have never been computed for this model's potential, so the phase_transition_gw_extension observable cannot be evaluated against any detector sensitivity.
members.proposed_resolution: Using the gap_2 bounce-solver output, derive alpha and beta/H for the viable parameter region and map them through standard sound-wave/bubble-collision spectral templates (PTPlot-style) to predict the GW spectrum and compare with LISA-class sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Superconformal attractor inflation primordial-black-hole dark matter
members.description: The second-order induced gravitational-wave spectrum is computed with simplified expressions the source itself flags as uncertain; the exact radiation-era kernel convolution of the model's P_R(k) has not been performed, so amplitude and peak frequency of Omega_GW carry unquantified errors.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute Omega_GW(f) with an exact second-order kernel calculation (Kohri-Terada-type kernels as implemented in public SIGW calculators such as SIGWfast) applied to the model's numerically obtained P_R(k), including finite-width-peak effects.

members.model_name: LED Planckeon black-hole remnant dark matter
members.description: The induced gravitational-wave and early matter-domination constraints on ultralight black-hole populations are derived for four-dimensional PBHs; no recast exists to LED black holes ending as Planckeon remnants, so the only gravitational probe of the remnant population cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Rederive the induced-GW spectrum from a transient LED black-hole-dominated era using higher-dimensional lifetime relations including the remnant endpoint, and map the published 4D exclusion regions onto the (M_*, n, T_RH/M_*, initial abundance) parameter space.

members.model_name: Primordial black holes with QCD color charge
members.description: The flagged gravitational-wave and BBN signatures of confinement-era charge dressing have no quantitative prediction: no GW spectrum from the dressing process and no computation of the perturbation to proton/neutron equilibrium near BBN exists, so these targets cannot be confronted with data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the stochastic GW spectrum sourced by the color-cloud dressing dynamics (using outputs of the gap_1 simulations) and couple the associated energy injection into a standard public BBN code such as AlterBBN or PRIMAT to obtain element-abundance constraints.

members.model_name: Two-scalar Z2 Higgs-portal dark matter without singlet-only s-s' cross-couplings
members.description: No gravitational-wave spectrum has been computed for the strong first-order transition: the nucleation parameters (T_n, alpha, beta/H, wall velocity) needed to turn the very strong v_c/T_c benchmarks into a stochastic GW prediction and compare with LISA sensitivity are missing.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute bounce solutions and nucleation parameters for the d1 benchmarks with CosmoTransitions, feed alpha and beta/H into standard sound-wave/turbulence GW templates, and evaluate signal-to-noise against LISA sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Dark SU(3) scalar glueball dark matter
members.description: The dark SU(3) confinement phase-transition dynamics needed for a gravitational-wave forecast (latent heat alpha_PT, inverse duration beta/H, bubble wall velocity) are not derived: the primary paper explicitly neglects bubble dynamics, and the transition is nonperturbative so perturbative bounce codes do not apply.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the transition parameters from SU(3) lattice thermodynamics combined with a Polyakov-loop/matrix-model nucleation calculation (extending the treatment of the cited dark-confinement GW literature), parameterized by (Lambda, xi_T), and feed the resulting (alpha_PT, beta/H, v_w) into standard sound-wave/bubble-collision GW templates.

members.model_name: Scalar Quartic bubble-filtered sudden freeze-out dark matter
members.description: The bubble wall velocity v_w, which controls both the exponentially sensitive bubble-filtering factor f_in and the gravitational-wave spectrum, is treated as a free input spanning nonrelativistic to relativistic cases; no calculation of v_w from the scalar quartic potential's friction and hydrodynamics is attached to the model.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive v_w for the scalar quartic benchmark using an established wall-velocity framework (hydrodynamic matching plus friction from the DM and bath couplings, e.g. a WallGo-style solver or the local-thermal-equilibrium approximation), and tabulate v_w over the potential-parameter and m_chi/T_n grid used for the relic and GW contours.

members.model_name: Primordial black-hole dark matter from stiff-era reheating collapse
members.description: The predicted small-scale baryon-to-photon fluctuation spectrum delta eta_B(k) is never converted into an observational likelihood (BBN/CMB constraints on baryon isocurvature or inhomogeneous nucleosynthesis), so this observable cannot be evaluated against data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the mapping from delta eta_B(k) to light-element abundance scatter and CMB baryon-isocurvature limits, and implement it as a bound on the scalar peak amplitude using existing inhomogeneous-BBN calculations.

members.model_name: Planck-suppressed Higgs-coupled oscillating scalar dark matter
members.description: No likelihood implementation exists for the model's joint CMB test: the beta_iso < 0.037 isocurvature bound and the tensor-to-scalar constraint are only quoted numbers, so the m_phi-r relation and the m_eff/H_inf isocurvature suppression cannot be statistically confronted with Planck/BICEP-Keck data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the model relations (phi_i = alpha H_inf, Omega_phi(m_phi, phi_i), residual isocurvature as a function of m_eff/H_inf) as a theory module in Cobaya/MontePython and sample against the Planck plus BICEP-Keck tensor and CDM-isocurvature likelihoods.

members.model_name: Randall-Sundrum bulk-scalar oscillating dark matter
members.description: No likelihood implementation exists for the model's joint CMB test: the beta_iso < 0.037 isocurvature bound and the tensor-to-scalar constraint are only quoted numbers, so the m_phi-r relation and the isocurvature suppression from the Hubble-scale inflationary mass cannot be statistically confronted with Planck/BICEP-Keck data.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the RS relations (phi_i = alpha H_inf, Omega_phi(m_phi, phi_i), m_phi from the warp factor, residual isocurvature versus m_eff/H_inf) as a theory module in Cobaya/MontePython and sample against the Planck plus BICEP-Keck tensor and CDM-isocurvature likelihoods.

members.model_name: Non-minimally coupled ultra-light axion cold dark matter
members.description: No likelihood pipeline exists for this model: the BBN dark-radiation bound is qualitative (exact exponent not recovered) and the matter-power bound xi < 0.01 is an approximate adiabatic-only figure comparison with no reusable likelihood, so neither constraint can be evaluated statistically or extended to mixed initial conditions.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the modified solver from gap_1 to Cobaya/MontePython with the public Planck, BAO, and full-shape galaxy power-spectrum likelihoods plus a BBN Neff likelihood, scanning (xi, m_phi, phi_i) for adiabatic, isocurvature, and mixed initial conditions to replace the approximate xi bound.

members.model_name: Long-lived radion dark matter in Randall-Sundrum cosmology
members.description: Only WMAP-era, curvaton-analogy constraints exist for the radion-induced effective baryon isocurvature; no modern (Planck-level) CMB likelihood evaluation of the S_eff and correlated curvature contribution has been performed for this model.
members.proposed_resolution: Map the computed correlated curvature/isocurvature spectra onto the standard CDI/BDI amplitude parameterization and evaluate against the public Planck 2018 (or later) isocurvature likelihood to update the allowed (M_R, Omega_R/Omega_M, alpha_R) region.

members.model_name: Geometric-baryogenesis ultralight axion-like cold dark matter
members.description: No CMB isocurvature likelihood is assembled for the geometric-baryogenesis parameter space: the claim that CDM isocurvature stays below the Planck limit for the M ~ 1e14 GeV ALP example is quoted from the paper rather than computed over (f_a, theta_osc, H_inf).
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the ALP isocurvature amplitude analytically from (H_inf, f_a, theta_osc) and confront it with the Planck 2018 beta_iso bound via a Cobaya run with the uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature parameterization, tabulating the allowed H_inf as a function of the ALP CDM fraction.

members.model_name: Starobinsky-induced scalar coherent-oscillation dark matter
members.description: No model-specific likelihood recast exists combining the Planck isocurvature limits with the abundance constraint for the curvature-induced displacement scenario, including the resonance/fluctuation-control regions the paper flags as excluded.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the uncorrelated CDM-isocurvature amplitude prediction as a function of (m_X, xi_X, lambda_X, initial field value) and compare it against the published Planck beta_iso likelihood, jointly with the Omega_X = Omega_DM condition, to produce an allowed-region map in the model parameter space.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter with primordial black-hole early matter domination
members.description: No assembled joint constraint-overlay module maps (M_BH, beta, m_0, theta_i) onto the CMB Delta N_eff likelihood, BBN evaporation-timing bounds, isocurvature limits, and GW background curves; each bound exists in the literature but is not packaged for this parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package the Planck Delta N_eff posterior, pre-BBN evaporation-temperature bound, Planck isocurvature limit, and GW detector sensitivity curves into a single overlay/likelihood function evaluated on the background-solver outputs.

members.model_name: Generalized no-scale inflation with PBH dark matter
members.description: The numerical benchmark values needed to reproduce the model are unreliable in the registry extraction: OCR dropped minus signs in PBH mass exponents, so the benchmark M_PBH values and the corresponding potential-parameter tables are not available as trustworthy structured data.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-extract the benchmark tables (alpha, potential parameters, k_peak, M_PBH, f_PBH) directly from the published source figures/tables of arXiv:2403.07333 and store them as verified structured parameters on the card.

members.model_name: Late-forming PBH dark matter from a fermion-scalar fluid
members.description: The model's non-monochromatic PBH mass function f(M) has not been digitized or recomputed as a numerical table, so the required extended-mass-function recast against the asteroid/sublunar constraint compilations cannot be executed and viability rests on the narrow-width monochromatic approximation.
members.proposed_resolution: Recompute f(M) numerically from the Press-Schechter step (or digitize the published curve), then apply the standard extended-mass-function method of Carr et al. (1705.05567) with a public PBH constraint compilation such as PBHbounds across the 1e-16 to 1e-10 solar-mass window.

members.model_name: ALP-triggered supercooled-phase-transition primordial black hole dark matter
members.description: The PBH constraint inputs are unverified: the f_PBH=1 mass-window exponents (~1e-16 to 1e-10 M_sun) are flagged as vulnerable to OCR minus-sign loss, and no machine-readable PBH constraint tables are attached for the constraint-mapping step.
members.proposed_resolution: Verify the mass-window exponents against the source PDF and import a machine-readable PBH constraint compilation (e.g. the public PBHbounds tables) plus AxionLimits data for the ALP-coupling complementarity mapping.

members.model_name: Gravitational-genesis two-component dark matter
members.description: BBN/CMB energy-injection and PBH-evaporation constraint tables are not implemented in the pipeline; the route's likelihoods entry states BBN/CMB/PBH constraints are not implemented, so only abundance targets can currently be checked.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize and package published PBH evaporation constraints (BBN light-element yields and CMB energy-injection bounds as functions of M_PBH and evaporation time) into recast tables applied as cuts on the (M_PBH, M_f) scan, using existing PBH constraint compilations.

members.model_name: Cosmological strangelet macro dark matter
members.description: No consolidated, machine-readable database of macro dark matter constraints (ancient mica tracks, terrestrial and lunar seismic limits, femtolensing and microlensing windows) exists with their assumptions (nuclear density, monochromatic mass, DM fraction) encoded, which is prerequisite to any reusable strangelet constraint evaluation.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published macro-DM exclusion envelopes (mica, seismic, lunar, femto/microlensing) into a versioned tabular database recording mass range, excluded DM fraction, density assumptions, and provenance, including the revised/weakened femtolensing analyses.

members.model_name: Liouville-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: The MACHO/microlensing and isocurvature constraint mappings used to define viable scalar-mass windows are only approximate: the exact excluded scalar-mass intervals are figure-level in the paper and were not digitized, so the (m_phi, f_DM) viability filter cannot be applied programmatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published compact-object f_DM(M) exclusion curves (EROS/OGLE/Subaru-HSC, CMB accretion limits) and the Planck isocurvature bound, and recompute the allowed (m_phi, coupling, f_DM) regions through the M_max(m_phi) relation from the solver of gap_1.

members.model_name: Logarithmic-potential self-interacting boson-star dark matter
members.description: The MACHO/microlensing and CMB-isocurvature constraint mappings defining viable scalar-mass windows are only approximate: the excluded scalar-mass intervals are figure-level in the paper and were not digitized, so the (m_phi, f_DM) viability filter cannot be applied programmatically.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published compact-object f_DM(M) exclusion curves (EROS/OGLE/Subaru-HSC, CMB accretion limits) and the Planck isocurvature bound, and recompute allowed (m_phi, coupling, f_DM) regions through the M_max(m_phi) relation from the solver of gap_1.

members.model_name: Dark proton-pion asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: The claimed near-threshold p'-pi' resonant self-interaction (sigma/m around 0.1 cm^2/g at v_R around 100 km/s) rests on an uncalibrated dark-hadron scattering estimate; no nonperturbative calculation of p'pi' and p'p' scattering versus m_pionprime/m_pprime exists to establish whether the resonance is actually realized.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute dark proton-pion scattering with lattice methods or effective-range/chiral EFT matched to lattice inputs across m_pionprime/m_pprime around 0.4, mapping where near-threshold resonances occur, and tabulate sigma(v)/m for dwarf-galaxy and cluster comparisons.

members.model_name: Dark neutron asymmetric mattergenesis model
members.description: The dark-neutron self-interaction cross section is only a lattice-motivated estimate rescaled from QCD with acknowledged large uncertainties, so the cluster bound (sigma/m below about 0.2 cm^2/g) and the preferred m_pionprime/m_nprime above 0.4 region cannot be evaluated reliably.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate n'n' scattering with dedicated lattice calculations (or chiral EFT with lattice-matched low-energy constants) as a function of m_pionprime/m_nprime across the relevant range, and tabulate sigma(v)/m for comparison with dwarf and cluster constraints.

members.model_name: Resonance-enhanced light singlet scalar dark matter
members.description: Existing SIDM structure-formation calibrations assume Yukawa-type velocity dependence, whereas this model's self-scattering is Breit-Wigner resonant in velocity; no simulation or halo-model calibration maps the resonant sigma_self(v) onto core-cusp and rotation-curve-diversity observables (card: simulation_calibrated partial).
members.proposed_resolution: Run SIDM N-body or gravothermal fluid models with the resonant velocity-dependent cross section (or its effective viscosity-weighted average) across dwarf-to-cluster halo masses, calibrating an effective sigma/m mapping usable in isothermal-Jeans fits to rotation-curve diversity data.

members.model_name: Twin SIMPs
members.description: The strong twin-pion self-scattering (m_pi/f_pi about 2) has no quantitative halo-observable pipeline: the card records simulation_calibrated unknown and the paper gives no computed sigma/m or mapping onto SIDM halo-core and substructure predictions, so the small-scale-structure observable cannot be evaluated against dwarf-galaxy data.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive sigma/m for the meson multiplet from the SU(4)_f chiral Lagrangian at next-to-leading order (the strongly coupled m_pi/f_pi ~ 2 regime needs unitarized amplitudes), then map the resulting velocity dependence onto existing SIDM N-body simulation calibrations and cluster/dwarf constraints on sigma/m.

members.model_name: Ultra-light axion soliton-core plus NFW halo model
members.description: The soliton-to-NFW transition is modeled as a step function and the soliton-halo mass relation carries uncalibrated scatter; without calibration against full wave simulations across halo masses and redshifts, inferred core masses and the resulting m_a bound carry unquantified systematic error.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of Schroedinger-Poisson halo simulations spanning dwarf-scale halo masses to calibrate the core-halo mass relation, its scatter, and the transition radius, and replace the step-function matching with the fitted parameterization.

members.model_name: Nearly supersymmetric atomic dark matter
members.description: Self-interaction constraints are applied only as rough recast targets: atom-atom scattering cross sections (including hyperfine-state dependence, recombination-enhanced channels, and molecular aggregation) are not computed for this model, and the quoted Bullet Cluster and halo-shape bounds predate calibrated SIDM simulations.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute velocity-dependent atom-atom transfer cross sections by solving the multi-channel Schrodinger problem for dark hydrogen scattering (as done for atomic dark matter in the non-SUSY case), then compare against modern simulation-calibrated SIDM constraints at dwarf and cluster velocities.

members.model_name: Lepton-portal freeze-in scalar with universal lepton couplings
members.description: The red-giant exclusion rests on a single quoted Bremsstrahlung bound (lambda_e < 7e-16) rather than a mass-dependent stellar emission calculation; Boltzmann suppression when m_phi approaches stellar core temperatures is not modeled, so the exclusion boundary across the keV mass range is not quantitatively established.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute electron/nucleus Bremsstrahlung and related production rates for the universal coupling as functions of m_phi over red-giant, white-dwarf, and solar profiles (e.g. using MESA stellar models), producing a mass-dependent lambda_e limit curve to replace the fixed literature number.

members.model_name: Quartic U(1)-breaking 2hdSMASH axion dark matter
members.description: Machine-readable benchmark tables (heavy CP-even, CP-odd, and charged Higgs masses, couplings, and branching ratios) are absent from the extracted card, leaving the HL-LHC collider-reach step only qualitative and blocking any analysis-specific recast with existing heavy-Higgs constraint tools.
members.proposed_resolution: Extract or regenerate the paper's allowed benchmark points (via the gap_1 spectrum implementation), tabulate masses and branching ratios in SLHA format, and run them through HiggsBounds/HiggsTools plus published HL-LHC heavy-Higgs projection curves to convert the qualitative reach statement into quantitative exclusion/discovery contours.

members.model_name: Dark-photon portal scalar millicharged dark matter
members.description: Digitized invisible dark-photon exclusion contours are missing: the BaBar and NA64 bounds for m_Aprime about 20-200 MeV are recorded only qualitatively (the coupling symbol is even noted as ambiguous in the extraction), so the collider route cannot produce quantitative excluded regions or Belle II/LDMX projections in the near-resonant EDGES-motivated parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published BaBar and NA64 invisible-search exclusion curves, resolve the coupling normalization against the original experimental papers, and encode them as limit tables with the invisible branching fraction (near unity per the route's validation test) and e_D dependence made explicit.

members.model_name: ALP-mediated fermion dark matter with freeze-in and decoupled freeze-out
members.description: There is no machine-readable database of the ALP mediator exclusion curves (E137, SN1987A, NA62/NA48/LHCb-style meson searches, horizontal-branch cooling) recast for this model's flavor-universal couplings and finite invisible branching ratio to dark matter; some primary bounds trace to private-communication curves.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published exclusion curves into a limit database (in the style of existing ALP limit compilations) and rescale each by the model's ALP lifetime and visible/invisible branching fractions computed from g_aff and g_a_chichi, producing an exclusion mask in the m_a-g_aff plane usable by the scan pipeline.

members.model_name: s-channel axial-vector simplified Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The collider exclusion is anchored to 8 TeV Run-I monojet/mono-Z/mono-W searches with minimal-width assumptions; no updated recast against Run-2/Run-3 missing-energy datasets exists for this axial-vector benchmark in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Regenerate mono-X signal samples with the public DMsimp axial-vector model in MadGraph/Pythia/Delphes and recast against current Run-2/Run-3 ATLAS/CMS monojet and mono-boson analyses using CheckMATE or MadAnalysis PAD implementations.

members.model_name: Next minimal Dirac dark matter model
members.description: The card's plain-text extraction obscures the exact Higgs mixing-angle (sine/cosine) convention, and using the wrong convention would invert the LEP-allowed region, so the numerical inputs for the collider and scattering computations are not yet trustworthy.
members.proposed_resolution: Retrieve the typeset equations of arXiv:1203.3116, fix the mixing-angle convention and the H_LZZ coupling normalization, and record them on the card before any numerical implementation.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with B-L vector NSI
members.description: B-L-vector mediator exclusions (electron/proton beam dumps, Texono, BaBar, LHCb, CHARM) are imported from prior work as summary curves; no digitized (m_V, g_V) exclusion masks or original likelihoods are packaged for the scan range 20 MeV to 100 GeV.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the beam-dump and collider exclusion curves (e.g. from Darkcast-style compilations of B-L vector limits) into (m_V, g_V) masks matching the card's required mediator-bound masks resource.

members.model_name: Inelastic U(1) B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: The LEP/Tevatron/LHC B-L Z-prime exclusion region used to filter the relic-viable parameter space exists only as a shaded figure in the primary paper; no machine-readable exclusion contour in the (m_Z_prime, g_B-L) plane is attached to the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published B-L Z-prime dilepton exclusion contours (LEP contact-interaction bound and LHC Run-2 dilepton searches) into a tabulated (m_Z_prime, g_B-L) exclusion curve stored as a registry data product for automated overlay.

members.model_name: Leptophilic non-thermal WIMP model from U(1)' cosmic strings
members.description: The relic abundance from U(1)' cosmic-string loop decay uses analytic string-network scaling approximations; the loop production function and decay branching into chi1/chi2 are not calibrated against string-network simulations for this symmetry-breaking scale.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate the loop-number density and energy-loss channels against published Nambu-Goto/Abelian-Higgs string-network simulation results at mu corresponding to T_c ~ 1e9 GeV, and propagate the calibrated yield through the nonthermal relic-density formula.

members.model_name: Real scalar singlet dark matter with vector-like quark UV completion
members.description: The relic-density calculation for phi phi annihilation into K K and eta eta rests on leading-order chiral perturbation theory near the kaon threshold, where final-state interactions and threshold effects are uncontrolled; no independent hadronic cross-check or uncertainty band exists.
members.proposed_resolution: Redo the annihilation cross section with unitarized ChPT (or dispersive meson-meson rescattering amplitudes) for the scalar-current source, quantify the deviation from the leading-order result across the sub-GeV mass window, and propagate the band through the freeze-out Boltzmann calculation.

members.model_name: Well-tempered singlet-quintuplet fermion WIMP
members.description: Standard relic-density codes do not include the electroweak Sommerfeld enhancement and bound-state effects that significantly shift the freeze-out abundance of an SU(2)_L 5-plet coannihilating sector.
members.proposed_resolution: Add Sommerfeld-corrected (co)annihilation cross sections for the quintuplet multiplet to the micrOMEGAs/MadDM implementation, adapting the published electroweak-multiplet Sommerfeld/bound-state calculations to the mixed singlet-quintuplet spectrum.

members.model_name: Hidden-sector glueball dark matter in a late-modulus low-reheat cosmology
members.description: The glueball relic abundance depends on 3-to-2 cannibal number-changing rates and hidden-sector thermalization efficiency that are only order-of-magnitude estimates; whether number-changing reactions are efficient is the stated validity condition of the hidden_confinement step.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate glueball self-couplings and 3-to-2 rates using existing lattice determinations of pure-glue spectra and interaction matrix elements, and solve the coupled hidden-sector temperature/number-density evolution numerically to replace the freeze-out estimates.

members.model_name: Cosmic-selection-rule SU(N)d glueball dark matter
members.description: The relic-abundance pipeline depends on nonperturbative Q-onium formation and annihilation rates and on the branching of Q-onium decays into SM versus dark gluons, which are only rough estimates; these control the entropy dump and dark reheat temperature that set the cosmic-selection curve.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute Q-onium bound-state formation, annihilation, and decay branching ratios with the established NRQCD-style bound-state-formation formalism for doubly charged (SU(3)c x SU(N)d) heavy quarks, and propagate the resulting rate uncertainties through the selection relation N_d(Lambda_d).

members.model_name: Gauge-mediated Q-ball dark matter
members.description: The Q-ball charge and abundance from Affleck-Dine condensate fragmentation are taken from analytic estimates; the fragmentation charge distribution for the gauge-mediation and new-type potentials used here is not calibrated by lattice simulations in any packaged form, limiting relic-abundance precision.
members.proposed_resolution: Run 3D lattice simulations of flat-direction condensate fragmentation for the gauge-mediated and new-type potentials (Kasuya-Kawasaki style) and fit a charge-distribution parameterization in terms of the initial amplitude and T_RH for use in the abundance formula.

members.model_name: Effective neutrinophilic dark matter with late kinetic decoupling
members.description: The LEP missing-energy and Fermi-LAT dwarf-galaxy limits mapped to protohalo mass (roughly 10^1 to 10^6 M_sun, operator and mass dependent) exist only as figures in the source papers; no machine-readable, operator-by-operator constraint tables are available for the recast step.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the constraint curves from arXiv:1305.1936 and 1305.4676 into per-operator (m_X, Lambda, M_cut) tables, or reimplement the limits directly from public LEP mono-photon results and the Fermi-LAT dwarf likelihood for annihilation to neutrinos.

members.model_name: p-wave Breit-Wigner enhanced dark matter annihilation
members.description: Velocity-dependent (effective) J factors for the Fermi-LAT dwarf-spheroidal sample, weighted by the sharply velocity-peaked Breit-Wigner cross section, are not available as a reusable data product; standard published J factors assume a velocity-independent cross section, so the dSph limit and its comparison to the AMS-favored region cannot be reproduced without recomputing them.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute effective J factors J_p(delta, gamma) for the 15-dwarf Fermi sample by convolving the Breit-Wigner velocity dependence with per-dwarf DM velocity distributions obtained via Eddington inversion of published density profiles, and release them as tables usable with the public Fermi dSph likelihoods.

members.model_name: ISS-NMSSM right-handed sneutrino dark matter
members.description: The muon g-2 constraint targets the BNL-era discrepancy; the Fermilab-final measurement and revised (lattice-informed) SM prediction are not incorporated, so the preferred Y_nu/chargino-sneutrino region is anchored to an obsolete target.
members.proposed_resolution: Update the a_mu likelihood term to the final Fermilab world average with the current Theory Initiative SM prediction (including the lattice HVP shift) and rerun the SPheno a_mu evaluation over the scan to remap the preferred region.

members.model_name: SU(2)_R axiogenesis with QCD axion kinetic-misalignment dark matter
members.description: The W_R collider constraints and HL-LHC prospects used in the m_WR versus f_a relation exist only as figure contours with the paper's spectrum and branching assumptions; no machine-readable limits, efficiencies, or recast pipeline is available for the SU(2)_R gauge-boson searches in this model's fermion variants.
members.proposed_resolution: Recast the published ATLAS/CMS W-prime search limits for the model's right-handed-neutrino and exotic-fermion branching patterns using a public recast framework (MadGraph plus CheckMATE or MadAnalysis), and release the digitized m_WR limit as a function of g_R and c_B.

members.model_name: High-scale SUSY D-term inflation with wino LSP dark matter
members.description: Modern wino-specific constraints — H.E.S.S./CTA galactic-center indirect-detection limits and LHC disappearing-track searches, which are the decisive tests of a 2.7 TeV wino LSP — are not ingested into the card, so the route can only check relic consistency and not current experimental viability.
members.proposed_resolution: Ingest the published H.E.S.S. galactic-center line/continuum limits and ATLAS disappearing-track exclusions as digitized likelihoods versus m_w, and add corresponding indirect-detection and collider observables plus route steps to the card.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino Higgs-portal freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The compiled X-ray/gamma-ray line, lifetime, and overproduction exclusion curves on the (M, sin^2 theta) plane exist in the literature but were not digitized into machine-readable form, so the decay-line constraint cannot be evaluated or rescaled for subdominant abundance fractions.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the XMM-Newton, Suzaku, HEAO-1, INTEGRAL, Swift, Chandra, and gamma-ray exclusion curves compiled in the primary paper into tabulated (M, sin^2 theta) limits with an f_DM rescaling rule, and store them as a recastable constraint surface.

members.model_name: Broad-mass PBH-Lambda dark matter universe
members.description: JWST deep-field selection functions and completeness-corrected high-z source-count data products needed for the jwst_count_test are not available in the pipeline; the card lists them as required code resources and the constraint's robustness is low without them.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt published JWST deep-survey (e.g. JADES/CEERS-class) flux limits, areas, and completeness/selection functions, and build a count-prediction comparison module that convolves the gap_1 luminosity function output with these selection functions.

members.model_name: QCD axion dark matter from Peccei-Quinn-field parametric resonance
members.description: The laboratory and astrophysical comparison data are not assembled: haloscope/dielectric-haloscope reach curves in the meV-band are not digitized, and no stellar/supernova-cooling constraint compilation is attached for the small-f_a range, so con_astrophysical_lower_fa and the haloscope-target observable cannot be evaluated within the registry.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize published dielectric-haloscope (e.g. MADMAX-class) reach curves and stellar/SN1987A cooling exclusion curves in the (m_a, g_a_gamma, g_an) plane and store them as constraint tables keyed to f_a for direct overlay with the model's m_a-f_a relation.

members.model_name: SUSY 4-2-2 GUT neutralino dark matter with lepton-flavor violation
members.description: No machine-readable likelihoods or digitized sensitivity curves (LZ/XENON-nT/DARWIN direct detection, MEG II/Mu2e/COMET LFV projections, Planck band) are packaged with the card, so accepted-point selection and figure-level statements cannot be reproduced per parameter point.
members.proposed_resolution: Assemble the direct-detection limits via DDCalc (which ships LZ/XENON-class likelihoods, with xi-rescaling for subdominant points), digitize the DARWIN and LFV projection curves, and store them as interpolable limit tables alongside the scan pipeline.

members.model_name: Jovian captured GeV dark matter toy model
members.description: The proposed 236 MeV monoenergetic-neutrino test requires a neutrino detector near Jupiter that does not exist, so this observable has no data stream or likelihood on any current timescale.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a near-Jupiter neutrino detector concept study with a simulated detector response, or recast the predicted line flux against existing large-volume terrestrial detectors (Super-K/JUNO class) pointing at Jupiter to obtain an interim sensitivity estimate.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model I Higgs-coupled Majorana WIMP
members.description: The neutron-star heating constraint is a forecast: no measured surface temperature of a sufficiently old (age above about 10^7 yr), nearby, isolated neutron star exists to compare against the few-thousand-K heating floor, and consequently no likelihood can be built for con_ns_temperature_muon_g2_wimp.
members.proposed_resolution: Obtain deep infrared/optical photometry of nearby old isolated neutron stars (e.g. with JWST or next-generation 30 m-class telescopes) to measure or bound surface temperatures at the few-thousand-K level, then wrap the measurement in a temperature likelihood with cooling-baseline and distance uncertainties.

members.model_name: Muon-g-2 Model II leptophilic Majorana WIMP without tree-level Higgs coupling
members.description: The neutron-star heating constraint is forecast-only: no measured surface temperature of a sufficiently old (above about 10^7 yr), nearby, isolated neutron star exists at the few-thousand-K sensitivity level, so no likelihood can be built for con_ns_temperature_muon_g2_wimp.
members.proposed_resolution: Carry out deep infrared photometry of nearby old isolated neutron stars (JWST or 30 m-class telescopes) to measure or bound few-thousand-K surface temperatures, then construct a temperature likelihood folding in age, distance, and cooling-baseline uncertainties.

members.model_name: Multiple Kaluza-Klein dark matter from stringy throats
members.description: The branching fractions F_X into individual throats and the tunneling lifetimes tau_tunn_i are external unpredicted inputs: no calculation exists that maps an explicit Type-IIB compactification (throat geometries, fluxes, inflaton sector) to the reheating branching ratios and tunneling rates, which the card lists as a required 'compactification/reheating model' code resource.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a parameterized throat-tunneling calculator for benchmark geometries (Klebanov-Strassler-like throats): compute graviton/KK wavefunction overlaps and tunneling widths as functions of warp factor and throat length, and emit priors on (F_X, tau_tunn_i) for a small grid of explicit multi-throat compactifications rather than treating them as free parameters.

members.model_name: Ultralight scalar dark matter with refractive neutrino masses
members.description: In the parameter region that reproduces observed neutrino masses, perturbativity of the forward-scattering expansion breaks down at low energies near resonance, and no resummed or nonperturbative calculation of the refractive dispersion relation exists for evaluating that region.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the neutrino dispersion relation on the scalar background beyond lowest order (multiple-scattering resummation or full finite-density propagator in the coherent-field case) and provide validity-corrected refractive-mass formulas for the near- and below-resonance regime.

members.model_name: Composite millicharged absorption-line dark matter
members.description: The dark-color composite spectroscopy — bound-state level splittings and photon-transition matrix elements of the heavy-light state — is not calculated from first principles, leaving the transition frequency nu_0 and line strengths as free phenomenological inputs for every line observable.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the heavy-light dark-hadron spectrum and electromagnetic transition matrix elements using the heavy-quark chiral-Lagrangian analogy calibrated to QCD, or a dedicated lattice calculation of the SU(N) dark-color theory, delivering nu_0 and Einstein coefficients as functions of the dark-quark masses and millicharge epsilon.

members.model_name: R-invariant new-inflation gauge-mediated gravitino dark matter
members.description: The messenger sector of the gauge-mediated branch is only implicit in the card, so no concrete GMSB input set (messenger scale, N_mess, Lambda) exists to feed a spectrum generator and fix the NLSP identity, mass, and lifetime.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a minimal messenger sector consistent with the R-invariant SUSY-breaking field (charge assignment and VEV from the primary paper), then generate benchmark spectra with a public GMSB spectrum generator such as SOFTSUSY or SPheno for m_3/2 near 10 GeV.

members.model_name: Neutrinophilic B-L charged scalar dark matter
members.description: The flavor structure of the mediator's coupling to (LH)(LH) and the hierarchy between the neutrino portal and the Higgs portal are under-specified on the card, so the annihilation and scattering rates entering both routes are not fully defined benchmarks.
members.proposed_resolution: Define benchmark flavor textures for the phi-neutrino coupling (e.g. flavor-universal and tau-dominated cases consistent with oscillation data) and a stated portal hierarchy, documenting them as registry benchmark points so downstream tools compute unambiguous rates.

members.model_name: Xogenesis with a new gauge-group sphaleron
members.description: The rate and decoupling temperature of the exotic sphaleron of the new gauge group, which sets T_D and hence the predicted m_X, is not computed beyond electroweak-sphaleron analogy; no calculation of the new-gauge sphaleron rate as a function of gauge coupling and breaking scale exists in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the exotic sphaleron energy and transition rate for the chosen gauge group and breaking pattern (adapting standard electroweak sphaleron rate calculations/lattice results to the new gauge coupling and scalar sector), yielding T_D(M_W', g_R) for use in the chemical-equilibrium step.

members.model_name: Z3 symmetric complex singlet scalar extension of type-II seesaw
members.description: The bubble-wall velocity and friction for this Z3 singlet plus type-II seesaw scalar sector are not computed (route caveat), yet the sound-wave GW amplitude and peak frequency, and hence detectability of obs_foewpt_stochastic_gw, depend strongly on the assumed wall velocity.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the wall velocity for representative FOEWPT benchmarks using a public friction framework (e.g. WallGo or the local-thermal-equilibrium approximation coupled to the CosmoTransitions potential) and propagate it, with alpha and beta/H, through the standard sound-wave template and LISA-band sensitivity curves (PTPlot).

members.model_name: Extended double-seesaw WIMP-FIMP dark matter model
members.description: The FOPT gravitational-wave prediction neglects Coleman-Weinberg one-loop terms in the thermal potential, so the strong-transition benchmarks and Omega_GW(f) spectra carry an uncontrolled theory systematic.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun the dark-Higgs phase-transition analysis in CosmoTransitions with the full one-loop Coleman-Weinberg plus daisy-resummed finite-temperature potential and recompute (v_c/T_c, alpha_PT, beta/H) and the GW spectra against BBO/DECIGO sensitivity curves.

members.model_name: Real singlet scalar Higgs-portal dark matter with strong electroweak phase transition
members.description: The EWPT observable is evaluated only through the gauge-dependent v_c/T_c > 1 critical-temperature proxy; no bubble-nucleation calculation (T_n, alpha, beta/H) exists for this model card, which blocks any quantitative baryogenesis-viability or gravitational-wave-spectrum statement.
members.proposed_resolution: Run CosmoTransitions (or BSMPT) on the source's finite-temperature singlet/Higgs potential to compute nucleation temperature and transition strength parameters, replacing the v_c/T_c proxy and enabling a LISA-style gravitational-wave signal estimate over the surviving parameter space.

members.model_name: Classically scale-invariant SU(2)_X vector dark matter
members.description: The GW source modeling (efficiency factors, source lifetime, sound-wave versus collision dominance) is not calibrated for the strongly supercooled regime of this classically scale-invariant transition, so the LISA/AEDGE SNR forecast carries an uncontrolled systematic that the card itself flags as a key uncertainty.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply and, where needed, extend hydrodynamic-simulation-calibrated GW efficiency and lifetime prescriptions for supercooled transitions (bubble-wall runaway versus long-lasting sound waves) to the (alpha, beta/H, T_p) region this model predicts, and propagate the calibration spread as a band on the forecast SNR.

members.model_name: Atomic dissipative dark matter with dark black holes
members.description: The dark black-hole binary formation rate and mass-pairing model is an uncalibrated Population-III-like scaling; there is no dark-sector binary population-synthesis capability, so predicted LIGO/Virgo event counts inherit an unquantified rate normalization.
members.proposed_resolution: Adapt a binary population-synthesis framework to DBH progenitors, using the calibrated cooling/Jeans-mass outputs to set initial mass functions and binding fractions, and propagate rate uncertainties as nuisance parameters in the population model.

members.model_name: Gravitino LSP with right-handed sneutrino NLSP
members.description: The BBN constraint on visible energy injection from Bino-like NNLSP decay relies on historical bound curves cited by the 2007 paper rather than a current, machine-readable late-decay energy-injection constraint, so con_bbn_nnlsp_decay is only an approximate recast.
members.proposed_resolution: Feed the analytic Bino hadronic/electromagnetic injection yields (step s1) into a public late-decay BBN code such as ACROPOLIS, or substitute updated Kawasaki-Kohri-Moroi-style bound tables, to obtain current allowed/excluded regions in (tau_B, B_had Y_X E_vis).

members.model_name: First-order phase-transition rescued self-interacting fermion dark matter
members.description: The direct-detection (CRESST-III, XENON1T-Migdal) and mediator (LSND/CHARM beam-dump, SN1987A, BBN-lifetime) exclusion curves used in the paper are not available as digitized data products alongside the card, blocking quantitative recasting of both recast steps.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published CRESST-III, XENON1T-Migdal, LSND/CHARM, and SN1987A exclusion curves (or import them from existing repositories such as the dark-photon/scalar-portal limit compilations) and store them as machine-readable constraint files keyed to (m_chi, m_phi, mixing angle).

members.model_name: Mini-Split supersymmetry with neutralino LSP dark matter
members.description: The bino-overproduction constraint is only qualitative in the card because the OCR of the source text drops the inequality directions for F and f_a, so the pre-BBN decay condition cannot be applied numerically.
members.proposed_resolution: Re-extract the F and f_a inequalities from the source PDF of arXiv:1210.0555 and encode the pre-BBN bino decay condition as an explicit analytic bound in the card.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with scalar-mediated neutrino NSI
members.description: Scalar-mediator exclusions (kaon decay, neutrino lifetime, BBN) are imported from earlier analyses as summary curves; no digitized (m_phi, lambda_phi) exclusion masks or standalone likelihoods are packaged for the 5 MeV to 10 GeV scan range.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the kaon-decay, neutrino-lifetime, and BBN exclusion curves for the scalar NSI mediator into (m_phi, lambda_phi) masks matching the card's required mediator-bound masks resource.

members.model_name: Sterile neutrino dark matter with neutrinophilic vector NSI
members.description: Neutrinophilic-vector mediator exclusions (Higgs invisible decay, kaon decay, Z decay, SN1987A, BBN) are imported from prior analyses as summary curves; no digitized (m_V, g_V) exclusion masks or recast likelihoods are packaged for the 5 MeV to 100 GeV scan range.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the laboratory, supernova, and BBN exclusion curves for the neutrinophilic vector into (m_V, g_V) masks matching the card's required mediator-bound masks resource.

members.model_name: Unified superfluid dark sector
members.description: No public halo phase-structure solver computes the superfluid core radius and normal-phase envelope as a function of halo mass and dark-sector thermodynamics for this two-state model, and no rotation-curve pipeline links the phonon-mediated force to galaxy data.
members.proposed_resolution: Build a semi-analytic halo phase solver (hydrostatic superfluid core matched to an NFW-like normal-phase envelope, following the superfluid-DM literature prescriptions cited by the paper) with the two-state populations included, and couple it to a standard rotation-curve fitter over SPARC-like galaxy samples.

members.model_name: Dissipative dark matter from multiple Standard Model sectors
members.description: No public solver exists for dissipative dark-plasma halo steady states implementing the paper's local heating-equals-cooling and hydrostatic-balance equations with dark bremsstrahlung/atomic cooling functions and kinetic-mixing supernova heating.
members.proposed_resolution: Develop a semi-analytic steady-state halo code that takes a baryonic mass model and star-formation history, computes the kinetic-mixing supernova heating rate H and dark-plasma cooling rate C as functions of N_sec, epsilon, and dark metallicity, and solves the coupled hydrostatic profile, validated against the paper's N_sec=5, epsilon~1.2e-10 examples.

members.model_name: Mirror dark plasma steady-state halo model
members.description: No public solver exists for the coupled steady-state problem H(r)=C(r) plus hydrostatic balance that returns the dark-plasma profiles rho(r), T(r) and the halo rotation-curve contribution v_halo(r) for a given baryonic mass model and supernova distribution; the source computed only representative solutions with unreleased code.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the source Euler-equation steady-state system (local H=C closure, hydrostatic support, mirror-plasma cooling function, SN heating kernel) as an open ODE/boundary-value solver taking (epsilon, baryonic profile, SFR/SN distribution) as inputs, validated against the paper's representative solutions and the r_D scaling test.

members.model_name: Charged Q-ball dark matter from B and L direction
members.description: No code exists to evolve the charge state of gauge-mediation Q-balls and anti-Q-balls through the thermal plasma, recombination, and structure formation, tracking electromagnetic capture of electrons and helium/hydrogen nuclei into atom-like and ion-like bound states; the route's s2 step is currently a rough by-hand estimate.
members.proposed_resolution: Write a dedicated capture/recombination rate code (analogous to CHAMP charge-evolution calculations) that integrates Coulomb capture cross sections for the Q-ball external potential over the cosmic thermal history, outputting the present charge-state distribution Z_Q as a function of M_F, Q, and T_RH.

members.model_name: Long-range scalar-interacting dark matter with screening species
members.description: No public N-body implementation of the screened attractive dark-sector scalar force (strength beta~O(1), comoving screening length r_s~1 Mpc, dark-sector-only coupling); the original exploratory simulations were never released as a reusable code.
members.proposed_resolution: Add a screened Yukawa dark-matter-only force term to an existing modified-gravity N-body code (e.g. the fifth-force machinery in MG-GADGET or ECOSMOG, or a GADGET-4 tree-force modification), parameterized by (beta, r_s), and validate against the CDM limit beta->0 and the paper's qualitative void/halo trends.

members.model_name: Non-resonantly produced sterile-neutrino mixed dark matter
members.description: No public subhalo/velocity-function emulator is calibrated for mixed cold plus NRP-sterile-neutrino dark matter as a function of (M_s, r_warm); existing WDM-calibrated emulators do not cover the mixed transfer-function shape, and the paper's simulations only sample r_warm = 0.25 and 0.50.
members.proposed_resolution: Run an N-body suite (GADGET-class plus SUBFIND) over a grid in M_s and r_warm using mixed transfer functions from the CLASS/CAMB sterile-neutrino module, and calibrate a subhalo V_max-function emulator (extending WDM emulators such as Galacticus- or SASHIMI-style semi-analytic models) on that suite.

members.model_name: Minimal decaying dark matter model for the S8 tension
members.description: No nonlinear matter-power emulator validated in the quasi-degenerate two-body DCDM regime (epsilon ~ 10^-3-10^-2, tau ~ 10-100 Gyr) including baryonic feedback, which weak-lensing S8 likelihoods need beyond the linear CLASS/CAMB output; existing DCDM emulators cover the regime only partially (card: simulation_calibrated 'partial', nonlinear and baryonic effects unhandled).
members.proposed_resolution: Extend an existing two-body DCDM nonlinear-suppression emulator (calibrated on dedicated N-body runs) into the small-epsilon quasi-degenerate corner and couple it to a baryonification model, then interface it with the KiDS/DES shear likelihoods used for S8.

members.model_name: Lightest sterile neutrino dark matter in the nuMSM from active-sterile transitions
members.description: Nonlinear Ly-alpha flux-power emulators are calibrated on thermal-WDM (or CDM) hydrodynamic simulations, so the distorted nonthermal DW distribution the paper says should be used directly in structure-formation simulations has no calibrated nonlinear forward model; the card's nonlinear block is uncalibrated (simulation_calibrated: no).
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small suite of hydrodynamic Ly-alpha simulations initialized with transfer functions from the exact DW f_s(q) across the (M1, mixing) plane and retrain an existing WDM flux-power emulator on them, or validate the area-criterion thermal-WDM mapping against those runs.

members.model_name: Two-body decaying dark matter with one massless and one massive daughter
members.description: The weak-lensing/S8 constraint at k ~ 0.1-1 h/Mpc needs a nonlinear matter-power prescription for two-body decaying dark matter; the card records simulation_calibrated: no, so the route currently stops at linear power.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt and validate an existing N-body-calibrated nonlinear suppression emulator for two-body DDM (the DMemu-style boost-factor approach) coupled to the modified CLASS output, and wire it into a weak-lensing likelihood in Cobaya/MontePython.

members.model_name: Higgs-portal pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone hot-and-cold dark matter
members.description: The small-scale isocurvature/ultracompact-minihalo constraint on late-annihilating walls is applied only as the qualitative H_decay > 22 eV threshold; no derivation exists of the isocurvature power spectrum sourced by the wall network for this model, so the exclusion boundary cannot be computed quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the pNG isocurvature power spectrum from wall-network annihilation (analytically or from the lattice outputs of the network simulation) and confront it with published ultracompact-minihalo and CMB small-scale constraints to replace the single H_decay threshold.

members.model_name: Spin-2 dark matter from inflation
members.description: The CMB isocurvature bound is applied through an order-of-magnitude estimate whose mapping from spin-2 spectator perturbations to observed isocurvature the paper explicitly leaves beyond scope for order-one sound speeds and EFT coefficients, so viability in that regime cannot be judged.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the spin-2-induced dark-matter isocurvature power spectrum from the mode functions (including scalar-helicity mixing with curvature perturbations at order-one couplings), and confront it with the Planck 2018 CDM-isocurvature likelihood to delimit the allowed (m, c_I, EFT-coefficient) space.

members.model_name: Bosonic superheavy X-particle from vacuum fluctuations
members.description: The isocurvature perturbation spectrum of the gravitationally produced X component has not been derived for this model, so the s4 likelihood step has no model-side input to compare against CMB isocurvature bounds despite a partial data-side likelihood existing.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the X-density isocurvature power spectrum from the mode functions of the production calculation as a function of (m_X/H_I, xi), following the treatment in the related isocurvature-constraint literature, and map it onto the Planck CDI amplitude parameter for use with the existing Planck isocurvature likelihood.

members.model_name: Inflation-produced superheavy X-particle dark matter
members.description: The X-density isocurvature amplitude from inflationary gravitational production has not been derived as a function of (m_X, H_I, xi) in a form that plugs into the public Planck isocurvature likelihood, so the CMB constraint cannot be evaluated.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the CDM-isocurvature power spectrum of gravitationally produced X particles (following the 2005.00391-style formalism) parameterized by m_X/H_I and xi, and run it through the Planck 2018 CDI isocurvature likelihood via Cobaya/MontePython.

members.model_name: QCD axion-ALP mass mixing with explicit PQ symmetry breaking
members.description: The claimed isocurvature suppression through the adiabatic transition has no quantitative pipeline: the isocurvature perturbation transfer through level crossing has not been derived and no comparison against Planck CMB isocurvature bounds has been performed for this scenario.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the linear perturbation equations for the two mixed eigenstates through level crossing, compute the resulting CDM isocurvature amplitude as a function of (f_a, r_m, R_m, H_inf), and recast against the Planck 2018 isocurvature bound.

members.model_name: Right-sneutrino FIMP dark matter with long-lived stau NLSP
members.description: The BBN constraint on the stau NLSP is applied only as the crude tau_stau < 100 s criterion; light-element yields for this model's specific hadronic branching fractions are never computed, so the boundary of the allowed lifetime window is uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Compute the stau hadronic/electromagnetic decay spectra for the benchmark points and run them through a public late-decay BBN code (e.g. ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN with injection modules) to replace the flat 100 s cut with an actual light-element likelihood.

members.model_name: Minimal GMSB gravitino superWIMP dark matter
members.description: The BBN safety of the late-decaying TeV neutralino is enforced only through the tau_NLSP < 1 s lifetime criterion; the electromagnetic (and any subdominant hadronic) energy injection from the photon+gravitino decay is not propagated through an actual BBN network, so the constraint boundary near tau ~ 0.1-1 s is uncalibrated.
members.proposed_resolution: Run the benchmark (m_NLSP, m_G, tau, abundance) grid through a public late-decay BBN injection code such as ACROPOLIS to replace the 1-second criterion with element-abundance-based exclusion contours.

members.model_name: Extremal Kerr black hole dark matter from Hawking evaporation
members.description: The pre-BBN consistency of the scenario (radiation injected by evaporating spinning PBHs with M_i < 1e13 M_Pl and lifetimes under 1 s) has never been checked with an evaporation-spectrum or BBN code; the constraint is only an analytic timing argument, and the route lists a spin-aware evaporation code plus radiation-history solver as required but unimplemented resources.
members.proposed_resolution: Couple the BH_Extremal stochastic mass/spin evolution to BlackHawk-style Kerr evaporation spectra and feed the injected radiation history into a BBN injection code (e.g. ACROPOLIS-type) to compute the allowed (M_i, formation time, initial abundance) region quantitatively.

members.model_name: Light dark scalar force dark matter
members.description: The hadronic decay widths and branching fractions of a Higgs-mixed light scalar below a few GeV (pion, kaon, gluon channels through the nonperturbative region) are not implemented in any tool cited by the card, degrading both the predicted Galactic Center cascade spectrum and the theta_hs-dependent mediator lifetime used for the BBN bound.
members.proposed_resolution: Adopt dispersive-analysis light-scalar width calculations (Winkler-type spectral functions for the pi pi and K K channels) as a tabulated width-and-branching module, feed it into a cascade-spectrum generator for chi chi -> phi phi decays, and use the same widths to compute tau_phi(theta_hs, m_phi) for the BBN lifetime target.

members.model_name: Hadrophilic scalar-mediator sequential freeze-in dark matter
members.description: The BBN lifetime bound on the MeV-scale mediator is only an illustrative benchmark: the hadrophilic scalar's decay channels (phi -> gamma gamma via hadron loops, optional phi -> nu nu) are not implemented in a BBN code, so the exclusion in (m_phi, y_q, y_nu) is not systematically computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the mediator's abundance, lifetime, and branching ratios in an existing photodisintegration/BBN code such as ACROPOLIS or AlterBBN, scanning (m_phi, y_q, y_nu) to replace the single MeV benchmark statement with a proper exclusion region.

members.model_name: Long-lived mixed scalar-pseudoscalar mediator model with Dirac dark matter
members.description: Exact LUX/XENON1T/LZ direct-detection limit tables and the CHARM/flavor beam-dump exclusion contours used to bound (g_q, m_Y) were not ingested, so the direct-detection comparison and light-mediator laboratory constraints cannot currently be evaluated from the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Import the published LUX 90% CL limit and XENON1T/LZ projection tables (e.g. via DDCalc) mapped to the g_q g_X cos^2 alpha effective SI cross section, and digitize the CHARM beam-dump and flavor-changing meson-decay exclusion regions for m_Y in the 10-100 MeV range.

members.model_name: Sub-MeV scalar-mediator dark matter
members.description: The stellar-cooling, fifth-force, supernova, and laboratory bounds on (m_phi, g_e, g_N) and the cosmological exclusion contours are not digitized in a consistent coupling normalization, so the constraint overlay on the direct-detection reach cannot be reproduced quantitatively.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published stellar/SN/fifth-force/laboratory limit curves on g_e and g_N versus m_phi into machine-readable tables with a documented normalization convention, and store them as constraint assets alongside the recoil-rate calculation.

members.model_name: s-channel vector simplified Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The collider exclusion and the direct-detection comparison are anchored to 8 TeV Run-I searches and LUX-era limits with minimal-width assumptions; no recast against Run-2/Run-3 mono-X data or current xenon-tonne-scale limits exists for this vector benchmark in the card.
members.proposed_resolution: Regenerate mono-X signal samples with the public DMsimp vector-mediator model in MadGraph/Pythia/Delphes, recast against current ATLAS/CMS monojet and mono-boson analyses via CheckMATE or MadAnalysis PAD, and replace the LUX comparison with LZ/XENONnT spin-independent limits.

members.model_name: Late-decay two-component millicharged dark matter model
members.description: The millicharged-particle constraint database required by the route does not exist in the pipeline: XQC, underground direct-detection, SN1987A, SLAC, CMS, MiniBooNE, LSND, ArgoNeuT, and milliQan exclusion curves compiled by the paper were not digitized, and the lifetime-dependent abundance rescaling (f_chi(z) from tau_Z1) needed to apply them is not implemented.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published millicharged-particle exclusion curves in the (m_chi, epsilon) plane into a constraint table (or adapt an existing millicharged-limit compilation) and add an abundance-rescaling layer that maps each bound to the time-dependent fraction f_chi(z) implied by tau_Z1.

members.model_name: t-channel scalar-mediator Dirac fermion dark matter
members.description: The combined collider/direct-detection exclusion for thermal Dirac t-channel dark matter is inherited from Run-I-era related studies (arXiv:1308.0592/1308.0612) rather than recomputed; no recast against Run-2/Run-3 jets+MET data or tonne-scale direct-detection limits exists for this card's specific flavor representation.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the colored-scalar-doublet t-channel model in FeynRules/MadGraph (or adopt the public DMsimp-t implementation), generate monojet and mediator pair-production samples, recast against current squark-search and monojet analyses, and redo the combined exclusion with LZ/XENONnT limits under explicit flavor-representation choices.

members.model_name: Asymmetric Bose gas Higgs-portal dark matter
members.description: No machine-readable XENON/CDMSLite spin-independent limit curves or likelihood are attached to the card, so the limit_overlay step can only be done by re-digitizing published exclusion plots rather than against a reusable data product.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the XENON and CDMSLite limit curves used by the paper (or substitute the equivalent published spin-independent limits via a public direct-detection limit package such as DDCalc) and store them as a versioned data product referenced by the route.

members.model_name: Light decoupled techni-dilaton dark matter
members.description: No digitized likelihood or exclusion tables exist in the card for the diffuse X-ray bound on the eV-scale TD two-photon decay (only quoted upper masses of about 140-460 eV) or for sub-millimeter inverse-square-law/fifth-force searches, so the decay_and_detection step cannot be closed at experiment level.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize diffuse/background X-ray decaying-dark-matter bounds in the 0.01-500 eV mass window into a tau_TD(M_TD) likelihood table, and import published torsion-balance and microsphere Yukawa exclusion curves as an (alpha, lambda) likelihood, wiring both into the route as the missing external likelihoods.

members.model_name: Radion misalignment dark matter in a five-dimensional weak-scale framework
members.description: No reusable likelihoods or digitized exclusion curves exist for the constraints this route compares against: atomic-clock/Dy-spectroscopy oscillatory-constant limits, fifth-force/equivalence-principle bounds, and black-hole superradiance regions are available only as figure-level overlays, and every constraint entry records likelihood_available no/unknown with recasting_needed yes.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the published clock/spectroscopy, fifth-force/EP, and superradiance exclusion curves in the (m_r, coupling) plane and package them as likelihood or limit tables that include the sqrt(rho_r/rho_0) subcomponent rescaling the card specifies, so the route can be run for arbitrary radion density fractions.

members.model_name: Scalar freeze-in inelastic dark matter with dark photon portal
members.description: The SN1987A cooling constraint enters only as a quoted analytic bound on epsilon; no supernova transport calculation or likelihood covers this model's dark photon plus light dark-sector states (which open trapping/re-absorption channels), and the bound is unreliable outside the MeV mediator window.
members.proposed_resolution: Rerun a supernova energy-loss calculation (following the Chang-Essig-McDermott style dark-photon luminosity treatment) including production and trapping of the dark photon with its decay to the split scalar pair, and publish the resulting exclusion as an (epsilon, m_V, e_D) mask usable as a route overlay.

members.model_name: B_3-L_2 Dirac right-handed-neutrino thermal dark matter
members.description: No reusable Borexino Phase-II solar-neutrino electron-recoil likelihood exists for a light Z' with kinetic mixing, so the epsilon bound at the g_X = 1.8e-4, m_Z' = 1 MeV benchmark cannot be recomputed or extended across the parameter space.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the Borexino Phase-II recoil spectrum fit as an open likelihood module: published Borexino event rates and efficiencies combined with standard solar fluxes and oscillation probabilities, taking (epsilon, g_X, m_Z') as inputs to the SM-plus-Z' neutrino-electron cross section.

members.model_name: Sub-eV scalar dark matter through the super-renormalizable Higgs portal
members.description: No machine-readable fifth-force or equivalence-principle likelihood exists for the super-renormalizable Higgs-portal parameterization (A, m_phi); the paper's exclusions are plotted bounds, so quantitative recasts require digitized experimental curves that are not supplied.
members.proposed_resolution: Digitize the torsion-balance inverse-square-law (Eot-Wash style) and equivalence-principle (including MICROSCOPE) exclusion curves as (Yukawa strength alpha, range lambda) likelihood tables, then map (A, m_phi) onto (alpha, lambda) with published Higgs-nucleon couplings and composition factors so the excluded portal region is reproduced as a reusable likelihood.

members.model_name: Vector-portal hidden-sector dark matter with an early matter-dominated era
members.description: Microhalo survival and gravitational heating at reheating dominate the boost-factor uncertainty: the boost is highly sensitive to the free-streaming cutoff and to how many prompt microhalos survive, and no simulation suite spans the (T_dom/T_RH, lambda_fs, m_X/m_Zprime) space needed to calibrate this beyond the paper's bracketing procedures.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a suite of high-resolution N-body simulations of microhalo formation and post-reheating disruption across a grid of EMDE durations and cutoff scales, and fit an emulator for the annihilation boost factor B_0 and its uncertainty band.

members.model_name: General interacting dark sector with dark matter and dark radiation
members.description: Nonlinear structure formation for IDS is uncalibrated (simulation_calibrated: no; halo and subhalo effects unknown), so weak-lensing and cluster-count constraints on the S8-suppression regime rely on nonlinear prescriptions never validated for DAO-like IDS spectra.
members.proposed_resolution: Run N-body simulations seeded with IDS initial power spectra across the (Gamma_0, f, Delta_N_fluid) posterior region and fit a nonlinear boost or emulator (halofit-style correction) for use in weak-lensing and cluster likelihoods.

members.model_name: Axion-like particle dark matter from N>1 string-wall annihilation
members.description: No public simulation or calibrated emulator exists for biased N>1 ALP string-wall networks that outputs the network scaling parameters, annihilation time, GW spectrum normalization, and the emitted ALP momentum spectrum needed for the abundance and dark-radiation split.
members.proposed_resolution: Run lattice field-theory simulations of Z_N string-wall networks with a vacuum bias term (extending Hiramatsu-Kawasaki-Saikawa-type domain-wall simulation codes), calibrate the area parameter, annihilation time versus epsilon_b, and the ALP and GW emission spectra, and release the results as fitting functions or an emulator over (V, v, N, epsilon_b, m_a).

members.model_name: Two-neutrino hot dark matter with a four-neutrino mass pattern
members.description: Cluster-abundance and void statistics for the Omega_m=1, Omega_nu=0.2 two-neutrino CHDM configuration are not simulation-calibrated; existing nuCDM emulators and halo-mass-function fits are calibrated on low-Omega_nu LCDM cosmologies and do not cover this regime.
members.proposed_resolution: Run a small suite of neutrino-inclusive N-body simulations (e.g. Gadget-4 with linear-response or particle neutrinos) at the CHDM parameter point to calibrate the halo mass function and void statistics near 10 h^-1 Mpc, validating the claimed cluster-overproduction reduction of two versus one hot species.

members.model_name: Supersymmetric Q-ball dark matter from condensate fragmentation
