members.model_name: Scalar-vector inelastic coannihilation dark matter model
members.description: No public UFO/FeynRules implementation of the scalar-vector inelastic model (s1, s2, dark photon A prime with kinetic mixing and the dark-current coupling) is identified, so event generation for A prime-mediated s1 s2 production and lifetime cross-checks cannot be rerun.
members.proposed_resolution: Implement the U(1)_D Lagrangian with Stueckelberg/kinetic mixing and the s1-s2 dark current in FeynRules, export UFO files, validate against the paper's m_Aprime = 3 m2 benchmark decay lengths, and publish the model files.

members.model_name: Scalar-vector inelastic coannihilation dark matter model
members.description: The dark-photon dilepton-resonance and electroweak-precision constraints have not been recast for this model, whose A prime branching fractions differ from the minimal dark photon because of the invisible/inelastic s1 s2 channel.
members.proposed_resolution: Apply a Darkcast-style rescaling of published dilepton-resonance and EWPT limits in the (m_Aprime, epsilon) plane using the model-specific A prime branching fractions including the s1 s2 mode, and store the result as a constraint table for the scan.

members.model_name: Left-right symmetric model with keV right-handed-neutrino warm dark matter
members.description: The N1 phase-space distribution after gauge production plus entropy dilution is not available (distribution_function_available is unknown), so no model-specific transfer function or free-streaming length can be computed for structure-formation comparisons.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive f(q) from the momentum-dependent production-plus-dilution calculation and pass it to CLASS/CAMB as a non-cold relic to obtain the linear transfer function, then map to an equivalent thermal-WDM mass for existing Ly-alpha and satellite-count bounds.

members.model_name: Fermion millicharged dark matter with supernova-remnant plasma dynamics
members.description: No nonlinear kinetic simulation exists of millicharged DM interacting with supernova-remnant shocks and subsequent Galactic magnetic-field transport; the linear instability analysis cannot predict the accelerated mDM spectrum, the degree of disk evacuation, or the local density and velocity distribution that direct-detection interpretations require.
members.proposed_resolution: Run particle-in-cell (or hybrid-kinetic) collisionless-shock simulations with an additional charged species scanned over |q_chi|/m_chi to obtain sweep-up efficiency and post-shock spectra, then propagate the swept population through a Galactic magnetic-field transport model (GALPROP/DRAGON-style diffusion adapted to the mDM rigidity) to predict the local flux and disk density suppression.

members.model_name: FNPQ DFSZ type-II flavored axion dark matter
members.description: The N>1 DFSZ domain-wall problem has no specified resolution in the card (inflationary dilution versus explicit/dynamical wall destabilization is left open), so the cosmological-viability output of the recast step cannot be evaluated quantitatively for the misalignment abundance window.
members.proposed_resolution: Specify a concrete wall-destabilization mechanism for this model (e.g. a PQ-breaking bias term or pre-PQ-breaking inflation), derive the resulting wall-decay temperature and gravitational-wave/entropy budget, and add the corresponding viability cut to the recast step using existing domain-wall network simulation scalings.

members.model_name: Multicomponent OHe and UU dark atoms
members.description: The OHe-nucleus interaction is not solved: no validated calculation of OHe slowing in matter, the shallow bound state with sodium, or the temperature-dependent radiative-capture rate exists (the paper flags this nuclear physics as under development), so the DAMA modulation and null-result evasion claims cannot be computed.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the OHe-nucleus potential and bound-state spectrum by solving the coupled Coulomb-plus-nuclear few-body problem (e.g. with standard nuclear few-body machinery) for sodium and cryogenic-detector targets, then publish temperature-dependent capture-rate tables usable in a detector-response model.

members.model_name: Coupled scalar-field dark matter and early-dark-energy model
members.description: The DES-Y3 S8 comparison relies on linear-to-nonlinear growth modeling that is uncalibrated for coupled SFDM-EDE (the card records halo/subhalo mass-function effects as unknown and simulation_calibrated no), so weak-lensing-scale predictions carry an unquantified nonlinear modeling error.
members.proposed_resolution: Calibrate a nonlinear matter-power prescription for this model, either by running N-body simulations with the modified linear input spectra and scale-dependent growth to refit a halofit/HMcode-style correction, or by validating that standard emulators remain accurate for the small coupled-sector departures within the posterior.

members.model_name: Ultralight L_mu-L_tau vector dark matter
members.description: No cosmological production calculation exists for this ultralight (m ~ 1e-23 eV) L_mu-L_tau vector: the card records production as unspecified and relic density as purely phenomenological (normalized to local rho_dm), so whether the field can actually constitute the dark matter with the required coherent amplitude is not evaluable.
members.proposed_resolution: Derive the relic abundance from a concrete production mechanism for ultralight vectors (misalignment with the required non-minimal coupling, inflationary fluctuation production, or tachyonic production from an axion-like coupling) and check consistency of the resulting rho_dm and coherence properties with the PTA-fit m and g.
